local Brownian integration, original continuous equations and paths, raw

PBGSO/AdaptedBrownianModification.lean.scope_note: Assume a probability source, actual pre-Brownian laws and original adaptation where requested. The construction proves the continuous modification; original raw paths are not claimed continuous.
PBGSO/AdaptedBrownianModification.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.AdaptedBrownianWindow
import PBGSO.ContinuousVersionGlue

/-! # Constructed globally continuous adapted Brownian modifications
The process is an explicit countable-horizon past-sample series. Genuine
Gaussian fourth moments and dyadic polygons derive its continuous paths;
countably many grid identities derive overlap. Its actual adaptation remains
with respect to the original filtration, without filtration completion.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.AdaptedBrownianModification
open ContinuousVersionGlue AdaptedBrownianWindow
variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]



variable (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B Q)
include hB



/-- Actual finite-dimensional Brownian laws and actual sample-path continuity
hold for the constructed global process. -/

/-- A genuine Brownian modification adapted to the original filtration is
constructed from a merely pre-Brownian adapted process. -/
end PBGSO.AdaptedBrownianModification

process.exact_header: def process (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ
process.exact_declaration:
def process (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ :=
  globalVersion (fun n => candidate B (horizon n))

process_stronglyAdapted.exact_header:
theorem process_stronglyAdapted (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : StronglyAdapted F B) :
    StronglyAdapted F (process B)
process_stronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem process_stronglyAdapted (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : StronglyAdapted F B) :
    StronglyAdapted F (process B) := by
  apply globalVersion_stronglyAdapted
  intro n
  exact candidate_stronglyAdapted F B hA (horizon n) (by unfold horizon; positivity)

process_ae.exact_header: theorem process_ae (t : ℝ≥0) : process B t =ᵐ[Q] B t
process_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem process_ae (t : ℝ≥0) : process B t =ᵐ[Q] B t := by
  apply globalVersion_ae Q B (fun n => candidate B (horizon n))
  intro n s hs
  exact candidate_ae Q B hB (horizon n) (by unfold horizon; positivity) s hs

process_continuous.exact_header: theorem process_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => process B t ω)
process_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem process_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => process B t ω) := by
  apply globalVersion_continuous Q B (fun n => candidate B (horizon n))
  · intro n t ht
    exact candidate_ae Q B hB (horizon n) (by unfold horizon; positivity) t ht
  · intro n
    exact candidate_continuous_paths Q B hB (horizon n) (by unfold horizon; positivity)

isBrownianReal.exact_declaration:
theorem isBrownianReal : IsBrownianReal (process B) Q where
  toIsPreBrownianReal := hB.congr (fun t => (process_ae Q B hB t).symm)
  cont := process_continuous Q B hB

exists_adapted_brownian_modification.exact_header:
theorem exists_adapted_brownian_modification (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (hA : StronglyAdapted F B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ,
      IsBrownianReal C Q ∧ StronglyAdapted F C ∧ ∀ t, C t =ᵐ[Q] B t
exists_adapted_brownian_modification.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_adapted_brownian_modification (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (hA : StronglyAdapted F B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ,
      IsBrownianReal C Q ∧ StronglyAdapted F C ∧ ∀ t, C t =ᵐ[Q] B t :=
  ⟨process B, isBrownianReal Q B hB, process_stronglyAdapted F B hA, process_ae Q B hB⟩

/-! # Actual adapted continuous Brownian versions on each finite horizon
The candidate uses only strict-past dyadic samples, even on exceptional
paths. Gaussian laws prove its continuous paths and its original timewise law.
No continuous-modification or adapted-limit conclusion is a premise.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.AdaptedBrownianWindow
open DyadicInterpolation BrownianDyadicProbability
variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]




/-- The raw candidate is genuinely adapted to the original past; no
completion of the filtration or supplied limiting adaptedness is used. -/

section Laws
variable (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B Q)
include hB

/-- Gaussian fourth moments supply the literal full-level grid bounds for
exactly the scaled curve appearing in the past-only candidate. -/

/-- At every horizon time, the actual adapted candidate is the original
Brownian variable almost surely, proved from convergence in measure. -/

/-- Actual simultaneous path continuity follows from the derived grid bounds
and deterministic polygon limits on the whole horizon. -/
end Laws
end PBGSO.AdaptedBrownianWindow

sampleTime.exact_header: def sampleTime (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0
sampleTime.exact_declaration:
def sampleTime (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  T * (leftTime (2 ^ n) ((t : ℝ) / T)).toNNReal

candidate.exact_header: def candidate (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : ℝ
candidate.exact_declaration:
def candidate (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  pastCandidate (scaled B T ω) ((t : ℝ) / T)

sampleTime_le.exact_header:
theorem sampleTime_le (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    sampleTime T n t ≤ t
sampleTime_le.exact_declaration:
theorem sampleTime_le (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    sampleTime T n t ≤ t := by
  have hTr : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  rw [sampleTime, NNReal.coe_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (leftTime_nonneg _ _)]
  calc
    (T : ℝ) * leftTime (2 ^ n) ((t : ℝ) / T) ≤ T * ((t : ℝ) / T) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (leftTime_le _ (by positivity) _ (by positivity)) T.coe_nonneg
    _ = t := by field_simp

candidate_stronglyAdapted.exact_header:
theorem candidate_stronglyAdapted (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hB : StronglyAdapted F B) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    StronglyAdapted F (candidate B T)
candidate_stronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem candidate_stronglyAdapted (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hB : StronglyAdapted F B) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    StronglyAdapted F (candidate B T) := by
  intro t
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := F t
  have hs (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable (fun ω => pastSample n (scaled B T ω) ((t : ℝ) / T)) := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (B (sampleTime T n t))
    exact (hB (sampleTime T n t)).mono (F.mono (sampleTime_le T hT n t))
  exact (hs 0).add (StronglyMeasurable.tsum (fun n => (hs (n + 1)).sub (hs n)))

ae_scaled_steps.exact_header:
theorem ae_scaled_steps (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ n,
      ‖scaled B T ω (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) -
        scaled B T ω ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ radius n
ae_scaled_steps.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_scaled_steps (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ n,
      ‖scaled B T ω (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) -
        scaled B T ω ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ radius n := by
  filter_upwards [ae_eventual_grid_bound Q B hB T] with ω hω
  filter_upwards [hω] with n hn
  intro j hj
  have he1 := scaled_sample B T ω (2 ^ n) (j + 1)
  have he0 := scaled_sample B T ω (2 ^ n) j
  simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at he1 he0
  rw [he1, he0]
  exact hn j hj

candidate_ae.exact_header:
theorem candidate_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    candidate B T t =ᵐ[Q] B t
candidate_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem candidate_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    candidate B T t =ᵐ[Q] B t := by
  have hTr : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hu : ((t : ℝ) / T) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨by positivity, (div_le_one hTr).mpr (by exact_mod_cast ht)⟩
  have he := BrownianTimeContinuity.scaled_left_limit_eq_ae Q B hB T ((t : ℝ) / T)
    hu.1 (candidate B T t) (by
      filter_upwards [ae_scaled_steps Q B hB T] with ω hω
      exact pastSample_tendsto_candidate (scaled B T ω) radius
        (fun n => (radius_pos n).le) radius_summable hω _ hu)
  have hs : T * ((t : ℝ) / T).toNNReal = t := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    rw [NNReal.coe_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ hu.1]
    field_simp
  simpa only [hs] using he

candidate_continuous_paths.exact_header:
theorem candidate_continuous_paths (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => candidate B T t ω) (Iic T)
candidate_continuous_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem candidate_continuous_paths (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => candidate B T t ω) (Iic T) := by
  have hTr : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  filter_upwards [ae_scaled_steps Q B hB T] with ω hω
  have hc := pastCandidate_continuousOn (scaled B T ω) radius
    (fun n => (radius_pos n).le) radius_summable hω
  have hm : MapsTo (fun t : ℝ≥0 => (t : ℝ) / T) (Iic T) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨by positivity, (div_le_one hTr).mpr (by exact_mod_cast ht)⟩
  exact hc.comp ((NNReal.continuous_coe.div_const (T : ℝ)).continuousOn) hm

import PBGSO.PastAverages
import PBGSO.MartingaleL2Limit

/-! # Adaptedness of actual past Bochner averages
The measurable L² subspace is preserved by integration, proved through
its actual continuous conditional projection. No projection identity for
a nonlinear coefficient or limiting adaptedness is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.AdaptedPastAverages
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)


/-- The actual Bochner integral over a past time interval belongs to the
current measurable L² subspace, even for merely time-integrable data. -/

/-- Past adaptedness in the time-L² sense. It follows from actual adapted
coefficient values and filtration monotonicity, and is stable under time
null-set changes. -/

integral_adapted.exact_header:
theorem integral_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (a b : ℝ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hi : IntervalIntegrable u volume a b) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (hU : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc a b), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (u r) Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] ((∫ r in a..b, u r : Lp Z 2 Q) : Ω → Z) Q
integral_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (a b : ℝ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hi : IntervalIntegrable u volume a b) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (hU : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc a b), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (u r) Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] ((∫ r in a..b, u r : Lp Z 2 Q) : Ω → Z) Q := by
  let P := MartingaleL2Limit.project (Z := Z) Q (F t) (F.le t)
  have hp : P (∫ r in a..b, u r) = ∫ r in a..b, u r := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, ← P.integral_comp_comm hi.left]
    exact integral_congr_ae (hU.mono (fun r hr => project_fixed Q F t (u r) hr))
  have hm := aestronglyMeasurable_condExpL2 (E := Z) (𝕜 := ℝ) (F.le t) (∫ r in a..b, u r)
  change AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (P (∫ r in a..b, u r)) Q at hm
  rw [hp] at hm
  exact hm

def PastAdapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) : Prop :=

pastMean_adapted.exact_header:
theorem pastMean_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hU : PastAdapted Q F u)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] ((PastAverages.pastMean (R := Lp Z 2 Q) u ε t) : Ω → Z) Q
pastMean_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem pastMean_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : LocallyIntegrable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hU : PastAdapted Q F u)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] ((PastAverages.pastMean (R := Lp Z 2 Q) u ε t) : Ω → Z) Q := by
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable u volume ((t : ℝ) - ε) t :=
    intervalIntegrable_iff.mpr ((hu.integrableOn_isCompact isCompact_uIcc).mono_set uIoc_subset_uIcc)
  have had : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc ((t : ℝ) - ε) t),
      AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (u r) Q := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (hU t), ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr hmem
    exact hr hmem.2
  have hm := (integral_adapted Q F u _ _ (by linarith) hi t had).const_smul ε⁻¹
  exact hm.congr (Lp.coeFn_smul ε⁻¹ (∫ r in (t : ℝ) - ε..t, u r)).symm

theorem pastAdapted_of_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hneg : ∀ r < 0, u r = 0)
    (hU : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (u r) Q) : PastAdapted Q F u
pastAdapted_of_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem pastAdapted_of_adapted (u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hneg : ∀ r < 0, u r = 0)
    (hU : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (u r) Q) : PastAdapted Q F u := by
  intro t
  apply ae_of_all
  intro r hrt
  by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
  · have hm := AEStronglyMeasurable.mono (F.mono (Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe.mpr hrt)) (hU r.toNNReal)
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal r hr] using hm
  · rw [hneg r (lt_of_not_ge hr)]
    exact aestronglyMeasurable_zero.congr (Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q).symm

/-! # Law-coherent actual additive mean-field processes on every initial coupling

space. The two measure-preserving projections of initial-coupling × noise pull
back those actual processes. Their output marginals are therefore the same
fixed laws for every initial coupling, and their sampler input is literally
common. No output-law identity or contraction estimate is assumed.

theorem IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution.pullback
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) {L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G}
    {Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q} {B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q}
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B) :

  continuous := (jointPullbackCLM hf).continuous.comp HY.continuous
  equation := by

def flow (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :

def flow (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (a : A)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 (μ.prod R) :=
  Classical.choose (exists_global_additive_integral_solution (μ.prod R) L
    (a, initialSampler R μ hμ) (input R μ B)
    ((lpPullbackCLM (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R))).continuous.comp hB)
    (by simp [input, hB0]))

    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (a : A)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution (μ.prod R) L (flow R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (input R μ B) ∧

theorem flow_spec (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

      flow R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 0 = (a, initialSampler R μ hμ) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_global_additive_integral_solution (μ.prod R) L

    ((lpPullbackCLM (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R))).continuous.comp hB)

realize_all_initial_couplings.exact_header:
theorem realize_all_initial_couplings
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 ν)
    (a b : A) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :
    ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
      IsCoupledWeakSolution M ∅ {couplingQuadratic D}
        (optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (optimizer R L ν hν b B hB hB0)
        (law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (law R L ν hν b B hB hB0) Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint
realize_all_initial_couplings.exact_declaration:
theorem realize_all_initial_couplings
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 ν)
    (a b : A) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :
    ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
      IsCoupledWeakSolution M ∅ {couplingQuadratic D}
        (optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (optimizer R L ν hν b B hB hB0)
        (law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (law R L ν hν b B hB hB0) Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint := by
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c R
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c R
  let hf := extension_left_preserving R μ ν c
  let hg := extension_right_preserving R μ ν c
  let hn := measurePreserving_snd (μ := c.joint) (ν := R)
  let Y := flow R L μ hμ a B hB hB0
  let W := flow R L ν hν b B hB hB0
  let Yc := fun t ↦ jointPullbackCLM hf (Y t)
  let Wc := fun t ↦ jointPullbackCLM hg (W t)
  have hY := (flow_spec R L μ hμ a B hB hB0).1.pullback hf
  have hW := (flow_spec R L ν hν b B hB hB0).1.pullback hg
  have hYL : (fun t ↦ lpPullbackCLM hf (input R μ B t)) = fun t ↦ lpPullbackCLM hn (B t) := by
    funext t
    unfold input
    rw [lpPullback_comp]
    rfl
  have hWR : (fun t ↦ lpPullbackCLM hg (input R ν B t)) = fun t ↦ lpPullbackCLM hn (B t) := by
    funext t
    unfold input
    rw [lpPullback_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hYL] at hY
  rw [hWR] at hW
  have hcoupled := hY.isCoupledWeakSolution_quadratic hW M H D
  have hleft : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution.samplerLaw (Q := Q) Yc =
      law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 := by
    funext t
    exact lpPullback_law hf (Y t).2
  have hright : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution.samplerLaw (Q := Q) Wc =
      law R L ν hν b B hB hB0 := by
    funext t
    exact lpPullback_law hg (W t).2
  change IsCoupledWeakSolution M ∅ {couplingQuadratic D}
    (optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) (optimizer R L ν hν b B hB hB0)
    (IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution.samplerLaw (Q := Q) Yc)
    (IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution.samplerLaw (Q := Q) Wc)
    (fun t ↦ samplerPairLaw Q (Yc t).2 (Wc t).2) at hcoupled
  rw [hleft, hright] at hcoupled
  refine ⟨_, hcoupled, ?_⟩
  change Q.map (fun ω ↦ ((Yc 0).2 ω, (Wc 0).2 ω)) = c.joint
  have hy0 : (Yc 0).2 = lpPullbackCLM hf (initialSampler R μ hμ) := by
    change lpPullbackCLM hf (flow R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 0).2 = _
    rw [(flow_spec R L μ hμ a B hB hB0).2]
  have hw0 : (Wc 0).2 = lpPullbackCLM hg (initialSampler R ν hν) := by
    change lpPullbackCLM hg (flow R L ν hν b B hB hB0 0).2 = _
    rw [(flow_spec R L ν hν b B hB hB0).2]
  rw [hy0, hw0]
  have hu : lpPullbackCLM hf (initialSampler R μ hμ) =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ ω.1.1 :=
    (lpPullback_coe hf _).trans (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (initialSampler_coe R μ hμ))
  have hv : lpPullbackCLM hg (initialSampler R ν hν) =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ ω.1.2 :=
    (lpPullback_coe hg _).trans (hg.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (initialSampler_coe R ν hν))
  rw [Measure.map_congr (hu.prodMk hv)]
  exact ULA.initialExtension_joint c R

constructed_law_contraction.exact_header:
theorem constructed_law_contraction
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 ν)
    (a b : A) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    optimizerLawDistance (optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 t)
      (optimizer R L ν hν b B hB hB0 t)
      (law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 t) (law R L ν hν b B hB hB0 t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * optimizerLawDistance a b μ ν
constructed_law_contraction.exact_declaration:
theorem constructed_law_contraction
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 ν)
    (a b : A) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    optimizerLawDistance (optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 t)
      (optimizer R L ν hν b B hB hB0 t)
      (law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 t) (law R L ν hν b B hB hB0 t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * optimizerLawDistance a b μ ν := by
  have hm0 := law_zero R L μ hμ a B hB hB0
  have hn0 := law_zero R L ν hν b B hB hB0
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 0) := by rw [hm0]; infer_instance

theorem LipschitzDynamics.sampler_uncurry_lipschitz (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) :
    LipschitzWith (2 * L.samplerLip) (Function.uncurry L.sampler) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro p q
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  have hp := L.sampler_parameter p.1 q.1 p.2
  have hx := (L.sampler_state q.1).norm_sub_le p.2 q.2
  have hs := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub
    (L.sampler p.1 p.2) (L.sampler q.1 p.2) (L.sampler q.1 q.2)
  have ho : ‖p.1 - q.1‖ ≤ ‖p - q‖ := norm_fst_le (p - q)
  have hz : ‖p.2 - q.2‖ ≤ ‖p - q‖ := norm_snd_le (p - q)
  change ‖L.sampler p.1 p.2 - L.sampler q.1 q.2‖ ≤ (2 * (L.samplerLip : ℝ)) * ‖p - q‖
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ho L.samplerLip.coe_nonneg,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz L.samplerLip.coe_nonneg]

import PBGSO.PaperTheorems
import KineticLangevin.IntegralCoupling

/-!
# Contraction of actual common-input integral solutions

The result applies to arbitrary nonlinear, nonconservative drifts. The
ambient Banach space can be an optimiser state times an L² sampler state;
the continuous linear transformation provides a Hilbert quadratic metric.
The energy differential inequality is derived from the integral equations,
not supplied as a hypothesis. Shared additive noise cancels in those
equations. State-dependent stochastic noise requires a separate Itô proof.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO

variable {E H : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- Squared transformed-distance decay for actual integral solutions of an
arbitrary Lipschitz drift driven by the same additive input. -/

/-- Exponential contraction in the specified transformed Hilbert norm. -/

/-- The paper's square-root condition-number prefactor, now derived from
the actual integral equations and monotonicity of their drift. -/

/-- Common additive noise also cancels when the reference trajectory has
an explicit continuous forcing. The resulting derivative is derived by
the fundamental theorem of calculus from the two integral equations. -/

/-- Exact perturbation bound for actual integral solutions. It is uniform
over time when the transformed forcing has uniform bound `c`. This is the

theorem transformed_additive_integral_energy_decay
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪C (x - y), C (g x - g y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t)
transformed_additive_integral_energy_dec.exact_declaration:
theorem transformed_additive_integral_energy_decay
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪C (x - y), C (g x - g y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ‖C (Y r - Z r)‖ ^ 2
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r =>
    -2 * ⟪C (Y r - Z r), C (g (Y r) - g (Z r))⟫
  have hc : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T) :=
    ((C.continuous.comp (hY.sub hZ)).norm.pow 2).continuousOn
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hdiff := KineticLangevin.integral_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
      g L hg Y Z B hY hZ T heY heZ r hr
    have hC := C.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt r hdiff
    simpa only [F, F', Function.comp_def, map_neg, inner_neg_right,
      mul_neg, neg_mul] using hC.norm_sq
  have hm : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, F' r ≤ -2 * ρ * F r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [F', F]
    have h := hmono (Y r) (Z r)
    nlinarith
  exact energy_decay hc hd hm t ht

theorem transformed_additive_integral_contraction
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪C (x - y), C (g x - g y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ := by
  have h := transformed_additive_integral_energy_decay

    (hcompUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + B t)

theorem additive_integral_contraction_with_condition_number
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ lower upper : ℝ)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hcompLower : ∀ x, lower * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C x‖ ^ 2)
    (hcompUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪C (x - y), C (g x - g y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖Y t - Z t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
      ‖Y 0 - Z 0‖ := by
  have hdec := transformed_additive_integral_energy_decay
    g L hg C ρ hmono Y Z B hY hZ T heY heZ t ht
  have hexp : Real.exp (-ρ * t) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hupper hlower.le), hexp]
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hlower).mp
  have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcompUpper (Y 0 - Z 0))

  calc
    lower * ‖Y t - Z t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ^ 2 := hcompLower _
    _ ≤ upper * ‖Y 0 - Z 0‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := hdec.trans hi
    _ = lower * (upper / lower * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * ‖Y 0 - Z 0‖ ^ 2) := by
      field_simp
      <;> ring

theorem forced_integral_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (Y Z B f : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hf : Continuous f) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + (∫ s in 0..t, f s) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Y r - Z r)
      (-(g (Y t) - g (Z t) + f t)) (Ici t) t := by
  have hforce : Continuous (fun s => g (Y s) - g (Z s) + f s) :=
    ((hg.continuous.comp hY).sub (hg.continuous.comp hZ)).add hf
  have heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y r - Z r = Y 0 - Z 0 - ∫ s in 0..r, g (Y s) - g (Z s) + f s := by
    intro r hr
    have hiY : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => g (Y s)) volume 0 r :=
      (hg.continuous.comp hY).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hiZ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => g (Z s)) volume 0 r :=
      (hg.continuous.comp hZ).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hiYZ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => g (Y s) - g (Z s)) volume 0 r :=
      hiY.sub hiZ
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hiYZ (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiY hiZ]
    have hy := heY r hr
    have hz := heZ r hr
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hy hz
    rw [hy, hz]
    abel
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
    (hforce.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    (hforce.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hforce.continuousAt
  have hmem : Icc 0 T ∈ 𝓝[Ici t] t := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iic_mem_nhds ht.2)] with r hr hrT
    exact ⟨ht.1.trans hr, hrT⟩
  have he : (fun r => Y r - Z r) =ᶠ[𝓝[Ici t] t]
      (fun r => Y 0 - Z 0 - ∫ s in 0..r, g (Y s) - g (Z s) + f s) := by
    filter_upwards [hmem] with r hr
    exact heq r hr
  exact (hd.const_sub (Y 0 - Z 0)).hasDerivWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq he

    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ c : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ⟪C (x - y), C (g x - g y)⟫)
    (Y Z B f : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hf : Continuous f) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g (Z s)) + (∫ s in 0..t, f s) + B t)
    (hforcing : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖C (f t)‖ ≤ c)
    (hinitial : Y 0 = Z 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ≤ c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ‖C (Y r - Z r)‖ ^ 2
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 *
    ⟪C (Y r - Z r), C (-(g (Y r) - g (Z r) + f r))⟫
  have hcont : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T) :=
    ((C.continuous.comp (hY.sub hZ)).norm.pow 2).continuousOn
  have hder : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    exact (C.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt r
      (forced_integral_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
        g L hg Y Z B f hY hZ hf T heY heZ r hr)).norm_sq
  have hnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ F r := fun r _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hzero : F 0 = 0 := by simp [F, hinitial]
  have hdiss : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T,
      F' r ≤ -2 * ρ * F r + 2 * c * Real.sqrt (F r) := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩
    have hm := hmono (Y r) (Z r)
    have hs := real_inner_le_norm (C (Y r - Z r)) (-C (f r))
    rw [norm_neg] at hs
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hforcing r hr') (norm_nonneg (C (Y r - Z r)))
    dsimp [F', F]
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), map_neg, map_add,
      inner_neg_right, inner_add_right]
    simp only [inner_neg_right] at hs
    nlinarith
  have h := forced_energy_bound hρ hc hcont hder hnonneg hzero hdiss t ht
  simpa only [F, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] using h

diffusionColumnsCLM.exact_header: def diffusionColumnsCLM (σ : I → Z) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z
diffusionColumnsCLM.exact_declaration:
def diffusionColumnsCLM (σ : I → Z) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z :=
  ∑ i, (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (σ i)).comp (EuclideanSpace.proj i)

diffusionColumnsCLM_apply.exact_header:
theorem diffusionColumnsCLM_apply (σ : I → Z) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) :
    diffusionColumnsCLM σ x = ∑ i, x i • σ i
diffusionColumnsCLM_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem diffusionColumnsCLM_apply (σ : I → Z) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ I) :
    diffusionColumnsCLM σ x = ∑ i, x i • σ i := by
  simp [diffusionColumnsCLM]

diffusionColumnsCLM_basis.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem diffusionColumnsCLM_basis (σ : I → Z) (i : I) :
    diffusionColumnsCLM σ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i) = σ i
diffusionColumnsCLM_basis.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem diffusionColumnsCLM_basis (σ : I → Z) (i : I) :
    diffusionColumnsCLM σ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i) = σ i := by
  classical
  rw [diffusionColumnsCLM_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  simp

normalizedDiffusionCLM.exact_header: def normalizedDiffusionCLM (σ : I → Z) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z
normalizedDiffusionCLM.exact_declaration:
def normalizedDiffusionCLM (σ : I → Z) : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z :=
  (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ • diffusionColumnsCLM σ

normalizedDiffusionCLM_basis.exact_header:
theorem normalizedDiffusionCLM_basis (σ : I → Z) (i : I) :
    Real.sqrt 2 • normalizedDiffusionCLM σ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i) = σ i
normalizedDiffusionCLM_basis.exact_declaration:
theorem normalizedDiffusionCLM_basis (σ : I → Z) (i : I) :
    Real.sqrt 2 • normalizedDiffusionCLM σ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i) = σ i := by
  simp [normalizedDiffusionCLM, smul_smul, Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

samplerBrownianInput_normalized.exact_header:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_normalized (σ : I → Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q (normalizedDiffusionCLM σ) W hW a t =
      (diffusionColumnsCLM σ).compLp
        (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t) -
          ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a)
samplerBrownianInput_normalized.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_normalized (σ : I → Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q (normalizedDiffusionCLM σ) W hW a t =
      (diffusionColumnsCLM σ).compLp
        (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t) -
          ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a) := by
  change ((normalizedDiffusionCLM σ).compLpL 2 Q)
    (Real.sqrt 2 • _) = _
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [normalizedDiffusionCLM, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_compLpL,
    smul_apply, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)), one_smul]
  rfl

additive_model_diffusion_columns.exact_header:
theorem additive_model_diffusion_columns
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (a₀ a : A) (z₀ z : Z) (i : I) :
    M.diffusion (M.parameter a) z i =
      Real.sqrt 2 • normalizedDiffusionCLM (M.diffusion (M.parameter a₀) z₀)
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i)
additive_model_diffusion_columns.exact_declaration:
theorem additive_model_diffusion_columns
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (a₀ a : A) (z₀ z : Z) (i : I) :
    M.diffusion (M.parameter a) z i =
      Real.sqrt 2 • normalizedDiffusionCLM (M.diffusion (M.parameter a₀) z₀)
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun I ℝ i) := by
  rw [normalizedDiffusionCLM_basis]
  exact H.diffusion_constant a a₀ z z₀ i

lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral.exact_header:
theorem lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ⟪X, W.compLpL 2 Q Y⟫_ℝ = ∫ ω, ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ⟪X, W.compLpL 2 Q Y⟫_ℝ = ∫ ω, ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [W.coeFn_compLpL Y] with ω hω
  rw [hω]

lp_weighted_pairing_integrable.exact_header:
theorem lp_weighted_pairing_integrable (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ) Q
lp_weighted_pairing_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem lp_weighted_pairing_integrable (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ) Q := by
  have h := L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) X (W.compLpL 2 Q Y)
  apply h.congr
  filter_upwards [W.coeFn_compLpL Y] with ω hω
  rw [hω]

liftedMetricBilinear.exact_header:
def liftedMetricBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) :
    (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] ℝ
liftedMetricBilinear.exact_declaration:
def liftedMetricBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) :
    (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q))
    (D.optimizerWeight.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q))) +
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q))
    ((D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)))

liftedMetricBilinear_apply.exact_header:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x y = ⟪x.1, D.optimizerWeight y.1⟫_ℝ +
      ∫ ω, ⟪x.2 ω, D.samplerWeight (y.2 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
liftedMetricBilinear_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x y = ⟪x.1, D.optimizerWeight y.1⟫_ℝ +
      ∫ ω, ⟪x.2 ω, D.samplerWeight (y.2 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  change ⟪x.1, D.optimizerWeight y.1⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪x.2, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q y.2⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]

liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x y = liftedMetricBilinear Q D y x
liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x y = liftedMetricBilinear Q D y x := by
  rw [liftedMetricBilinear_apply, liftedMetricBilinear_apply]
  congr 1
  · exact (D.optimizer_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all Q fun ω ↦ (D.sampler_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)

liftedEuclideanSq.exact_header: def liftedEuclideanSq (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : ℝ
liftedEuclideanSq.exact_declaration: def liftedEuclideanSq (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : ℝ := ‖x.1‖ ^ 2 + ‖x.2‖ ^ 2

liftedMetricBilinear_lower.exact_header:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_lower (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    D.lower * liftedEuclideanSq Q x ≤ liftedMetricBilinear Q D x x
liftedMetricBilinear_lower.exact_declaration:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_lower (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    D.lower * liftedEuclideanSq Q x ≤ liftedMetricBilinear Q D x x := by
  have hi := integral_mono
    (((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable x.2)).mp (Lp.memLp x.2)).const_mul D.lower)
    (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight x.2 x.2)
    (fun ω ↦ D.sampler_lower (x.2 ω))
  rw [integral_const_mul, ← ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q x.2] at hi
  rw [liftedMetricBilinear_apply]
  dsimp [liftedEuclideanSq]
  have ho := D.optimizer_lower x.1
  linarith

liftedMetricBilinear_upper.exact_header:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_upper (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x x ≤ D.upper * liftedEuclideanSq Q x
liftedMetricBilinear_upper.exact_declaration:
theorem liftedMetricBilinear_upper (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D x x ≤ D.upper * liftedEuclideanSq Q x := by
  have hi := integral_mono (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight x.2 x.2)
    (((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable x.2)).mp (Lp.memLp x.2)).const_mul D.upper)
    (fun ω ↦ D.sampler_upper (x.2 ω))
  rw [integral_const_mul, ← ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q x.2] at hi
  rw [liftedMetricBilinear_apply]
  dsimp [liftedEuclideanSq]
  have ho := D.optimizer_upper x.1
  linarith

AdditiveModelCompatibility.exact_header: structure AdditiveModelCompatibility (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I) : Prop
AdditiveModelCompatibility.exact_declaration:
structure AdditiveModelCompatibility (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I) : Prop where
  observation : ∀ a z, M.observation (M.parameter a) (M.position z) = L.observation a z
  response : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ a g, M.optimizer t a g = L.response (a, g)
  sampler : ∀ a z, M.drift (M.parameter a) z = L.sampler a z
  diffusion_constant : ∀ a b z w i,
    M.diffusion (M.parameter a) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter b) w i

samplerPairLaw.exact_header: def samplerPairLaw (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) : Measure (Z × Z)
samplerPairLaw.exact_declaration:
def samplerPairLaw (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) : Measure (Z × Z) :=
  Q.map (fun ω ↦ (U ω, V ω))

samplerPairLaw_coupling.exact_header:
theorem samplerPairLaw_coupling (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    IsCoupling (samplerPairLaw Q U V) (Q.map U) (Q.map V)
samplerPairLaw_coupling.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerPairLaw_coupling (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    IsCoupling (samplerPairLaw Q U V) (Q.map U) (Q.map V) := by
  constructor
  · rw [samplerPairLaw, Measure.map_map measurable_fst
      ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable U).measurable.prodMk (Lp.stronglyMeasurable V).measurable)]
    rfl
  · rw [samplerPairLaw, Measure.map_map measurable_snd
      ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable U).measurable.prodMk (Lp.stronglyMeasurable V).measurable)]
    rfl

lp_law_second_moment.exact_header: theorem lp_law_second_moment (U : Lp Z 2 Q) : HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map U)
lp_law_second_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem lp_law_second_moment (U : Lp Z 2 Q) : HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map U) := by
  apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop)
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable).mpr
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U)).mp (Lp.memLp U)

model_meanGradient_eq_expectedObservatio.exact_header:
theorem model_meanGradient_eq_expectedObservation
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (a : A) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    M.meanGradient (Q.map U) a = L.expectedObservation Q a U
model_meanGradient_eq_expectedObservatio.exact_declaration:
theorem model_meanGradient_eq_expectedObservation
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (a : A) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    M.meanGradient (Q.map U) a = L.expectedObservation Q a U := by

additive_sampler_work.exact_header:
theorem additive_sampler_work (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (a b : A) (zz : Z × Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D a b zz =
      ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight (L.sampler a zz.1 - L.sampler b zz.2)⟫_ℝ
additive_sampler_work.exact_declaration:
theorem additive_sampler_work (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (a b : A) (zz : Z × Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D a b zz =
      ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight (L.sampler a zz.1 - L.sampler b zz.2)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hz (i : I) : M.diffusion (M.parameter a) zz.1 i -
      M.diffusion (M.parameter b) zz.2 i = 0 :=
    sub_eq_zero.mpr (H.diffusion_constant a b zz.1 zz.2 i)
  simp only [samplerCouplingWork, hz, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq, map_zero,
    inner_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, H.sampler]

samplerPairLaw_cost_integral.exact_header:
theorem samplerPairLaw_cost_integral (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V) =
      ⟪U - V, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q (U - V)⟫_ℝ
samplerPairLaw_cost_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerPairLaw_cost_integral (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V) =
      ⟪U - V, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q (U - V)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    fun_prop
  rw [samplerPairLaw, integral_map
    (((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable).prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable) hc.aestronglyMeasurable,
    lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub U V] with ω hω
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hω
  rw [hω]
  rfl

samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable.exact_header:
theorem samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun zz ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) (samplerPairLaw Q U V)
samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun zz ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) (samplerPairLaw Q U V) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    fun_prop
  apply (integrable_map_measure hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    (((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable).prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable)).mpr

theorem samplerPairLaw_work_integral (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (a b : A) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D a b zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V) =
      ⟪U - V, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q

theorem samplerPairLaw_work_integrable (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (a b : A) (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D a b) (samplerPairLaw Q U V) := by
  have heq : samplerCouplingWork M D a b = fun zz ↦
      ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight (L.sampler a zz.1 - L.sampler b zz.2)⟫_ℝ :=
    funext (additive_sampler_work L M H D a b)
  rw [heq]
  have hc : Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z ↦
      ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight (L.sampler a zz.1 - L.sampler b zz.2)⟫_ℝ) := by
    exact (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd).inner
      (D.samplerWeight.continuous.comp (((L.sampler_state a).continuous.comp continuous_fst).sub
        ((L.sampler_state b).continuous.comp continuous_snd)))

    (((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable).prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable)).mpr

    (liftMap Q (L.sampler a) (L.sampler_state a) U -
      liftMap Q (L.sampler b) (L.sampler_state b) V)).congr
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub U V, sampler_drift_difference_coe Q L a b U V] with ω hd hb
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hd
  rw [hd, hb]

theorem lifted_joint_dissipation_of_model (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G)
    (M : Model A G Z X I) (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M)
    (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D (x - y) (L.field Q x - L.field Q y) ≤
      -ρ * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (x - y) (x - y)
lifted_joint_dissipation_of_model.exact_declaration:
theorem lifted_joint_dissipation_of_model (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G)
    (M : Model A G Z X I) (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M)
    (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D (x - y) (L.field Q x - L.field Q y) ≤
      -ρ * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (x - y) (x - y) := by
  let U := x.2
  let V := y.2
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map U) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map V) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hU := lp_law_second_moment Q U
  have hV := lp_law_second_moment Q V
  have hoU : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter x.1) (M.position z)) (Q.map U) := by
    simp_rw [H.observation]
    exact observation_integrable_of_lipschitz (Q.map U) _ (L.observation_state x.1) hU
  have hoV : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter y.1) (M.position z)) (Q.map V) := by
    simp_rw [H.observation]
    exact observation_integrable_of_lipschitz (Q.map V) _ (L.observation_state y.1) hV
  have h := hmono 0 le_rfl x.1 y.1 (Q.map U) (Q.map V) (samplerPairLaw Q U V)
    (samplerPairLaw_coupling Q U V) inferInstance inferInstance hU hV hoU hoV
    (samplerPairLaw_work_integrable Q L M H D x.1 y.1 U V)
    (samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable Q D U V)
  rw [samplerPairLaw_work_integral Q L M H D x.1 y.1 U V,
    samplerPairLaw_cost_integral Q D U V] at h
  have hf (a : A) (Z : Lp Z 2 Q) : M.optimizerField 0 a (Q.map Z) =
      L.response (a, L.expectedObservation Q a Z) := by
    rw [Model.optimizerField, H.response 0 le_rfl,
      model_meanGradient_eq_expectedObservation Q L M H a Z]
  rw [hf x.1 U, hf y.1 V] at h
  exact h

additive_model_integral_energy_decay.exact_header:
theorem additive_model_integral_energy_decay
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hW : Continuous W) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t))
    (heW : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      W t - W 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D (Y t - W t) (Y t - W t) ≤
      liftedMetricBilinear Q D (Y 0 - W 0) (Y 0 - W 0) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t)
additive_model_integral_energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem additive_model_integral_energy_decay
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hW : Continuous W) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t))
    (heW : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      W t - W 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    liftedMetricBilinear Q D (Y t - W t) (Y t - W t) ≤
      liftedMetricBilinear Q D (Y 0 - W 0) (Y 0 - W 0) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
  let Bq := liftedMetricBilinear Q D
  let F := fun r ↦ Bq (Y r - W r) (Y r - W r)
  let F' := fun r ↦ 2 * Bq (Y r - W r) (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r))
  have hc : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T) := by
    apply Continuous.continuousOn
    exact (Bq.continuous.comp (hY.sub hW)).clm_apply (hY.sub hW)
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hg : LipschitzWith L.fieldLip (fun z ↦ -L.field Q z) := (L.field_lipschitz Q).neg
    have heY' : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 T,
        Y s - Y 0 = -(∫ u in 0..s, -L.field Q (Y u)) + (0, B s) := by
      intro s hs
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using heY s hs
    have heW' : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 T,
        W s - W 0 = -(∫ u in 0..s, -L.field Q (W u)) + (0, B s) := by
      intro s hs
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using heW s hs
    have hdiff := KineticLangevin.integral_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
      (fun z ↦ -L.field Q z) L.fieldLip hg Y W (fun s ↦ (0, B s)) hY hW T heY' heW' r hr
    have hd' : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ Y s - W s)
        (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)) (Ici r) r := by
      convert hdiff using 1 <;> module
    have hF := (quadratic_hasFDerivAt Bq (Y r - W r)).comp_hasDerivWithinAt r hd'
    have hsym := liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric Q D
      (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)) (Y r - W r)
    convert hF using 1
    · rfl
    · change 2 * Bq (Y r - W r) (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)) =
        Bq (Y r - W r) (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)) +
          Bq (L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)) (Y r - W r)
      rw [hsym]
      ring
  have hm : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, F' r ≤ -2 * ρ * F r := by
    intro r _
    have h := lifted_joint_dissipation_of_model Q L M H D ρ hmono (Y r) (W r)
    dsimp [F', F, Bq]
    linarith
  exact energy_decay hc hd hm t ht

theorem additive_model_integral_contraction
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hW : Continuous W) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t))
    (heW : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      W t - W 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y t - W t)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y 0 - W 0))
additive_model_integral_contraction.exact_declaration:
theorem additive_model_integral_contraction
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hW : Continuous W) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t))
    (heW : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      W t - W 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y t - W t)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y 0 - W 0)) := by
  have hd := additive_model_integral_energy_decay Q L M H D ρ hmono Y W B hY hW T heY heW t ht
  have hlo := liftedMetricBilinear_lower Q D (Y t - W t)
  have hup := liftedMetricBilinear_upper Q D (Y 0 - W 0)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hn (x : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : 0 ≤ liftedEuclideanSq Q x := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hn _), mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hκ, Real.sq_sqrt (hn _)]
  have he : Real.exp (-ρ * t) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left D.lower_pos).mp
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hup (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * t)).le
  have heq : D.lower * (D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) *
      liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y 0 - W 0)) =
      D.upper * liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y 0 - W 0) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.conditionNumber]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt D.lower_pos]
  rw [heq]
  exact hlo.trans (hd.trans hupper)

exists_additive_model_contracting_pair.exact_header:
theorem exists_additive_model_contracting_pair
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y t - W t)) ≤
        Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
          Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (initial - other)))
exists_additive_model_contracting_pair.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_additive_model_contracting_pair
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other = (∫ s in 0..t, L.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (Y t - W t)) ≤
        Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
          Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (initial - other))) := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hiY, heY⟩ := L.exists_integral Q initial B hB hB0 T hT
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hiW, heW⟩ := L.exists_integral Q other B hB hB0 T hT
  refine ⟨Y, W, hY, hW, hiY, hiW, heY, heW, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have h := additive_model_integral_contraction Q L M H D ρ hmono Y W B hY hW T
    (fun s hs ↦ by simpa only [hiY] using heY s hs)
    (fun s hs ↦ by simpa only [hiW] using heW s hs) t ht
  simpa only [hiY, hiW] using h

import PBGSO.AdditiveCanonicalRealization
import PBGSO.NumericsTarget

/-! # Actual frozen invariance builds the additive stationary target data

The frozen sampler input is an actual continuous L² trajectory with its
integral equation and constant output law. This is the source frozen
invariance assumption, not a conclusion inferred from an empty test family.
Its constant optimiser extension is derived, primitive uniqueness identifies
the canonical target process, and every initial coupling is then realized by
the already constructed product extension. No relaxation bound or realizer
is a hypothesis.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO
namespace AdditiveStationary
variable {Ξ A G Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ξ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [MeasurableSpace A] [BorelSpace A] [SecondCountableTopology A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
  [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [SecondCountableTopology G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Fintype I]
  (R : Measure Ξ) [IsProbabilityMeasure R]
  (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
  (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M)
  (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
  (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 νStar) (aStar : A)
  (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 R) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)

/-- Actual frozen invariant dynamics with the model's sampler drift and the
same initial-law/noise source as the canonical construction. -/

variable (F : FrozenTrajectory R L νStar hνStar aStar B)
include H F

/-- The optimiser's zero observation follows from the actual frozen law. -/

/-- The fixed optimiser plus the actual frozen sampler satisfy the complete
mean-field integral equation; optimiser stationarity is derived. -/

/-- The canonical target flow has the actual stationary optimiser and law;
this is proved by primitive same-input uniqueness against the frozen flow. -/

/-- The actual frozen invariant trajectory builds every stationary-target
process premise used by the finite-particle/numerical theorem. In particular,
its all-initial-couplings realizer is a conclusion of the construction. -/

end AdditiveStationary
end PBGSO

theorem frozen_is_global_solution
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0) :
    IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution (νStar.prod R) L
      (fun t => (aStar, F.sampler t)) (AdditiveCanonical.input R νStar B) where
  continuous := continuous_const.prodMk F.continuous
  equation := by
    intro t ht
    have hr : L.response (aStar, 0) = 0 := (H.response 0 le_rfl aStar 0).symm.trans (hfix 0 le_rfl)
    have hf (r : ℝ) (hr' : 0 ≤ r) :
        L.field (νStar.prod R) (aStar, F.sampler r) =

            (F.sampler r)) := by
      simp only [LipschitzDynamics.field, expectedObservation_zero R L M H νStar hνStar
        aStar B F hg r hr', hr]
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun r => liftMap (νStar.prod R) (L.sampler aStar) (L.sampler_state aStar)
          (F.sampler r)) volume 0 t :=
      ((liftMap_lipschitz (νStar.prod R) _ _).continuous.comp F.continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hint : (∫ r in 0..t, L.field (νStar.prod R) (aStar, F.sampler r)) =
        (0, ∫ r in 0..t,
          liftMap (νStar.prod R) (L.sampler aStar) (L.sampler_state aStar) (F.sampler r)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ r in 0..t, (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A (Lp Z 2 (νStar.prod R)))
            (liftMap (νStar.prod R) (L.sampler aStar) (L.sampler_state aStar) (F.sampler r)) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro r hr'
          exact hf r ((uIcc_of_le ht) ▸ hr').1
        _ = _ := (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A (Lp Z 2 (νStar.prod R))).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
    rw [hint]
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · exact F.equation t ht

canonical_target_stationary.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_target_stationary
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    AdditiveCanonical.optimizer R L νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0 t = aStar ∧
      AdditiveCanonical.law R L νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0 t = νStar := by
  have hf := frozen_is_global_solution R L M H νStar hνStar aStar B F hg hfix
  have hc := (AdditiveCanonical.flow_spec R L νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0).1
  have hz : AdditiveCanonical.flow R L νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0 0 =
      (aStar, F.sampler 0) := by
    rw [(AdditiveCanonical.flow_spec R L νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0).2, F.initial]
  have he := hc.eq_of_initial hf hz t ht
  constructor
  · exact congrArg Prod.fst he
  · change (νStar.prod R).map _ = νStar
    rw [congrArg Prod.snd he]
    exact F.stationary_law t ht

def stationaryParameterData (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)

    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0)

stationaryParameterData.exact_declaration:
def stationaryParameterData (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hprojection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0)
    (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 μ) (a : A) :
    StationaryParameterData M D (AdditiveCanonical.optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0)
      (AdditiveCanonical.law R L μ hμ a B hB hB0) ρ := by
  have hmoment : HasFiniteSecondMoment νStar :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm continuous_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hνStar
  have hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter aStar) (M.position z)) νStar := by
    simp_rw [H.observation]
    exact observation_integrable_of_lipschitz νStar _ (L.observation_state aStar) hmoment
  refine
    { projection := hprojection
      tests := ∅
      pairTests := {couplingQuadratic D}
      mean_solution := (AdditiveCanonical.flow_spec R L μ hμ a B hB hB0).1.isWeakSolution_empty M H
      sStar := aStar
      νStar := νStar
      frozen_stationary := ?_
      gradient_integrable := hint
      gradient_zero := hg
      optimizer_fixed := hfix
      quadratic_test := Set.mem_singleton _
      rate_positive := hρ
      joint_monotonicity := hmono
      realize := ?_ }
  · exact
      { probability := inferInstance
        second_moment := hmoment
        test_integrable := by simp
        generator_integrable := by simp
        generator_zero := by simp }
  · intro c
    let c' : ULA.Coupling μ νStar :=
      ⟨c.joint, c.fst.trans (AdditiveCanonical.law_zero R L μ hμ a B hB hB0), c.snd⟩
    obtain ⟨Λ, hc, hzero⟩ := AdditiveCanonical.realize_all_initial_couplings R L M H D
      μ νStar hμ hνStar a aStar B hB hB0 c'
    have hs := canonical_target_stationary R L M H νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0 F hg hfix
    refine ⟨Λ, ?_, hzero⟩
    refine
      { coupling := ?_
        test_integrable := hc.test_integrable
        generator_integrable := ?_
        forward_equation := ?_ }
    · intro t ht
      simpa only [(hs t ht).2] using hc.coupling t ht
    · intro φ hφ t ht
      simpa only [(hs t ht).1] using hc.generator_integrable φ hφ t ht
    · intro φ hφ t ht
      simpa only [(hs t ht).1] using hc.forward_equation φ hφ t ht

exists_global_additive_integral_solution.exact_header:
theorem exists_global_additive_integral_solution
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (initial : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B ∧ Y 0 = initial
exists_global_additive_integral_solution.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_global_additive_integral_solution
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (initial : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B ∧ Y 0 = initial := by
  classical
  let flow := fun n : ℕ ↦ Classical.choose
    (L.exists_integral Q initial B hB hB0 ((n : ℝ) + 1) (Nat.cast_add_one_pos n).le)
  have hs (n : ℕ) : Continuous (flow n) ∧ flow n 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 ((n : ℝ) + 1), flow n t - initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q (flow n r)) + (0, B t) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (L.exists_integral Q initial B hB hB0 ((n : ℝ) + 1) (Nat.cast_add_one_pos n).le)
  have coherent (m n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
      (hm : r ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1) (hn : r ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) : flow m r = flow n r := by
    have hg : LipschitzWith L.fieldLip (fun z ↦ -L.field Q z) := (L.field_lipschitz Q).neg
    have he := ULA.langevin_integral_unique (fun z ↦ -L.field Q z) L.fieldLip hg initial
      (fun t ↦ (0, B t)) (flow m) (flow n) (hs m).1 (hs n).1 r hr
      (fun t ht ↦ by
        simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
          (hs m).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hm⟩)
      (fun t ht ↦ by
        simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
          (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hn⟩)
    exact he ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩
  let Y := fun t : ℝ ↦ flow (Nat.ceil (max 0 t)) (max 0 t)
  have agree (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : max 0 r ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) :
      Y r = flow n (max 0 r) := by
    apply coherent _ n _ (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by linarith)
    · exact hr
  have hcont : Continuous Y := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro t
    let n := Nat.ceil (max 0 t)
    have ht : max 0 t < (n : ℝ) + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_ceil _) (by linarith)
    have hc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ ↦ max 0 r) := continuous_const.max continuous_id
    have hev : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 t, max 0 r < (n : ℝ) + 1 := hc.continuousAt.eventually (gt_mem_nhds ht)
    apply ((hs n).1.comp hc).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    exact hev.mono fun r hr ↦ agree n r hr.le
  have hzero : Y 0 = initial := by
    have h : Y 0 = flow 0 0 := by simpa only [max_self] using agree 0 0 (by norm_num)
    exact h.trans (hs 0).2.1
  refine ⟨Y, ⟨hcont, ?_⟩, hzero⟩
  intro t ht
  let n := Nat.ceil t
  have hnt : t ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := (Nat.le_ceil t).trans (by linarith)
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 t) : Y r = flow n r := by
    simpa only [max_eq_right hr.1] using agree n r (by rw [max_eq_right hr.1]; exact hr.2.trans hnt)
  have hint : (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q (Y r)) = ∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q (flow n r) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht] at hr
    change L.field Q (Y r) = L.field Q (flow n r)
    rw [he r hr]
  rw [he t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩, hzero, hint]
  exact (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht, hnt⟩

theorem optimizer_hasDerivWithinAt
    (H : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r ↦ (Y r).1) (L.field Q (Y t)).1 (Ici 0) t
optimizer_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem optimizer_hasDerivWithinAt
    (H : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r ↦ (Y r).1) (L.field Q (Y t)).1 (Ici 0) t := by
  let f := fun r ↦ (L.field Q (Y r)).1
  have hc : Continuous f := continuous_fst.comp ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp H.continuous)
  have heq (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : (Y r).1 = (Y 0).1 + ∫ u in 0..r, f u := by
    have he := congrArg Prod.fst (H.equation r hr)
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ L.field Q (Y u)) volume 0 r :=
      ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp H.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 r
    have hi := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hint
    change (∫ u in 0..r, f u) = (∫ u in 0..r, L.field Q (Y u)).1 at hi
    simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.fst_add, add_zero] at he
    rw [← hi] at he
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp he |>.trans (add_comm _ _)
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 t := hc.intervalIntegrable 0 t
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
    hint (hc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hc.continuousAt
  exact (hd.const_add (Y 0).1).hasDerivWithinAt.congr heq (heq t ht)

    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B)
    (HW : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L W B) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r ↦ Y r - W r)
      (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)) (Ici 0) t
difference_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem difference_hasDerivWithinAt
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B)
    (HW : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L W B) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r ↦ Y r - W r)
      (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)) (Ici 0) t := by
  let f := fun r ↦ L.field Q (Y r) - L.field Q (W r)
  have hc : Continuous f := ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp HY.continuous).sub
    ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp HW.continuous)
  have heq (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : Y r - W r = Y 0 - W 0 + ∫ u in 0..r, f u := by
    have hiy : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ L.field Q (Y u)) volume 0 r :=
      ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp HY.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 r
    have hiw : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ L.field Q (W u)) volume 0 r :=
      ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp HW.continuous).intervalIntegrable 0 r
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiy hiw]
    have hy := HY.equation r hr
    have hw := HW.equation r hr
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hy hw
    rw [hy, hw]
    module
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable f volume 0 t := hc.intervalIntegrable 0 t
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
    hint (hc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hc.continuousAt
  exact (hd.const_add (Y 0 - W 0)).hasDerivWithinAt.congr heq (heq t ht)

pair_quadratic_forward.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_quadratic_forward
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B)
    (HW : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L W B)
    (M : Model A G Z X I) (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M)
    (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r ↦ ∫ zz, couplingQuadratic D zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (Y r).2 (W r).2)
      (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (Y t).1 (W t).1 (couplingQuadratic D) zz
        ∂samplerPairLaw Q (Y t).2 (W t).2) (Ici 0) t := by
  let Bs : Lp Z 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp Z 2 Q →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Lp Z 2 Q))
      (D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q)
  have hdiff := HY.difference_hasDerivWithinAt HW t ht
  have hx := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt t hdiff
  have hF := (quadratic_hasFDerivAt Bs ((Y t).2 - (W t).2)).comp_hasDerivWithinAt t hx
  have hsym (u v : Lp Z 2 Q) : Bs u v = Bs v u := by
    change ⟪u, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q v⟫_ℝ = ⟪v, D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q u⟫_ℝ
    rw [lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all Q fun ω ↦ (D.sampler_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)
  have he (r : ℝ) : (∫ zz, couplingQuadratic D zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (Y r).2 (W r).2) =
      Bs ((Y r).2 - (W r).2) ((Y r).2 - (W r).2) :=
    samplerPairLaw_cost_integral Q D (Y r).2 (W r).2
  have hv : (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (Y t).1 (W t).1 (couplingQuadratic D) zz
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (Y t).2 (W t).2) =
      2 * Bs ((Y t).2 - (W t).2) (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)).2 := by
    simp_rw [synchronousGenerator_quadratic]
    rw [integral_const_mul, samplerPairLaw_work_integral Q L M H D]
    rfl
  rw [hv]
  convert hF using 1
  · funext r
    exact he r
  · change 2 * Bs ((Y t).2 - (W t).2) (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)).2 =
      Bs ((Y t).2 - (W t).2) (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)).2 +
      Bs (L.field Q (Y t) - L.field Q (W t)).2 ((Y t).2 - (W t).2)
    rw [hsym]
    ring

state_moment_bound.exact_header:
theorem state_moment_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c)
    (x₀ x m : Ω → E) (hx₀ : MemLp x₀ 2 Q) (hm : MemLp m 2 Q)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
    (heq : x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => x₀ ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m ω) :
    (∫ ω, ‖x ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 3 * (∫ ω, ‖x₀ ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) + 3 * c ^ 2 +
      3 * (∫ ω, ‖m ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
state_moment_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem state_moment_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c)
    (x₀ x m : Ω → E) (hx₀ : MemLp x₀ 2 Q) (hm : MemLp m 2 Q)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
    (heq : x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => x₀ ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m ω) :
    (∫ ω, ‖x ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 3 * (∫ ω, ‖x₀ ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) + 3 * c ^ 2 +
      3 * (∫ ω, ‖m ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  have hx := state_memLp Q T b hb c hpaths x₀ x m hx₀ hm t ht heq
  have hxi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hx.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hx
  have hzi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hx₀.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hx₀
  have hmi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hm
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖x ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ‖x₀ ω‖ ^ 2 + 3 * c ^ 2 + 3 * ‖m ω‖ ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, heq] with ω hp he
    have hv := (primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2
    have hn : ‖x ω‖ ≤ ‖x₀ ω‖ + c + ‖m ω‖ := by
      rw [he]
      exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith [norm_add_le (x₀ ω) (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)])
    have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖x₀ ω‖ + c + ‖m ω‖)).mpr hn
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x₀ ω‖ - c), sq_nonneg (‖x₀ ω‖ - ‖m ω‖), sq_nonneg (c - ‖m ω‖)]
  have hi := integral_mono_ae hxi
    (((hzi.const_mul 3).add (integrable_const (3 * c ^ 2))).add (hmi.const_mul 3)) hbound
  change (∫ ω, ‖x ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
    ∫ ω, (3 * ‖x₀ ω‖ ^ 2 + 3 * c ^ 2) + 3 * ‖m ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q at hi
  have he₁ := integral_add ((hzi.const_mul 3).add (integrable_const (3 * c ^ 2))) (hmi.const_mul 3)
  have he₂ := integral_add (hzi.const_mul 3) (integrable_const (3 * c ^ 2))
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at he₁ he₂
  rw [he₁, he₂] at hi
  simp only [integral_const_mul] at hi
  simpa using hi

badGrid.exact_header: def badGrid (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : Set Ω

grid_fourth_integral.exact_header:
theorem grid_fourth_integral (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
      ‖B (uniformTime T N (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N k) ω‖ ^ 4 ∂Q) =
      (N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)
grid_fourth_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_fourth_integral (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
      ‖B (uniformTime T N (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N k) ω‖ ^ 4 ∂Q) =
      (N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2) := by
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => increment_fourth_integrable Q B hB _ _)]
  simp_rw [increment_fourth_moment Q B hB, uniformTime_dist]
  simp

badGrid_real_le.exact_header:
theorem badGrid_real_le (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Q.real (badGrid B T N a) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)) / a ^ 4
badGrid_real_le.exact_declaration:
theorem badGrid_real_le (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Q.real (badGrid B T N a) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)) / a ^ 4 := by
  let V : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
    ‖B (uniformTime T N (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N k) ω‖ ^ 4
  have hV : Integrable V Q := integrable_finsetSum _
    (fun k _ => increment_fourth_integrable Q B hB _ _)
  have hnonneg (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ V ω := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity)
  have hsub : badGrid B T N a ⊆ {ω | a ^ 4 ≤ V ω} := by
    rintro ω ⟨k, hk, he⟩
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le he 4
    apply hp.trans
    change ‖B (uniformTime T N (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N k) ω‖ ^ 4 ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ‖B (uniformTime T N (j + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N j) ω‖ ^ 4
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : ℕ =>
      ‖B (uniformTime T N (j + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T N j) ω‖ ^ 4)
      (fun _ _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnonneg) hV (a ^ 4)
  have he : (∫ ω, V ω ∂Q) = (N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2) :=
    grid_fourth_integral Q B hB T N
  rw [he] at hm
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos ha 4)).mpr
  calc
    Q.real (badGrid B T N a) * a ^ 4 = a ^ 4 * Q.real (badGrid B T N a) := mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ a ^ 4 * Q.real {ω | a ^ 4 ≤ V ω} :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (measureReal_mono hsub) (pow_nonneg ha.le 4)
    _ ≤ _ := hm

include hB in

badGrid_le.exact_header:
theorem badGrid_le (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Q (badGrid B T N a) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)) / a ^ 4)
badGrid_le.exact_declaration:
theorem badGrid_le (T : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Q (badGrid B T N a) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((N : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)) / a ^ 4) := by
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top Q _) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp

decay_nonneg.exact_declaration: theorem decay_nonneg : 0 ≤ decay := by unfold decay; positivity

decay_lt_one.exact_declaration:
theorem decay_lt_one : decay < 1 := by
  rw [decay, root_four]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)
  nlinarith

grid_budget_geometric.exact_header:
theorem grid_budget_geometric (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / (2 ^ n : ℕ)) ^ 2)) /
        radius n ^ 4 = fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * decay ^ n
grid_budget_geometric.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_budget_geometric (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (fourthConstant * ((T : ℝ) / (2 ^ n : ℕ)) ^ 2)) /
        radius n ^ 4 = fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * decay ^ n := by
  have hp : ((root⁻¹) ^ n) ^ 4 = ((root ^ 4) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm n 4, pow_mul, inv_pow, inv_pow]
  simp only [radius, decay, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [hp]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_inv]
  field_simp
  have hc : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n * 2 ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  calc
    _ = (fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * (root ^ 4) ^ n) *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n * 2 ^ n) := by rw [hc]; ring
    _ = _ := by ring

include hB in

badDyadic_summable.exact_header:
theorem badDyadic_summable (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (∑' n, Q (badGrid B T (2 ^ n) (radius n))) < ∞
badDyadic_summable.exact_declaration:
theorem badDyadic_summable (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (∑' n, Q (badGrid B T (2 ^ n) (radius n))) < ∞ := by
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : Q (badGrid B T (2 ^ n) (radius n)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * decay ^ n) := by
    rw [← grid_budget_geometric]
    exact badGrid_le Q B hB T (2 ^ n) (radius n) (radius_pos n)
  have hs : Summable (fun n => fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * decay ^ n) :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one decay_nonneg decay_lt_one).mul_left _
  have hsum : (∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (fourthConstant * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 * decay ^ n)) < ∞ := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun n => mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg fourthConstant_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg decay_nonneg n)) hs]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hbound) hsum

include hB in

ae_eventual_grid_bound.exact_header:
theorem ae_eventual_grid_bound (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ k < 2 ^ n,
      ‖B (uniformTime T (2 ^ n) (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T (2 ^ n) k) ω‖ ≤ radius n
ae_eventual_grid_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_eventual_grid_bound (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ k < 2 ^ n,
      ‖B (uniformTime T (2 ^ n) (k + 1)) ω - B (uniformTime T (2 ^ n) k) ω‖ ≤ radius n := by
  have hc := ae_eventually_notMem (badDyadic_summable Q B hB T).ne
  filter_upwards [hc] with ω hω
  filter_upwards [hω] with n hn
  intro k hk
  exact le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hn ⟨k, hk, h⟩))

scaled.exact_header: def scaled (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
scaled.exact_declaration: def scaled (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := B (T * t.toNNReal) ω

scaled_sample.exact_header:
theorem scaled_sample (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) (N k : ℕ) :
