scaled_sample.exact_declaration:
theorem scaled_sample (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) (N k : ℕ) :
    scaled B T ω ((k : ℝ) / N) = B (uniformTime T N k) ω := by
  have ht : T * ((k : ℝ) / N).toNNReal = uniformTime T N k := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [uniformTime, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_natCast,
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) (Nat.cast_nonneg N))]
    ring
  exact congrArg (fun τ => B τ ω) ht

radius_succ_le.exact_header: theorem radius_succ_le (n : ℕ) : radius (n + 1) ≤ radius n
radius_succ_le.exact_declaration:
theorem radius_succ_le (n : ℕ) : radius (n + 1) ≤ radius n := by
  rw [radius, pow_succ]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr root_pos.le) n)
    ((inv_le_one₀ root_pos).mpr root_gt_one.le)

ae_uniform_polygon_limit.exact_header:
theorem ae_uniform_polygon_limit (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∃ U : C(DyadicInterpolation.UnitWindow, ℝ),
      TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : DyadicInterpolation.UnitWindow) =>
        DyadicInterpolation.dyadicPolygon n (scaled B T ω) t) U atTop
ae_uniform_polygon_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_uniform_polygon_limit (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∃ U : C(DyadicInterpolation.UnitWindow, ℝ),
      TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : DyadicInterpolation.UnitWindow) =>
        DyadicInterpolation.dyadicPolygon n (scaled B T ω) t) U atTop := by
  filter_upwards [ae_eventual_grid_bound Q B hB T] with ω hω
  have hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖scaled B T ω (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        scaled B T ω ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ radius n := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hω
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    intro j hj
    have hb := hN (n + 1) (by omega) j hj
    have he1 := scaled_sample B T ω (2 ^ (n + 1)) (j + 1)
    have he0 := scaled_sample B T ω (2 ^ (n + 1)) j
    simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at he1 he0
    rw [he1, he0]
    exact hb.trans (radius_succ_le n)
  obtain ⟨U, _, hU⟩ := DyadicInterpolation.exists_uniform_dyadic_limit
    (scaled B T ω) radius (fun n => (radius_pos n).le) radius_summable hstep
  exact ⟨U, hU⟩

gaussian_fourth_moment.exact_header:
theorem gaussian_fourth_moment (v : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖x‖ ^ 4 ∂gaussianReal 0 v) = fourthConstant * (v : ℝ) ^ 2
gaussian_fourth_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem gaussian_fourth_moment (v : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖x‖ ^ 4 ∂gaussianReal 0 v) = fourthConstant * (v : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hv : (NNReal.mk ((Real.sqrt (v : ℝ)) ^ 2) (sq_nonneg _) : ℝ≥0) * 1 = v := by
    ext
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mk, mul_one]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt v.coe_nonneg
  have hLaw : HasLaw (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (v : ℝ) * x)
      (gaussianReal 0 v) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have h := gaussianReal_const_mul (HasLaw.id (μ := gaussianReal 0 1)) (Real.sqrt (v : ℝ))
    rw [hv] at h
    simpa only [Function.id_def, mul_zero] using h
  have he := hLaw.integral_comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ‖x‖ ^ 4) (by fun_prop)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), mul_pow] at he
  rw [integral_const_mul] at he
  have hs : Real.sqrt (v : ℝ) ^ 4 = (v : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 * 2 by decide, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt v.coe_nonneg]
  rw [hs] at he
  simpa only [fourthConstant, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm] using he.symm

increment_fourth_integrable.exact_declaration:

  have h := (hB.hasLaw_sub t s).integrable_comp
    ((memLp_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := nndist (t : ℝ) (s : ℝ)) 4).integrable_norm_pow' (p := 4))
  exact h

increment_fourth_moment.exact_header:

increment_fourth_moment.exact_declaration:

      fourthConstant * dist (t : ℝ) (s : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have he := (hB.hasLaw_sub t s).integral_comp (f := fun x : ℝ => ‖x‖ ^ 4) (by fun_prop)
  rw [gaussian_fourth_moment] at he

theorem increment_tail_real (s t : ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :

increment_tail_real.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_tail_real (s t : ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Q.real {ω | a ≤ ‖B t ω - B s ω‖} ≤
      fourthConstant * dist (t : ℝ) (s : ℝ) ^ 2 / a ^ 4 := by
  have hevent : {ω | a ≤ ‖B t ω - B s ω‖} =
      {ω | a ^ 4 ≤ ‖B t ω - B s ω‖ ^ 4} := by
    ext ω
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ ha.le (norm_nonneg _) (by decide : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).symm
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (B t ω - B s ω)) 4))
    (increment_fourth_integrable Q B hB s t) (a ^ 4)
  rw [increment_fourth_moment Q B hB s t, ← hevent] at hm
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos ha 4)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hm)

increment_tail.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_tail (s t : ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :

  have hind := (hB.indepFun_shift s).comp (measurable_pi_apply (t - s)) measurable_id
  rw [brownianFiltration, Filtration.natural_eq_comap]

  rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hst] at hind

    hA.measurable.comap_le

increment_smul_memLp.exact_header:
theorem increment_smul_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) : MemLp (fun ω => increment B s t ω • A ω) 2 Q
increment_smul_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_smul_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) : MemLp (fun ω => increment B s t ω • A ω) 2 Q :=
  independent_smul_memLp Q _ _ (increment_memLp Q B hB s t hst) hA2
    (increment_independent_coefficient Q B hB hBm s t hst A hA)

increment_smul_isometry.exact_header:
theorem increment_smul_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪increment B s t ω • A ω, W (increment B s t ω • A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ((t : ℝ) - s) * (∫ ω, ⟪A ω, W (A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
increment_smul_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_smul_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪increment B s t ω • A ω, W (increment B s t ω • A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ((t : ℝ) - s) * (∫ ω, ⟪A ω, W (A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  have hind := (increment_independent_coefficient Q B hB hBm s t hst A hA).comp
    (show Measurable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) by fun_prop)
    (show Measurable (fun z : Z => ⟪z, W z⟫_ℝ) by fun_prop)
  have hi1 := ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (increment_memLp Q B hB s t hst).aestronglyMeasurable).mp
      (increment_memLp Q B hB s t hst))
  have hi2 := pairing_integrable Q W A A hA2 hA2
  have he := hind.integral_mul_eq_mul_integral
    ((continuous_pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable.comp_aemeasurable
      (increment_hasLaw Q B hB s t hst).aemeasurable) hi2.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at he
  rw [increment_second_moment Q B hB s t hst] at he
  convert he using 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all Q fun ω => by
    simp only [map_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      Function.comp_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
    ring

increment_smul_condExp_zero.exact_header:
theorem increment_smul_condExp_zero (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) :
    Q[(fun ω => increment B s t ω • A ω) | brownianFiltration B hBm s] =ᵐ[Q]
      (0 : Ω → Z)
increment_smul_condExp_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_smul_condExp_zero (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Ω → Z) (hA : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm s] A)
    (hA2 : MemLp A 2 Q) :
    Q[(fun ω => increment B s t ω • A ω) | brownianFiltration B hBm s] =ᵐ[Q]
      (0 : Ω → Z) := by
  let F := brownianFiltration B hBm s
  let G := MeasurableSpace.comap (increment B s t) inferInstance
  have hF : F ≤ mΩ := (brownianFiltration (mΩ := mΩ) B hBm).le s
  have hm : @Measurable Ω ℝ mΩ inferInstance (increment B s t) :=
    (hBm t).sub (hBm s)
  have hG : G ≤ mΩ := hm.comap_le
  have hmeas : StronglyMeasurable[G] (increment B s t) :=
    (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl).stronglyMeasurable
  have hzero := condExp_indep_eq (μ := Q) hG hF hmeas
    (increment_independent_past (mΩ := mΩ) Q B hB hBm s t hst)
  have hzero' : Q[increment B s t | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → ℝ) := by
    change Q[increment B s t | F] =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    simpa only [increment_mean (mΩ := mΩ) Q B hB s t hst] using hzero
  have hp := condExp_smul_of_aestronglyMeasurable_right (mΩ := mΩ)
    ((increment_memLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q B hB s t hst).integrable (by norm_num))
    ((increment_smul_memLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q B hB hBm s t hst A hA hA2).integrable (by norm_num))
    hA.aestronglyMeasurable
  have heqfun : increment B s t • A = (fun ω => increment B s t ω • A ω) := rfl
  rw [heqfun] at hp
  filter_upwards [hp, hzero'] with ω hp hz
  have hz' : Q[increment B s t | brownianFiltration (mΩ := mΩ) B hBm s] ω = 0 := hz
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply'] at hp
  rw [hz', zero_smul] at hp
  exact hp

gridSum.exact_header: def gridSum (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : Z
gridSum.exact_declaration:
def gridSum (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  ∑ k : Fin n, increment B (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) ω • A k ω

gridSum_zero.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ A 0 ω = 0
gridSum_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ A 0 ω = 0 := by simp [gridSum]

gridSum_succ.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ A (n + 1) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω +
      increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω
gridSum_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ A (n + 1) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω +
      increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω := by
  simp only [gridSum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

gridSum_memLp.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) : MemLp (gridSum B τ A n) 2 Q
gridSum_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) : MemLp (gridSum B τ A n) 2 Q := by
  apply memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ
  intro k _
  exact increment_smul_memLp Q B hB hBm _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)) (A k) (hA k) (hA2 k)

gridSum_adapted.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_adapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ n)] (gridSum B τ A n)
gridSum_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_adapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ n)] (gridSum B τ A n) := by
  have hBmeas (k : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (B (τ k)) :=
    Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural (fun t => (hBm t).stronglyMeasurable) (τ k)
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
  intro k _
  have hb1 := (hBmeas (k + 1)).mono
    ((brownianFiltration B hBm).mono (hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.isLt)))
  have hb0 := (hBmeas k).mono
    ((brownianFiltration B hBm).mono (hτ (Nat.le_of_lt k.isLt)))
  have ha := (hA k).mono
    ((brownianFiltration B hBm).mono (hτ (Nat.le_of_lt k.isLt)))
  exact (hb1.sub hb0).smul ha

gridFiltration.exact_header: def gridFiltration (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ
gridFiltration.exact_declaration:
def gridFiltration (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ where
  seq n := brownianFiltration B hBm (τ n)
  mono' _ _ h := (brownianFiltration B hBm).mono (hτ h)
  le' n := (brownianFiltration B hBm).le (τ n)

gridSum_martingale.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) :
    Martingale (gridSum B τ A) (gridFiltration B hBm τ hτ) Q
gridSum_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) :
    Martingale (gridSum B τ A) (gridFiltration B hBm τ hτ) Q := by
  apply martingale_of_condExp_sub_eq_zero_nat
    (show StronglyAdapted (gridFiltration B hBm τ hτ) (gridSum B τ A) from
      gridSum_adapted B hBm τ hτ A hA)
    (fun n => (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).integrable (by norm_num))
  intro n
  have heq : gridSum B τ A (n + 1) - gridSum B τ A n =
      (fun ω => increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, gridSum_succ, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [heq]
  exact increment_smul_condExp_zero Q B hB hBm _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n))
    (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n)

gridSum_isometry.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω, W (gridSum B τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) *
        (∫ ω, ⟪A k ω, W (A k ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
gridSum_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω, W (gridSum B τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) *
        (∫ ω, ⟪A k ω, W (A k ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [gridSum_zero, inner_zero_left, integral_zero,
      Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    let Y : Ω → Z := fun ω => increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω
    have hX2 := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n
    have hY2 := increment_smul_memLp Q B hB hBm _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n))
      (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n)
    have hcross := conditional_zero_pairing Q W (brownianFiltration B hBm (τ n))
      ((brownianFiltration B hBm).le (τ n)) (gridSum B τ A n) Y hX2 hY2
      (gridSum_adapted B hBm τ hτ A hA n).aestronglyMeasurable
      (increment_smul_condExp_zero Q B hB hBm _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n))
        (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n))
    have hpoint : (fun ω => ⟪gridSum B τ A (n + 1) ω, W (gridSum B τ A (n + 1) ω)⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun ω => ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω, W (gridSum B τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ +
          2 * ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ + ⟪Y ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ) := by
      funext ω
      rw [gridSum_succ]
      change ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω + Y ω, W (gridSum B τ A n ω + Y ω)⟫_ℝ = _
      simp only [map_add, inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
      have hs : ⟪Y ω, W (gridSum B τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ =
          ⟪gridSum B τ A n ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ :=
        (real_inner_comm _ _).trans (hW _ _).symm
      rw [hs]
      ring
    have h00 := pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hX2 hX2
    have h01 := (pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hX2 hY2).const_mul 2
    have h11 := pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hY2 hY2
    have hint1 := integral_add (h00.add h01) h11
    have hint2 := integral_add h00 h01
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hint1 hint2
    rw [hpoint, hint1, hint2, integral_const_mul, hcross, mul_zero, add_zero, ih]
    change _ + (∫ ω, ⟪increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω,
      W (increment B (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) ω • A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = _
    rw [increment_smul_isometry Q B hB hBm W _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n),
      Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

gridSum_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * (∫ ω, ‖A k ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
gridSum_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * (∫ ω, ‖A k ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  let hS := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖hS.toLp (gridSum B τ A n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      ∫ ω, ‖gridSum B τ A n ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q :=
    integral_congr_ae (hS.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z : Z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))
  rw [he]
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using
    gridSum_isometry Q B hB hBm (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (fun _ _ => rfl)
      τ hτ A hA hA2 n

gridSum_sub.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ (A - C) n ω = gridSum B τ A n ω - gridSum B τ C n ω
gridSum_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B τ (A - C) n ω = gridSum B τ A n ω - gridSum B τ C n ω := by
  simp only [gridSum, Pi.sub_apply, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

gridSum_distance_sq.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_distance_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A C : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hC : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (C k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (hC2 : ∀ k, MemLp (C k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n) -
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ C hC hC2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ C n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * (∫ ω, ‖A k ω - C k ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
gridSum_distance_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_distance_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A C : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k))
    (hC : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (C k))
    (hA2 : ∀ k, MemLp (A k) 2 Q) (hC2 : ∀ k, MemLp (C k) 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n) -
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ C hC hC2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ C n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * (∫ ω, ‖A k ω - C k ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  let hS := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (A - C)
    (fun k => (hA k).sub (hC k)) (fun k => (hA2 k).sub (hC2 k)) n
  have heq : hS.toLp (gridSum B τ (A - C) n) =
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n) -
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ C hC hC2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ C n) := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hS.coeFn_toLp,
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).coeFn_toLp,
      (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ C hC hC2 n).coeFn_toLp,
      Lp.coeFn_sub
        ((gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ A hA hA2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ A n))
        ((gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ C hC hC2 n).toLp (gridSum B τ C n))]
      with ω hs ha hc hsub
    rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hs, ha, hc]
    exact gridSum_sub B τ A C n ω
  rw [← heq]
  exact gridSum_norm_sq Q B hB hBm τ hτ (A - C)
    (fun k => (hA k).sub (hC k)) (fun k => (hA2 k).sub (hC2 k)) n

gridSum_refine_two.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_refine_two (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (2 * k) = τ k)
    (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B υ (fun k => A (k / 2)) (2 * n) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω
gridSum_refine_two.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_refine_two (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (2 * k) = τ k)
    (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B υ (fun k => A (k / 2)) (2 * n) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mul_zero, gridSum_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = (2 * n + 1) + 1 by omega,
      gridSum_succ, gridSum_succ, ih, gridSum_succ]
    have hn0 : 2 * n / 2 = n := by omega
    have hn1 : (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n := by omega
    simp only [hn0, hn1]
    rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]
    congr 2
    simp only [increment]
    rw [show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) by omega, hυ n, hυ (n + 1)]
    ring

refined_coefficients_adapted.exact_header:
theorem refined_coefficients_adapted (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (2 * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k)) (j : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (υ j)] (A (j / 2))
refined_coefficients_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem refined_coefficients_adapted (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (2 * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (τ k)] (A k)) (j : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm (υ j)] (A (j / 2)) := by
  apply (hA (j / 2)).mono
  apply (brownianFiltration B hBm).mono
  rw [← hυ (j / 2)]
  exact hυmono (by omega)

constant_block_sum.exact_header:
theorem constant_block_sum (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (a d : ℕ) (z : Z) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, increment B (υ (a + j)) (υ (a + j + 1)) ω • z) =
      increment B (υ a) (υ (a + d)) ω • z
constant_block_sum.exact_declaration:
theorem constant_block_sum (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (a d : ℕ) (z : Z) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, increment B (υ (a + j)) (υ (a + j + 1)) ω • z) =
      increment B (υ a) (υ (a + d)) ω • z := by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp [increment]
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, ← add_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [increment, add_assoc]
    ring

gridSum_refine_mul.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_refine_mul (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B υ (fun k => A (k / d)) (d * n) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω
gridSum_refine_mul.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_refine_mul (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → Ω → Z) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum B υ (fun k => A (k / d)) (d * n) ω = gridSum B τ A n ω := by
  have h1 (m : ℕ) : gridSum B υ (fun k => A (k / d)) m ω =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, increment B (υ j) (υ (j + 1)) ω • A (j / d) ω :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => increment B (υ j) (υ (j + 1)) ω • A (j / d) ω) m
  have h2 (m : ℕ) : gridSum B τ A m ω =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, increment B (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) ω • A j ω :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => increment B (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) ω • A j ω) m
  rw [h1, h2]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    congr 1
    have he : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
        increment B (υ (d * n + j)) (υ (d * n + j + 1)) ω • A ((d * n + j) / d) ω) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
          increment B (υ (d * n + j)) (υ (d * n + j + 1)) ω • A n ω := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have hj' := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      rw [Nat.mul_add_div hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hj', add_zero]
    rw [he, constant_block_sum]
    rw [show d * n + d = d * (n + 1) by ring, hυ n, hυ (n + 1)]

import PBGSO.BrownianDriverPathLaw
import PBGSO.DriverPushforward
import PBGSO.NaturalPastTransport

/-! # Actual Brownian drivers on independent initial-state / Wiener paths

The target process is literal path evaluation and its filtration contains
the full joint initial/Brownian past. Brownian and independence properties
are proved by probability pushforward of a genuine filtered driver. The
input map is constructed from the original continuous Brownian modification.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.BrownianPathDriver
open FilteredBrownian BrownianPathSpace
variable {Ω Z I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]




/-- The complete current initial-state / Brownian evaluation vector. -/





variable (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (X : Ω → Z) (hX : Measurable X)

/-- The actual initial variable and entire continuous Brownian path. -/





/-- A genuine Wiener-path driver. Literal coordinate evaluation, the full
joint natural past, and all Brownian fields are derived from primitive data. -/



omit hX

section Canonical
variable (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]


/-- A canonical driver on the literal independent initial-law × Wiener
path probability, constructed without a supplied Brownian-path law. -/



end Canonical

end PBGSO.BrownianPathDriver

Space.exact_declaration: abbrev Space (Z I : Type*) := Z × (I → C(ℝ≥0,ℝ))

probability.exact_header: def probability (μ : Measure Z) : Measure (Space Z I)
probability.exact_declaration:
def probability (μ : Measure Z) : Measure (Space Z I) :=
  μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : I => wiener))

instance_at_28.exact_header:
instance (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (probability (I := I) μ)
instance_at_28.exact_declaration:
instance (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (probability (I := I) μ) := by dsimp [probability]; infer_instance

process.exact_header: def process (t : ℝ≥0) (p : Space Z I) : Z × (I → ℝ)
process.exact_declaration: def process (t : ℝ≥0) (p : Space Z I) : Z × (I → ℝ) := (p.1, fun i => p.2 i t)

process_measurable.exact_header: theorem process_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (process (Z := Z) (I := I) t)
process_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem process_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (process (Z := Z) (I := I) t) := by
  apply measurable_fst.prodMk
  apply measurable_pi_iff.mpr
  intro i
  exact (ContinuousMap.measurable_eval t).comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd)

filtration.exact_header: def filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Space Z I))
filtration.exact_declaration:
def filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Space Z I)) :=
  Filtration.natural (process (Z := Z) (I := I)) (fun t => (process_measurable t).stronglyMeasurable)

coordinate.exact_header: def coordinate (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) (p : Space Z I) : ℝ
coordinate.exact_declaration: def coordinate (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) (p : Space Z I) : ℝ := p.2 i t

coordinate_adapted.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_adapted (i : I) : StronglyAdapted (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I))
    (coordinate i)
coordinate_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_adapted (i : I) : StronglyAdapted (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I))
    (coordinate i) := by
  intro t
  have h := Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural
    (fun r => (process_measurable (Z := Z) (I := I) r).stronglyMeasurable) t
  exact ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd).comp_stronglyMeasurable h

inputMap.exact_header: def inputMap (ω : Ω) : Space Z I

inputMap_measurable.exact_header: theorem inputMap_measurable : Measurable (inputMap Q D X)
inputMap_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem inputMap_measurable : Measurable (inputMap Q D X) :=
  hX.prodMk (vectorPathMap_measurable Q _ (fun i t =>
    (((continuousDriver Q D).adapted i t).mono ((continuousDriver Q D).filtration.le t)).measurable))

inputMap_coordinate_ae.exact_header:
theorem inputMap_coordinate_ae (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (fun ω => coordinate i t (inputMap Q D X ω)) =ᵐ[Q] (continuousDriver Q D).process i t
inputMap_coordinate_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem inputMap_coordinate_ae (i : I) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (fun ω => coordinate i t (inputMap Q D X ω)) =ᵐ[Q] (continuousDriver Q D).process i t := by
  filter_upwards [vectorPathMap_ae Q ((continuousDriver Q D).process)
    (continuousDriver_continuous Q D)] with ω hω
  exact hω i t

inputMap_past.exact_header:
theorem inputMap_past (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MeasurableSpace.comap (inputMap Q D X) (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) t) ≤
      (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)).filtration t
inputMap_past.exact_declaration:
theorem inputMap_past (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MeasurableSpace.comap (inputMap Q D X) (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) t) ≤
      (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)).filtration t := by
  apply natural_comap_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration
    (process (Z := Z) (I := I)) (fun t => (process_measurable t).stronglyMeasurable)
    (inputMap_measurable Q D X hX)
  intro r
  have hB : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration r]
      (fun ω => fun i => (continuousDriver Q D).process i r ω) := by
    apply Measurable.stronglyMeasurable
    exact (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ => ℝ) (D.filtration r) (fun _ => inferInstance)
      (fun ω i => (continuousDriver Q D).process i r ω)).mpr
        (fun i => ((continuousDriver Q D).adapted i r).measurable)
  have hpair := (hXA.mono (D.filtration.mono (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ r from bot_le))).prodMk
    hB.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply hpair.congr
  filter_upwards [vectorPathMap_ae Q ((continuousDriver Q D).process)
    (continuousDriver_continuous Q D)] with ω hω
  change (X ω, fun i => (continuousDriver Q D).process i r ω) =
    (X ω, fun i => vectorPathMap Q ((continuousDriver Q D).process) ω i r)
  congr 1
  exact funext (fun i => (hω i r).symm)

inputMap_preserving.exact_header:
theorem inputMap_preserving (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    MeasurePreserving (inputMap Q D X) Q (probability (I := I) (Q.map X))
inputMap_preserving.exact_declaration:
theorem inputMap_preserving (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    MeasurePreserving (inputMap Q D X) Q (probability (I := I) (Q.map X)) :=
  D.initialPathMap_measurePreserving Q X hX hXA

ofSource.exact_header:
def ofSource (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    Driver (I := I) (probability (I := I) (Q.map X))
ofSource.exact_declaration:
def ofSource (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    Driver (I := I) (probability (I := I) (Q.map X)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map X) := (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
    hX.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  exact pushforwardDriver (inputMap_preserving Q D X hX hXA)
    (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) coordinate filtration coordinate_adapted
    (inputMap_coordinate_ae Q D X hX) (inputMap_past Q D X hX hXA)

ofSource_process.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem ofSource_process (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    (ofSource Q D X hX hXA).process = coordinate
ofSource_process.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem ofSource_process (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    (ofSource Q D X hX hXA).process = coordinate := rfl

ofSource_filtration.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem ofSource_filtration (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    (ofSource Q D X hX hXA).filtration = filtration
ofSource_filtration.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem ofSource_filtration (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) :
    (ofSource Q D X hX hXA).filtration = filtration := rfl

canonical_initial_adapted.exact_header:
theorem canonical_initial_adapted :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ).filtration 0]
      (Prod.fst : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I → Z)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
canonical_initial_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_initial_adapted :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ).filtration 0]
      (Prod.fst : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I → Z)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by
  have h := Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural
    (fun r => (CanonicalInitialFiltration.process_measurable (Z := Z) (I := I) r).stronglyMeasurable)
    (0 : ℝ≥0)
  exact (continuous_fst.comp_stronglyMeasurable h).aestronglyMeasurable

driver.exact_header: def driver : Driver (I := I) (probability (I := I) μ)
driver.exact_declaration:
def driver : Driver (I := I) (probability (I := I) μ) := by
  let R := μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)
  let D := CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ
  let X : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I → Z := Prod.fst
  have hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X R := canonical_initial_adapted μ
  have hf : MeasurePreserving (inputMap R D X) R (probability (I := I) μ) := by
    simpa only [R, X, Measure.map_fst_prod, measure_univ, one_smul] using
      inputMap_preserving R D X measurable_fst hXA
  exact pushforwardDriver hf (nullAugmentedDriver R (continuousDriver R D))
    coordinate filtration coordinate_adapted (inputMap_coordinate_ae R D X measurable_fst)
    (inputMap_past R D X measurable_fst hXA)

driver_process.exact_declaration: @[simp] theorem driver_process : (driver (I := I) μ).process = coordinate := rfl

driver_filtration.exact_declaration: @[simp] theorem driver_filtration : (driver (I := I) μ).filtration = filtration := rfl

bad.exact_header: def bad (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E) : Set Ω
bad.exact_declaration:
def bad (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E) : Set Ω :=
  toMeasurable Q {ω | ¬ Continuous (fun t => B t ω)}

pathMap.exact_header: def pathMap (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E) (ω : Ω) : C(ℝ≥0,E)
pathMap.exact_declaration:
def pathMap (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E) (ω : Ω) : C(ℝ≥0,E) :=
  if h : ω ∈ bad Q B then 0 else
    ⟨fun t => B t ω, by
      by_contra hn
      exact h (subset_toMeasurable Q _ hn)⟩

bad_null.exact_header:
theorem bad_null (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) : Q (bad Q B) = 0
bad_null.exact_declaration:
theorem bad_null (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) : Q (bad Q B) = 0 := by
  rw [bad,measure_toMeasurable]
  exact ae_iff.mp hc

pathMap_measurable.exact_header:
theorem pathMap_measurable (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) : Measurable (pathMap Q B)
pathMap_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem pathMap_measurable (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) : Measurable (pathMap Q B) := by
  apply ContinuousMap.measurable_iff_eval.mpr
  intro t
  have he : (fun ω => pathMap Q B ω t) = (bad Q B).piecewise (fun _ => 0) (B t) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases h : ω ∈ bad Q B
    · simp [pathMap,h]
    · simp [pathMap,h]
  rw [he]
  exact Measurable.piecewise (measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _) measurable_const (hB t)

pathMap_ae.exact_header:
theorem pathMap_ae (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, pathMap Q B ω t = B t ω
pathMap_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem pathMap_ae (Q : Measure Ω) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → E)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, pathMap Q B ω t = B t ω := by
  filter_upwards [(show ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∉ bad Q B from ae_iff.mpr (by simpa using bad_null Q B hc))] with ω hω
  intro t
  simp only [pathMap,dite_eq_right hω,ContinuousMap.coe_mk]

path_comap_eq.exact_header:
theorem path_comap_eq :
    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun f : C(ℝ≥0,E) => fun t => f t)
      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℝ≥0 → E)) =
      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace C(ℝ≥0,E))
path_comap_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem path_comap_eq :
    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun f : C(ℝ≥0,E) => fun t => f t)
      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ℝ≥0 → E)) =
      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace C(ℝ≥0,E)) := by
  rw [MeasurableSpace.pi]
  simp_rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup,MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
  exact ContinuousMap.measurableSpace_eq_iSup_comap_eval.symm

measure_eq_of_raw_map_eq.exact_header:
theorem measure_eq_of_raw_map_eq (μ ν : Measure C(ℝ≥0,E))
    (h : μ.map (fun f => fun t => f t) = ν.map (fun f => fun t => f t)) : μ = ν
measure_eq_of_raw_map_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem measure_eq_of_raw_map_eq (μ ν : Measure C(ℝ≥0,E))
    (h : μ.map (fun f => fun t => f t) = ν.map (fun f => fun t => f t)) : μ = ν := by
  ext s hs
  have hs' : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun f : C(ℝ≥0,E) => fun t => f t) inferInstance] s := by
    exact (congrArg (fun m : MeasurableSpace C(ℝ≥0,E) => @MeasurableSet _ m s)
      (path_comap_eq (E := E))).mpr hs
  obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := hs'
  have hm : Measurable (fun f : C(ℝ≥0,E) => fun t => f t) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => ContinuousMap.measurable_eval t)
  rw [← Measure.map_apply hm hv,← Measure.map_apply hm hv,h]

scalar_raw_law_eq.exact_header:
theorem scalar_raw_law_eq (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B Q) (hC : IsPreBrownianReal C R)
    (hmB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (hmC : ∀ t, Measurable (C t)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => fun t => B t ω) = R.map (fun ω => fun t => C t ω)
scalar_raw_law_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem scalar_raw_law_eq (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B Q) (hC : IsPreBrownianReal C R)
    (hmB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (hmC : ∀ t, Measurable (C t)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => fun t => B t ω) = R.map (fun ω => fun t => C t ω) := by
  have hQ : IsProjectiveLimit (Q.map (fun ω => fun t => B t ω))
      ProbabilityTheory.BrownianReal.projectiveFamily := by
    intro J
    rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (Finset.measurable_restrict _).aemeasurable
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr hmB).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hB.hasLaw J).map_eq
  have hR : IsProjectiveLimit (R.map (fun ω => fun t => C t ω))
      ProbabilityTheory.BrownianReal.projectiveFamily := by
    intro J
    rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (Finset.measurable_restrict _).aemeasurable
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr hmC).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hC.hasLaw J).map_eq
  exact hQ.unique hR

scalar_path_law_eq.exact_header:
theorem scalar_path_law_eq (hB : IsBrownianReal B Q) (hC : IsBrownianReal C R)
    (hmB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (hmC : ∀ t, Measurable (C t)) :
    Q.map (pathMap Q B) = R.map (pathMap R C)
scalar_path_law_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem scalar_path_law_eq (hB : IsBrownianReal B Q) (hC : IsBrownianReal C R)
    (hmB : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (hmC : ∀ t, Measurable (C t)) :
    Q.map (pathMap Q B) = R.map (pathMap R C) := by
  apply measure_eq_of_raw_map_eq
  rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => ContinuousMap.measurable_eval t))
      (pathMap_measurable Q B hmB),
    Measure.map_map (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => ContinuousMap.measurable_eval t))
      (pathMap_measurable R C hmC)]

independent_pair_vectors.exact_header:
theorem independent_pair_vectors
    (X : I → Ω → E) (Y : I → Ω → F)
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) Q) (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) Q)
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (X i ω, Y i ω)) Q)
    (hxy : ∀ i, IndepFun (X i) (Y i) Q) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i => X i ω) (fun ω i => Y i ω) Q
independent_pair_vectors.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_pair_vectors
    (X : I → Ω → E) (Y : I → Ω → F)
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) Q) (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) Q)
    (hpairs : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (X i ω, Y i ω)) Q)
    (hxy : ∀ i, IndepFun (X i) (Y i) Q) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i => X i ω) (fun ω i => Y i ω) Q := by
  have hxind : iIndepFun X Q := hpairs.comp (fun _ p => p.1) (fun _ => measurable_fst)
  have hyind : iIndepFun Y Q := hpairs.comp (fun _ p => p.2) (fun _ => measurable_snd)
  apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (.of_eval hX) (.of_eval hY)).2
  rw [hxind.map_fun_eq_pi_map hX, hyind.map_fun_eq_pi_map hY]
  let rearrange := MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow E F I
  have hrep : Q.map (fun ω => ((fun i => X i ω), fun i => Y i ω)) =
      (Q.map (fun ω i => (X i ω, Y i ω))).map rearrange := by
    exact (AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable rearrange.measurable.aemeasurable
      (.of_eval fun i => (hX i).prodMk (hY i))).symm
  rw [hrep, hpairs.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hX i).prodMk (hY i))]
  simp_rw [(hxy _).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hX _) (hY _)]
  exact (measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow E F I
    (fun i => Q.map (X i)) (fun i => Q.map (Y i))).map_eq

brownian_vector_future_past_independent.exact_header:
theorem brownian_vector_future_past_independent
    (hpm : ∀ i, Measurable (fun ω t => W i t ω))
    (hpaths : iIndepFun (fun i ω t => W i t ω) Q) (s : ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i t => W i (s + t) ω - W i s ω)
      (fun ω i (t : Set.Iic s) => W i t ω) Q
brownian_vector_future_past_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem brownian_vector_future_past_independent
    (hpm : ∀ i, Measurable (fun ω t => W i t ω))
    (hpaths : iIndepFun (fun i ω t => W i t ω) Q) (s : ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i t => W i (s + t) ω - W i s ω)
      (fun ω i (t : Set.Iic s) => W i t ω) Q := by
  apply independent_pair_vectors Q
  · intro i
    exact (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t => ((measurable_pi_apply (s + t)).comp (hpm i)).sub
      ((measurable_pi_apply s).comp (hpm i))).aemeasurable
  · intro i
    exact (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t : Set.Iic s =>
      (measurable_pi_apply (t : ℝ≥0)).comp (hpm i)).aemeasurable
  · exact hpaths.comp (fun _ p => ((fun t => p (s + t) - p s), fun (t : Set.Iic s) => p t))
      (fun _ => (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t => (measurable_pi_apply (s + t)).sub
        (measurable_pi_apply s)).prodMk
          (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t : Set.Iic s => measurable_pi_apply (t : ℝ≥0)))
  · intro i
    exact (hW i).indepFun_shift s

independent_future_with_initial.exact_header:
theorem independent_future_with_initial
    (X : Ω → E) (Y : Ω → F) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hxy : IndepFun X Y Q) :
    IndepFun (fun p : Z × Ω => X p.2) (fun p : Z × Ω => (p.1, Y p.2)) (μ.prod Q)
independent_future_with_initial.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_future_with_initial
    (X : Ω → E) (Y : Ω → F) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hxy : IndepFun X Y Q) :
    IndepFun (fun p : Z × Ω => X p.2) (fun p : Z × Ω => (p.1, Y p.2)) (μ.prod Q) := by
  let νX := Q.map X
  let νY := Q.map Y
  have hpair : MeasurePreserving (fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) Q (νX.prod νY) :=
    ⟨hX.prodMk hY, hxy.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable⟩
  have h0 := (MeasurePreserving.id μ).prod hpair
  have h1 := (measurePreserving_prodAssoc μ νX νY).symm MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc
  have h2 := (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := μ) (ν := νX)).prod (MeasurePreserving.id νY)
  have h3 := measurePreserving_prodAssoc νX μ νY
  have hall : MeasurePreserving
      (fun p : Z × Ω => (X p.2, p.1, Y p.2)) (μ.prod Q) (νX.prod (μ.prod νY)) :=
    h3.comp (h2.comp (h1.comp h0))
  apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (hX.comp measurable_snd).aemeasurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hY.comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable).2
  change (μ.prod Q).map (fun p => (X p.2, p.1, Y p.2)) =
    ((μ.prod Q).map (fun p => X p.2)).prod
      ((μ.prod Q).map (fun p => (p.1, Y p.2)))
  have hx : MeasurePreserving (fun p : Z × Ω => X p.2) (μ.prod Q) νX :=
    (measurePreserving_fst (μ := νX) (ν := μ.prod νY)).comp hall
  have hy : MeasurePreserving (fun p : Z × Ω => (p.1, Y p.2)) (μ.prod Q) (μ.prod νY) :=
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := νX) (ν := μ.prod νY)).comp hall
  rw [hall.map_eq, hx.map_eq, hy.map_eq]

independent_pullback.exact_header:
theorem independent_pullback {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q R)
    (X : Ω' → E) (Y : Ω' → F) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hxy : IndepFun X Y R) : IndepFun (X ∘ f) (Y ∘ f) Q
independent_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_pullback {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q R)
    (X : Ω' → E) (Y : Ω' → F) (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
    (hxy : IndepFun X Y R) : IndepFun (X ∘ f) (Y ∘ f) Q := by
  apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (hX.comp hf.measurable).aemeasurable (hY.comp hf.measurable).aemeasurable).2
  have hx : Q.map (X ∘ f) = R.map X := by rw [← Measure.map_map hX hf.measurable, hf.map_eq]
  have hy : Q.map (Y ∘ f) = R.map Y := by rw [← Measure.map_map hY hf.measurable, hf.map_eq]
  rw [hx, hy, ← hxy.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable]
  change Q.map ((fun ω => (X ω, Y ω)) ∘ f) = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map (hX.prodMk hY) hf.measurable, hf.map_eq]

canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_i.exact_header:
theorem canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_independent (s : ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I => fun i t =>
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (s + t) p.2 - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
        (p.1, fun i (t : Set.Iic s) => ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t p.2))
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_i.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_independent (s : ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I => fun i t =>
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (s + t) p.2 - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
        (p.1, fun i (t : Set.Iic s) => ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t p.2))
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by
  apply independent_future_with_initial (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I) μ
    (fun ω i t => ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (s + t) ω -
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s ω)
    (fun ω i (t : Set.Iic s) => ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t ω)
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t =>
      ((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable (s + t)).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)).sub
        ((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable s).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i => measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun t : Set.Iic s =>
      (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable t).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  · exact canonical_brownian_vector_future_past_independent I s

process_measurable.exact_header: theorem process_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (process (Z := Z) (I := I) t)
process_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem process_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (process (Z := Z) (I := I) t) :=
  measurable_fst.prodMk (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i =>
    ((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable t).comp
      (measurable_pi_apply i : Measurable (fun ω : ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I => ω i))).comp
        (measurable_snd : Measurable (Prod.snd : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I → _)))

increment_independent_past.exact_header:
theorem increment_independent_past (i : I) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t p.2 - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
      inferInstance) (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) s)
        (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
increment_independent_past.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_independent_past (i : I) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t p.2 - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
      inferInstance) (filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) s)
        (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by
  have hi := (canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_independent (I := I) μ s).comp
    ((measurable_pi_apply (t - s)).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun u : Iic s => measurable_fst.prodMk
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j =>
        ((measurable_pi_apply u).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)).comp measurable_snd))
  rw [filtration, Filtration.natural_eq_comap]
  change IndepFun (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t p.2 - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
    (fun p (u : Iic s) => process u p) _
  change IndepFun (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I =>
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (s + (t - s)) p.2 -
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
    (fun p (u : Iic s) => process u p) _ at hi
  rwa [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hst] at hi

columns_inner.exact_header:
theorem columns_inner (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (i j : ℕ) (a b : R) :
    ⟪column (τ i) (τ (i + 1)) a, column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) b⟫_ℝ =
      if i = j then ((τ (i + 1) : ℝ) - τ i) * ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ else 0
columns_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem columns_inner (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (i j : ℕ) (a b : R) :
    ⟪column (τ i) (τ (i + 1)) a, column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) b⟫_ℝ =
      if i = j then ((τ (i + 1) : ℝ) - τ i) * ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ else 0 := by
  rw [column_inner]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, Set.inter_self]
    simp only [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (show (τ i : ℝ) ≤ τ (i + 1) from hτ (Nat.le_succ i)))]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
    have hd : Disjoint (Ioc (τ i : ℝ) (τ (i + 1))) (Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1))) := by
      apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      obtain h | h := lt_or_gt_of_ne hij
      · have hh : (τ (i + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ j := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (hx.2.trans hh)) hy.1
      · have hh : (τ (j + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ i := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (hy.2.trans hh)) hx.1
    rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hd]
    simp

column_postmap.exact_header:
theorem column_postmap (W : R →L[ℝ] R) (s t : ℝ) (a : R) :
    W.compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (column s t a) = column s t (W a)
column_postmap.exact_declaration:
theorem column_postmap (W : R →L[ℝ] R) (s t : ℝ) (a : R) :
    W.compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (column s t a) = column s t (W a) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [W.coeFn_compLpL (column s t a),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp)
      (c := a) (s := Ioc s t),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp)
      (c := W a) (s := Ioc s t)] with r hw h1 h2
  rw [hw]
  change column s t a r = _ at h1
  change column s t (W a) r = _ at h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero]

theorem stochasticStep_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    weightedPairing Q W (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n)
      (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n) =
    ⟪coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n,
      (W.compLpL 2 Q).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n)⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  let hS := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (A k).value)
    (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n
  have he : (∫ ω, ⟪stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n ω,
      W (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪gridSum B τ (fun k => (A k).value) n ω,
        W (gridSum B τ (fun k => (A k).value) n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hS.coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
    change ⟪hS.toLp _ ω, W (hS.toLp _ ω)⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [hω]
  rw [he, gridSum_isometry Q B hB hBm W hW τ hτ
    (fun k => (A k).value) (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n,
    coefficientStep, TimeGridEnergy.grid_weighted (W.compLpL 2 Q) τ hτ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  rw [lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(A k).square.coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
  change ⟪(A k).value ω, W ((A k).value ω)⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪(A k).square.toLp _ ω, W ((A k).square.toLp _ ω)⟫_ℝ
  rw [hω]

    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)

    (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (I : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q B hBm (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hI : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q B hB hBm (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))

theorem stochasticIntegral_limit_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (I : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q B hBm (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hI : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q B hB hBm (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 I)) :
    weightedPairing Q W I I = ⟪u, (W.compLpL 2 Q).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) u⟫_ℝ := by

def domainSub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G) :
    IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G := by
  refine ⟨u.val - v.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := v.property
  refine ⟨fun n => subtract Q B hBm (G.time n) (A n) (C n), ?_⟩

theorem stochasticIntegral_sub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G) :

stochasticIntegral_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_sub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q B hB hBm G (domainSub Q B hBm G u v) =
      stochasticIntegral Q B hB hBm G u - stochasticIntegral Q B hB hBm G v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := v.property
  have hsub := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q B hB hBm G (domainSub Q B hBm G u v)
    (fun n => subtract Q B hBm (G.time n) (A n) (C n))
    ((hA.sub hC).congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
      (coefficientStep_sub Q B hBm (G.time n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n)).symm)))
  have hdiff := (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q B hB hBm G u A hA).sub
    (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q B hB hBm G v C hC)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hsub (hdiff.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
    (stochasticStep_sub Q B hB hBm (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n)).symm)))

timeCut_sub.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_sub (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    timeCut Q u 0 t - timeCut Q u 0 s = timeCut Q u s t
timeCut_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_sub (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    timeCut Q u 0 t - timeCut Q u 0 s = timeCut Q u s t := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (timeCut Q u 0 t) (timeCut Q u 0 s),
    timeCut_coe Q u 0 t, timeCut_coe Q u 0 s, timeCut_coe Q u s t] with r hsub ht' hs' hst'
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, ht', hs', hst']
  by_cases hr0 : r ≤ 0
  · have hrs : r ≤ s := hr0.trans hs
    simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, not_lt.mpr hr0, not_lt.mpr hrs]
  · have h0r : 0 < r := lt_of_not_ge hr0
    by_cases hrs : r ≤ s
    · have hrt : r ≤ t := hrs.trans hst
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, h0r, hrs, hrt, not_lt.mpr hrs]
    · have hsr : s < r := lt_of_not_ge hrs
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, h0r, hsr, hrs]

timeCut_weighted.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    ⟪timeCut Q u s t, (W.compLpL 2 Q).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (timeCut Q u s t)⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, weightedPairing Q W (u r) (u r)
timeCut_weighted.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    ⟪timeCut Q u s t, (W.compLpL 2 Q).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (timeCut Q u s t)⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, weightedPairing Q W (u r) (u r) := by
  rw [L2.inner_def, ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(W.compLpL 2 Q).coeFn_compLpL (timeCut Q u s t), timeCut_coe Q u s t]
    with r hw hcut
  rw [hw, hcut]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, weightedPairing_apply]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero, inner_zero_left]

theorem stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)

    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (Us Ut : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G)
    (hUs : Us.val = timeCut Q u 0 s) (hUt : Ut.val = timeCut Q u 0 t) :

theorem stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (u : Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (Us Ut : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q B hBm G)
    (hUs : Us.val = timeCut Q u 0 s) (hUt : Ut.val = timeCut Q u 0 t) :

increment_coordinates_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_coordinates_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    iIndepFun (fun (i : I) (p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I) ↦
      coordinate i t p - coordinate i s p) (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I
  let X := fun i (ω : ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I) ↦
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i t ω - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s ω
  have hX (i : I) : HasLaw (X i) (R.map (X i)) R :=
    ⟨(((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable t).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)).sub
      ((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.process_measurable s).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))).aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hi : iIndepFun X R := (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_paths_independent I).comp
    (fun _ p ↦ p t - p s) (fun _ ↦ (measurable_pi_apply t).sub (measurable_pi_apply s))
  have hfull := (hi.hasLaw_pi hX).comp
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R)).hasLaw
  exact (iIndepFun_iff_hasLaw_pi_pi (fun i ↦ (hX i).comp
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R)).hasLaw)).mpr hfull

theorem future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ fun i ↦ coordinate i t p - coordinate i s p)
      inferInstance) (CanonicalInitialFiltration.filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) s)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
future_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ fun i ↦ coordinate i t p - coordinate i s p)
      inferInstance) (CanonicalInitialFiltration.filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) s)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by
  have hi := (canonical_brownian_future_initial_past_independent (I := I) μ s).comp
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i ↦ (measurable_pi_apply (t - s)).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun u : Iic s ↦ measurable_fst.prodMk
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j ↦
        ((measurable_pi_apply u).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)).comp measurable_snd))
  rw [CanonicalInitialFiltration.filtration, Filtration.natural_eq_comap]
  change IndepFun (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ fun i ↦
    coordinate i t p - coordinate i s p)
    (fun p (u : Iic s) ↦ CanonicalInitialFiltration.process u p) _
  change IndepFun (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ fun i ↦
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (s + (t - s)) p.2 -
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i s p.2)
    (fun p (u : Iic s) ↦ CanonicalInitialFiltration.process u p) _ at hi
  rwa [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hst] at hi

def driver : FilteredBrownian.Driver (I := I) (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) where

matrixAction.exact_header: def matrixAction (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n
matrixAction.exact_declaration:
def matrixAction (A : Matrix n n ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ n :=
  (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).toContinuousLinearMap

matrixAction_inner.exact_header:
theorem matrixAction_inner (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ⟪x, matrixAction A y⟫_ℝ = (fun i => x i) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (fun i => y i))
matrixAction_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem matrixAction_inner (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ⟪x, matrixAction A y⟫_ℝ = (fun i => x i) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (fun i => y i)) := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  change (A *ᵥ (fun i => y i)) ⬝ᵥ (fun i => x i) = _
  exact dotProduct_comm _ _

euclidean_dot_self.exact_header:
theorem euclidean_dot_self (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    (fun i => x i) ⬝ᵥ (fun i => x i) = ‖x‖ ^ 2
euclidean_dot_self.exact_declaration:
theorem euclidean_dot_self (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    (fun i => x i) ⬝ᵥ (fun i => x i) = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
  simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, star_trivial] using
    (real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq x)

matrixAction_lower.exact_header:
theorem matrixAction_lower {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, matrixAction A x⟫_ℝ
matrixAction_lower.exact_declaration:
theorem matrixAction_lower {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪x, matrixAction A x⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [matrixAction_inner, ← euclidean_dot_self]
  exact minimumEigenvalue_quadratic hA.isHermitian _

matrixAction_upper.exact_header:
theorem matrixAction_upper (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ⟪x, matrixAction A x⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖matrixAction A‖ * ‖x‖ ^ 2
matrixAction_upper.exact_declaration:
theorem matrixAction_upper (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ⟪x, matrixAction A x⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖matrixAction A‖ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖matrixAction A x‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ * (‖matrixAction A‖ * ‖x‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((matrixAction A).le_opNorm x) (norm_nonneg x)
    _ = _ := by ring

matrixGeometry.exact_declaration:
def matrixGeometry (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (B : Matrix m m ℝ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    TwistedGeometry (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (EuclideanSpace ℝ m) where
  optimizerWeight := matrixAction A
  samplerWeight := matrixAction B
  lower := min (minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian) (minimumEigenvalue hB.isHermitian)
  upper := min (minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian) (minimumEigenvalue hB.isHermitian) +
    ‖matrixAction A‖ + ‖matrixAction B‖
  lower_pos := lt_min (minimumEigenvalue_pos hA) (minimumEigenvalue_pos hB)
  lower_le_upper := by linarith [norm_nonneg (matrixAction A), norm_nonneg (matrixAction B)]
  optimizer_symmetric := by
    intro x y
    exact (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA.isHermitian x y).symm
  sampler_symmetric := by
    intro x y
    exact (Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hB.isHermitian x y).symm
  optimizer_lower := fun x =>
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)).trans (matrixAction_lower hA x)
  sampler_lower := fun x =>
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)).trans (matrixAction_lower hB x)
  optimizer_upper := by
    intro x
    have hp := lt_min (minimumEigenvalue_pos hA) (minimumEigenvalue_pos hB)
    have hc : ‖matrixAction A‖ ≤
        min (minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian) (minimumEigenvalue hB.isHermitian) +
          ‖matrixAction A‖ + ‖matrixAction B‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (matrixAction B)]
    exact (matrixAction_upper A x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg ‖x‖))
  sampler_upper := by
    intro x
    have hp := lt_min (minimumEigenvalue_pos hA) (minimumEigenvalue_pos hB)
    have hc : ‖matrixAction B‖ ≤
        min (minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian) (minimumEigenvalue hB.isHermitian) +
          ‖matrixAction A‖ + ‖matrixAction B‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (matrixAction A)]
    exact (matrixAction_upper B x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg ‖x‖))

@[simp] theorem inner_isometry_symm_right (e : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : S) (y : E) :

inner_isometry_symm_left.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem inner_isometry_symm_left (e : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : S) (y : E) :

inner_isometry_symm_left.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem inner_isometry_symm_left (e : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : S) (y : E) :

def transportGeometry (D : TwistedGeometry E F)
    (e : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) : TwistedGeometry S Z
transportGeometry.exact_declaration:
def transportGeometry (D : TwistedGeometry E F)
    (e : S ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (f : Z ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) : TwistedGeometry S Z where
  optimizerWeight := e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L
    D.optimizerWeight ∘L e.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  samplerWeight := f.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L
    D.samplerWeight ∘L f.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap
  lower := D.lower
  upper := D.upper
  lower_pos := D.lower_pos
  lower_le_upper := D.lower_le_upper
  optimizer_symmetric := by
    intro x y
    simpa using D.optimizer_symmetric (e x) (e y)
  sampler_symmetric := by
    intro x y
    simpa using D.sampler_symmetric (f x) (f y)
  optimizer_lower := by
    intro x
    simpa using D.optimizer_lower (e x)
  optimizer_upper := by
    intro x
    simpa using D.optimizer_upper (e x)
  sampler_lower := by
    intro x
    simpa using D.sampler_lower (f x)
  sampler_upper := by

blockK.exact_header: def blockK (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ
blockK.exact_declaration:
def blockK (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (c • (1 : Matrix a a ℝ)) 0 0 A

blockK_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem blockK_quadratic (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (q : a → ℝ) (p : u → ℝ) :
    Sum.elim q p ⬝ᵥ (blockK c A *ᵥ Sum.elim q p) =
      c * (q ⬝ᵥ q) + p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ p)
blockK_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem blockK_quadratic (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (q : a → ℝ) (p : u → ℝ) :
    Sum.elim q p ⬝ᵥ (blockK c A *ᵥ Sum.elim q p) =
      c * (q ⬝ᵥ q) + p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ p) := by
  simp [blockK, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

blockK_posDef.exact_header:
theorem blockK_posDef (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (blockK (a := a) c A).PosDef
blockK_posDef.exact_declaration:
theorem blockK_posDef (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (blockK (a := a) c A).PosDef := by
  have hI : (c • (1 : Matrix a a ℝ)).PosDef := Matrix.PosDef.one.smul hc
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    (hI.isHermitian.fromBlocks (by simp) hA.isHermitian)
  intro z hz
  change 0 < star z ⬝ᵥ (blockK (a := a) c A *ᵥ z)
  have heq : z = Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr) := by ext (i | j) <;> rfl
  rw [star_trivial, heq, blockK_quadratic]
  by_cases hp : (z ∘ Sum.inr) = 0
  · have hq : (z ∘ Sum.inl) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq
      apply hz
      rw [heq, hp, hq]
      ext (i | j) <;> rfl
    have hpos := (Matrix.PosDef.one : (1 : Matrix a a ℝ).PosDef).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hq
    simpa only [star_trivial, Matrix.one_mulVec, hp, Matrix.mulVec_zero, dotProduct_zero,
      add_zero] using mul_pos hc hpos
  · have hq := (Matrix.PosSemidef.one : (1 : Matrix a a ℝ).PosSemidef).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      (z ∘ Sum.inl)
    have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hp
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hq hpos
    exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (mul_nonneg hc.le hq) hpos

blockK_coordinate_form.exact_header:
theorem blockK_coordinate_form (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (z : BlockSpace a u) :
    blockCoordinates z ⬝ᵥ (blockK c A *ᵥ blockCoordinates z) =
      c * ‖z.fst‖ ^ 2 + ⟪z.snd, matrixAction A z.snd⟫_ℝ
blockK_coordinate_form.exact_declaration:
theorem blockK_coordinate_form (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix u u ℝ) (z : BlockSpace a u) :
    blockCoordinates z ⬝ᵥ (blockK c A *ᵥ blockCoordinates z) =
      c * ‖z.fst‖ ^ 2 + ⟪z.snd, matrixAction A z.snd⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [blockCoordinates_apply, blockK_quadratic, euclidean_dot_self, matrixAction_inner]

theorem canonicalGeometry_optimizer_form (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ)

canonicalGeometry_optimizer_form.exact_declaration:
theorem canonicalGeometry_optimizer_form (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ)

theorem canonical_projected_source_criterion
    (M : Model (BlockSpace a u) (EuclideanSpace ℝ a) (BlockSpace x v) (EuclideanSpace ℝ x) I)
    (hparameter : M.parameter = WithLp.fst) (hposition : M.position = WithLp.fst)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ a → EuclideanSpace ℝ x → EuclideanSpace ℝ x)
    (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ) (DSam : Matrix (x ⊕ v) (x ⊕ v) ℝ)
    (Dm : Matrix u u ℝ) (Dv : Matrix v v ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hDm : Dm.PosDef) (hDv : Dv.PosDef)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam)
    (hmono : (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv) β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → BlockSpace x v) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
      ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) s s' ν ν' Λ →
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).Integrability s s' Λ) :
    let ρ := min
      (generalizedMinimum hDOpt (blockK_posDef (a := a) _ hc Dm hDm))
      (generalizedMinimum hDSam (blockK_posDef (a := x) _ hc Dv hDv))
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) ρ
canonical_projected_source_criterion.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_projected_source_criterion
    (M : Model (BlockSpace a u) (EuclideanSpace ℝ a) (BlockSpace x v) (EuclideanSpace ℝ x) I)
    (hparameter : M.parameter = WithLp.fst) (hposition : M.position = WithLp.fst)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ a → EuclideanSpace ℝ x → EuclideanSpace ℝ x)
    (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ) (DSam : Matrix (x ⊕ v) (x ⊕ v) ℝ)
    (Dm : Matrix u u ℝ) (Dv : Matrix v v ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hDm : Dm.PosDef) (hDv : Dv.PosDef)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam)
    (hmono : (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv) β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → BlockSpace x v) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
      ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) s s' ν ν' Λ →
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).Integrability s s' Λ) :
    let ρ := min
      (generalizedMinimum hDOpt (blockK_posDef (a := a) _ hc Dm hDm))
      (generalizedMinimum hDSam (blockK_posDef (a := x) _ hc Dv hDv))
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) ρ := by
  apply projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_spectral M
    (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv)
    β r AOpt ASam hβ hmono haux σ hσ hInt DOpt (blockK _ Dm) DSam (blockK _ Dv)
    hDOpt (blockK_posDef _ hc Dm hDm) hDSam (blockK_posDef _ hc Dv hDv)
    blockCoordinates blockCoordinates
  · exact canonicalGeometry_optimizer_form DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam
  · exact canonicalGeometry_sampler_form DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam
  · intro d
    simpa only [canonicalData, ProjectedData.optimizerAuxSq, WithLp.fstL_apply,
      WithLp.sndL_apply] using blockK_coordinate_form (β * r - AOpt - ASam) Dm d
  · intro zz
    simpa only [canonicalData, ProjectedData.samplerAuxSq, WithLp.fstL_apply,
      WithLp.sndL_apply] using blockK_coordinate_form (β * r - AOpt - ASam) Dv (zz.1 - zz.2)

import PBGSO.ProductLpSections
import PBGSO.CanonicalBrownianDriver

/-! # Separable canonical initial/Brownian sample measures
The isonormal Brownian source uses an actual Hilbert basis of scalar time L².
That basis is countable, derived from separability rather than postulated.
Consequently all finite-coordinate initial/noise sample spaces are countably
generated, and their actual probability measures are separable.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.CanonicalSeparable


/-- Canonical scalar samples are countably generated because their actual
isonormal Gaussian coordinate index is countable. -/

/-- No separable-measure assumption is needed on actual finite-vector
canonical Brownian probability: it is proved from its constructed sample space. -/

/-- The actual random-initial/full-vector Brownian probability is separable. -/

end PBGSO.CanonicalSeparable

basisIndex_countable.exact_declaration:
instance basisIndex_countable : Countable ULA.CanonicalBrownian.basisIndex := by
  letI : Fact ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  let e := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.basis
  have horth := e.orthonormal
  have hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Metric.ball (e i) (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Metric.ball (e j) (1 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Metric.ball_disjoint_ball
    have hn : ‖e i - e j‖ ^ 2 = 2 := by
      rw [norm_sub_sq_real, horth.norm_eq_one, horth.norm_eq_one,
        horth.inner_eq_zero hij]
      norm_num
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (e i - e j)]
  exact hd.countable_of_isOpen_disjoint (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    (fun i => ⟨e i, by simp⟩)

    [TopologicalSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Countable I]
    (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    IsSeparable (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
initial_vector_isSeparable.exact_declaration:
theorem initial_vector_isSeparable {Z I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Countable I]
    (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    IsSeparable (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) := by infer_instance
