PBGSO/ClosedDomainCuts.lean.scope_note: No extra adaptedness, time continuity or approximation sequence is required of the closed-domain member. These are deterministic domain identities used to construct one consistent stochastic integral process.
PBGSO/ClosedDomainCuts.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.PredictableStepDensity

/-! # Interval stability of the literal closed predictable-step domain -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)

/-- Literal finite predictable time steps are measurable with respect to every
later past. This is proved from the actual coefficient representatives. -/

/-- Literal interval masks preserve past adaptedness without pointwise time
regularity or a boundedness assumption. -/

/-- Nested masks intersect their deterministic intervals. -/

/-- An actual finite step supported in the fixed horizon is unchanged by
horizon restriction. Endpoint values are harmless time-null choices. -/

/-- Cutting an actual finite predictable step stays in the completed domain;
the new observation endpoints need not be dyadic grid points. -/

/-- Every interval cut preserves the literal closed predictable-step domain.
This follows from actual finite-step density and the norm-one indicator map. -/

/-- The actual completed-domain entry for an arbitrary deterministic interval. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

coefficientStep_pastAdapted.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_pastAdapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    PastAdaptedColumns Q D (coefficientStep Q D τ A n)
coefficientStep_pastAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_pastAdapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    PastAdaptedColumns Q D (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) := by
  apply pastAdaptedColumns_congr Q D
    (TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) n)
    (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) (TimeGridContinuity.grid_coe τ _ n).symm
  intro i t
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro r hrt
  change AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t]
    ((TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) n r).ofLp i) Q
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc (τ 0 : ℝ) (τ n)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_interval τ hτ n r hr
    rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_eq τ hτ _ n k r hk]
    have hkt : τ k ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hk.1.le.trans hrt
    have hm := ((A k).adapted i).mono (D.filtration.mono hkt)
    exact hm.aestronglyMeasurable.congr ((A k).square i).coeFn_toLp.symm
  · rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_zero_outside τ hτ _ n r hr]
    exact aestronglyMeasurable_zero.congr (Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q).symm

timeCut_pastAdapted.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_pastAdapted
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) (s t : ℝ) :
    PastAdaptedColumns Q D (timeCut Q U s t)
timeCut_pastAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_pastAdapted
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) (s t : ℝ) :
    PastAdaptedColumns Q D (timeCut Q U s t) := by
  intro i r
  filter_upwards [hU i r, timeCut_coe Q U s t] with a ha hcut har
  rw [hcut]
  by_cases ham : a ∈ Ioc s t
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ham]
    exact ha har
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ham]
    exact aestronglyMeasurable_zero.congr (Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q).symm

timeCut_commute.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_commute
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (a b s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeCut Q U a b) s t = timeCut Q (timeCut Q U s t) a b
timeCut_commute.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_commute
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (a b s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeCut Q U a b) s t = timeCut Q (timeCut Q U s t) a b := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (timeCut Q U a b) s t,
    timeCut_coe Q (timeCut Q U s t) a b, timeCut_coe Q U a b,
    timeCut_coe Q U s t] with r h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [h1, h2]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc a b <;> by_cases hs : r ∈ Ioc s t
  all_goals simp only [Set.indicator, hr, hs, ite_true, ite_false] at h3 h4 ⊢
  all_goals simp_all only []

coefficientStep_horizon.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n)) :
    timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n) A ((dyadicGrids T).count n))
      0 T = coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n) A ((dyadicGrids T).count n)
coefficientStep_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n)) :
    timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n) A ((dyadicGrids T).count n))
      0 T = coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n) A ((dyadicGrids T).count n) := by
  let G := dyadicGrids T
  have hz : G.time n 0 = 0 := by simp [G, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids]
  have he : G.time n (G.count n) = T := by
    simp only [G, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hp : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) A (G.count n)) 0 T,
    TimeGridContinuity.grid_coe (G.time n) (fun k => (A k).toLp) (G.count n)]
    with r hc hg
  change (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) A (G.count n)) r = _ at hg
  change (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) A (G.count n)) 0 T) r =
    (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) A (G.count n)) r
  rw [hc]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hr _
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, hg]
    exact (TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_zero_outside (G.time n) (G.monotone n) _
      (G.count n) r (by simpa only [hz, he, NNReal.coe_zero] using hr)).symm

finiteStep_timeCut_mem.exact_header:
theorem finiteStep_timeCut_mem (T : ℝ≥0)
    (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) A) s t ∈
      closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)))
finiteStep_timeCut_mem.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStep_timeCut_mem (T : ℝ≥0)
    (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) A) s t ∈
      closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))) := by
  have ha := coefficientStep_pastAdapted Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time A.1)
    ((dyadicGrids T).monotone A.1) A.2 ((dyadicGrids T).count A.1)
  have hc := timeCut_mem_closedStep Q D T
    (timeCut Q (finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) A) s t)
    (timeCut_pastAdapted Q D _ ha s t)
  rw [timeCut_commute Q _ s t 0 T] at hc
  change timeCut Q (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time A.1) A.2
    ((dyadicGrids T).count A.1)) 0 T) s t ∈ _ at hc
  rw [coefficientStep_horizon Q D T A.1 A.2] at hc
  exact hc

closedStep_timeCut_mem.exact_header:
theorem closedStep_timeCut_mem (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q U.val s t ∈ closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)))
closedStep_timeCut_mem.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStep_timeCut_mem (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q U.val s t ∈ closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D (dyadicGrids T) U
  have hl := ((timeCut_lipschitz (I := I) (Z := Z) Q s t).continuous.tendsto U.val).comp hA
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hl
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n => finiteStep_timeCut_mem Q D T (A n) s t)

  process : Window T → Ω → Z

exists_continuousWindowVersion.exact_header:
theorem exists_continuousWindowVersion (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    Nonempty (ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U)
exists_continuousWindowVersion.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_continuousWindowVersion (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    Nonempty (ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D (dyadicGrids T) U
  let f (n : ℕ) := stoppedGridSum Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time (A n).1) (A n).2
    ((dyadicGrids T).count (A n).1)
  have hf (n : ℕ) : Martingale (f n) D.filtration Q :=
    stoppedGridSum_martingale Q D _ ((dyadicGrids T).monotone (A n).1) _ _
  have h2 (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : MemLp (f n t) 2 Q :=
    stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D _ ((dyadicGrids T).monotone (A n).1) _ _ t
  have hlim (t : ℝ≥0) : Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop
      (𝓝 (closedIntegral Q D T U t)) := closedIntegral_stopped_tendsto Q D T U A hA t
  have hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro n
    exact stoppedGridSum_continuous_paths Q D _ ((dyadicGrids T).monotone (A n).1) _ _ hB
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφlim⟩ := exists_uniform_subsequence Q D.filtration f hf h2 T (hlim T).cauchySeq hc
  let M : Window T → Ω → Z :=
    fun t ω => MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val) t ω
  have hM (t : Window T) : M t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U t.val := by
    have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => f (φ n) t.val ω) atTop (𝓝 (M t ω)) :=
      hφlim.mono (fun ω hω => hω.1.tendsto_at t)
    have hprob := tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae (fun n => (h2 (φ n) t.val).aestronglyMeasurable) hpoint
    have hLp := tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp ((hlim t.val).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    have hraw := TendstoInMeasure.congr_left (fun n => (h2 (φ n) t.val).coeFn_toLp) hLp
    exact tendstoInMeasure_ae_unique hprob hraw
  refine ⟨⟨M, hφlim.mono (fun _ hω => hω.2), ?_, hM⟩⟩
  intro t
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := D.filtration t.val
  exact (StronglyMeasurable.tsum (fun n =>
    ((hf (φ (n + 1))).stronglyAdapted t.val).sub ((hf (φ n)).stronglyAdapted t.val))).add
      ((hf (φ 0)).stronglyAdapted t.val)

ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_rea.exact_header:
theorem ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_realization (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (V : ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U) :
    ∃ g : Window T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = V.process t ω
ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_rea.exact_declaration:
theorem ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_realization (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (V : ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U) :
    ∃ g : Window T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = V.process t ω := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hsub, hBm, hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null (ae_iff.mp V.continuous_paths)
  let g : Window T → Ω → Z := fun t ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else V.process t ω
  have hc (ω : Ω) : Continuous (fun t => g t ω) := by
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simpa only [g, hω, ite_true] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Window T => (0 : Z)))
    · have hv : Continuous (fun t => V.process t ω) := by
        by_contra hbad
        exact hω (hsub hbad)
      simpa only [g, hω, ite_false] using hv
  have hg (t : Window T) : StronglyMeasurable (g t) := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (B.piecewise (fun _ => (0 : Z)) (V.process t))
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise hBm ((V.adapted t).mono (D.filtration.le t.val))
  refine ⟨g, stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_stronglyMeasurable hc hg, hc, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr hB0] with ω hω t
  change ω ∉ B at hω
  simp only [g, hω, ite_false]

ContinuousWindowVersion.stopped_aestrong.exact_header:
theorem ContinuousWindowVersion.stopped_aestronglyMeasurable (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (V : ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U) (τ : Ω → Window T) (hτ : Measurable τ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => V.process (τ ω) ω) Q
ContinuousWindowVersion.stopped_aestrong.exact_declaration:
theorem ContinuousWindowVersion.stopped_aestronglyMeasurable (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (V : ContinuousWindowVersion Q D T U) (τ : Ω → Window T) (hτ : Measurable τ) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => V.process (τ ω) ω) Q := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, _, he⟩ := ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_realization Q D T U V
  have hs : StronglyMeasurable (fun ω => g (τ ω) ω) := hg.comp_measurable (hτ.prodMk measurable_id)
  apply hs.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
  exact he.mono (fun ω hω => hω (τ ω))

closedStep_horizon.exact_header:
theorem closedStep_horizon (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) : timeCut Q U.val 0 T = U.val
closedStep_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStep_horizon (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) : timeCut Q U.val 0 T = U.val := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D (dyadicGrids T) U
  have hcut := ((timeCut_lipschitz (I := I) (Z := Z) Q 0 T).continuous.tendsto U.val).comp hA
  have he (n : ℕ) : timeCut Q (finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) (A n)) 0 T =
      finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) (A n) := coefficientStep_horizon Q D T (A n).1 (A n).2
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique hcut
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, he] using hA

timeCut_horizon_intersection.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_horizon_intersection
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (T t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeCut Q U 0 T) 0 t = timeCut Q U 0 (min t T)
timeCut_horizon_intersection.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_horizon_intersection
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (T t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeCut Q U 0 T) 0 t = timeCut Q U 0 (min t T) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (timeCut Q U 0 T) 0 t, timeCut_coe Q U 0 T,
    timeCut_coe Q U 0 (min t T)] with r houter hinner hmin
  rw [houter, hmin]
  have he := congrArg (fun s : Set ℝ => s.indicator U r)
    (show Ioc 0 t ∩ Ioc 0 T = Ioc 0 (min t T) by rw [Ioc_inter_Ioc, max_self])
  rw [← Set.indicator_indicator] at he
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 t
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hinner]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr] using he
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr] using he

closedIntegral_stopped.exact_header:
theorem closedIntegral_stopped (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T U (min t T) = closedIntegral Q D T U t
closedIntegral_stopped.exact_declaration:
theorem closedIntegral_stopped (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T U (min t T) = closedIntegral Q D T U t := by
  unfold closedIntegral
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change timeCut Q U.val 0 (min t T : ℝ≥0) = timeCut Q U.val 0 t
  rw [NNReal.coe_min, ← timeCut_horizon_intersection, closedStep_horizon]

  have hs := (ContinuousWindowVersion.extend_realizes Q D T U V s).trans

theorem exists_continuous_martingale_version (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))

theorem exists_continuous_martingale_version (T : ℝ≥0)

    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :

timeCut_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_norm_sq
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    ‖timeCut Q U s t‖ ^ 2 = ∫ r in Ioc s t, ‖U r‖ ^ 2 := by

theorem closedIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (closedIntegral Q D T U t - closedIntegral Q D T U s)
      (closedIntegral Q D T U t - closedIntegral Q D T U s) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((U.val r).ofLp i) ((U.val r).ofLp i)

theorem closedIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))

      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((U.val r).ofLp i) ((U.val r).ofLp i) := by
  rw [closedIntegral, closedIntegral, ← closedStepIntegral_sub,

closedIntegral_increment_primitive.exact_declaration:
theorem closedIntegral_increment_primitive (T : ℝ≥0)

  have hF : Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ∫ r in 0..(t : ℝ), ‖U.val r‖ ^ 2) :=

  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr

  have hs := ((hF.tendsto t).sub_const (∫ r in 0..(t : ℝ), ‖U.val r‖ ^ 2)).abs
  have hs' : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ≥0 => ‖closedIntegral Q D T U s - closedIntegral Q D T U t‖ ^ 2)

    simpa only [closedIntegral_increment_primitive Q D T U, sub_self, abs_zero] using hs

predictableIntegral_increment_isometry.exact_header:
theorem predictableIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W (predictableIntegral Q D T U hU t - predictableIntegral Q D T U hU s)
      (predictableIntegral Q D T U hU t - predictableIntegral Q D T U hU s) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((U r).ofLp i) ((U r).ofLp i)
predictableIntegral_increment_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W (predictableIntegral Q D T U hU t - predictableIntegral Q D T U hU s)
      (predictableIntegral Q D T U hU t - predictableIntegral Q D T U hU s) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((U r).ofLp i) ((U r).ofLp i) := by
  rw [predictableIntegral, predictableIntegral, closedIntegral_increment_isometry Q D T _ W hW s t hst]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (timeCut_coe Q U 0 T), ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc]
    with r hr hm
  have hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt s.coe_nonneg hm.1, hm.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast ht)⟩
  change (timeCut Q U 0 T) r = _ at hr
  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hR] at hr
  change (∑ i, weightedPairing Q W (((timeCut Q U 0 T) r).ofLp i)
    (((timeCut Q U 0 T) r).ofLp i)) = _
  rw [hr]

stoppedStep_clamp.exact_header:
theorem stoppedStep_clamp (a b t : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedStep Q D a b A t ω = ∑ i,
      (D.process i (min t b) ω - D.process i (min t a) ω) • A.value i ω
stoppedStep_clamp.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedStep_clamp (a b t : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedStep Q D a b A t ω = ∑ i,
      (D.process i (min t b) ω - D.process i (min t a) ω) • A.value i ω := by
  by_cases hat : a ≤ t
  · simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_true, noiseStep,
      PredictableIsometry.stepSum, increment, min_eq_right hat]
  · have hta : t ≤ a := le_of_not_ge hat
    have htb : t ≤ b := hta.trans hab
    simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_false, min_eq_left hta, min_eq_left htb,
      sub_self, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

    stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω = ∑ i,
      BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum (D.process i) (fun k => min t (τ k))

stoppedGridSum_columns_clamp.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_columns_clamp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)

theorem stoppedGridSum_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :

stoppedGridSum_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedGridSum Q D υ (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) t ω =
      stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω := by
  rw [stoppedGridSum_columns_clamp Q D υ hυmono,
    stoppedGridSum_columns_clamp Q D τ hτ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum_refine_mul (D.process i)
    (fun k => min t (τ k)) (fun k => min t (υ k)) d hd
    (fun k => congrArg (min t) (hυ k)) (fun k => (A k).value i) n ω

theorem stoppedIntegralLp_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)

stoppedIntegralLp_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    stoppedIntegralLp Q D υ hυmono (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) t =
      stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ A n t := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D υ hυmono
    (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) t).coeFn_toLp,
    (stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n t).coeFn_toLp] with ω h1 h2
  change (stoppedIntegralLp Q D υ hυmono _ _ t) ω = _ at h1
  change (stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ _ _ t) ω = _ at h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact stoppedGridSum_refine Q D τ υ hτ hυmono d hd hυ A n t ω

stoppedIntegralLp_dist_cross.exact_header:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    dist (stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m) t)
      (stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) C (G.count n)) =
    dist (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D (G.time m) A (G.count m)) 0 t)
      (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) C (G.count n))
stoppedIntegralLp_dist_cross.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    dist (stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m) t)
      (stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) C (G.count n)) =
    dist (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D (G.time m) A (G.count m)) 0 t)
      (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) C (G.count n)) := by
  rcases le_total m n with hmn | hnm
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hcount, htime⟩ := G.compatible m n hmn
    let R := refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n) (G.monotone n) d hd htime A
    have hs := stoppedIntegralLp_refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n)
      (G.monotone m) (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m) t
    have hc := coefficientStep_refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n)
      (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m)
    rw [← hs, ← hc, ← hcount]
    exact stoppedIntegralLp_dist Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) R C (G.count n) t
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hcount, htime⟩ := G.compatible n m hnm
    let R := refine Q D (G.time n) (G.time m) (G.monotone m) d hd htime C
    have hs := stochasticStep_refine Q D (G.time n) (G.time m)
      (G.monotone n) (G.monotone m) d hd htime C (G.count n)
    have hc := coefficientStep_refine Q D (G.time n) (G.time m)
      (G.monotone m) d hd htime C (G.count n)
    rw [← hs, ← hc, ← hcount]
    exact stoppedIntegralLp_dist Q D (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A R (G.count m) t

    (hA : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) (A n)) atTop (𝓝 U.val))

theorem closedIntegral_stopped_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))

    (closedCutDomain Q D T U 0 t) hC

    simpa only [finiteStepInput_pullback, Function.comp_def, pullbackClosedDomain] using

  have h1 := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q (pullbackDriver hf D) G
    (fun n => pullbackFiniteStep hf D G (A n)) (pullbackClosedDomain hf D G u) hB

theorem timeCut_pullback

    (isClosed_eq ((extend_continuous f g hiso).comp continuous_fst |>.dist
      ((extend_continuous f g hiso).comp continuous_snd))
      (continuous_fst.dist continuous_snd))

theorem tendsto_extend {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (a : ι → A) (u : Domain f)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun i => f (a i)) l (nhds u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => g (a i)) l (nhds (extend f g u))
tendsto_extend.exact_declaration:
theorem tendsto_extend {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (a : ι → A) (u : Domain f)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun i => f (a i)) l (nhds u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => g (a i)) l (nhds (extend f g u)) := by
  have hsub : Tendsto (fun i => (⟨f (a i), subset_closure (mem_range_self _)⟩ : Domain f)) l (nhds u) :=
    tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr hu
  have hext := (extend_continuous f g hiso).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hsub
  apply hext.congr'
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro i
  have he := extend_eq f g hiso (⟨f (a i), mem_range_self _⟩ : Set.range f)
  change extend f g (inclusion f ⟨f (a i), mem_range_self _⟩) = g (a i)
  rw [he]
  apply dist_eq_zero.mp
  have hchosen : f (Classical.choose (⟨f (a i), mem_range_self _⟩ : Set.range f).property) = f (a i) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (⟨f (a i), mem_range_self _⟩ : Set.range f).property
  change dist (g (Classical.choose (⟨f (a i), mem_range_self _⟩ : Set.range f).property)) (g (a i)) = 0
  rw [hiso, hchosen, dist_self]

theorem finiteStep_refine_exists (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) (k : ℕ) (hk : A.1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time k),
      coefficientStep Q D (G.time k) B (G.count k) = finiteStepInput Q D G A ∧
      stochasticStep Q D (G.time k) (G.monotone k) B (G.count k) = finiteStepOutput Q D G A
finiteStep_refine_exists.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStep_refine_exists (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) (k : ℕ) (hk : A.1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time k),
      coefficientStep Q D (G.time k) B (G.count k) = finiteStepInput Q D G A ∧
      stochasticStep Q D (G.time k) (G.monotone k) B (G.count k) = finiteStepOutput Q D G A := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hcount, htime⟩ := G.compatible A.1 k hk
  let B := refine Q D (G.time A.1) (G.time k) (G.monotone k) d hd htime A.2
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcount]
    exact coefficientStep_refine Q D (G.time A.1) (G.time k)
      (G.monotone k) d hd htime A.2 (G.count A.1)
  · rw [hcount]
    exact stochasticStep_refine Q D (G.time A.1) (G.time k)
      (G.monotone A.1) (G.monotone k) d hd htime A.2 (G.count A.1)

theorem finiteStep_sub_exists (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A B : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ C : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G,
      finiteStepInput Q D G C = finiteStepInput Q D G A - finiteStepInput Q D G B ∧
      finiteStepOutput Q D G C = finiteStepOutput Q D G A - finiteStepOutput Q D G B
finiteStep_sub_exists.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStep_sub_exists (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A B : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ C : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G,
      finiteStepInput Q D G C = finiteStepInput Q D G A - finiteStepInput Q D G B ∧
      finiteStepOutput Q D G C = finiteStepOutput Q D G A - finiteStepOutput Q D G B := by
  obtain ⟨A', hA, hA'⟩ := finiteStep_refine_exists Q D G A (max A.1 B.1) (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨B', hB, hB'⟩ := finiteStep_refine_exists Q D G B (max A.1 B.1) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨⟨max A.1 B.1, subtract Q D _ A' B'⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change coefficientStep Q D _ _ _ = _
    rw [coefficientStep_sub, hA, hB]
  · change stochasticStep Q D _ _ _ _ = _
    rw [stochasticStep_sub, hA', hB']

closedStep_sub_mem.exact_declaration:

    (u v : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    u.val - v.val ∈ closure (range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D G)) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G v
  choose C hC using fun n => finiteStep_sub_exists Q D G (A n) (B n)
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (hA.sub hB)
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro n
  rw [← (hC n).1]
  exact subset_closure (mem_range_self _)

theorem closedStepIntegral_sub (G : RefiningGrids)
    (u v : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q D G (closedSub Q D G u v) =
      closedStepIntegral Q D G u - closedStepIntegral Q D G v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G v
  choose C hC using fun n => finiteStep_sub_exists Q D G (A n) (B n)
  have hI : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (C n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (closedSub Q D G u v).val) := by
    change Tendsto _ atTop (𝓝 (u.val - v.val))
    simpa only [fun n => (hC n).1] using hA.sub hB
  have hC' := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G C (closedSub Q D G u v) hI
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique hC'
  simpa only [fun n => (hC n).2] using
    (closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G A u hA).sub (closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G B v hB)

FiniteStepData.exact_declaration: abbrev FiniteStepData (G : RefiningGrids) := Σ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)

finiteStepInput.exact_header:
def finiteStepInput (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

finiteStepOutput.exact_header: def finiteStepOutput (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) : Lp Z 2 Q
finiteStepOutput.exact_declaration:
def finiteStepOutput (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  stochasticStep Q D (G.time A.1) (G.monotone A.1) A.2 (G.count A.1)

finiteStep_distance.exact_header:
theorem finiteStep_distance (G : RefiningGrids) (A C : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    dist (finiteStepOutput Q D G A) (finiteStepOutput Q D G C) =
      dist (finiteStepInput Q D G A) (finiteStepInput Q D G C)
finiteStep_distance.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStep_distance (G : RefiningGrids) (A C : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    dist (finiteStepOutput Q D G A) (finiteStepOutput Q D G C) =
      dist (finiteStepInput Q D G A) (finiteStepInput Q D G C) :=
  stochasticStep_dist_cross Q D G A.1 C.1 A.2 C.2

ClosedStepDomain.exact_declaration:
abbrev ClosedStepDomain (G : RefiningGrids) :=
  ClosedIsometricExtension.Domain (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D G)

closedStepIntegral.exact_header: def closedStepIntegral (G : RefiningGrids) : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G → Lp Z 2 Q
closedStepIntegral.exact_declaration:
def closedStepIntegral (G : RefiningGrids) : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G → Lp Z 2 Q :=
  ClosedIsometricExtension.extend (finiteStepInput Q D G) (finiteStepOutput Q D G)

closedStepIntegral_isometry.exact_header:
theorem closedStepIntegral_isometry (G : RefiningGrids) :
    Isometry (closedStepIntegral (Z := Z) Q D G)
closedStepIntegral_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_isometry (G : RefiningGrids) :
    Isometry (closedStepIntegral (Z := Z) Q D G) :=
  ClosedIsometricExtension.extend_isometry (finiteStepInput Q D G) (finiteStepOutput Q D G)
    (finiteStep_distance Q D G)

closedStepIntegral_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem closedStepIntegral_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids) (A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepOutput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 (closedStepIntegral Q D G u))
closedStepIntegral_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids) (A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepOutput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 (closedStepIntegral Q D G u)) :=
  ClosedIsometricExtension.tendsto_extend (finiteStepInput Q D G) (finiteStepOutput Q D G)

exists_finiteStep_approximation.exact_header:
theorem exists_finiteStep_approximation (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G,
      Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val)
exists_finiteStep_approximation.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_finiteStep_approximation (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G,
      Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val) := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hlim⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp u.property
  choose A hA using hv
  exact ⟨A, (show (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) = v from funext hA) ▸ hlim⟩

toClosedStepDomain.exact_header:
def toClosedStepDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :

toClosedStepDomain.exact_declaration:
def toClosedStepDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G := by
  refine ⟨u.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hA
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure (show coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n)
    (G.count n) ∈ Set.range (finiteStepInput Q D G) from ⟨⟨n, A n⟩, rfl⟩))

theorem closedStepIntegral_eq_stochasticIntegral (G : RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :

closedStepIntegral_eq_stochasticIntegral.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_eq_stochasticIntegral (G : RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q D G (toClosedStepDomain Q D G u) = stochasticIntegral Q D G u := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  have hc := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G (fun n => ⟨n, A n⟩) (toClosedStepDomain Q D G u) hA
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hc (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G u A hA)

theorem closedStepIntegral_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    weightedPairing Q W (closedStepIntegral Q D G u) (closedStepIntegral Q D G u) =
      ⟪u.val, (columnWeight (I := I) Q W).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) u.val⟫_ℝ
closedStepIntegral_weighted.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    weightedPairing Q W (closedStepIntegral Q D G u) (closedStepIntegral Q D G u) =
      ⟪u.val, (columnWeight (I := I) Q W).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) u.val⟫_ℝ := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  have hI := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G A u hA
  have hl := (weightedPairing Q W).continuous₂.tendsto _ |>.comp (hI.prodMk_nhds hI)
  have hr := Filter.Tendsto.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) hA
    (((columnWeight (I := I) Q W).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).continuous.tendsto u.val |>.comp hA)

theorem cloudEncoding_norm_le (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) :
    ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
cloudEncoding_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem cloudEncoding_norm_le (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) :
    ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)).mpr
  intro i
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← MethodMetricComparisons.cloud_norm_sq x]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin N =>
    ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x j‖^2)
    (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)

cloudEncoding_inverse_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem cloudEncoding_inverse_norm_le (x : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x‖≤Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)*‖x‖

theorem cloudEncoding_inverse_norm_le (x : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x‖≤Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)*‖x‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0≤Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)*‖x‖)).mp
  rw [mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg N),
    ← MethodMetricComparisons.cloud_norm_sq ((euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  calc
    ∑ i, ‖x i‖^2 ≤ ∑ _i : Fin N, ‖x‖^2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr (norm_le_pi_norm x i)
    _ = (N:ℝ)*‖x‖^2 := by simp

    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).toContinuousLinearMap‖≤1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by norm_num)
  intro x
  change ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x‖≤1*‖x‖

cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_le_sqrt.exact_declaration:

    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖≤Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (cloudEncoding_inverse_norm_le N J)

cloudEncoding_opNorm_eq_one.exact_header:
theorem cloudEncoding_opNorm_eq_one (hN : 0 < N) [Nonempty J] :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).toContinuousLinearMap‖ = 1
cloudEncoding_opNorm_eq_one.exact_declaration:
theorem cloudEncoding_opNorm_eq_one (hN : 0 < N) [Nonempty J] :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).toContinuousLinearMap‖ = 1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := ‹Nonempty J›
  let i : Fin N := ⟨0,hN⟩
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J) := PiLp.single 2 (i,j) (1:ℝ)
  have hx : ‖x‖=1 := by simp [x,PiLp.norm_single]
  have hi : euclideanParticleEncoding N J x i=PiLp.single 2 j (1:ℝ) := by
    ext k
    simp [x,euclideanParticleEncoding_apply,PiLp.single_apply]
  apply le_antisymm (cloudEncoding_opNorm_le_one N J)
  calc
    1 = ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x i‖ := by rw [hi]; simp [PiLp.norm_single]
    _ ≤ ‖euclideanParticleEncoding N J x‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).toContinuousLinearMap‖*‖x‖ :=
      (euclideanParticleEncoding N J).toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm x
    _ = _ := by rw [hx,mul_one]

cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_eq_sqrt.exact_header:
theorem cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_eq_sqrt (hN : 0 < N) [Nonempty J] :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ = Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)
cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_eq_sqrt.exact_declaration:
theorem cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_eq_sqrt (hN : 0 < N) [Nonempty J] :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ = Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := ‹Nonempty J›
  let i : Fin N := ⟨0,hN⟩
  let _ : Nonempty (Fin N) := ⟨i⟩
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ J := PiLp.single 2 j (1:ℝ)
  let x : Fin N → EuclideanSpace ℝ J := fun _ => e
  have he : ‖e‖=1 := by simp [e,PiLp.norm_single]
  have hx : ‖x‖=1 := by simp [x,he]
  have hi : ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x‖=Real.sqrt (N:ℝ) := by
    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg N),
      ← MethodMetricComparisons.cloud_norm_sq ((euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x)]
    simp [x,he]
  apply le_antisymm (cloudEncoding_inverse_opNorm_le_sqrt N J)
  calc
    Real.sqrt (N:ℝ)=‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm x‖ := hi.symm
    _ ≤ ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖*‖x‖ :=
      (euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm x
    _ = _ := by rw [hx,mul_one]

    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (s s' : S) (g g' : Θ) (z w : Z) :
    max (⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizer t s g-M.optimizer t s' g')⟫_ℝ +
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w)) 0 ≤
      ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖s-s'‖ * (LΨ : ℝ) *
        (‖M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)-g‖ +
          ‖M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)-g'‖) := by
  let f := M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)
  let f' := M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)
  have hd := particleCouplingWork_le M D ρ hmono 1 (by norm_num) t ht
    s s' (fun _ => z) (fun _ => w)
  have hd' : ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizer t s f-M.optimizer t s' f')⟫_ℝ +
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤ 0 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ D.optimizerSq (s-s') + D.samplerSq (z-w) :=
      add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg _) (D.samplerSq_nonneg _)
    have hn : -ρ * (D.optimizerSq (s-s') + D.samplerSq (z-w)) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hρ) hp
    have hd'' : ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizer t s f-M.optimizer t s' f')⟫_ℝ +
        samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤
        -ρ * (D.optimizerSq (s-s') + D.samplerSq (z-w)) := by
      simpa [particleCouplingWork,particleCouplingEnergy,Model.particleField,
        Model.particleGradient,Fin.sum_univ_one,f,f'] using hd
    exact hd''.trans hn
  let e := (M.optimizer t s g-M.optimizer t s f) -
      (M.optimizer t s' g'-M.optimizer t s' f')
  have he : ‖e‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * (‖f-g‖+‖f'-g'‖) := by
    calc
      ‖e‖ ≤ ‖M.optimizer t s g-M.optimizer t s f‖ +
          ‖M.optimizer t s' g'-M.optimizer t s' f'‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-f‖ + (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g'-f'‖ := add_le_add (hΨ _ _ _) (hΨ _ _ _)
      _ = _ := by rw [norm_sub_rev g f,norm_sub_rev g' f']; ring
  have hi : ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight e⟫_ℝ ≤
      ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖s-s'‖ * (LΨ : ℝ) * (‖f-g‖+‖f'-g'‖) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖s-s'‖ * ‖D.optimizerWeight e‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖s-s'‖ * (‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖e‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.optimizerWeight.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ‖s-s'‖ * (‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (‖f-g‖+‖f'-g'‖))) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  apply max_le
  · have heq : M.optimizer t s g-M.optimizer t s' g' =
        (M.optimizer t s f-M.optimizer t s' f')+e := by dsimp [e]; abel
    rw [heq,map_add,inner_add_right]
    change _ ≤ ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖s-s'‖ * (LΨ : ℝ) * (‖f-g‖+‖f'-g'‖)
    linarith
  · positivity

theorem fluctuation_integrable_of_variance (V : ℝ)
    (h2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (observation M Q U r) 2 Q)
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ≤ V) :

fluctuation_integrable_of_variance.exact_declaration:
theorem fluctuation_integrable_of_variance (V : ℝ)
    (h2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (observation M Q U r) 2 Q)
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ≤ V) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q U))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hf (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : MemLp (fluctuation M Q U r) 2 Q :=
    (h2 r hr).sub (memLp_const _)
  have hb (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      (∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ∂Q) ≤ Real.sqrt V := by
    have hc := integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals Q (fun ω => ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖)
      (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (hf r hr).norm (memLp_const _)
    have he : (∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ∂Q) ≤
        Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by simpa using hc
    exact he.trans (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hVar r hr))
  apply (integrable_prod_iff (fluctuation_strong M Q U hF).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact (hf r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2⟩).integrable (by norm_num)
  · apply (integrable_const (Real.sqrt V)).mono'
      (fluctuation_strong M Q U hF).norm.integral_prod_right'.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))]
    exact hb r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2⟩

theorem fluctuation_integrable_of_stationarity (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), U.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (U.sampler r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q U))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
fluctuation_integrable_of_stationarity.exact_declaration:
theorem fluctuation_integrable_of_stationarity (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), U.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (U.sampler r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q U))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let f := fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient νStar sStar
  have hi : Integrable f νStar := hobs.sub (integrable_const _)
  have hFmeas : Measurable f := (hF.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).sub_const _
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      fluctuation M Q U r = f ∘ U.sampler r := by
    funext ω
    rw [fluctuation,mean_eq M Q U hF,hopt r hr,hlaw r hr]
    simp only [observation,f,Function.comp_apply,hopt r hr]
  have hm (r : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (U.sampler r) Q := U.sampler_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hs (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Integrable (fluctuation M Q U r) Q := by
    rw [he r hr]
    apply (integrable_map_measure hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable (hm r)).mp
    rwa [hlaw r hr]
  have hv (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      (∫ ω, ‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖ ∂Q) = ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ∂νStar := by
    rw [he r hr]
    change (∫ ω, ‖f (U.sampler r ω)‖ ∂Q) = _
    rw [← integral_map (hm r) hFmeas.norm.aestronglyMeasurable,hlaw r hr]
  apply (integrable_prod_iff (fluctuation_strong M Q U hF).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact hs r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2⟩
  · apply (integrable_const (∫ z, ‖f z‖ ∂νStar)).congr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact (hv r ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2⟩).symm

theorem positive_work_integrable
    (V : RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (hU : Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q U))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hV : Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q V))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      max (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
positive_work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem positive_work_integrable
    (V : RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (hU : Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q U))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hV : Integrable (Function.uncurry (fluctuation M Q V))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      max (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let μ := (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data.optimizer_continuous Q M U).sub
      (RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data.optimizer_continuous Q M V))
  let R := max 0 C
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hb (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ‖U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r‖ ≤ R :=
    (hC r hr).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hp (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) (ω : Ω) :
      max (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V r ω)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V r ω)) 0 ≤
      ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r‖ * (LΨ : ℝ) *
        (‖fluctuation M Q U r ω‖+‖fluctuation M Q V r ω‖) := by
    have hd := positive_work_le M D ρ hρ hmono r hr.1 LΨ (hΨ r hr)
      (U.optimizer r) (V.optimizer r)
      (∫ ω', observation M Q U r ω' ∂Q) (∫ ω', observation M Q V r ω' ∂Q)
      (U.sampler r ω) (V.sampler r ω)
    rw [mean_eq M Q U hF,mean_eq M Q V hF] at hd
    change max (⟪U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r,D.optimizerWeight
        (U.optimizerDrift r-V.optimizerDrift r)⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω,D.samplerWeight
        (M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (U.sampler r ω)-
         M.drift (M.parameter (V.optimizer r)) (V.sampler r ω))⟫_ℝ) 0 ≤ _
    rw [U.optimizerDrift_realizes r hr,V.optimizerDrift_realizes r hr]
    simp only [fluctuation]
    rw [mean_eq M Q U hF,mean_eq M Q V hF]
    simpa only [Model.optimizerField,observation,
      RawConstantNoiseContraction.sampler_work_eq_drift M D hσ] using hd
  have hm := (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D).continuous₂.comp_stronglyMeasurable
    ((RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState_strong Q M U V).prodMk
      (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift_strong Q M U V))
  apply ((hU.norm.add hV.norm).const_mul (‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * R * (LΨ : ℝ))).mono'
    (continuous_max.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (hm.aestronglyMeasurable.prodMk aestronglyMeasurable_const))
  have htime : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, p.1 ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_Icc.preimage measurable_fst)).mpr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact ae_of_all Q (fun _ => ⟨hr.1.le,hr.2⟩)
  filter_upwards [htime] with p hp'
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _)]
  apply (hp p.1 hp' p.2).trans
  change ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * ‖U.optimizer p.1-V.optimizer p.1‖ * (LΨ : ℝ) *
      (‖fluctuation M Q U p.1 p.2‖+‖fluctuation M Q V p.1 p.2‖) ≤
    ‖D.optimizerWeight‖ * R * (LΨ : ℝ) *
      (‖fluctuation M Q U p.1 p.2‖+‖fluctuation M Q V p.1 p.2‖)
  gcongr
  exact hb p.1 hp'

    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)

    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),

        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler r)) ≤ V0)

      rw [integral_map U.sampler_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable.aemeasurable
        hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable] at hvr

      rw [mean_eq M Q U hF]

  · exact fluctuation_integrable_of_stationarity M Q V hF sStar νStar hopt hlaw hobs

        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)

      ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler T-ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler T‖ ^ 2) ≤

theorem rms_decay_of_positive_work (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      max (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer T-V.optimizer T‖ ^ 2+
      ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler T-ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler T‖ ^ 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler 0-ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hd := RawConstantNoiseContraction.energy_decay Q M D U V ρ hmono hσ hb hp
  rw [pair_energy_eq_lifted Q M D U V T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩,
    pair_energy_eq_lifted Q M D U V 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩] at hd
  let At := (U.optimizer T-V.optimizer T,ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler T-
    ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler T)
  let A0 := (U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0,ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler 0-
    ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler 0)
  have hlo := liftedMetricBilinear_lower Q D At
  have hup := liftedMetricBilinear_upper Q D A0
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1).trans D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hn (x : S × Lp Z 2 Q) : 0 ≤ liftedEuclideanSq Q x := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  change Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q At) ≤
    Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q A0)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hn _),mul_pow,mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hκ,Real.sq_sqrt (hn _)]
  have he : Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) := by
    rw [pow_two,← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left D.lower_pos).mp
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ))).le
  have heq : D.lower * (D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) * liftedEuclideanSq Q A0) =
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) * (D.upper * liftedEuclideanSq Q A0) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.conditionNumber]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt D.lower_pos]
  rw [heq]
  exact hlo.trans (hd.trans hupper)

theorem pair_law_distance_decay_of_positive_work
    (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      max (RawConstantNoiseContraction.rawMetricBilinear D
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (RawConstantNoiseContraction.pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler 0-ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) := by
  let A := ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler T
  let B := ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler T
  have hA : Q.map A = Q.map (U.sampler T) :=
    Measure.map_congr (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae Q U.sampler (U.sampler_square T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩))
  have hB : Q.map B = Q.map (V.sampler T) :=
    Measure.map_congr (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae Q V.sampler (V.sampler_square T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩))
  have hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (Q.map A) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (lp_law_second_moment Q A)
  have hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (Q.map B) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (lp_law_second_moment Q B)
  let c : ULA.Coupling (Q.map A) (Q.map B) :=
    ⟨samplerPairLaw Q A B,(samplerPairLaw_coupling Q A B).1,(samplerPairLaw_coupling Q A B).2⟩
  have hc := coupling_difference_memLp (Q.map A) (Q.map B) hν hν' c
  have hbnd := wasserstein_le_finite_coupling (Q.map A) (Q.map B) c hc.eLpNorm_ne_top
  have hs := couplingCost_sq_eq_integral c.joint hc
  rw [IntegralModelContraction.samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral] at hs
  apply le_trans _ (rms_decay_of_positive_work M D Q U V ρ hρ hmono hσ hb hp)
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  change ‖U.optimizer T-V.optimizer T‖ ^ 2+ULA.wasserstein2Real (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ^ 2 ≤
    ‖U.optimizer T-V.optimizer T‖ ^ 2+‖A-B‖ ^ 2
  rw [← hA,← hB]
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  rw [← hs]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mpr hbnd

import PBGSO.EmpiricalMonotonicity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space

/-! # A one-sided work criterion for the constant-diffusion branch
The paper's joint condition implies pointwise frozen-sampler dissipativity.
Only the parameter-cross drift can contribute uncontrolled positive work.
The resulting positive-work integrability criterion is strictly weaker than
square integrability of the full sampler drift or its total variation.
The parameter-cross assumptions below are explicit additional conditions;
this file does not claim that minimal source A1(i) implies them.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.ConstantNoiseWork
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [Fintype I]
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ)
  (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
include hmono

omit hmono in
/-- Constant diffusion cancels exactly in the source synchronous coupling
work, leaving the actual sampler drift pairing. -/

/-- The full law-level source A3 implies the pointwise frozen sampler
condition, by actual one-point empirical laws. -/

/-- Dropping the nonnegative diffusion correction gives frozen drift
one-sided monotonicity without any drift growth hypothesis. -/

/-- Frozen superlinear dissipation is retained; only the genuine parameter
change needs an upper work bound. -/

/-- The positive part of actual sampler drift work is dominated solely by
parameter-cross work, rather than the norm of the whole drift. -/

section Integrability
variable {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] (μ : Measure A)
  (a a' : A → S) (x y : A → Z)
  (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable x μ) (hy : AEStronglyMeasurable y μ)
  (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (x r)) μ)
  (hb' : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (y r)) μ)
include hx hy hb hb'

/-- Actual positive work is integrable whenever the parameter-cross norm
product is integrable. Full drift L² or L² total variation is not required. -/

end Integrability

section ParameterGrowth
variable {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] (μ : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
  (a a' : A → S) (x y : A → Z)

/-- A parameter-Lipschitz drift with linear sampler growth controls positive
work under actual state L² moments, even for a superlinear frozen drift. -/

end ParameterGrowth

    max ⟪z-w, D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z - M.drift (M.parameter s') w)⟫_ℝ 0 ≤
      ‖D.samplerWeight‖ * ‖z-w‖ * ‖M.drift (M.parameter s) w - M.drift (M.parameter s') w‖ := by
  apply max_le
  · exact (parameter_cross_work_le M D ρ hmono s s' z w).trans
      (add_le_of_nonpos_left (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hρ)
        (D.samplerSq_nonneg _)))
  · positivity

theorem positive_work_integrable (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)

theorem positive_work_integrable_of_parameter_growth
    (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (L K : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hparam : ∀ r, ‖M.parameter (a r) - M.parameter (a' r)‖ ≤ K)
    (hcross : ∀ θ θ' z, ‖M.drift θ z - M.drift θ' z‖ ≤
      L * ‖θ-θ'‖ * (1 + ‖z‖))
    (hx : MemLp x 2 μ) (hy : MemLp y 2 μ)
    (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (x r)) μ)
    (hb' : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (y r)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun r => max ⟪x r-y r,
      D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (x r) - M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (y r))⟫_ℝ 0) μ := by
  have hi : Integrable (fun r => ‖x r-y r‖ * (1 + ‖y r‖)) μ :=
    (hx.sub hy).norm.integrable_mul ((memLp_const (1 : ℝ)).add hy.norm)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => ⟪x r-y r,
      D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (x r) - M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (y r))⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    (hx.aestronglyMeasurable.sub hy.aestronglyMeasurable).inner
      (D.samplerWeight.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hb.sub hb'))
  apply (hi.const_mul (‖D.samplerWeight‖ * L * K)).mono'
    (continuous_max.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hm.prodMk aestronglyMeasurable_const))
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro r
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖D.samplerWeight‖ * ‖x r-y r‖ *
        ‖M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (y r) - M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (y r)‖ :=
      positive_work_le M D ρ hmono hρ (a r) (a' r) (x r) (y r)
    _ ≤ ‖D.samplerWeight‖ * ‖x r-y r‖ * (L * K * (1+‖y r‖)) := by
      gcongr
      exact (hcross _ _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact hparam r)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem canonical_input_eq (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (t : ℝ) :
    AdditiveCanonical.input (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) μ
      (samplerBrownianInput (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) K
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0) t =
      samplerBrownianInput (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) K
        (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).process
        (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).brownian 0 t
canonical_input_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_input_eq (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (t : ℝ) :
    AdditiveCanonical.input (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) μ
      (samplerBrownianInput (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) K
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0) t =
      samplerBrownianInput (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) K
        (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).process
        (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).brownian 0 t := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
  let hf := measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R)
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (samplerBrownianInput R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0 t),
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (samplerBrownianInput_coe R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0 t),
    samplerBrownianInput_coe (μ.prod R) K
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).process
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).brownian 0 t] with p hp hn hd
  change ((lpPullbackCLM hf) (samplerBrownianInput R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0 t)) p = _
  rw [hp]
  change (samplerBrownianInput R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0 t) p.2 = _ at hn
  rw [hn, hd]
  rfl

theorem canonical_meanField_aestronglyAdapted
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (a : A)
    (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    let B := samplerBrownianInput (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) K
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ).filtration t]
      (AdditiveCanonical.flow (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) L μ hμ a B
        (samplerBrownianInput_continuous _ _ _ _ _) (samplerBrownianInput_zero _ _ _ _ _) t).2
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
  let B := samplerBrownianInput R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0
  let hB := samplerBrownianInput_continuous R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0
  let hB0 := samplerBrownianInput_zero R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0
  let D := CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := J) μ
  have hs := AdditiveCanonical.flow_spec R L μ hμ a B hB hB0

    hs.1 ((lpPullbackCLM (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R))).continuous.comp hB)

    AEStronglyMeasurable[(ParticleBrownianDriver.driver (J := J) μ N).filtration 0]
      (independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z)
        (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) N

particle_initial_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem particle_initial_measurable (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (a : A) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(ParticleBrownianDriver.driver (J := J) μ N).filtration 0]
      (independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z)
        (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) N
        (a, AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) μ hμ))
      (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
  let Q := μ.prod R
  let QN := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let hf := ParticleNoiseSpace.initial_noise_preserving (J := J) μ N
  let D := ParticleBrownianDriver.driver (J := J) μ N
  have h : StronglyMeasurable[CanonicalInitialFiltration.filtration
      (Z := Fin N → Z) (I := Fin N × J) 0]
      (CanonicalInitialFiltration.process (Z := Fin N → Z) (I := Fin N × J) 0) :=
    Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural
      (fun r ↦ (CanonicalInitialFiltration.process_measurable
        (Z := Fin N → Z) (I := Fin N × J) r).stronglyMeasurable) 0
  have hfst := continuous_fst.comp_stronglyMeasurable h
  have hpull : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0]
      (fun ω : Fin N → Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample J ↦ fun i ↦ (ω i).1) :=
    hfst.comp_measurable (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl)
  have hraw : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0]
      (fun ω : Fin N → Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample J ↦ (a, fun i ↦ (ω i).1)) :=
    stronglyMeasurable_const.prodMk hpull
  have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂QN, ∀ i : Fin N, AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler R μ hμ (ω i) = (ω i).1 := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Q) i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe R μ hμ)
  apply hraw.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
  filter_upwards [independentReferenceCLM_coe (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N
    (a, AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler R μ hμ), hall] with ω hp hi
  have hcloud : (a, fun i : Fin N ↦ AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler R μ hμ (ω i)) =
      (a, fun i : Fin N ↦ (ω i).1) := Prod.ext rfl (funext hi)
  exact (hp.trans hcloud).symm

    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (Geo : TwistedGeometry A Z) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 μ) (a : A)
    (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (V : ℝ)
    (P :
      let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
      let B := samplerBrownianInput R K ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0
      AdditiveParticleRealization (μ.prod R) L M Geo N hN
        (AdditiveCanonical.flow R L μ hμ a B (samplerBrownianInput_continuous _ _ _ _ _)
          (samplerBrownianInput_zero _ _ _ _ _)) (AdditiveCanonical.input R μ B) V)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(ParticleBrownianDriver.driver (J := J) μ N).filtration t]
      (P.state t) (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
  let Q := μ.prod R
  let QN := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N

    ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian 0

      ∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U t

    (continuousDriver_joint_continuous Q D)

  intro t

initial_difference_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem initial_difference_norm_sq (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :
    ‖lpPullbackCLM (AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c)
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ) -
      lpPullbackCLM (AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c)
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)‖ ^ 2 =
      (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2
initial_difference_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem initial_difference_norm_sq (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :
    ‖lpPullbackCLM (AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c)
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ) -
      lpPullbackCLM (AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c)
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)‖ ^ 2 =
      (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2 := by
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let U := lpPullbackCLM hf (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ)
  let V := lpPullbackCLM hg (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)
  have hU : U =ᵐ[Q] fun p => p.1.1 :=
    (lpPullback_coe hf _).trans (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ μ hμ))
  have hV : V =ᵐ[Q] fun p => p.1.2 :=
    (lpPullback_coe hg _).trans (hg.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp
      (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ ν hν))
  have hpair : samplerPairLaw Q U V = c.joint := by
    rw [samplerPairLaw, Measure.map_congr (hU.prodMk hV)]
    exact ULA.initialExtension_joint c _
  calc
    ‖U - V‖ ^ 2 = ∫ p, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V :=
      (IntegralModelContraction.samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral (Q := Q) U V).symm
    _ = (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2 := by
      rw [hpair]
      exact (couplingCost_sq_eq_integral c.joint (coupling_difference_memLp μ ν hμ hν c)).symm

theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ)
    (hV0 : V.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν
law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ)
    (hV0 : V.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings μ ν (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μ ν hμ hν)
    (fun c => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  intro c hc
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ ν c
  let Uc := U.pullback hf E (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_process_eq μ ν c)
    (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_filtration_le μ ν c)
  let Vc := V.pullback hg E (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_process_eq μ ν c)
    (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_filtration_le μ ν c)
  have h := ConstructedItoModel.law_distance_decay G Uc Vc hb hσ ρ hmono
  change optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
    (Q.map (lpPullbackCLM hf (U.sampler T))) (Q.map (lpPullbackCLM hg (V.sampler T))) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖lpPullbackCLM hf (U.sampler 0) - lpPullbackCLM hg (V.sampler 0)‖ ^ 2) at h
  rw [lpPullback_law hf, lpPullback_law hg, hU0, hV0,
    initial_difference_norm_sq μ ν hμ hν c] at h
  exact h
