theorem difference_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u v : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (hV : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (v t i) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t)
      (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, diffusionEnergy Q W (fun r i => u r i - v r i) r := by
  have he := stochasticIntegral_sub_weighted Q D W hW (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
    (continuousCutDomain Q D T u hu hU t.toNNReal)
    (continuousCutDomain Q D T v hv hV t.toNNReal)
  change weightedPairing Q W (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t)
      (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t) = _ at he
  rw [continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut, continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut,
    ← timeCut_subtract, timeCut_weighted, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1] at he
  rw [he, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (continuousDomain_coe Q D T u hu hU),
    ae_restrict_of_ae (continuousDomain_coe Q D T v hv hV),
    ae_restrict_of_ae (Lp.coeFn_sub (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val
      (continuousDomain Q D T v hv hV).val), ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc]
    with r hU hV hsub hr
  have hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hR] at hU hV
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hU, hV]
  rfl

Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift : ℝ → S
  sampler : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q
  optimizerDrift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable optimizerDrift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  diffusion_continuous : Continuous diffusion
  sampler_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (sampler t) Q
  diffusion_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i,
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (diffusion t i) Q
  optimizerDrift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), optimizerDrift t =
    M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler t))
  optimizer_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    optimizer t = optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, optimizerDrift r
  sampler_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    sampler t = sampler 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, drift r) +
      integral Q D T diffusion diffusion_continuous diffusion_adapted t
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i, diffusion t i =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω) i
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (sampler t))

Data.optimizer_continuous.exact_header:
theorem Data.optimizer_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.optimizer_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.optimizer_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.optimizerDrift
    U.optimizerDrift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => U.optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, U.optimizerDrift r)
      (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := continuousOn_const.add hi
  exact hc.congr (fun t ht => U.optimizer_integral t ht)

Data.sampler_continuous.exact_header:
theorem Data.sampler_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.sampler (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.sampler_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.sampler_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.sampler (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.drift
    U.drift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => U.sampler 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, U.drift r) +
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t)
      (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := (continuousOn_const.add hi).add
        (integral_continuous Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted).continuousOn
  exact hc.congr (fun t ht => U.sampler_integral t ht)

Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_header:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q D M T) (i : I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r i) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ)))
Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q D M T) (i : I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r i) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun r => U.diffusion r i) :=
    (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : I => Lp Z 2 Q) i).comp U.diffusion_continuous
  obtain ⟨P, _, hP⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_horizon_bound T _ hc
  have hm := TimeGridContinuity.horizon_memLp T _ hc.aestronglyMeasurable P hP
  rw [memLp_indicator_iff_restrict measurableSet_Ioc] at hm
  simpa only [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hm

Data.drift_adapted.exact_header:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[realFiltration Q D t] (U.drift t) Q
Data.drift_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[realFiltration Q D t] (U.drift t) Q := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t.toNNReal] (U.sampler t) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1.le] using U.sampler_adapted t.toNNReal
  have hd : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t.toNNReal]
      (fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (U.sampler t ω)) Q := by
    refine ⟨M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) ∘ hs.mk (U.sampler t), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((hb _).comp hs.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable).stronglyMeasurable
    · exact hs.ae_eq_mk.fun_comp _
  exact hd.congr (U.drift_realizes t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).symm

Data.residual_eq.exact_header:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q D M T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t =
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t
Data.residual_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q D M T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t =
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t := by
  dsimp only [martingaleResidual]
  rw [U.sampler_integral t ht]
  abel

Data.trajectory.exact_header:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.ModelIntegralTrajectory Q (realFiltration Q D) M T
Data.trajectory.exact_declaration:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.ModelIntegralTrajectory Q (realFiltration Q D) M T where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler := U.sampler
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion t i := U.diffusion t i
  noise := noise Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted
  optimizer_continuous := U.optimizer_continuous
  sampler_continuous := U.sampler_continuous
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable
  diffusion_timeL2 := U.diffusion_timeL2
  optimizerDrift_realizes := U.optimizerDrift_realizes
  optimizer_integral := U.optimizer_integral
  drift_realizes := U.drift_realizes
  diffusion_realizes := U.diffusion_realizes
  martingale := noise_martingale Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted
  noise_realizes t ht := (noise_ae Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t).trans
    (by rw [U.residual_eq t ht])
  initial_adapted := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration (0 : ℝ).toNNReal] (U.sampler 0) Q
    rw [Real.toNNReal_zero]
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero] using U.sampler_adapted 0
  drift_adapted := U.drift_adapted hb
  observation_integrable := U.observation_integrable

synchronous_isometry.exact_header:
theorem synchronous_isometry (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.SynchronousIsometry G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb)
synchronous_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem synchronous_isometry (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.SynchronousIsometry G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb) := by
  intro t ht
  change weightedPairing Q G.samplerWeight
      (martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t - martingaleResidual Q V.sampler V.drift t)
      (martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t - martingaleResidual Q V.sampler V.drift t) = _
  rw [U.residual_eq t ht, V.residual_eq t ht]
  exact difference_isometry Q D T U.diffusion V.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous
    V.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted V.diffusion_adapted
    G.samplerWeight G.sampler_symmetric t ht

law_distance_decay.exact_header:
theorem law_distance_decay (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2)
law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) := by
  exact IntegralModelContraction.pair_law_distance_decay G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb)
    T.coe_nonneg hb hσ ρ hmono (synchronous_isometry G U V hb)

OneHilbert.exact_declaration: abbrev OneHilbert (N : ℕ) (S Z : Type*) := WithLp 2 (S × PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z))

PairHilbert.exact_declaration: abbrev PairHilbert (N : ℕ) (S Z : Type*) := WithLp 2 (OneHilbert N S Z × OneHilbert N S Z)

oneEquiv.exact_header: def oneEquiv (N : ℕ) : OneHilbert N S Z ≃L[ℝ] (S × (Fin N → Z))
oneEquiv.exact_declaration:
def oneEquiv (N : ℕ) : OneHilbert N S Z ≃L[ℝ] (S × (Fin N → Z)) :=
  (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ S (PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z))).trans
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodCongr (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ S)
      (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin N => Z)))

pairEquiv.exact_header: def pairEquiv (N : ℕ) : PairHilbert N S Z ≃L[ℝ] ParticlePair N S Z

optimizerProjection.exact_header: def optimizerProjection (N : ℕ) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] S
optimizerProjection.exact_declaration:
def optimizerProjection (N : ℕ) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] S :=
  (particleOptimizerDifference N).comp (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap

samplerProjection.exact_header: def samplerProjection (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] Z
samplerProjection.exact_declaration:
def samplerProjection (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] Z :=
  (particleSamplerDifference N i).comp (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap

metricWeight.exact_header: def metricWeight (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] PairHilbert N S Z
metricWeight.exact_declaration:
def metricWeight (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) : PairHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] PairHilbert N S Z :=
  (optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N).adjoint.comp (G.optimizerWeight.comp (optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N)) +
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
      (samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N i).adjoint.comp (G.samplerWeight.comp (samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N i))

metricWeight_inner.exact_header:
theorem metricWeight_inner (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : PairHilbert N S Z) :

metricWeight_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem metricWeight_inner (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : PairHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x, metricWeight N G y⟫_ℝ =
      particleQuadraticBilinear G N (pairEquiv N x) (pairEquiv N y) := by
  simp only [metricWeight, add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    smul_apply, sum_apply,
    inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_sum]
  rw [(optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N).adjoint_inner_right]
  simp_rw [(samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N _).adjoint_inner_right]
  rw [particleQuadraticBilinear_apply]

metricWeight_symmetric.exact_declaration:

particleBilinear_transport.exact_header:
theorem particleBilinear_transport (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (PairHilbert N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N G ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q U)
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q V) =
      weightedPairing Q (metricWeight N G) U V
particleBilinear_transport.exact_declaration:
theorem particleBilinear_transport (N : ℕ) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (PairHilbert N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N G ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q U)
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q V) =
      weightedPairing Q (metricWeight N G) U V := by
  rw [particleBilinear_integral, weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL U,
    (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL V] with ω hu hv

computed_isometry.exact_header:
theorem computed_isometry (Driver : Driver (I := K) Q) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := K) (Z := H) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i)
computed_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem computed_isometry (Driver : Driver (I := K) Q) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := K) (Z := H) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i) := by
  have he := stochasticIntegral_weighted Q Driver W hW (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
    (continuousCutDomain Q Driver T u hu hU t.toNNReal)
  change weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
    (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) = _ at he
  rw [continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut, timeCut_weighted, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1] at he
  rw [he, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (continuousDomain_coe Q Driver T u hu hU),
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr hrt
  have hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨hrt.1, hrt.2.trans ht.2⟩
  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hR] at hr
  rw [hr]

martingale_banach_map.exact_header:
theorem martingale_banach_map [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} (P : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) :
    Martingale (fun t => P ∘ m t) ℱ Q
martingale_banach_map.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_banach_map [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} (P : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) :
    Martingale (fun t => P ∘ m t) ℱ Q := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    exact P.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hm.stronglyAdapted t)
  · intro s t hst
    exact (P.comp_condExp_comm (hm.integrable t)).symm.trans
      ((hm.condExp_ae_eq hst).fun_comp P)

Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data where
  state : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := Fin N × I) (Z := PairHilbert N S Z) Q
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  diffusion_continuous : Continuous diffusion
  state_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (state t) Q
  diffusion_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ ij,
    AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (diffusion t ij) Q
  integral_equation : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), state t = state 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, drift r) +
    (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T diffusion diffusion_continuous diffusion_adapted t)
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (state t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ ij,
    (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (diffusion t ij) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => particleCopyDiffusion M N (state t ω) ij
  drift_measurable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Measurable (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t)
  diffusion_measurable : ∀ ij, Measurable (fun p => particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)

def Data.physicalDiffusion (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ij : Fin N × I) :

Data.noise.exact_header: def Data.noise (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) : Ω → ParticlePair N S Z

Data.continuous.exact_header: theorem Data.continuous (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) : ContinuousOn U.state (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.continuous (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) : ContinuousOn U.state (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.drift U.drift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hnoise := ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).continuous.comp
    (ConstructedItoModel.integral_continuous Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted)
  exact ((continuousOn_const.add hi).add hnoise.continuousOn).congr
    (fun t ht => U.integral_equation t ht)

Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_header:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.physicalDiffusion r ij) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ)))
Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.physicalDiffusion r ij) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun r => U.diffusion r ij) :=
    (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin N × I => Lp (PairHilbert N S Z) 2 Q) ij).comp
      U.diffusion_continuous
  obtain ⟨P, _, hP⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_horizon_bound T _ hc
  have hm := TimeGridContinuity.horizon_memLp T _ hc.aestronglyMeasurable P hP
  rw [memLp_indicator_iff_restrict measurableSet_Ioc] at hm
  have hm' : MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r ij) 2
      (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
    simpa only [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hm
  exact ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).comp_memLp' hm'

Data.drift_adapted.exact_header:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedItoModel.realFiltration Q Driver t] (U.drift t) Q
Data.drift_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedItoModel.realFiltration Q Driver t] (U.drift t) Q := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t.toNNReal] (U.state t) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1.le] using U.state_adapted t.toNNReal
  have hd : AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t.toNNReal]
      (fun ω => particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (U.state t ω)) Q := by
    refine ⟨particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t ∘ hs.mk (U.state t), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((U.drift_measurable t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).comp hs.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable).stronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hs.ae_eq_mk] with ω hω
      exact congrArg (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t) hω
  exact hd.congr (U.drift_realizes t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).symm

Data.residual_eq.exact_header:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t = (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t)
Data.residual_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t = (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t) := by
  dsimp only [driftResidual]
  rw [U.integral_equation t ht]
  abel

Data.trajectory.exact_header:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) :
    ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T (ConstructedItoModel.realFiltration Q Driver)
Data.trajectory.exact_declaration:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) :
    ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T (ConstructedItoModel.realFiltration Q Driver) where
  state := U.state
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion := U.physicalDiffusion
  noise := U.noise
  continuous := U.continuous
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable
  diffusion_timeL2 := U.diffusion_timeL2
  drift_realizes := U.drift_realizes
  diffusion_realizes := U.diffusion_realizes
  drift_measurable := U.drift_measurable
  diffusion_measurable := U.diffusion_measurable
  martingale := by
    exact martingale_banach_map Q (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap _
      (ConstructedItoModel.noise_martingale Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted)
  noise_realizes t ht := by
    have hn := ConstructedItoModel.noise_ae Q Driver T U.diffusion
      U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t
    have hc := (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (ConstructedItoModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t)
    rw [U.residual_eq t ht]
    filter_upwards [hn, hc] with ω hω hcω
    change (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N)
      (ConstructedItoModel.noise Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t ω) = _
    rw [hω]
    exact hcω.symm
  initial_adapted := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration (0 : ℝ).toNNReal] (U.state 0) Q
    rw [Real.toNNReal_zero]
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero] using U.state_adapted 0
  drift_adapted := U.drift_adapted

Data.synchronous_isometry.exact_header:
theorem Data.synchronous_isometry (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    U.trajectory.SynchronousIsometry G
Data.synchronous_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.synchronous_isometry (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    U.trajectory.SynchronousIsometry G := by
  intro t ht
  change particleBilinear Q N G (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t)
    (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t) = _
  rw [U.residual_eq t ht, particleBilinear_transport]
  rw [computed_isometry Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted
    (metricWeight N G) (metricWeight_symmetric N G) t ht]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro r _
  change (∑ ij, weightedPairing Q (metricWeight N G) (U.diffusion r ij) (U.diffusion r ij)) =
    ∑ ij, particleBilinear Q N G
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (U.diffusion r ij))
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (U.diffusion r ij))
  simp_rw [particleBilinear_transport]

    (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (U.law r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',

        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T))

    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (U.law r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hSync : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (U.state 0 ω).1 = (U.state 0 ω).2) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 (U.law T) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂U.law T) ≤

Data.parameter_target_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.parameter_target_bound
    (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter) (sStar : S)
    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (U.law r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hSync : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (U.state 0 ω).1 = (U.state 0 ω).2) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 (U.law T) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂U.law T) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) + ‖sbar T - sStar‖ := by
  obtain ⟨hm, htriangle⟩ := PBGSO.parameter_target_rms_bound M D hProjection N
    (U.law T) (sbar T) sStar (hbar T ⟨T.coe_nonneg, le_rfl⟩)
    (U.trajectory.quadratic_integrable D T)
  refine ⟨hm, htriangle.trans (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)⟩
  have hE := U.forced_energy_bound D hN ρ hρ hmono LΨ V hV sbar
    hν hF hCloud hbar hΨ hVariance hSync
  have he := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg D.lower)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt D.upper / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = D.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ, D.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  apply he.trans_eq
  rw [hs]
  ring

pullback_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem pullback_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (U : Lp Z 2 R)
    (hU : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] U R) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t] (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf U) Q := by

continuousIntegral_pullback.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_pullback (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    continuousIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r)) ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
      (fun r i => pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (continuousIntegral R D T u hu hU t)
continuousIntegral_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_pullback (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    continuousIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r)) ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
      (fun r i => pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (continuousIntegral R D T u hu hU t) := by
  let v := continuousCutDomain Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
    (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r)) ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
    (fun r i => pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)) t
  let w := pullbackDomain hf D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
    (continuousCutDomain R D T u hu hU t)
  have hv : v = w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Lp.ext
    have hw := (columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).coeFn_compLpL
      (continuousCutDomain R D T u hu hU t).val
    filter_upwards [continuousCutDomain_coe Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r)) ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
      (fun r i => pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)) t,
      continuousCutDomain_coe R D T u hu hU t, hw] with r hv hr hw
    change v.val r = w.val r
    change w.val r = columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf ((continuousCutDomain R D T u hu hU t).val r) at hw
    rw [hv, hw, hr]
    by_cases hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) <;> by_cases hrt : r ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)
    all_goals simp only [Set.indicator, hR, hrt, ite_true, ite_false, map_zero]
  change stochasticIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) _ v = _
  rw [hv]
  exact stochasticIntegral_pullback hf D _ _

theorem continuousIntegral_pullback_enlarge (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
    (hp : (pullbackDriver hf D).process = E.process)
    (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    continuousIntegral Q E T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
      (fun r i => (pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)).mono (he r)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (continuousIntegral R D T u hu hU t)
continuousIntegral_pullback_enlarge.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_pullback_enlarge (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
    (hp : (pullbackDriver hf D).process = E.process)
    (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    continuousIntegral Q E T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp hu)
      (fun r i => (pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i)).mono (he r)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (continuousIntegral R D T u hu hU t) := by
  rw [continuousIntegral_enlarge Q (pullbackDriver hf D) E hp he T
    _ _ (fun r i => pullback_adapted hf D r (u r i) (hU r i))]

Data.pullback.exact_header: def Data.pullback (U : Data R D M T) : Data Q E M T
Data.pullback.exact_declaration:
def Data.pullback (U : Data R D M T) : Data Q E M T where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler t := lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.sampler t)
  drift t := lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.drift t)
  diffusion t := columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (U.diffusion t)
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable
  drift_integrable := by
    constructor
    · exact (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).integrable_comp U.drift_integrable.1
    · exact (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).integrable_comp U.drift_integrable.2
  diffusion_continuous := (columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).continuous.comp U.diffusion_continuous
  sampler_adapted t := (pullback_adapted hf D t (U.sampler t) (U.sampler_adapted t)).mono (he t)
  diffusion_adapted t i :=
    (pullback_adapted hf D t (U.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion_adapted t i)).mono (he t)
  optimizerDrift_realizes t ht := by
    rw [lpPullback_law]
    exact U.optimizerDrift_realizes t ht
  optimizer_integral := U.optimizer_integral
  sampler_integral t ht := by
    have hi := congrArg (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf) (U.sampler_integral t ht)
    rw [map_add, map_add, ← (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).intervalIntegral_comp_comm
      (U.drift_integrable.mono_set (by
        rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1, uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
        exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2))] at hi
    rw [hi]
    congr 1
    exact (continuousIntegral_pullback_enlarge hf D E hp he T U.diffusion
      U.diffusion_continuous U.diffusion_adapted t.toNNReal).symm
  drift_realizes t ht := by
    filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (U.drift t),
      hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.drift_realizes t ht),
      lpPullback_coe hf (U.sampler t)] with ω hd hr hs
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hr
    rw [hd, hr, hs]
  diffusion_realizes t ht i := by
    filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (U.diffusion t i),
      hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.diffusion_realizes t ht i),
      lpPullback_coe hf (U.sampler t)] with ω hd hr hs
    change (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.diffusion t i)) ω = _
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hr
    rw [hd, hr, hs]
  observation_integrable t ht := by
    rw [lpPullback_law]
    exact U.observation_integrable t ht

exists_joint_continuous_noise.exact_header:
theorem exists_joint_continuous_noise (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∃ b : ℝ → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) ∧
      (∀ t, b t =ᵐ[Q] integral Q D T u hu hU t) ∧
      ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => b t ω)
exists_joint_continuous_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_joint_continuous_noise (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∃ b : ℝ → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) ∧
      (∀ t, b t =ᵐ[Q] integral Q D T u hu hU t) ∧
      ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => b t ω) := by
  let C := predictableDomain Q D T (curveHorizon Q T u hu) (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T u hu hU)
  obtain ⟨V⟩ := exists_continuousWindowVersion Q D T C hB
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgc, hge⟩ := ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_realization Q D T C V
  let c : ℝ → Window T := fun t => windowClip T t.toNNReal
  have hc : Continuous c := (windowClip_continuous T).comp continuous_real_toNNReal
  let b : ℝ → Ω → Z := fun t ω => g (c t) ω
  have hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) :=
    hg.comp_measurable ((hc.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_, fun ω => (hgc ω).comp hc⟩
  intro t
  have hgv : b t =ᵐ[Q] V.process (c t) := hge.mono (fun ω hω => hω (c t))
  have he : b t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T C (c t).val := hgv.trans (V.realizes (c t))
  change b t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T C t.toNNReal
  have hs : closedIntegral Q D T C (c t).val = closedIntegral Q D T C t.toNNReal :=
    closedIntegral_stopped Q D T C t.toNNReal
  exact he.trans (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => congrArg (fun A : Lp Z 2 Q => A ω) hs))

Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version_o.exact_header:
theorem Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version_of_stronglyMeasurable (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω))
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) × Z =>
      M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer p.1.val)) p.2)) :
    ∃ u b : ℝ → Ω → Z,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧ StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t =ᵐ[Q] U.sampler t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), b t =ᵐ[Q]
        integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ≥0, (t : ℝ) ≤ T → AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t) Q) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        u 0 ω = U.sampler 0 ω ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun t => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (u t ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t ω - u 0 ω =
          (∫ s in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω)) + b t ω
Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version_o.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version_of_stronglyMeasurable (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω))
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) × Z =>
      M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer p.1.val)) p.2)) :
    ∃ u b : ℝ → Ω → Z,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧ StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t =ᵐ[Q] U.sampler t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), b t =ᵐ[Q]
        integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ≥0, (t : ℝ) ≤ T → AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t) Q) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        u 0 ω = U.sampler 0 ω ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun t => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (u t ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t ω - u 0 ω =
          (∫ s in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω)) + b t ω := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbEq, hbc⟩ := exists_joint_continuous_noise U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted hB
  let ct : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => min (max t 0) (T : ℝ)
  have hct : Continuous ct := (continuous_id.max continuous_const).min continuous_const
  have hct_mem (t : ℝ) : ct t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ⟨le_min (le_max_right _ _) T.coe_nonneg, min_le_right _ _⟩
  have hct_eq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ct t = t := by
    simp only [ct, max_eq_left ht.1, min_eq_left ht.2]
  let cw : ℝ → Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := fun t => ⟨ct t, hct_mem t⟩
  have hcw : Continuous cw := hct.subtype_mk _
  let f : ℝ → Z → Z := fun t z => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer (ct t))) z
  have hfm : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f) :=
    hf.comp_measurable ((hcw.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hF : IntegrableOn U.drift (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp U.drift_integrable
  have hfield (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : U.drift t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => f t (U.sampler t ω) := by
    simpa only [f, hct_eq t ht] using U.drift_realizes t ht
  have heq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : U.sampler t - U.sampler 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, U.drift s) + integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t := by
    rw [U.sampler_integral t ht]
    abel
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huEq, hupath⟩ := LpContinuousVersion.exists_continuous_integral_version_of_stronglyMeasurable Q
    (T : ℝ) T.coe_nonneg U.sampler U.drift
    (integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted)
    hF b hb (fun t _ => hbEq t) (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => (hbc ω).continuousOn)) f hfm hfield heq
  refine ⟨u, b, hu, hb, huEq, (fun t _ => hbEq t), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact (U.sampler_adapted t).congr (huEq t ⟨t.coe_nonneg, ht⟩).symm
  · filter_upwards [hupath] with ω hω
    have hfeq (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
        f s (u s ω) = M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω) := by
      simp only [f, hct_eq s hs]
    have hfi : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun s => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ) :=
      hω.2.2.1.congr (fun s hs => hfeq s (by
        rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hs
        exact ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩))
    refine ⟨hω.1, (hbc ω).continuousOn, hω.2.1, hfi, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    have hi : (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) =
        ∫ s in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hs
      exact hfeq s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
    rw [← hi]
    exact hω.2.2.2 t ht

theorem parameter_bound
    (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 νStar) (aStar : S)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory R L νStar hνStar aStar B)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hparam : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖(particleRealization R L M H D μ hμ a B hB hB0 N hN V hVariance).parameter hparam t -
      Lp.const 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) (μ.prod R)) (M.parameter aStar)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
      ((L.responseLip : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t))
parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem parameter_bound
    (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 νStar) (aStar : S)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory R L νStar hνStar aStar B)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hparam : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t aStar 0 = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ V) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖(particleRealization R L M H D μ hμ a B hB hB0 N hN V hVariance).parameter hparam t -
      Lp.const 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) (μ.prod R)) (M.parameter aStar)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
      ((L.responseLip : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  let T := AdditiveStationary.stationaryParameterData R L M H νStar hνStar aStar B hB hB0
    Frozen D ρ hρ hmono hparam hg hfix μ hμ a
  let P := particleRealization R L M H D μ hμ a B hB hB0 N hN V hVariance
  have h := P.parameter_bound T hV t ht
  have hs : T.sStar = aStar := rfl
  have hν : T.νStar = νStar := rfl
  have hopt : AdditiveCanonical.optimizer R L μ hμ a B hB hB0 0 = a :=
    congrArg Prod.fst (AdditiveCanonical.flow_spec R L μ hμ a B hB hB0).2
  have hb : T.continuousBudget L.responseLip V N t =
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
      ((L.responseLip : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
    simp only [StationaryParameterData.continuousBudget, hs, hν, hopt,
      AdditiveCanonical.law_zero]
  have hfinal := h.trans_eq hb
  simpa only [hs] using hfinal

theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ)
    (hV0 : V.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν
law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ)
    (hV0 : V.sampler 0 = AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings μ ν (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μ ν hμ hν)
    (fun c => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  intro c hc
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ ν c
  let Uc := U.pullback hf E (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_process_eq μ ν c)
    (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_filtration_le μ ν c)
  let Vc := V.pullback hg E (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_process_eq μ ν c)
    (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_filtration_le μ ν c)
  have h := ConstructedPredictableModel.law_distance_decay G Uc Vc hb hσ ρ hmono
  change optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
    (Q.map (lpPullbackCLM hf (U.sampler T))) (Q.map (lpPullbackCLM hg (V.sampler T))) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖lpPullbackCLM hf (U.sampler 0) - lpPullbackCLM hg (V.sampler 0)‖ ^ 2) at h
  rw [lpPullback_law hf, lpPullback_law hg, hU0, hV0,
    initial_difference_norm_sq μ ν hμ hν c] at h
  exact h

    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)

    weightedPairing Q W (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t)
      (integral Q D T u hu hU t - integral Q D T v hv hV t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, diffusionEnergy Q W (fun r i => u r i - v r i) r := by
  have he := predictableCurveIntegral_increment_isometry Q D T (u - v)
    (hu.sub hv) (curveSubtract_adapted Q D u v hU hV) W hW 0 t.toNNReal (by simp) (by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
      exact ht.2)
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_zero, sub_zero] at he

  rw [← hs]

structure Data where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift : ℝ → S
  sampler : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q
  optimizerDrift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable optimizerDrift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  diffusion_square : MemLp diffusion 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
  sampler_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (sampler t) Q
  diffusion_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i,
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (diffusion t i) Q
  optimizerDrift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), optimizerDrift t =
    M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler t))
  optimizer_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    optimizer t = optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, optimizerDrift r
  sampler_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    sampler t = sampler 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, drift r) +
      integral Q D T diffusion diffusion_square diffusion_adapted t
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i, diffusion t i =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω) i
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (sampler t))

Data.optimizer_continuous.exact_header:
theorem Data.optimizer_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.optimizer_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.optimizer_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.optimizerDrift
    U.optimizerDrift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => U.optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, U.optimizerDrift r)
      (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := continuousOn_const.add hi
  exact hc.congr (fun t ht => U.optimizer_integral t ht)

Data.sampler_continuous.exact_header:
theorem Data.sampler_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.sampler (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.sampler_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.sampler_continuous (U : Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.sampler (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.drift
    U.drift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => U.sampler 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, U.drift r) +
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t)
      (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := (continuousOn_const.add hi).add
        (integral_continuous Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted).continuousOn
  exact hc.congr (fun t ht => U.sampler_integral t ht)

Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_header:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q D M T) (i : I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r i) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ)))
Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q D M T) (i : I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r i) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
  have hm := (FilteredBrownian.columnEval (I := I) (Z := Z) Q i).comp_memLp' U.diffusion_square
  simpa only [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg, Function.comp_def, FilteredBrownian.columnEval_apply] using hm

Data.drift_adapted.exact_header:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[realFiltration Q D t] (U.drift t) Q
Data.drift_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[realFiltration Q D t] (U.drift t) Q := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t.toNNReal] (U.sampler t) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1.le] using U.sampler_adapted t.toNNReal
  have hd : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t.toNNReal]
      (fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (U.sampler t ω)) Q := by
    refine ⟨M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) ∘ hs.mk (U.sampler t), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((hb _).comp hs.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable).stronglyMeasurable
    · exact hs.ae_eq_mk.fun_comp _
  exact hd.congr (U.drift_realizes t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).symm

Data.residual_eq.exact_header:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q D M T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t =
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t
Data.residual_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q D M T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t =
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t := by
  dsimp only [martingaleResidual]
  rw [U.sampler_integral t ht]
  abel

Data.trajectory.exact_header:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.ModelIntegralTrajectory Q (realFiltration Q D) M T
Data.trajectory.exact_declaration:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q D M T) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.ModelIntegralTrajectory Q (realFiltration Q D) M T where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler := U.sampler
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion t i := U.diffusion t i
  noise := noise Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted
  optimizer_continuous := U.optimizer_continuous
  sampler_continuous := U.sampler_continuous
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable
  diffusion_timeL2 := U.diffusion_timeL2
  optimizerDrift_realizes := U.optimizerDrift_realizes
  optimizer_integral := U.optimizer_integral
  drift_realizes := U.drift_realizes
  diffusion_realizes := U.diffusion_realizes
  martingale := noise_martingale Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted
  noise_realizes t ht := (noise_ae Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t).trans
    (by rw [U.residual_eq t ht])
  initial_adapted := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration (0 : ℝ).toNNReal] (U.sampler 0) Q
    rw [Real.toNNReal_zero]
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero] using U.sampler_adapted 0
  drift_adapted := U.drift_adapted hb
  observation_integrable := U.observation_integrable

synchronous_isometry.exact_header:
theorem synchronous_isometry (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.SynchronousIsometry G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb)
synchronous_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem synchronous_isometry (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)) :
    IntegralModelContraction.SynchronousIsometry G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb) := by
  intro t ht
  change weightedPairing Q G.samplerWeight
      (martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t - martingaleResidual Q V.sampler V.drift t)
      (martingaleResidual Q U.sampler U.drift t - martingaleResidual Q V.sampler V.drift t) = _
  rw [U.residual_eq t ht, V.residual_eq t ht]
  exact difference_isometry Q D T U.diffusion V.diffusion U.diffusion_square
    V.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted V.diffusion_adapted
    G.samplerWeight G.sampler_symmetric t ht

law_distance_decay.exact_header:
theorem law_distance_decay (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2)
law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : Data Q D M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) := by
  exact IntegralModelContraction.pair_law_distance_decay G (U.trajectory hb) (V.trajectory hb)
    T.coe_nonneg hb hσ ρ hmono (synchronous_isometry G U V hb)

computed_isometry.exact_header:
theorem computed_isometry {K H : Type*} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    (Driver : Driver (I := K) Q) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := K) (Z := H) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i)
computed_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem computed_isometry {K H : Type*} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
    (Driver : Driver (I := K) Q) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := K) (Z := H) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i) := by
  have he := predictableCurveIntegral_increment_isometry Q Driver T u hu hU W hW
    0 t.toNNReal (by simp) (by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
      exact ht.2)
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_zero, sub_zero] at he
  change weightedPairing Q W (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t)
    (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T u hu hU t) = _ at he
  rw [he, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
  rfl

Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data where
  state : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := Fin N × I) (Z := PairHilbert N S Z) Q
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  diffusion_square : MemLp diffusion 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
  state_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (state t) Q
  diffusion_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ ij,
    AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t] (diffusion t ij) Q
  integral_equation : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), state t = state 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, drift r) +
    (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T diffusion diffusion_square diffusion_adapted t)
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (state t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ ij,
    (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (diffusion t ij) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => particleCopyDiffusion M N (state t ω) ij
  drift_measurable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Measurable (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t)
  diffusion_measurable : ∀ ij, Measurable (fun p => particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)

Data.physicalDiffusion.exact_header:
def Data.physicalDiffusion (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q

Data.noise.exact_header: def Data.noise (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) : Ω → ParticlePair N S Z

Data.continuous.exact_header: theorem Data.continuous (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) : ContinuousOn U.state (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
Data.continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.continuous (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) : ContinuousOn U.state (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous U.drift U.drift_integrable).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hnoise := ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).continuous.comp
    (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral_continuous Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted)
  exact ((continuousOn_const.add hi).add hnoise.continuousOn).congr
    (fun t ht => U.integral_equation t ht)

Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_header:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.physicalDiffusion r ij) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ)))
Data.diffusion_timeL2.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.diffusion_timeL2 (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    MemLp (fun r => U.physicalDiffusion r ij) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
  have hm := (FilteredBrownian.columnEval (I := Fin N × I)
    (Z := PairHilbert N S Z) Q ij).comp_memLp' U.diffusion_square
  have hm' : MemLp (fun r => U.diffusion r ij) 2
      (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
    simpa only [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg, Function.comp_def,
      FilteredBrownian.columnEval_apply] using hm
  exact ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).comp_memLp' hm'

Data.drift_adapted.exact_header:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q Driver t] (U.drift t) Q
Data.drift_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.drift_adapted (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q Driver t] (U.drift t) Q := by
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t.toNNReal] (U.state t) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1.le] using U.state_adapted t.toNNReal
  have hd : AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration t.toNNReal]
      (fun ω => particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (U.state t ω)) Q := by
    refine ⟨particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t ∘ hs.mk (U.state t), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((U.drift_measurable t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).comp hs.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable).stronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hs.ae_eq_mk] with ω hω
      exact congrArg (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t) hω
  exact hd.congr (U.drift_realizes t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).symm

Data.residual_eq.exact_header:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t = (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t)
Data.residual_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.residual_eq (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t = (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t) := by
  dsimp only [driftResidual]
  rw [U.integral_equation t ht]
  abel

Data.trajectory.exact_header:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) :
    ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q Driver)
Data.trajectory.exact_declaration:
def Data.trajectory (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) :
    ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q Driver) where
  state := U.state
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion := U.physicalDiffusion
  noise := U.noise
  continuous := U.continuous
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable
  diffusion_timeL2 := U.diffusion_timeL2
  drift_realizes := U.drift_realizes
  diffusion_realizes := U.diffusion_realizes
  drift_measurable := U.drift_measurable
  diffusion_measurable := U.diffusion_measurable
  martingale := by
    exact martingale_banach_map Q (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap _
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.noise_martingale Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted)
  noise_realizes t ht := by
    have hn := ConstructedPredictableModel.noise_ae Q Driver T U.diffusion
      U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t
    have hc := (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t)
    rw [U.residual_eq t ht]
    filter_upwards [hn, hc] with ω hω hcω
    change (pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N)
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.noise Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t ω) = _
    rw [hω]
    exact hcω.symm
  initial_adapted := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable[Driver.filtration (0 : ℝ).toNNReal] (U.state 0) Q
    rw [Real.toNNReal_zero]
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero] using U.state_adapted 0
  drift_adapted := U.drift_adapted

Data.synchronous_isometry.exact_header:
theorem Data.synchronous_isometry (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    U.trajectory.SynchronousIsometry G
Data.synchronous_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.synchronous_isometry (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    U.trajectory.SynchronousIsometry G := by
  intro t ht
  change particleBilinear Q N G (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t)
    (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift t) = _
  rw [U.residual_eq t ht, particleBilinear_transport]
  rw [computed_isometry Q Driver T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted
    (metricWeight N G) (metricWeight_symmetric N G) t ht]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro r _
  change (∑ ij, weightedPairing Q (metricWeight N G) (U.diffusion r ij) (U.diffusion r ij)) =
    ∑ ij, particleBilinear Q N G
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (U.diffusion r ij))
      ((pairEquiv (S := S) (Z := Z) N).toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (U.diffusion r ij))
  simp_rw [particleBilinear_transport]

theorem Data.parameter_target_bound
    (U : Data Q Driver M ν T) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter) (sStar : S)
    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (U.law r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hSync : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (U.state 0 ω).1 = (U.state 0 ω).2) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 (U.law T) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂U.law T) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) + ‖sbar T - sStar‖ := by
  obtain ⟨hm, htriangle⟩ := PBGSO.parameter_target_rms_bound M D hProjection N
    (U.law T) (sbar T) sStar (hbar T ⟨T.coe_nonneg, le_rfl⟩)
    (U.trajectory.quadratic_integrable D T)
  refine ⟨hm, htriangle.trans (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)⟩
  have hE := U.forced_energy_bound D hN ρ hρ hmono LΨ V hV sbar
    hν hF hCloud hbar hΨ hVariance hSync
  have he := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg D.lower)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt D.upper / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = D.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ, D.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  apply he.trans_eq
  rw [hs]
  ring

The original time-L² diffusion, integral equation and marginal laws transport
through a measure-preserving source map and valid filtration enlargement.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

  {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q R)
  {D : Driver (I := I) R} (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (hp : (pullbackDriver hf D).process = E.process)
  (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
  {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}

/-- Original model data transported into one actual common Brownian source.
All marginal laws and the stochastic integral equation are derived. -/

Data.pullback.exact_declaration:
def Data.pullback (U : Data R D M T) : Data Q E M T where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler t := lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.sampler t)
  drift t := lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.drift t)
  diffusion t := columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (U.diffusion t)
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable
  drift_integrable := by
    constructor
    · exact (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).integrable_comp U.drift_integrable.1
    · exact (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).integrable_comp U.drift_integrable.2
  diffusion_square := (columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' U.diffusion_square
  sampler_adapted t := (columnPullback_adapted hf D t (U.sampler t) (U.sampler_adapted t)).mono (he t)
  diffusion_adapted t i :=
    (columnPullback_adapted hf D t (U.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion_adapted t i)).mono (he t)
  optimizerDrift_realizes t ht := by
    rw [lpPullback_law]
    exact U.optimizerDrift_realizes t ht
  optimizer_integral := U.optimizer_integral
  sampler_integral t ht := by
    have hi := congrArg (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf) (U.sampler_integral t ht)
    rw [map_add, map_add, ← (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf).intervalIntegral_comp_comm
      (U.drift_integrable.mono_set (by
        rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1, uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
        exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2))] at hi
    rw [hi]
    congr 1
    exact (predictableCurveIntegral_pullback_enlarge hf D E hp he T U.diffusion
      U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t.toNNReal).symm
  drift_realizes t ht := by
    filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (U.drift t),
      hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.drift_realizes t ht),
      lpPullback_coe hf (U.sampler t)] with ω hd hr hs
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hr
    rw [hd, hr, hs]
  diffusion_realizes t ht i := by
    filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (U.diffusion t i),
      hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.diffusion_realizes t ht i),
      lpPullback_coe hf (U.sampler t)] with ω hd hr hs
    change (lpPullbackCLM (E := Z) hf (U.diffusion t i)) ω = _
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hr
    rw [hd, hr, hs]
  observation_integrable t ht := by
    rw [lpPullback_law]
    exact U.observation_integrable t ht

    (rawDiffusionIntegral_representative_ae Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA t.toNNReal).trans (hnoise t).symm

      (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) Q := by
    refine ⟨fun t => hR.stronglyAdapted t.toNNReal, ?_⟩
    intro s t hst
    exact hR.condExp_ae_eq (Real.toNNReal_mono hst)

    intro t ht

    rw [he]
    abel

    hxcont hmcont hpaths

theorem work_product_integrable (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hσA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q)
    (hxjoint : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hxA : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D t] (x t) Q)
    (hmA : StronglyAdapted (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) m)
    (hnoise : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA t.toNNReal)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ⟪x p.1 p.2, W (b p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let J := rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA
  let R := MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration J
  have hR : Martingale R D.filtration Q :=
    rawDiffusionIntegral_martingale Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA
  have hrep (t : ℝ) : R t.toNNReal =ᵐ[Q] m t :=
    (rawDiffusionIntegral_representative_ae Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA t.toNNReal).trans (hnoise t).symm
  have hmartR : Martingale (fun t : ℝ => R t.toNNReal)
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) Q := by
    refine ⟨fun t => hR.stronglyAdapted t.toNNReal, ?_⟩
    intro s t hst
    exact hR.condExp_ae_eq (Real.toNNReal_mono hst)
  have hm : Martingale m (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) Q :=
    hmartR.congr hmA hrep
  have h2m (t : ℝ) : MemLp (m t) 2 Q := (memLp_congr_ae (hnoise t)).mpr (Lp.memLp _)
  have hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hxcont, hpaths] with ω hx hp
    have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous (fun r => b r ω) hp.1).continuousOn
    rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
    apply ((hx.sub continuousOn_const).sub hi).congr
    intro t ht
    have he := hp.2.2 t ht
    change m t ω = (x t ω - x 0 ω) - (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)
    rw [he]
    abel
  let A := ExpectedBilinearLimits.spatialPairing W
  have hWork := (RandomVariationWork.integrable_and_swap Q
    (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) T A x b m hxjoint hb (h2x 0) h2m
    hm B hB hxcont hmcont hpaths).1
  simp only [A, ExpectedBilinearLimits.spatialPairing_apply] at hWork
  exact hWork

theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)

    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))

    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q)
    (hxA : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      AEStronglyMeasurable[ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D t] (x t) Q)
    (hmA : StronglyAdapted (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) m)
    (hnoise : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hσA t.toNNReal)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :

    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +

    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +

  have hmartR : Martingale (fun t : ℝ => R t.toNNReal)
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.realFiltration Q D) Q := by
    refine ⟨fun t => hR.stronglyAdapted t.toNNReal, ?_⟩
    intro s t hst

      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), b t =ᵐ[Q]
        integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t) ∧
