Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.exists_continuous_sampler_version (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω))
    (hf : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × Z => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer p.1)) p.2)
      ((Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Z))) :
    ∃ u b : ℝ → Ω → Z,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧ StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t =ᵐ[Q] U.sampler t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), b t =ᵐ[Q]
        integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ≥0, (t : ℝ) ≤ T → AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t) Q) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        u 0 ω = U.sampler 0 ω ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun t => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (u t ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), u t ω - u 0 ω =
          (∫ s in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω)) + b t ω := by
  let C := predictableDomain Q D T (curveHorizon Q T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square)
    (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted)
  obtain ⟨V⟩ := exists_continuousWindowVersion Q D T C hB
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgc, hge⟩ := ContinuousWindowVersion.exists_joint_realization Q D T C V
  let c : ℝ → Window T := fun t => windowClip T t.toNNReal
  have hc : Continuous c := (windowClip_continuous T).comp continuous_real_toNNReal
  let b : ℝ → Ω → Z := fun t ω => g (c t) ω
  have hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) :=
    hg.comp_measurable ((hc.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hbc (ω : Ω) : Continuous (fun t => b t ω) := (hgc ω).comp hc
  have hbEq (t : ℝ) (_ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : b t =ᵐ[Q]
      integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t := by
    have hgv : b t =ᵐ[Q] V.process (c t) := hge.mono (fun ω hω => hω (c t))
    have he : b t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T C (c t).val := hgv.trans (V.realizes (c t))
    change b t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T C t.toNNReal
    have hs : closedIntegral Q D T C (c t).val = closedIntegral Q D T C t.toNNReal :=
      closedIntegral_stopped Q D T C t.toNNReal
    exact he.trans (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => congrArg (fun A : Lp Z 2 Q => A ω) hs))
  let ct : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ((c t).val : ℝ)
  have hct : Continuous ct := continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp hc)
  have hct_mem (t : ℝ) : ct t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ⟨(c t).val.coe_nonneg, by exact_mod_cast (c t).property⟩
  have hct_eq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ct t = t := by
    change ((min t.toNNReal T : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = t
    have hh : t.toNNReal ≤ T := by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
      exact ht.2
    rw [min_eq_left hh, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
  let f : ℝ → Z → Z := fun t z => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer (ct t))) z
  have hfc : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) :=
    hf.comp_continuous ((hct.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
      (fun p => ⟨hct_mem p.1, Set.mem_univ p.2⟩)
  have hF : IntegrableOn U.drift (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp U.drift_integrable
  have hfield (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : U.drift t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => f t (U.sampler t ω) := by
    simpa only [f, hct_eq t ht] using U.drift_realizes t ht
  have heq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : U.sampler t - U.sampler 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, U.drift s) + integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted t := by
    rw [U.sampler_integral t ht]
    abel
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huEq, hupath⟩ := LpContinuousVersion.exists_continuous_integral_version Q
    (T : ℝ) T.coe_nonneg U.sampler U.drift
    (integral Q D T U.diffusion U.diffusion_square U.diffusion_adapted)
    hF b hb hbEq (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => (hbc ω).continuousOn)) f hfc hfield heq
  refine ⟨u, b, hu, hb, huEq, hbEq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact (U.sampler_adapted t).congr (huEq t ⟨t.coe_nonneg, ht⟩).symm
  · filter_upwards [hupath] with ω hω
    have hdpath : ContinuousOn
        (fun t => M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (u t ω)) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
      hf.comp (continuousOn_id.prodMk hω.1) (fun t ht => ⟨ht, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    refine ⟨hω.1, (hbc ω).continuousOn, hω.2.1, hdpath.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc T.coe_nonneg, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    have hi : (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) =
        ∫ s in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (u s ω) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      have hs' : s ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := by
        rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hs
        exact ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
      simp only [f, hct_eq s hs']
    rw [← hi]
    exact hω.2.2 t ht

FrozenSamplerData.exact_declaration:
structure FrozenSamplerData (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) where
  sampler : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  diffusion_square : MemLp diffusion 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
  sampler_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (sampler t) Q
  diffusion_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i,
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (diffusion t i) Q
  sampler_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), sampler t = sampler 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, drift r) +
    ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T diffusion diffusion_square diffusion_adapted t
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter sStar) (sampler t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i, diffusion t i =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter sStar) (sampler t ω) i
  invariant_law : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (sampler t) = νStar

theorem FrozenSamplerData.probability {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}

  have he := F.invariant_law 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩
  rw [← he]
  exact (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance

def FrozenSamplerData.constantData {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}

    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)

FrozenSamplerData.constantData.exact_declaration:
def FrozenSamplerData.constantData {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) : Data Q D M T where
  optimizer _ := sStar
  optimizerDrift _ := 0
  sampler := F.sampler
  drift := F.drift
  diffusion := F.diffusion
  optimizerDrift_integrable := intervalIntegrable_const
  drift_integrable := F.drift_integrable
  diffusion_square := F.diffusion_square
  sampler_adapted := F.sampler_adapted
  diffusion_adapted := F.diffusion_adapted

    change 0 = M.optimizer t sStar (M.meanGradient (Q.map (F.sampler t)) sStar)

  sampler_integral := F.sampler_integral
  drift_realizes := F.drift_realizes
  diffusion_realizes := F.diffusion_realizes
  observation_integrable := by
    intro t ht
    rw [F.invariant_law t ht]

theorem stationary_of_frozen (hunique : DataUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hz : U.sampler 0 = F.sampler 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler t) = νStar
stationary_of_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_of_frozen (hunique : DataUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hz : U.sampler 0 = F.sampler 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler t) = νStar := by
  have hu := hunique U (F.constantData hint hg hfix) hs hz t ht
  refine ⟨hu.1, ?_⟩
  rw [hu.2]
  exact F.invariant_law t ht

theorem stationary_product_law [MeasurableSpace S] (hunique : DataUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)

          (∫ ω, ⟪M (min t (τ ω)) ω, W (M (min t (τ ω)) ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
            ∫ r in Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, ∑ i,
              ∫ ω in {ω | r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)},
                ⟪(U.val r).ofLp i ω, W ((U.val r).ofLp i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  obtain ⟨M, hMM, hMC, hM⟩ := exists_constructed_continuous_martingale_version Q D T U
  obtain ⟨N, hNM, hNC, hN⟩ := exists_constructed_continuous_martingale_version Q D T
    (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U)
  refine ⟨M, N, hMM, hNM, hMC, hNC, hM, hN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply continuous_versions_indistinguishable Q N (fun t ω => M (min t (τ ω)) ω) hNC
    · exact hMC.mono (fun ω hc => hc.comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const))
    · intro t
      exact (hN t).trans
        (boundedStoppedIntegral_realizes_of_continuous Q D T τ hτ hstop U M hM hMC t)
  · intro W hW t ht
    exact boundedStopped_path_isometry Q D T τ hτ hstop U M hM hMC W hW t ht

  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (T : ℝ≥0)

/-- One-sided joint dissipativity proves actual same-initial pathwise

dataUniqueness_of_twisted.exact_header:
theorem dataUniqueness_of_twisted (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) : DataUniqueness Q D M T
dataUniqueness_of_twisted.exact_declaration:
theorem dataUniqueness_of_twisted (G : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) : DataUniqueness Q D M T := by
  intro U V hs hz t ht
  have hIso : IntegralModelContraction.SynchronousIsometry G
      ((U.trajectory hb).restrict ht) ((V.trajectory hb).restrict ht) := by
    intro r hr
    exact (ConstructedPredictableModel.synchronous_isometry G U V hb) r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have hd := IntegralModelContraction.pair_rms_decay G
    ((U.trajectory hb).restrict ht) ((V.trajectory hb).restrict ht) ht.1 hb hσ ρ hmono hIso
  change Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler t - V.sampler t‖ ^ 2) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) at hd
  simp only [hs, hz, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0),
    add_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero] at hd
  have he := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (le_antisymm hd (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)),
    zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] at he
  have ho : ‖U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖U.sampler t - V.sampler t‖]
  have hz' : ‖U.sampler t - V.sampler t‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t‖]
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ho)),
    sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz'))⟩

modified_future_independent.exact_header:
private theorem modified_future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun ω i => AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) t ω -
        AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) s ω) inferInstance)
      (D.filtration s) Q
modified_future_independent.exact_declaration:
private theorem modified_future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun ω i => AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) t ω -
        AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) s ω) inferInstance)
      (D.filtration s) Q := by
  let old : Ω → I → ℝ := fun ω i => D.process i t ω - D.process i s ω
  let new : Ω → I → ℝ := fun ω i =>
    AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) t ω -
      AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i) s ω
  have heq : old =ᵐ[Q] new := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => modified_increment_ae Q D s t i)] with ω hω
    funext i
    exact (hω i).symm
  have hi : @IndepFun Ω (I → ℝ) Ω mΩ inferInstance (D.filtration s) old id Q := by
    simpa only [IndepFun, Kernel.IndepFun, Indep, MeasurableSpace.comap_id] using D.future_independent s t hst
  have hj := hi.congr heq (Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl : (id : Ω → Ω) =ᵐ[Q] id)

def continuousDriver : Driver (I := I) Q where
  process i := AdaptedBrownianModification.process (D.process i)
  brownian i := (AdaptedBrownianModification.isBrownianReal Q (D.process i)
    (D.brownian i)).toIsPreBrownianReal
  filtration := D.filtration
  adapted i := AdaptedBrownianModification.process_stronglyAdapted
    D.filtration (D.process i) (D.adapted i)
  increment_coordinates s t hst :=
    (D.increment_coordinates s t hst).congr

  future_independent := modified_future_independent Q D

flow_add.exact_header:
theorem flow_add (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Φ (t + s, x) = Φ (s, Φ (t, x))
flow_add.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_add (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Φ (t + s, x) = Φ (s, Φ (t, x)) := by
  have hshift (u : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r => Φ (t + r, x))
      (f (Φ (t + u, x))) u := by
    simpa only [zero_add, one_smul, Function.comp_def] using (hODE (t + u) x).scomp u
      ((hasDerivAt_const u t).add (hasDerivAt_id u))
  let a := min 0 s - 1
  let b := max 0 s + 1
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo a b := by
    constructor <;> dsimp [a, b] <;>
      linarith [min_le_left (0 : ℝ) s, le_max_left (0 : ℝ) s]
  have hs : s ∈ Icc a b := by
    constructor <;> dsimp [a, b] <;>
      linarith [min_le_right (0 : ℝ) s, le_max_right (0 : ℝ) s]
  have heq := FlowSourceRegularity.trajectories_unique_Icc f hf a b 0 hzero
    (fun r => Φ (t + r, x)) (fun r => Φ (r, Φ (t, x)))
    (fun u _ => (hshift u).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun u _ => (hODE u (Φ (t, x))).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun u _ => hshift u) (fun u _ => hODE u (Φ (t, x)))
    (by simp only [add_zero, hinit])
  exact heq hs

flow_bijective.exact_header:
theorem flow_bijective (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun x => Φ (t, x))
flow_bijective.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_bijective (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun x => Φ (t, x)) := by
  have hinv (s : ℝ) (x : E) : Φ (-s, Φ (s, x)) = x := by

  constructor
  · intro x y hxy

  · intro x

    (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)

theorem divergenceFree_flow_measurePreserving
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hdiv : ∀ x, (ContinuousVolume.derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f x)).trace = 0)
    (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))

    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x => Φ (t, x)) volume volume := by
  have hΦ := FlowSourceRegularity.flow_contDiff Φ f hf hODE hinit
  have ht : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => Φ (t, x)) :=
    (hΦ.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).differentiable (by norm_num)

maximal_norm_measure_le.exact_header:
theorem maximal_norm_measure_le (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → H) (hX : Martingale X F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 Q) (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ n, τ n ≤ T)
    (δ b : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (_hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hE : (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ δ ^ 2 * b) :
    Q {ω | ∃ n, δ ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b
maximal_norm_measure_le.exact_declaration:
theorem maximal_norm_measure_le (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → H) (hX : Martingale X F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 Q) (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ n, τ n ≤ T)
    (δ b : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (_hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hE : (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ δ ^ 2 * b) :
    Q {ω | ∃ n, δ ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b := by
  let a : ℝ≥0 := ⟨δ ^ 2, sq_nonneg δ⟩
  have hm := MartingaleMaximalL2.maximal_countable Q F X hX h2 τ T hτ a
  have he : {ω | ∃ n, δ ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖} = {ω | ∃ n, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    apply exists_congr
    intro n
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ hδ.le (norm_nonneg _)).symm
  have ha : (a : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2) := ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq a
  rw [ha, ← he] at hm
  apply (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (by positivity : ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2) ≠ 0)
    ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
  calc
    Q {ω | ∃ n, δ ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖} * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2) * Q {ω | ∃ n, δ ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖} := mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := hm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2 * b) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hE
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal b * ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ 2) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg δ), mul_comm]

ae_uniform_of_terminal_bounds.exact_header:
theorem ae_uniform_of_terminal_bounds (f : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → H)
    (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q) (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (δ b : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 < δ n) (hsδ : Summable δ)
    (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) (hsb : Summable b)
    (hE : ∀ n, (∫ ω, ‖f (n + 1) T ω - f n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ (δ n) ^ 2 * b n)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val ω)
      (fun t => MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val) t ω) atTop ∧
      Continuous (fun t : Window T =>
        MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val) t ω)
ae_uniform_of_terminal_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_uniform_of_terminal_bounds (f : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → H)
    (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q) (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (δ b : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 < δ n) (hsδ : Summable δ)
    (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) (hsb : Summable b)
    (hE : ∀ n, (∫ ω, ‖f (n + 1) T ω - f n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ (δ n) ^ 2 * b n)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val ω)
      (fun t => MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val) t ω) atTop ∧
      Continuous (fun t : Window T =>
        MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val) t ω) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Window T) := ⟨⟨0, by change (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ T; exact zero_le⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_dense_seq (Window T)
  have hm (n : ℕ) :
      Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ Set.range τ, δ n ≤ ‖f (n + 1) t.val ω - f n t.val ω‖} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b n) := by
    have hd := maximal_norm_measure_le Q F (f (n + 1) - f n) ((hf (n + 1)).sub (hf n))
      (fun t => (h2 (n + 1) t).sub (h2 n t)) (fun k => (τ k).val) T (fun k => (τ k).property)
      (δ n) (b n) (hδ n) (hb n) (hE n)
    convert hd using 2
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, Pi.sub_apply]
    aesop
  have hbad : (∑' n, Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ Set.range τ, δ n ≤ ‖f (n + 1) t.val ω - f n t.val ω‖}) ≠ ∞ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hsb.tsum_ofReal_ne_top (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hm)
  exact MartingaleUniformLimit.ae_uniform_seriesLimit Q (fun n (t : Window T) => f n t.val)
    (Set.range τ) hτ δ hsδ hbad (hc.mono (fun ω hω n => (hω n).comp continuous_subtype_val))

exists_uniform_subsequence.exact_header:
theorem exists_uniform_subsequence (f : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → H)
    (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q) (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (hcau : CauchySeq (fun n => (h2 n T).toLp (f n T)))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val ω)
        (fun t => MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val) t ω) atTop ∧
        Continuous (fun t : Window T =>
          MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val) t ω)
exists_uniform_subsequence.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_uniform_subsequence (f : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → H)
    (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q) (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (hcau : CauchySeq (fun n => (h2 n T).toLp (f n T)))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val ω)
        (fun t => MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val) t ω) atTop ∧
        Continuous (fun t : Window T =>
          MartingaleUniformLimit.seriesLimit (fun n (t : Window T) => f (φ n) t.val) t ω) := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hdist⟩ := Metric.exists_subseq_bounded_of_cauchySeq
    (fun n => (h2 n T).toLp (f n T)) hcau (fun n => (1 / (4 : ℝ)) ^ n) (fun n => by positivity)
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  apply ae_uniform_of_terminal_bounds Q F (fun n => f (φ n)) (fun n => hf (φ n))
    (fun n t => h2 (φ n) t) T (fun n => (1 / (2 : ℝ)) ^ n) (fun n => (1 / (4 : ℝ)) ^ n)
    (fun n => by positivity) summable_geometric_two (fun n => by positivity)
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  · intro n
    let A := (h2 (φ (n + 1)) T).toLp (f (φ (n + 1)) T)
    let B := (h2 (φ n) T).toLp (f (φ n) T)
    have he : (∫ ω, ‖f (φ (n + 1)) T ω - f (φ n) T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = ‖A - B‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub A B, (h2 (φ (n + 1)) T).coeFn_toLp,
        (h2 (φ n) T).coeFn_toLp] with ω hab ha hb
      change A ω = _ at ha
      change B ω = _ at hb
      rw [hab, Pi.sub_apply, ha, hb]
    rw [he]
    have hd := (hdist n (φ (n + 1)) (hφ.monotone (Nat.le_succ n))).le
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
    have hp : ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) ^ n) ^ 2 = (1 / (4 : ℝ)) ^ n := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm n 2, pow_mul]
      norm_num
    rw [hp]
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hd 2).trans_eq (pow_two _)
  · exact hc.mono (fun ω hω n => hω (φ n))

then derive joint strong measurability; no jointly measurable version is an

namespace PBGSO.ContinuousProcessRepresentative
variable {Ω T Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [TopologicalSpace T] [MetrizableSpace T] [MeasurableSpace T]
  [SecondCountableTopology T] [OpensMeasurableSpace T]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z]
  [SecondCountableTopology Z]

exists_joint.exact_header:
theorem exists_joint (Q : Measure Ω) (X : T → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, StronglyMeasurable (X t))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = X t ω
exists_joint.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_joint (Q : Measure Ω) (X : T → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, StronglyMeasurable (X t))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = X t ω := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hsub, hBm, hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null (ae_iff.mp hc)
  let g : T → Ω → Z := fun t ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else X t ω
  have hcont (ω : Ω) : Continuous (fun t => g t ω) := by
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simpa only [g, hω, ite_true] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : T => (0 : Z)))
    · have hgood : Continuous (fun t => X t ω) := by
        by_contra hbad
        exact hω (hsub hbad)
      simpa only [g, hω, ite_false] using hgood
  have hmeas (t : T) : StronglyMeasurable (g t) := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (B.piecewise (fun _ => (0 : Z)) (X t))
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise hBm (hX t)
  refine ⟨g, stronglyMeasurable_uncurry_of_continuous_of_stronglyMeasurable hcont hmeas, hcont, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr hB0] with ω hω t
  change ω ∉ B at hω
  simp only [g, hω, ite_false]

exists_joint_of_measurable.exact_header:
theorem exists_joint_of_measurable (Q : Measure Ω) (X : T → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, Measurable (X t))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = X t ω
exists_joint_of_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_joint_of_measurable (Q : Measure Ω) (X : T → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, Measurable (X t))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → Z, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, g t ω = X t ω :=
  exists_joint Q X (fun t => (hX t).stronglyMeasurable) hc

/-! # Genuine countable-horizon gluing of continuous process versions
Fixed-time identities on countably many dyadic points and path continuity
derive simultaneous overlap. The global process uses a deterministic horizon
larger than its current time, preserving actual adaptation.

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.ContinuousVersionGlue






variable {R : Type*} [MetricSpace R]

/-- Continuous paths agreeing on the actual dyadic grid agree on every
point of their common closed horizon. -/





variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (Q : Measure Ω)
  (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → R) (W : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → R)
  (hW : ∀ n t, t ≤ horizon n → W n t =ᵐ[Q] B t)
  (hc : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => W n t ω) (Iic (horizon n)))

include hW in

gridTime.exact_declaration: def gridTime (n k : ℕ) : ℝ≥0 := k / (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n

pastTime.exact_declaration:
def pastTime (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  (DyadicInterpolation.leftTime (2 ^ n) (t : ℝ)).toNNReal

pastTime_eq_grid.exact_header:
theorem pastTime_eq_grid (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    pastTime n t = gridTime n (DyadicInterpolation.leftIndex (2 ^ n) (t : ℝ))
pastTime_eq_grid.exact_declaration:
theorem pastTime_eq_grid (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    pastTime n t = gridTime n (DyadicInterpolation.leftIndex (2 ^ n) (t : ℝ)) := by
  apply NNReal.eq
  change ((DyadicInterpolation.leftTime (2 ^ n) (t : ℝ)).toNNReal : ℝ) = _
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (DyadicInterpolation.leftTime_nonneg _ _)]
  simp only [gridTime, DyadicInterpolation.leftTime, NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_natCast,
    NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]

pastTime_le.exact_header: theorem pastTime_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : pastTime n t ≤ t
pastTime_le.exact_declaration:
theorem pastTime_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : pastTime n t ≤ t := by
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  rw [pastTime, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (DyadicInterpolation.leftTime_nonneg _ _)]
  exact DyadicInterpolation.leftTime_le _ (by positivity) _ t.coe_nonneg

pastTime_tendsto.exact_header: theorem pastTime_tendsto (t : ℝ≥0) : Tendsto (fun n => pastTime n t) atTop (𝓝 t)
pastTime_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem pastTime_tendsto (t : ℝ≥0) : Tendsto (fun n => pastTime n t) atTop (𝓝 t) := by
  have h := (continuous_real_toNNReal.tendsto (t : ℝ)).comp
    (DyadicInterpolation.leftTime_dyadic_tendsto _ t.coe_nonneg)
  simpa only [Real.toNNReal_coe, Function.comp_def, pastTime] using h

eq_on_overlap_of_grid.exact_header:
theorem eq_on_overlap_of_grid (u v : ℝ≥0 → R) (a b : ℝ≥0)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Iic a)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Iic b))
    (hgrid : ∀ n k, gridTime n k ≤ a → gridTime n k ≤ b →
      u (gridTime n k) = v (gridTime n k))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (hta : t ≤ a) (htb : t ≤ b) : u t = v t
eq_on_overlap_of_grid.exact_declaration:
theorem eq_on_overlap_of_grid (u v : ℝ≥0 → R) (a b : ℝ≥0)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Iic a)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Iic b))
    (hgrid : ∀ n k, gridTime n k ≤ a → gridTime n k ≤ b →
      u (gridTime n k) = v (gridTime n k))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (hta : t ≤ a) (htb : t ≤ b) : u t = v t := by
  have hseq (c : ℝ≥0) (htc : t ≤ c) :
      Tendsto (fun n => pastTime n t) atTop (𝓝[Iic c] t) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨pastTime_tendsto t,
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (pastTime_le n t).trans htc)⟩
  have hU := (hu t hta).tendsto.comp (hseq a hta)
  have hV := (hv t htb).tendsto.comp (hseq b htb)
  have he : ∀ n, u (pastTime n t) = v (pastTime n t) := by
    intro n
    rw [pastTime_eq_grid]
    exact hgrid _ _ (by rw [← pastTime_eq_grid]; exact (pastTime_le n t).trans hta)
      (by rw [← pastTime_eq_grid]; exact (pastTime_le n t).trans htb)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hU (hV.congr (fun n => (he n).symm))

horizonIndex.exact_declaration: def horizonIndex (t : ℝ≥0) : ℕ := Nat.ceil (t : ℝ)

horizon_exceeds.exact_header: theorem horizon_exceeds (t : ℝ≥0) : t < horizon (horizonIndex t)
horizon_exceeds.exact_declaration:
theorem horizon_exceeds (t : ℝ≥0) : t < horizon (horizonIndex t) := by
  change (t : ℝ) < (Nat.ceil (t : ℝ) : ℝ) + 1
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_ceil _) (lt_add_one _)

globalVersion.exact_header: def globalVersion {Ω : Type*} (W : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → R) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : R
globalVersion.exact_declaration:
def globalVersion {Ω : Type*} (W : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → R) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : R :=
  W (horizonIndex t) t ω

globalVersion_ae.exact_header: theorem globalVersion_ae (t : ℝ≥0) : globalVersion W t =ᵐ[Q] B t
globalVersion_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem globalVersion_ae (t : ℝ≥0) : globalVersion W t =ᵐ[Q] B t :=
  hW _ _ (horizon_exceeds t).le

include hW hc in

ae_overlap.exact_header:
theorem ae_overlap : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m t,
    t ≤ horizon n → t ≤ horizon m → W n t ω = W m t ω
ae_overlap.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_overlap : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m t,
    t ≤ horizon n → t ≤ horizon m → W n t ω = W m t ω := by
  have hgrid : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m i k,
      gridTime i k ≤ horizon n → gridTime i k ≤ horizon m →
      W n (gridTime i k) ω = W m (gridTime i k) ω := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro n
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro m
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro k
    by_cases hn : gridTime i k ≤ horizon n
    · by_cases hm : gridTime i k ≤ horizon m
      · exact ((hW n _ hn).trans (hW m _ hm).symm).mono (fun ω he _ _ => he)
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ he => False.elim (hm he))
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ he _ => False.elim (hn he))
  filter_upwards [hgrid, ae_all_iff.mpr hc] with ω hg hcont
  intro n m t htn htm
  exact eq_on_overlap_of_grid (fun s => W n s ω) (fun s => W m s ω)
    _ _ (hcont n) (hcont m) (hg n m) t htn htm

include hW hc in

globalVersion_continuous.exact_header: theorem globalVersion_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => globalVersion W t ω)
globalVersion_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem globalVersion_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => globalVersion W t ω) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_overlap Q B W hW hc, ae_all_iff.mpr hc] with ω he hcont
  have hg (n : ℕ) : ContinuousOn (fun t => globalVersion W t ω) (Iic (horizon n)) := by
    apply (hcont n).congr
    intro t ht
    exact he (horizonIndex t) n t (horizon_exceeds t).le ht
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro t
  exact (hg (horizonIndex t) t (horizon_exceeds t).le).continuousAt
    (Iic_mem_nhds (horizon_exceeds t))

globalVersion_stronglyAdapted.exact_header:
theorem globalVersion_stronglyAdapted (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω))
    (hA : ∀ n, StronglyAdapted F (W n)) : StronglyAdapted F (globalVersion W)

  fun t => hA (horizonIndex t) t

/-- The integral ODE follows from the original time derivative and initial
condition by the fundamental theorem of calculus. -/

/-- Differentiating the actual integral ODE in its initial value proves
the spatial integral equation for a C¹ joint flow. -/

/-- The true spatial derivative satisfies the variational ODE with only
C¹ flow and C¹ vector-field regularity. Differentiation under the time
integral and the fundamental theorem of calculus prove this equation. -/

end COneFlow

section COneMatrixFlow
variable {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]

/-- The actual standard-basis Jacobian satisfies its matrix variational
equation for a C¹ joint flow of a C¹ vector field. -/

/-- C¹ regularity of the arbitrary coupled position force gives C¹
regularity of the actual interwoven A/B vector field. -/

/-- The continuous Jacobian determinant theorem for an actual C¹ joint
flow of the source's C¹ force field. The spatial variational equation is
derived by differentiation under its actual integral ODE. -/

/-- C¹-flow version of the source continuous volume lemma, stated with
the genuine derivative of the fixed-time flow. A global C¹ joint flow is
explicitly supplied; its smooth dependence from C¹ vector-field regularity
and globally existing individual trajectories is a separate obligation. -/

end COneMatrixFlow

detRows.exact_header: def detRows : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : ι => ι → ℝ) ℝ
detRows.exact_declaration:
def detRows : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : ι => ι → ℝ) ℝ where
  toMultilinearMap := (Matrix.detRowAlternating : (ι → ℝ) [⋀^ι]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ).toMultilinearMap
  cont := continuous_id.matrix_det

detRows_apply.exact_header: @[simp] theorem detRows_apply (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : detRows A = A.det
detRows_apply.exact_declaration: @[simp] theorem detRows_apply (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : detRows A = A.det := rfl

detRows_linearDeriv_mul.exact_header:
theorem detRows_linearDeriv_mul (A J : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (detRows.linearDeriv J) (A * J) = A.trace * J.det
detRows_linearDeriv_mul.exact_declaration:
theorem detRows_linearDeriv_mul (A J : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    (detRows.linearDeriv J) (A * J) = A.trace * J.det := by
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.linearDeriv_apply]
  change (∑ i, (J.updateRow i ((A * J) i)).det) = _
  have hrow (i : ι) : (A * J) i = ∑ k, A i k • J k := by
    ext j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [hrow, Matrix.det_updateRow_sum, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  rfl

hasDerivAt_det_of_variational.exact_declaration:
theorem hasDerivAt_det_of_variational {J : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hJ : HasDerivAt J (A * J t) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (J s).det) (A.trace * (J t).det) t := by
  have h := (detRows.hasFDerivAt (J t)).comp_hasDerivAt t hJ
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, detRows_apply, detRows_linearDeriv_mul] using h

det_eq_initial_of_variational.exact_header:
theorem det_eq_initial_of_variational (J A : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt J (A t * J t) t)
    (htrace : ∀ t, (A t).trace = 0) (t : ℝ) : (J t).det = (J 0).det
det_eq_initial_of_variational.exact_declaration:
theorem det_eq_initial_of_variational (J A : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt J (A t * J t) t)
    (htrace : ∀ t, (A t).trace = 0) (t : ℝ) : (J t).det = (J 0).det := by
  have hd (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r => (J r).det) 0 s := by
    simpa only [htrace s, zero_mul] using hasDerivAt_det_of_variational (hJ s)
  exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun s => (hd s).differentiableAt)
    (fun s => (hd s).deriv) t 0

positionProjection.exact_declaration:
def positionProjection : Phase ι →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj (Sum.inr i))

phaseField.exact_header: def phaseField (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι) : Phase ι
phaseField.exact_declaration:
def phaseField (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι) : Phase ι :=
  Sum.elim (fun i => -F (positionProjection z) i) (fun i => z (Sum.inl i))

phaseFieldDerivative.exact_header: def phaseFieldDerivative (L : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ)) : Phase ι →L[ℝ] Phase ι
phaseFieldDerivative.exact_declaration:
def phaseFieldDerivative (L : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ι → ℝ)) : Phase ι →L[ℝ] Phase ι :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi (Sum.elim
    (fun i => -((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp (L.comp positionProjection)))
    (fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj (Sum.inl i)))

phaseField_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem phaseField_hasFDerivAt (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (positionProjection z)) :
    HasFDerivAt (phaseField F) (phaseFieldDerivative (fderiv ℝ F (positionProjection z))) z
phaseField_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem phaseField_hasFDerivAt (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (positionProjection z)) :
    HasFDerivAt (phaseField F) (phaseFieldDerivative (fderiv ℝ F (positionProjection z))) z := by
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi.2
  intro k
  cases k with
  | inl i =>
    exact (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).hasFDerivAt.comp z
      (hF.hasFDerivAt.comp z positionProjection.hasFDerivAt)).neg)
  | inr i => exact (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (Sum.inl i) : Phase ι →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt

derivativeMatrix.exact_header:
def derivativeMatrix {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) : Matrix κ κ ℝ
derivativeMatrix.exact_declaration:
def derivativeMatrix {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) : Matrix κ κ ℝ :=
  fun i j => L (Pi.single j 1) i

derivativeMatrix_mul.exact_header:
theorem derivativeMatrix_mul {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (L K : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) :
    derivativeMatrix (L.comp K) = derivativeMatrix L * derivativeMatrix K
derivativeMatrix_mul.exact_declaration:
theorem derivativeMatrix_mul {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (L K : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) :
    derivativeMatrix (L.comp K) = derivativeMatrix L * derivativeMatrix K := by
  ext i j
  have hvec : K (Pi.single j 1) = ∑ k : κ, K (Pi.single j 1) k • Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) := by
    exact pi_eq_sum_univ' _
  change L (K (Pi.single j 1)) i = ∑ k, _
  rw [hvec, map_sum]
  simp [derivativeMatrix, Finset.sum_apply, map_smul, mul_comm]

phaseField_trace_zero.exact_header:
theorem phaseField_trace_zero (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (positionProjection z)) :
    (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (phaseField F) z)).trace = 0
phaseField_trace_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem phaseField_trace_zero (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (z : Phase ι)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (positionProjection z)) :
    (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (phaseField F) z)).trace = 0 := by
  rw [(phaseField_hasFDerivAt F z hF).fderiv]
  simp [derivativeMatrix, phaseFieldDerivative, positionProjection,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  change (∑ i : ι, (fderiv ℝ F (positionProjection z)) 0 i) = 0
  simp

spatial_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem spatial_hasFDerivAt (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (t, y))
      ((fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)) x
spatial_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem spatial_hasFDerivAt (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (t, y))
      ((fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)) x := by
  exact (hΦ (t, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp x
    ((hasFDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id x))

joint_time_derivative.exact_header:
theorem joint_time_derivative (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) : fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (1, 0) = f (Φ (t, x))
joint_time_derivative.exact_declaration:
theorem joint_time_derivative (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x : E) : fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (1, 0) = f (Φ (t, x)) := by
  have hd := (hΦ (t, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x))
  exact hd.unique (hode t x)

mixed_flow_variational.exact_header:
theorem mixed_flow_variational (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (t, x) (1, 0) (0, v) =
      fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x)) (fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (0, v))
mixed_flow_variational.exact_declaration:
theorem mixed_flow_variational (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (t, x) (1, 0) (0, v) =
      fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x)) (fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (0, v)) := by
  have hdΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ := hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hD : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) :=
    (hΦ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hsec : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => (t, y))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E) x :=
    (hasFDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id x)
  have hl := ((hD (t, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp x hsec).clm_apply
    (hasFDerivAt_const ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E)) x)
  have hr := (hf (Φ (t, x))).hasFDerivAt.comp x (spatial_hasFDerivAt Φ hdΦ t x)
  have heq : (fun y : E => fderiv ℝ Φ (t, y) (1, 0)) =
      (fun y : E => f (Φ (t, y))) :=
    funext (joint_time_derivative Φ f hdΦ hode t)
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hl hr
  rw [heq] at hl
  have he := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] E => L v) (hl.unique hr)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply, add_zero,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply] at he
  have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Φ (t, x) :=
    (hΦ.contDiffAt (x := (t, x))).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num)
  simp only [map_zero, zero_add] at he
  exact (hsym.eq (1, 0) (0, v)).trans he

flowJacobian.exact_header: def flowJacobian (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) : Matrix κ κ ℝ
flowJacobian.exact_declaration:
def flowJacobian (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) : Matrix κ κ ℝ :=
  fun i j => fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (0, Pi.single j 1) i

flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix.exact_header:
theorem flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    flowJacobian Φ t x = derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (t, y)) x)
flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix.exact_declaration:
theorem flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    flowJacobian Φ t x = derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (t, y)) x) := by
  rw [(spatial_hasFDerivAt Φ hΦ t x).fderiv]
  rfl

linearMap_eval_eq_sum.exact_header:
theorem linearMap_eval_eq_sum (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) (v : κ → ℝ) (i : κ) :
    L v i = ∑ j, derivativeMatrix L i j * v j
linearMap_eval_eq_sum.exact_declaration:
theorem linearMap_eval_eq_sum (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) (v : κ → ℝ) (i : κ) :
    L v i = ∑ j, derivativeMatrix L i j * v j := by
  conv_lhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' v]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp [derivativeMatrix, Finset.sum_apply, mul_comm]

flowJacobian_hasDeriv.exact_header:
theorem flowJacobian_hasDeriv (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)
      (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))) * flowJacobian Φ t x) t
flowJacobian_hasDeriv.exact_declaration:
theorem flowJacobian_hasDeriv (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)
      (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))) * flowJacobian Φ t x) t := by
  have hD : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) :=
    (hΦ.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have htime := (hD (t, x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x))
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.2
  intro i
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.2
  intro j
  have hcol := htime.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const t ((0 : ℝ), Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)))
  have hi := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hcol
  simp only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, map_zero, add_zero] at hi
  rw [mixed_flow_variational Φ f hΦ hf hode t x (Pi.single j 1)] at hi
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x i j) _ t at hi
  convert hi using 1
  exact (linearMap_eval_eq_sum (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x)))
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (0, Pi.single j 1)) i).symm

flowJacobian_initial.exact_header:
theorem flowJacobian_initial (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ) (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    flowJacobian Φ 0 x = 1
flowJacobian_initial.exact_declaration:
theorem flowJacobian_initial (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hΦ : Differentiable ℝ Φ) (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    flowJacobian Φ 0 x = 1 := by
  rw [flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix Φ hΦ]
  have he : (fun y => Φ (0, y)) = id := funext hinit
  rw [he, fderiv_id]
  ext i j
  simp [derivativeMatrix, Matrix.one_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

derivativeMatrix_det.exact_header:
theorem derivativeMatrix_det (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) :
    (derivativeMatrix L).det = L.det
derivativeMatrix_det.exact_declaration:
theorem derivativeMatrix_det (L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ)) :
    (derivativeMatrix L).det = L.det := by
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix' L.toLinearMap).det = L.toLinearMap.det
  exact LinearMap.det_toMatrix' _

phase_flowJacobian_det_one.exact_header:
theorem phase_flowJacobian_det_one
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (phaseField F (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : Phase ι) :
    (flowJacobian Φ t x).det = 1
phase_flowJacobian_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem phase_flowJacobian_det_one
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (phaseField F (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : Phase ι) :
    (flowJacobian Φ t x).det = 1 := by
  have hf : Differentiable ℝ (phaseField F) := fun z =>
    (phaseField_hasFDerivAt F z (hF _)).differentiableAt
  have hJ := flowJacobian_hasDeriv Φ (phaseField F) hΦ hf hode
  have htrace (s : ℝ) :
      (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (phaseField F) (Φ (s, x)))).trace = 0 :=
    phaseField_trace_zero F (Φ (s, x)) (hF _)
  have h := det_eq_initial_of_variational (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)
    (fun s => derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ (phaseField F) (Φ (s, x))))
    (fun s => hJ s x) htrace t
  rw [flowJacobian_initial Φ (hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num)) hinit x, Matrix.det_one] at h
  exact h

phase_flow_fderiv_det_one.exact_header:
theorem phase_flow_fderiv_det_one
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (phaseField F (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : Phase ι) :
    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (t, y)) x).det = 1
phase_flow_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem phase_flow_fderiv_det_one
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 2 Φ)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (phaseField F (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : Phase ι) :
    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (t, y)) x).det = 1 := by
  rw [← derivativeMatrix_det,
    ← flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix Φ (hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num))]
  exact phase_flowJacobian_det_one F hF Φ hΦ hode hinit t x

jointSpatialDerivative.exact_header: def jointSpatialDerivative (G : ℝ × E → E) (p : ℝ × E) : E →L[ℝ] E
jointSpatialDerivative.exact_declaration:
def jointSpatialDerivative (G : ℝ × E → E) (p : ℝ × E) : E →L[ℝ] E :=
  (fderiv ℝ G p).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)

jointSpatialDerivative_continuous.exact_header:
theorem jointSpatialDerivative_continuous (G : ℝ × E → E) (hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G) :
    Continuous (jointSpatialDerivative G)
jointSpatialDerivative_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem jointSpatialDerivative_continuous (G : ℝ × E → E) (hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G) :
    Continuous (jointSpatialDerivative G) :=
  (hG.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_comp continuous_const

integral_spatial_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem integral_spatial_hasFDerivAt (G : ℝ × E → E) (hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G)
    (a b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∫ s in a..b, G (s, y))
      (∫ s in a..b, jointSpatialDerivative G (s, x)) x
integral_spatial_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_spatial_hasFDerivAt (G : ℝ × E → E) (hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G)
    (a b : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∫ s in a..b, G (s, y))
      (∫ s in a..b, jointSpatialDerivative G (s, x)) x := by
  have hD := jointSpatialDerivative_continuous G hG
  have hcompact : IsCompact (uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall x 1) :=
    isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall x 1)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hcompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hD.continuousOn
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (s := Metric.closedBall x 1) (bound := fun _ => M)
    (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x zero_lt_one)
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y =>
      (hG.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable.mono_measure
        Measure.restrict_le_self)
  · exact (hG.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable a b
  · exact (hD.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable.mono_measure
      Measure.restrict_le_self
  · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro s hs y hy
    exact hM (s, y) ⟨⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩, hy⟩
  · exact intervalIntegrable_const
  · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro s hs y hy

theorem spatial_derivative_integral_identity (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    jointSpatialDerivative Φ (t, x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E +
      ∫ s in 0..t, jointSpatialDerivative (fun p => f (Φ p)) (s, x) := by
  have hleft := spatial_hasFDerivAt Φ (hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num)) t x

theorem jointSpatialDerivative_hasDeriv_C1 (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => jointSpatialDerivative Φ (s, x))
      ((fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))).comp (jointSpatialDerivative Φ (t, x))) t
jointSpatialDerivative_hasDeriv_C1.exact_declaration:
theorem jointSpatialDerivative_hasDeriv_C1 (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => jointSpatialDerivative Φ (s, x))
      ((fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))).comp (jointSpatialDerivative Φ (t, x))) t := by
  let G : ℝ × E → E := fun p => f (Φ p)
  have hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G := hf.comp hΦ
  have hD : Continuous (fun s => jointSpatialDerivative G (s, x)) :=
    (jointSpatialDerivative_continuous G hG).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hFTC := (hasDerivAt_const t (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).add
    (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hD.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
      (hD.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hD.continuousAt)
  have heq : (fun s => jointSpatialDerivative Φ (s, x)) =
      (fun s => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E + ∫ r in 0..s, jointSpatialDerivative G (r, x)) :=
    funext (fun s => spatial_derivative_integral_identity Φ f hΦ hf hode hinit s x)
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun s => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E + ∫ r in 0..s, jointSpatialDerivative G (r, x))
    (0 + jointSpatialDerivative G (t, x)) t at hFTC
  rw [← heq] at hFTC
  have hchain : fderiv ℝ G (t, x) =
      (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x)) :=
    (((hf.differentiable (by norm_num)) _).hasFDerivAt.comp (t, x)
      (((hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num)) _).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
  simpa only [zero_add, jointSpatialDerivative, hchain, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc] using hFTC

theorem flowJacobian_hasDeriv_C1 (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)
      (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))) * flowJacobian Φ t x) t
flowJacobian_hasDeriv_C1.exact_declaration:
theorem flowJacobian_hasDeriv_C1 (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hode : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)
      (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x))) * flowJacobian Φ t x) t := by
  have hJ := jointSpatialDerivative_hasDeriv_C1 Φ f hΦ hf hode hinit t x
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.2
  intro i
  apply hasDerivAt_pi.2
  intro j
  have hcol := hJ.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const t (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ)))
  have hi := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hcol
  simp only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, map_zero, add_zero,
    jointSpatialDerivative, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply] at hi
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x i j) _ t at hi
  convert hi using 1
  exact (linearMap_eval_eq_sum (fderiv ℝ f (Φ (t, x)))
    (fderiv ℝ Φ (t, x) (0, Pi.single j 1)) i).symm

PBGSO/CountableProductDependence.lean.shared_context:
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.MeasurableSpace.Prod
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated

/-! # Countable spatial dependence of jointly measurable random fields

Every measurable set in a product algebra uses only countably many spatial
generators. A random field valued in a countably generated codomain therefore
is jointly measurable over a countably generated subalgebra of its original
sample space. No separability of the ambient probability measure is needed.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace PBGSO.CountableProductDependence
variable {T Ω R : Type*} [mT : MeasurableSpace T] [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]


/-- A product measurable event depends on a countable collection of
original spatial events. The dependence is exact, not only almost everywhere. -/

variable [mR : MeasurableSpace R] [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated R]

/-- A jointly measurable field has an actual countably generated spatial
subalgebra on which it is still jointly measurable. -/

end PBGSO.CountableProductDependence

prod_mono_right.exact_header:
private theorem prod_mono_right {m n : MeasurableSpace Ω} (h : m ≤ n) :
    mT.prod m ≤ mT.prod n

measurableSet_countable_spatial_dependen.exact_declaration:
theorem measurableSet_countable_spatial_dependence {s : Set (T × Ω)}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∃ C : Set (Set Ω), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, MeasurableSet c) ∧
      @MeasurableSet (T × Ω) (mT.prod (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom C)) s := by
  rw [← generateFrom_prod] at hs
  induction s, hs using MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_induction with
  | hC s hs _ =>
    obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,rfl⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨{b}, countable_singleton _, by simpa using hb,
      @MeasurableSet.prod T Ω mT (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {b}) a b ha
        (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (by simp))⟩
  | empty => exact ⟨∅, countable_empty, by simp,
      @MeasurableSet.empty (T × Ω) (mT.prod (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom ∅))⟩
  | compl s hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hCm,hCs⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨C,hC,hCm,hCs.compl⟩
  | iUnion s hs ih =>
    choose C hC hCm hCs using ih
    refine ⟨⋃ n, C n, countable_iUnion hC, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c hc
      obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hc
      exact hCm n c hn
    · apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
      intro n
      exact prod_mono_right (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_mono (subset_iUnion C n)) _ (hCs n)

measurable_countable_spatial_dependence.exact_declaration:
theorem measurable_countable_spatial_dependence (f : T × Ω → R) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∃ m : MeasurableSpace Ω, m ≤ mΩ ∧ @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Ω m ∧
      @Measurable (T × Ω) R (mT.prod m) mR f := by
  let B := MeasurableSpace.countableGeneratingSet R
  have hB : B.Countable := MeasurableSpace.countable_countableGeneratingSet (α := R)
  letI : Countable B := hB.to_subtype
  have h (s : B) : ∃ C : Set (Set Ω), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, MeasurableSet c) ∧
      @MeasurableSet (T × Ω) (mT.prod (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom C)) (f ⁻¹' s.val) :=
    measurableSet_countable_spatial_dependence (hf
      (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_countableGeneratingSet s.property))
  choose C hC hCm hCs using h
  let A := ⋃ s : B, C s
  have hA : A.Countable := countable_iUnion hC
  have hAm : ∀ a ∈ A, MeasurableSet a := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp ha
    exact hCm s a hs
  have hCG : @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Ω (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom A) :=
    @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated.mk Ω (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom A) ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩
  refine ⟨MeasurableSpace.generateFrom A, MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le hAm, hCG, ?_⟩
  apply (@measurable_iff_comap_le (T × Ω) R (mT.prod (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom A)) mR f).mpr
  rw [← MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_countableGeneratingSet (α := R),
    MeasurableSpace.comap_generateFrom]
  apply MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le
  rintro _ ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩
  exact prod_mono_right (MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_mono (subset_iUnion C (⟨s,hs⟩ : B))) _
    (hCs (⟨s,hs⟩ : B))

theorem projection_filtration_le (j : Z → Y) (hj : Continuous j) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (filtration (Z := Y) (I := I) t).comap
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ (j p.1, p.2)) ≤
      filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) t
projection_filtration_le.exact_declaration:
theorem projection_filtration_le (j : Z → Y) (hj : Continuous j) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (filtration (Z := Y) (I := I) t).comap
      (fun p : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I ↦ (j p.1, p.2)) ≤
      filtration (Z := Z) (I := I) t := by
  simp only [filtration, Filtration.natural_eq_comap, MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
  let H : (Iic t → Z × (I → ℝ)) → (Iic t → Y × (I → ℝ)) :=
    fun h r ↦ (j (h r).1, (h r).2)
  have hH : Measurable H := measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun r ↦
    (hj.measurable.comp ((measurable_pi_apply r).fst)).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply r).snd
  have hh := MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (g := fun p (r : Iic t) ↦ process r p) hH.comap_le
  simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp, H, Function.comp_def, process] using hh

These estimates are valid for nonconservative forces. The quantities in the

the lemmas do not assume a stochastic energy identity or assert SDE existence.

noncomputable section
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO

/-- Diagonal dominance gives an explicit small-gain rate, without a spectral
eigenvalue computation. Here `a,b` are the two squared-energy square roots. -/

/-- The determinant small-gain condition, written as a completed square.
It proves positive definiteness for every nonzero pair. -/

/-- Combine projected strong monotonicity, auxiliary dissipation and an

small_gain_diagonal.exact_header:
theorem small_gain_diagonal (a b rOpt rSam cross diffusion ρ : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ cross) (ho : ρ ≤ rOpt - diffusion - cross / 2)
    (hs : ρ ≤ rSam - diffusion - cross / 2) :
    -rOpt * a ^ 2 - rSam * b ^ 2 + cross * a * b +
      diffusion * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ -ρ * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
small_gain_diagonal.exact_declaration:
theorem small_gain_diagonal (a b rOpt rSam cross diffusion ρ : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ cross) (ho : ρ ≤ rOpt - diffusion - cross / 2)
    (hs : ρ ≤ rSam - diffusion - cross / 2) :
    -rOpt * a ^ 2 - rSam * b ^ 2 + cross * a * b +
      diffusion * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ -ρ * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
  have hcross := mul_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg (a - b))
  have hOpt := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ho) (sq_nonneg a)
  have hSam := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs) (sq_nonneg b)
  nlinarith

small_gain_positive.exact_header:
theorem small_gain_positive (A B C a b : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hdet : C ^ 2 < 4 * A * B) (hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) :
    0 < A * a ^ 2 - C * a * b + B * b ^ 2
small_gain_positive.exact_declaration:
theorem small_gain_positive (A B C a b : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hdet : C ^ 2 < 4 * A * B) (hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) :
    0 < A * a ^ 2 - C * a * b + B * b ^ 2 := by
  have hid : 4 * A * (A * a ^ 2 - C * a * b + B * b ^ 2) =
      (2 * A * a - C * b) ^ 2 + (4 * A * B - C ^ 2) * b ^ 2 := by ring
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · have ha : a ≠ 0 := hab.resolve_right (by simpa only [hb, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true])
    simp only [hb, mul_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), sub_zero, add_zero]
    exact mul_pos hA (sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha)
  · have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdet) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * A * a - C * b)]

theorem projected_dissipation (workOpt workSam opt sam R auxOpt auxSam
    β rPhi AOpt ASam ρ energy : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hPhi : rPhi * R ≤ workOpt + workSam)
    (hOpt : opt ≤ -β * workOpt - auxOpt + AOpt * R)
    (hSam : sam ≤ -β * workSam - auxSam + ASam * R)
    (hmetric : ρ * energy ≤ (β * rPhi - AOpt - ASam) * R + auxOpt + auxSam) :

projected_dissipation.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_dissipation (workOpt workSam opt sam R auxOpt auxSam
    β rPhi AOpt ASam ρ energy : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hPhi : rPhi * R ≤ workOpt + workSam)
    (hOpt : opt ≤ -β * workOpt - auxOpt + AOpt * R)
    (hSam : sam ≤ -β * workSam - auxSam + ASam * R)
    (hmetric : ρ * energy ≤ (β * rPhi - AOpt - ASam) * R + auxOpt + auxSam) :

  have hw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPhi hβ

hypocoerciveEnergy.exact_header: def hypocoerciveEnergy (γ : ℝ) (q p : H) : ℝ
hypocoerciveEnergy.exact_declaration:
def hypocoerciveEnergy (γ : ℝ) (q p : H) : ℝ :=
  γ * ‖q‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ⟪q, p⟫ + (2 / γ) * ‖p‖ ^ 2

hypocoerciveEnergy_identity.exact_header:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_identity (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p : H) :
    γ * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p = ‖γ • q + p‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2
hypocoerciveEnergy_identity.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_identity (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p : H) :
    γ * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p = ‖γ • q + p‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp only [hypocoerciveEnergy, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_add_left,
    inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm p q]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

hypocoerciveEnergy_pos.exact_header:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H)
    (hqp : q ≠ 0 ∨ p ≠ 0) : 0 < hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p
hypocoerciveEnergy_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H)
    (hqp : q ≠ 0 ∨ p ≠ 0) : 0 < hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p := by
  have hid := hypocoerciveEnergy_identity γ (ne_of_gt hγ) q p
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · have hq : q ≠ 0 := hqp.resolve_right (by simpa only [hp, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true])
    simp only [hypocoerciveEnergy, hp, norm_zero, inner_zero_right,
      zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact mul_pos hγ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hq))
  · have hn := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖γ • q + p‖]

hypocoercive_pairing.exact_header:
theorem hypocoercive_pairing (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p f : H) :
    ⟪q, γ • p + (-f - γ • p)⟫ +
      ⟪p, p + (2 / γ) • (-f - γ • p)⟫ =
      -⟪q, f⟫ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫
hypocoercive_pairing.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_pairing (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p f : H) :
    ⟪q, γ • p + (-f - γ • p)⟫ +
      ⟪p, p + (2 / γ) • (-f - γ • p)⟫ =
      -⟪q, f⟫ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫ := by
  simp only [inner_add_right, inner_sub_right, inner_neg_right,
    real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

force_cross_young.exact_header:
theorem force_cross_young (δ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (p f : H) :
    -δ * ⟪p, f⟫ ≤ η * ‖p‖ ^ 2 + δ ^ 2 / (4 * η) * ‖f‖ ^ 2
force_cross_young.exact_declaration:
theorem force_cross_young (δ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (p f : H) :
    -δ * ⟪p, f⟫ ≤ η * ‖p‖ ^ 2 + δ ^ 2 / (4 * η) * ‖f‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hs := sq_nonneg ‖(2 * η) • p + δ • f‖
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hs
  simp only [inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm p f,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs] at hs
  have hy : -δ * ⟪p, f⟫ - η * ‖p‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 / (4 * η) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * η by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]

theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_upper (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H) :
    hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p ≤

hypocoerciveEnergy_upper.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_upper (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H) :
    hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p ≤
      (γ + 1 + 2 / γ) * (‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hcross := sq_nonneg ‖q - p‖
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real] at hcross
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ 2 / γ := by positivity
  have hq := mul_nonneg hdiv (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)
  have hp := mul_nonneg hγ.le (sq_nonneg ‖p‖)
  dsimp [hypocoerciveEnergy]
  nlinarith

theorem hypocoercive_dissipation (γ η r L ρ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (q p f : H)
    (hmono : r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪q, f⟫)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2)
    (hrateQ : ρ * (γ + 1 + 2 / γ) ≤ r - (2 / γ) ^ 2 / (4 * η) * L ^ 2)
    (hrateP : ρ * (γ + 1 + 2 / γ) ≤ 1 - η) :
    -⟪q, f⟫ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫ ≤
      -ρ * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p
hypocoercive_dissipation.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_dissipation (γ η r L ρ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (q p f : H)
    (hmono : r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪q, f⟫)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2)
    (hrateQ : ρ * (γ + 1 + 2 / γ) ≤ r - (2 / γ) ^ 2 / (4 * η) * L ^ 2)
    (hrateP : ρ * (γ + 1 + 2 / γ) ≤ 1 - η) :
    -⟪q, f⟫ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫ ≤
      -ρ * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p := by
  have hy := force_cross_young (2 / γ) η hη p f
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (2 / γ) ^ 2 / (4 * η) := by positivity
  have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hforce hcoef
  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrateQ (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrateP (sq_nonneg ‖p‖)
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hypocoerciveEnergy_upper γ hγ q p) hρ

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Integrals.Basic

/-! # Deterministic damping after a genuine stopping time
After the stopping time the state is extended by exponential contraction.
The original stopped Brownian noise stays unchanged. This supplies sharp
dissipation at all times without a stochastic product-rule premise.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.DampedContinuation
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]








/-- The after-stop correction is an ordinary deterministic exponential
primitive, even though the stopping time will later depend on the sample. -/

/-- The new drift differs from the genuinely stopped original drift only
by the explicit ordinary exponential correction. -/

/-- Actual original stopped integral equations imply the damped integral
equation. No stochastic integration-by-parts or multiplied-noise identity
is assumed. -/



/-- Damping never enlarges the original stopped state. -/


/-- The extended drift has a genuinely square-integrable random variation
budget whenever the stopped state has one; no new uniform cap is imposed. -/

end PBGSO.DampedContinuation

damping.exact_header: def damping (ρ τ t : ℝ) : ℝ
damping.exact_declaration: def damping (ρ τ t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (-ρ * (t - min t τ))

extension.exact_header: def extension (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) (t : ℝ) : E
extension.exact_declaration: def extension (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) (t : ℝ) : E := damping ρ τ t • x (min t τ)

drift.exact_header: def drift (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (r : ℝ) : E
drift.exact_declaration:
def drift (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (r : ℝ) : E :=
  if r ≤ τ then b r else -ρ • extension ρ τ x r

correction.exact_header: def correction (ρ τ r : ℝ) : ℝ
correction.exact_declaration:
def correction (ρ τ r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if τ < r then -ρ * Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ)) else 0

extension_before.exact_header:
theorem extension_before (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ τ) :

extension_before.exact_declaration:
theorem extension_before (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ τ) :

extension_after.exact_header:
theorem extension_after (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : τ ≤ t) :

theorem extension_after (ρ τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : τ ≤ t) :

correction_integrable.exact_header:

correction_integrable.exact_declaration:

    IntervalIntegrable (correction ρ τ) volume a t := by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
  have h : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => -ρ * Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ))) := by fun_prop
  exact (h.integrableOn_Icc).mono_set (uIoc_subset_uIcc) |>.indicator measurableSet_Ioi

integral_correction.exact_header:
theorem integral_correction (ρ τ t : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, correction ρ τ r) = damping ρ τ t - 1
integral_correction.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_correction (ρ τ t : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, correction ρ τ r) = damping ρ τ t - 1 := by
  have hd (r : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r => Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ)))
      (-ρ * Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ))) r := by
    simpa only [id_eq, mul_one, mul_comm] using ((((hasDerivAt_id r).sub_const τ).const_mul (-ρ)).exp)
  by_cases h : t ≤ τ
  · have hz : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, correction ρ τ r) = 0 := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_zero_ae
      apply ae_of_all
      intro r hr
      simp only [uIoc_of_le ht,mem_Ioc] at hr
      exact ite_eq_right (not_lt_of_ge (hr.2.trans h))
    rw [hz]
    simp [damping,min_eq_left h]
  · have hτt : τ ≤ t := (lt_of_not_ge h).le
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht]
    change (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, (Ioi τ).indicator
      (fun r => -ρ * Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ))) r) = _
    rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
    have hs : Ioc (0 : ℝ) t ∩ Ioi τ = Ioc τ t := by
      ext r
      simp only [mem_inter_iff,mem_Ioc,mem_Ioi]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hr0,hrt⟩,hrτ⟩
        exact ⟨hrτ,hrt⟩
      · rintro ⟨hrτ,hrt⟩
        exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hτ hrτ,hrt⟩,hrτ⟩
    rw [hs, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hτt]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun r _ => hd r) (by exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => -ρ * Real.exp (-ρ * (r - τ)))).intervalIntegrable τ t)]
    simp [damping,min_eq_right hτt]

drift_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem drift_decomposition (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (r : ℝ) :
    drift ρ τ x b r = (if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + correction ρ τ r • x τ
drift_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_decomposition (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (r : ℝ) :
    drift ρ τ x b r = (if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + correction ρ τ r • x τ := by
  by_cases h : r ≤ τ
  · simp [drift,correction,h,not_lt_of_ge h]
  · rw [drift,ite_eq_right h,ite_eq_right h,zero_add,
      extension_after ρ τ x (le_of_not_ge h),correction,ite_eq_left (lt_of_not_ge h),smul_smul]

extension_integral_equation.exact_header:
theorem extension_integral_equation (ρ τ t : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (x b m : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume 0 t)
    (heq : x (min t τ) = x 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + m t) :
    extension ρ τ x t = x 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, drift ρ τ x b r) + m t
extension_integral_equation.exact_declaration:
theorem extension_integral_equation (ρ τ t : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (x b m : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume 0 t)
    (heq : x (min t τ) = x 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + m t) :
    extension ρ τ x t = x 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, drift ρ τ x b r) + m t := by
  have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => correction ρ τ r • x τ) volume 0 t := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff] at *
    exact (correction_integrable ρ τ 0 t).def'.smul_const (x τ)
  have hdecomp : (fun r => drift ρ τ x b r) =
      (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + fun r => correction ρ τ r • x τ :=
    funext (drift_decomposition ρ τ x b)
  rw [hdecomp]
  change extension ρ τ x t = x 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t,
    (if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) + correction ρ τ r • x τ) + m t
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hb hc, intervalIntegral.integral_smul_const,
    integral_correction ρ τ t hτ ht]
  have hext : extension ρ τ x t = x (min t τ) + (damping ρ τ t - 1) • x τ := by
    by_cases h : t ≤ τ
    · simp [extension,damping,min_eq_left h]
    · simp only [extension,damping,min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]
      rw [sub_smul,one_smul]
      abel
  rw [hext,heq]
  abel

damping_nonneg.exact_declaration: theorem damping_nonneg (ρ τ t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ damping ρ τ t := (Real.exp_pos _).le

damping_le_one.exact_declaration:
theorem damping_le_one {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (τ t : ℝ) : damping ρ τ t ≤ 1 := by
  apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hρ)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (min_le_left t τ))

extension_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem extension_norm_le {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖extension ρ τ x t‖ ≤ ‖x (min t τ)‖
extension_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem extension_norm_le {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ → E) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖extension ρ τ x t‖ ≤ ‖x (min t τ)‖ := by
  rw [extension,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (damping_nonneg ρ τ t)]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (damping_le_one hρ τ t)

drift_integrable.exact_header:
theorem drift_integrable (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (a t : ℝ)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume a t) :
    IntervalIntegrable (drift ρ τ x b) volume a t
drift_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_integrable (ρ τ : ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E) (a t : ℝ)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume a t) :
    IntervalIntegrable (drift ρ τ x b) volume a t := by
  have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => correction ρ τ r • x τ) volume a t := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
    exact (correction_integrable ρ τ a t).def'.smul_const (x τ)
  change IntervalIntegrable (fun r => drift ρ τ x b r) volume a t
  simp_rw [drift_decomposition]
  exact hb.add hc

drift_variation_le.exact_header:
theorem drift_variation_le {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (τ T c C : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume 0 T)
    (hTV : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖if r ≤ τ then b r else 0‖) ≤ c)
    (hC : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖x (min r τ)‖ ≤ C) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖drift ρ τ x b r‖) ≤ c + ρ * T * C
drift_variation_le.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_variation_le {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (τ T c C : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => if r ≤ τ then b r else 0) volume 0 T)
    (hTV : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖if r ≤ τ then b r else 0‖) ≤ c)
    (hC : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖x (min r τ)‖ ≤ C) :
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖drift ρ τ x b r‖) ≤ c + ρ * T * C := by
  have hi := (drift_integrable ρ τ x b 0 T hb).norm
  have hconst : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => ρ * C) volume 0 T := intervalIntegrable_const
  have hbnd (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) :
      ‖drift ρ τ x b r‖ ≤ ‖if r ≤ τ then b r else 0‖ + ρ * C := by
    by_cases h : r ≤ τ
    · simp only [drift,ite_eq_left h]
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg (x (min r τ))).trans (hC r hr)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hρ hC0]
    · simp only [drift,ite_eq_right h,norm_zero,zero_add,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_neg,
        abs_of_nonneg hρ]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((extension_norm_le hρ τ x r).trans (hC r hr)) hρ
  have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hT hi (hb.norm.add hconst) hbnd
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hb.norm hconst,intervalIntegral.integral_const] at hm
  simp only [sub_zero,smul_eq_mul] at hm
  nlinarith

/-! # Quadratic Dirac-optimizer growth from finite coupling work
This module makes the finite-work reading of the source condition explicit:
for each fixed optimizer pair, the signed sampler coupling work has quadratic
growth. Universal finite P₂ work integrability can supply that premise.
Dirac instances of source A3 then derive the weighted Dirac optimizer growth;
no optimizer continuity or Lipschitz gradient-response condition is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.DiracOptimizerGrowth
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [Fintype I]
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

observation, at the fixed source time zero. -/

work. This is an intermediate finite-integrability certificate, not an
assumed contraction or positive-work conclusion for a solution. -/

variable (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
include hρ hmono

/-- Actual one-point empirical laws yield the joint Dirac work inequality. -/

/-- Finite work at the two optimizer anchors s±v bounds the corresponding
component of the actual weighted Dirac optimizer field. -/

/-- An actual finite orthonormal basis converts all proved directional
bounds into a norm bound for each fixed optimizer state. -/

/-- Explicit finite-integral reading of the source's universal P₂ sampler
work domain. The weight is exactly one plus the two second moments. -/

omit hρ hmono in
/-- Universal finite P₂ work integrability actually derives the fixed-pair
quadratic work bound by the atomic probability argument. -/

/-- For each fixed sampler point the weighted Dirac optimizer is an
actual everywhere-defined monotone finite-dimensional field. -/

/-- In finite optimizer dimension, the explicit universal finite-work
interpretation of A3 derives fixed-state quadratic Dirac response growth. -/

/-- Monotonicity in the optimizer and its proved fixed-state growth make

/-- At the fixed time zero, Dirac A3 and the proved compact quadratic
