field.exact_declaration:
def field (s : S) (z : Z) : S :=
  -D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizer 0 s (M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)))

WorkGrowth.exact_declaration:
def WorkGrowth : Prop := ∀ s s' : S, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z w : Z,
  |samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w)| ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2)

dirac_work_le_zero.exact_header:
theorem dirac_work_le_zero (s s' : S) (z w : Z) :
    ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizer 0 s (M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))-
       M.optimizer 0 s' (M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)))⟫_ℝ +
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤ 0
dirac_work_le_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem dirac_work_le_zero (s s' : S) (z w : Z) :
    ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizer 0 s (M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))-
       M.optimizer 0 s' (M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)))⟫_ℝ +
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤ 0 := by
  have h := particleCouplingWork_le M D ρ hmono 1 (by norm_num) 0 (by norm_num)
    s s' (fun _ => z) (fun _ => w)
  have hh : ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizer 0 s (M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))-
       M.optimizer 0 s' (M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)))⟫_ℝ +
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤
      -ρ*(D.optimizerSq (s-s')+D.samplerSq (z-w)) := by
    simpa [particleCouplingWork,particleCouplingEnergy,Model.particleField,
      Model.particleGradient,Fin.sum_univ_one] using h
  exact hh.trans (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hρ)
    (add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg _) (D.samplerSq_nonneg _)))

component_growth.exact_header:
theorem component_growth (hwork : WorkGrowth M D) (s v : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z,
      |⟪v,field M D s z⟫_ℝ| ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)
component_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem component_growth (hwork : WorkGrowth M D) (s v : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z,
      |⟪v,field M D s z⟫_ℝ| ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨Cp,hCp,hp⟩ := hwork s (s+v)
  obtain ⟨Cm,hCm,hm⟩ := hwork s (s-v)
  let Bp := |⟪v,field M D (s+v) 0⟫_ℝ|
  let Bm := |⟪v,field M D (s-v) 0⟫_ℝ|
  refine ⟨Cp+Cm+Bp+Bm,by dsimp [Bp,Bm]; positivity,?_⟩
  intro z
  have hpz := hp z 0
  have hmz := hm z 0
  norm_num at hpz hmz
  have hplus := dirac_work_le_zero M D ρ hρ hmono s (s+v) z 0
  have hminus := dirac_work_le_zero M D ρ hρ hmono s (s-v) z 0
  have hep : s-(s+v) = -v := by abel
  have hem : s-(s-v) = v := by abel
  rw [hep,map_sub,inner_neg_left,inner_sub_right] at hplus
  rw [hem,map_sub,inner_sub_right] at hminus
  have hfield (a : S) (w : Z) :
      ⟪v,field M D a w⟫_ℝ =
      -⟪v,D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizer 0 a (M.observation (M.parameter a) (M.position w)))⟫_ℝ := by
    simp only [field,inner_neg_right]
  have h_upper : ⟪v,field M D s z⟫_ℝ ≤ Cp*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)+Bp := by
    have ha := neg_abs_le (samplerCouplingWork M D s (s+v) (z,0))
    have hb := le_abs_self ⟪v,field M D (s+v) 0⟫_ℝ
    dsimp only [Bp]
    simp only [hfield] at hb ⊢
    linarith
  have h_lower : -⟪v,field M D s z⟫_ℝ ≤ Cm*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)+Bm := by
    have ha := neg_abs_le (samplerCouplingWork M D s (s-v) (z,0))
    have hb := neg_abs_le ⟪v,field M D (s-v) 0⟫_ℝ
    dsimp only [Bm]
    simp only [hfield] at hb ⊢
    linarith
  have hK : 1 ≤ 1+‖z‖ ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
  have hBpn : 0 ≤ Bp := abs_nonneg _
  have hBmn : 0 ≤ Bm := abs_nonneg _
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · have hrest : 0 ≤ Cp*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)+Bp := by positivity
    have hBm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK hBmn
    nlinarith
  · have hrest : 0 ≤ Cm*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)+Bm := by positivity
    have hBp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK hBpn
    nlinarith

field_growth.exact_header:
theorem field_growth {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ S)
    (hwork : WorkGrowth M D) (s : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z, ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)
field_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem field_growth {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ S)
    (hwork : WorkGrowth M D) (s : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z, ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
  classical
  choose C hC hbound using fun i => component_growth M D ρ hρ hmono hwork s (b i)
  refine ⟨∑ i, C i,Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hC i),?_⟩
  intro z
  calc
    ‖field M D s z‖ = ‖∑ i, ⟪b i,field M D s z⟫_ℝ • b i‖ := by rw [b.sum_repr']
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖⟪b i,field M D s z⟫_ℝ • b i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, |⟪b i,field M D s z⟫_ℝ| := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul,b.orthonormal.norm_eq_one,mul_one,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, C i*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbound i z)
    _ = (∑ i, C i)*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm

workGrowth_of_finiteCouplingWork.exact_header: theorem workGrowth_of_finiteCouplingWork (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) : WorkGrowth M D
workGrowth_of_finiteCouplingWork.exact_declaration:
theorem workGrowth_of_finiteCouplingWork (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) : WorkGrowth M D := by
  intro s s'
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hb⟩ := UniversalMomentGrowth.growth_of_probability_integrability
    (fun p : Z × Z => 1+‖p.1‖ ^ 2+‖p.2‖ ^ 2)
    (fun p => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖p.1‖,sq_nonneg ‖p.2‖])
    (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') (fun Λ hp hi => hfull s s' Λ hp hi)
  exact ⟨C,hC,fun z w => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb (z,w)⟩

field_monotone.exact_header:
theorem field_monotone (z : Z) (s s' : S) :
    0 ≤ ⟪s-s',field M D s z-field M D s' z⟫_ℝ
field_monotone.exact_declaration:
theorem field_monotone (z : Z) (s s' : S) :
    0 ≤ ⟪s-s',field M D s z-field M D s' z⟫_ℝ := by
  have h := dirac_work_le_zero M D ρ hρ hmono s s' z z
  have hn : 0 ≤ samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,z) := by
    simp only [samplerCouplingWork,sub_self,inner_zero_left,zero_add]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => D.samplerSq_nonneg _))
  dsimp only [field]
  rw [inner_sub_right,inner_neg_right,inner_neg_right]
  rw [map_sub,inner_sub_right] at h
  linarith

theorem field_growth_of_finiteCouplingWork [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (s : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z, ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)
field_growth_of_finiteCouplingWork.exact_declaration:
theorem field_growth_of_finiteCouplingWork [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (s : S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : Z, ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) :=
  field_growth M D ρ hρ hmono (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ S)
    (workGrowth_of_finiteCouplingWork M D hfull) s

theorem field_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ∀ z : Z,
      ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2)
field_growth_on_compact.exact_declaration:
theorem field_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ∀ z : Z,
      ‖field M D s z‖ ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
  exact MonotoneLocalBound.uniform_growth_on_compact
    (fun z s => field M D s z) (fun z => 1+‖z‖ ^ 2)
    (fun z => by positivity)
    (fun z s s' => field_monotone M D ρ hρ hmono z s s')
    (fun s => field_growth_of_finiteCouplingWork M D ρ hρ hmono hfull s) K hK

theorem positive_sampler_work_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :

positive_sampler_work_growth_on_compact.exact_declaration:
theorem positive_sampler_work_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
    (hfull : FiniteCouplingWork M D) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ∀ s' ∈ K, ∀ z w : Z,
      max (samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w)) 0 ≤ C*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hfield⟩ := field_growth_on_compact M D ρ hρ hmono hfull K hK
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (continuous_id.continuousOn : ContinuousOn (fun s : S => s) K)
  let R := max 0 R0
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hbound (s : S) (hs : s ∈ K) : ‖s‖ ≤ R := (hR0 s hs).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨4*R*C,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro s hs s' hs' z w
  have hδ : ‖s-s'‖ ≤ 2*R := (norm_sub_le s s').trans (by linarith [hbound s hs,hbound s' hs'])
  have ha : ‖field M D s z-field M D s' w‖ ≤ C*(2+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply (norm_sub_le _ _).trans
    have hsum := add_le_add (hfield s hs z) (hfield s' hs' w)
    convert hsum using 1 <;> ring
  have hd := dirac_work_le_zero M D ρ hρ hmono s s' z w
  have he : ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizer 0 s (M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))-
       M.optimizer 0 s' (M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position w)))⟫_ℝ =
      -⟪s-s',field M D s z-field M D s' w⟫_ℝ := by
    simp only [field,map_sub,inner_sub_right,inner_neg_right]
    ring
  rw [he] at hd
  apply max_le
  · calc
      samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) ≤ ⟪s-s',field M D s z-field M D s' w⟫_ℝ := by linarith
      _ ≤ ‖s-s'‖ * ‖field M D s z-field M D s' w‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ (2*R)*(C*(2+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul hδ ha (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (2*R)*(C*(2*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2))) := by
        gcongr
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖z‖,sq_nonneg ‖w‖]
      _ = (4*R*C)*(1+‖z‖ ^ 2+‖w‖ ^ 2) := by ring
  · positivity

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ProdL2

/-! # Primitive joint monotonicity bounds frozen drift anchors and energy
The entire weighted Dirac field is monotone in the actual Euclidean product
Hilbert space. Finite-dimensional local boundedness gives a uniform drift
anchor bound on optimizer compact sets; frozen dissipativity then derives a
constant radial energy bound. Neither drift-norm growth nor universal finite
work integrability is required for these moment prerequisites.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.DiracSamplerCoercivity
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [Fintype I]
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

/-- The actual weighted full Dirac field, on the L² product Hilbert norm. -/

variable (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
include hρ hmono

/-- Source A3 on one-point empirical laws proves actual full-field
monotonicity. The nonnegative diffusion correction may be discarded. -/

/-- The actual weighted frozen drift at z=0 is uniformly bounded on every
optimizer compact set, derived solely from full Dirac monotonicity. -/

/-- Positive source dissipation and the proved compact drift-anchor bound
yield a uniform constant radial-energy ceiling, despite superlinear drift
norms. This is the primitive hypothesis needed by stopped moment/Fatou. -/

fullField.exact_header: def fullField (x : WithLp 2 (S × Z)) : WithLp 2 (S × Z)

fullField_monotone.exact_header:
theorem fullField_monotone (x y : WithLp 2 (S × Z)) :
    0 ≤ ⟪x-y,fullField M D x-fullField M D y⟫_ℝ
fullField_monotone.exact_declaration:
theorem fullField_monotone (x y : WithLp 2 (S × Z)) :
    0 ≤ ⟪x-y,fullField M D x-fullField M D y⟫_ℝ := by
  have h := DiracOptimizerGrowth.dirac_work_le_zero M D ρ hρ hmono
    x.ofLp.1 y.ofLp.1 x.ofLp.2 y.ofLp.2
  have hn : 0 ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)*∑ i,
      D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter x.ofLp.1) x.ofLp.2 i-
        M.diffusion (M.parameter y.ofLp.1) y.ofLp.2 i) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => D.samplerSq_nonneg _))
  rw [samplerCouplingWork] at h
  simp only [WithLp.prod_inner_apply,WithLp.ofLp_sub,Prod.fst_sub,Prod.snd_sub,
    fullField,WithLp.ofLp_toLp,DiracOptimizerGrowth.field,
    inner_sub_right,inner_neg_right,map_sub] at ⊢
  simp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd,map_sub,inner_sub_right] at h
  linarith

drift_anchor_bound.exact_header:
theorem drift_anchor_bound [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ‖D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) 0)‖ ≤ B
drift_anchor_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_anchor_bound [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ‖D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) 0)‖ ≤ B := by
  let C : Set (WithLp 2 (S × Z)) := (fun s : S => WithLp.toLp 2 (s,(0 : Z))) '' K
  have hC : IsCompact C := hK.image (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbound⟩ := MonotoneLocalBound.uniform_growth_on_compact
    (fun _ : Unit => fullField M D) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => zero_le_one)
    (fun _ x y => fullField_monotone M D ρ hρ hmono x y)
    (fun x => ⟨‖fullField M D x‖,norm_nonneg _,fun _ => le_of_eq (mul_one _).symm⟩) C hC
  refine ⟨B,hB,?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hh := hbound (WithLp.toLp 2 (s,(0 : Z))) ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ ()
  have he := WithLp.norm_snd_le (p := (2 : ENNReal)) (α := S) (β := Z) (fullField M D (WithLp.toLp 2 (s,(0 : Z))))
  simpa only [fullField,WithLp.ofLp_toLp,WithLp.snd,norm_neg,mul_one] using he.trans hh

radial_coercivity_on_compact.exact_header:
theorem radial_coercivity_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ∀ z : Z,
      ⟪z,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z)⟫_ℝ ≤ C
radial_coercivity_on_compact.exact_declaration:
theorem radial_coercivity_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (hρpos : 0 < ρ) (K : Set S) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s ∈ K, ∀ z : Z,
      ⟪z,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z)⟫_ℝ ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbound⟩ := drift_anchor_bound M D ρ hρ hmono K hK
  let ε := ρ*D.lower
  have hε : 0 < ε := mul_pos hρpos D.lower_pos
  let C := B ^ 2/ε
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hε.le
  have heC : ε*C = B ^ 2 := by dsimp only [C]; field_simp
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro s hs z
  have hf := ConstantNoiseWork.frozen_drift_le M D ρ hmono s z 0
  simp only [sub_zero,TwistedGeometry.samplerSq] at hf
  have hl := D.sampler_lower z
  have hlow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hρ
  have ha := real_inner_le_norm z (D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) 0))
  have hb : ⟪z,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) 0)⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖z‖*B :=
    ha.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound s hs) (norm_nonneg _))
  rw [map_sub,inner_sub_right] at hf
  have hq : ⟪z,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ε*‖z‖ ^ 2+‖z‖*B := by
    dsimp only [ε]
    nlinarith
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hε).mp
  rw [heC]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hε.le
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ε*‖z‖-B)]

upperShear.exact_header: def upperShear (L : E →L[ℝ] E) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (E × E)

lowerShear.exact_header: def lowerShear (L : E →L[ℝ] E) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (E × E)

upperShear_det.exact_declaration:
theorem upperShear_det (L : E →L[ℝ] E) : (upperShear L).det = 1 := by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis ℝ E
  change LinearMap.det _ = 1
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (b.prod b)]
  have hm : LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod b) (b.prod b) (upperShear L).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (LinearMap.toMatrix b b L.toLinearMap) 0 1 := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [upperShear, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Module.Basis.prod_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
        Matrix.fromBlocks, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

lowerShear_det.exact_declaration:
theorem lowerShear_det (L : E →L[ℝ] E) : (lowerShear L).det = 1 := by
  classical
  let b := Module.finBasis ℝ E
  change LinearMap.det _ = 1
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (b.prod b)]
  have hm : LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod b) (b.prod b) (lowerShear L).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 (LinearMap.toMatrix b b L.toLinearMap) 1 := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;>
      simp [lowerShear, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Module.Basis.prod_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
        Matrix.fromBlocks, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp

kickStep_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem kickStep_hasFDerivAt (F : E → E) (h : ℝ) (z : E × E)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z.2) :
    HasFDerivAt (KineticLangevin.kickStep F h)
      (upperShear (-(h • fderiv ℝ F z.2))) z
kickStep_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem kickStep_hasFDerivAt (F : E → E) (h : ℝ) (z : E × E)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z.2) :
    HasFDerivAt (KineticLangevin.kickStep F h)
      (upperShear (-(h • fderiv ℝ F z.2))) z := by
  have hs := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E).hasFDerivAt (x := z)
  have hf := hF.hasFDerivAt.comp z hs
  have hd := ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E).hasFDerivAt (x := z).sub (hf.const_smul h)).prodMk hs
  convert hd using 1
  · rfl
  · ext v <;> simp [upperShear]

driftStep_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem driftStep_hasFDerivAt (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    HasFDerivAt (KineticLangevin.driftStep h)
      (lowerShear (h • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) z
driftStep_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem driftStep_hasFDerivAt (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    HasFDerivAt (KineticLangevin.driftStep h)
      (lowerShear (h • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) z := by
  have hf := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E).hasFDerivAt (x := z)
  have hs := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E).hasFDerivAt (x := z)
  convert hf.prodMk (hs.add (hf.const_smul h)) using 1
  · rfl
  · ext v <;> simp [lowerShear]

kickStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_header:
theorem kickStep_fderiv_det_one (F : E → E) (h : ℝ) (z : E × E)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z.2) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.kickStep F h) z).det = 1
kickStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem kickStep_fderiv_det_one (F : E → E) (h : ℝ) (z : E × E)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z.2) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.kickStep F h) z).det = 1 := by
  rw [(kickStep_hasFDerivAt F h z hF).fderiv]
  exact upperShear_det _

driftStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_header:
theorem driftStep_fderiv_det_one (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.driftStep h) z).det = 1
driftStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem driftStep_fderiv_det_one (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.driftStep h) z).det = 1 := by
  rw [(driftStep_hasFDerivAt h z).fderiv]
  exact lowerShear_det _

fderiv_det_comp.exact_header:
theorem fderiv_det_comp (f g : E × E → E × E) (z : E × E)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g z)) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
    (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ g) z).det =
      (fderiv ℝ f (g z)).det * (fderiv ℝ g z).det
fderiv_det_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem fderiv_det_comp (f g : E × E → E × E) (z : E × E)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g z)) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
    (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ g) z).det =
      (fderiv ℝ f (g z)).det * (fderiv ℝ g z).det := by
  rw [fderiv_comp z hf hg]
  change LinearMap.det (_ ∘ₗ _) = _
  exact LinearMap.det_comp _ _

verletStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_header:
theorem verletStep_fderiv_det_one (F : E → E) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.verletStep F h) z).det = 1
verletStep_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem verletStep_fderiv_det_one (F : E → E) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (h : ℝ) (z : E × E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.verletStep F h) z).det = 1 := by
  let k := KineticLangevin.kickStep F (h / 2)
  let d := KineticLangevin.driftStep (E := E) h
  have hk (x : E × E) : DifferentiableAt ℝ k x :=
    (kickStep_hasFDerivAt F (h / 2) x (hF _)).differentiableAt
  have hd (x : E × E) : DifferentiableAt ℝ d x :=
    (driftStep_hasFDerivAt h x).differentiableAt
  change (fderiv ℝ (k ∘ (d ∘ k)) z).det = 1
  rw [fderiv_det_comp k (d ∘ k) z (hk _) ((hd _).comp z (hk z)),
    fderiv_det_comp d k z (hd _) (hk z)]
  change (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.kickStep F (h / 2)) _).det *
    ((fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.driftStep h) _).det *
      (fderiv ℝ (KineticLangevin.kickStep F (h / 2)) z).det) = 1
  rw [kickStep_fderiv_det_one F _ _ (hF _), driftStep_fderiv_det_one,
    kickStep_fderiv_det_one F _ _ (hF _)]
  norm_num

interwovenBAB_fderiv_det_one.exact_header:
theorem interwovenBAB_fderiv_det_one
    {Q : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Q] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Q]
    [CompleteSpace Q] [MeasurableSpace Q] [BorelSpace Q] [SecondCountableTopology Q]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ Q] (F : Q → Q) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (h : ℝ) (z : Q × Q) :
    (fderiv ℝ (interwovenBAB F h) z).det = 1
interwovenBAB_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem interwovenBAB_fderiv_det_one
    {Q : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Q] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Q]
    [CompleteSpace Q] [MeasurableSpace Q] [BorelSpace Q] [SecondCountableTopology Q]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ Q] (F : Q → Q) (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (h : ℝ) (z : Q × Q) :
    (fderiv ℝ (interwovenBAB F h) z).det = 1 :=
  DiscreteVolume.verletStep_fderiv_det_one F hF h z

running.exact_header: def running (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) : ℕ → Ω → ℝ
running.exact_declaration:
def running (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) : ℕ → Ω → ℝ
  | 0 => fun _ => 0
  | n + 1 => fun ω => max (running f n ω) (f n ω)

running_nonneg.exact_header: theorem running_nonneg (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ running f n ω
running_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem running_nonneg (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ running f n ω := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih => exact ih.trans (le_max_left _ _)

running_mono.exact_header: theorem running_mono (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun n => running f n ω)
running_mono.exact_declaration:
theorem running_mono (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun n => running f n ω) :=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun _ => le_max_left _ _)

sum_running_increments.exact_header:
theorem sum_running_increments (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (running f (k + 1) ω - running f k ω)) = running f n ω
sum_running_increments.exact_declaration:
theorem sum_running_increments (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (running f (k + 1) ω - running f k ω)) = running f n ω := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [running]
  | succ n ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; ring

running_memLp.exact_header:
theorem running_memLp (Q : Measure Ω) (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, MemLp (f n) 2 Q)

running_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem running_memLp (Q : Measure Ω) (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, MemLp (f n) 2 Q)
    (n : ℕ) : MemLp (running f n) 2 Q := by

running_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem running_stronglyMeasurable (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : StronglyAdapted F f) (n t : ℕ) (hnt : n ≤ t + 1) :
    StronglyMeasurable[F t] (running f n)
running_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem running_stronglyMeasurable (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : StronglyAdapted F f) (n t : ℕ) (hnt : n ≤ t + 1) :
    StronglyMeasurable[F t] (running f n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact stronglyMeasurable_const
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ((ih (by omega)).measurable.max
      (((hf n).mono (F.mono (by omega))).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable

running_square_bound.exact_header:
theorem running_square_bound (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (running f n ω) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
      f k ω * (running f (k + 1) ω - running f k ω)
running_square_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem running_square_bound (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (running f n ω) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
      f k ω * (running f (k + 1) ω - running f k ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [running]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hi : (running f (n + 1) ω) ^ 2 - (running f n ω) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * f n ω * (running f (n + 1) ω - running f n ω) := by
      by_cases h : f n ω ≤ running f n ω
      · simp only [running, max_eq_left h, sub_self, mul_zero, le_refl]
      · simp only [running, max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f n ω - running f n ω)]
    linarith

weighted_expectation_le.exact_header:
theorem weighted_expectation_le (k n : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (H : Ω → ℝ) (hH : StronglyMeasurable[F k] H) (hH2 : MemLp H 2 Q)
    (hH0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ H ω) :
    (∫ ω, H ω * f k ω ∂Q) ≤ ∫ ω, H ω * f n ω ∂Q
weighted_expectation_le.exact_declaration:
theorem weighted_expectation_le (k n : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (H : Ω → ℝ) (hH : StronglyMeasurable[F k] H) (hH2 : MemLp H 2 Q)
    (hH0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ H ω) :
    (∫ ω, H ω * f k ω ∂Q) ≤ ∫ ω, H ω * f n ω ∂Q := by
  have hik := hH2.integrable_mul (h2 k)
  have hin := hH2.integrable_mul (h2 n)
  have hpull := condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left hH hin (hf.integrable n)
  have hic : Integrable (fun ω => H ω * Q[f n | F k] ω) Q := integrable_condExp.congr hpull
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ ω, H ω * Q[f n | F k] ω ∂Q := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hik hic
      filter_upwards [hf.2.1 k n hkn] with ω hω
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hω (hH0 ω)
    _ = _ := (integral_congr_ae hpull).symm.trans (integral_condExp (F.le k))

finite_maximum_square.exact_header:
theorem finite_maximum_square (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, (running f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, (f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q
finite_maximum_square.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_maximum_square (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, (running f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, (f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  let H (k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := running f (k + 1) ω - running f k ω
  have hH2 (k : ℕ) : MemLp (H k) 2 Q :=
    (running_memLp Q f h2 (k + 1)).sub (running_memLp Q f h2 k)
  have hH (k : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[F k] (H k) :=
    (running_stronglyMeasurable F f hf.stronglyAdapted (k + 1) k le_rfl).sub
      (running_stronglyMeasurable F f hf.stronglyAdapted k k (by omega))
  have hH0 (k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ H k ω := sub_nonneg.mpr (running_mono f ω (Nat.le_succ k))
  have hsquare := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (running_memLp Q f h2 n).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (running_memLp Q f h2 n)
  have hsquare' : Integrable (fun ω => (running f n ω) ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using hsquare
  have hterminal := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (h2 n).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (h2 n)
  have hterminal' : Integrable (fun ω => (f n ω) ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using hterminal
  have hprod := (running_memLp Q f h2 n).integrable_mul (h2 n)
  have hfirst : (∫ ω, (running f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ ω, H k ω * f k ω ∂Q) := by
    change (∫ ω, (running f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ ω, (H k * f k) ω ∂Q)
    rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hH2 k).integrable_mul (h2 k)),
      ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono hsquare'
      ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hH2 k).integrable_mul (h2 k))).const_mul 2)
    intro ω
    simpa only [H, Pi.mul_apply, mul_comm (f _ ω)] using running_square_bound f n ω
  have htransfer : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ ω, H k ω * f k ω ∂Q)) ≤
      ∫ ω, running f n ω * f n ω ∂Q := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ ω, H k ω * f n ω ∂Q) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k hk
        exact weighted_expectation_le Q F f hf h2 k n (Finset.mem_range.mp hk).le
          (H k) (hH k) (hH2 k) (hH0 k)
      _ = _ := by
        change (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∫ ω, (H k * f n) ω ∂Q)) = _
        rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hH2 k).integrable_mul (h2 n))]
        apply integral_congr_ae
        apply ae_of_all
        intro ω
        change (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, H k ω * f n ω) = running f n ω * f n ω
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, H k ω = running f n ω :=
          sum_running_increments f n ω
        rw [hsum]
  have hyoung : (∫ ω, running f n ω * f n ω ∂Q) ≤
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (∫ ω, (running f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) +
        (∫ ω, (f n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add (hsquare'.const_mul _) hterminal']
    apply integral_mono hprod ((hsquare'.const_mul _).add hterminal')
    intro ω
    change running f n ω * f n ω ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (running f n ω) ^ 2 + (f n ω) ^ 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (running f n ω - 2 * f n ω)]
  linarith

norm_submartingale.exact_header: theorem norm_submartingale : Submartingale (fun t ω => ‖X t ω‖) F Q
norm_submartingale.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_submartingale : Submartingale (fun t ω => ‖X t ω‖) F Q := by
  refine ⟨fun t => (hX.stronglyAdapted t).norm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s t hst
    filter_upwards [norm_condExp_le (μ := Q) (m := F s) (X t),
      hX.condExp_ae_eq hst] with ω hj he
    rw [he] at hj
    exact hj
  · intro t
    exact (hX.integrable t).norm

finite_grid.exact_header:
theorem finite_grid (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, (running (fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖) n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      4 * ∫ ω, ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
finite_grid.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_grid (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, (running (fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖) n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      4 * ∫ ω, ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  exact finite_maximum_square Q (MartingaleMaximalL2.sampledFiltration (F := F) τ hτ)
    (fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖)
    (norm_submartingale Q _ (fun k => X (τ k))
      (MartingaleMaximalL2.sampled_martingale Q hX τ hτ) (fun k => h2 (τ k)))
    (fun k => (h2 (τ k)).norm) n

/-! # Initial information and finite Brownian paths
Primitive future independence is promoted to joint independence of an actual
initial variable and every finite set of full-vector Brownian evaluations.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- Successive independence from the entire previous past gives actual
mutual independence, including an arbitrary adapted initial variable. -/

variable (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
  (X : Ω → H) (hX : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X)

include hX

/-- The initial variable and the complete finite array of vector increments
are independent; temporal and spatial dependence are not assumed away. -/


omit hX in

/-- The initial variable and every full finite vector of Brownian values
are independent, reconstructed from the primitive increment information. -/

/-- Initial information is independent of arbitrary finite joint path
evaluations, derived from the Driver's future/full-past primitive. -/


omit hX in
/-- The natural AE-adapted initial-variable interface. Measurable
representatives are used only internally; the independence conclusion is
about the original raw initial variable and original raw Brownian values. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

independent_sequence_of_history.exact_header:
theorem independent_sequence_of_history {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E]
    (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → E)
    (hY : ∀ n, @Measurable Ω E (F n) inferInstance (Y n))
    (hind : ∀ n, Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (Y (n+1)) inferInstance) (F n) Q) :
    iIndepFun Y Q
independent_sequence_of_history.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_sequence_of_history {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E]
    (F : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → E)
    (hY : ∀ n, @Measurable Ω E (F n) inferInstance (Y n))
    (hind : ∀ n, Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (Y (n+1)) inferInstance) (F n) Q) :
    iIndepFun Y Q := by
  classical
  rw [iIndepFun_iff_measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul]
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on_max with
  | empty => intro sets hs; simp
  | insert n s hlt ih =>
    intro sets hs
    have hn : n ∉ s := fun hn => (hlt n hn).false
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hn]
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hse : s = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro k hk
        exact Nat.not_lt_zero k (hlt k hk)
      simp [hse]
    | succ n =>
      have hpast : MeasurableSet[F n] (⋂ k ∈ s, Y k ⁻¹' sets k) := by
        apply Finset.measurableSet_biInter
        intro k hk
        exact ((hY k).mono (F.mono (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hlt k hk))) le_rfl)
          (hs k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))
      have hcurr : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap (Y (n+1)) inferInstance]
          (Y (n+1) ⁻¹' sets (n+1)) :=
        ⟨sets (n+1),hs (n+1) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _),rfl⟩
      have hf := (Indep_iff _ _ _).mp (hind n) _ _ hcurr hpast
      have he : (⋂ k ∈ insert (n+1) s, Y k ⁻¹' sets k) =
          (Y (n+1) ⁻¹' sets (n+1)) ∩ (⋂ k ∈ s, Y k ⁻¹' sets k) := by ext ω; simp
      rw [he,hf,ih (fun k hk => hs k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))]

initial_finite_increments_independent.exact_header:
theorem initial_finite_increments_independent (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω (k : Fin n) i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) Q
initial_finite_increments_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem initial_finite_increments_independent (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω (k : Fin n) i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) Q := by
  classical
  let F : Filtration ℕ mΩ :=
    ⟨fun n => D.filtration (τ n),fun _ _ h => D.filtration.mono (hτ h),fun n => D.filtration.le (τ n)⟩
  let Y : ℕ → Ω → H × (I → ℝ)
    | 0 => fun ω => (X ω,0)
    | k+1 => fun ω => (0,fun i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω)
  have hY (k : ℕ) : @Measurable Ω (H × (I → ℝ)) (F k) inferInstance (Y k) := by
    cases k with
    | zero => exact (hX.mono (D.filtration.mono zero_le)).measurable.prodMk measurable_const
    | succ k =>
      apply measurable_const.prodMk
      apply (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ => ℝ) (D.filtration (τ (k+1)))
        (fun _ => inferInstance) _).mpr
      intro i
      exact (D.adapted i (τ (k+1))).measurable.sub
        (((D.adapted i (τ k)).mono (D.filtration.mono (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)))).measurable)
  have hi : iIndepFun Y Q := independent_sequence_of_history Q F Y hY (fun k => by
    apply indep_of_indep_of_le_left (D.future_independent (τ k) (τ (k+1)) (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)))
    have hm : Measurable (fun a : I → ℝ => ((0 : H),a)) := measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id
    simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp,Function.comp_def,Y] using
      MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (g := fun ω i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) hm.comap_le)
  have hfin := hi.precomp (g := fun k : Fin (n+1) => (k : ℕ)) Fin.val_injective
  have hmeas (k : Fin (n+1)) : Measurable (Y k) := (hY k).mono (F.le k) le_rfl
  have hsplit := hfin.indepFun_finset ({0} : Finset (Fin (n+1)))
    (Finset.univ.erase 0) (by simp) hmeas
  have hleft : Measurable (fun a : ({0} : Finset (Fin (n+1))) → H × (I → ℝ) =>
      (a ⟨0,by simp⟩).1) := measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
  have hright : Measurable (fun a : (Finset.univ.erase (0 : Fin (n+1))) → H × (I → ℝ) =>
      fun k : Fin n => (a ⟨k.succ,by simp⟩).2) := by
    apply measurable_pi_iff.mpr
    intro k
    exact measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
  exact hsplit.comp hleft hright

partialSum_measurable.exact_header:
private theorem partialSum_measurable {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (n+1)) :
    Measurable (fun r : Fin n → ℝ => Fin.partialSum r k)
partialSum_measurable.exact_declaration:
private theorem partialSum_measurable {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (n+1)) :
    Measurable (fun r : Fin n → ℝ => Fin.partialSum r k) := by
  induction k using Fin.inductionOn with
  | zero => simp only [Fin.partialSum_zero]; exact measurable_const
  | succ k hk =>
    simp only [Fin.partialSum_succ]
    change Measurable ((fun r : Fin n → ℝ => Fin.partialSum r k.castSucc)+(fun r => r k))
    exact hk.add (measurable_pi_apply k)

initial_finite_values_independent.exact_header:
theorem initial_finite_values_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) (h0 : τ 0 = 0) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω (k : Fin (n+1)) i => D.process i (τ k) ω) Q
initial_finite_values_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem initial_finite_values_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) (h0 : τ 0 = 0) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω (k : Fin (n+1)) i => D.process i (τ k) ω) Q := by
  let τ' : ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun k => τ ⟨min k n,by omega⟩
  have hτ' : Monotone τ' := fun a b hab => hτ (min_le_min hab le_rfl)
  have he (k : Fin (n+1)) : τ' k = τ k := by
    dsimp [τ']
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    exact Nat.min_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt)
  have he0 (k : Fin n) : τ' k = τ k.castSucc := he k.castSucc
  have he1 (k : Fin n) : τ' (k+1) = τ k.succ := he k.succ
  have hi : IndepFun X
      (fun ω (k : Fin n) i => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω) Q := by
    simpa only [he0,he1] using initial_finite_increments_independent Q D X hX τ' hτ' n
  have hm : Measurable (fun a : Fin n → I → ℝ => fun k : Fin (n+1) =>
      fun i => Fin.partialSum (fun j => a j i) k) := by
    apply measurable_pi_iff.mpr
    intro k
    apply measurable_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact (partialSum_measurable k).comp
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun j => (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)))
  have hf := hi.comp measurable_id hm
  apply hf.congr .rfl
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (D.brownian i).eval_zero_ae_eq_zero)] with ω hω
  funext k i
  change Fin.partialSum (fun j : Fin n => D.process i (τ j.succ) ω-D.process i (τ j.castSucc) ω) k =
    D.process i (τ k) ω
  induction k using Fin.inductionOn with
  | zero => simp [h0,hω i]
  | succ k hk => rw [Fin.partialSum_succ,hk]; abel

Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent.exact_header:
theorem Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent (J : Finset ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t i => D.process i t ω)) Q
Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent (J : Finset ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t i => D.process i t ω)) Q := by
  classical
  let e := J.orderIsoOfFin rfl
  let τ : Fin (J.card+1) → ℝ≥0 := Fin.cons 0 (fun k => (e k : ℝ≥0))
  have hτ : Monotone τ := by
    intro a
    refine Fin.cases (fun b _ => ?_) (fun a b hab => ?_) a
    · simpa only [τ,Fin.cons_zero] using (zero_le : (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ τ b)
    · refine Fin.cases (fun hab => ?_) (fun b hab => ?_) b hab
      · exact False.elim (by simpa using hab)
      · change (e a : ℝ≥0) ≤ (e b : ℝ≥0)
        exact e.monotone (by simpa using hab)
  have hi := initial_finite_values_independent Q D X hX J.card τ hτ (by simp [τ])
  have h := hi.comp measurable_id (show Measurable
      (fun a : Fin (J.card+1) → I → ℝ => fun t : J => a (e.symm t).succ) from
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => measurable_pi_apply _))
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · funext ω t i
    simp [τ]

theorem Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent_ae

Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent_.exact_declaration:
theorem Driver.initial_finite_paths_independent_ae
    (hXA : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration 0] X Q) (J : Finset ℝ≥0) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t i => D.process i t ω)) Q := by

/-! # Actual ambient-null augmentation of a Brownian filtration
Every augmented event has an original past event equal almost surely.
Future Brownian independence is preserved by literal measure substitution.
The ambient space and probability measure are unchanged.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- The actual measurable events equal a.e. to an event of the past algebra. -/





/-- Every null cover of the ambient probability space is present already at
initial time, while every event remains an actual ambient measurable set. -/


/-- Adjoining ambient null events preserves actual independence. -/

/-- The same Brownian coordinates on the same sample space with completed
past null events. Every Driver property is proved from the original one. -/

/-- A single measurable null cover gives an actually adapted, everywhere
continuous version after the proved null augmentation. It agrees with the
original process simultaneously at every time off that cover. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

nullAugmentation.exact_header: def nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) : MeasurableSpace Ω
nullAugmentation.exact_declaration:
def nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) : MeasurableSpace Ω where
  MeasurableSet' s := @MeasurableSet Ω mΩ s ∧ ∃ t, MeasurableSet[m] t ∧ s =ᵐ[Q] t
  measurableSet_empty := ⟨@MeasurableSet.empty Ω mΩ, ∅, @MeasurableSet.empty Ω m, EventuallyEq.rfl⟩
  measurableSet_compl := by
    rintro s ⟨hs,t,ht,he⟩
    exact ⟨hs.compl, tᶜ, ht.compl, he.compl⟩
  measurableSet_iUnion := by
    intro s hs
    choose hm t ht he using hs
    refine ⟨MeasurableSet.iUnion hm, ⋃ n, t n, MeasurableSet.iUnion ht, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr he] with ω hω
    simp only [mem_iUnion]
    exact propext (exists_congr (fun n => (hω n).to_iff))

nullAugmentation_le.exact_header: theorem nullAugmentation_le (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) : nullAugmentation (mΩ := mΩ) Q m ≤ mΩ
nullAugmentation_le.exact_declaration:

le_nullAugmentation.exact_header:
theorem le_nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) :

le_nullAugmentation.exact_declaration:
theorem le_nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) :

theorem nullAugmentation_mono {m n : MeasurableSpace Ω} (h : m ≤ n) :

nullAugmentation_mono.exact_declaration:
theorem nullAugmentation_mono {m n : MeasurableSpace Ω} (h : m ≤ n) :

theorem measurableSet_nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (s : Set Ω)

theorem measurableSet_nullAugmentation (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (s : Set Ω)

def nullAugmentedFiltration (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ where

  mono' _ _ h := nullAugmentation_mono Q (ℱ.mono h)

indep_nullAugmentation_right.exact_header:
theorem indep_nullAugmentation_right (m n : MeasurableSpace Ω)
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (hn : n ≤ mΩ) (h : Indep m n Q) :
    Indep m (nullAugmentation (mΩ := mΩ) Q n) Q
indep_nullAugmentation_right.exact_declaration:
theorem indep_nullAugmentation_right (m n : MeasurableSpace Ω)
    (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (hn : n ≤ mΩ) (h : Indep m n Q) :
    Indep m (nullAugmentation (mΩ := mΩ) Q n) Q := by
  apply (@indep_iff_forall_indepSet Ω m (nullAugmentation (mΩ := mΩ) Q n) mΩ Q).mpr
  intro s t hs ht
  change @MeasurableSet Ω mΩ t ∧ ∃ u, MeasurableSet[n] u ∧ t =ᵐ[Q] u at ht
  obtain ⟨ht, u, hu, htu⟩ := ht
  apply (@indepSet_iff_measure_inter_eq_mul Ω mΩ s t (hm s hs) ht Q inferInstance).mpr
  have he : s ∩ t =ᵐ[Q] s ∩ u := by
    filter_upwards [htu] with ω hω
    simp only [mem_inter_iff]
    exact propext (and_congr_right (fun _ => hω.to_iff))
  rw [measure_congr he, measure_congr htu]
  exact (h.indepSet_of_measurableSet hs hu).measure_inter_eq_mul

nullAugmentedDriver.exact_header: def nullAugmentedDriver (D : Driver (I := I) Q) : Driver (I := I) Q
nullAugmentedDriver.exact_declaration:
def nullAugmentedDriver (D : Driver (I := I) Q) : Driver (I := I) Q where
  process := D.process
  brownian := D.brownian
  filtration := nullAugmentedFiltration Q D.filtration
  adapted i t := (D.adapted i t).mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t)
  increment_coordinates := D.increment_coordinates
  future_independent s t hst := by
    apply indep_nullAugmentation_right Q _ _ _ (D.filtration.le s) (D.future_independent s t hst)
    apply Measurable.comap_le
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact ((D.adapted i t).measurable.mono (D.filtration.le t) le_rfl).sub
      ((D.adapted i s).measurable.mono (D.filtration.le s) le_rfl)

exists_nullAugmented_continuous_version.exact_header:
theorem exists_nullAugmented_continuous_version {Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hX : StronglyAdapted ℱ X)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z,
      StronglyAdapted (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ) Y ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => Y t ω)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, Y t ω = X t ω)
exists_nullAugmented_continuous_version.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_nullAugmented_continuous_version {Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hX : StronglyAdapted ℱ X)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => X t ω)) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z,
      StronglyAdapted (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ) Y ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => Y t ω)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, Y t ω = X t ω) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hbad, hBm, hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null
    (show Q {ω | ¬ Continuous (fun t => X t ω)} = 0 from
      ae_iff.mp hcont)
  let Y : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z := fun t ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else X t ω
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise
      (measurableSet_nullAugmentation Q (ℱ t) B hBm hB0)
      ((hX t).mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q ℱ t))
  · intro ω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simpa only [Y, ite_eq_left hω] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ≥0 => (0 : Z)))
    · have hc : Continuous (fun t => X t ω) := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hω (hbad hn)
      simpa only [Y, ite_eq_right hω] using hc
  · filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hB0] with ω hω
    intro t
    exact ite_eq_right hω

/-! # Whole coordinate-path independence from primitive filtered drivers
Future vector increments are independent of the full past. Together with
spatial independence for each interval this gives joint independence across
space and time, rather than assuming independent whole coordinate paths.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)

/-- Any nondecreasing deterministic grid has independent full-vector
increments, derived from actual future/full-past independence. -/

/-- The actual vector process has independent increments. -/


/-- Grouping disjoint rows of an actually independent scalar array preserves
independence of the complete rows. -/

/-- Primitive spatial and temporal increment independence combine into
independence of each coordinate's complete finite increment vector. -/

/-- Finite-grid scalar values are independent across coordinates. The
starting value is derived to vanish from each primitive Brownian law. -/

vector_grid_increments_independent.exact_header:
theorem vector_grid_increments_independent (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    iIndepFun (fun n ω i => D.process i (τ (n+1)) ω-D.process i (τ n) ω) Q
vector_grid_increments_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem vector_grid_increments_independent (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    iIndepFun (fun n ω i => D.process i (τ (n+1)) ω-D.process i (τ n) ω) Q := by
  classical
  rw [iIndepFun_iff_measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul]
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on_max with
  | empty =>
    intro sets hs
    simp
  | insert n s hlt ih =>
    intro sets hs
    have hn : n ∉ s := fun hn => (hlt n hn).false
    have hsn : MeasurableSet (sets n) := hs n (Finset.mem_insert_self n s)
    have hpast : MeasurableSet[D.filtration (τ n)]
        (⋂ k ∈ s, (fun ω i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) ⁻¹' sets k) := by
      apply Finset.measurableSet_biInter
      intro k hk
      have hkn : k+1 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hlt k hk)
      have hm : @Measurable Ω (I → ℝ) (D.filtration (τ n)) inferInstance
          (fun ω i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) := by
        apply (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ => ℝ) (D.filtration (τ n))
          (fun _ => inferInstance) _).mpr
        intro i
        exact ((D.adapted i (τ (k+1))).mono (D.filtration.mono (hτ hkn))).measurable.sub
          (((D.adapted i (τ k)).mono (D.filtration.mono (hτ ((Nat.le_succ k).trans hkn)))).measurable)
      exact hm (hs k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))
    have hcurr : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap
        (fun ω i => D.process i (τ (n+1)) ω-D.process i (τ n) ω) inferInstance]
        ((fun ω i => D.process i (τ (n+1)) ω-D.process i (τ n) ω) ⁻¹' sets n) :=
      ⟨sets n,hsn,rfl⟩
    have hf := (Indep_iff _ _ _).mp (D.future_independent (τ n) (τ (n+1)) (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)))
      _ _ hcurr hpast
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hn]
    have he : (⋂ k ∈ insert n s, (fun ω i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) ⁻¹' sets k) =
        ((fun ω i => D.process i (τ (n+1)) ω-D.process i (τ n) ω) ⁻¹' sets n) ∩
        (⋂ k ∈ s, (fun ω i => D.process i (τ (k+1)) ω-D.process i (τ k) ω) ⁻¹' sets k) := by
      ext ω
      simp
    rw [he,hf,ih (fun k hk => hs k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk))]

vector_hasIndepIncrements.exact_header:
theorem vector_hasIndepIncrements :
    HasIndepIncrements (fun t ω i => D.process i t ω) Q
vector_hasIndepIncrements.exact_declaration:
theorem vector_hasIndepIncrements :
    HasIndepIncrements (fun t ω i => D.process i t ω) Q := by
  apply HasIndepIncrements.of_nat
  intro τ hτ _
  exact vector_grid_increments_independent Q D τ hτ

independent_array_rows.exact_header:
theorem independent_array_rows {A B : Type*} (X : A → B → Ω → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ a b, Measurable (X a b))
    (h : iIndepFun (fun p : A × B => X p.1 p.2) Q) :
    iIndepFun (fun a ω b => X a b ω) Q
independent_array_rows.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_array_rows {A B : Type*} (X : A → B → Ω → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ a b, Measurable (X a b))
    (h : iIndepFun (fun p : A × B => X p.1 p.2) Q) :
    iIndepFun (fun a ω b => X a b ω) Q := by
  let μ := fun a b => Q.map (X a b)
  letI (a : A) (b : B) : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ a b) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hm a b).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hflat := (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map (fun p : A × B => hm p.1 p.2)).mp h
  have hrow (a : A) : Q.map (fun ω b => X a b ω) = Measure.infinitePi (μ a) := by
    apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map (hm a)).mp
    exact h.precomp (g := fun b => (a,b)) (fun _ _ h => (Prod.mk.inj h).2)
  apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_infinitePi_map (fun a => measurable_pi_iff.mpr (hm a))).mpr
  calc
    Q.map (fun ω a b => X a b ω) =
        (Q.map (fun ω (p : A × B) => X p.1 p.2 ω)).map (MeasurableEquiv.curry A B ℝ) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map (MeasurableEquiv.curry A B ℝ).measurable
        (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun p => hm p.1 p.2))]
      rfl
    _ = Measure.infinitePi (fun a => Measure.infinitePi (μ a)) := by
      rw [hflat,Measure.infinitePi_map_curry μ]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      funext a
      exact (hrow a).symm

coordinate_finite_increments_independent.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_finite_increments_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω (k : Fin n) => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω) Q
coordinate_finite_increments_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_finite_increments_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω (k : Fin n) => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω) Q := by
  have hv := vector_hasIndepIncrements Q D n τ hτ
  have hm (k : Fin n) (i : I) :
      Measurable (fun ω => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω) :=
    increment_measurable Q D _ _ i
  have hs (k : Fin n) : iIndepFun
      (fun i ω => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω) Q :=
    D.increment_coordinates _ _ (hτ (Fin.castSucc_le_succ k))
  have hf := iIndepFun_uncurry' hm hv hs
  apply independent_array_rows Q
    (fun i (k : Fin n) ω => D.process i (τ k.succ) ω-D.process i (τ k.castSucc) ω)
    (fun i k => hm k i)
  exact hf.precomp (g := fun p : I × Fin n => (p.2,p.1)) (Equiv.prodComm I (Fin n)).injective

coordinate_finite_values_independent.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_finite_values_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) (h0 : τ 0 = 0) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω (k : Fin (n+1)) => D.process i (τ k) ω) Q
coordinate_finite_values_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_finite_values_independent (n : ℕ) (τ : Fin (n+1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : Monotone τ) (h0 : τ 0 = 0) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω (k : Fin (n+1)) => D.process i (τ k) ω) Q := by
  have hm (k : Fin (n+1)) : Measurable (fun r : Fin n → ℝ => Fin.partialSum r k) := by
    induction k using Fin.inductionOn with
    | zero => simp only [Fin.partialSum_zero]; exact measurable_const
    | succ k hk =>
      simp only [Fin.partialSum_succ]
      change Measurable ((fun r : Fin n → ℝ => Fin.partialSum r k.castSucc)+(fun r => r k))
      exact hk.add (measurable_pi_apply k)
  have hi := (coordinate_finite_increments_independent Q D n τ hτ).comp
    (fun _ r => Fin.partialSum r) (fun _ => measurable_pi_iff.mpr hm)
  apply hi.congr
  intro i
  filter_upwards [(D.brownian i).eval_zero_ae_eq_zero] with ω hω
  funext k
  change Fin.partialSum (fun j : Fin n => D.process i (τ j.succ) ω-D.process i (τ j.castSucc) ω) k =
    D.process i (τ k) ω
  induction k using Fin.inductionOn with
  | zero => simp [h0,hω]
  | succ k hk =>
    rw [Fin.partialSum_succ,hk]
    abel

Driver.finite_paths_independent.exact_header:
theorem Driver.finite_paths_independent (J : Finset ℝ≥0) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => J.restrict (fun t => D.process i t ω)) Q
Driver.finite_paths_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem Driver.finite_paths_independent (J : Finset ℝ≥0) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => J.restrict (fun t => D.process i t ω)) Q := by
  classical
  let e := J.orderIsoOfFin rfl
  let τ : Fin (J.card+1) → ℝ≥0 := Fin.cons 0 (fun k => (e k : ℝ≥0))
  have hτ : Monotone τ := by
    intro a
    refine Fin.cases (fun b _ => ?_) (fun a b hab => ?_) a
    · simpa only [τ,Fin.cons_zero] using (zero_le : (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ τ b)
    · refine Fin.cases (fun hab => ?_) (fun b hab => ?_) b hab
      · exact False.elim (by simpa using hab)
      · change (e a : ℝ≥0) ≤ (e b : ℝ≥0)
        exact e.monotone (by simpa using hab)
  have hi := coordinate_finite_values_independent Q D J.card τ hτ (by simp [τ])
  have h := hi.comp (fun _ a => fun t : J => a (e.symm t).succ)
    (fun _ => measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => measurable_pi_apply _))
  convert h using 1
  funext i ω t
  simp [τ]

theorem hasLaw_of_comp {Y : Ω' → A} {μ : Measure A} (hY : Measurable Y)

hasLaw_of_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem hasLaw_of_comp {Y : Ω' → A} {μ : Measure A} (hY : Measurable Y)
    (h : HasLaw (Y ∘ f) μ Q) : HasLaw Y μ R where
  aemeasurable := hY.aemeasurable
  map_eq := by rw [← hf.map_eq, Measure.map_map hY hf.measurable]; exact h.map_eq

indepFun_of_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem indepFun_of_comp {Y : Ω' → A} {Z : Ω' → B}
    (hY : Measurable Y) (hZ : Measurable Z)
    (h : IndepFun (Y ∘ f) (Z ∘ f) Q) : IndepFun Y Z R := by
  apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hY.aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable).mpr
  have hh := h.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (hY.comp hf.measurable).aemeasurable
    (hZ.comp hf.measurable).aemeasurable
  rw [← hf.map_eq, Measure.map_map hY hf.measurable,
    Measure.map_map hZ hf.measurable, Measure.map_map (hY.prodMk hZ) hf.measurable]
  exact hh

iIndepFun_of_comp.exact_header:
theorem iIndepFun_of_comp {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Y : ι → Ω' → A} (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (h : iIndepFun (fun i => Y i ∘ f) Q) : iIndepFun Y R
iIndepFun_of_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem iIndepFun_of_comp {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {Y : ι → Ω' → A} (hY : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i))
    (h : iIndepFun (fun i => Y i ∘ f) Q) : iIndepFun Y R := by
  apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hY i).aemeasurable)).mpr
  have hh := h.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => ((hY i).comp hf.measurable).aemeasurable)
  rw [← hf.map_eq, Measure.map_map (measurable_pi_iff.mpr hY) hf.measurable]
  simp_rw [Measure.map_map (hY _) hf.measurable]
  exact hh

pushforward_brownian.exact_header: theorem pushforward_brownian (i : I) : IsPreBrownianReal (b i) R
pushforward_brownian.exact_declaration:
theorem pushforward_brownian (i : I) : IsPreBrownianReal (b i) R where
  hasLaw J := by
    apply hasLaw_of_comp hf (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t : J =>
      ((hA i t.val).mono (ℱ.le t.val)).measurable))
    apply ((D.brownian i).hasLaw J).congr
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun t : J => hp i t)] with ω hω
    exact funext hω

pushforward_increment_coordinates.exact_header:
theorem pushforward_increment_coordinates (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => b i t ω - b i s ω) R
pushforward_increment_coordinates.exact_declaration:
theorem pushforward_increment_coordinates (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => b i t ω - b i s ω) R := by
  apply iIndepFun_of_comp hf (fun i =>
    ((hA i t).mono (ℱ.le t)).measurable.sub ((hA i s).mono (ℱ.le s)).measurable)
  apply (D.increment_coordinates s t hst).congr
  intro i

theorem pushforward_future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :

pushforward_future_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem pushforward_future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => b i t ω - b i s ω) inferInstance)

hat.exact_header: def hat (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
hat.exact_declaration: def hat (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (1 - |(N : ℝ) * t - k|)

polygon.exact_header: def polygon (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ) : R
polygon.exact_declaration:
def polygon (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ) : R :=

hat_continuous.exact_header: theorem hat_continuous (N k : ℕ) : Continuous (hat N k)
hat_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem hat_continuous (N k : ℕ) : Continuous (hat N k) := by

polygon_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_continuous (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) : Continuous (polygon N f) := by

hat_left.exact_header:
theorem hat_left (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) : hat N k t = (k + 1 : ℝ) - N * t
hat_left.exact_declaration:
theorem hat_left (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) : hat N k t = (k + 1 : ℝ) - N * t := by
  rw [hat, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
  ring

hat_right.exact_header:
theorem hat_right (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) : hat N (k + 1) t = (N : ℝ) * t - k
hat_right.exact_declaration:
theorem hat_right (N k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) : hat N (k + 1) t = (N : ℝ) * t - k := by
  rw [hat, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith),
    max_eq_right (by linarith)]
  ring

hat_other.exact_header:
theorem hat_other (N k j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) (hj : j ≠ k) (hj' : j ≠ k + 1) :
    hat N j t = 0
hat_other.exact_declaration:
theorem hat_other (N k j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t)
    (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) (hj : j ≠ k) (hj' : j ≠ k + 1) :
    hat N j t = 0 := by
  unfold hat
  apply max_eq_left
  by_cases hjk : j ≤ k
  · have hlt : j + 1 ≤ k := by omega
    have hc : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hlt
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  · have hlt : k + 2 ≤ j := by omega
    have hc : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hlt
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
    linarith

polygon_cell.exact_header:
theorem polygon_cell (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) :
    polygon N f t = ((k + 1 : ℝ) - N * t) • f k +
      ((N : ℝ) * t - k) • f (k + 1)
polygon_cell.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_cell (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1) :
    polygon N f t = ((k + 1 : ℝ) - N * t) • f k +
      ((N : ℝ) * t - k) • f (k + 1) := by
  classical
  have hsub : ({k, k + 1} : Finset ℕ) ⊆ Finset.range (N + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl <;> simp only [Finset.mem_range] <;> omega
  calc
    polygon N f t = ∑ j ∈ ({k, k + 1} : Finset ℕ), hat N j t • f j := by
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset hsub
      intro j _ hj
      have hn : j ≠ k ∧ j ≠ k + 1 := by
        simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] using hj
      rw [hat_other N k j t hlo hhi hn.1 hn.2, zero_smul]
    _ = _ := by simp [hat_left N k t hlo hhi, hat_right N k t hlo hhi]

exists_cell.exact_header:
theorem exists_cell (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k < N ∧ (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t ∧ (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1
exists_cell.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_cell (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k < N ∧ (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t ∧ (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1 := by
  have hx : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) * t := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.1
  have hxN : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ N := mul_le_of_le_one_right (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.2
  by_cases hk : ⌊(N : ℝ) * t⌋₊ < N
  · exact ⟨_, hk, Nat.floor_le hx, (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _).le⟩
  · refine ⟨N - 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hf : (N : ℝ) ≤ ⌊(N : ℝ) * t⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N ≤ ⌊(N : ℝ) * t⌋₊)
      have hs : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le N 1)
      exact hs.trans (hf.trans (Nat.floor_le hx))
    · have he : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = N := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hN)
      linarith

polygon_cell_bound.exact_header:
theorem polygon_cell_bound (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1)
    (v : R) (C : ℝ) (hleft : ‖f k - v‖ ≤ C) (hright : ‖f (k + 1) - v‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖polygon N f t - v‖ ≤ C
polygon_cell_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_cell_bound (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1)
    (v : R) (C : ℝ) (hleft : ‖f k - v‖ ≤ C) (hright : ‖f (k + 1) - v‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖polygon N f t - v‖ ≤ C := by
  rw [polygon_cell N k hk f t hlo hhi]
  let a : ℝ := (k + 1 : ℝ) - N * t
  let b : ℝ := (N : ℝ) * t - k
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hab : a + b = 1 := by dsimp [a, b]; ring
  have he : a • f k + b • f (k + 1) - v = a • (f k - v) + b • (f (k + 1) - v) := by
    calc
      _ = a • f k + b • f (k + 1) - (a • v + b • v) := by
        rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
      _ = _ := by rw [smul_sub, smul_sub]; abel
  change ‖a • f k + b • f (k + 1) - v‖ ≤ C
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖a • (f k - v)‖ + ‖b • (f (k + 1) - v)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = a * ‖f k - v‖ + b * ‖f (k + 1) - v‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    _ ≤ a * C + b * C := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hleft ha)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright hb)
    _ = C := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

node_dist_forward.exact_header:
theorem node_dist_forward (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (a : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ j < M, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a)
    (j k : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ M) :
    ‖f k - f j‖ ≤ ((k : ℝ) - j) * a
node_dist_forward.exact_declaration:
theorem node_dist_forward (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (a : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ j < M, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a)
    (j k : ℕ) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ M) :
    ‖f k - f j‖ ≤ ((k : ℝ) - j) * a := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hj : j = 0 := by omega
    simp [hj]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases he : j = k + 1
    · simp [he]
    · have hjk' : j ≤ k := by omega
      have hkm : k ≤ M := by omega
      calc
        ‖f (k + 1) - f j‖ ≤ ‖f (k + 1) - f k‖ + ‖f k - f j‖ :=
          norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
        _ ≤ a + ((k : ℝ) - j) * a := add_le_add (hstep k (by omega)) (ih hjk' hkm)
        _ = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - j) * a := by push_cast; ring

node_dist.exact_header:
theorem node_dist (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (a : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ j < M, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a)
    (j k : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M) (hk : k ≤ M) :
    ‖f j - f k‖ ≤ |(j : ℝ) - k| * a
node_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem node_dist (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (a : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ j < M, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a)
    (j k : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M) (hk : k ≤ M) :
    ‖f j - f k‖ ≤ |(j : ℝ) - k| * a := by
  by_cases hjk : j ≤ k
  · have hcast : (j : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hjk
    rw [norm_sub_rev, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hcast)]
    have h := node_dist_forward M f a hstep j k hjk hk
    linarith
  · have hkj : k ≤ j := by omega
    have hcast : (k : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hkj
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcast)]
    exact node_dist_forward M f a hstep k j hkj hj

polygon_refine_bound.exact_header:
theorem polygon_refine_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hmatch : ∀ j ≤ N, f j = g (2 * j)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 * N, ‖g (j + 1) - g j‖ ≤ a)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ‖polygon (2 * N) g t - polygon N f t‖ ≤ 5 * a
polygon_refine_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_refine_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hmatch : ∀ j ≤ N, f j = g (2 * j)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 * N, ‖g (j + 1) - g j‖ ≤ a)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ‖polygon (2 * N) g t - polygon N f t‖ ≤ 5 * a := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hklo, hkhi⟩ := exists_cell N hN t ht
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hllo, hlhi⟩ := exists_cell (2 * N) (by omega) t ht
  have hklim : 2 * k ≤ 2 * N := by omega
  have hfine (j : ℕ) (hjlo : l ≤ j) (hjhi : j ≤ l + 1) : ‖g j - g (2 * k)‖ ≤ 3 * a := by
    have hjlim : j ≤ 2 * N := by omega
    have hi : |(j : ℝ) - (2 * k : ℕ)| ≤ 3 := by
      have hjlo' : (l : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hjlo
      have hjhi' : (j : ℝ) ≤ l + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hjhi
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hllo hlhi ⊢
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    exact (node_dist (2 * N) g a hstep j (2 * k) hjlim hklim).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi ha)
  have hF : ‖polygon (2 * N) g t - g (2 * k)‖ ≤ 3 * a :=
    polygon_cell_bound (2 * N) l hl g t hllo hlhi _ _
      (hfine l le_rfl (Nat.le_succ l)) (hfine (l + 1) (Nat.le_succ l) le_rfl)
  have hC : ‖polygon N f t - g (2 * k)‖ ≤ 2 * a := by
    apply polygon_cell_bound N k hk f t hklo hkhi
    · rw [hmatch k (by omega), sub_self, norm_zero]
      positivity
    · rw [hmatch (k + 1) (by omega)]
      have hb := node_dist_forward (2 * N) g a hstep (2 * k) (2 * (k + 1))
        (by omega) (by omega)
      convert hb using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  calc
    ‖polygon (2 * N) g t - polygon N f t‖ ≤
        ‖polygon (2 * N) g t - g (2 * k)‖ + ‖g (2 * k) - polygon N f t‖ :=
      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
    _ ≤ 3 * a + 2 * a := by rw [norm_sub_rev (g (2 * k))]; exact add_le_add hF hC
    _ = 5 * a := by ring

sampledPolygon.exact_header: def sampledPolygon (N : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) : ℝ → R

dyadicPolygon.exact_header: def dyadicPolygon (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) : ℝ → R
dyadicPolygon.exact_declaration: def dyadicPolygon (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) : ℝ → R := sampledPolygon (2 ^ n) F

dyadicPolygon_continuous.exact_header:
theorem dyadicPolygon_continuous (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) :

dyadicPolygon_succ_bound.exact_header:
theorem dyadicPolygon_succ_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ‖dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t - dyadicPolygon n F t‖ ≤ 5 * a
dyadicPolygon_succ_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicPolygon_succ_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    ‖dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t - dyadicPolygon n F t‖ ≤ 5 * a := by
  have hp : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ n := by omega
  have hc : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hmatch : ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ (2 ^ n : ℕ) →
      F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) = F (((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
    intro j _
    congr 1
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hst : ∀ j < 2 * 2 ^ n,
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n))‖ ≤ a := by
    intro j hj
    simpa only [pow_succ, mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) 2] using hstep j (by omega)
  have hb := polygon_refine_bound (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
    (fun j => F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n))
    (fun j => F ((j : ℝ) / (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n))) hmatch a ha hst t ht
  simpa only [dyadicPolygon, sampledPolygon, hp, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hb

polygon_left_bound.exact_header:
theorem polygon_left_bound (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hstep : ‖f (k + 1) - f k‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖polygon N f t - f k‖ ≤ a
polygon_left_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_left_bound (N k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (hlo : (k : ℝ) ≤ N * t) (hhi : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ k + 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hstep : ‖f (k + 1) - f k‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖polygon N f t - f k‖ ≤ a :=
  polygon_cell_bound N k hk f t hlo hhi (f k) a (by simpa using ha) hstep

dyadicMap.exact_header: def dyadicMap (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) : C(UnitWindow, R)
dyadicMap.exact_declaration:
def dyadicMap (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) : C(UnitWindow, R) :=
  ⟨fun t => dyadicPolygon n F t, (dyadicPolygon_continuous n F).comp continuous_subtype_val⟩

dyadicMap_succ_bound.exact_header:
theorem dyadicMap_succ_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a) :
    dist (dyadicMap n F) (dyadicMap (n + 1) F) ≤ 5 * a
dyadicMap_succ_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicMap_succ_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a) :
    dist (dyadicMap n F) (dyadicMap (n + 1) F) ≤ 5 * a := by
  rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le (dyadicMap (n + 1) F - dyadicMap n F) (by positivity)).mpr
  intro t
  exact dyadicPolygon_succ_bound n F a ha hstep t t.property

exists_dyadicMap_limit.exact_header:
theorem exists_dyadicMap_limit (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hsum : Summable a)
    (hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a n) :
    ∃ U : C(UnitWindow, R), Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U)
exists_dyadicMap_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_dyadicMap_limit (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hsum : Summable a)
    (hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a n) :
    ∃ U : C(UnitWindow, R), Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U) := by
  have hd : Summable (fun n => dist (dyadicMap n F) (dyadicMap (n + 1) F)) := by
    apply (hsum.mul_left 5).of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat
    filter_upwards [hstep] with n hn
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg dist_nonneg]
    exact dyadicMap_succ_bound n F (a n) (ha n) hn
  exact cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (cauchySeq_of_summable_dist hd)

dyadicMap_tendsto_uniformly.exact_header:
theorem dyadicMap_tendsto_uniformly (F : ℝ → R) (U : C(UnitWindow, R))
    (hU : Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U)) :
    TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop
dyadicMap_tendsto_uniformly.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicMap_tendsto_uniformly (F : ℝ → R) (U : C(UnitWindow, R))
    (hU : Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U)) :
    TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop := by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have he := hU.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds U hε)
  filter_upwards [he] with n hn t
  have hc : dist U (dyadicMap n F) < ε := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hn
  exact (ContinuousMap.dist_apply_le_dist (f := U) (g := dyadicMap n F) t).trans_lt hc

exists_uniform_dyadic_limit.exact_header:
theorem exists_uniform_dyadic_limit (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hsum : Summable a)
    (hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a n) :
    ∃ U : C(UnitWindow, R),
      Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U) ∧
      TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop
exists_uniform_dyadic_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_uniform_dyadic_limit (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
    (hsum : Summable a)
    (hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a n) :
    ∃ U : C(UnitWindow, R),
      Tendsto (fun n => dyadicMap n F) atTop (𝓝 U) ∧
      TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_dyadicMap_limit F a ha hsum hstep
  exact ⟨U, hU, dyadicMap_tendsto_uniformly F U hU⟩

/-! # The continuous dyadic limit has an explicit past-only series
The raw candidate is defined without a convergence assumption. Actual
summable grid bounds prove convergence and identify its value with the
continuous polygon limit, simultaneously throughout the unit window.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open Set Filter
open scoped Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.DyadicInterpolation
variable {R : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup R] [NormedSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]



/-- Actual endpoint control identifies each polygon with its past-only
sample to within the actual adjacent-grid bound. -/

variable (F : ℝ → R) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n)
  (hsum : Summable a)
  (hstep : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ j < 2 ^ n,
    ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) - F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ a n)

include hstep in
/-- Actual summable eventual dyadic increments give the past-only candidate
continuous sample paths; no measurable choice of the continuous polygon limit
enters the candidate's definition. -/

end PBGSO.DyadicInterpolation

pastSample.exact_header: def pastSample (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) : R
pastSample.exact_declaration: def pastSample (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) : R := F (leftTime (2 ^ n) t)

pastCandidate.exact_header: def pastCandidate (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) : R
pastCandidate.exact_declaration:
def pastCandidate (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) : R :=
  pastSample 0 F t + ∑' n, (pastSample (n + 1) F t - pastSample n F t)

dyadic_past_bound.exact_header:
theorem dyadic_past_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ n,
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) - F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖dyadicPolygon n F t - pastSample n F t‖ ≤ a
dyadic_past_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_past_bound (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → R) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < 2 ^ n,
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) - F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖dyadicPolygon n F t - pastSample n F t‖ ≤ a := by
  have h := polygon_past_bound (2 ^ n) (by positivity)
    (fun j => F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) t ht a ha hstep
  simpa only [dyadicPolygon, sampledPolygon, pastSample, leftTime,
    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using h

eventual_steps.exact_declaration:
theorem eventual_steps : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
    (∀ j < 2 ^ n,
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) - F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)‖ ≤ a n) ∧
    (∀ j < 2 ^ (n + 1),
      ‖F (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) -
        F ((j : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))‖ ≤ a (n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hstep
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
  exact ⟨hN n hn, hN (n + 1) (by omega)⟩

include ha hsum hstep in

past_differences_summable.exact_header:
theorem past_differences_summable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    Summable (fun n => ‖pastSample (n + 1) F t - pastSample n F t‖)
past_differences_summable.exact_declaration:
theorem past_differences_summable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    Summable (fun n => ‖pastSample (n + 1) F t - pastSample n F t‖) := by
  have hshift : Summable (fun n => a (n + 1)) := hsum.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective
  apply (hsum.add (hshift.mul_left 6)).of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat
  filter_upwards [eventual_steps F a hstep] with n hn
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  have hp := dyadic_past_bound n F t ht (a n) (ha n) hn.1
  have hp' := dyadic_past_bound (n + 1) F t ht (a (n + 1)) (ha (n + 1)) hn.2
  have hd := dyadicPolygon_succ_bound n F (a (n + 1)) (ha (n + 1)) hn.2 t ht
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖pastSample (n + 1) F t - dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t‖ +
        ‖dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t - pastSample n F t‖ :=
      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
    _ ≤ ‖pastSample (n + 1) F t - dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t‖ +
        (‖dyadicPolygon (n + 1) F t - dyadicPolygon n F t‖ +
          ‖dyadicPolygon n F t - pastSample n F t‖) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _)
    _ ≤ a (n + 1) + (5 * a (n + 1) + a n) := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev (pastSample (n + 1) F t)]
      exact add_le_add hp' (add_le_add hd hp)
    _ = a n + 6 * a (n + 1) := by ring

include ha hsum hstep in

pastSample_tendsto_candidate.exact_header:
theorem pastSample_tendsto_candidate (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n => pastSample n F t) atTop (𝓝 (pastCandidate F t))
pastSample_tendsto_candidate.exact_declaration:
theorem pastSample_tendsto_candidate (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n => pastSample n F t) atTop (𝓝 (pastCandidate F t)) := by
  have hs := (past_differences_summable F a ha hsum hstep t ht).of_norm
  have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => pastSample 0 F t) atTop (𝓝 (pastSample 0 F t)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have hh := hc.add hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have he (n : ℕ) : pastSample 0 F t +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (pastSample (k + 1) F t - pastSample k F t) = pastSample n F t := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← add_assoc, ih]
      abel
  simpa only [he, pastCandidate] using hh

include ha hsum hstep in

pastCandidate_eq_of_uniform_limit.exact_header:
theorem pastCandidate_eq_of_uniform_limit (U : C(UnitWindow, R))
    (hU : TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop)
    (t : UnitWindow) : pastCandidate F t = U t
pastCandidate_eq_of_uniform_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem pastCandidate_eq_of_uniform_limit (U : C(UnitWindow, R))
    (hU : TendstoUniformly (fun n (t : UnitWindow) => dyadicPolygon n F t) U atTop)
    (t : UnitWindow) : pastCandidate F t = U t := by
  have hz : Tendsto (fun n => ‖pastSample n F t - dyadicPolygon n F t‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsum.tendsto_atTop_zero
    filter_upwards [hstep] with n hn
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
    exact dyadic_past_bound n F t t.property (a n) (ha n) hn
  have hv : Tendsto (fun n => pastSample n F t - dyadicPolygon n F t) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr hz
  have hp := hv.add (hU.tendsto_at t)
  have he : (fun n => (pastSample n F t - dyadicPolygon n F t) + dyadicPolygon n F t) =
      fun n => pastSample n F t := by funext n; abel
  rw [he, zero_add] at hp
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (pastSample_tendsto_candidate F a ha hsum hstep t t.property) hp

include ha hsum hstep in

pastCandidate_continuousOn.exact_declaration:
theorem pastCandidate_continuousOn : ContinuousOn (pastCandidate F) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hshift : Summable (fun n => a (n + 1)) := hsum.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective
  have hnext := (eventual_steps F a hstep).mono (fun _ hn => hn.2)
  obtain ⟨U, _, hU⟩ := exists_uniform_dyadic_limit F (fun n => a (n + 1))
    (fun n => ha (n + 1)) hshift hnext
  apply continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mpr
  have he : (fun t : UnitWindow => pastCandidate F t) = U := by
    funext t
    exact pastCandidate_eq_of_uniform_limit F a ha hsum hstep U hU t
  change Continuous (fun t : UnitWindow => pastCandidate F t)
  rw [he]
  exact U.continuous
