/-! # Past-only grid samples and their actual polygon comparison
The left sample time never exceeds the observation time. Its deterministic
mesh error and polygon distance justify retaining the original filtration
when constructing continuous Brownian modifications.
-/
noncomputable section
open Set Filter
open scoped Topology
namespace PBGSO.DyadicInterpolation
variable {R : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup R] [NormedSpace ℝ R]





/-- The past sample index lies in the actual finite interpolation grid. -/

/-- On the whole unit interval, including its right endpoint, the actual
polygon is within one adjacent-increment bound of the past-only sample. -/

/-- Actual past dyadic sample times converge to every nonnegative observation time. -/

end PBGSO.DyadicInterpolation

leftIndex.exact_declaration: def leftIndex (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌊(N : ℝ) * t⌋₊

leftTime.exact_declaration: def leftTime (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (leftIndex N t : ℝ) / N

leftTime_nonneg.exact_header: theorem leftTime_nonneg (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ leftTime N t
leftTime_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem leftTime_nonneg (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ leftTime N t := by
  unfold leftTime
  positivity

leftTime_le.exact_header:
theorem leftTime_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    leftTime N t ≤ t
leftTime_le.exact_declaration:
theorem leftTime_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    leftTime N t ≤ t := by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  rw [leftTime, div_le_iff₀ hNr]
  simpa only [leftIndex, mul_comm] using Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht)

leftTime_gap.exact_header:
theorem leftTime_gap (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) :
    t - leftTime N t ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹
leftTime_gap.exact_declaration:
theorem leftTime_gap (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) :
    t - leftTime N t ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hf := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((N : ℝ) * t)).le
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hNr).mp
  dsimp [leftTime, leftIndex]
  field_simp
  rw [mul_comm (N : ℝ) t] at hf
  nlinarith

leftIndex_le.exact_header: theorem leftIndex_le (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) : leftIndex N t ≤ N
leftIndex_le.exact_declaration:
theorem leftIndex_le (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) : leftIndex N t ≤ N := by
  have hm : (N : ℝ) * t ≤ N := mul_le_of_le_one_right (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.2
  have hf := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.1)
  exact_mod_cast hf.trans hm

polygon_past_bound.exact_header:
theorem polygon_past_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < N, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖polygon N f t - f (leftIndex N t)‖ ≤ a
polygon_past_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem polygon_past_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (f : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ j < N, ‖f (j + 1) - f j‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖polygon N f t - f (leftIndex N t)‖ ≤ a := by
  have hf := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.1)
  have hf' := (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((N : ℝ) * t)).le
  change (leftIndex N t : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) * t at hf
  change (N : ℝ) * t ≤ (leftIndex N t : ℝ) + 1 at hf'
  by_cases hk : leftIndex N t < N
  · exact polygon_left_bound N _ hk f t hf hf' a ha (hstep _ hk)
  · have he : leftIndex N t = N := by have := leftIndex_le N t ht; omega
    have hx : (N : ℝ) * t = N := by
      rw [he] at hf
      exact le_antisymm (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Nat.cast_nonneg N) ht.2) hf
    have hlast : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_add_cancel hN
    have hp := polygon_cell N (N - 1) (by omega) f t (by rw [hx]; linarith) (by rw [hx]; linarith)
    rw [hp, hx, hlast, sub_self, zero_smul, zero_add, he]
    have hone : (N : ℝ) - ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 := by linarith
    rw [hone, one_smul, Nat.sub_add_cancel hN, sub_self, norm_zero]
    exact ha

leftTime_dyadic_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem leftTime_dyadic_tendsto (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Tendsto (fun n => leftTime (2 ^ n) t) atTop (𝓝 t)
leftTime_dyadic_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem leftTime_dyadic_tendsto (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Tendsto (fun n => leftTime (2 ^ n) t) atTop (𝓝 t) := by
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [inv_pow] using
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2⁻¹)
        (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1)
  have hg : Tendsto (fun n => t - leftTime (2 ^ n) t) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => sub_nonneg.mpr (leftTime_le _ (by positivity) t ht))
      (fun n => by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        leftTime_gap (2 ^ n) (by positivity) t) hinv
  have he : (fun n => leftTime (2 ^ n) t) = fun n => t - (t - leftTime (2 ^ n) t) := by
    funext n
    ring
  rw [he]
  simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hg

dyadic_time_last.exact_header:
theorem dyadic_time_last (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ) :
    (dyadicGrids T).time m ((dyadicGrids T).count m) = T
dyadic_time_last.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_time_last (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ) :
    (dyadicGrids T).time m ((dyadicGrids T).count m) = T := by
  simp only [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hp : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ m ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

dyadic_time_succ.exact_header:
theorem dyadic_time_succ (T : ℝ≥0) (m k : ℕ) :
    ((dyadicGrids T).time m (k + 1) : ℝ) =
      ((dyadicGrids T).time m k : ℝ) + (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m
dyadic_time_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_time_succ (T : ℝ≥0) (m k : ℕ) :
    ((dyadicGrids T).time m (k + 1) : ℝ) =
      ((dyadicGrids T).time m k : ℝ) + (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
  simp only [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_one, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_natCast, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
  ring

dyadicStopIndex.exact_header:
def dyadicStopIndex (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ
dyadicStopIndex.exact_declaration:
def dyadicStopIndex (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ :=
  Nat.find (show ∃ k, τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k from
    ⟨(dyadicGrids T).count m, by rw [dyadic_time_last]; exact hτ ω⟩)

dyadicStopIndex_spec.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStopIndex_spec (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m (dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω)
dyadicStopIndex_spec.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStopIndex_spec (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m (dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω) :=
by
  unfold dyadicStopIndex
  exact Nat.find_spec (p := fun k => τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k) _

dyadicStopIndex_le_iff.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStopIndex_le_iff (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω ≤ k ↔ τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k
dyadicStopIndex_le_iff.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStopIndex_le_iff (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω ≤ k ↔ τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k := by
  constructor
  · intro hk
    exact (dyadicStopIndex_spec T τ hτ m ω).trans ((dyadicGrids T).monotone m hk)
  · intro hk
    unfold dyadicStopIndex
    exact Nat.find_min' _ hk

dyadicStoppingIndex.exact_declaration:
def dyadicStoppingIndex (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) (m : ℕ) :
    GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m) where
  index := dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m
  bound ω := (dyadicStopIndex_le_iff T τ hτ m _ ω).mpr (by
    rw [dyadic_time_last]; exact hτ ω)
  stopping k := by
    have he : {ω | dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω ≤ k} =
        {ω | τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k} := by
      ext ω
      exact dyadicStopIndex_le_iff T τ hτ m k ω
    rw [he]
    exact hstop _

dyadicStop.exact_header:
def dyadicStop (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ≥0

dyadicStop_bounds.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStop_bounds (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : τ ω ≤ dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω ∧ dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω ≤ T
dyadicStop_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStop_bounds (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : τ ω ≤ dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω ∧ dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω ≤ T := by
  refine ⟨dyadicStopIndex_spec T τ hτ m ω, ?_⟩
  calc
    dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m ((dyadicGrids T).count m) :=
      (dyadicGrids T).monotone m ((dyadicStopIndex_le_iff T τ hτ m _ ω).mpr (by
        rw [dyadic_time_last]; exact hτ ω))
    _ = T := dyadic_time_last T m

dyadicStop_error.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStop_error (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ) ≤ (τ ω : ℝ) + (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m
dyadicStop_error.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStop_error (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ) ≤ (τ ω : ℝ) + (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
  have hspec := dyadicStopIndex_spec T τ hτ m ω
  cases he : dyadicStopIndex T τ hτ m ω with
  | zero =>
    rw [dyadicStop, he]
    simp only [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, NNReal.coe_zero]
    positivity
  | succ k =>
    have hprev : ¬ τ ω ≤ (dyadicGrids T).time m k := by
      intro hk
      have hi := (dyadicStopIndex_le_iff T τ hτ m k ω).mpr hk
      rw [he] at hi
      omega
    have hlt : ((dyadicGrids T).time m k : ℝ) < (τ ω : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast lt_of_not_ge hprev
    rw [dyadicStop, he, dyadic_time_succ]
    exact add_le_add hlt.le le_rfl

dyadicStop_tendsto_real.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStop_tendsto_real (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) : Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (τ ω : ℝ))
dyadicStop_tendsto_real.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStop_tendsto_real (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) : Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (τ ω : ℝ)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_order.mp (TimeGridContinuity.dyadic_mesh_tendsto T)).2 ε hε)
  refine ⟨M, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (dyadicStop_bounds T τ hτ m ω).1))]
  have he := dyadicStop_error T τ hτ m ω
  linarith [hM m hm]

dyadicStop_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStop_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) : Tendsto (fun m => dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω) atTop (𝓝 (τ ω))
dyadicStop_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStop_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) : Tendsto (fun m => dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω) atTop (𝓝 (τ ω)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (dyadicStop_tendsto_real T τ hτ ω) ε hε
  exact ⟨M, fun m hm => hM m hm⟩

dyadicStop_indicator_eventually.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStop_indicator_eventually (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ∀ᶠ m in atTop, (r ≤ (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ) ↔ r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ))
dyadicStop_indicator_eventually.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStop_indicator_eventually (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T)
    (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ∀ᶠ m in atTop, (r ≤ (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω : ℝ) ↔ r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)) := by
  by_cases hr : r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun m => iff_of_true
      (hr.trans (by exact_mod_cast (dyadicStop_bounds T τ hτ m ω).1)) hr)
  · have he := (tendsto_order.mp (dyadicStop_tendsto_real T τ hτ ω)).2 r (lt_of_not_ge hr)
    exact he.mono (fun m hm => iff_of_false (not_le_of_gt hm) hr)

/-! # Measurability of the actual empirical Wasserstein statistic

Finite equality-pattern strata collapse duplicate cloud points to fixed finite
weighted support indices. Every genuine empirical coupling is pulled back by
an actual finite measurable embedding inverse, and every index coupling is
pushed forward. This proves exact equality with a fixed index-coupling infimum.
Each finite-index cost is continuous; its infimum is upper semicontinuous and
measurable. The finite measurable stratum cover proves global measurability.
Neither an optimal coupling nor a Wasserstein triangle inequality is assumed.
-/

IndexCoupling.exact_header:
structure IndexCoupling {J K : Type*} [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace K]
    (μ : Measure J) (ν : Measure K)
IndexCoupling.exact_declaration:
structure IndexCoupling {J K : Type*} [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSpace K]
    (μ : Measure J) (ν : Measure K) where
  joint : Measure (J × K)
  fst : joint.map Prod.fst = μ
  snd : joint.map Prod.snd = ν

finite_measurableEmbedding.exact_header:
theorem finite_measurableEmbedding (f : J → H) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    MeasurableEmbedding f
finite_measurableEmbedding.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_measurableEmbedding (f : J → H) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    MeasurableEmbedding f :=
  ⟨hf, measurable_of_countable f, fun s _ ↦ ((Set.toFinite s).countable.image f).measurableSet⟩

embedding_inverse_ae.exact_header:
theorem embedding_inverse_ae (f : J → H) (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map f, f (hf.invFun x) = x
embedding_inverse_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem embedding_inverse_ae (f : J → H) (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map f, f (hf.invFun x) = x := by
  apply (ae_map_iff hf.measurable.aemeasurable (by measurability)).mpr
  exact ae_of_all _ fun j ↦ congrArg f (hf.leftInverse_invFun j)

liftCoupling.exact_header:
def liftCoupling (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) : ULA.Coupling (μ.map f) (ν.map g)
liftCoupling.exact_declaration:
def liftCoupling (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) : ULA.Coupling (μ.map f) (ν.map g) where
  joint := c.joint.map (fun p ↦ (f p.1, g p.2))
  fst := by
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (f ∘ Prod.fst) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_of_countable f) measurable_fst, c.fst]
  snd := by
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_snd (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (g ∘ Prod.snd) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (measurable_of_countable g) measurable_snd, c.snd]

liftCoupling_cost.exact_header:
theorem liftCoupling_cost (f : J → H) (g : K → H) (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) :
    ULA.couplingCost (liftCoupling μ ν f g c).joint =
      eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 c.joint
liftCoupling_cost.exact_declaration:
theorem liftCoupling_cost (f : J → H) (g : K → H) (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) :
    ULA.couplingCost (liftCoupling μ ν f g c).joint =
      eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 c.joint := by
  exact eLpNorm_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)

pullCoupling.exact_declaration:
def pullCoupling (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (c : ULA.Coupling (μ.map f) (ν.map g)) : IndexCoupling μ ν where
  joint := c.joint.map (fun p ↦ (hf.invFun p.1, hg.invFun p.2))
  fst := by
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (hf.invFun ∘ Prod.fst) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map hf.measurable_invFun measurable_fst, c.fst,
      Measure.map_map hf.measurable_invFun hf.measurable]
    have he : hf.invFun ∘ f = id := funext hf.leftInverse_invFun
    rw [he, Measure.map_id]
  snd := by
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_snd (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (hg.invFun ∘ Prod.snd) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map hg.measurable_invFun measurable_snd, c.snd,
      Measure.map_map hg.measurable_invFun hg.measurable]
    have he : hg.invFun ∘ g = id := funext hg.leftInverse_invFun
    rw [he, Measure.map_id]

pullCoupling_cost.exact_header:
theorem pullCoupling_cost (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (c : ULA.Coupling (μ.map f) (ν.map g)) :
    eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 (pullCoupling μ ν f g hf hg c).joint =
      ULA.couplingCost c.joint
pullCoupling_cost.exact_declaration:
theorem pullCoupling_cost (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (c : ULA.Coupling (μ.map f) (ν.map g)) :
    eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 (pullCoupling μ ν f g hf hg c).joint =
      ULA.couplingCost c.joint := by
  rw [pullCoupling, eLpNorm_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  apply eLpNorm_congr_ae
  have hleft : ∀ᵐ p ∂c.joint, f (hf.invFun p.1) = p.1 := by
    have h := embedding_inverse_ae μ f hf
    rw [← c.fst] at h
    exact (ae_map_iff measurable_fst.aemeasurable (by measurability)).mp h
  have hright : ∀ᵐ p ∂c.joint, g (hg.invFun p.2) = p.2 := by
    have h := embedding_inverse_ae ν g hg
    rw [← c.snd] at h
    exact (ae_map_iff measurable_snd.aemeasurable (by measurability)).mp h
  filter_upwards [hleft, hright] with p hp hq
  exact congrArg₂ (· - ·) hp hq

transport_eq_index_inf.exact_header:
theorem transport_eq_index_inf (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 (μ.map f) (ν.map g) =
      ⨅ c : IndexCoupling μ ν, eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 c.joint
transport_eq_index_inf.exact_declaration:
theorem transport_eq_index_inf (f : J → H) (g : K → H)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 (μ.map f) (ν.map g) =
      ⨅ c : IndexCoupling μ ν, eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ f p.1 - g p.2) 2 c.joint := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_iInf fun c ↦ ?_
    exact (ULA.wasserstein2_le_couplingCost (liftCoupling μ ν f g c)).trans_eq
      (liftCoupling_cost μ ν f g c)
  · refine le_iInf fun c ↦ ?_
    exact (iInf_le _ (pullCoupling μ ν f g (finite_measurableEmbedding f hf)
      (finite_measurableEmbedding g hg) c)).trans_eq
      (pullCoupling_cost μ ν f g (finite_measurableEmbedding f hf)
        (finite_measurableEmbedding g hg) c)

indexCoupling_probability.exact_header: instance indexCoupling_probability (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint
indexCoupling_probability.exact_declaration:
instance indexCoupling_probability (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := by
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (c.joint.map Prod.fst) := by rw [c.fst]; infer_instance
  exact (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff measurable_fst.aemeasurable).mp inferInstance

indexIndependent.exact_declaration:
def indexIndependent : IndexCoupling μ ν where
  joint := μ.prod ν
  fst := (measurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := ν)).map_eq
  snd := (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := ν)).map_eq

indexCost.exact_header: def indexCost (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) (z : (J → H) × (K → H)) : ℝ≥0∞
indexCost.exact_declaration:
def indexCost (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) (z : (J → H) × (K → H)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  eLpNorm (fun p : J × K ↦ z.1 p.1 - z.2 p.2) 2 c.joint

indexCost_continuous.exact_header:
theorem indexCost_continuous (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) :
    Continuous (indexCost (H := H) μ ν c)
indexCost_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem indexCost_continuous (c : IndexCoupling μ ν) :
    Continuous (indexCost (H := H) μ ν c) := by
  have he (z : (J → H) × (K → H)) :
      indexCost μ ν c z =
        (∑ p : J × K, ‖z.1 p.1 - z.2 p.2‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) * c.joint {p}) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [indexCost, eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (measurable_of_countable _).aestronglyMeasurable, lintegral_fintype]
    norm_num
  change Continuous (fun z ↦ indexCost μ ν c z)
  simp_rw [he]
  apply ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.comp
  apply continuous_finset_sum
  intro p _
  apply (ENNReal.continuous_mul_const (measure_ne_top _ _)).comp
  apply ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.comp
  exact (((continuous_apply p.1).comp continuous_fst).sub
    ((continuous_apply p.2).comp continuous_snd)).enorm

indexInf.exact_declaration: def indexInf (z : (J → H) × (K → H)) : ℝ≥0∞ := ⨅ c : IndexCoupling μ ν, indexCost μ ν c z

indexInf_upperSemicontinuous.exact_header: theorem indexInf_upperSemicontinuous : UpperSemicontinuous (indexInf (H := H) μ ν)
indexInf_upperSemicontinuous.exact_declaration:
theorem indexInf_upperSemicontinuous : UpperSemicontinuous (indexInf (H := H) μ ν) :=
  upperSemicontinuous_iInf fun c ↦ (indexCost_continuous μ ν c).upperSemicontinuous

indexInf_measurable.exact_header: theorem indexInf_measurable : Measurable (indexInf (H := H) μ ν)
indexInf_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem indexInf_measurable : Measurable (indexInf (H := H) μ ν) :=
  (indexInf_upperSemicontinuous μ ν).measurable

CloudPattern.exact_header: def CloudPattern (r : Fin N → Fin N) (z : Fin N → H) : Prop
CloudPattern.exact_declaration:
def CloudPattern (r : Fin N → Fin N) (z : Fin N → H) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, z i = z j ↔ r i = r j

exists_cloudPattern.exact_header: theorem exists_cloudPattern (z : Fin N → H) : ∃ r, CloudPattern N r z
exists_cloudPattern.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_cloudPattern (z : Fin N → H) : ∃ r, CloudPattern N r z := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ Function.invFun z (z i), ?_⟩
  intro i j
  constructor
  · exact congrArg (Function.invFun z)
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg z h
    simpa only [Function.apply_invFun_apply] using he

cloudPattern_measurableSet.exact_header:
theorem cloudPattern_measurableSet (r : Fin N → Fin N) :
    MeasurableSet {z : Fin N → H | CloudPattern N r z}
cloudPattern_measurableSet.exact_declaration:
theorem cloudPattern_measurableSet (r : Fin N → Fin N) :
    MeasurableSet {z : Fin N → H | CloudPattern N r z} := by
  classical
  simp only [CloudPattern, setOf_forall]
  apply MeasurableSet.iInter
  intro i
  apply MeasurableSet.iInter
  intro j
  by_cases h : r i = r j
  · simpa only [h, iff_true] using
      measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply j)
  · simpa only [h, iff_false, Set.compl_setOf] using
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply j)).compl

PatternIndex.exact_header: abbrev PatternIndex (r : Fin N → Fin N)
PatternIndex.exact_declaration: abbrev PatternIndex (r : Fin N → Fin N) := Set.range r

patternIndex_fintype.exact_header: instance patternIndex_fintype (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Fintype (PatternIndex N r)
patternIndex_fintype.exact_declaration:
instance patternIndex_fintype (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Fintype (PatternIndex N r) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

patternIndex_nonempty.exact_header: instance patternIndex_nonempty (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Nonempty (PatternIndex N r)
patternIndex_nonempty.exact_declaration:
instance patternIndex_nonempty (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Nonempty (PatternIndex N r) :=
  ⟨⟨r 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩⟩

patternMap.exact_header: def patternMap (r : Fin N → Fin N) (i : Fin N) : PatternIndex N r
patternMap.exact_declaration: def patternMap (r : Fin N → Fin N) (i : Fin N) : PatternIndex N r := ⟨r i, ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩

patternLaw.exact_header: def patternLaw (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Measure (PatternIndex N r)
patternLaw.exact_declaration:
def patternLaw (r : Fin N → Fin N) : Measure (PatternIndex N r) :=
  Model.empiricalLaw N (patternMap N r)

patternLaw_probability.exact_header: instance patternLaw_probability (r : Fin N → Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (patternLaw N r)
patternLaw_probability.exact_declaration:
instance patternLaw_probability (r : Fin N → Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (patternLaw N r) := by
  constructor
  simp [patternLaw, Model.empiricalLaw]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne N)) (by simp)

patternEval.exact_header: def patternEval (r : Fin N → Fin N) (z : Fin N → H) (j : PatternIndex N r) : H
patternEval.exact_declaration:
def patternEval (r : Fin N → Fin N) (z : Fin N → H) (j : PatternIndex N r) : H :=
  z (Function.invFun r j.val)

patternEval_reconstruct.exact_header:
theorem patternEval_reconstruct {r : Fin N → Fin N} {z : Fin N → H}
    (hp : CloudPattern N r z) (i : Fin N) : patternEval N r z (patternMap N r i) = z i

patternEval_injective.exact_header:
theorem patternEval_injective {r : Fin N → Fin N} {z : Fin N → H}
    (hp : CloudPattern N r z) : Function.Injective (patternEval N r z)
patternEval_injective.exact_declaration:
theorem patternEval_injective {r : Fin N → Fin N} {z : Fin N → H}
    (hp : CloudPattern N r z) : Function.Injective (patternEval N r z) := by
  intro i j h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := (hp _ _).mp h
  simpa only [Function.invFun_eq i.property, Function.invFun_eq j.property] using he

patternLaw_map.exact_header:
theorem patternLaw_map {r : Fin N → Fin N} {z : Fin N → H} (hp : CloudPattern N r z) :
    (patternLaw N r).map (patternEval N r z) = Model.empiricalLaw N z
patternLaw_map.exact_declaration:
theorem patternLaw_map {r : Fin N → Fin N} {z : Fin N → H} (hp : CloudPattern N r z) :
    (patternLaw N r).map (patternEval N r z) = Model.empiricalLaw N z := by
  rw [patternLaw, empiricalLaw_map N _ _ (measurable_of_countable _)]
  congr 1
  exact funext (patternEval_reconstruct N hp)

patternCost.exact_header: def patternCost (r s : Fin N → Fin N) (z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H)) : ℝ≥0∞
patternCost.exact_declaration:
def patternCost (r s : Fin N → Fin N) (z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  indexInf (patternLaw N r) (patternLaw N s) (patternEval N r z.1, patternEval N s z.2)

patternCost_measurable.exact_header:
theorem patternCost_measurable (r s : Fin N → Fin N) :
    Measurable (patternCost (H := H) N r s)
patternCost_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem patternCost_measurable (r s : Fin N → Fin N) :
    Measurable (patternCost (H := H) N r s) := by
  apply (indexInf_measurable (patternLaw N r) (patternLaw N s)).comp
  apply Measurable.prodMk
  · exact Measurable.of_eval fun i ↦ (measurable_pi_apply _).comp measurable_fst
  · exact Measurable.of_eval fun i ↦ (measurable_pi_apply _).comp measurable_snd

empirical_transport_eq_pattern.exact_header:
theorem empirical_transport_eq_pattern {r s : Fin N → Fin N}
    {z w : Fin N → H} (hz : CloudPattern N r z) (hw : CloudPattern N s w) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) =
      patternCost N r s (z, w)
empirical_transport_eq_pattern.exact_declaration:
theorem empirical_transport_eq_pattern {r s : Fin N → Fin N}
    {z w : Fin N → H} (hz : CloudPattern N r z) (hw : CloudPattern N s w) :
    ULA.wasserstein2 (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) =
      patternCost N r s (z, w) := by
  rw [← patternLaw_map N hz, ← patternLaw_map N hw]
  exact transport_eq_index_inf (patternLaw N r) (patternLaw N s)
    (patternEval N r z) (patternEval N s w)
    (patternEval_injective N hz) (patternEval_injective N hw)

empirical_wasserstein_measurable.exact_header:
theorem empirical_wasserstein_measurable :
    Measurable (fun z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H) ↦
      ULA.wasserstein2 (Model.empiricalLaw N z.1) (Model.empiricalLaw N z.2))
empirical_wasserstein_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem empirical_wasserstein_measurable :
    Measurable (fun z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H) ↦
      ULA.wasserstein2 (Model.empiricalLaw N z.1) (Model.empiricalLaw N z.2)) := by
  intro B hB
  have he : (fun z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H) ↦
      ULA.wasserstein2 (Model.empiricalLaw N z.1) (Model.empiricalLaw N z.2)) ⁻¹' B =
      ⋃ r : Fin N → Fin N, ⋃ s : Fin N → Fin N,
        {z : (Fin N → H) × (Fin N → H) | CloudPattern N r z.1 ∧ CloudPattern N s z.2} ∩
          (patternCost N r s ⁻¹' B) := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_iUnion, mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_cloudPattern N z.1
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_cloudPattern N z.2
      exact ⟨r, s, ⟨hr, hs⟩, (empirical_transport_eq_pattern N hr hs) ▸ hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, s, ⟨hr, hs⟩, hz⟩
      exact (empirical_transport_eq_pattern N hr hs).symm ▸ hz
  rw [he]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro r
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro s
  exact ((cloudPattern_measurableSet (H := H) N r).preimage measurable_fst |>.inter
    ((cloudPattern_measurableSet (H := H) N s).preimage measurable_snd)).inter
      (patternCost_measurable N r s hB)

particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable.exact_header:
theorem particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Measurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N)
particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Measurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) := by
  letI : NeZero N := ⟨hN.ne'⟩
  unfold particleEmpiricalDistanceSq
  apply Measurable.add
  · fun_prop
  · apply Measurable.pow_const
    unfold ULA.wasserstein2Real
    apply ENNReal.measurable_toReal.comp
    let cloud : ParticlePair N S Z → (Fin N → Z) × (Fin N → Z) :=
      fun p ↦ (p.1.2, p.2.2)
    have hc : Measurable cloud := by
      exact (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (measurable_snd.comp measurable_snd)
    have h := (empirical_wasserstein_measurable (H := Z) N).comp hc
    exact h

particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_aestronglyMe.exact_header:
theorem particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_aestronglyMeasurable (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) Q
particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_aestronglyMe.exact_declaration:
theorem particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_aestronglyMeasurable (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) Q :=
  (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable N hN).aestronglyMeasurable

optimizerProjection.exact_header: def optimizerProjection (N : ℕ) : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] S
optimizerProjection.exact_declaration:
def optimizerProjection (N : ℕ) : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] S :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).comp (oneEquiv N).toContinuousLinearMap

samplerProjection.exact_header: def samplerProjection (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N) : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] Z

weight.exact_header: def weight (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] OneHilbert N S Z
weight.exact_declaration:
def weight (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] OneHilbert N S Z :=
  (optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N).adjoint.comp
    (D.optimizerWeight.comp (optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N))+
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
    (samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N i).adjoint.comp
      (D.samplerWeight.comp (samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N i))

weight_inner.exact_header:
theorem weight_inner (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D y⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪(oneEquiv N x).1,D.optimizerWeight (oneEquiv N y).1⟫_ℝ+
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹*∑ i, ⟪(oneEquiv N x).2 i,D.samplerWeight ((oneEquiv N y).2 i)⟫_ℝ
weight_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem weight_inner (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D y⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪(oneEquiv N x).1,D.optimizerWeight (oneEquiv N y).1⟫_ℝ+
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹*∑ i, ⟪(oneEquiv N x).2 i,D.samplerWeight ((oneEquiv N y).2 i)⟫_ℝ := by
  simp only [weight,add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,smul_apply,sum_apply,
    inner_add_right,inner_smul_right,inner_sum]
  rw [(optimizerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N).adjoint_inner_right]
  simp_rw [(samplerProjection (S := S) (Z := Z) N _).adjoint_inner_right]
  rfl

weight_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem weight_symmetric (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D y⟫_ℝ = ⟪weight N D x,y⟫_ℝ
weight_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem weight_symmetric (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D y⟫_ℝ = ⟪weight N D x,y⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [real_inner_comm y (weight N D x),weight_inner,weight_inner]
  congr 1
  · exact (D.optimizer_symmetric (oneEquiv N x).1 (oneEquiv N y).1).trans
      (real_inner_comm (oneEquiv N y).1 (D.optimizerWeight (oneEquiv N x).1))
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (D.sampler_symmetric ((oneEquiv N x).2 i) ((oneEquiv N y).2 i)).trans
      (real_inner_comm ((oneEquiv N y).2 i) (D.samplerWeight ((oneEquiv N x).2 i)))

weight_nonneg.exact_header:
theorem weight_nonneg (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    0≤⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ
weight_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem weight_nonneg (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    0≤⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [weight_inner]
  exact add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => D.samplerSq_nonneg _)))

norm_sq_coordinates.exact_header:
theorem norm_sq_coordinates (N : ℕ) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ‖x‖^2=‖(oneEquiv N x).1‖^2+∑ i, ‖(oneEquiv N x).2 i‖^2
norm_sq_coordinates.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_sq_coordinates (N : ℕ) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ‖x‖^2=‖(oneEquiv N x).1‖^2+∑ i, ‖(oneEquiv N x).2 i‖^2 := by
  change ‖x‖^2=‖x.fst‖^2+∑ i, ‖x.snd i‖^2
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2,PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]

lower.exact_header: def lower (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : ℝ
lower.exact_declaration: def lower (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : ℝ := D.lower*min 1 (N : ℝ)⁻¹

upper.exact_header: def upper (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : ℝ
upper.exact_declaration: def upper (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : ℝ := D.upper*max 1 (N : ℝ)⁻¹

lower_pos.exact_header: theorem lower_pos (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : 0<lower N D
lower_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem lower_pos (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : 0<lower N D := by
  dsimp [lower]
  exact mul_pos D.lower_pos (lt_min zero_lt_one (inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hN)))

upper_nonneg.exact_header: theorem upper_nonneg (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : 0≤upper N D
upper_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem upper_nonneg (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) : 0≤upper N D := by
  dsimp [upper]
  exact mul_nonneg (D.lower_pos.le.trans D.lower_le_upper) (le_max_of_le_left zero_le_one)

weight_lower.exact_header:
theorem weight_lower (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    lower N D*‖x‖^2≤⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ
weight_lower.exact_declaration:
theorem weight_lower (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    lower N D*‖x‖^2≤⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ := by
  have ho := D.optimizer_lower (oneEquiv N x).1
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => D.sampler_lower ((oneEquiv N x).2 i))
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hs
  have hs' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0≤(N : ℝ)⁻¹ by positivity)
  have hc1 : lower N D≤D.lower := by
    dsimp [lower]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right D.lower_pos.le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hc2 : lower N D≤(N : ℝ)⁻¹*D.lower := by
    dsimp [lower]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right (1 : ℝ) (N : ℝ)⁻¹) D.lower_pos.le]
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 (sq_nonneg ‖(oneEquiv N x).1‖)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => sq_nonneg ‖(oneEquiv N x).2 i‖))
  rw [weight_inner,norm_sq_coordinates]
  nlinarith

weight_upper.exact_header:
theorem weight_upper (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ≤upper N D*‖x‖^2
weight_upper.exact_declaration:
theorem weight_upper (N : ℕ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ≤upper N D*‖x‖^2 := by
  have hD : 0≤D.upper := D.lower_pos.le.trans D.lower_le_upper
  have ho := D.optimizer_upper (oneEquiv N x).1
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => D.sampler_upper ((oneEquiv N x).2 i))
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hs
  have hs' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0≤(N : ℝ)⁻¹ by positivity)
  have hc1 : D.upper≤upper N D := by
    dsimp [upper]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hD (le_max_left _ _)
  have hc2 : (N : ℝ)⁻¹*D.upper≤upper N D := by
    dsimp [upper]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (N : ℝ)⁻¹) hD]
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 (sq_nonneg ‖(oneEquiv N x).1‖)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => sq_nonneg ‖(oneEquiv N x).2 i‖))
  rw [weight_inner,norm_sq_coordinates]
  nlinarith

exists_factor.exact_header:
theorem exists_factor [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖^2=⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ) ∧
      (∀ x, Real.sqrt (lower N D)*‖x‖≤‖C x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt (upper N D)*‖x‖)
exists_factor.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_factor [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖^2=⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ) ∧
      (∀ x, Real.sqrt (lower N D)*‖x‖≤‖C x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt (upper N D)*‖x‖) :=
  MetricFactor.exists_coercive_factor (weight N D) (weight_symmetric N D)
    (lower N D) (upper N D) (lower_pos N hN D) (upper_nonneg N D)
    (weight_lower N D) (weight_upper N D)

drift_dissipation.exact_header:
theorem drift_dissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x-y,weight N D (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t x-RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t y)⟫_ℝ ≤
      -ρ*⟪x-y,weight N D (x-y)⟫_ℝ
drift_dissipation.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_dissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (x y : OneHilbert N S Z) :
    ⟪x-y,weight N D (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t x-RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t y)⟫_ℝ ≤
      -ρ*⟪x-y,weight N D (x-y)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hd := particleCouplingWork_le M D ρ hmono N hN t ht
    (oneEquiv N x).1 (oneEquiv N y).1 (oneEquiv N x).2 (oneEquiv N y).2
  have hnoise :
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹*∑ i : Fin N, (1/2 : ℝ)*∑ j : I,
        D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter (oneEquiv N x).1) ((oneEquiv N x).2 i) j-
          M.diffusion (M.parameter (oneEquiv N y).1) ((oneEquiv N y).2 i) j) ≥ 0 := by
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => D.samplerSq_nonneg _))
  simp only [particleCouplingWork,samplerCouplingWork,Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hd
  rw [weight_inner,weight_inner]

theorem lift_dissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N)
    (C : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] K)
    (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2=⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t))
    (U V : Lp (OneHilbert N S Z) 2 Q) :
    ⟪C.compLpL 2 Q (U-V),C.compLpL 2 Q
      (liftMap Q (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t) hLip U-
        liftMap Q (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t) hLip V)⟫_ℝ ≤
      -ρ*‖C.compLpL 2 Q (U-V)‖^2
lift_dissipation.exact_declaration:
theorem lift_dissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N)
    (C : OneHilbert N S Z →L[ℝ] K)
    (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2=⟪x,weight N D x⟫_ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t))
    (U V : Lp (OneHilbert N S Z) 2 Q) :
    ⟪C.compLpL 2 Q (U-V),C.compLpL 2 Q
      (liftMap Q (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t) hLip U-
        liftMap Q (RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t) hLip V)⟫_ℝ ≤
      -ρ*‖C.compLpL 2 Q (U-V)‖^2 := by
  let f := RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t
  let FU := liftMap Q f hLip U
  let FV := liftMap Q f hLip V
  rw [factor_lp_pairing Q N D C hC,factor_lp_norm_sq Q N D C hC]
  rw [lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral,lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral,← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono_ae (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q (weight N D) (U-V) (FU-FV))
    ((lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q (weight N D) (U-V) (U-V)).const_mul (-ρ))
  filter_upwards [liftMap_coe Q f hLip U,liftMap_coe Q f hLip V,
    Lp.coeFn_sub U V,Lp.coeFn_sub FU FV] with ω hu hv hsub hFsub
  change ⟪(U-V) ω,weight N D ((FU-FV) ω)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*⟪(U-V) ω,weight N D ((U-V) ω)⟫_ℝ
  change FU ω=f (U ω) at hu
  change FV ω=f (V ω) at hv
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hsub hFsub
  rw [hsub,hFsub,hu,hv]
  exact drift_dissipation M D ρ hmono N hN t ht (U ω) (V ω)

theorem exists_transported_metric {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (P : E ≃L[ℝ] Lp (OneHilbert N S Z) 2 Q)
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0<N)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (f : E → E)
    (hfield : ∀ x, P (f x) =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t (P x ω)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : E →L[ℝ] Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (lower N D)/(‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1))*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(Real.sqrt (upper N D)*‖P.toContinuousLinearMap‖)*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2)
exists_transported_metric.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_transported_metric {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Z]
    (P : E ≃L[ℝ] Lp (OneHilbert N S Z) 2 Q)
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0<N)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (f : E → E)
    (hfield : ∀ x, P (f x) =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t (P x ω)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : E →L[ℝ] Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (lower N D)/(‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1))*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(Real.sqrt (upper N D)*‖P.toContinuousLinearMap‖)*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2) := by
  obtain ⟨n,C,hC,_,_⟩ := exists_factor N hN D
  let T := (C.compLpL 2 Q).comp P.toContinuousLinearMap
  refine ⟨n,T,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hl := factor_lp_coercivity Q N hN D C hC (P x)
    have hP : ‖x‖≤(‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1)*‖P x‖ := by
      have hp := P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (P x)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,P.symm_apply_apply] at hp
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (P x)]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP
      (show 0≤Real.sqrt (lower N D)/(‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1) by positivity)
    have hden : 0<‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1 := by positivity
    have he : (Real.sqrt (lower N D)/(‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1))*
        ((‖P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1)*‖P x‖)=Real.sqrt (lower N D)*‖P x‖ := by
      field_simp
    rw [he] at hm
    exact hm.trans hl
  · intro x
    have hu := factor_lp_upper Q N D C hC (P x)
    have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (P.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm x)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (upper N D))
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hp
    exact hu.trans (by nlinarith [hp])
  · exact transported_lift_dissipation_of_coe Q P.toContinuousLinearMap M D ρ hmono hN C hC
      t ht f hfield

/-! # Lifting the general law-level condition to actual empirical clouds

The pairing measure here is the actual empirical law of the paired particle
coordinates. Its two marginals are proved equal to the empirical cloud laws.
Joint monotonicity therefore applies to the actual finite-particle force and
the averaged synchronous diffusion correction, without an independence premise
for the interacting particles.
-/

theorem empiricalPair_isCoupling (N : ℕ) (z w : Fin N → Z) :
    IsCoupling (Model.empiricalLaw N (fun i => (z i, w i)))
      (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w)
empiricalPair_isCoupling.exact_declaration:
theorem empiricalPair_isCoupling (N : ℕ) (z w : Fin N → Z) :
    IsCoupling (Model.empiricalLaw N (fun i => (z i, w i)))
      (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) := by
  constructor
  · exact empiricalLaw_map N _ Prod.fst measurable_fst
  · exact empiricalLaw_map N _ Prod.snd measurable_snd

particleCouplingEnergy.exact_header:
def particleCouplingEnergy (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (s s' : S) (z w : Fin N → Z) : ℝ

particleCouplingWork.exact_header:
def particleCouplingWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s s' : S) (z w : Fin N → Z) : ℝ
particleCouplingWork.exact_declaration:
def particleCouplingWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s s' : S) (z w : Fin N → Z) : ℝ :=
  ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
    (M.particleField N t s z - M.particleField N t s' w)⟫ +
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z i, w i)

particleCouplingWork_le.exact_header:
theorem particleCouplingWork_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (s s' : S) (z w : Fin N → Z) :
    particleCouplingWork M D N t s s' z w ≤
      -ρ * particleCouplingEnergy D N s s' z w
particleCouplingWork_le.exact_declaration:
theorem particleCouplingWork_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (s s' : S) (z w : Fin N → Z) :
    particleCouplingWork M D N t s s' z w ≤
      -ρ * particleCouplingEnergy D N s s' z w := by
  have h := hmono t ht s s' (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w)
    (Model.empiricalLaw N (fun i => (z i, w i)))
    (empiricalPair_isCoupling N z w)
    (Model.empiricalLaw_probability N hN z) (Model.empiricalLaw_probability N hN w)
    (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN z _) (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN w _)
    (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN z _) (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN w _)
    (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN (fun i => (z i, w i)) _)
    (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN (fun i => (z i, w i)) _)
  simp only [integral_empiricalLaw, smul_eq_mul,
    Model.optimizerField, Model.meanGradient_empirical] at h
  exact h

particle_population_work_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem particle_population_work_decomposition (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s s' : S)
    (z w : Fin N → Z) (ν : Measure Z) :
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.particleField N t s z - M.optimizerField t s' ν)⟫ +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z i, w i) =
    particleCouplingWork M D N t s s' z w +
      ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
        (M.particleField N t s' w - M.optimizerField t s' ν)⟫
particle_population_work_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem particle_population_work_decomposition (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s s' : S)
    (z w : Fin N → Z) (ν : Measure Z) :
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.particleField N t s z - M.optimizerField t s' ν)⟫ +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z i, w i) =
    particleCouplingWork M D N t s s' z w +
      ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
        (M.particleField N t s' w - M.optimizerField t s' ν)⟫ := by
  unfold particleCouplingWork
  simp only [map_sub, inner_sub_right]
  ring

PBGSO/ExpectedBilinearLimits.lean.scope_note: The displayed raw path convergence and genuine L² domination are explicit intermediate hypotheses. Later raw finite-variation factories construct their radii internally.

import PBGSO.PartitionQuadraticEnergy
import PBGSO.PartitionVariationBounds
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

/-! # Actual expectation limits of weighted partition sums
The functions are literal pairings of actual L² variables. Their
measurability and finite-expectation properties are derived here.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.ExpectedBilinearLimits
open QuadraticMartingale
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)

/-- The original weighted spatial bilinear form. -/


/-- Actual finite sums of L² pairings have an integrable raw realization. -/

/-- Integrating the raw partition sum gives exactly the actual weighted L² sum. -/

/-- Dominated convergence for actual finite L² pair sums. The raw limiting
function becomes integrable as a conclusion, with no measurability premise. -/

end PBGSO.ExpectedBilinearLimits

spatialPairing.exact_declaration:
def spatialPairing : Z →L[ℝ] Z →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) W

spatialPairing_apply.exact_header: @[simp] theorem spatialPairing_apply (z w : Z) : spatialPairing W z w = ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ
spatialPairing_apply.exact_declaration: @[simp] theorem spatialPairing_apply (z w : Z) : spatialPairing W z w = ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ := rfl

pairSum_integrable.exact_header:
theorem pairSum_integrable (A C : ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, spatialPairing W (A k ω) (C k ω)) Q
pairSum_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem pairSum_integrable (A C : ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, spatialPairing W (A k ω) (C k ω)) Q := by
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro k hk
  exact lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q W (A k) (C k)

pairSum_integral.exact_header:
theorem pairSum_integral (A C : ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, spatialPairing W (A k ω) (C k ω) ∂Q) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (A k) (C k)
pairSum_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem pairSum_integral (A C : ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, spatialPairing W (A k ω) (C k ω) ∂Q) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (A k) (C k) := by
  simp only [spatialPairing_apply]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q W (A k) (C k))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact (lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral Q W (A k) (C k)).symm

pairSum_limit.exact_header:
theorem pairSum_limit (A C : ℕ → ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (count : ℕ → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → ℝ) (hR : Integrable R Q)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n), spatialPairing W (A n k ω) (C n k ω)‖ ≤ R ω)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n), spatialPairing W (A n k ω) (C n k ω))
        atTop (𝓝 (g ω))) :
    Integrable g Q ∧ Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n),
      weightedPairing Q W (A n k) (C n k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω, g ω ∂Q))
pairSum_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem pairSum_limit (A C : ℕ → ℕ → Lp Z 2 Q) (count : ℕ → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → ℝ) (hR : Integrable R Q)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n), spatialPairing W (A n k ω) (C n k ω)‖ ≤ R ω)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n), spatialPairing W (A n k ω) (C n k ω))
        atTop (𝓝 (g ω))) :
    Integrable g Q ∧ Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n),
      weightedPairing Q W (A n k) (C n k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω, g ω ∂Q)) := by
  let f (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (count n),
    spatialPairing W (A n k ω) (C n k ω)
  have hfm (n : ℕ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) Q :=
    (pairSum_integrable Q W (A n) (C n) (count n)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g Q := aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop hfm hlim
  have hgb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖g ω‖ ≤ R ω := by
    filter_upwards [hlim, ae_all_iff.mpr hbound] with ω hω hb
    exact le_of_tendsto' hω.norm hb
  refine ⟨hR.mono' hgm hgb, ?_⟩
  have hh := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence R hfm hR hbound hlim
  simpa only [f, pairSum_integral] using hh

PBGSO/FilteredBrownian.lean.scope_note: Driver contains only Brownian laws, filtration, adaptation and independence. Square-integrable random coefficient columns are measurable at the actual left endpoint. No stochastic-integral, final martingale or isometry conclusion is a Driver field. CanonicalBrownianDriver constructs these properties for the actual canonical initial/noise source.
PBGSO/FilteredBrownian.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.PredictableIsometry
import Mathlib.Probability.BrownianMotion.Basic
import PBGSO.BrownianGridIsometry

/-! # Finite predictable integration for a filtered Brownian vector

Primitive inputs are Brownian coordinate laws, coordinate independence,
adapted evaluations, and independence of every future increment vector
from the filtration. The filtration can include independent initialization.
Quadratic moments and the martingale property are derived.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
open PBGSO.PredictableIsometry
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- The primitive filtered Brownian-driver properties. No stochastic
integral, moment-isometry or forward equation is included. -/

variable (D : Driver (I := I) Q)






/-- Primitive random coefficient columns measurable at one actual time. -/

















/-- Finite predictable Brownian integration has its exact weighted
quadratic moment for every selfadjoint bounded operator. -/



/-- The finite vector sum equals the sum of its coordinate integrals. -/



/-- Repeating coefficients on refined intervals preserves adaptedness. -/

/-- Exact pathwise vector refinement; every grid uses the same actual
coordinate Brownian paths. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

Driver.exact_declaration:
structure Driver where
  process : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ
  brownian : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (process i) Q
  filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ
  adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted filtration (process i)
  increment_coordinates : ∀ s t : ℝ≥0, s ≤ t →
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => process i t ω - process i s ω) Q
  future_independent : ∀ s t : ℝ≥0, s ≤ t →
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => process i t ω - process i s ω) inferInstance)
      (filtration s) Q

increment.exact_header: def increment (s t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) (ω : Ω) : ℝ
increment.exact_declaration: def increment (s t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) (ω : Ω) : ℝ := D.process i t ω - D.process i s ω

increment_law.exact_header:
theorem increment_law (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    HasLaw (increment Q D s t i) (gaussianReal 0 (t - s)) Q
increment_law.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_law (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    HasLaw (increment Q D s t i) (gaussianReal 0 (t - s)) Q := by
  change HasLaw (fun ω => D.process i t ω - D.process i s ω) _ Q
  simpa only [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hst] using ((D.brownian i).shift s).hasLaw_eval (t - s)

increment_memLp.exact_header:
theorem increment_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    MemLp (increment Q D s t i) 2 Q
increment_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    MemLp (increment Q D s t i) 2 Q :=
  (increment_law Q D s t hst i).memLp (memLp_id_gaussianReal (2 : ℝ≥0))

increment_mean.exact_header:
theorem increment_mean (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω ∂Q) = 0
increment_mean.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_mean (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i : I) :
    (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω ∂Q) = 0 :=
  ((increment_law Q D s t hst i).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)).trans integral_id_gaussianReal

increment_measurable.exact_header: theorem increment_measurable (s t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) : Measurable (increment Q D s t i)
increment_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_measurable (s t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) : Measurable (increment Q D s t i) :=
  (((D.adapted i t).mono (D.filtration.le t)).measurable).sub
    (((D.adapted i s).mono (D.filtration.le s)).measurable)

Coefficient.exact_declaration:
structure Coefficient (t : ℝ≥0) where
  value : I → Ω → Z
  adapted : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (value i)
  square : ∀ i, MemLp (value i) 2 Q

Coefficients.exact_declaration: abbrev Coefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) := ∀ k, Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D (τ k)

increment_independent.exact_header:
theorem increment_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i => increment Q D s t i ω) (fun ω i => A.value i ω) Q
increment_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    IndepFun (fun ω i => increment Q D s t i ω) (fun ω i => A.value i ω) Q := by
  apply indep_of_indep_of_le_right (D.future_independent s t hst)
  have hm : @Measurable Ω (I → Z) (D.filtration s) inferInstance
      (fun ω i => A.value i ω) :=
    (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ => Z) (D.filtration s) (fun _ => inferInstance)
      (fun ω i => A.value i ω)).mpr (fun i => (A.adapted i).measurable)
  exact hm.comap_le

increment_cross_moment.exact_header:
theorem increment_cross_moment (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω * increment Q D s t j ω ∂Q) =
      if i = j then (t : ℝ) - s else 0
increment_cross_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_cross_moment (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω * increment Q D s t j ω ∂Q) =
      if i = j then (t : ℝ) - s else 0 := by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    have he := ((increment_law Q D s t hst i).integral_comp
      (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (by fun_prop)).trans
      (ULA.centered_gaussian_second_moment (t - s))
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, pow_two, NNReal.coe_sub hst] using he
  · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
    have he := ((D.increment_coordinates s t hst).indepFun hij).integral_mul_eq_mul_integral
      (increment_memLp Q D s t hst i).aestronglyMeasurable
      (increment_memLp Q D s t hst j).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hi := increment_mean Q D s t hst i
    have hj := increment_mean Q D s t hst j
    change (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω * increment Q D s t j ω ∂Q) =
      (∫ ω, increment Q D s t i ω ∂Q) * (∫ ω, increment Q D s t j ω ∂Q) at he
    rw [hi, hj, zero_mul] at he
    exact he

noiseStep.exact_header: def noiseStep (s t : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) (ω : Ω) : Z
noiseStep.exact_declaration:
def noiseStep (s t : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  stepSum (increment Q D s t) A.value ω

noiseStep_memLp.exact_header:
theorem noiseStep_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    MemLp (noiseStep Q D s t A) 2 Q
noiseStep_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem noiseStep_memLp (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    MemLp (noiseStep Q D s t A) 2 Q :=
  stepSum_memLp Q _ _ (increment_memLp Q D s t hst) A.square (increment_independent Q D s t hst A)

noiseStep_isometry.exact_header:
theorem noiseStep_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪noiseStep Q D s t A ω, W (noiseStep Q D s t A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ((t : ℝ) - s) * ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪A.value i ω, W (A.value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
noiseStep_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem noiseStep_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪noiseStep Q D s t A ω, W (noiseStep Q D s t A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ((t : ℝ) - s) * ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪A.value i ω, W (A.value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  have hξ := increment_memLp Q D s t hst
  have hind := increment_independent Q D s t hst A
  have hm (i : I) : MemLp (fun ω => increment Q D s t i ω • A.value i ω) 2 Q :=
    independent_smul_memLp Q _ _ (hξ i) (A.square i)
      (hind.comp (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hi (i j : I) : Integrable
      (fun ω => ⟪increment Q D s t i ω • A.value i ω,
        W (increment Q D s t j ω • A.value j ω)⟫_ℝ) Q :=
    pairing_integrable Q W _ _ (hm i) (hm j)
  have he : (fun ω => ⟪noiseStep Q D s t A ω, W (noiseStep Q D s t A ω)⟫_ℝ) =
      (fun ω => ∑ i, ∑ j, ⟪increment Q D s t i ω • A.value i ω,
        W (increment Q D s t j ω • A.value j ω)⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [noiseStep, stepSum, map_sum, sum_inner, inner_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [he, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi _ j)]
  simp_rw [weighted_cross_moment Q W _ _ hξ A.square hind,
    increment_cross_moment Q D s t hst]
  simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
  simp [Finset.mul_sum]

noiseStep_condExp_zero.exact_header:
theorem noiseStep_condExp_zero (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    Q[noiseStep Q D s t A | D.filtration s] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z)
noiseStep_condExp_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem noiseStep_condExp_zero (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s) :
    Q[noiseStep Q D s t A | D.filtration s] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z) :=
  independent_step_condExp_zero Q (D.filtration s) (D.filtration.le s)
    (increment Q D s t) A.value (increment_measurable Q D s t)
    (increment_memLp Q D s t hst) A.square A.adapted
    (increment_independent Q D s t hst A) (D.future_independent s t hst)
    (increment_mean Q D s t hst)

gridSum.exact_header: def gridSum (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : Z
gridSum.exact_declaration:
def gridSum (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  ∑ k : Fin n, noiseStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k) ω

gridSum_zero.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A 0 ω = 0
gridSum_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A 0 ω = 0 := by simp [gridSum]

gridSum_succ.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω +
      noiseStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) ω
gridSum_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω +
      noiseStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) ω := by
  simp only [gridSum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

gridSum_memLp.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) : MemLp (gridSum Q D τ A n) 2 Q
gridSum_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) : MemLp (gridSum Q D τ A n) 2 Q := by
  apply memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ
  intro k _
  exact noiseStep_memLp Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)) (A k)

gridSum_adapted.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_adapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration (τ n)] (gridSum Q D τ A n)
gridSum_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_adapted (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration (τ n)] (gridSum Q D τ A n) := by
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
  intro k _
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
  intro i _
  have h1 := (D.adapted i (τ (k + 1))).mono
    (D.filtration.mono (hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.isLt)))
  have h0 := (D.adapted i (τ k)).mono
    (D.filtration.mono (hτ (Nat.le_of_lt k.isLt)))
  exact (h1.sub h0).smul ((A k).adapted i |>.mono
    (D.filtration.mono (hτ (Nat.le_of_lt k.isLt))))

gridFiltration.exact_header: def gridFiltration (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ
gridFiltration.exact_declaration:
def gridFiltration (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ where
  seq n := D.filtration (τ n)
  mono' _ _ h := D.filtration.mono (hτ h)
  le' n := D.filtration.le (τ n)

gridSum_martingale.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Martingale (gridSum Q D τ A) (gridFiltration Q D τ hτ) Q
gridSum_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Martingale (gridSum Q D τ A) (gridFiltration Q D τ hτ) Q := by
  apply martingale_of_condExp_sub_eq_zero_nat
    (show StronglyAdapted (gridFiltration Q D τ hτ) (gridSum Q D τ A) from
      gridSum_adapted Q D τ hτ A)
    (fun n => (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).integrable (by norm_num))
  intro n
  have he : gridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) - gridSum Q D τ A n =
      noiseStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, gridSum_succ, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [he]
  exact noiseStep_condExp_zero Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n)

gridSum_isometry.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) *
        ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪(A k).value i ω, W ((A k).value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
gridSum_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) *
        ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪(A k).value i ω, W ((A k).value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [gridSum_zero, inner_zero_left, integral_zero,
      Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    let Y := noiseStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n)
    have hX2 := gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n
    have hY2 := noiseStep_memLp Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n)
    have hcross := conditional_zero_pairing Q W (D.filtration (τ n))
      (D.filtration.le (τ n)) (gridSum Q D τ A n) Y hX2 hY2
      (gridSum_adapted Q D τ hτ A n).aestronglyMeasurable
      (noiseStep_condExp_zero Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n))
    have hpoint : (fun ω => ⟪gridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) ω)⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun ω => ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ +
          2 * ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ + ⟪Y ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ) := by
      funext ω
      rw [gridSum_succ]
      change ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω + Y ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω + Y ω)⟫_ℝ = _
      simp only [map_add, inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
      have hs : ⟪Y ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ =
          ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ :=
        (real_inner_comm _ _).trans (hW _ _).symm
      rw [hs]
      ring
    have h00 := pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hX2 hX2
    have h01 := (pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hX2 hY2).const_mul 2
    have h11 := pairing_integrable Q W _ _ hY2 hY2
    have hint1 := integral_add (h00.add h01) h11
    have hint2 := integral_add h00 h01
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hint1 hint2
    rw [hpoint, hint1, hint2, integral_const_mul, hcross, mul_zero, add_zero, ih]
    rw [show (∫ ω, ⟪Y ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = _ from
      noiseStep_isometry Q D W _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n), Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

gridSum_columns.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_columns (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A n ω = ∑ i, BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum (D.process i) τ
      (fun k => (A k).value i) n ω
gridSum_columns.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_columns (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ A n ω = ∑ i, BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum (D.process i) τ
      (fun k => (A k).value i) n ω := by
  simp only [gridSum, noiseStep, stepSum, BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

subtract.exact_header:
def subtract (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ
subtract.exact_declaration:
def subtract (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ := fun k =>
  ⟨fun i ω => (A k).value i ω - (C k).value i ω,
    fun i => ((A k).adapted i).sub ((C k).adapted i),
    fun i => ((A k).square i).sub ((C k).square i)⟩

gridSum_sub.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ (subtract Q D τ A C) n ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω - gridSum Q D τ C n ω
gridSum_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ (subtract Q D τ A C) n ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω - gridSum Q D τ C n ω := by
  simp only [gridSum, noiseStep, stepSum, subtract, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

refine.exact_declaration:
def refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D υ := fun j =>
  ⟨(A (j / d)).value,
    fun i => ((A (j / d)).adapted i).mono (D.filtration.mono (by
      rw [← hυ (j / d)]
      exact hυmono (Nat.mul_div_le j d))), (A (j / d)).square⟩

gridSum_refine.exact_header:
theorem gridSum_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D υ (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω
gridSum_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem gridSum_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D υ (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω := by
  rw [gridSum_columns, gridSum_columns]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum_refine_mul (D.process i) τ υ d hd hυ
    (fun k => (A k).value i) n ω

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)



/-- The elementary integral is stopped exactly at its observation time. -/



/-- Every elementary predictable Brownian integral is a genuine
continuous-time martingale, including times before its left endpoint. -/



/-- The actual finite step integral stopped at every real observation time. -/




/-- The selected representative of any timewise L² limit of the actual
