end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

Coefficient.raise.exact_header:
def Coefficient.raise {a s : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (has : a ≤ s) :
    Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D s

noiseStep_split.exact_header:
theorem noiseStep_split (a s t : ℝ≥0) (has : a ≤ s) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    noiseStep Q D a t A ω = noiseStep Q D a s A ω + noiseStep Q D s t (A.raise Q D has) ω
noiseStep_split.exact_declaration:
theorem noiseStep_split (a s t : ℝ≥0) (has : a ≤ s) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    noiseStep Q D a t A ω = noiseStep Q D a s A ω + noiseStep Q D s t (A.raise Q D has) ω := by
  simp only [noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, Coefficient.raise,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← add_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [increment]
  ring

stoppedStep.exact_header: def stoppedStep (a b : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : Z
stoppedStep.exact_declaration:
def stoppedStep (a b : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  if a ≤ t then noiseStep Q D a (min t b) A ω else 0

stoppedStep_memLp.exact_header:
theorem stoppedStep_memLp (a b : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (stoppedStep Q D a b A t) 2 Q
stoppedStep_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedStep_memLp (a b : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (stoppedStep Q D a b A t) 2 Q := by
  by_cases hat : a ≤ t
  · have he : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = noiseStep Q D a (min t b) A := by
      funext ω
      simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_true]
    rw [he]
    exact noiseStep_memLp Q D a (min t b) (le_min hat hab) A
  · have he : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = (0 : Ω → Z) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_false, Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [he]
    exact MemLp.zero

stoppedStep_adapted.exact_header:
theorem stoppedStep_adapted (a b : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (stoppedStep Q D a b A t)
stoppedStep_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedStep_adapted (a b : ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (stoppedStep Q D a b A t) := by
  by_cases hat : a ≤ t
  · have he : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = noiseStep Q D a (min t b) A := by
      funext ω
      simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_true]
    rw [he]
    apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
    intro i _
    exact (((D.adapted i (min t b)).mono (D.filtration.mono (min_le_left _ _))).sub
      ((D.adapted i a).mono (D.filtration.mono hat))).smul
      ((A.adapted i).mono (D.filtration.mono hat))
  · have he : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = (0 : Ω → Z) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_false, Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [he]
    exact stronglyMeasurable_zero

stoppedStep_martingale.exact_header:
theorem stoppedStep_martingale (a b : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) :
    Martingale (stoppedStep Q D a b A) D.filtration Q
stoppedStep_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedStep_martingale (a b : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b) (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) :
    Martingale (stoppedStep Q D a b A) D.filtration Q := by
  refine ⟨stoppedStep_adapted Q D a b A, ?_⟩
  intro s t hst
  by_cases has : a ≤ s
  · have hat := has.trans hst
    by_cases hsb : s ≤ b
    · let C := A.raise Q D has
      have hy := noiseStep_condExp_zero Q D s (min t b) (le_min hst hsb) C
      have hsplit : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = stoppedStep Q D a b A s +
          noiseStep Q D s (min t b) C := by
        funext ω
        simp only [stoppedStep, has, hat, ite_true, min_eq_left hsb, Pi.add_apply]
        exact noiseStep_split Q D a s (min t b) has A ω
      rw [hsplit]
      have ha := (stoppedStep_memLp Q D a b hab A s).integrable (by norm_num)
      have hb := (noiseStep_memLp Q D s (min t b) (le_min hst hsb) C).integrable (by norm_num)
      have hc := condExp_add ha hb (D.filtration s)
      have hx := condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable (D.filtration.le s)
        (stoppedStep_adapted Q D a b A s) ha
      filter_upwards [hc, hy] with ω hc hy
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply, hx, hy, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero] using hc
    · have hbs : b ≤ s := le_of_not_ge hsb
      have hbt : b ≤ t := hbs.trans hst
      have he : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = stoppedStep Q D a b A s := by
        funext ω
        simp only [stoppedStep, has, hat, ite_true, min_eq_right hbs, min_eq_right hbt]
      rw [he]
      exact ae_of_all Q fun ω => congrFun (condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable (D.filtration.le s)
        (stoppedStep_adapted Q D a b A s)
        ((stoppedStep_memLp Q D a b hab A s).integrable (by norm_num))) ω
  · have hsa : s ≤ a := le_of_not_ge has
    have heS : stoppedStep Q D a b A s = (0 : Ω → Z) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [stoppedStep, has, ite_false, Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [heS]
    by_cases hat : a ≤ t
    · have heT : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = noiseStep Q D a (min t b) A := by
        funext ω
        simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_true]
      rw [heT]
      have hy := noiseStep_condExp_zero Q D a (min t b) (le_min hat hab) A
      have htower := condExp_condExp_of_le (μ := Q) (f := noiseStep Q D a (min t b) A)
        (D.filtration.mono hsa) (D.filtration.le a)
      exact htower.symm.trans ((condExp_congr_ae hy).trans (by rw [condExp_zero]))
    · have heT : stoppedStep Q D a b A t = (0 : Ω → Z) := by
        funext ω
        simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_false, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [heT, condExp_zero]

stoppedGridSum.exact_header:
def stoppedGridSum (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : Z

stoppedGridSum_memLp.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t) 2 Q
stoppedGridSum_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_memLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t) 2 Q := by
  apply memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ
  intro k _
  exact stoppedStep_memLp Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)) (A k) t

stoppedGridSum_succ.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedGridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) t ω = stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω +
      stoppedStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) t ω
stoppedGridSum_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedGridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) t ω = stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω +
      stoppedStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) t ω := by
  simp only [stoppedGridSum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

stoppedGridSum_martingale.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    Martingale (stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n) D.filtration Q
stoppedGridSum_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_martingale (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    Martingale (stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n) D.filtration Q := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have he : stoppedGridSum Q D τ A 0 = (0 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) := by
      funext t ω
      simp [stoppedGridSum]
    rw [he]
    exact martingale_zero Z D.filtration Q
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : stoppedGridSum Q D τ A (n + 1) = stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n +
        stoppedStep Q D (τ n) (τ (n + 1)) (A n) := by
      funext t ω
      exact stoppedGridSum_succ Q D τ A n t ω
    rw [he]
    exact ih.add (stoppedStep_martingale Q D _ _ (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n))

stoppedGridSum_limit_martingale.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_limit_martingale (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) (M : ℝ≥0 → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hM : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n =>
      (stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n) t).toLp
        (stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n) t)) atTop (𝓝 (M t))) :
    Martingale (MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration M) D.filtration Q
stoppedGridSum_limit_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_limit_martingale (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) (M : ℝ≥0 → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hM : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n =>
      (stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n) t).toLp
        (stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n) t)) atTop (𝓝 (M t))) :
    Martingale (MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration M) D.filtration Q :=
  MartingaleL2Limit.martingale_representative Q D.filtration
    (fun n => stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n))
    (fun n => stoppedGridSum_martingale Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
    (fun n t => stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n) t) M hM

timeCut_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_norm_le (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : ‖timeCut Q u s t‖ ≤ ‖u‖
timeCut_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_norm_le (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : ‖timeCut Q u s t‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  rw [timeCut, Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_def]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top u) (eLpNorm_indicator_le u measurableSet_Ioc)

timeCut_subtract.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_subtract (u v : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : timeCut Q (u - v) s t = timeCut Q u s t - timeCut Q v s t
timeCut_subtract.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_subtract (u v : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : timeCut Q (u - v) s t = timeCut Q u s t - timeCut Q v s t := by

  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (u - v) s t, timeCut_coe Q u s t, timeCut_coe Q v s t,
    Lp.coeFn_sub u v, Lp.coeFn_sub (timeCut Q u s t) (timeCut Q v s t)]
    with r hsub hu hv huv hcut
  rw [hcut, Pi.sub_apply, hsub, hu, hv]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, huv, Pi.sub_apply]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, sub_zero]

theorem independent_comap (m n : MeasurableSpace Ω') (hm : m ≤ mΩ') (hn : n ≤ mΩ')

independent_comap.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_comap (m n : MeasurableSpace Ω') (hm : m ≤ mΩ') (hn : n ≤ mΩ')
    (hi : Indep m n R) : Indep (m.comap f) (n.comap f) Q := by
  apply (Indep_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := hb
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ω' := mΩ'
  have hma : @MeasurableSet Ω' mΩ' a' := hm a' ha'
  have hmb : @MeasurableSet Ω' mΩ' b' := hn b' hb'
  have hp (s : Set Ω') (hs : MeasurableSet s) : Q (f ⁻¹' s) = R s := by
    rw [← hf.map_eq, Measure.map_apply hf.measurable hs]
  rw [← preimage_inter, hp _ (hma.inter hmb),
    hp _ hma, hp _ hmb]
  exact (Indep_iff _ _ _).mp hi a' b' ha' hb'

def pullbackFiltration (D : Driver (I := I) R) : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ where
  seq t := (D.filtration t).comap f
  mono' _ _ h := MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (D.filtration.mono h)
  le' t := (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (D.filtration.le t)).trans hf.measurable.comap_le

pullbackDriver.exact_header: def pullbackDriver (D : Driver (I := I) R) : Driver (I := I) Q
pullbackDriver.exact_declaration:
def pullbackDriver (D : Driver (I := I) R) : Driver (I := I) Q where
  process i t ω := D.process i t (f ω)
  brownian i := ⟨fun s ↦ (D.brownian i).hasLaw s |>.comp hf.hasLaw⟩
  filtration := pullbackFiltration hf D
  adapted i t := (D.adapted i t).comp_measurable (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl)
  increment_coordinates s t hst := by
    let X := fun i ω ↦ D.process i t ω - D.process i s ω
    have hm (i : I) : Measurable (X i) := increment_measurable R D s t i
    have hX (i : I) : HasLaw (X i) (R.map (X i)) R := ⟨(hm i).aemeasurable, rfl⟩
    have hi := ((D.increment_coordinates s t hst).hasLaw_pi hX).comp hf.hasLaw
    exact (iIndepFun_iff_hasLaw_pi_pi (fun i ↦ (hX i).comp hf.hasLaw)).mpr hi
  future_independent s t hst := by
    have hi := independent_comap hf
      (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i ↦ D.process i t ω - D.process i s ω) inferInstance)
      (D.filtration s)
      ((measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun i ↦ increment_measurable R D s t i).comap_le)
      (D.filtration.le s) (D.future_independent s t hst)
    simpa only [pullbackFiltration, MeasurableSpace.comap_comp, Function.comp_def] using hi

continuousIntervalDomain.exact_declaration:
def continuousIntervalDomain (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T) :=
  Classical.choose (exists_interval_continuous_domain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht)

continuousIntervalDomain_coe.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntervalDomain_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht).val =ᵐ[volume] (Ioc s t).indicator u
continuousIntervalDomain_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntervalDomain_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht).val =ᵐ[volume] (Ioc s t).indicator u :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_interval_continuous_domain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht)

continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht).val =
      timeCut Q (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val s t
continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht).val =
      timeCut Q (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val s t := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [continuousIntervalDomain_coe Q D T u hu hU s t hs ht,
    timeCut_coe Q (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val s t,
    continuousDomain_coe Q D T u hu hU] with r hinterval hcut hfull
  rw [hinterval, hcut]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · have hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hs hr.1, hr.2.trans ht⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hfull, Set.indicator_of_mem hR]
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]

continuous_integral_increment_isometry.exact_header:
theorem continuous_integral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    QuadraticMartingale.weightedPairing Q W
      (stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 t le_rfl ht) -
       stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 s le_rfl (hst.trans ht)))
      (stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 t le_rfl ht) -
       stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 s le_rfl (hst.trans ht))) =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, ∑ i, QuadraticMartingale.weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i)
continuous_integral_increment_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_integral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    QuadraticMartingale.weightedPairing Q W
      (stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 t le_rfl ht) -
       stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 s le_rfl (hst.trans ht)))
      (stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 t le_rfl ht) -
       stochasticIntegral Q D (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T)
        (continuousIntervalDomain Q D T u hu hU 0 s le_rfl (hst.trans ht))) =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, ∑ i, QuadraticMartingale.weightedPairing Q W (u r i) (u r i) := by
  rw [stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry Q D W hW
    (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T) (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val s t hs hst
    _ _ (continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut Q D T u hu hU 0 s le_rfl (hst.trans ht))
    (continuousIntervalDomain_eq_timeCut Q D T u hu hU 0 t le_rfl ht)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (continuousDomain_coe Q D T u hu hU),
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr hmem
  have hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hs hmem.1, hmem.2.trans ht⟩
  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hR] at hr
  rw [hr]

Primitive Driver properties replace any assumed stochastic-integral isometry. FilteredContinuousIntegrands derives domain membership for continuous adapted columns rather than asking the application to supply an approximation.
PBGSO/FilteredIntegralCompletion.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
import PBGSO.GridIntegralCompletion

/-! # Completion for filtered finite-column Brownian integration -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)












/-- The same distance identity holds across different compatible grids. -/

/-- Completion is derived from coefficient-time-L² convergence. No
Cauchy or isometry assumption is imposed on the stochastic sums. -/

/-- Every convergent sequence of actual adapted step integrands defines a
unique L² Brownian-integral limit and its norm equals the integrand norm. -/

/-- The completed integral is independent of the approximating adapted
step functions. More generally it preserves their exact L² distance. -/



/-- The domain consists of actual time-L² limits of adapted finite-step
functions on the refining grids. Thus stochastic integration is constructed
on the closure represented by such approximations. -/


/-- The actual L² Brownian integral, constructed by completion. -/


/-- Every qualifying adapted step approximation converges to the
constructed integral, independently of all classical choices. -/

/-- Brownian integration is an actual isometry on the constructed
predictable step-closure domain. -/


end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

ColumnHilbert.exact_declaration: abbrev ColumnHilbert := PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Lp Z 2 Q)

Coefficient.toLp.exact_header: def Coefficient.toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q
Coefficient.toLp.exact_declaration:
def Coefficient.toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (A.square i).toLp (A.value i))

coefficientStep.exact_header:
def coefficientStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

stochasticStep.exact_header:
def stochasticStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) : Lp Z 2 Q

stochasticStep_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n‖ ^ 2 = ‖coefficientStep Q D τ A n‖ ^ 2
stochasticStep_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n‖ ^ 2 = ‖coefficientStep Q D τ A n‖ ^ 2 := by
  have he : ‖stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ ω, ‖gridSum Q D τ A n ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
    exact integral_congr_ae ((gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp.fun_comp
      (fun z : Z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))
  rw [he, coefficientStep, TimeGridEnergy.grid_norm_sq τ hτ]
  have hi := gridSum_isometry Q D (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (fun _ _ => rfl) τ hτ A n
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hi
  rw [hi]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae (((A k).square i).coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z : Z => ‖z‖ ^ 2)) |>.symm

subtract_toLp.exact_header:
theorem subtract_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (subtract Q D τ A C k).toLp = (A k).toLp - (C k).toLp
subtract_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem subtract_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (subtract Q D τ A C k).toLp = (A k).toLp - (C k).toLp := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change ((subtract Q D τ A C k).square i).toLp _ =
    ((A k).square i).toLp _ - ((C k).square i).toLp _
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [((subtract Q D τ A C k).square i).coeFn_toLp,
    ((A k).square i).coeFn_toLp, ((C k).square i).coeFn_toLp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (((A k).square i).toLp ((A k).value i))
      (((C k).square i).toLp ((C k).value i))] with ω hs ha hc hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hs, ha, hc]
  rfl

coefficientStep_sub.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D τ (subtract Q D τ A C) n =
      coefficientStep Q D τ A n - coefficientStep Q D τ C n
coefficientStep_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D τ (subtract Q D τ A C) n =
      coefficientStep Q D τ A n - coefficientStep Q D τ C n := by
  simp only [coefficientStep, subtract_toLp]
  exact TimeGridEnergy.grid_sub τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) (fun k => (C k).toLp) n

stochasticStep_sub.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D τ hτ (subtract Q D τ A C) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n - stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n
stochasticStep_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D τ hτ (subtract Q D τ A C) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n - stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ C n).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ (subtract Q D τ A C) n).coeFn_toLp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n)]
    with ω ha hc hs hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply]
  simp only [stochasticStep]
  rw [hs, ha, hc]
  exact gridSum_sub Q D τ A C n ω

stochasticStep_dist.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n) =
      dist (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) (coefficientStep Q D τ C n)
stochasticStep_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n) =
      dist (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) (coefficientStep Q D τ C n) := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← stochasticStep_sub, ← coefficientStep_sub]
  exact stochasticStep_norm_sq Q D τ hτ _ n

coefficientStep_refine.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D υ (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      coefficientStep Q D τ A n
coefficientStep_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D υ (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      coefficientStep Q D τ A n :=
  TimeGridEnergy.grid_refine_mul τ υ hυmono d hd hυ (fun k => (A k).toLp) n

stochasticStep_refine.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D υ hυmono (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n
stochasticStep_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D υ hυmono (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q D υ hυmono (refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n)).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp] with ω hc ha
  simp only [stochasticStep]
  rw [hc, ha]
  exact gridSum_refine Q D τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A n ω

stochasticStep_dist_cross.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q D (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m))
      (stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) C (G.count n)) =
    dist (coefficientStep Q D (G.time m) A (G.count m))
      (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) C (G.count n))
stochasticStep_dist_cross.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n)) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q D (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m))
      (stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) C (G.count n)) =
    dist (coefficientStep Q D (G.time m) A (G.count m))
      (coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) C (G.count n)) := by
  wlog hmn : m ≤ n generalizing m n A C
  · rw [dist_comm, dist_comm (coefficientStep Q D (G.time m) A (G.count m))]
    exact this n m C A (by omega)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hcount, htime⟩ := G.compatible m n hmn
  let R := refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n) (G.monotone n) d hd htime A
  have hS := stochasticStep_refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n)
    (G.monotone m) (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m)
  have hU := coefficientStep_refine Q D (G.time m) (G.time n)
    (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m)
  rw [← hS, ← hU, ← hcount]
  exact stochasticStep_dist Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) R C (G.count n)

stochasticStep_cauchy.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_cauchy (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (hA : CauchySeq (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n))) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
stochasticStep_cauchy.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_cauchy (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (hA : CauchySeq (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n))) :
    CauchySeq (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n)) := by
  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff] at hA ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hA ε hε
  refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [stochasticStep_dist_cross]
  exact hN m hm n hn

exists_stochasticIntegral_limit.exact_header:
theorem exists_stochasticIntegral_limit (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u)) :
    ∃ I : Lp Z 2 Q,
      Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
        atTop (𝓝 I) ∧ ‖I‖ = ‖u‖
exists_stochasticIntegral_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_stochasticIntegral_limit (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u)) :
    ∃ I : Lp Z 2 Q,
      Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
        atTop (𝓝 I) ∧ ‖I‖ = ‖u‖ := by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete
    (stochasticStep_cauchy Q D G A hu.cauchySeq)
  refine ⟨I, hI, ?_⟩
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  have hIl := ((continuous_norm.tendsto I).comp hI).pow 2
  have hul := ((continuous_norm.tendsto u).comp hu).pow 2
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hIl (hul.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
    (stochasticStep_norm_sq Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n)).symm)))

stochasticIntegral_limit_dist.exact_header:
theorem stochasticIntegral_limit_dist (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A C : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u v : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (I J : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hv : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (C n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 v))
    (hI : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 I))
    (hJ : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (C n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 J)) : dist I J = dist u v
stochasticIntegral_limit_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_limit_dist (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A C : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u v : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (I J : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hv : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (C n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 v))
    (hI : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 I))
    (hJ : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (C n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 J)) : dist I J = dist u v := by
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hI.dist hJ) ((hu.dist hv).congr'
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (stochasticStep_dist Q D (G.time n)
      (G.monotone n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n)).symm)))

IntegralDomain.exact_declaration:
abbrev IntegralDomain (G : RefiningGrids) :=

integralDomain_exists_limit.exact_header:
theorem integralDomain_exists_limit (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ I : Lp Z 2 Q, ∃ A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n),
      Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
        atTop (𝓝 I) ∧ ‖I‖ = ‖u.val‖
integralDomain_exists_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem integralDomain_exists_limit (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ∃ I : Lp Z 2 Q, ∃ A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n),
      Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))

  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property

stochasticIntegral_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem stochasticIntegral_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (hA : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))

stochasticIntegral_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids) (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (hA : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))
      atTop (𝓝 (stochasticIntegral Q D G u)) := by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, _⟩ := exists_stochasticIntegral_limit Q D G A u.val hA
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hI, _⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (integralDomain_exists_limit Q D G u)
  have hd := stochasticIntegral_limit_dist Q D G A C u.val u.val J
    (stochasticIntegral Q D G u) hA hC hJ hI
  rw [dist_self, dist_eq_zero] at hd
  simpa only [hd] using hJ

stochasticIntegral_isometry.exact_header:
theorem stochasticIntegral_isometry (G : RefiningGrids) :
    Isometry (stochasticIntegral (Z := Z) Q D G)
stochasticIntegral_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_isometry (G : RefiningGrids) :
    Isometry (stochasticIntegral (Z := Z) Q D G) := by
  apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro u v
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := v.property
  exact stochasticIntegral_limit_dist Q D G A C u.val v.val _ _ hA hC
    (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G u A hA)
    (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G v C hC)

continuousIntegral.exact_declaration:
def continuousIntegral (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)

weightedPairing_id.exact_header:
theorem weightedPairing_id (X : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    weightedPairing Q (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) X X = ‖X‖ ^ 2
weightedPairing_id.exact_declaration:
theorem weightedPairing_id (X : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    weightedPairing Q (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) X X = ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [weightedPairing_apply]
  have he : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z).compLpL 2 Q X = X := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z).coeFn_compLpL X).trans (ae_of_all Q (fun _ => rfl))
  rw [he, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

columnWeighted_id.exact_header:
theorem columnWeighted_id (x : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) :
    (∑ i, weightedPairing Q (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (x.ofLp i) (x.ofLp i)) = ‖x‖ ^ 2
columnWeighted_id.exact_declaration:
theorem columnWeighted_id (x : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) :

  simp only [weightedPairing_id, PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]

continuousIntegral_increment_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_increment_norm_sq (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ‖(continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val r‖ ^ 2
continuousIntegral_increment_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_increment_norm_sq (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ‖(continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val r‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [← weightedPairing_id]
  rw [continuousIntegral, continuousIntegral, stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry Q D
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (fun _ _ => rfl) (dyadicGrids T)
    (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val s t s.coe_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hst)
    _ _ (continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut Q D T u hu hU s)
    (continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut Q D T u hu hU t)]
  simp only [columnWeighted_id]

continuousIntegral_increment_bound.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_increment_bound (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (_hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 ≤
      P ^ 2 * ((t : ℝ) - s)
continuousIntegral_increment_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_increment_bound (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (_hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 ≤
      P ^ 2 * ((t : ℝ) - s) := by
  rw [continuousIntegral_increment_norm_sq Q D T u hu hU s t hst]
  let U := (continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖U r‖ ^ 2 ≤ P ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [continuousDomain_coe Q D T u hu hU] with r hr
    change ‖(continuousDomain Q D T u hu hU).val r‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    rw [hr]
    by_cases hR : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hR]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hP r ⟨hR.1.le, hR.2⟩) 2
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hR, norm_zero, zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)]
      positivity
  have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.memLp U).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (Lp.memLp U)
  have hic : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => P ^ 2) ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc (s : ℝ) t)) :=
    integrable_const _
  have hb := integral_mono_ae hi.integrableOn hic (ae_restrict_of_ae hbound)
  refine hb.trans_eq ?_
  rw [setIntegral_const, Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioc,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hst)), smul_eq_mul]
  ring

continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 ≤
      P ^ 2 * dist t s
continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ^ 2 ≤
      P ^ 2 * dist t s := by
  rcases le_total s t with hst | hts
  · rw [NNReal.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hst))]
    exact continuousIntegral_increment_bound Q D T u hu hU P hP0 hP s t hst
  · rw [norm_sub_rev, dist_comm, NNReal.dist_eq,
      abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hts))]
    exact continuousIntegral_increment_bound Q D T u hu hU P hP0 hP t s hts

continuousIntegral_holder_bound.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_holder_bound (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ≤
      P * Real.sqrt (dist t s)
continuousIntegral_holder_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_holder_bound (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q)
    (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P) (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU t - continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU s‖ ≤
      P * Real.sqrt (dist t s) := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hP0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist t s)]
  exact continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist Q D T u hu hU P hP0 hP s t

continuousIntegral_continuous.exact_header:
theorem continuousIntegral_continuous (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q) :
    Continuous (continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU)
continuousIntegral_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem continuousIntegral_continuous (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q) :
    Continuous (continuousIntegral Q D T u hu hU) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP0, hP⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_horizon_bound T u hu
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro t
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hp : 0 < P ^ 2 + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨ε ^ 2 / (P ^ 2 + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hε.le).mp
  have hb := continuousIntegral_norm_sq_le_dist Q D T u hu hU P hP0 hP t s
  have hd : dist s t * (P ^ 2 + 1) < ε ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hp).mp hs
  nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := s) (y := t)]

/-! # Actual Brownian integration under enlargement of the filtration
The same Brownian coordinates and coefficient columns give the same finite
sums and the same completed integral. Enlargement changes only the proved
adaptedness witnesses; no stochastic-integral equality is a premise.

noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

  (hprocess : D.process = E.process)
  (henlarge : ∀ t, D.filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)

/-- A genuine predictable coefficient remains predictable in the larger
filtration. Its actual values and L² variables do not change. -/




/-- Actual finite sums are unchanged when the Brownian coordinates are the

omit hprocess

/-- The actual represented integral domain embeds in the larger filtration
without changing its literal time-L² coefficient function. -/

enlargement. No limiting equality or stochastic isometry is assumed. -/

/-- Any two actual domain entries with the same time integrand have equal

def enlargeCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :

@[simp] theorem coefficientStep_enlarge (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :

include hprocess henlarge

stochasticStep_enlarge.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_enlarge (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n =

stochasticStep_enlarge.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_enlarge (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp] with ω hE hD
  dsimp only [stochasticStep]
  rw [hE, hD]
  simp only [gridSum, noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, increment, enlargeCoefficients, enlargeCoefficient]
  rw [hprocess]

def enlargeDomain (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q E G
enlargeDomain.exact_declaration:
def enlargeDomain (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q E G := by
  refine ⟨u.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  exact ⟨fun n ↦ enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge (G.time n) (A n), hA⟩

stochasticIntegral_enlarge.exact_header:
theorem stochasticIntegral_enlarge (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q E G (enlargeDomain Q D E henlarge G u) = stochasticIntegral Q D G u
stochasticIntegral_enlarge.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_enlarge (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q E G (enlargeDomain Q D E henlarge G u) = stochasticIntegral Q D G u := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  have h1 := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q E G (enlargeDomain Q D E henlarge G u)
    (fun n ↦ enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge (G.time n) (A n)) hA
  have h2 := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G u A hA
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique h1
  simpa only [stochasticStep_enlarge Q D E hprocess henlarge] using h2

import PBGSO.FilteredBrownianMartingale
import PBGSO.FilteredContinuousIntegrands
import PBGSO.TimeGridCut

/-! # Martingale realization of the completed filtered Brownian integral

Stopped finite sums are represented on actual cell-splitting grids. Their
L² distances from the masked-grid sums equal the distances between literal
time-step integrands. Their limits therefore give the actual completed
integral, and the martingale property follows by conditional projection.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)

/-- The first half-cell contains the old coefficient and the second zero.
The cell split is the observation time clamped between its endpoints. -/






/-- The key comparison is exact on a genuine common cell-splitting grid. -/



/-- Stopped finite sums converge to the constructed masked integral.
Both approximation premises concern actual coefficient functions only;
the stochastic convergence is derived through the common split grid. -/

/-- A completed integral with actual coefficient approximations is an
actual martingale. The finite raw processes and their convergence are
constructed, rather than supplied as a limiting-martingale hypothesis. -/



/-- Every observation time has an actual masked domain entry, including
times beyond the fixed horizon where the integral stays stopped. -/



/-- Literal dyadic full-curve coefficients converge to the chosen full domain. -/


/-- The actual completed Brownian integral of continuous adapted diffusion
columns is a martingale. Approximation convergence and all finite
martingale properties have been derived from the primitive driver. -/



/-- The actual continuous-column integral is the timewise L² limit of
one fixed sequence of stopped predictable martingales. -/

/-- The actual adapted martingale representative equals the constructed
L² Brownian integral at each time. -/

/-- The constructed actual martingale is square integrable. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

splitCoefficients.exact_declaration:
def splitCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) := fun j =>
  ⟨fun i ω => if j % 2 = 0 then (A (j / 2)).value i ω else 0,
    fun i => by
      by_cases hj : j % 2 = 0
      · have he : j = 2 * (j / 2) := by omega
        have ht : TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t j = τ (j / 2) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [he]
          exact TimeGridCut.splitTime_even τ t (j / 2)
        simp only [hj, ite_true]
        change StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t j)] ((A (j / 2)).value i)
        rw [ht]
        exact (A (j / 2)).adapted i
      · simp only [hj, ite_false]
        exact stronglyMeasurable_const,
    fun i => by
      by_cases hj : j % 2 = 0
      · simpa only [hj, ite_true] using (A (j / 2)).square i
      · simp only [hj, ite_false]
        exact memLp_const (0 : Z)⟩

splitCoefficients_toLp.exact_header:
theorem splitCoefficients_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (j : ℕ) :
    (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A j).toLp = TimeGridCut.splitValues (fun k => (A k).toLp) j
splitCoefficients_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem splitCoefficients_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (j : ℕ) :
    (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A j).toLp = TimeGridCut.splitValues (fun k => (A k).toLp) j := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hj : j % 2 = 0
  · simp only [Coefficient.toLp, PiLp.toLp_apply, TimeGridCut.splitValues, hj, ite_true]
    congr 1
    funext ω
    simp only [splitCoefficients, hj, ite_true]
  · simp only [Coefficient.toLp, PiLp.toLp_apply, TimeGridCut.splitValues, hj, ite_false]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [((splitCoefficients Q D τ t A j).square i).coeFn_toLp,
      Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (μ := Q) (p := 2)] with ω ha hz
    change ((splitCoefficients Q D τ t A j).square i).toLp _ ω = (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) ω
    rw [hz, ha]
    simp only [splitCoefficients, hj, ite_false, Pi.zero_apply]

stoppedStep_eq_clamped.exact_header:
theorem stoppedStep_eq_clamped (a b t : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedStep Q D a b A t ω = noiseStep Q D a (max a (min t b)) A ω
stoppedStep_eq_clamped.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedStep_eq_clamped (a b t : ℝ≥0) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D a) (ω : Ω) :
    stoppedStep Q D a b A t ω = noiseStep Q D a (max a (min t b)) A ω := by
  by_cases hat : a ≤ t
  · simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_true, max_eq_right (le_min hat hab)]
  · have hta : t ≤ a := le_of_not_ge hat
    have hm : min t b ≤ a := (min_le_left _ _).trans hta
    simp only [stoppedStep, hat, ite_false, max_eq_left hm,
      noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, increment, sub_self, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]

stoppedGridSum_eq_split.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_eq_split (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n) ω =
      stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω
stoppedGridSum_eq_split.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_eq_split (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n) ω =
      stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [mul_zero, gridSum_zero, stoppedGridSum, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = (2 * n + 1) + 1 by omega,
      gridSum_succ, gridSum_succ, ih, stoppedGridSum_succ]
    have h0 : 2 * n % 2 = 0 := by omega
    have h1 : (2 * n + 1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hd : 2 * n / 2 = n := by omega
    simp only [noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, splitCoefficients, h0, h1,
      ite_true, ite_false, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    rw [TimeGridCut.splitTime_even, TimeGridCut.splitTime_odd]
    rw [hd]
    congr 1
    exact (stoppedStep_eq_clamped Q D _ _ t (hτ (Nat.le_succ n)) (A n) ω).symm

stoppedIntegralLp_eq_split.exact_header:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_eq_split (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ A n t =
      stochasticStep Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) (TimeGridCut.splitTime_monotone τ hτ t)
        (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n)
stoppedIntegralLp_eq_split.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_eq_split (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ A n t =
      stochasticStep Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) (TimeGridCut.splitTime_monotone τ hτ t)
        (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n t).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D (TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t) (TimeGridCut.splitTime_monotone τ hτ t)
      (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n)).coeFn_toLp] with ω ha hb
  simp only [stoppedIntegralLp, stochasticStep]
  rw [ha, hb, stoppedGridSum_eq_split Q D τ hτ A n t ω]

stoppedIntegralLp_dist.exact_header:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    dist (stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ A n t) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n) =
      dist (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) 0 t) (coefficientStep Q D τ C n)
stoppedIntegralLp_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    dist (stoppedIntegralLp Q D τ hτ A n t) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ C n) =
      dist (timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) 0 t) (coefficientStep Q D τ C n) := by
  let υ := TimeGridCut.splitTime τ t
  have hυ := TimeGridCut.splitTime_monotone τ hτ t
  have he := TimeGridCut.splitTime_even τ t
  rw [stoppedIntegralLp_eq_split]
  rw [← stochasticStep_refine Q D τ υ hτ hυ 2 (by norm_num) he C n]
  rw [stochasticStep_dist]
  rw [coefficientStep_refine]
  have htime : coefficientStep Q D υ (splitCoefficients Q D τ t A) (2 * n) =
      timeCut Q (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) 0 t := by
    simp only [coefficientStep, splitCoefficients_toLp]
    exact TimeGridCut.split_grid_eq_cut τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) t n
  rw [htime]

theorem stoppedIntegralLp_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A C : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (U : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hU : U.val = timeCut Q u 0 t)
    (hA : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hC : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (C n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 U.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n) t)

stoppedIntegralLp_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedIntegralLp_tendsto (G : RefiningGrids)
    (A C : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (U : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hU : U.val = timeCut Q u 0 t)
    (hA : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hC : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (C n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 U.val)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n) t)
      atTop (𝓝 (stochasticIntegral Q D G U)) := by
  have hcut := ((timeCut_lipschitz (I := I) (Z := Z) Q 0 t).continuous.tendsto u).comp hA
  rw [← hU] at hcut
  have hdist := hcut.dist hC
  rw [dist_self] at hdist
  have he := hdist.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
    (stoppedIntegralLp_dist Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n) t).symm))
  have hnoise := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G U C hC
  exact hnoise.congr_dist (he.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => dist_comm _ _)))

theorem continuousCutDomain_eq_timeCut (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)

masked_curveCoefficients_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem masked_curveCoefficients_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : Continuous u)
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u t i) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time n)
      (curveCoefficients Q D ((Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator u)
        (masked_columns_adapted Q D u hU 0 t) ((dyadicGrids T).time n)) ((dyadicGrids T).count n))
      atTop (𝓝 (continuousCutDomain Q D T u hu hU t).val) := by

theorem stochasticStep_congr_ae (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n =

stochasticStep_congr_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_congr_ae (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n := by
  have hcoord : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ k : Fin n, ∀ i,
      D.process i (τ k) ω = E.process i (τ k) ω ∧
      D.process i (τ (k + 1)) ω = E.process i (τ (k + 1)) ω :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun k => ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i =>
      (hprocess i (τ k)).and (hprocess i (τ (k + 1)))))
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q E τ hτ (enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge τ A) n).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp, hcoord] with ω hE hD hc
  change (stochasticStep Q E τ hτ _ n) ω = _ at hE
  change (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) ω = _ at hD
  rw [hE, hD]
  unfold gridSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  unfold noiseStep PredictableIsometry.stepSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [increment, enlargeCoefficients, enlargeCoefficient]
  rw [← (hc k i).1, ← (hc k i).2]

theorem closedStepIntegral_congr_ae (G : RefiningGrids)
    (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q E G (enlargeClosedDomain Q D E henlarge G u) =
      closedStepIntegral Q D G u := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  let B (n : ℕ) : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q E G :=
    ⟨(A n).1, enlargeCoefficients Q D E henlarge (G.time (A n).1) (A n).2⟩
  have h1 := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q E G B (enlargeClosedDomain Q D E henlarge G u) hA
  have h2 := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G A u hA
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique h1
  simpa only [B, finiteStepOutput, stochasticStep_congr_ae Q D E hprocess henlarge] using h2

  toFun U := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => lpPullbackCLM hf (U i))
  map_add' U V := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    change lpPullbackCLM hf (U i + V i) = _
    exact map_add (lpPullbackCLM hf) _ _
  map_smul' c U := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i

  cont := (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : I => Lp Z 2 Q)).symm.continuous.comp

theorem coefficientStep_pullback (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) R D τ) (n : ℕ) :

stochasticStep_pullback.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_pullback (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) R D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q (pullbackDriver hf D) τ hτ (pullbackCoefficients hf D τ A) n =

stochasticStep_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_pullback (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) R D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q (pullbackDriver hf D) τ hτ (pullbackCoefficients hf D τ A) n =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (stochasticStep R D τ hτ A n) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q (pullbackDriver hf D) τ hτ
      (pullbackCoefficients hf D τ A) n).coeFn_toLp,
    lpPullback_coe hf (stochasticStep R D τ hτ A n),
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (gridSum_memLp R D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp]
    with ω hQ hP hR
  change (stochasticStep Q (pullbackDriver hf D) τ hτ (pullbackCoefficients hf D τ A) n) ω = _ at hQ
  change (stochasticStep R D τ hτ A n) (f ω) = gridSum R D τ A n (f ω) at hR
  rw [hQ, hP, hR]
  rfl

def pullbackDomain (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) R D G) :
    IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q (pullbackDriver hf D) G := by
  refine ⟨timePullbackCLM (I := I) hf u.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  refine ⟨fun n => pullbackCoefficients hf D (G.time n) (A n), ?_⟩
  simpa only [coefficientStep_pullback, Function.comp_def] using
    ((timePullbackCLM (I := I) hf).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA

stochasticIntegral_pullback.exact_header:
theorem stochasticIntegral_pullback (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) R D G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) G (pullbackDomain hf D G u) =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (stochasticIntegral R D G u)
stochasticIntegral_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_pullback (G : GridIntegralCompletion.RefiningGrids)
    (u : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) R D G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) G (pullbackDomain hf D G u) =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (stochasticIntegral R D G u) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  have hQ : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q (pullbackDriver hf D) (G.time n)
      (pullbackCoefficients hf D (G.time n) (A n)) (G.count n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (pullbackDomain hf D G u).val) := by
    simpa only [coefficientStep_pullback, pullbackDomain, Function.comp_def] using
      ((timePullbackCLM (I := I) hf).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA
  have h1 := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q (pullbackDriver hf D) G (pullbackDomain hf D G u)
    (fun n => pullbackCoefficients hf D (G.time n) (A n)) hQ
  have h2 := ((lpPullbackCLM hf).continuous.tendsto (stochasticIntegral R D G u)).comp
    (stochasticIntegral_tendsto R D G u A hA)
  have h2' : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q (pullbackDriver hf D) (G.time n)
      (G.monotone n) (pullbackCoefficients hf D (G.time n) (A n)) (G.count n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (lpPullbackCLM hf (stochasticIntegral R D G u))) := by
    simpa only [stochasticStep_pullback, Function.comp_def] using h2
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2'

theorem pastMean_column (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)

  have hi : IntervalIntegrable u volume (t - ε) t :=
    intervalIntegrable_iff.mpr ((hu.integrableOn_isCompact isCompact_uIcc).mono_set uIoc_subset_uIcc)
  change columnEval Q i (ε⁻¹ • ∫ r in t - ε..t, u r) = _

def columnWeight (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]

theorem stochasticStep_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    weightedPairing Q W (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) =

stochasticStep_weighted.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :

  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  have he : (∫ ω, ⟪stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n ω, W (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪gridSum Q D τ A n ω, W (gridSum Q D τ A n ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by

    filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
    change ⟪(gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).toLp _ ω,
      W ((gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).toLp _ ω)⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [hω]
  rw [he, gridSum_isometry Q D W hW τ hτ A n,
    coefficientStep]
  have ht := TimeGridEnergy.grid_weighted (columnWeight (I := I) Q W) τ hτ
    (fun k => (A k).toLp) n
  rw [ht]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  rw [columnWeight_inner]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [((A k).square i).coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
  change ⟪(A k).value i ω, W ((A k).value i ω)⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪((A k).square i).toLp _ ω, W (((A k).square i).toLp _ ω)⟫_ℝ
  rw [hω]

theorem stochasticIntegral_limit_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (J : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hJ : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))

theorem stochasticIntegral_limit_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (A : ∀ n, Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D (G.time n))
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (J : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => coefficientStep Q D (G.time n) (A n) (G.count n)) atTop (𝓝 u))
    (hJ : Tendsto (fun n => stochasticStep Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (G.count n))

theorem stochasticIntegral_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)

theorem stochasticIntegral_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)

def domainSub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :

domainSub.exact_declaration:
def domainSub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G := by
  refine ⟨u.val - v.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := v.property
  refine ⟨fun n => subtract Q D (G.time n) (A n) (C n), ?_⟩
  exact (hA.sub hC).congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>

theorem stochasticIntegral_sub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :

stochasticIntegral_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_sub (G : RefiningGrids) (u v : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    stochasticIntegral Q D G (domainSub Q D G u v) =
      stochasticIntegral Q D G u - stochasticIntegral Q D G v := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := u.property
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := v.property
  have hsub := stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G (domainSub Q D G u v)
    (fun n => subtract Q D (G.time n) (A n) (C n))
    ((hA.sub hC).congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
      (coefficientStep_sub Q D (G.time n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n)).symm)))
  have hdiff := (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G u A hA).sub
    (stochasticIntegral_tendsto Q D G v C hC)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hsub (hdiff.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n =>
    (stochasticStep_sub Q D (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (A n) (C n) (G.count n)).symm)))

timeCut_sub.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_sub (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    timeCut Q u 0 t - timeCut Q u 0 s = timeCut Q u s t
timeCut_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_sub (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    timeCut Q u 0 t - timeCut Q u 0 s = timeCut Q u s t := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (timeCut Q u 0 t) (timeCut Q u 0 s),
    timeCut_coe Q u 0 t, timeCut_coe Q u 0 s, timeCut_coe Q u s t] with r hsub ht' hs' hst'
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, ht', hs', hst']
  by_cases hr0 : r ≤ 0
  · have hrs : r ≤ s := hr0.trans hs
    simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, not_lt.mpr hr0, not_lt.mpr hrs]
  · have h0r : 0 < r := lt_of_not_ge hr0
    by_cases hrs : r ≤ s
    · have hrt : r ≤ t := hrs.trans hst
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, h0r, hrs, hrt, not_lt.mpr hrs]
    · have hsr : s < r := lt_of_not_ge hrs
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, h0r, hsr, hrs]

timeCut_weighted.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    ⟪timeCut Q u s t, (columnWeight (I := I) Q W).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (timeCut Q u s t)⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((u r).ofLp i) ((u r).ofLp i)
timeCut_weighted.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_weighted (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    ⟪timeCut Q u s t, (columnWeight (I := I) Q W).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) (timeCut Q u s t)⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ r in Ioc s t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((u r).ofLp i) ((u r).ofLp i) := by
  rw [L2.inner_def, ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(columnWeight (I := I) Q W).coeFn_compLpL (timeCut Q u s t), timeCut_coe Q u s t]
    with r hw hcut
  rw [hw, hcut]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, columnWeight_inner]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero, inner_zero_left]

theorem stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (Us Ut : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hUs : Us.val = timeCut Q u 0 s) (hUt : Ut.val = timeCut Q u 0 t) :

      ∫ r in Ioc s t, ∑ i, weightedPairing Q W ((u r).ofLp i) ((u r).ofLp i)
stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticIntegral_increment_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (G : RefiningGrids) (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (Us Ut : IntegralDomain (Z := Z) Q D G)
    (hUs : Us.val = timeCut Q u 0 s) (hUt : Ut.val = timeCut Q u 0 t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (stochasticIntegral Q D G Ut - stochasticIntegral Q D G Us)
      (stochasticIntegral Q D G Ut - stochasticIntegral Q D G Us) =

Universal finite signed coupling work yields compact-uniform quadratic
positive sampler work. Actual product-L² states and the original optimizer
Bochner equations then derive positive joint-work integrability. No optimizer
response Lipschitz condition, drift moment, or energy identity is assumed.

positive_work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem positive_work_integrable (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M D)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hU : MemLp (Function.uncurry U.sampler) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hV : MemLp (Function.uncurry V.sampler) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (rawMetricBilinear D
      (pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2) (pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
positive_work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem positive_work_integrable (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M D)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hU : MemLp (Function.uncurry U.sampler) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hV : MemLp (Function.uncurry V.sampler) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (rawMetricBilinear D
      (pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2) (pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let μ := (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q
  let Copt : Set S := (U.optimizer '' Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∪ (V.optimizer '' Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
  have hCopt : IsCompact Copt :=
    (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn (Data.optimizer_continuous Q M U)).union
      (isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn (Data.optimizer_continuous Q M V))
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := DiracOptimizerGrowth.positive_sampler_work_growth_on_compact
    M D ρ hρ hmono hfull Copt hCopt
  obtain ⟨R0,hR0⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((Data.optimizer_continuous Q M U).sub (Data.optimizer_continuous Q M V))
  let R := max 0 R0
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hRbound (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ‖U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r‖ ≤ R :=
    (hR0 r hr).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hj : IntegrableOn (fun r => U.optimizerDrift r-V.optimizerDrift r) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp
      (U.optimizerDrift_integrable.sub V.optimizerDrift_integrable)
  have hu2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.sampler p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hU.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hU
  have hv2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖V.sampler p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hV.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hV
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      (‖D.optimizerWeight‖*R)*‖U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1‖+
        C*(1+‖U.sampler p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2+‖V.sampler p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)) μ :=
    ((hj.norm.comp_fst Q).const_mul (‖D.optimizerWeight‖*R)).add
      ((((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add hu2).add hv2).const_mul C)
  have hm := (rawMetricBilinear D).continuous₂.comp_stronglyMeasurable
    ((pairState_strong Q M U V).prodMk (pairDrift_strong Q M U V))
  apply hmajor.mono'
    (continuous_max.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hm.aestronglyMeasurable.prodMk aestronglyMeasurable_const))
  have htime : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, p.1 ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_Icc.preimage measurable_fst)).mpr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact ae_of_all Q (fun _ => Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)
  filter_upwards [htime] with p hp
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _)]
  have huC : U.optimizer p.1 ∈ Copt := Or.inl ⟨p.1,hp,rfl⟩
  have hvC : V.optimizer p.1 ∈ Copt := Or.inr ⟨p.1,hp,rfl⟩
  have hs := hbound (U.optimizer p.1) huC (V.optimizer p.1) hvC (U.sampler p.1 p.2) (V.sampler p.1 p.2)
  rw [sampler_work_eq_drift M D hσ] at hs
  have ho : ⟪U.optimizer p.1-V.optimizer p.1,D.optimizerWeight
      (U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1)⟫_ℝ ≤
      (‖D.optimizerWeight‖*R)*‖U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖U.optimizer p.1-V.optimizer p.1‖*‖D.optimizerWeight
          (U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1)‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ R*(‖D.optimizerWeight‖*‖U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1‖) :=
        mul_le_mul (hRbound p.1 hp) (D.optimizerWeight.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _) hR
      _ = _ := by ring
  change max (⟪U.optimizer p.1-V.optimizer p.1,D.optimizerWeight
      (U.optimizerDrift p.1-V.optimizerDrift p.1)⟫_ℝ+
    ⟪U.sampler p.1 p.2-V.sampler p.1 p.2,D.samplerWeight
      (M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer p.1)) (U.sampler p.1 p.2)-
        M.drift (M.parameter (V.optimizer p.1)) (V.sampler p.1 p.2))⟫_ℝ) 0 ≤ _
  apply max_le
  · exact (add_le_add ho (le_max_left _ _)).trans (add_le_add le_rfl hs)
  · positivity

exists_quadratic_not_quartic.exact_header:
theorem exists_quadratic_not_quartic :
    ∃ μ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2) μ ∧ ¬ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) μ
exists_quadratic_not_quartic.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_quadratic_not_quartic :
    ∃ μ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2) μ ∧ ¬ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) μ := by
  by_contra hn
  have h : ∀ μ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ →
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2) μ → Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) μ := by
    intro μ hp hw
    by_contra hq
    exact hn ⟨μ,hp,hw,hq⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := UniversalMomentGrowth.growth_of_probability_integrability
    (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2) (fun x => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
    (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) h
  let x := Real.sqrt (C+1)
  have hs : x ^ 2 = C+1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hb := hbound x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ x ^ 4)] at hb
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg C]

drift_strongly_dissipative.exact_header:
theorem drift_strongly_dissipative (x y : ℝ) :
    (x-y)*(drift x-drift y) ≤ -(x-y)^2
drift_strongly_dissipative.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_strongly_dissipative (x y : ℝ) :
    (x-y)*(drift x-drift y) ≤ -(x-y)^2 := by
  have h : 0 ≤ x^2+x*y+y^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x+y),sq_nonneg x,sq_nonneg y]
  have hp := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x-y)) h
  dsimp [drift]
  nlinarith

exists_p2_nonintegrable_work.exact_header:
theorem exists_p2_nonintegrable_work :
    ∃ μ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 μ ∧
      ¬ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x*(drift x-drift 0)) μ
exists_p2_nonintegrable_work.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_p2_nonintegrable_work :
    ∃ μ : Measure ℝ, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 μ ∧
      ¬ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x*(drift x-drift 0)) μ := by
  obtain ⟨μ,hp,hw,hq⟩ := exists_quadratic_not_quartic
  letI := hp
  have h2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x^2) μ := by
    apply hw.mono' (by fun_prop)
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg x)]; linarith)
  refine ⟨μ,hp,(memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (by fun_prop)).mpr ?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs] using h2
  · intro hi
    apply hq
    have he : (fun x : ℝ => -(x*(drift x-drift 0))-x^2) = fun x : ℝ => x^4 := by
      funext x
      dsimp [drift]
      ring
    rw [← he]
    exact hi.neg.sub h2
