fixedPoint_continuousAt.exact_header:
theorem fixedPoint_continuousAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (hF : ContinuousAt F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContinuousAt ψ a₀
fixedPoint_continuousAt.exact_declaration:
theorem fixedPoint_continuousAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (hF : ContinuousAt F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContinuousAt ψ a₀ := by
  have hcontract (a : A) : ContractingWith c (fun b => F (a, b)) := ⟨hc, hLip a⟩
  have hbound (a : A) : dist (ψ a) (ψ a₀) ≤
      dist (ψ a₀) (F (a, ψ a₀)) / (1 - (c : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [dist_comm] using
      (hcontract a).dist_le_of_fixedPoint (ψ a₀) (hfix a)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun a => dist (ψ a₀) (F (a, ψ a₀)) / (1 - (c : ℝ)))
      (𝓝 a₀) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hFa : ContinuousAt (fun a : A => F (a, ψ a₀)) a₀ :=
      ContinuousAt.comp' (f := fun a : A => (a, ψ a₀)) hF
        (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
    have h := ((continuousAt_const (y := ψ a₀)).dist hFa).div_const (1 - (c : ℝ))
    simpa only [hfix a₀, dist_self, zero_div] using h
  have hd := squeeze_zero (fun a => dist_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ dist (ψ a) (ψ a₀)) hbound hlim
  exact tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr hd

fixedPoint_continuousAt_of_eventually.exact_header:
theorem fixedPoint_continuousAt_of_eventually (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (a₀ : A) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1)
    (hLip : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a)
    (hF : ContinuousAt F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContinuousAt ψ a₀
fixedPoint_continuousAt_of_eventually.exact_declaration:
theorem fixedPoint_continuousAt_of_eventually (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (a₀ : A) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1)
    (hLip : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a)
    (hF : ContinuousAt F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContinuousAt ψ a₀ := by
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, dist (ψ a) (ψ a₀) ≤
      dist (ψ a₀) (F (a, ψ a₀)) / (1 - (c : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hLip] with a ha
    simpa only [dist_comm] using
      (show ContractingWith c (fun b => F (a, b)) from ⟨hc, ha⟩).dist_le_of_fixedPoint
        (ψ a₀) (hfix a)
  have hFa : ContinuousAt (fun a : A => F (a, ψ a₀)) a₀ :=
    ContinuousAt.comp' (f := fun a : A => (a, ψ a₀)) hF
      (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun a => dist (ψ a₀) (F (a, ψ a₀)) / (1 - (c : ℝ)))
      (𝓝 a₀) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [hfix a₀, dist_self, zero_div] using
      ((continuousAt_const (y := ψ a₀)).dist hFa).div_const (1 - (c : ℝ))
  exact tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
    (squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => dist_nonneg) hbound hlim)

one_sub_isInvertible.exact_header:
theorem one_sub_isInvertible (L : B →L[ℝ] B) (hL : ‖L‖ < 1) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - L).IsInvertible
one_sub_isInvertible.exact_declaration:
theorem one_sub_isInvertible (L : B →L[ℝ] B) (hL : ‖L‖ < 1) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - L).IsInvertible := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_one_sub_of_norm_lt_one hL
  refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofUnit u, ?_⟩
  change (u : B →L[ℝ] B) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - L
  exact hu

fixedPoint_hasStrictFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem fixedPoint_hasStrictFDerivAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (D : (A × B) →L[ℝ] B) (hF : HasStrictFDerivAt F D (a₀, ψ a₀)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt ψ
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)).inverse).comp
        (D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A B))) a₀
fixedPoint_hasStrictFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem fixedPoint_hasStrictFDerivAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (D : (A × B) →L[ℝ] B) (hF : HasStrictFDerivAt F D (a₀, ψ a₀)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt ψ
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)).inverse).comp
        (D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A B))) a₀ := by
  let R : A × B → B := fun p => p.2 - F p
  let DR : (A × B) →L[ℝ] B := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A B - D
  have hR : HasStrictFDerivAt R DR (a₀, ψ a₀) := hasStrictFDerivAt_snd.sub hF
  have hpartial : HasFDerivAt (fun b => F (a₀, b))
      (D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)) (ψ a₀) :=
    hF.hasFDerivAt.comp (ψ a₀)
      ((hasFDerivAt_const a₀ (ψ a₀)).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id (ψ a₀)))
  have hnorm := hpartial.le_of_lipschitz (hLip a₀)
  have hbound : ‖D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)‖ < 1 :=
    hnorm.trans_lt (show (c : ℝ) < 1 by exact_mod_cast hc)
  have hDR : DR.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - D.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) := by
    ext b
    rfl
  have hinv : (DR.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hDR]
    exact one_sub_isInvertible _ hbound
  have hImplicit := hR.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv
  have hψ := fixedPoint_continuousAt F ψ c hc hLip hfix a₀ hF.continuousAt
  have hgraph : Tendsto (fun a => (a, ψ a)) (𝓝 a₀) (𝓝 (a₀, ψ a₀)) :=
    continuousAt_id.prodMk hψ
  have hevent := hgraph.eventually (hR.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv)
  have hEq : hR.implicitFunctionOfProdDomain hinv =ᶠ[𝓝 a₀] ψ := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with a ha
    exact ha.mp (by simp only [R, hfix, sub_self])
  have hfinal := hImplicit.congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq
  convert hfinal using 1
  rw [hDR]
  ext a
  simp only [DR, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, sub_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.inl_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', zero_sub,
    neg_apply, map_neg, neg_neg]

fixedPoint_contDiffAt.exact_header:
theorem fixedPoint_contDiffAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ a₀
fixedPoint_contDiffAt.exact_declaration:
theorem fixedPoint_contDiffAt (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1) (hLip : ∀ a, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a) (a₀ : A)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ a₀ := by
  let R : A × B → B := fun p => p.2 - F p
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 R (a₀, ψ a₀) := contDiffAt_snd.sub hF
  have hRder := hR.hasStrictFDerivAt (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0)
  have hFder := hF.hasStrictFDerivAt (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0)
  have hpartial : HasFDerivAt (fun b => F (a₀, b))
      ((fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)) (ψ a₀) :=
    hFder.hasFDerivAt.comp (ψ a₀)
      ((hasFDerivAt_const a₀ (ψ a₀)).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id (ψ a₀)))
  have hnorm := hpartial.le_of_lipschitz (hLip a₀)
  have hDR : (fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - (fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) := by
    rw [show fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀) = ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A B -
      fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀) from (hasFDerivAt_snd.sub hFder.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    ext b
    rfl
  have hinv : ((fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hDR]
    exact one_sub_isInvertible _ (hnorm.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hc))
  have hψ := fixedPoint_continuousAt F ψ c hc hLip hfix a₀ hF.continuousAt
  have hevent := (continuousAt_id.prodMk hψ).eventually
    (hR.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv)
  have hEq : hR.implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv =ᶠ[𝓝 a₀] ψ := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with a ha
    exact ha.mp (by simp only [R, id_eq, hfix, sub_self])
  exact (hR.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv).congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq.symm

fixedPoint_contDiffAt_of_eventually.exact_header:
theorem fixedPoint_contDiffAt_of_eventually (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (a₀ : A) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1)
    (hLip : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ a₀
fixedPoint_contDiffAt_of_eventually.exact_declaration:
theorem fixedPoint_contDiffAt_of_eventually (F : A × B → B) (ψ : A → B)
    (a₀ : A) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c < 1)
    (hLip : ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 a₀, LipschitzWith c (fun b => F (a, b)))
    (hfix : ∀ a, F (a, ψ a) = ψ a)
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F (a₀, ψ a₀)) : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ a₀ := by
  let R : A × B → B := fun p => p.2 - F p
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 R (a₀, ψ a₀) := contDiffAt_snd.sub hF
  have hRder := hR.hasStrictFDerivAt (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0)
  have hFder := hF.hasStrictFDerivAt (by norm_num : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0)
  have hpartial : HasFDerivAt (fun b => F (a₀, b))
      ((fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)) (ψ a₀) :=
    hFder.hasFDerivAt.comp (ψ a₀)
      ((hasFDerivAt_const a₀ (ψ a₀)).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id (ψ a₀)))
  have hnorm := hpartial.le_of_lipschitz (hLip.self_of_nhds)
  have hDR : (fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ B - (fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B) := by
    rw [show fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀) = ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A B -
      fderiv ℝ F (a₀, ψ a₀) from (hasFDerivAt_snd.sub hFder.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    ext b
    rfl
  have hinv : ((fderiv ℝ R (a₀, ψ a₀)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hDR]
    exact one_sub_isInvertible _ (hnorm.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hc))
  have hψ := fixedPoint_continuousAt_of_eventually F ψ a₀ c hc hLip hfix hF.continuousAt
  have hevent := (continuousAt_id.prodMk hψ).eventually
    (hR.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv)
  have hEq : hR.implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv =ᶠ[𝓝 a₀] ψ := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with a ha
    exact ha.mp (by simp only [R, id_eq, hfix, sub_self])
  exact (hR.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hinv).congr_of_eventuallyEq hEq.symm

curveOperator.exact_header: def curveOperator (D : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E)) : C(K, E) →L[ℝ] C(K, E)
curveOperator.exact_declaration:
def curveOperator (D : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E)) : C(K, E) →L[ℝ] C(K, E) :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := fun v => ⟨fun k => D k (v k), D.continuous.clm_apply v.continuous⟩
      map_add' := fun v w => by ext k; exact (D k).map_add _ _
      map_smul' := fun r v => by ext k; exact (D k).map_smul r _ }
    ‖D‖ (by
      intro v
      apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg D) (norm_nonneg v))).mpr
      intro k
      exact ((D k).le_opNorm (v k)).trans
        (mul_le_mul (D.norm_coe_le_norm k) (v.norm_coe_le_norm k) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

curveOperator_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem curveOperator_apply (D : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E)) (v : C(K, E)) (k : K) :

curveOperator_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem curveOperator_apply (D : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E)) (v : C(K, E)) (k : K) :
    curveOperator D v k = D k (v k) := rfl

superposition.exact_header: def superposition (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f) (v : C(K, E)) : C(K, E)
superposition.exact_declaration:
def superposition (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f) (v : C(K, E)) : C(K, E) :=

derivativeAlong.exact_header: def derivativeAlong (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (u : C(K, E)) : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E)
derivativeAlong.exact_declaration:
def derivativeAlong (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (u : C(K, E)) : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E) :=
  ⟨fun k => fderiv ℝ f (u k), (hf.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).comp u.continuous⟩

superposition_hasStrictFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem superposition_hasStrictFDerivAt [ProperSpace E]
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (u : C(K, E)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (superposition f hf.continuous)
      (curveOperator (derivativeAlong f hf u)) u
superposition_hasStrictFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem superposition_hasStrictFDerivAt [ProperSpace E]
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (u : C(K, E)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (superposition f hf.continuous)
      (curveOperator (derivativeAlong f hf u)) u := by
  apply HasStrictFDerivAt.of_isLittleO
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro ε hε
  let R := ‖u‖ + 1
  have hUC := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous
    (hf.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hmod⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hUC ε hε
  let δ := min 1 (δ₀ / 2)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min (by norm_num) (half_pos hδ₀)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ₀' : δ < δ₀ := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (half_lt_self hδ₀)
  have hu (k : K) : u k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
      (u.norm_coe_le_norm k).trans (show ‖u‖ ≤ R by dsimp [R]; linarith)
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (u, u) hδ] with p hp
  have hv : ‖p.1 - u‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (show dist p.1 u ≤ dist p (u, u) by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hp
  have hw : ‖p.2 - u‖ < δ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (show dist p.2 u ≤ dist p (u, u) by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hp
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg hε.le (norm_nonneg (p.1 - p.2)))).mpr
  intro k
  let g : E → E := fun z => f z - (fderiv ℝ f (u k)) z
  have hd (z : E) : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ f z - fderiv ℝ f (u k)) z :=
    ((hf.differentiable (by norm_num)) z).hasFDerivAt.sub (fderiv ℝ f (u k)).hasFDerivAt
  have hb (z : E) (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (u k) δ) :
      ‖fderiv ℝ f z - fderiv ℝ f (u k)‖ ≤ ε := by
    have hz' : dist z (u k) ≤ δ := hz
    have hzR : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R := by
      apply (dist_triangle z (u k) 0).trans
      simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
        (add_le_add hz' (u.norm_coe_le_norm k)).trans (by dsimp [R]; linarith)
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (hmod z hzR (u k) (hu k) (hz'.trans_lt hδ₀')).le
  have hvk : p.1 k ∈ Metric.closedBall (u k) δ := by
    change dist (p.1 k) (u k) ≤ δ
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using
      ((p.1 - u).norm_coe_le_norm k).trans hv.le
  have hwk : p.2 k ∈ Metric.closedBall (u k) δ := by
    change dist (p.2 k) (u k) ≤ δ
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using
      ((p.2 - u).norm_coe_le_norm k).trans hw.le
  have hmean := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    (fun z _ => (hd z).differentiableAt)
    (fun z hz => by simpa only [(hd z).fderiv] using hb z hz)
    (convex_closedBall (u k) δ) hwk hvk
  change ‖f (p.1 k) - f (p.2 k) - (fderiv ℝ f (u k)) ((p.1 - p.2) k)‖ ≤ _
  have heq : f (p.1 k) - f (p.2 k) - (fderiv ℝ f (u k)) ((p.1 - p.2) k) =
      g (p.1 k) - g (p.2 k) := by
    dsimp [g]
    rw [map_sub]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  exact hmean.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((p.1 - p.2).norm_coe_le_norm k) hε.le)

curveOperatorMap.exact_header: def curveOperatorMap : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] (C(K, E) →L[ℝ] C(K, E))
curveOperatorMap.exact_declaration:
def curveOperatorMap : C(K, E →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] (C(K, E) →L[ℝ] C(K, E)) :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := curveOperator (K := K) (E := E)
      map_add' := fun D D' => by ext v k; rfl
      map_smul' := fun r D => by ext v k; rfl }
    1 (by
      intro D
      rw [one_mul]
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg D)
      intro v
      apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg D) (norm_nonneg v))).mpr
      intro k
      exact ((D k).le_opNorm (v k)).trans
        (mul_le_mul (D.norm_coe_le_norm k) (v.norm_coe_le_norm k)
          (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

superposition_contDiff.exact_header:
theorem superposition_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (superposition (K := K) f hf.continuous)
superposition_contDiff.exact_declaration:
theorem superposition_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (superposition (K := K) f hf.continuous) := by
  apply contDiff_one_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr
  refine ⟨fun u => curveOperator (derivativeAlong f hf u), ?_,
    fun u => (superposition_hasStrictFDerivAt f hf u).hasFDerivAt⟩
  exact (curveOperatorMap (K := K) (E := E)).continuous.comp
    (ContinuousMap.continuous_postcomp ⟨fderiv ℝ f, hf.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)⟩)

extendCurve.exact_header: def extendCurve (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) : ℝ → E
extendCurve.exact_declaration:
def extendCurve (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) : ℝ → E :=
  fun t => v (projIcc (-T) T (by linarith) t)

extendCurve_continuous.exact_header:
theorem extendCurve_continuous (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) :
    Continuous (extendCurve T hT v)
extendCurve_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem extendCurve_continuous (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) :
    Continuous (extendCurve T hT v) := v.continuous.comp continuous_projIcc

extendCurve_val.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem extendCurve_val (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) (t : Time T) :
    extendCurve T hT v t = v t
extendCurve_val.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem extendCurve_val (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) (t : Time T) :
    extendCurve T hT v t = v t := by simp only [extendCurve, projIcc_val]

volterra.exact_header: def volterra (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : C(Time T, E) →L[ℝ] C(Time T, E)
volterra.exact_declaration:
def volterra (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : C(Time T, E) →L[ℝ] C(Time T, E) :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := fun v =>
        ⟨fun t => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), extendCurve T hT v s,
          (intervalIntegral.differentiable_integral_of_continuous
            (extendCurve_continuous T hT v)).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩
      map_add' := fun v w => by
        ext t
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_add
          ((extendCurve_continuous T hT v).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((extendCurve_continuous T hT w).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      map_smul' := fun r v => by
        ext t
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_smul r (extendCurve T hT v) }
    T (by
      intro v
      apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg hT (norm_nonneg v))).mpr
      intro t
      exact (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (fun s _ => v.norm_coe_le_norm _)).trans (by
          rw [sub_zero, mul_comm T]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mpr t.property) (norm_nonneg v)))

volterra_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem volterra_apply (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) (t : Time T) :
    volterra T hT v t = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), extendCurve T hT v s
volterra_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem volterra_apply (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) (t : Time T) :
    volterra T hT v t = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), extendCurve T hT v s := rfl

volterra_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem volterra_norm_le (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) :
    ‖volterra T hT v‖ ≤ T * ‖v‖
volterra_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem volterra_norm_le (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (v : C(Time T, E)) :
    ‖volterra T hT v‖ ≤ T * ‖v‖ := by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg hT (norm_nonneg v))).mpr
  intro t
  exact (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (fun s _ => v.norm_coe_le_norm _)).trans (by
      rw [sub_zero, mul_comm T]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mpr t.property) (norm_nonneg v))

picardMap.exact_header:
def picardMap (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (p : E × C(Time T, E)) : C(Time T, E)

superposition_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem superposition_lipschitz (K : Type*) [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
    (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LipschitzWith L (superposition (K := K) f hf)
superposition_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem superposition_lipschitz (K : Type*) [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
    (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LipschitzWith L (superposition (K := K) f hf) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro v w
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg L.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro k
  exact (hLip.norm_sub_le (v k) (w k)).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((v - w).norm_coe_le_norm k) L.coe_nonneg)

picardMap_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem picardMap_lipschitz (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (x : E) :
    LipschitzWith (⟨T, hT⟩ * L) (fun v => picardMap T hT f hf (x, v))
picardMap_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem picardMap_lipschitz (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (x : E) :
    LipschitzWith (⟨T, hT⟩ * L) (fun v => picardMap T hT f hf (x, v)) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro v w
  simp only [picardMap, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← map_sub]
  exact (volterra_norm_le T hT _).trans (by
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((superposition_lipschitz (Time T) f hf L hLip).norm_sub_le v w) hT)

picardMap_contDiff.exact_header:
theorem picardMap_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (picardMap T hT f hf.continuous)
picardMap_contDiff.exact_declaration:
theorem picardMap_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (picardMap T hT f hf.continuous) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.const ℝ (Time T) : E →L[ℝ] C(Time T, E)).contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).add
    ((volterra T hT).contDiff.comp ((superposition_contDiff f hf).comp contDiff_snd))

flowCurve.exact_declaration:
def flowCurve (T : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (x : E) : C(Time T, E) :=
  ⟨fun t => Φ (t, x),
    (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => (hODE t x).continuousAt)).comp
      continuous_subtype_val⟩

flowCurve_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem flowCurve_apply (T : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hODE) (x : E)
    (t : Time T) : flowCurve T Φ f hODE x t = Φ (t, x)
flowCurve_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem flowCurve_apply (T : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hODE) (x : E)
    (t : Time T) : flowCurve T Φ f hODE x t = Φ (t, x) := rfl

flowCurve_fixedPoint.exact_header:
theorem flowCurve_fixedPoint (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (x : E) :
    picardMap T hT f hf (x, flowCurve T Φ f hODE x) = flowCurve T Φ f hODE x
flowCurve_fixedPoint.exact_declaration:
theorem flowCurve_fixedPoint (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (x : E) :
    picardMap T hT f hf (x, flowCurve T Φ f hODE x) = flowCurve T Φ f hODE x := by
  ext t
  change x + (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ),
    extendCurve T hT (superposition f hf (flowCurve T Φ f hODE x)) s) = Φ (t, x)
  have hcon : Continuous (fun s => f (Φ (s, x))) := hf.comp
    (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun s => (hODE s x).continuousAt))
  have heq : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ),
      extendCurve T hT (superposition f hf (flowCurve T Φ f hODE x)) s) =
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), f (Φ (s, x)) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    have hsT : s ∈ Time T := by
      apply Set.uIcc_subset_Icc (by constructor <;> linarith) t.property hs
    simp only [extendCurve, projIcc_of_mem _ hsT, superposition, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      flowCurve]
  rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun s _ => hODE s x) (hcon.intervalIntegrable _ _), hinit]
  abel

flowCurve_contDiff_short.exact_header:
theorem flowCurve_contDiff_short [ProperSpace E]
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (hshort : T * (L : ℝ) < 1)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (flowCurve T Φ f hODE)
flowCurve_contDiff_short.exact_declaration:
theorem flowCurve_contDiff_short [ProperSpace E]
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (hshort : T * (L : ℝ) < 1)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (flowCurve T Φ f hODE) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  exact fixedPoint_contDiffAt _ _ (⟨T, hT⟩ * L) (by exact_mod_cast hshort)
    (picardMap_lipschitz T hT f hf.continuous L hLip)
    (flowCurve_fixedPoint T hT Φ f hf.continuous hODE hinit) x
    (picardMap_contDiff T hT f hf).contDiffAt

scaledPicardMap.exact_header:
def scaledPicardMap (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (p : (ℝ × E) × C(Time 1, E)) : C(Time 1, E)
scaledPicardMap.exact_declaration:
def scaledPicardMap (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (p : (ℝ × E) × C(Time 1, E)) : C(Time 1, E) :=
  ContinuousMap.const (Time 1) p.1.2 + p.1.1 • volterra 1 (by norm_num)
    (superposition f hf p.2)

scaledPicardMap_contDiff.exact_header:
theorem scaledPicardMap_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (scaledPicardMap f hf.continuous)
scaledPicardMap_contDiff.exact_declaration:
theorem scaledPicardMap_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (scaledPicardMap f hf.continuous) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.const ℝ (Time 1) : E →L[ℝ] C(Time 1, E)).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)).add
    ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).smul
      ((volterra 1 (by norm_num)).contDiff.comp
        ((superposition_contDiff f hf).comp contDiff_snd)))

scaledPicardMap_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem scaledPicardMap_lipschitz (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (q : ℝ × E) (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hqc : |q.1| * (L : ℝ) ≤ c) :
    LipschitzWith c (fun v => scaledPicardMap f hf (q, v))
scaledPicardMap_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem scaledPicardMap_lipschitz (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f) (q : ℝ × E) (c : ℝ≥0)
    (hqc : |q.1| * (L : ℝ) ≤ c) :
    LipschitzWith c (fun v => scaledPicardMap f hf (q, v)) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro v w
  simp only [scaledPicardMap, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub,
    ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← map_sub]
  calc
    |q.1| * ‖volterra 1 (by norm_num) (superposition f hf v - superposition f hf w)‖
        ≤ |q.1| * (1 * ‖superposition f hf v - superposition f hf w‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (volterra_norm_le 1 (by norm_num) _) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ |q.1| * (L * ‖v - w‖) := by
      rw [one_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((superposition_lipschitz (Time 1) f hf L hLip).norm_sub_le v w) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ c * ‖v - w‖ := by
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqc (norm_nonneg _)

scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (q : ℝ × E) (τ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (q.1 * s, q.2)) (q.1 • f (Φ (q.1 * τ, q.2))) τ
scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (q : ℝ × E) (τ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (q.1 * s, q.2)) (q.1 • f (Φ (q.1 * τ, q.2))) τ := by
  simpa only [mul_one, Function.comp_def] using (hODE (q.1 * τ) q.2).scomp τ
    ((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul q.1)

scaledFlowCurve.exact_declaration:
def scaledFlowCurve (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (q : ℝ × E) : C(Time 1, E) :=
  ⟨fun τ => Φ (q.1 * τ, q.2),
    (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun τ =>
      (scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt Φ f hODE q τ).continuousAt)).comp continuous_subtype_val⟩

scaledFlowCurve_fixedPoint.exact_header:
theorem scaledFlowCurve_fixedPoint (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (q : ℝ × E) :
    scaledPicardMap f hf (q, scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q) = scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q
scaledFlowCurve_fixedPoint.exact_declaration:
theorem scaledFlowCurve_fixedPoint (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (q : ℝ × E) :
    scaledPicardMap f hf (q, scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q) = scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q := by
  ext τ
  change q.2 + q.1 • (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(τ : ℝ),
    extendCurve 1 (by norm_num) (superposition f hf (scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q)) s) =
      Φ (q.1 * τ, q.2)
  have hcon : Continuous (fun s => q.1 • f (Φ (q.1 * s, q.2))) :=
    continuous_const.smul (hf.comp (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
      (fun s => (scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt Φ f hODE q s).continuousAt)))
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
  have heq : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(τ : ℝ), q.1 •
      extendCurve 1 (by norm_num) (superposition f hf (scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE q)) s) =
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(τ : ℝ), q.1 • f (Φ (q.1 * s, q.2)) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    have hsT : s ∈ Time 1 :=
      Set.uIcc_subset_Icc (by constructor <;> norm_num) τ.property hs
    simp only [extendCurve, projIcc_of_mem _ hsT, superposition, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      scaledFlowCurve]
  rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun s _ => scaled_trajectory_hasDerivAt Φ f hODE q s) (hcon.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  simp only [mul_zero, hinit, add_sub_cancel]

flow_contDiffAt_short.exact_header:
theorem flow_contDiffAt_short [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (q : ℝ × E) (hshort : |q.1| * (L : ℝ) < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Φ q
flow_contDiffAt_short.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_contDiffAt_short [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (q : ℝ × E) (hshort : |q.1| * (L : ℝ) < 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Φ q := by
  let c : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(|q.1| * (L : ℝ) + 1) / 2, by positivity⟩
  have hc : c < 1 := by change (|q.1| * (L : ℝ) + 1) / 2 < 1; linarith
  have hlt : |q.1| * (L : ℝ) < c := by change _ < (_ + 1) / 2; linarith
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ p : ℝ × E in 𝓝 q, |p.1| * (L : ℝ) < c :=
    ((continuous_fst.abs.mul_const (L : ℝ)).continuousAt).eventually_lt continuousAt_const hlt
  have hLip' : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 q,
      LipschitzWith c (fun v => scaledPicardMap f hf.continuous (p, v)) := by
    filter_upwards [hnear] with p hp
    exact scaledPicardMap_lipschitz f hf.continuous L hLip p c hp.le
  have hcurve := fixedPoint_contDiffAt_of_eventually
    (scaledPicardMap f hf.continuous) (scaledFlowCurve Φ f hODE) q c hc hLip'
    (scaledFlowCurve_fixedPoint Φ f hf.continuous hODE hinit)
    (scaledPicardMap_contDiff f hf).contDiffAt
  have hfinal := ((ContinuousMap.evalCLM ℝ (⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ : Time 1) :
    C(Time 1, E) →L[ℝ] E).contDiff.contDiffAt).comp q hcurve
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousMap.evalCLM_apply, scaledFlowCurve,
    ContinuousMap.coe_mk, mul_one] using hfinal

flow_add.exact_header:
theorem flow_add (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Φ (t + s, x) = Φ (s, Φ (t, x))
flow_add.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_add (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Φ (t + s, x) = Φ (s, Φ (t, x)) := by
  have hshift (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun u => Φ (t + u, x))
      (f (Φ (t + s, x))) s := by
    simpa only [zero_add, one_smul, Function.comp_def] using (hODE (t + s) x).scomp s
      ((hasDerivAt_const s t).add (hasDerivAt_id s))
  have h := ODE_solution_unique_univ (v := fun _ => f) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
    (K := L) (t₀ := (0 : ℝ))
    (fun _ => hLip.lipschitzOnWith)
    (fun u => ⟨hshift u, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (fun u => ⟨hODE u (Φ (t, x)), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by simp only [add_zero, hinit])
  exact congrFun h s

flow_slice_contDiff.exact_header:
theorem flow_slice_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ (t, x))
flow_slice_contDiff.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_slice_contDiff [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ (t, x)) := by
  have hsmall (s : ℝ) (hs : |s| * (L : ℝ) < 1) :
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ (s, x)) := by
    apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
    intro x
    exact (flow_contDiffAt_short Φ f hf L hLip hODE hinit (s, x) hs).comp x
      (contDiffAt_const.prodMk contDiffAt_id)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 1 (|t| * (L : ℝ)))
  have hn0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    (le_of_lt ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hn))
  have hnL : |t| * (L : ℝ) < n := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hn
  let s := t / n
  have hs : |s| * (L : ℝ) < 1 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hn0, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_one hn0]
    exact hnL
  have hind (k : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ ((k : ℝ) * s, x)) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        have heq : (fun x : E => Φ (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s, x)) = id := by
          funext x
          change Φ (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s, x) = x
          simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] using hinit x
        rw [heq]
        exact contDiff_id
    | succ k ih =>
        have hc := (hsmall s hs).comp ih
        convert hc using 1
        ext x
        simp only [Function.comp_def]
        rw [← flow_add Φ f L hLip hODE hinit]
        apply congrArg (fun u : ℝ => Φ (u, x))
        push_cast
        ring
  have htime : (n : ℝ) * s = t := by dsimp [s]; field_simp
  simpa only [htime] using hind n

flow_contDiff_of_globalLip.exact_header:
theorem flow_contDiff_of_globalLip [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ
flow_contDiff_of_globalLip.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_contDiff_of_globalLip [ProperSpace E] (Φ : ℝ × E → E)
    (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (L : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro q
  have hinner : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × E => (p.1 - q.1, Φ (q.1, p.2))) :=
    (contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).prodMk
      ((flow_slice_contDiff Φ f hf L hLip hODE hinit q.1).comp contDiff_snd)
  have hout := flow_contDiffAt_short Φ f hf L hLip hODE hinit
    (0, Φ (q.1, q.2)) (by simp)
  have hfinal : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × E => Φ (p.1 - q.1, Φ (q.1, p.2))) q := by
    have hout' : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Φ (q.1 - q.1, Φ (q.1, q.2)) := by
      simpa only [sub_self] using hout
    exact hout'.comp q hinner.contDiffAt
  convert hfinal using 1
  ext p
  rw [← flow_add Φ f L hLip hODE hinit]
  apply congrArg (fun u : ℝ => Φ (u, p.2))
  ring

theorem phase_flow_fderiv_det_one_globalLip
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι) (L : ℝ≥0)

/-! # A globally Lipschitz C¹ field agreeing near a compact orbit

A compactly supported smooth scalar cutoff leaves the vector field unchanged
on an open neighborhood of the compact set. The cut-off field is C¹ and its
global Lipschitz constant is derived from the compact support of its actual
derivative. This is a localization tool, not a global Lipschitz assumption on
the original field.
-/
noncomputable section
open Set Metric
open scoped NNReal ContDiff
namespace PBGSO

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- A primitive C¹ field has a C¹ globally Lipschitz replacement agreeing on
an open neighborhood of any given compact set. -/

end PBGSO

exists_global_lipschitz_C1_cutoff.exact_header:
theorem exists_global_lipschitz_C1_cutoff (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ (g : E → F) (L : ℝ≥0) (U : Set E),
      IsOpen U ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ EqOn g f U ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧
        LipschitzWith L g ∧ HasCompactSupport g
exists_global_lipschitz_C1_cutoff.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_global_lipschitz_C1_cutoff (f : E → F) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ (g : E → F) (L : ℝ≥0) (U : Set E),
      IsOpen U ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ EqOn g f U ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧
        LipschitzWith L g ∧ HasCompactSupport g := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_ball (0 : E)
  let r : ℝ := max R 1
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  let b : ContDiffBump (0 : E) :=
    { rIn := r
      rOut := r + 1
      rIn_pos := hr
      rIn_lt_rOut := by linarith }
  let g : E → F := fun x => b x • f x
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ 1 g := b.contDiff.smul hf
  have hs : HasCompactSupport g := b.hasCompactSupport.smul_right
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hc.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hs (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨g, L, ball 0 r, isOpen_ball, ?_, ?_, hc, hL, hs⟩
  · exact hR.trans (ball_subset_ball (le_max_left _ _))
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [g]
    rw [b.one_of_mem_closedBall (ball_subset_closedBall hx), one_smul]

trajectories_unique_Icc.exact_header:
theorem trajectories_unique_Icc (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (a b t₀ : ℝ) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo a b) (u v : ℝ → E)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc a b))
    (hu' : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt u (f (u t)) t)
    (hv' : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt v (f (v t)) t)
    (heq : u t₀ = v t₀) : EqOn u v (Icc a b)
trajectories_unique_Icc.exact_declaration:
theorem trajectories_unique_Icc (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (a b t₀ : ℝ) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Ioo a b) (u v : ℝ → E)
    (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc a b)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc a b))
    (hu' : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt u (f (u t)) t)
    (hv' : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt v (f (v t)) t)
    (heq : u t₀ = v t₀) : EqOn u v (Icc a b) := by
  obtain ⟨Cu, hCu⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hu
  obtain ⟨Cv, hCv⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hv
  let R := max Cu Cv
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (hf.contDiffOn (s := closedBall (0 : E) R)).exists_lipschitzOnWith
    (by norm_num) (convex_closedBall _ _) (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
  have humem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b) : u t ∈ closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
      (hCu t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).trans (le_max_left Cu Cv)
  have hvmem (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo a b) : v t ∈ closedBall (0 : E) R := by
    simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using
      (hCv t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).trans (le_max_right Cu Cv)
  exact ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun _ => f)
    (s := fun _ => closedBall (0 : E) R) (fun _ _ => hL) ht₀
    hu hu' humem hv hv' hvmem heq

flow_contDiff_of_cutoff_solutions.exact_header:
theorem flow_contDiff_of_cutoff_solutions
    (hExists : ∀ (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → LipschitzWith L g →
      ∃ Ψ : ℝ × E → E,
        (∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ (s, x)) (g (Ψ (t, x))) t) ∧
        (∀ x, Ψ (0, x) = x))
    (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ
flow_contDiff_of_cutoff_solutions.exact_declaration:
theorem flow_contDiff_of_cutoff_solutions
    (hExists : ∀ (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → LipschitzWith L g →
      ∃ Ψ : ℝ × E → E,
        (∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ (s, x)) (g (Ψ (t, x))) t) ∧
        (∀ x, Ψ (0, x) = x))
    (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro q
  let a := min 0 q.1 - 1
  let b := max 0 q.1 + 1
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo a b := by
    constructor <;> dsimp [a, b] <;> linarith [min_le_left (0 : ℝ) q.1, le_max_left (0 : ℝ) q.1]
  have hq : q.1 ∈ Ioo a b := by
    constructor <;> dsimp [a, b] <;> linarith [min_le_right (0 : ℝ) q.1, le_max_right (0 : ℝ) q.1]
  have htime (x : E) : Continuous (fun t => Φ (t, x)) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => (hODE t x).continuousAt)
  let K := (fun t => Φ (t, q.2)) '' Icc a b
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.image (htime q.2)
  obtain ⟨g, L, U, hU, hKU, hgf, hg, hLip, _⟩ :=
    exists_global_lipschitz_C1_cutoff f hf K hK
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨODE, hΨinit⟩ := hExists g L hg hLip
  have hΨ : ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ := FlowDifferentiability.flow_contDiff_of_globalLip
    Ψ g hg L hLip hΨODE hΨinit
  have hEqbase : EqOn (fun t => Ψ (t, q.2)) (fun t => Φ (t, q.2)) (Icc a b) := by
    apply ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun _ => g) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
      (K := L) (fun _ _ => hLip.lipschitzOnWith) hzero
      (fun t _ => (hΨODE t q.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => hΨODE t q.2) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      (htime q.2).continuousOn
      (fun t ht => ?_) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (by rw [hΨinit, hinit])
    rw [hgf (hKU (mem_image_of_mem _ (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)))]
    exact hODE t q.2
  let curried : C(E, C(ℝ, E)) :=
    (⟨fun p : E × ℝ => Ψ (p.2, p.1), hΨ.continuous.comp continuous_swap⟩ :
      C(E × ℝ, E)).curry
  have hbase : MapsTo (curried q.2) (Icc a b) U := by
    intro t ht
    change Ψ (t, q.2) ∈ U
    have heqpoint : Ψ (t, q.2) = Φ (t, q.2) := hEqbase ht
    rw [heqpoint]
    exact hKU (mem_image_of_mem _ ht)
  have htube : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q.2, MapsTo (curried x) (Icc a b) U :=
    (curried.continuous.tendsto q.2).eventually
      (ContinuousMap.eventually_mapsTo isCompact_Icc hU hbase)
  have hEqnear : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q.2,
      EqOn (fun t => Φ (t, x)) (fun t => Ψ (t, x)) (Icc a b) := by
    filter_upwards [htube] with x hx
    apply trajectories_unique_Icc f hf a b 0 hzero _ _ (htime x).continuousOn
      (fun t _ => (hΨODE t x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => hODE t x) (fun t ht => ?_) (by rw [hinit, hΨinit])
    have hmem : Ψ (t, x) ∈ U := hx (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
    rw [← hgf hmem]
    exact hΨODE t x
  have hEqlocal : Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 q] Ψ := by
    filter_upwards [continuousAt_fst.eventually (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hq),
      continuousAt_snd.eventually hEqnear] with p hp hx
    exact hx (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp)
  exact hΨ.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hEqlocal

flow_contDiff.exact_header:
theorem flow_contDiff (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)

theorem flow_contDiff (Φ : ℝ × E → E) (f : E → E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ := by

theorem divergenceFree_flow_fderiv_det_one
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hdiv : ∀ x, (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f x)).trace = 0)
    (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)

divergenceFree_flow_fderiv_det_one.exact_declaration:
theorem divergenceFree_flow_fderiv_det_one
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hdiv : ∀ x, (derivativeMatrix (fderiv ℝ f x)).trace = 0)
    (Φ : ℝ × (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ))
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t)
    (hinit : ∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) (t : ℝ) (x : κ → ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (t, y)) x).det = 1 := by
  have hΦ := flow_contDiff Φ f hf hODE hinit
  rw [← derivativeMatrix_det,
    ← flowJacobian_eq_derivativeMatrix Φ (hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num))]
  have hJ := flowJacobian_hasDeriv_C1 Φ f hΦ hf hODE hinit
  have h := det_eq_initial_of_variational (fun s => flowJacobian Φ s x)

    (fun s => hJ s x) (fun s => hdiv (Φ (s, x))) t
  rw [flowJacobian_initial Φ (hΦ.differentiable (by norm_num)) hinit x, Matrix.det_one] at h
  exact h

phase_flow_fderiv_det_one_source.exact_declaration:
theorem phase_flow_fderiv_det_one_source
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F)
    (Φ : ℝ × Phase ι → Phase ι)
    (hODE : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, x)) (phaseField F (Φ (t, x))) t)

`Model` has independent optimiser, parameter, sampler, observation and noise

optimiser state. Bounds use `0 < N`, since no gradient estimate exists for an

/-- The sampler empirical measure. At positive population size its total
mass is one; zero population is excluded by all sampling estimates. -/

HasFiniteSecondMoment.exact_declaration:
def HasFiniteSecondMoment (ν : Measure Z) : Prop :=
  Integrable (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2) ν

Model.exact_header:
structure Model (S Θ Z X I : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
Model.exact_declaration:
structure Model (S Θ Z X I : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] where
  parameter : S → Θ
  position : Z → X
  observation : Θ → X → Θ
  optimizer : ℝ → S → Θ → S
  drift : Θ → Z → Z
  diffusion : Θ → Z → I → Z

meanGradient.exact_header: def meanGradient (ν : Measure Z) (s : S) : Θ
meanGradient.exact_declaration:
def meanGradient (ν : Measure Z) (s : S) : Θ :=
  ∫ z, M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z) ∂ν

optimizerField.exact_header: def optimizerField (t : ℝ) (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) : S
optimizerField.exact_declaration:
def optimizerField (t : ℝ) (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) : S :=
  M.optimizer t s (M.meanGradient ν s)

particleGradient.exact_header: def particleGradient (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) : Θ
particleGradient.exact_declaration:
def particleGradient (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) : Θ :=
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position (z i))

empiricalLaw.exact_header: def empiricalLaw (N : ℕ) (z : Fin N → Z) : Measure Z
empiricalLaw.exact_declaration:
def empiricalLaw (N : ℕ) (z : Fin N → Z) : Measure Z :=
  (N : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (z i)

meanGradient_empirical.exact_header:
theorem meanGradient_empirical [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [CompleteSpace Θ]
    (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) :
    M.meanGradient (empiricalLaw N z) s = M.particleGradient N s z
meanGradient_empirical.exact_declaration:
theorem meanGradient_empirical [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [CompleteSpace Θ]
    (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) :
    M.meanGradient (empiricalLaw N z) s = M.particleGradient N s z := by
  classical
  unfold meanGradient empiricalLaw particleGradient
  rw [integral_smul_measure]
  rw [integral_finsetSum_measure
    (fun i _ => integrable_dirac (by simp))]
  simp

meanGradient_of_marginal.exact_header:
theorem meanGradient_of_marginal [MeasurableSpace X]
    (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) (π : Measure X)
    (hposition : AEMeasurable M.position ν)
    (hmarginal : ν.map M.position = π)
    (hobs : AEStronglyMeasurable (M.observation (M.parameter s)) π) :
    M.meanGradient ν s = ∫ x, M.observation (M.parameter s) x ∂π
meanGradient_of_marginal.exact_declaration:
theorem meanGradient_of_marginal [MeasurableSpace X]
    (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) (π : Measure X)
    (hposition : AEMeasurable M.position ν)
    (hmarginal : ν.map M.position = π)
    (hobs : AEStronglyMeasurable (M.observation (M.parameter s)) π) :
    M.meanGradient ν s = ∫ x, M.observation (M.parameter s) x ∂π := by
  rw [meanGradient, ← hmarginal]
  exact (integral_map hposition (hmarginal ▸ hobs)).symm

empiricalLaw_probability.exact_header:
theorem empiricalLaw_probability (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (z : Fin N → Z) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (empiricalLaw N z)
empiricalLaw_probability.exact_declaration:
theorem empiricalLaw_probability (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (z : Fin N → Z) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (empiricalLaw N z) := by
  constructor
  simp [empiricalLaw]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by exact_mod_cast hN.ne') (by simp)

particleField.exact_header: def particleField (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) : S
particleField.exact_declaration:
def particleField (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z) : S :=
  M.optimizer t s (M.particleGradient N s z)

particleEulerStep.exact_header:
def particleEulerStep (N : ℕ) (t h : ℝ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z)
    (noise : Fin N → I → ℝ) : S × (Fin N → Z)
particleEulerStep.exact_declaration:
def particleEulerStep (N : ℕ) (t h : ℝ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z)
    (noise : Fin N → I → ℝ) : S × (Fin N → Z) :=
  (s + h • M.particleField N t s z,
   fun i => z i + h • M.drift (M.parameter s) (z i) +
     ∑ j, noise i j • M.diffusion (M.parameter s) (z i) j)

generator.exact_header: def generator (θ : Θ) (φ : Z → ℝ) (z : Z) : ℝ
generator.exact_declaration:
def generator (θ : Θ) (φ : Z → ℝ) (z : Z) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ φ z (M.drift θ z) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i,
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) z (M.diffusion θ z i)) (M.diffusion θ z i)

IsWeakSolution.exact_header:
structure IsWeakSolution (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (s : ℝ → S)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) : Prop
IsWeakSolution.exact_declaration:
structure IsWeakSolution (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (s : ℝ → S)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) : Prop where
  probability : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)
  second_moment : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasFiniteSecondMoment (ν t)
  gradient_integrable : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (s t)) (M.position z)) (ν t)
  optimizer_ode : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    HasDerivWithinAt s (M.optimizerField t (s t) (ν t)) (Ici 0) t
  test_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ tests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Integrable φ (ν t)
  generator_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ tests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    Integrable (M.generator (M.parameter (s t)) φ) (ν t)
  forward_equation : ∀ φ ∈ tests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => ∫ z, φ z ∂ν r)
      (∫ z, M.generator (M.parameter (s t)) φ z ∂ν t) (Ici 0) t

FrozenStationary.exact_header: structure FrozenStationary (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (θ : Θ) (ν : Measure Z) : Prop
FrozenStationary.exact_declaration:
structure FrozenStationary (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (θ : Θ) (ν : Measure Z) : Prop where
  probability : IsProbabilityMeasure ν
  second_moment : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν
  test_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ tests, Integrable φ ν
  generator_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ tests, Integrable (M.generator θ φ) ν
  generator_zero : ∀ φ ∈ tests, (∫ z, M.generator θ φ z ∂ν) = 0

constant_isWeakSolution.exact_header:
theorem constant_isWeakSolution (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hν : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) :
    M.IsWeakSolution tests (fun _ => sStar) (fun _ => νStar)
constant_isWeakSolution.exact_declaration:
theorem constant_isWeakSolution (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hν : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) :
    M.IsWeakSolution tests (fun _ => sStar) (fun _ => νStar) where
  probability := fun _ _ => hν.probability
  second_moment := fun _ _ => hν.second_moment
  gradient_integrable := fun _ _ => hint
  optimizer_ode := by
    intro t ht
    simpa [optimizerField, hg, hfix t ht] using
      (hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Ici (0 : ℝ)) sStar)
  test_integrable := fun φ hφ _ _ => hν.test_integrable φ hφ
  generator_integrable := fun φ hφ _ _ => hν.generator_integrable φ hφ
  forward_equation := by
    intro φ hφ t ht
    simpa [hν.generator_zero φ hφ] using
      (hasDerivWithinAt_const t (Ici (0 : ℝ)) (∫ z, φ z ∂νStar))

stationary_of_frozen.exact_header:
theorem stationary_of_frozen (tests : Set (Z → ℝ))
    (hunique : M.WeakUniqueness tests) (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hν : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (s : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hsol : M.IsWeakSolution tests s ν)
    (hs : s 0 = sStar) (hn : ν 0 = νStar) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    s t = sStar ∧ ν t = νStar
stationary_of_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_of_frozen (tests : Set (Z → ℝ))
    (hunique : M.WeakUniqueness tests) (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hν : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (s : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hsol : M.IsWeakSolution tests s ν)
    (hs : s 0 = sStar) (hn : ν 0 = νStar) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    s t = sStar ∧ ν t = νStar :=
  hunique s ν (fun _ => sStar) (fun _ => νStar) hsol
    (M.constant_isWeakSolution tests sStar νStar hν hint hg hfix) hs hn t ht

meanGradient_zero_of_gradient_identity.exact_header:
theorem meanGradient_zero_of_gradient_identity
    (loss : Θ → ℝ) [InnerProductSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hid : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = gradient loss (M.parameter sStar))
    (hcritical : gradient loss (M.parameter sStar) = 0) :
    M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0
meanGradient_zero_of_gradient_identity.exact_declaration:
theorem meanGradient_zero_of_gradient_identity
    (loss : Θ → ℝ) [InnerProductSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hid : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = gradient loss (M.parameter sStar))
    (hcritical : gradient loss (M.parameter sStar) = 0) :
    M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0 := hid.trans hcritical

particleGradient_perm.exact_header:
theorem particleGradient_perm (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
    M.particleGradient N s (z ∘ e) = M.particleGradient N s z
particleGradient_perm.exact_declaration:
theorem particleGradient_perm (N : ℕ) (s : S) (z : Fin N → Z)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
    M.particleGradient N s (z ∘ e) = M.particleGradient N s z := by
  unfold particleGradient
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Symmetric
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Add
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ExpDeriv
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Automatic skew correction in the general frozen sampler

The manuscript's double-divergence identity for `Q exp(-H)` is proved here
from skew symmetry and C² regularity. This establishes the local differential
cancellation. Normalisation, integration by parts, nonexplosion and the
identification of stationary Fokker--Planck solutions with invariant process
laws remain separate analytic requirements.
-/

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators
namespace PBGSO

variable {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- A finite double sum of a skew-symmetric real array is zero. -/

/-- The second Fréchet derivative respects negation, including at points
where derivatives use Mathlib's totalised convention. -/

/-- Mixed derivatives commute for each C² component. Their finite
contraction against a skew-symmetric field therefore vanishes. -/

/-- The exact skew double-divergence cancellation in the manuscript's
generalised Langevin construction. Taking `v` to be coordinate basis
vectors gives the stated sum of mixed partial derivatives. -/

end PBGSO

sum_skew_eq_zero.exact_header:
theorem sum_skew_eq_zero (A : I → I → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = -A j i) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j = 0
sum_skew_eq_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem sum_skew_eq_zero (A : I → I → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = -A j i) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j = 0 := by
  have h : (∑ i, ∑ j, A i j) = -(∑ i, ∑ j, A i j) := by
    calc
      (∑ i, ∑ j, A i j) = ∑ j, ∑ i, A i j := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, -A j i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact hA i j
      _ = -(∑ i, ∑ j, A i j) := by simp
  linarith

second_fderiv_neg.exact_header:
theorem second_fderiv_neg (f : E → ℝ) (z u v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (-f)) z u v =
      -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u v)
second_fderiv_neg.exact_declaration:
theorem second_fderiv_neg (f : E → ℝ) (z u v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (-f)) z u v =
      -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u v) := by
  have h : fderiv ℝ (-f) = -(fderiv ℝ f) :=
    funext fun x => fderiv_neg
  rw [h, fderiv_neg]
  rfl

skew_second_divergence_zero.exact_header:
theorem skew_second_divergence_zero (A : I → I → E → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A i j))
    (hskew : ∀ i j z, A i j z = -A j i z) (z : E) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (A i j)) z (v i) (v j) = 0
skew_second_divergence_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem skew_second_divergence_zero (A : I → I → E → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (hA : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A i j))
    (hskew : ∀ i j z, A i j z = -A j i z) (z : E) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (A i j)) z (v i) (v j) = 0 := by
  apply sum_skew_eq_zero
  intro i j
  have hfun : A i j = -(A j i) := funext fun x => hskew i j x
  rw [hfun, second_fderiv_neg]
  congr 1
  exact ((hA j i).contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num)).eq (v i) (v j)

skew_gibbs_second_divergence_zero.exact_header:
theorem skew_gibbs_second_divergence_zero
    (Q : I → I → E → ℝ) (H : E → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (Q i j)) (hH : ContDiff ℝ 2 H)
    (hskew : ∀ i j z, Q i j z = -Q j i z) (z : E) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => Q i j x * Real.exp (-H x))) z
        (v i) (v j) = 0
skew_gibbs_second_divergence_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem skew_gibbs_second_divergence_zero
    (Q : I → I → E → ℝ) (H : E → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (Q i j)) (hH : ContDiff ℝ 2 H)
    (hskew : ∀ i j z, Q i j z = -Q j i z) (z : E) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => Q i j x * Real.exp (-H x))) z
        (v i) (v j) = 0 := by
  apply skew_second_divergence_zero
  · intro i j
    exact (hQ i j).mul hH.neg.exp
  · intro i j x
    rw [hskew i j x]
    ring

physical_column_eq.exact_header:
theorem physical_column_eq (α γ : ℝ) (a : A)
    (z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)) (i : J) :

    (νStar : Measure (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (aStar : A)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) νStar hνStar aStar (input α))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ)
    (hg : (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G C : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ 1 → n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T →
        ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) aStar‖ ≤
        higherOrderDiscretizationBudget (Fin N × J) D α γ G
          (G + γ * P + (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G) P P C h 0 n +
        (Real.sqrt Geo.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))) *
          optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +

            (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ)))))
parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem parameter_bound
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (νStar : Measure (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (aStar : A)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) νStar hνStar aStar (input α))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ)
    (hg : (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G C : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ 1 → n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T →
        ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) aStar‖ ≤
        higherOrderDiscretizationBudget (Fin N × J) D α γ G
          (G + γ * P + (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G) P P C h 0 n +
        (Real.sqrt Geo.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))) *
          optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
          (1 / ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geo.conditionNumber * Variance / (N : ℝ)) *
            (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))))) := by
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let hf := ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N
  let L := higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ
  let M := sourceModel D α γ
  let H := higherOrder_compatibility D.F D.G D.parameterLip D.samplerLip
    D.parameter_bound D.sampler_bound α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α)
  let Part := particle D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance
  have hYeq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Part.state t - Part.state 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Part.state r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N
        (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α))
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf)
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf) 0 t := by
    intro t ht
    have he := Part.equation t ht
    dsimp only [input] at he
    rw [ParticleBrownianInput.packed_input_eq] at he
    exact he
  obtain ⟨P, G, C, hP, hG, hC, hrefs⟩ :=
    MethodSegments.exists_higherOrderReference_of_particle_integral Q hf D hcloud α γ hα hγ
      Part.state Part.continuous hYeq T
  refine ⟨P, G, C, hP, hG, hC, ?_⟩
  intro h n hh hh1 hn
  obtain ⟨Ref, hRef⟩ := hrefs h n hh hh1 hn
  have hparam := higherOrder_parameter_lipschitz D.F D.G α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α)
  have hcoordinate : (Ref.r n 0).1 = Part.parameter hparam (n * (h : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hRef]
    simp only [add_zero]
    exact higherOrderUnpackLp_parameter Q D α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α) _
  have hbound := hol_mypgd_constructed_parameter_bound L M H Geo μ hμ a
    (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) N D.nonempty Variance hVariance
    νStar hνStar aStar Frozen ρ hρ hmono hparam hg
    (by intros; exact neg_zero) hV D Ref
    (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) hcoordinate
  have hinit : Ref.r 0 0 = initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance := by
    rw [hRef]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hinit] at hbound
  have hm : M.parameter aStar = aStar := rfl
  have hl : (L.responseLip : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
  rw [hm, hl] at hbound
  simpa only [holError, sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] using hbound

theorem numerical_parameter_bound
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)

    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (model D γ) Geometry ρ)
    (hg : (model D γ).meanGradient νStar (targetState star) = 0)

      ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * h ≤ T →

          (particleBrownian (J := J) μ N) (particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N)
          D γ h (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).2.1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) star‖ ≤
        momentumDiscretizationBudget D γ h R P (G + γ * P) 0 n +
        (Real.sqrt Geometry.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * h)) *
          optimizerLawDistance a (targetState star) μ νStar +
          ((2 + γ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geometry.conditionNumber * Variance / (N : ℝ)) *

  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let W := particleBrownian (J := J) μ N
  let hW := particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N
  let L := momentumForceDynamics D γ
  let M := model D γ
  let H := compatibility D γ

  let Y : ℝ → Lp (HypocoercivePhase A × (Fin N → HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q := Ptc.state
  have hY : Continuous Y := Ptc.continuous
  have heq (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Y t - Y 0 =

      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N

    exact (Ptc.equation t ht).trans (congrArg (fun b =>
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) + b)
      (ParticleBrownianInput.packed_input_eq μ N (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ) 0 t))
  obtain ⟨P, G, R, hP, hG, hR, refs⟩ := exists_momentum_references_from_source Q W hW D hcloud γ hγ Y hY heq
    (particleBrownian_grid_paths_independent (J := J) μ N) T
  refine ⟨P, G, R, hP, hG, hR, ?_⟩
  intro h hh hh1 n hn
  obtain ⟨Ref, href⟩ := refs h hh hh1 n hn
  let hp := momentum_parameter_lipschitz D.F D.G γ (diffusionColumns γ)
  have hcoord : (Ref.q n 0).1 = Ptc.parameter hp (n * h) := by
    rw [(href n 0).2]
    simp only [add_zero]
    exact momentumUnpackLp_parameter Q D γ (diffusionColumns γ) (Y (n * h))
  have hbound := m_mfpo_constructed_parameter_bound L M H Geometry μ hμ a
    (input γ) (input_continuous γ) (input_zero γ) N D.nonempty Variance hVariance
    νStar hνStar (targetState star) Frozen ρ hρ hmono hp hg (fun t _ ↦ target_fixed D γ star t) hV
    D Ref (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) hcoord
  have href0 : (Ref.p 0 0, Ref.q 0 0) = initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, initial, Y, Ptc] using (href 0 0).1
    · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, initial, Y, Ptc] using (href 0 0).2
  have he0 : phaseError (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) (Ref.p 0 0, Ref.q 0 0) = 0 := by
    rw [href0]
    simp [phaseError]
  have hstar : M.parameter (targetState star) = star := rfl
  have hresponse : (L.responseLip : ℝ) = 2 + γ := by
    change 2 + ‖γ‖ = 2 + γ
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hγ]
  simpa only [he0, hstar, hresponse] using hbound

The original source A3 constructs the complete empirical metric. Actual
particle integral dynamics, exact restarts, printed Gaussian innovations,
local defects, reference moments and numerical stability are all derived.
The numerical error is uniform over every iteration on a strictly positive
explicit small-step interval. No common force potential is required.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
set_option maxHeartbeats 900000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace

variable {A J : Type*} {N : ℕ}
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [MeasurableSpace A] [BorelSpace A] [SecondCountableTopology A]
  [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  (D : ParticleForceData A (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) N)



variable (α γ : ℝ) (Geo : TwistedGeometry A (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)))

  (Variance : ℝ)
  (hVariance : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r →
    (∫ z, ‖(sourceModel D α γ).observation
      ((sourceModel D α γ).parameter (AdditiveCanonical.optimizer
        (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ)
        μ hμ a (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) r))
      ((sourceModel D α γ).position z) -
      (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient (AdditiveCanonical.law
        (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ)
        μ hμ a (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) r)
        (AdditiveCanonical.optimizer (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
          (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) μ hμ a
          (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) r)‖ ^ 2
      ∂AdditiveCanonical.law (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
        (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) μ hμ a
        (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) r) ≤ Variance)

metricCoercivity.exact_declaration: def metricCoercivity : ℝ := Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N Geo) / 2

metricUpper.exact_declaration: def metricUpper : ℝ := 2 * Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N Geo)

localConstant0.exact_declaration:
def localConstant0 : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  holUniformLocalConstant0 (Fin N × J) α γ D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip
    ‖D.meanForceLp Q 0 0‖ ‖D.samplerForceLp Q 0 0‖
    ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ 0‖

localConstant1.exact_declaration:
def localConstant1 : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip
    ‖D.meanForceLp Q 0 0‖ ‖D.samplerForceLp Q 0 0‖

noiseRadius.exact_declaration: def noiseRadius : ℝ := holUniformNoiseRadius (Fin N × J) α

zeroStartRadius.exact_declaration:
def zeroStartRadius : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  UniformIntegral.radius (holDriftGlobalLip D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip α γ)
    ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ 0‖
    (noiseRadius (N := N) (J := J) α) 0

zeroStartMoment.exact_declaration: def zeroStartMoment : ℝ := metricUpper (N := N) Geo * zeroStartRadius D α γ μ

referenceRadius.exact_declaration:
def referenceRadius (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let S := zeroStartMoment D α γ Geo μ
  metricUpper (N := N) Geo * ‖initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance‖ +
    S / (1 - Real.exp (-ρ)) + S

radiusGrowth.exact_declaration:
def radiusGrowth : ℝ :=
  metricUpper (N := N) Geo * localConstant1 D α γ μ / metricCoercivity (N := N) Geo

discretizationConstant.exact_declaration:
def discretizationConstant (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (4 * (metricUpper (N := N) Geo * localConstant0 D α γ μ +
    radiusGrowth D α γ Geo μ * referenceRadius D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ) / ρ) /
      metricCoercivity (N := N) Geo

maximumStep.exact_declaration: def maximumStep (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ := UniformStep.maximumStep ρ (radiusGrowth D α γ Geo μ)

explicit_discretization_guarantee.exact_header:
theorem explicit_discretization_guarantee [FiniteDimensional ℝ A]
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ) :
    0 < maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ ∧
      0 ≤ discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ →
        ‖higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n -
          higherOrderUnpackLp (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) D
            ((particle D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance).state (n * (h : ℝ)))‖ ≤
          discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)
explicit_discretization_guarantee.exact_declaration:
theorem explicit_discretization_guarantee [FiniteDimensional ℝ A]
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ) :
    0 < maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ ∧
      0 ≤ discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ →
        ‖higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n -
          higherOrderUnpackLp (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) D
            ((particle D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance).state (n * (h : ℝ)))‖ ≤
          discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let hf := ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N
  let L := higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ
  let M := sourceModel D α γ
  let H := higherOrder_compatibility D.F D.G D.parameterLip D.samplerLip
    D.parameter_bound D.sampler_bound α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α)
  let Part := particle D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance
  let U := higherOrderUnpackLp Q D
  let Y := fun t : ℝ ↦ U (Part.state t)
  have hY : Continuous Y := U.continuous.comp Part.continuous
  have hYeq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Part.state t - Part.state 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Part.state r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N
        (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α))
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf)
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf) 0 t := by
    intro t ht
    have he := Part.equation t ht
    dsimp only [input] at he
    rw [ParticleBrownianInput.packed_input_eq] at he
    exact he
  have hraw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (Y r)) +
        higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0 t := by
    intro t ht
    have he := higherOrderUnpackLp_integral Q D α γ Part.state
      (samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N
        (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α))
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf)
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf) 0)
      Part.continuous hYeq t ht
    rw [higherOrderUnpackLp_brownian Q D hcloud] at he
    exact he
  obtain ⟨dim, C, hcoerc, hupper, hCmono⟩ := MethodMetricComparisons.higherOrder_metric_explicit Q D hcloud α γ
    (physicalColumns (J := J) α) Geo ρ hmono
  let m := Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N Geo) / 2
  let Upper := 2 * Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N Geo)
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (EmpiricalMetric.lower_pos N D.nonempty Geo)) (by positivity)
  have hUpper : 0 ≤ Upper := by dsimp [Upper]; positivity
  have hCnorm : ‖C‖ ≤ Upper := C.opNorm_le_bound hUpper hupper
  let f₀ := ‖D.meanForceLp Q 0 0‖
  let g₀ := ‖D.samplerForceLp Q 0 0‖
  let b₀ := ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ 0‖
  let c₀ := holUniformLocalConstant0 (Fin N × J) α γ D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip f₀ g₀ b₀
  let c₁ := holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip f₀ g₀
  let Lip := holDriftGlobalLip D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip α γ
  let Ξ := holUniformNoiseRadius (Fin N × J) α
  let P₀ := UniformIntegral.radius Lip b₀ Ξ 0
  let S := Upper * P₀
  let R := Upper * ‖Y 0‖ + S / (1 - Real.exp (-ρ)) + S
  let b := Upper * c₁ / m
  let K := (4 * (Upper * c₀ + b * R) / ρ) / m
  have hc := holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg (Fin N × J) α γ D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip
    f₀ g₀ b₀ hα hγ D.meanLip.coe_nonneg D.samplerForceLip.coe_nonneg
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hc₀ : 0 ≤ c₀ := hc.1
  have hc₁ : 0 ≤ c₁ := hc.2
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hP₀ : 0 ≤ P₀ := by
    exact UniformIntegral.radius_nonneg Lip (norm_nonneg _)
      (by dsimp [Ξ, holUniformNoiseRadius]; positivity) (le_refl 0)
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := mul_nonneg hUpper hP₀
  have hgap : 0 < 1 - Real.exp (-ρ) := sub_pos.mpr (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith))
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hactualR : holUniformReferenceRadius
      (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ) Lip C ρ Ξ (Y 0) ≤ R := by
    have hs : ‖C‖ * P₀ ≤ S := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm hP₀
    exact add_le_add (add_le_add (hupper (Y 0))
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hs hgap.le)) hs
  have hab : ‖C‖ * c₁ / m ≤ b :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm hc₁) hm.le
  change 0 < UniformStep.maximumStep ρ b ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ _
  refine ⟨UniformStep.maximumStep_pos ρ b hρ hb, hK, ?_⟩
  intro h n hh hhmax
  obtain ⟨hh1, hρh, hsmall⟩ := UniformStep.admissible ρ b h hρ hb hh hhmax
  have hsmallC : (‖C‖ * c₁ / m) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ≤ ρ / 4 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans hsmall
  have hnum := higherOrder_time_uniform_of_integral Q hf
    (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) D.meanLip D.samplerForceLip α γ
    D.meanLip.coe_nonneg D.samplerForceLip.coe_nonneg
    (D.meanForceLp_bound Q) (D.samplerForceLp_bound Q) hα hγ C m ρ hm hρ hcoerc hCmono
    Y hY hraw h hh hh1 hρh hsmallC n
  have hdisc : ‖higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J) Q hf D α γ h
      (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n - Y ((n : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))‖ ≤
      K * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
    apply hnum.trans
    have hRactual0 : 0 ≤ holUniformReferenceRadius
        (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ) Lip C ρ Ξ (Y 0) := by
      dsimp [holUniformReferenceRadius]
      positivity
    have hbudget : ‖C‖ * c₀ + (‖C‖ * c₁ / m) *
        holUniformReferenceRadius (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ)
          Lip C ρ Ξ (Y 0) ≤ Upper * c₀ + b * R := by
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm hc₀)
        (mul_le_mul hab hactualR hRactual0 hb)
    calc
      _ ≤ ((4 * (Upper * c₀ + b * R) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)) / m := by gcongr
      _ = K * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by dsimp [K]; ring
  exact hdisc
