    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (aStar : A)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) νStar hνStar aStar (input α))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ)
    (hg : (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ))
    (hhstep : (h : ℝ) ≤ maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ) :
        ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) aStar‖ ≤
        discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) +
        (Real.sqrt Geo.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))) *
          optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
          (1 / ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geo.conditionNumber * Variance / (N : ℝ)) *
            (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))))) := by
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let hf := ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N
  let L := higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ
  let M := sourceModel D α γ
  let H := higherOrder_compatibility D.F D.G D.parameterLip D.samplerLip
    D.parameter_bound D.sampler_bound α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α)
  let Part := particle D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance
  let Y := fun t : ℝ ↦ higherOrderUnpackLp Q D (Part.state t)
  let K := discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ
  have hdisc := explicit_discretization_bound D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance
    hcloud hα hγ ρ hρ hmono h n hh hhstep
  have hparam := higherOrder_parameter_lipschitz D.F D.G α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α)
  have hcparam := AdditiveConstructed.parameter_bound (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
    L M H Geo μ hμ a (input α) (input_continuous α) (input_zero α) N D.nonempty
    Variance hVariance νStar hνStar aStar Frozen ρ hρ hmono hparam hg
    (by intros; exact neg_zero) hV (n * (h : ℝ)) (by positivity)
  have hcoordinate : (Y (n * (h : ℝ))).1 = Part.parameter hparam (n * (h : ℝ)) :=
    higherOrderUnpackLp_parameter Q D α γ (physicalColumns (J := J) α) _
  change ‖Part.parameter hparam (n * (h : ℝ)) - Lp.const 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)))
      (M.parameter aStar)‖ ≤ _ at hcparam
  rw [← hcoordinate] at hcparam
  have hidentity : M.parameter aStar = aStar := rfl
  have hresponse : (L.responseLip : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
  rw [hidentity, hresponse] at hcparam
  have hdiscθ : ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J) Q hf D α γ h
      (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 - (Y (n * (h : ℝ))).1‖ ≤
      K * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := (norm_fst_le _).trans hdisc
  exact (numerical_target_triangle Q _ (Y (n * (h : ℝ))).1 aStar).trans
    (add_le_add hdiscθ hcparam)

parameter_bound.exact_header:
theorem parameter_bound [FiniteDimensional ℝ A]
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (νStar : Measure (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (aStar : A)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) νStar hνStar aStar (input α))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ)
    (hg : (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) :
    ∃ hmax K : ℝ, 0 < hmax ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ hmax →
        ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) aStar‖ ≤
        K * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) +
        (Real.sqrt Geo.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))) *
          optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
          (1 / ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geo.conditionNumber * Variance / (N : ℝ)) *
            (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ)))))
parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem parameter_bound [FiniteDimensional ℝ A]
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (νStar : Measure (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (aStar : A)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ) νStar hνStar aStar (input α))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (sourceModel D α γ) Geo ρ)
    (hg : (sourceModel D α γ).meanGradient νStar aStar = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) :
    ∃ hmax K : ℝ, 0 < hmax ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ hmax →
        ‖(higherOrderPullbackParticleIterate (Fin N × J)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (ParticleNoiseSpace.noise_preserving (J := J) μ N) D α γ h
          (initial D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) aStar‖ ≤
        K * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) +
        (Real.sqrt Geo.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))) *
          optimizerLawDistance a aStar μ νStar +
          (1 / ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geo.conditionNumber * Variance / (N : ℝ)) *
            (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * (n * (h : ℝ))))) := by
  obtain ⟨hhmax, hK, _⟩ := explicit_discretization_guarantee D α γ Geo μ hμ a
    Variance hVariance hcloud hα hγ ρ hρ hmono
  refine ⟨maximumStep D α γ Geo μ ρ, discretizationConstant D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance ρ, hhmax, hK, ?_⟩
  intro h n hh hhstep
  exact explicit_parameter_bound D α γ Geo μ hμ a Variance hVariance hcloud hα hγ
    νStar hνStar aStar Frozen ρ hρ hmono hg hV h n hh hhstep

PBGSO/FullyUniformMomentum.lean.scope_note: Finite-dimensional physical coordinates, independent globally jointly Lipschitz forces, nonnegative friction, positive N/rho, P2 initial/target laws, an actual frozen invariant trajectory, zero target mean observation and A5 are explicit. No metric, process, reference, moment, local defect or final recurrence is supplied. Constants may depend on fixed N.
PBGSO/FullyUniformMomentum.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.FullyConstructedMomentum
import PBGSO.MomentumUniformParticle
import PBGSO.MethodMetricComparisons
import PBGSO.UniformStepSize

/-! # Fully constructed time-uniform M-MFPO target guarantee
The source joint monotonicity builds the contracting empirical metric.
Primitive force regularity, actual Gaussian coupling and Picard integral
solutions derive uniform moments, local defects and numerical stability.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
set_option maxHeartbeats 700000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.FullyUniformMomentum
open Methods ImplementationDynamics FullyConstructedMomentum

variable {A J : Type*} {N : ℕ} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ A]
  [MeasurableSpace A] [BorelSpace A] [SecondCountableTopology A]
  (D : ParticleForceData A (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) N)
  (γ : ℝ)

variable
  (Geometry : TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)))
  (μ : Measure (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (hμ : MemLp (fun z : HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 μ)
  (a : HypocoercivePhase A) (Variance : ℝ)
  (hVariance : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r →
    (∫ z, ‖(model D γ).observation
      ((model D γ).parameter (AdditiveCanonical.optimizer (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
        (momentumForceDynamics D γ) μ hμ a (input γ) (input_continuous γ) (input_zero γ) r))
      ((model D γ).position z) -
      (model D γ).meanGradient (AdditiveCanonical.law (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
        (momentumForceDynamics D γ) μ hμ a (input γ) (input_continuous γ) (input_zero γ) r)
        (AdditiveCanonical.optimizer (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) (momentumForceDynamics D γ)
          μ hμ a (input γ) (input_continuous γ) (input_zero γ) r)‖ ^ 2
      ∂AdditiveCanonical.law (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) (momentumForceDynamics D γ)
        μ hμ a (input γ) (input_continuous γ) (input_zero γ) r) ≤ Variance)

/-- Coercivity of the constructed source metric in raw kinetic coordinates. -/

/-- Data-only upper norm bound for the constructed metric factor. -/

/-- Actual Brownian increment radius, with the given nonnegative friction. -/

/-- State-independent part of the proved OBABO local Gaussian error. -/

/-- Linear initial-state part of the proved OBABO local Gaussian error. -/

/-- Explicit one-unit exact kinetic radius when started at zero. -/

/-- Data-only transformed zero-start radius `S`. -/

/-- Uniform exact-reference radius, derived by contraction and unit restarts. -/

/-- Linear-radius coefficient absorbed by exact-flow dissipation. -/

/-- Explicit time-uniform numerical coefficient, independent of `h,n`. -/

/-- Explicit positive upper step size; `hγ` only forms the physical friction. -/

/-- Positivity and both uniform bounds for the explicit data-defined constants. -/

/-- Final parameter theorem with data-defined coefficient and step size. -/

end PBGSO.FullyUniformMomentum

metricCoercivity.exact_declaration: def metricCoercivity : ℝ := Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N Geometry) / 2

metricUpper.exact_declaration: def metricUpper : ℝ := 2 * Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N Geometry)

noiseRadius.exact_declaration:
def noiseRadius (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := Fin N × J) ⟨γ, hγ⟩

localConstant0.exact_declaration:
def localConstant0 (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  (momentumUniformDefect (momentumUniformForceLip D) ⟨γ, hγ⟩
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
    (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin N × J) : ℝ)) (noiseRadius (N := N) (J := J) γ hγ)).1

localConstant1.exact_declaration:
def localConstant1 (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  (momentumUniformDefect (momentumUniformForceLip D) ⟨γ, hγ⟩
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
    (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin N × J) : ℝ)) (noiseRadius (N := N) (J := J) γ hγ)).2

zeroStartRadius.exact_declaration:
def zeroStartRadius (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let γnn : ℝ≥0 := ⟨γ, hγ⟩
  UniformIntegral.radius (momentumUniformForceLip D + γnn + 1)
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
    (noiseRadius (N := N) (J := J) γ hγ) 0

zeroStartMoment.exact_declaration:
def zeroStartMoment (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  metricUpper (N := N) Geometry * zeroStartRadius D γ μ hγ

referenceRadius.exact_declaration:
def referenceRadius (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let S := zeroStartMoment D γ Geometry μ hγ
  metricUpper (N := N) Geometry * ‖initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance‖ +
    S / (1 - Real.exp (-ρ)) + S

radiusGrowth.exact_declaration:
def radiusGrowth (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) : ℝ :=
  metricUpper (N := N) Geometry * localConstant1 D γ μ hγ / metricCoercivity (N := N) Geometry

discretizationConstant.exact_declaration:
def discretizationConstant (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * (metricUpper (N := N) Geometry * localConstant0 D γ μ hγ +
    radiusGrowth D γ Geometry μ hγ * referenceRadius D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ) /
      (ρ * metricCoercivity (N := N) Geometry)

maximumStep.exact_declaration:
def maximumStep (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (ρ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  UniformStep.maximumStep ρ (radiusGrowth D γ Geometry μ hγ)

explicit_guarantee.exact_header:
theorem explicit_guarantee
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (star : A) (νStar : Measure (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (momentumForceDynamics D γ) νStar hνStar (targetState star) (input γ))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (model D γ) Geometry ρ)
    (hg : (model D γ).meanGradient νStar (targetState star) = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) :
    0 < maximumStep D γ Geometry μ hγ ρ ∧
      0 ≤ discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ ∧
      ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ maximumStep D γ Geometry μ hγ ρ → ∀ n : ℕ,
        (‖momentumParticleIterate (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (particleBrownian (J := J) μ N) (particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N)
          D γ h (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n -
          momentumUnpackLp (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) D
            ((particles D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance).state (n*h))‖ ≤ discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ * Real.sqrt h) ∧
        ‖(momentumParticleIterate (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (particleBrownian (J := J) μ N) (particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N)
          D γ h (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).2.1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) star‖ ≤
        discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ * Real.sqrt h +
        (Real.sqrt Geometry.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n*h)) *
          optimizerLawDistance a (targetState star) μ νStar +
          ((2+γ)/ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geometry.conditionNumber * Variance/(N : ℝ)) *
            (1-Real.exp (-ρ * (n*h))))
explicit_guarantee.exact_declaration:
theorem explicit_guarantee
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (star : A) (νStar : Measure (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hνStar : MemLp (fun z : HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J) ↦ z) 2 νStar)
    (Frozen : AdditiveStationary.FrozenTrajectory (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)
      (momentumForceDynamics D γ) νStar hνStar (targetState star) (input γ))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (model D γ) Geometry ρ)
    (hg : (model D γ).meanGradient νStar (targetState star) = 0)
    (hV : 0 ≤ Variance) :
    0 < maximumStep D γ Geometry μ hγ ρ ∧
      0 ≤ discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ ∧
      ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ maximumStep D γ Geometry μ hγ ρ → ∀ n : ℕ,
        (‖momentumParticleIterate (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (particleBrownian (J := J) μ N) (particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N)
          D γ h (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n -
          momentumUnpackLp (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) D
            ((particles D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance).state (n*h))‖ ≤ discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ * Real.sqrt h) ∧
        ‖(momentumParticleIterate (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
          (particleBrownian (J := J) μ N) (particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N)
          D γ h (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n).2.1 -
          Lp.const 2 (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N) star‖ ≤
        discretizationConstant D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance hγ ρ * Real.sqrt h +
        (Real.sqrt Geometry.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (n*h)) *
          optimizerLawDistance a (targetState star) μ νStar +
          ((2+γ)/ρ) * Real.sqrt (Geometry.conditionNumber * Variance/(N : ℝ)) *
            (1-Real.exp (-ρ * (n*h)))) := by
  let Q := ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N
  let W := particleBrownian (J := J) μ N
  let hW := particleBrownian_isPreBrownian (J := J) μ N
  let L := momentumForceDynamics D γ
  let M := model D γ
  let H := compatibility D γ
  let Ptc := particles D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance
  let Y := Ptc.state
  let z := fun t ↦ momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y t)
  have hY : Continuous Y := Ptc.continuous
  have hz : Continuous z := (momentumUnpackLp Q D).continuous.comp hY
  have heq (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Y t-Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r))+
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N
        (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ)) W hW 0 t := by
    exact (Ptc.equation t ht).trans (congrArg (fun b ↦
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r))+b)
      (ParticleBrownianInput.packed_input_eq μ N (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ) 0 t))
  have hze (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : z t-z 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ (z r))+
        MethodSegments.momentumInput Q W hW γ t := by
    have he := momentumUnpackLp_integral Q D γ Y
      (samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N
        (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ)) W hW 0) hY heq t ht
    rw [momentumUnpackLp_brownian Q D hcloud W hW γ 0 t] at he
    exact he
  obtain ⟨d,C,hcoerc,hupper,hdrift⟩ := MethodMetricComparisons.momentum_metric_explicit Q D hcloud γ
    (diffusionColumns (J := J) γ) Geometry ρ hmono
  let m := Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N Geometry) / 2
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    exact div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (EmpiricalMetric.lower_pos N D.nonempty Geometry)) (by positivity)
  let Mbound := 2 * Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N Geometry)
  have hMbound : 0 ≤ Mbound := by dsimp [Mbound]; positivity
  have hCnorm : ‖C‖ ≤ Mbound := C.opNorm_le_bound hMbound hupper
  let γnn : ℝ≥0 := ⟨γ,hγ⟩
  let Force := coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)
  let LF := momentumUniformForceLip D
  let Ξ := Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin N × J) : ℝ)
  let β := momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := Fin N × J) γnn
  let rawAB := momentumUniformDefect LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ Ξ β
  let actualAB := momentumMetricDefect LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ Ξ β C m
  let AB := (Mbound*rawAB.1,Mbound*rawAB.2/m)
  let baseR := UniformIntegral.radius (LF+γnn+1) ‖Force 0‖ β 0
  let R := Mbound*‖z 0‖+(Mbound*baseR)/(1-Real.exp (-ρ))+Mbound*baseR
  let U := 4*(AB.1+AB.2*R)/(ρ*m)
  have hβ : 0 ≤ β := by dsimp [β,momentumUniformBrownianRadius]; positivity
  have hab := momentumUniformDefect_nonneg LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ Ξ β
    (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hβ
  have ha₀ := hab.1
  have hb₀ := hab.2
  have hABa : 0 ≤ AB.1 := by dsimp [AB,rawAB]; positivity
  have hABb : 0 ≤ AB.2 := by dsimp [AB,rawAB]; positivity
  have hgap : 0 < 1-Real.exp (-ρ) := sub_pos.mpr (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith))
  have hrad := UniformIntegral.radius_nonneg (LF+γnn+1) (norm_nonneg (Force 0)) hβ (le_refl 0)
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R,baseR]; positivity
  have hAcomp : actualAB.1 ≤ AB.1 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm ha₀
  have hBcomp : actualAB.2 ≤ AB.2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm hb₀) hm.le
  have hScomp : ‖C‖*baseR ≤ Mbound*baseR := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCnorm hrad
  have hRcomp : momentumUniformReferenceRadius LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ β ρ C (z 0) ≤ R :=
    add_le_add (add_le_add (hupper (z 0))
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hScomp hgap.le)) hScomp
  have hactualR : 0 ≤ momentumUniformReferenceRadius LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ β ρ C (z 0) := by
    dsimp [momentumUniformReferenceRadius]
    positivity
  have hUcomp : momentumUniformErrorConstant LF γnn ‖Force 0‖ Ξ β ρ C m (z 0) ≤ U := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (mul_nonneg hρ.le hm.le)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤4)
    exact add_le_add hAcomp (mul_le_mul hBcomp hRcomp hactualR hABb)
  have hU : 0 ≤ U := by
    change 0 ≤ 4*(AB.1+AB.2*R)/(ρ*m)
    positivity
  change 0 < UniformStep.maximumStep ρ AB.2 ∧ 0 ≤ U ∧ _
  refine ⟨UniformStep.maximumStep_pos ρ AB.2 hρ hABb,hU,?_⟩
  intro h hh hhmax n
  obtain ⟨hh1,hρh,hsmall⟩ := UniformStep.admissible ρ AB.2 h hρ hABb hh hhmax
  have hsmallActual : actualAB.2*Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ/4 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBcomp (Real.sqrt_nonneg h)).trans hsmall
  have hnum := momentumParticle_time_uniform Q W hW D γnn C m ρ hm hρ hcoerc hdrift
    z hz hze h hh hh1 hρh hsmallActual n
  let num := momentumParticleIterate Q W hW D γ h
    (initial D γ Geometry μ hμ a Variance hVariance) n
  have herror : ‖num-z (n*h)‖ ≤ U*Real.sqrt h :=
    hnum.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hUcomp (Real.sqrt_nonneg h))

    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))

theorem coupledForce_lipschitz (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : Θ × X) :
    ‖coupledForce Fbar G z - coupledForce Fbar G w‖ ≤
      coupledLipschitzConstant LF LG * ‖z - w‖ := by
  have hs : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z - w‖ := by
    have h1 : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
    have h2 : ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_snd_le (z - w)
    linarith
  change max _ _ ≤ _
  apply max_le
  · apply (hF _ _ _ _).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ LF * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hLF
      _ ≤ (max LF LG) * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := by gcongr; exact le_max_left _ _
      _ = _ := by unfold coupledLipschitzConstant; ring
  · apply (hG _ _ _ _).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ LG * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hLG
      _ ≤ (max LF LG) * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := by gcongr; exact le_max_right _ _
      _ = _ := by unfold coupledLipschitzConstant; ring

            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) +
            (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (coupledLipschitzConstant LF LG + γ + 1) * R) *
              (n * h) * Real.sqrt h) := by
  have hGaussianLaw := momentumHalfNoise_pathLaw Q W hW h hh hpaths
  apply momentum_integral_reference_finite_sqrt_rate (coupledForce Fbar G)
    (coupledLipschitzConstant LF LG) γ h R P F (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ))
    (by unfold coupledLipschitzConstant; positivity) hγ hh hh1 hR hP hforce
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (coupledForce_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG hLF hLG hF hG)
    p q (momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Θ) Q W hW γ h)
    (momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Θ) Q W hW h) n hpInt hfInt hp hq hcompat hmod hpbound hfbound
  · intro k _
    constructor <;> dsimp [momentumGaussianNoise] <;>
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, sub_self, norm_zero, max_eq_right (norm_nonneg _)] <;>
      exact (momentumHalfNoise_norm Q W hW h hh _).le
  · intro _ _
    rfl

theorem hol_mypgd_gaussian_finite_bound
    (Fbar : Θ → HOLGaussianSpace I → Θ) (G : Θ → HOLGaussianSpace I → HOLGaussianSpace I)
    (LF LG α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hFθ : 0 ≤ Fθ) (hFG : 0 ≤ FG)
    (hU0 : 0 ≤ U) (hV0 : 0 ≤ V) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (r : ℕ → ℝ → HOLState Θ (HOLGaussianSpace I)) (n : ℕ)
    (hInt : ∀ k, k < n → IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) volume 0 h)
    (heq : ∀ k, k < n → r k h = r k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) +
      holBrownianIncrement (higherOrderGaussianIncrement I α γ h k))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, k < n → r (k + 1) 0 = r k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k, k < n → ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 (h : ℝ) →
      ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t) - holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k 0)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t)
    (hFbound : ∀ k, k < n → ‖Fbar (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ Fθ)
    (hGbound : ∀ k, k < n →
      ‖G ((r k 0).1 - (h : ℝ) • Fbar (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1) (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ FG)
    (hU : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.1‖ ≤ U)
    (hV : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.2‖ ≤ V)
    (z : HOLState Θ (HOLGaussianSpace I)) :
    holError (trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h)
      (higherOrderGaussianNoise I α γ h) z n) (r n 0) ≤
      Real.exp (holStabilityConstant α γ LF LG * (h : ℝ) * n) *
        (holError z (r 0 0) +
          (holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) LG Fθ FG U V +
            Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * holScalarNoiseConstant α γ +
            (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * (n * (h : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ))

theorem hol_mypgd_gaussian_finite_bound
    (Fbar : Θ → HOLGaussianSpace I → Θ) (G : Θ → HOLGaussianSpace I → HOLGaussianSpace I)
    (LF LG α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0)

    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (r : ℕ → ℝ → HOLState Θ (HOLGaussianSpace I)) (n : ℕ)
    (hInt : ∀ k, k < n → IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) volume 0 h)
    (heq : ∀ k, k < n → r k h = r k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) +
      holBrownianIncrement (higherOrderGaussianIncrement I α γ h k))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, k < n → r (k + 1) 0 = r k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k, k < n → ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 (h : ℝ) →
      ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t) - holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k 0)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t)
    (hFbound : ∀ k, k < n → ‖Fbar (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ Fθ)
    (hGbound : ∀ k, k < n →
      ‖G ((r k 0).1 - (h : ℝ) • Fbar (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1) (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ FG)
    (hU : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.1‖ ≤ U)
    (hV : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.2‖ ≤ V)
    (z : HOLState Θ (HOLGaussianSpace I)) :
    holError (trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h)
      (higherOrderGaussianNoise I α γ h) z n) (r n 0) ≤
      Real.exp (holStabilityConstant α γ LF LG * (h : ℝ) * n) *

          (holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) LG Fθ FG U V +

    (by unfold holScalarNoiseConstant holRemainderConstants; positivity) hF hG
    r (higherOrderGaussianIncrement I α γ h) (higherOrderGaussianNoise I α γ h) n

  intro k _

import PBGSO.QuadraticMartingale
import PBGSO.AdditiveWeakRealization

/-! # General diffusion quadratic weak realization from martingale structure

The source drift and diffusion are realized by actual L² processes, with
arbitrary parameter and sampler-state dependence. The optimiser satisfies
its original ODE. The sampler drift residual is an actual martingale.
Only its synchronous increment isometry is an explicit stochastic-integral
interface; the quadratic forward equation is derived.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace PBGSO.GeneralMartingaleRealization
open PBGSO.QuadraticMartingale

variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Fintype I]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)

/-- Actual drift/martingale trajectory data. No sampler quadratic forward
identity is a field, and no additive-noise restriction is imposed. -/

variable {Q ℱ} {M : Model S Θ Z X I}

/-- Actual sampler marginals realize the empty marginal test domain from
the optimiser equation and true L² moment bounds. -/

/-- Drift subtraction commutes with the actual residual construction. -/

/-- The actual sampler work is the pullback of weighted drift and diffusion
pairings of the realized L² columns. -/


/-- Primitive continuity of model coefficients supplies measurability of
the displayed source generator integrand on its actual joint law. -/



/-- Synchronous weighted Itô isometry for the actual difference residual.
This is the stochastic-integral interface, not a quadratic forward equation. -/

/-- The sampler quadratic forward equation for arbitrary source diffusion
columns follows from actual martingales and synchronous increment isometry. -/

/-- General state/parameter-dependent diffusions realize the actual
quadratic coupled weak solution from martingale trajectories and their
synchronous isometry. Marginal test domains are explicitly empty. -/

/-- Source joint monotonicity contracts the actual quadratic coupling
energy of the martingale trajectories. Diffusion remains fully general;
the synchronous stochastic-integral isometry is explicitly required. -/

end PBGSO.GeneralMartingaleRealization

ModelL2Trajectory.exact_header: structure ModelL2Trajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
ModelL2Trajectory.exact_declaration:
structure ModelL2Trajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I) where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  sampler : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q
  noise : ℝ → Ω → Z
  sampler_continuous : Continuous sampler
  drift_continuous : Continuous drift
  diffusion_continuous : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => diffusion t i)
  drift_realizes : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, diffusion t i =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω) i
  martingale : Martingale noise ℱ Q
  noise_realizes : ∀ t, noise t =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q sampler drift t
  adapted : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (sampler t) Q
  observation_integrable : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (sampler t))
  optimizer_ode : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt optimizer
    (M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler t))) (Ici 0) t

  forward_equation := by simp

residual_sub.exact_header:
theorem residual_sub (U V b c : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hb : Continuous b) (hc : Continuous c) (t : ℝ) :
    martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U r - V r) (fun r => b r - c r) t =
      martingaleResidual Q U b t - martingaleResidual Q V c t
residual_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem residual_sub (U V b c : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hb : Continuous b) (hc : Continuous c) (t : ℝ) :
    martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U r - V r) (fun r => b r - c r) t =
      martingaleResidual Q U b t - martingaleResidual Q V c t := by
  dsimp [martingaleResidual]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hc.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  abel

work_pullback_ae.exact_header:
theorem work_pullback_ae (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => ⟪(U.sampler t - V.sampler t) ω,
      D.samplerWeight ((U.drift t - V.drift t) ω)⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, ⟪(U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω,
        D.samplerWeight ((U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω)⟫_ℝ
work_pullback_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem work_pullback_ae (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => ⟪(U.sampler t - V.sampler t) ω,
      D.samplerWeight ((U.drift t - V.drift t) ω)⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, ⟪(U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω,
        D.samplerWeight ((U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hσ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i,
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω =
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (U.sampler t ω) i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (V.optimizer t)) (V.sampler t ω) i := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (U.diffusion t i) (V.diffusion t i),
      U.diffusion_realizes t ht i, V.diffusion_realizes t ht i] with ω hs hu hv
    simp only [hs, Pi.sub_apply, hu, hv]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t),
    Lp.coeFn_sub (U.drift t) (V.drift t), U.drift_realizes t ht, V.drift_realizes t ht,
    hσ] with ω hX hb hu hv hσ
  simp only [hX, hb, Pi.sub_apply, hu, hv, hσ, samplerCouplingWork, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]

work_pullback_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_pullback_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) Q
work_pullback_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_pullback_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) Q := by
  apply (Integrable.add (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight _ _)
    ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))).const_mul
        (1 / 2 : ℝ))).congr
  exact (work_pullback_ae D U V t ht).symm

work_continuous.exact_header:
theorem work_continuous (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) :
    Continuous (samplerCouplingWork M D s s')
work_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem work_continuous (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) :
    Continuous (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') := by
  change Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z =>
    ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, ⟪M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i, D.samplerWeight
          (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i - M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)⟫_ℝ)
  fun_prop

work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t))
      (samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t))
work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t))
      (samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) := by
  apply (integrable_map_measure (work_continuous D _ _ hb hσ).aestronglyMeasurable
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.sampler t)).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (V.sampler t)).aemeasurable)).mpr
  exact work_pullback_integrable D U V t ht

work_integral.exact_header:
theorem work_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) zz
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) =
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.drift t - V.drift t) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i)
work_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) zz
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) =
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.drift t - V.drift t) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) := by
  rw [samplerPairLaw, integral_map
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.sampler t)).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (V.sampler t)).aemeasurable)
    (work_continuous D _ _ hb hσ).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rw [integral_congr_ae (work_pullback_ae D U V t ht), integral_add
    (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight _ _)
    ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))).const_mul
        (1 / 2 : ℝ)), integral_const_mul,
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))]
  simp only [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]

SynchronousIsometry.exact_header: def SynchronousIsometry (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M) : Prop
SynchronousIsometry.exact_declaration:
def SynchronousIsometry (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M) : Prop :=
  ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
    weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
      (martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U.sampler r - V.sampler r)
        (fun r => U.drift r - V.drift r) t -
       martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U.sampler r - V.sampler r)
        (fun r => U.drift r - V.drift r) s)
      (martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U.sampler r - V.sampler r)
        (fun r => U.drift r - V.drift r) t -
       martingaleResidual Q (fun r => U.sampler r - V.sampler r)
        (fun r => U.drift r - V.drift r) s) =
      ∫ r in s..t, diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight
        (fun u i => U.diffusion u i - V.diffusion u i) r

pair_quadratic_forward.exact_header:
theorem pair_quadratic_forward (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (hIsometry : SynchronousIsometry D U V) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r => ∫ zz, couplingQuadratic D zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler r) (V.sampler r))
      (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) (couplingQuadratic D) zz
        ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) (Ici 0) t
pair_quadratic_forward.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_quadratic_forward (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelL2Trajectory Q ℱ M)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Continuous (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Continuous (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (hIsometry : SynchronousIsometry D U V) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r => ∫ zz, couplingQuadratic D zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler r) (V.sampler r))
      (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) (couplingQuadratic D) zz
        ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) (Ici 0) t := by
  let u : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q := fun r => U.sampler r - V.sampler r
  let b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q := fun r => U.drift r - V.drift r
  let σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q := fun r i => U.diffusion r i - V.diffusion r i
  have hrep : ∀ r, (U.noise r - V.noise r) =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q u b r := by
    intro r
    rw [residual_sub U.sampler V.sampler U.drift V.drift U.drift_continuous V.drift_continuous]
    exact ((U.noise_realizes r).sub (V.noise_realizes r)).trans (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).symm
  have hadapt (r : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (u r) Q := by
    apply ((U.adapted r).sub (V.adapted r)).congr
    exact (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).symm
  have henergy := expected_energy_hasDerivWithinAt Q ℱ D.samplerWeight D.sampler_symmetric
    u b σ (U.sampler_continuous.sub V.sampler_continuous)
    (U.drift_continuous.sub V.drift_continuous)
    (fun i => (U.diffusion_continuous i).sub (V.diffusion_continuous i))
    (U.noise - V.noise) (U.martingale.sub V.martingale) hrep hadapt hIsometry t ht
  have hcost (r : ℝ) :
      (∫ zz, couplingQuadratic D zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler r) (V.sampler r)) =
        ∫ ω, ⟪u r ω, D.samplerWeight (u r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    change (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler r) (V.sampler r)) = _
    rw [samplerPairLaw_cost_integral, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  have hgen : (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (couplingQuadratic D) zz ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) =
      2 * (∫ ω, ⟪u t ω, D.samplerWeight (b t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
        ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪σ t i ω, D.samplerWeight (σ t i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    simp_rw [synchronousGenerator_quadratic]
    rw [integral_const_mul, work_integral D U V hb hσ t ht]
    simp only [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    dsimp [u, b, σ]
    ring

    ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler r) (V.sampler r)) =
      (fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪u r ω, D.samplerWeight (u r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) from funext hcost]
  exact henergy

theorem isCoupledWeakSolution_quadratic (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

  right := V.isWeakSolution_empty

theorem centered_map_lipschitz (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LipschitzWith L (fun x => f x - f 0) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using hf.dist_le_mul x y

liftMap.exact_header:
def liftMap (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (X : Lp E 2 Q) : Lp K 2 Q

liftMap_coe.exact_header:
theorem liftMap_coe (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (X : Lp E 2 Q) : liftMap Q f hf X =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => f (X ω)
liftMap_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem liftMap_coe (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (X : Lp E 2 Q) : liftMap Q f hf X =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => f (X ω) := by
  unfold liftMap
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add ((centered_map_lipschitz f hf).compLp (by simp) X)
      (Lp.const 2 Q (f 0)),
    (centered_map_lipschitz f hf).coeFn_compLp (by simp) X,
    Lp.coeFn_const (μ := Q) (p := 2) (c := f 0)] with ω ha hc hz
  simp only [ha, hc, hz, Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply, Function.const_apply]
  exact sub_add_cancel _ _

liftMap_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem liftMap_lipschitz (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LipschitzWith L (liftMap Q f hf)
liftMap_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem liftMap_lipschitz (f : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    LipschitzWith L (liftMap Q f hf) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro X Y
  simp only [liftMap, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  exact (centered_map_lipschitz f hf).norm_compLp_sub_le (by simp) X Y

liftMap_parameter_bound.exact_header:
theorem liftMap_parameter_bound (a b : A) (X : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X - liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) X‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖
liftMap_parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem liftMap_parameter_bound (a b : A) (X : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X - liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) X‖ ≤
      (L : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ := by
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖(liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X - liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) X) ω‖ ≤
        (L : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X)
      (liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) X), liftMap_coe Q (f a) (hf a) X,
      liftMap_coe Q (f b) (hf b) X] with ω hs hfa hfb
    simpa only [hs, hfa, hfb, Pi.sub_apply] using ha a b (X ω)
  simpa [measureUnivNNReal] using Lp.norm_le_of_ae_bound
    (show 0 ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ by positivity) hbound

theorem liftMap_joint_bound (a b : A) (X Y : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X - liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) Y‖ ≤
      2 * (L : ℝ) * ‖(a, X) - (b, Y)‖
liftMap_joint_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem liftMap_joint_bound (a b : A) (X Y : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X - liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) Y‖ ≤
      2 * (L : ℝ) * ‖(a, X) - (b, Y)‖ := by
  have hsplit := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub
    (liftMap Q (f a) (hf a) X) (liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) X)
    (liftMap Q (f b) (hf b) Y)
  have hp := liftMap_parameter_bound Q f L hf ha a b X
  have hx := (liftMap_lipschitz Q (f b) (hf b)).norm_sub_le X Y
  have hA : ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖(a, X) - (b, Y)‖ := norm_fst_le ((a, X) - (b, Y))
  have hX : ‖X - Y‖ ≤ ‖(a, X) - (b, Y)‖ := norm_snd_le ((a, X) - (b, Y))
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA L.coe_nonneg,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX L.coe_nonneg]

structure LipschitzDynamics (A Z G : Type*)

LipschitzDynamics.exact_declaration:
structure LipschitzDynamics (A Z G : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] where
  observation : A → Z → G
  response : A × G → A
  sampler : A → Z → Z
  observationLip : ℝ≥0
  responseLip : ℝ≥0
  samplerLip : ℝ≥0
  observation_state : ∀ a, LipschitzWith observationLip (observation a)
  observation_parameter : ∀ a b z,
    ‖observation a z - observation b z‖ ≤ (observationLip : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖
  response_lipschitz : LipschitzWith responseLip response
  sampler_state : ∀ a, LipschitzWith samplerLip (sampler a)
  sampler_parameter : ∀ a b z,
    ‖sampler a z - sampler b z‖ ≤ (samplerLip : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖

    ‖D.expectedObservation Q a X - D.expectedObservation Q b Y‖ ≤
      2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) * ‖(a, X) - (b, Y)‖ := by
  unfold expectedObservation

fieldLip.exact_declaration: def fieldLip : ℝ≥0 := D.responseLip * (1 + 2 * D.observationLip) + 2 * D.samplerLip

field_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem field_lipschitz : LipschitzWith D.fieldLip (D.field Q) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  change max ‖D.response (s.1, D.expectedObservation Q s.1 s.2) -
      D.response (t.1, D.expectedObservation Q t.1 t.2)‖
    ‖liftMap Q (D.sampler s.1) (D.sampler_state s.1) s.2 -
      liftMap Q (D.sampler t.1) (D.sampler_state t.1) t.2‖ ≤ _
  have hA : ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_fst_le (s - t)
  have hG := D.expectedObservation_bound Q s.1 t.1 s.2 t.2
  have hR := D.response_lipschitz.norm_sub_le
    (s.1, D.expectedObservation Q s.1 s.2) (t.1, D.expectedObservation Q t.1 t.2)
  have hB := liftMap_joint_bound Q D.sampler D.samplerLip
    D.sampler_state D.sampler_parameter s.1 t.1 s.2 t.2
  change ‖D.response _ - D.response _‖ ≤
    (D.responseLip : ℝ) * max ‖s.1 - t.1‖
      ‖D.expectedObservation Q s.1 s.2 - D.expectedObservation Q t.1 t.2‖ at hR
  have hc : max ‖s.1 - t.1‖
      ‖D.expectedObservation Q s.1 s.2 - D.expectedObservation Q t.1 t.2‖ ≤
      (1 + 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ)) * ‖s - t‖ := by
    apply max_le
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.observationLip.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (s - t))]
    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - t)]
  have hr := hR.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc D.responseLip.coe_nonneg)
  apply max_le
  · dsimp [fieldLip]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.samplerLip.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (s - t))]
  · dsimp [fieldLip]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.responseLip.coe_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) by positivity)
        (norm_nonneg (s - t)))]

theorem exists_integral (initial : A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t)

    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t) := by
  have hg : LipschitzWith D.fieldLip (fun s => -D.field Q s) :=
    (D.field_lipschitz Q).neg

  intro t ht
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using he t ht
