theorem minimumEigenvalue_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA ≤ hA.eigenvalues i
minimumEigenvalue_le.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA ≤ hA.eigenvalues i :=
  Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)

minimumEigenvalue_pos.exact_header:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    0 < minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian
minimumEigenvalue_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) :
    0 < minimumEigenvalue hA.isHermitian := by
  apply (Finset.lt_inf'_iff _).mpr
  intro i hi
  exact hA.eigenvalues_pos i

minimumEigenvalue_attained.exact_header:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_attained {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ i, minimumEigenvalue hA = hA.eigenvalues i
minimumEigenvalue_attained.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_attained {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ i, minimumEigenvalue hA = hA.eigenvalues i := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' (s := (Finset.univ : Finset n))
    Finset.univ_nonempty hA.eigenvalues
  exact ⟨i, he⟩

minimumEigenvalue_isLeast_spectrum.exact_header:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_isLeast_spectrum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsLeast (spectrum ℝ A) (minimumEigenvalue hA)
minimumEigenvalue_isLeast_spectrum.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_isLeast_spectrum {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsLeast (spectrum ℝ A) (minimumEigenvalue hA) := by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := minimumEigenvalue_attained hA
    rw [hi]
    exact hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i
  · intro r hr
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hr
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hr
    exact minimumEigenvalue_le hA i

minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef.exact_header:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (A - minimumEigenvalue hA • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef
minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (A - minimumEigenvalue hA • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
  let U := (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - minimumEigenvalue hA)).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_diagonal_iff.mpr (fun i => sub_nonneg.mpr (minimumEigenvalue_le hA i))
  have hc := hdiag.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same U
  have hspec : A = U * Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [U, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, Function.comp_def,
      RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose] using
      hA.spectral_theorem
  have hU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    simpa only [U, ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star] using
      (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self hA.eigenvectorUnitary)
  have heq : U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - minimumEigenvalue hA) * Uᴴ =
      A - minimumEigenvalue hA • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) := by
    rw [show Matrix.diagonal (fun i => hA.eigenvalues i - minimumEigenvalue hA) =
        Matrix.diagonal hA.eigenvalues - minimumEigenvalue hA • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) by
      ext i j
      by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, ← hspec]
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_one, hU]
  rwa [heq] at hc

minimumEigenvalue_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_quadratic {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)
minimumEigenvalue_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem minimumEigenvalue_quadratic {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (x : n → ℝ) :
    minimumEigenvalue hA * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) := by
  have h := (minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef hA).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  simpa only [Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_nonneg] using h

whitened.exact_header: def whitened (D K : Matrix n n ℝ) : Matrix n n ℝ
whitened.exact_declaration:
def whitened (D K : Matrix n n ℝ) : Matrix n n ℝ :=
  (CFC.sqrt D)⁻¹ * K * (CFC.sqrt D)⁻¹

sqrt_posDef.exact_header: theorem sqrt_posDef {D : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) : (CFC.sqrt D).PosDef
sqrt_posDef.exact_declaration:
theorem sqrt_posDef {D : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) : (CFC.sqrt D).PosDef :=
  (IsStrictlyPositive.sqrt D hD.isStrictlyPositive).posDef

whitened_posDef.exact_header:
theorem whitened_posDef {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) :
    (whitened D K).PosDef
whitened_posDef.exact_declaration:
theorem whitened_posDef {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) :
    (whitened D K).PosDef := by
  have hW := (sqrt_posDef hD).inv
  have h := hK.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (B := (CFC.sqrt D)⁻¹)
    (Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hW.isUnit)
  simpa only [hW.isHermitian.eq, whitened] using h

generalizedMinimum.exact_header: def generalizedMinimum {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) : ℝ
generalizedMinimum.exact_declaration:
def generalizedMinimum {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) : ℝ :=
  minimumEigenvalue (whitened_posDef hD hK).isHermitian

generalizedMinimum_pos.exact_header:
theorem generalizedMinimum_pos {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) :
    0 < generalizedMinimum hD hK
generalizedMinimum_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem generalizedMinimum_pos {D K : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) :
    0 < generalizedMinimum hD hK :=
  minimumEigenvalue_pos (whitened_posDef hD hK)

generalizedMinimum_sub_posSemidef.exact_declaration:
theorem generalizedMinimum_sub_posSemidef {D K : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) :
    (K - generalizedMinimum hD hK • D).PosSemidef := by
  let S := CFC.sqrt D
  have hS : S.PosDef := sqrt_posDef hD
  have hunit : IsUnit S.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det S).mp hS.isUnit
  have hleft : S * S⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S hunit
  have hright : S⁻¹ * S = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S hunit
  have hsq : S * S = D := by
    simpa only [S, pow_two] using CFC.sq_sqrt D hD.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hfirst : S * whitened D K * S = K := by
    calc
      S * whitened D K * S = (S * S⁻¹) * K * (S⁻¹ * S) := by
        dsimp [whitened, S]
        noncomm_ring
      _ = K := by rw [hleft, hright]; simp
  have hsecond : S * (generalizedMinimum hD hK • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) * S =
      generalizedMinimum hD hK • D := by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_one, hsq]
  have hp := (minimumEigenvalue_sub_posSemidef
    (whitened_posDef hD hK).isHermitian).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same S
  change (Sᴴ * (whitened D K - generalizedMinimum hD hK • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) * S).PosSemidef at hp
  rw [hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, hfirst, hsecond] at hp
  exact hp

generalizedMinimum_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem generalizedMinimum_quadratic {D K : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hK : K.PosDef) (x : n → ℝ) :
    generalizedMinimum hD hK * (x ⬝ᵥ (D *ᵥ x)) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ (K *ᵥ x) := by
  have h := (generalizedMinimum_sub_posSemidef hD hK).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
  simpa only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_nonneg] using h

whitened_eq_sqrt_inv.exact_header:
theorem whitened_eq_sqrt_inv {D : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (K : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    whitened D K = CFC.sqrt D⁻¹ * K * CFC.sqrt D⁻¹
whitened_eq_sqrt_inv.exact_declaration:
theorem whitened_eq_sqrt_inv {D : Matrix n n ℝ} (hD : D.PosDef) (K : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    whitened D K = CFC.sqrt D⁻¹ * K * CFC.sqrt D⁻¹ := by
  rw [whitened, hD.posSemidef.inv_sqrt]

projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_spect.exact_header:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_spectral
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (DOpt KOpt : Matrix n n ℝ) (DSam KSam : Matrix m m ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hKOpt : KOpt.PosDef)
    (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hKSam : KSam.PosDef)
    (coordinateOpt : S →L[ℝ] (n → ℝ)) (coordinateSam : Z →L[ℝ] (m → ℝ))
    (hDOptForm : ∀ d, D.optimizerSq d =
      coordinateOpt d ⬝ᵥ (DOpt *ᵥ coordinateOpt d))
    (hDSamForm : ∀ d, D.samplerSq d =
      coordinateSam d ⬝ᵥ (DSam *ᵥ coordinateSam d))
    (hKOptForm : ∀ d, coordinateOpt d ⬝ᵥ (KOpt *ᵥ coordinateOpt d) =
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hKSamForm : ∀ zz : Z × Z,
      coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2) ⬝ᵥ (KSam *ᵥ coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2)) =
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 +
        C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    let ρ := min (generalizedMinimum hDOpt hKOpt) (generalizedMinimum hDSam hKSam)
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ
projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_spect.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_spectral
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (DOpt KOpt : Matrix n n ℝ) (DSam KSam : Matrix m m ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hKOpt : KOpt.PosDef)
    (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hKSam : KSam.PosDef)
    (coordinateOpt : S →L[ℝ] (n → ℝ)) (coordinateSam : Z →L[ℝ] (m → ℝ))
    (hDOptForm : ∀ d, D.optimizerSq d =
      coordinateOpt d ⬝ᵥ (DOpt *ᵥ coordinateOpt d))
    (hDSamForm : ∀ d, D.samplerSq d =
      coordinateSam d ⬝ᵥ (DSam *ᵥ coordinateSam d))
    (hKOptForm : ∀ d, coordinateOpt d ⬝ᵥ (KOpt *ᵥ coordinateOpt d) =
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hKSamForm : ∀ zz : Z × Z,
      coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2) ⬝ᵥ (KSam *ᵥ coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2)) =
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 +
        C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    let ρ := min (generalizedMinimum hDOpt hKOpt) (generalizedMinimum hDSam hKSam)
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ := by
  dsimp
  refine ⟨lt_min (generalizedMinimum_pos hDOpt hKOpt)
    (generalizedMinimum_pos hDSam hKSam), ?_⟩
  apply projected_twistedJointMonotonicity M D C β r AOpt ASam _ hβ hmono haux σ hσ hInt
  · intro d
    calc
      _ ≤ generalizedMinimum hDOpt hKOpt * D.optimizerSq d :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (D.optimizerSq_nonneg d)
      _ ≤ coordinateOpt d ⬝ᵥ (KOpt *ᵥ coordinateOpt d) := by
        rw [hDOptForm]
        exact generalizedMinimum_quadratic hDOpt hKOpt (coordinateOpt d)
      _ = _ := hKOptForm d
  · intro zz
    calc
      _ ≤ generalizedMinimum hDSam hKSam * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (D.samplerSq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2) ⬝ᵥ (KSam *ᵥ coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
        rw [hDSamForm]
        exact generalizedMinimum_quadratic hDSam hKSam (coordinateSam (zz.1 - zz.2))
      _ = _ := hKSamForm zz

PBGSO/GlobalIntegral.lean.scope_note: Assume a complete real Banach state space, a globally Lipschitz field, an initial state and continuous additive input starting at zero. A global solution is a conclusion. Negative times are continuously extended by the initial value; the equation is asserted for t≥0.
PBGSO/GlobalIntegral.lean.shared_context:
import UnadjustedLangevin.LangevinUniqueness

/-! # Global additive integral dynamics for an arbitrary Banach vector field

Finite Picard solutions are glued by actual common-input uniqueness. The
result covers deterministic ODEs and random complete particle states, with
arbitrary continuous additive inputs. No global solution is a hypothesis.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]


end PBGSO

exists_global_integral_solution.exact_header:
theorem exists_global_integral_solution
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (initial : E)
    (B : ℝ → E) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → E, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - initial = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t
exists_global_integral_solution.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_global_integral_solution
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (initial : E)
    (B : ℝ → E) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → E, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - initial = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t := by
  classical
  have exists_finite (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : ∃ Y : ℝ → E,
      Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
        Y t - initial = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t := by
    obtain ⟨Y, hc, hi, he⟩ := ULA.exists_langevin_integral
      (fun z => -f z) L hf.neg initial B hB hB0 T hT
    exact ⟨Y, hc, hi, fun t ht => by
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using he t ht⟩
  let flow := fun n : ℕ ↦ Classical.choose
    (exists_finite ((n : ℝ) + 1) (Nat.cast_add_one_pos n).le)
  have hs (n : ℕ) : Continuous (flow n) ∧ flow n 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 ((n : ℝ) + 1), flow n t - initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, f (flow n r)) + B t :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_finite ((n : ℝ) + 1) (Nat.cast_add_one_pos n).le)
  have coherent (m n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
      (hm : r ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1) (hn : r ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) : flow m r = flow n r := by
    have hg : LipschitzWith L (fun z ↦ -f z) := hf.neg
    have he := ULA.langevin_integral_unique (fun z ↦ -f z) L hg initial
      (fun t ↦ B t) (flow m) (flow n) (hs m).1 (hs n).1 r hr
      (fun t ht ↦ by
        simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
          (hs m).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hm⟩)
      (fun t ht ↦ by
        simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
          (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hn⟩)
    exact he ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩
  let Y := fun t : ℝ ↦ flow (Nat.ceil (max 0 t)) (max 0 t)
  have agree (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : max 0 r ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) :
      Y r = flow n (max 0 r) := by
    apply coherent _ n _ (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by linarith)
    · exact hr
  have hcont : Continuous Y := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro t
    let n := Nat.ceil (max 0 t)
    have ht : max 0 t < (n : ℝ) + 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_ceil _) (by linarith)
    have hc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ ↦ max 0 r) := continuous_const.max continuous_id
    have hev : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 t, max 0 r < (n : ℝ) + 1 := hc.continuousAt.eventually (gt_mem_nhds ht)
    apply ((hs n).1.comp hc).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    exact hev.mono fun r hr ↦ agree n r hr.le
  have hzero : Y 0 = initial := by
    have h : Y 0 = flow 0 0 := by simpa only [max_self] using agree 0 0 (by norm_num)
    exact h.trans (hs 0).2.1
  refine ⟨Y, hcont, hzero, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let n := Nat.ceil t
  have hnt : t ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := (Nat.le_ceil t).trans (by linarith)
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 t) : Y r = flow n r := by
    simpa only [max_eq_right hr.1] using agree n r (by rw [max_eq_right hr.1]; exact hr.2.trans hnt)
  have hint : (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) = ∫ r in 0..t, f (flow n r) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht] at hr
    change f (Y r) = f (flow n r)
    rw [he r hr]
  rw [he t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩, hint]
  exact (hs n).2.2 t ⟨ht, hnt⟩

PBGSO/GlobalMeshRegularity.lean.scope_note: Assume an actual norm-continuous L² integral trajectory, primitive globally Lipschitz drift and fixed linear Brownian input from the supplied coordinate pre-Brownian laws. No moment radius or increment-modulus estimate is supplied; no uniform-in-time bound follows.
PBGSO/GlobalMeshRegularity.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.IntegralModulus

/-! # Finite-horizon regularity uniform over the numerical mesh

The state and actual drift radii are derived from compactness of the continuous
integral trajectory. Brownian increments then give one square-root modulus for
all subintervals of length at most one in the fixed horizon. These constants
are independent of the number and width of the mesh intervals; no moment or
modulus inequality is supplied as a process hypothesis.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO

variable {Ω I E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  (Q : Measure Ω)

/-- Actual Brownian-driven integral trajectories have mesh-uniform state,
drift and square-root increment bounds on any fixed finite horizon. -/

end PBGSO

exists_brownian_mesh_regularity.exact_header:
theorem exists_brownian_mesh_regularity
    (f : Lp E 2 Q → Lp E 2 Q) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] E)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (T : ℝ) (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 t) :
    ∃ P G R : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ R ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖Y t‖ ≤ P ∧ ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G) ∧
      ∀ a s : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → a + s ≤ T →
        ‖Y (a + s) - Y a‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt s ∧
          ‖f (Y (a + s)) - f (Y a)‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * R * Real.sqrt s
exists_brownian_mesh_regularity.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_brownian_mesh_regularity
    (f : Lp E 2 Q → Lp E 2 Q) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] E)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (T : ℝ) (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 t) :
    ∃ P G R : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ R ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖Y t‖ ≤ P ∧ ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G) ∧
      ∀ a s : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → a + s ≤ T →
        ‖Y (a + s) - Y a‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt s ∧
          ‖f (Y (a + s)) - f (Y a)‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * R * Real.sqrt s := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP0, hP⟩ := exists_drift_radius id continuous_id Y hY T
  obtain ⟨G, hG0, hG⟩ := exists_drift_radius f hf.continuous Y hY T
  let Ξ : ℝ := ‖K‖ * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ))
  refine ⟨P, G, G + Ξ, hP0, hG0, by dsimp [Ξ]; positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact ⟨hP t ht, hG t ht⟩
  · intro a s ha hs hs1 haT
    have hnoise : ‖samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 (a + s) -
        samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 a‖ ≤ Ξ * Real.sqrt s := by
      rw [samplerBrownianInput_segment]
      exact samplerBrownianInput_bound Q K W hW a s ha hs
    have hinc := integral_segment_sqrt_modulus f Y (samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0)
      T a s G Ξ (hf.continuous.comp hY) ha hs hs1 haT hG0 heq hG hnoise
    refine ⟨hinc, ?_⟩
    exact (hf.norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by
      calc
        _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ((G + Ξ) * Real.sqrt s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinc L.coe_nonneg
        _ = _ := by ring)

PBGSO/GlobalODE.lean.scope_note: Assume a complete real Banach state space and a globally Lipschitz primitive field. Neither trajectory existence nor regularity of the selector in the initial state is a premise. Joint C¹ dependence is subsequently derived by FlowDifferentiability for C¹ fields.
PBGSO/GlobalODE.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.GlobalIntegral

/-! # Global ODE trajectories from a primitive globally Lipschitz field

Forward and reverse Picard integral trajectories are glued at time zero.
Their actual derivatives agree there. The resulting all-real-time flow
selector assumes no joint continuity or differentiability in its initial
state; those properties can subsequently be proved from the vector field.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The ODE is derived from the actual zero-input integral equation by FTC. -/

/-- Primitive global Lipschitz regularity constructs an actual all-time
trajectory from every initial state, including the derivative at zero. -/

end PBGSO

global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_header:
theorem global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (initial : E) (Y : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - initial = ∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt Y (f (Y t)) (Ici 0) t
global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (initial : E) (Y : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - initial = ∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt Y (f (Y t)) (Ici 0) t := by
  have hc := hf.comp hY
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
    (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 t) (hc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hc.continuousAt
  apply (hd.const_add initial).hasDerivWithinAt.congr
  · intro r hr
    exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (heq r hr)).trans (add_comm _ _)
  · exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (heq t ht)).trans (add_comm _ _)

exists_global_ode_flow.exact_header:
theorem exists_global_ode_flow (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × E → E, (∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) ∧
      ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun r => Φ (r, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t
exists_global_ode_flow.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_global_ode_flow (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × E → E, (∀ x, Φ (0, x) = x) ∧
      ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun r => Φ (r, x)) (f (Φ (t, x))) t := by
  classical
  have ex (g : E → E) (hg : LipschitzWith L g) (x : E) :
      ∃ Y : ℝ → E, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = x ∧
        ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - x = ∫ r in 0..t, g (Y r) := by
    obtain ⟨Y, hc, hz, he⟩ := exists_global_integral_solution g L hg x
      (fun _ => 0) continuous_const rfl
    exact ⟨Y, hc, hz, fun t ht => by simpa using he t ht⟩
  choose Yp hpc hp0 hpe using ex f hf
  choose Ym hmc hm0 hme using ex (fun z => -f z) hf.neg
  let Φ : ℝ × E → E := fun p => if 0 ≤ p.1 then Yp p.2 p.1 else Ym p.2 (-p.1)
  have hΦ0 (x : E) : Φ (0, x) = x := by simp [Φ, hp0]
  have hpd (x : E) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (Yp x) (f (Yp x t)) (Ici 0) t :=
    global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt f hf.continuous x (Yp x) (hpc x) (hpe x) t ht
  have hmd (x : E) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (Ym x) (-f (Ym x t)) (Ici 0) t :=
    global_integral_hasDerivWithinAt (fun z => -f z) hf.continuous.neg x
      (Ym x) (hmc x) (hme x) t ht
  refine ⟨Φ, hΦ0, ?_⟩
  intro t x
  rcases lt_trichotomy t 0 with ht | rfl | ht
  · have hd := ((hmd x (-t) (by linarith)).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds (by linarith)))
      |>.scomp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)
    have he : (fun r => Φ (r, x)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun r => Ym x (-r)) := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_lt_nhds ht] with r hr
      simp [Φ, not_le.mpr hr]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, neg_smul, one_smul, neg_neg,
      Φ, ite_eq_right (not_le.mpr ht)] using hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq he
  · have hp : HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Φ (r, x)) (f x) (Ici 0) 0 := by
      have hd := hpd x 0 le_rfl
      rw [hp0 x] at hd
      exact hd.congr (fun r hr => by simp [Φ, show 0 ≤ r from hr]) (by simp [Φ])
    have hm : HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Φ (r, x)) (f x) (Iic 0) 0 := by
      have hd0 := hmd x 0 le_rfl
      have hd : HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Ym x (-r)) (f x) (Iic 0) 0 := by
        have hc := (hmd x (-0) (by norm_num)).scomp 0
          ((hasDerivAt_neg (0 : ℝ)).hasDerivWithinAt (s := Iic 0))
          (show MapsTo (fun r : ℝ => -r) (Iic 0) (Ici 0) from
            fun r hr => by
              change 0 ≤ -r
              exact neg_nonneg.mpr (show r ≤ 0 from hr))
        simpa [Function.comp_def, hm0] using hc
      apply hd.congr
      · intro r hr
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show r ≤ 0 from hr) with hr | rfl
        · simp [Φ, not_le.mpr hr]
        · simp [hΦ0, hm0]
      · simp [hΦ0, hm0]
    have hu := hp.union hm
    rw [Ici_union_Iic] at hu
    simpa only [hΦ0] using hu.hasDerivAt (by simp)
  · have hd := (hpd x t ht.le).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds ht)
    have he : (fun r => Φ (r, x)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] Yp x := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds ht] with r hr
      simp [Φ, hr.le]
    simpa only [Φ, ite_eq_left ht.le] using hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq he

PBGSO/GridIntegralCompletion.lean.scope_note: IntegralDomain consists precisely of time-L² limits represented by the actual adapted step approximations in the signature. Scalar pre-Brownian laws and measurable evaluations are explicit. Density, membership of arbitrary continuous diffusion processes, timewise martingale consistency and a full state-dependent SDE are not claimed by this completion alone.
PBGSO/GridIntegralCompletion.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.BrownianGridIsometry
import PBGSO.TimeGridEnergy

/-! # L² completion of actual predictable Brownian sums

Coefficient step functions are literal elements of L²(time;L²(Ω)).
Refinement uses the same Brownian path. The stochastic-limit isometry is
derived from the finite formulas; it is not a supplied stochastic-integral
property.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.GridIntegralCompletion
open PBGSO.BrownianGridIsometry
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B Q)
  (hBm : ∀ t, Measurable (B t))

/-- A primitive adapted square-integrable random coefficient. -/






/-- Finite Brownian integration preserves the actual L² distance of its
coefficient time-step functions. -/



/-- Actual coefficient refinement, measurable at the new left endpoint. -/



/-- The primitive grid compatibility needed for completion. This contains
only deterministic time-grid relations. -/
/-- The same distance identity holds across different compatible grids. -/
/-- Completion is derived from coefficient-time-L² convergence. No
Cauchy or isometry assumption is imposed on the stochastic sums. -/
/-- Every convergent sequence of actual adapted step integrands defines a
unique L² Brownian-integral limit and its norm equals the integrand norm. -/
/-- The completed integral is independent of the approximating adapted
step functions. More generally it preserves their exact L² distance. -/



/-- A concrete compatible sequence of dyadic grids. -/

/-- The domain consists of actual time-L² limits of adapted finite-step
functions on the refining grids. Thus stochastic integration is constructed
on the closure represented by such approximations. -/
/-- The actual L² Brownian integral, constructed by completion. -/
/-- Every qualifying adapted step approximation converges to the
constructed integral, independently of all classical choices. -/
/-- Brownian integration is an actual isometry on the constructed
predictable step-closure domain. -/

end PBGSO.GridIntegralCompletion

Coefficient.exact_declaration:
structure Coefficient (t : ℝ≥0) where
  value : Ω → Z
  adapted : StronglyMeasurable[brownianFiltration B hBm t] value
  square : MemLp value 2 Q

Coefficients.exact_declaration: abbrev Coefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) := ∀ k, Coefficient (Z := Z) Q B hBm (τ k)

Coefficient.toLp.exact_header: def Coefficient.toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q B hBm t) : Lp Z 2 Q
Coefficient.toLp.exact_declaration:
def Coefficient.toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q B hBm t) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  A.square.toLp A.value

coefficientStep.exact_header:
def coefficientStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)
coefficientStep.exact_declaration:
def coefficientStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp (Lp Z 2 Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
  TimeGridEnergy.grid τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) n

include hB in

stochasticStep.exact_header:
def stochasticStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) : Lp Z 2 Q
stochasticStep.exact_declaration:
def stochasticStep (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  (gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (A k).value)
    (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n).toLp
      (gridSum B τ (fun k => (A k).value) n)

include hB in

stochasticStep_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n‖ ^ 2 = ‖coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n‖ ^ 2
stochasticStep_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n‖ ^ 2 = ‖coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [stochasticStep, gridSum_norm_sq Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (A k).value)
    (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n, coefficientStep,
    TimeGridEnergy.grid_norm_sq τ hτ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact (A k).square.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z : Z => ‖z‖ ^ 2) |>.symm

subtract.exact_header:
def subtract (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ
subtract.exact_declaration:
def subtract (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ := fun k =>
  ⟨fun ω => (A k).value ω - (C k).value ω,
    (A k).adapted.sub (C k).adapted, (A k).square.sub (C k).square⟩

subtract_toLp.exact_header:
theorem subtract_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).toLp = (A k).toLp - (C k).toLp
subtract_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem subtract_toLp (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).toLp = (A k).toLp - (C k).toLp := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).square.coeFn_toLp,
    (A k).square.coeFn_toLp, (C k).square.coeFn_toLp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (A k).toLp (C k).toLp] with ω hs ha hc hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply]
  simp only [Coefficient.toLp]
  rw [hs, ha, hc]
  rfl

coefficientStep_sub.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q B hBm τ (subtract Q B hBm τ A C) n =
      coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n - coefficientStep Q B hBm τ C n
coefficientStep_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q B hBm τ (subtract Q B hBm τ A C) n =
      coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n - coefficientStep Q B hBm τ C n := by
  simp only [coefficientStep, subtract_toLp]
  exact TimeGridEnergy.grid_sub τ (fun k => (A k).toLp) (fun k => (C k).toLp) n

include hB in

stochasticStep_sub.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ (subtract Q B hBm τ A C) n =
      stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n - stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ C n
stochasticStep_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ (subtract Q B hBm τ A C) n =
      stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n - stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ C n := by
  let hA := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (A k).value)
    (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n
  let hC := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (C k).value)
    (fun k => (C k).adapted) (fun k => (C k).square) n
  let hS := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ
    (fun k => (subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).value)
    (fun k => (subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).adapted)
    (fun k => (subtract Q B hBm τ A C k).square) n
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hA.coeFn_toLp, hC.coeFn_toLp, hS.coeFn_toLp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n)
      (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ C n)] with ω ha hc hs hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply]
  simp only [stochasticStep]
  rw [hs, ha, hc]
  exact gridSum_sub B τ (fun k => (A k).value) (fun k => (C k).value) n ω

include hB in

stochasticStep_dist.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ C n) =
      dist (coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n) (coefficientStep Q B hBm τ C n)
stochasticStep_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_dist (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n) (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ C n) =
      dist (coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n) (coefficientStep Q B hBm τ C n) := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← stochasticStep_sub, ← coefficientStep_sub]
  exact stochasticStep_norm_sq Q B hB hBm τ hτ _ n

refine.exact_declaration:
def refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm υ := fun j =>
  ⟨(A (j / d)).value,
    (A (j / d)).adapted.mono ((brownianFiltration B hBm).mono (by
      rw [← hυ (j / d)]
      exact hυmono (Nat.mul_div_le j d))), (A (j / d)).square⟩

refine_toLp.exact_header:
theorem refine_toLp (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (j : ℕ) :
    (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A j).toLp = (A (j / d)).toLp
refine_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem refine_toLp (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (j : ℕ) :
    (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A j).toLp = (A (j / d)).toLp := rfl

coefficientStep_refine.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q B hBm υ (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n
coefficientStep_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q B hBm υ (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      coefficientStep Q B hBm τ A n := by
  simp only [coefficientStep, refine_toLp]
  exact TimeGridEnergy.grid_refine_mul τ υ hυmono d hd hυ (fun k => (A k).toLp) n

include hB in

stochasticStep_refine.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q B hB hBm υ hυmono (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n
stochasticStep_refine.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_refine (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (hυmono : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q B hB hBm υ hυmono (refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A) (d * n) =
      stochasticStep Q B hB hBm τ hτ A n := by
  let C := refine Q B hBm τ υ hυmono d hd hυ A
  let hc := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm υ hυmono (fun k => (C k).value)
    (fun k => (C k).adapted) (fun k => (C k).square) (d * n)
  let ha := gridSum_memLp Q B hB hBm τ hτ (fun k => (A k).value)
    (fun k => (A k).adapted) (fun k => (A k).square) n
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hc.coeFn_toLp, ha.coeFn_toLp] with ω hc ha
  simp only [stochasticStep]
  rw [hc, ha]
  exact gridSum_refine_mul B τ υ d hd hυ (fun k => (A k).value) n ω

RefiningGrids.exact_declaration:
structure RefiningGrids where
  time : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ≥0
  monotone : ∀ n, Monotone (time n)
  count : ℕ → ℕ
  compatible : ∀ m n, m ≤ n → ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ count n = d * count m ∧
    ∀ k, time n (d * k) = time m k

include hB in

stochasticStep_dist_cross.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm (G.time n)) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m))
      (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm (G.time n) (G.monotone n) C (G.count n)) =
    dist (coefficientStep Q B hBm (G.time m) A (G.count m))
      (coefficientStep Q B hBm (G.time n) C (G.count n))
stochasticStep_dist_cross.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_dist_cross (G : RefiningGrids) (m n : ℕ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm (G.time m))
    (C : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q B hBm (G.time n)) :
    dist (stochasticStep Q B hB hBm (G.time m) (G.monotone m) A (G.count m))

    (G.monotone m) (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m)

    (G.monotone n) d hd htime A (G.count m)

dyadicGrids.exact_declaration:
def dyadicGrids (T : ℝ≥0) : RefiningGrids where
  time n k := (k : ℝ≥0) * (T / (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n)
  monotone n := fun a b hab => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hab) (by positivity)
  count n := 2 ^ n
  compatible m n hmn := by
    refine ⟨2 ^ (n - m), by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        2 ^ n = 2 ^ ((n - m) + m) := congrArg (fun j : ℕ => 2 ^ j) (by omega)
        _ = _ := pow_add 2 (n - m) m
    · intro k
      have hp : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n = (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (n - m) * (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ m := by
        rw [← pow_add, show n - m + m = n by omega]
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      rw [hp]
      have h1 : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (n - m) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ m ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp

    (he.const_mul (4 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3))).sub (he.const_mul (2 * γ / α)))
  have hC := ((hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub he2).const_mul
    (3 * γ ^ 3 / (2 * α ^ 4) + γ / α ^ 2)
  have hd := (hA.add (hB.mul ht)).add hC
  convert hd using 1
  · funext s
    dsimp [holSigma13]
  · dsimp [holCoefficients]
    field_simp
    <;> ring

holSigma23_hasDeriv.exact_header:
theorem holSigma23_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (holSigma23 α γ)
      (2 * α * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23 * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33) t
holSigma23_hasDeriv.exact_declaration:
theorem holSigma23_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (holSigma23 α γ)
      (2 * α * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23 * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33) t := by
  have he := hol_exp_hasDeriv α t
  have ht := hasDerivAt_id t
  have he2 := he.pow 2
  have hA := ((((he2.sub (he.const_mul 2)).sub_const 2).const_mul
    (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2)).mul ht)
  have hB := ((he2.sub (he.const_mul 4)).add_const 3).const_mul (3 * γ ^ 3 / (2 * α ^ 3))
  have hC := (((hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub he).pow 2).const_mul (γ / α)
  have hd := (hA.add hB).add hC
  convert hd using 1
  · funext s
    dsimp [holSigma23]
  · dsimp [holCoefficients]
    field_simp
    <;> ring

holSigma33_hasDeriv.exact_header:
theorem holSigma33_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (holSigma33 α γ)
      (2 * α * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33 ^ 2) t
holSigma33_hasDeriv.exact_declaration:
theorem holSigma33_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (holSigma33 α γ)
      (2 * α * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33 ^ 2) t := by
  have he := hol_exp_hasDeriv α t
  have ht := hasDerivAt_id t
  have he2 := he.pow 2
  have hA := ((ht.pow 2).mul he2).const_mul (-(γ ^ 4 / α ^ 2))
  have hB := ((he2.const_mul (-(2 * γ ^ 2 / α))).add
    ((((he2.const_mul (-3)).add (he.const_mul 4)).add_const 2).const_mul
      (γ ^ 4 / α ^ 3))).mul ht
  have hC := (((he2.const_mul (-5)).add (he.const_mul 16)).sub_const 11).const_mul
    (γ ^ 4 / (2 * α ^ 4))
  have hD := (((he2.const_mul (-3)).add (he.const_mul 4)).sub_const 1).const_mul (γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2)
  have hE := (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub he2
  have hd := (((hA.add hB).add hC).add hD).add hE
  convert hd using 1
  · funext s
    dsimp [holSigma33]
    ring
  · dsimp [holCoefficients]
    field_simp
    <;> ring

holCovarianceMatrix.exact_declaration:
def holCovarianceMatrix (α γ h : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ![![holSigma11 α γ h, holSigma12 α γ h, holSigma13 α γ h],
    ![holSigma12 α γ h, holSigma22 α γ h, holSigma23 α γ h],
    ![holSigma13 α γ h, holSigma23 α γ h, holSigma33 α γ h]]

holTripleKernels.exact_header: def holTripleKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ → ℝ
holTripleKernels.exact_declaration:
def holTripleKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ → ℝ :=

continuous_holTripleKernels.exact_header:
theorem continuous_holTripleKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :

continuous_holTripleKernels.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_holTripleKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :

holTriple_product.exact_header:
private theorem holTriple_product (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (i j : Fin 3) :
    holTripleKernels α γ i t * holTripleKernels α γ j t =
      2 * α * ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13,
        (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] i *
        ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13,
          (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] j
holTriple_product.exact_declaration:
private theorem holTriple_product (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (i j : Fin 3) :
    holTripleKernels α γ i t * holTripleKernels α γ j t =
      2 * α * ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13,
        (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] i *
        ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13,
          (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] j := by
  have he (i : Fin 3) : holTripleKernels α γ i t = Real.sqrt (2 * α) *
      ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13,
        (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [he i, he j]
  calc
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * α) ^ 2 *
        (![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23,
          (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] i *
        ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23,
          (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33] j) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]; ring

holCovarianceMatrix_hasDeriv.exact_header:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (i j : Fin 3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => holCovarianceMatrix α γ s i j)
      (holTripleKernels α γ i t * holTripleKernels α γ j t) t
holCovarianceMatrix_hasDeriv.exact_declaration:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_hasDeriv (α γ t : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (i j : Fin 3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => holCovarianceMatrix α γ s i j)
      (holTripleKernels α γ i t * holTripleKernels α γ j t) t := by
  rw [holTriple_product α γ t hα.le i j]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, pow_two, mul_assoc] using holSigma11_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix] using holSigma12_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix] using holSigma13_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      holSigma12_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, pow_two, mul_assoc] using holSigma22_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix] using holSigma23_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      holSigma13_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      holSigma23_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'
  · simpa [holCovarianceMatrix, pow_two, mul_assoc] using holSigma33_hasDeriv α γ t hα.ne'

holCovarianceMatrix_zero.exact_header: theorem holCovarianceMatrix_zero (α γ : ℝ) : holCovarianceMatrix α γ 0 = 0
holCovarianceMatrix_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_zero (α γ : ℝ) : holCovarianceMatrix α γ 0 = 0 := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [holCovarianceMatrix, holSigma11, holSigma12, holSigma13,
      holSigma22, holSigma23, holSigma33]

holCovarianceMatrix_eq_gram.exact_header:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_eq_gram (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    holCovarianceMatrix α γ h = gramCovariance (holTripleKernels α γ) h
holCovarianceMatrix_eq_gram.exact_declaration:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_eq_gram (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    holCovarianceMatrix α γ h = gramCovariance (holTripleKernels α γ) h := by
  ext i j
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun t _ => holCovarianceMatrix_hasDeriv α γ t hα i j)
    (((continuous_holTripleKernels α γ i).mul
      (continuous_holTripleKernels α γ j)).intervalIntegrable 0 h)
  have hz : holCovarianceMatrix α γ 0 i j = 0 := by rw [holCovarianceMatrix_zero]; rfl
  simpa only [hz, sub_zero, gramCovariance] using hi.symm

holCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef.exact_header:
theorem holCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :

theorem holCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :

  rw [holCovarianceMatrix_eq_gram α γ h hα]
  exact gramCovariance_posSemidef _ (continuous_holTripleKernels α γ) hh

theorem holTripleNoise_jointLaw (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (a h : ℝ≥0) :

PBGSO/HOLNoise.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.HigherOrderMethod
import KineticLangevin.VectorSegmentEquations

/-!
# Actual jointly Gaussian innovations for HOL-MYPGD

The three response kernels are the implementation's `μ13, μ23, μ33`,
multiplied by `sqrt(2α)`. A fourth constant kernel couples them to the actual
Brownian increment on the same interval. Their joint law is constructed from
the canonical Brownian source and has the genuine integral Gram covariance.
No supplied covariance or noise-matching bound is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal RealInnerProductSpace Topology
namespace PBGSO.Methods
open KineticLangevin KineticLangevin.BrownianConvolution

/-- The three implemented Gaussian response kernels and the coupled
unfiltered Brownian kernel, in the order `(x,u,v,B)`. -/


/-- The four responses on one actual canonical Brownian segment. -/

/-- The constructed responses are jointly Gaussian with their actual
Gram covariance. This includes their coupling to the Brownian increment. -/

/-- Every covariance entry is a verified integral of the response kernels. -/

/-- The Brownian isometry computes the exact second moment of a response. -/

/-- Kernel subtraction is subtraction of the actual coupled responses. -/

/-- Scaling a deterministic response scales its coupled Wiener integral. -/

/-- The fourth innovation is precisely the scaled actual Brownian
increment; it is not merely an independently chosen Gaussian with the
same marginal variance. -/

/-- A bounded kernel gives a derived `sqrt(h)` response norm bound. -/

/-- The exact spatial dimension factor follows from the real coordinate
second moments and the product source's marginal measures. -/

/-- Vector response norm from its scalar response, with exact `sqrt(d)`. -/

/-- Actual vector innovations, with independent spatial Brownian sources. -/

/-- The reference increment used in the vector noise budget is the actual
scaled coordinatewise Brownian increment on the same time segment. -/

/-- Independent full Gaussian blocks over all iterations and all spatial
coordinates. The four coordinates inside each block retain their proved
correlations. -/

/-- The complete independent Brownian innovation array has exactly the
product of the verified four-coordinate Gaussian block laws. -/

end PBGSO.Methods

holNoiseKernels.exact_header: def holNoiseKernels (α γ : ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℝ
holNoiseKernels.exact_declaration:
def holNoiseKernels (α γ : ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℝ := fun i t =>
  Real.sqrt (2 * α) *
    ![(holCoefficients α γ t).μ13, (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23,
      (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33, 1] i

continuous_holNoiseKernels.exact_header:
theorem continuous_holNoiseKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 4) :
    Continuous (holNoiseKernels α γ i)
continuous_holNoiseKernels.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_holNoiseKernels (α γ : ℝ) (i : Fin 4) :
    Continuous (holNoiseKernels α γ i) := by
  fin_cases i
  · change Continuous (fun t => Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ13)
    unfold holCoefficients
    fun_prop
  · change Continuous (fun t => Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ23)
    unfold holCoefficients
    fun_prop
  · change Continuous (fun t => Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (holCoefficients α γ t).μ33)
    unfold holCoefficients
    fun_prop
  · change Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (2 * α) * 1)
    exact continuous_const

holScalarNoise.exact_header: def holScalarNoise (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin 4) : Lp ℝ 2 probability
holScalarNoise.exact_declaration:
def holScalarNoise (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin 4) : Lp ℝ 2 probability :=
  segmentConvolutionLp (holNoiseKernels α γ i) (continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ i) a h

holScalarNoise_jointLaw.exact_header:
theorem holScalarNoise_jointLaw (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => holScalarNoise α γ a h i ω))
      (kernelGaussian (holNoiseKernels α γ) h) probability
holScalarNoise_jointLaw.exact_declaration:
theorem holScalarNoise_jointLaw (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => holScalarNoise α γ a h i ω))
      (kernelGaussian (holNoiseKernels α γ) h) probability :=
  segmentConvolutionLp_jointLaw (holNoiseKernels α γ)
    (continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ) a h

holScalarNoise_covariance.exact_header:
theorem holScalarNoise_covariance (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) (i j : Fin 4) :
    cov[holScalarNoise α γ a h i, holScalarNoise α γ a h j; probability] =
      ∫ s in 0..(h : ℝ), holNoiseKernels α γ i s * holNoiseKernels α γ j s
holScalarNoise_covariance.exact_declaration:
theorem holScalarNoise_covariance (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) (i j : Fin 4) :
    cov[holScalarNoise α γ a h i, holScalarNoise α γ a h j; probability] =
      ∫ s in 0..(h : ℝ), holNoiseKernels α γ i s * holNoiseKernels α γ j s :=
  segmentConvolutionLp_covariance _ _ _ _ _ _

segmentConvolution_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem segmentConvolution_norm_sq (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h‖ ^ 2 = ∫ s in 0..(h : ℝ), k s ^ 2
segmentConvolution_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem segmentConvolution_norm_sq (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    ‖segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h‖ ^ 2 = ∫ s in 0..(h : ℝ), k s ^ 2 := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, segmentConvolutionLp,
    (ULA.GaussianHilbert.isonormal ULA.CanonicalBrownian.basis).inner_map_map,
    segmentKernelLp_inner]
  simp only [pow_two]

segmentConvolution_sub.exact_header:
theorem segmentConvolution_sub (k l : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (hl : Continuous l)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h - segmentConvolutionLp l hl a h =
      segmentConvolutionLp (fun s => k s - l s) (hk.sub hl) a h
segmentConvolution_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem segmentConvolution_sub (k l : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (hl : Continuous l)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h - segmentConvolutionLp l hl a h =
      segmentConvolutionLp (fun s => k s - l s) (hk.sub hl) a h := by
  unfold segmentConvolutionLp
  rw [← map_sub]
  congr 1
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (segmentKernelLp k hk a h) (segmentKernelLp l hl a h),
    segmentKernelLp_coe k hk a h, segmentKernelLp_coe l hl a h,
    segmentKernelLp_coe (fun s => k s - l s) (hk.sub hl) a h] with r hs hk hl hkl
  rw [hs, Pi.sub_apply, hk, hl, hkl]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc (a : ℝ) ((a : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)) <;> simp [hr]

segmentConvolution_smul.exact_header:
theorem segmentConvolution_smul (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (c : ℝ)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    segmentConvolutionLp (fun s => c * k s) (continuous_const.mul hk) a h =
      c • segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h
segmentConvolution_smul.exact_declaration:
theorem segmentConvolution_smul (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (c : ℝ)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    segmentConvolutionLp (fun s => c * k s) (continuous_const.mul hk) a h =
      c • segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h := by
  unfold segmentConvolutionLp
  rw [← map_smul]
  congr 1
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul c (segmentKernelLp k hk a h),
    segmentKernelLp_coe k hk a h,
    segmentKernelLp_coe (fun s => c * k s) (continuous_const.mul hk) a h]
    with r hs hk hck
  rw [hs, Pi.smul_apply, hk, hck]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc (a : ℝ) ((a : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)) <;> simp [hr]

holScalarNoise_brownian.exact_header:
theorem holScalarNoise_brownian (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    holScalarNoise α γ a h 3 = Real.sqrt (2 * α) • segmentBrownianLp a h
holScalarNoise_brownian.exact_declaration:
theorem holScalarNoise_brownian (α γ : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    holScalarNoise α γ a h 3 = Real.sqrt (2 * α) • segmentBrownianLp a h := by
  unfold holScalarNoise
  change segmentConvolutionLp (fun _ => Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (1 : ℝ)) _ a h = _
  simpa only [segmentConvolutionLp_one] using
    segmentConvolution_smul (fun _ => 1) continuous_const (Real.sqrt (2 * α)) a h

segmentConvolution_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem segmentConvolution_norm_le (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (a h : ℝ≥0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ), |k s| ≤ C) :
    ‖segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)
segmentConvolution_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem segmentConvolution_norm_le (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Continuous k) (a h : ℝ≥0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ), |k s| ≤ C) :
    ‖segmentConvolutionLp k hk a h‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..(h : ℝ), k s ^ 2) ≤ C ^ 2 * (h : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ _s in 0..(h : ℝ), C ^ 2 := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h.coe_nonneg
          ((hk.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const
        intro s hs
        have hb := hbound s hs
        change k s ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2
        exact (sq_abs (k s)) ▸ ((sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (k s)) hC).mpr hb)
      _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm]
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h.coe_nonneg, segmentConvolution_norm_sq]
  exact hi

spatialLift_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem spatialLift_norm_sq (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X : Lp ℝ 2 probability) :
    ‖spatialLift ι X‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ‖X‖ ^ 2
spatialLift_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem spatialLift_norm_sq (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X : Lp ℝ 2 probability) :
    ‖spatialLift ι X‖ ^ 2 = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, L2.inner_def]
  have hs : (fun ω => inner ℝ (spatialLift ι X ω) (spatialLift ι X ω)) =ᵐ[
      ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability ι]
      (fun ω => ∑ i : ι, X (ω i) ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [spatialLift_coe ι X] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  rw [integral_congr_ae hs]
  have hi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω : ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample ι =>
      X (ω i) ^ 2) (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability ι) := by
    exact (measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi (fun _ : ι => probability) i).integrable_comp_of_integrable
      (Lp.memLp X).integrable_sq
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)]
  have he (i : ι) : (∫ ω : ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample ι, X (ω i) ^ 2
      ∂ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability ι) = ‖X‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hp : MeasurePreserving (fun ω : ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample ι => ω i)
        (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability ι) probability :=
      measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi (fun _ : ι => probability) i
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => X x ^ 2)
        ((ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability ι).map (fun ω => ω i)) := by
      simpa only [hp.map_eq] using (Lp.memLp X).integrable_sq.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hint := integral_map hp.measurable.aemeasurable hm
    rw [hp.map_eq] at hint
    rw [← hint]
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with ω
    simp [pow_two]
  simp_rw [he]
  simp

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.Methods
open KineticLangevin KineticLangevin.BrownianConvolution

/-- Explicit scalar noise-coupling constant, with no unknown covariance
or innovation remainder parameter. -/

/-- The implemented middle response is bounded linearly in elapsed time. -/

/-- All three relevant kernel defects are bounded directly from the exact
printed coefficients. -/

/-- The exact three-coordinate noise discrepancy from the coupled Brownian

holScalarNoiseConstant.exact_declaration:
def holScalarNoiseConstant (α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (γ / 2 + γ + α + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33)

hol_mu23_bound.exact_header:
theorem hol_mu23_bound (α γ s : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ23| ≤ γ * s
hol_mu23_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem hol_mu23_bound (α γ s : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ23| ≤ γ * s := by
  have he : Real.exp (-α * s) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have he' := Real.add_one_le_exp (-α * s)
  have hc : 0 ≤ γ / α := div_nonneg hγ hα.le
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (show 1 - Real.exp (-α * s) ≤ α * s by linarith) hc
  dsimp [holCoefficients]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc (sub_nonneg.mpr he))]
  convert hmul using 1 <;> field_simp <;> ring

holNoiseKernels_bounds.exact_header:
theorem holNoiseKernels_bounds (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ)) :
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 0 s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (γ / 2) * (h : ℝ) ∧
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 1 s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * α) * γ * (h : ℝ) ∧
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 2 s - holNoiseKernels α γ 3 s| ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (α + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33) * (h : ℝ)
holNoiseKernels_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem holNoiseKernels_bounds (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ)) :
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 0 s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (γ / 2) * (h : ℝ) ∧
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 1 s| ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * α) * γ * (h : ℝ) ∧
    |holNoiseKernels α γ 2 s - holNoiseKernels α γ 3 s| ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (α + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33) * (h : ℝ) := by
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := hs.2.trans hh1
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 ≤ (h : ℝ) := by nlinarith [hs.1, hs.2]
  have hc33 : 0 ≤ (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33 := by
    dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    positivity
  have h13 : |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ13| ≤ γ / 2 * (h : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hs0 : s = 0
    · simp [hs0, holCoefficients]
      positivity
    · have hc := (holCoefficient_bounds α γ s hα hγ (lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (Ne.symm hs0)) hs1).bound13
      change |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ13| ≤ γ / 2 * s ^ 2 at hc
      exact hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 (by positivity))
  have h23 := (hol_mu23_bound α γ s hα hγ hs.1).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 hγ)
  have h33 : |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ33 - 1| ≤
      (α + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33) * (h : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hs0 : s = 0
    · simp [hs0, holCoefficients]
      positivity
    · have hc := (holCoefficient_bounds α γ s hα hγ (lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (Ne.symm hs0)) hs1).bound33
      have ha : |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ33 - 1| ≤
          |(holCoefficients α γ s).μ33 - 1 + α * s| + α * s := by
        have hab := abs_sub ((holCoefficients α γ s).μ33 - 1 + α * s) (α * s)
        simpa [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα.le hs.1)] using hab
      have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 hc33
      have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 hα.le
      nlinarith
  constructor
  · simp only [holNoiseKernels, Matrix.cons_val_zero, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h13 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by ring)
  constructor
  · simp only [holNoiseKernels, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h23 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by ring)
  · have he : holNoiseKernels α γ 2 s - holNoiseKernels α γ 3 s =
        Real.sqrt (2 * α) * ((holCoefficients α γ s).μ33 - 1) := by
      simp [holNoiseKernels]
      ring
    rw [he, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h33 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by ring)

holScalarNoise_error_le.exact_header:
theorem holScalarNoise_error_le (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1) :
    ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 0‖ + ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 1‖ +
      ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 2 - holScalarNoise α γ a h 3‖ ≤
      holScalarNoiseConstant α γ * (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)
holScalarNoise_error_le.exact_declaration:
theorem holScalarNoise_error_le (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1) :
    ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 0‖ + ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 1‖ +
      ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 2 - holScalarNoise α γ a h 3‖ ≤
      holScalarNoiseConstant α γ * (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
  have hc33 : 0 ≤ (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33 := by
    dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    positivity
  have h0 := segmentConvolution_norm_le (holNoiseKernels α γ 0)
    (continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ 0) a h
    (Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (γ / 2) * (h : ℝ)) (by positivity)
    (fun s hs => (holNoiseKernels_bounds α γ hα hγ h hh1 s hs).1)
  have h1 := segmentConvolution_norm_le (holNoiseKernels α γ 1)
    (continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ 1) a h
    (Real.sqrt (2 * α) * γ * (h : ℝ)) (by positivity)
    (fun s hs => (holNoiseKernels_bounds α γ hα hγ h hh1 s hs).2.1)
  have h2 := segmentConvolution_norm_le
    (fun s => holNoiseKernels α γ 2 s - holNoiseKernels α γ 3 s)
    ((continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ 2).sub (continuous_holNoiseKernels α γ 3)) a h
    (Real.sqrt (2 * α) * (α + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33) * (h : ℝ))
    (by positivity)
    (fun s hs => (holNoiseKernels_bounds α γ hα hγ h hh1 s hs).2.2)
  rw [← segmentConvolution_sub] at h2
  change ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 2 - holScalarNoise α γ a h 3‖ ≤ _ at h2
  change ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 0‖ ≤ _ at h0
  change ‖holScalarNoise α γ a h 1‖ ≤ _ at h1
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (add_le_add h0 h1) h2
    _ = _ := by unfold holScalarNoiseConstant; ring

theorem holVectorNoise_error_le (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)

holVectorNoise_error_le.exact_declaration:
theorem holVectorNoise_error_le (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1) :

  have hu := ULA.langevin_integral_unique (fun w ↦ -holDrift Fbar G α γ w)
    (holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ)
    (holDrift_globally_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG).neg z
    (higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α a)
    (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a) r
    (higherOrderRestart_continuous Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a) hr t ht
    (fun s hs ↦ by
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
        higherOrderRestart_equation Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a s hs.1)
    (fun s hs ↦ by
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using heq s hs.1)
  exact hu ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩

higherOrderRestart_agrees.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderRestart_agrees
    (Y : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, holDrift Fbar G α γ (Y s)) + higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0 t)
    (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG (Y a) a t = Y (a + t)
higherOrderRestart_agrees.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderRestart_agrees
    (Y : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, holDrift Fbar G α γ (Y s)) + higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0 t)
    (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG (Y a) a t = Y (a + t) := by
  apply higherOrderRestart_unique Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG (Y a) a
    (fun s ↦ Y (a + s)) (hY.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)) (by simp)
  · intro s hs
    have he := PBGSO.MethodSegments.integral_shift Y (fun r ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (Y r))
      (higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0)
      ((holDrift_globally_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG).continuous.comp hY)
      heq a s ha hs
    rw [higherOrderRestartInput_increment] at he
    exact he
  · exact ht

higherOrderRestart_contracts.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderRestart_contracts
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (C : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (holDrift Fbar G α γ x - holDrift Fbar G α γ y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (z w : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖C (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a t -
        higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG w a t)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖C (z - w)‖
higherOrderRestart_contracts.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderRestart_contracts
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (C : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (holDrift Fbar G α γ x - holDrift Fbar G α γ y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (z w : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖C (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a t -
        higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG w a t)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖C (z - w)‖ := by
  have hm : ∀ x y, ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      inner ℝ (C (x - y))
        (C ((-holDrift Fbar G α γ x) - (-holDrift Fbar G α γ y))) := by
    intro x y
    rw [show -holDrift Fbar G α γ x - -holDrift Fbar G α γ y =
      -(holDrift Fbar G α γ x - holDrift Fbar G α γ y) by abel,
      map_neg, inner_neg_right]
    linarith [hmono x y]
  have hc := PBGSO.transformed_additive_integral_contraction
    (fun w ↦ -holDrift Fbar G α γ w) (holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ)
    (holDrift_globally_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG).neg C ρ hm
    (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a)
    (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG w a)
    (higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α a)
    (higherOrderRestart_continuous Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a)
    (higherOrderRestart_continuous Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG w a) t
    (fun s hs ↦ by
      simpa only [higherOrderRestart_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
        higherOrderRestart_equation Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a s hs.1)
    (fun s hs ↦ by
      simpa only [higherOrderRestart_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using
        higherOrderRestart_equation Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG w a s hs.1)
    t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
  simpa only [higherOrderRestart_zero] using hc

/-! # Explicit restarted HOL local error from primitive assumptions

The original integral equation, global force regularity and actual Brownian
increment moments derive every radius and temporal modulus used here.
The resulting error is affine in the arbitrary random initial state's norm.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.Methods

/-- Actual final-auxiliary Brownian increment radius. -/

/-- State-independent part of the actual HOL local error coefficient. -/

/-- Linear initial-state part of the actual HOL local error coefficient. -/


variable {Ω I Θ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {f : Ω → ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I}
  (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
  (Fbar : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Θ)
  (G : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)
  (LF LG α γ : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
  (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
  (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))

holUniformNoiseRadius.exact_header: def holUniformNoiseRadius (I : Type*) [Fintype I] (α : ℝ) : ℝ
holUniformNoiseRadius.exact_declaration:
def holUniformNoiseRadius (I : Type*) [Fintype I] (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt α * Real.sqrt (2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ))

holUniformLocalConstant0.exact_header:
def holUniformLocalConstant0 (I : Type*) [Fintype I]
    (α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero : ℝ) : ℝ
holUniformLocalConstant0.exact_declaration:
def holUniformLocalConstant0 (I : Type*) [Fintype I]
    (α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let L : ℝ := holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ
  let Ξ := holUniformNoiseRadius I α
  holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG fzero gzero +
    Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * holScalarNoiseConstant α γ +
    (8 / 3 : ℝ) * L * (bzero + L * Real.exp (L + 1) * (bzero + Ξ) + Ξ)

holUniformLocalConstant1.exact_header: def holUniformLocalConstant1 (α γ LF LG fzero gzero : ℝ) : ℝ
holUniformLocalConstant1.exact_declaration:
def holUniformLocalConstant1 (α γ LF LG fzero gzero : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let L : ℝ := holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ
  holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG fzero gzero +
    (8 / 3 : ℝ) * L ^ 2 * Real.exp (L + 1)

holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg.exact_header:
theorem holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg (I : Type*) [Fintype I]
    (α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hfzero : 0 ≤ fzero) (hgzero : 0 ≤ gzero) (hbzero : 0 ≤ bzero) :
    0 ≤ holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero ∧
    0 ≤ holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG fzero gzero
holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg (I : Type*) [Fintype I]
    (α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hfzero : 0 ≤ fzero) (hgzero : 0 ≤ gzero) (hbzero : 0 ≤ bzero) :
    0 ≤ holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG fzero gzero bzero ∧
    0 ≤ holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG fzero gzero := by
  have hc := holLocalGrowthConstant_nonneg α γ LF LG fzero gzero hα hγ hLF hLG hfzero hgzero
  have hn : 0 ≤ holScalarNoiseConstant α γ := by
    dsimp [holScalarNoiseConstant, holRemainderConstants]; positivity
  constructor <;>
    dsimp [holUniformLocalConstant0, holUniformLocalConstant1, holUniformNoiseRadius] <;> positivity

higherOrderRestart_local_error.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderRestart_local_error
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (a h : ℝ≥0)
    (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (z : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z
        (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 0,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 1,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 2))
      (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a h) ≤
      (holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
          ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖ +
        holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ * ‖z‖) *
          (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)
higherOrderRestart_local_error.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderRestart_local_error
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (a h : ℝ≥0)
    (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (z : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z
        (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 0,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 1,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 2))
      (higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a h) ≤
      (holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
          ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖ +
        holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ * ‖z‖) *
          (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
  let r := higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a
  let B := higherOrderRestartInput (Θ := Θ) Q hf α a
  let L := holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ
  let Ξ := holUniformNoiseRadius I α
  let P := PBGSO.UniformIntegral.radius L ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖ Ξ ‖z‖
  let M := ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖ + (L : ℝ) * P + Ξ
  have hr : Continuous r := higherOrderRestart_continuous Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a
  have hB : Continuous B := higherOrderRestartInput_continuous Q hf α a
  have hr0 : r 0 = z := higherOrderRestart_zero Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a
  have hLip := holDrift_globally_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG
  have heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ), r t - r 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r s)) + B t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hr0]
    exact higherOrderRestart_equation Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG z a t ht.1
  have hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ), ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ * Real.sqrt t := by
    intro t ht
    exact higherOrderRestartInput_bound Q hf α a t a.coe_nonneg ht.1
  have hreg := PBGSO.UniformIntegral.local_regularity (holDrift Fbar G α γ) L hLip
    r B hr hB h Ξ h.coe_nonneg hh1 (by dsimp [Ξ, holUniformNoiseRadius]; positivity) heq hinput
  have hmod : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ),
      ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t) - holDrift Fbar G α γ (r 0)‖ ≤
        ((L : ℝ) * M) * Real.sqrt t := by
    intro t ht
    have hi := (hreg t ht).2.2
    rw [hr0] at hi
    calc
      _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖r t - r 0‖ := hLip.norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * (M * Real.sqrt t) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ L.coe_nonneg
        simpa only [hr0, M, P] using hi
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hend : r h = r 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t)) +
      holBrownianIncrement (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3) := by
    have he := heq h ⟨h.coe_nonneg, le_rfl⟩
    dsimp only [B] at he
    rw [higherOrderRestartInput_endpoint Q hf α γ hα.le a h] at he
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at he
    rw [he]
    abel
  have he := higherOrder_pullback_integral_local_error Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ
    ((L : ℝ) * M) a h hLF hLG hα hγ hh hh1 hF hG r
    ((hLip.continuous.comp hr).intervalIntegrable _ _) hend hmod
  rw [hr0] at he
  apply he.trans_eq
  congr 1
  dsimp [holUniformLocalConstant0, holUniformLocalConstant1, M, P,
    PBGSO.UniformIntegral.radius, L, Ξ]
  ring

import PBGSO.HOLRestartLocal

/-! # Time-uniform strong error for the actual printed HOL scheme

The actual Gaussian update is compared with constructed exact Picard restarts.
Primitive weighted dissipativity contracts those restarts. Explicit local
errors grow linearly in the numerical input radius, which is absorbed under
an explicit small-step restriction. Uniform reference moments are derived
from the original integral equation. Numerical contractivity, local errors,
reference moments and final recurrences are not assumptions.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.Methods

/-- The proved uniform exact-flow radius, expressed using primitive data. -/

variable {Ω I Θ H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {f : Ω → ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I}
  (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
  (Fbar : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Θ)
  (G : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)
  (LF LG α γ : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
  (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
  (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))

include hLF hLG hF hG in
/-- Comprehensive time-uniform error against an actual continuous integral
trajectory, for every iteration. The only stability hypothesis is primitive
weighted dissipativity of the original drift; in the particle application it
is derived from source A3. The reference moment radius is a conclusion. -/

/-- Fully constructed exact-reference version of the uniform HOL theorem.
The reference process is the actual Picard solution on the same Brownian
