holUniformReferenceRadius.exact_header:
def holUniformReferenceRadius
    {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ Ξ : ℝ) (z : E) : ℝ
holUniformReferenceRadius.exact_declaration:
def holUniformReferenceRadius
    {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ Ξ : ℝ) (z : E) : ℝ :=
  let S := ‖C‖ * PBGSO.UniformIntegral.radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0
  ‖C z‖ + S / (1 - Real.exp (-ρ)) + S

higherOrder_time_uniform_of_integral.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_time_uniform_of_integral
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (C : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H)
    (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (holDrift Fbar G α γ x - holDrift Fbar G α γ y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (Y : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, holDrift Fbar G α γ (Y s)) + higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0 t)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hρh : ρ * (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (‖C‖ * holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ / m) *
      Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ≤ ρ / 4) (n : ℕ) :
    let c₀ := holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖
    let c₁ := holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
    let R := holUniformReferenceRadius (holDrift Fbar G α γ) (holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ)
      C ρ (holUniformNoiseRadius I α) (Y 0)
    ‖trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h)
        (higherOrderPullbackGaussianNoise I hf α γ h) (Y 0) n - Y ((n : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))‖ ≤
      ((4 * (‖C‖ * c₀ + (‖C‖ * c₁ / m) * R) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)) / m
higherOrder_time_uniform_of_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_time_uniform_of_integral
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (C : HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H)
    (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (holDrift Fbar G α γ x - holDrift Fbar G α γ y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (Y : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ s in 0..t, holDrift Fbar G α γ (Y s)) + higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0 t)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hρh : ρ * (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (‖C‖ * holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ / m) *
      Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ≤ ρ / 4) (n : ℕ) :
    let c₀ := holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖
    let c₁ := holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
    let R := holUniformReferenceRadius (holDrift Fbar G α γ) (holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ)
      C ρ (holUniformNoiseRadius I α) (Y 0)
    ‖trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h)
        (higherOrderPullbackGaussianNoise I hf α γ h) (Y 0) n - Y ((n : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))‖ ≤
      ((4 * (‖C‖ * c₀ + (‖C‖ * c₁ / m) * R) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)) / m := by
  let c₀ := holUniformLocalConstant0 I α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖
  let c₁ := holUniformLocalConstant1 α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
  let L := holDriftGlobalLip LF LG α γ
  let Ξ := holUniformNoiseRadius I α
  let R := holUniformReferenceRadius (holDrift Fbar G α γ) L C ρ Ξ (Y 0)
  let X := trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h)
    (higherOrderPullbackGaussianNoise I hf α γ h) (Y 0)
  let Z := fun k : ℕ ↦ Y ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))
  let A := fun (k : ℕ) x ↦ higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h x
    (higherOrderPullbackGaussianNoise I hf α γ h k)
  let Φ := fun (k : ℕ) x ↦ higherOrderRestart Q hf Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG x
    ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) h
  have hLip := holDrift_globally_lipschitz Fbar G LF LG α γ hLF hLG hF hG
  obtain ⟨hc₀, hc₁⟩ := holUniformLocalConstants_nonneg I α γ LF LG
    ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ 0‖ hα hγ hLF hLG
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hreference (k : ℕ) : ‖C (Z k)‖ ≤ R := by
    apply PBGSO.UniformIntegral.uniform_moment (holDrift Fbar G α γ) L hLip C ρ hρ hmono
      Y (higherOrderRestartInput Q hf α 0) hY
      (higherOrderRestartInput_continuous Q hf α 0) heq Ξ
      (by dsimp [Ξ, holUniformNoiseRadius]; positivity) ?_ ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) (by positivity)
    intro a s ha hs

theorem hol_force_linear_growth
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) :
    ‖Fbar z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ (‖Fbar 0 0‖ + 2 * LF) * (1 + ‖z‖) ∧
    ‖G z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ (‖G 0 0‖ + 2 * LG) * (1 + ‖z‖)
hol_force_linear_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem hol_force_linear_growth
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) :
    ‖Fbar z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ (‖Fbar 0 0‖ + 2 * LF) * (1 + ‖z‖) ∧
    ‖G z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ (‖G 0 0‖ + 2 * LG) * (1 + ‖z‖) := by
  have hθ : ‖z.1‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_fst_le z
  have hx : ‖z.2.1‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := (norm_fst_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z)
  have hf := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub (Fbar 0 0) (Fbar z.1 z.2.1)
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hf
  have hg := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub (G 0 0) (G z.1 z.2.1)
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hg
  have hf' := hF z.1 0 z.2.1 0
  have hg' := hG z.1 0 z.2.1 0
  simp only [sub_zero] at hf' hg'
  constructor
  · have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hθ hLF
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hLF
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (Fbar 0 0)) (norm_nonneg z)]
  · have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hθ hLG
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hLG
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (G 0 0)) (norm_nonneg z)]

theorem higherOrder_euler_linear_growth_error
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG α γ h : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b) ≤
      holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ *
        (1 + ‖z‖) * h ^ 2 + ‖ξ.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.2 - b‖

theorem higherOrder_euler_linear_growth_error
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG α γ h : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b) ≤
      holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ *
        (1 + ‖z‖) * h ^ 2 + ‖ξ.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.2 - b‖ := by
  let A := ‖Fbar 0 0‖ + 2 * LF
  let B := ‖G 0 0‖ + 2 * LG + LG * A
  let R := 1 + ‖z‖
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hgθ : ∀ θ θ' x, ‖G θ x - G θ' x‖ ≤ LG * ‖θ - θ'‖ := by
    intro θ θ' x
    simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] using hG θ θ' x x
  obtain ⟨hf, hg⟩ := hol_force_linear_growth Fbar G LF LG hLF hLG hF hG z
  have hshift : ‖G (z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1) z.2.1‖ ≤ B * R := by
    have hb := higherOrder_shifted_force_bound Fbar G LG h (A * R)
      ((‖G 0 0‖ + 2 * LG) * R) hLG (by simpa [abs_of_pos hh] using hh1)
      hgθ z.1 z.2.1 hf hg
    convert hb using 1
    dsimp [B, R]
    ring
  have hu : ‖z.2.2.1‖ ≤ R := by
    have hp := (norm_fst_le z.2.2).trans ((norm_snd_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z))
    dsimp [R]; linarith
  have hv : ‖z.2.2.2‖ ≤ R := by
    have hp := (norm_snd_le z.2.2).trans ((norm_snd_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z))
    dsimp [R]; linarith
  have he := higherOrder_euler_error Fbar G LG α γ h (A * R) (B * R) R R
    hLG hgθ z ξ b hf hshift hu hv
  have hb := holDeterministicBudget_quadratic α γ h LG (A * R) (B * R) R R
    hα hγ hh hh1 (mul_nonneg hB hR) hR hR
  have hid : holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) LG
      (A * R) (B * R) R R =
      holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ * R := by
    dsimp [holLocalConsistencyConstant, holLocalGrowthConstant, A, B]; ring
  rw [hid] at hb
  dsimp only [holRemainderBudget, holDeterministicBudget] at he hb
  dsimp only [R] at hb
  linarith

    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (r : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q))
    (hInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t)) volume 0 h)
    (heq : r h = r 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t)) +
      holBrownianIncrement (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ),
      ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t) - holDrift Fbar G α γ (r 0)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h (r 0)
        (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 0,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 1,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 2)) (r h) ≤
      (holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ * (1 + ‖r 0‖) +
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * holScalarNoiseConstant α γ + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) *
          (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ)
higherOrder_pullback_integral_local_erro.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_pullback_integral_local_error
    (Fbar : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Θ)
    (G : Θ → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q → Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)
    (LF LG α γ C : ℝ) (a h : ℝ≥0)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (r : ℝ → HOLState Θ (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q))
    (hInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t)) volume 0 h)
    (heq : r h = r 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t)) +
      holBrownianIncrement (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ),
      ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ (r t) - holDrift Fbar G α γ (r 0)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h (r 0)
        (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 0,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 1,
         holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 2)) (r h) ≤
      (holLocalGrowthConstant α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖ * (1 + ‖r 0‖) +
        Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * holScalarNoiseConstant α γ + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) *
          (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
  have he := higherOrder_integral_linear_growth_error Fbar G LF LG α γ h C
    hLF hLG hα hγ hh hh1 hF hG r
    (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 0,
     holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 1,
     holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 2)
    (holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3) hInt heq hmod
  have hn := holPullbackVectorNoise_error_le I hf α γ hα hγ a h hh1
  have hc := holLocalGrowthConstant_nonneg α γ LF LG ‖Fbar 0 0‖ ‖G 0 0‖
    hα hγ hLF hLG (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hs : (h : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith [h.coe_nonneg])
  have hp : (h : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (h : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs h.coe_nonneg
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp
    (mul_nonneg hc (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + ‖r 0‖))
  dsimp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at he
  nlinarith

import PBGSO.HigherOrderMethod
import PBGSO.MomentumConsistency

/-!
# HOL-MYPGD versus its actual continuous higher-order integral equations

The error bound keeps the exact paper coefficients, the sequential parameter
update, and the mismatch between its correlated Gaussian triple and the
reference Brownian increment visible. No target-law or covariance identity is
assumed implicitly. A finite-horizon result follows from the map stability and
this derived local consistency estimate.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
namespace PBGSO.Methods
variable {Θ X : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]

/-- The actual higher-order particle vector field, before discretisation. -/

/-- Diffusion acts solely on the final auxiliary variable `v`. -/

/-- Euler comparison, used only to connect the implemented map to the
continuous integral equation; this is not substituted for the implementation. -/


/-- The completely explicit local consistency budget. Scalar coefficient
errors are kept as exact expressions, so no small-step asymptotics or hidden
constants are required. -/

/-- New local consistency bound for the actual sequential HOL-MYPGD map.
The term `h² LG Fθ` is the parameter/sampler Lie--Trotter splitting error. -/

/-- Sum norm versus the product Banach norm. -/

/-- The product Banach norm is bounded by the coordinate sum used by the
numerical estimates. -/

/-- Original force regularity controls the full higher-order drift. Combined
with an integral-solution increment estimate, this discharges its temporal
modulus hypothesis without assuming a numerical-error inequality. -/

/-- Bounding the original sampler force and the optimiser force bounds the
sampler force at the sequentially updated parameter. -/

/-- The reference Euler defect is derived from its Banach-valued integral
equation and a square-root drift modulus, not from a numerical recurrence. -/

/-- The deterministic portion of the explicit HOL Euler remainder. -/

/-- New finite-horizon discretisation bound for the actual HOL-MYPGD
implementation against compatible solutions of its higher-order integral
system. All assumptions are on the original forces, reference solution, or
innovations; a numerical error recurrence is a derived conclusion.

The explicit coefficient budget does not assert a convergence order by itself.
The bounds `Fθ,FG,U,V,C,B` must be established on the intended time horizon.
For an L² application the ambient Banach spaces and supplied Gaussian/Brownian

end PBGSO.Methods

holDrift.exact_header:
def holDrift (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (α γ : ℝ)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) : HOLState Θ X
holDrift.exact_declaration:
def holDrift (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (α γ : ℝ)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) : HOLState Θ X :=
  (-Fbar z.1 z.2.1, z.2.2.1,
    -G z.1 z.2.1 + γ • z.2.2.2, -γ • z.2.2.1 - α • z.2.2.2)

holBrownianIncrement.exact_header: def holBrownianIncrement (b : X) : HOLState Θ X
holBrownianIncrement.exact_declaration: def holBrownianIncrement (b : X) : HOLState Θ X := (0, 0, 0, b)

holEuler.exact_header:
def holEuler (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (α γ h : ℝ)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (b : X) : HOLState Θ X

norm_four_hol.exact_header:
private theorem norm_four_hol (a b c d : X) :
    ‖a + b + c + d‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ + ‖d‖
norm_four_hol.exact_declaration:
private theorem norm_four_hol (a b c d : X) :
    ‖a + b + c + d‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ + ‖d‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖a + b + c‖ + ‖d‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖a + b‖ + ‖c‖) + ‖d‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _

holRemainderBudget.exact_header:
def holRemainderBudget (μ : HOLCoefficients) (α γ h LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ)
    (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X) : ℝ
holRemainderBudget.exact_declaration:
def holRemainderBudget (μ : HOLCoefficients) (α γ h LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ)
    (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X) : ℝ :=
  (h ^ 2 / 2 + |μ.μ31 * h|) * FG +
    (|μ.μ12 - h| + |μ.μ22 - 1| + |μ.μ32 + γ * h|) * U +
    (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23 - γ * h| + |μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h|) * V +
    h ^ 2 * LG * Fθ + ‖ξ.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.2 - b‖

higherOrder_euler_error.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_euler_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LG α γ h Fθ FG U V : ℝ) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x, ‖G θ x - G θ' x‖ ≤ LG * ‖θ - θ'‖)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X)
    (hF : ‖Fbar z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ Fθ)
    (hforce : ‖G (z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1) z.2.1‖ ≤ FG)
    (hu : ‖z.2.2.1‖ ≤ U) (hv : ‖z.2.2.2‖ ≤ V) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b) ≤
      holRemainderBudget (holCoefficients α γ h) α γ h LG Fθ FG U V ξ b
higherOrder_euler_error.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_euler_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LG α γ h Fθ FG U V : ℝ) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x, ‖G θ x - G θ' x‖ ≤ LG * ‖θ - θ'‖)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) (b : X)
    (hF : ‖Fbar z.1 z.2.1‖ ≤ Fθ)
    (hforce : ‖G (z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1) z.2.1‖ ≤ FG)
    (hu : ‖z.2.2.1‖ ≤ U) (hv : ‖z.2.2.2‖ ≤ V) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b) ≤
      holRemainderBudget (holCoefficients α γ h) α γ h LG Fθ FG U V ξ b := by
  let μ := holCoefficients α γ h
  let θ := z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1
  let g := G θ z.2.1
  have hforce' : ‖g‖ ≤ FG := hforce
  have hdiff : ‖h • (G z.1 z.2.1 - g)‖ ≤ h ^ 2 * LG * Fθ := by
    have ht : ‖z.1 - θ‖ ≤ |h| * Fθ := by
      have he : z.1 - θ = h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1 := by dsimp [θ]; module
      rw [he, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (abs_nonneg h)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      _ ≤ |h| * (LG * ‖z.1 - θ‖) := by gcongr; exact hG _ _ _
      _ ≤ |h| * (LG * (|h| * Fθ)) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [show |h| * (LG * (|h| * Fθ)) = |h| ^ 2 * LG * Fθ by ring, sq_abs]
  have hx : ‖-(h ^ 2 / 2) • g + (μ.μ12 - h) • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.1‖ ≤
      h ^ 2 / 2 * FG + |μ.μ12 - h| * U + |μ.μ13| * V + ‖ξ.1‖ := by
    apply (norm_four_hol _ _ _ _).trans
    simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ h ^ 2 / 2)]
    gcongr
  have hu' : ‖h • (G z.1 z.2.1 - g) + (μ.μ22 - 1) • z.2.2.1 +
      (μ.μ23 - γ * h) • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.1‖ ≤
      h ^ 2 * LG * Fθ + |μ.μ22 - 1| * U + |μ.μ23 - γ * h| * V + ‖ξ.2.1‖ := by
    apply (norm_four_hol _ _ _ _).trans
    simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at *
    gcongr
  have hv' : ‖(μ.μ31 * h) • g + (μ.μ32 + γ * h) • z.2.2.1 +
      (μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h) • z.2.2.2 + (ξ.2.2 - b)‖ ≤
      |μ.μ31 * h| * FG + |μ.μ32 + γ * h| * U +
      |μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h| * V + ‖ξ.2.2 - b‖ := by
    apply (norm_four_hol _ _ _ _).trans
    simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    gcongr
  have hθeq : (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ).1 -
      (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b).1 = 0 := by
    dsimp [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep, holResponse, holEuler, holDrift, holBrownianIncrement]
    module
  have hxeq : (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ).2.1 -
      (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b).2.1 =
      -(h ^ 2 / 2) • g + (μ.μ12 - h) • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.1 := by
    dsimp [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep, holResponse, holEuler, holDrift,
      holBrownianIncrement, g, θ, μ]
    module
  have hueq : (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ).2.2.1 -
      (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b).2.2.1 =
      h • (G z.1 z.2.1 - g) + (μ.μ22 - 1) • z.2.2.1 +
        (μ.μ23 - γ * h) • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.1 := by
    dsimp [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep, holResponse, holEuler, holDrift,
      holBrownianIncrement, g, θ, μ]
    module
  have hveq : (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ).2.2.2 -
      (holEuler Fbar G α γ h z b).2.2.2 =
      (μ.μ31 * h) • g + (μ.μ32 + γ * h) • z.2.2.1 +
        (μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h) • z.2.2.2 + (ξ.2.2 - b) := by
    dsimp [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep, holResponse, holEuler, holDrift,
      holBrownianIncrement, g, θ, μ]
    module
  unfold holError
  rw [hθeq, hxeq, hueq, hveq, norm_zero, zero_add]
  dsimp [holRemainderBudget, μ] at *
  nlinarith

holError_le_four_norm.exact_header: theorem holError_le_four_norm (z w : HOLState Θ X) : holError z w ≤ 4 * ‖z - w‖
holError_le_four_norm.exact_declaration:
theorem holError_le_four_norm (z w : HOLState Θ X) : holError z w ≤ 4 * ‖z - w‖ := by
  have h1 : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
  have h2 : ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := (norm_fst_le (z.2 - w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le (z - w))
  have h3 : ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ :=
    (norm_fst_le (z.2.2 - w.2.2)).trans ((norm_snd_le (z.2 - w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le (z - w)))
  have h4 : ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ :=
    (norm_snd_le (z.2.2 - w.2.2)).trans ((norm_snd_le (z.2 - w.2)).trans (norm_snd_le (z - w)))
  unfold holError
  linarith

norm_sub_le_holError.exact_header: theorem norm_sub_le_holError (z w : HOLState Θ X) : ‖z - w‖ ≤ holError z w
norm_sub_le_holError.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_sub_le_holError (z w : HOLState Θ X) : ‖z - w‖ ≤ holError z w := by
  change max ‖z.1 - w.1‖ (max ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖
    (max ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖)) ≤ _
  unfold holError
  have h1 := norm_nonneg (z.1 - w.1)
  have h2 := norm_nonneg (z.2.1 - w.2.1)
  have h3 := norm_nonneg (z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1)
  have h4 := norm_nonneg (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2)
  exact max_le (by linarith) (max_le (by linarith) (max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)))

holDrift_error.exact_header:
theorem holDrift_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG α γ : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : HOLState Θ X) :
    ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ z - holDrift Fbar G α γ w‖ ≤
      (LF + LG + 1 + 2 * |γ| + |α|) * holError z w
holDrift_error.exact_declaration:
theorem holDrift_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG α γ : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : HOLState Θ X) :
    ‖holDrift Fbar G α γ z - holDrift Fbar G α γ w‖ ≤
      (LF + LG + 1 + 2 * |γ| + |α|) * holError z w := by
  let e := holError z w
  have hab : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖ ≤ e := by
    dsimp [e, holError]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2)]
  have hu : ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ ≤ e := by
    dsimp [e, holError]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z.1 - w.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.1 - w.2.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2)]
  have hv : ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ ≤ e := by
    dsimp [e, holError]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z.1 - w.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.1 - w.2.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1)]
  have hsampler : ‖(-G z.1 z.2.1 + γ • z.2.2.2) - (-G w.1 w.2.1 + γ • w.2.2.2)‖ ≤
      ‖G z.1 z.2.1 - G w.1 w.2.1‖ + |γ| * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ := by
    have he : (-G z.1 z.2.1 + γ • z.2.2.2) - (-G w.1 w.2.1 + γ • w.2.2.2) =
        -(G z.1 z.2.1 - G w.1 w.2.1) + γ • (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2) := by module
    rw [he]
    simpa only [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_add_le
      (-(G z.1 z.2.1 - G w.1 w.2.1)) (γ • (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2))
  have haux : ‖(-γ • z.2.2.1 - α • z.2.2.2) - (-γ • w.2.2.1 - α • w.2.2.2)‖ ≤
      |γ| * ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ + |α| * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ := by
    have he : (-γ • z.2.2.1 - α • z.2.2.2) - (-γ • w.2.2.1 - α • w.2.2.2) =
        (-γ) • (z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1) - α • (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2) := by module
    rw [he]
    simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg] using norm_sub_le
      ((-γ) • (z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1)) (α • (z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2))
  calc
    _ ≤ holError (holDrift Fbar G α γ z) (holDrift Fbar G α γ w) := norm_sub_le_holError _ _
    _ ≤ (LF + LG) * (‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) +
        (1 + |γ|) * ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ +
        (|γ| + |α|) * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ := by
      dsimp [holError, holDrift]
      simp only [neg_sub_neg, norm_sub_rev]
      have hf := hF z.1 w.1 z.2.1 w.2.1
      have hg := hG z.1 w.1 z.2.1 w.2.1
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ (LF + LG) * e + (1 + |γ|) * e + (|γ| + |α|) * e := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by dsimp [e]; ring

higherOrder_shifted_force_bound.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_shifted_force_bound (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LG h Fθ FG : ℝ) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hh : |h| ≤ 1)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x, ‖G θ x - G θ' x‖ ≤ LG * ‖θ - θ'‖)
    (θ : Θ) (x : X) (hF : ‖Fbar θ x‖ ≤ Fθ) (hforce : ‖G θ x‖ ≤ FG) :
    ‖G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x‖ ≤ FG + LG * Fθ
higherOrder_shifted_force_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_shifted_force_bound (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LG h Fθ FG : ℝ) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG) (hh : |h| ≤ 1)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x, ‖G θ x - G θ' x‖ ≤ LG * ‖θ - θ'‖)
    (θ : Θ) (x : X) (hF : ‖Fbar θ x‖ ≤ Fθ) (hforce : ‖G θ x‖ ≤ FG) :
    ‖G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x‖ ≤ FG + LG * Fθ := by
  have hn : ‖G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x‖ ≤
      ‖G θ x‖ + ‖G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x - G θ x‖ := by
    have he : G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x = G θ x + (G (θ - h • Fbar θ x) x - G θ x) := by module
    conv_lhs => rw [he]
    exact norm_add_le _ _
  have hg := hG (θ - h • Fbar θ x) θ x
  have he : (θ - h • Fbar θ x) - θ = -(h • Fbar θ x) := by module

    have hp := norm_nonneg (Fbar θ x)
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖Fbar θ x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh hp
      _ ≤ Fθ := by simpa using hF
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hLG

holDeterministicBudget.exact_declaration:
def holDeterministicBudget (μ : HOLCoefficients) (α γ h LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (h ^ 2 / 2 + |μ.μ31 * h|) * FG +
    (|μ.μ12 - h| + |μ.μ22 - 1| + |μ.μ32 + γ * h|) * U +
    (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23 - γ * h| + |μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h|) * V +
    h ^ 2 * LG * Fθ

  have he := holEuler_integral_error Fbar G α γ h C hh (r k) (b k) (hInt k) (heq k) (hmod k)

private theorem node_in_horizon (h : ℝ≥0) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n)
    {T s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hsh : s ≤ (h : ℝ)) (hn : n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T) :
    (k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + s ∈ Icc 0 T := by
  constructor
  · positivity
  · have hk' : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk
    calc
      (k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + s ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (h : ℝ) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk' h.coe_nonneg

      (∫ r in 0..t, holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (z r)) +
        higherOrderInput Q hf α t)
    (hstate : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖z t‖ ≤ P)
    (hdrift : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (z t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hmod : ∀ a s : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → a + s ≤ T →
      ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (z (a + s)) -
        holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (z a)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt s)
    (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (hh : 0 < (h : ℝ)) (hh1 : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (hn : n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T) :

      (G + γ * P + (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G) P P C h n where
  auxiliary_friction_pos := hα
  momentum_coupling_nonneg := hγ
  step_pos := hh
  step_le_one := hh1
  optimizer_force_nonneg := hG
  sampler_force_nonneg := by positivity
  first_auxiliary_nonneg := hP
  second_auxiliary_nonneg := hP
  modulus_nonneg := hC
  r k s := z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + s)
  drift_integrable k hk := hd.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id) |>.intervalIntegrable _ _
  equation k hk := by
    have hs := integral_shift z _ (higherOrderInput (A := A) Q hf α) hd heq
      ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) (h : ℝ) (by positivity) h.coe_nonneg
    rw [higherOrderInput_increment Q hf α γ hα.le h k] at hs
    simpa only [add_zero] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hs).trans (by abel)
  grid_compatible k hk := by congr 1; push_cast; ring

    simpa only [add_zero] using hmod ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) s

  optimizer_force_bound k hk := by
    simpa only [add_zero, holDrift, norm_neg] using
      (norm_fst_le (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ
        (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))))).trans
        (hdrift _ (by simpa using node_in_horizon h hk (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) h.coe_nonneg hn))
  sampler_force_bound k hk := by
    let w := z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))
    let d := holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ w
    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ P := hstate _
      (by simpa using node_in_horizon h hk (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) h.coe_nonneg hn)
    have hdg : ‖d‖ ≤ G := hdrift _
      (by simpa using node_in_horizon h hk (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) h.coe_nonneg hn)
    have hv : ‖w.2.2.2‖ ≤ P :=
      (norm_snd_le w.2.2).trans ((norm_snd_le w.2).trans ((norm_snd_le w).trans hw))
    have hdu : ‖d.2.2.1‖ ≤ G :=
      (norm_fst_le d.2.2).trans ((norm_snd_le d.2).trans ((norm_snd_le d).trans hdg))
    have hforce : ‖D.samplerForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1‖ ≤ G + γ * P := by
      have hid : D.samplerForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1 = -d.2.2.1 + γ • w.2.2.2 := by
        dsimp [d, holDrift]; module
      rw [hid]
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖-d.2.2.1‖ + ‖γ • w.2.2.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖d.2.2.1‖ + γ * ‖w.2.2.2‖ := by rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hγ]
        _ ≤ G + γ * P := add_le_add hdu (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv hγ)
    have hopt : ‖D.meanForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1‖ ≤ G := by
      simpa only [d, holDrift, norm_neg] using (norm_fst_le d).trans hdg
    have hpert := D.samplerForceLp_bound Q
      (w.1 - (h : ℝ) • D.meanForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1) w.1 w.2.1 w.2.1
    have hdiff : ‖(w.1 - (h : ℝ) • D.meanForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1) - w.1‖ ≤ G := by
      rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h.coe_nonneg]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hopt h.coe_nonneg).trans (by nlinarith)
    have hpert' : ‖D.samplerForceLp Q
        (w.1 - (h : ℝ) • D.meanForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1) w.2.1 -
        D.samplerForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1‖ ≤ (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G := by
      exact hpert.trans (by simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff D.samplerForceLip.coe_nonneg)
    simp only [add_zero]
    change ‖D.samplerForceLp Q (w.1 - (h : ℝ) • D.meanForceLp Q w.1 w.2.1) w.2.1‖ ≤ _
    exact (norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _).trans (by linarith)
  first_auxiliary_bound k hk := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using
      (norm_fst_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))).2.2).trans
        ((norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))).2).trans
          ((norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)))).trans
            (hstate _ (by simpa using node_in_horizon h hk (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) h.coe_nonneg hn))))
  second_auxiliary_bound k hk := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using
      (norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))).2.2).trans
        ((norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))).2).trans
          ((norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)))).trans
            (hstate _ (by simpa using node_in_horizon h hk (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) h.coe_nonneg hn))))

exists_higherOrderReference_of_particle_.exact_header:
theorem exists_higherOrderReference_of_particle_integral
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField N)
        ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N
        (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α))
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf)
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf) 0 t)
    (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G C : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ 1 → n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T →
        ∃ Ref : HigherOrderPullbackIntegralReference (Fin N × J) Q hf D α γ G
          (G + γ * P + (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G) P P C h n,
          ∀ k s, Ref.r k s = higherOrderUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + s))
exists_higherOrderReference_of_particle_.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_higherOrderReference_of_particle_integral
    (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField N)
        ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N
        (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α))
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf)
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf) 0 t)
    (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G C : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ), 0 < (h : ℝ) → (h : ℝ) ≤ 1 → n * (h : ℝ) ≤ T →
        ∃ Ref : HigherOrderPullbackIntegralReference (Fin N × J) Q hf D α γ G
          (G + γ * P + (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * G) P P C h n,
          ∀ k s, Ref.r k s = higherOrderUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + s)) := by
  let L := higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ
  let F := ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty)
  have hF : LipschitzWith L.fieldLip F := ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz Q _ _
  let U := higherOrderUnpackLp Q D
  let K := ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := A) N (higherOrderPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) α)
  let W := canonicalPullbackCoordinate (Fin N × J) hf
  let hW := canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian (Fin N × J) hf
  obtain ⟨P0, G0, R0, hP0, hG0, hR0, hbounds, hmod⟩ :=
    exists_brownian_mesh_regularity Q F L.fieldLip hF Y hY K W hW T
      (fun t ht ↦ heq t ht.1)
  have hcoord (V : Lp (A × (Fin N → HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q) :
      U (F V) = holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (U V) :=
    higherOrderUnpackLp_drift Q D α γ V
  have hd : Continuous (fun t ↦ holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (U (Y t))) := by
    have hc := U.continuous.comp (hF.continuous.comp hY)
    exact hc.congr fun t ↦ hcoord (Y t)
  have hraw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → U (Y t) - U (Y 0) =
      (∫ r in 0..t, holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ (U (Y r))) +
        higherOrderInput Q hf α t := by
    intro t ht
    have he := higherOrderUnpackLp_integral Q D α γ Y
      (samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0) hY heq t ht
    rw [higherOrderUnpackLp_brownian Q D hcloud W hW] at he
    exact he
  refine ⟨‖U‖ * P0, ‖U‖ * G0, ‖U‖ * (L.fieldLip : ℝ) * R0,
    by positivity, by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro h n hh hh1 hn
  let Ref := higherOrderReference_of_integral Q hf D α γ
    (‖U‖ * P0) (‖U‖ * G0) (‖U‖ * (L.fieldLip : ℝ) * R0) T
    hα hγ (by positivity) (by positivity) (by positivity) (fun t ↦ U (Y t)) hd hraw
    (fun t ht ↦ (U.le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbounds t ht).1 (norm_nonneg U)))
    (fun t ht ↦ by
      rw [← hcoord]
      exact (U.le_opNorm _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbounds t ht).2 (norm_nonneg U)))
    (fun a s ha hs hs1 haT ↦ by
      rw [← hcoord, ← hcoord, ← map_sub]
      exact (U.le_opNorm _).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hmod a s ha hs hs1 haT).2 (norm_nonneg U)).trans_eq (by ring)))
    h n hh hh1 hn
  exact ⟨Ref, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩

/-!

The seven coefficients below are transcribed from Appendix `mmle_details.tex`.
The covariance law is deliberately not asserted by a pathwise definition. The
innovation argument contains a correlated triple for each particle; no noise is
added to the optimiser. The sampler force may be smoothed while the optimiser
uses the original force. Thus these results do not silently remove smoothing
bias or the finite-particle error.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.Methods

variable {Θ X : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- The physically useful sum of the four coordinate discrepancies. -/

/-- Triangle inequality in the sum of the four coordinate errors. -/

/-- A general quadrature version; the optimiser Euler step is completed first
and the sampler force is evaluated at the updated parameter. -/

/-- The actual HOL-MYPGD implementation uses endpoint quadrature `hG(θ,x)`.
`G=∇ₓE^λ` and `Fbar=N⁻¹∑F(θ,xᵢ)` can be chosen independently. -/

/-- Sensitivity to replacing the integrated force. All other data, including
the entire innovation triple, are identical. -/


/-- Sum of the three innovation discrepancies. -/

/-- The full affine response estimate, retaining the coefficient dependence. -/

/-- Explicit stability factor for the implemented higher-order map. -/

/-- New one-step stability bound for the actual endpoint implementation,
derived using the independent Lipschitz properties of `Fbar` and `G`.
The factor uses maximum column sums and tends to one as the step vanishes. -/

section Quadrature
variable [CompleteSpace X]

/-- The line-integrated force that the endpoint approximation replaces. -/

/-- New quadrature guarantee, proved by integrating Lipschitz variation along
the actual line segment. It is not an assumed numerical-error recurrence. -/

/-- New full-state local consistency bound for the implementation's endpoint
force quadrature versus the same affine Gaussian update with exact line
quadrature. It applies to every supplied innovation and every particle count.
This comparison is not an exact-SDE convergence claim. -/

/-- New finite-step bound for the endpoint-quadrature implementation against

HOLCoefficients.exact_declaration:
structure HOLCoefficients where
  μ12 : ℝ
  μ13 : ℝ
  μ22 : ℝ
  μ23 : ℝ
  μ31 : ℝ
  μ32 : ℝ
  μ33 : ℝ

holCoefficients.exact_header: def holCoefficients (α γ h : ℝ) : HOLCoefficients
holCoefficients.exact_declaration:
def holCoefficients (α γ h : ℝ) : HOLCoefficients where
  μ12 := (1 + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * h - γ ^ 2 / (2 * α) * h ^ 2 -
    γ ^ 2 / α ^ 3 * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ13 := γ / α * h - γ / α ^ 2 * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ22 := 1 + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2 * (1 - α * h - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ23 := γ / α * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ31 := γ / α - γ / (α ^ 2 * h) * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ32 := γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h + γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h * Real.exp (-α * h) -
    (2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))
  μ33 := Real.exp (-α * h) * (1 + γ ^ 2 / α * h) -
    γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2 * (1 - Real.exp (-α * h))

HOLState.exact_declaration: abbrev HOLState (Θ X : Type*) := Θ × X × X × X

holError.exact_header: def holError (z w : HOLState Θ X) : ℝ

holError_triangle.exact_header:
theorem holError_triangle (z u w : HOLState Θ X) :
    holError z w ≤ holError z u + holError u w
holError_triangle.exact_declaration:
theorem holError_triangle (z u w : HOLState Θ X) :
    holError z w ≤ holError z u + holError u w := by
  have h1 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub z.1 u.1 w.1
  have h2 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub z.2.1 u.2.1 w.2.1
  have h3 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub z.2.2.1 u.2.2.1 w.2.2.1
  have h4 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub z.2.2.2 u.2.2.2 w.2.2.2
  unfold holError
  linarith

holResponse.exact_header:
def holResponse (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ) (θ : Θ) (x u v D : X)
    (ξ : X × X × X) : HOLState Θ X
holResponse.exact_declaration:
def holResponse (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ) (θ : Θ) (x u v D : X)
    (ξ : X × X × X) : HOLState Θ X :=
  (θ, x - (h / 2) • D + μ.μ12 • u + μ.μ13 • v + ξ.1,
    -D + μ.μ22 • u + μ.μ23 • v + ξ.2.1,
    μ.μ31 • D + μ.μ32 • u + μ.μ33 • v + ξ.2.2)

holQuadratureStep.exact_declaration:
def holQuadratureStep (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (Q : Θ → X → X → X)
    (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ) (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) :
    HOLState Θ X :=
  let θ := z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1
  holResponse μ h θ z.2.1 z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2 (Q θ z.2.1 z.2.2.1) ξ

higherOrderStep.exact_header:
def higherOrderStep (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (α γ h : ℝ)
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) : HOLState Θ X

holResponse_force_error.exact_header:
theorem holResponse_force_error (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ)
    (θ : Θ) (x u v D D' : X) (ξ : X × X × X) :
    holError (holResponse μ h θ x u v D ξ) (holResponse μ h θ x u v D' ξ) =
      (|h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * ‖D - D'‖
holResponse_force_error.exact_declaration:
theorem holResponse_force_error (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ)
    (θ : Θ) (x u v D D' : X) (ξ : X × X × X) :
    holError (holResponse μ h θ x u v D ξ) (holResponse μ h θ x u v D' ξ) =
      (|h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * ‖D - D'‖ := by
  have hx : (x - (h / 2) • D + μ.μ12 • u + μ.μ13 • v + ξ.1) -
      (x - (h / 2) • D' + μ.μ12 • u + μ.μ13 • v + ξ.1) =
      -(h / 2) • (D - D') := by module
  have hu : (-D + μ.μ22 • u + μ.μ23 • v + ξ.2.1) -
      (-D' + μ.μ22 • u + μ.μ23 • v + ξ.2.1) = -(D - D') := by module
  have hv : (μ.μ31 • D + μ.μ32 • u + μ.μ33 • v + ξ.2.2) -
      (μ.μ31 • D' + μ.μ32 • u + μ.μ33 • v + ξ.2.2) =
      μ.μ31 • (D - D') := by module
  dsimp [holError, holResponse]
  rw [sub_self, norm_zero, hx, hu, hv]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, norm_neg, abs_div]
  norm_num
  ring

norm_five.exact_header:
private theorem norm_five (a b c d e : X) :
    ‖a + b + c + d + e‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ + ‖d‖ + ‖e‖
norm_five.exact_declaration:
private theorem norm_five (a b c d e : X) :
    ‖a + b + c + d + e‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ + ‖d‖ + ‖e‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖a + b + c + d‖ + ‖e‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖a + b + c‖ + ‖d‖) + ‖e‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((‖a + b‖ + ‖c‖) + ‖d‖) + ‖e‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _

holNoiseError.exact_header: def holNoiseError (ξ ζ : X × X × X) : ℝ
holNoiseError.exact_declaration:
def holNoiseError (ξ ζ : X × X × X) : ℝ :=
  ‖ξ.1 - ζ.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.1 - ζ.2.1‖ + ‖ξ.2.2 - ζ.2.2‖

holResponse_error.exact_header:
theorem holResponse_error (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ)
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x x' u u' v v' D D' : X) (ξ ζ : X × X × X) :
    holError (holResponse μ h θ x u v D ξ) (holResponse μ h θ' x' u' v' D' ζ) ≤
      ‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖ + (|h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * ‖D - D'‖ +
      (|μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32|) * ‖u - u'‖ +
      (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33|) * ‖v - v'‖ + holNoiseError ξ ζ
holResponse_error.exact_declaration:
theorem holResponse_error (μ : HOLCoefficients) (h : ℝ)
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x x' u u' v v' D D' : X) (ξ ζ : X × X × X) :
    holError (holResponse μ h θ x u v D ξ) (holResponse μ h θ' x' u' v' D' ζ) ≤
      ‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖ + (|h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * ‖D - D'‖ +
      (|μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32|) * ‖u - u'‖ +
      (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33|) * ‖v - v'‖ + holNoiseError ξ ζ := by
  have hxid : (x - (h / 2) • D + μ.μ12 • u + μ.μ13 • v + ξ.1) -
      (x' - (h / 2) • D' + μ.μ12 • u' + μ.μ13 • v' + ζ.1) =
      (x - x') + (-(h / 2)) • (D - D') + μ.μ12 • (u - u') +
        μ.μ13 • (v - v') + (ξ.1 - ζ.1) := by module
  have huid : (-D + μ.μ22 • u + μ.μ23 • v + ξ.2.1) -
      (-D' + μ.μ22 • u' + μ.μ23 • v' + ζ.2.1) =
      -(D - D') + μ.μ22 • (u - u') + μ.μ23 • (v - v') +
        (ξ.2.1 - ζ.2.1) + 0 := by module
  have hvid : (μ.μ31 • D + μ.μ32 • u + μ.μ33 • v + ξ.2.2) -
      (μ.μ31 • D' + μ.μ32 • u' + μ.μ33 • v' + ζ.2.2) =
      μ.μ31 • (D - D') + μ.μ32 • (u - u') + μ.μ33 • (v - v') +
        (ξ.2.2 - ζ.2.2) + 0 := by module
  have hx := norm_five (x - x') ((-(h / 2)) • (D - D'))
    (μ.μ12 • (u - u')) (μ.μ13 • (v - v')) (ξ.1 - ζ.1)
  have hu := norm_five (-(D - D')) (μ.μ22 • (u - u'))
    (μ.μ23 • (v - v')) (ξ.2.1 - ζ.2.1) 0
  have hv := norm_five (μ.μ31 • (D - D')) (μ.μ32 • (u - u'))
    (μ.μ33 • (v - v')) (ξ.2.2 - ζ.2.2) 0
  rw [← hxid] at hx
  rw [← huid] at hu
  rw [← hvid] at hv
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_div, norm_neg,
    norm_zero, add_zero] at hx hu hv
  norm_num at hx
  dsimp [holError, holResponse, holNoiseError]
  nlinarith

holAmplification.exact_header: def holAmplification (μ : HOLCoefficients) (LF LG h : ℝ) : ℝ

higherOrder_error.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG α γ h : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : HOLState Θ X) (ξ ζ : X × X × X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h w ζ) ≤
      holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF LG h * holError z w + holNoiseError ξ ζ
higherOrder_error.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG α γ h : ℝ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : HOLState Θ X) (ξ ζ : X × X × X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ) (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h w ζ) ≤
      holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF LG h * holError z w + holNoiseError ξ ζ := by
  let μ := holCoefficients α γ h
  let W := |h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|
  let T := 1 + |h| * LF
  let θ := z.1 - h • Fbar z.1 z.2.1
  let θ' := w.1 - h • Fbar w.1 w.2.1
  have hW : 0 ≤ W := by dsimp [W]; positivity
  have hθx : ‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖ ≤ T * (‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) := by
    have he : θ - θ' = (z.1 - w.1) - h • (Fbar z.1 z.2.1 - Fbar w.1 w.2.1) := by
      dsimp [θ, θ']; module
    have hn := norm_sub_le (z.1 - w.1) (h • (Fbar z.1 z.2.1 - Fbar w.1 w.2.1))
    rw [← he, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hn
    have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF z.1 w.1 z.2.1 w.2.1) (abs_nonneg h)
    dsimp [T]
    nlinarith
  have hD : ‖h • G θ z.2.1 - h • G θ' w.2.1‖ ≤
      |h| * LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) := by
    rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hG _ _ _ _) (abs_nonneg h)).trans_eq (by ring)
  have hr := holResponse_error μ h θ θ' z.2.1 w.2.1
    z.2.2.1 w.2.2.1 z.2.2.2 w.2.2.2 (h • G θ z.2.1) (h • G θ' w.2.1) ξ ζ
  have hC : (1 + W * |h| * LG) * T ≤ holAmplification μ LF LG h := by
    have he : (1 + W * |h| * LG) * T =
        (1 + |h| * LF) * (1 + (|h| / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * |h| * LG) := by
      dsimp [T, W]
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  have hU : |μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32| ≤ holAmplification μ LF LG h :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hV : |μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33| ≤ holAmplification μ LF LG h :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  dsimp only [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep]
  apply hr.trans
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + W * |h| * LG) * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) +
        (|μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32|) * ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ +
        (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33|) * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ + holNoiseError ξ ζ := by
      have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD hW
      dsimp [W] at hb ⊢
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ ((1 + W * |h| * LG) * T) * (‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) +
        (|μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32|) * ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ +
        (|μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33|) * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ + holNoiseError ξ ζ := by
      have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hθx (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + W * |h| * LG)
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ holAmplification μ LF LG h * (‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2.1 - w.2.1‖) +
        holAmplification μ LF LG h * ‖z.2.2.1 - w.2.2.1‖ +
        holAmplification μ LF LG h * ‖z.2.2.2 - w.2.2.2‖ + holNoiseError ξ ζ := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by dsimp [holError, μ]; ring

lineForce.exact_header: def lineForce (G : Θ → X → X) (h : ℝ) (θ : Θ) (x u : X) : X
lineForce.exact_declaration:
def lineForce (G : Θ → X → X) (h : ℝ) (θ : Θ) (x u : X) : X :=
  ∫ t in 0..h, G θ (x + t • u)

endpoint_quadrature_error.exact_header:
theorem endpoint_quadrature_error (G : Θ → X → X) (L : ℝ≥0) (h : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith L (G θ)) (θ : Θ) (x u : X) :
    ‖lineForce G h θ x u - h • G θ x‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖u‖ * h ^ 2 / 2
endpoint_quadrature_error.exact_declaration:
theorem endpoint_quadrature_error (G : Θ → X → X) (L : ℝ≥0) (h : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith L (G θ)) (θ : Θ) (x u : X) :
    ‖lineForce G h θ x u - h • G θ x‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖u‖ * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
  have hInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ G θ (x + t • u)) volume 0 h :=
    ((hLip θ).continuous.comp (by fun_prop)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have he : lineForce G h θ x u - h • G θ x =
      ∫ t in 0..h, G θ (x + t • u) - G θ x := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hInt intervalIntegrable_const]
    simp [lineForce]
  rw [he]
  have hb (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 h) :
      ‖G θ (x + t • u) - G θ x‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖u‖ * t := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖(x + t • u) - x‖ := by
        simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (hLip θ).dist_le_mul (x + t • u) x
      _ = _ := by simp [norm_smul, abs_of_nonneg ht.1.le]; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ t in 0..h, (L : ℝ) * ‖u‖ * t :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hh
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb) ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ (L : ℝ) * ‖u‖ * t)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]; ring

higherOrder_quadrature_error.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_quadrature_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (α γ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith L (G θ))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ)
      (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h z ξ) ≤
      (h / 2 + 1 + |(holCoefficients α γ h).μ31|) *
        ((L : ℝ) * ‖z.2.2.1‖ * h ^ 2 / 2)
higherOrder_quadrature_error.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_quadrature_error (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (α γ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith L (G θ))
    (z : HOLState Θ X) (ξ : X × X × X) :
    holError (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h z ξ)
      (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h z ξ) ≤
      (h / 2 + 1 + |(holCoefficients α γ h).μ31|) *
        ((L : ℝ) * ‖z.2.2.1‖ * h ^ 2 / 2) := by
  dsimp only [higherOrderStep, holQuadratureStep]
  rw [holResponse_force_error, norm_sub_rev, abs_of_nonneg hh]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (endpoint_quadrature_error G L h hh hLip _ _ _) (by positivity)

higherOrder_finite_quadrature_error.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_finite_quadrature_error
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF : ℝ) (LG : ℝ≥0)
    (α γ h R : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ (LG : ℝ) * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith LG (G θ))
    (ξ : ℕ → X × X × X) (z w : HOLState Θ X)
    (hvelocity : ∀ k,
      ‖(trajectory (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h) ξ w k).2.2.1‖ ≤ R)
    (n : ℕ) :
    holError (trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h) ξ z n)
      (trajectory (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h) ξ w n) ≤
      holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF (LG : ℝ) h ^ n * holError z w +
        ((h / 2 + 1 + |(holCoefficients α γ h).μ31|) *
          ((LG : ℝ) * R * h ^ 2 / 2)) *
          amplificationSum (holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF (LG : ℝ) h) n
higherOrder_finite_quadrature_error.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_finite_quadrature_error
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF : ℝ) (LG : ℝ≥0)
    (α γ h R : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖Fbar θ x - Fbar θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ (LG : ℝ) * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hLip : ∀ θ, LipschitzWith LG (G θ))
    (ξ : ℕ → X × X × X) (z w : HOLState Θ X)
    (hvelocity : ∀ k,
      ‖(trajectory (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h) ξ w k).2.2.1‖ ≤ R)
    (n : ℕ) :
    holError (trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h) ξ z n)
      (trajectory (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h) ξ w n) ≤
      holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF (LG : ℝ) h ^ n * holError z w +
        ((h / 2 + 1 + |(holCoefficients α γ h).μ31|) *
          ((LG : ℝ) * R * h ^ 2 / 2)) *
          amplificationSum (holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF (LG : ℝ) h) n := by
  have hA : 0 ≤ holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF (LG : ℝ) h := by
    unfold holAmplification
    positivity
  apply finite_accumulation _ _ _ hA _ n
  intro k
  dsimp only [trajectory]
  let a := trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h) ξ z k
  let b := trajectory (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h) ξ w k
  have hs := higherOrder_error Fbar G LF (LG : ℝ) α γ h hLF LG.coe_nonneg hF hG a b (ξ k) (ξ k)
  simp only [holNoiseError, sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] at hs
  have hl := higherOrder_quadrature_error Fbar G LG α γ h hh hLip b (ξ k)
  have hb : (LG : ℝ) * ‖b.2.2.1‖ * h ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (LG : ℝ) * R * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
    gcongr
    exact hvelocity k
  have hlocal := hl.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity))
  have ht := holError_triangle (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h a (ξ k))
    (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h b (ξ k))
    (holQuadratureStep Fbar (lineForce G h) (holCoefficients α γ h) h b (ξ k))
  exact ht.trans (add_le_add hs hlocal)

/-! # Explicit small-step consistency constants for HOL-MYPGD
These estimates use only the elementary exponential remainder and the exact
seven implementation coefficients. In particular the paper's affine response
is not misidentified with the exponential of the complete linear subsystem.
-/
noncomputable section
namespace PBGSO.Methods

/-- Explicit constants controlling all seven coefficient remainders for
`0<h≤1`, `α>0`, and `γ≥0`. The `μ31` slot bounds `|μ31*h|`. -/

/-- All needed implementation coefficient estimates, including the
cancellation of the first-order terms. -/

section ReferenceRate

holRemainderConstants.exact_declaration:
def holRemainderConstants (α γ : ℝ) : HOLCoefficients where
  μ12 := γ ^ 2 / (2 * α)
  μ13 := γ / 2
  μ22 := γ ^ 2 / 2
  μ23 := γ * α / 2
  μ31 := γ / 2
  μ32 := γ ^ 3 / α +
    (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * α ^ 2 / 2
  μ33 := γ ^ 2 + (1 + γ ^ 2 / α + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * α ^ 2 / 2

HOLCoefficientBounds.exact_header: structure HOLCoefficientBounds (μ c : HOLCoefficients) (α γ h : ℝ) : Prop
HOLCoefficientBounds.exact_declaration:
structure HOLCoefficientBounds (μ c : HOLCoefficients) (α γ h : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound12 : |μ.μ12 - h| ≤ c.μ12 * h ^ 2
  bound13 : |μ.μ13| ≤ c.μ13 * h ^ 2
  bound22 : |μ.μ22 - 1| ≤ c.μ22 * h ^ 2
  bound23 : |μ.μ23 - γ * h| ≤ c.μ23 * h ^ 2
  bound31 : |μ.μ31 * h| ≤ c.μ31 * h ^ 2
  bound31' : |μ.μ31| ≤ c.μ31 * h
  bound32 : |μ.μ32 + γ * h| ≤ c.μ32 * h ^ 2
  bound33 : |μ.μ33 - 1 + α * h| ≤ c.μ33 * h ^ 2

holCoefficient_bounds.exact_header:
theorem holCoefficient_bounds (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    HOLCoefficientBounds (holCoefficients α γ h) (holRemainderConstants α γ) α γ h
holCoefficient_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem holCoefficient_bounds (α γ h : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    HOLCoefficientBounds (holCoefficients α γ h) (holRemainderConstants α γ) α γ h := by
  let r := Real.exp (-α * h) - 1 + α * h
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by
    have he := Real.add_one_le_exp (-α * h)
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hr' : r ≤ α ^ 2 * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have he := KineticLangevin.exp_neg_le_quadratic (α * h) (by positivity)
    rw [← neg_mul] at he
    dsimp [r]
    nlinarith
  have he : Real.exp (-α * h) = 1 - α * h + r := by dsimp [r]; ring
  have e12 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ12 - h =
      -(γ ^ 2 / (2 * α) * h ^ 2) + (γ ^ 2 / α ^ 3) * r := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e13 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ13 = γ / α ^ 2 * r := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e22 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ22 - 1 = -(γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2 * r) := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e23 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ23 - γ * h = -(γ / α * r) := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e31 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ31 * h = γ / α ^ 2 * r := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e32 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ32 + γ * h =
      -(γ ^ 3 / α * h ^ 2) +
        (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * r := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have e33 : (holCoefficients α γ h).μ33 - 1 + α * h =
      -(γ ^ 2 * h ^ 2) + (1 + γ ^ 2 / α * h + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * r := by
    dsimp [holCoefficients]; rw [he]; field_simp; ring
  have b12 : (γ ^ 2 / α ^ 3) * r ≤ γ ^ 2 / (2 * α) * h ^ 2 := by
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr' (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 / α ^ 3) using 1 <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  have b13 : (γ / α ^ 2) * r ≤ γ / 2 * h ^ 2 := by
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr' (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ / α ^ 2) using 1 <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  have b22 : (γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * r ≤ γ ^ 2 / 2 * h ^ 2 := by
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr' (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) using 1 <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  have b23 : (γ / α) * r ≤ γ * α / 2 * h ^ 2 := by
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr' (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ / α) using 1 <;>
      field_simp <;> ring
  have b32 : (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * r ≤
      (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * (α ^ 2 * h ^ 2 / 2) := by
    apply mul_le_mul _ hr' hr (by positivity)
    have hb : γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h ≤ γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2)
    linarith only [hb]
  have b33 : (1 + γ ^ 2 / α * h + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * r ≤
      (1 + γ ^ 2 / α + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * (α ^ 2 * h ^ 2 / 2) := by
    apply mul_le_mul _ hr' hr (by positivity)
    have hb : γ ^ 2 / α * h ≤ γ ^ 2 / α := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 / α)
    linarith only [hb]
  have b31 : |(holCoefficients α γ h).μ31 * h| ≤ γ / 2 * h ^ 2 := by
    rw [e31, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact b13
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e12]; dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have hn : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 / α ^ 3 * r := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hn : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 / (2 * α) * h ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  · rw [e13, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact b13
  · rw [e22, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact b22
  · rw [e23, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact b23
  · exact b31
  · dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hh] at b31
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hh).mp (by convert b31 using 1 <;> ring)
  · rw [e32]
    dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have hn : 0 ≤ (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 * h + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * r := by positivity
      have hc : 0 ≤ (γ ^ 3 / α ^ 2 + 2 * γ ^ 3 / α ^ 3 + γ / α) * α ^ 2 / 2 * h ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith only [hn, hc]
    · have hn : 0 ≤ γ ^ 3 / α * h ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith only [b32, hn]
  · rw [e33]
    dsimp [holRemainderConstants]
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have hn : 0 ≤ (1 + γ ^ 2 / α * h + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * r := by positivity
      have hc : 0 ≤ (1 + γ ^ 2 / α + γ ^ 2 / α ^ 2) * α ^ 2 / 2 * h ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith only [hn, hc]
    · have hn : 0 ≤ γ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith only [b33, hn]

holLocalConsistencyConstant.exact_header: def holLocalConsistencyConstant (c : HOLCoefficients) (LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ) : ℝ

holDeterministicBudget_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem holDeterministicBudget_quadratic
    (α γ h LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hFG : 0 ≤ FG) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    holDeterministicBudget (holCoefficients α γ h) α γ h LG Fθ FG U V ≤
      holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) LG Fθ FG U V * h ^ 2
holDeterministicBudget_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem holDeterministicBudget_quadratic
    (α γ h LG Fθ FG U V : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hFG : 0 ≤ FG) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    holDeterministicBudget (holCoefficients α γ h) α γ h LG Fθ FG U V ≤
      holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) LG Fθ FG U V * h ^ 2 := by
  have hc := holCoefficient_bounds α γ h hα hγ hh hh1
  unfold holDeterministicBudget
  calc
    _ ≤ (h ^ 2 / 2 + (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ31 * h ^ 2) * FG +
        ((holRemainderConstants α γ).μ12 * h ^ 2 +
          (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ22 * h ^ 2 +
          (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ32 * h ^ 2) * U +
        ((holRemainderConstants α γ).μ13 * h ^ 2 +
          (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ23 * h ^ 2 +
          (holRemainderConstants α γ).μ33 * h ^ 2) * V + h ^ 2 * LG * Fθ := by
      gcongr
      exact hc.bound31
      exact hc.bound12
      exact hc.bound22
      exact hc.bound32
      exact hc.bound13
      exact hc.bound23
      exact hc.bound33
    _ = _ := by unfold holLocalConsistencyConstant; ring

holStabilityConstant.exact_header: def holStabilityConstant (α γ LF LG : ℝ) : ℝ
holStabilityConstant.exact_declaration:
def holStabilityConstant (α γ LF LG : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let c := holRemainderConstants α γ
  max (LF + ((3 + γ) / 2) * LG * (1 + LF))
    (max (1 + γ + c.μ12 + c.μ22 + c.μ32) (γ + α + c.μ13 + c.μ23 + c.μ33))

abs_le_remainder_add.exact_header: private theorem abs_le_remainder_add (x y c : ℝ) (hb : |x - y| ≤ c) : |x| ≤ c + |y|
abs_le_remainder_add.exact_declaration:
private theorem abs_le_remainder_add (x y c : ℝ) (hb : |x - y| ≤ c) : |x| ≤ c + |y| := by
  calc
    |x| = |(x - y) + y| := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ |x - y| + |y| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr

holAmplification_linear_bound.exact_header:
theorem holAmplification_linear_bound (α γ LF LG h : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF LG h ≤
      1 + holStabilityConstant α γ LF LG * h
holAmplification_linear_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem holAmplification_linear_bound (α γ LF LG h : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    holAmplification (holCoefficients α γ h) LF LG h ≤
      1 + holStabilityConstant α γ LF LG * h := by
  let μ := holCoefficients α γ h
  let c := holRemainderConstants α γ
  let K := holStabilityConstant α γ LF LG
  have hc := holCoefficient_bounds α γ h hα hγ hh hh1
  have hh2 : h ^ 2 ≤ h := by nlinarith
  have h12 := abs_le_remainder_add μ.μ12 h (c.μ12 * h ^ 2) hc.bound12
  have h22 := abs_le_remainder_add μ.μ22 1 (c.μ22 * h ^ 2) hc.bound22
  have h32 := abs_le_remainder_add μ.μ32 (-γ * h) (c.μ32 * h ^ 2) (by
    simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add, neg_mul] using hc.bound32)
  have h23 := abs_le_remainder_add μ.μ23 (γ * h) (c.μ23 * h ^ 2) hc.bound23
  have h33 := abs_le_remainder_add μ.μ33 (1 - α * h) (c.μ33 * h ^ 2) (by
    convert hc.bound33 using 1 <;> dsimp [μ] <;> congr 1 <;> ring)
  have he33 : |1 - α * h| ≤ 1 + α * h := by
    apply (abs_sub _ _).trans
    simp [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ α * h)]
  have hKu : 1 + γ + c.μ12 + c.μ22 + c.μ32 ≤ K :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hKv : γ + α + c.μ13 + c.μ23 + c.μ33 ≤ K :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hKc : LF + ((3 + γ) / 2) * LG * (1 + LF) ≤ K := le_max_left _ _
  have hcu : 0 ≤ c.μ12 + c.μ22 + c.μ32 := by dsimp [c, holRemainderConstants]; positivity
  have hcv : 0 ≤ c.μ13 + c.μ23 + c.μ33 := by dsimp [c, holRemainderConstants]; positivity
  have hU : |μ.μ12| + |μ.μ22| + |μ.μ32| ≤ 1 + K * h := by
    simp only [abs_of_pos hh, abs_one, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hγ,
      abs_of_pos hh] at h12 h22 h32
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 hcu
    have hk := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKu hh.le
    nlinarith
  have hV : |μ.μ13| + |μ.μ23| + |μ.μ33| ≤ 1 + K * h := by
    simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hγ, abs_of_pos hh] at h23
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 hcv
    have hk := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKv hh.le
    nlinarith [hc.bound13]
  have hW : h / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31| ≤ (3 + γ) / 2 := by
    have hb := hc.bound31'
    change |μ.μ31| ≤ γ / 2 * h at hb
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ / 2)]
  have hC : (1 + h * LF) * (1 + (h / 2 + 1 + |μ.μ31|) * h * LG) ≤ 1 + K * h := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 + h * LF) * (1 + ((3 + γ) / 2) * h * LG) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 1 + (LF + ((3 + γ) / 2) * LG * (1 + LF)) * h := by
        have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ LF * ((3 + γ) / 2) * LG)
        nlinarith
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  unfold holAmplification
  rw [abs_of_pos hh]
  exact max_le hC (max_le hU hV)

amplification_exponential_bound.exact_header:
theorem amplification_exponential_bound (a K h : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hA : a ≤ 1 + K * h) (n : ℕ) :
    a ^ n ≤ Real.exp (K * h * n) ∧
      amplificationSum a n ≤ n * Real.exp (K * h * n)
amplification_exponential_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem amplification_exponential_bound (a K h : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hA : a ≤ 1 + K * h) (n : ℕ) :
    a ^ n ≤ Real.exp (K * h * n) ∧
      amplificationSum a n ≤ n * Real.exp (K * h * n) := by
  have hp (k : ℕ) : a ^ k ≤ Real.exp (K * h * k) := by
    have hb : a ≤ Real.exp (K * h) := hA.trans (by simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (K * h))
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (K * h) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hb k
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  constructor
  · exact hp n
  · unfold amplificationSum
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.exp (K * h * n) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k hk
        exact (hp k).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
          have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_range.mp hk).le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk' (mul_nonneg hK hh)))
      _ = _ := by simp

finite_budget_sqrt_rate.exact_header:
theorem finite_budget_sqrt_rate (e e0 a D N C K h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e0) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hA : a ≤ 1 + K * h)
    (hbudget : e ≤ a ^ n * e0 +
      (D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h) * amplificationSum a n) :
    e ≤ Real.exp (K * h * n) *
      (e0 + (D + N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h)
finite_budget_sqrt_rate.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_budget_sqrt_rate (e e0 a D N C K h : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (he0 : 0 ≤ e0) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hA : a ≤ 1 + K * h)
    (hbudget : e ≤ a ^ n * e0 +
      (D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h) * amplificationSum a n) :
    e ≤ Real.exp (K * h * n) *
      (e0 + (D + N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h) := by
  have hp := amplification_exponential_bound a K h ha hK hh.le hA n
  have hpow : h ^ 2 ≤ h := by nlinarith
  have hs : h ^ 2 ≤ h * Real.sqrt h := by
    have hroot := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hpow
    nlinarith
  have hb : D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h ≤
      (D + N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
    have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hD
    nlinarith
  have hsum : 0 ≤ amplificationSum a n := by unfold amplificationSum; positivity
  calc
    e ≤ a ^ n * e0 +
      (D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h) * amplificationSum a n := hbudget
    _ ≤ Real.exp (K * h * n) * e0 +
        ((D + N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * h * Real.sqrt h) *
          (n * Real.exp (K * h * n)) := by
      gcongr
      exact hp.1
      exact hp.2
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem higherOrder_integral_reference_sqrt_rate
    (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (LF LG α γ h Fθ FG U V C N : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)

    (hInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) volume 0 h)
    (heq : ∀ k, r k h = r k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift Fbar G α γ (r k t)) +

    (hcompat : ∀ k, r (k + 1) 0 = r k h)

    (z : HOLState Θ X) (n : ℕ) :
    holError (trajectory (higherOrderStep Fbar G α γ h) ξ z n) (r n 0) ≤

        (holError z (r 0 0) +

    (r : ℕ → ℝ → HOLState Θ X) (b : ℕ → X) (ξ : ℕ → X × X × X)

  have hsum : 0 ≤ amplificationSum A n := by unfold amplificationSum; positivity

hypocoerciveYoung.exact_header: def hypocoerciveYoung (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ
hypocoerciveYoung.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveYoung (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + 2 * L ^ 2 / (r * γ ^ 2)) / 2

hypocoerciveAuxiliary.exact_header: def hypocoerciveAuxiliary (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ
hypocoerciveAuxiliary.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveAuxiliary (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 - hypocoerciveYoung γ r L

hypocoerciveLeakage.exact_header: def hypocoerciveLeakage (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ
hypocoerciveLeakage.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveLeakage (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ := L ^ 2 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2)

hypocoerciveRemainder.exact_header: def hypocoerciveRemainder (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ
hypocoerciveRemainder.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveRemainder (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ := r - 2 * hypocoerciveLeakage γ r L

hypocoerciveLower.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveLower (γ : ℝ) : ℝ := min (γ / 4) (1 / (2 * γ))

hypocoerciveUpper.exact_declaration: def hypocoerciveUpper (γ : ℝ) : ℝ := γ + 1 + 2 / γ

hypocoerciveRate.exact_header: def hypocoerciveRate (γ r L : ℝ) : ℝ

hypocoercive_threshold_of_source.exact_header:
theorem hypocoercive_threshold_of_source (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hsource : Real.sqrt 2 * L / Real.sqrt r < γ) :
    2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2
hypocoercive_threshold_of_source.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_threshold_of_source (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hsource : Real.sqrt 2 * L / Real.sqrt r < γ) :
    2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2 := by
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 * L < γ * Real.sqrt r :=
    (div_lt_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hr)).mp hsource
  have hsq := (sq_lt_sq₀ (show 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * L by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ γ * Real.sqrt r by positivity)).mpr hs
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
    Real.sq_sqrt hr.le] at hsq
  nlinarith

hypocoerciveYoung_bounds.exact_header:
theorem hypocoerciveYoung_bounds (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) :
    0 < hypocoerciveYoung γ r L ∧ hypocoerciveYoung γ r L < 1
hypocoerciveYoung_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveYoung_bounds (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) :
    0 < hypocoerciveYoung γ r L ∧ hypocoerciveYoung γ r L < 1 := by
  have hd : 0 < r * γ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have ha : 0 ≤ 2 * L ^ 2 / (r * γ ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hb : 2 * L ^ 2 / (r * γ ^ 2) < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).mpr hthreshold
  dsimp [hypocoerciveYoung]
  constructor <;> linarith

hypocoercive_coefficients_positive.exact_header:
theorem hypocoercive_coefficients_positive (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) :
    0 < hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L ∧ 0 < hypocoerciveRemainder γ r L
hypocoercive_coefficients_positive.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_coefficients_positive (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) :
    0 < hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L ∧ 0 < hypocoerciveRemainder γ r L := by
  obtain ⟨hη, hη1⟩ := hypocoerciveYoung_bounds γ r L hγ hr hthreshold
  refine ⟨sub_pos.mpr hη1, ?_⟩
  have hden : 0 < hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hηid : hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * (r * γ ^ 2) =
      (r * γ ^ 2 + 2 * L ^ 2) / 2 := by
    unfold hypocoerciveYoung
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  have hdiv : 2 * L ^ 2 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) < r := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hden).mpr
    nlinarith
  dsimp [hypocoerciveRemainder, hypocoerciveLeakage]
  rw [mul_div_assoc] at hdiv
  linarith

hypocoerciveLower_pos.exact_header: theorem hypocoerciveLower_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) : 0 < hypocoerciveLower γ
hypocoerciveLower_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveLower_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) : 0 < hypocoerciveLower γ := by
  exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)

hypocoerciveUpper_pos.exact_header: theorem hypocoerciveUpper_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) : 0 < hypocoerciveUpper γ
hypocoerciveUpper_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveUpper_pos (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) : 0 < hypocoerciveUpper γ := by
  dsimp [hypocoerciveUpper]
  positivity

hypocoerciveRate_pos.exact_header:
theorem hypocoerciveRate_pos (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) : 0 < hypocoerciveRate γ r L
hypocoerciveRate_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveRate_pos (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) : 0 < hypocoerciveRate γ r L := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := hypocoercive_coefficients_positive γ r L hγ hr hthreshold
  exact div_pos (lt_min hc ha) (hypocoerciveUpper_pos γ hγ)

hypocoerciveEnergy_lower.exact_header:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_lower (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H) :
    hypocoerciveLower γ * (‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) ≤ hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p
hypocoerciveEnergy_lower.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoerciveEnergy_lower (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (q p : H) :
    hypocoerciveLower γ * (‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2) ≤ hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p := by
  have hy := force_cross_young 2 (3 * γ / 4) (by positivity) q p
  have hid : (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (4 * (3 * γ / 4)) = 4 / (3 * γ) := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hid] at hy
  have hpcoef : 1 / (2 * γ) ≤ 2 / γ - 4 / (3 * γ) := by
    have hid : 2 / γ - 4 / (3 * γ) - 1 / (2 * γ) = 1 / (6 * γ) := by
      field_simp
      <;> ring
    have : 0 ≤ 1 / (6 * γ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (min_le_left (γ / 4) (1 / (2 * γ))) (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    ((min_le_right (γ / 4) (1 / (2 * γ))).trans hpcoef) (sq_nonneg ‖p‖)
  dsimp [hypocoerciveLower, hypocoerciveEnergy] at *
  linarith

hypocoercive_auxiliary_estimate.exact_header:
theorem hypocoercive_auxiliary_estimate (γ r L R : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) (q p f : H)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * R) :
    -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫_ℝ ≤
      -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L * ‖p‖ ^ 2 +
        hypocoerciveLeakage γ r L * R
hypocoercive_auxiliary_estimate.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_auxiliary_estimate (γ r L R : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) (q p f : H)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * R) :
    -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫_ℝ ≤
      -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L * ‖p‖ ^ 2 +
        hypocoerciveLeakage γ r L * R := by
  have hη := (hypocoerciveYoung_bounds γ r L hγ hr hthreshold).1
  have hy := force_cross_young (2 / γ) (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L) hη p f
  have hcoef : (2 / γ) ^ 2 / (4 * hypocoerciveYoung γ r L) =
      1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  rw [hcoef] at hy
  have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hforce
    (show 0 ≤ 1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) by positivity)
  have hid : 1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) * (L ^ 2 * R) =
      (L ^ 2 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2)) * R := by ring
  rw [hid] at hf
  dsimp [hypocoerciveAuxiliary, hypocoerciveLeakage]
  linarith

hypocoercive_dissipation_explicit.exact_header:
theorem hypocoercive_dissipation_explicit (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) (q p f : H)
    (hmono : r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪q, f⟫_ℝ)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * L ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2) :
    -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫_ℝ ≤
      -hypocoerciveRate γ r L * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p
hypocoercive_dissipation_explicit.exact_declaration:
theorem hypocoercive_dissipation_explicit (γ r L : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hthreshold : 2 * L ^ 2 < r * γ ^ 2) (q p f : H)
    (hmono : r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪q, f⟫_ℝ)
    (hforce : ‖f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * L ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2) :
    -⟪q, f⟫_ℝ - ‖p‖ ^ 2 - (2 / γ) * ⟪p, f⟫_ℝ ≤
      -hypocoerciveRate γ r L * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p := by
  have hη := (hypocoerciveYoung_bounds γ r L hγ hr hthreshold).1
  have hρ := hypocoerciveRate_pos γ r L hγ hr hthreshold
  have hcoef : (2 / γ) ^ 2 / (4 * hypocoerciveYoung γ r L) =
      1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) := by field_simp <;> ring
  have hy := force_cross_young (2 / γ) (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L) hη p f
  rw [hcoef] at hy
  have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hforce
    (show 0 ≤ 1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) by positivity)
  have hcancel : hypocoerciveRate γ r L * hypocoerciveUpper γ =
      min (hypocoerciveRemainder γ r L) (hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L) :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (hypocoerciveUpper_pos γ hγ))
  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (min_le_left (hypocoerciveRemainder γ r L) (hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L))
    (sq_nonneg ‖q‖)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (min_le_right (hypocoerciveRemainder γ r L) (hypocoerciveAuxiliary γ r L))
    (sq_nonneg ‖p‖)
  have hu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hypocoerciveEnergy_upper γ hγ q p) hρ.le
  change hypocoerciveRate γ r L * hypocoerciveEnergy γ q p ≤
    hypocoerciveRate γ r L * (hypocoerciveUpper γ * (‖q‖ ^ 2 + ‖p‖ ^ 2)) at hu
  rw [← mul_assoc, hcancel] at hu
  dsimp [hypocoerciveRemainder, hypocoerciveAuxiliary, hypocoerciveLeakage] at hu hq hp
  have hid : 1 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2) * (2 * L ^ 2 * ‖q‖ ^ 2) =
      2 * (L ^ 2 / (hypocoerciveYoung γ r L * γ ^ 2)) * ‖q‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [hid] at hf
  linarith

hypocoerciveWeight.exact_header: def hypocoerciveWeight (γ : ℝ) : HypocoercivePhase H →L[ℝ] HypocoercivePhase H
hypocoerciveWeight.exact_declaration:
def hypocoerciveWeight (γ : ℝ) : HypocoercivePhase H →L[ℝ] HypocoercivePhase H :=

    ((γ • (WithLp.fstL 2 ℝ H H) + WithLp.sndL 2 ℝ H H).prod
      (WithLp.fstL 2 ℝ H H + (2 / γ) • WithLp.sndL 2 ℝ H H))

theorem hypocoerciveWeight_pairing (γ : ℝ) (z : HypocoercivePhase H) :

theorem hypocoerciveWeight_pairing (γ : ℝ) (z : HypocoercivePhase H) :

hypocoerciveWeight_symmetric.exact_declaration:

theorem hypocoerciveWeight_field_pairing (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p f : H) :

theorem hypocoerciveWeight_field_pairing (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) (q p f : H) :
