hypocoerciveGeometry.exact_header:
def hypocoerciveGeometry {A Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase Z)
hypocoerciveGeometry.exact_declaration:
def hypocoerciveGeometry {A Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [InnerProductSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) :
    TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase Z) where
  optimizerWeight := hypocoerciveWeight γ
  samplerWeight := hypocoerciveWeight γ
  lower := hypocoerciveLower γ
  upper := hypocoerciveUpper γ
  lower_pos := hypocoerciveLower_pos γ hγ
  lower_le_upper := by
    apply (min_le_left (γ / 4) (1 / (2 * γ))).trans
    dsimp [hypocoerciveUpper]
    have : 0 ≤ 2 / γ := by positivity
    linarith
  optimizer_symmetric := hypocoerciveWeight_symmetric γ
  sampler_symmetric := hypocoerciveWeight_symmetric γ
  optimizer_lower := by
    intro z
    rw [hypocoerciveWeight_pairing, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    exact hypocoerciveEnergy_lower γ hγ z.fst z.snd
  optimizer_upper := by
    intro z
    rw [hypocoerciveWeight_pairing, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    exact hypocoerciveEnergy_upper γ hγ z.fst z.snd
  sampler_lower := by
    intro z
    rw [hypocoerciveWeight_pairing, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    exact hypocoerciveEnergy_lower γ hγ z.fst z.snd
  sampler_upper := by
    intro z
    rw [hypocoerciveWeight_pairing, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    exact hypocoerciveEnergy_upper γ hγ z.fst z.snd

integral_norm_sq_ge_norm_integral_sq.exact_header:
theorem integral_norm_sq_ge_norm_integral_sq (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (f : Ω → H) (hf : Integrable f Q) (hfsq : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ 2) Q) :
    ‖∫ ω, f ω ∂Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
integral_norm_sq_ge_norm_integral_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_norm_sq_ge_norm_integral_sq (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (f : Ω → H) (hf : Integrable f Q) (hfsq : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ 2) Q) :
    ‖∫ ω, f ω ∂Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  let m := ∫ ω, f ω ∂Q
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪m, f ω⟫_ℝ) Q := hf.const_inner m
  have hsub : Integrable (fun ω => ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ⟪m, f ω⟫_ℝ) Q :=
    hfsq.sub (hi.const_mul 2)
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ⟪m, f ω⟫_ℝ + ‖m‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro ω
    have h := sq_nonneg ‖f ω - m‖
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real] at h
    have heq : ⟪f ω, m⟫_ℝ = ⟪m, f ω⟫_ℝ := real_inner_comm _ _
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h
  rw [integral_add hsub (integrable_const _),
    integral_sub hfsq (hi.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, integral_inner hf m] at hn
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hn
  change 0 ≤ (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) - 2 * ⟪m, m⟫_ℝ + ‖m‖ ^ 2 at hn
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hn
  change ‖m‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  linarith

def heavyBallModel (γ : ℝ) (F : A → X → A) (H : A → X → X)

def heavyBallProjectedData (γ r L : ℝ) (F : A → X → A) (H : A → X → X)

heavyBall_optimizerField_difference.exact_header:
theorem heavyBall_optimizerField_difference (γ : ℝ) (F : A → X → A) (H : A → X → X)
    (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X) (t : ℝ) (s s' : HypocoercivePhase A)
    (ν ν' : Measure (HypocoercivePhase X)) :
    (heavyBallModel γ F H σ).optimizerField t s ν -
      (heavyBallModel γ F H σ).optimizerField t s' ν' =

    (s s' : HypocoercivePhase A)

    ((A × (Fin N → X)) × (A × (Fin N → X))) ≃L[ℝ]

  toFun := momentumParticleState
  invFun := fun z => ((z.1.snd, fun i => (z.2 i).snd), (z.1.fst, fun i => (z.2 i).fst))

  right_inv := by
    intro z
    apply Prod.ext

    · funext i
      exact WithLp.toLp_ofLp 2 (z.2 i)
  map_add' := by intros; rfl
  map_smul' := by intros; rfl
  continuous_toFun := by unfold momentumParticleState; fun_prop
  continuous_invFun := by fun_prop

theorem phase_difference_le (x x' : E) (y y' : F) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x, y) - WithLp.toLp 2 (x', y')‖ ≤ ‖x - x'‖ + ‖y - y'‖
phase_difference_le.exact_declaration:
theorem phase_difference_le (x x' : E) (y y' : F) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x, y) - WithLp.toLp 2 (x', y')‖ ≤ ‖x - x'‖ + ‖y - y'‖ := by
  have he : WithLp.toLp 2 (x, y) - WithLp.toLp 2 (x', y') =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (x - x', (0 : F)) + WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : E), y - y') := by
    apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
    simp
  rw [he]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans_eq (by
    rw [WithLp.norm_toLp_fst, WithLp.norm_toLp_snd])

damped_difference_le.exact_header:
theorem damped_difference_le (γ : ℝ) (f g p q : E) :
    ‖(-f - γ • p) - (-g - γ • q)‖ ≤ ‖f - g‖ + ‖γ‖ * ‖p - q‖
damped_difference_le.exact_declaration:
theorem damped_difference_le (γ : ℝ) (f g p q : E) :
    ‖(-f - γ • p) - (-g - γ • q)‖ ≤ ‖f - g‖ + ‖γ‖ * ‖p - q‖ := by
  have he : (-f - γ • p) - (-g - γ • q) = -(f - g) - γ • (p - q) := by module
  rw [he]
  simpa only [norm_neg, norm_smul] using norm_sub_le (-(f - g)) (γ • (p - q))

momentumDynamics.exact_header: def momentumDynamics : LipschitzDynamics (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase X) A
momentumDynamics.exact_declaration:
def momentumDynamics : LipschitzDynamics (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase X) A where
  observation := fun s z => F s.fst z.fst
  response := fun p => WithLp.toLp 2 (p.1.snd, -p.2 - γ • p.1.snd)
  sampler := fun s z => WithLp.toLp 2 (z.snd, -G s.fst z.fst - γ • z.snd)
  observationLip := LF
  responseLip := 2 + ‖γ‖₊
  samplerLip := 1 + LG + ‖γ‖₊
  observation_state := by
    intro s
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro z w
    have hb := hF s.fst s.fst z.fst w.fst
    simp only [dist_eq_norm, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_add] at hb ⊢
    exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (z - w)) LF.coe_nonneg)
  observation_parameter := by
    intro s t z
    have hb := hF s.fst t.fst z.fst z.fst
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] at hb
    exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (s - t)) LF.coe_nonneg)
  response_lipschitz := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro p q
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have hv : ‖p.1.snd - q.1.snd‖ ≤ ‖p - q‖ :=
      (WithLp.norm_snd_le _ (p.1 - q.1)).trans (norm_fst_le (p - q))
    have hg : ‖p.2 - q.2‖ ≤ ‖p - q‖ := norm_snd_le (p - q)
    have hb := (phase_difference_le p.1.snd q.1.snd
      (-p.2 - γ • p.1.snd) (-q.2 - γ • q.1.snd)).trans
        (add_le_add (le_refl _) (damped_difference_le γ p.2 q.2 p.1.snd q.1.snd))
    change _ ≤ (2 + ‖γ‖) * ‖p - q‖
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg γ)]
  sampler_state := by
    intro s
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro z w
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have hv : ‖z.snd - w.snd‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := WithLp.norm_snd_le _ (z - w)
    have hx : ‖z.fst - w.fst‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (z - w)
    have hg := hG s.fst s.fst z.fst w.fst
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_add] at hg
    have hg' := hg.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx LG.coe_nonneg)
    have hb := (phase_difference_le z.snd w.snd
      (-G s.fst z.fst - γ • z.snd) (-G s.fst w.fst - γ • w.snd)).trans
        (add_le_add (le_refl _) (damped_difference_le γ (G s.fst z.fst) (G s.fst w.fst)
          z.snd w.snd))
    change _ ≤ (1 + (LG : ℝ) + ‖γ‖) * ‖z - w‖
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg γ)]
  sampler_parameter := by
    intro s t z
    have hg := hG s.fst t.fst z.fst z.fst
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] at hg
    have hs : ‖s.fst - t.fst‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (s - t)
    have hb := (phase_difference_le z.snd z.snd
      (-G s.fst z.fst - γ • z.snd) (-G t.fst z.fst - γ • z.snd)).trans
        (add_le_add (le_refl _) (damped_difference_le γ (G s.fst z.fst) (G t.fst z.fst)
          z.snd z.snd))
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at hb
    change _ ≤ (1 + (LG : ℝ) + ‖γ‖) * ‖s - t‖
    have hgs := hg.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs LG.coe_nonneg)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - t), mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg γ) (norm_nonneg (s - t))]

  intro s t
  simpa [dist_eq_norm, heavyBallModel] using WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (s - t)

HigherOrderSampler.exact_declaration: abbrev HigherOrderSampler (X : Type*) := WithLp 2 (X × WithLp 2 (X × X))

higherOrderSamplerField.exact_header: def higherOrderSamplerField (a : A) (z : HigherOrderSampler X) : HigherOrderSampler X

higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le (a b : A) (z w : HigherOrderSampler X) :
    ‖higherOrderSamplerField G α γ a z - higherOrderSamplerField G α γ b w‖ ≤
      ‖G a z.fst - G b w.fst‖ + (1 + ‖γ‖) * ‖z.snd.fst - w.snd.fst‖ +
        (‖γ‖ + ‖α‖) * ‖z.snd.snd - w.snd.snd‖
higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le (a b : A) (z w : HigherOrderSampler X) :
    ‖higherOrderSamplerField G α γ a z - higherOrderSamplerField G α γ b w‖ ≤
      ‖G a z.fst - G b w.fst‖ + (1 + ‖γ‖) * ‖z.snd.fst - w.snd.fst‖ +
        (‖γ‖ + ‖α‖) * ‖z.snd.snd - w.snd.snd‖ := by
  have h1 := phase_difference_le z.snd.fst w.snd.fst
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (-G a z.fst + γ • z.snd.snd, -γ • z.snd.fst - α • z.snd.snd))
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (-G b w.fst + γ • w.snd.snd, -γ • w.snd.fst - α • w.snd.snd))
  have h2 := phase_difference_le (-G a z.fst + γ • z.snd.snd)
    (-G b w.fst + γ • w.snd.snd) (-γ • z.snd.fst - α • z.snd.snd)
    (-γ • w.snd.fst - α • w.snd.snd)
  have h3 := damped_difference_le (-γ) (G a z.fst) (G b w.fst) z.snd.snd w.snd.snd
  have h4 := damped_difference_le α (γ • z.snd.fst) (γ • w.snd.fst) z.snd.snd w.snd.snd
  simp only [neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, norm_neg] at h3
  simp only [← neg_smul, ← smul_sub, norm_smul] at h4
  dsimp only [higherOrderSamplerField]
  linarith

higherOrderModel.exact_header: def higherOrderModel (σ : I → X) : Model A A (HigherOrderSampler X) X I
higherOrderModel.exact_declaration:
def higherOrderModel (σ : I → X) : Model A A (HigherOrderSampler X) X I where
  parameter := id
  position := WithLp.fst
  observation := F
  optimizer := fun _ _ g => -g
  drift := higherOrderSamplerField G α γ
  diffusion := fun _ _ i => WithLp.toLp 2 (0, WithLp.toLp 2 (0, σ i))

higherOrderDynamics.exact_header: def higherOrderDynamics : LipschitzDynamics A (HigherOrderSampler X) A
higherOrderDynamics.exact_declaration:
def higherOrderDynamics : LipschitzDynamics A (HigherOrderSampler X) A where
  observation := fun a z => F a z.fst
  response := fun p => -p.2
  sampler := higherOrderSamplerField G α γ
  observationLip := LF
  responseLip := 1
  samplerLip := 1 + LG + 2 * ‖γ‖₊ + ‖α‖₊
  observation_state := by
    intro a
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro z w
    have hb := hF a a z.fst w.fst
    simp only [dist_eq_norm, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_add] at hb ⊢
    exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (z - w)) LF.coe_nonneg)
  observation_parameter := by
    intro a b z
    simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] using hF a b z.fst z.fst
  response_lipschitz := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro p q
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, neg_sub_neg, norm_sub_rev, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Prod.snd_sub]
      using norm_snd_le (p - q)
  sampler_state := by
    intro a
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro z w
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have hx : ‖z.fst - w.fst‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := WithLp.norm_fst_le _ (z - w)
    have hu : ‖z.snd.fst - w.snd.fst‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ :=
      (WithLp.norm_fst_le _ ((z - w).snd)).trans (WithLp.norm_snd_le _ (z - w))
    have hv : ‖z.snd.snd - w.snd.snd‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ :=
      (WithLp.norm_snd_le _ ((z - w).snd)).trans (WithLp.norm_snd_le _ (z - w))
    have hg := hG a a z.fst w.fst
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_add] at hg
    have hgs := hg.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx LG.coe_nonneg)
    have hb := higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le G α γ a a z w
    change _ ≤ (1 + (LG : ℝ) + 2 * ‖γ‖ + ‖α‖) * ‖z - w‖
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (norm_nonneg γ),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg γ),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg α)]
  sampler_parameter := by
    intro a b z
    have hb := higherOrderSamplerField_difference_le G α γ a b z z
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hb
    have hg := hG a b z.fst z.fst
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero] at hg
    change _ ≤ (1 + (LG : ℝ) + 2 * ‖γ‖ + ‖α‖) * ‖a - b‖
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a - b), mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg γ) (norm_nonneg (a - b)),
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg α) (norm_nonneg (a - b))]

    (γ t : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X)

def phaseSplitLp : Lp ((A × C) × (A × C)) 2 Q →L[ℝ]

phaseSplitLp.exact_declaration:
def phaseSplitLp : Lp ((A × C) × (A × C)) 2 Q →L[ℝ]
    ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :=
  ((((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A C).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).compLpL 2 Q).prod
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A C).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).compLpL 2 Q)).prod
  ((((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A C).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).compLpL 2 Q).prod
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A C).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).compLpL 2 Q))

theorem phaseSplitLp_coe (U : Lp ((A × C) × (A × C)) 2 Q) :

  filter_upwards [((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A C).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).coeFn_compLpL U,
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A C).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (A × C) (A × C))).coeFn_compLpL U,
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A C).comp

  exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext h1 h2) (Prod.ext h3 h4)

  filter_upwards [D.meanForceLp_coe Q z.1 z.2.1, D.samplerForceLp_coe_cloud Q z.1 z.2.1,
    Lp.coeFn_neg (D.meanForceLp Q z.1 z.2.1),
    Lp.coeFn_add (-(D.samplerForceLp Q z.1 z.2.1)) (γ • z.2.2.2),

  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.smul_apply] at hn ha hng hγ hs hγu hαv

    (Y B : ℝ → Lp (HypocoercivePhase A × (Fin N → HypocoercivePhase X)) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField N)
        ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y t) - momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y 0) =
      (∫ r in 0..t,
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y r)).2 -
          γ • (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y r)).1, (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y r)).1)) +

    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

          γ • (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y r)).1, (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y r)).1)) +
      momentumUnpackLp Q D (B t) := by
  let T := momentumUnpackLp Q D

      RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t ((oneEquiv N).symm p)
physical_drift_of_compatibility.exact_declaration:
theorem physical_drift_of_compatibility (N : ℕ) (L : LipschitzDynamics S Z Θ)
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0≤t) (p : S × (Fin N → Z)) :
    (oneEquiv N).symm (L.particleField N p)=
      RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift M N t ((oneEquiv N).symm p) := by
  apply (oneEquiv N).injective
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift_coordinates,
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (additive_particle_field N L M H t ht p).symm

momentum_drift_ae.exact_header:
theorem momentum_drift_ae (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D
      (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2-γ • z.1,z.1) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) N 0
        (momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω)
momentum_drift_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_drift_ae (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D
      (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2-γ • z.1,z.1) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) N 0
        (momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω) := by
  let E := oneEquiv (S := HypocoercivePhase A) (Z := HypocoercivePhase X) N
  let L := momentumForceDynamics D γ
  have hcompat : AdditiveModelCompatibility L (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) :=
    momentum_compatibility D.F D.G D.parameterLip D.samplerLip D.parameter_bound D.sampler_bound γ σ
  change E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (momentumPackLp Q D (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2-γ • z.1,z.1)) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) N 0
        (E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (momentumPackLp Q D z) ω)
  rw [momentumPackLp_drift]
  filter_upwards [E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (momentumPackLp Q D z)),
    ULA.lpDrift_coe Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (momentumPackLp Q D z),
    E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (momentumPackLp Q D z)] with ω he hf hx
  rw [he,hf,hx]
  exact physical_drift_of_compatibility N L (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) hcompat 0 le_rfl _

higherOrder_drift_ae.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_drift_ae (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → X)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) :
    higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ z) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) N 0
        (higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω)
higherOrder_drift_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_drift_ae (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → X)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) :
    higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ z) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) N 0
        (higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω) := by
  let E := oneEquiv (S := A) (Z := HigherOrderSampler X) N
  let L := higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ
  have hcompat : AdditiveModelCompatibility L (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) :=
    higherOrder_compatibility D.F D.G D.parameterLip D.samplerLip D.parameter_bound D.sampler_bound α γ σ
  change E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
      (higherOrderPackLp Q D (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ z)) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) N 0
        (E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (higherOrderPackLp Q D z) ω)
  rw [higherOrderPackLp_drift]
  filter_upwards [E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (higherOrderPackLp Q D z)),
    ULA.lpDrift_coe Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (higherOrderPackLp Q D z),
    E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (higherOrderPackLp Q D z)] with ω he hf hx
  rw [he,hf,hx]
  exact physical_drift_of_compatibility N L (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) hcompat 0 le_rfl _

momentum_metric.exact_header:
theorem momentum_metric [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
    (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X)
    (G : TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase X)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/
        (‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1))*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G)*
        ‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).toContinuousLinearMap‖)*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T ((-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) x.2-γ • x.1,x.1)-
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) y.2-γ • y.1,y.1))⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2)
momentum_metric.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_metric [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
    (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase X)
    (G : TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase X)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/
        (‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1))*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G)*
        ‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).toContinuousLinearMap‖)*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T ((-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) x.2-γ • x.1,x.1)-
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) y.2-γ • y.1,y.1))⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2) :=
  EmpiricalMetric.exists_transported_metric Q (momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D)
    (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) G ρ hmono D.nonempty 0 le_rfl
    (fun x => (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) x.2-γ • x.1,x.1))
    (momentum_drift_ae Q D γ σ)

higherOrder_metric.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_metric [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
    (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → X)
    (G : TwistedGeometry A (HigherOrderSampler X)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) G ρ) :

      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G)*

        holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2)
higherOrder_metric.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_metric [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
    (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → X)
    (G : TwistedGeometry A (HigherOrderSampler X)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q) →L[ℝ]

state and driving-noise seed. The fixed-time cloud law and independence of the

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
namespace PBGSO

/-- One independent complete seed per reference copy. -/

law, derived from independent seeds rather than supplied as an assumption. -/

trajectories independent, not merely their individual fixed-time marginals. -/

cloud_measurable.exact_header:

PBGSO/InitialPathIndependence.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.BrownianPathSpace

/-! # Original initial independence from finite observed noise
Finite joint time observations determine the full initial/path product law.
No whole-path independence or product-law conclusion is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped Classical
namespace PBGSO.ProcessPathIndependence
variable {Ω T V A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace V] [MeasurableSpace A]
  [Nonempty T] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (Y : T → Ω → V) (X : Ω → A) (hm : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hX : Measurable X)
include hm hX

/-- Independence of initialization from every finite noise observation
implies independence from the original complete raw path. -/
end PBGSO.ProcessPathIndependence

initial_independent_of_finite.exact_header:
theorem initial_independent_of_finite
    (hi : ∀ J : Finset T, IndepFun X (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)) Q) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω => fun t => Y t ω) Q
initial_independent_of_finite.exact_declaration:
theorem initial_independent_of_finite
    (hi : ∀ J : Finset T, IndepFun X (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)) Q) :
    IndepFun X (fun ω => fun t => Y t ω) Q := by
  have hmY : Measurable (fun ω => fun t => Y t ω) := measurable_pi_iff.mpr hm
  let μX := Q.map X
  let μY := Q.map (fun ω => fun t => Y t ω)
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μX :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hX.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μY :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hmY.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  let ν := μX.prod μY
  let f : A × (T → V) → T → A × V := fun p t => (p.1,p.2 t)
  have hf : Measurable f := by fun_prop
  let F (J : Finset T) := Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => (X ω,Y t ω)))
  have hmF (J : Finset T) : Measurable (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => (X ω,Y t ω))) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => hX.prodMk (hm t))
  haveI (J : Finset T) : IsProbabilityMeasure (F J) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hmF J).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hQ : IsProjectiveLimit (Q.map (fun ω => fun t => (X ω,Y t ω))) F :=
    isProjectiveLimit_map (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => hX.prodMk (hm t))).aemeasurable
  have hν : IsProjectiveLimit (ν.map f) F := by
    intro J
    let g : A × (J → V) → J → A × V := fun p t => (p.1,p.2 t)
    have hg : Measurable g := by fun_prop
    have hmJ : Measurable (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)) :=
      measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => hm t)
    have hμJ : μY.map J.restrict = Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map (Finset.measurable_restrict J) hmY]
      rfl
    have hp : μX.prod (Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω))) =
        ν.map (Prod.map id J.restrict) := by
      rw [← hμJ]
      simpa only [Measure.map_id] using
        Measure.map_prod_map μX μY measurable_id (Finset.measurable_restrict J)
    have hjoint := (hi J).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX.aemeasurable hmJ.aemeasurable
    calc
      (ν.map f).map J.restrict = ν.map (fun p => J.restrict (f p)) :=
        Measure.map_map (Finset.measurable_restrict J) hf
      _ = (μX.prod (Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)))).map g := by
        rw [hp,Measure.map_map hg (measurable_id.prodMap (Finset.measurable_restrict J))]
        rfl
      _ = (Q.map (fun ω => (X ω,J.restrict (fun t => Y t ω)))).map g := by rw [hjoint]
      _ = F J := by
        rw [Measure.map_map hg (hX.prodMk hmJ)]
        rfl
  have he := hQ.unique hν
  let t0 : T := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let g : (T → A × V) → A × (T → V) := fun p => ((p t0).1,fun t => (p t).2)
  have hg : Measurable g := by fun_prop
  have hh := congrArg (Measure.map g) he
  rw [Measure.map_map hg (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => hX.prodMk (hm t))),
    Measure.map_map hg hf] at hh
  have hleft : g ∘ (fun ω => fun t => (X ω,Y t ω)) = fun ω => (X ω,fun t => Y t ω) := rfl
  have hright : g ∘ f = id := rfl
  rw [hleft,hright,Measure.map_id] at hh
  exact (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX.aemeasurable hmY.aemeasurable).mpr hh

integral_mem_subspace.exact_header:
theorem integral_mem_subspace
    (V : Submodule ℝ E) [CompleteSpace V]
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ V, f x ∈ V)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → Y r - Y 0 = (∫ u in 0..r, f (Y u)) + B r)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hinit : Y 0 ∈ V)
    (hinput : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 t, B r ∈ V) : Y t ∈ V
integral_mem_subspace.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_mem_subspace
    (V : Submodule ℝ E) [CompleteSpace V]
    (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ V, f x ∈ V)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → Y r - Y 0 = (∫ u in 0..r, f (Y u)) + B r)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hinit : Y 0 ∈ V)
    (hinput : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 t, B r ∈ V) : Y t ∈ V := by
  let fV : V → V := fun x ↦ ⟨f x, hV x x.property⟩
  have hfV : LipschitzWith L fV := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    exact hf.dist_le_mul x y
  let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun r ↦ min (max 0 r) t
  have hc : Continuous clamp := (continuous_const.max continuous_id).min continuous_const
  have hclamp (r : ℝ) : clamp r ∈ Icc 0 t := by
    exact ⟨le_min (le_max_left _ _) ht, min_le_right _ _⟩
  let Bv : ℝ → V := fun r ↦ ⟨B (clamp r), hinput _ (hclamp r)⟩
  have hBv : Continuous Bv := (hB.comp hc).subtype_mk _
  have hBv0 : Bv 0 = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change B (min (max 0 0) t) = 0
    simpa only [max_self, min_eq_left ht] using hB0
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hX0, hXe⟩ := exists_global_integral_solution fV L hfV ⟨Y 0, hinit⟩ Bv hBv hBv0
  let W : ℝ → E := fun r ↦ V.subtypeL (X r)
  have hW : Continuous W := V.subtypeL.continuous.comp hX
  have hW0 : W 0 = Y 0 := by simp only [W, hX0]; rfl
  have hWe : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 t, W r - Y 0 = (∫ u in 0..r, f (W u)) + B r := by
    intro r hr
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun u ↦ fV (X u)) volume 0 r :=
      (hfV.continuous.comp hX).intervalIntegrable 0 r
    have hh := congrArg V.subtypeL (hXe r hr.1)
    rw [map_sub, map_add, ← V.subtypeL.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi] at hh
    change W r - Y 0 = (∫ u in 0..r, f (W u)) + B (clamp r) at hh
    simpa only [clamp, max_eq_right hr.1, min_eq_left hr.2] using hh
  have he := ULA.langevin_integral_unique (fun x ↦ -f x) L hf.neg (Y 0) B Y W hY hW t ht
    (fun r hr ↦ by simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using heq r hr.1)
    (fun r hr ↦ by simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using hWe r hr)
  rw [he ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩]
  exact (X t).property

theorem lpDrift_mem_lpMeas

theorem lifted_integral_aestronglyAdapted
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (Y B : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → Y r - Y 0 =
      (∫ u in 0..r, ULA.lpDrift Q g hg (Y u)) + B r)
    (hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[F 0] (Y 0) Q)
    (hinput : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (B r) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (Y t) Q
lifted_integral_aestronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem lifted_integral_aestronglyAdapted
    (g : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (Y B : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → Y r - Y 0 =
      (∫ u in 0..r, ULA.lpDrift Q g hg (Y u)) + B r)
    (hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[F 0] (Y 0) Q)
    (hinput : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (B r) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (Y t) Q := by
  let V := lpMeas E ℝ (F t) 2 Q
  letI : Fact (F t ≤ mΩ) := ⟨F.le t⟩
  apply (mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  apply integral_mem_subspace V (ULA.lpDrift Q g hg) L (ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz Q g hg)
    (fun x hx ↦ lpDrift_mem_lpMeas (F t) Q g L hg x hx)
    Y B hY hB hB0 heq (t : ℝ) t.coe_nonneg
  · exact (mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mpr
      (AEStronglyMeasurable.mono (F.mono (by positivity)) hinit)
  · intro r hr
    have hrt : r.toNNReal ≤ t := Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe.mpr hr.2
    have hm := AEStronglyMeasurable.mono (F.mono hrt) (hinput r.toNNReal)
    exact (mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mpr (by
      simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal r hr.1] using hm)

theorem meanField_aestronglyAdapted
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[F 0] (Y 0).2 Q)
    (hinput : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (B r) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (Y t).2 Q
meanField_aestronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem meanField_aestronglyAdapted
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Y B)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[F 0] (Y 0).2 Q)
    (hinput : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (B r) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (Y t).2 Q := by
  let V : Submodule ℝ (A × Lp Z 2 Q) :=
    (lpMeas Z ℝ (F t) 2 Q).comap (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)).toLinearMap
  have hc : IsClosed (V : Set (A × Lp Z 2 Q)) :=
    (isClosed_aestronglyMeasurable (F.le t)).preimage continuous_snd
  letI : CompleteSpace V := hc.completeSpace_coe
  have hinput' : Continuous (fun r ↦ ((0 : A), B r)) := continuous_const.prodMk hB
  have hB0' : ((0 : A), B 0) = 0 := by simp [hB0]
  have hfield : ∀ x ∈ V, L.field Q x ∈ V := by
    intro x hx
    exact liftMap_mem_lpMeas (F t) Q (L.sampler x.1) L.samplerLip (L.sampler_state x.1) x.2 hx
  have hmem : Y t ∈ V := integral_mem_subspace V (L.field Q) L.fieldLip
    (L.field_lipschitz Q) hfield Y (fun r ↦ (0, B r)) HY.continuous hinput' hB0'
    HY.equation t t.coe_nonneg
    ((mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mpr
      (AEStronglyMeasurable.mono (F.mono (by positivity)) hinit))
    (by
      intro r hr
      change B r ∈ lpMeas Z ℝ (F t) 2 Q
      have hrt : r.toNNReal ≤ t := Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe.mpr hr.2
      have hm := AEStronglyMeasurable.mono (F.mono hrt) (hinput r.toNNReal)
      exact (mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mpr (by
        simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal r hr.1] using hm))
  change (Y t).2 ∈ lpMeas Z ℝ (F t) 2 Q at hmem
  exact (mem_lpMeas_iff_aestronglyMeasurable (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp hmem

samplerBrownianInput_aestronglyMeasurabl.exact_header:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_aestronglyMeasurable
    (D : FilteredBrownian.Driver (I := I) Q) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] E)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t]
      (samplerBrownianInput Q K D.process D.brownian 0 t) Q
samplerBrownianInput_aestronglyMeasurabl.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_aestronglyMeasurable
    (D : FilteredBrownian.Driver (I := I) Q) (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] E)
    (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t]
      (samplerBrownianInput Q K D.process D.brownian 0 t) Q := by
  have hcoords (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : s ≤ t) :
      StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (ULA.brownianCoordinates D.process s) := by
    have hm : @Measurable Ω (I → ℝ) (D.filtration t) inferInstance
        (fun ω i ↦ D.process i s ω) :=
      (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ ↦ ℝ) (D.filtration t) (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)
        (fun ω i ↦ D.process i s ω)).mpr
        (fun i ↦ ((D.adapted i s).mono (D.filtration.mono hs)).measurable)
    exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : I ↦ ℝ)).comp_stronglyMeasurable hm.stronglyMeasurable
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t]
      (fun ω ↦ K (Real.sqrt 2 •
        (ULA.brownianCoordinates D.process t ω - ULA.brownianCoordinates D.process 0 ω))) :=
    K.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable
      (((hcoords t le_rfl).sub (hcoords 0 (by positivity))).const_smul (Real.sqrt 2))
  apply hm.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
  simpa only [zero_add, Real.toNNReal_coe, Real.toNNReal_zero] using
    (samplerBrownianInput_coe Q K D.process D.brownian 0 t).symm

theorem particle_integral_aestronglyAdapted
    {A Z G : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]

    (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (Y B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)

      (∫ u in 0..r, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y u)) + B r)

particle_integral_aestronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem particle_integral_aestronglyAdapted
    {A Z G : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (F : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (Y B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → Y r - Y 0 =
      (∫ u in 0..r, ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N)
        (L.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y u)) + B r)
    (hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[F 0] (Y 0) Q)
    (hinput : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[F r] (B r) Q)

/-! # Forced quadratic energy with a.e. time dissipation
The regularized square-root comparison uses absolute continuity and an
actual integral energy equation; no pointwise derivative is assumed. -/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter Metric
open scoped Topology NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.IntegralForcedEnergy
open IntegralQuadraticEnergy

/-- Gronwall for absolutely continuous scalar curves and an a.e. derivative
inequality, proved through the integral fundamental theorem. -/

/-- A positive regularization of the square root preserves absolute
continuity. The local Lipschitz constant is derived on the actual compact
range; it is not an extra assumption. -/

/-- The exact forced-energy square-root bound from merely a.e. dissipation.
The initial energy vanishes and the forcing radius is c. -/

ac_gronwall.exact_header:
theorem ac_gronwall (e : ℝ → ℝ) {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (he : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval e 0 T)
    (hd : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T), deriv e r ≤ c * e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * e 0
ac_gronwall.exact_declaration:
theorem ac_gronwall (e : ℝ → ℝ) {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (he : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval e 0 T)
    (hd : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T), deriv e r ≤ c * e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * e 0 := by
  apply integral_gronwall e (deriv e) hT he.intervalIntegrable_deriv
  · intro r hr
    have hh := (he.mono (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le hr.1, uIcc_of_le hT]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hr.2)).integral_deriv_eq_sub
    rw [hh]
    ring
  · exact hd

regularized_sqrt_ac.exact_header:
theorem regularized_sqrt_ac (f : ℝ → ℝ) {T ε : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f 0 T)
    (hpos : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ f r) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun r => Real.sqrt (f r + ε ^ 2)) 0 T
regularized_sqrt_ac.exact_declaration:
theorem regularized_sqrt_ac (f : ℝ → ℝ) {T ε : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hf : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f 0 T)
    (hpos : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ f r) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun r => Real.sqrt (f r + ε ^ 2)) 0 T := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.exists_bound
  let R := max C 0 + ε ^ 2
  have hsqrt : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Real.sqrt (Icc (ε ^ 2) R) :=
    contDiffOn_id.sqrt (fun x hx => ne_of_gt ((sq_pos_of_pos hε).trans_le hx.1))
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hsqrt.exists_lipschitzOnWith (by norm_num) (convex_Icc _ _) isCompact_Icc
  have hc : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun _ : ℝ => ε ^ 2) 0 T :=
    contDiff_const.contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval
  apply hL.comp_absolutelyContinuousOnInterval _ (hf.add hc)
  intro r hr
  have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using hr
  change ε ^ 2 ≤ f r + ε ^ 2 ∧ f r + ε ^ 2 ≤ R
  constructor
  · linarith [hpos r hr']
  · have hh := (le_abs_self (f r)).trans (hC r hr)
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [le_max_left C 0]

forced_energy_bound.exact_header:
theorem forced_energy_bound (e w : ℝ → ℝ) {T ρ c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hw : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 T)
    (he : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, e r = e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s)
    (hE : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ e r) (hzero : e 0 = 0)
    (hdiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T),
      w r ≤ -2 * ρ * e r + 2 * c * Real.sqrt (e r)) :
    Real.sqrt (e T) ≤ c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T))
forced_energy_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem forced_energy_bound (e w : ℝ → ℝ) {T ρ c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hw : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 T)
    (he : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, e r = e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s)
    (hE : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ e r) (hzero : e 0 = 0)
    (hdiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T),
      w r ≤ -2 * ρ * e r + 2 * c * Real.sqrt (e r)) :
    Real.sqrt (e T) ≤ c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  let F := fun r => e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s
  have hF : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 T :=
    (contDiff_const.contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval (f := fun _ : ℝ => e 0)).add
      (hw.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral (by simp))
  have hFe (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) : F r = e r := (he r hr).symm
  have hFpos : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ F r := fun r hr => hFe r hr ▸ hE r hr
  let u := fun r => Real.sqrt (F r + ε ^ 2)
  let uprime := fun r => w r / (2 * u r)
  let C := (c + ρ * ε) / ρ
  have hu := regularized_sqrt_ac F hT hε hF hFpos
  have hC : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun _ : ℝ => C) 0 T :=
    contDiff_const.contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval
  have hup (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) : 0 < u r :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by nlinarith [hFpos r hr])
  have husq (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) : u r ^ 2 = F r + ε ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hFpos r hr])
  have hεu (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) : ε ≤ u r := by
    nlinarith [husq r hr, hFpos r hr, (hup r hr).le]
  have hsqrt (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) : Real.sqrt (e r) ≤ u r := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [hFe r hr]
    nlinarith
  have hder : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T),
      deriv (fun s => u s - C) r ≤ -ρ * (u r - C) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hw.ae_hasDerivAt_integral,
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc, hdiss] with r hr hrt hdiss
    have hrt' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := Ioc_subset_Icc_self hrt
    have hrt'' : r ∈ uIcc 0 T := by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using hrt'
    have hFd : HasDerivAt F (w r) r := (hr hrt'' 0 (by simp)).const_add (e 0)
    have hud : HasDerivAt u (uprime r) r := by
      exact (hFd.add_const (ε ^ 2)).sqrt (ne_of_gt (by nlinarith [hFpos r hrt']))
    rw [(hud.sub_const C).deriv]
    have hb : uprime r ≤ -ρ * u r + (c + ρ * ε) := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (hup r hrt'))).mpr
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsqrt r hrt') (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * c)
      have hreg := mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * ρ * ε) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hεu r hrt'))
      have heq := husq r hrt'
      rw [hFe r hrt'] at heq
      nlinarith
    have hρC : ρ * C = c + ρ * ε := by dsimp [C]; field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hgr := ac_gronwall (fun r => u r - C) hT (hu.sub hC) hder
  have hu0 : u 0 = ε := by simp [u, F, hzero, Real.sqrt_sq hε.le]
  rw [hu0] at hgr
  have hFT : F T = e T := hFe T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩
  have heq : Real.exp (-ρ * T) * (ε - C) + C =
      c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) + ε := by
    dsimp [C]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hbound : u T ≤ c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) + ε := by
    rw [← heq]
    linarith
  exact (hsqrt T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).trans hbound

ModelIntegralTrajectory.exact_header: structure ModelIntegralTrajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (T : ℝ)
ModelIntegralTrajectory.exact_declaration:
structure ModelIntegralTrajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (T : ℝ) where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift : ℝ → S
  sampler : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q
  noise : ℝ → Ω → Z
  optimizer_continuous : ContinuousOn optimizer (Icc 0 T)
  sampler_continuous : ContinuousOn sampler (Icc 0 T)
  optimizerDrift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable optimizerDrift volume 0 T
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 T
  diffusion_timeL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun r => diffusion r i) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 T))
  optimizerDrift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, optimizerDrift t =
    M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler t))
  optimizer_integral : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
    optimizer t = optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, optimizerDrift r
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ i, diffusion t i =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (sampler t ω) i
  martingale : Martingale noise ℱ Q
  noise_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, noise t =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q sampler drift t
  initial_adapted : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (sampler 0) Q
  drift_adapted : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (drift t) Q
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (sampler t))

ModelIntegralTrajectory.restrict.exact_header:
def ModelIntegralTrajectory.restrict (U : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : R ∈ Icc 0 T) : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M R
ModelIntegralTrajectory.restrict.exact_declaration:
def ModelIntegralTrajectory.restrict (U : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : R ∈ Icc 0 T) : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M R where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler := U.sampler
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion := U.diffusion
  noise := U.noise
  optimizer_continuous := U.optimizer_continuous.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hR.2)
  sampler_continuous := U.sampler_continuous.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hR.2)
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    rw [uIoc_of_le hR.1, uIoc_of_le (hR.1.trans hR.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hR.2)
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    rw [uIoc_of_le hR.1, uIoc_of_le (hR.1.trans hR.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hR.2)
  diffusion_timeL2 := fun i => (U.diffusion_timeL2 i).mono_measure
    (Measure.restrict_mono (by
      rw [uIoc_of_le hR.1, uIoc_of_le (hR.1.trans hR.2)]
      exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hR.2) le_rfl)
  optimizerDrift_realizes := fun r hr => U.optimizerDrift_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  optimizer_integral := fun r hr => U.optimizer_integral r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  drift_realizes := fun r hr => U.drift_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  diffusion_realizes := fun r hr => U.diffusion_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  martingale := U.martingale
  noise_realizes := fun r hr => U.noise_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  initial_adapted := U.initial_adapted
  drift_adapted := fun r hr => U.drift_adapted r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  observation_integrable := fun r hr => U.observation_integrable r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩

work_pullback_ae.exact_header:
theorem work_pullback_ae (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => ⟪(U.sampler t - V.sampler t) ω,
      D.samplerWeight ((U.drift t - V.drift t) ω)⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, ⟪(U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω,
        D.samplerWeight ((U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω)⟫_ℝ
work_pullback_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem work_pullback_ae (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => ⟪(U.sampler t - V.sampler t) ω,
      D.samplerWeight ((U.drift t - V.drift t) ω)⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, ⟪(U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω,
        D.samplerWeight ((U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hσ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i,
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) ω =
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (U.sampler t ω) i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (V.optimizer t)) (V.sampler t ω) i := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (U.diffusion t i) (V.diffusion t i),
      U.diffusion_realizes t ht i, V.diffusion_realizes t ht i] with ω hs hu hv
    simp only [hs, Pi.sub_apply, hu, hv]
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t),
    Lp.coeFn_sub (U.drift t) (V.drift t), U.drift_realizes t ht, V.drift_realizes t ht,
    hσ] with ω hX hb hu hv hσ
  simp only [hX, hb, Pi.sub_apply, hu, hv, hσ, samplerCouplingWork, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]

work_pullback_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_pullback_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) Q
work_pullback_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_pullback_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (fun ω => samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t)
      (U.sampler t ω, V.sampler t ω)) Q := by
  apply (Integrable.add (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight _ _)
    ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))).const_mul
        (1 / 2 : ℝ))).congr
  exact (work_pullback_ae D U V t ht).symm

work_measurable.exact_header:
theorem work_measurable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) :
    Measurable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s')
work_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_measurable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) :
    Measurable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') := by
  have hz : Measurable (fun zz : Z × Z => zz.1 - zz.2) := measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd
  have hbb := ((hb (M.parameter s)).comp measurable_fst).sub
    ((hb (M.parameter s')).comp measurable_snd)
  have hinner : Continuous (fun p : Z × Z => ⟪p.1, p.2⟫_ℝ) := continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd
  have hpair := hinner.measurable.comp (hz.prodMk (D.samplerWeight.continuous.measurable.comp hbb))
  have hsum : Measurable (fun zz : Z × Z => ∑ i,
      D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro i _
    have hi := ((hσ (M.parameter s) i).comp measurable_fst).sub
      ((hσ (M.parameter s') i).comp measurable_snd)
    exact hinner.measurable.comp (hi.prodMk (D.samplerWeight.continuous.measurable.comp hi))
  exact hpair.add (hsum.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ))

work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t))
      (samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t))
work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t))
      (samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) := by
  apply (integrable_map_measure (work_measurable D _ _ hb hσ).aestronglyMeasurable
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.sampler t)).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (V.sampler t)).aemeasurable)).mpr
  exact work_pullback_integrable D U V t ht

work_integral.exact_header:
theorem work_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) zz
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) =
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.drift t - V.drift t) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i)
work_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) zz
      ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t)) =
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.drift t - V.drift t) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) := by
  rw [samplerPairLaw, integral_map
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.sampler t)).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (V.sampler t)).aemeasurable)
    (work_measurable D _ _ hb hσ).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rw [integral_congr_ae (work_pullback_ae D U V t ht), integral_add
    (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight _ _)
    ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
      (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))).const_mul
        (1 / 2 : ℝ)), integral_const_mul,
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i) (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i))]
  simp only [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]

martingale_condExpL2_local.exact_header:
theorem martingale_condExpL2_local (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (Ms Mt : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt) :
    (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) Mt : Lp Z 2 Q) = Ms
martingale_condExpL2_local.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_condExpL2_local (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (Ms Mt : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt) :
    (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) Mt : Lp Z 2 Q) = Ms := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hCE : (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) Mt : Ω → Z) =ᵐ[Q] Q[Mt | ℱ s] := by
    simpa only [Lp.toLp_coeFn] using
      (Lp.memLp Mt).condExpL2_ae_eq_condExp (𝕜 := ℝ) (ℱ.le s)
  exact hCE.trans ((condExp_congr_ae ht.symm).trans ((hm.condExp_ae_eq hst).trans hs))

martingale_orthogonal_local.exact_header:
theorem martingale_orthogonal_local (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (Y Ms Mt : Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) : weightedPairing Q W Y (Mt - Ms) = 0
martingale_orthogonal_local.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_orthogonal_local (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (Y Ms Mt : Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) : weightedPairing Q W Y (Mt - Ms) = 0 := by
  have hadapt : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] (W.compLpL 2 Q Y) Q :=
    (W.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY).congr (W.coeFn_compLpL Y).symm
  have hcond : (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) (Mt - Ms) : Lp Z 2 Q) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, Submodule.coe_sub]
    rw [martingale_condExpL2_local m hm hst Ms Mt hs ht,
      martingale_condExpL2_local m hm le_rfl Ms Ms hs hs, sub_self]
  have hinner := inner_condExpL2_eq_inner_fun (𝕜 := ℝ) (ℱ.le s)
    (Mt - Ms) (W.compLpL 2 Q Y) hadapt
  rw [hcond, inner_zero_left] at hinner
  rw [weightedPairing_left Q W hW, real_inner_comm, ← hinner]

pairState.exact_header: def pairState (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ)
pairState.exact_declaration:
def pairState (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) :=
  (U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t, U.sampler t - V.sampler t)

pairDrift.exact_header: def pairDrift (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ)
pairDrift.exact_declaration:
def pairDrift (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) :=
  (U.optimizerDrift t - V.optimizerDrift t, U.drift t - V.drift t)

pairDiffusion.exact_header: def pairDiffusion (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) (i : I)
pairDiffusion.exact_declaration:
def pairDiffusion (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) (i : I) :=
  U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i

pairMartingale.exact_header: def pairMartingale (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ)
pairMartingale.exact_declaration:
def pairMartingale (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) :=

pairEnergy.exact_header: def pairEnergy (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ)
pairEnergy.exact_declaration:
def pairEnergy (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (t : ℝ) :=
  liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V t) (pairState U V t)

pairDiffusion_integrable.exact_header:
theorem pairDiffusion_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) :
    IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V)) volume 0 T
pairDiffusion_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem pairDiffusion_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) :
    IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V)) volume 0 T := by
  change IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
    (U.diffusion r i - V.diffusion r i) (U.diffusion r i - V.diffusion r i)) volume 0 T
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
  exact integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    (quadratic_time_integrable (weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight) _
      ((U.diffusion_timeL2 i).sub (V.diffusion_timeL2 i))).def')

pair_dissipation.exact_header:
theorem pair_dissipation (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    2 * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V t) (pairDrift U V t) +
      diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) t ≤
      (-2 * ρ) * pairEnergy D U V t
pair_dissipation.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_dissipation (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    2 * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V t) (pairDrift U V t) +
      diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) t ≤
      (-2 * ρ) * pairEnergy D U V t := by
  let ν := Q.map (U.sampler t)
  let ν' := Q.map (V.sampler t)
  have hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.sampler t)).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hν' : IsProbabilityMeasure ν' := (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (V.sampler t)).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hh := hmono t ht.1 (U.optimizer t) (V.optimizer t) ν ν'
    (samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler t) (V.sampler t))
    (samplerPairLaw_coupling Q _ _) hν hν'
    (lp_law_second_moment Q _) (lp_law_second_moment Q _)
    (U.observation_integrable t ht) (V.observation_integrable t ht)
    (work_integrable D U V hb hσ t ht)
    (samplerPairLaw_cost_integrable Q D _ _)
  rw [work_integral D U V hb hσ t ht, samplerPairLaw_cost_integral] at hh
  rw [← U.optimizerDrift_realizes t ht, ← V.optimizerDrift_realizes t ht] at hh
  change 2 * (⟪U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t,
      D.optimizerWeight (U.optimizerDrift t - V.optimizerDrift t)⟫_ℝ +
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.drift t - V.drift t)) +
      (∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i)
        (U.diffusion t i - V.diffusion t i)) ≤
      (-2 * ρ) * (D.optimizerSq (U.optimizer t - V.optimizer t) +
      weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight (U.sampler t - V.sampler t) (U.sampler t - V.sampler t))
  simp only [weightedPairing_apply] at *
  linarith

pair_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem pair_decomposition (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    pairState U V r = pairState U V 0 + (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift U V s) +
      (0, pairMartingale U V r)
pair_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_decomposition (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    pairState U V r = pairState U V 0 + (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift U V s) +
      (0, pairMartingale U V r) := by
  have hbU : IntervalIntegrable U.drift volume 0 r := U.drift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le (hr.1.trans hr.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2)
  have hbV : IntervalIntegrable V.drift volume 0 r := V.drift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le (hr.1.trans hr.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2)
  have hvU : IntervalIntegrable U.optimizerDrift volume 0 r := U.optimizerDrift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le (hr.1.trans hr.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2)
  have hvV : IntervalIntegrable V.optimizerDrift volume 0 r := V.optimizerDrift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le (hr.1.trans hr.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2)
  have hp : IntervalIntegrable (pairDrift U V) volume 0 r :=
    ⟨(hvU.1.sub hvV.1).prodMk (hbU.1.sub hbV.1),
      (hvU.2.sub hvV.2).prodMk (hbU.2.sub hbV.2)⟩
  have hint : (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift U V s) =
      (∫ s in 0..r, U.optimizerDrift s - V.optimizerDrift s,
       ∫ s in 0..r, U.drift s - V.drift s) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Lp Z 2 Q)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hp).symm
    · exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S (Lp Z 2 Q)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hp).symm
  rw [hint]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change U.optimizer r - V.optimizer r =
      (U.optimizer 0 - V.optimizer 0) +
        (∫ s in 0..r, U.optimizerDrift s - V.optimizerDrift s) + 0
    rw [U.optimizer_integral r hr, V.optimizer_integral r hr,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub hvU hvV]
    abel
  · change U.sampler r - V.sampler r = (U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0) +
      (∫ s in 0..r, U.drift s - V.drift s) + pairMartingale U V r
    simp only [pairMartingale, martingaleResidual,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub hbU hbV]
    abel

theorem liftedMetricBilinear_noise (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

SynchronousIsometry.exact_header: def SynchronousIsometry (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) : Prop
SynchronousIsometry.exact_declaration:
def SynchronousIsometry (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) : Prop :=
  ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
    (pairMartingale U V t) (pairMartingale U V t) =
      ∫ r in 0..t, diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) r

pair_energy_integral.exact_header:
theorem pair_energy_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    pairEnergy D U V T = pairEnergy D U V 0 +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V r) (pairDrift U V r) +
        diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) r
pair_energy_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_energy_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    pairEnergy D U V T = pairEnergy D U V 0 +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V r) (pairDrift U V r) +
        diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) r := by
  have hm : Martingale (U.noise - V.noise) ℱ Q := U.martingale.sub V.martingale
  have hrep := pairMartingale_rep U V
  have hzero := pairMartingale_zero U V
  have hinit : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0) Q :=
    (U.initial_adapted.sub V.initial_adapted).congr (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).symm
  have hbadapt (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 T) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (U.drift r - V.drift r) Q :=
    ((U.drift_adapted r hr).sub (V.drift_adapted r hr)).congr (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).symm
  apply quadratic_balance (liftedMetricBilinear Q D) (liftedMetricBilinear_symmetric Q D)
    (pairState U V) (pairDrift U V) (fun r => (0, pairMartingale U V r))
    (diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V)) hT
    (pairDrift_integrable U V) (pairDiffusion_integrable D U V) (pairState_continuous U V)
    (fun r hr => pair_decomposition U V hr)
  · rw [liftedMetricBilinear_noise]
    simpa only [pairState, hzero, sub_zero] using
      martingale_orthogonal_local D.samplerWeight D.sampler_symmetric
        (U.sampler 0 - V.sampler 0) (pairMartingale U V 0) (pairMartingale U V T)
        (U.noise - V.noise) hm hT (hrep 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩) (hrep T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩) hinit
  · intro r hr
    have hp : ((0 : S), pairMartingale U V T) - (0, pairMartingale U V r) =
        (0, pairMartingale U V T - pairMartingale U V r) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [hp]
    rw [liftedMetricBilinear_noise]
    exact martingale_orthogonal_local D.samplerWeight D.sampler_symmetric
      (U.drift r - V.drift r) (pairMartingale U V r) (pairMartingale U V T)
      (U.noise - V.noise) hm hr.2 (hrep r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr))
      (hrep T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩) (hbadapt r hr)
  · rw [liftedMetricBilinear_noise]
    exact hIso T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩

pair_energy_decay.exact_header:
theorem pair_energy_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    pairEnergy D U V T ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) * pairEnergy D U V 0
pair_energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_energy_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    pairEnergy D U V T ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) * pairEnergy D U V 0 := by
  apply integral_gronwall (pairEnergy D U V)
    (fun r => 2 * liftedMetricBilinear Q D (pairState U V r) (pairDrift U V r) +
      diffusionEnergy Q D.samplerWeight (pairDiffusion U V) r) hT
  · apply IntervalIntegrable.add _ (pairDiffusion_integrable D U V)
    exact (bilinear_continuous_integrable (liftedMetricBilinear Q D)
      (pairState U V) (pairDrift U V)
      (by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using pairState_continuous U V)
      (pairDrift_integrable U V)).const_mul 2
  · intro r hr
    exact pair_energy_integral D (U.restrict hr) (V.restrict hr) hr.1
      (fun s hs => hIso s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans hr.2⟩)
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    exact pair_dissipation D U V hb hσ ρ hmono r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)

pair_rms_decay.exact_header:
theorem pair_rms_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0))
pair_rms_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_rms_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0)) := by
  have hd := pair_energy_decay D U V hT hb hσ ρ hmono hIso
  have hlo := liftedMetricBilinear_lower Q D (pairState U V T)
  have hup := liftedMetricBilinear_upper Q D (pairState U V 0)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hn (x : S × Lp Z 2 Q) : 0 ≤ liftedEuclideanSq Q x := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hn _), mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hκ, Real.sq_sqrt (hn _)]
  have he : Real.exp (-ρ * T) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left D.lower_pos).mp
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * T)).le
  have heq : D.lower * (D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) *
      liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0)) =
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) * (D.upper * liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0)) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.conditionNumber]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt D.lower_pos]
  rw [heq]
  exact hlo.trans (hd.trans hupper)

samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral.exact_header:
theorem samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    (∫ zz, ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2 ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V) = ‖U - V‖ ^ 2
samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral (U V : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    (∫ zz, ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2 ∂samplerPairLaw Q U V) = ‖U - V‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hf : Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z => ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  rw [samplerPairLaw, integral_map
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable.prodMk (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable)
    hf.aestronglyMeasurable, ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (U - V)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub U V] with ω hω
  rw [hω]
  rfl

theorem pair_joint_law_rms_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)

          ∫ zz, ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2 ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler 0) (V.sampler 0))
pair_joint_law_rms_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_joint_law_rms_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :

      ∫ zz, ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2 ∂samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler T) (V.sampler T)) ≤

pair_law_distance_decay.exact_header:
theorem pair_law_distance_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0))
pair_law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_law_distance_decay (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : ModelIntegralTrajectory Q ℱ M T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hIso : SynchronousIsometry D U V) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler T)) (Q.map (V.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        Real.sqrt (liftedEuclideanSq Q (pairState U V 0)) := by
  let ν := Q.map (U.sampler T)
  let ν' := Q.map (V.sampler T)
  have hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
      (lp_law_second_moment Q _)
  have hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν' :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
      (lp_law_second_moment Q _)
  let c : ULA.Coupling ν ν' := ⟨samplerPairLaw Q (U.sampler T) (V.sampler T),
    (samplerPairLaw_coupling Q _ _).1, (samplerPairLaw_coupling Q _ _).2⟩
  have hc := coupling_difference_memLp ν ν' hν hν' c
  have hbnd := wasserstein_le_finite_coupling ν ν' c hc.eLpNorm_ne_top
  have hs := couplingCost_sq_eq_integral c.joint hc
  rw [samplerPairLaw_euclidean_integral] at hs
  apply le_trans _ (pair_rms_decay D U V hT hb hσ ρ hmono hIso)
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  change ‖U.optimizer T - V.optimizer T‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' ^ 2 ≤
    ‖U.optimizer T - V.optimizer T‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sampler T - V.sampler T‖ ^ 2
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  rw [← hs]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mpr hbnd

PBGSO/IntegralModulus.lean.scope_note: Supply the actual integral equation, drift continuity, a nonnegative finite-horizon drift radius, an input square-root increment bound and a segment inside the horizon. The drift radius is proved to exist from continuity but is horizon dependent. This does not prove a uniform-in-time moment bound or a variable-diffusion Itô estimate.
PBGSO/IntegralModulus.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.BrownianProcess

/-! # Increment estimates derived from the actual integral equations

On a finite horizon a continuous L² solution has bounded continuous drift.
The integral equation and Brownian-coordinate increment moments then give a
square-root increment modulus. It need not be postulated independently of
the constructed process. The drift radius is horizon dependent.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO

exists_drift_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_drift_radius (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (Y : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ G : ℝ, 0 ≤ G ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G
exists_drift_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_drift_radius (f : E → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (Y : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ G : ℝ, 0 ≤ G ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).image
    (hf.comp hY)).isBounded.exists_norm_le
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  exact (hC _ (mem_image_of_mem _ ht)).trans (le_max_left _ _)

integral_segment_increment.exact_header:
theorem integral_segment_increment (f : E → E) (Y B : ℝ → E) (T a h G N : ℝ)
    (hcont : Continuous (fun t => f (Y t)))
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (haT : a + h ≤ T)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, f (Y s)) + B t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hB : ‖B (a + h) - B a‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt h) :
    ‖Y (a + h) - Y a‖ ≤ G * h + N * Real.sqrt h
integral_segment_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_segment_increment (f : E → E) (Y B : ℝ → E) (T a h G N : ℝ)
    (hcont : Continuous (fun t => f (Y t)))
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (haT : a + h ≤ T)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, f (Y s)) + B t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hB : ‖B (a + h) - B a‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt h) :
    ‖Y (a + h) - Y a‖ ≤ G * h + N * Real.sqrt h := by
  have hae : a ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨ha, by linarith⟩
  have hah : a + h ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨by linarith, haT⟩
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..a + h, f (Y s)) - (∫ s in 0..a, f (Y s)) =
      ∫ s in a..a + h, f (Y s) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hcont.intervalIntegrable a (a + h))]
    abel
  have hy : Y (a + h) - Y a =
      (∫ s in a..a + h, f (Y s)) + (B (a + h) - B a) := by
    have he1 := heq (a + h) hah
    have he0 := heq a hae
    calc
      Y (a + h) - Y a = (Y (a + h) - Y 0) - (Y a - Y 0) := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [he1, he0, ← hi]; abel
  have hint : ‖∫ s in a..a + h, f (Y s)‖ ≤ G * h := by
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := a) (b := a + h) (C := G) (f := fun s => f (Y s)) (fun s hs => ?_)
    · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg hh] using hb
    · rw [uIoc_of_le (by linarith : a ≤ a + h)] at hs
      exact hG s ⟨ha.trans hs.1.le, hs.2.trans haT⟩
  rw [hy]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hint hB)

integral_segment_sqrt_modulus.exact_header:
theorem integral_segment_sqrt_modulus (f : E → E) (Y B : ℝ → E)
    (T a h G N : ℝ) (hcont : Continuous (fun t => f (Y t)))
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (haT : a + h ≤ T) (hG0 : 0 ≤ G)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, f (Y s)) + B t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hB : ‖B (a + h) - B a‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt h) :
    ‖Y (a + h) - Y a‖ ≤ (G + N) * Real.sqrt h
integral_segment_sqrt_modulus.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_segment_sqrt_modulus (f : E → E) (Y B : ℝ → E)
    (T a h G N : ℝ) (hcont : Continuous (fun t => f (Y t)))
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (haT : a + h ≤ T) (hG0 : 0 ≤ G)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, f (Y s)) + B t)
    (hG : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hB : ‖B (a + h) - B a‖ ≤ N * Real.sqrt h) :
    ‖Y (a + h) - Y a‖ ≤ (G + N) * Real.sqrt h := by
  have hi := integral_segment_increment f Y B T a h G N hcont ha hh haT heq hG hB
  have hs : h ≤ Real.sqrt h := by
    have he := Real.sq_sqrt hh
    have hp := Real.sqrt_nonneg h
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hG0]

samplerBrownianInput_segment.exact_header:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_segment (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (a h : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 (a + h) - samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 a =
      samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW a h
samplerBrownianInput_segment.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_segment (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (a h : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 (a + h) - samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0 a =
      samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW a h := by
  change (K.compLpL 2 Q) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 (a + h)) -
    (K.compLpL 2 Q) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 a) =
      (K.compLpL 2 Q) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a h)
  rw [← map_sub]
  congr 1
  simp only [ULA.brownianLangevinNoise, zero_add]
  module
