quadratic_continuous.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_continuous (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x => B x x)
quadratic_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_continuous (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x => B x x) := B.continuous.clm_apply continuous_id

bilinear_continuous.exact_header:
theorem bilinear_continuous (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun pq : E × E => B pq.1 pq.2)
bilinear_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem bilinear_continuous (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun pq : E × E => B pq.1 pq.2) :=
  (B.continuous.comp continuous_fst).clm_apply continuous_snd

polynomial_generator_measurable.exact_header:
theorem polynomial_generator_measurable [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : E → E) (σ : E → J → E)
    (hb : Measurable b) (hσ : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => σ x j)) :
    Measurable (fun x => 2 * B x (b x) + ∑ j, B (σ x j) (σ x j))
polynomial_generator_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem polynomial_generator_measurable [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : E → E) (σ : E → J → E)
    (hb : Measurable b) (hσ : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => σ x j)) :
    Measurable (fun x => 2 * B x (b x) + ∑ j, B (σ x j) (σ x j)) := by
  have hB : Measurable (fun pq : E × E => B pq.1 pq.2) := (bilinear_continuous B).measurable
  have hwork := hB.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hb)
  have hsum : Measurable (fun x => ∑ j, B (σ x j) (σ x j)) := by
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro j _
    exact hB.comp ((hσ j).prodMk (hσ j))
  exact (hwork.const_mul 2).add hsum

driftResidual.exact_header: def driftResidual (X b : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (t : ℝ) : Lp E 2 Q
driftResidual.exact_declaration:
def driftResidual (X b : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (t : ℝ) : Lp E 2 Q :=
  X t - X 0 - ∫ r in 0..t, b r

driftResidual_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem driftResidual_decomposition (X b : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (t : ℝ) :
    X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + driftResidual Q X b t
driftResidual_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem driftResidual_decomposition (X b : ℝ → Lp E 2 Q) (t : ℝ) :
    X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + driftResidual Q X b t := by
  dsimp [driftResidual]
  abel

projected_pair_integral.exact_header:
theorem projected_pair_integral (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (U V : Lp E 2 Q) : weightedPairing Q W (P.compLpL 2 Q U) (P.compLpL 2 Q V) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪P (U ω), W (P (V ω))⟫_ℝ ∂Q
projected_pair_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_pair_integral (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (U V : Lp E 2 Q) : weightedPairing Q W (P.compLpL 2 Q U) (P.compLpL 2 Q V) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪P (U ω), W (P (V ω))⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [P.coeFn_compLpL U, P.coeFn_compLpL V] with ω hu hv
  rw [hu, hv]

projected_pair_integrable.exact_header:
theorem projected_pair_integrable (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (U V : Lp E 2 Q) : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪P (U ω), W (P (V ω))⟫_ℝ) Q
projected_pair_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_pair_integrable (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (U V : Lp E 2 Q) : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪P (U ω), W (P (V ω))⟫_ℝ) Q := by
  apply (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q W (P.compLpL 2 Q U) (P.compLpL 2 Q V)).congr
  filter_upwards [P.coeFn_compLpL U, P.coeFn_compLpL V] with ω hu hv
  rw [hu, hv]

martingale_clm.exact_header:
theorem martingale_clm {ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} (P : E →L[ℝ] H)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) :
    Martingale (fun t => P ∘ m t) ℱ Q
martingale_clm.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_clm {ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} (P : E →L[ℝ] H)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) :
    Martingale (fun t => P ∘ m t) ℱ Q := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    exact P.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hm.stronglyAdapted t)
  · intro s t hst
    exact (P.comp_condExp_comm (hm.integrable t)).symm.trans
      ((hm.condExp_ae_eq hst).fun_comp P)

projected_martingale_orthogonal.exact_header:
theorem projected_martingale_orthogonal (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
    (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (Y Ms Mt : Lp E 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (P.compLpL 2 Q Y) (P.compLpL 2 Q (Mt - Ms)) = 0
projected_martingale_orthogonal.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_martingale_orthogonal (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
    (P : E →L[ℝ] H) (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hW : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (Y Ms Mt : Lp E 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → E) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (P.compLpL 2 Q Y) (P.compLpL 2 Q (Mt - Ms)) = 0 := by
  rw [map_sub]
  apply martingale_orthogonal_local W hW _ _ _ (fun t => P ∘ m t) (martingale_clm Q P m hm) hst
  · exact (hs.fun_comp P).trans (P.coeFn_compLpL Ms).symm
  · exact (ht.fun_comp P).trans (P.coeFn_compLpL Mt).symm
  · exact (P.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY).congr (P.coeFn_compLpL Y).symm

particleBilinear.exact_header:
def particleBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q →L[ℝ] ℝ
particleBilinear.exact_declaration:
def particleBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp ((particleOptimizerDifference (S := S) (Z := Z) N).compLpL 2 Q)
    ((D.optimizerWeight.compLpL 2 Q).comp
      ((particleOptimizerDifference (S := S) (Z := Z) N).compLpL 2 Q)) +
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N, (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp
    ((particleSamplerDifference (S := S) (Z := Z) N i).compLpL 2 Q)
    ((D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q).comp
      ((particleSamplerDifference (S := S) (Z := Z) N i).compLpL 2 Q))

particleBilinear_apply.exact_header:
theorem particleBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V =
      weightedPairing Q D.optimizerWeight
        ((particleOptimizerDifference N).compLpL 2 Q U) ((particleOptimizerDifference N).compLpL 2 Q V) +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        ((particleSamplerDifference N i).compLpL 2 Q U) ((particleSamplerDifference N i).compLpL 2 Q V)
particleBilinear_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem particleBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V =
      weightedPairing Q D.optimizerWeight
        ((particleOptimizerDifference N).compLpL 2 Q U) ((particleOptimizerDifference N).compLpL 2 Q V) +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, weightedPairing Q D.samplerWeight
        ((particleSamplerDifference N i).compLpL 2 Q U) ((particleSamplerDifference N i).compLpL 2 Q V) := by
  simp [particleBilinear, weightedPairing, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]

particleBilinear_integral.exact_header:
theorem particleBilinear_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V =
      ∫ ω, particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U ω) (V ω) ∂Q
particleBilinear_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem particleBilinear_integral (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V =
      ∫ ω, particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U ω) (V ω) ∂Q := by
  rw [particleBilinear_apply, projected_pair_integral]
  simp_rw [projected_pair_integral]
  rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => projected_pair_integrable Q (particleSamplerDifference N i) D.samplerWeight U V),
    ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add
      (projected_pair_integrable Q (particleOptimizerDifference N) D.optimizerWeight U V)
      ((integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => projected_pair_integrable Q (particleSamplerDifference N i) D.samplerWeight U V)).const_mul _)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all Q (fun ω => by
    simp [particleQuadraticBilinear_apply, particleOptimizerDifference, particleSamplerDifference])

particleBilinear_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem particleBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V = particleBilinear Q N D V U
particleBilinear_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem particleBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (U V : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q) :
    particleBilinear Q N D U V = particleBilinear Q N D V U := by
  rw [particleBilinear_integral, particleBilinear_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all Q (fun ω => particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric D N (U ω) (V ω)))

particleBilinear_orthogonal.exact_header:
theorem particleBilinear_orthogonal (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (Y Ms Mt : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → ParticlePair N S Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) : particleBilinear Q N D Y (Mt - Ms) = 0
particleBilinear_orthogonal.exact_declaration:
theorem particleBilinear_orthogonal (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (Y Ms Mt : Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → ParticlePair N S Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : m s =ᵐ[Q] Ms) (ht : m t =ᵐ[Q] Mt)
    (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] Y Q) : particleBilinear Q N D Y (Mt - Ms) = 0 := by
  rw [particleBilinear_apply,
    projected_martingale_orthogonal Q ℱ (particleOptimizerDifference N) D.optimizerWeight D.optimizer_symmetric Y Ms Mt m hm hst hs ht hY]
  have hz (i : Fin N) := projected_martingale_orthogonal Q ℱ (particleSamplerDifference N i)
    D.samplerWeight D.sampler_symmetric Y Ms Mt m hm hst hs ht hY
  simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]

particleCopyGenerator_bilinear.exact_header:
theorem particleCopyGenerator_bilinear (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

particleCopyGenerator_bilinear.exact_declaration:
theorem particleCopyGenerator_bilinear (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.exact_header:
structure ParticleIntegralTrajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z)
    (T : ℝ) (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›)
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.exact_declaration:
structure ParticleIntegralTrajectory (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z)
    (T : ℝ) (ℱ : Filtration ℝ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›) where
  state : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  drift : ℝ → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  diffusion : ℝ → (Fin N × I) → Lp (ParticlePair N S Z) 2 Q
  noise : ℝ → Ω → ParticlePair N S Z
  continuous : ContinuousOn state (Icc 0 T)
  drift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable drift volume 0 T
  diffusion_timeL2 : ∀ ij, MemLp (fun r => diffusion r ij) 2 (volume.restrict (uIoc 0 T))
  drift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, drift t =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (state t ω)
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ ij, diffusion t ij =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => particleCopyDiffusion M N (state t ω) ij
  drift_measurable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Measurable (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t)
  diffusion_measurable : ∀ ij, Measurable (fun p => particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)
  martingale : Martingale noise ℱ Q
  noise_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, noise t =ᵐ[Q] driftResidual Q state drift t
  initial_adapted : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (state 0) Q
  drift_adapted : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (drift t) Q

bilinear_lp_integrable.exact_header:
theorem bilinear_lp_integrable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U V : Lp E 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => B (U ω) (V ω)) Q
bilinear_lp_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem bilinear_lp_integrable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (U V : Lp E 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => B (U ω) (V ω)) Q := by
  have hh : MemLp (fun ω => ‖U ω‖ * ‖V ω‖) 1 Q := (Lp.memLp U).norm.mul (Lp.memLp V).norm
  apply ((memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hh).const_mul ‖B‖).mono'
  · exact B.continuous₂.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).prodMk (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V))
  · filter_upwards with ω
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using B.le_opNorm₂ (U ω) (V ω)

theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.quadratic_integrable

  apply (integrable_map_measure
    (quadratic_continuous (particleQuadraticBilinear D N)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.state t)).aemeasurable).mpr
  exact bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) _ _

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_eq
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (t : ℝ) :
    expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law t = particleBilinear Q N D (U.state t) (U.state t) := by
  have hq : Continuous (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) :=
    quadratic_continuous (particleQuadraticBilinear D N)
  rw [expectedParticleEnergy, ParticleIntegralTrajectory.law, integral_map
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.state t)).aemeasurable hq.aestronglyMeasurable]

def ParticleIntegralTrajectory.SynchronousIsometry (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ)

theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_measurable

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_mea.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_measurable
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Measurable (particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)) := by
  have hgen : particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) =
      fun p => 2 * particleQuadraticBilinear D N p (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t p) +
        ∑ ij : Fin N × I, particleQuadraticBilinear D N
          (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij) (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij) :=
    funext (fun p => particleCopyGenerator_bilinear N M D (ν t) t p)
  have hm := polynomial_generator_measurable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N)
    (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t) (particleCopyDiffusion M N)

theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_realizes
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (fun ω => particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
      (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) (U.state t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => 2 * particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U.state t ω) (U.drift t ω) +
      ∑ ij : Fin N × I, particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U.diffusion t ij ω) (U.diffusion t ij ω)
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_rea.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_realizes
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (fun ω => particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
      (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) (U.state t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
    fun ω => 2 * particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U.state t ω) (U.drift t ω) +
      ∑ ij : Fin N × I, particleQuadraticBilinear D N (U.diffusion t ij ω) (U.diffusion t ij ω) := by
  filter_upwards [U.drift_realizes t ht, ae_all_iff.mpr (U.diffusion_realizes t ht)] with ω hb hσ
  rw [particleCopyGenerator_bilinear, ← hb]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ij _
  rw [← hσ ij]

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_int.exact_header:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_integrable
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)) (U.law t)
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_int.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.generator_integrable
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Integrable (particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)) (U.law t) := by
  apply (integrable_map_measure (U.generator_measurable D t ht).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.state t)).aemeasurable).mpr
  apply ((bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) (U.state t) (U.drift t)).const_mul 2 |>.add
    (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun ij _ =>
      bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) (U.diffusion t ij) (U.diffusion t ij)))).congr
  exact (U.generator_realizes D t ht).symm

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.work_generato.exact_header:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.work_generator_integral
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state t) (U.drift t) + U.noiseEnergy D t =
      ∫ p, particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
        (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p ∂U.law t
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.work_generato.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.work_generator_integral
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state t) (U.drift t) + U.noiseEnergy D t =
      ∫ p, particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
        (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p ∂U.law t := by
  rw [ParticleIntegralTrajectory.law, integral_map
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U.state t)).aemeasurable
    (U.generator_measurable D t ht).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_congr_ae (U.generator_realizes D t ht),
    integral_add ((bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) (U.state t) (U.drift t)).const_mul 2)
      (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun ij _ =>
        bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) (U.diffusion t ij) (U.diffusion t ij))),
    integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun ij _ =>
      bilinear_lp_integrable (particleQuadraticBilinear D N) (U.diffusion t ij) (U.diffusion t ij))]
  simp_rw [← particleBilinear_integral Q N D]
  rfl

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_integr.exact_header:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_integral
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hIso : U.SynchronousIsometry D) :
    expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law T = expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law 0 +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state r) (U.drift r) + U.noiseEnergy D r
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_integr.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.energy_integral
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hIso : U.SynchronousIsometry D) :
    expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law T = expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law 0 +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state r) (U.drift r) + U.noiseEnergy D r := by
  rw [U.energy_eq, U.energy_eq]
  have hzero : driftResidual Q U.state U.drift 0 = 0 := by simp [driftResidual]
  apply quadratic_balance (particleBilinear Q N D) (particleBilinear_symmetric Q N D)
    U.state U.drift (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift) (U.noiseEnergy D) hT
    U.drift_integrable (U.noiseEnergy_integrable D) U.continuous
    (fun r _ => driftResidual_decomposition Q U.state U.drift r)
  · simpa only [hzero, sub_zero] using particleBilinear_orthogonal Q N ℱ D
      (U.state 0) (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift 0) (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift T)
      U.noise U.martingale hT (U.noise_realizes 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩)
      (U.noise_realizes T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩) U.initial_adapted
  · intro r hr
    exact particleBilinear_orthogonal Q N ℱ D (U.drift r)
      (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift r) (driftResidual Q U.state U.drift T)
      U.noise U.martingale hr.2 (U.noise_realizes r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr))
      (U.noise_realizes T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩) (U.drift_adapted r hr)
  · exact hIso T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.restrict.exact_header:
def ParticleIntegralTrajectory.restrict (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : R ∈ Icc 0 T) : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν R ℱ
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.restrict.exact_declaration:
def ParticleIntegralTrajectory.restrict (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : R ∈ Icc 0 T) : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν R ℱ where
  state := U.state
  drift := U.drift
  diffusion := U.diffusion
  noise := U.noise
  continuous := U.continuous.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hR.2)
  drift_integrable := U.drift_integrable.mono_set' (by
    rw [uIoc_of_le hR.1, uIoc_of_le (hR.1.trans hR.2)]
    exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hR.2)
  diffusion_timeL2 := fun ij => (U.diffusion_timeL2 ij).mono_measure
    (Measure.restrict_mono (by
      rw [uIoc_of_le hR.1, uIoc_of_le (hR.1.trans hR.2)]
      exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hR.2) le_rfl)
  drift_realizes := fun r hr => U.drift_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  diffusion_realizes := fun r hr => U.diffusion_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  drift_measurable := fun r hr => U.drift_measurable r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  diffusion_measurable := U.diffusion_measurable
  martingale := U.martingale
  noise_realizes := fun r hr => U.noise_realizes r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩
  initial_adapted := U.initial_adapted
  drift_adapted := fun r hr => U.drift_adapted r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hR.2⟩

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.residual_meas.exact_header:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.residual_measurable
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Measurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν t) t)
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.residual_meas.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.residual_measurable
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Measurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν t) t) := by
  have hdiag : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => (p.2, p.2)) :=
    measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_snd
  have hfirst : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => p.1.1) :=
    measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst
  have hsecond : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => p.2.1) :=
    measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd
  have he : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2) :=
    hfirst.comp ((U.drift_measurable t ht).comp hdiag)
  have hp : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => M.optimizerField t p.2.1 (ν t)) :=
    hsecond.comp (U.drift_measurable t ht)
  have hi : Continuous (fun p : S × S => ⟪p.1, D.optimizerWeight p.2⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  exact hi.measurable.comp ((hfirst.sub hsecond).prodMk (he.sub hp))

ParticleIntegralTrajectory.forcing_dissi.exact_header:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.forcing_dissipation
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : S)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : (U.law t).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law t, p.2.1 = sbar)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) -
      M.meanGradient (ν t) sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V) :
    2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state t) (U.drift t) + U.noiseEnergy D t ≤
      -2 * ρ * expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law t +
      2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) *
        Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law t)
ParticleIntegralTrajectory.forcing_dissi.exact_declaration:
theorem ParticleIntegralTrajectory.forcing_dissipation
    (U : ParticleIntegralTrajectory Q N M ν T ℱ) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hN : 0 < N) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : S)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : (U.law t).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law t, p.2.1 = sbar)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) -
      M.meanGradient (ν t) sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V) :
    2 * particleBilinear Q N D (U.state t) (U.drift t) + U.noiseEnergy D t ≤
      -2 * ρ * expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law t +
      2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) *
        Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N U.law t) := by
  have hq := U.quadratic_integrable D t
  obtain ⟨hir, hres⟩ := expectedParticlePopulationResidual_le M D N hN (ν t) sbar hF
    (U.law t) hCloud hbar hq t LΨ hΨ (U.residual_measurable D t ht).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hsum : Integrable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z =>
      particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
        particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν t) t p) (U.law t) := by
    have hi := (U.generator_integrable D t ht).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    convert hi using 1
    ext p
    rw [particleCopyGenerator_quadratic]
    dsimp only [particlePopulationResidual]
    ring
  have hiw : Integrable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z =>
      particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2) (U.law t) := by
    convert hsum.sub hir using 1
    ext p

    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,

    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ p ∂U.law r, p.2.1 = sbar r)

absolutelyContinuous_of_dist_le.exact_header:
theorem absolutelyContinuous_of_dist_le {f : ℝ → E} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ uIcc a b, ∀ y ∈ uIcc a b, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist (g x) (g y)) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b
absolutelyContinuous_of_dist_le.exact_declaration:
theorem absolutelyContinuous_of_dist_le {f : ℝ → E} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g a b)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ uIcc a b, ∀ y ∈ uIcc a b, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist (g x) (g y)) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval f a b := by
  rw [absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_iff] at hg ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := hg ε hε
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun S hS hsum => ?_⟩
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ (hd S hS hsum)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact h _ (hS.1 i hi).1 _ (hS.1 i hi).2

theorem integral_absolutelyContinuous (b : ℝ → E) {a t : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a t) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun r => ∫ s in a..r, b s) a t := by
  apply absolutelyContinuous_of_dist_le
    (hb.norm.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral (by simp : a ∈ uIcc a t))
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' : IntervalIntegrable b volume a x := hb.mono_set' (by grind [uIoc, uIcc])
  have hy' : IntervalIntegrable b volume a y := hb.mono_set' (by grind [uIoc, uIcc])
  rw [dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq,
    intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left hx' hy',
    intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left hx'.norm hy'.norm]
  exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_abs_integral_norm

theorem quadratic_lipschitzOn_ball (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (R : ℝ≥0) :
    LipschitzOnWith (2 * ‖B‖₊ * R) (fun x => B x x) (closedBall (0 : E) R)
quadratic_lipschitzOn_ball.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_lipschitzOn_ball (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (R : ℝ≥0) :
    LipschitzOnWith (2 * ‖B‖₊ * R) (fun x => B x x) (closedBall (0 : E) R) := by
  apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
  have hy' : ‖y‖ ≤ R := by simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy
  have he : B x x - B y y = B (x-y) x + B y (x-y) := by
    simp only [map_sub, sub_apply]; ring
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖B (x-y) x‖ + ‖B y (x-y)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖x-y‖ * ‖x‖ + ‖B‖ * ‖y‖ * ‖x-y‖ := add_le_add (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _) (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _)
    _ ≤ (2 * (‖B‖₊ : ℝ) * R) * ‖x-y‖ := by
      simp only [coe_nnnorm]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx' (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg B) (norm_nonneg (x-y))),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy' (norm_nonneg B)) (norm_nonneg (x-y))]

theorem quadratic_absolutelyContinuous (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)

    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun r => B (u r) (u r)) a t := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hu.exists_bound
  let R : ℝ≥0 := ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0⟩

  intro r hr
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  change ‖u r‖ ≤ (R : ℝ)
  exact (hC r hr).trans (le_max_left C 0)

theorem integral_quadratic (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (b : ℝ → E) {a t : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a t) :
    B (∫ r in a..t, b r) (∫ r in a..t, b r) =
      2 * ∫ r in a..t, B (∫ s in a..r, b s) (b r)
integral_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_quadratic (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (b : ℝ → E) {a t : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a t) :
    B (∫ r in a..t, b r) (∫ r in a..t, b r) =
      2 * ∫ r in a..t, B (∫ s in a..r, b s) (b r) := by
  let A := fun r => ∫ s in a..r, b s
  have hA := integral_absolutelyContinuous b hb
  have hQ := quadratic_absolutelyContinuous B A hA
  have hd : ∀ᵐ r, r ∈ uIcc a t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => B (A s) (A s)) (2 * B (A r) (b r)) r := by
    filter_upwards [hb.ae_hasDerivAt_integral] with r hr hrt
    have hh := (PBGSO.quadratic_hasFDerivAt B (A r)).comp_hasDerivAt r (hr hrt a (by simp))
    convert hh using 1 <;> try rfl
    change 2 * B (A r) (b r) = B (A r) (b r) + B (b r) (A r)
    rw [hB (b r) (A r)]
    ring
  have he := hQ.integral_deriv_eq_sub
  have heq : (∫ r in a..t, deriv (fun s => B (A s) (A s)) r) =
      ∫ r in a..t, 2 * B (A r) (b r) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hd] with r hr hrt
    exact (hr (uIoc_subset_uIcc hrt)).deriv
  rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at he
  simpa [A] using he.symm

    (heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, X r = X 0 + (∫ s in 0..r, b s) + M r)

    (horthb : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, B (b r) (M T - M r) = 0)
    (hiso : B (M T) (M T) = ∫ r in 0..T, q r) :
    B (X T) (X T) = B (X 0) (X 0) +

    (heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, X r = X 0 + (∫ s in 0..r, b s) + M r)
    (horth0 : B (X 0) (M T) = 0)
    (horthb : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, B (b r) (M T - M r) = 0)
    (hiso : B (M T) (M T) = ∫ r in 0..T, q r) :
    B (X T) (X T) = B (X 0) (X 0) +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * B (X r) (b r) + q r := by
  let A := fun r => ∫ s in 0..r, b s
  have hA := integral_absolutelyContinuous b hb
  have hX' : ContinuousOn X (uIcc 0 T) := by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using hX
  have hM : ContinuousOn M (uIcc 0 T) := by
    apply ((hX'.sub continuousOn_const).sub hA.continuousOn).congr
    intro r hr
    have hh := heq r (by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using hr)
    dsimp [A]
    rw [hh]
    abel
  have hxb := bilinear_continuous_integrable B X b hX' hb
  have hab := bilinear_continuous_integrable B A b hA.continuousOn hb
  have hmb := bilinear_continuous_integrable B M b hM hb
  have h0b : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => B (X 0) (b r)) volume 0 T :=
    bilinear_continuous_integrable B (fun _ => X 0) b continuousOn_const hb
  have hcross : B (A T) (M T) = ∫ r in 0..T, B (M r) (b r) := by
    change B.flip (M T) (∫ r in 0..T, b r) = _
    rw [← (B.flip (M T)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hb]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with r hr
    have hh := horthb r (by simpa [uIoc_of_le hT] using hr)
    rw [map_sub] at hh
    change B (b r) (M T) = B (M r) (b r)
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hh, hB]
  have hwork : (∫ r in 0..T, B (X r) (b r)) =
      B (X 0) (A T) + (∫ r in 0..T, B (A r) (b r)) +
      (∫ r in 0..T, B (M r) (b r)) := by
    rw [← (B (X 0)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hb,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add h0b hab,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add (h0b.add hab) hmb]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with r hr
    rw [heq r (by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using uIoc_subset_uIcc hr)]
    simp only [map_add, add_apply]
    rfl
  have hAt := integral_quadratic B hB b hb
  change B (A T) (A T) = _ at hAt
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hxb.const_mul 2) hq,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hwork]
  rw [congrArg (fun x => B x x) (heq T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩)]
  change B (X 0 + A T + M T) (X 0 + A T + M T) = _
  simp only [map_add, add_apply]
  rw [hB (A T) (X 0), hB (M T) (X 0), hB (M T) (A T), horth0, hAt, hcross, hiso]
  ring

theorem integral_gronwall (e w : ℝ → ℝ) {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hw : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 T)
    (he : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, e r = e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T), w r ≤ c * e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * e 0
integral_gronwall.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_gronwall (e w : ℝ → ℝ) {T c : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hw : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 T)
    (he : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, e r = e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s)
    (hle : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T), w r ≤ c * e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * e 0 := by
  let F := fun r => e 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, w s
  let g := fun r => Real.exp (-c * r) * F r
  have hF : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval F 0 T :=
    (contDiff_const.contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval (f := fun _ : ℝ => e 0)).add
      (hw.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval_intervalIntegral (by simp))
  have hexp : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * r)) := by fun_prop
  have hg : AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval g 0 T :=
    hexp.contDiffOn.absolutelyContinuousOnInterval.fun_mul hF
  have hder : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T), deriv g r ≤ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hw.ae_hasDerivAt_integral,
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc, hle] with r hr hrt hle
    have hrt' : r ∈ uIcc 0 T := by simp only [uIcc_of_le hT]; exact Ioc_subset_Icc_self hrt
    have hFder : HasDerivAt F (w r) r := (hr hrt' 0 (by simp)).const_add (e 0)
    have hExpder := ((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul (-c)).exp
    have hgd := hExpder.mul hFder
    have hFr : F r = e r := (he r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hrt)).symm
    change HasDerivAt g _ r at hgd
    rw [hgd.deriv]
    dsimp only [id_eq] at *
    rw [hFr]
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-c * r)]
  have hneg : (∫ r in 0..T, deriv g r) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT]
    exact integral_nonpos_of_ae hder
  rw [hg.integral_deriv_eq_sub] at hneg
  have hmain : Real.exp (-c * T) * e T ≤ e 0 := by
    have hFT : F T = e T := (he T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).symm
    simpa [g, F, hFT] using hneg
  have hinv : Real.exp (c * T) * Real.exp (-c * T) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show c * T + -c * T = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
  calc
    e T = Real.exp (c * T) * (Real.exp (-c * T) * e T) := by rw [← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain (Real.exp_nonneg _)

theorem martingale_orthogonal_at (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (U : Lp Z 2 Q) (M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] M r)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hU : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] U Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W U (M t - M s) = 0
martingale_orthogonal_at.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_orthogonal_at (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (U : Lp Z 2 Q) (M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] M r)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hU : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] U Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W U (M t - M s) = 0 := by
  classical
  let V : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q := fun r => if r = s then U else 0
  have hV (r : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (V r) Q := by
    by_cases hr : r = s
    · subst r; simpa [V] using hU
    · have hz : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) Q :=
        (aestronglyMeasurable_zero : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (0 : Ω → Z) Q).congr (Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q).symm
      simpa [V, hr] using hz
  simpa [V] using martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal Q ℱ W hW V M m hm hrep hV s t hst

theorem expected_energy_integral (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (hσ : IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) volume 0 T)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X b r)
    (hX0 : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (X 0) Q)
    (hbAdapt : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (b r) Q)
    (hIsometry : weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X b T)
      (martingaleResidual Q X b T) = ∫ r in 0..T, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (b r) + diffusionEnergy Q W σ r
expected_energy_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem expected_energy_integral (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (hσ : IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) volume 0 T)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X b r)
    (hX0 : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (X 0) Q)
    (hbAdapt : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (b r) Q)
    (hIsometry : weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X b T)
      (martingaleResidual Q X b T) = ∫ r in 0..T, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      ∫ r in 0..T, 2 * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (b r) + diffusionEnergy Q W σ r := by
  have hzero : martingaleResidual Q X b 0 = 0 := by simp [martingaleResidual]
  apply quadratic_balance (weightedPairing Q W) (weightedPairing_symmetric Q W hW)
    X b (martingaleResidual Q X b) (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) hT hb hσ hX
    (fun r _ => martingaleResidual_decomposition Q X b r)
  · simpa only [hzero, sub_zero] using martingale_orthogonal_at Q ℱ W hW (X 0)
      (martingaleResidual Q X b) m hm hrep hT hX0
  · intro r hr
    exact martingale_orthogonal_at Q ℱ W hW (b r) (martingaleResidual Q X b) m hm hrep
      hr.2 (hbAdapt r hr)
  · exact hIsometry

expected_energy_decay.exact_header:
theorem expected_energy_decay (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    {T ρ : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (hσ : IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) volume 0 T)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X b r)
    (hX0 : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (X 0) Q)
    (hbAdapt : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (b r) Q)
    (hIsometry : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X b t) (martingaleResidual Q X b t) =
        ∫ r in 0..t, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r)
    (hDiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T),
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (b r) + diffusionEnergy Q W σ r ≤
        (-2 * ρ) * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (X r)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) * weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0)
expected_energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem expected_energy_decay (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    {T ρ : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hX : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 T))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (hσ : IntervalIntegrable (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) volume 0 T)
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ r, m r =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X b r)
    (hX0 : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] (X 0) Q)
    (hbAdapt : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ r] (b r) Q)
    (hIsometry : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X b t) (martingaleResidual Q X b t) =
        ∫ r in 0..t, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r)
    (hDiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T),
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (b r) + diffusionEnergy Q W σ r ≤
        (-2 * ρ) * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (X r)) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * T) * weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) := by
  apply integral_gronwall (fun r => weightedPairing Q W (X r) (X r))
    (fun r => 2 * weightedPairing Q W (X r) (b r) + diffusionEnergy Q W σ r) hT
  · apply IntervalIntegrable.add _ hσ
    exact (bilinear_continuous_integrable (weightedPairing Q W) X b
      (by simpa [uIcc_of_le hT] using hX) hb).const_mul 2
  · intro r hr
    apply expected_energy_integral Q ℱ W hW X b σ hr.1
      (hX.mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hr.2))
      (hb.mono_set' (by simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le hT]; exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2))
      (hσ.mono_set' (by simp only [uIoc_of_le hr.1, uIoc_of_le hT]; exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2))
      m hm hrep hX0 (fun s hs => hbAdapt s (Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hr.2 hs))
      (hIsometry r hr)
  · exact hDiss

import PBGSO.Framework
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Prod
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.Basic

/-! # Stationarity from actual sampler integral equations and pathwise uniqueness

This file makes the stochastic-integral interpretation an explicit argument.
For any supplied integral operator, a solution must satisfy the actual
optimiser ODE and the sampler integral equation. No property of that operator
is assumed: the stationarity proof uses only substitution and uniqueness.
Instantiating it with an Itô integral still requires a separate implementation
of that integral. The frozen sampler invariance input is an actual constant
output law, as in the paper's second assumption, rather than infinitesimal
generator stationarity alone.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators
namespace PBGSO

variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [Fintype I]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- An integral interpretation supplied by the stochastic implementation.
The same operator is used for every process driven by the same noise.
The separate `C` argument selects the implementation's admissible process
class, for example adapted continuous processes with admissible integrands. -/

/-- Actual sampler integral equation for a complete optimiser trajectory.
This retains state- and parameter-dependent diffusion columns. -/

/-- A law-consistent integral solution. Its sampler law is the actual
pushforward of the random trajectory, and its optimiser uses that law. -/

/-- Same-driver pathwise uniqueness for the displayed equations. The explicit `C` process class includes
adaptedness and any initial-noise independence or integrand restrictions
required by the intended stochastic implementation. -/

/-- An actual frozen invariant trajectory supplies a constant-optimiser
solution. The invariant sampler law, observation integrability, zero gradient,
and optimiser fixed point are all explicit inputs. -/

/-- Source stationarity argument directly at the integral-equation level,
with arbitrary multiplicative diffusion and arbitrary optimiser response.
The output law equality is derived from pathwise uniqueness. -/

/-- The stationary law is literally the deterministic-optimiser product
law on the complete state, retaining all auxiliary coordinates. -/

end PBGSO

structure IsSamplerIntegralSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I)

IsSamplerIntegralSolution.exact_declaration:
structure IsSamplerIntegralSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop)
    (s : ℝ → S) (Zp : ℝ → Ω → Z) : Prop where
  admissible : C s Zp
  measurable : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Measurable (Zp t)
  continuous_paths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => Zp t ω) (Ici 0)
  drift_integrable : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (s r)) (Zp r ω)) volume 0 t
  equation : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
    Zp t ω = Zp 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (s r)) (Zp r ω)) +
      J (fun r ω i => M.diffusion (M.parameter (s r)) (Zp r ω) i) t ω

structure IsMeanFieldIntegralSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop)

  sampler : IsSamplerIntegralSolution Q M J C s Zp
  second_moment : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map (Zp t))

def IntegralPathwiseUniqueness (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ s Zp s' Zp', IsMeanFieldIntegralSolution Q M J C s Zp →
    IsMeanFieldIntegralSolution Q M J C s' Zp' →
    s 0 = s' 0 → Zp 0 =ᵐ[Q] Zp' 0 →
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → s t = s' t ∧ Zp t =ᵐ[Q] Zp' t

theorem frozen_integral_isMeanFieldSolution
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) (Zstar : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hfrozen : IsSamplerIntegralSolution Q M J C (fun _ => sStar) Zstar)
    (hlaw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Q.map (Zstar t) = νStar)
    (hmoment : HasFiniteSecondMoment νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) :
    IsMeanFieldIntegralSolution Q M J C (fun _ => sStar) Zstar where

  gradient_integrable := by intro t ht; simpa [hlaw t ht] using hint

integral_stationary_of_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_stationary_of_frozen
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop)
    (hunique : IntegralPathwiseUniqueness Q M J C)

theorem integral_stationary_product_law
    [MeasurableSpace S] (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (J : SamplerIntegral (Ω := Ω) (I := I) (Z := Z))
    (C : (ℝ → S) → (ℝ → Ω → Z) → Prop)
    (hunique : IntegralPathwiseUniqueness Q M J C)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) (Zstar : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hfrozen : IsSamplerIntegralSolution Q M J C (fun _ => sStar) Zstar)
    (hlaw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Q.map (Zstar t) = νStar)
    (hmoment : HasFiniteSecondMoment νStar)
    (hint : Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (s : ℝ → S) (Zp : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hsol : IsMeanFieldIntegralSolution Q M J C s Zp)
    (hs : s 0 = sStar) (hz : Zp 0 =ᵐ[Q] Zstar 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Q.map (fun ω => (s t, Zp t ω)) = (Measure.dirac sStar).prod νStar := by

/-!
# From actual coupling energies to Wasserstein laws

The transport distance is the infimum over all genuine initial couplings.
No optimal-coupling existence or supplied Wasserstein conclusion is assumed.
The generic energy theorem takes actual output couplings and their quadratic
energy comparisons; coupled-generator or integral-equation arguments can
produce those data. Realising the same output laws from every initial coupling
is an explicit process-level requirement of that theorem.

The additive specialisation below applies to actual integral solutions of
the independent general observation/response/sampler maps. It derives the
sampler law bound from their proved common-input contraction. State-dependent
strong-SDE and martingale-problem equivalence are separate requirements.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO

section CouplingCost
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]

omit [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
/-- The genuine coupling cost squared is its quadratic integral, whenever
the difference has a finite second moment. -/

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
/-- Finite-second-moment marginals make every coupling cost finite; this
does not require the coupling to be independent or optimal. -/

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
/-- A finite actual joint law bounds the ordinary real-valued transport
distance without converting infinity to zero. -/

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
  [SecondCountableTopology H] in
/-- The first norm moment is at most the root second moment on a probability
space. Applied to the actual coupling difference, this supplies the
characteristic-function estimate used for separation of transport laws. -/

/-- The characteristic functions of the two marginal laws are controlled by
the cost of any finite coupling. -/

/-- Pairing particle i with particle i gives the finite empirical
Wasserstein bound. The proof uses the genuine empirical pair measure and
computes its quadratic transport cost exactly; no particle independence is
assumed. The positive particle count makes the two empirical measures laws. -/

variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Zero quadratic transport separates probability laws. The proof chooses
arbitrarily small finite couplings from the defining infimum and compares
characteristic functions; no optimal coupling is assumed. -/

/-- The real transport distance can be used for equality only after its
finiteness has been established explicitly. -/

end CouplingCost

section InfimumBridge
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]

/-- Actual quadratic coupling energies give the condition-number prefactor
after taking the infimum over all initial couplings. The family contains

omit [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
/-- Finite couplings whose costs converge to the defining transport
infimum. Attainment of that infimum is unnecessary. -/

omit [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in

optimal transport infimum. This also supports the mixed deterministic-law

/-- The paper's Euclidean product distance between a deterministic full
optimiser state and a sampler law. Its transport component is a genuine

/-- The full multiplicative-noise weak-generator contraction passes to the

theorem couplingCost_sq_eq_integral (Λ : Measure (H × H))
    (hΛ : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2) 2 Λ) :
    (ULA.couplingCost Λ).toReal ^ 2 = ∫ p, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂Λ
couplingCost_sq_eq_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem couplingCost_sq_eq_integral (Λ : Measure (H × H))
    (hΛ : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2) 2 Λ) :
    (ULA.couplingCost Λ).toReal ^ 2 = ∫ p, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂Λ := by
  let D := hΛ.toLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2)
  have hn := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Λ D
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp] at hn
  change (ULA.couplingCost Λ).toReal ^ 2 = _ at hn
  exact hn.trans (integral_congr_ae (hΛ.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2))

theorem coupling_difference_memLp (μ ν : Measure H)
    (hμ : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 ν)
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :

coupling_difference_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem coupling_difference_memLp (μ ν : Measure H)
    (hμ : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 ν)
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) :
    MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2) 2 c.joint := by
  have hx : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1) 2 c.joint := by
    have h := hμ
    rw [← c.fst] at h
    exact h.comp_of_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable
  have hy : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.2) 2 c.joint := by
    have h := hν
    rw [← c.snd] at h
    exact h.comp_of_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable
  exact hx.sub hy

integral_norm_le_second_cost.exact_header:
theorem integral_norm_le_second_cost {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Ω → H) (hD : MemLp D 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, ‖D ω‖ ∂Q) ≤ (eLpNorm D 2 Q).toReal
integral_norm_le_second_cost.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_norm_le_second_cost {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Ω → H) (hD : MemLp D 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, ‖D ω‖ ∂Q) ≤ (eLpNorm D 2 Q).toReal := by
  have hInt := (hD.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2))
  have hOne : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖D ω‖ ∂Q) = eLpNorm D 1 Q := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hInt,
      eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm hD.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hle : eLpNorm D 1 Q ≤ eLpNorm D 2 Q :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono hD.eLpNorm_ne_top hle
  rw [← hOne, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)] at hr
  exact hr

theorem charFun_norm_sub_le_couplingCost (μ ν : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) (hc : ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤) (t : H) :
    ‖charFun μ t - charFun ν t‖ ≤ ‖t‖ * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal
charFun_norm_sub_le_couplingCost.exact_declaration:
theorem charFun_norm_sub_le_couplingCost (μ ν : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (c : ULA.Coupling μ ν) (hc : ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤) (t : H) :
    ‖charFun μ t - charFun ν t‖ ≤ ‖t‖ * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal := by
  let := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hD : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2) 2 c.joint :=
    lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hc
  have hInt := (hD.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)).norm
  have hb := ULA.charFun_marginals_norm_sub_le c.joint hInt t
  rw [c.fst, c.snd] at hb
  exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (integral_norm_le_second_cost c.joint _ hD) (norm_nonneg _))

theorem empiricalCloud_wasserstein_sq_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (z w : Fin N → H) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) ^ 2 ≤
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖z i - w i‖ ^ 2
empiricalCloud_wasserstein_sq_le.exact_declaration:
theorem empiricalCloud_wasserstein_sq_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (z w : Fin N → H) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) ^ 2 ≤
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖z i - w i‖ ^ 2 := by
  let Λ := Model.empiricalLaw N (fun i => (z i, w i))
  have hpair := empiricalPair_isCoupling N z w
  let c : ULA.Coupling (Model.empiricalLaw N z) (Model.empiricalLaw N w) :=
    ⟨Λ, hpair.1, hpair.2⟩
  have hΛ : MemLp (fun p : H × H => p.1 - p.2) 2 Λ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
      (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd).aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (empiricalLaw_integrable N hN (fun i => (z i, w i)) _)
  have hb := wasserstein_le_finite_coupling _ _ c hΛ.eLpNorm_ne_top
  have hs := couplingCost_sq_eq_integral Λ hΛ
  calc
    _ ≤ (ULA.couplingCost Λ).toReal ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).2 hb
    _ = _ := by rw [hs, integral_empiricalLaw]; rfl

measure_eq_of_wasserstein2_zero.exact_header:
theorem measure_eq_of_wasserstein2_zero (μ ν : Measure H)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hzero : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν = 0) : μ = ν
measure_eq_of_wasserstein2_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem measure_eq_of_wasserstein2_zero (μ ν : Measure H)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hzero : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν = 0) : μ = ν := by
  apply Measure.ext_of_charFun
  funext t
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (‖t‖ + 1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hi : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν < ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    rw [hzero]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hδ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.mp hi
  have hcfin : ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (hc.trans_le le_top)
  have hcr : (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal < δ := by
    have hh := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hcfin ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hc
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hδ.le] using hh
  have hb := charFun_norm_sub_le_couplingCost μ ν c hcfin t
  have hb' : ‖charFun μ t - charFun ν t‖ ≤
      (‖t‖ + 1) * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal := by
    nlinarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := ULA.couplingCost c.joint)]
  have hl : ‖charFun μ t - charFun ν t‖ < ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖t‖ + 1) * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal := hb'
      _ < (‖t‖ + 1) * δ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcr (by positivity)
      _ = ε := by dsimp [δ]; field_simp
  simpa only [zero_add] using hl.le

theorem measure_eq_of_finite_wasserstein2Real_zero (μ ν : Measure H)

    (hfinite : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν ≠ ⊤) (hzero : ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν = 0) :

wasserstein_decay_of_coupled_energies.exact_header:
theorem wasserstein_decay_of_coupled_energies
    (μ ν μt νt : Measure H)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μt] [IsProbabilityMeasure νt]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 ν)
    (hμt : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μt) (hνt : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 νt)
    (lower upper ρ t : ℝ) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (output : ULA.Coupling μ ν → ULA.Coupling μt νt)
    (initialEnergy finalEnergy : ULA.Coupling μ ν → ℝ)
    (hInitial : ∀ c, initialEnergy c ≤ upper * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2)
    (hFinal : ∀ c, lower * (ULA.couplingCost (output c).joint).toReal ^ 2 ≤ finalEnergy c)
    (hDecay : ∀ c, finalEnergy c ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * initialEnergy c) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real μt νt ≤ Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν
wasserstein_decay_of_coupled_energies.exact_declaration:
theorem wasserstein_decay_of_coupled_energies
    (μ ν μt νt : Measure H)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μt] [IsProbabilityMeasure νt]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 ν)
    (hμt : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 μt) (hνt : MemLp (fun x : H => x) 2 νt)
    (lower upper ρ t : ℝ) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (output : ULA.Coupling μ ν → ULA.Coupling μt νt)
    (initialEnergy finalEnergy : ULA.Coupling μ ν → ℝ)
    (hInitial : ∀ c, initialEnergy c ≤ upper * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2)
    (hFinal : ∀ c, lower * (ULA.couplingCost (output c).joint).toReal ^ 2 ≤ finalEnergy c)
    (hDecay : ∀ c, finalEnergy c ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * initialEnergy c) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real μt νt ≤ Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν := by
  let a : ℝ≥0 := ⟨Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t), by positivity⟩
  have hi := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μ ν hμ hν
  have ho := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μt νt hμt hνt
  have hs := ULA.wasserstein2_affine_bound_real_of_finite_couplings
    μ ν μt νt a 0 hi ho
  apply (by simpa only [NNReal.coe_zero, add_zero] using hs :
    (∀ c : ULA.Coupling μ ν, ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤ →
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μt νt ≤ (a : ℝ) * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal) → _)
  intro c _
  have hOutFin := (coupling_difference_memLp μt νt hμt hνt (output c)).eLpNorm_ne_top
  apply (wasserstein_le_finite_coupling μt νt (output c) hOutFin).trans
  have hsq : (ULA.couplingCost (output c).joint).toReal ^ 2 ≤
      (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2 := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hlower).mp
    have hi' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hInitial c) (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * t)).le
    calc
      _ ≤ finalEnergy c := hFinal c
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * (upper * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2) :=
        (hDecay c).trans hi'
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  change (ULA.couplingCost (output c).joint).toReal ≤
    (Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t)) * (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hupper hlower.le)]
  have he : Real.exp (-ρ * t) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact hsq

    (hfinite : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν ≠ ⊤) :

      (∀ n, ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint ≠ ⊤) ∧

        Filter.atTop (𝓝 (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν))
exists_coupling_cost_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_coupling_cost_tendsto (μ ν : Measure H)
    (hfinite : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ULA.Coupling μ ν,
      (∀ n, ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint ≠ ⊤) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint).toReal)
        Filter.atTop (𝓝 (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)) := by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃ c : ULA.Coupling μ ν,
      ULA.couplingCost c.joint <
        ENNReal.ofReal (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    apply iInf_lt_iff.mp
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hfinite ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (add_nonneg hnonneg (by positivity))]
    change ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν < _
    have hp : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    linarith
  choose c hc using hex
  have hcfin (n : ℕ) : ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_of_lt ((hc n).trans_le le_top)
  refine ⟨c, hcfin, ?_⟩
  have hlo (n : ℕ) : ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν ≤
      (ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint).toReal :=
    wasserstein_le_finite_coupling μ ν (c n) (hcfin n)
  have hup (n : ℕ) : (ULA.couplingCost (c n).joint).toReal ≤
      ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (hcfin n) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr (hc n)
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (add_nonneg hnonneg (by positivity))] at h
    exact h.le
  have hz : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hz' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν +
      1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hz.const_add (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hz' hlo hup

theorem bound_of_all_finite_couplings (μ ν : Measure H)
    (hfinite : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν ≠ ⊤) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling μ ν, ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤ →
      b ≤ f (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal) :
    b ≤ f (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)
bound_of_all_finite_couplings.exact_declaration:
theorem bound_of_all_finite_couplings (μ ν : Measure H)
    (hfinite : ULA.wasserstein2 μ ν ≠ ⊤) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousAt f (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν)) (b : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling μ ν, ULA.couplingCost c.joint ≠ ⊤ →
      b ≤ f (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal) :
    b ≤ f (ULA.wasserstein2Real μ ν) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, ht⟩ := exists_coupling_cost_tendsto μ ν hfinite
  exact ge_of_tendsto (hf.tendsto.comp ht) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => hb (c n) (hc n))

optimizerLawDistance.exact_header: def optimizerLawDistance (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z) : ℝ
optimizerLawDistance.exact_declaration:
def optimizerLawDistance (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' ^ 2)

weak_law_contraction.exact_header:
theorem weak_law_contraction
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν 0)] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν' 0)]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν 0))
    (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' 0))
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) (ν' 0),
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests s s' ν ν' Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    optimizerLawDistance (s t) (s' t) (ν t) (ν' t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        optimizerLawDistance (s 0) (s' 0) (ν 0) (ν' 0)
weak_law_contraction.exact_declaration:
theorem weak_law_contraction
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν 0)] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν' 0)]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν 0))
    (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' 0))
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) (ν' 0),
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests s s' ν ν' Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    optimizerLawDistance (s t) (s' t) (ν t) (ν' t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        optimizerLawDistance (s 0) (s' 0) (ν 0) (ν' 0) := by
  have hfinite := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp (ν 0) (ν' 0) hν hν'
  apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings (ν 0) (ν' 0) hfinite
    (fun d => Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
      Real.sqrt (‖s 0 - s' 0‖ ^ 2 + d ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  intro c _
  obtain ⟨Λ, hsol, hΛ⟩ := realize c
  let ct : ULA.Coupling (ν t) (ν' t) :=
    ⟨Λ t, (hsol.coupling t ht.1).1, (hsol.coupling t ht.1).2⟩
  have hνt : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.left.second_moment t ht.1)
  have hνt' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.right.second_moment t ht.1)
  have hct := coupling_difference_memLp (ν t) (ν' t) hνt hνt' ct
  have hb := wasserstein_le_finite_coupling (ν t) (ν' t) ct hct.eLpNorm_ne_top
  have hsq := couplingCost_sq_eq_integral ct.joint hct
  have hmetric : optimizerLawDistance (s t) (s' t) (ν t) (ν' t) ≤
      Real.sqrt (euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    dsimp only [euclideanCouplingEnergy]
    rw [← hsq]
    exact add_le_add (le_refl _) ((sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).2 hb)
  have hd := hsol.rms_decay D hquad ρ T hmono t ht
  have hinit := couplingCost_sq_eq_integral c.joint
    (coupling_difference_memLp (ν 0) (ν' 0) hν hν' c)
  apply hmetric.trans
  simpa only [euclideanCouplingEnergy, hΛ, ← hinit] using hd

stationary_weak_laws_unique.exact_header:
theorem stationary_weak_laws_unique [CompleteSpace Z]
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling ν ν',
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests (fun _ => s) (fun _ => s')
          (fun _ => ν) (fun _ => ν') Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint) :
    s = s' ∧ ν = ν'
stationary_weak_laws_unique.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_weak_laws_unique [CompleteSpace Z]
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling ν ν',
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests (fun _ => s) (fun _ => s')
          (fun _ => ν) (fun _ => ν') Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint) :
    s = s' ∧ ν = ν' := by
  have hd : optimizerLawDistance s s' ν ν' = 0 :=
    stationary_distance_zero (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hρ (fun t ht =>
      weak_law_contraction M D tests pairTests (fun _ => s) (fun _ => s')
        (fun _ => ν) (fun _ => ν') hν hν' hquad ρ t hmono realize t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖s - s'‖)
    (sq_nonneg (ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν')))
  change optimizerLawDistance s s' ν ν' ^ 2 = _ at hs
  rw [hd, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] at hs
  have hn : ‖s - s'‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν')]
  have hw : ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖s - s'‖]
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn),
    measure_eq_of_finite_wasserstein2Real_zero ν ν'
      (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp ν ν' hν hν') hw⟩

exists_contracting_pair_laws.exact_header:
theorem exists_contracting_pair_laws (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (C : (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ lower upper : ℝ)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hLower : ∀ x, lower * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C x‖ ^ 2)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hJoint : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (D.field Q x - D.field Q y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, D.field Q (Y r)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other =
        (∫ r in 0..t, D.field Q (W r)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
        max ‖(Y t).1 - (W t).1‖
          (ULA.wasserstein2Real (Q.map (Y t).2) (Q.map (W t).2)) ≤
        Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
          max ‖initial.1 - other.1‖ ‖initial.2 - other.2‖)
exists_contracting_pair_laws.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_contracting_pair_laws (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (C : (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ lower upper : ℝ)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hLower : ∀ x, lower * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C x‖ ^ 2)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hJoint : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (D.field Q x - D.field Q y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, D.field Q (Y r)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other =
        (∫ r in 0..t, D.field Q (W r)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
        max ‖(Y t).1 - (W t).1‖
          (ULA.wasserstein2Real (Q.map (Y t).2) (Q.map (W t).2)) ≤
        Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
          max ‖initial.1 - other.1‖ ‖initial.2 - other.2‖) := by
  obtain ⟨Y, W, hY, hW, hYi, hWi, heY, heW, hd⟩ :=
    D.exists_contracting_pair Q initial other B hB hB0 C ρ lower upper hlower hupper
      hLower hUpper hJoint T hT
  refine ⟨Y, W, hY, hW, hYi, hWi, heY, heW, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hLaw := ULA.wasserstein2_le_Lp_cost_real Q (Y t).2 (W t).2
  have hA : ‖(Y t).1 - (W t).1‖ ≤ ‖Y t - W t‖ := norm_fst_le (Y t - W t)
  have hZ : ‖(Y t).2 - (W t).2‖ ≤ ‖Y t - W t‖ := norm_snd_le (Y t - W t)
  have hb := max_le (hA.trans (hd t ht)) ((hLaw.trans hZ).trans (hd t ht))
  simpa only [Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub] using hb

theorem computed_endpoint_moment_bound_at (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖X t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (t+1) * L) * t) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A
computed_endpoint_moment_bound_at.exact_declaration:
theorem computed_endpoint_moment_bound_at (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖X t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (t+1) * L) * t) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A := by
  have hbi : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
    exact hb.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous b hbi).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hcont : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.add hi).add
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral_continuous Q D T σ hσ hA).continuousOn).congr
        (fun t ht => heq t ht)
  have hsq : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 t :=
    ((hcont.norm.pow 2).mono (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1]
      exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2)).intervalIntegrable
  have hsub : volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t) ≤ volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono (Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl ht.2) le_rfl
  exact endpoint_moment_bound X b
    (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA) σ ht.1 hL
    (hb.mono_measure hsub) (hσ.mono_measure hsub) hsq
    (fun r hr => heq r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩)
    (fun r hr => le_of_eq (computed_noise_norm_sq Q D T σ hσ hA r
      ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩))
    (fun r hr => hgrowth r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩)

    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))

    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :

theorem computed_uniform_moment_bound (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖X t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (T+1) * L) * T) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A := by
  have hmoment := computed_endpoint_moment_bound_at Q D X b σ T hL hb hσ hA heq hgrowth t ht
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht.1 ht.2 2

    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.2 hL
    nlinarith
  have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hc
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp
    (show 0 ≤ 3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A by positivity)

/-! # Endpoint moment control for linear-growth original integral equations
These estimates avoid an unproved strong Doob maximal inequality. The actual
L² drift primitive and actual noise energy give an endpoint Volterra bound;
its constants can be uniform over a stopping localization. Fatou and primitive
linear growth can then transfer coefficient moments to the un-stopped process.
