noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.LinearGrowthMoment

/-- An integral upper inequality suffices for Gronwall. Neither a pointwise
energy derivative nor absolute continuity of the bounded curve is assumed. -/

section IntegralSquare
variable {E F H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedAddCommGroup H]

/-- The square of a genuine Bochner drift primitive is controlled by its
actual time-square integral, with the exact horizon-length factor. -/

/-- A literal state/drift/noise decomposition yields its quadratic endpoint
bound. The stochastic noise term is its actual norm, not an assumed error. -/

/-- Primitive linear growth yields the quadratic coefficient bound, without
assuming a moment or energy inequality. -/

/-- Genuine integral decomposition and actual noise moments imply a uniform
endpoint bound. This is directly applicable with E an actual L² space; its
noise-moment premise is discharged by the computed Brownian corollary below. -/
end IntegralSquare

section LocalizationLimit
variable {Ω H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  (Q : Measure Ω)

/-- A uniform actual endpoint second-moment bound survives almost-sure
localization limits. Both L² membership and the limiting moment are derived
by Fatou; neither uniform integrability nor L² convergence is assumed. -/
end LocalizationLimit

section RawGrowth
variable {Ω H E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- The norm square of an actual L² class is the raw second moment. -/

/-- Actual primitive pointwise linear growth derives both spatial L²
coefficient membership and their exact quadratic moment bound. -/
/-- Original coefficients restricted to an actual stopping event obey
the same primitive linear-growth estimate against the stopped state. The
coefficient moments are then derived, rather than supplied as a hypothesis. -/

/-- Uniform actual second moments and joint strong measurability derive
product-space square integrability on a finite horizon. This supplies the
raw coefficient hypothesis of the actual section/integrator construction. -/

/-- The actual integrated raw energy is bounded by horizon length times
the uniform derived spatial moment, with Fubini justified internally. -/

/-- Jointly measurable primitive linear-growth coefficients have actual
global time×probability L² membership once the uniform state endpoint
moment has been derived. No L²-valued coefficient curve is supplied. -/

end RawGrowth

section Computed
open ProbabilityTheory FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)

/-- The actual completed predictable Brownian integral has exactly its
original finite-column time-square energy. -/

/-- Genuine computed Brownian noise and primitive quadratic coefficient
growth give an actual endpoint second-moment bound, with no supplied noise
isometry, martingale, dissipation, energy or state-moment conclusion. The
constant is independent of any localization index entering X,b,σ. -/
end Computed
end PBGSO.LinearGrowthMoment

volterra_bound.exact_header:
theorem volterra_bound (e : ℝ → ℝ) {T a A c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (he : IntervalIntegrable e volume 0 T)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, e t ≤ a + c * ∫ r in 0..t, A + e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * (a + A) - A
volterra_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem volterra_bound (e : ℝ → ℝ) {T a A c : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (he : IntervalIntegrable e volume 0 T)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, e t ≤ a + c * ∫ r in 0..t, A + e r) :
    e T ≤ Real.exp (c * T) * (a + A) - A := by
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => c * (A + e r)
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => a + A + ∫ r in 0..t, w r
  have hw : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 T :=
    ((intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => A) volume 0 T).add he).const_mul c
  have hF (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : e t + A ≤ F t := by
    dsimp only [F, w]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    linarith [hbound t ht]
  have hG := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_gronwall F w hT hw
    (by intro r hr; simp only [F, intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero])
    (by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
      simpa only [w, add_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)) hc)
  have hlast := hF T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩
  simp only [F, intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero] at hG
  linarith

integral_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem integral_norm_sq (b : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t))) :
    ‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖ ^ 2 ≤ t * ∫ r in 0..t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2
integral_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_norm_sq (b : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t))) :
    ‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖ ^ 2 ≤ t * ∫ r in 0..t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hi := hb.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hnorm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (f := b) (μ := volume) ht
  have hcs := PBGSO.integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t))
    (fun r => ‖b r‖) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) hb.norm (memLp_const 1)
  simp only [mul_one, one_pow, integral_const, Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply_univ,
    Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ht, smul_eq_mul] at hcs
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht] at hnorm ⊢
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
  have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt ht
  have hleft : ‖∫ r in Ioc 0 t, b r‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt t := hnorm.trans hcs
  have hprod : (Real.sqrt (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt t) ^ 2 =
      (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) * t := by rw [mul_pow, h1, h2]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, b r),
    Real.sqrt_nonneg (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg t,
    sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt t -
      ‖∫ r in Ioc 0 t, b r‖)]

decomposition_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem decomposition_norm_sq (x x0 m : E) (b : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)))
    (heq : x = x0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + m) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ‖x0‖ ^ 2 +
      3 * t * (∫ r in 0..t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) + 3 * ‖m‖ ^ 2
decomposition_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem decomposition_norm_sq (x x0 m : E) (b : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)))
    (heq : x = x0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + m) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ‖x0‖ ^ 2 +
      3 * t * (∫ r in 0..t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2) + 3 * ‖m‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hs := integral_norm_sq b ht hb
  have hn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x0‖ + ‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖ + ‖m‖ := by
    rw [heq]
    have h1 := norm_add_le x0 (∫ r in 0..t, b r)
    have h2 := norm_add_le (x0 + ∫ r in 0..t, b r) m
    linarith
  have hsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖x0‖ + ‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖ + ‖m‖) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn 2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x0‖ - ‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖),
    sq_nonneg (‖x0‖ - ‖m‖), sq_nonneg (‖∫ r in 0..t, b r‖ - ‖m‖)]

quadratic_growth.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_growth (x : H) (b : E) (σ : F) {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hg : ‖b‖ + ‖σ‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖x‖)) :
    ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖x‖ ^ 2)
quadratic_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_growth (x : H) (b : E) (σ : F) {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hg : ‖b‖ + ‖σ‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖x‖)) :
    ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hsq : (‖b‖ + ‖σ‖) ^ 2 ≤ (K * (1 + P + ‖x‖)) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hg 2
  have haux : (1 + P + ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1-P), sq_nonneg (1-‖x‖), sq_nonneg (P-‖x‖)]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haux (sq_nonneg K)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg b) (norm_nonneg σ)]

endpoint_moment_bound.exact_header:
theorem endpoint_moment_bound (X b m : ℝ → E) (σ : ℝ → F)
    {T A L : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T)))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T)))
    (hX : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 T)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + m t)
    (hnoise : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖m t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ r in 0..t, ‖σ r‖ ^ 2)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2)) :
    ‖X T‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (T+1) * L) * T) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A
endpoint_moment_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem endpoint_moment_bound (X b m : ℝ → E) (σ : ℝ → F)
    {T A L : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T)))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T)))
    (hX : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 T)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) + m t)
    (hnoise : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖m t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ r in 0..t, ‖σ r‖ ^ 2)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 T, ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2)) :
    ‖X T‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (T+1) * L) * T) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A := by
  apply volterra_bound (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) hT (by positivity) hX
  intro t ht
  have hsub : volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t) ≤ volume.restrict (Ioc 0 T) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono (Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl ht.2) le_rfl
  have hb' := hb.mono_measure hsub
  have hσ' := hσ.mono_measure hsub
  have hbs := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hb'.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hb'
  have hss := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hσ'.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hσ'
  have hx : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 t := hX.mono_set' (by simpa only [uIoc_of_le ht.1, uIoc_of_le hT] using Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl ht.2)
  have hright : Integrable (fun r => L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2)) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)) := by
    exact ((integrable_const A).add ((intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ht.1).mp hx)).const_mul L
  have hi := integral_mono_ae (hbs.add hss) hright
    (by filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
        exact hgrowth r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_add hbs hss, integral_const_mul] at hi
  have hdec := decomposition_norm_sq (X t) (X 0) (m t) b ht.1 hb' (heq t ht)
  have hno := hnoise t ht
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1] at hdec hno ⊢
  have hnB : 0 ≤ ∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖b r‖ ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hnS : 0 ≤ ∫ r in Ioc 0 t, ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  have htB := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) hnB
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 * (T+1))
  nlinarith

localized_limit_memLp.exact_header:
theorem localized_limit_memLp (Y : ℕ → Ω → H) (X : Ω → H) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hY : ∀ n, MemLp (Y n) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ‖(hY n).toLp (Y n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => Y n ω) atTop (𝓝 (X ω))) :
    ∃ hX : MemLp X 2 Q, ‖hX.toLp X‖ ^ 2 ≤ C
localized_limit_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem localized_limit_memLp (Y : ℕ → Ω → H) (X : Ω → H) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hY : ∀ n, MemLp (Y n) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ‖(hY n).toLp (Y n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => Y n ω) atTop (𝓝 (X ω))) :
    ∃ hX : MemLp X 2 Q, ‖hX.toLp X‖ ^ 2 ≤ C := by
  have hm := aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop (fun n => (hY n).aestronglyMeasurable) hlim
  have hnorm (n : ℕ) : eLpNorm (Y n) 2 Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt C) := by
    rw [← Lp.enorm_toLp (hY n), ← ofReal_norm]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (hbound n))
  have hFatou := Lp.eLpNorm_le_of_ae_tendsto (Eventually.of_forall hnorm)
    (fun n => (hY n).aestronglyMeasurable) hm hlim
  have hX : MemLp X 2 Q := lt_of_le_of_lt hFatou (by finiteness)
  refine ⟨hX, ?_⟩
  have hn : ‖hX.toLp X‖ ≤ Real.sqrt C := by
    rw [Lp.norm_toLp]
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.sqrt_nonneg C)] using
      ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt C) ≠ ⊤) hFatou
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hn 2
  rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hC] at hs

toLp_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem toLp_norm_sq (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :
    ‖hf.toLp f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
toLp_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem toLp_norm_sq (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :
    ‖hf.toLp f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae (hf.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))

coefficients_of_linear_growth.exact_header:
theorem coefficients_of_linear_growth (X : Ω → H) (b : Ω → E) (σ : Ω → F)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable b Q) (hσ : AEStronglyMeasurable σ Q)
    {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖b ω‖ + ‖σ ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X ω‖)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp b 2 Q, ∃ hσ2 : MemLp σ 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp b‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp σ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖hX.toLp X‖ ^ 2)
coefficients_of_linear_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficients_of_linear_growth (X : Ω → H) (b : Ω → E) (σ : Ω → F)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable b Q) (hσ : AEStronglyMeasurable σ Q)
    {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖b ω‖ + ‖σ ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X ω‖)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp b 2 Q, ∃ hσ2 : MemLp σ 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp b‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp σ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖hX.toLp X‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hcontrol : MemLp (fun ω => K * (1 + P + ‖X ω‖)) 2 Q :=
    ((memLp_const (1+P)).add hX.norm).const_mul K
  have hb2 : MemLp b 2 Q := hcontrol.mono' hb (hg.mono fun ω hω => by
    linarith [norm_nonneg (σ ω)])
  have hσ2 : MemLp σ 2 Q := hcontrol.mono' hσ (hg.mono fun ω hω => by
    linarith [norm_nonneg (b ω)])
  refine ⟨hb2, hσ2, ?_⟩
  rw [toLp_norm_sq Q b hb2, toLp_norm_sq Q σ hσ2, toLp_norm_sq Q X hX]
  have hbs := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hb2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hb2
  have hss := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hσ2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hσ2
  have hxs := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hX.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hX
  have hi := integral_mono_ae (hbs.add hss)
    (((integrable_const (1+P^2)).add hxs).const_mul (3*K^2))
    (hg.mono fun ω hω => quadratic_growth (X ω) (b ω) (σ ω) hK hP hω)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_add hbs hss, integral_const_mul, integral_add (integrable_const _) hxs,
    integral_const] at hi
  simpa only [Measure.real, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul, add_assoc] using hi

stopped_coefficients_of_linear_growth.exact_header:
theorem stopped_coefficients_of_linear_growth (X Y : Ω → H) (b : Ω → E) (σ : Ω → F)
    (S : Set Ω) (hY : MemLp Y 2 Q) (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable b Q)
    (hσ : AEStronglyMeasurable σ Q) {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hbefore : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∈ S → Y ω = X ω)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∉ S → b ω = 0 ∧ σ ω = 0)
    (hgrowth : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∈ S → ‖b ω‖ + ‖σ ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X ω‖)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp b 2 Q, ∃ hσ2 : MemLp σ 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp b‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp σ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖hY.toLp Y‖ ^ 2)
stopped_coefficients_of_linear_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem stopped_coefficients_of_linear_growth (X Y : Ω → H) (b : Ω → E) (σ : Ω → F)
    (S : Set Ω) (hY : MemLp Y 2 Q) (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable b Q)
    (hσ : AEStronglyMeasurable σ Q) {K P : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hbefore : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∈ S → Y ω = X ω)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∉ S → b ω = 0 ∧ σ ω = 0)
    (hgrowth : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ω ∈ S → ‖b ω‖ + ‖σ ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X ω‖)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp b 2 Q, ∃ hσ2 : MemLp σ 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp b‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp σ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖hY.toLp Y‖ ^ 2) := by
  apply coefficients_of_linear_growth Q Y b σ hY hb hσ hK hP
  filter_upwards [hbefore, hzero, hgrowth] with ω hbef hz hg
  by_cases hω : ω ∈ S
  · rw [hbef hω]
    exact hg hω
  · simpa only [(hz hω).1, (hz hω).2, norm_zero, add_zero] using
      mul_nonneg hK (show 0 ≤ 1 + P + ‖Y ω‖ by positivity)

product_memLp_of_uniform_moment.exact_header:
theorem product_memLp_of_uniform_moment (f : ℝ → Ω → E) (T : ℝ≥0) {C : ℝ}
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hmem : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      ‖(hmem t ht).toLp (f t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C) :
    MemLp (Function.uncurry f) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
product_memLp_of_uniform_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem product_memLp_of_uniform_moment (f : ℝ → Ω → E) (T : ℝ≥0) {C : ℝ}
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hmem : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      ‖(hmem t ht).toLp (f t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C) :
    MemLp (Function.uncurry f) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hs : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) := hf.norm.pow 2
  have hinner : Integrable (fun t => ∫ ω, ‖f t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
    apply (integrable_const C).mono' hs.integral_prod_right'.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    rw [← toLp_norm_sq Q (f t) (hmem t ht)]
    exact hbound t ht
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hs.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hmem t ht).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (hmem t ht)
  · simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] using hinner

product_energy_le.exact_header:
theorem product_energy_le (f : ℝ → Ω → E) (T : ℝ≥0) {C : ℝ}
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hmem : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      ‖(hmem t ht).toLp (f t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C) :
    (∫ p : ℝ × Ω, ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) ≤ T * C
product_energy_le.exact_declaration:
theorem product_energy_le (f : ℝ → Ω → E) (T : ℝ≥0) {C : ℝ}
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hmem : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      ‖(hmem t ht).toLp (f t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C) :
    (∫ p : ℝ × Ω, ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) ≤ T * C := by
  have hm := product_memLp_of_uniform_moment Q f T hf hmem hbound
  have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hm
  change Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
    ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) at hi
  rw [integral_prod _ hi]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _ in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), C := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hi.integral_prod_left (integrable_const C)
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
      rw [← toLp_norm_sq Q (f t) (hmem t ht)]
      exact hbound t ht
    _ = T * C := by simp only [integral_const, Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal T.coe_nonneg, smul_eq_mul]

coefficient_product_memLp.exact_header:
theorem coefficient_product_memLp (X : ℝ → Ω → H) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (σ : ℝ → Ω → F) (T : ℝ≥0) {K P C : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hσ : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry σ))
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (X t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ‖(hX t ht).toLp (X t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C)
    (hgrowth : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖b t ω‖ + ‖σ t ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X t ω‖)) :
    MemLp (Function.uncurry b) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
      MemLp (Function.uncurry σ) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
coefficient_product_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficient_product_memLp (X : ℝ → Ω → H) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (σ : ℝ → Ω → F) (T : ℝ≥0) {K P C : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hσ : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry σ))
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (X t) 2 Q)
    (hbound : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ‖(hX t ht).toLp (X t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C)
    (hgrowth : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖b t ω‖ + ‖σ t ω‖ ≤ K * (1 + P + ‖X t ω‖)) :
    MemLp (Function.uncurry b) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
      MemLp (Function.uncurry σ) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hpoint (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    coefficients_of_linear_growth Q (X t) (b t) (σ t) (hX t ht)
      hb.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable hσ.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable
      hK hP (hgrowth t ht)
  choose hb2 hσ2 hs using hpoint
  have hall (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      ‖(hb2 t ht).toLp (b t)‖ ^ 2 + ‖(hσ2 t ht).toLp (σ t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + C) :=
    (hs t ht).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (show 1 + P ^ 2 + ‖(hX t ht).toLp (X t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 + P ^ 2 + C by
        linarith [hbound t ht]) (by positivity))
  constructor
  · apply product_memLp_of_uniform_moment Q b T (C := 3*K^2*(1+P^2+C)) hb hb2
    intro t ht
    nlinarith [hall t ht, sq_nonneg ‖(hσ2 t ht).toLp (σ t)‖]
  · apply product_memLp_of_uniform_moment Q σ T (C := 3*K^2*(1+P^2+C)) hσ hσ2
    intro t ht
    nlinarith [hall t ht, sq_nonneg ‖(hb2 t ht).toLp (b t)‖]

computed_noise_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem computed_noise_norm_sq (T : ℝ≥0)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ‖σ r‖ ^ 2
computed_noise_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem computed_noise_norm_sq (T : ℝ≥0)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ r in 0..t, ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 := by
  have he := predictableCurveIntegral_increment_isometry Q D T σ hσ hA
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (fun _ _ => rfl) 0 t.toNNReal (by simp) (by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
      exact ht.2)
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_zero, sub_zero, weightedPairing_id] at he
  simp only [columnWeighted_id] at he
  simpa only [ConstructedPredictableModel.integral,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, NNReal.coe_zero, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1] using he

computed_endpoint_moment_bound.exact_header:
theorem computed_endpoint_moment_bound (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2)) :
    ‖X T‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (T+1) * L) * T) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A
computed_endpoint_moment_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem computed_endpoint_moment_bound (X b : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (σ : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (T : ℝ≥0) {A L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hb : MemLp b 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hσ : MemLp σ 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ t i) Q)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, b r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA t)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖b r‖ ^ 2 + ‖σ r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L * (A + ‖X r‖ ^ 2)) :
    ‖X T‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp ((3 * (T+1) * L) * T) * (3 * ‖X 0‖ ^ 2 + A) - A := by
  have hbi : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
    exact hb.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hi := (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous b hbi).continuousOn
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hi
  have hcont : ContinuousOn X (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.add hi).add
      (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral_continuous Q D T σ hσ hA).continuousOn).congr
        (fun t ht => heq t ht)
  have hsq : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => ‖X r‖ ^ 2) volume 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ((hcont.norm.pow 2).mono (by
      intro r hr
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hr)).intervalIntegrable
  exact endpoint_moment_bound X b
    (ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T σ hσ hA) σ T.coe_nonneg hL hb hσ hsq heq
    (fun t ht => le_of_eq (computed_noise_norm_sq Q D T σ hσ hA t ht)) hgrowth

stoppedField.exact_declaration:
def stoppedField (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (f : ℝ → Ω → Z) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Z :=

theorem stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Measurable τ)

theorem stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Measurable τ)

stoppedField_adapted.exact_header:
theorem stoppedField_adapted (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) (f : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (Q : Measure Ω)
    (hf : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (f t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (stoppedField τ f t) Q
stoppedField_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedField_adapted (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) (f : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (Q : Measure Ω)
    (hf : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (f t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (stoppedField τ f t) Q := by
  have hs : IsStoppingTime ℱ (fun ω => (τ ω : WithTop ℝ≥0)) := by
    intro t
    simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe] using hstop t
  have hm : MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | (t : ℝ) ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)} := by
    simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe, NNReal.coe_le_coe] using hs.measurableSet_ge t
  refine ⟨{ω | (t : ℝ) ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)}.indicator ((hf t).mk (f t)),
    (hf t).stronglyMeasurable_mk.indicator hm, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [(hf t).ae_eq_mk] with ω hω
  unfold stoppedField
  by_cases h : t ≤ τ ω <;> simp [h, hω, NNReal.coe_le_coe]

firstHit_scalar_integrable.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_scalar_integrable
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hτ : Measurable (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) q p.1 p.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    (∫ p : ℝ × Ω,
      stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) q p.1 p.2
        ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) ≤ c
firstHit_scalar_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_scalar_integrable
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hτ : Measurable (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) q p.1 p.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    (∫ p : ℝ × Ω,
      stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) q p.1 p.2
        ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) ≤ c := by
  let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c
  have hτT (ω) : τ ω ≤ T := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_le_horizon T A c ω (hA ω)
  have hzero (ω) : A 0 ω ≤ c := by
    rw [hint 0 bot_le ω]
    simpa using hc
  have hcap (ω) : A (τ ω) ω ≤ c :=
    PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_energy_le T A c ω (hA ω) (hzero ω)
  have hfield := stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable τ hτ q hq
  have hsection (ω) : IntegrableOn (fun r => stoppedField τ q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    change Integrable (fun r => if r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ) then q r ω else 0) _
    exact (hlocal ω).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  have heq (ω) : (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), stoppedField τ q r ω) = A (τ ω) ω := by
    rw [hint (τ ω) (hτT ω) ω]
    change (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), (Iic (τ ω : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r) = _
    rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Iic]
    have hs : Iic (τ ω : ℝ) ∩ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) = Ioc 0 (τ ω : ℝ) := by
      ext r
      simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioc, mem_Iic]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hrτ,hr0,hrT⟩
        exact ⟨hr0,hrτ⟩
      · rintro ⟨hr0,hrτ⟩
        exact ⟨hrτ,hr0,hrτ.trans (by exact_mod_cast hτT ω)⟩
    rw [Set.inter_comm, hs]
  have hnorm (ω) : (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖stoppedField τ q r ω‖) = A (τ ω) ω := by
    rw [← heq ω]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with r
    exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (by unfold stoppedField; split_ifs <;> simp [hpos])
  have hiA : Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖stoppedField τ q r ω‖) Q := by
    apply (integrable_const c).mono'
      hfield.norm.integral_prod_left.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards with ω
    rw [hnorm ω, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
    · exact hcap ω
    · rw [← heq ω]
      exact integral_nonneg (fun r => by unfold stoppedField; split_ifs <;> simp [hpos])
  have hi := (integrable_prod_iff' hfield.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    ⟨Eventually.of_forall hsection, hiA⟩
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  change (∫ p : ℝ × Ω, Function.uncurry (stoppedField τ q) p
    ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) ≤ c
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _ : Ω, c ∂Q := integral_mono hi.integral_prod_right (integrable_const c)
      (fun ω => by change (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), stoppedField τ q r ω) ≤ c; rw [heq ω]; exact hcap ω)
    _ = c := by simp

theorem firstHit_column_square_integrable
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hτ : Measurable (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c))
    (f : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hdom : ∀ r ω, ‖f r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      ‖stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
firstHit_column_square_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_column_square_integrable
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hτ : Measurable (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c))
    (f : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hdom : ∀ r ω, ‖f r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      ‖stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hi := (firstHit_scalar_integrable Q T q hq hpos hlocal A hA hint c hc hτ).1
  apply hi.mono'
    ((stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable _ hτ f hf).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards with p
  change ‖‖stoppedField (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c) f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ _
  unfold stoppedField
  by_cases h : p.1 ≤ (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c p.2 : ℝ)
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left h, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖f p.1 p.2‖)]
    exact hdom _ _
  · simp [h]

firstHit_column_sections_memLp.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_column_sections_memLp [SeparableSpace Z]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))

theorem firstHit_column_sections_memLp [SeparableSpace Z]

theorem firstHit_physical_columns {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [SeparableSpace Z] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun t => A t ω))
    (hAA : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (A t))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (f : I → ℝ → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (hadapt : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (f i t) Q)
    (hdom : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖f i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c
    let u := ProductLpSections.columnSections Q (fun i => stoppedField τ (f i))
    (∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) ∧
    MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q) ∧
    (∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ∀ i, (u t).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] stoppedField τ (f i) t) ∧

firstHit_physical_columns.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_physical_columns {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [SeparableSpace Z] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun t => A t ω))
    (hAA : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (A t))
    (hint : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → ∀ ω, A t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (f : I → ℝ → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (hadapt : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (f i t) Q)
    (hdom : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖f i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c
    let u := ProductLpSections.columnSections Q (fun i => stoppedField τ (f i))
    (∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) ∧
    MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q) ∧
    (∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ∀ i, (u t).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] stoppedField τ (f i) t) ∧
    (∫ t in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u t‖ ^ 2) ≤ c := by
  classical
  let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T A c
  have hs := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_stopping ℱ T A c hA hmono hAA
  have hτ : Measurable τ := by
    apply measurable_of_Iic
    intro t
    exact ℱ.le t _ (hs t)
  have hdi (i : I) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ‖f i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω := by
    apply le_trans _ (hdom r ω)
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖f j r ω‖) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hm (i : I) := stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable τ hτ (f i) (hf i)
  have h2 (i : I) := firstHit_column_square_integrable Q T q hq hpos hlocal A hA hint c hc hτ
    (f i) (hf i) (hdi i)
  refine ⟨hs, ProductLpSections.columnSections_memLp _ Q _ hm h2, ?_,
    ProductLpSections.columnSections_ae _ Q _ hm h2, ?_⟩
  · intro t i
    change AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t]
      (ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q (stoppedField τ (f i)) (t : ℝ)) Q
    apply ProductLpSections.sectionLp_adapted Q (ℱ t)
    exact stoppedField_adapted ℱ τ hs (f i) Q (fun t => hadapt t i) t
  · rw [ProductLpSections.integral_columnSections_norm_sq _ Q _ hm h2,
      ← integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => h2 i)]
    have hqi := firstHit_scalar_integrable Q T q hq hpos hlocal A hA hint c hc hτ
    apply le_trans (integral_mono (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => h2 i)) hqi.1 _) hqi.2
    intro p
    change (∑ i, ‖stoppedField τ (f i) p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) ≤ stoppedField τ q p.1 p.2
    by_cases h : p.1 ≤ (τ p.2 : ℝ)
    · simpa only [stoppedField, if_pos h] using hdom p.1 p.2
    · simp [stoppedField, h]

PBGSO/LpContinuousVersion.lean.scope_note: The raw additive input must be jointly strongly measurable, represent the actual L² input at each horizon time, and have almost-sure continuous paths. The L¹-time L² drift and actual integral equation are explicit; nonlinear drift continuity and its original L² realization are used. A pre-Brownian Driver alone does not supply sample-path continuity.
PBGSO/LpContinuousVersion.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.LpJointRepresentative
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.FundThmCalculus

/-! # Simultaneous continuous versions of actual additive integral processes

A joint L¹ drift representative is constructed, then its literal pathwise
primitive supplies one process version at every time. Continuity of the actual
raw additive input is explicit; a merely pre-Brownian Driver does not assert
sample-path continuity. The nonlinear drift equation is transferred using
joint measurability and Fubini, not a separate equation at each exceptional set.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 500000
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.LpContinuousVersion
variable {Ω R : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup R] [InnerProductSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]




/-- Construct one jointly strongly measurable continuous path version of an
actual L² integral process, with its literal original nonlinear drift equation.
All pathwise assertions hold on one spatial full-measure set for every time in
the finite horizon. -/
end PBGSO.LpContinuousVersion

primitive.exact_header: def primitive (g : ℝ → Ω → R) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : R
primitive.exact_declaration: def primitive (g : ℝ → Ω → R) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : R := ∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω

primitive_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem primitive_stronglyMeasurable (g : ℝ → Ω → R)
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (primitive g))
primitive_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem primitive_stronglyMeasurable (g : ℝ → Ω → R)
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (primitive g)) := by
  let K : (ℝ × Ω) × ℝ → R :=
    ({p | 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ p.1.1} : Set ((ℝ × Ω) × ℝ)).indicator
      (fun p => g p.2 p.1.2)
  have hset : MeasurableSet ({p | 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ p.1.1} : Set ((ℝ × Ω) × ℝ)) := by
    exact (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_snd).inter
      (measurableSet_le measurable_snd (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst))
  have hK : StronglyMeasurable K :=
    (hg.comp_measurable (measurable_snd.prodMk (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))).indicator hset
  have hi := hK.integral_prod_right' (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
  convert hi using 1
  funext p
  change (∫ s in Ioc 0 p.1, g s p.2) = ∫ s, K (p, s)
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  congr 1

primitive_continuousOn.exact_header:
theorem primitive_continuousOn (g : ℝ → Ω → R) (T : ℝ) (_hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) (hi : IntegrableOn (fun s => g s ω) (Icc 0 T)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => primitive g t ω) (Icc 0 T)
primitive_continuousOn.exact_declaration:
theorem primitive_continuousOn (g : ℝ → Ω → R) (T : ℝ) (_hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (ω : Ω) (hi : IntegrableOn (fun s => g s ω) (Icc 0 T)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => primitive g t ω) (Icc 0 T) := by
  exact intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive hi

exists_continuous_integral_version.exact_header:
theorem exists_continuous_integral_version
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Y F B : ℝ → Lp R 2 Q)
    (hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc 0 T))
    (b : ℝ → Ω → R) (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hbEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, b t =ᵐ[Q] B t)
    (hbCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (f : ℝ → R → R) (hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f))
    (hfield : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => f t (Y t ω)))
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, F s) + B t) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
        u 0 ω = Y 0 ω ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
          u t ω - u 0 ω = (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) + b t ω
exists_continuous_integral_version.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_continuous_integral_version
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Y F B : ℝ → Lp R 2 Q)
    (hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc 0 T))
    (b : ℝ → Ω → R) (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hbEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, b t =ᵐ[Q] B t)
    (hbCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (f : ℝ → R → R) (hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f))
    (hfield : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => f t (Y t ω)))
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, F s) + B t) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
        u 0 ω = Y 0 ω ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
          u t ω - u 0 ω = (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) + b t ω := by
  let μ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)
  let g : ℝ → Ω → R := LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative μ Q F hF
  have hg : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable μ Q F hF
  have hgi : Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod Q) :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_integrable μ Q F hF
  have hgs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[Q] F t :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_section μ Q F hF
  let u : ℝ → Ω → R := fun t ω => Y 0 ω + primitive g t ω + b t ω
  have hu : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) :=
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable (Y 0)).comp_snd.add (primitive_stronglyMeasurable g hg)).add hb
  have hurep (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t := by
    have hsub : Ioc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 T := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
    have hi := LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_setIntegral μ Q F hF (Ioc 0 t)
    rw [Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset hsub] at hi
    have he := heq t ht
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1] at he
    filter_upwards [hi, hbEq t ht, Lp.coeFn_sub (Y t) (Y 0),
      Lp.coeFn_add (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, F s) (B t)] with ω hω hbω hYω hBω
    have heω := congrArg (fun V : Lp R 2 Q => V ω) he
    rw [hYω, hBω] at heω
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply] at heω
    change (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, F s) ω = ∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω at hω
    rw [hω] at heω
    dsimp [u, primitive]
    rw [hbω]
    calc
      Y 0 ω + (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω) + B t ω =
          ((∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω) + B t ω) + Y 0 ω := by abel
      _ = Y t ω := (eq_add_of_sub_eq heω).symm
  have hcomp : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => f p.1 (u p.1 p.2)) :=
    hf.comp_stronglyMeasurable (measurable_fst.stronglyMeasurable.prodMk hu)
  have hprod : (Function.uncurry g) =ᵐ[μ.prod Q]
      (fun p => f p.1 (u p.1 p.2)) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (hg.measurableSet_eq_fun hcomp)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hgs, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht hti
    exact ht.trans ((hfield t hti).trans ((hurep t hti).symm.fun_comp (f t)))
  have hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, g s ω = f s (u s ω) :=
    Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
      ((Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := Q) (ν := μ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hprod)
  have hzero : B 0 = 0 := by
    have hh := heq 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
    simpa only [sub_self, intervalIntegral.integral_same, zero_add] using hh.symm
  have hbzero : b 0 =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => 0) := by
    have hh := hbEq 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
    rw [hzero] at hh
    exact hh.trans (Lp.coeFn_zero R 2 Q)
  refine ⟨u, hu, hurep, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hgi.prod_left_ae, hbCont, hpath, hbzero] with ω hi hc hp hz
  have hcU : ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) :=
    (continuousOn_const.add (primitive_continuousOn g T hT ω hi)).add hc
  have hu0 : u 0 ω = Y 0 ω := by simp [u, primitive, hz]
  refine ⟨hcU, hu0, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hsub : Ioc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 T := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have hpeq : (fun s => g s ω) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)] (fun s => f s (u s ω)) :=
    hp.filter_mono (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_set _ hsub))
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, ← integral_congr_ae hpeq, hu0]
  dsimp [u, primitive]
  abel

PBGSO/LpIntegralSections.lean.scope_note: Assume a Bochner L¹ family of L² variables, a jointly AE strongly measurable realization and AE-time exact sections. No product-integrability premise is needed. LpJointRepresentative constructs such a joint realization on finite time/probability spaces.
PBGSO/LpIntegralSections.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.PastAverages
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.AEEqOfIntegral
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod

/-! # Actual sections of Bochner integrals in L²
Finite spatial test integrals are bounded linear maps. Fubini and uniqueness
from those tests identify integration of jointly measurable realizations,
including past translation averages without pointwise time regularity.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.LpIntegralSections
variable {X R : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X)
  [NormedAddCommGroup R] [InnerProductSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]





section Sections
variable {T : Type*} [MeasurableSpace T] (μ : Measure T) [SFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]

/-- A jointly measurable realization of an L¹ family of L² variables is integrable
on every finite-measure spatial test set. -/

/-- Bochner integration in L² agrees almost everywhere with integrating any
jointly measurable realization. All integrability statements follow from L¹(L²). -/
end Sections

/-- The literal time-L² past average has the continuous moving-integral
representative. This statement assumes no pointwise time regularity of U. -/
end PBGSO.LpIntegralSections

indicatorCLM.exact_header:
def indicatorCLM (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    R →L[ℝ] Lp R 2 ν
indicatorCLM.exact_declaration:
def indicatorCLM (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    R →L[ℝ] Lp R 2 ν :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := indicatorConstLp 2 hs hν
      map_add' := fun _ _ => indicatorConstLp_add.symm
      map_smul' := by
        intro c a
        apply Lp.ext
        filter_upwards [indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := hs) (hμs := hν) (c := c • a),
          indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := hs) (hμs := hν) (c := a),
          Lp.coeFn_smul c (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hν a)] with x hx hy hz
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [hx, hz]
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply, hy]
        by_cases hxs : x ∈ s <;> simp [hxs] }
    (ν.real s ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))) (by
      intro a
      change ‖indicatorConstLp 2 hs hν a‖ ≤ _
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, mul_comm] using
        (norm_indicatorConstLp_le (p := 2) (hs := hs) (hμs := hν) (c := a)))

setIntegralCLM.exact_header:
def setIntegralCLM (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    Lp R 2 ν →L[ℝ] R
setIntegralCLM.exact_declaration:
def setIntegralCLM (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    Lp R 2 ν →L[ℝ] R := (indicatorCLM ν s hs hν).adjoint

setIntegralCLM_apply.exact_header:
theorem setIntegralCLM_apply (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞)
    (U : Lp R 2 ν) : setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν U = ∫ x in s, U x ∂ν
setIntegralCLM_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem setIntegralCLM_apply (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞)
    (U : Lp R 2 ν) : setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν U = ∫ x in s, U x ∂ν := by
  apply ext_inner_left ℝ
  intro a
  rw [setIntegralCLM, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  exact L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_eq_inner_setIntegral ℝ hs hν a U

integral_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem integral_norm_le (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞)
    (U : Lp R 2 ν) :
    ∫ x in s, ‖U x‖ ∂ν ≤ ‖setIntegralCLM (R := ℝ) ν s hs hν‖ * ‖U‖
integral_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_norm_le (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞)
    (U : Lp R 2 ν) :
    ∫ x in s, ‖U x‖ ∂ν ≤ ‖setIntegralCLM (R := ℝ) ν s hs hν‖ * ‖U‖ := by
  let V : Lp ℝ 2 ν := (Lp.memLp U).norm.toLp (fun x => ‖U x‖)
  have hV : ‖V‖ = ‖U‖ := by
    rw [Lp.norm_toLp, eLpNorm_norm _ (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U), Lp.norm_def]
  have hi : setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν V = ∫ x in s, ‖U x‖ ∂ν := by
    rw [setIntegralCLM_apply]
    exact integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (MemLp.coeFn_toLp (Lp.memLp U).norm))
  calc
    ∫ x in s, ‖U x‖ ∂ν ≤ ‖∫ x in s, ‖U x‖ ∂ν‖ := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ ‖setIntegralCLM (R := ℝ) ν s hs hν‖ * ‖U‖ := by
      rw [← hi, ← hV]
      exact (setIntegralCLM (R := ℝ) ν s hs hν).le_opNorm V

integrable_restrict_prod.exact_header:
theorem integrable_restrict_prod (F : T → Lp R 2 ν) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (g : T → X → R) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod ν))
    (hsec : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[ν] F t)
    (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod (ν.restrict s))
integrable_restrict_prod.exact_declaration:
theorem integrable_restrict_prod (F : T → Lp R 2 ν) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (g : T → X → R) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod ν))
    (hsec : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[ν] F t)
    (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hν : ν s ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod (ν.restrict s)) := by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod (ν.restrict s)) :=
    hg.mono_measure (Measure.prod_mono le_rfl Measure.restrict_le_self)
  apply (integrable_prod_iff hm).mpr
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [hsec] with t ht
    exact (integrableOn_Lp_of_measure_ne_top (F t) (by norm_num) hν).congr
      (ae_restrict_of_ae ht.symm)
  · apply (hF.norm.const_mul ‖setIntegralCLM (R := ℝ) ν s hs hν‖).mono'
      hm.norm.integral_prod_right'
    filter_upwards [hsec] with t ht
    have ht' : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν.restrict s, ‖g t x‖ = ‖F t x‖ := by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae ht] with x hx using congrArg norm hx
    simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _),
      integral_congr_ae ht']
    exact integral_norm_le ν s hs hν (F t)

integral_coe_ae.exact_header:
theorem integral_coe_ae (F : T → Lp R 2 ν) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (g : T → X → R) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod ν))
    (hsec : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[ν] F t) :
    (∫ t, F t ∂μ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun x => ∫ t, g t x ∂μ)
integral_coe_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_coe_ae (F : T → Lp R 2 ν) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (g : T → X → R) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod ν))
    (hsec : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[ν] F t) :
    (∫ t, F t ∂μ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun x => ∫ t, g t x ∂μ) := by
  apply ae_eq_of_forall_setIntegral_eq_of_sigmaFinite
  · intro s hs hν
    exact integrableOn_Lp_of_measure_ne_top _ (by norm_num) hν.ne
  · intro s hs hν
    exact (integrable_restrict_prod ν μ F hF g hg hsec s hs hν.ne).integral_prod_right
  · intro s hs hν
    have hi := integrable_restrict_prod ν μ F hF g hg hsec s hs hν.ne
    calc
      (∫ x in s, (∫ t, F t ∂μ) x ∂ν) =
          setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν.ne (∫ t, F t ∂μ) :=
        (setIntegralCLM_apply ν s hs hν.ne _).symm
      _ = ∫ t, setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν.ne (F t) ∂μ :=
        ((setIntegralCLM ν s hs hν.ne).integral_comp_comm hF).symm
      _ = ∫ t, ∫ x in s, g t x ∂ν ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hsec] with t ht
        rw [setIntegralCLM_apply]
        exact integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae ht.symm)
      _ = ∫ x in s, ∫ t, g t x ∂μ ∂ν := integral_integral_swap hi

average_coe_ae.exact_header:
theorem average_coe_ae (U : PastAverages.TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    PastAverages.average U ε =ᵐ[volume] PastAverages.pastMean U ε
average_coe_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem average_coe_ae (U : PastAverages.TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    PastAverages.average U ε =ᵐ[volume] PastAverages.pastMean U ε := by
  have hi : Integrable (PastAverages.shift U) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ε)) :=
    ((PastAverages.shift_continuous U).intervalIntegrable 0 ε).1
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => U (p.2 - p.1)) :=
    (Lp.stronglyMeasurable U).comp_measurable (measurable_snd.sub measurable_fst)
  have he := integral_coe_ae (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ε))
    (PastAverages.shift U) hi (fun r t => U (t - r)) hm.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun r => (PastAverages.shift_coe U r).symm)
  have hsm := Lp.coeFn_smul ε⁻¹ (∫ r in Ioc 0 ε, PastAverages.shift U r)
  filter_upwards [he, hsm] with t ht hst
  change (ε⁻¹ • ∫ r in 0..ε, PastAverages.shift U r) t = _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hε.le, hst]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [ht, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hε.le,
    intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left, sub_zero]
  rfl

PBGSO/LpJointRepresentative.lean.scope_note: The time measure is finite, the spatial measure a probability, and the output a complete real Hilbert space. No measurable global L² evaluation map or joint representative is assumed. Every actual time-set Bochner integral has its proved section identity.
PBGSO/LpJointRepresentative.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.LpIntegralSections
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.SimpleFuncDenseLp
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.ConvergenceInMeasure

/-! # Actual joint representatives for Bochner L¹ families of L² variables

The representative is constructed from literal finite-valued time families,
completed in product L¹. Joint measurability of unrestricted point evaluation
on L² is neither assumed nor used. Section equality follows from actual L²
convergence, product-a.e. subsequence convergence and uniqueness in measure.
The finite time measure and probability-space assumptions are explicit.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.LpJointRepresentative
variable {T Ω R : Type*} [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup R] [InnerProductSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]
  (μ : Measure T) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- Literal joint realization of a finite-valued family of L² variables. -/





/-- A fixed finite bound for the probability-space embedding L²→L¹. -/





/-- A Bochner L¹ family of L² random variables has an actual jointly
strongly measurable, product-integrable representative. No pointwise evaluation
of the whole L² space is assumed measurable. -/


/-- A chosen actual joint representative, constructed through simple functions
and completion, for an arbitrary Bochner L¹ family of L² random variables. -/




/-- All actual time-set integrals of the joint representative represent the
corresponding L² Bochner integrals. The exceptional spatial set may depend on
that time set; a simultaneous continuous version is a further process result. -/

end PBGSO.LpJointRepresentative

simpleRaw.exact_header: def simpleRaw (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : T × Ω → R
simpleRaw.exact_declaration: def simpleRaw (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : T × Ω → R := fun p => S p.1 p.2

simpleRaw_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem simpleRaw_stronglyMeasurable (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (simpleRaw Q S)
simpleRaw_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem simpleRaw_stronglyMeasurable (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (simpleRaw Q S) := by
  classical
  induction S using SimpleFunc.induction' with
  | const v => exact (Lp.stronglyMeasurable v).comp_snd
  | @pcw f g s hs hf hg =>
    have hm : StronglyMeasurable ((Prod.fst ⁻¹' s).piecewise (simpleRaw Q f) (simpleRaw Q g)) :=
      hf.piecewise (hs.preimage measurable_fst) hg
    convert hm using 1
    funext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ s <;> simp [simpleRaw, hp]

simpleRaw_integrable.exact_header:
theorem simpleRaw_integrable (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    Integrable (simpleRaw Q S) (μ.prod Q)
simpleRaw_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem simpleRaw_integrable (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    Integrable (simpleRaw Q S) (μ.prod Q) := by
  have h := LpIntegralSections.integrable_restrict_prod Q μ S
    (S.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure) (fun t ω => S t ω)
    (simpleRaw_stronglyMeasurable Q S).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl))
    Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ (measure_ne_top Q Set.univ)
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at h
  exact h

simpleLift.exact_header: def simpleLift (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : Lp R 1 (μ.prod Q)
simpleLift.exact_declaration:
def simpleLift (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : Lp R 1 (μ.prod Q) :=
  (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr (simpleRaw_integrable μ Q S)).toLp _

simpleLift_coe.exact_header:
theorem simpleLift_coe (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    simpleLift μ Q S =ᵐ[μ.prod Q] simpleRaw Q S
simpleLift_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem simpleLift_coe (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    simpleLift μ Q S =ᵐ[μ.prod Q] simpleRaw Q S :=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr (simpleRaw_integrable μ Q S))

simpleLift_dist_le.exact_header:
theorem simpleLift_dist_le (S V : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    dist (simpleLift μ Q S) (simpleLift μ Q V) ≤
      embeddingConstant Q * ∫ t, ‖S t - V t‖ ∂μ
simpleLift_dist_le.exact_declaration:
theorem simpleLift_dist_le (S V : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    dist (simpleLift μ Q S) (simpleLift μ Q V) ≤
      embeddingConstant Q * ∫ t, ‖S t - V t‖ ∂μ := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, L1.norm_eq_integral_norm]
  have hraw : (fun p => ‖(simpleLift μ Q S - simpleLift μ Q V) p‖) =ᵐ[μ.prod Q]
      (fun p => ‖simpleRaw Q S p - simpleRaw Q V p‖) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (simpleLift μ Q S) (simpleLift μ Q V),
      simpleLift_coe μ Q S, simpleLift_coe μ Q V] with p hp hS hV
    simp only [hp, Pi.sub_apply, hS, hV]
  rw [integral_congr_ae hraw]
  have hfub := integral_prod (fun p => ‖simpleRaw Q S p - simpleRaw Q V p‖)
    (((simpleRaw_integrable μ Q S).sub (simpleRaw_integrable μ Q V)).norm)
  rw [hfub]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
  · exact ((S.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure.sub V.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure).norm.const_mul _)
  · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    have he : (fun ω => (S t - V t) ω) =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => S t ω - V t ω) :=
      Lp.coeFn_sub (S t) (V t)
    change (∫ ω, ‖S t ω - V t ω‖ ∂Q) ≤ _
    have hi := integral_congr_ae (he.fun_comp norm)
    change (∫ ω, ‖(S t - V t) ω‖ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ‖S t ω - V t ω‖ ∂Q) at hi
    rw [← hi]
    simpa only [embeddingConstant, Measure.restrict_univ] using
      LpIntegralSections.integral_norm_le (R := R) Q Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
        (measure_ne_top Q Set.univ) (S t - V t)

simpleTimeLift.exact_header: def simpleTimeLift (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : Lp (Lp R 2 Q) 1 μ
simpleTimeLift.exact_declaration:
def simpleTimeLift (S : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) : Lp (Lp R 2 Q) 1 μ :=
  (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr S.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure).toLp _

simpleTimeLift_dist.exact_header:
theorem simpleTimeLift_dist (S V : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    dist (simpleTimeLift μ Q S) (simpleTimeLift μ Q V) = ∫ t, ‖S t - V t‖ ∂μ
simpleTimeLift_dist.exact_declaration:
theorem simpleTimeLift_dist (S V : SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q)) :
    dist (simpleTimeLift μ Q S) (simpleTimeLift μ Q V) = ∫ t, ‖S t - V t‖ ∂μ := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, L1.norm_eq_integral_norm]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (simpleTimeLift μ Q S) (simpleTimeLift μ Q V),
    MemLp.coeFn_toLp (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr (S.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure (μ := μ))),
    MemLp.coeFn_toLp (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr (V.integrable_of_isFiniteMeasure (μ := μ)))] with t ht hS hV
  rw [ht]
  change ‖simpleTimeLift μ Q S t - simpleTimeLift μ Q V t‖ = _
  change simpleTimeLift μ Q S t = S t at hS
  change simpleTimeLift μ Q V t = V t at hV
  rw [hS, hV]

exists_joint_representative.exact_header:
theorem exists_joint_representative (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod Q) ∧
      ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[Q] F t
exists_joint_representative.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_joint_representative (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    ∃ g : T → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod Q) ∧
      ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[Q] F t := by
  borelize ↥(Lp R 2 Q)
  let V : Lp (Lp R 2 Q) 1 μ := (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr hF).toLp _
  have hVm : Measurable V := (Lp.stronglyMeasurable V).measurable
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (Set.range V ∪ {0} : Set (Lp R 2 Q)) :=
    StronglyMeasurable.separableSpace_range_union_singleton (Lp.stronglyMeasurable V)
  let S : ℕ → SimpleFunc T (Lp R 2 Q) := fun n =>
    SimpleFunc.approxOn V hVm (Set.range V ∪ {0}) 0 (by simp) n
  have hpoint (t : T) : Tendsto (fun n => S n t) atTop (𝓝 (V t)) :=
    SimpleFunc.tendsto_approxOn (s := Set.range V ∪ {0}) (y₀ := 0) (x := t)
      hVm (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton 0))
      (subset_closure (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self t)))
  have htime : Tendsto (fun n => simpleTimeLift μ Q (S n)) atTop (𝓝 V) := by
    have hv := SimpleFunc.tendsto_approxOn_range_Lp (p := 1) (by norm_num) hVm (Lp.memLp V)
    simpa only [simpleTimeLift, S, Lp.toLp_coeFn] using hv
  have hc : CauchySeq (fun n => simpleLift μ Q (S n)) := by
    have ht := htime.cauchySeq
    rw [cauchySeq_iff_tendsto_dist_atTop_0] at ht ⊢
    have hb (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
        dist (simpleLift μ Q (S p.1)) (simpleLift μ Q (S p.2)) ≤
          embeddingConstant Q * dist (simpleTimeLift μ Q (S p.1)) (simpleTimeLift μ Q (S p.2)) := by
      rw [simpleTimeLift_dist]
      exact simpleLift_dist_le μ Q (S p.1) (S p.2)
    have hz : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => embeddingConstant Q *
        dist (simpleTimeLift μ Q (S p.1)) (simpleTimeLift μ Q (S p.2))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul ht)
    exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) hb hz
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hc
  have hm : TendstoInMeasure (μ.prod Q) (fun n => simpleRaw Q (S n)) atTop G := by
    apply TendstoInMeasure.congr (fun n => simpleLift_coe μ Q (S n)) Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
    exact tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp hG
  obtain ⟨ns, hns, hae⟩ := hm.exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  have hrows : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      Tendsto (fun n => S (ns n) t ω) atTop (𝓝 (G (t, ω))) :=
    Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hae
  refine ⟨fun t ω => G (t, ω), Lp.stronglyMeasurable G,
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (Lp.memLp G), ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hrows, MemLp.coeFn_toLp (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr hF)] with t ht hFt
  have hLp : Tendsto (fun n => S (ns n) t) atTop (𝓝 (V t)) :=
    (hpoint t).comp hns.tendsto_atTop
  have hraw := tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_ae
    (fun n => (Lp.stronglyMeasurable (S (ns n) t)).aestronglyMeasurable) ht
  have heq := tendstoInMeasure_ae_unique hraw (tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp hLp)
  exact heq.trans (by rw [hFt])

jointRepresentative.exact_header: def jointRepresentative (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) : T → Ω → R
jointRepresentative.exact_declaration:
def jointRepresentative (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) : T → Ω → R :=
  Classical.choose (exists_joint_representative μ Q F hF)

jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (jointRepresentative μ Q F hF))
jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (jointRepresentative μ Q F hF)) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_joint_representative μ Q F hF)).1

jointRepresentative_integrable.exact_header:
theorem jointRepresentative_integrable (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry (jointRepresentative μ Q F hF)) (μ.prod Q)
jointRepresentative_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem jointRepresentative_integrable (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    Integrable (Function.uncurry (jointRepresentative μ Q F hF)) (μ.prod Q) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_joint_representative μ Q F hF)).2.1

jointRepresentative_section.exact_header:
theorem jointRepresentative_section (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, jointRepresentative μ Q F hF t =ᵐ[Q] F t
jointRepresentative_section.exact_declaration:
theorem jointRepresentative_section (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, jointRepresentative μ Q F hF t =ᵐ[Q] F t :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_joint_representative μ Q F hF)).2.2

jointRepresentative_setIntegral.exact_header:
theorem jointRepresentative_setIntegral (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (s : Set T) :
    (∫ t in s, F t ∂μ) =ᵐ[Q]
      (fun ω => ∫ t in s, jointRepresentative μ Q F hF t ω ∂μ)
jointRepresentative_setIntegral.exact_declaration:
theorem jointRepresentative_setIntegral (F : T → Lp R 2 Q) (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (s : Set T) :
    (∫ t in s, F t ∂μ) =ᵐ[Q]
      (fun ω => ∫ t in s, jointRepresentative μ Q F hF t ω ∂μ) := by
  apply LpIntegralSections.integral_coe_ae Q (μ.restrict s) F hF.integrableOn
    (jointRepresentative μ Q F hF)
  · exact (jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable μ Q F hF).aestronglyMeasurable.mono_measure
      (Measure.prod_mono Measure.restrict_le_self le_rfl)
  · exact ae_restrict_of_ae (jointRepresentative_section μ Q F hF)

PBGSO/LpMeasurableContinuousVersion.lean.scope_note: Actual original L2 equations, time-L1(L2) drift, and a joint continuous raw input version are explicit. Pathwise drift integrability is derived; the selected sampler is asserted AE adapted per time rather than strictly adapted on every sample point.
PBGSO/LpMeasurableContinuousVersion.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.LpContinuousVersion

/-! # Continuous integral paths with a merely measurable original drift
Joint L¹ representatives and Fubini identify the literal nonlinear drift.
Its pathwise integrability is derived; no drift continuity is needed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.LpContinuousVersion
variable {Ω R : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup R] [InnerProductSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]
  [MeasurableSpace R] [BorelSpace R] [SecondCountableTopology R]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- Construct one jointly strongly measurable continuous path version of an
actual L² integral process, with its literal original nonlinear drift equation.
All pathwise assertions hold on one spatial full-measure set for every time in
the finite horizon. -/
end PBGSO.LpContinuousVersion

exists_continuous_integral_version_of_st.exact_header:
theorem exists_continuous_integral_version_of_stronglyMeasurable
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Y F B : ℝ → Lp R 2 Q)
    (hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc 0 T))
    (b : ℝ → Ω → R) (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hbEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, b t =ᵐ[Q] B t)
    (hbCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (f : ℝ → R → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hfield : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => f t (Y t ω)))
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, F s) + B t) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
        u 0 ω = Y 0 ω ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => f s (u s ω)) volume 0 T ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
          u t ω - u 0 ω = (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) + b t ω
exists_continuous_integral_version_of_st.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_continuous_integral_version_of_stronglyMeasurable
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (Y F B : ℝ → Lp R 2 Q)
    (hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc 0 T))
    (b : ℝ → Ω → R) (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hbEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, b t =ᵐ[Q] B t)
    (hbCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => b t ω) (Icc 0 T))
    (f : ℝ → R → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (hfield : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => f t (Y t ω)))
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, F s) + B t) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
        ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) ∧
        u 0 ω = Y 0 ω ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun s => f s (u s ω)) volume 0 T ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
          u t ω - u 0 ω = (∫ s in 0..t, f s (u s ω)) + b t ω := by
  let μ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)
  let g : ℝ → Ω → R := LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative μ Q F hF
  have hg : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_stronglyMeasurable μ Q F hF
  have hgi : Integrable (Function.uncurry g) (μ.prod Q) :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_integrable μ Q F hF
  have hgs : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, g t =ᵐ[Q] F t :=
    LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_section μ Q F hF
  let u : ℝ → Ω → R := fun t ω => Y 0 ω + primitive g t ω + b t ω
  have hu : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry u) :=
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable (Y 0)).comp_snd.add (primitive_stronglyMeasurable g hg)).add hb
  have hurep (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : u t =ᵐ[Q] Y t := by
    have hsub : Ioc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 T := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
    have hi := LpJointRepresentative.jointRepresentative_setIntegral μ Q F hF (Ioc 0 t)
    rw [Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset hsub] at hi
    have he := heq t ht
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1] at he
    filter_upwards [hi, hbEq t ht, Lp.coeFn_sub (Y t) (Y 0),
      Lp.coeFn_add (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, F s) (B t)] with ω hω hbω hYω hBω
    have heω := congrArg (fun V : Lp R 2 Q => V ω) he
    rw [hYω, hBω] at heω
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply] at heω
    change (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, F s) ω = ∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω at hω
    rw [hω] at heω
    dsimp [u, primitive]
    rw [hbω]
    calc
      Y 0 ω + (∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω) + B t ω =
          ((∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s ω) + B t ω) + Y 0 ω := by abel
      _ = Y t ω := (eq_add_of_sub_eq heω).symm
  have hcomp : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => f p.1 (u p.1 p.2)) :=
    hf.comp_measurable (measurable_fst.prodMk hu.measurable)
  have hprod : (Function.uncurry g) =ᵐ[μ.prod Q]
      (fun p => f p.1 (u p.1 p.2)) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (hg.measurableSet_eq_fun hcomp)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hgs, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht hti
    exact ht.trans ((hfield t hti).trans ((hurep t hti).symm.fun_comp (f t)))
  have hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, g s ω = f s (u s ω) :=
    Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
      ((Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := Q) (ν := μ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hprod)
  have hzero : B 0 = 0 := by
    have hh := heq 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
    simpa only [sub_self, intervalIntegral.integral_same, zero_add] using hh.symm
  have hbzero : b 0 =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => 0) := by
    have hh := hbEq 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
    rw [hzero] at hh
    exact hh.trans (Lp.coeFn_zero R 2 Q)
  refine ⟨u, hu, hurep, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hgi.prod_left_ae, hbCont, hpath, hbzero] with ω hi hc hp hz
  have hcU : ContinuousOn (fun t => u t ω) (Icc 0 T) :=
    (continuousOn_const.add (primitive_continuousOn g T hT ω hi)).add hc
  have hu0 : u 0 ω = Y 0 ω := by simp [u, primitive, hz]
  have hiField : IntegrableOn (fun s => f s (u s ω)) (Icc 0 T) := hi.congr hp
  have hiInterval : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => f s (u s ω)) volume 0 T :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hT).mpr hiField
  refine ⟨hcU, hu0, hiInterval, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hsub : Ioc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 T := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
  have hpeq : (fun s => g s ω) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t)] (fun s => f s (u s ω)) :=
    hp.filter_mono (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_set _ hsub))
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, ← integral_congr_ae hpeq, hu0]
  dsimp [u, primitive]
  abel
