import PBGSO.GeneralProcess
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap

/-! # Change of probability space for the constructed mean-field dynamics

A measure-preserving map pulls back actual L² variables. The three primitive
maps, their Bochner expectation, and their complete mean-field vector field
commute with that pullback. Consequently a constructed integral trajectory can
be realized on an initial-coupling extension without changing either marginal
law. No equality of output laws or of mean-field forces is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO

section Pullback
variable {Ω Ω' E K : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
  {Q : Measure Ω} {Q' : Measure Ω'} {f : Ω' → Ω}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]

/-- The actual measure-preserving L² pullback as a continuous linear map. -/



/-- Pulling back twice is pullback along the composed map. -/

/-- Composition of a primitive Lipschitz map commutes with pullback. -/

/-- Pullback preserves a Bochner expectation of an actual L² variable. -/

end Pullback

section Dynamics
variable {Ω Ω' A Z G : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
  {Q : Measure Ω} {Q' : Measure Ω'} {f : Ω' → Ω}
  [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] [IsProbabilityMeasure Q']
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]

/-- Pullback acts identically on the deterministic optimiser coordinate. -/


/-- The observation expectation is preserved, by actual change of variables. -/

/-- The complete mean-field force commutes with a change of probability space. -/

/-- Integral trajectories pull back to actual integral trajectories. The
new common input is the actual pullback of the old input. -/

end Dynamics

section Laws
variable {Ω Ω' Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
  {Q : Measure Ω} {Q' : Measure Ω'} {f : Ω' → Ω}
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z]

/-- The actual output sampler law is unchanged by probability-space pullback. -/

end Laws
end PBGSO

lpPullbackCLM.exact_header: def lpPullbackCLM (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) : Lp E 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp E 2 Q'
lpPullbackCLM.exact_declaration:
def lpPullbackCLM (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) : Lp E 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp E 2 Q' :=
  (Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ f hf).toContinuousLinearMap

lpPullback_coe.exact_header:
theorem lpPullback_coe (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hf U =ᵐ[Q'] fun ω => U (f ω)
lpPullback_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem lpPullback_coe (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hf U =ᵐ[Q'] fun ω => U (f ω) :=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving U hf

lpPullback_norm.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem lpPullback_norm (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖lpPullbackCLM hf U‖ = ‖U‖
lpPullback_norm.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem lpPullback_norm (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    ‖lpPullbackCLM hf U‖ = ‖U‖ := Lp.norm_compMeasurePreserving U hf

lpPullback_comp.exact_header:
theorem lpPullback_comp {Ω'' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω'']
    {Q'' : Measure Ω''} {g : Ω'' → Ω'}
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (hg : MeasurePreserving g Q'' Q')
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hg (lpPullbackCLM hf U) = lpPullbackCLM (hf.comp hg) U
lpPullback_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem lpPullback_comp {Ω'' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω'']
    {Q'' : Measure Ω''} {g : Ω'' → Ω'}
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (hg : MeasurePreserving g Q'' Q')
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hg (lpPullbackCLM hf U) = lpPullbackCLM (hf.comp hg) U :=
  (Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply U hf hg).symm

lpPullback_liftMap.exact_header:
theorem lpPullback_liftMap [IsFiniteMeasure Q] [IsFiniteMeasure Q']
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (g : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hg : LipschitzWith L g) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hf (liftMap Q g hg U) =
      liftMap Q' g hg (lpPullbackCLM hf U)
lpPullback_liftMap.exact_declaration:
theorem lpPullback_liftMap [IsFiniteMeasure Q] [IsFiniteMeasure Q']
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (g : E → K) {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hg : LipschitzWith L g) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    lpPullbackCLM hf (liftMap Q g hg U) =
      liftMap Q' g hg (lpPullbackCLM hf U) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (liftMap Q g hg U),
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (liftMap_coe Q g hg U),
    liftMap_coe Q' g hg (lpPullbackCLM hf U), lpPullback_coe hf U]
    with ω h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change (liftMap Q g hg U) (f ω) = g (U (f ω)) at h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]

lpPullback_integral.exact_header:
theorem lpPullback_integral [IsFiniteMeasure Q] [IsFiniteMeasure Q']
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, lpPullbackCLM hf U ω ∂Q') = ∫ ω, U ω ∂Q
lpPullback_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem lpPullback_integral [IsFiniteMeasure Q] [IsFiniteMeasure Q']
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp E 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, lpPullbackCLM hf U ω ∂Q') = ∫ ω, U ω ∂Q := by
  rw [integral_congr_ae (lpPullback_coe hf U)]
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => U ω) (Q'.map f) := by
    rw [hf.map_eq]
    exact Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U
  exact (integral_map hf.measurable.aemeasurable hm).symm.trans
    (by rw [hf.map_eq])

jointPullbackCLM.exact_header:
def jointPullbackCLM (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) :
    (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] (A × Lp Z 2 Q')
jointPullbackCLM.exact_declaration:
def jointPullbackCLM (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) :
    (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] (A × Lp Z 2 Q') :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)).prod
    ((lpPullbackCLM hf).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Lp Z 2 Q)))

jointPullback_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem jointPullback_apply (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : jointPullbackCLM hf y = (y.1, lpPullbackCLM hf y.2)
jointPullback_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem jointPullback_apply (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : jointPullbackCLM hf y = (y.1, lpPullbackCLM hf y.2) := rfl

expectedObservation_pullback.exact_header:
theorem expectedObservation_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (a : A) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    L.expectedObservation Q' a (lpPullbackCLM hf U) =
      L.expectedObservation Q a U
expectedObservation_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem expectedObservation_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (a : A) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    L.expectedObservation Q' a (lpPullbackCLM hf U) =
      L.expectedObservation Q a U := by
  unfold LipschitzDynamics.expectedObservation
  rw [← lpPullback_liftMap hf]
  exact lpPullback_integral hf _

field_pullback.exact_header:
theorem field_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    L.field Q' (jointPullbackCLM hf y) = jointPullbackCLM hf (L.field Q y)
field_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem field_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) :
    L.field Q' (jointPullbackCLM hf y) = jointPullbackCLM hf (L.field Q y) := by
  simp only [LipschitzDynamics.field, jointPullback_apply,
    expectedObservation_pullback hf, lpPullback_liftMap hf]

integral_solution_pullback.exact_header:
theorem integral_solution_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (initial : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (T : ℝ) (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
      (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q (Y r)) + (0, B t)) :
    Continuous (fun t => jointPullbackCLM hf (Y t)) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, jointPullbackCLM hf (Y t) - jointPullbackCLM hf initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q' (jointPullbackCLM hf (Y r))) +
          (0, lpPullbackCLM hf (B t))
integral_solution_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_solution_pullback (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q)
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (initial : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (Y : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (T : ℝ) (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
      (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q (Y r)) + (0, B t)) :
    Continuous (fun t => jointPullbackCLM hf (Y t)) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, jointPullbackCLM hf (Y t) - jointPullbackCLM hf initial =
        (∫ r in 0..t, L.field Q' (jointPullbackCLM hf (Y r))) +
          (0, lpPullbackCLM hf (B t)) := by
  refine ⟨(jointPullbackCLM hf).continuous.comp hY, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => L.field Q (Y r)) volume 0 t :=
    ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp hY).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h := congrArg (jointPullbackCLM hf) (heq t ht)
  rw [map_sub, map_add, ← (jointPullbackCLM hf).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi] at h
  simpa only [← field_pullback hf, jointPullback_apply] using h

lpPullback_law.exact_header:
theorem lpPullback_law (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Q'.map (lpPullbackCLM hf U) = Q.map U
lpPullback_law.exact_declaration:
theorem lpPullback_law (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q' Q) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    Q'.map (lpPullbackCLM hf U) = Q.map U := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (lpPullback_coe hf U)]
  change Q'.map ((fun ω => U ω) ∘ f) = Q.map U
  rw [← Measure.map_map (Lp.stronglyMeasurable U).measurable hf.measurable, hf.map_eq]

PBGSO/MartingaleCountableMaximal.lean.scope_note: No observation ordering, process time continuity or maximal inequality is assumed. This is a countable-observation estimate; extending a martingale to simultaneous continuous sample paths requires a separate construction.
PBGSO/MartingaleCountableMaximal.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.MartingaleMaximalL2
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort

/-! # Maximal bounds on arbitrary finite and countable observation sets
Finite times are sorted internally and a terminal time is appended. Increasing
unions then give the same bound for any countable family of earlier times.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.MartingaleMaximalL2
variable {Ω H ι : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [LinearOrder ι]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
  (X : ι → Ω → H) (hX : Martingale X F Q)
  (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 Q)

include hX h2

/-- Any finite observation set has its terminal L² maximal bound, without an
ordering premise on the input observations. -/

/-- A countable family of observations is controlled by the same actual
terminal second moment, without a time-continuity assumption. -/

end PBGSO.MartingaleMaximalL2

maximal_finset.exact_header:
theorem maximal_finset (s : Finset ι) (T : ι) (hs : ∀ t ∈ s, t ≤ T) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ s, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
maximal_finset.exact_declaration:
theorem maximal_finset (s : Finset ι) (T : ι) (hs : ∀ t ∈ s, t ≤ T) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ s, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  classical
  let τ : ℕ → ι := fun n => if hn : n < s.card then s.orderEmbOfFin rfl ⟨n, hn⟩ else T
  have hτ : Monotone τ := by
    intro i j hij
    dsimp [τ]
    split_ifs with hi hj
    · exact (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).monotone hij
    · exact hs _ (s.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl _)
    · omega
    · rfl
  have hT : τ s.card = T := by simp [τ]
  have hd := maximal_grid Q hX h2 τ hτ a s.card
  rw [hT] at hd
  apply le_trans ?_ hd
  apply mul_le_mul_right
  apply measure_mono
  intro ω hω
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hta⟩ := hω
  have ht' : t ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact ht
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ht'
  change (a : ℝ) ≤ (Finset.range (s.card + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
    (fun k => ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ^ 2)
  apply hta.trans
  have he : τ j.val = t := by simp only [τ, dif_pos j.isLt, hj]
  rw [← he]
  exact Finset.le_sup' (fun k => ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ^ 2) (by simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega)

maximal_countable.exact_header:
theorem maximal_countable (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ n, τ n ≤ T) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | ∃ n, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
maximal_countable.exact_declaration:
theorem maximal_countable (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ n, τ n ≤ T) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | ∃ n, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  classical
  let A : ℕ → Set Ω := fun n => {ω | ∃ k ≤ n, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ^ 2}
  have hA : Monotone A := by
    intro m n hmn ω hω
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hka⟩ := hω
    exact ⟨k, hk.trans hmn, hka⟩
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q (A n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
    have hf := maximal_finset Q F X hX h2 ((Finset.range (n + 1)).image τ) T
      (by intro t ht; obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht; exact hτ k) a
    have he : A n = {ω | ∃ t ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).image τ,
        (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [A, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      aesop
    rw [he]
    exact hf
  have he : {ω | ∃ n, (a : ℝ) ≤ ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2} = ⋃ n, A n := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, A]
    aesop
  rw [he, hA.measure_iUnion, ENNReal.mul_iSup]
  exact iSup_le hb

open MeasureTheory Filter

projection and uniqueness of limits. -/

project.exact_header: def project (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) : Lp Z 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp Z 2 Q

project_coe.exact_header:
theorem project_coe (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := mΩ
    project Q m hm U =ᵐ[Q] Q[U | m]
project_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem project_coe (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := mΩ
    project Q m hm U =ᵐ[Q] Q[U | m] := by
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := mΩ
  have h := (Lp.memLp U).condExpL2_ae_eq_condExp (𝕜 := ℝ) hm
  change (condExpL2 Z ℝ hm U : Ω → Z) =ᵐ[Q] Q[U | m]
  simpa only [Lp.toLp_coeFn] using h

project_toLp.exact_header:
theorem project_toLp (F : Filtration ι mΩ) (f : ι → Ω → Z)
    (hf : Martingale f F Q) (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (s t : ι) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    project Q (F s) (F.le s) ((h2 t).toLp (f t)) = (h2 s).toLp (f s)
project_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem project_toLp (F : Filtration ι mΩ) (f : ι → Ω → Z)
    (hf : Martingale f F Q) (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (f t) 2 Q)
    (s t : ι) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    project Q (F s) (F.le s) ((h2 t).toLp (f t)) = (h2 s).toLp (f s) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  exact (project_coe Q (F s) (F.le s) _).trans
    ((condExp_congr_ae (h2 t).coeFn_toLp).trans
      ((hf.condExp_ae_eq hst).trans (h2 s).coeFn_toLp.symm))

project_limit.exact_header:
theorem project_limit (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (s t : ι) (hst : s ≤ t) : project Q (F s) (F.le s) (X t) = X s
project_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem project_limit (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (s t : ι) (hst : s ≤ t) : project Q (F s) (F.le s) (X t) = X s := by
  have hp := ((project Q (F s) (F.le s)).continuous.tendsto (X t)).comp (hlim t)
  have he : (fun n => project Q (F s) (F.le s) ((h2 n t).toLp (f n t))) =
      (fun n => (h2 n s).toLp (f n s)) :=
    funext fun n => project_toLp Q F (f n) (hf n) (h2 n) s t hst
  change Tendsto (fun n => project Q (F s) (F.le s) ((h2 n t).toLp (f n t))) _ _ at hp
  rw [he] at hp
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hp (hlim s)

representative.exact_header: def representative (F : Filtration ι mΩ) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ι) : Ω → Z
representative.exact_declaration:
def representative (F : Filtration ι mΩ) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ι) : Ω → Z :=
  Q[X t | F t]

representative_ae.exact_header:
theorem representative_ae (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (t : ι) : representative Q F X t =ᵐ[Q] X t
representative_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem representative_ae (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (t : ι) : representative Q F X t =ᵐ[Q] X t := by
  have he := project_limit Q F f hf h2 X hlim t t le_rfl
  exact (project_coe Q (F t) (F.le t) (X t)).symm.trans (by rw [he])

martingale_representative.exact_header:
theorem martingale_representative (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t))) :
    Martingale (representative Q F X) F Q
martingale_representative.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_representative (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t))) :
    Martingale (representative Q F X) F Q := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    exact stronglyMeasurable_condExp
  · intro s t hst
    have ht := representative_ae Q F f hf h2 X hlim t
    have hs := representative_ae Q F f hf h2 X hlim s
    have he := project_limit Q F f hf h2 X hlim s t hst
    exact (condExp_congr_ae ht).trans
      ((project_coe Q (F s) (F.le s) (X t)).symm.trans
        ((by rw [he] : project Q (F s) (F.le s) (X t) =ᵐ[Q] X s).trans hs.symm))

representative_memLp.exact_header:
theorem representative_memLp (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (t : ι) : MemLp (representative Q F X t) 2 Q
representative_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem representative_memLp (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
    (f : ℕ → ι → Ω → Z) (hf : ∀ n, Martingale (f n) F Q)
    (h2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (f n t) 2 Q) (X : ι → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hlim : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => (h2 n t).toLp (f n t)) atTop (𝓝 (X t)))
    (t : ι) : MemLp (representative Q F X t) 2 Q :=
  (memLp_congr_ae (representative_ae Q F f hf h2 X hlim t)).mpr (Lp.memLp (X t))

/-! # Maximal control from actual square-integrable martingales
Conditional Jensen produces the squared-norm submartingale. Doob's maximal
inequality then bounds any finite observation grid by its terminal L² energy.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.MartingaleMaximalL2
variable {Ω H ι : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Preorder ι]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ι mΩ)
  (X : ι → Ω → H) (hX : Martingale X F Q)
  (h2 : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 Q)

include hX h2 in
/-- Squared norms of actual square-integrable martingales are submartingales. -/

variable {F X}

/-- A monotone observation grid carries the actual sampled filtration. -/
/-- Weak L² maximal inequality on every finite monotone observation grid.
This applies to actual computed Itô martingales without a maximal-bound premise. -/

end PBGSO.MartingaleMaximalL2

norm_sq_submartingale.exact_header: theorem norm_sq_submartingale : Submartingale (fun t ω => ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2) F Q
norm_sq_submartingale.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_sq_submartingale : Submartingale (fun t ω => ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2) F Q := by
  have hi (t : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => ‖X t ω‖ ^ 2) Q :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (h2 t).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (h2 t)
  refine ⟨fun t => (hX.stronglyAdapted t).norm.pow 2, ?_, hi⟩
  intro s t hst
  have hj := _root_.Integrable.norm_condExp_rpow_le (μ := Q) (m := F s) (f := X t)
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by simpa only [Real.rpow_two] using hi t)
  simp only [Real.rpow_two] at hj
  filter_upwards [hj, hX.condExp_ae_eq hst] with ω hω he
  rw [he] at hω
  exact hω

sampledFiltration.exact_header: def sampledFiltration (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ
sampledFiltration.exact_declaration:
def sampledFiltration (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) : Filtration ℕ mΩ where
  seq n := F (τ n)
  mono' _ _ h := F.mono (hτ h)
  le' n := F.le (τ n)

include hX in

sampled_martingale.exact_header:
theorem sampled_martingale (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    Martingale (fun n => X (τ n)) (sampledFiltration (F := F) τ hτ) Q
sampled_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem sampled_martingale (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) :
    Martingale (fun n => X (τ n)) (sampledFiltration (F := F) τ hτ) Q :=
  ⟨fun n => hX.stronglyAdapted (τ n), fun i j h => hX.condExp_ae_eq (hτ h)⟩

include hX h2 in

maximal_grid.exact_header:
theorem maximal_grid (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) (a : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | (a : ℝ) ≤
      (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ^ 2)} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q)
maximal_grid.exact_declaration:
theorem maximal_grid (τ : ℕ → ι) (hτ : Monotone τ) (a : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (a : ℝ≥0∞) * Q {ω | (a : ℝ) ≤
      (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ^ 2)} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖X (τ n) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  have hm := norm_sq_submartingale Q (sampledFiltration (F := F) τ hτ)
    (fun n => X (τ n)) (sampled_martingale Q hX τ hτ) (fun n => h2 (τ n))
  have hd := maximal_ineq hm (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (ε := a) n
  exact hd.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (setIntegral_le_integral (hm.integrable n)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => sq_nonneg _)))

This generic Borel-Cantelli foundation uses actual dense-observation maximal
probabilities and actual continuity of the approximating sample paths.
It assumes neither uniform convergence nor continuity of the limit.

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology

/-- The telescoping-series candidate is defined everywhere; its actual
convergence and continuity hold on the single full-measure event proved below. -/

/-- Summable maximal tail probabilities on a dense observation set imply

seriesLimit.exact_header: def seriesLimit (f : ℕ → T → Ω → H) (t : T) (ω : Ω) : H
seriesLimit.exact_declaration:
def seriesLimit (f : ℕ → T → Ω → H) (t : T) (ω : Ω) : H :=
  (∑' n, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)) + f 0 t ω

ae_uniform_seriesLimit.exact_header:
theorem ae_uniform_seriesLimit (f : ℕ → T → Ω → H) (S : Set T) (hS : Dense S)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : Summable δ)
    (hbad : (∑' n, Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ S, δ n ≤ ‖f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω‖}) ≠ ∞)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n t => f n t ω) (fun t => seriesLimit f t ω) atTop ∧
      Continuous (fun t => seriesLimit f t ω)
ae_uniform_seriesLimit.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_uniform_seriesLimit (f : ℕ → T → Ω → H) (S : Set T) (hS : Dense S)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : Summable δ)
    (hbad : (∑' n, Q {ω | ∃ t ∈ S, δ n ≤ ‖f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω‖}) ≠ ∞)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, Continuous (fun t => f n t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, TendstoUniformly (fun n t => f n t ω) (fun t => seriesLimit f t ω) atTop ∧
      Continuous (fun t => seriesLimit f t ω) := by
  have hBC := ae_eventually_notMem hbad
  filter_upwards [hc, hBC] with ω hcont hevent
  have hb : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t : T, ‖f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω‖ ≤ δ n := by
    filter_upwards [hevent] with n hn
    intro t
    apply hS.induction (P := fun t => ‖f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω‖ ≤ δ n) (x := t)
    · intro t ht
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hn ⟨t, ht, h⟩))
    · exact isClosed_le ((hcont (n + 1)).sub (hcont n)).norm continuous_const
  have hs := tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat_eventually hδ
    (s := Set.univ) (f := fun n t => f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)
    (hb.mono (fun _ hn t _ => hn t))
  have hs' : TendstoUniformly (fun N t => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω))
      (fun t => ∑' n, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)) atTop := by
    simpa only [tendstoUniformlyOn_univ] using hs
  have h0 : TendstoUniformly (fun _ : ℕ => fun t => f 0 t ω) (fun t => f 0 t ω) atTop :=
    by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
      intro ε hε
      exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ => by simpa only [dist_self] using hε)
  have hu := hs'.add h0
  change TendstoUniformly (fun N t =>
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)) + f 0 t ω)
    (fun t => (∑' n, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)) + f 0 t ω) atTop at hu
  have hsum (N : ℕ) (t : T) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (f (n + 1) t ω - f n t ω)) + f 0 t ω = f N t ω := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => f n t ω) N, sub_add_cancel]
  have hu' : TendstoUniformly (fun n t => f n t ω) (fun t => seriesLimit f t ω) atTop := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply, hsum, seriesLimit] using hu
  exact ⟨hu', hu'.continuous (Frequently.of_forall hcont)⟩

stoppedGridSum_continuous_paths.exact_header:
theorem stoppedGridSum_continuous_paths (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω)
stoppedGridSum_continuous_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedGridSum_continuous_paths (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω) := by
  filter_upwards [hB] with ω hω
  have he : (fun t => stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n t ω) =
      fun t => ∑ i, BrownianGridIsometry.gridSum (D.process i) (fun k => min t (τ k))
        (fun k => (A k).value i) n ω := by
    funext t
    exact stoppedGridSum_columns_clamp Q D τ hτ A n t ω
  rw [he]
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro k _
  exact (((hω i).comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const)).sub
    ((hω i).comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const))).smul continuous_const

PBGSO/MeanFieldContraction.lean.scope_note: Assume a probability space and complete real Banach coordinates, LipschitzDynamics, time-independent primitive maps, a common continuous L² sampler input starting at zero, a continuous linear metric map into a Hilbert space, positive lower and nonnegative upper norm-comparison constants, and the stated joint drift inequality. import PBGSO.GeneralProcess
import PBGSO.AdditiveContraction

/-! # Constructed general mean-field dynamics with exponential contraction

The hypotheses are primitive global Lipschitz bounds, joint monotonicity of
the constructed drift in a specified quadratic metric, and a common continuous
L² additive sampler input. Both solutions are constructed by Picard; no
energy derivative inequality or pre-existing solution is assumed. This is an
additive-input result, not the paper's full multiplicative-noise theorem.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace PBGSO.LipschitzDynamics

variable {Ω A Z G H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  (D : PBGSO.LipschitzDynamics A Z G)

/-- Existence and contraction of actual general mean-field integral solutions.
The optimiser receives no additive input. `C` specifies the full twisted
metric and its lower and upper comparison constants are explicit. -/

end PBGSO.LipschitzDynamics

exists_contracting_pair.exact_header:
theorem exists_contracting_pair (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (C : (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ lower upper : ℝ)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hLower : ∀ x, lower * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C x‖ ^ 2)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hJoint : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (D.field Q x - D.field Q y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖Y t - W t‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖initial - other‖)
exists_contracting_pair.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_contracting_pair (initial other : A × Lp Z 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (C : (A × Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] H) (ρ lower upper : ℝ)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hLower : ∀ x, lower * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C x‖ ^ 2)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ‖C x‖ ^ 2 ≤ upper * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    (hJoint : ∀ x y,
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (D.field Q x - D.field Q y)) ≤
        -ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y W : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q,
      Continuous Y ∧ Continuous W ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧ W 0 = other ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (Y s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, W t - other =
        (∫ s in 0..t, D.field Q (W s)) + (0, B t)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖Y t - W t‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖initial - other‖) := by
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYi, heY⟩ := D.exists_integral Q initial B hB hB0 T hT
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWi, heW⟩ := D.exists_integral Q other B hB hB0 T hT
  refine ⟨Y, W, hY, hW, hYi, hWi, heY, heW, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hg : LipschitzWith D.fieldLip (fun s => -D.field Q s) :=
    (D.field_lipschitz Q).neg
  have hm (x y : A × Lp Z 2 Q) : ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      inner ℝ (C (x - y)) (C (-D.field Q x - -D.field Q y)) := by
    have hn : -D.field Q x - -D.field Q y = -(D.field Q x - D.field Q y) := by abel
    rw [hn, map_neg, inner_neg_right]
    linarith [hJoint x y]
  have he := PBGSO.additive_integral_contraction_with_condition_number
    (fun s => -D.field Q s) D.fieldLip hg C ρ lower upper hlower hupper
    hLower hUpper hm Y W (fun s => (0, B s)) hY hW T
    (fun s hs => by simpa [hYi] using heY s hs)
    (fun s hs => by simpa [hWi] using heW s hs) t ht
  simpa only [hYi, hWi] using he

brownianLangevinNoise_coe.exact_header:
theorem brownianLangevinNoise_coe
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt 2 • (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal ω -
        ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal ω)
brownianLangevinNoise_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem brownianLangevinNoise_coe
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt 2 • (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal ω -
        ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal ω) := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt 2)
      (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t) - ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a),
    Lp.coeFn_sub (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t))
      (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a),
    ULA.brownianCoordinatesLp_coe Q W hW (a + t).toNNReal,
    ULA.brownianCoordinatesLp_coe Q W hW a.toNNReal] with ω hs hd ht ha
  change (Real.sqrt 2 • (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t) -
    ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a)) ω = _
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [hd]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp]
  rw [ht, ha]

momentumHalfNoise_sum_brownian.exact_header:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_sum_brownian
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k) +
      momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h
momentumHalfNoise_sum_brownian.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_sum_brownian
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k) +
      momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k + 1)) =
      Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h := by
  have ht0 : ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal = ((k : ℝ) * h).toNNReal := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ h / 2),
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le)]
    push_cast
    ring
  have ht1 : ((2 * k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal = ((k : ℝ) * h + h).toNNReal := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ h / 2),
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * h + h)]
    push_cast
    ring
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt (γ * h))
      (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k) + momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k + 1)),
    Lp.coeFn_add (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k)) (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k + 1)),
    Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt γ) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h),
    brownianLangevinNoise_coe Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i ↦ momentumHalfNoise_brownian_increment Q W hW γ h hγ hh k i)]
    with ω hs ha hr hb hcoord
  rw [hs, hr]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [ha, hb]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change Real.sqrt (γ * h) * (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k) ω i +
    momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * k + 1) ω i) =
    Real.sqrt γ * (Real.sqrt 2 * (W i (((k : ℝ) * h + h).toNNReal) ω -
      W i (((k : ℝ) * h).toNNReal) ω))
  rw [hcoord i, ht0, ht1, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.sqrt_mul hγ,
    mul_comm γ 2]

momentumGaussianIncrement_brownian.exact_header:
theorem momentumGaussianIncrement_brownian
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Θ) Q W hW γ h k =
      (0, Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h)
momentumGaussianIncrement_brownian.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumGaussianIncrement_brownian
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Θ) Q W hW γ h k =
      (0, Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW ((k : ℝ) * h) h) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change Real.sqrt (γ * h) • ((0 : Θ) + 0) = 0
    simp
  · exact momentumHalfNoise_sum_brownian Q W hW γ h hγ hh k

higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement_bro.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement_brownian (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3 =
      Real.sqrt α • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf) (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf)
        (a : ℝ) (h : ℝ)
higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement_bro.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement_brownian (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (a h : ℝ≥0) :
    holPullbackVectorNoise I hf α γ a h 3 =
      Real.sqrt α • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf) (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf)
        (a : ℝ) (h : ℝ) := by
  have hc : holVectorNoise I α γ a h 3 =ᵐ[ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I]
      fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt (2 * α) • WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i ↦
        ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (a + h) ω - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i a ω) := by
    rw [holVectorNoise_brownian]
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt (2 * α))
        (KineticLangevin.BrownianConvolution.vectorBrownianIncrementLp I a h),
      KineticLangevin.BrownianConvolution.vectorBrownianIncrementLp_coe I a h] with ω hs hv
    rw [hs]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
    rw [hv]
  have ht : ((a : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)).toNNReal = a + h := by
    apply NNReal.eq
    simp only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (add_nonneg a.coe_nonneg h.coe_nonneg), NNReal.coe_add]
  have ha : (a : ℝ).toNNReal = a := by simp
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hf (holVectorNoise I α γ a h 3),
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hc,
    Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt α) (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q
      (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf) (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf) a h),
    brownianLangevinNoise_coe Q (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf)
      (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf) a h] with ω hp hc hs hb
  change (lpPullbackCLM hf (holVectorNoise I α γ a h 3)) ω = _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hc
  rw [hp, hc, hs]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [hb]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change Real.sqrt (2 * α) *
      (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (a + h) (f ω) - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i a (f ω)) =
    Real.sqrt α * (Real.sqrt 2 *
      (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf i (((a : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)).toNNReal) ω -
        canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf i (a : ℝ).toNNReal ω))
  rw [ht, ha]
  change _ = Real.sqrt α * (Real.sqrt 2 *
    (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i (a + h) (f ω) - ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate i a (f ω)))
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  ring

integral_shift.exact_header:
theorem integral_shift (Y F B : ℝ → E) (hF : Continuous F)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, F r) + B t)
    (a h : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    Y (a + h) - Y a = (∫ r in 0..h, F (a + r)) + (B (a + h) - B a)
integral_shift.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_shift (Y F B : ℝ → E) (hF : Continuous F)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, F r) + B t)
    (a h : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    Y (a + h) - Y a = (∫ r in 0..h, F (a + r)) + (B (a + h) - B a) := by
  have hi : (∫ r in 0..a + h, F r) - (∫ r in 0..a, F r) = ∫ r in a..a + h, F r := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hF.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hF.intervalIntegrable a (a + h))]
    abel
  have hy : Y (a + h) - Y a = (∫ r in a..a + h, F r) + (B (a + h) - B a) := by
    calc
      _ = (Y (a + h) - Y 0) - (Y a - Y 0) := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [heq (a + h) (add_nonneg ha hh), heq a ha, ← hi]; abel
  rw [hy]
  have hshift : (∫ r in a..a + h, F r) = ∫ r in 0..h, F (a + r) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left
      (f := F) (a := 0) (b := h) a).symm
  rw [hshift]

momentumInput.exact_declaration:
def momentumInput (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ t : ℝ) : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) :=
  ((0, Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 t), (0, 0))

brownianNoise_increment.exact_header:
theorem brownianNoise_increment (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a h : ℝ) :
    ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 (a + h) - ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 a =
      ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a h
brownianNoise_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem brownianNoise_increment (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a h : ℝ) :
    ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 (a + h) - ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 a =
      ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a h := by
  simp only [ULA.brownianLangevinNoise, zero_add]
  module

momentumInput_increment.exact_header:
theorem momentumInput_increment
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    momentumInput (A := A) Q W hW γ ((k : ℝ) * h + h) - momentumInput Q W hW γ ((k : ℝ) * h) =
      (momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW γ h k, (0, 0))
momentumInput_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumInput_increment
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (k : ℕ) :
    momentumInput (A := A) Q W hW γ ((k : ℝ) * h + h) - momentumInput Q W hW γ ((k : ℝ) * h) =
      (momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW γ h k, (0, 0)) := by
  rw [momentumGaussianIncrement_brownian Q W hW γ h hγ hh k]
  change ((0 - 0, Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 ((k : ℝ) * h + h) -
      Real.sqrt γ • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 ((k : ℝ) * h)), (0 - 0, 0 - 0)) = _
  rw [← smul_sub, brownianNoise_increment]
  simp

higherOrderInput.exact_header: def higherOrderInput (α t : ℝ) : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)

higherOrderInput_increment.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderInput_increment (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (h : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    higherOrderInput (A := A) Q hf α ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)) -
      higherOrderInput Q hf α ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) =
        holBrownianIncrement (higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement I hf α γ h k)
higherOrderInput_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrderInput_increment (α γ : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (h : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    higherOrderInput (A := A) Q hf α ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)) -
      higherOrderInput Q hf α ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) =
        holBrownianIncrement (higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement I hf α γ h k) := by
  have hn : higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement I hf α γ h k =
      Real.sqrt α • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q
        (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf) (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf)
        ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ)) (h : ℝ) :=
    higherOrderPullbackGaussianIncrement_brownian Q hf α γ hα ((k : ℝ≥0) * h) h
  rw [hn]
  change (0 - 0, 0 - 0, 0 - 0,
    Real.sqrt α • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf)
      (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf) 0 ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) + (h : ℝ)) -
    Real.sqrt α • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q (canonicalPullbackCoordinate I hf)
      (canonicalPullbackCoordinate_isPreBrownian I hf) 0 ((k : ℝ) * (h : ℝ))) = _
  rw [← smul_sub, brownianNoise_increment]
  simp [holBrownianIncrement]

pairJoinLp.exact_header: def pairJoinLp : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) →L[ℝ] Lp (A × C) 2 Q
pairJoinLp.exact_declaration:
def pairJoinLp : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) →L[ℝ] Lp (A × C) 2 Q :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).compLpL 2 Q).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) +
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).compLpL 2 Q).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q))

pairJoinLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem pairJoinLp_coe (z : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    pairJoinLp Q z =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => (z.1 ω,z.2 ω)
pairJoinLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem pairJoinLp_coe (z : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    pairJoinLp Q z =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => (z.1 ω,z.2 ω) :=
  pairLp_coe Q z.1 z.2

phaseJoinLp.exact_header:
def phaseJoinLp : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]

phaseJoinLp.exact_declaration:
def phaseJoinLp : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]
    Lp ((A × C) × (A × C)) 2 Q :=
  (pairJoinLp (A := A × C) (C := A × C) Q).comp
    ((pairJoinLp (A := A) (C := C) Q).prodMap (pairJoinLp (A := A) (C := C) Q))

phaseJoinLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem phaseJoinLp_coe
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :

phaseJoinLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem phaseJoinLp_coe
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    phaseJoinLp Q z =ᵐ[Q] phaseValue Q z := by
  filter_upwards [pairJoinLp_coe Q (pairJoinLp Q z.1,pairJoinLp Q z.2),
    pairJoinLp_coe Q z.1,pairJoinLp_coe Q z.2] with ω h h1 h2
  exact h.trans (Prod.ext h1 h2)

mapLpEquiv.exact_header: def mapLpEquiv (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) : Lp E 2 Q ≃L[ℝ] Lp F 2 Q
mapLpEquiv.exact_declaration:
def mapLpEquiv (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) : Lp E 2 Q ≃L[ℝ] Lp F 2 Q where
  toFun := e.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
  invFun := e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q
  left_inv := by
    intro x
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (e.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q x),e.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL x]
      with ω h1 h2
    exact h1.trans (by rw [h2]; exact e.symm_apply_apply _)
  right_inv := by
    intro x
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [e.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL
      (e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q x),e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL x]
      with ω h1 h2
    exact h1.trans (by rw [h2]; exact e.apply_symm_apply _)
  map_add' := (e.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).map_add
  map_smul' := (e.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).map_smul
  continuous_toFun := (e.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).continuous
  continuous_invFun := (e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q).continuous

momentumPackLp_drift.exact_header:
theorem momentumPackLp_drift (γ : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    momentumPackLp Q D
      (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2-γ • z.1,z.1) =
      ULA.lpDrift Q ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField N)
        ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty)
        (momentumPackLp Q D z)
momentumPackLp_drift.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumPackLp_drift (γ : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    momentumPackLp Q D
      (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2-γ • z.1,z.1) =
      ULA.lpDrift Q ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField N)
        ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty)
        (momentumPackLp Q D z) := by
  have he := congrArg (momentumPackLp Q D)
    (momentumUnpackLp_drift Q D γ (momentumPackLp Q D z))
  simpa only [momentumPack_unpack,momentumUnpack_pack] using he.symm

higherOrderPackLp_drift.exact_header:
theorem higherOrderPackLp_drift (α γ : ℝ) (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) :
    higherOrderPackLp Q D (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ z) =
      ULA.lpDrift Q ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField N)
        ((higherOrderForceDynamics D α γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty)
        (higherOrderPackLp Q D z)

theorem momentum_point_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)

    ‖(oneEquiv N).symm (momentumEncodedStateEquiv D z)‖^2=

theorem momentum_point_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)

momentum_lp_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem momentum_lp_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖^2=
      ‖z.1.1‖^2+‖z.1.2‖^2+‖z.2.1‖^2+‖z.2.2‖^2
momentum_lp_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_lp_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖^2=
      ‖z.1.1‖^2+‖z.1.2‖^2+‖z.2.1‖^2+‖z.2.2‖^2 := by
  let E := oneEquiv (S := HypocoercivePhase A)
    (Z := HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)) N
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω‖^2=
      ‖z.1.1 ω‖^2+‖z.1.2 ω‖^2+‖z.2.1 ω‖^2+‖z.2.2 ω‖^2 := by
    filter_upwards [E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (momentumPackLp Q D z),
      momentumPackLp_coe Q D z] with ω h1 h2
    change ‖E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (momentumPackLp Q D z) ω‖^2=_
    rw [h1,h2]
    exact momentum_point_norm_sq D hcloud (phaseValue Q z ω)
  have hi₁ := (Lp.memLp z.1.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hi₂ := (Lp.memLp z.1.2).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hi₃ := (Lp.memLp z.2.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hi₄ := (Lp.memLp z.2.2).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q]
  have e₄ := integral_add ((hi₁.add hi₂).add hi₃) hi₄
  have e₃ := integral_add (hi₁.add hi₂) hi₃
  have e₂ := integral_add hi₁ hi₂
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at e₄ e₃ e₂
  rw [integral_congr_ae hae,e₄,e₃,e₂]
  simp only [← ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q]

theorem higherOrder_lp_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)

    ‖higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖^2=

theorem higherOrder_lp_norm_sq (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q)) :
    ‖higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖^2=
      ‖z.1‖^2+‖z.2.1‖^2+‖z.2.2.1‖^2+‖z.2.2.2‖^2 := by
  let E := oneEquiv (S := A) (Z := HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)) N
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ‖higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z ω‖^2=
      ‖z.1 ω‖^2+‖z.2.1 ω‖^2+‖z.2.2.1 ω‖^2+‖z.2.2.2 ω‖^2 := by
    filter_upwards [E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.coeFn_compLpL (higherOrderPackLp Q D z),

    change ‖E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.compLpL 2 Q (higherOrderPackLp Q D z) ω‖^2=_
    rw [h1,h2]
    exact higherOrder_point_norm_sq D hcloud (holValue Q z ω)

  have hi₂ := (Lp.memLp z.2.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hi₃ := (Lp.memLp z.2.2.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hi₄ := (Lp.memLp z.2.2.2).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q]
  have e₄ := integral_add ((hi₁.add hi₂).add hi₃) hi₄
  have e₃ := integral_add (hi₁.add hi₂) hi₃
  have e₂ := integral_add hi₁ hi₂
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at e₄ e₃ e₂
  rw [integral_congr_ae hae,e₄,e₃,e₂]
  simp only [← ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q]

momentum_norm_le_two.exact_header:
theorem momentum_norm_le_two (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖≤2*‖z‖
momentum_norm_le_two.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_norm_le_two (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖≤2*‖z‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity : 0≤2*‖z‖)).mp
  rw [momentum_lp_norm_sq Q D hcloud]
  have h₁ := (norm_fst_le z.1).trans (norm_fst_le z)
  have h₂ := (norm_snd_le z.1).trans (norm_fst_le z)
  have h₃ := (norm_fst_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z)
  have h₄ := (norm_snd_le z.2).trans (norm_snd_le z)
  have h₁' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₁
  have h₂' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₂
  have h₃' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₃
  have h₄' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₄
  nlinarith only [h₁',h₂',h₃',h₄']

  have h₄ := ((norm_snd_le z.2.2).trans (norm_snd_le z.2)).trans (norm_snd_le z)
  have h₁' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₁
  have h₂' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₂
  have h₃' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₃
  have h₄' := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr h₄

theorem momentum_norm_ge (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖z‖≤‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖
momentum_norm_ge.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_norm_ge (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q))) :
    ‖z‖≤‖momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z‖ := by
  have he := momentum_lp_norm_sq Q D hcloud z
  have hp := norm_nonneg (momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D z)
