momentum_metric_explicit.exact_header:
theorem momentum_metric_explicit (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))
    (G : TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/2)*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(2*Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) x.2-γ • x.1,x.1)-
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) y.2-γ • y.1,y.1))⟫_ℝ
          ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2)
momentum_metric_explicit.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_metric_explicit (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (γ : ℝ) (σ : I → HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))
    (G : TwistedGeometry (HypocoercivePhase A) (HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J)))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (heavyBallModel γ D.F D.G σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) ×
      (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q)) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/2)*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(2*Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) x.2-γ • x.1,x.1)-
        (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) y.2-γ • y.1,y.1))⟫_ℝ
          ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,T,hl,hu,hm⟩ := ImplementationMetric.momentum_metric Q D γ σ G ρ hmono
  refine ⟨n,T,?_,?_,hm⟩
  · intro x
    apply le_trans _ (hl x)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg x)
    have hden : ‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1≤2 := by
      linarith [momentum_inverse_opNorm_le_one Q D hcloud]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (by positivity : 0<‖(momentumPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1) hden
  · intro x
    apply (hu x).trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg x)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (momentum_opNorm_le_two Q D hcloud)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))]

higherOrder_metric_explicit.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_metric_explicit (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ J)
    (G : TwistedGeometry A (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/2)*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(2*Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ x-
        holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2)
higherOrder_metric_explicit.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_metric_explicit (hcloud : D.cloud = euclideanParticleEncoding N J)
    (α γ : ℝ) (σ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ J)
    (G : TwistedGeometry A (HigherOrderSampler (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity (higherOrderModel D.F D.G α γ σ) G ρ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N × J)) 2 Q) →L[ℝ]
        Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 2 Q,
      (∀ x, (Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.lower N G)/2)*‖x‖≤‖T x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T x‖≤(2*Real.sqrt (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))*‖x‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ⟪T (x-y),T (holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ x-
        holDrift (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖T (x-y)‖^2) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,T,hl,hu,hm⟩ := ImplementationMetric.higherOrder_metric Q D α γ σ G ρ hmono
  refine ⟨n,T,?_,?_,hm⟩
  · intro x
    apply le_trans _ (hl x)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg x)
    have hden : ‖(higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1≤2 := by
      linarith [higherOrder_inverse_opNorm_le_one Q D hcloud]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (by positivity : 0<‖(higherOrderPhysicalLpEquiv Q D).symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖+1) hden
  · intro x
    apply (hu x).trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg x)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (higherOrder_opNorm_le_two Q D hcloud)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (EmpiricalMetric.upper N G))]

PBGSO/MethodParticles.lean.scope_note: Assume positive particle count and the separate nonnegative global joint sum-norm Lipschitz bounds for the original observation and sampler force. The whole coupled force constant is 2 max(LF,LG) in the product Banach norm. No common potential or probability independence is needed for these deterministic map estimates.
PBGSO/MethodParticles.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.HigherOrderMethod

/-! # Identifying the implementation maps with actual particle forces
The optimiser uses `N⁻¹∑F(θ,xᵢ)` and the sampler uses the unaveraged force on
each particle. The dimension-free Lipschitz bounds use the cloud sup norm.
-/
noncomputable section
namespace PBGSO.Methods
variable {Θ X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- Actual empirical optimiser force. A nonempty cloud is required in the
bound below; the map itself follows Lean's total real division convention. -/

/-- Actual sampler force on the entire particle cloud. -/

/-- M-MFPO with the actual empirical force and a thermostat only on sampler
momenta. The optimiser innovation is definitionally zero. -/

/-- HOL-MYPGD with the actual average optimiser force and the sampler force
applied separately to each particle. -/

/-- Averaging does not amplify the Lipschitz constant in the cloud sup norm. -/

/-- Applying the sampler force coordinatewise preserves its Lipschitz bound. -/

/-- A Lipschitz condition for the whole coupled force follows from separate
conditions on `F` and `G`, with no compatibility or potential assumption. -/

end PBGSO.Methods

particleMeanForce.exact_header: def particleMeanForce {N : ℕ} (F : Θ → X → Θ) (θ : Θ) (x : Fin N → X) : Θ
particleMeanForce.exact_declaration:
def particleMeanForce {N : ℕ} (F : Θ → X → Θ) (θ : Θ) (x : Fin N → X) : Θ :=
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, F θ (x i)

particleSamplerForce.exact_header: def particleSamplerForce {N : ℕ} (G : Θ → X → X) (θ : Θ) (x : Fin N → X) : Fin N → X
particleSamplerForce.exact_declaration:
def particleSamplerForce {N : ℕ} (G : Θ → X → X) (θ : Θ) (x : Fin N → X) : Fin N → X :=
  fun i ↦ G θ (x i)

particleMomentumStep.exact_declaration:
def particleMomentumStep {N : ℕ} (F : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (γ h : ℝ) (z : (Θ × (Fin N → X)) × (Θ × (Fin N → X)))
    (ξ ξ' : Fin N → X) :=
  momentumStep (particleMeanForce F) (particleSamplerForce G) γ h z ξ ξ'

particleHigherOrderStep.exact_header:
def particleHigherOrderStep {N : ℕ} (F : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X)
    (α γ h : ℝ) (z : HOLState Θ (Fin N → X)) (ξ : (Fin N → X) × (Fin N → X) × (Fin N → X))

particleMeanForce_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem particleMeanForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (F : Θ → X → Θ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖F θ x - F θ' x'‖ ≤ L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x y : Fin N → X) :
    ‖particleMeanForce F θ x - particleMeanForce F θ' y‖ ≤
      L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - y‖)
particleMeanForce_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem particleMeanForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (F : Θ → X → Θ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖F θ x - F θ' x'‖ ≤ L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x y : Fin N → X) :
    ‖particleMeanForce F θ x - particleMeanForce F θ' y‖ ≤
      L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - y‖) := by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have he : particleMeanForce F θ x - particleMeanForce F θ' y =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, (F θ (x i) - F θ' (y i)) := by
    simp only [particleMeanForce, ← smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [he, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg hNr.le]
  calc
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖F θ (x i) - F θ' (y i)‖ := by
      gcongr; exact norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i : Fin N, L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - y‖) := by
      gcongr with i
      exact (hF θ θ' (x i) (y i)).trans (by
        gcongr
        exact norm_le_pi_norm (x - y) i)
    _ = _ := by simp; field_simp

particleSamplerForce_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem particleSamplerForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (G : Θ → X → X) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x y : Fin N → X) :
    ‖particleSamplerForce G θ x - particleSamplerForce G θ' y‖ ≤
      L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - y‖)
particleSamplerForce_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem particleSamplerForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (G : Θ → X → X) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (θ θ' : Θ) (x y : Fin N → X) :
    ‖particleSamplerForce G θ x - particleSamplerForce G θ' y‖ ≤
      L * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - y‖) := by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).mpr
  intro i
  exact (hG θ θ' (x i) (y i)).trans (by
    gcongr
    exact norm_le_pi_norm (x - y) i)

particleCoupledForce_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem particleCoupledForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (F : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖F θ x - F θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : Θ × (Fin N → X)) :
    ‖coupledForce (particleMeanForce F) (particleSamplerForce G) z -
      coupledForce (particleMeanForce F) (particleSamplerForce G) w‖ ≤
      (2 * max LF LG) * ‖z - w‖
particleCoupledForce_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem particleCoupledForce_lipschitz {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (F : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (LF LG : ℝ)
    (hLF : 0 ≤ LF) (hLG : 0 ≤ LG)
    (hF : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖F θ x - F θ' x'‖ ≤ LF * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (hG : ∀ θ θ' x x', ‖G θ x - G θ' x'‖ ≤ LG * (‖θ - θ'‖ + ‖x - x'‖))
    (z w : Θ × (Fin N → X)) :
    ‖coupledForce (particleMeanForce F) (particleSamplerForce G) z -
      coupledForce (particleMeanForce F) (particleSamplerForce G) w‖ ≤
      (2 * max LF LG) * ‖z - w‖ := by
  have hs : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z - w‖ := by
    have h1 : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
    have h2 : ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_snd_le (z - w)
    linarith
  have h1 := particleMeanForce_lipschitz hN F LF hLF hF z.1 w.1 z.2 w.2
  have h2 := particleSamplerForce_lipschitz G LG hLG hG z.1 w.1 z.2 w.2
  change max _ _ ≤ _
  apply max_le
  · apply h1.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ LF * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hLF
      _ ≤ (max LF LG) * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := by gcongr; exact le_max_left _ _
      _ = _ := by ring
  · apply h2.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ LG * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hLG
      _ ≤ (max LF LG) * (2 * ‖z - w‖) := by gcongr; exact le_max_right _ _
      _ = _ := by ring

PBGSO/Methods.lean.scope_note: Assume a global Lipschitz bound for the full coupled force, a nonnegative Lipschitz constant, thermostat factor of absolute value at most one, and the displayed innovation perturbation bounds. These are pathwise robustness bounds. Their amplification factor can exceed one; they are not a Gibbs mixing or uniform-in-time convergence theorem.
PBGSO/Methods.lean.shared_context:
import KineticLangevin.OBABO
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Integrals.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# New pathwise bounds for the two PBGSO implementation methods

The bounds in this file concern the **actual discrete update maps**. They do not
assert a Gibbs target, a stochastic stationary law, or an optimal mixing rate.
Forces in the optimiser and sampler may be unrelated. Supplied innovations are
arbitrary vectors: consequently the estimates also hold samplewise for Gaussian
innovations, without assuming that the optimiser receives thermal noise.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
namespace PBGSO
namespace Methods

variable {E Θ X : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]

/-- The sum norm on a momentum-position difference, independent of the ambient
product space's max norm. The order is `(momentum, position)`. -/

/-- Triangle inequality for the explicit sum of coordinate errors. -/

/-- A finite geometric sum, which remains defined at amplification factor one. -/

/-- Iteration with a possibly time-dependent innovation. -/

/-- Finite accumulation used below. Each application proves its recurrence
from concrete maps, rather than assuming it as a modelling hypothesis. -/




/-- The force kick has an explicit Lipschitz amplification factor. -/

/-- The drift shear has amplification at most `1+|h|`. -/

/-- A damped thermostat is nonexpansive with synchronous innovations, and its
response to innovation perturbation is exactly controlled by `|σ|`. -/

/-- The general coupled force. `Fbar` is the empirical optimiser force and `G`
is the sampler force, usually `∇ₓE`; no common potential is imposed. -/

/-- The paper's M-MFPO OBABO map. A particle innovation has zero optimiser
coordinate; hence both optimiser thermostat stages are deterministic. -/

/-- An explicit conservative amplification coefficient for a BAB stage. -/

/-- New one-step OBABO robustness estimate. Its force Lipschitz hypothesis is
on the arbitrary coupled vector field, not a joint-potential Hessian. -/

/-- New finite-step perturbation bound for the concrete OBABO map. For a
synchronous coupling (`ε=0`) the initial discrepancy is multiplied by `A^n`.
The estimate is finite horizon stability, not a claim that `A<1`. -/

/-- Finite-horizon accumulation only requires the local estimate on steps
strictly preceding the requested endpoint. -/

end Methods
end PBGSO

phaseError.exact_header: def phaseError (z w : E × E) : ℝ
phaseError.exact_declaration: def phaseError (z w : E × E) : ℝ := ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖z.2 - w.2‖

phaseError_triangle.exact_header:
theorem phaseError_triangle (z u w : E × E) :
    phaseError z w ≤ phaseError z u + phaseError u w
phaseError_triangle.exact_declaration:
theorem phaseError_triangle (z u w : E × E) :
    phaseError z w ≤ phaseError z u + phaseError u w := by
  have hp : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ ‖z.1 - u.1‖ + ‖u.1 - w.1‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
  have hq : ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ ‖z.2 - u.2‖ + ‖u.2 - w.2‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
  unfold phaseError
  linarith

amplificationSum.exact_declaration: def amplificationSum (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ k

trajectory.exact_header: def trajectory {S I : Type*} (step : S → I → S) (noise : ℕ → I) (z : S) : ℕ → S
trajectory.exact_declaration:
def trajectory {S I : Type*} (step : S → I → S) (noise : ℕ → I) (z : S) : ℕ → S
  | 0 => z
  | n + 1 => step (trajectory step noise z n) (noise n)

finite_accumulation.exact_header:
theorem finite_accumulation (e : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ a * e n + b) (n : ℕ) :
    e n ≤ a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n
finite_accumulation.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_accumulation (e : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ a * e n + b) (n : ℕ) :
    e n ≤ a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [amplificationSum]
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      e (n + 1) ≤ a * e n + b := hstep n
      _ ≤ a * (a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n) + b := by gcongr
      _ = a ^ (n + 1) * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a (n + 1) := by
        simp only [amplificationSum, geom_sum_succ, pow_succ]
        ring

norm_sub_add_le.exact_header:
private theorem norm_sub_add_le (a b c d : E) :
    ‖(a + b) - (c + d)‖ ≤ ‖a - c‖ + ‖b - d‖
norm_sub_add_le.exact_declaration:
private theorem norm_sub_add_le (a b c d : E) :
    ‖(a + b) - (c + d)‖ ≤ ‖a - c‖ + ‖b - d‖ := by
  have he : (a + b) - (c + d) = (a - c) + (b - d) := by module
  rw [he]
  exact norm_add_le _ _

norm_sub_sub_le.exact_header:
private theorem norm_sub_sub_le (a b c d : E) :
    ‖(a - b) - (c - d)‖ ≤ ‖a - c‖ + ‖b - d‖
norm_sub_sub_le.exact_declaration:
private theorem norm_sub_sub_le (a b c d : E) :
    ‖(a - b) - (c - d)‖ ≤ ‖a - c‖ + ‖b - d‖ := by
  have he : (a - b) - (c - d) = (a - c) - (b - d) := by module
  rw [he]
  exact norm_sub_le _ _

kick_error.exact_header:
theorem kick_error (G : E → E) (L h : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) (z w : E × E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.kickStep G h z)
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G h w) ≤ (1 + |h| * L) * phaseError z w
kick_error.exact_declaration:
theorem kick_error (G : E → E) (L h : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) (z w : E × E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.kickStep G h z)
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G h w) ≤ (1 + |h| * L) * phaseError z w := by
  have hn : ‖(z.1 - h • G z.2) - (w.1 - h • G w.2)‖ ≤
      ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + |h| * (L * ‖z.2 - w.2‖) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + ‖h • G z.2 - h • G w.2‖ := norm_sub_sub_le _ _ _ _
      _ = ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + |h| * ‖G z.2 - G w.2‖ := by
        rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact hLip _ _
  dsimp [phaseError, KineticLangevin.kickStep]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z.1 - w.1), mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg h) hL]

drift_error.exact_header:
theorem drift_error (h : ℝ) (z w : E × E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.driftStep h z)
      (KineticLangevin.driftStep h w) ≤ (1 + |h|) * phaseError z w
drift_error.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_error (h : ℝ) (z w : E × E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.driftStep h z)
      (KineticLangevin.driftStep h w) ≤ (1 + |h|) * phaseError z w := by
  have hn : ‖(z.2 + h • z.1) - (w.2 + h • w.1)‖ ≤
      ‖z.2 - w.2‖ + |h| * ‖z.1 - w.1‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖z.2 - w.2‖ + ‖h • z.1 - h • w.1‖ := norm_sub_add_le _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  dsimp [phaseError, KineticLangevin.driftStep]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg h) (norm_nonneg (z.2 - w.2))]

thermostat_error.exact_header:
theorem thermostat_error (η σ : ℝ) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) (z w : E × E) (ξ ζ : E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z)
      (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w) ≤ phaseError z w + |σ| * ‖ξ - ζ‖
thermostat_error.exact_declaration:
theorem thermostat_error (η σ : ℝ) (hη : |η| ≤ 1) (z w : E × E) (ξ ζ : E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z)
      (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w) ≤ phaseError z w + |σ| * ‖ξ - ζ‖ := by
  have hn : ‖(η • z.1 + σ • ξ) - (η • w.1 + σ • ζ)‖ ≤
      |η| * ‖z.1 - w.1‖ + |σ| * ‖ξ - ζ‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖η • z.1 - η • w.1‖ + ‖σ • ξ - σ • ζ‖ := norm_sub_add_le _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by simp only [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  dsimp [phaseError, KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη (norm_nonneg (z.1 - w.1))]

coupledForce.exact_header: def coupledForce (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (q : Θ × X) : Θ × X
coupledForce.exact_declaration:
def coupledForce (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (q : Θ × X) : Θ × X :=
  (Fbar q.1 q.2, G q.1 q.2)

momentumStep.exact_header:
def momentumStep (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (γ h : ℝ)
    (z : (Θ × X) × (Θ × X)) (ξ ξ' : X) : (Θ × X) × (Θ × X)
momentumStep.exact_declaration:
def momentumStep (Fbar : Θ → X → Θ) (G : Θ → X → X) (γ h : ℝ)
    (z : (Θ × X) × (Θ × X)) (ξ ξ' : X) : (Θ × X) × (Θ × X) :=
  KineticLangevin.obaboStep (coupledForce Fbar G) h
    (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)) (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) z (0, ξ) (0, ξ')

momentumAmplification.exact_declaration: def momentumAmplification (L h : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + |h| * L / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + |h|)

obabo_error.exact_header:
theorem obabo_error (G : E → E) (L h η σ : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (z w : E × E) (ξ ξ' ζ ζ' : E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ z ξ ξ')
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ w ζ ζ') ≤
      momentumAmplification L h * phaseError z w +
        |σ| * (momentumAmplification L h * ‖ξ - ζ‖ + ‖ξ' - ζ'‖)
obabo_error.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_error (G : E → E) (L h η σ : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (z w : E × E) (ξ ξ' ζ ζ' : E) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ z ξ ξ')
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ w ζ ζ') ≤
      momentumAmplification L h * phaseError z w +
        |σ| * (momentumAmplification L h * ‖ξ - ζ‖ + ‖ξ' - ζ'‖) := by
  let a := 1 + |h| * L / 2
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hd : 0 ≤ 1 + |h| := by positivity
  have hh : 1 + |h / 2| * L = a := by dsimp [a]; rw [abs_div]; norm_num; ring
  have h1 := thermostat_error η σ hη z w ξ ζ
  have h2 := kick_error G L (h / 2) hL hLip
    (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w)
  rw [hh] at h2
  have h3 := drift_error h
    (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z))
    (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w))
  have h4 := kick_error G L (h / 2) hL hLip
    (KineticLangevin.driftStep h
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z)))
    (KineticLangevin.driftStep h
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w)))
  rw [hh] at h4
  have h5 := thermostat_error η σ hη
    (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.driftStep h
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z))))
    (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.driftStep h
      (KineticLangevin.kickStep G (h / 2) (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ζ w)))) ξ' ζ'
  calc
    _ ≤ a * ((1 + |h|) * (a * (phaseError z w + |σ| * ‖ξ - ζ‖))) +
        |σ| * ‖ξ' - ζ'‖ := by
      apply h5.trans
      gcongr
      exact h4.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (h3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ha)) hd)) ha)
    _ = _ := by dsimp [momentumAmplification, a]; ring

obabo_finite_error.exact_header:
theorem obabo_finite_error (G : E → E) (L h η σ ε : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → E × E) (hnoise : ∀ n,
      ‖(ξ n).1 - (ζ n).1‖ ≤ ε ∧ ‖(ξ n).2 - (ζ n).2‖ ≤ ε)
    (z w : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ζ w n) ≤
      momentumAmplification L h ^ n * phaseError z w +
        (|σ| * (momentumAmplification L h + 1) * ε) *
          amplificationSum (momentumAmplification L h) n
obabo_finite_error.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_finite_error (G : E → E) (L h η σ ε : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (ξ ζ : ℕ → E × E) (hnoise : ∀ n,
      ‖(ξ n).1 - (ζ n).1‖ ≤ ε ∧ ‖(ξ n).2 - (ζ n).2‖ ≤ ε)
    (z w : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ζ w n) ≤
      momentumAmplification L h ^ n * phaseError z w +
        (|σ| * (momentumAmplification L h + 1) * ε) *
          amplificationSum (momentumAmplification L h) n := by
  have hA : 0 ≤ momentumAmplification L h := by unfold momentumAmplification; positivity
  apply finite_accumulation _ _ _ hA _ n
  intro k
  dsimp only [trajectory]
  apply (obabo_error G L h η σ hL hη hLip _ _ _ _ _ _).trans
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hnoise k).1 hA
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h1 (hnoise k).2) (abs_nonneg σ)
  nlinarith

finite_accumulation_upto.exact_header:
theorem finite_accumulation_upto (e : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ k, k < n → e (k + 1) ≤ a * e k + b) →
    e n ≤ a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n
finite_accumulation_upto.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_accumulation_upto (e : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ k, k < n → e (k + 1) ≤ a * e k + b) →
    e n ≤ a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _; simp [amplificationSum]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hstep
    have hi := ih (fun k hk ↦ hstep k (Nat.lt.step hk))
    calc
      e (n + 1) ≤ a * e n + b := hstep n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      _ ≤ a * (a ^ n * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a n) + b := by gcongr
      _ = a ^ (n + 1) * e 0 + b * amplificationSum a (n + 1) := by
        simp only [amplificationSum, geom_sum_succ, pow_succ]
        ring

PBGSO/MetricFactor.lean.scope_note: Assume the original finite-dimensional real Hilbert space and symmetric positive metric; no factor, square-root operator or coercivity conclusion is supplied.
PBGSO/MetricFactor.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.PaperTheorems
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Positive
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

/-! # Constructing a genuine linear metric factor from positive weights -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.MetricFactor
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]

/-- Every finite-dimensional symmetric nonnegative weight admits an actual
finite Euclidean factor. The factor and its squared-norm identity are proved
from a positive rank-one decomposition, rather than assumed. -/

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] in
/-- A positive lower quadratic bound gives coercivity of the constructed
factor in the original norm. -/

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] in
/-- The upper quadratic bound supplies a norm bound for the same actual
factor; no arbitrary matrix norm comparison is an input. -/

omit [FiniteDimensional ℝ H] in
/-- The constructed squared-norm factor preserves the entire weighted
pairing, by real polarization. -/

/-- Strictly positive primitive quadratic bounds construct both a genuine
metric factor and its original-norm comparisons. -/
end PBGSO.MetricFactor

exists_factor.exact_header:
theorem exists_factor (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0≤ ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ C : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m),
      ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ
exists_factor.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_factor (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0≤ ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ C : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m),
      ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ := by
  classical
  have hp : W.IsPositive := (ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff W).mpr
    ⟨fun x y => (hsym x y).symm,fun x => by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hpos x⟩
  obtain ⟨m,u,hu⟩ := ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff_eq_sum_rankOne.mp hp
  let C : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) :=
    (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => innerSL ℝ (u i)))
  refine ⟨m,C,fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  change (∑ i : Fin m, (⟪u i,x⟫_ℝ)^2)= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ
  rw [hu]
  simp only [sum_apply,inner_sum,InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,inner_smul_right]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [real_inner_comm x (u i)]
  ring

coercivity.exact_header:
theorem coercivity {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (hm : 0≤m) (hLower : ∀ x, m*‖x‖^2≤ ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) (x : H) :
    Real.sqrt m*‖x‖≤‖C x‖
coercivity.exact_declaration:
theorem coercivity {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (m : ℝ) (hm : 0≤m) (hLower : ∀ x, m*‖x‖^2≤ ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) (x : H) :
    Real.sqrt m*‖x‖≤‖C x‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hm,hC]
  exact hLower x

upper_bound.exact_header:
theorem upper_bound {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0≤M) (hUpper : ∀ x, ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ ≤ M*‖x‖^2) (x : H) :
    ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt M*‖x‖
upper_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem upper_bound {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2= ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0≤M) (hUpper : ∀ x, ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ ≤ M*‖x‖^2) (x : H) :
    ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt M*‖x‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hM,hC]
  exact hUpper x

pairing.exact_header:
theorem pairing {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2 = ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) (x y : H) :
    ⟪C x,C y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ
pairing.exact_declaration:
theorem pairing {K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℝ K]
    (W : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] K)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ x, ‖C x‖^2 = ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) (x y : H) :
    ⟪C x,C y⟫_ℝ = ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ := by
  have hxy := hC (x+y)
  rw [map_add,norm_add_sq_real] at hxy
  simp only [map_add,inner_add_left,inner_add_right] at hxy
  have hcross : ⟪y,W x⟫_ℝ = ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ :=
    (real_inner_comm (W x) y).trans (hsym x y).symm
  rw [hC x,hC y,hcross] at hxy
  nlinarith

exists_coercive_factor.exact_header:
theorem exists_coercive_factor (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (m M : ℝ) (hm : 0<m) (hM : 0≤M)
    (hLower : ∀ x, m*‖x‖^2≤⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ ≤ M*‖x‖^2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖^2 = ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) ∧
      (∀ x, Real.sqrt m*‖x‖≤‖C x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt M*‖x‖)
exists_coercive_factor.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_coercive_factor (W : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x,W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x,y⟫_ℝ)
    (m M : ℝ) (hm : 0<m) (hM : 0≤M)
    (hLower : ∀ x, m*‖x‖^2≤⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ)
    (hUpper : ∀ x, ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ ≤ M*‖x‖^2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖^2 = ⟪x,W x⟫_ℝ) ∧
      (∀ x, Real.sqrt m*‖x‖≤‖C x‖) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖C x‖≤Real.sqrt M*‖x‖) := by
  obtain ⟨n,C,hC⟩ := exists_factor W hsym (fun x =>
    (mul_nonneg hm.le (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)).trans (hLower x))
  exact ⟨n,C,hC,coercivity W C hC m hm.le hLower,upper_bound W C hC M hM hUpper⟩

PBGSO/MomentumBrownian.lean.scope_note: Assume a probability measure, finite spatial index, real coordinate pre-Brownian processes, positive step size and nonnegative friction. The joint Gaussian path law additionally assumes coordinate grid-path independence; marginal Brownianity alone is not substituted for it. Reference SDE existence and its moment bounds are separate from these proved innovation facts.
PBGSO/MomentumBrownian.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.MomentumRates
import UnadjustedLangevin.ProductBrownian
import UnadjustedLangevin.GaussianInnovationVectors

/-! # Actual Gaussian/Brownian coupling for M-MFPO

Normalised Brownian increments on the half-step grid give exactly the
independent standard Gaussian innovations used by the proposed implementation.
Their L² radii and the noise-matching error are derived, with explicit spatial
dimension. Independence of coordinate grid paths is a visible hypothesis for
the joint standard-Gaussian law; it is not inferred from marginal Brownianity.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace PBGSO.Methods

variable {Ω I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- A genuine standard-Gaussian vector from each half Brownian interval. -/

/-- Every half-step innovation has the exact square-root-dimension L² norm. -/

/-- The entire innovation sequence has the iid standard multivariate
Gaussian law. In particular both halves and all iterations are independent. -/

/-- The implementation's net momentum innovation is coupled to the sum of
the two actual normalised Brownian half increments. The local discrepancy is
explicitly O(h sqrt(h)); no noise-error premise remains. -/

/-- The comparison increment is the actual scaled Brownian increment over
the two adjacent half intervals, coordinate by coordinate almost surely. -/

end PBGSO.Methods

momentumHalfNoise.exact_declaration:
def momentumHalfNoise (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (h : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q :=
  ULA.Hilbert.brownianEulerNoise Q W hW (h / 2) n

momentumHalfNoise_norm.exact_header:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_norm (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n‖ = Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)
momentumHalfNoise_norm.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_norm (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n‖ = Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one] using ULA.gaussian_coordinates_Lp_norm Q
    (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n) 1
    (fun i => ULA.Hilbert.sourceEulerNoise_coordinateLaw Q W hW (h / 2) (by positivity) n i)

momentumHalfNoise_pathLaw.exact_header:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_pathLaw (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hpaths : iIndepFun
      (fun i ω (n : ℕ) => W i ((n : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) Q) :
    Q.map (fun ω n => momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n ω) =
      Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ I))
momentumHalfNoise_pathLaw.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_pathLaw (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hpaths : iIndepFun
      (fun i ω (n : ℕ) => W i ((n : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) Q) :
    Q.map (fun ω n => momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n ω) =
      Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ I)) := by
  exact ULA.gaussianInnovations_pathLaw Q
    (fun n ω => momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h n ω)
    (fun n => (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _).aemeasurable)
    (fun n i => ULA.Hilbert.sourceEulerNoise_coordinateLaw Q W hW (h / 2) (by positivity) n i)
    (ULA.Hilbert.sourceEulerNoise_independent Q W hW (h / 2) (by positivity) hpaths)

momentumBrownian_noise_bound.exact_header:
theorem momentumBrownian_noise_bound (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h)) •
        (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2) • momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) +
          momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1)) -
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) +
        momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1))‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) *
        h * Real.sqrt h
momentumBrownian_noise_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumBrownian_noise_bound (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h)) •
        (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2) • momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) +
          momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1)) -
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) +
        momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1))‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) *
        h * Real.sqrt h := by
  exact momentum_noise_coupling_bound γ h (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ))
    hγ hh.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _ _
    (momentumHalfNoise_norm Q W hW h hh _).le
    (momentumHalfNoise_norm Q W hW h hh _).le

momentumHalfNoise_brownian_increment.exact_header:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_brownian_increment (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) * (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) ω i +
        momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1) ω i) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * γ) *
        (W i (((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω -
          W i (((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω)
momentumHalfNoise_brownian_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumHalfNoise_brownian_increment (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) * (momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) ω i +
        momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1) ω i) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * γ) *
        (W i (((2 * n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω -
          W i (((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) := by
  have hs : Real.sqrt (h / 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  have hscale : Real.sqrt (γ * h) / Real.sqrt (h / 2) = Real.sqrt (2 * γ) := by
    rw [show γ * h = (2 * γ) * (h / 2) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * γ), mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hs]
  filter_upwards
    [ULA.Hilbert.sourceEulerNoise_normalized_coordinate Q W hW (h / 2) (by positivity)
      (2 * n) i,
     ULA.Hilbert.sourceEulerNoise_normalized_coordinate Q W hW (h / 2) (by positivity)
      (2 * n + 1) i] with ω hfirst hsecond
  change momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n) ω i = _ at hfirst
  change momentumHalfNoise Q W hW h (2 * n + 1) ω i = _ at hsecond
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  unfold ULA.normalizedBrownianIncrement
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ h / 2)]
  simp only [show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * n + 2 by omega]
  rw [show Real.sqrt (γ * h) *
      ((W i (↑(2 * n + 1) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω -
          W i (↑(2 * n) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) / Real.sqrt (h / 2) +
        (W i (↑(2 * n + 2) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω -
          W i (↑(2 * n + 1) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) / Real.sqrt (h / 2)) =
      (Real.sqrt (γ * h) / Real.sqrt (h / 2)) *
        (W i (↑(2 * n + 2) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω -
          W i (↑(2 * n) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) by ring]
  rw [hscale]

PBGSO/MomentumConsistency.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.Methods
import UnadjustedLangevin.LocalError

/-!
# A finite-horizon discretisation bound against an additive integral solution

The reference is specified by its integral equations, not by an assumed error
recurrence. Moment/modulus and innovation-coupling assumptions are stated at the
point of use. In particular a Brownian law, its existence, and a coupling of the
two Gaussian O stages to a Brownian increment are not inferred from these
pathwise equations. The ambient Banach norm can equally be an L² norm.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
namespace PBGSO.Methods
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- Euler comparison with noise only in momentum. -/

/-- Explicit algebraic remainder budget for OBABO relative to Euler. The
coefficient of `‖ξ‖` accounts for the position's response to the first O stage. -/

/-- New local algebraic consistency estimate for the actual OBABO map. All
force and noise errors are derived from the expanded scheme. -/

/-- Integral square-root modulus estimate used for the reference drift. -/

/-- New Euler comparison derived from the kinetic integral equations. The
square-root modulus is suitable for an L² Brownian-driven reference. -/

/-- Changing only the additive momentum increment has exactly this effect. -/

/-- New finite-horizon bound for OBABO against compatible kinetic integral
solution segments. It is derived from the actual map and integral equations.

`R` controls the reference square-root modulus, `P,F` its grid-point moments,
`Ξ` the first O innovation norm, and `B` the error coupling the net O increment
to the reference additive increment. These can be deterministic norms or L²
norms. Establishing these assumptions for a particular stochastic construction
is a separate obligation; no stationary target is assumed or concluded. -/

/-- Finite-horizon version, with hypotheses only on the first `n` steps. -/

end PBGSO.Methods

momentumEuler.exact_header: def momentumEuler (G : E → E) (γ h : ℝ) (z : E × E) (b : E) : E × E
momentumEuler.exact_declaration:
def momentumEuler (G : E → E) (γ h : ℝ) (z : E × E) (b : E) : E × E :=
  (z.1 - h • G z.2 - (γ * h) • z.1 + b, z.2 + h • z.1)

momentumRemainderBudget.exact_header: def momentumRemainderBudget (L γ h η σ P F Ξ : ℝ) : ℝ
momentumRemainderBudget.exact_declaration:
def momentumRemainderBudget (L γ h η σ P F Ξ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  |η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h| * P + |h * (1 - η)| * F +
    |η * h / 2| * L * (|h| * (|η| * P + |σ| * Ξ + |h| / 2 * F)) +
    |h * (η - 1)| * P + h ^ 2 / 2 * F + |h * σ| * Ξ

obabo_euler_error.exact_header:
theorem obabo_euler_error (G : E → E) (L γ h η σ P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (z : E × E) (ξ ξ' : E) (hp : ‖z.1‖ ≤ P) (hf : ‖G z.2‖ ≤ F)
    (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ z ξ ξ')
      (momentumEuler G γ h z (σ • (η • ξ + ξ'))) ≤
      momentumRemainderBudget L γ h η σ P F Ξ
obabo_euler_error.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_euler_error (G : E → E) (L γ h η σ P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (z : E × E) (ξ ξ' : E) (hp : ‖z.1‖ ≤ P) (hf : ‖G z.2‖ ≤ F)
    (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) :
    phaseError (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ z ξ ξ')
      (momentumEuler G γ h z (σ • (η • ξ + ξ'))) ≤
      momentumRemainderBudget L γ h η σ P F Ξ := by
  let v := η • z.1 + σ • ξ - (h / 2) • G z.2
  let q := z.2 + h • v
  have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ |η| * P + |σ| * Ξ + |h| / 2 * F := by
    calc
      ‖v‖ ≤ ‖η • z.1 + σ • ξ‖ + ‖(h / 2) • G z.2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖η • z.1‖ + ‖σ • ξ‖) + ‖(h / 2) • G z.2‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div]; norm_num; gcongr
  have hq : ‖q - z.2‖ ≤ |h| * (|η| * P + |σ| * Ξ + |h| / 2 * F) := by
    dsimp [q]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (abs_nonneg h)
  have heqv : η • (v - (h / 2) • G q) + σ • ξ' -
      (z.1 - h • G z.2 - (γ * h) • z.1 + σ • (η • ξ + ξ')) =
      (η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h) • z.1 + (h * (1 - η)) • G z.2 -
        (η * h / 2) • (G q - G z.2) := by dsimp [v]; module
  have heqx : q - (z.2 + h • z.1) =
      (h * (η - 1)) • z.1 - (h ^ 2 / 2) • G z.2 + (h * σ) • ξ := by
    dsimp [q, v]; module
  have hvel : ‖η • (v - (h / 2) • G q) + σ • ξ' -
      (z.1 - h • G z.2 - (γ * h) • z.1 + σ • (η • ξ + ξ'))‖ ≤
      |η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h| * P + |h * (1 - η)| * F +
      |η * h / 2| * L * (|h| * (|η| * P + |σ| * Ξ + |h| / 2 * F)) := by
    rw [heqv]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h) • z.1 + (h * (1 - η)) • G z.2‖ +
          ‖(η * h / 2) • (G q - G z.2)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖(η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h) • z.1‖ + ‖(h * (1 - η)) • G z.2‖) +
          ‖(η * h / 2) • (G q - G z.2)‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by
        simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((hLip q z.2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hL))
          (abs_nonneg (η * h / 2))
        have hab := add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (abs_nonneg (η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h)))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf (abs_nonneg (h * (1 - η))))
        convert add_le_add hab hg using 1 <;> ring
  have hpos : ‖q - (z.2 + h • z.1)‖ ≤
      |h * (η - 1)| * P + h ^ 2 / 2 * F + |h * σ| * Ξ := by
    rw [heqx]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(h * (η - 1)) • z.1 - (h ^ 2 / 2) • G z.2‖ + ‖(h * σ) • ξ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖(h * (η - 1)) • z.1‖ + ‖(h ^ 2 / 2) • G z.2‖) + ‖(h * σ) • ξ‖ := by
        gcongr; exact norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ h ^ 2 / 2)]; gcongr
  change ‖η • (v - (h / 2) • G q) + σ • ξ' - _‖ + ‖q - _‖ ≤ _
  exact (add_le_add hvel hpos).trans_eq (by unfold momentumRemainderBudget; ring)

integral_deviation_sqrt.exact_header:
theorem integral_deviation_sqrt (f : ℝ → E) (C h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h, ‖f t - f 0‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t) :
    ‖∫ t in 0..h, f t - f 0‖ ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * C * h * Real.sqrt h
integral_deviation_sqrt.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_deviation_sqrt (f : ℝ → E) (C h : ℝ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h, ‖f t - f 0‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t) :
    ‖∫ t in 0..h, f t - f 0‖ ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * C * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ t in 0..h, C * Real.sqrt t :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hh
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht ↦ hbound t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩))
        ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ C * Real.sqrt t)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ULA.integral_sqrt_zero h hh]; ring

momentumEuler_integral_error.exact_header:
theorem momentumEuler_integral_error (G : E → E) (L γ h R : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℝ → E) (b : E)
    (hpInt : IntervalIntegrable p volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q t) + γ • p t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : p h = p 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q t) + γ • p t) + b)
    (hq : q h = q 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p t))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h,
      ‖p t - p 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q t - q 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t) :
    phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b) (p h, q h) ≤
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R * h * Real.sqrt h
momentumEuler_integral_error.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumEuler_integral_error (G : E → E) (L γ h R : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℝ → E) (b : E)
    (hpInt : IntervalIntegrable p volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q t) + γ • p t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : p h = p 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q t) + γ • p t) + b)
    (hq : q h = q 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p t))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h,
      ‖p t - p 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q t - q 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t) :
    phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b) (p h, q h) ≤
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  have hf (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h) :
      ‖(G (q t) + γ • p t) - (G (q 0) + γ • p 0)‖ ≤
        ((L + γ) * R) * Real.sqrt t := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖G (q t) - G (q 0)‖ + ‖γ • p t - γ • p 0‖ := by
        have he : (G (q t) + γ • p t) - (G (q 0) + γ • p 0) =
            (G (q t) - G (q 0)) + (γ • p t - γ • p 0) := by module
        rw [he]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ L * (R * Real.sqrt t) + γ * (R * Real.sqrt t) := by
        rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hγ]
        exact add_le_add
          ((hLip _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmod t ht).2 hL))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmod t ht).1 hγ)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hv := integral_deviation_sqrt (fun t ↦ G (q t) + γ • p t) ((L + γ) * R) h hh hf
  have hx := integral_deviation_sqrt p R h hh (fun t ht ↦ (hmod t ht).1)
  have hev : (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b).1 - p h =
      ∫ t in 0..h, (G (q t) + γ • p t) - (G (q 0) + γ • p 0) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hfInt intervalIntegrable_const]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero]
    dsimp [momentumEuler]
    rw [hp]
    module
  have hex : (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b).2 - q h =
      -(∫ t in 0..h, p t - p 0) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hpInt intervalIntegrable_const]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero]
    dsimp [momentumEuler]
    rw [hq]
    module
  unfold phaseError
  rw [hev, hex, norm_neg]
  nlinarith

momentumEuler_noise_error.exact_header:
theorem momentumEuler_noise_error (G : E → E) (γ h : ℝ) (z : E × E) (b c : E) :
    phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h z b) (momentumEuler G γ h z c) = ‖b - c‖
momentumEuler_noise_error.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumEuler_noise_error (G : E → E) (γ h : ℝ) (z : E × E) (b c : E) :
    phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h z b) (momentumEuler G γ h z c) = ‖b - c‖ := by
  unfold phaseError momentumEuler
  have he : (z.1 - h • G z.2 - (γ * h) • z.1 + b) -
      (z.1 - h • G z.2 - (γ * h) • z.1 + c) = b - c := by module
  rw [he, sub_self, norm_zero, add_zero]

obabo_integral_reference_bound.exact_header:
theorem obabo_integral_reference_bound
    (G : E → E) (L γ h η σ R P F Ξ B : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℕ → ℝ → E) (b : ℕ → E) (ξ : ℕ → E × E)
    (hpInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (p k) volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q k t) + γ • p k t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : ∀ k, p k h = p k 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q k t) + γ • p k t) + b k)
    (hq : ∀ k, q k h = q k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p k t))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, p (k + 1) 0 = p k h ∧ q (k + 1) 0 = q k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h →
      ‖p k t - p k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧
      ‖q k t - q k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ∀ k, ‖p k 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ∀ k, ‖G (q k 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξbound : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hnoise : ∀ k, ‖σ • (η • (ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2) - b k‖ ≤ B)
    (z : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      momentumAmplification L h ^ n * phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
        (momentumRemainderBudget L γ h η σ P F Ξ + B +
          (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R * h * Real.sqrt h) *
            amplificationSum (momentumAmplification L h) n
obabo_integral_reference_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_integral_reference_bound
    (G : E → E) (L γ h η σ R P F Ξ B : ℝ)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hη : |η| ≤ 1)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℕ → ℝ → E) (b : ℕ → E) (ξ : ℕ → E × E)
    (hpInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (p k) volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q k t) + γ • p k t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : ∀ k, p k h = p k 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q k t) + γ • p k t) + b k)
    (hq : ∀ k, q k h = q k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p k t))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, p (k + 1) 0 = p k h ∧ q (k + 1) 0 = q k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h →
      ‖p k t - p k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧
      ‖q k t - q k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ∀ k, ‖p k 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ∀ k, ‖G (q k 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξbound : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hnoise : ∀ k, ‖σ • (η • (ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2) - b k‖ ≤ B)
    (z : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      momentumAmplification L h ^ n * phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
        (momentumRemainderBudget L γ h η σ P F Ξ + B +
          (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R * h * Real.sqrt h) *
            amplificationSum (momentumAmplification L h) n := by
  have hA : 0 ≤ momentumAmplification L h := by unfold momentumAmplification; positivity
  apply finite_accumulation _ _ _ hA _ n
  intro k
  dsimp only [trajectory]
  rw [(hcompat k).1, (hcompat k).2]
  let s := trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z k
  let r : E × E := (p k 0, q k 0)
  let c := σ • (η • (ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2)
  have hs := obabo_error G L h η σ hL hη hLip s r
    (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2 (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2
  simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at hs
  have hl := obabo_euler_error G L γ h η σ P F Ξ hL hLip r
    (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2 (hpbound k) (hfbound k) (hξbound k)
  have hn : phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h r c) (momentumEuler G γ h r (b k)) ≤ B := by
    rw [momentumEuler_noise_error]
    exact hnoise k
  have he := momentumEuler_integral_error G L γ h R hh hL hγ hLip
    (p k) (q k) (b k) (hpInt k) (hfInt k) (hp k) (hq k) (hmod k)
  have ht1 := phaseError_triangle
    (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2)
    (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ r (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2) (p k h, q k h)
  have ht2 := phaseError_triangle
    (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ r (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2)
    (momentumEuler G γ h r c) (p k h, q k h)
  have ht3 := phaseError_triangle (momentumEuler G γ h r c)
    (momentumEuler G γ h r (b k)) (p k h, q k h)
  dsimp only [s, r, c] at *
  linarith

MomentumState.exact_declaration:
abbrev MomentumState := ((Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) ×
  (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q))

momentumDrift.exact_header: def momentumDrift (γ : ℝ) (z : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q
momentumDrift.exact_declaration:
def momentumDrift (γ : ℝ) (z : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q :=
  (-coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2 - γ • z.1, z.1)

momentum_global_step.exact_header:
theorem momentum_global_step (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (z : ℝ → MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q)
    (hDrift : Continuous (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)))
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → z t - z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, momentumDrift Q D γ (z r)) +
      momentumInput Q W hW γ t) (k : ℕ) :
    (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).1 = (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).1 -
      (∫ t in 0..h, coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)
        (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).2 + γ • (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).1) +
      momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW γ h k ∧
    (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).2 = (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).2 +
      (∫ t in 0..h, (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).1)
momentum_global_step.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_global_step (γ h : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (z : ℝ → MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q)
    (hDrift : Continuous (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)))
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → z t - z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, momentumDrift Q D γ (z r)) +
      momentumInput Q W hW γ t) (k : ℕ) :
    (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).1 = (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).1 -
      (∫ t in 0..h, coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)
        (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).2 + γ • (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).1) +
      momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW γ h k ∧
    (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).2 = (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).2 +
      (∫ t in 0..h, (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).1) := by
  have hs := integral_shift z (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t))
    (momentumInput (A := A) Q W hW γ) hDrift heq ((k : ℝ) * h) h
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le) hh.le
  rw [momentumInput_increment Q W hW γ h hγ hh k] at hs
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun r ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))) volume 0 h :=
    (hDrift.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 h
  have hp := congrArg Prod.fst hs
  have hq := congrArg Prod.snd hs
  have hip := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)
    (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  have hiq := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)
    (Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.fst_add] at hp
  simp only [Prod.snd_sub, Prod.snd_add, add_zero] at hq
  change (∫ r in 0..h, (momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).1) =
    (∫ r in 0..h, momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).1 at hip
  change (∫ r in 0..h, (momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).2) =
    (∫ r in 0..h, momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).2 at hiq
  rw [← hip] at hp
  rw [← hiq] at hq
  change (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).2 - (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).2 =
    (∫ r in 0..h, (momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).2) + 0 at hq
  rw [add_zero] at hq
  have hm : (fun r ↦ (momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).1) =
      fun r ↦ -(coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)
        (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r)).2 + γ • (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r)).1) := by
    funext r
    dsimp [momentumDrift]
    module
  change (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).1 - (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).1 =
    (∫ r in 0..h, (momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r))).1) + _ at hp
  rw [hm, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hp
  constructor
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hp
    rw [hp]
    module
  · change (z ((k : ℝ) * h + h)).2 - (z ((k : ℝ) * h)).2 =
      ∫ r in 0..h, (z ((k : ℝ) * h + r)).1 at hq
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hq
    rw [hq]
    module

momentum_force_radius.exact_header:
theorem momentum_force_radius (γ P G : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (z : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hP : ‖z‖ ≤ P)
    (hG : ‖momentumDrift Q D γ z‖ ≤ G) :
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2‖ ≤ G + γ * P
momentum_force_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_force_radius (γ P G : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (z : MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hP : ‖z‖ ≤ P)
    (hG : ‖momentumDrift Q D γ z‖ ≤ G) :
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2‖ ≤ G + γ * P := by
  have he : coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) z.2 =
      -(momentumDrift Q D γ z).1 - γ • z.1 := by
    dsimp [momentumDrift]
    module
  rw [he]
  have hb := norm_sub_le (-(momentumDrift Q D γ z).1) (γ • z.1)
  rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hγ] at hb
  exact hb.trans (add_le_add ((norm_fst_le _).trans hG)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((norm_fst_le z).trans hP) hγ))

momentumReferenceOfGlobal.exact_header:
def momentumReferenceOfGlobal (γ h T R P G : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (z : ℝ → MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hz : Continuous z)
    (hDrift : Continuous (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)))
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → z t - z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, momentumDrift Q D γ (z r)) +
      momentumInput Q W hW γ t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖z t‖ ≤ P ∧ ‖momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hmod : ∀ a s : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → a + s ≤ T →
      ‖z (a + s) - z a‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt s)
    (hpaths : iIndepFun (fun i ω (j : ℕ) ↦ W i ((j : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) Q)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : ℝ) * h ≤ T) : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P (G + γ * P) n
momentumReferenceOfGlobal.exact_declaration:
def momentumReferenceOfGlobal (γ h T R P G : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (z : ℝ → MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hz : Continuous z)
    (hDrift : Continuous (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)))
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → z t - z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, momentumDrift Q D γ (z r)) +
      momentumInput Q W hW γ t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖z t‖ ≤ P ∧ ‖momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)‖ ≤ G)
    (hmod : ∀ a s : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → a + s ≤ T →
      ‖z (a + s) - z a‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt s)
    (hpaths : iIndepFun (fun i ω (j : ℕ) ↦ W i ((j : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) Q)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : ℝ) * h ≤ T) : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P (G + γ * P) n := by
  let p := fun k : ℕ ↦ fun t : ℝ ↦ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).1
  let q := fun k : ℕ ↦ fun t : ℝ ↦ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t)).2
  have hclock (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : (k : ℝ) * h + h ≤ T := by
    calc
      _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk) hh.le
      _ ≤ T := hn
  have htime (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : (k : ℝ) * h ∈ Icc 0 T :=
    ⟨mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le, (by linarith [hclock k hk])⟩
  have hcontp (k : ℕ) : Continuous (p k) :=
    continuous_fst.comp (hz.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  have hcontq (k : ℕ) : Continuous (q k) :=
    continuous_snd.comp (hz.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
  have hforce (k : ℕ) : Continuous (fun t ↦
      coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) (q k t) + γ • p k t) := by
    have h : Continuous (fun t : ℝ ↦ -(momentumDrift Q D γ (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t))).1) :=
      (continuous_fst.comp (hDrift.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))).neg
    convert h using 1
    funext t
    dsimp [p, q, momentumDrift]
    module
  refine {
    friction_nonneg := hγ
    step_pos := hh
    step_le_one := hh1
    modulus_nonneg := hR
    momentum_nonneg := hP
    force_nonneg := add_nonneg hG (mul_nonneg hγ hP)
    independent_paths := hpaths
    p := p
    q := q
    momentum_integrable := fun k _ ↦ (hcontp k).intervalIntegrable 0 h
    force_integrable := fun k _ ↦ (hforce k).intervalIntegrable 0 h
    momentum_equation := ?_
    position_equation := ?_
    grid_compatible := ?_
    modulus := ?_
    momentum_bound := ?_
    force_bound := ?_ }
  · intro k _
    simpa only [p, q, add_zero] using (momentum_global_step Q W hW D γ h hγ hh z hDrift heq k).1
  · intro k _
    simpa only [p, q, add_zero] using (momentum_global_step Q W hW D γ h hγ hh z hDrift heq k).2
  · intro k _
    have he : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * h + 0 = (k : ℝ) * h + h := by push_cast; ring
    exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst (congrArg z he), congrArg Prod.snd (congrArg z he)⟩
  · intro k hk t ht
    have hs := hmod ((k : ℝ) * h) t (htime k hk).1 ht.1 (ht.2.trans hh1)
      (by linarith [ht.2, hclock k hk])
    constructor
    · simpa only [p, add_zero, Prod.fst_sub] using (norm_fst_le (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t) - z ((k : ℝ) * h))).trans hs
    · simpa only [q, add_zero, Prod.snd_sub] using (norm_snd_le (z ((k : ℝ) * h + t) - z ((k : ℝ) * h))).trans hs
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [p, add_zero] using (norm_fst_le (z ((k : ℝ) * h))).trans (hbound _ (htime k hk)).1
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [q, add_zero] using momentum_force_radius Q D γ P G hγ (z ((k : ℝ) * h))
      (hbound _ (htime k hk)).1 (hbound _ (htime k hk)).2

exists_momentum_references_from_source.exact_header:
theorem exists_momentum_references_from_source (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (HypocoercivePhase A × (Fin N → HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField N)
        ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N
        (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ)) W hW 0 t)
    (hpaths : ∀ h : ℝ≥0, iIndepFun (fun i ω (j : ℕ) ↦ W i ((j : ℝ≥0) * h) ω) Q)
    (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G R : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ R ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * h ≤ T →
        ∃ Ref : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P (G + γ * P) n,
          ∀ k t, Ref.p k t = (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * h + t))).1 ∧
            Ref.q k t = (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * h + t))).2
exists_momentum_references_from_source.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_momentum_references_from_source (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (Y : ℝ → Lp (HypocoercivePhase A × (Fin N → HypocoercivePhase (EuclideanSpace ℝ J))) 2 Q)
    (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField N)
        ((momentumForceDynamics D γ).particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty) (Y r)) +
      samplerBrownianInput Q (ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N
        (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ)) W hW 0 t)
    (hpaths : ∀ h : ℝ≥0, iIndepFun (fun i ω (j : ℕ) ↦ W i ((j : ℝ≥0) * h) ω) Q)
    (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ P G R : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧ 0 ≤ G ∧ 0 ≤ R ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * h ≤ T →
        ∃ Ref : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P (G + γ * P) n,
          ∀ k t, Ref.p k t = (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * h + t))).1 ∧
            Ref.q k t = (momentumUnpackLp Q D (Y ((k : ℝ) * h + t))).2 := by
  let L := momentumForceDynamics D γ
  let f := ULA.lpDrift Q (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N D.nonempty)
  let U := momentumUnpackLp Q D
  let K := ParticleBrownianInput.diffusion (A := HypocoercivePhase A) N (momentumPhysicalDiffusion (J := J) γ)
  have hf : LipschitzWith L.fieldLip f := ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz Q _ _
  obtain ⟨P0, G0, R0, hP0, hG0, hR0, hbound, hmod⟩ := exists_brownian_mesh_regularity
    Q f L.fieldLip hf Y hY K W hW T (fun t ht ↦ heq t ht.1)
  let c : ℝ := ‖U‖
  let z := fun t ↦ U (Y t)
  have hzc : Continuous z := U.continuous.comp hY
  have hd (t : ℝ) : momentumDrift Q D γ (z t) = U (f (Y t)) :=
    (momentumUnpackLp_drift Q D γ (Y t)).symm
  have hdc : Continuous (fun t ↦ momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)) := by
    simp_rw [hd]
    exact U.continuous.comp (hf.continuous.comp hY)
  have hze (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : z t - z 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, momentumDrift Q D γ (z r)) + momentumInput Q W hW γ t := by
    have h := momentumUnpackLp_integral Q D γ Y (samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW 0) hY heq t ht
    rw [momentumUnpackLp_brownian Q D hcloud W hW γ 0 t] at h
    exact h
  have hzb (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : ‖z t‖ ≤ c * P0 ∧
      ‖momentumDrift Q D γ (z t)‖ ≤ c * G0 := by
    constructor
    · exact (U.le_opNorm (Y t)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t ht).1 (norm_nonneg U))
    · rw [hd]
      exact (U.le_opNorm (f (Y t))).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t ht).2 (norm_nonneg U))
  have hzm (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (hasT : a + s ≤ T) :
      ‖z (a + s) - z a‖ ≤ (c * R0) * Real.sqrt s := by
    change ‖U (Y (a + s)) - U (Y a)‖ ≤ _
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact (U.le_opNorm _).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmod a s ha hs hs1 hasT).1
      (norm_nonneg U)).trans_eq (by dsimp [c]; ring))
  refine ⟨c * P0, c * G0, c * R0, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hP0,
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hG0, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hR0, ?_⟩
  intro h hh hh1 n hn
  let Ref := momentumReferenceOfGlobal Q W hW D γ h T (c * R0) (c * P0) (c * G0) hγ hh hh1
    (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hR0) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hP0)
    (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg U) hG0) z hzc hdc hze hzb hzm (hpaths (h / 2).toNNReal) n hn
  exact ⟨Ref, fun _ _ ↦ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
