/-- The deterministic quadratic consistency coefficient. -/

/-- The actual BAB amplification grows at most linearly in the step size. -/

/-- The physical damping and noise coefficients give a quadratic deterministic
remainder plus an `h*sqrt(h)` innovation response. -/

/-- The square root of the OU variance differs from the Brownian coefficient
by at most a cubic-half-order term. -/

section NoiseComparison
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Actual two-half-step innovation comparison. If `ξ,ξ'` are normalized
Brownian half increments, `sqrt(γh)*(ξ+ξ')` is the reference full Brownian
increment. The bound is pathwise, and also valid in L². -/

end NoiseComparison

section ReferenceRate
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
open MeasureTheory

/-- New explicit finite-horizon square-root-step error bound for the actual
M-MFPO OBABO coefficients, coupled to normalized Brownian half increments.
The optimiser remains noise-free when `E=Θ×X` and all innovations have first
coordinate zero. Gaussianity is not needed for this pathwise theorem; a
Brownian implementation supplies the displayed increment identity. -/

/-- Finite-horizon square-root-step rate: every reference and innovation
premise is restricted to the first `n` steps. -/

end ReferenceRate

end PBGSO.Methods

momentumStabilityConstant.exact_declaration: def momentumStabilityConstant (L : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 + 2 * L + L ^ 2 / 2

momentumLocalConsistencyConstant.exact_header: def momentumLocalConsistencyConstant (L γ P F Ξ : ℝ) : ℝ

momentumAmplification_linear_bound.exact_header:
theorem momentumAmplification_linear_bound (L h : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    momentumAmplification L h ≤ 1 + momentumStabilityConstant L * h
momentumAmplification_linear_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumAmplification_linear_bound (L h : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) :
    momentumAmplification L h ≤ 1 + momentumStabilityConstant L * h := by
  have hh2 : h ^ 2 ≤ h := by nlinarith
  have hh3 : h ^ 3 ≤ h := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 hh]
  have hb1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 hL
  have hb2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 / 4)
  have hb3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh3 (by positivity : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 / 4)
  unfold momentumAmplification momentumStabilityConstant
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hh]
  nlinarith only [hb1, hb2, hb3]

momentumRemainderBudget_small_step.exact_header:
theorem momentumRemainderBudget_small_step (L γ h P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) :
    momentumRemainderBudget L γ h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
      (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) P F Ξ ≤
      momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ * h ^ 2 +
        (Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h
momentumRemainderBudget_small_step.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumRemainderBudget_small_step (L γ h P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) :
    momentumRemainderBudget L γ h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
      (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) P F Ξ ≤
      momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ * h ^ 2 +
        (Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  let η := Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)
  let σ := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hηsq : η ^ 2 = Real.exp (-γ * h) := by
    dsimp [η]
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have he := Real.add_one_le_exp (-γ * h / 2)
  have hhalf : 1 - η ≤ γ * h / 2 := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hfull : 0 ≤ η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h := by
    rw [hηsq]
    have hx := Real.add_one_le_exp (-γ * h)
    linarith
  have hquad : η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h ≤ γ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [hηsq]
    have hx := KineticLangevin.exp_neg_le_quadratic (γ * h) (by positivity)
    rw [← neg_mul] at hx
    nlinarith
  have hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hv : 0 ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-γ * h) := by
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith))
  have hσ1 : σ ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (by
    have hx := Real.exp_pos (-γ * h)
    linarith)
  have hσroot : σ ≤ Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt h := by
    have hv' : 1 - Real.exp (-γ * h) ≤ γ * h := by
      have hx := Real.add_one_le_exp (-γ * h)
      linarith
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hv').trans_eq (Real.sqrt_mul hγ _)
  have hb0 : |η ^ 2 - 1 + γ * h| * P ≤ (γ ^ 2 / 2 * P) * h ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hfull]
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hquad hP using 1 <;> ring
  have hb1 : |h * (1 - η)| ≤ γ * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hh.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hη1))]
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hh.le
    nlinarith
  have hb1' : |h * (η - 1)| ≤ γ * h ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have heq : h * (η - 1) = -(h * (1 - η)) := by ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg]
    exact hb1
  have hb2 : |η * h / 2| ≤ h / 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη1 hh.le]
  have hb3 : |h| * (|η| * P + |σ| * Ξ + |h| / 2 * F) ≤
      h * (P + Ξ + F / 2) := by
    rw [abs_of_pos hh, abs_of_nonneg hη0, abs_of_nonneg hσ0]
    gcongr
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη1 hP]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ1 hΞ]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh1 hF]
  have hbn : |h * σ| * Ξ ≤ (Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hh.le hσ0)]
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσroot (mul_nonneg hh.le hΞ)
    nlinarith
  unfold momentumRemainderBudget
  change _ ≤ momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ * h ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h
  calc
    _ ≤ (γ ^ 2 / 2 * P) * h ^ 2 + (γ * h ^ 2 / 2) * F +
        (h / 2) * L * (h * (P + Ξ + F / 2)) +
        (γ * h ^ 2 / 2) * P + h ^ 2 / 2 * F +
        (Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by unfold momentumLocalConsistencyConstant; ring

sqrt_exponential_variance_error.exact_header:
theorem sqrt_exponential_variance_error (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    |Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-t)) - Real.sqrt t| ≤ t * Real.sqrt t / 2
sqrt_exponential_variance_error.exact_declaration:
theorem sqrt_exponential_variance_error (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    |Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-t)) - Real.sqrt t| ≤ t * Real.sqrt t / 2 := by
  let s := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-t))
  have hv : 0 ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-t) := sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith))
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 - Real.exp (-t) := Real.sq_sqrt hv
  have ht2 := Real.sq_sqrt ht
  have hvle : 1 - Real.exp (-t) ≤ t := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-t)]
  have hsle : s ≤ Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hvle
  have hrem : t - s ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [hs2]
    linarith [KineticLangevin.exp_neg_le_quadratic t ht]
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hsle)]
  change -(s - Real.sqrt t) ≤ t * Real.sqrt t / 2
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with hzero | hpos
  · subst t
    norm_num [s]
  · have hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hroot).mp
    have hcross : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt t - s) * s := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hsle) hs0
    nlinarith only [hrem, hcross, ht2]

momentum_noise_coupling_bound.exact_header:
theorem momentum_noise_coupling_bound (γ h Ξ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (ξ ξ' : E) (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ) :
    ‖Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h)) •
        (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2) • ξ + ξ') -
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (ξ + ξ')‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h
momentum_noise_coupling_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_noise_coupling_bound (γ h Ξ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (ξ ξ' : E) (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ) :
    ‖Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h)) •
        (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2) • ξ + ξ') -
      Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (ξ + ξ')‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  let t := γ * h
  let η := Real.exp (-t / 2)
  let σ := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-t))
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := mul_nonneg hγ hh
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by dsimp [t]; nlinarith)
  have hhalf : |η - 1| ≤ t / 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hη1)]
    have he := Real.add_one_le_exp (-t / 2)
    dsimp [η]
    linarith
  have hs := sqrt_exponential_variance_error t ht
  have hfirst : |σ * η - Real.sqrt t| ≤ t * Real.sqrt t := by
    calc
      _ = |η * (σ - Real.sqrt t) + (η - 1) * Real.sqrt t| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |η * (σ - Real.sqrt t)| + |(η - 1) * Real.sqrt t| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = η * |σ - Real.sqrt t| + |η - 1| * Real.sqrt t := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hη0, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg t)]
      _ ≤ 1 * (t * Real.sqrt t / 2) + (t / 2) * Real.sqrt t := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have heq : σ • (η • ξ + ξ') - Real.sqrt t • (ξ + ξ') =
      (σ * η - Real.sqrt t) • ξ + (σ - Real.sqrt t) • ξ' := by module
  have hb : ‖σ • (η • ξ + ξ') - Real.sqrt t • (ξ + ξ')‖ ≤
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * t * Real.sqrt t * Ξ := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(σ * η - Real.sqrt t) • ξ‖ + ‖(σ - Real.sqrt t) • ξ'‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |σ * η - Real.sqrt t| * ‖ξ‖ + |σ - Real.sqrt t| * ‖ξ'‖ := by
        simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ (t * Real.sqrt t) * Ξ + (t * Real.sqrt t / 2) * Ξ := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  dsimp [η, σ, t] at hb
  rw [show -(γ * h) = -γ * h by ring] at hb
  convert hb using 1
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul hγ]
  ring

momentum_integral_reference_sqrt_rate.exact_header:
theorem momentum_integral_reference_sqrt_rate
    (G : E → E) (L γ h R P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℕ → ℝ → E) (b : ℕ → E) (ξ : ℕ → E × E)
    (hpInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (p k) volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q k t) + γ • p k t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : ∀ k, p k h = p k 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q k t) + γ • p k t) + b k)
    (hq : ∀ k, q k h = q k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p k t))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, p (k + 1) 0 = p k h ∧ q (k + 1) 0 = q k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h →
      ‖p k t - p k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q k t - q k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ∀ k, ‖p k 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ∀ k, ‖G (q k 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξbound : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ ∧ ‖(ξ k).2‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : ∀ k, b k = Real.sqrt (γ * h) • ((ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2))
    (z : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      Real.exp (momentumStabilityConstant L * h * n) *
        (phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
          (momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ + Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h)
momentum_integral_reference_sqrt_rate.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_integral_reference_sqrt_rate
    (G : E → E) (L γ h R P F Ξ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℕ → ℝ → E) (b : ℕ → E) (ξ : ℕ → E × E)
    (hpInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (p k) volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : ∀ k, IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q k t) + γ • p k t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : ∀ k, p k h = p k 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q k t) + γ • p k t) + b k)
    (hq : ∀ k, q k h = q k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p k t))
    (hcompat : ∀ k, p (k + 1) 0 = p k h ∧ q (k + 1) 0 = q k h)
    (hmod : ∀ k t, t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h →
      ‖p k t - p k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q k t - q k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ∀ k, ‖p k 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ∀ k, ‖G (q k 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξbound : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ ∧ ‖(ξ k).2‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : ∀ k, b k = Real.sqrt (γ * h) • ((ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2))
    (z : E × E) (n : ℕ) :
    phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) s r.1 r.2) ξ z n)
      (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      Real.exp (momentumStabilityConstant L * h * n) *
        (phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
          (momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ + Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h) := by
  let η := Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)
  let σ := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))
  let A := momentumAmplification L h
  let D := momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ
  let K := momentumStabilityConstant L
  let N := Real.sqrt γ * Ξ + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R
  have hη : |η| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hnoise (k : ℕ) : ‖σ • (η • (ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2) - b k‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ * h * Real.sqrt h) := by
    rw [hbrown k]
    exact momentum_noise_coupling_bound γ h Ξ hγ hh.le hΞ _ _ (hξbound k).1 (hξbound k).2
  have hbase := obabo_integral_reference_bound G L γ h η σ R P F Ξ
    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ * h * Real.sqrt h)
    hh.le hL hγ hη hLip p q b ξ hpInt hfInt hp hq hcompat hmod hpbound hfbound
    (fun k ↦ (hξbound k).1) hnoise z n
  have hrem := momentumRemainderBudget_small_step L γ h P F Ξ hL hγ hh hh1 hP hF hΞ
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A, momentumAmplification]; positivity
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D, momentumLocalConsistencyConstant]; positivity
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K, momentumStabilityConstant]; positivity
  have hA : A ≤ 1 + K * h := momentumAmplification_linear_bound L h hL hh.le hh1
  have hsum : 0 ≤ amplificationSum A n := by unfold amplificationSum; positivity
  have hbudget : phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n) (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      A ^ n * phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
        (D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * 0) * h * Real.sqrt h) * amplificationSum A n := by
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrem hsum
    dsimp [η, σ, A, D, N] at *
    nlinarith only [hbase, hb]
  have hr := finite_budget_sqrt_rate _ (phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0)) A D N 0 K h n
    (by unfold phaseError; positivity) hA0 hD hN (by norm_num) hK hh hh1 hA hbudget
  dsimp [η, σ, A, D, N, K] at hr
  simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, add_assoc] using hr

        (phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
          (momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ + Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
            (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h) := by
  let η := Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)
  let σ := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))
  let A := momentumAmplification L h
  let D := momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ
  let K := momentumStabilityConstant L
  let N := Real.sqrt γ * Ξ + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R
  have hη : |η| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hnoise (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : ‖σ • (η • (ξ k).1 + (ξ k).2) - b k‖ ≤
      ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ * h * Real.sqrt h) := by
    rw [hbrown k hk]
    exact momentum_noise_coupling_bound γ h Ξ hγ hh.le hΞ _ _ (hξbound k hk).1 (hξbound k hk).2
  have hbase := obabo_integral_reference_finite_bound G L γ h η σ R P F Ξ
    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ * h * Real.sqrt h)
    hh.le hL hγ hη hLip p q b ξ n hpInt hfInt hp hq hcompat hmod hpbound hfbound
    (fun k hk ↦ (hξbound k hk).1) hnoise z
  have hrem := momentumRemainderBudget_small_step L γ h P F Ξ hL hγ hh hh1 hP hF hΞ
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A, momentumAmplification]; positivity
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D, momentumLocalConsistencyConstant]; positivity
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K, momentumStabilityConstant]; positivity
  have hA : A ≤ 1 + K * h := momentumAmplification_linear_bound L h hL hh.le hh1
  have hsum : 0 ≤ amplificationSum A n := by unfold amplificationSum; positivity
  have hbudget : phaseError
      (trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ s r.1 r.2) ξ z n) (p n 0, q n 0) ≤
      A ^ n * phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0) +
        (D * h ^ 2 + (N + (8 / 3 : ℝ) * 0) * h * Real.sqrt h) * amplificationSum A n := by
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrem hsum
    dsimp [η, σ, A, D, N] at *
    nlinarith only [hbase, hb]
  have hr := finite_budget_sqrt_rate _ (phaseError z (p 0 0, q 0 0)) A D N 0 K h n
    (by unfold phaseError; positivity) hA0 hD hN (by norm_num) hK hh hh1 hA hbudget
  dsimp [η, σ, A, D, N, K] at hr
  simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, add_assoc] using hr

/-! # Actual time-uniform M-MFPO discretisation
The exact step maps are constructed by Picard iteration. Their contraction,
the affine numerical defect, and every exact reference moment are derived.
Numerical contractivity and numerical moments are conclusions, not premises.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.Methods
variable {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

/-- The explicit uniform exact-reference radius in metric coordinates. -/

/-- Time-uniform error for the actual OBABO iteration and original kinetic
integral trajectory. Primitive global force regularity, original drift

momentumUniformReferenceRadius.exact_header:
def momentumUniformReferenceRadius (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero β ρ : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (initial : E × E) : ℝ
momentumUniformReferenceRadius.exact_declaration:
def momentumUniformReferenceRadius (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero β ρ : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (initial : E × E) : ℝ :=
  let S := ‖C‖ * UniformIntegral.radius (L+γ+1) fzero β 0
  ‖C initial‖ + S / (1-Real.exp (-ρ)) + S

momentumMetricDefect.exact_header:
def momentumMetricDefect (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero Ξ β : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ
momentumMetricDefect.exact_declaration:
def momentumMetricDefect (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero Ξ β : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (‖C‖ * (momentumUniformDefect L γ fzero Ξ β).1,
    ‖C‖ * (momentumUniformDefect L γ fzero Ξ β).2 / m)

momentumUniformErrorConstant.exact_header:
def momentumUniformErrorConstant (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero Ξ β ρ : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m : ℝ) (initial : E × E) : ℝ
momentumUniformErrorConstant.exact_declaration:
def momentumUniformErrorConstant (L γ : ℝ≥0) (fzero Ξ β ρ : ℝ)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m : ℝ) (initial : E × E) : ℝ :=
  let ab := momentumMetricDefect L γ fzero Ξ β C m
  4 * (ab.1 + ab.2 * momentumUniformReferenceRadius L γ fzero β ρ C initial) / (ρ*m)

obabo_time_uniform.exact_header:
theorem obabo_time_uniform (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L G)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m*‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (uniformMomentumDrift G γ x-uniformMomentumDrift G γ y)⟫_ℝ
      ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hb : Continuous b)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b t,0))
    (Ξ β : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hincrement : ∀ a s, 0 ≤ a → s ∈ Icc 0 1 →
      ‖b (a+s)-b a‖ ≤ β*Real.sqrt s)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hρh : ρ*h ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (momentumMetricDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β C m).2 * Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ/4)
    (ξ : ℕ → E × E) (hξ : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ ∧ ‖(ξ k).2‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : ∀ k : ℕ, b ((k : ℝ)*h+h)-b ((k : ℝ)*h) =
      Real.sqrt ((γ : ℝ)*h) • ((ξ k).1+(ξ k).2)) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h/2))
      (Real.sqrt (1-Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h))) s r.1 r.2) ξ (Y 0) n - Y (n*h)‖ ≤
      momentumUniformErrorConstant L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β ρ C m (Y 0)*Real.sqrt h
obabo_time_uniform.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_time_uniform (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith L G)
    (C : (E × E) →L[ℝ] H) (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m*‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (uniformMomentumDrift G γ x-uniformMomentumDrift G γ y)⟫_ℝ
      ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hb : Continuous b)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b t,0))
    (Ξ β : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hincrement : ∀ a s, 0 ≤ a → s ∈ Icc 0 1 →
      ‖b (a+s)-b a‖ ≤ β*Real.sqrt s)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hρh : ρ*h ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (momentumMetricDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β C m).2 * Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ/4)
    (ξ : ℕ → E × E) (hξ : ∀ k, ‖(ξ k).1‖ ≤ Ξ ∧ ‖(ξ k).2‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : ∀ k : ℕ, b ((k : ℝ)*h+h)-b ((k : ℝ)*h) =
      Real.sqrt ((γ : ℝ)*h) • ((ξ k).1+(ξ k).2)) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h/2))
      (Real.sqrt (1-Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h))) s r.1 r.2) ξ (Y 0) n - Y (n*h)‖ ≤
      momentumUniformErrorConstant L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β ρ C m (Y 0)*Real.sqrt h := by
  let f := uniformMomentumDrift G γ
  let K : ℝ≥0 := L+γ+1
  have hf : LipschitzWith K f := uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz G L γ hLip
  let B : ℝ → E × E := fun t ↦ (b t,0)
  have hB : Continuous B := hb.prodMk continuous_const
  let shifted : ℕ → ℝ → E × E := fun k t ↦ (b ((k : ℝ)*h+t)-b ((k : ℝ)*h),0)
  have hscont (k : ℕ) : Continuous (shifted k) :=
    ((hb.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const
  have hexists (k : ℕ) (x : E × E) : ∃ Z : ℝ → E × E,
      Continuous Z ∧ Z 0=x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h,
        Z t-Z 0=(∫ r in 0..t, f (Z r))+shifted k t := by
    obtain ⟨Z,hZ,hZ0,hZe⟩ := ULA.exists_langevin_integral
      (fun x ↦ -f x) K hf.neg x (shifted k) (hscont k) (by simp [shifted]) h hh.le
    refine ⟨Z,hZ,hZ0,?_⟩
    intro t ht
    simpa only [hZ0,intervalIntegral.integral_neg,neg_neg] using hZe t ht
  choose Z hZ hZ0 hZe using hexists
  let Φ : ℕ → (E × E) → E × E := fun k x ↦ Z k x h
  let A : ℕ → (E × E) → E × E := fun k x ↦
    KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h/2))
      (Real.sqrt (1-Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h))) x (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2
  let X : ℕ → E × E := trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h
    (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h/2)) (Real.sqrt (1-Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ)*h))) s r.1 r.2) ξ (Y 0)
  let Ygrid : ℕ → E × E := fun k ↦ Y ((k : ℝ)*h)
  let ab := momentumMetricDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β C m
  let R := momentumUniformReferenceRadius L γ ‖G 0‖ β ρ C (Y 0)
  have hab := momentumUniformDefect_nonneg L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β (norm_nonneg _) hΞ hβ
  have ha0 := hab.1
  have hb0 := hab.2
  have ha : 0 ≤ ab.1 := by dsimp [ab,momentumMetricDefect]; positivity
  have hb' : 0 ≤ ab.2 := by dsimp [ab,momentumMetricDefect]; positivity
  have hgap : 0 < 1-Real.exp (-ρ) := sub_pos.mpr (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith))
  have hrad := UniformIntegral.radius_nonneg K (norm_nonneg (G 0)) hβ (le_refl 0)
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by dsimp [R,momentumUniformReferenceRadius]; positivity
  have hcontract (k : ℕ) (x y : E × E) :
      ‖C (Φ k x-Φ k y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*h)*‖C (x-y)‖ := by
    have hc := UniformIntegral.contraction f K hf C ρ hmono (Z k x) (Z k y)
      (shifted k) (hZ k x) (hZ k y) h (hZe k x) (hZe k y) h ⟨hh.le,le_rfl⟩
    simpa only [Φ,hZ0] using hc
  have hseg (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 h) :
      Y ((k : ℝ)*h+t)-Y ((k : ℝ)*h+0) =
        (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y ((k : ℝ)*h+r)))+shifted k t := by
    simpa only [B,shifted,add_zero,Prod.mk_sub_mk,sub_zero] using
      MethodSegments.integral_shift Y (fun r ↦ f (Y r)) B (hf.continuous.comp hY)
        heq ((k : ℝ)*h) t (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le) ht.1
  have hYstep (k : ℕ) : Ygrid (k+1)=Φ k (Ygrid k) := by
    have hc := UniformIntegral.contraction f K hf C ρ hmono (Z k (Ygrid k))
      (fun r ↦ Y ((k : ℝ)*h+r)) (shifted k) (hZ k (Ygrid k))
      (hY.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)) h (hZe k (Ygrid k)) (hseg k)
      h ⟨hh.le,le_rfl⟩
    simp only [hZ0,add_zero,Ygrid,sub_self,map_zero,norm_zero,mul_zero] at hc
    have hnorm := hcoerc (Z k (Ygrid k) h-Y ((k : ℝ)*h+h))
    have he : Z k (Ygrid k) h=Y ((k : ℝ)*h+h) := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      apply norm_eq_zero.mp
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Z k (Ygrid k) h-Y ((k : ℝ)*h+h))]
    change Y (((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*h)=Z k (Ygrid k) h
    rw [he]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hdefect (k : ℕ) (x : E × E) :
      ‖C (A k x-Φ k x)‖ ≤ (h*Real.sqrt h)*(ab.1+ab.2*‖C x‖) := by
    have hl := obabo_affine_local_defect G L γ hLip (Z k x)
      (fun t ↦ b ((k : ℝ)*h+t)-b ((k : ℝ)*h)) (hZ k x)
      ((hb.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const)
      Ξ β h hΞ hβ hh hh1 (hZe k x)
      (fun t ht ↦ hincrement _ t (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le) ⟨ht.1,ht.2.trans hh1⟩)
      (ξ k).1 (ξ k).2 (hξ k).1 (hξ k).2 (hbrown k)
    rw [hZ0] at hl
    have hmetric := (transformed_norm_sub_le_phaseError C (A k x) (Φ k x)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (norm_nonneg C))
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖/m := (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hcoerc x)
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖C‖ * (((momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).1+
          (momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).2 * ‖x‖)*h*Real.sqrt h) := hmetric
      _ ≤ ‖C‖ * (((momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).1+
          (momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).2 * (‖C x‖/m))*h*Real.sqrt h) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by dsimp [ab,momentumMetricDefect]; ring
  have href (k : ℕ) : ‖C (Ygrid k)‖ ≤ R := by
    have hr := UniformIntegral.uniform_moment f K hf C ρ hρ hmono Y B hY hB heq β hβ
      (by intro a s ha hs; simpa [B] using hincrement a s ha hs) ((k : ℝ)*h)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hh.le)
    simpa only [f,uniformMomentumDrift_zero_norm,R,momentumUniformReferenceRadius,Ygrid,K] using hr
  have he := UniformDiscrete.one_step_same_initial_uniform_norm C A Φ X Ygrid
    ρ h ab.1 ab.2 R m hρ hh ha hb' hR hm hcoerc hρh hsmall
    (fun k ↦ rfl) hYstep hcontract hdefect href (by simp [X,Ygrid,trajectory]) n
  change ‖X n-Ygrid n‖ ≤ _
  apply he.trans_eq
  dsimp [momentumUniformErrorConstant,ab,R]
  ring

uniformMomentum_component_equations.exact_header:
theorem uniformMomentum_component_equations (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (h : ℝ)
    (heq : Y h - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..h, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b h, 0)) :
    (Y h).1 = (Y 0).1 -
      (∫ r in 0..h, G (Y r).2 + (γ : ℝ) • (Y r).1) + b h ∧
    (Y h).2 = (Y 0).2 + (∫ r in 0..h, (Y r).1)
uniformMomentum_component_equations.exact_declaration:
theorem uniformMomentum_component_equations (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (h : ℝ)
    (heq : Y h - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..h, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b h, 0)) :
    (Y h).1 = (Y 0).1 -
      (∫ r in 0..h, G (Y r).2 + (γ : ℝ) • (Y r).1) + b h ∧
    (Y h).2 = (Y 0).2 + (∫ r in 0..h, (Y r).1) := by
  have hc := (uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz G L γ hLip).continuous.comp hY
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun r ↦ uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) volume 0 h :=
    hc.intervalIntegrable 0 h
  have hp := congrArg Prod.fst heq
  have hq := congrArg Prod.snd heq
  have hip := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  have hiq := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hi
  simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.fst_add] at hp
  simp only [Prod.snd_sub, Prod.snd_add, add_zero] at hq
  change (∫ r in 0..h, (uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).1) =
    (∫ r in 0..h, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).1 at hip
  change (∫ r in 0..h, (uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).2) =
    (∫ r in 0..h, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).2 at hiq
  rw [← hip] at hp
  rw [← hiq] at hq
  have hm : (fun r ↦ (uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).1) =
      fun r ↦ -(G (Y r).2 + (γ : ℝ) • (Y r).1) := by
    funext r
    dsimp [uniformMomentumDrift]
    module
  change (Y h).1 - (Y 0).1 =
    (∫ r in 0..h, (uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)).1) + b h at hp
  rw [hm, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hp
  change (Y h).2 - (Y 0).2 = ∫ r in 0..h, (Y r).1 at hq
  constructor
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hp
    rw [hp]
    module
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hq
    rw [hq]
    module

obabo_affine_local_defect.exact_header:
theorem obabo_affine_local_defect (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hb : Continuous b)
    (Ξ β h : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b t, 0))
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, ‖b t‖ ≤ β * Real.sqrt t)
    (ξ ξ' : E) (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : b h = Real.sqrt ((γ : ℝ) * h) • (ξ + ξ')) :
    phaseError
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ) * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ) * h))) (Y 0) ξ ξ')
      (Y h) ≤
      ((momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).1 +
        (momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).2 * ‖Y 0‖) * h * Real.sqrt h
obabo_affine_local_defect.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_affine_local_defect (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) (Y : ℝ → E × E) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hY : Continuous Y) (hb : Continuous b)
    (Ξ β h : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, uniformMomentumDrift G γ (Y r)) + (b t, 0))
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 h, ‖b t‖ ≤ β * Real.sqrt t)
    (ξ ξ' : E) (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : b h = Real.sqrt ((γ : ℝ) * h) • (ξ + ξ')) :
    phaseError
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ) * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-(γ : ℝ) * h))) (Y 0) ξ ξ')
      (Y h) ≤
      ((momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).1 +
        (momentumUniformDefect L γ ‖G 0‖ Ξ β).2 * ‖Y 0‖) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  let K : ℝ≥0 := L + γ + 1

momentumLocalDefectConstant.exact_header: def momentumLocalDefectConstant (L γ P F Ξ R : ℝ) : ℝ

def momentumLocalDefectConstant (L γ P F Ξ R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ + Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ +
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R

obabo_integral_local_sqrt_bound.exact_header:
theorem obabo_integral_local_sqrt_bound
    (G : E → E) (L γ h P F Ξ R : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (_hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℝ → E) (ξ ξ' b : E)
    (hpInt : IntervalIntegrable p volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q t) + γ • p t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : p h = p 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q t) + γ • p t) + b)
    (hq : q h = q 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p t))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h,
      ‖p t - p 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q t - q 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ‖p 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ‖G (q 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : b = Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (ξ + ξ')) :
    phaseError
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) (p 0, q 0) ξ ξ')
      (p h, q h) ≤ momentumLocalDefectConstant L γ P F Ξ R * h * Real.sqrt h
obabo_integral_local_sqrt_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem obabo_integral_local_sqrt_bound
    (G : E → E) (L γ h P F Ξ R : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1)
    (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ) (_hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖G x - G y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖)
    (p q : ℝ → E) (ξ ξ' b : E)
    (hpInt : IntervalIntegrable p volume 0 h)
    (hfInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ G (q t) + γ • p t) volume 0 h)
    (hp : p h = p 0 - (∫ t in 0..h, G (q t) + γ • p t) + b)
    (hq : q h = q 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p t))
    (hmod : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 h,
      ‖p t - p 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q t - q 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t)
    (hpbound : ‖p 0‖ ≤ P) (hfbound : ‖G (q 0)‖ ≤ F)
    (hξ : ‖ξ‖ ≤ Ξ) (hξ' : ‖ξ'‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (hbrown : b = Real.sqrt (γ * h) • (ξ + ξ')) :
    phaseError
      (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2))
        (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) (p 0, q 0) ξ ξ')
      (p h, q h) ≤ momentumLocalDefectConstant L γ P F Ξ R * h * Real.sqrt h := by
  let η := Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)
  let σ := Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))
  let c := σ • (η • ξ + ξ')
  have h1 := obabo_euler_error G L γ h η σ P F Ξ hL hLip (p 0, q 0)
    ξ ξ' hpbound hfbound hξ
  have h2 : phaseError (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) c)
      (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b) ≤
        ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Ξ) * h * Real.sqrt h := by
    rw [momentumEuler_noise_error, hbrown]
    exact momentum_noise_coupling_bound γ h Ξ hγ hh.le hΞ ξ ξ' hξ hξ'
  have h3 := momentumEuler_integral_error G L γ h R hh.le hL hγ hLip p q b
    hpInt hfInt hp hq hmod
  have ht1 := phaseError_triangle
    (KineticLangevin.obaboStep G h η σ (p 0, q 0) ξ ξ')
    (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) c) (p h, q h)
  have ht2 := phaseError_triangle (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) c)
    (momentumEuler G γ h (p 0, q 0) b) (p h, q h)
  have hrem := momentumRemainderBudget_small_step L γ h P F Ξ
    hL hγ hh hh1 hP hF hΞ
  have hs : h ≤ Real.sqrt h := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hh.le, Real.sqrt_nonneg h]
  have hD : 0 ≤ momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F Ξ := by
    unfold momentumLocalConsistencyConstant
    positivity
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hh.le) hD
  dsimp only [η, σ, c] at *
  unfold momentumLocalDefectConstant
  nlinarith only [h1, h2, h3, ht1, ht2, hrem, hd]

momentumDefectAffine.exact_header: def momentumDefectAffine (L γ Ξ p₀ p₁ f₀ f₁ r₀ r₁ : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ
momentumDefectAffine.exact_declaration:
def momentumDefectAffine (L γ Ξ p₀ p₁ f₀ f₁ r₀ r₁ : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  let a := (γ ^ 2 + γ + L) / 2
  let b := (γ + 1) / 2 + L / 4
  let c := (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1)
  (a * p₀ + b * f₀ + (L / 2 + Real.sqrt γ +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ) * Ξ + c * r₀,
    a * p₁ + b * f₁ + c * r₁)

uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) :
    LipschitzWith (L + γ + 1) (uniformMomentumDrift G γ)
uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem uniformMomentumDrift_lipschitz (G : E → E) (L γ : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith L G) :
    LipschitzWith (L + γ + 1) (uniformMomentumDrift G γ) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro z w
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  have hp : ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
  have hq : ‖z.2 - w.2‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := norm_snd_le (z - w)
  have hf := hLip.norm_sub_le z.2 w.2
  have he : (uniformMomentumDrift G γ z - uniformMomentumDrift G γ w).1 =
      -(G z.2 - G w.2) - (γ : ℝ) • (z.1 - w.1) := by
    dsimp [uniformMomentumDrift]
    module
  change max _ _ ≤ _
  apply max_le
  · change ‖(uniformMomentumDrift G γ z - uniformMomentumDrift G γ w).1‖ ≤ _
    rw [he]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖G z.2 - G w.2‖ + (γ : ℝ) * ‖z.1 - w.1‖ := by
        simpa only [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg γ.coe_nonneg] using norm_sub_le (-(G z.2 - G w.2))
            ((γ : ℝ) • (z.1 - w.1))
      _ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖z - w‖ + (γ : ℝ) * ‖z - w‖ := by
        exact add_le_add (hf.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq L.coe_nonneg))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp γ.coe_nonneg)
      _ ≤ ((L + γ + 1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) * ‖z - w‖ := by
        simp only [NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_one]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - w)]
  · change ‖z.1 - w.1‖ ≤ _
    simp only [NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_one]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg L.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (z - w)),
      mul_nonneg γ.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (z - w))]

theorem momentumParticle_time_uniform
    (γ : ℝ≥0)
    (C : MethodSegments.MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q →L[ℝ] H)
    (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m*‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ x-
      MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y : ℝ → MethodSegments.MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ (Y r))+
        MethodSegments.momentumInput Q W hW γ t)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hρh : ρ*h ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (momentumMetricDefect (momentumUniformForceLip D) γ
      ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ) C m).2 *
        Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ/4) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖momentumParticleIterate Q W hW D γ h (Y 0) n-Y (n*h)‖ ≤
      momentumUniformErrorConstant (momentumUniformForceLip D) γ
        ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
        (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ)

momentumParticle_time_uniform.exact_declaration:
theorem momentumParticle_time_uniform
    (γ : ℝ≥0)
    (C : MethodSegments.MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q →L[ℝ] H)
    (m ρ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hcoerc : ∀ x, m*‖x‖ ≤ ‖C x‖)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ x-
      MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y : ℝ → MethodSegments.MomentumState (A := A) (I := I) Q) (hY : Continuous Y)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, MethodSegments.momentumDrift Q D γ (Y r))+
        MethodSegments.momentumInput Q W hW γ t)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hρh : ρ*h ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (momentumMetricDefect (momentumUniformForceLip D) γ
      ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ) C m).2 *
        Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ/4) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖momentumParticleIterate Q W hW D γ h (Y 0) n-Y (n*h)‖ ≤
      momentumUniformErrorConstant (momentumUniformForceLip D) γ
        ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) 0‖
        (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ)
        ρ C m (Y 0)*Real.sqrt h := by
  let b : ℝ → Lp A 2 Q × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q := fun t ↦
    (0,Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 t)
  have hnoise : Continuous (fun t ↦ Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 t) := by
    have hs : Continuous (fun z : Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q ↦ Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • z) :=
      continuous_const_smul (Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ))
    exact hs.comp (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_continuous Q W hW 0)
  have hb : Continuous b := continuous_const.prodMk hnoise
  have hincrement (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 1) :
      ‖b (a+s)-b a‖ ≤ momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ*Real.sqrt s := by
    change ‖((0 : Lp A 2 Q),Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 (a+s))-
      (0,Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 a)‖ ≤ _
    change max ‖(0 : Lp A 2 Q)-0‖
      ‖Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 (a+s)-
        Real.sqrt (γ : ℝ) • ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW 0 a‖ ≤ _
    rw [← smul_sub,MethodSegments.brownianNoise_increment Q W hW a s]
    simp only [sub_self,norm_zero,norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
      ULA.brownianLangevinNoise_norm Q W hW a s ha hs.1]
    rw [max_eq_right (by positivity)]
    dsimp [momentumUniformBrownianRadius]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have hξ (k : ℕ) :
      ‖(momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h k).1‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ∧
      ‖(momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h k).2‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by
    simp [momentumGaussianNoise,momentumHalfNoise_norm Q W hW h hh]
  have hbrown (k : ℕ) : b ((k : ℝ)*h+h)-b ((k : ℝ)*h) =
      Real.sqrt ((γ : ℝ)*h) •
        ((momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h k).1+
          (momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h k).2) := by
    have he := congrArg Prod.fst (MethodSegments.momentumInput_increment
      (A := A) Q W hW γ h γ.coe_nonneg hh k)
    exact he
  exact obabo_time_uniform (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q))
    (momentumUniformForceLip D) γ (momentumUniformForce_lipschitz Q D)
    C m ρ hm hρ hcoerc hmono Y b hY hb heq
    (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (momentumUniformBrownianRadius (I := I) γ)
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by unfold momentumUniformBrownianRadius; positivity)
    hincrement h hh hh1 hρh hsmall (momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h) hξ hbrown n

norm_le_sum_abs_inner.exact_header:
theorem norm_le_sum_abs_inner (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (v : E) :
    ‖v‖ ≤ ∑ i, |⟪b i, v⟫_ℝ|
norm_le_sum_abs_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_le_sum_abs_inner (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (v : E) :
    ‖v‖ ≤ ∑ i, |⟪b i, v⟫_ℝ| := by
  calc
    ‖v‖ = ‖∑ i, ⟪b i,v⟫_ℝ • b i‖ := congrArg norm (b.sum_repr' v).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖⟪b i,v⟫_ℝ • b i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp [norm_smul, b.orthonormal.norm_eq_one]

norm_le_of_vertices.exact_header:
theorem norm_le_of_vertices (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (T : E → E)
    (hT : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪x-y, T x-T y⟫_ℝ)
    (x₀ x : E) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hplus : ∀ i, ‖T (x₀+b i)‖ ≤ C)
    (hminus : ∀ i, ‖T (x₀-b i)‖ ≤ C)
    (hd : ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖T x‖ ≤ 4 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * C
norm_le_of_vertices.exact_declaration:
theorem norm_le_of_vertices (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (T : E → E)
    (hT : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪x-y, T x-T y⟫_ℝ)
    (x₀ x : E) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hplus : ∀ i, ‖T (x₀+b i)‖ ≤ C)
    (hminus : ∀ i, ‖T (x₀-b i)‖ ≤ C)
    (hd : ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ 1/2) :
    ‖T x‖ ≤ 4 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * C := by
  have hcomp (i : ι) : |⟪b i,T x⟫_ℝ| ≤ ‖x-x₀‖ * ‖T x‖ + 2*C := by
    have htest (v : E) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hanchor : ‖T (x₀+v)‖ ≤ C) :
        ⟪v,T x⟫_ℝ ≤ ‖x-x₀‖ * ‖T x‖ + 2*C := by
      have hm := hT x (x₀+v)
      have hi : ⟪x-(x₀+v),T x-T (x₀+v)⟫_ℝ =
          ⟪x-x₀,T x⟫_ℝ - ⟪v,T x⟫_ℝ - ⟪x-(x₀+v),T (x₀+v)⟫_ℝ := by
        have he : x-(x₀+v) = (x-x₀)-v := by abel
        rw [inner_sub_right, he, inner_sub_left]
      have hn : ‖x-(x₀+v)‖ ≤ 2 := by
        calc
          _ = ‖(x-x₀)-v‖ := by congr 1; abel
          _ ≤ ‖x-x₀‖ + ‖v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ 2 := by linarith
      have h1 := real_inner_le_norm (x-x₀) (T x)
      have h2 : -⟪x-(x₀+v),T (x₀+v)⟫_ℝ ≤ 2*C := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ‖x-(x₀+v)‖ * ‖T (x₀+v)‖ :=
            (neg_le_abs _).trans (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
          _ ≤ 2*C := mul_le_mul hn hanchor (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      rw [hi] at hm
      linarith
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have hm := htest (-b i) (by simp [b.orthonormal.norm_eq_one])
        (by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hminus i)
      simp only [inner_neg_left] at hm
      linarith
    · exact htest (b i) (b.orthonormal.norm_eq_one i) (hplus i)
  have hs : ‖T x‖ ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (‖x-x₀‖*‖T x‖ + 2*C) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |⟪b i,T x⟫_ℝ| := norm_le_sum_abs_inner b _
      _ ≤ ∑ _ : ι, (‖x-x₀‖*‖T x‖ + 2*C) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcomp i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (norm_nonneg (T x))
  nlinarith

uniform_growth_on_compact.exact_header:
theorem uniform_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : A → E → E) (w : A → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a)
    (hT : ∀ a x y, 0 ≤ ⟪x-y,T a x-T a y⟫_ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a, ‖T a x‖ ≤ C*w a)
    (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a, ‖T a x‖ ≤ C*w a
uniform_growth_on_compact.exact_declaration:
theorem uniform_growth_on_compact [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : A → E → E) (w : A → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a)
    (hT : ∀ a x y, 0 ≤ ⟪x-y,T a x-T a y⟫_ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a, ‖T a x‖ ≤ C*w a)
    (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a, ‖T a x‖ ≤ C*w a := by
  classical
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  let d : ℝ := Module.finrank ℝ E
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  let δ : ℝ := 1/(2*(d+1))
  have hden : 0 < 2*(d+1) := by positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hden).mpr (by linarith)
  choose C hC hCg using hg
  let B : E → ℝ := fun x₀ => ∑ i, (C (x₀+b i) + C (x₀-b i))
  have hB : ∀ x₀, 0 ≤ B x₀ := fun x₀ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => add_nonneg (hC _) (hC _))
  have hlocal (x₀ x : E) (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ) (a : A) :
      ‖T a x‖ ≤ (4*d*B x₀)*w a := by
    have hdist : ‖x-x₀‖ < δ := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hx
    have hsmall : d * ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ 1/2 := by
      have hp : ‖x-x₀‖ * (2*(d+1)) < 1 := (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp hdist
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x-x₀)]
    have hvertex (i : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E)) :
        C (x₀+b i) ≤ B x₀ ∧ C (x₀-b i) ≤ B x₀ := by
      have hh : C (x₀+b i)+C (x₀-b i) ≤ B x₀ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => C (x₀+b j)+C (x₀-b j))
          (fun j _ => add_nonneg (hC _) (hC _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      constructor <;> linarith [hC (x₀+b i),hC (x₀-b i)]
    have hh := norm_le_of_vertices b (T a) (hT a) x₀ x (B x₀*w a)
      (mul_nonneg (hB _) (hw _))
      (fun i => (hCg _ a).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hvertex i).1 (hw _)))
      (fun i => (hCg _ a).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hvertex i).2 (hw _)))
      (hdist.le.trans hδ1) (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hsmall)
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, d, mul_assoc] using hh
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun x₀ => Metric.ball x₀ δ)
    (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) (fun x _ => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩)
  have hB' (x₀ : E) : 0 ≤ 4*d*B x₀ := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hd) (hB _)
  refine ⟨∑ x₀ ∈ s,4*d*B x₀,Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x₀ _ => hB' _),?_⟩
  intro x hx a
  obtain ⟨x₀,hx₀⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hs hx)
  obtain ⟨hx₀s,hball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx₀
  exact (hlocal x₀ x hball a).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun y => 4*d*B y) (fun y _ => hB' _) hx₀s) (hw a))

exists_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_radius (u : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, Measurable (u n))
    (h2 : ∀ n, MemLp (u n) 2 Q) (h0 : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ u n ω)
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun n => u n ω)) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hbound : ∀ n, (∫ ω, (u n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ R) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ R ∧ ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, u n ω ≤ C ω
exists_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_radius (u : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, Measurable (u n))
    (h2 : ∀ n, MemLp (u n) 2 Q) (h0 : ∀ n ω, 0 ≤ u n ω)
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun n => u n ω)) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hbound : ∀ n, (∫ ω, (u n ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ R) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ R ∧ ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, u n ω ≤ C ω := by
  let S (ω : Ω) : ℝ≥0∞ := ⨆ n, ENNReal.ofReal ((u n ω) ^ 2)
  have hS : Measurable S := Measurable.iSup (fun n => (hu n).pow_const 2 |>.ennreal_ofReal)
  have hsq (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun ω => (u n ω) ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (h2 n).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (h2 n)
  have hsum : (∫⁻ ω, S ω ∂Q) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R := by
    rw [lintegral_iSup (fun n => (hu n).pow_const 2 |>.ennreal_ofReal)]
    · apply iSup_le
      intro n
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hsq n) (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound n)
    · intro i j hij ω
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (pow_le_pow_left₀ (h0 i ω) (hmono ω hij) 2)
  have hf : (∫⁻ ω, S ω ∂Q) ≠ ∞ := (hsum.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top).ne
  have hfin : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, S ω < ∞ := ae_lt_top hS hf
  let C (ω : Ω) := Real.sqrt (S ω).toReal
  have hCm : Measurable C := Real.continuous_sqrt.measurable.comp hS.ennreal_toReal
  have hC0 (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ C ω := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hCsq (ω : Ω) : C ω ^ 2 = (S ω).toReal := Real.sq_sqrt ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q :=
    (integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hS.aemeasurable hf).congr (ae_of_all _ (fun ω => (hCsq ω).symm))
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hCm.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using hCi
  have hCB : (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ R := by
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hR |>.mp
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hCi (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))]
    apply le_trans _ hsum
    apply lintegral_mono_ae
    filter_upwards [hfin] with ω hω
    rw [hCsq, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hω.ne]
  refine ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hC2, hCB, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hfin] with ω hω
  intro n
  have he : ENNReal.ofReal ((u n ω) ^ 2) ≤ S ω := le_iSup (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal ((u n ω) ^ 2)) n
  have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono hω.ne he
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _), ← hCsq] at hr
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (h0 n ω) (hC0 ω)).mp hr

theorem law_distance_decay
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data R E M T)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hU : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = μ) (hV : R.map (V.sampler.state 0) = ν)
    (A : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) μ (U.optimizer 0))
    (B : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) ν (V.optimizer 0))
    (huniqueU : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (huniqueV : PathwiseUniqueness R (nullAugmentedDriver R (continuousDriver R E)) M T)
    (huniqueA : PathwiseUniqueness (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ))) M T)
    (huniqueB : PathwiseUniqueness (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν))) M T)
    (hpathμ : ∃ W : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ) M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = U.optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (hpathν : ∃ W : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver ν) M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν] Prod.fst)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M G)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) (R.map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  have hA0 : (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (A.data.sampler.state 0) = μ := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr A.initial_sampler,Measure.map_fst_prod,measure_univ,one_smul]
  have hB0 : (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (B.data.sampler.state 0) = ν := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr B.initial_sampler,Measure.map_fst_prod,measure_univ,one_smul]
  have hUA := law_unique_two_sources U A.data μ hU hA0 A.initial_optimizer.symm
    huniqueU huniqueA hpathμ T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  have hVB := law_unique_two_sources V B.data ν hV hB0 B.initial_optimizer.symm
    huniqueV huniqueB hpathν T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩

    A.initial_sampler B.initial_sampler G ρ hρ hmono hfull hσ hb hObs hDrift hOptimizer
  rw [A.initial_optimizer,B.initial_optimizer] at h
  rw [hUA.1,hVB.1,hUA.2,hVB.2]
  exact h

      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤

theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (hV0 : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M G)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  have hUI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) U.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ U.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ U 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hU0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ μ hμ).symm)
  have hVI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) V.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ V.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ V 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hV0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ ν hν).symm)
  apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings μ ν (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μ ν hμ hν)
    (fun c => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+c ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  intro c hc
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  letI : IsSeparable Q := CanonicalSeparable.initial_vector_isSeparable (I := I) c.joint
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ ν c
  have hp : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hf (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_process_eq μ ν c) i) t)
  have hq : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hg (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_process_eq μ ν c) i) t)
  let he := CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_filtration_le (I := I) μ ν c
  let hk := CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_filtration_le (I := I) μ ν c
  let Uc := U.pullback hf E he hp
  let Vc := V.pullback hg E hk hq
  have h := NaturalFiniteWorkContraction.pair_law_distance_decay Uc Vc G ρ hρ hmono
    hfull hσ hb hObs hDrift hOptimizer
  have huLaw : Q.map (Uc.sampler.state T) = (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T) :=
    U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  have hvLaw : Q.map (Vc.sampler.state T) = (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T) :=
    V.sampler.pullback_law hg E hk hq T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  rw [huLaw,hvLaw] at h
  change optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
    ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T))
    ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+
        ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Uc.sampler.state 0-
          ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Vc.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) at h
  rw [pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),
    pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),hUI,hVI,
    initial_difference_norm_sq μ ν hμ hν c] at h

theorem natural_comap_le_nullAugmented (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)

    {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : Measurable f)

  have h : @Measurable Ω (Iic t → E) (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ t) inferInstance
      (fun ω r => u r (f ω)) := by

theorem common_input_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
    (Y Z B a b : ℝ → E) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, a s) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Z t - Z 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, b s) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Y r - Z r) (a t - b t) (Ici t) t
common_input_difference_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem common_input_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
    (Y Z B a b : ℝ → E) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, a s) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Z t - Z 0 = (∫ s in 0..t, b s) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico 0 T) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Y r - Z r) (a t - b t) (Ici t) t := by
  have heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y r - Z r = Y 0 - Z 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, a s - b s := by
    intro r hr
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    have hy := heY r hr
    have hz := heZ r hr
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hy hz
    rw [hy, hz]
    abel
  have hdiff : Continuous (fun s => a s - b s) := ha.sub hb
  have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
    (hdiff.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    (hdiff.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hdiff.continuousAt
  have hmem : Icc 0 T ∈ 𝓝[Ici t] t := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
      mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iic_mem_nhds ht.2)] with r hr hrT
    exact ⟨ht.1.trans hr, hrT⟩
  have he : (fun r => Y r - Z r) =ᶠ[𝓝[Ici t] t]
      (fun r => Y 0 - Z 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, a s - b s) := by
    filter_upwards [hmem] with r hr
    exact heq r hr
  exact (hd.const_add (Y 0 - Z 0)).hasDerivWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq he
    (heq t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩)

theorem nonautonomous_additive_integral_energy_decay
    (g : ℝ → E → E) (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ T : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x y,
      ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪C (x - y), C (g r x - g r y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hgY : Continuous (fun r => g r (Y r)))
    (hgZ : Continuous (fun r => g r (Z r)))
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g s (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g s (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t)

theorem nonautonomous_additive_integral_energy_decay
    (g : ℝ → E → E) (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ T : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x y,
      ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪C (x - y), C (g r x - g r y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hgY : Continuous (fun r => g r (Y r)))
    (hgZ : Continuous (fun r => g r (Z r)))
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Y t - Y 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g s (Y s)) + B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g s (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ‖C (Y r - Z r)‖ ^ 2
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r =>
    -2 * ⟪C (Y r - Z r), C (g r (Y r) - g r (Z r))⟫
  have hc : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 T) :=
    ((C.continuous.comp (hY.sub hZ)).norm.pow 2).continuousOn
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hy : ∀ u ∈ Icc 0 T,
        Y u - Y 0 = (∫ s in 0..u, -g s (Y s)) + B u := by
      intro u hu
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using heY u hu
    have hz : ∀ u ∈ Icc 0 T,
        Z u - Z 0 = (∫ s in 0..u, -g s (Z s)) + B u := by
      intro u hu
      simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using heZ u hu
    have hdiff := common_input_difference_hasDerivWithinAt
      Y Z B (fun s => -g s (Y s)) (fun s => -g s (Z s))
      hgY.neg hgZ.neg T hy hz r hr
    have hdiff' : HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => Y r - Z r)
        (-(g r (Y r) - g r (Z r))) (Ici r) r := by
      convert hdiff using 1 <;> abel
    have hC := C.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt r hdiff'
    simpa only [F, F', Function.comp_def, map_neg, inner_neg_right,
      mul_neg, neg_mul] using hC.norm_sq
  have hm : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, F' r ≤ -2 * ρ * F r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [F', F]
    have h := hmono r hr (Y r) (Z r)
    nlinarith
  exact energy_decay hc hd hm t ht

theorem nonautonomous_additive_integral_contraction
    (g : ℝ → E → E) (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ T : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, ∀ x y,
      ρ * ‖C (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪C (x - y), C (g r x - g r y)⟫)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z)
    (hgY : Continuous (fun r => g r (Y r)))
    (hgZ : Continuous (fun r => g r (Z r)))
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,

    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      Z t - Z 0 = -(∫ s in 0..t, g s (Z s)) + B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t - Z t)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ * t) * ‖C (Y 0 - Z 0)‖ := by

numerical_target_triangle.exact_header:
theorem numerical_target_triangle (X Y : Lp A 2 Q) (a : A) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ ‖X - Y‖ + ‖Y - Lp.const 2 Q a‖
numerical_target_triangle.exact_declaration:
theorem numerical_target_triangle (X Y : Lp A 2 Q) (a : A) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ ‖X - Y‖ + ‖Y - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ :=
  norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub X Y _

numerical_target_shift.exact_header:
theorem numerical_target_shift (X : Lp A 2 Q) (a b : A) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q b‖ ≤ ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ + ‖a - b‖
numerical_target_shift.exact_declaration:
theorem numerical_target_shift (X : Lp A 2 Q) (a b : A) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q b‖ ≤ ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ + ‖a - b‖ := by
  have h := numerical_target_triangle Q X (Lp.const 2 Q a) b
  rw [← map_sub, Lp.norm_const 2 Q (a - b) (by norm_num)] at h
  simpa using h

lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms.exact_header:
theorem lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms (X : Lp A 2 Q) (a : A)
    (Γ : Measure B) (f : B → A) (hf : AEMeasurable f Γ)
    (hLaw : Q.map X = Γ.map f) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖f p - a‖ ^ 2 ∂Γ)
lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms.exact_declaration:
theorem lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms (X : Lp A 2 Q) (a : A)
    (Γ : Measure B) (f : B → A) (hf : AEMeasurable f Γ)
    (hLaw : Q.map X = Γ.map f) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖f p - a‖ ^ 2 ∂Γ) := by
  have hn := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (X - Lp.const 2 Q a)
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖(X - Lp.const 2 Q a) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      ∫ ω, ‖X ω - a‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub X (Lp.const 2 Q a),
      Lp.coeFn_const 2 Q a] with ω hs hc
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Function.const_apply] at hs hc
    rw [hs, hc]
  rw [he] at hn
  have hX : AEMeasurable X Q := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable X).aemeasurable
  have hg : Continuous (fun v : A ↦ ‖v - a‖ ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hmap : (∫ ω, ‖X ω - a‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ p, ‖f p - a‖ ^ 2 ∂Γ := by
    rw [← integral_map hX hg.aestronglyMeasurable, hLaw,
      integral_map hf hg.aestronglyMeasurable]
  rw [hmap] at hn
  rw [← hn, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

momentum_parameter_triangle.exact_header:
theorem momentum_parameter_triangle
    (z r : ((Lp A 2 Q) × C) × ((Lp A 2 Q) × C)) (a : A) :
    ‖z.2.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ phaseError z r + ‖r.2.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖
momentum_parameter_triangle.exact_declaration:
theorem momentum_parameter_triangle
    (z r : ((Lp A 2 Q) × C) × ((Lp A 2 Q) × C)) (a : A) :
    ‖z.2.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ phaseError z r + ‖r.2.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ := by
  have hc : ‖z.2.1 - r.2.1‖ ≤ phaseError z r := by
    have h := norm_fst_le (z.2 - r.2)
    dsimp only [Prod.fst_sub] at h
    exact h.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _))
  exact (numerical_target_triangle Q _ _ a).trans (add_le_add hc (le_refl _))

higherOrder_parameter_triangle.exact_header:
theorem higherOrder_parameter_triangle
    (z r : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) C) (a : A) :
    ‖z.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ holError z r + ‖r.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖
higherOrder_parameter_triangle.exact_declaration:
theorem higherOrder_parameter_triangle
    (z r : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) C) (a : A) :
    ‖z.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ ≤ holError z r + ‖r.1 - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ := by
  have hc : ‖z.1 - r.1‖ ≤ holError z r := by
    dsimp [holError]
    linarith [norm_nonneg (z.2.1 - r.2.1), norm_nonneg (z.2.2.1 - r.2.2.1),
      norm_nonneg (z.2.2.2 - r.2.2.2)]
  exact (numerical_target_triangle Q _ _ a).trans (add_le_add hc (le_refl _))

StationaryParameterData.exact_header:
structure StationaryParameterData (M : Model S A Z Y J) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (ρ : ℝ)
StationaryParameterData.exact_declaration:
structure StationaryParameterData (M : Model S A Z Y J) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (ρ : ℝ) where
  projection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter
  tests : Set (Z → ℝ)
  pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ)
  mean_solution : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν
  sStar : S
  νStar : Measure Z
  frozen_stationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar
  gradient_integrable : Integrable
    (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar
  gradient_zero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0
  optimizer_fixed : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0
  quadratic_test : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests
  rate_positive : 0 < ρ
  joint_monotonicity : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ
  realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
    ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
      SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
        Λ 0 = c.joint

StationaryParameterData.continuousBudget.exact_header:
def StationaryParameterData.continuousBudget
    {M : Model S A Z Y J} {D : TwistedGeometry S Z} {sbar : ℝ → S}
    {ν : ℝ → Measure Z} {ρ : ℝ} (T : StationaryParameterData M D sbar ν ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
StationaryParameterData.continuousBudget.exact_declaration:
def StationaryParameterData.continuousBudget
    {M : Model S A Z Y J} {D : TwistedGeometry S Z} {sbar : ℝ → S}
    {ν : ℝ → Measure Z} {ρ : ℝ} (T : StationaryParameterData M D sbar ν ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
    optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) T.sStar (ν 0) T.νStar +
  ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
    (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t))

StationaryParameterData.reference_norm_b.exact_header:
theorem StationaryParameterData.reference_norm_bound
    {M : Model S A Z Y J} {D : TwistedGeometry S Z} {sbar : ℝ → S}
    {ν : ℝ → Measure Z} {ρ : ℝ} (T : StationaryParameterData M D sbar ν ρ)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {LΨ : ℝ≥0} {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (P : ParticleParameterApproximation M D N ν sbar LΨ V)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (X : Lp A 2 Q) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (compatible : Q.map X = (P.jointLaw t).map (fun p ↦ M.parameter p.1.1)) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q (M.parameter T.sStar)‖ ≤ T.continuousBudget LΨ V N t
StationaryParameterData.reference_norm_b.exact_declaration:
theorem StationaryParameterData.reference_norm_bound
    {M : Model S A Z Y J} {D : TwistedGeometry S Z} {sbar : ℝ → S}
    {ν : ℝ → Measure Z} {ρ : ℝ} (T : StationaryParameterData M D sbar ν ρ)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {LΨ : ℝ≥0} {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (P : ParticleParameterApproximation M D N ν sbar LΨ V)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (X : Lp A 2 Q) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (compatible : Q.map X = (P.jointLaw t).map (fun p ↦ M.parameter p.1.1)) :
    ‖X - Lp.const 2 Q (M.parameter T.sStar)‖ ≤ T.continuousBudget LΨ V N t := by
  have hf : AEMeasurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ M.parameter p.1.1) (P.jointLaw t) :=
    (T.projection.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)).measurable.aemeasurable
  rw [lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms Q X (M.parameter T.sStar) (P.jointLaw t) _ hf compatible]
  exact P.parameter_bound T.projection T.tests T.pairTests T.mean_solution T.sStar T.νStar
    T.frozen_stationary T.gradient_integrable T.gradient_zero T.optimizer_fixed
    T.quadratic_test T.rate_positive T.joint_monotonicity T.realize hN hV t ht

momentumParticleIterate.exact_declaration:
def momentumParticleIterate (γ h : ℝ)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) ×
      ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) (n : ℕ) :=
  trajectory (fun s r ↦ KineticLangevin.obaboStep
    (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)) h
    (Real.exp (-γ * h / 2)) (Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-γ * h))) s r.1 r.2)
    (momentumGaussianNoise (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW h) z n

momentumDiscretizationBudget.exact_header: def momentumDiscretizationBudget (γ h R P F : ℝ) (e0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
momentumDiscretizationBudget.exact_declaration:
def momentumDiscretizationBudget (γ h R P F : ℝ) (e0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  let L := coupledLipschitzConstant (D.meanLip : ℝ) (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ)
  Real.exp (momentumStabilityConstant L * h * n) *
    (e0 + (momentumLocalConsistencyConstant L γ P F (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) +
      Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) +
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * γ * Real.sqrt γ * Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) +
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (L + γ + 1) * R) * (n * h) * Real.sqrt h)

MomentumIntegralReference.exact_header: structure MomentumIntegralReference (γ h R P F : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
MomentumIntegralReference.exact_declaration:
structure MomentumIntegralReference (γ h R P F : ℝ) (n : ℕ) where
  friction_nonneg : 0 ≤ γ
  step_pos : 0 < h
  step_le_one : h ≤ 1
  modulus_nonneg : 0 ≤ R
  momentum_nonneg : 0 ≤ P
  force_nonneg : 0 ≤ F
  independent_paths : iIndepFun
    (fun i ω (j : ℕ) ↦ W i ((j : ℝ≥0) * (h / 2).toNNReal) ω) Q
  p : ℕ → ℝ → (Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q
  q : ℕ → ℝ → (Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q
  momentum_integrable : ∀ k, k < n → IntervalIntegrable (p k) volume 0 h
  force_integrable : ∀ k, k < n → IntervalIntegrable
    (fun t ↦ coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) (q k t) + γ • p k t) volume 0 h
  momentum_equation : ∀ k, k < n → p k h = p k 0 -
    (∫ t in 0..h, coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) (q k t) + γ • p k t) +
    momentumGaussianIncrement (Θ := Lp A 2 Q) Q W hW γ h k
  position_equation : ∀ k, k < n → q k h = q k 0 + (∫ t in 0..h, p k t)
  grid_compatible : ∀ k, k < n → p (k + 1) 0 = p k h ∧ q (k + 1) 0 = q k h
  modulus : ∀ k, k < n → ∀ t, t ∈ Icc 0 h →
    ‖p k t - p k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t ∧ ‖q k t - q k 0‖ ≤ R * Real.sqrt t
  momentum_bound : ∀ k, k < n → ‖p k 0‖ ≤ P
  force_bound : ∀ k, k < n →
    ‖coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) (q k 0)‖ ≤ F

MomentumIntegralReference.finite_bound.exact_header:
theorem MomentumIntegralReference.finite_bound
    {γ h R P F : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (Ref : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P F n)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) ×
      ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) :
    phaseError (momentumParticleIterate Q W hW D γ h z n) (Ref.p n 0, Ref.q n 0) ≤
      momentumDiscretizationBudget D γ h R P F (phaseError z (Ref.p 0 0, Ref.q 0 0)) n
MomentumIntegralReference.finite_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem MomentumIntegralReference.finite_bound
    {γ h R P F : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (Ref : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P F n)
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q) ×
      ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) 2 Q)) :
    phaseError (momentumParticleIterate Q W hW D γ h z n) (Ref.p n 0, Ref.q n 0) ≤
      momentumDiscretizationBudget D γ h R P F (phaseError z (Ref.p 0 0, Ref.q 0 0)) n := by
  exact m_mfpo_particle_lp_gaussian_finite_bound Q W hW D γ h R P F
    Ref.friction_nonneg Ref.step_pos Ref.step_le_one Ref.modulus_nonneg
    Ref.momentum_nonneg Ref.force_nonneg Ref.independent_paths Ref.p Ref.q n
    Ref.momentum_integrable Ref.force_integrable Ref.momentum_equation Ref.position_equation
    Ref.grid_compatible Ref.modulus Ref.momentum_bound Ref.force_bound z

higherOrderParticleIterate.exact_declaration:
def higherOrderParticleIterate (α γ : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) (HOLGaussianSpace I))
    (n : ℕ) :=
  trajectory (higherOrderStep (D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
    (D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) α γ h)
    (higherOrderGaussianNoise I α γ h) z n

higherOrderDiscretizationBudget.exact_header: def higherOrderDiscretizationBudget (α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0) (e0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
higherOrderDiscretizationBudget.exact_declaration:
def higherOrderDiscretizationBudget (α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0) (e0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (holStabilityConstant α γ (D.meanLip : ℝ) (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) * n) *
    (e0 + (holLocalConsistencyConstant (holRemainderConstants α γ) (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ)
      Fθ FG U V + Real.sqrt (Fintype.card I : ℝ) * holScalarNoiseConstant α γ +
      (8 / 3 : ℝ) * C) * (n * (h : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (h : ℝ))

HigherOrderIntegralReference.exact_header: structure HigherOrderIntegralReference (α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
HigherOrderIntegralReference.exact_declaration:
structure HigherOrderIntegralReference (α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ) (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) where
  auxiliary_friction_pos : 0 < α
  momentum_coupling_nonneg : 0 ≤ γ
  step_pos : 0 < (h : ℝ)
  step_le_one : (h : ℝ) ≤ 1
  optimizer_force_nonneg : 0 ≤ Fθ
  sampler_force_nonneg : 0 ≤ FG
  first_auxiliary_nonneg : 0 ≤ U
  second_auxiliary_nonneg : 0 ≤ V
  modulus_nonneg : 0 ≤ C
  r : ℕ → ℝ → HOLState (Lp A 2 (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) (HOLGaussianSpace I)
  drift_integrable : ∀ k, k < n → IntervalIntegrable
    (fun t ↦ holDrift (D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
      (D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) α γ (r k t)) volume 0 h
  equation : ∀ k, k < n → r k h = r k 0 +
    (∫ t in 0..h, holDrift (D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
      (D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) α γ (r k t)) +
    holBrownianIncrement (higherOrderGaussianIncrement I α γ h k)
  grid_compatible : ∀ k, k < n → r (k + 1) 0 = r k h
  drift_modulus : ∀ k, k < n → ∀ t, t ∈ Icc 0 (h : ℝ) →
    ‖holDrift (D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
      (D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) α γ (r k t) -
      holDrift (D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I))
      (D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) α γ (r k 0)‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt t
  optimizer_force_bound : ∀ k, k < n →
    ‖D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I) (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ Fθ
  sampler_force_bound : ∀ k, k < n →
    ‖D.samplerForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)
      ((r k 0).1 - (h : ℝ) • D.meanForceLp (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)
        (r k 0).1 (r k 0).2.1) (r k 0).2.1‖ ≤ FG
  first_auxiliary_bound : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.1‖ ≤ U
  second_auxiliary_bound : ∀ k, k < n → ‖(r k 0).2.2.2‖ ≤ V

HigherOrderIntegralReference.finite_boun.exact_header:
theorem HigherOrderIntegralReference.finite_bound
    {α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ} {h : ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (Ref : HigherOrderIntegralReference I D α γ Fθ FG U V C h n)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) (HOLGaussianSpace I)) :
    holError (higherOrderParticleIterate I D α γ h z n) (Ref.r n 0) ≤
      higherOrderDiscretizationBudget I D α γ Fθ FG U V C h (holError z (Ref.r 0 0)) n
HigherOrderIntegralReference.finite_boun.exact_declaration:
theorem HigherOrderIntegralReference.finite_bound
    {α γ Fθ FG U V C : ℝ} {h : ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (Ref : HigherOrderIntegralReference I D α γ Fθ FG U V C h n)
    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability I)) (HOLGaussianSpace I)) :
    holError (higherOrderParticleIterate I D α γ h z n) (Ref.r n 0) ≤
      higherOrderDiscretizationBudget I D α γ Fθ FG U V C h (holError z (Ref.r 0 0)) n := by
  exact hol_mypgd_particle_lp_gaussian_finite_bound I D α γ Fθ FG U V C h
    Ref.auxiliary_friction_pos Ref.momentum_coupling_nonneg Ref.step_pos Ref.step_le_one
    Ref.optimizer_force_nonneg Ref.sampler_force_nonneg Ref.first_auxiliary_nonneg
    Ref.second_auxiliary_nonneg Ref.modulus_nonneg Ref.r n Ref.drift_integrable Ref.equation
    Ref.grid_compatible Ref.drift_modulus Ref.optimizer_force_bound Ref.sampler_force_bound
    Ref.first_auxiliary_bound Ref.second_auxiliary_bound z

m_mfpo_numerical_parameter_bound.exact_header:
theorem m_mfpo_numerical_parameter_bound
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q)
    (D : ParticleForceData A X (EuclideanSpace ℝ I) N)
    {γ h R P F : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (Ref : MomentumIntegralReference Q W hW D γ h R P F n)

def samplerCouplingWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ

def samplerCouplingWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ :=
  ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i,
      D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)

    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) : Prop
TwistedJointMonotonicity.exact_declaration:
def TwistedJointMonotonicity (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ s s' ν ν' (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)),
    IsCoupling Λ ν ν' →
    IsProbabilityMeasure ν → IsProbabilityMeasure ν' →
    HasFiniteSecondMoment ν → HasFiniteSecondMoment ν' →
    Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν →
    Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν' →
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') Λ →
    Integrable (fun zz => D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ →
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')⟫_ℝ +
      (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz ∂Λ) ≤
      -ρ * (D.optimizerSq (s - s') +
        ∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ)

    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hder : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt E (E' t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ E t) (hzero : E 0 = 0)
    (hdiss : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
