theorem forced_energy_bound {E E' : ℝ → ℝ} {ρ c T : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hder : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt E (E' t) (Ici t) t)
    (hE : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ E t) (hzero : E 0 = 0)
    (hdiss : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
      E' t ≤ -2 * ρ * E t + 2 * c * Real.sqrt (E t))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (E t) ≤ c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => Real.sqrt (E r + ε ^ 2)
  let u' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => E' r / (2 * u r)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := ht.1.trans ht.2
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hup : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 < u r := by
    intro r hr
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by nlinarith [hE r hr])
  have husq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, u r ^ 2 = E r + ε ^ 2 := by
    intro r hr
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith [hE r hr])
  have hεu : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ε ≤ u r := by
    intro r hr
    nlinarith [husq r hr, hE r hr, (hup r hr).le]
  have hsqrt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, Real.sqrt (E r) ≤ u r := by
    intro r hr
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
  have hucont : ContinuousOn u (Icc 0 T) :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn (hcont.add continuousOn_const)
  have huder : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt u (u' r) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩
    simpa only [u, u', add_zero] using
      ((hder r hr).add_const (ε ^ 2)).sqrt
        (ne_of_gt (by nlinarith [hE r hr'] : 0 < E r + ε ^ 2))
  have hubound : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T, u' r ≤ -ρ * u r + (c + ρ * ε) := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (hup r hr'))).mpr
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsqrt r hr') (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * c)
    have hreg := mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * ρ * ε)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hεu r hr'))
    have heq := husq r hr'
    have hd := hdiss r hr
    nlinarith
  have hgr := le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le hucont
    (fun r hr a ha => (huder r hr).liminf_right_slope_le ha)
    (le_refl (u 0)) hubound t ht
  rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 (neg_ne_zero.mpr hρ.ne'), sub_zero] at hgr
  have hu0 : u 0 = ε := by
    simp only [u, hzero, zero_add, Real.sqrt_sq hε.le]
  rw [hu0] at hgr
  have heq : ε * Real.exp (-ρ * t) +
      (c + ρ * ε) / -ρ * (Real.exp (-ρ * t) - 1) =
      c / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) + ε := by
    field_simp
    <;> ring
  exact (hsqrt t ht).trans (heq ▸ hgr)

theorem distance_decay_of_energy {E E' d : ℝ → ℝ} {ρ T lower upper : ℝ}
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hder : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt E (E' t) (Ici t) t)
    (hdiss : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, E' t ≤ -2 * ρ * E t)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ d t)
    (hcomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, lower * d t ^ 2 ≤ E t)
    (hinit : E 0 ≤ upper * d 0 ^ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    d t ≤ Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * d 0
distance_decay_of_energy.exact_declaration:
theorem distance_decay_of_energy {E E' d : ℝ → ℝ} {ρ T lower upper : ℝ}
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn E (Icc 0 T))
    (hder : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt E (E' t) (Ici t) t)
    (hdiss : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, E' t ≤ -2 * ρ * E t)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ d t)
    (hcomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, lower * d t ^ 2 ≤ E t)
    (hinit : E 0 ≤ upper * d 0 ^ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    d t ≤ Real.sqrt (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * d 0 := by
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := ht.1.trans ht.2
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hd0 := hd 0 h0
  have hdec := energy_decay hcont hder hdiss t ht
  have hs : d t ^ 2 ≤ (upper / lower) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * d 0 ^ 2 := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hlower).mp
    have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinit (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * t)).le
    calc
      lower * d t ^ 2 ≤ E t := hcomp t ht
      _ ≤ (upper * d 0 ^ 2) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := hdec.trans hi
      _ = lower * ((upper / lower) * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) * d 0 ^ 2) := by
        field_simp
        <;> ring
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (hd t ht) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hupper hlower.le)]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-ρ * t) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  exact hs

theorem rms_eq_eLpNorm (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :

rms_eq_eLpNorm.exact_declaration:
theorem rms_eq_eLpNorm (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = (eLpNorm f 2 Q).toReal := by
  have hn := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (hf.toLp f)
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp] at hn
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖hf.toLp f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hf.coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
  rw [he] at hn
  rw [← hn, Real.sqrt_sq ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]

theorem rms_add_constant (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) (c : E) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ f ω + c) 2 Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖f ω + c‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤

rms_add_constant.exact_declaration:
theorem rms_add_constant (f : Ω → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) (c : E) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ f ω + c) 2 Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖f ω + c‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) + ‖c‖ := by
  have hc : MemLp (fun _ : Ω ↦ c) 2 Q := memLp_const c
  have hs : MemLp (fun ω ↦ f ω + c) 2 Q := hf.add hc
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  rw [rms_eq_eLpNorm Q _ hs, rms_eq_eLpNorm Q f hf]
  have hle := eLpNorm_add_le (μ := Q) (f := f) (g := fun _ : Ω ↦ c)
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
    ⟨hf.eLpNorm_ne_top, hc.eLpNorm_ne_top⟩) hle
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hf.eLpNorm_ne_top hc.eLpNorm_ne_top] at hr
  have he : (eLpNorm (fun _ : Ω ↦ c) 2 Q).toReal = ‖c‖ := by
    simp [eLpNorm_const c (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) (by exact NeZero.ne Q)]
  change (eLpNorm (fun ω ↦ f ω + c) 2 Q).toReal ≤
    (eLpNorm f 2 Q).toReal + (eLpNorm (fun _ : Ω ↦ c) 2 Q).toReal at hr
  simpa only [he] using hr

theorem optimizer_interaction_rms_bound (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (sbar : S) (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar)
    (hquad : Integrable (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) Q) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ p.1.1 - sbar) 2 Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖p.1.1 - sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) / Real.sqrt D.lower := by
  let q := fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p
  have hpos (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : 0 ≤ q p := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [particleQuadraticBilinear_diag]
    exact add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ D.samplerSq_nonneg _))
  have hqp (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : D.optimizerSq (p.1.1 - p.2.1) ≤ q p := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [particleQuadraticBilinear_diag]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ D.samplerSq_nonneg _))
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, ‖p.1.1 - sbar‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (q p) / Real.sqrt D.lower := by
    filter_upwards [hbar] with p hp
    rw [← hp]
    exact (D.optimizer_norm_le _).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hqp p)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  have hq := sqrt_energy_memLp Q q hquad.aestronglyMeasurable hquad hpos
  have hg : MemLp (fun p ↦ Real.sqrt (q p) / Real.sqrt D.lower) 2 Q := by
    convert hq.const_mul (1 / Real.sqrt D.lower) using 1
    ext p
    ring
  have hf : MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ p.1.1 - sbar) 2 Q :=
    hg.mono' (by fun_prop) hbound
  refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
  have hsqbound : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, ‖p.1.1 - sbar‖ ^ 2 ≤ q p / D.lower := by
    filter_upwards [hbar] with p hp
    rw [← hp]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ D.lower_pos).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (D.optimizer_lower _).trans (hqp p)

    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hf)
    (hquad.div_const D.lower) hsqbound
  have hr := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hs
  rw [integral_div, Real.sqrt_div (integral_nonneg hpos)] at hr
  exact hr

    (sbar sStar : S) (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar)

    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hzero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :

theorem stationary_target_law_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hzero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    optimizerLawDistance (sbar t) sStar (ν t) νStar ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar := by
  letI := hmean.probability 0 le_rfl
  letI := hstationary.probability
  have hν : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 (ν 0) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
      (hmean.second_moment 0 le_rfl)
  have hνStar : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 νStar :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
      hstationary.second_moment
  have hStar := M.constant_isWeakSolution tests sStar νStar hstationary hgradient hzero hfix
  apply weak_law_contraction M D tests pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar)
    hν hνStar hquad ρ T hmono ?_ t ht
  intro c
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hinit⟩ := realize c
  exact ⟨Λ, hΛ.toCoupledWeakSolution hmean hStar, hinit⟩

    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (particleTests : Set (ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ))
    (Γ : ℝ → Measure (ParticlePair N S Z))

    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hResidual : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,

    (hzero : expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 (Γ t) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Γ t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar +
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t))

theorem finite_particle_parameter_bound
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hgradientZero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hpairQuad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (particleTests : Set (ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ))
    (Γ : ℝ → Measure (ParticlePair N S Z))
    (hparticle : IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν particleTests Γ)
    (hparticleQuad : (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ particleTests)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V T : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      MemLp (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (Γ r).map (fun p ↦ p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N ↦ ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hResidual : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r) (Γ r))
    (hzero : expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    MemLp (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z ↦ M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 (Γ t) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Γ t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar +
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  letI := hparticle.probability t ht.1
  obtain ⟨hm, htriangle⟩ := parameter_target_rms_bound M D hProjection N (Γ t)
    (sbar t) sStar (hbar t ht) (hparticle.test_integrable _ hparticleQuad t ht.1)
  have hrelax := (optimizer_norm_le_lawDistance (sbar t) sStar (ν t) νStar).trans
    (stationary_target_law_bound M D tests pairTests sbar ν hmean sStar νStar hstationary
      hgradient hgradientZero hfix hpairQuad ρ T hmono realize t ht)
  have hforcing := hparticle.forced_energy_bound D hN hparticleQuad ρ hρ hmono LΨ V T hV
    sbar (fun r hr ↦ hmean.probability r hr.1) hF hCloud hbar hΨ hVariance hResidual hzero t ht
  have hinteract := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hforcing (Real.sqrt_nonneg D.lower)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt D.upper / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = D.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ, D.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  have hinteract' : Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ t) / Real.sqrt D.lower ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
    apply hinteract.trans_eq
    rw [hs]
    ring
  refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [expectedParticleEnergy] at hinteract'
  linarith

    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (family : ∀ n : ℕ, ParticleParameterApproximation M D (n + 1) ν sbar LΨ V) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ ↦ (family p.1).parameterError sStar p.2)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0)
finite_particle_parameter_joint_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_particle_parameter_joint_limit
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hgradientZero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hpairQuad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ ↦ sStar) ν (fun _ ↦ νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (family : ∀ n : ℕ, ParticleParameterApproximation M D (n + 1) ν sbar LΨ V) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ ↦ (family p.1).parameterError sStar p.2)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
  let d0 := optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar
  let floor := fun n : ℕ ↦ ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) *
    Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let decay := fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) * d0
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ D.conditionNumber * V / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (D.conditionNumber * V)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_zero, mul_one_div] using hh
  have hfloor : Tendsto floor atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdiv).const_mul
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ)
    simpa only [floor, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero, Function.comp_def] using hh
  have hdecay : Tendsto decay atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [decay, mul_zero, zero_mul] using
      ((relaxation_tendsto_zero hρ).const_mul (Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber)).mul_const d0
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ ↦ decay p.2 + floor p.1)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero, Function.comp_def] using (hdecay.comp tendsto_snd).add (hfloor.comp tendsto_fst)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun p ↦ Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ?_ hsum
  filter_upwards [tendsto_snd.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ))] with p hp
  have hb := (family p.1).parameter_bound hProjection tests pairTests hmean sStar νStar
    hstationary hgradient hgradientZero hfix hpairQuad hρ hmono realize
    (Nat.succ_pos p.1) hV p.2 hp
  have hf : 0 ≤ floor p.1 := by dsimp [floor]; positivity
  have he : floor p.1 * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * p.2)) ≤ floor p.1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-ρ * p.2)]
  exact hb.trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) he)

pairedLaw.exact_declaration:
def pairedLaw (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) : Measure (E × F) :=
  Q.map (fun ω ↦ (U ω, V ω))

liftMap_paired_law.exact_header:
theorem liftMap_paired_law (f : E → A) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q f hf U) = (pairedLaw Q U V).map (fun p ↦ f p.1)
liftMap_paired_law.exact_declaration:
theorem liftMap_paired_law (f : E → A) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q f hf U) = (pairedLaw Q U V).map (fun p ↦ f p.1) := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (liftMap_coe Q f hf U)]
  exact (AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
    (hf.continuous.comp continuous_fst).measurable.aemeasurable
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable)).symm

theorem compLp_paired_law (f : E →L[ℝ] A)
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) :
    Q.map (f.compLp U) = (pairedLaw Q U V).map (fun p ↦ f p.1)
compLp_paired_law.exact_declaration:
theorem compLp_paired_law (f : E →L[ℝ] A)
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) :
    Q.map (f.compLp U) = (pairedLaw Q U V).map (fun p ↦ f p.1) := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (f.coeFn_compLp U)]
  exact (AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
    (f.continuous.comp continuous_fst).measurable.aemeasurable
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable.prodMk
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable V).aemeasurable)).symm

liftMap_target_norm_eq_paired_rms.exact_header:
theorem liftMap_target_norm_eq_paired_rms
    (f : E → A) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (U : Lp E 2 Q) (V : Lp F 2 Q) (a : A) :
    ‖liftMap Q f hf U - Lp.const 2 Q a‖ =

theorem liftMap_target_norm_eq_paired_rms

  exact lp_target_norm_eq_law_rms Q (liftMap Q f hf U) a
    (pairedLaw Q U V) (fun p ↦ f p.1)
    (hf.continuous.comp continuous_fst).measurable.aemeasurable

    (hparam : LipschitzWith L M.parameter)
    (U V : Lp (S × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q (fun p : S × (Fin N → Z) ↦ M.parameter p.1)

    (hparam : LipschitzWith L M.parameter)
    (U V : Lp (S × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q (fun p : S × (Fin N → Z) ↦ M.parameter p.1)

theorem optimizer_parameter_law (M : Model S A Z X I) {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hparam : LipschitzWith L M.parameter)
    (U V : Lp (S × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q M.parameter hparam

optimizer_parameter_law.exact_declaration:
theorem optimizer_parameter_law (M : Model S A Z X I) {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hparam : LipschitzWith L M.parameter)
    (U V : Lp (S × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (liftMap Q M.parameter hparam
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).compLp U)) =
      (pairedLaw Q U V).map (fun p ↦ M.parameter p.1.1) := by
  rw [Measure.map_congr (liftMap_coe Q M.parameter hparam
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).compLp U))]
  have he : (fun ω ↦ M.parameter
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).compLp U) ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω ↦ M.parameter (U ω).1 := by
    filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).coeFn_compLp U]
      with ω hω
    rw [hω]
    rfl
  rw [Measure.map_congr he]
  exact (AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable
    (hparam.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)).measurable.aemeasurable
    ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U).aemeasurable.prodMk

theorem momentumParticleState_aemeasurable
    (z : ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp C 2 Q) × ((Lp A 2 Q) × Lp C 2 Q)) :

  have ha := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable z.2.1).aemeasurable
  have hm := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable z.1.1).aemeasurable
  have hx := D.cloud.continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable z.2.2).aemeasurable
  have hv := D.cloud.continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable z.1.2).aemeasurable
  exact (ha.prodMk hm).prodMk (AEMeasurable.of_eval fun i ↦
    ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp_aemeasurable hx).prodMk
      ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp_aemeasurable hv))

packLp.exact_header: def packLp : (Fin N → Lp Z 2 Q) →L[ℝ] Lp (Fin N → Z) 2 Q

packLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem packLp_coe (U : Fin N → Lp Z 2 Q) :
    packLp (Z := Z) Q N U =ᵐ[Q] fun ω i ↦ U i ω
packLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem packLp_coe (U : Fin N → Lp Z 2 Q) :
    packLp (Z := Z) Q N U =ᵐ[Q] fun ω i ↦ U i ω := by
  classical
  have hs := Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin N ↦
    (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Z) i).compLp (U i))
  have hi : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i : Fin N,
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Z) i).compLp (U i)) ω =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Z) i) (U i ω) := by
    exact (ae_all_iff.mpr fun i ↦ (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Z) i).coeFn_compLp (U i))
  filter_upwards [hs, hi] with ω hs hi
  have hdef : (packLp (Z := Z) Q N) U = ∑ i : Fin N, (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Z) i).compLp (U i) := by
    simp only [packLp, sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hdef]
  rw [hs]
  funext j
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [hi]
  simp

@[simp] theorem packLp_proj (U : Fin N → Lp Z 2 Q) (i : Fin N) :
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin N → Z) →L[ℝ] Z).compLpL 2 Q)
      (packLp (Z := Z) Q N U) = U i
packLp_proj.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem packLp_proj (U : Fin N → Lp Z 2 Q) (i : Fin N) :
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin N → Z) →L[ℝ] Z).compLpL 2 Q)
      (packLp (Z := Z) Q N U) = U i := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin N → Z) →L[ℝ] Z).coeFn_compLpL
    (packLp (Z := Z) Q N U), packLp_coe Q N U] with ω hp hu
  rw [hp, hu]
  rfl

particleLpBilinear.exact_header:
def particleLpBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) :
    Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q →L[ℝ] ℝ
particleLpBilinear.exact_declaration:
def particleLpBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry A Z) :
    Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N)
    ((D.optimizerWeight.compLpL 2 Q).comp (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N)) +
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N, (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i)
    ((D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q).comp (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i))

particleLpBilinear_integral.exact_header:
theorem particleLpBilinear_integral (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (U V : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    particleLpBilinear Q N D U V = ∫ ω,
      ⟪(U ω).1, D.optimizerWeight (V ω).1⟫_ℝ +
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin N, ⟪(U ω).2 i, D.samplerWeight ((V ω).2 i)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
particleLpBilinear_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem particleLpBilinear_integral (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (U V : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    particleLpBilinear Q N D U V = ∫ ω,
      ⟪(U ω).1, D.optimizerWeight (V ω).1⟫_ℝ +
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin N, ⟪(U ω).2 i, D.samplerWeight ((V ω).2 i)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  have hA := lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.optimizerWeight
    (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N U) (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N V)
  have hZ (i : Fin N) := lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
    (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i U) (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i V)
  simp only [particleLpBilinear, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change ⟪particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N U, D.optimizerWeight.compLpL 2 Q (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N V)⟫_ℝ +
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ⟪particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i U,
      D.samplerWeight.compLpL 2 Q (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i V)⟫_ℝ = _
  simp_rw [lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ ↦ hZ i), ← integral_const_mul,
    ← integral_add hA ((integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ ↦ hZ i)).const_mul _)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  have hi (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i U) ω = (U ω).2 i ∧
      (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i V) ω = (V ω).2 i := by
    filter_upwards [((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Fin N → Z))).coeFn_compLpL U,
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Fin N → Z))).coeFn_compLpL V] with ω hu hv
    exact ⟨hu, hv⟩
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).coeFn_compLpL U,
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).coeFn_compLpL V,
    ae_all_iff.mpr hi] with ω hu hv hz
  simp only [particleOptimizerLp] at hu hv ⊢
  rw [hu, hv]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [(hz i).1, (hz i).2]

theorem particleLpWork_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (U V : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ ⟪(U ω).1, D.optimizerWeight (V ω).1⟫_ℝ +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin N, ⟪(U ω).2 i, D.samplerWeight ((V ω).2 i)⟫_ℝ) Q

theorem particleLpWork_integrable (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (U V : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ ⟪(U ω).1, D.optimizerWeight (V ω).1⟫_ℝ +
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin N, ⟪(U ω).2 i, D.samplerWeight ((V ω).2 i)⟫_ℝ) Q := by
  have hA := lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.optimizerWeight
    (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N U) (particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N V)
  have hZ (i : Fin N) := lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
    (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i U) (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i V)
  apply (hA.add ((integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ ↦ hZ i)).const_mul (N : ℝ)⁻¹)).congr
  have hi (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i U) ω = (U ω).2 i ∧
      (particleSamplerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N i V) ω = (V ω).2 i := by
    filter_upwards [((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Fin N → Z))).coeFn_compLpL U,
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ A (Fin N → Z))).coeFn_compLpL V] with ω hu hv
    exact ⟨hu, hv⟩
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).coeFn_compLpL U,
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).coeFn_compLpL V,
    ae_all_iff.mpr hi] with ω hu hv hz
  change ⟪(particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N U) ω,
    D.optimizerWeight ((particleOptimizerLp (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N V) ω)⟫_ℝ + _ = _
  simp only [particleOptimizerLp] at hu hv ⊢
  rw [hu, hv]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [(hz i).1, (hz i).2]

theorem particle_integral_pair_weak
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z)
    (Y W FY FW B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hFY : Continuous FY) (hFW : Continuous FW)
    (hY : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, FY r) + B t)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → W t - W 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, FW r) + B t)
    (hsource : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Continuous (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t))
    (hfield : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (FY t ω, FW t ω) = particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (Y t ω, W t ω)) :
    IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν {fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p}
      (fun t ↦ particlePairLaw Q N (Y t) (W t))
particle_integral_pair_weak.exact_declaration:
theorem particle_integral_pair_weak
    (L : LipschitzDynamics A Z G) (M : Model A G Z X I)
    (H : AdditiveModelCompatibility L M) (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z)
    (Y W FY FW B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hFY : Continuous FY) (hFW : Continuous FW)
    (hY : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, FY r) + B t)
    (hW : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → W t - W 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, FW r) + B t)
    (hsource : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Continuous (particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t))
    (hfield : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (FY t ω, FW t ω) = particleCopyDrift M N (ν t) t (Y t ω, W t ω)) :
    IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν {fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p}
      (fun t ↦ particlePairLaw Q N (Y t) (W t)) := by
  have hmeas (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (fun ω ↦ (Y t ω, W t ω)) Q :=
    (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (Y t)).aemeasurable.prodMk (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (W t)).aemeasurable
  have htest (t : ℝ) : Integrable (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)
      (particlePairLaw Q N (Y t) (W t)) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure
      (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun p : ParticlePair N A Z ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (hmeas t)).mpr
    exact particlePairWork_integrable Q N D (Y t) (W t) (Y t) (W t)
  have hgen (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
      (fun ω ↦ particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
        (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) (Y t ω, W t ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
      (fun ω ↦ 2 * particleQuadraticBilinear D N (Y t ω, W t ω) (FY t ω, FW t ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hfield t ht] with ω hω
    rw [particleCopyGenerator_additive N L M H, ← hω]
  have hcgen (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p))
      (particlePairLaw Q N (Y t) (W t)) := by
    change AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p ↦ particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
      (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p) _
    simp_rw [particleCopyGenerator_additive N L M H]
    exact (continuous_const.mul ((particleQuadraticBilinear D N).continuous.clm_apply (hsource t ht))).aestronglyMeasurable
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t _
    exact (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hmeas t)).mpr inferInstance
  · intro φ hφ t _
    have he : φ = fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hφ
    subst φ
    exact htest t
  · intro φ hφ t ht
    have he : φ = fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hφ
    subst φ
    apply (integrable_map_measure (hcgen t ht) (hmeas t)).mpr
    exact ((particlePairWork_integrable Q N D (Y t) (W t) (FY t) (FW t)).const_mul 2).congr (hgen t ht).symm
  · intro φ hφ t ht
    have he : φ = fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hφ
    subst φ
    let f := fun r ↦ FY r - FW r
    have hfc : Continuous f := hFY.sub hFW
    have heq (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : Y r - W r = Y 0 - W 0 + ∫ u in 0..r, f u := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hFY.intervalIntegrable 0 r) (hFW.intervalIntegrable 0 r)]
      have hy := hY r hr
      have hw := hW r hr
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hy hw
      rw [hy, hw]
      module
    have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := t)
      (hfc.intervalIntegrable 0 t) (hfc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 t)) hfc.continuousAt
    have hdiff := (hd.const_add (Y 0 - W 0)).hasDerivWithinAt.congr heq (heq t ht)
    have hquad := (quadratic_hasFDerivAt (particleLpBilinear Q N D) (Y t - W t)).comp_hasDerivWithinAt t hdiff
    have hv : (∫ p, particleCopyGenerator M N (ν t) t
        (fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p ∂particlePairLaw Q N (Y t) (W t)) =
        2 * particleLpBilinear Q N D (Y t - W t) (FY t - FW t) := by
      rw [particlePairLaw, integral_map (hmeas t) (hcgen t ht), integral_congr_ae (hgen t ht),
        integral_const_mul, particlePairWork_integral]
    rw [hv]
    have heall (r : ℝ) := particlePairLaw_energy_integral Q N D (Y r) (W r)
    convert hquad.congr (fun r _ ↦ heall r) (heall t) using 1 <;>
      simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, particleLpBilinear_symmetric, two_mul, f] <;> rfl

theorem exists_additive_particle_copy_weak (hN : 0 < N)
    (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (Ybar : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Ybar B)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q),
      Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (Ybar 0) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
        (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift (IndependentCopies.seeds Q) (L.particleField N)
          (L.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y r)) +
        independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (0, B t)) ∧
      IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N (fun t ↦ Q.map (Ybar t).2)
        {fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p}
        (fun t ↦ particlePairLaw (IndependentCopies.seeds Q) N (Y t)
          (independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (Ybar t))) := by
  let QN := IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q
  let C := independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N
  let f := ULA.lpDrift QN (L.particleField N) (L.particleField_lipschitz N hN)
  have hf : LipschitzWith L.fieldLip f := ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz QN _ _
  have hinput : Continuous (fun t ↦ C (0, B t)) :=
    C.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk hB)
  have hinput0 : C (0, B 0) = 0 := by rw [hB0]; exact C.map_zero
  obtain ⟨Y, hcont, hzero, heq⟩ := exists_global_integral_solution f L.fieldLip hf
    (C (Ybar 0)) (fun t ↦ C (0, B t)) hinput hinput0
  have hYe (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Y t - Y 0 =
      (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + C (0, B t) := by rw [hzero]; exact heq t ht
  refine ⟨Y, hcont, hzero, hYe, ?_⟩
  apply particle_integral_pair_weak QN N L M H D (fun t ↦ Q.map (Ybar t).2)
    Y (fun t ↦ C (Ybar t)) (fun t ↦ f (Y t))
    (fun t ↦ C (L.field Q (Ybar t))) (fun t ↦ C (0, B t))
  · exact hf.continuous.comp hcont
  · exact C.continuous.comp ((L.field_lipschitz Q).continuous.comp HY.continuous)
  · exact hYe
  · exact independentReference_integral Q N L M H HY
  · exact fun t ht ↦ particleCopyDrift_actual_continuous Q N L M H hN (Ybar t).2 t ht
  · exact fun t ht ↦ independent_particle_copy_field_coe Q N L M H hN (Ybar t) (Y t) t ht

theorem exists_additive_particle_approximation (hN : 0 < N)
    (D : TwistedGeometry A Z)
    (Ybar : ℝ → A × Lp Z 2 Q) (B : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (HY : IsGlobalAdditiveIntegralSolution Q L Ybar B)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (V : ℝ)
    (hVariance : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r →
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (Ybar r).1) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (Ybar r).2) (Ybar r).1‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (Ybar r).2) ≤ V) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q),
      Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (Ybar 0) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t - Y 0 =
        (∫ r in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift (IndependentCopies.seeds Q) (L.particleField N)
          (L.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y r)) +
        independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (0, B t)) ∧
      ∃ P : ParticleParameterApproximation M D N (fun t ↦ Q.map (Ybar t).2)
          (fun t ↦ (Ybar t).1) L.responseLip V,
        P.jointLaw = fun t ↦ particlePairLaw (IndependentCopies.seeds Q) N (Y t)
          (independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (Ybar t)) := by
  let QN := IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q
  let C := independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N
  obtain ⟨Y, hc, hi, he, hw⟩ := exists_additive_particle_copy_weak Q N L M H hN D Ybar B HY hB hB0
  let Γ := fun t ↦ particlePairLaw QN N (Y t) (C (Ybar t))
  have hCloud (r : ℝ) : (Γ r).map (fun p ↦ p.2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N ↦ Q.map (Ybar r).2) := by
    rw [particlePairLaw_reference_cloud]
    exact independentReference_cloud_law Q N (Ybar r)
  have hbar (r : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ r, p.2.1 = (Ybar r).1 :=
    particlePairLaw_reference_optimizer QN N (Y r) (C (Ybar r)) (Ybar r).1
      (independentReference_optimizer_coe Q N (Ybar r))
  have hF (r : ℝ) : MemLp
      (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter (Ybar r).1) (M.position z)) 2 (Q.map (Ybar r).2) := by
    simp_rw [H.observation]
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff (L.observation_state (Ybar r).1).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (Ybar r).2).aemeasurable).mpr
    exact ProximalLangevin.memLp_lipschitz_observable Q (L.observation_state (Ybar r).1)
      (Lp.memLp (Ybar r).2)
  have hΨ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (s : A) (g g' : G) :
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (L.responseLip : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖ := by
    rw [H.response r hr, H.response r hr]
    simpa only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self, Prod.norm_def, norm_zero, max_eq_right (norm_nonneg _)] using
      L.response_lipschitz.norm_sub_le (s, g) (s, g')
  have hR (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (Q.map (Ybar r).2) r) (Γ r) := by
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map (Ybar r).2) :=
      (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (Ybar r).2).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
    exact particlePopulationResidual_aestronglyMeasurable M D N (Q.map (Ybar r).2)
      (Ybar r).1 (hF r) (Γ r) (hCloud r) (hbar r) r L.responseLip (hΨ r hr (Ybar r).1)
  refine ⟨Y, hc, hi, he, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨{
    jointLaw := Γ
    tests := {fun p ↦ particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p}
    solution := hw
    quadratic_test := Set.mem_singleton _
    observation_second_moment := fun r _ ↦ hF r
    reference_cloud := fun r _ ↦ hCloud r
    reference_optimizer := fun r _ ↦ hbar r
    response := hΨ
    observation_variance := hVariance
    residual_measurable := hR
    zero_initial_error := particlePairLaw_zero_energy QN N D Y (fun t ↦ C (Ybar t)) hi
  }, rfl⟩

samplerBrownianInput_coe.exact_header:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_coe (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW a t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => K (Real.sqrt 2 •
        (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal ω -
          ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal ω))
samplerBrownianInput_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerBrownianInput_coe (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ I →L[ℝ] Z)
    (W : I → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsPreBrownianReal (W i) Q) (a t : ℝ) :
    samplerBrownianInput Q K W hW a t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => K (Real.sqrt 2 •
        (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal ω -
          ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal ω)) := by
  filter_upwards [K.coeFn_compLp (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a t),
    Lp.coeFn_smul (Real.sqrt 2)
      (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t) - ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a),
    Lp.coeFn_sub (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW (a + t))
      (ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp Q W hW a),
    ULA.brownianCoordinatesLp_coe Q W hW (a + t).toNNReal,
    ULA.brownianCoordinatesLp_coe Q W hW a.toNNReal] with ω hK hs hd ht ha
  change (K.compLp (ULA.brownianLangevinNoise Q W hW a t)) ω = _
  rw [hK]
  simp only [ULA.brownianLangevinNoise]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
  rw [hd]
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, ULA.brownianCoordinatesRealLp]
  rw [ht, ha]

theorem packed_input_eq (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (a t : ℝ) :
    independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) N
      (0, AdditiveCanonical.input (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) μ
        (samplerBrownianInput (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) K
          ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian a) t) =
      samplerBrownianInput (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
        (diffusion (A := A) N K) (coordinate (Z := Z) N)

packed_input_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem packed_input_eq (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ J →L[ℝ] Z) (a t : ℝ) :
    independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z)
      (μ.prod (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J)) N
      (0, AdditiveCanonical.input (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) μ
        (samplerBrownianInput (ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J) K
          ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian a) t) =
      samplerBrownianInput (ParticleNoiseSpace.probability (J := J) μ N)
        (diffusion (A := A) N K) (coordinate (Z := Z) N)
        (coordinate_isPreBrownian μ N) a t := by
  let R := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.vectorProbability J
  let Q := μ.prod R
  let QN := IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q
  let W := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate (I := J)
  let hW := ULA.CanonicalBrownian.coordinate_isPreBrownian (I := J)
  let B := samplerBrownianInput R K W hW a
  have hB := samplerBrownianInput_coe R K W hW a t
  have hinput : AdditiveCanonical.input R μ B t =ᵐ[Q] fun p => K (Real.sqrt 2 •
      (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal p.2 - ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal p.2)) :=
    (lpPullback_coe (measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R)) _).trans
      ((measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := R)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hB)
  have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂QN, ∀ i : Fin N, AdditiveCanonical.input R μ B t (ω i) =
      K (Real.sqrt 2 • (ULA.brownianCoordinates W (a + t).toNNReal (ω i).2 -
        ULA.brownianCoordinates W a.toNNReal (ω i).2)) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hinput
  change independentReferenceCLM (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N (0, AdditiveCanonical.input R μ B t) =
    samplerBrownianInput QN (diffusion (A := A) N K) (coordinate (Z := Z) N)
      (coordinate_isPreBrownian μ N) a t
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [independentReferenceCLM_coe (A := A) (Z := Z) Q N
      (0, AdditiveCanonical.input R μ B t), hall,
    samplerBrownianInput_coe QN (diffusion (A := A) N K) (coordinate (Z := Z) N)
      (coordinate_isPreBrownian μ N) a t] with ω hp hall hf
  rw [hp, hf, diffusion_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · funext i
    dsimp only
    rw [hall i]
    congr 1

almost everywhere. All four coordinates use the same sample. -/

end Random

section ParticleMomentumRate

  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

pairLp.exact_header: def pairLp (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) : Lp (A × C) 2 Q

pairLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem pairLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    pairLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ (a ω, x ω)
pairLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem pairLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    pairLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ (a ω, x ω) := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add ((ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).compLp a)
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).compLp x),
    (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).coeFn_compLp a,
    (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).coeFn_compLp x] with ω ha h1 h2
  change (pairLp Q a x) ω = _
  rw [show pairLp Q a x = (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).compLp a +
    (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).compLp x from rfl, ha]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp

inlLp_norm_le.exact_header:
private theorem inlLp_norm_le (a : Lp A 2 Q) :
    ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).compLp a‖ ≤ ‖a‖
inlLp_norm_le.exact_declaration:
private theorem inlLp_norm_le (a : Lp A 2 Q) :
    ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).compLp a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
  apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A C).coeFn_compLp a] with ω hω
  rw [hω]
  simp

inrLp_norm_le.exact_header:
private theorem inrLp_norm_le (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).compLp x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
inrLp_norm_le.exact_declaration:
private theorem inrLp_norm_le (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).compLp x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
  filter_upwards [(ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A C).coeFn_compLp x] with ω hω
  rw [hω]
  simp

pairLp_norm_sub_le.exact_header:
theorem pairLp_norm_sub_le (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖pairLp Q a x - pairLp Q b y‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖
pairLp_norm_sub_le.exact_declaration:
theorem pairLp_norm_sub_le (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖pairLp Q a x - pairLp Q b y‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖ := by
  have he : pairLp Q a x - pairLp Q b y = pairLp Q (a - b) (x - y) := by
    unfold pairLp
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    module
  rw [he]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (inlLp_norm_le Q _) (inrLp_norm_le Q _))

jointValue.exact_header: def jointValue (s : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) (ω : Ω) : A × C
jointValue.exact_declaration: def jointValue (s : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) (ω : Ω) : A × C := (s.1 ω, s.2 ω)

phaseValue.exact_header:
def phaseValue (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q))
    (ω : Ω) : (A × C) × (A × C)
phaseValue.exact_declaration:
def phaseValue (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q))
    (ω : Ω) : (A × C) × (A × C) := (jointValue Q z.1 ω, jointValue Q z.2 ω)

jointValue_add.exact_header:
theorem jointValue_add (s t : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (s + t) ω = jointValue Q s ω + jointValue Q t ω
jointValue_add.exact_declaration:
theorem jointValue_add (s t : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (s + t) ω = jointValue Q s ω + jointValue Q t ω := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add s.1 t.1, Lp.coeFn_add s.2 t.2] with ω h1 h2
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

jointValue_sub.exact_header:
theorem jointValue_sub (s t : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (s - t) ω = jointValue Q s ω - jointValue Q t ω
jointValue_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem jointValue_sub (s t : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (s - t) ω = jointValue Q s ω - jointValue Q t ω := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub s.1 t.1, Lp.coeFn_sub s.2 t.2] with ω h1 h2
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

jointValue_smul.exact_header:
theorem jointValue_smul (r : ℝ) (s : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (r • s) ω = r • jointValue Q s ω
jointValue_smul.exact_declaration:
theorem jointValue_smul (r : ℝ) (s : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, jointValue Q (r • s) ω = r • jointValue Q s ω := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul r s.1, Lp.coeFn_smul r s.2] with ω h1 h2
  exact Prod.ext h1 h2

ornsteinStep_Lp_coe.exact_header:
theorem ornsteinStep_Lp_coe (η σ : ℝ) (ξ : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z) ω =
        KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ (jointValue Q ξ ω) (phaseValue Q z ω)
ornsteinStep_Lp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem ornsteinStep_Lp_coe (η σ : ℝ) (ξ : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ ξ z) ω =
        KineticLangevin.ornsteinStep η σ (jointValue Q ξ ω) (phaseValue Q z ω) := by
  filter_upwards [jointValue_add Q (η • z.1) (σ • ξ),
    jointValue_smul Q η z.1, jointValue_smul Q σ ξ] with ω ha hη hσ
  change (jointValue Q (η • z.1 + σ • ξ) ω, jointValue Q z.2 ω) = _
  rw [ha, hη, hσ]
  rfl

driftStep_Lp_coe.exact_header:
theorem driftStep_Lp_coe (h : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.driftStep h z) ω =
      KineticLangevin.driftStep h (phaseValue Q z ω)
driftStep_Lp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem driftStep_Lp_coe (h : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.driftStep h z) ω =
      KineticLangevin.driftStep h (phaseValue Q z ω) := by
  filter_upwards [jointValue_add Q z.2 (h • z.1), jointValue_smul Q h z.1] with ω ha hs
  change (jointValue Q z.1 ω, jointValue Q (z.2 + h • z.1) ω) = _
  rw [ha, hs]
  rfl

holValue.exact_header: def holValue (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) (ω : Ω) : HOLState A C
holValue.exact_declaration:
def holValue (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) (ω : Ω) : HOLState A C :=
  (z.1 ω, z.2.1 ω, z.2.2.1 ω, z.2.2.2 ω)

linear5Lp_coe.exact_header:
theorem linear5Lp_coe (r s t u v : ℝ) (a b c d e : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (r • a + s • b + t • c + u • d + v • e) ω =
      r • a ω + s • b ω + t • c ω + u • d ω + v • e ω
linear5Lp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem linear5Lp_coe (r s t u v : ℝ) (a b c d e : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (r • a + s • b + t • c + u • d + v • e) ω =
      r • a ω + s • b ω + t • c ω + u • d ω + v • e ω := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add (r • a) (s • b),
    Lp.coeFn_add (r • a + s • b) (t • c),
    Lp.coeFn_add (r • a + s • b + t • c) (u • d),
    Lp.coeFn_add (r • a + s • b + t • c + u • d) (v • e),
    Lp.coeFn_smul r a, Lp.coeFn_smul s b, Lp.coeFn_smul t c,
    Lp.coeFn_smul u d, Lp.coeFn_smul v e] with ω h1 h2 h3 h4 ha hb hc hd he
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] at h1 h2 h3 h4 ha hb hc hd he
  rw [h4, h3, h2, h1, ha, hb, hc, hd, he]

ParticleForceData.exact_header:
structure ParticleForceData (A X C : Type*) (N : ℕ)
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup C] [NormedSpace ℝ C]
ParticleForceData.exact_declaration:
structure ParticleForceData (A X C : Type*) (N : ℕ)
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup C] [NormedSpace ℝ C] where
  nonempty : 0 < N
  F : A → X → A
  G : A → X → X
  parameterLip : ℝ≥0
  samplerLip : ℝ≥0
  parameter_bound : ∀ a b x y,
    ‖F a x - F b y‖ ≤ (parameterLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖)
  sampler_bound : ∀ a b x y,
    ‖G a x - G b y‖ ≤ (samplerLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖)
  cloud : C ≃L[ℝ] (Fin N → X)

meanForce.exact_declaration: def meanForce (s : A × C) : A := particleMeanForce D.F s.1 (D.cloud s.2)

samplerForce.exact_declaration:
def samplerForce (s : A × C) : C :=
  D.cloud.symm (particleSamplerForce D.G s.1 (D.cloud s.2))

meanForce_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem meanForce_lipschitz : LipschitzWith D.meanLip D.meanForce := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  have hm := particleMeanForce_lipschitz D.nonempty D.F (D.parameterLip : ℝ)
    D.parameterLip.coe_nonneg D.parameter_bound s.1 t.1 (D.cloud s.2) (D.cloud t.2)
  have he := D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap.lipschitzWith.norm_sub_le s.2 t.2
  have hA : ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_fst_le (s - t)
  have hC : ‖s.2 - t.2‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_snd_le (s - t)
  have henc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC (norm_nonneg D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap)
  change ‖particleMeanForce D.F s.1 (D.cloud s.2) -
    particleMeanForce D.F t.1 (D.cloud t.2)‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (D.parameterLip : ℝ) * (‖s.1 - t.1‖ + ‖D.cloud s.2 - D.cloud t.2‖) := hm
    _ ≤ (D.parameterLip : ℝ) *
        (‖s - t‖ + ‖D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖s - t‖) := by
      gcongr
      exact he.trans henc
    _ = _ := by simp [meanLip, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_add]; ring

samplerForce_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerForce_lipschitz : LipschitzWith D.samplerForceLip D.samplerForce := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  have hg := particleSamplerForce_lipschitz D.G (D.samplerLip : ℝ)
    D.samplerLip.coe_nonneg D.sampler_bound s.1 t.1 (D.cloud s.2) (D.cloud t.2)
  have he := D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap.lipschitzWith.norm_sub_le s.2 t.2
  have hi := D.cloud.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.lipschitzWith.norm_sub_le
    (particleSamplerForce D.G s.1 (D.cloud s.2))
    (particleSamplerForce D.G t.1 (D.cloud t.2))
  have hA : ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_fst_le (s - t)
  have hC : ‖s.2 - t.2‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_snd_le (s - t)
  have henc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC (norm_nonneg D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap)
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖D.cloud.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ *
      ‖particleSamplerForce D.G s.1 (D.cloud s.2) -
        particleSamplerForce D.G t.1 (D.cloud t.2)‖ := hi
    _ ≤ ‖D.cloud.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ((D.samplerLip : ℝ) *
      (‖s - t‖ + ‖D.cloud.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖s - t‖)) := by
      gcongr
      exact hg.trans (by gcongr; exact he.trans henc)
    _ = _ := by simp [samplerForceLip, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_add]; ring

meanForceLp.exact_header: def meanForceLp (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) : Lp A 2 Q
meanForceLp.exact_declaration:
def meanForceLp (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) : Lp A 2 Q :=
  PBGSO.liftMap Q D.meanForce D.meanForce_lipschitz (pairLp Q a x)

samplerForceLp.exact_header: def samplerForceLp (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) : Lp C 2 Q
samplerForceLp.exact_declaration:
def samplerForceLp (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) : Lp C 2 Q :=
  PBGSO.liftMap Q D.samplerForce D.samplerForce_lipschitz (pairLp Q a x)

meanForceLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem meanForceLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    D.meanForceLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, D.F (a ω) (D.cloud (x ω) i)
meanForceLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem meanForceLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    D.meanForceLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, D.F (a ω) (D.cloud (x ω) i) := by
  filter_upwards [PBGSO.liftMap_coe Q D.meanForce D.meanForce_lipschitz (pairLp Q a x),
    pairLp_coe Q a x] with ω hf hp
  change (D.meanForceLp Q a x) ω = D.meanForce ((pairLp Q a x) ω) at hf
  rw [hf, hp]
  rfl

samplerForceLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem samplerForceLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i : Fin N,
      D.cloud (D.samplerForceLp Q a x ω) i = D.G (a ω) (D.cloud (x ω) i)
samplerForceLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerForceLp_coe (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i : Fin N,
      D.cloud (D.samplerForceLp Q a x ω) i = D.G (a ω) (D.cloud (x ω) i) := by
  filter_upwards [PBGSO.liftMap_coe Q D.samplerForce D.samplerForce_lipschitz (pairLp Q a x),
    pairLp_coe Q a x] with ω hf hp
  change (D.samplerForceLp Q a x) ω = D.samplerForce ((pairLp Q a x) ω) at hf
  rw [hf, hp]
  simp [samplerForce, particleSamplerForce]

samplerForceLp_coe_cloud.exact_header:
theorem samplerForceLp_coe_cloud (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    D.samplerForceLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ D.samplerForce (a ω, x ω)
samplerForceLp_coe_cloud.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerForceLp_coe_cloud (a : Lp A 2 Q) (x : Lp C 2 Q) :
    D.samplerForceLp Q a x =ᵐ[Q] fun ω ↦ D.samplerForce (a ω, x ω) := by
  filter_upwards [PBGSO.liftMap_coe Q D.samplerForce D.samplerForce_lipschitz (pairLp Q a x),
    pairLp_coe Q a x] with ω hf hp
  change (D.samplerForceLp Q a x) ω = D.samplerForce ((pairLp Q a x) ω) at hf
  rw [hf, hp]

meanForceLp_bound.exact_header:
theorem meanForceLp_bound (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖D.meanForceLp Q a x - D.meanForceLp Q b y‖ ≤
      (D.meanLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖)
meanForceLp_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem meanForceLp_bound (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖D.meanForceLp Q a x - D.meanForceLp Q b y‖ ≤
      (D.meanLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖) := by
  exact ((PBGSO.liftMap_lipschitz Q D.meanForce D.meanForce_lipschitz).norm_sub_le
    (pairLp Q a x) (pairLp Q b y)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pairLp_norm_sub_le Q a b x y) D.meanLip.coe_nonneg)

samplerForceLp_bound.exact_header:
theorem samplerForceLp_bound (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖D.samplerForceLp Q a x - D.samplerForceLp Q b y‖ ≤
      (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖)
samplerForceLp_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerForceLp_bound (a b : Lp A 2 Q) (x y : Lp C 2 Q) :
    ‖D.samplerForceLp Q a x - D.samplerForceLp Q b y‖ ≤
      (D.samplerForceLip : ℝ) * (‖a - b‖ + ‖x - y‖) := by
  exact ((PBGSO.liftMap_lipschitz Q D.samplerForce D.samplerForce_lipschitz).norm_sub_le
    (pairLp Q a x) (pairLp Q b y)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pairLp_norm_sub_le Q a b x y) D.samplerForceLip.coe_nonneg)

rawCoupledForce.exact_header: def rawCoupledForce (q : A × C) : A × C
rawCoupledForce.exact_declaration: def rawCoupledForce (q : A × C) : A × C := (D.meanForce q, D.samplerForce q)

coupledForceLp_coe.exact_header:
theorem coupledForceLp_coe (q : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      jointValue Q (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) q) ω =
        D.rawCoupledForce (jointValue Q q ω)
coupledForceLp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem coupledForceLp_coe (q : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      jointValue Q (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) q) ω =
        D.rawCoupledForce (jointValue Q q ω) := by
  filter_upwards [D.meanForceLp_coe Q q.1 q.2,
    D.samplerForceLp_coe_cloud Q q.1 q.2] with ω hf hg
  exact Prod.ext hf hg

kickStep_Lp_coe.exact_header:
theorem kickStep_Lp_coe (h : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.kickStep
        (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)) h z) ω =
      KineticLangevin.kickStep D.rawCoupledForce h (phaseValue Q z ω)
kickStep_Lp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem kickStep_Lp_coe (h : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.kickStep
        (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)) h z) ω =
      KineticLangevin.kickStep D.rawCoupledForce h (phaseValue Q z ω) := by
  let f := coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)
  filter_upwards [jointValue_sub Q z.1 (h • f z.2),
    jointValue_smul Q h (f z.2), D.coupledForceLp_coe Q z.2] with ω hsub hs hf
  change (jointValue Q (z.1 - h • f z.2) ω, jointValue Q z.2 ω) = _
  rw [hsub, hs, hf]
  rfl

obaboStep_Lp_coe.exact_header:
theorem obaboStep_Lp_coe (h η σ : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q))
    (ξ ξ' : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.obaboStep
        (coupledForce (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q)) h η σ z ξ ξ') ω =
      KineticLangevin.obaboStep D.rawCoupledForce h η σ
        (phaseValue Q z ω) (jointValue Q ξ ω) (jointValue Q ξ' ω)
obaboStep_Lp_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem obaboStep_Lp_coe (h η σ : ℝ)
    (z : (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) × (Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q))
    (ξ ξ' : Lp A 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      phaseValue Q (KineticLangevin.obaboStep

    (z : HOLState (Lp A 2 Q) (Lp C 2 Q)) (ξ : Lp C 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q × Lp C 2 Q) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      holValue Q (higherOrderStep (D.meanForceLp Q) (D.samplerForceLp Q) α γ h z ξ) ω =
        higherOrderStep (fun a x ↦ D.meanForce (a, x))
          (fun a x ↦ D.samplerForce (a, x)) α γ h (holValue Q z ω)
          (ξ.1 ω, ξ.2.1 ω, ξ.2.2 ω) := by

  let Δ := h • D.samplerForceLp Q θ z.2.1

  have hθ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, θ ω = z.1 ω - h • D.meanForce (z.1 ω, z.2.1 ω) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub z.1 (h • D.meanForceLp Q z.1 z.2.1),
      Lp.coeFn_smul h (D.meanForceLp Q z.1 z.2.1),
      D.meanForceLp_coe Q z.1 z.2.1] with ω hs hm hf
    change (z.1 - h • D.meanForceLp Q z.1 z.2.1) ω = _
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply] at hs hm
    rw [hs, hm, hf]
    rfl
  have hΔ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Δ ω = h • D.samplerForce (θ ω, z.2.1 ω) := by
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul h (D.samplerForceLp Q θ z.2.1),
      D.samplerForceLp_coe_cloud Q θ z.2.1] with ω hs hg
    change (h • D.samplerForceLp Q θ z.2.1) ω = _
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at hs
    rw [hs, hg]
  have hx : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (z.2.1 - (h / 2) • Δ + μ.μ12 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.1) ω =
        z.2.1 ω + (-(h / 2)) • Δ ω + μ.μ12 • z.2.2.1 ω +
          μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 ω + ξ.1 ω := by
    have he : z.2.1 - (h / 2) • Δ + μ.μ12 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.1 =
        1 • z.2.1 + (-(h / 2)) • Δ + μ.μ12 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + 1 • ξ.1 := by module
    rw [he]
    simpa only [one_smul] using linear5Lp_coe Q 1 (-(h / 2)) μ.μ12 μ.μ13 1
      z.2.1 Δ z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2 ξ.1
  have hu : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,

    have he : -Δ + μ.μ22 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ23 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.1 =
        (-1 : ℝ) • Δ + μ.μ22 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ23 • z.2.2.2 + 1 • ξ.2.1 + 0 • z.2.2.1 := by module
    rw [he]
    simpa only [neg_one_smul, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero] using
      linear5Lp_coe Q (-1) μ.μ22 μ.μ23 1 0 Δ z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2 ξ.2.1 z.2.2.1
  have hv : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (μ.μ31 • Δ + μ.μ32 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ33 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.2) ω =
        μ.μ31 • Δ ω + μ.μ32 • z.2.2.1 ω + μ.μ33 • z.2.2.2 ω + ξ.2.2 ω := by
    have he : μ.μ31 • Δ + μ.μ32 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ33 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.2 =
        μ.μ31 • Δ + μ.μ32 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ33 • z.2.2.2 + 1 • ξ.2.2 + 0 • z.2.2.1 := by module
    rw [he]
    simpa only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero] using
      linear5Lp_coe Q μ.μ31 μ.μ32 μ.μ33 1 0 Δ z.2.2.1 z.2.2.2 ξ.2.2 z.2.2.1
  filter_upwards [hθ, hΔ, hx, hu, hv] with ω ht hd hxx huu hvv

    (z.2.1 - (h / 2) • Δ + μ.μ12 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ13 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.1) ω,
    (-Δ + μ.μ22 • z.2.2.1 + μ.μ23 • z.2.2.2 + ξ.2.1) ω,

/-! # Constructing the general interacting particle integral equation

The shared optimiser is a random coordinate of the particle state. Every
sampler particle uses this same optimiser and the actual finite-sum
observation. The construction has no potential assumption and no optimiser
noise. It gives norm-continuous L² solutions for additive input.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.LipschitzDynamics

variable {A Z G : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
  (D : PBGSO.LipschitzDynamics A Z G)

/-- The particle observation is the actual finite average. -/

averageObservation.exact_header: def averageObservation (N : ℕ) (s : A × (Fin N → Z)) : G
averageObservation.exact_declaration:
def averageObservation (N : ℕ) (s : A × (Fin N → Z)) : G :=
  (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, D.observation s.1 (s.2 i)

averageObservation_bound.exact_header:
theorem averageObservation_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (s t : A × (Fin N → Z)) :
    ‖D.averageObservation N s - D.averageObservation N t‖ ≤
      2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖
averageObservation_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem averageObservation_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (s t : A × (Fin N → Z)) :
    ‖D.averageObservation N s - D.averageObservation N t‖ ≤
      2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖ := by
  classical
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hobs (i : Fin N) :
      ‖D.observation s.1 (s.2 i) - D.observation t.1 (t.2 i)‖ ≤
        2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖ := by
    have ha := D.observation_parameter s.1 t.1 (s.2 i)
    have hx := (D.observation_state t.1).norm_sub_le (s.2 i) (t.2 i)
    have hs := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub
      (D.observation s.1 (s.2 i)) (D.observation t.1 (s.2 i))
      (D.observation t.1 (t.2 i))
    have hA : ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_fst_le (s - t)
    have hZ : ‖s.2 i - t.2 i‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ :=
      (norm_le_pi_norm (s.2 - t.2) i).trans (norm_snd_le (s - t))
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA D.observationLip.coe_nonneg,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ D.observationLip.coe_nonneg]
  calc
    _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖∑ i,
        (D.observation s.1 (s.2 i) - D.observation t.1 (t.2 i))‖ := by
      simp only [averageObservation, ← smul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)]
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖D.observation s.1 (s.2 i) -
        D.observation t.1 (t.2 i)‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i : Fin N, 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hobs i)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hn), one_mul]

particleField.exact_header: def particleField (N : ℕ) (s : A × (Fin N → Z)) : A × (Fin N → Z)
particleField.exact_declaration:
def particleField (N : ℕ) (s : A × (Fin N → Z)) : A × (Fin N → Z) :=
  (D.response (s.1, D.averageObservation N s), fun i => D.sampler s.1 (s.2 i))

particleField_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem particleField_lipschitz (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    LipschitzWith D.fieldLip (D.particleField N)
particleField_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem particleField_lipschitz (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    LipschitzWith D.fieldLip (D.particleField N) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s t
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  change max ‖D.response (s.1, D.averageObservation N s) -
      D.response (t.1, D.averageObservation N t)‖
    ‖(fun i => D.sampler s.1 (s.2 i)) - (fun i => D.sampler t.1 (t.2 i))‖ ≤ _
  have hA : ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ := norm_fst_le (s - t)
  have hG := D.averageObservation_bound N hN s t
  have hmax : max ‖s.1 - t.1‖ ‖D.averageObservation N s - D.averageObservation N t‖ ≤
      (1 + 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ)) * ‖s - t‖ := by
    apply max_le
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.observationLip.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (s - t))]
    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - t)]
  have hR := D.response_lipschitz.norm_sub_le
    (s.1, D.averageObservation N s) (t.1, D.averageObservation N t)
  have hr : ‖D.response (s.1, D.averageObservation N s) -
      D.response (t.1, D.averageObservation N t)‖ ≤
      (D.responseLip : ℝ) * ((1 + 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ)) * ‖s - t‖) :=
    hR.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax D.responseLip.coe_nonneg)
  have hS : ‖(fun i => D.sampler s.1 (s.2 i)) - (fun i => D.sampler t.1 (t.2 i))‖ ≤
      2 * (D.samplerLip : ℝ) * ‖s - t‖ := by
    apply pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity) |>.mpr
    intro i
    change ‖D.sampler s.1 (s.2 i) - D.sampler t.1 (t.2 i)‖ ≤ _
    have ha := D.sampler_parameter s.1 t.1 (s.2 i)
    have hx := (D.sampler_state t.1).norm_sub_le (s.2 i) (t.2 i)
    have hs := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub
      (D.sampler s.1 (s.2 i)) (D.sampler t.1 (s.2 i)) (D.sampler t.1 (t.2 i))
    have hZ : ‖s.2 i - t.2 i‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ :=
      (norm_le_pi_norm (s.2 - t.2) i).trans (norm_snd_le (s - t))
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA D.samplerLip.coe_nonneg,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ D.samplerLip.coe_nonneg]
  apply max_le
  · dsimp [fieldLip]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.samplerLip.coe_nonneg (norm_nonneg (s - t))]
  · dsimp [fieldLip]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg D.responseLip.coe_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * (D.observationLip : ℝ) by positivity)
        (norm_nonneg (s - t)))]

exists_particle_integral.exact_header:
theorem exists_particle_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (initial : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (D.particleField N)
          (D.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y s)) + B t
exists_particle_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_particle_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (initial : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (D.particleField N)
          (D.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y s)) + B t := by
  let f := ULA.lpDrift Q (D.particleField N) (D.particleField_lipschitz N hN)
  have hf : LipschitzWith D.fieldLip f := ULA.lpDrift_lipschitz Q _ _
  obtain ⟨Y, hc, hi, he⟩ := ULA.exists_langevin_integral
    (fun s => -f s) D.fieldLip hf.neg initial B hB hB0 T hT
  refine ⟨Y, hc, hi, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg] using he t ht

exists_particle_sampler_integral.exact_header:
theorem exists_particle_sampler_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (initial : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Fin N → Z) 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (D.particleField N)
          (D.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y s)) + particleSamplerInput Q N (B t)
exists_particle_sampler_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_particle_sampler_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (initial : Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q)
    (B : ℝ → Lp (Fin N → Z) 2 Q) (hB : Continuous B) (hB0 : B 0 = 0)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ → Lp (A × (Fin N → Z)) 2 Q, Continuous Y ∧ Y 0 = initial ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - initial =
        (∫ s in 0..t, ULA.lpDrift Q (D.particleField N)
          (D.particleField_lipschitz N hN) (Y s)) + particleSamplerInput Q N (B t) := by
  apply D.exists_particle_integral Q N hN initial
    (fun t => particleSamplerInput Q N (B t))
  · exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).compLpL 2 Q).continuous.comp hB
  · change ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A (Fin N → Z)).compLpL 2 Q) (B 0) = 0
    rw [hB0, map_zero]
  · exact hT

theorem toLp_real_norm_eq_sqrt_integral (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :
    ‖hf.toLp f‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂Q)
toLp_real_norm_eq_sqrt_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem toLp_real_norm_eq_sqrt_integral (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) :
    ‖hf.toLp f‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  have hn := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (hf.toLp f)
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖hf.toLp f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hf.coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
    simp only [hω, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [he] at hn
  rw [← hn, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals.exact_header:
theorem integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals (f g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) (hg : MemLp g 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂Q) * Real.sqrt (∫ ω, g ω ^ 2 ∂Q)
integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals (f g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : MemLp f 2 Q) (hg : MemLp g 2 Q) :
    (∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂Q) * Real.sqrt (∫ ω, g ω ^ 2 ∂Q) := by
  have he : (∫ ω, f ω * g ω ∂Q) = inner ℝ (hf.toLp f) (hg.toLp g) := by

theorem referenceObservationError_memLp (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ)

theorem particlePopulationResidual_aestronglyMeasurable (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (sbar : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z))
    (hCloud : Q.map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar) (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ g g', ‖M.optimizer t sbar g - M.optimizer t sbar g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q
particlePopulationResidual_aestronglyMea.exact_declaration:
theorem particlePopulationResidual_aestronglyMeasurable (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (sbar : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z))
    (hCloud : Q.map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar) (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ g g', ‖M.optimizer t sbar g - M.optimizer t sbar g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q := by
  let f : Θ → S := fun e =>
    M.optimizer t sbar (e + M.meanGradient ν sbar) - M.optimizer t sbar (M.meanGradient ν sbar)
  have hf : LipschitzWith LΨ f := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    simpa only [f, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using
      hΨ (x + M.meanGradient ν sbar) (y + M.meanGradient ν sbar)
  have hE := (referenceObservationError_memLp M N ν sbar hF Q hCloud).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hW := D.optimizerWeight.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    (hf.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hE)
  have hA : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => p.1.1 - sbar) Q :=
    (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const
  apply (hA.inner hW).congr
  filter_upwards [hbar] with p hp
  simp only [particlePopulationResidual, Model.particleField, Model.optimizerField, hp,
    f, referenceObservationError, sub_add_cancel]

theorem particlePopulationResidual_abs_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) (sbar : S) (p : ParticlePair N S Z)
    (hbar : p.2.1 = sbar) :
    |particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p| ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
        Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) *
          ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar p‖
particlePopulationResidual_abs_le.exact_declaration:
theorem particlePopulationResidual_abs_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) (sbar : S) (p : ParticlePair N S Z)
    (hbar : p.2.1 = sbar) :
    |particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p| ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
        Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) *
          ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar p‖ := by
  have hp := D.optimizer_pairing_bound (p.1.1 - p.2.1)
    (M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.optimizerField t p.2.1 ν)
  have hl := hΨ p.2.1 (M.particleGradient N p.2.1 p.2.2) (M.meanGradient ν p.2.1)
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (optimizerSq_le_particleQuadratic D N p)
  have hu : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt D.upper := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (D.optimizerSq (p.1.1 - p.2.1))) hu)
  have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt D.upper * (LΨ : ℝ) *
      ‖M.particleGradient N p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.meanGradient ν p.2.1‖)
  dsimp only [particlePopulationResidual, Model.particleField, Model.optimizerField]
  unfold Model.particleField Model.optimizerField at hp
  unfold referenceObservationError
  rw [← hbar]
  nlinarith

theorem expectedParticlePopulationResidual_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (sbar : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (hCloud : Q.map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar)
    (hquad : Integrable (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) Q)
    (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hR : AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q) :

    (∫ p, particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p ∂Q) ≤

        Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) *

expectedParticlePopulationResidual_le.exact_declaration:
theorem expectedParticlePopulationResidual_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (sbar : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (hCloud : Q.map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
    (hbar : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, p.2.1 = sbar)
    (hquad : Integrable (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) Q)
    (t : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hR : AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q) :
    Integrable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q ∧
    (∫ p, particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p ∂Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) *
        Real.sqrt ((∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) -
          M.meanGradient ν sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) / (N : ℝ)) := by
  let a := fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p)
  let b := fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar p‖
  let C := (LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper
  have ha : MemLp a 2 Q := sqrt_energy_memLp Q _ hquad.aestronglyMeasurable hquad
    (particleQuadratic_nonneg D N)
  have hb : MemLp b 2 Q := (referenceObservationError_memLp M N ν sbar hF Q hCloud).norm
  have hab : Integrable (fun p => C * (a p * b p)) Q := by
    have hh : MemLp (fun p => a p * b p) 1 Q := ha.mul hb
    exact (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hh).const_mul C
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ p ∂Q, |particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p| ≤ C * (a p * b p) := by
    filter_upwards [hbar] with p hp
    simpa only [C, a, b, mul_assoc] using
      particlePopulationResidual_abs_le M D N ν t LΨ hΨ sbar p hp
  have hir : Integrable (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t) Q :=
    hab.mono' hR (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound)
  refine ⟨hir, ?_⟩
  have hi := integral_mono_ae hir hab (hbound.mono fun p hp => (le_abs_self _).trans hp)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hi
  have hcs := integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals Q a b ha hb
  have heA : (∫ p, a p ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all Q fun p => Real.sq_sqrt (particleQuadratic_nonneg D N p)
  have heB : (∫ p, b p ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient ν sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) / (N : ℝ) :=
    referenceObservationError_variance M N hN ν sbar hF Q hCloud
  rw [heA, heB] at hcs
  have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs
    (show 0 ≤ C from mul_nonneg LΨ.coe_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  exact hi.trans (by simpa [C, mul_assoc] using hc)
