particle_empirical_rms_le_energy.exact_declaration:
theorem particle_empirical_rms_le_energy (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (Q : Measure (ParticlePair N S Z))
    (hq : Integrable (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) Q)
    (hmetric : AEStronglyMeasurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) Q) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N p ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) / Real.sqrt D.lower := by
  have hpos (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : 0 ≤ particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N p :=
    add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hp (p : ParticlePair N S Z) :
      particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N p ≤ (D.lower)⁻¹ * particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p := by
    have h := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_le N hN p)
      D.lower_pos.le).trans (particleEuclideanEnergy_lower D N p)
    rw [inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ D.lower_pos).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using h)
  have hi : Integrable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) Q :=
    (hq.const_mul D.lower⁻¹).mono' hmetric
      (ae_of_all Q fun p => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hpos p)] using hp p)
  have hb := integral_mono hi (hq.const_mul D.lower⁻¹) hp
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hb
  have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q :=
    integral_nonneg (particleQuadratic_nonneg D N)
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (D.lower⁻¹ * ∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb
    _ = Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Q) / Real.sqrt D.lower := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr D.lower_pos.le), Real.sqrt_inv]
      ring

    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hquad : (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ tests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V T : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (Γ r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hR : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r) (Γ r))
    (hzero : expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ t) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) / ρ *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  let E' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * ∫ p,
    particleCouplingWork M D N r p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
      particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r p ∂Γ r
  let c : ℝ := (LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))
  have hd (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ) (E' r) (Ici 0) r :=
    hsol.energy_hasDerivWithinAt D hquad r hr
  apply PBGSO.forced_energy_bound (E' := E') (T := T) hρ
    (show 0 ≤ c from mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg LΨ.coe_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  · intro r hr
    exact (hd r hr.1).continuousWithinAt.mono Icc_subset_Ici_self
  · intro r hr
    exact (hd r hr.1).mono (Ici_subset_Ici.mpr hr.1)
  · intro r _
    exact integral_nonneg (particleQuadratic_nonneg D N)
  · exact hzero
  · intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩
    letI := hν r hr'
    letI := hsol.probability r hr.1
    have hq := hsol.test_integrable _ hquad r hr.1
    obtain ⟨hir, hres⟩ := expectedParticlePopulationResidual_le M D N hN (ν r) (sbar r)
      (hF r hr') (Γ r) (hCloud r hr') (hbar r hr') hq r LΨ (hΨ r hr') (hR r hr')
    have hsum : Integrable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z =>
        particleCouplingWork M D N r p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
          particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r p) (Γ r) := by
      have hi := (hsol.generator_integrable _ hquad r hr.1).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      convert hi using 1
      ext p
      rw [particleCopyGenerator_quadratic]
      dsimp only [particlePopulationResidual]
      ring
    have hiw : Integrable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z =>
        particleCouplingWork M D N r p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2) (Γ r) := by
      convert hsum.sub hir using 1
      ext p
      exact (add_sub_cancel_right _ _).symm
    have hwork := integral_mono hiw (hq.const_mul (-ρ))
      (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z =>
        by simpa only [particleQuadraticBilinear_diag] using
          particleCouplingWork_le M D ρ hmono N hN r hr.1 p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at hwork
    have hvar := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hVariance r hr') (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N))
    have hvar' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvar
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper *
        Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ r))
    change _ ≤ ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
      Real.sqrt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ r) * _ at hres
    dsimp only [E']
    rw [integral_add hiw hir]
    dsimp only [c, expectedParticleEnergy] at *
    nlinarith
  · exact ht

    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hquad : (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ tests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V T : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (Γ r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hR : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r) (Γ r))
    (hzero : expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T)
    (hmetric : AEStronglyMeasurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) (Γ t)) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N p ∂Γ t) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t))
finite_particle_interaction_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_particle_interaction_bound (hsol : IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν tests Γ)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hquad : (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ tests)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V T : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hν : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r))
    (hF : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν r))
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (Γ r).map (fun p => p.2.2) = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν r))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ r, p.2.1 = sbar r)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g - M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖)
    (hVariance : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar r)) (M.position z) -
        M.meanGradient (ν r) (sbar r)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν r) ≤ V)
    (hR : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 T,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (particlePopulationResidual M D N (ν r) r) (Γ r))
    (hzero : expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ 0 = 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T)
    (hmetric : AEStronglyMeasurable (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq (S := S) (Z := Z) N) (Γ t)) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ p, particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N p ∂Γ t) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * t)) := by
  have hE := hsol.forced_energy_bound D hN hquad ρ hρ hmono LΨ V T hV sbar
    hν hF hCloud hbar hΨ hVariance hR hzero t ht
  have hm := particle_empirical_rms_le_energy D N hN (Γ t)
    (hsol.test_integrable _ hquad t ht.1) hmetric
  have he := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg D.lower)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt D.upper / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show D.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = D.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ, D.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  apply hm.trans (he.trans_eq ?_)
  rw [hs]
  ring

import PBGSO.WeakContraction
import PBGSO.EmpiricalMonotonicity

/-! # The actual particle/copy synchronous generator

The complete optimiser is a coordinate of the random interacting state.
The reference optimiser uses a population observation and its sampler copies
use the same coordinate Brownian drivers as the interacting particles.
The quadratic generator is computed from both derivatives of the actual
finite-dimensional test. Its expected-energy identity follows from a weak
forward equation, rather than being assumed as an error estimate.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO

variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] [Fintype I]

/-- A full interacting state paired with a full independent-copy state.
The law of the latter is separately required to be an independent-copy law
when the Monte Carlo variance theorem is used. -/

/-- Difference of the complete optimiser coordinates. -/

/-- Difference of the paired i-th sampler coordinates. -/

/-- The actual bilinear form of the normalised particle coupling metric. -/




/-- The actual paired drift: empirical observation for the interacting
optimiser, population observation for the reference optimiser. -/

/-- One Brownian driver for particle i acts on the same reference copy i.
Both optimiser noise coordinates are identically zero. -/

/-- Full paired particle generator with the true empirical optimiser map. -/

/-- A diffusion column has exactly its corresponding normalised sampler
quadratic cost, with no optimiser contribution. -/

/-- The quadratic generator contains joint empirical work and precisely
the additional empirical-versus-population optimiser fluctuation. -/

section ForwardEquation
variable [MeasurableSpace S]

/-- The law-level forward equation for the displayed actual particle/copy
drift and synchronous diffusion. Reference iid marginals and deterministic
reference optimiser states are separate premises of sampling estimates. -/

/-- Expected actual optimiser-plus-averaged-particle quadratic separation. -/

namespace IsParticleCopyWeakSolution
variable {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {N : ℕ} {ν : ℝ → Measure Z}
  {tests : Set (ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ)} {Γ : ℝ → Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)}

/-- The expected energy derivative is computed from the actual full-state
generator, retaining precisely the population-gradient fluctuation term. -/

end IsParticleCopyWeakSolution
end ForwardEquation

end PBGSO

ParticlePair.exact_declaration:
abbrev ParticlePair (N : ℕ) (S Z : Type*) :=
  (S × (Fin N → Z)) × (S × (Fin N → Z))

particleOptimizerDifference.exact_header: def particleOptimizerDifference (N : ℕ) : ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] S
particleOptimizerDifference.exact_declaration:
def particleOptimizerDifference (N : ℕ) : ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] S :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (S × (Fin N → Z)) (S × (Fin N → Z))) -
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (S × (Fin N → Z)) (S × (Fin N → Z)))

particleSamplerDifference.exact_header: def particleSamplerDifference (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N) : ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] Z
particleSamplerDifference.exact_declaration:
def particleSamplerDifference (N : ℕ) (i : Fin N) : ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] Z :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (S × (Fin N → Z)) (S × (Fin N → Z))) -
     (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S (Fin N → Z)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (S × (Fin N → Z)) (S × (Fin N → Z))))

particleQuadraticBilinear.exact_header:
def particleQuadraticBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) :
    ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] ℝ
particleQuadraticBilinear.exact_declaration:
def particleQuadraticBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) :
    ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] ParticlePair N S Z →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (particleOptimizerDifference N)
      (D.optimizerWeight.comp (particleOptimizerDifference N)) +
    (N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin N,
      (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (particleSamplerDifference N i)
        (D.samplerWeight.comp (particleSamplerDifference N i))

particleQuadraticBilinear_apply.exact_header:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p q : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p q =
      ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight (q.1.1 - q.2.1)⟫ +
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ⟪p.1.2 i - p.2.2 i,
          D.samplerWeight (q.1.2 i - q.2.2 i)⟫
particleQuadraticBilinear_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p q : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p q =
      ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight (q.1.1 - q.2.1)⟫ +
        (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ⟪p.1.2 i - p.2.2 i,
          D.samplerWeight (q.1.2 i - q.2.2 i)⟫ := by
  simp [particleQuadraticBilinear, particleOptimizerDifference,
    particleSamplerDifference, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
    inner_sub_left, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p q : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p q = particleQuadraticBilinear D N q p
particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p q : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p q = particleQuadraticBilinear D N q p := by
  simp only [particleQuadraticBilinear_apply]
  congr 1
  · exact (D.optimizer_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (D.sampler_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)

particleQuadraticBilinear_diag.exact_header:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_diag (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p =
      particleCouplingEnergy D N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2
particleQuadraticBilinear_diag.exact_declaration:
theorem particleQuadraticBilinear_diag (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p =
      particleCouplingEnergy D N p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 :=
  particleQuadraticBilinear_apply D N p p

particleCopyDrift.exact_header:
def particleCopyDrift (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z)
    (t : ℝ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : ParticlePair N S Z
particleCopyDrift.exact_declaration:
def particleCopyDrift (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z)
    (t : ℝ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : ParticlePair N S Z :=
  ((M.particleField N t p.1.1 p.1.2,
      fun i => M.drift (M.parameter p.1.1) (p.1.2 i)),
   (M.optimizerField t p.2.1 ν,
      fun i => M.drift (M.parameter p.2.1) (p.2.2 i)))

particleCopyDiffusion.exact_header:
def particleCopyDiffusion (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) (ij : Fin N × I) : ParticlePair N S Z
particleCopyDiffusion.exact_declaration:
def particleCopyDiffusion (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) (ij : Fin N × I) : ParticlePair N S Z :=
  ((0, fun k => if k = ij.1 then M.diffusion (M.parameter p.1.1) (p.1.2 k) ij.2 else 0),
   (0, fun k => if k = ij.1 then M.diffusion (M.parameter p.2.1) (p.2.2 k) ij.2 else 0))

particleCopyGenerator.exact_header:
def particleCopyGenerator (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z)
    (t : ℝ) (φ : ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : ℝ
particleCopyGenerator.exact_declaration:
def particleCopyGenerator (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z)
    (t : ℝ) (φ : ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ φ p (particleCopyDrift M N ν t p) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ ij : Fin N × I,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) p
        (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij) (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)

particleCopyDiffusion_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem particleCopyDiffusion_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)
      (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij) =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * D.samplerSq
        (M.diffusion (M.parameter p.1.1) (p.1.2 ij.1) ij.2 -
         M.diffusion (M.parameter p.2.1) (p.2.2 ij.1) ij.2)
particleCopyDiffusion_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem particleCopyDiffusion_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (p : ParticlePair N S Z) (ij : Fin N × I) :
    particleQuadraticBilinear D N (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij)
      (particleCopyDiffusion M N p ij) =
      (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * D.samplerSq
        (M.diffusion (M.parameter p.1.1) (p.1.2 ij.1) ij.2 -
         M.diffusion (M.parameter p.2.1) (p.2.2 ij.1) ij.2) := by
  classical
  rw [particleQuadraticBilinear_apply]
  dsimp only [particleCopyDiffusion]
  simp only [sub_self, inner_zero_left, zero_add]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ij.1]
  · simp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
  · intro k _ hk
    simp [hk]
  · simp

particleCopyGenerator_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem particleCopyGenerator_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleCopyGenerator M N ν t (fun q => particleQuadraticBilinear D N q q) p =
      2 * (particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
        ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight
          (M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.optimizerField t p.2.1 ν)⟫)
particleCopyGenerator_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem particleCopyGenerator_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ)
    (p : ParticlePair N S Z) :
    particleCopyGenerator M N ν t (fun q => particleQuadraticBilinear D N q q) p =
      2 * (particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
        ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight
          (M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.optimizerField t p.2.1 ν)⟫) := by
  classical

  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
    quadratic_second_fderiv, particleQuadraticBilinear_symmetric]
  rw [← particle_population_work_decomposition M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 ν]
  simp_rw [← two_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp_rw [particleCopyDiffusion_quadratic]
  simp only [particleQuadraticBilinear_apply, particleCopyDrift]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, samplerCouplingWork, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

structure IsParticleCopyWeakSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (tests : Set (ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ))
    (Γ : ℝ → Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) : Prop
IsParticleCopyWeakSolution.exact_declaration:
structure IsParticleCopyWeakSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ)
    (ν : ℝ → Measure Z) (tests : Set (ParticlePair N S Z → ℝ))
    (Γ : ℝ → Measure (ParticlePair N S Z)) : Prop where
  probability : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → IsProbabilityMeasure (Γ t)
  test_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ tests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Integrable φ (Γ t)

energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_header:
theorem energy_hasDerivWithinAt (hsol : IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν tests Γ)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hquad : (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ tests)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ)
      (2 * ∫ p, particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
        ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight
          (M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.optimizerField t p.2.1 (ν t))⟫ ∂Γ t)
      (Set.Ici 0) t
energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_hasDerivWithinAt (hsol : IsParticleCopyWeakSolution M N ν tests Γ)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (hquad : (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) ∈ tests)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (expectedParticleEnergy D N Γ)
      (2 * ∫ p, particleCouplingWork M D N t p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2 +
        ⟪p.1.1 - p.2.1, D.optimizerWeight
          (M.particleField N t p.2.1 p.2.2 - M.optimizerField t p.2.1 (ν t))⟫ ∂Γ t)
      (Set.Ici 0) t := by
  have hd := hsol.forward_equation _ hquad t ht
  simp_rw [particleCopyGenerator_quadratic] at hd
  change HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => ∫ p, particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p ∂Γ r)
    _ _ _
  simpa only [integral_const_mul] using hd

The drift is only Bochner L¹ on each path. No L¹-time L² drift or
quadratic-variation conclusion is an assumption.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology NNReal
namespace PBGSO.PartitionFiniteVariation
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]



variable {T : ℝ}





/-- Total variation on the actual partition is bounded by the original
pathwise L¹ drift integral, including repeated partition times. -/

/-- A bilinear increment sum is controlled by one uniform increment bound
and the original total variation of the other path. -/

/-- Work error for an arbitrary monotone partition. Only continuity of the
state and pathwise L¹ drift are used; a time derivative is unnecessary. -/

/-- The actual uniform dyadic partition, not a supplied approximation. -/


/-- Compact path continuity supplies a simultaneous bound for every point
of every fine dyadic cell, with no assumed modulus. -/



/-- Error controls on every positive tolerance imply an actual limit. -/

/-- Left-state work sums converge to the actual pathwise drift work. -/

/-- The indefinite primitive has the literal original drift increments. -/

/-- Quadratic finite-variation increments vanish on actual dyadic meshes.

clm_intervalIntegrable.exact_declaration:
theorem clm_intervalIntegrable (L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ → E) {a c : ℝ}
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume a c) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => L (b r)) volume a c := by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff] at hb ⊢
  exact L.integrable_comp hb

Partition.exact_declaration:
structure Partition (T : ℝ) where
  time : ℕ → ℝ
  count : ℕ
  monotone : Monotone time
  start : time 0 = 0
  finish : time count = T

Partition.nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.nonneg (P : Partition T) : 0 ≤ T := by
  simpa only [P.start, P.finish] using P.monotone (Nat.zero_le P.count)

Partition.mem.exact_header:
theorem Partition.mem (P : Partition T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ P.count) :
    P.time k ∈ Icc 0 T
Partition.mem.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.mem (P : Partition T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ P.count) :
    P.time k ∈ Icc 0 T := by
  constructor
  · rw [← P.start]; exact P.monotone (Nat.zero_le _)
  · exact (P.monotone hk).trans_eq P.finish

Partition.cell_integrable.exact_header:
theorem Partition.cell_integrable (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    IntervalIntegrable b volume (P.time k) (P.time (k + 1))
Partition.cell_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.cell_integrable (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    IntervalIntegrable b volume (P.time k) (P.time (k + 1)) := by
  apply hb.mono_set'
  rw [uIoc_of_le (P.monotone (Nat.le_succ k)), uIoc_of_le P.nonneg]
  exact Ioc_subset_Ioc (P.mem k hk.le).1 (P.mem (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)).2

Partition.sum_integrals.exact_header:
theorem Partition.sum_integrals (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r) =
      ∫ r in 0..T, b r
Partition.sum_integrals.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.sum_integrals (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r) =
      ∫ r in 0..T, b r := by
  simpa only [P.start, P.finish] using intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals
    (fun k hk => P.cell_integrable b hb k hk)

Partition.variation_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.variation_bound (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ ≤
      ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.variation_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.variation_bound (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ ≤
      ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), ‖b r‖) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (P.monotone (Nat.le_succ k))
    _ = _ := P.sum_integrals (fun r => ‖b r‖) hb.norm

Partition.bilinear_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.bilinear_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → E) (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ha : ∀ k < P.count, ‖a k‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, B (a k) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * ε) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.bilinear_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.bilinear_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (a : ℕ → E) (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ha : ∀ k < P.count, ‖a k‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, B (a k) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * ε) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        ‖B (a k) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        (‖B‖ * ε) * ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      exact (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact ha k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
    _ = (‖B‖ * ε) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (P.variation_bound b hb) (by positivity)

Partition.work_error_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.work_error_bound (P : Partition T)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 T)) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hosc : ∀ k < P.count, ∀ r ∈ Icc (P.time k) (P.time (k + 1)),
      ‖x (P.time k) - x r‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖(∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        B (x (P.time k)) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)) -
        ∫ r in 0..T, B (x r) (b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * ε) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.work_error_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.work_error_bound (P : Partition T)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 T)) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hosc : ∀ k < P.count, ∀ r ∈ Icc (P.time k) (P.time (k + 1)),
      ‖x (P.time k) - x r‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖(∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        B (x (P.time k)) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)) -
        ∫ r in 0..T, B (x r) (b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * ε) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ := by
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := P.nonneg
  have hwork := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.bilinear_continuous_integrable B x b
    (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hT] using hx) hb
  have he : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (x (P.time k)) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)) -
        ∫ r in 0..T, B (x r) (b r) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1),
        B (x (P.time k) - x r) (b r)) := by
    rw [← P.sum_integrals _ hwork, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    have hkb := P.cell_integrable b hb k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    have hkw := P.cell_integrable _ hwork k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
    rw [← (B (x (P.time k))).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hkb,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (clm_intervalIntegrable (B (x (P.time k))) b hkb) hkw]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    simp only [map_sub, sub_apply]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count, ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1),
        B (x (P.time k) - x r) (b r)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
        (‖B‖ * ε) * (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), ‖b r‖) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hkn := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hkb := P.cell_integrable b hb k hkn
      have hkw := P.cell_integrable _ hwork k hkn
      have hki : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => B (x (P.time k) - x r) (b r)) volume
          (P.time k) (P.time (k + 1)) := by
        simpa only [map_sub, sub_apply] using
          (clm_intervalIntegrable (B (x (P.time k))) b hkb).sub hkw
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), ‖B (x (P.time k) - x r) (b r)‖ :=
          intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (P.monotone (Nat.le_succ k))
        _ ≤ ∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), (‖B‖ * ε) * ‖b r‖ := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (P.monotone (Nat.le_succ k)) hki.norm
            (hkb.norm.const_mul _)
          intro r hr
          exact (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact hosc k hkn r hr)
        _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, P.sum_integrals _ hb.norm]

dyadic.exact_header: def dyadic (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) : Partition (T : ℝ)
dyadic.exact_declaration:
def dyadic (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) : Partition (T : ℝ) where
  time k := ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n k : ℝ)
  count := (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).count n
  monotone := fun i j hij => (GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).monotone n hij
  start := by simp [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids]
  finish := by
    simp only [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_div,
      NNReal.coe_natCast, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
    field_simp

dyadic_mesh.exact_header:
theorem dyadic_mesh (T : ℝ≥0) (n k : ℕ) :
    (dyadic T n).time (k + 1) - (dyadic T n).time k = (T : ℝ) / 2 ^ n
dyadic_mesh.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_mesh (T : ℝ≥0) (n k : ℕ) :
    (dyadic T n).time (k + 1) - (dyadic T n).time k = (T : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
  simp only [dyadic, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_div,
    NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_natCast]
  push_cast
  ring

eventual_cell_oscillation.exact_header:
theorem eventual_cell_oscillation (T : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ k < (dyadic T n).count,
      ∀ r ∈ Icc ((dyadic T n).time k) ((dyadic T n).time (k + 1)),
        ‖x ((dyadic T n).time k) - x r‖ ≤ ε
eventual_cell_oscillation.exact_declaration:
theorem eventual_cell_oscillation (T : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ k < (dyadic T n).count,
      ∀ r ∈ Icc ((dyadic T n).time k) ((dyadic T n).time (k + 1)),
        ‖x ((dyadic T n).time k) - x r‖ ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
    (isCompact_Icc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hx) ε hε
  have hm := (TimeGridContinuity.dyadic_mesh_tendsto T).eventually
    (gt_mem_nhds hδ)
  filter_upwards [hm] with n hn
  intro k hk r hr
  have hleft := (dyadic T n).mem k hk.le
  have hright := (dyadic T n).mem (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)
  have hrt : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨hleft.1.trans hr.1, hr.2.trans hright.2⟩
  have hdist : dist ((dyadic T n).time k) r < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hr.1)]
    have he := dyadic_mesh T n k
    linarith [hr.2]
  exact le_of_lt (by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hd _ hleft _ hrt hdist)

tendsto_of_error_control.exact_header:
theorem tendsto_of_error_control (u : ℕ → ℝ) (L C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ‖u n - L‖ ≤ C * ε) :
    Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 L)
tendsto_of_error_control.exact_declaration:
theorem tendsto_of_error_control (u : ℕ → ℝ) (L C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ‖u n - L‖ ≤ C * ε) :
    Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hd : 0 < ε / (C + 1) := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (h _ hd)
  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  apply (hN n hn).trans_lt
  have he : (C + 1) * (ε / (C + 1)) = ε := by field_simp
  nlinarith

work_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem work_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (x ((dyadic T n).time k))
        (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r)))
work_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem work_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (x ((dyadic T n).time k))
        (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r))) := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall T.coe_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  apply tendsto_of_error_control _ _ (‖B‖ * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖) (by positivity)
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [eventual_cell_oscillation T x hx ε hε] with n hn
  exact ((dyadic T n).work_error_bound B x b hx hb ε hε.le hn).trans_eq (by ring)

primitive_increment.exact_header:
theorem primitive_increment (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (P : Partition T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    (∫ r in 0..P.time (k + 1), b r) - (∫ r in 0..P.time k, b r) =
      ∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r
primitive_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem primitive_increment (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T)
    (P : Partition T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    (∫ r in 0..P.time (k + 1), b r) - (∫ r in 0..P.time k, b r) =
      ∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r := by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left
  · apply hb.mono_set
    rw [uIcc_of_le P.nonneg,
      uIcc_of_le (P.mem (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)).1]
    exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (P.mem (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)).2
  · apply hb.mono_set
    rw [uIcc_of_le P.nonneg, uIcc_of_le (P.mem k hk.le).1]
    exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (P.mem k hk.le).2

quadratic_variation_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_variation_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)
        (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)) atTop (𝓝 0)
quadratic_variation_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_variation_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)
        (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let V : ℝ → E := fun t => ∫ r in 0..t, b r
  have hc : ContinuousOn V (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using
      (IntegralQuadraticEnergy.integral_absolutelyContinuous b hb).continuousOn
  have hC : 0 ≤ ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall T.coe_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  apply tendsto_of_error_control _ _ (‖B‖ * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖) (by positivity)
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [eventual_cell_oscillation T V hc ε hε] with n hn
  simp only [sub_zero]
  apply ((dyadic T n).bilinear_bound B _ b hb ε hε.le ?_).trans_eq (by ring)
  intro k hk
  rw [← primitive_increment b hb (dyadic T n) k hk, norm_sub_rev]
  exact hn k hk _ ⟨(dyadic T n).monotone (Nat.le_succ _), le_rfl⟩

cross_variation_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem cross_variation_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b m : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hm : ContinuousOn m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)
        (m ((dyadic T n).time (k + 1)) - m ((dyadic T n).time k))) atTop (𝓝 0)
cross_variation_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem cross_variation_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b m : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hm : ContinuousOn m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (dyadic T n).count,
      B (∫ r in (dyadic T n).time k..(dyadic T n).time (k + 1), b r)
        (m ((dyadic T n).time (k + 1)) - m ((dyadic T n).time k))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall T.coe_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  apply tendsto_of_error_control _ _ (‖B.flip‖ * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖) (by positivity)
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [eventual_cell_oscillation T m hm ε hε] with n hn
  simp only [sub_zero]
  apply ((dyadic T n).bilinear_bound B.flip _ b hb ε hε.le ?_).trans_eq (by ring)
  intro k hk
  rw [norm_sub_rev]
  exact hn k hk _ ⟨(dyadic T n).monotone (Nat.le_succ _), le_rfl⟩

/-! # Exact finite-partition energy from actual martingales
Only point-time L² random variables are used. No time-integrability of a drift,
quadratic forward equation, or supplied stochastic orthogonality is required.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.PartitionQuadraticEnergy
open QuadraticMartingale
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ℝ mΩ)
  (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)

include hW

/-- A past-measurable L² variable is orthogonal to actual martingale increments.
The zero pairing is derived by the genuine conditional L² projection. -/

/-- Actual martingale orthogonality yields exact quadratic increment additivity,
without an assumed stochastic isometry or quadratic-variation formula. -/

/-- One exact energy increment, derived from actual decomposition and past
adaptation. The finite-variation component need not be time-L¹ in L². -/

/-- Exact expected quadratic energy on any finite monotone time partition.
Only point-time L² state, finite-variation and martingale values are required.
N₀=0 and the decomposition also imply V₀=0, so no redundant initial premise
for V is necessary. Both stochastic orthogonalities are proved above. -/

end PBGSO.PartitionQuadraticEnergy

increment_orthogonal.exact_header:
theorem increment_orthogonal (N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) (Y : Lp Z 2 Q) (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] Y Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W Y (N t - N s) = 0
increment_orthogonal.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_orthogonal (N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) (Y : Lp Z 2 Q) (hY : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] Y Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W Y (N t - N s) = 0 := by
  have ha : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] (W.compLpL 2 Q Y) Q :=
    (W.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY).congr (W.coeFn_compLpL Y).symm
  have hcond : (condExpL2 Z ℝ (F.le s) (N t - N s) : Lp Z 2 Q) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, Submodule.coe_sub]
    rw [martingale_condExpL2 Q F N m hm hrep s t hst,
      martingale_condExpL2 Q F N m hm hrep s s le_rfl, sub_self]
  have hi := inner_condExpL2_eq_inner_fun (𝕜 := ℝ) (F.le s) (N t - N s) (W.compLpL 2 Q Y) ha
  rw [hcond, inner_zero_left] at hi
  rw [weightedPairing_left Q W hW, real_inner_comm, ← hi]

martingale_increment_energy.exact_header:
theorem martingale_increment_energy (N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (N t - N s) (N t - N s) =
      weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) - weightedPairing Q W (N s) (N s)
martingale_increment_energy.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_increment_energy (N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (N t - N s) (N t - N s) =
      weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) - weightedPairing Q W (N s) (N s) := by
  have ha : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] (N s) Q :=
    (hm.stronglyAdapted s).aestronglyMeasurable.congr (hrep s)
  have ho := increment_orthogonal Q F W hW N m hm hrep s t hst (N s) ha
  have he := bilinear_increment (weightedPairing Q W) (weightedPairing_symmetric Q W hW) (N s) (N t)
  rw [ho, mul_zero, zero_add] at he
  exact he.symm

energy_increment.exact_header:
theorem energy_increment (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : X s = X 0 + V s + N s)
    (ht : X t = X 0 + V t + N t) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] (X s) Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X t) (X t) - weightedPairing Q W (X s) (X s) =
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (X s) (V t - V s) +
      weightedPairing Q W (V t - V s) (V t - V s) +
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (V t - V s) (N t - N s) +
      (weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) - weightedPairing Q W (N s) (N s))
energy_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_increment (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) (hs : X s = X 0 + V s + N s)
    (ht : X t = X 0 + V t + N t) (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable[F s] (X s) Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X t) (X t) - weightedPairing Q W (X s) (X s) =
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (X s) (V t - V s) +
      weightedPairing Q W (V t - V s) (V t - V s) +
      2 * weightedPairing Q W (V t - V s) (N t - N s) +
      (weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) - weightedPairing Q W (N s) (N s)) := by
  have ho := increment_orthogonal Q F W hW N m hm hrep s t hst (X s) hX
  have hv := martingale_increment_energy Q F W hW N m hm hrep s t hst
  have he := quadratic_increment_forward (weightedPairing Q W) (weightedPairing_symmetric Q W hW)
    X (fun r => X 0 + V r) N (fun r => weightedPairing Q W (N r) (N r)) s t hs ht ho hv
  have hd : (X 0 + V t) - (X 0 + V s) = V t - V s := by abel
  simpa only [hd] using he

finite_partition_identity.exact_header:
theorem finite_partition_identity (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (T : ℝ) (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) (hz : τ 0 = 0) (hend : τ n = T)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0)
    (hdecomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, X t = X 0 + V t + N t)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (X (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) +
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k))) +
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (N (τ (k + 1)) - N (τ k)) +
      weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T)
finite_partition_identity.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_partition_identity (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m F Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (T : ℝ) (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) (hz : τ 0 = 0) (hend : τ n = T)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0)
    (hdecomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, X t = X 0 + V t + N t)
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (X (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) +
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k))) +
      2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (N (τ (k + 1)) - N (τ k)) +
      weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T) := by
  have hmem (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) : τ k ∈ Icc 0 T := by
    constructor
    · rw [← hz]
      exact hτ (Nat.zero_le k)
    · rw [← hend]
      exact hτ hk
  have hp : ∀ j, j ≤ n →
      weightedPairing Q W (X (τ j)) (X (τ j)) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
        2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, weightedPairing Q W (X (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) +
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k))) +
        2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, weightedPairing Q W (V (τ (k + 1)) - V (τ k)) (N (τ (k + 1)) - N (τ k)) +
        weightedPairing Q W (N (τ j)) (N (τ j)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      simp only [hz, hN0, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, map_zero, add_zero]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have hi := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj)
      have he := energy_increment Q F W hW X V N m hm hrep (τ j) (τ (j + 1))
        (hτ (Nat.le_succ j)) (hdecomp _ (hmem j (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj)))
        (hdecomp _ (hmem (j + 1) hj)) (hX _ (hmem j (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj)))
      simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      linarith
  simpa only [hend] using hp n le_rfl

/-! # Derived domination of finite-variation energy sums
All bounds refer to original pathwise drift integrals and actual state/noise
paths. They supply the bounds for dominated convergence after localization.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology NNReal
namespace PBGSO.PartitionFiniteVariation
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable {T : ℝ}

/-- Every actual drift increment is bounded by the original total variation. -/

/-- The work sum is bounded by the original state radius times total variation. -/

/-- Quadratic drift sums are bounded using only the original L¹ norm. -/

/-- Cross sums are bounded by the continuous noise radius times total variation.
No stochastic property of the noise is needed for this deterministic bound. -/

Partition.increment_le_variation.exact_header:
theorem Partition.increment_le_variation (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ ≤ ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.increment_le_variation.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.increment_le_variation (P : Partition T) (b : ℝ → E)
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.count) :
    ‖∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r‖ ≤ ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ := by
  apply le_trans _ (P.variation_bound b hb)
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => norm_nonneg
    (∫ r in P.time j..P.time (j + 1), b r)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)

Partition.work_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.work_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hx : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖x t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (x (P.time k)) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
        (‖B‖ * K) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.work_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.work_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hx : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖x t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (x (P.time k)) (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
        (‖B‖ * K) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ :=
  P.bilinear_bound B _ b hb K hK (fun k hk => hx _ (P.mem k hk.le))

Partition.quadratic_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.quadratic_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)
        (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
      ‖B‖ * (∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖) ^ 2
Partition.quadratic_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.quadratic_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)
        (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)‖ ≤
      ‖B‖ * (∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖) ^ 2 := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall P.nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  exact (P.bilinear_bound B _ b hb _ hC
    (fun k hk => P.increment_le_variation b hb k hk)).trans_eq (by ring)

Partition.cross_bound.exact_header:
theorem Partition.cross_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b m : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hm : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖m t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)
        (m (P.time (k + 1)) - m (P.time k))‖ ≤
      (‖B.flip‖ * (2 * K)) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖
Partition.cross_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem Partition.cross_bound (P : Partition T) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (b m : ℝ → E) (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 T) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hm : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖m t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.count,
      B (∫ r in P.time k..P.time (k + 1), b r)
        (m (P.time (k + 1)) - m (P.time k))‖ ≤
      (‖B.flip‖ * (2 * K)) * ∫ r in 0..T, ‖b r‖ := by
  apply P.bilinear_bound B.flip _ b hb (2 * K) (by positivity)
  intro k hk
  exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by
    linarith [hm _ (P.mem (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)), hm _ (P.mem k hk.le)])

drift_work_bound.exact_header:
theorem drift_work_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * K) * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖
drift_work_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_work_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b : ℝ → E)
    (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r)‖ ≤
      (‖B‖ * K) * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖ := by
  exact le_of_tendsto' (work_tendsto T B x b hx hb).norm
    (fun n => (dyadic T n).work_bound B x b hb K hK hbound)

noncomputable section

namespace PBGSO.PastAverages

TimeLp.exact_declaration: abbrev TimeLp := Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

shift.exact_header: def shift (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (r : ℝ) : TimeLp (R := R)
shift.exact_declaration:
def shift (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (r : ℝ) : TimeLp (R := R) :=
  (DomAddAct.mk (-r) : DomAddAct ℝ) +ᵥ U

shift_continuous.exact_header: theorem shift_continuous (U : TimeLp (R := R)) : Continuous (shift U)
shift_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem shift_continuous (U : TimeLp (R := R)) : Continuous (shift U) :=
  (DomAddAct.continuous_mk.comp continuous_neg).vadd continuous_const

shift_zero.exact_header: @[simp] theorem shift_zero (U : TimeLp (R := R)) : shift U 0 = U
shift_zero.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem shift_zero (U : TimeLp (R := R)) : shift U 0 = U := by
  have hm : DomAddAct.mk (0 : ℝ) = (0 : DomAddAct ℝ) := rfl
  rw [shift, neg_zero, hm, zero_vadd]

shift_coe.exact_header:
theorem shift_coe (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (r : ℝ) :
    shift U r =ᵐ[volume] (fun t => U (t - r))
shift_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem shift_coe (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (r : ℝ) :
    shift U r =ᵐ[volume] (fun t => U (t - r)) := by
  simpa only [shift, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, vadd_eq_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
    DomAddAct.vadd_Lp_ae_eq (DomAddAct.mk (-r)) U

average.exact_header: def average (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) : TimeLp (R := R)
average.exact_declaration:
def average (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) : TimeLp (R := R) :=
  ε⁻¹ • ∫ r in 0..ε, shift U r

average_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem average_tendsto (U : TimeLp (R := R)) :
    Tendsto (average U) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 U)
average_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem average_tendsto (U : TimeLp (R := R)) :
    Tendsto (average U) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 U) := by
  have hder : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => ∫ r in 0..ε, shift U r) U 0 := by
    simpa only [shift_zero] using intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      ((shift_continuous U).intervalIntegrable 0 0)
      (shift_continuous U).aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter
      (shift_continuous U).continuousAt
  change Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε⁻¹ • ∫ r in 0..ε, shift U r) _ _
  simpa only [zero_add, intervalIntegral.integral_same, sub_zero] using
    hder.tendsto_slope_zero_right

average_sub.exact_header:
theorem average_sub (U V : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) :
    average (U - V) ε = average U ε - average V ε
average_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem average_sub (U V : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) :
    average (U - V) ε = average U ε - average V ε := by
  have he : shift (U - V) = fun r => shift U r - shift V r := by
    funext r
    exact DomAddAct.vadd_Lp_sub (DomAddAct.mk (-r)) U V
  rw [average, he, intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    ((shift_continuous U).intervalIntegrable 0 ε) ((shift_continuous V).intervalIntegrable 0 ε), smul_sub]
  rfl

average_norm_le.exact_header:
theorem average_norm_le (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖average U ε‖ ≤ ‖U‖
average_norm_le.exact_declaration:
theorem average_norm_le (U : TimeLp (R := R)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖average U ε‖ ≤ ‖U‖ := by
  rw [average, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hε]
  have hn : (fun r => ‖shift U r‖) = (fun _ : ℝ => ‖U‖) := by
    funext r
    exact DomAddAct.norm_vadd_Lp (DomAddAct.mk (-r)) U
  calc
    ε⁻¹ * ‖∫ r in 0..ε, shift U r‖ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ∫ r in 0..ε, ‖shift U r‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hε.le) (by positivity)
    _ = ‖U‖ := by rw [hn, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]; field_simp

average_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem average_lipschitz (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun U : TimeLp (R := R) => average U ε)
average_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem average_lipschitz (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun U : TimeLp (R := R) => average U ε) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro U V
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm]
  rw [← average_sub]
  exact average_norm_le (U - V) ε hε

pastMean.exact_header: def pastMean (u : ℝ → R) (ε t : ℝ) : R
pastMean.exact_declaration: def pastMean (u : ℝ → R) (ε t : ℝ) : R := ε⁻¹ • ∫ r in t - ε..t, u r

pastMean_continuous.exact_header:
theorem pastMean_continuous (u : ℝ → R) (hu : LocallyIntegrable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ε : ℝ) :
    Continuous (pastMean u ε)
pastMean_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem pastMean_continuous (u : ℝ → R) (hu : LocallyIntegrable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ε : ℝ) :
    Continuous (pastMean u ε) := by
  have hi (a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable u volume a b :=
    intervalIntegrable_iff.mpr ((hu.integrableOn_isCompact isCompact_uIcc).mono_set uIoc_subset_uIcc)
  have hp : Continuous (fun t => ∫ r in 0..t, u r) := intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hi 0
  have he : pastMean u ε = fun t => ε⁻¹ • ((∫ r in 0..t, u r) - ∫ r in 0..t - ε, u r) := by
    funext t
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hi 0 t) (hi 0 (t - ε))]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact (hp.sub (hp.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))).const_smul _

PBGSO/PathEnergyStopping.lean.scope_note: Continuity, monotonicity and current-past measurability of the actual path energy are explicit. PathwiseLocalEnergy derives them for the literal local coefficient integral. No stopping-time or cap conclusion is assumed.
PBGSO/PathEnergyStopping.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.StoppingSteps
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

/-! # Genuine stopping times from continuous monotone path energies -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.PathEnergyStopping
variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]

/-- The actual first-hit set, restricted to the fixed finite horizon. -/

/-- First threshold hit, capped at T; empty hit sets stop at T. -/





/-- The stopping event is a current-time energy event, with no use of
future information or a supplied stopping-time conclusion. -/

/-- Actual primitive stopping events follow from the actual adapted path
energy and the proved first-hit CDF identity. -/

/-- Continuity and genuine first-hit minimality prove the energy cap.
No bounded stopped-energy hypothesis is supplied. -/

/-- Increasing the localization threshold increases the actual stopping time. -/


/-- Every finite path energy eventually lies below a natural threshold.
The actual localization stops are eventually exactly T on each sample. -/

end PBGSO.PathEnergyStopping

hitSet.exact_header: def hitSet (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Set ℝ≥0
hitSet.exact_declaration:
def hitSet (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Set ℝ≥0 :=
  {t | t ≤ T ∧ c ≤ A t ω}

firstHit.exact_header: def firstHit (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ≥0
firstHit.exact_declaration:
def firstHit (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ≥0 := by
  classical
  exact if h : (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty then sInf (hitSet T A c ω) else T

hitSet_closed.exact_header:
theorem hitSet_closed (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) : IsClosed (hitSet T A c ω)
hitSet_closed.exact_declaration:
theorem hitSet_closed (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) : IsClosed (hitSet T A c ω) :=
  isClosed_Iic.inter (isClosed_Ici.preimage hA)

firstHit_mem.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_mem (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hne : (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty) :
    firstHit T A c ω ∈ hitSet T A c ω
firstHit_mem.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_mem (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hne : (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty) :
    firstHit T A c ω ∈ hitSet T A c ω := by
  classical
  rw [firstHit, dif_pos hne]
  exact (hitSet_closed T A c ω hA).csInf_mem hne (OrderBot.bddBelow _)

firstHit_le_horizon.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_le_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) : firstHit T A c ω ≤ T
firstHit_le_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_le_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) : firstHit T A c ω ≤ T := by
  classical
  by_cases hne : (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty
  · exact (firstHit_mem T A c ω hA hne).1
  · simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hne, le_refl]

firstHit_le_of_hit.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_le_of_hit (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) (hc : c ≤ A t ω) :
    firstHit T A c ω ≤ t
firstHit_le_of_hit.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_le_of_hit (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) (hc : c ≤ A t ω) :
    firstHit T A c ω ≤ t := by
  classical
  have hmem : t ∈ hitSet T A c ω := ⟨ht, hc⟩
  have hne := Set.nonempty_of_mem hmem
  rw [firstHit, dif_pos hne]
  exact csInf_le (OrderBot.bddBelow _) hmem

firstHit_le_iff.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_le_iff (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    firstHit T A c ω ≤ t ↔ T ≤ t ∨ c ≤ A t ω
firstHit_le_iff.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_le_iff (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    firstHit T A c ω ≤ t ↔ T ≤ t ∨ c ≤ A t ω := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro ht
    by_cases hT : T ≤ t
    · exact Or.inl hT
    · right
      have hne : (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hn
        simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hn] at ht
        exact hT ht
      exact (firstHit_mem T A c ω hA hne).2.trans (hmono ht)
  · rintro (hT | hc)
    · exact (firstHit_le_horizon T A c ω hA).trans hT
    · by_cases hT : T ≤ t
      · exact (firstHit_le_horizon T A c ω hA).trans hT
      · exact firstHit_le_of_hit T A c ω hA t (le_of_not_ge hT) hc

firstHit_stopping.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_stopping (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun t => A t ω))
    (hadapted : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (A t)) :
    ∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | firstHit T A c ω ≤ t}
firstHit_stopping.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_stopping (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => A t ω))
    (hmono : ∀ ω, Monotone (fun t => A t ω))
    (hadapted : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (A t)) :
    ∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | firstHit T A c ω ≤ t} := by
  intro t
  have he : {ω | firstHit T A c ω ≤ t} = {ω | T ≤ t ∨ c ≤ A t ω} := by
    ext ω
    exact firstHit_le_iff T A c ω (hA ω) (hmono ω) t
  rw [he]
  exact (MeasurableSet.const (T ≤ t)).union ((hadapted t) measurableSet_Ici)

firstHit_energy_le.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_energy_le (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hzero : A 0 ω ≤ c) :
    A (firstHit T A c ω) ω ≤ c
firstHit_energy_le.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_energy_le (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hzero : A 0 ω ≤ c) :
    A (firstHit T A c ω) ω ≤ c := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : c < A (firstHit T A c ω) ω := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hAu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ firstHit T A c ω from bot_le)
    hA.continuousOn ⟨hzero, hlt.le⟩
  have hmin := firstHit_le_of_hit T A c ω hA u
    (hu.2.trans (firstHit_le_horizon T A c ω hA)) (le_of_eq hAu.symm)
  have huEq : u = firstHit T A c ω := le_antisymm hu.2 hmin
  rw [huEq] at hAu
  linarith

firstHit_mono_threshold.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_mono_threshold (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ω : Ω) (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) :
    firstHit T A a ω ≤ firstHit T A b ω
firstHit_mono_threshold.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_mono_threshold (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ω : Ω) (hA : Continuous (fun t => A t ω)) (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) :
    firstHit T A a ω ≤ firstHit T A b ω := by
  have hb := (firstHit_le_iff T A b ω hA hmono (firstHit T A b ω)).mp le_rfl
  rcases hb with hT | hB
  · exact (firstHit_le_horizon T A a ω hA).trans hT
  · exact firstHit_le_of_hit T A a ω hA _ (firstHit_le_horizon T A b ω hA) (hab.trans hB)

firstHit_eq_horizon_of_lt.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_eq_horizon_of_lt (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) (hc : A T ω < c) : firstHit T A c ω = T
firstHit_eq_horizon_of_lt.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_eq_horizon_of_lt (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) (hc : A T ω < c) : firstHit T A c ω = T := by
  classical
  have hne : ¬ (hitSet T A c ω).Nonempty := by
    rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact (not_le_of_gt hc) (ht.2.trans (hmono ht.1))
  simp only [firstHit, dif_neg hne]

firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon.exact_header:
theorem firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, firstHit T A n ω = T
firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon (T : ℝ≥0) (A : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω)
    (hmono : Monotone (fun t => A t ω)) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, firstHit T A n ω = T := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (A T ω)
  refine eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  exact firstHit_eq_horizon_of_lt T A n ω hmono
    (lt_of_lt_of_le hN (by exact_mod_cast hn))

PBGSO/PathwiseDriftFubini.lean.scope_note: The raw paths and radius domination are explicit. No time-L1(L2) drift, product work-integrability or Fubini conclusion is supplied.
PBGSO/PathwiseDriftFubini.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.PartitionVariationBounds
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod

/-! # Fubini for localized pathwise drift work
Only the raw joint measurability, pathwise L¹ drift and the actual square
localization radius are needed. Time-L¹(L²) drift is not assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.PathwiseDriftFubini
variable {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- Absolute work is bounded by the original state radius times pathwise
variation, before taking any expectation. -/

/-- Original jointly measurable drift work is absolutely integrable on the
actual time/sample product, as a theorem of the localized path data. -/

/-- The actual expected pathwise work equals the actual time integral of
expected original coefficient work, with all absolute integrability derived. -/

end PBGSO.PathwiseDriftFubini

absolute_work_bound.exact_header:
theorem absolute_work_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → E) (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t‖ ≤ C) :
    (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖B (x r) (b r)‖) ≤
      (‖B‖ * C) * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖
absolute_work_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem absolute_work_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → E) (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ)) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t‖ ≤ C) :
    (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖B (x r) (b r)‖) ≤
      (‖B‖ * C) * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r‖ := by
  have hi := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.bilinear_continuous_integrable B x b
    (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hx) hb
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on T.coe_nonneg hi.norm (hb.norm.const_mul _)
  intro r hr
  exact (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact hbound r hr)

work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_integrable (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → E) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integrable (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → E) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let μ := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))
  let f := fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.prod Q) :=
    B.continuous₂.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hx.prodMk hb)
  apply (integrable_prod_iff' hfm).mpr
  constructor
  · filter_upwards [hpaths] with ω hp
    have hi := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.bilinear_continuous_integrable B
      (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω)
      (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hp.1) hp.2.1
    exact hi.1
  · apply (hC.const_mul ‖B‖).mono' hfm.norm.prod_swap.integral_prod_right'
    filter_upwards [hpaths] with ω hp
    have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ r, ‖f (r, ω)‖ ∂μ := integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    change ‖∫ r, ‖f (r, ω)‖ ∂μ‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * C ω ^ 2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hn]
    change (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖B (x r ω) (b r ω)‖) ≤ ‖B‖ * C ω ^ 2
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
    apply (absolute_work_bound T B (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω)
      hp.1 hp.2.1 (C ω) hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2.1).trans
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp.2.2.2.2
      (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg B) hp.2.2.1)]

integral_swap.exact_header:
theorem integral_swap (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → E) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r ω) (b r ω)) ∂Q) =
      ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), (∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q)
integral_swap.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_swap (T : ℝ≥0) (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → E) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r ω) (b r ω)) ∂Q) =
      ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), (∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q) := by
  have hi := work_integrable Q T B x b C hx hb hC hpaths
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
  exact (integral_integral_swap hi).symm

PBGSO/PathwiseLocalEnergy.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.LocalizedDiffusion
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

/-! # Continuous adapted path energies from raw local coefficients
The local energy is a literal time integral. Continuity, monotonicity and
current-past measurability are derived; no stopping-time or energy-cap
conclusion is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.PathwiseLocalEnergy
variable {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]

/-- The actual cumulative path energy, constant after the fixed horizon. -/

/-- Literal raw integral identification at every time before the horizon. -/

/-- Mere pathwise time-L¹ integrability supplies all-path continuity. -/

/-- Nonnegative raw energy makes the actual cumulative integral monotone. -/

/-- Raw progressive measurability on each past time window implies actual
adaptedness of its time integral in that same past algebra. -/

/-- The first-hit localization prerequisites are conclusions of the raw
pathwise time-integrability and progressive scalar energy. -/

end PBGSO.PathwiseLocalEnergy

energy.exact_header: def energy (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : ℝ
energy.exact_declaration:
def energy (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r

energy_eq_integral.exact_header:
theorem energy_eq_integral (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) (ω : Ω) :
    energy T q t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω
energy_eq_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_eq_integral (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) (ω : Ω) :
    energy T q t ω = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (t : ℝ), q r ω := by
  rw [energy, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le t.coe_nonneg,
    setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
  have hs : Ioc (0 : ℝ) t ∩ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) = Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) := by
    exact Set.inter_eq_left.mpr (Ioc_subset_Ioc_right (by exact_mod_cast ht))
  rw [hs]

energy_continuous.exact_header:
theorem energy_continuous (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ω : Ω) :
    Continuous (fun t => energy T q t ω)
energy_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_continuous (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ω : Ω) :
    Continuous (fun t => energy T q t ω) := by
  have hi : Integrable ((Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω)) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (hlocal ω)
  exact (hi.continuous_primitive 0).comp continuous_subtype_val

energy_monotone.exact_header:
theorem energy_monotone (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω) (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun t => energy T q t ω)
energy_monotone.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_monotone (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω) (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun t => energy T q t ω) := by
  intro s t hst
  change (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(s : ℝ), (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r) ≤
    (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le s.coe_nonneg,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le t.coe_nonneg]
  apply setIntegral_mono_set
    (((integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (hlocal ω)).integrableOn)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun r => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun r _ => hpos r ω) r)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast hst)⟩)

energy_measurable.exact_header:
theorem energy_measurable (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable[ℱ t] (energy T q t)
energy_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_measurable (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable[ℱ t] (energy T q t) := by
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) r) p.1) := by
    exact (hpast t).piecewise (measurableSet_Ioc.preimage measurable_fst) stronglyMeasurable_const
  have he : energy T q t = fun ω => ∫ r,
      (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r) r := by
    funext ω
    rw [energy, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le t.coe_nonneg]
    rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with r
    by_cases ht : r ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> by_cases hT : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) <;>
      simp [ht,hT]
  rw [he]
  have hm' := @StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_left ℝ Ω ℝ
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ) (ℱ t) volume _ _ _
    (fun r ω => (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator
      (fun r => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r ω) r) r) hm
  exact hm'.measurable

energy_firstHit_properties.exact_header:
theorem energy_firstHit_properties (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T (energy T q) c
    (∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) ∧
    (∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) ∧
    (∀ ω, (∫ r in Ioc 0 (τ ω : ℝ), q r ω) ≤ c) ∧
    (∀ ω, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T (energy T q) n ω = T)
energy_firstHit_properties.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_firstHit_properties (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    let τ := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T (energy T q) c
    (∀ t, MeasurableSet[ℱ t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t}) ∧
    (∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) ∧
    (∀ ω, (∫ r in Ioc 0 (τ ω : ℝ), q r ω) ≤ c) ∧
    (∀ ω, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T (energy T q) n ω = T) := by
  have hC := energy_continuous T q hlocal
  have hM := energy_monotone T q hlocal hpos
  refine ⟨PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_stopping ℱ T _ c hC hM (energy_measurable ℱ T q hpast),
    fun ω => PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_le_horizon T _ c ω (hC ω), ?_,
    fun ω => PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon T _ ω (hM ω)⟩
  intro ω
  rw [← energy_eq_integral T q _
    (PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_le_horizon T _ c ω (hC ω)) ω]
  apply PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_energy_le T _ c ω (hC ω)
  simpa only [energy, NNReal.coe_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_same] using hc
