import PBGSO.ExpectedBilinearLimits

/-! # Expected quadratic energy with merely pathwise L¹ drift
The actual martingale and original pathwise primitive determine the energy.
Time L¹(L²) drift is not an assumption. A square-integrable path radius is
explicit, as supplied by bounded localization.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology NNReal RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.PathwiseMartingaleEnergy
open QuadraticMartingale PartitionFiniteVariation ExpectedBilinearLimits
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ℝ mΩ)
  (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)

/-- The original raw state, noise and drift-primitive realizations agree on
one event at all actual dyadic grid times. -/

/-- Actual expected quadratic balance, derived from finite martingale
orthogonality and pathwise finite-variation limits. The bound is an explicit
localization radius, not a claimed consequence of point-time P₂ alone. -/

end PBGSO.PathwiseMartingaleEnergy

grid_realizations.exact_header:
theorem grid_realizations (T : ℝ≥0) (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, x t =ᵐ[Q] X t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t)
    (hN : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, ∀ k ≤ (dyadic T n).count,
      x ((dyadic T n).time k) ω = X ((dyadic T n).time k) ω ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(dyadic T n).time k, b r ω) = V ((dyadic T n).time k) ω ∧
      m ((dyadic T n).time k) ω = N ((dyadic T n).time k) ω
grid_realizations.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_realizations (T : ℝ≥0) (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ t, x t =ᵐ[Q] X t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t)
    (hN : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n, ∀ k ≤ (dyadic T n).count,
      x ((dyadic T n).time k) ω = X ((dyadic T n).time k) ω ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(dyadic T n).time k, b r ω) = V ((dyadic T n).time k) ω ∧
      m ((dyadic T n).time k) ω = N ((dyadic T n).time k) ω := by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro n
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k ≤ (dyadic T n).count
  · filter_upwards [hX ((dyadic T n).time k),
      hV _ ((dyadic T n).mem k hk), hN ((dyadic T n).time k)] with ω hx hv hn _
    exact ⟨hx, hv, hn⟩
  · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ h => False.elim (hk h))

include hW

quadratic_balance.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (hN : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (hX : ∀ t, x t =ᵐ[Q] X t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0)
    (hdecomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + V t + N t)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q)
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω ∧ ‖m t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T)
quadratic_balance.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (X V N : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (C : Ω → ℝ)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (hN : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] N t)
    (hX : ∀ t, x t =ᵐ[Q] X t)
    (hV : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t)
    (hN0 : N 0 = 0)
    (hdecomp : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), X t = X 0 + V t + N t)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q)
    (hC : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω ∧ ‖m t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) = weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T) := by
  let P := dyadic T
  let B := spatialPairing W
  let A (n k : ℕ) := X ((P n).time k)
  let D (n k : ℕ) := V ((P n).time (k + 1)) - V ((P n).time k)
  let E (n k : ℕ) := N ((P n).time (k + 1)) - N ((P n).time k)
  let work (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count,
    B (x ((P n).time k) ω) (∫ r in (P n).time k..(P n).time (k + 1), b r ω)
  let q (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count,
    B (∫ r in (P n).time k..(P n).time (k + 1), b r ω)
      (∫ r in (P n).time k..(P n).time (k + 1), b r ω)
  let cross (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count,
    B (∫ r in (P n).time k..(P n).time (k + 1), b r ω)
      (m ((P n).time (k + 1)) ω - m ((P n).time k) ω)
  have hgrid := grid_realizations Q T X V N x b m hX hV hN
  have hraw (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (∀ k < (P n).count, D n k ω = ∫ r in (P n).time k..(P n).time (k + 1), b r ω) ∧
      (∀ k < (P n).count, A n k ω = x ((P n).time k) ω) ∧
      (∀ k < (P n).count, E n k ω = m ((P n).time (k + 1)) ω - m ((P n).time k) ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hgrid, hpaths,
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun k => Lp.coeFn_sub (V ((P n).time (k + 1))) (V ((P n).time k))),
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun k => Lp.coeFn_sub (N ((P n).time (k + 1))) (N ((P n).time k)))]
      with ω hg hp hv hn
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      change (V ((P n).time (k + 1)) - V ((P n).time k)) ω = _
      rw [hv k, Pi.sub_apply, ← (hg n (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)).2.1,
        ← (hg n k hk.le).2.1]
      exact primitive_increment (fun r => b r ω) hp.2.2.1 (P n) k hk
    · intro k hk
      exact (hg n k hk.le).1.symm
    · intro k hk
      change (N ((P n).time (k + 1)) - N ((P n).time k)) ω = _
      rw [hn k, Pi.sub_apply, ← (hg n (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)).2.2,
        ← (hg n k hk.le).2.2]
  have heq (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (A n k ω) (D n k ω)) = work n ω ∧
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (D n k ω)) = q n ω ∧
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (E n k ω)) = cross n ω := by
    filter_upwards [hraw n] with ω hh
    refine ⟨Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_),
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)⟩
    · rw [hh.1 k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk), hh.2.1 k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]
    · rw [hh.1 k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]
    · rw [hh.1 k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk), hh.2.2 k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]
  have hwlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (A n k ω) (D n k ω)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r ω) (b r ω))) := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, ae_all_iff.mpr heq] with ω hp he
    exact (work_tendsto T B (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 hp.2.2.1).congr'
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (he n).1.symm))
  have hqlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (D n k ω)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, ae_all_iff.mpr heq] with ω hp he
    exact (quadratic_variation_tendsto T B (fun r => b r ω) hp.2.2.1).congr'
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (he n).2.1.symm))
  have hclim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (E n k ω)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, ae_all_iff.mpr heq] with ω hp he
    exact (cross_variation_tendsto T B (fun r => b r ω) (fun r => m r ω)
      hp.2.2.1 hp.2.1).congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (he n).2.2.symm))
  have hwbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (A n k ω) (D n k ω)‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * C ω ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, heq n] with ω hp he
    rw [he.1]
    apply ((P n).work_bound B _ _ hp.2.2.1 _ hp.2.2.2.1
      (fun t ht => (hp.2.2.2.2.1 t ht).1)).trans
    have hc := hp.2.2.2.2.2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg B) hp.2.2.2.1)]
  have hqbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (D n k ω)‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * C ω ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, heq n] with ω hp he
    rw [he.2.1]
    apply ((P n).quadratic_bound B _ hp.2.2.1).trans
    have hpos : 0 ≤ ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall T.coe_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hpos hp.2.2.2.2.2 2) (norm_nonneg B)
  have hcbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, B (D n k ω) (E n k ω)‖ ≤
        (2 * ‖B.flip‖) * C ω ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hpaths, heq n] with ω hp he
    rw [he.2.2]
    apply ((P n).cross_bound B _ _ hp.2.2.1 _ hp.2.2.2.1
      (fun t ht => (hp.2.2.2.2.1 t ht).2)).trans
    have hc := hp.2.2.2.2.2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc
      (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg B.flip) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hp.2.2.2.1))]
  obtain ⟨hwork, hw⟩ := pairSum_limit Q W A D (fun n => (P n).count) _ _
    (hC.const_mul ‖B‖) hwbound hwlim
  have hq := (pairSum_limit Q W D D (fun n => (P n).count) (fun _ => 0) _
    (hC.const_mul ‖B‖) hqbound hqlim).2
  have hc := (pairSum_limit Q W D E (fun n => (P n).count) (fun _ => 0) _
    (hC.const_mul (2 * ‖B.flip‖)) hcbound hclim).2
  refine ⟨hwork, ?_⟩
  have htotal := ((((tendsto_const_nhds (x := weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0))).add (hw.const_mul 2)).add hq).add
    (hc.const_mul 2)).add_const (weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T))
  have hevery (n : ℕ) : weightedPairing Q W (X 0) (X 0) +
      2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, weightedPairing Q W (A n k) (D n k)) +
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, weightedPairing Q W (D n k) (D n k)) +
      2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P n).count, weightedPairing Q W (D n k) (E n k)) +
      weightedPairing Q W (N T) (N T) = weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T) :=
    (PartitionQuadraticEnergy.finite_partition_identity Q F W hW X V N m hmart hN
      T (P n).time (P n).monotone (P n).count (P n).start (P n).finish hN0 hdecomp hadapt).symm
  have hh := tendsto_nhds_unique
    (htotal.congr (fun n => hevery n)) (tendsto_const_nhds (x := weightedPairing Q W (X T) (X T)))
  simpa only [integral_zero, add_zero, mul_zero, B, spatialPairing_apply] using hh.symm

PBGSO/PathwiseNullRegularization.lean.scope_note: Raw nonnegative progressive energy is only almost surely pathwise L1. The null augmentation is explicit. A diffusion application must use the same mask for both the scalar energy and physical columns.
PBGSO/PathwiseNullRegularization.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.DriverNullAugmentation

/-! # Genuine progressive local coefficient versions after null augmentation
One measurable initial-null event regularizes all time sections together.
No path integrability, adaptation or coefficient identity is changed a.s.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω R : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup R] [NormedSpace ℝ R]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- A raw progressive coefficient whose sample paths are locally time-L¹
almost surely admits a genuine progressive version with every path time-L¹.
The construction changes only one ambient measurable null event, which the
proved augmented Brownian filtration contains already at time zero. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

exists_nullAugmented_integrable_version.exact_header:
theorem exists_nullAugmented_integrable_version (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → R)
    (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∃ q' : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q') ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
          (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ t)]
          (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q' r p.2) p.1)) ∧
      (∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q' r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, q' r ω = q r ω)
exists_nullAugmented_integrable_version.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_nullAugmented_integrable_version (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (q : ℝ → Ω → R)
    (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∃ q' : ℝ → Ω → R,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q') ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
          (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ t)]
          (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q' r p.2) p.1)) ∧
      (∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q' r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, q' r ω = q r ω) := by
  classical
  let P : Ω → Prop := fun ω => IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))
  have hP : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, P ω := hlocal
  have hP0 : Q {ω | ¬ P ω} = 0 := ae_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨B,hbad,hBm,hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null hP0
  let q' : ℝ → Ω → R := fun r ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else q r ω
  refine ⟨q', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hb : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × Ω | p.2 ∈ B} := hBm.preimage measurable_snd
    have hz : StronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => (0 : R)) := stronglyMeasurable_const
    exact hz.piecewise hb hq
  · intro t
    have hprod : (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t) ≤
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ t) := by
      exact sup_le_sup le_rfl (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q ℱ t))
    have hp := (hpast t).mono hprod
    have hb : MeasurableSet[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
        (nullAugmentedFiltration Q ℱ t)] {p : ℝ × Ω | p.2 ∈ B} :=
      (measurableSet_nullAugmentation Q (ℱ t) B hBm hB0).preimage measurable_snd
    have hfun : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q' r p.2) p.1) =
        fun p : ℝ × Ω => if p.2 ∈ B then 0 else
          (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1 := by
      funext p
      by_cases hB : p.2 ∈ B <;> by_cases ht : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [q',hB,ht]
    rw [hfun]
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise hb hp
  · intro ω
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simpa only [q', ite_eq_left hω] using (integrableOn_zero : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : R)) _)
    · have hi : IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hω (hbad hn)
      simpa only [q', ite_eq_right hω] using hi
  · filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hB0] with ω hω
    exact fun r => ite_eq_right hω

PBGSO/PositiveWorkFubini.lean.scope_note: Nonnegative quadratic energy, initial-energy integrability, actual path equation and positive-work integrability are explicit. The last condition is an additional analytic criterion. NaturalFiniteWorkContraction derives it from the explicit finite signed-work convention; A4/A5 derive it for stationary-target comparisons.
PBGSO/PositiveWorkFubini.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.IntegralQuadraticEnergy
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod

/-! # Expected quadratic balance from positive work alone
Actual pathwise finite-variation equations give a quadratic identity. Its
nonnegative terminal energy bounds negative work by positive work plus the
initial energy. Thus product-integrable positive work suffices for full
Fubini and expected balance, without square-integrable total variation,
time-L¹(L²) drift, or an endpoint uniform-integrability premise.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 500000
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.PositiveWorkFubini
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- Actual pathwise quadratic FTC for a continuous primitive with merely
Bochner-integrable drift. The identity is proved rather than assumed. -/


variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (Q : Measure Ω) [SFinite Q]

/-- Positive work and the actual primitive equation control the full expected
absolute work. No expected-energy equation is supplied as a premise. -/

/-- Full product integrability, terminal quadratic integrability and exact
expected balance follow from the actual raw primitive and positive work. -/

/-- Constant-input cancellation leaves a raw finite-variation pair. Positive
work and the original full-law work inequality then give exponential expected
energy decay. The energy identity and time absolute continuity are conclusions. -/

end PBGSO.PositiveWorkFubini

path_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem path_quadratic (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → E) (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r = x 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, b s) :
    B (x T) (x T) = B (x 0) (x 0) + 2 * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r)
path_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem path_quadratic (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → E) (hx : ContinuousOn x (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hb : IntervalIntegrable b volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (heq : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r = x 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, b s) :
    B (x T) (x T) = B (x 0) (x 0) + 2 * ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), B (x r) (b r) := by
  have h := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.quadratic_balance B hB x b (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
    T.coe_nonneg hb (by simpa using (intervalIntegrable_const :
      IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) volume 0 (T : ℝ))) hx
    (fun r hr => by simpa only [add_zero] using heq r hr)
    (by simp) (fun _ _ => by simp) (by simp)
  simpa only [add_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] using h

abs_eq_two_pos_sub.exact_header: private theorem abs_eq_two_pos_sub (r : ℝ) : ‖r‖ = 2 * max r 0 - r
abs_eq_two_pos_sub.exact_declaration:
private theorem abs_eq_two_pos_sub (r : ℝ) : ‖r‖ = 2 * max r 0 - r := by
  by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
  · rw [max_eq_left hr, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr]
    ring
  · have hr' := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hr)
    rw [max_eq_right hr', Real.norm_of_nonpos hr']
    ring

work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_integrable (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integrable (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let w : ℝ × Ω → ℝ := fun p => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)
  have hw : StronglyMeasurable w := B.continuous₂.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hx.prodMk hb)
  have hsection : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Integrable (fun r => w (r,ω)) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) := by
    filter_upwards [hpath] with ω hω
    have hi := IntegralQuadraticEnergy.bilinear_continuous_integrable B
      (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω) (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hω.1) hω.2.1
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp hi
  apply (integrable_prod_iff' hw.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  refine ⟨hsection, ?_⟩
  apply ((hp.integral_prod_right.const_mul 2).add hzero).mono'
    hw.norm.integral_prod_left'.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [hpath, hsection, hp.prod_left_ae] with ω hω hi hpi
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))]
  have habs : (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖w (r,ω)‖) =
      2 * (∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), max (w (r,ω)) 0) -
        ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), w (r,ω) := by
    simp_rw [abs_eq_two_pos_sub]
    rw [integral_sub (hpi.const_mul 2) hi, integral_const_mul]
  rw [habs]
  have he := path_quadratic B hB T (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω)
    hω.1 hω.2.1 hω.2.2
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at he
  change B (x T ω) (x T ω) = B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) +
    2 * ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), w (r,ω) at he
  have ht := hpos (x T ω)
  have hz := hpos (x 0 ω)
  change 2 * _ - _ ≤ 2 * _ + B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)
  linarith

theorem expected_quadratic_balance (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => B (x T ω) (x T ω)) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, B (x T ω) (x T ω) ∂Q) = (∫ ω, B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) ∂Q) +

theorem expected_quadratic_balance (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => B (x T ω) (x T ω)) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, B (x T ω) (x T ω) ∂Q) = (∫ ω, B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) ∂Q) +
      2 * ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), ∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q := by
  have hw := work_integrable Q B hB hpos T x b hx hb hpath hzero hp
  have he : (fun ω => B (x T ω) (x T ω)) =ᵐ[Q]
      (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) + 2 * ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), B (x r ω) (b r ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hpath] with ω hω
    simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using
      path_quadratic B hB T (fun r => x r ω) (fun r => b r ω) hω.1 hω.2.1 hω.2.2
  have hright := hzero.add (hw.integral_prod_right.const_mul 2)
  refine ⟨hw, hright.congr he.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae he, integral_add hzero (hw.integral_prod_right.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
    integral_integral_swap (μ := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ν := Q)
      (f := fun r ω => B (x r ω) (b r ω)) hw]

theorem expected_energy_decay (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hdiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      (∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q) ≤ -ρ * ∫ ω, B (x r ω) (x r ω) ∂Q) :
    (∫ ω, B (x T ω) (x T ω) ∂Q) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) ∂Q
expected_energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem expected_energy_decay (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (x b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω)
    (hzero : Integrable (fun ω => B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω)) Q)
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => max (B (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hdiss : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)),
      (∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q) ≤ -ρ * ∫ ω, B (x r ω) (x r ω) ∂Q) :
    (∫ ω, B (x T ω) (x T ω) ∂Q) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) * ∫ ω, B (x 0 ω) (x 0 ω) ∂Q := by
  let e : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ∫ ω, B (x r ω) (x r ω) ∂Q
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * ∫ ω, B (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q
  have hw := work_integrable Q B hB hpos T x b hx hb hpath hzero hp
  have hwi : IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
    exact hw.integral_prod_left.const_mul 2
  have he (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : e t = e 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, w r := by
    let τ : ℝ≥0 := ⟨t,ht.1⟩
    have hsub : Icc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (τ : ℝ)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (τ : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (τ : ℝ), x r ω = x 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, b s ω := by
      filter_upwards [hpath] with ω hω
      refine ⟨hω.1.mono hsub, hω.2.1.mono_set ?_, fun r hr => hω.2.2 r (hsub hr)⟩
      change uIcc 0 t ⊆ uIcc 0 (T : ℝ)
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le ht.1, uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using hsub
    have hle : (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (τ : ℝ)) ≤

  filter_upwards [curveHorizon_coe Q T (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu),
    curveHorizon_coe R T u hu,
    (columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).coeFn_compLpL (curveHorizon R T u hu)] with r hQ hR hp
  change (timePullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (curveHorizon R T u hu)) r = _ at hp
  rw [hQ, hp, hR]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero]

predictableCurveIntegral_pullback.exact_header:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_pullback (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (predictableCurveIntegral R D T u hu hU t)
predictableCurveIntegral_pullback.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_pullback (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
      (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (predictableCurveIntegral R D T u hu hU t) := by
  let UR := predictableDomain R D T (curveHorizon R T u hu) (curveHorizon_pastAdapted R D T u hu hU)
  let UQ := predictableDomain Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T
    (curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu))
    (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T _ _
      (fun r i => columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)))
  have he : UQ = pullbackClosedDomain hf D (dyadicGrids T) UR := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change timeCut Q (curveHorizon Q T _ _) 0 T =
      timePullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (timeCut R (curveHorizon R T u hu) 0 T)
    rw [curveHorizon_pullback, timeCut_pullback]
  change closedIntegral Q (pullbackDriver hf D) T UQ t =
    lpPullbackCLM hf (closedIntegral R D T UR t)
  rw [he, closedIntegral_pullback]

predictableCurveIntegral_enlarge.exact_header:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_enlarge (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hD : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (hE : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[E.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T u hu hE t = predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hD t
predictableCurveIntegral_enlarge.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_enlarge (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hD : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (hE : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[E.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T u hu hE t = predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hD t := by
  exact closedStepIntegral_eq_of_enlargement Q D E hprocess henlarge (dyadicGrids T)
    (closedCutDomain Q D T (predictableDomain Q D T _ (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T u hu hD)) 0 t)
    (closedCutDomain Q E T (predictableDomain Q E T _ (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q E T u hu hE)) 0 t) rfl

predictableCurveIntegral_pullback_enlarg.exact_header:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_pullback_enlarge (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
    (hp : (pullbackDriver hf D).process = E.process)
    (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => (columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)).mono (he r)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (predictableCurveIntegral R D T u hu hU t)
predictableCurveIntegral_pullback_enlarg.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_pullback_enlarge (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
    (hp : (pullbackDriver hf D).process = E.process)
    (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) R)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) R)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T (fun r => columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf (u r))
      ((columnPullbackCLM (I := I) (Z := Z) hf).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => (columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)).mono (he r)) t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (predictableCurveIntegral R D T u hu hU t) := by
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_enlarge Q (pullbackDriver hf D) E hp he T _ _
    (fun r i => columnPullback_adapted hf D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i))]
  exact predictableCurveIntegral_pullback hf D T u hu hU t

The symmetric continuous metric weight is arbitrary. This is a finite unit-grid construction; continuous stochastic integration is not claimed here.

/-! # Random-coefficient Gaussian step isometry

The coefficients may depend on the entire past. Independence is imposed
between the current innovation vector and that past, not between the
coefficient columns. Weighted second moments are calculated from Gaussian
coordinate laws and primitive independence.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.PredictableIsometry

variable {Ω Z I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]


/-- Independence of a square-integrable scalar innovation and random
coefficient gives an actual square-integrable noise contribution. -/

section Vector
variable [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

/-- One actual innovation step with random coefficient columns. -/


/-- Cross moments separate the current innovation vector from the random
past-dependent coefficients. Within-column Gaussian independence is a
separate primitive and will discharge the innovation covariance below. -/

/-- A fresh independent standard Gaussian coordinate vector has its
actual identity covariance, derived from its primitive laws. -/

/-- Exact weighted isometry of an actual Gaussian step with arbitrary
random coefficient columns independent of the fresh innovation vector. -/

/-- A predictable random-coefficient Gaussian step has zero conditional
mean. Independence from the past and adaptedness are primitive inputs;
the martingale increment property is derived by conditional pull-out. -/

/-- Conditional centering makes a square-integrable increment orthogonal
to every adapted square-integrable past vector in the actual weighted
pairing. This is derived from conditional pull-out, not assumed. -/

end Vector
section Canonical
variable [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]








/-- The complete current Gaussian vector is independent of every measurable
random coefficient formed from the strict finite past. -/

/-- An actual canonical iid Gaussian path and arbitrary square-integrable
past-dependent coefficient columns satisfy the weighted one-step isometry.
All Gaussian laws and current/past independence are constructed. -/

/-- The actual strict-past filtration of the canonical Gaussian path. -/




/-- The predictable step is a genuine centered martingale increment on
the constructed Gaussian path and its strict-past filtration. -/

/-- Every finite input prefix has exactly the finite product Gaussian law. -/

/-- Actual step with a coefficient determined solely by past innovations. -/








/-- The finite sums of the actual predictable Gaussian increments form
an actual martingale, derived from independent future innovations. -/

/-- The accumulated actual predictable Gaussian martingale satisfies its
exact weighted finite-sum Itô isometry. The coefficient maps may be
nonlinear functions of every past innovation. -/

/-- Exact L² norm of the constructed predictable sum. -/


/-- The L² distance of two predictable integrals is exactly the coefficient
L² distance. This gives the Cauchy estimate needed for completion. -/

end Canonical

pairing_integrable.exact_header:
theorem pairing_integrable (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (A B : Ω → Z)
    (hA : MemLp A 2 Q) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ⟪A ω, W (B ω)⟫_ℝ) Q
pairing_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem pairing_integrable (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (A B : Ω → Z)
    (hA : MemLp A 2 Q) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ⟪A ω, W (B ω)⟫_ℝ) Q := by
  apply (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q W (hA.toLp A) (hB.toLp B)).congr
  filter_upwards [hA.coeFn_toLp, hB.coeFn_toLp] with ω ha hb
  rw [ha, hb]

independent_smul_memLp.exact_header:
theorem independent_smul_memLp (ξ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → Z)
    (hξ : MemLp ξ 2 Q) (hA : MemLp A 2 Q) (hInd : IndepFun ξ A Q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => ξ ω • A ω) 2 Q
independent_smul_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_smul_memLp (ξ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → Z)
    (hξ : MemLp ξ 2 Q) (hA : MemLp A 2 Q) (hInd : IndepFun ξ A Q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => ξ ω • A ω) 2 Q := by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hξ.aestronglyMeasurable.smul
    hA.aestronglyMeasurable)).mpr
  have hξsq := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hξ.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hξ
  have hAsq := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hA.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hA
  have hind := hInd.comp (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable
  have hi := hind.integrable_mul hξsq hAsq
  apply hi.congr
  exact ae_of_all Q fun ω => by
    change ‖ξ ω‖ ^ 2 * ‖A ω‖ ^ 2 = ‖ξ ω • A ω‖ ^ 2
    rw [norm_smul, mul_pow]

stepSum.exact_header: def stepSum (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z) (ω : Ω) : Z
stepSum.exact_declaration:
def stepSum (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  ∑ i, ξ i ω • A i ω

stepSum_memLp.exact_header:
theorem stepSum_memLp (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) :
    MemLp (stepSum ξ A) 2 Q
stepSum_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem stepSum_memLp (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) :
    MemLp (stepSum ξ A) 2 Q := by
  apply memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ
  intro i _
  apply independent_smul_memLp Q _ _ (hξ i) (hA i)
  exact hInd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply i)

weighted_cross_moment.exact_header:
theorem weighted_cross_moment (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪ξ i ω • A i ω, W (ξ j ω • A j ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      (∫ ω, ξ i ω * ξ j ω ∂Q) * (∫ ω, ⟪A i ω, W (A j ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
weighted_cross_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem weighted_cross_moment (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪ξ i ω • A i ω, W (ξ j ω • A j ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      (∫ ω, ξ i ω * ξ j ω ∂Q) * (∫ ω, ⟪A i ω, W (A j ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  have hind := hInd.comp
    (show Measurable (fun x : I → ℝ => x i * x j) by fun_prop)
    (show Measurable (fun x : I → Z => ⟪x i, W (x j)⟫_ℝ) by fun_prop)
  have h1 : Integrable (fun ω => ξ i ω * ξ j ω) Q :=
    (hξ i).integrable_mul (hξ j)
  have h2 := pairing_integrable Q W (A i) (A j) (hA i) (hA j)
  have he := hind.integral_mul_eq_mul_integral h1.aestronglyMeasurable h2.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.mul_apply] at he
  convert he using 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all Q fun ω => by
    simp only [map_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring

gaussian_cross_moment.exact_header:
theorem gaussian_cross_moment (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ)
    (hLaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (ξ i) (gaussianReal 0 1) Q) (hInd : iIndepFun ξ Q) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, ξ i ω * ξ j ω ∂Q) = if i = j then 1 else 0
gaussian_cross_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem gaussian_cross_moment (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ)
    (hLaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (ξ i) (gaussianReal 0 1) Q) (hInd : iIndepFun ξ Q) (i j : I) :
    (∫ ω, ξ i ω * ξ j ω ∂Q) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    simpa only [pow_two, Function.comp_apply, NNReal.coe_one] using ((hLaw i).integral_comp
      (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (by fun_prop)).trans (ULA.centered_gaussian_second_moment 1)
  · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
    have hi : (∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂Q) = 0 := by
      exact ((hLaw i).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)).trans integral_id_gaussianReal
    have hj : (∫ ω, ξ j ω ∂Q) = 0 := by
      exact ((hLaw j).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)).trans integral_id_gaussianReal
    have he := (hInd.indepFun hij).integral_mul_eq_mul_integral
      (hLaw i).aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable (hLaw j).aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, hi, hj, zero_mul] using he

gaussian_step_isometry.exact_header:
theorem gaussian_step_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hLaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (ξ i) (gaussianReal 0 1) Q)
    (hξInd : iIndepFun ξ Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪stepSum ξ A ω, W (stepSum ξ A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪A i ω, W (A i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
gaussian_step_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem gaussian_step_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hLaw : ∀ i, HasLaw (ξ i) (gaussianReal 0 1) Q)
    (hξInd : iIndepFun ξ Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪stepSum ξ A ω, W (stepSum ξ A ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪A i ω, W (A i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  have hξ (i : I) : MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q :=
    (hLaw i).memLp (memLp_id_gaussianReal (2 : ℝ≥0))
  have hm (i : I) : MemLp (fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) 2 Q :=
    independent_smul_memLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q _ _ (hξ i) (hA i)
      (hInd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hi (i j : I) : Integrable
      (fun ω => ⟪ξ i ω • A i ω, W (ξ j ω • A j ω)⟫_ℝ) Q :=
    pairing_integrable Q W _ _ (hm i) (hm j)
  have he : (fun ω => ⟪stepSum ξ A ω, W (stepSum ξ A ω)⟫_ℝ) =
      (fun ω => ∑ i, ∑ j, ⟪ξ i ω • A i ω, W (ξ j ω • A j ω)⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [stepSum, map_sum, sum_inner, inner_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [he, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi i j))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hi _ j)]
  simp_rw [weighted_cross_moment Q W ξ A hξ hA hInd,
    gaussian_cross_moment Q ξ hLaw hξInd]
  simp

independent_step_condExp_zero.exact_header:
theorem independent_step_condExp_zero
    (F : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : F ≤ mΩ)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξmeas : ∀ i, @Measurable Ω ℝ mΩ inferInstance (ξ i))
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hAadapt : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F] (A i))
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q)
    (hPast : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => ξ i ω) inferInstance) F Q)
    (hmean : ∀ i, (∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂Q) = 0) :
    Q[stepSum ξ A | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z)
independent_step_condExp_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem independent_step_condExp_zero
    (F : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : F ≤ mΩ)
    (ξ : I → Ω → ℝ) (A : I → Ω → Z)
    (hξmeas : ∀ i, @Measurable Ω ℝ mΩ inferInstance (ξ i))
    (hξ : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 Q) (hA : ∀ i, MemLp (A i) 2 Q)
    (hAadapt : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[F] (A i))
    (hInd : IndepFun (fun ω i => ξ i ω) (fun ω i => A i ω) Q)
    (hPast : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => ξ i ω) inferInstance) F Q)
    (hmean : ∀ i, (∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂Q) = 0) :
    Q[stepSum ξ A | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z) := by
  let G := MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => ξ i ω) inferInstance
  have hmwhole : @Measurable Ω (I → ℝ) mΩ inferInstance (fun ω i => ξ i ω) :=
    (@measurable_pi_iff Ω I (fun _ => ℝ) mΩ (fun _ => inferInstance)
      (fun ω i => ξ i ω)).mpr hξmeas
  have hG : G ≤ mΩ := hmwhole.comap_le
  have hprod (i : I) : MemLp (fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) 2 Q :=
    independent_smul_memLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q _ _ (hξ i) (hA i)
      (hInd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hξcond (i : I) : Q[ξ i | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → ℝ) := by
    have hmblock : Measurable[G] (fun ω i => ξ i ω) :=
      measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
    have hmeas : Measurable[G] (ξ i) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (measurable_pi_apply i).comp hmblock
    have he := condExp_indep_eq hG hF hmeas.stronglyMeasurable hPast
    change Q[ξ i | F] =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    simpa only [hmean i] using he
  have hcond (i : I) : Q[(fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z) := by
    have hp := condExp_smul_of_aestronglyMeasurable_right
      ((hξ i).integrable (by norm_num)) ((hprod i).integrable (by norm_num))
      (hAadapt i).aestronglyMeasurable
    have heqfun : ξ i • A i = (fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) := rfl
    rw [heqfun] at hp
    filter_upwards [hp, hξcond i] with ω hp hξ0
    simpa only [Pi.smul_apply', hξ0, zero_smul, Pi.zero_apply] using hp
  have he := condExp_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => (hprod i).integrable (by norm_num)) F
  have hsum : (∑ i : I, Q[(fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) | F]) =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hcond] with ω hω
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, hω, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hfun : stepSum ξ A = ∑ i : I, (fun ω => ξ i ω • A i ω) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [stepSum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [hfun]
  exact he.trans hsum

conditional_zero_pairing.exact_header:
theorem conditional_zero_pairing (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (F : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : F ≤ mΩ) (X Y : Ω → Z)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) (hY : MemLp Y 2 Q)
    (hXadapt : AEStronglyMeasurable[F] X Q)
    (hYmean : Q[Y | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z)) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = 0
conditional_zero_pairing.exact_declaration:
theorem conditional_zero_pairing (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (F : MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : F ≤ mΩ) (X Y : Ω → Z)
    (hX : MemLp X 2 Q) (hY : MemLp Y 2 Q)
    (hXadapt : AEStronglyMeasurable[F] X Q)
    (hYmean : Q[Y | F] =ᵐ[Q] (0 : Ω → Z)) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = 0 := by
  let B : Z →L[ℝ] Z →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) W
  have hp := condExp_bilin_of_aestronglyMeasurable_left (mΩ := mΩ) (μ := Q) (m := F) B
    hXadapt (pairing_integrable (mΩ := mΩ) Q W X Y hX hY) (hY.integrable (by norm_num))
  have hzero : Q[(fun ω => ⟪X ω, W (Y ω)⟫_ℝ) | F] =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hp, hYmean] with ω hp hy
    simpa only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, hy, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero, inner_zero_right] using hp
  have he := integral_congr_ae hzero
  rw [integral_condExp hF, integral_zero] at he
  exact he

NoisePath.exact_declaration: abbrev NoisePath (I : Type*) := ℕ → NoiseVector I

vectorLaw.exact_declaration: def vectorLaw : Measure (NoiseVector I) := Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)

pathLaw.exact_declaration: def pathLaw : Measure (NoisePath I) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ => vectorLaw (I := I))

vectorLaw_probability.exact_declaration:
instance vectorLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure (vectorLaw (I := I)) := by
  dsimp [vectorLaw]
  infer_instance

pathLaw_probability.exact_declaration:
instance pathLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  dsimp [pathLaw]
  infer_instance

pastPrefix.exact_header: def pastPrefix (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Fin n → NoiseVector I
pastPrefix.exact_declaration: def pastPrefix (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Fin n → NoiseVector I := fun k => w k

fresh_hasLaw.exact_header:
theorem fresh_hasLaw (n : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (fun w : NoisePath I => w n) (vectorLaw (I := I)) (pathLaw (I := I))
fresh_hasLaw.exact_declaration:
theorem fresh_hasLaw (n : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (fun w : NoisePath I => w n) (vectorLaw (I := I)) (pathLaw (I := I)) where
  aemeasurable := (measurable_pi_apply n).aemeasurable
  map_eq := Measure.infinitePi_map_eval _ n

coordinate_hasLaw.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_hasLaw (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    HasLaw (fun w : NoisePath I => w n i) (gaussianReal 0 1) (pathLaw (I := I))
coordinate_hasLaw.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_hasLaw (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    HasLaw (fun w : NoisePath I => w n i) (gaussianReal 0 1) (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  have hc := (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : I => gaussianReal 0 1) i).hasLaw
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hc.comp (fresh_hasLaw (I := I) n)

coordinate_independent.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_independent (n : ℕ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i => fun w : NoisePath I => w n i) (pathLaw (I := I))
coordinate_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_independent (n : ℕ) :
    iIndepFun (fun i => fun w : NoisePath I => w n i) (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (coordinate_hasLaw n i).aemeasurable)).mpr
  simp only [(coordinate_hasLaw n _).map_eq]
  exact (fresh_hasLaw (I := I) n).map_eq

fresh_independent_coefficient.exact_header:
theorem fresh_independent_coefficient (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A) :
    IndepFun (fun w : NoisePath I => fun i => w n i)
      (fun w i => A (pastPrefix n w) i) (pathLaw (I := I))
fresh_independent_coefficient.exact_declaration:
theorem fresh_independent_coefficient (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A) :
    IndepFun (fun w : NoisePath I => fun i => w n i)
      (fun w i => A (pastPrefix n w) i) (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  change IndepFun (fun w : NoisePath I => w n) (fun w => A (pastPrefix n w)) _
  unfold pastPrefix pathLaw
  exact (ULA.iid_prefix_independent_fresh (vectorLaw (I := I)) n).symm.comp measurable_id hA

canonical_step_isometry.exact_header:
theorem canonical_step_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A)
    (hA2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    (∫ w, ⟪(∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i),
      W (∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)) =
      ∑ i, ∫ w, ⟪A (pastPrefix n w) i, W (A (pastPrefix n w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)
canonical_step_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_step_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A)
    (hA2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    (∫ w, ⟪(∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i),
      W (∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)) =
      ∑ i, ∫ w, ⟪A (pastPrefix n w) i, W (A (pastPrefix n w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I) :=
  gaussian_step_isometry (pathLaw (I := I)) W _ _
    (coordinate_hasLaw n) (coordinate_independent n) hA2 (fresh_independent_coefficient n A hA)

pastFiltration.exact_header: def pastFiltration : Filtration ℕ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (NoisePath I))
pastFiltration.exact_declaration:
def pastFiltration : Filtration ℕ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (NoisePath I)) where
  seq n := MeasurableSpace.comap (pastPrefix (I := I) n) inferInstance
  mono' := by
    intro n m hnm
    let restrict : (Fin m → NoiseVector I) → (Fin n → NoiseVector I) :=
      fun v i => v ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hnm⟩
    have hr : Measurable restrict := by fun_prop
    have hm : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap (pastPrefix (I := I) m) inferInstance]
        (pastPrefix m) := measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
    have hn : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap (pastPrefix (I := I) m) inferInstance]
        (pastPrefix n) := by
      change Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap (pastPrefix (I := I) m) inferInstance]
        (fun w => fun i : Fin n => w i.val)
      exact hr.comp hm
    exact hn.comap_le
  le' n := (show Measurable (pastPrefix (I := I) n) from
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.val)).comap_le

pastPrefix_measurable.exact_header:
theorem pastPrefix_measurable (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable[pastFiltration (I := I) n] (pastPrefix n)
pastPrefix_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem pastPrefix_measurable (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable[pastFiltration (I := I) n] (pastPrefix n) :=
  measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl

coefficient_adapted.exact_header:
theorem coefficient_adapted (n : ℕ) (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : Measurable A) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable[pastFiltration (I := I) n] (fun w => A (pastPrefix n w) i)
coefficient_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficient_adapted (n : ℕ) (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : Measurable A) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable[pastFiltration (I := I) n] (fun w => A (pastPrefix n w) i) :=
  ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp (hA.comp (pastPrefix_measurable n))).stronglyMeasurable

fresh_past_independent.exact_header:
theorem fresh_past_independent (n : ℕ) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun w : NoisePath I => w n) inferInstance)
      (pastFiltration (I := I) n) (pathLaw (I := I))
fresh_past_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem fresh_past_independent (n : ℕ) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun w : NoisePath I => w n) inferInstance)
      (pastFiltration (I := I) n) (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  exact (ULA.iid_prefix_independent_fresh (vectorLaw (I := I)) n).symm

canonical_step_condExp_zero.exact_header:
theorem canonical_step_condExp_zero (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A)
    (hA2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    (pathLaw (I := I))[(fun w => ∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i) |
      pastFiltration (I := I) n] =ᵐ[pathLaw (I := I)] (0 : NoisePath I → Z)
canonical_step_condExp_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem canonical_step_condExp_zero (n : ℕ)
    (A : (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z) (hA : Measurable A)
    (hA2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    (pathLaw (I := I))[(fun w => ∑ i, w n i • A (pastPrefix n w) i) |
      pastFiltration (I := I) n] =ᵐ[pathLaw (I := I)] (0 : NoisePath I → Z) := by
  apply independent_step_condExp_zero (pathLaw (I := I)) (pastFiltration n)
    ((pastFiltration (I := I)).le n) (fun i w => w n i)
    (fun i w => A (pastPrefix n w) i) (fun i => by fun_prop)
    (fun i => (coordinate_hasLaw n i).memLp (memLp_id_gaussianReal (2 : ℝ≥0))) hA2
    (coefficient_adapted n A hA) (fresh_independent_coefficient n A hA)
    (fresh_past_independent n)
  intro i
  exact ((coordinate_hasLaw n i).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)).trans integral_id_gaussianReal

pastPrefix_hasLaw.exact_header:
theorem pastPrefix_hasLaw (n : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (pastPrefix (I := I) n) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => vectorLaw (I := I)))
      (pathLaw (I := I))
pastPrefix_hasLaw.exact_declaration:
theorem pastPrefix_hasLaw (n : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (pastPrefix (I := I) n) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => vectorLaw (I := I)))
      (pathLaw (I := I)) where
  aemeasurable := (show Measurable (pastPrefix (I := I) n) from
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.val)).aemeasurable
  map_eq := by
    change (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => vectorLaw (I := I))).map
      (fun (w : NoisePath I) (i : Fin n) => w i.val) = _
    rw [Measure.map_infinitePi_infinitePi_of_inj Fin.val_injective, Measure.infinitePi_eq_pi]

predictableStep.exact_header:
def predictableStep (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Z
predictableStep.exact_declaration:
def predictableStep (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Z := ∑ i, w n i • A n (pastPrefix n w) i

predictableSum.exact_header:
def predictableSum (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Z
predictableSum.exact_declaration:
def predictableSum (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) : Z := ∑ k : Fin n, predictableStep A k w

predictableSum_zero.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem predictableSum_zero (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (w : NoisePath I) : predictableSum A 0 w = 0
predictableSum_zero.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem predictableSum_zero (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (w : NoisePath I) : predictableSum A 0 w = 0 := by simp [predictableSum]

predictableSum_succ.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_succ (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) :
    predictableSum A (n + 1) w = predictableSum A n w + predictableStep A n w
predictableSum_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_succ (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (n : ℕ) (w : NoisePath I) :
    predictableSum A (n + 1) w = predictableSum A n w + predictableStep A n w := by
  simp only [predictableSum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

predictableStep_memLp.exact_header:
theorem predictableStep_memLp (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) : MemLp (predictableStep A n) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))
predictableStep_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableStep_memLp (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) : MemLp (predictableStep A n) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)) :=
  stepSum_memLp (pathLaw (I := I)) _ _
    (fun i => (coordinate_hasLaw n i).memLp (memLp_id_gaussianReal (2 : ℝ≥0)))
    (hA2 n) (fresh_independent_coefficient n (A n) (hA n))

predictableSum_memLp.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_memLp (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) : MemLp (predictableSum A n) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))
predictableSum_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_memLp (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) : MemLp (predictableSum A n) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)) :=
  memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun k _ => predictableStep_memLp A hA hA2 k)

predictableStep_adapted.exact_header:
theorem predictableStep_adapted (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) (n : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[pastFiltration (I := I) (n + 1)] (predictableStep A n)
predictableStep_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableStep_adapted (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) (n : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable[pastFiltration (I := I) (n + 1)] (predictableStep A n) := by
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
  intro i _
  have hξ : Measurable[pastFiltration (I := I) (n + 1)] (fun w : NoisePath I => w n i) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply i).comp ((measurable_pi_apply (Fin.last n)).comp
      (pastPrefix_measurable (n + 1)))
  exact hξ.stronglyMeasurable.smul ((coefficient_adapted n (A n) (hA n) i).mono
    ((pastFiltration (I := I)).mono (Nat.le_succ n)))

predictableSum_adapted.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_adapted (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) :
    StronglyAdapted (pastFiltration (I := I)) (predictableSum A)
predictableSum_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_adapted (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) :
    StronglyAdapted (pastFiltration (I := I)) (predictableSum A) := by
  intro n
  apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
  intro k _
  exact (predictableStep_adapted A hA k).mono
    ((pastFiltration (I := I)).mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.isLt))

predictableSum_martingale.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_martingale (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    Martingale (predictableSum A) (pastFiltration (I := I)) (pathLaw (I := I))
predictableSum_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_martingale (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I))) :
    Martingale (predictableSum A) (pastFiltration (I := I)) (pathLaw (I := I)) := by
  apply martingale_of_condExp_sub_eq_zero_nat (predictableSum_adapted A hA)
    (fun n => (predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n).integrable (by norm_num))
  intro n
  have heq : predictableSum A (n + 1) - predictableSum A n = predictableStep A n := by
    funext w
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, predictableSum_succ, add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [heq]
  exact canonical_step_condExp_zero n (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n)

predictableSum_isometry.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ w, ⟪predictableSum A n w, W (predictableSum A n w)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ⟪A k (pastPrefix k w) i,
        W (A k (pastPrefix k w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)
predictableSum_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_isometry (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ w, ⟪predictableSum A n w, W (predictableSum A n w)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ⟪A k (pastPrefix k w) i,
        W (A k (pastPrefix k w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [predictableSum_zero, inner_zero_left, integral_zero, Finset.univ_eq_empty,
      Finset.sum_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hSn := predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n
    have hYn := predictableStep_memLp A hA hA2 n
    have hcross := conditional_zero_pairing (pathLaw (I := I)) W (pastFiltration n)
      ((pastFiltration (I := I)).le n) (predictableSum A n) (predictableStep A n)
      hSn hYn (predictableSum_adapted A hA n).aestronglyMeasurable
      (canonical_step_condExp_zero n (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n))
    have hstep := canonical_step_isometry W n (A n) (hA n) (hA2 n)
    have hpoint : (fun w => ⟪predictableSum A (n + 1) w, W (predictableSum A (n + 1) w)⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun w => ⟪predictableSum A n w, W (predictableSum A n w)⟫_ℝ +
          2 * ⟪predictableSum A n w, W (predictableStep A n w)⟫_ℝ +
          ⟪predictableStep A n w, W (predictableStep A n w)⟫_ℝ) := by
      funext w
      rw [predictableSum_succ]
      simp only [map_add, inner_add_left, inner_add_right]
      have hsym : ⟪predictableStep A n w, W (predictableSum A n w)⟫_ℝ =
          ⟪predictableSum A n w, W (predictableStep A n w)⟫_ℝ :=
        (real_inner_comm _ _).trans (hW _ _).symm
      rw [hsym]
      ring
    have h00 := pairing_integrable (pathLaw (I := I)) W _ _ hSn hSn
    have h01 := (pairing_integrable (pathLaw (I := I)) W _ _ hSn hYn).const_mul 2
    have h11 := pairing_integrable (pathLaw (I := I)) W _ _ hYn hYn
    have hint1 := integral_add (h00.add h01) h11
    have hint2 := integral_add h00 h01
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hint1 hint2
    rw [hpoint, hint1, hint2, integral_const_mul, hcross, mul_zero, add_zero, ih]
    change _ + (∫ w, ⟪(∑ i, w n i • A n (pastPrefix n w) i),
      W (∑ i, w n i • A n (pastPrefix n w) i)⟫_ℝ ∂pathLaw (I := I)) = _
    rw [hstep, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

predictableSum_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_norm_sq
    (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n).toLp (predictableSum A n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ‖A k (pastPrefix k w) i‖ ^ 2 ∂pathLaw (I := I)
predictableSum_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_norm_sq
    (A : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n).toLp (predictableSum A n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ‖A k (pastPrefix k w) i‖ ^ 2 ∂pathLaw (I := I) := by
  let hS := predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  have he : (∫ w, ‖hS.toLp (predictableSum A n) w‖ ^ 2 ∂pathLaw (I := I)) =
      ∫ w, ‖predictableSum A n w‖ ^ 2 ∂pathLaw (I := I) :=
    integral_congr_ae (hS.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z : Z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))
  rw [he]
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using
    predictableSum_isometry (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Z) (fun _ _ => rfl) A hA hA2 n

theorem predictableSum_sub

predictableSum_distance_sq.exact_header:
theorem predictableSum_distance_sq
    (A B : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) (hB : ∀ n, Measurable (B n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (hB2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => B n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n).toLp (predictableSum A n) -
      (predictableSum_memLp B hB hB2 n).toLp (predictableSum B n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ‖A k (pastPrefix k w) i - B k (pastPrefix k w) i‖ ^ 2
        ∂pathLaw (I := I)
predictableSum_distance_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableSum_distance_sq
    (A B : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z)
    (hA : ∀ n, Measurable (A n)) (hB : ∀ n, Measurable (B n))
    (hA2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => A n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (hB2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (fun w : NoisePath I => B n (pastPrefix n w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n).toLp (predictableSum A n) -
      (predictableSum_memLp B hB hB2 n).toLp (predictableSum B n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ∑ i, ∫ w, ‖A k (pastPrefix k w) i - B k (pastPrefix k w) i‖ ^ 2
        ∂pathLaw (I := I) := by
  let C : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin n → NoiseVector I) → I → Z := fun k p i => A k p i - B k p i
  have hC (k : ℕ) : Measurable (C k) := (hA k).sub (hB k)
  have hC2 (k : ℕ) (i : I) : MemLp
      (fun w : NoisePath I => C k (pastPrefix k w) i) 2 (pathLaw (I := I)) :=
    (hA2 k i).sub (hB2 k i)
  let hSA := predictableSum_memLp A hA hA2 n
  let hSB := predictableSum_memLp B hB hB2 n
  let hSC := predictableSum_memLp C hC hC2 n
  have hLp : hSC.toLp (predictableSum C n) =
      hSA.toLp (predictableSum A n) - hSB.toLp (predictableSum B n) := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hSC.coeFn_toLp, hSA.coeFn_toLp, hSB.coeFn_toLp,
      Lp.coeFn_sub (hSA.toLp (predictableSum A n)) (hSB.toLp (predictableSum B n))]
      with w hc ha hb hs
    rw [hs, Pi.sub_apply, hc, ha, hb]
    exact predictableSum_sub A B n w
  rw [← hLp]
  exact predictableSum_norm_sq C hC hC2 n

theorem averagedDomain_eq_timeCut (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :

averagedDomain_eq_timeCut.exact_declaration:
theorem averagedDomain_eq_timeCut (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (averagedDomain Q D T U hU ε hε.le).val = timeCut Q (PastAverages.average U ε) 0 T := by

    timeCut_coe Q (PastAverages.average U ε) 0 T,
    LpIntegralSections.average_coe_ae U ε hε] with r hmean hcut hr
  rw [hmean, hcut]

timeCut_mem_closedStep.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_mem_closedStep (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) :
    timeCut Q U 0 T ∈ closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)))
timeCut_mem_closedStep.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_mem_closedStep (T : ℝ≥0)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hU : PastAdaptedColumns Q D U) :
    timeCut Q U 0 T ∈ closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))) := by
  have hlim := ((timeCut_lipschitz (I := I) (Z := Z) Q 0 T).continuous.tendsto U).comp
    (PastAverages.average_tendsto U)
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hlim
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
  have hε' : 0 < ε := hε
  have hc := (averagedClosedDomain Q D T U hU ε hε'.le).property
  have he := averagedDomain_eq_timeCut Q D T U hU ε hε'
  change (averagedDomain Q D T U hU ε hε'.le).val ∈ _ at hc

paths_independent_of_finite.exact_header:
theorem paths_independent_of_finite
    (hi : ∀ J : Finset T, iIndepFun (fun i ω => J.restrict (fun t => B i t ω)) Q) :

paths_independent_of_finite.exact_declaration:
theorem paths_independent_of_finite
    (hi : ∀ J : Finset T, iIndepFun (fun i ω => J.restrict (fun t => B i t ω)) Q) :
    iIndepFun (fun i ω => fun t => B i t ω) Q := by
  let m (i : I) := Q.map (fun ω => fun t => B i t ω)
  have hmB (i : I) : Measurable (fun ω => fun t => B i t ω) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (hm i)
  haveI (i : I) : IsProbabilityMeasure (m i) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hmB i).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  let ν := Measure.pi m
  let F (J : Finset T) := Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t i => B i t ω))
  have hmF (J : Finset T) : Measurable (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t i => B i t ω)) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t => measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => hm i t))
  haveI (J : Finset T) : IsProbabilityMeasure (F J) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hmF J).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hQ : IsProjectiveLimit (Q.map (fun ω => fun t i => B i t ω)) F :=
    isProjectiveLimit_map (measurable_pi_iff.mpr
      (fun t => measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => hm i t))).aemeasurable
  have hν : IsProjectiveLimit (ν.map (transpose I T E)) F := by
    intro J
    apply (MeasurableEquiv.map_measurableEquiv_injective (transpose J I E))
    rw [Measure.map_map (transpose J I E).measurable (Finset.measurable_restrict J),
      Measure.map_map ((transpose J I E).measurable.comp (Finset.measurable_restrict J))
        (transpose I T E).measurable,
      Measure.map_map (transpose J I E).measurable (hmF J)]
    change (Measure.pi m).map (fun x i => J.restrict (x i)) =
      Q.map (fun ω i => J.restrict (fun t => B i t ω))
    haveI (i : I) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((m i).map J.restrict) :=
      (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (Finset.measurable_restrict J).aemeasurable).mpr
        inferInstance
    rw [Measure.pi_map_pi (fun _ => (Finset.measurable_restrict J).aemeasurable)]
    have hmi (i : I) : (m i).map J.restrict =
        Q.map (fun ω => J.restrict (fun t => B i t ω)) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map (Finset.measurable_restrict J) (hmB i)]
      rfl
    simp_rw [hmi]
    exact ((hi J).map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i =>
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t : J => hm i t)).aemeasurable)).symm
  have he := hQ.unique hν
  have ht : (Q.map (fun ω i t => B i t ω)).map (transpose I T E) =
      ν.map (transpose I T E) := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (transpose I T E).measurable
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => hmB i))]
    exact he
  have hraw := (MeasurableEquiv.map_measurableEquiv_injective (transpose I T E)) ht
  exact (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hmB i).aemeasurable)).mpr hraw
