measurable_distance_criterion.exact_header:
private theorem measurable_distance_criterion {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    [PseudoMetricSpace B] [SecondCountableTopology B] [MeasurableSpace B] [BorelSpace B]
    (g : A → B) (hg : ∀ b, Measurable (fun a => dist (g a) b)) : Measurable g
measurable_distance_criterion.exact_declaration:
private theorem measurable_distance_criterion {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    [PseudoMetricSpace B] [SecondCountableTopology B] [MeasurableSpace B] [BorelSpace B]
    (g : A → B) (hg : ∀ b, Measurable (fun a => dist (g a) b)) : Measurable g := by
  have hbase : IsTopologicalBasis {s : Set B | ∃ b r, s = Metric.ball b r} := by
    apply isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds
    · rintro _ ⟨b,r,rfl⟩
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball
    · intro b s hbs hs
      obtain ⟨r,hr,hrs⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hs b hbs
      exact ⟨Metric.ball b r, ⟨b,r,rfl⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, hrs⟩
  have hm : @Measurable A B _ (borel B) g := by
    rw [hbase.borel_eq_generateFrom]
    apply measurable_generateFrom
    rintro _ ⟨b,r,rfl⟩
    exact measurableSet_lt (hg b) measurable_const
  exact hm.mono le_rfl (by rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := B)])

measurable_section_eLpNorm.exact_declaration:
private theorem measurable_section_eLpNorm (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    Measurable (fun t => eLpNorm (f t) 2 Q) := by
  have hlin : Measurable (fun t => ∫⁻ ω, ‖f t ω‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂Q) :=
    (hf.enorm.pow_const (2 : ℝ)).lintegral_prod_right'
  have he (t : T) : eLpNorm (f t) 2 Q =
      (∫⁻ ω, ‖f t ω‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂Q) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa using eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
      (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞) (hf.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable (μ := Q))
  simp_rw [he]
  exact hlin.pow_const _

sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable_of_isSepara.exact_header:
theorem sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable_of_isSeparable [IsSeparable Q] [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : T → Ω → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (sectionLp Q f)
sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable_of_isSepara.exact_declaration:
theorem sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable_of_isSeparable [IsSeparable Q] [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : T → Ω → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (sectionLp Q f) := by
  classical
  letI : Fact ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  borelize ↥(Lp R 2 Q)
  apply Measurable.stronglyMeasurable
  apply measurable_distance_criterion
  intro a
  have hm : MeasurableSet {t | MemLp (f t) 2 Q} := by
    have he : {t | MemLp (f t) 2 Q} = {t | eLpNorm (f t) 2 Q < ∞} := by
      ext t
      rfl
    rw [he]
    exact measurableSet_lt (measurable_section_eLpNorm Q f hf) measurable_const
  have hsub : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : T × Ω => f p.1 p.2 - a p.2) :=
    hf.sub (Lp.stronglyMeasurable a).comp_snd
  have hd : Measurable (fun t => (eLpNorm (fun ω => f t ω - a ω) 2 Q).toReal) :=
    (measurable_section_eLpNorm Q (fun t ω => f t ω - a ω) hsub).ennreal_toReal
  have he (t : T) : dist (sectionLp Q f t) a =
      if MemLp (f t) 2 Q then (eLpNorm (fun ω => f t ω - a ω) 2 Q).toReal
      else dist (0 : Lp R 2 Q) a := by
    by_cases ht : MemLp (f t) 2 Q
    · simp only [sectionLp, dite_eq_left ht, ite_eq_left ht, Lp.dist_def]
      congr 1
      exact eLpNorm_congr_ae (ht.coeFn_toLp.sub Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl)
    · simp [sectionLp, ht]
  simp_rw [he]
  exact hd.piecewise hm measurable_const

exists_countable_sigmaFinite_algebra.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_countable_sigmaFinite_algebra [MeasurableSpace R]
    [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated R] (f : T × Ω → R) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∃ m : MeasurableSpace Ω, ∃ hm : m ≤ mΩ,
      @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Ω m ∧
      @SigmaFinite Ω m (Q.trim hm) ∧ @Measurable (T × Ω) R (mT.prod m) _ f := by
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hcg,hf⟩ := CountableProductDependence.measurable_countable_spatial_dependence f hf
  let c := MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (Set.range (spanningSets Q))
  have hc : c ≤ mΩ := MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le (by
    rintro _ ⟨n,rfl⟩
    exact measurableSet_spanningSets Q n)
  have hcc : @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Ω c :=
    ⟨Set.range (spanningSets Q), Set.countable_range _, rfl⟩
  let m' := m ⊔ c
  have hm' : m' ≤ mΩ := sup_le hm hc
  have hset (n : ℕ) : @MeasurableSet Ω m' (spanningSets Q n) :=
    (show c ≤ m' from le_sup_right) _ (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Set.mem_range_self n))
  have hs : @SigmaFinite Ω m' (Q.trim hm') := by
    refine ⟨⟨⟨spanningSets Q, (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _), ?_, iUnion_spanningSets Q⟩⟩⟩
    intro n
    rw [trim_measurableSet_eq hm' (hset n)]
    exact measure_spanningSets_lt_top Q n
  refine ⟨m',hm',hcg.sup hcc,hs,?_⟩
  exact hf.mono (sup_le_sup le_rfl (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono le_sup_left)) le_rfl

sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable [SeparableSpace R] (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q f)
sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable [SeparableSpace R] (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q f) := by
  borelize R
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hcg,hs,hfm⟩ := exists_countable_sigmaFinite_algebra Q
    (Function.uncurry f) hf.measurable
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := mΩ
  let Ωc := ULift.{0} Ω
  letI mc : MeasurableSpace Ωc := MeasurableSpace.comap ULift.down m
  letI : MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Ωc := @MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated.comap Ωc Ω m hcg ULift.down
  have hdown : @Measurable Ωc Ω mc m ULift.down := measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl
  have hup : Measurable (ULift.up : Ω → Ωc) := by
    apply measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr
    change MeasurableSpace.comap ULift.up (MeasurableSpace.comap ULift.down m) ≤ mΩ
    rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
    change MeasurableSpace.comap (id : Ω → Ω) m ≤ mΩ
    simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_id] using hm
  let Qc : Measure Ωc := Q.map ULift.up
  have hp : MeasurePreserving (ULift.up : Ω → Ωc) Q Qc := ⟨hup,rfl⟩
  have hsQc : SigmaFinite Qc := by
    refine ⟨⟨⟨(fun n => ULift.down ⁻¹' spanningSets (Q.trim hm) n),
      (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _), ?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · intro n
      have hset : MeasurableSet (ULift.down ⁻¹' spanningSets (Q.trim hm) n) :=
        hdown (measurableSet_spanningSets (Q.trim hm) n)
      rw [show Qc = Q.map ULift.up from rfl, Measure.map_apply hup hset]
      change Q (spanningSets (Q.trim hm) n) < ∞
      exact measure_spanningSets_trim_lt_top hm Q n
    · ext x
      simpa only [mem_iUnion, mem_preimage, mem_univ, iff_true] using
        Set.mem_iUnion.mp (show x.down ∈ ⋃ n, spanningSets (Q.trim hm) n by rw [iUnion_spanningSets]; trivial)
  letI := hsQc
  letI : IsSeparable Qc := isSeparable_of_sigmaFinite Qc
  let fc : T → Ωc → R := fun t ω => f t ω.down
  have hfc : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry fc) :=
    (hfm.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk (hdown.comp measurable_snd))).stronglyMeasurable
  let U := ProductLpSections.sectionLp Qc fc
  let L := lpPullbackCLM (E := R) hp
  have hU : StronglyMeasurable U := ProductLpSections.sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable_of_isSeparable Qc fc hfc
  have he (t : T) : L (U t) = ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q f t := by
    have hmem : MemLp (fc t) 2 Qc ↔ MemLp (f t) 2 Q := by
      change eLpNorm (fc t) 2 Qc < ∞ ↔ eLpNorm (f t) 2 Q < ∞
      rw [← eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving hfc.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable hp]
      rfl
    by_cases ht : MemLp (f t) 2 Q
    · have hct := hmem.mpr ht
      apply Lp.ext
      filter_upwards [lpPullback_coe hp (U t),
        hp.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae Qc fc hct),
        ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae Q f ht] with ω hL hc hf
      exact (hL.trans hc).trans hf.symm
    · have hct := mt hmem.mp ht
      simp only [U, ProductLpSections.sectionLp, dite_eq_right ht, dite_eq_right hct, map_zero]
  have heq : (fun t => L (U t)) = ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q f := funext he
  rw [← heq]
  exact L.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable hU

ae_memLp.exact_header:
theorem ae_memLp (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, MemLp (f t) 2 Q
ae_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem ae_memLp (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, MemLp (f t) 2 Q := by
  filter_upwards [h2.prod_right_ae] with t ht
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (hf.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable (μ := Q))).mpr ht

sectionLp_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem sectionLp_norm_sq (f : T → Ω → R) {t : T} (ht : MemLp (f t) 2 Q) :
    ‖sectionLp Q f t‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖f t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
sectionLp_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem sectionLp_norm_sq (f : T → Ω → R) {t : T} (ht : MemLp (f t) 2 Q) :
    ‖sectionLp Q f t‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ω, ‖f t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
  exact integral_congr_ae ((sectionLp_ae Q f ht).fun_comp (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))

sectionLp_memLp.exact_header:
theorem sectionLp_memLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : T → Ω → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    MemLp (sectionLp Q f) 2 μ
sectionLp_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem sectionLp_memLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : T → Ω → R) (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    MemLp (sectionLp Q f) 2 μ := by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (sectionLp_stronglyMeasurable Q f hf).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  have hi : Integrable (fun t => ∫ ω, ‖f t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) μ := h2.integral_prod_left
  apply hi.congr
  filter_upwards [ae_memLp μ Q f hf h2] with t ht
  exact (sectionLp_norm_sq Q f ht).symm

integral_sectionLp_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem integral_sectionLp_norm_sq (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    (∫ t, ‖sectionLp Q f t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∫ p : T × Ω, ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod Q)
integral_sectionLp_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_sectionLp_norm_sq (f : T → Ω → R)
    (hf : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry f))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    (∫ t, ‖sectionLp Q f t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∫ p : T × Ω, ‖f p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod Q) := by
  rw [integral_prod _ h2]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_memLp μ Q f hf h2] with t ht
  exact sectionLp_norm_sq Q f ht

curryLp.exact_header:
def curryLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) : Lp (Lp R 2 Q) 2 μ
curryLp.exact_declaration:
def curryLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) : Lp (Lp R 2 Q) 2 μ :=
  (sectionLp_memLp μ Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) (Lp.stronglyMeasurable F)
    ((Lp.memLp F).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))).toLp _

curryLp_section.exact_header:
theorem curryLp_section [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, curryLp μ Q F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => F (t, ω))
curryLp_section.exact_declaration:
theorem curryLp_section [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, curryLp μ Q F t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => F (t, ω)) := by
  have hm := sectionLp_memLp μ Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) (Lp.stronglyMeasurable F)
    ((Lp.memLp F).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))
  filter_upwards [hm.coeFn_toLp,
    ae_memLp μ Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) (Lp.stronglyMeasurable F)
      ((Lp.memLp F).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))] with t ht hft
  change curryLp μ Q F t = sectionLp Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) t at ht
  rw [ht]
  exact sectionLp_ae Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) hft

curryLp_norm.exact_header:
theorem curryLp_norm [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) : ‖curryLp μ Q F‖ = ‖F‖
curryLp_norm.exact_declaration:
theorem curryLp_norm [SeparableSpace R]
    (F : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) : ‖curryLp μ Q F‖ = ‖F‖ := by
  have hsq : ‖curryLp μ Q F‖ ^ 2 = ‖F‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral,
      ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral]
    have hm := sectionLp_memLp μ Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) (Lp.stronglyMeasurable F)
      ((Lp.memLp F).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))
    calc
      _ = ∫ t, ‖sectionLp Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω)) t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        exact integral_congr_ae (hm.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))
      _ = _ := integral_sectionLp_norm_sq μ Q (fun t ω => F (t, ω))
        (Lp.stronglyMeasurable F)
        ((Lp.memLp F).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (curryLp μ Q F), norm_nonneg F]

curryLp_sub.exact_header:
theorem curryLp_sub [SeparableSpace R]
    (F G : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) :
    curryLp μ Q (F - G) = curryLp μ Q F - curryLp μ Q G
curryLp_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem curryLp_sub [SeparableSpace R]
    (F G : Lp R 2 (μ.prod Q)) :
    curryLp μ Q (F - G) = curryLp μ Q F - curryLp μ Q G := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hp := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (Lp.coeFn_sub F G)
  filter_upwards [curryLp_section μ Q (F - G), curryLp_section μ Q F,
    curryLp_section μ Q G, hp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (curryLp μ Q F) (curryLp μ Q G)] with t hfg hf hg hp ht
  rw [ht]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hfg, hf, hg, hp,
    Lp.coeFn_sub (curryLp μ Q F t) (curryLp μ Q G t)] with ω hfg hf hg hp hs
  change curryLp μ Q (F - G) t ω = (curryLp μ Q F t - curryLp μ Q G t) ω
  rw [hs, Pi.sub_apply, hfg, hf, hg, hp]
  rfl

curryLp_isometry.exact_header:
theorem curryLp_isometry [SeparableSpace R] :
    Isometry (curryLp (R := R) μ Q)
curryLp_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem curryLp_isometry [SeparableSpace R] :
    Isometry (curryLp (R := R) μ Q) := by
  apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro F G
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← curryLp_sub, curryLp_norm]

sectionLp_adapted.exact_header:
theorem sectionLp_adapted (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (f : T → Ω → R) (t : T)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (f t) Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (fun ω => sectionLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q f t ω) Q
sectionLp_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem sectionLp_adapted (m : MeasurableSpace Ω) (f : T → Ω → R) (t : T)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (f t) Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[m] (fun ω => sectionLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q f t ω) Q := by
  classical
  by_cases ht : MemLp (f t) 2 Q
  · exact hf.congr (sectionLp_ae (mΩ := mΩ) Q f ht).symm
  · have he : sectionLp (mΩ := mΩ) Q f t = 0 := by simp [sectionLp, ht]
    rw [he]
    exact aestronglyMeasurable_zero.congr (Lp.coeFn_zero (E := R) (p := 2) (μ := Q)).symm

columnSections.exact_header:
def columnSections (f : I → T → Ω → R) (t : T) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Lp R 2 Q)

columnSections_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem columnSections_apply (f : I → T → Ω → R) (t : T) (i : I) :
    (columnSections Q f t).ofLp i = sectionLp Q (f i) t
columnSections_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem columnSections_apply (f : I → T → Ω → R) (t : T) (i : I) :
    (columnSections Q f t).ofLp i = sectionLp Q (f i) t := rfl

columnSections_memLp.exact_header:
theorem columnSections_memLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    MemLp (columnSections Q f) 2 μ
columnSections_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem columnSections_memLp [SeparableSpace R]
    (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    MemLp (columnSections Q f) 2 μ := by
  apply memLp_piLp_iff.mpr
  intro i
  exact sectionLp_memLp μ Q (f i) (hf i) (h2 i)

columnSections_ae.exact_header:
theorem columnSections_ae (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ∀ i, (columnSections Q f t).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] f i t
columnSections_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem columnSections_ae (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ∀ i, (columnSections Q f t).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] f i t := by
  have hall : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ∀ i, MemLp (f i t) 2 Q :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_memLp μ Q (f i) (hf i) (h2 i))
  filter_upwards [hall] with t ht
  intro i
  exact sectionLp_ae Q (f i) (ht i)

integral_columnSections_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem integral_columnSections_norm_sq (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    (∫ t, ‖columnSections Q f t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ p : T × Ω, ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod Q)
integral_columnSections_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_columnSections_norm_sq (f : I → T → Ω → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (f i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : T × Ω => ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) (μ.prod Q)) :
    (∫ t, ‖columnSections Q f t‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ p : T × Ω, ‖f i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod Q) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => integral_sectionLp_norm_sq μ Q (f i) (hf i) (h2 i))
  · intro i _
    have hi := (h2 i).integral_prod_left
    apply hi.congr
    filter_upwards [ae_memLp μ Q (f i) (hf i) (h2 i)] with t ht
    exact (sectionLp_norm_sq Q (f i) ht).symm

Joint.exact_declaration: abbrev Joint (S Z : Type*) := WithLp 2 (S × Z)

embed.exact_header: def embed (s : S) (z : Z) : Joint S Z
embed.exact_declaration: def embed (s : S) (z : Z) : Joint S Z := WithLp.toLp 2 (s, z)

embed_measurable.exact_header: @[fun_prop] theorem embed_measurable (s : S) : Measurable (embed (Z := Z) s)
embed_measurable.exact_declaration:
@[fun_prop] theorem embed_measurable (s : S) : Measurable (embed (Z := Z) s) :=
  (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 (S × Z)).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)

embed_lipschitz.exact_header: theorem embed_lipschitz (s : S) : LipschitzWith 1 (embed (Z := Z) s)
embed_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem embed_lipschitz (s : S) : LipschitzWith 1 (embed (Z := Z) s) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro z w
  change dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (s, z)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (s, w)) ≤ _
  simp only [dist_eq_norm, ← WithLp.toLp_sub, Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self]
  rw [WithLp.norm_toLp_snd]
  simp [dist_eq_norm]

law.exact_header: def law (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) : Measure (Joint S Z)
law.exact_declaration: def law (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) : Measure (Joint S Z) := ν.map (embed s)

law_eq_dirac_prod.exact_header:
theorem law_eq_dirac_prod (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) [SFinite ν] :
    law s ν = ((Measure.dirac s).prod ν).map (WithLp.toLp 2)
law_eq_dirac_prod.exact_declaration:
theorem law_eq_dirac_prod (s : S) (ν : Measure Z) [SFinite ν] :
    law s ν = ((Measure.dirac s).prod ν).map (WithLp.toLp 2) := by

liftCoupling.exact_header:

liftCoupling.exact_declaration:
def liftCoupling (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} (c : ULA.Coupling ν ν') :
    ULA.Coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν') where
  joint := c.joint.map (fun p => (embed s p.1, embed s' p.2))
  fst := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (f := fun p : Z × Z => (embed s p.1, embed s' p.2))
      measurable_fst (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (embed s ∘ Prod.fst) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (embed_measurable s) measurable_fst, c.fst]
    rfl
  snd := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (f := fun p : Z × Z => (embed s p.1, embed s' p.2))
      measurable_snd (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (embed s' ∘ Prod.snd) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (embed_measurable s') measurable_snd, c.snd]
    rfl

    (c : ULA.Coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν')) : ULA.Coupling ν ν'
projectCoupling.exact_declaration:
def projectCoupling (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z}
    (c : ULA.Coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν')) : ULA.Coupling ν ν' where
  joint := c.joint.map (fun p => (p.1.snd, p.2.snd))
  fst := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (f := fun p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z => (p.1.snd, p.2.snd))
      measurable_fst (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (WithLp.snd ∘ Prod.fst) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable measurable_fst, c.fst]
    exact law_sampler_marginal s ν
  snd := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (f := fun p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z => (p.1.snd, p.2.snd))
      measurable_snd (by fun_prop)]
    change c.joint.map (WithLp.snd ∘ Prod.snd) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_map (WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable measurable_snd, c.snd]
    exact law_sampler_marginal s' ν'

coupling_cost_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem coupling_cost_decomposition (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (c : ULA.Coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν')) :
    (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2 = ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 +
      (ULA.couplingCost (projectCoupling s s' c).joint).toReal ^ 2
coupling_cost_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem coupling_cost_decomposition (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (c : ULA.Coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν')) :
    (ULA.couplingCost c.joint).toReal ^ 2 = ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 +
      (ULA.couplingCost (projectCoupling s s' c).joint).toReal ^ 2 := by
  letI := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hm := coupling_difference_memLp (law s ν) (law s' ν')
    (law_second_moment s ν hν) (law_second_moment s' ν' hν') c
  have hp := coupling_difference_memLp ν ν' hν hν' (projectCoupling s s' c)
  rw [couplingCost_sq_eq_integral c.joint hm,
    couplingCost_sq_eq_integral (projectCoupling s s' c).joint hp]
  have hleft : ∀ᵐ p ∂c.joint, p.1.fst = s := by
    have hi := law_optimizer_ae s ν
    rw [← c.fst] at hi
    exact (ae_map_iff measurable_fst.aemeasurable
      ((isClosed_eq (WithLp.continuous_fst 2 S Z) continuous_const).measurableSet)).mp hi
  have hright : ∀ᵐ p ∂c.joint, p.2.fst = s' := by
    have hi := law_optimizer_ae s' ν'
    rw [← c.snd] at hi
    exact (ae_map_iff measurable_snd.aemeasurable
      ((isClosed_eq (WithLp.continuous_fst 2 S Z) continuous_const).measurableSet)).mp hi
  have hmap := integral_map
    (((WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk
      ((WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable.comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : Z × Z => ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((projectCoupling s s' c).joint) from hp.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.pow 2)
  change (∫ p, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂c.joint) =
    ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ∫ p, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(projectCoupling s s' c).joint
  change (∫ p : Z × Z, ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 ∂(projectCoupling s s' c).joint) =
    ∫ p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z, ‖p.1.snd - p.2.snd‖ ^ 2 ∂c.joint at hmap
  rw [hmap]
  have hi : Integrable (fun p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z => ‖p.1.snd - p.2.snd‖ ^ 2) c.joint :=
    ((hp.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).comp_measurable
      (((WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk
        ((WithLp.continuous_snd 2 S Z).measurable.comp measurable_snd)))
  have hsum : (∫ p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z,
      ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ‖p.1.snd - p.2.snd‖ ^ 2 ∂c.joint) =
      ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ∫ p : Joint S Z × Joint S Z, ‖p.1.snd - p.2.snd‖ ^ 2 ∂c.joint := by
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hi]
    simp
  rw [← hsum]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hleft, hright] with p hs hs'
  rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  simp only [WithLp.sub_fst, WithLp.sub_snd, hs, hs']

theorem project_lift_joint (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} (c : ULA.Coupling ν ν') :

theorem project_lift_joint (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} (c : ULA.Coupling ν ν') :
    (projectCoupling s s' (liftCoupling s s' c)).joint = c.joint := by
  change (c.joint.map (fun p => (embed s p.1, embed s' p.2))).map
    (fun p => (p.1.snd, p.2.snd)) = c.joint
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]

theorem lifted_cost_decomposition (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)

lifted_cost_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem lifted_cost_decomposition (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']

wasserstein_product_eq.exact_header:
theorem wasserstein_product_eq (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν') :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (law s ν) (law s' ν') =
      Real.sqrt (‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' ^ 2)
wasserstein_product_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem wasserstein_product_eq (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν') :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (law s ν) (law s' ν') =
      Real.sqrt (‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' ^ 2) := by
  have hFull := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp (law s ν) (law s' ν')
    (law_second_moment s ν hν) (law_second_moment s' ν' hν')
  have hSam := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp ν ν' hν hν'
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings ν ν' hSam
      (fun x => Real.sqrt (‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + x ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
    intro c _
    have hc := (coupling_difference_memLp (law s ν) (law s' ν')
      (law_second_moment s ν hν) (law_second_moment s' ν' hν')
      (liftCoupling s s' c)).eLpNorm_ne_top
    apply (wasserstein_le_finite_coupling (law s ν) (law s' ν')
      (liftCoupling s s' c) hc).trans_eq
    rw [← lifted_cost_decomposition s s' ν ν' hν hν' c,
      Real.sqrt_sq ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
  · apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings (law s ν) (law s' ν') hFull
      (fun x => x) continuousAt_id
    intro c _
    have hp := (coupling_difference_memLp ν ν' hν hν' (projectCoupling s s' c)).eLpNorm_ne_top
    have hw := wasserstein_le_finite_coupling ν ν' (projectCoupling s s' c) hp
    have hs : ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' ^ 2 ≤
        (ULA.couplingCost (projectCoupling s s' c).joint).toReal ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mpr hw
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), coupling_cost_decomposition s s' ν ν' hν hν' c]
    linarith

weak_product_law_contraction.exact_header:
theorem weak_product_law_contraction
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν 0)] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν' 0)]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν 0))
    (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' 0))
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) (ν' 0),
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests s s' ν ν' Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (ProductTransport.law (s t) (ν t))
      (ProductTransport.law (s' t) (ν' t)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        ULA.wasserstein2Real (ProductTransport.law (s 0) (ν 0))
          (ProductTransport.law (s' 0) (ν' 0))
weak_product_law_contraction.exact_declaration:
theorem weak_product_law_contraction
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν 0)] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ν' 0)]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν 0))
    (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' 0))
    (hquad : couplingQuadratic D ∈ pairTests)
    (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) (ν' 0),
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        IsCoupledWeakSolution M tests pairTests s s' ν ν' Λ ∧ Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ULA.wasserstein2Real (ProductTransport.law (s t) (ν t))
      (ProductTransport.law (s' t) (ν' t)) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        ULA.wasserstein2Real (ProductTransport.law (s 0) (ν 0))
          (ProductTransport.law (s' 0) (ν' 0)) := by
  have hfinite := ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp (ν 0) (ν' 0) hν hν'
  obtain ⟨c, _⟩ := ULA.exists_finiteCost_coupling (ν 0) (ν' 0) hfinite
  obtain ⟨Λ, hsol, _⟩ := realize c
  letI := hsol.left.probability t ht.1
  letI := hsol.right.probability t ht.1
  have hνt : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.left.second_moment t ht.1)
  have hνt' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.right.second_moment t ht.1)
  rw [ProductTransport.wasserstein_product_eq _ _ _ _ hνt hνt',
    ProductTransport.wasserstein_product_eq _ _ _ _ hν hν']
  exact weak_law_contraction M D tests pairTests s s' ν ν' hν hν' hquad ρ T hmono realize t ht

theorem meanGradient_difference_of_coupling (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} {Λ : Measure (Z × Z)}
    (hΛ : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hf : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν') :
    M.meanGradient ν s - M.meanGradient ν' s' =
      ∫ zz, M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position zz.1) -
        M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position zz.2) ∂Λ
meanGradient_difference_of_coupling.exact_declaration:
theorem meanGradient_difference_of_coupling (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} {Λ : Measure (Z × Z)}
    (hΛ : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hf : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν') :
    M.meanGradient ν s - M.meanGradient ν' s' =
      ∫ zz, M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position zz.1) -
        M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position zz.2) ∂Λ := by
  have hfm : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))
      (Λ.map Prod.fst) := hΛ.1.symm ▸ hf
  have hgm : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z))
      (Λ.map Prod.snd) := hΛ.2.symm ▸ hg
  have hfΛ := hfm.comp_measurable measurable_fst
  have hgΛ := hgm.comp_measurable measurable_snd
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at hfΛ hgΛ
  rw [integral_sub hfΛ hgΛ]
  rw [← integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hfm.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hgm.aestronglyMeasurable,
    hΛ.1, hΛ.2]
  rfl

projected_monotonicity_integral.exact_header:
theorem projected_monotonicity_integral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M) (r : ℝ)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} {Λ : Measure (Z × Z)}
    (hΛ : IsCoupling Λ ν ν') [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hf : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν')
    (hInt : C.Integrability s s' Λ) :
    r * C.radius s s' Λ ≤
      C.optimizerProjectedWork s s' ν ν' + ∫ zz, C.scoreWork s s' zz ∂Λ
projected_monotonicity_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_monotonicity_integral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M) (r : ℝ)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (s s' : S) {ν ν' : Measure Z} {Λ : Measure (Z × Z)}
    (hΛ : IsCoupling Λ ν ν') [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hf : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν')
    (hInt : C.Integrability s s' Λ) :
    r * C.radius s s' Λ ≤
      C.optimizerProjectedWork s s' ν ν' + ∫ zz, C.scoreWork s s' zz ∂Λ := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Λ.map Prod.fst) := hΛ.1.symm ▸ inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Λ :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff measurable_fst.aemeasurable).mp inferInstance
  have hfΛ : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z =>
      M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position zz.1)) Λ :=
    (hΛ.1.symm ▸ hf).comp_measurable measurable_fst
  have hgΛ : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z =>
      M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position zz.2)) Λ :=
    (hΛ.2.symm ▸ hg).comp_measurable measurable_snd
  have hobs := hfΛ.sub hgΛ
  have hw : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z =>
      ⟪C.parameterProjection (s - s'),
        M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position zz.1) -
          M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position zz.2)⟫_ℝ) Λ :=
    hobs.const_inner (C.parameterProjection (s - s'))
  have heq : C.optimizerProjectedWork s s' ν ν' =
      ∫ zz, ⟪C.parameterProjection (s - s'),
        M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position zz.1) -
          M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position zz.2)⟫_ℝ ∂Λ := by
    unfold ProjectedData.optimizerProjectedWork
    rw [meanGradient_difference_of_coupling M s s' hΛ hf hg]
    exact (integral_inner hobs _).symm
  rw [heq, ← integral_add hw hInt.score_work]
  have hleft : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z =>
      r * (‖C.parameterProjection (s - s')‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2)) Λ :=
    ((integrable_const _).add hInt.position_sq).const_mul r
  have hbound := integral_mono hleft (hw.add hInt.score_work) (fun zz => ?_)
  · simpa only [Pi.add_apply, integral_const_mul, integral_add (integrable_const _) hInt.position_sq,
      integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul, ProjectedData.radius] using hbound
  · simpa only [Pi.add_apply, ProjectedData.scoreWork, C.parameter_eq, C.position_eq, map_sub] using
      hmono (C.parameterProjection s) (C.parameterProjection s')
        (C.positionProjection zz.1) (C.positionProjection zz.2)

ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling.exact_header:
structure ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) : Prop
ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling.exact_declaration:
structure ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) : Prop where
  coupling : IsCoupling Λ ν ν'
  left_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure ν
  right_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure ν'
  left_moment : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν
  right_moment : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν'
  left_observation : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) ν
  right_observation : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) ν'
  sampler_work : Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') Λ
  sampler_sq : Integrable (fun zz => D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ

samplerDriftWork.exact_header:
def samplerDriftWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ
samplerDriftWork.exact_declaration:
def samplerDriftWork (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ :=
  ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
    (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ

ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation.exact_header:
structure ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β AOpt ASam : ℝ) : Prop
ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation.exact_declaration:
structure ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β AOpt ASam : ℝ) : Prop where
  optimizer : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
    ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')⟫_ℝ ≤
      -β * C.optimizerProjectedWork s s' ν ν' - C.optimizerAuxSq (s - s') +
        AOpt * C.radius s s' Λ
  sampler : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
    ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
    (∫ zz, samplerDriftWork M D s s' zz ∂Λ) ≤
      -β * (∫ zz, C.scoreWork s s' zz ∂Λ) -
        (∫ zz, C.samplerAuxSq zz ∂Λ) + ASam * C.radius s s' Λ

samplerCouplingWork_eq_drift_of_constant.exact_header:
theorem samplerCouplingWork_eq_drift_of_constant (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (σ : I → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ) (s s' : S) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' = samplerDriftWork M D s s'
samplerCouplingWork_eq_drift_of_constant.exact_declaration:
theorem samplerCouplingWork_eq_drift_of_constant (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (σ : I → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ) (s s' : S) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' = samplerDriftWork M D s s' := by
  funext zz
  simp [samplerCouplingWork, samplerDriftWork, hσ, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]

projected_metric_integral.exact_header:
theorem projected_metric_integral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c ρ : ℝ)
    (hOpt : ∀ d, ρ * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      c * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSam : ∀ zz : Z × Z, ρ * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      c * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 + C.samplerAuxSq zz)
    (s s' : S) (Λ : Measure (Z × Z))
    (hInt : C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hSq : Integrable (fun zz => D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    ρ * (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + ∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) ≤
      c * C.radius s s' Λ + C.optimizerAuxSq (s - s') +
        ∫ zz, C.samplerAuxSq zz ∂Λ
projected_metric_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_metric_integral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c ρ : ℝ)
    (hOpt : ∀ d, ρ * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      c * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSam : ∀ zz : Z × Z, ρ * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      c * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 + C.samplerAuxSq zz)
    (s s' : S) (Λ : Measure (Z × Z))
    (hInt : C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hSq : Integrable (fun zz => D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    ρ * (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + ∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) ≤
      c * C.radius s s' Λ + C.optimizerAuxSq (s - s') +
        ∫ zz, C.samplerAuxSq zz ∂Λ := by
  have hi := integral_mono (hSq.const_mul ρ)
    ((hInt.position_sq.const_mul c).add hInt.auxiliary_sq) hSam
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (hInt.position_sq.const_mul c) hInt.auxiliary_sq,
    integral_const_mul] at hi
  dsimp [ProjectedData.radius]
  linarith [hOpt (s - s')]

projected_twistedJointMonotonicity.exact_header:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam ρ : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hOpt : ∀ d, ρ * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSam : ∀ zz : Z × Z, ρ * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 +
        C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ
projected_twistedJointMonotonicity.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam ρ : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hOpt : ∀ d, ρ * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSam : ∀ zz : Z × Z, ρ * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      (β * r - AOpt - ASam) * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 +
        C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ := by
  intro t ht s s' ν ν' Λ hΛ hν hν' hν2 hν2' hf hg hw hs
  let ha : ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ :=
    ⟨hΛ, hν, hν', hν2, hν2', hf, hg, hw, hs⟩
  letI := hν
  have hmono' := projected_monotonicity_integral M C r hmono s s' hΛ hf hg
    (hInt s s' ν ν' Λ ha)
  have hmetric := projected_metric_integral M D C (β * r - AOpt - ASam) ρ
    hOpt hSam s s' Λ (hInt s s' ν ν' Λ ha) hs
  rw [samplerCouplingWork_eq_drift_of_constant M D σ hσ]
  exact projected_dissipation
    (C.optimizerProjectedWork s s' ν ν') (∫ zz, C.scoreWork s s' zz ∂Λ)
    _ _ (C.radius s s' Λ) (C.optimizerAuxSq (s - s'))
    (∫ zz, C.samplerAuxSq zz ∂Λ) β r AOpt ASam ρ _ hβ hmono'
    (haux.optimizer t ht s s' ν ν' Λ ha) (haux.sampler s s' ν ν' Λ ha) hmetric

projectedCertifiedRate.exact_header: def projectedCertifiedRate (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (c mLower vLower : ℝ) : ℝ
projectedCertifiedRate.exact_declaration:
def projectedCertifiedRate (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (c mLower vLower : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min c (min mLower vLower) / D.upper

projectedCertifiedRate_pos.exact_header:
theorem projectedCertifiedRate_pos (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (c mLower vLower : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower) :
    0 < projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower
projectedCertifiedRate_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem projectedCertifiedRate_pos (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (c mLower vLower : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower) :
    0 < projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower := by
  exact div_pos (lt_min hc (lt_min hm hv)) (D.lower_pos.trans_le D.lower_le_upper)

projected_optimizer_metric_certified.exact_header:
theorem projected_optimizer_metric_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c mLower vLower : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hsplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hlower : ∀ d, mLower * ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2 ≤ C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (d : S) :
    projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      c * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d
projected_optimizer_metric_certified.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_optimizer_metric_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c mLower vLower : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hsplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hlower : ∀ d, mLower * ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2 ≤ C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (d : S) :
    projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.optimizerSq d ≤
      c * ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + C.optimizerAuxSq d := by
  let k := min c (min mLower vLower)
  have hρ := projectedCertifiedRate_pos D c mLower vLower hc hm hv
  have hcomp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.optimizer_upper d) hρ.le
  have hcancel : projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.upper = k :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (D.lower_pos.trans_le D.lower_le_upper))
  rw [← mul_assoc, hcancel, hsplit d] at hcomp
  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left c (min mLower vLower))
    (sq_nonneg ‖C.parameterProjection d‖)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    ((min_le_right c (min mLower vLower)).trans (min_le_left mLower vLower))
    (sq_nonneg ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖)
  change projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.optimizerSq d ≤ _
  dsimp [TwistedGeometry.optimizerSq] at *
  linarith [hlower d]

projected_sampler_metric_certified.exact_header:
theorem projected_sampler_metric_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c mLower vLower : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hsplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.positionProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.samplerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hlower : ∀ zz, vLower * ‖C.samplerAuxiliary (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C.samplerAuxSq zz) (zz : Z × Z) :
    projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      c * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 + C.samplerAuxSq zz
projected_sampler_metric_certified.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_sampler_metric_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (c mLower vLower : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hsplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.positionProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.samplerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hlower : ∀ zz, vLower * ‖C.samplerAuxiliary (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C.samplerAuxSq zz) (zz : Z × Z) :
    projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ≤
      c * ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 + C.samplerAuxSq zz := by
  let k := min c (min mLower vLower)
  have hρ := projectedCertifiedRate_pos D c mLower vLower hc hm hv
  have hcomp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.sampler_upper (zz.1 - zz.2)) hρ.le
  have hcancel : projectedCertifiedRate D c mLower vLower * D.upper = k :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (D.lower_pos.trans_le D.lower_le_upper))
  rw [← mul_assoc, hcancel, hsplit (zz.1 - zz.2)] at hcomp
  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left c (min mLower vLower))
    (sq_nonneg ‖C.positionProjection (zz.1 - zz.2)‖)
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    ((min_le_right c (min mLower vLower)).trans (min_le_right mLower vLower))
    (sq_nonneg ‖C.samplerAuxiliary (zz.1 - zz.2)‖)
  dsimp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq] at *
  linarith [hlower zz]

projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_certi.exact_header:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam mLower vLower : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hOptSplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hSamSplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.positionProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.samplerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hOptLower : ∀ d, mLower * ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2 ≤ C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSamLower : ∀ zz, vLower * ‖C.samplerAuxiliary (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    let ρ := projectedCertifiedRate D (β * r - AOpt - ASam) mLower vLower
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ
projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_certi.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_twistedJointMonotonicity_certified (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (C : ProjectedData (U := U) (V := V) M)
    (β r AOpt ASam mLower vLower : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam) (hm : 0 < mLower) (hv : 0 < vLower)
    (hmono : C.StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M D C β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → Z) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ, ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M D s s' ν ν' Λ →
      C.Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hOptSplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.parameterProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hSamSplit : ∀ d, ‖d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖C.positionProjection d‖ ^ 2 + ‖C.samplerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2)
    (hOptLower : ∀ d, mLower * ‖C.optimizerAuxiliary d‖ ^ 2 ≤ C.optimizerAuxSq d)
    (hSamLower : ∀ zz, vLower * ‖C.samplerAuxiliary (zz.1 - zz.2)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C.samplerAuxSq zz) :
    let ρ := projectedCertifiedRate D (β * r - AOpt - ASam) mLower vLower
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ := by
  dsimp
  refine ⟨projectedCertifiedRate_pos D _ _ _ hc hm hv, ?_⟩
  apply projected_twistedJointMonotonicity M D C β r AOpt ASam _ hβ hmono haux σ hσ hInt
  · exact projected_optimizer_metric_certified M D C _ _ _ hc hm hv hOptSplit hOptLower
  · exact projected_sampler_metric_certified M D C _ _ _ hc hm hv hSamSplit hSamLower

PBGSO/ProjectedFiniteWork.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.CanonicalProjectedCriterion
import PBGSO.DiracOptimizerGrowth

/-! # The projected source criterion with its explicit finite signed domain
The source U5 sampler inequality contains a signed drift-work integral for
every P2 coupling. Reading those integrals as finite is stated independently
of the inequality. Constant diffusion turns this domain directly into the
universal finite-work convention needed by the constant-noise law theorem.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open Matrix MeasureTheory

/-- Explicit ordinary finite signed-integral domain of the universal U5

canonical_projected_source_criterion_fin.exact_header:
theorem canonical_projected_source_criterion_finite
    (M : Model (BlockSpace a u) (EuclideanSpace ℝ a) (BlockSpace x v) (EuclideanSpace ℝ x) I)
    (hparameter : M.parameter = WithLp.fst) (hposition : M.position = WithLp.fst)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ a → EuclideanSpace ℝ x → EuclideanSpace ℝ x)
    (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ) (DSam : Matrix (x ⊕ v) (x ⊕ v) ℝ)
    (Dm : Matrix u u ℝ) (Dv : Matrix v v ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hDm : Dm.PosDef) (hDv : Dv.PosDef)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam)
    (hmono : (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv) β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → BlockSpace x v) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
      ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) s s' ν ν' Λ →
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hfinite : FiniteSamplerDriftDomain M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)) :
    let ρ := min
      (generalizedMinimum hDOpt (blockK_posDef (a := a) _ hc Dm hDm))
      (generalizedMinimum hDSam (blockK_posDef (a := x) _ hc Dv hDv))
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) ρ ∧
      DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)

theorem canonical_projected_source_criterion_finite
    (M : Model (BlockSpace a u) (EuclideanSpace ℝ a) (BlockSpace x v) (EuclideanSpace ℝ x) I)
    (hparameter : M.parameter = WithLp.fst) (hposition : M.position = WithLp.fst)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℝ a → EuclideanSpace ℝ x → EuclideanSpace ℝ x)
    (DOpt : Matrix (a ⊕ u) (a ⊕ u) ℝ) (DSam : Matrix (x ⊕ v) (x ⊕ v) ℝ)
    (Dm : Matrix u u ℝ) (Dv : Matrix v v ℝ)
    (hDOpt : DOpt.PosDef) (hDSam : DSam.PosDef) (hDm : Dm.PosDef) (hDv : Dv.PosDef)
    (β r AOpt ASam : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hc : 0 < β * r - AOpt - ASam)
    (hmono : (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).StrongMonotonicity r)
    (haux : ProjectedAuxiliaryDissipation M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv) β AOpt ASam)
    (σ : I → BlockSpace x v) (hσ : ∀ θ z, M.diffusion θ z = σ)
    (hInt : ∀ s s' ν ν' Λ,
      ProjectedAdmissibleCoupling M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) s s' ν ν' Λ →
      (canonicalData M hparameter hposition H Dm Dv).Integrability s s' Λ)
    (hfinite : FiniteSamplerDriftDomain M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam)) :
    let ρ := min
      (generalizedMinimum hDOpt (blockK_posDef (a := a) _ hc Dm hDm))
      (generalizedMinimum hDSam (blockK_posDef (a := x) _ hc Dv hDv))
    0 < ρ ∧ TwistedJointMonotonicity M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) ρ ∧
      DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M (canonicalGeometry DOpt DSam hDOpt hDSam) := by
  have h := canonical_projected_source_criterion M hparameter hposition H DOpt DSam Dm Dv
    hDOpt hDSam hDm hDv β r AOpt ASam hβ hc hmono haux σ hσ hInt
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2,finiteCouplingWork_of_U5_domain M _ σ hσ hfinite⟩

bilinear_increment.exact_header:
theorem bilinear_increment (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (x y : H) :
    B y y - B x x = 2 * B x (y - x) + B (y - x) (y - x)
bilinear_increment.exact_declaration:
theorem bilinear_increment (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (x y : H) :
    B y y - B x x = 2 * B x (y - x) + B (y - x) (y - x) := by
  simp only [map_sub, sub_apply]
  rw [hB y x]
  ring

quadratic_increment_forward.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_increment_forward (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (X A M : ℝ → H) (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : X s = A s + M s) (ht : X t = A t + M t)
    (ho : B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hv : B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = v t - v s) :
    B (X t) (X t) - B (X s) (X s) =
      2 * B (X s) (A t - A s) + B (A t - A s) (A t - A s) +
        2 * B (A t - A s) (M t - M s) + (v t - v s)
quadratic_increment_forward.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_increment_forward (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) (X A M : ℝ → H) (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : X s = A s + M s) (ht : X t = A t + M t)
    (ho : B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hv : B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = v t - v s) :
    B (X t) (X t) - B (X s) (X s) =
      2 * B (X s) (A t - A s) + B (A t - A s) (A t - A s) +
        2 * B (A t - A s) (M t - M s) + (v t - v s) := by
  rw [bilinear_increment B hB]
  have hdiff : X t - X s = (A t - A s) + (M t - M s) := by rw [hs, ht]; abel
  rw [hdiff]
  simp only [map_add, add_apply, ho, add_zero]
  rw [hB (M t - M s) (A t - A s), hv]
  ring

quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (X A M : ℝ → H) (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → X r = A r + M r)
    (horth : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = v t - v s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (b : H) (a : ℝ)
    (hX : ContinuousWithinAt X (Ici 0) t)
    (hM : ContinuousWithinAt M (Ici 0) t)
    (hA : HasDerivWithinAt A b (Ici 0) t)
    (hv : HasDerivWithinAt v a (Ici 0) t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => B (X r) (X r)) (2 * B (X t) b + a) (Ici 0) t
quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (X A M : ℝ → H) (v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hdecomp : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → X r = A r + M r)
    (horth : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = v t - v s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (b : H) (a : ℝ)
    (hX : ContinuousWithinAt X (Ici 0) t)
    (hM : ContinuousWithinAt M (Ici 0) t)
    (hA : HasDerivWithinAt A b (Ici 0) t)
    (hv : HasDerivWithinAt v a (Ici 0) t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => B (X r) (X r)) (2 * B (X t) b + a) (Ici 0) t := by
  let l := 𝓝[Ici 0 \ {t}] t
  have hsl : Tendsto (slope A t) l (𝓝 b) := hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hA
  have hsv : Tendsto (slope v t) l (𝓝 a) := hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hv
  have hlimX : Tendsto X l (𝓝 (X t)) := hX.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ (show Ici (0 : ℝ) \ {t} ⊆ Ici 0 from sdiff_subset))
  have hlimA : Tendsto (fun r => A r - A t) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using
      (hA.continuousWithinAt.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ (show Ici (0 : ℝ) \ {t} ⊆ Ici 0 from sdiff_subset))).sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := A t))
  have hlimM : Tendsto (fun r => M r - M t) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using
      (hM.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ (show Ici (0 : ℝ) \ {t} ⊆ Ici 0 from sdiff_subset))).sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := M t))
  have hDA : Tendsto (fun r => B (slope A t r) (A r - A t)) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Function.uncurry_def, map_zero] using
      (B.continuous₂.tendsto (b, 0)).comp (hsl.prodMk_nhds hlimA)
  have hDM : Tendsto (fun r => B (slope A t r) (M r - M t)) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Function.uncurry_def, map_zero] using
      (B.continuous₂.tendsto (b, 0)).comp (hsl.prodMk_nhds hlimM)
  have hlead : Tendsto (fun r => B (X t) (slope A t r)) l (𝓝 (B (X t) b)) :=
    ((B (X t)).continuous.tendsto b).comp hsl
  have hlead' : Tendsto (fun r => B (X r) (slope A t r)) l (𝓝 (B (X t) b)) :=
    (B.continuous₂.tendsto (X t, b)).comp (hlimX.prodMk_nhds hsl)
  let plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * B (X t) (slope A t r) +
    B (slope A t r) (A r - A t) + 2 * B (slope A t r) (M r - M t) + slope v t r
  let minus : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * B (X r) (slope A t r) -
    B (slope A t r) (A r - A t) - 2 * B (slope A t r) (M r - M t) + slope v t r
  have hp : Tendsto plus l (𝓝 (2 * B (X t) b + a)) := by
    simpa only [plus, mul_zero, add_zero] using
      (((hlead.const_mul 2).add hDA).add (hDM.const_mul 2)).add hsv
  have hm : Tendsto minus l (𝓝 (2 * B (X t) b + a)) := by
    simpa only [minus, mul_zero, sub_zero] using
      (((hlead'.const_mul 2).sub hDA).sub (hDM.const_mul 2)).add hsv
  rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope]
  have hpiece := hp.if' (p := fun r => r ∈ Ici t) hm
  apply hpiece.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := hr.1
  have hrne : r ≠ t := by simpa only [mem_singleton_iff] using hr.2
  have hden : r - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hrne
  split_ifs with htr
  · have he := quadratic_increment_forward B hB X A M v t r (hdecomp t ht)
      (hdecomp r hr0) (horth t r ht htr) (hvar t r ht htr)
    dsimp [plus]
    simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, map_smul, smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    rw [he]
    ring
  · have hrt : r ≤ t := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge htr)
    have he := quadratic_increment_forward B hB X A M v r t (hdecomp r hr0)
      (hdecomp t ht) (horth r t hr0 hrt) (hvar r t hr0 hrt)
    have ha : A t - A r = -(A r - A t) := (neg_sub _ _).symm
    have hM' : M t - M r = -(M r - M t) := (neg_sub _ _).symm
    rw [ha, hM'] at he
    simp only [map_neg, neg_apply, neg_neg] at he
    dsimp [minus]
    simp only [slope, vsub_eq_sub, map_smul, smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    have he' : B (X r) (X r) - B (X t) (X t) =
        2 * B (X r) (A r - A t) - B (A r - A t) (A r - A t) -
        2 * B (A r - A t) (M r - M t) + (v r - v t) := by linarith
    rw [he']
    ring

quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt_of_integral.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt_of_integral [CompleteSpace H]
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (X drift M : ℝ → H) (a : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hM : Continuous M) (hb : Continuous drift) (ha : Continuous a)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → X r = X 0 + (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..r, drift u) + M r)
    (horth : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = ∫ u in s..t, a u)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => B (X r) (X r))
      (2 * B (X t) (drift t) + a t) (Ici 0) t
quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt_of_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt_of_integral [CompleteSpace H]
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
    (X drift M : ℝ → H) (a : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hM : Continuous M) (hb : Continuous drift) (ha : Continuous a)
    (heq : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → X r = X 0 + (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..r, drift u) + M r)
    (horth : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → B (X s) (M t - M s) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      B (M t - M s) (M t - M s) = ∫ u in s..t, a u)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => B (X r) (X r))
      (2 * B (X t) (drift t) + a t) (Ici 0) t := by
  let A : ℝ → H := fun r => X 0 + ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..r, drift u
  let v : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..r, a u
  have hA : HasDerivAt A (drift t) t :=
    (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hb.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hb.continuousAt).const_add _
  have hv : HasDerivAt v (a t) t :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (ha.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (ha.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) ha.continuousAt
  apply quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt B hB X A M v heq horth _ t ht (drift t) (a t)
    hX.continuousWithinAt hM.continuousWithinAt hA.hasDerivWithinAt hv.hasDerivWithinAt
  intro s r hs hsr
  rw [hvar s r hs hsr]
  exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (ha.intervalIntegrable 0 r)
    (ha.intervalIntegrable 0 s)).symm

theorem martingale_condExpL2 (M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)

martingale_condExpL2.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_condExpL2 (M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] M t)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) (M t) : Lp Z 2 Q) = M s := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hCE : (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) (M t) : Ω → Z) =ᵐ[Q]
      Q[(M t) | ℱ s] := by

    ((hm.condExp_ae_eq hst).trans (hrep s)))

theorem weightedPairing_left (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W X Y = ⟪W.compLpL 2 Q X, Y⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [W.coeFn_compLpL X] with ω hω
  rw [hω]
  exact hW _ _

weightedPairing_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem weightedPairing_symmetric (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W X Y = weightedPairing Q W Y X
weightedPairing_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem weightedPairing_symmetric (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    weightedPairing Q W X Y = weightedPairing Q W Y X := by
  rw [weightedPairing_left Q W hW, weightedPairing_apply, real_inner_comm]

martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal.exact_header:
theorem martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] M t)
    (hX : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (X t) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X s) (M t - M s) = 0
martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal.exact_declaration:
theorem martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X M : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q) (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] M t)
    (hX : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (X t) Q)
    (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    weightedPairing Q W (X s) (M t - M s) = 0 := by
  have hadapt : AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ s] (W.compLpL 2 Q (X s)) Q := by
    apply (W.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hX s)).congr
    exact (W.coeFn_compLpL (X s)).symm
  have hcond : (condExpL2 Z ℝ (ℱ.le s) (M t - M s) : Lp Z 2 Q) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, Submodule.coe_sub]
    rw [martingale_condExpL2 Q ℱ M m hm hrep s t hst,
      martingale_condExpL2 Q ℱ M m hm hrep s s le_rfl, sub_self]
  have hinner := inner_condExpL2_eq_inner_fun (𝕜 := ℝ) (ℱ.le s)
    (M t - M s) (W.compLpL 2 Q (X s)) hadapt
  rw [hcond, inner_zero_left] at hinner
  rw [weightedPairing_left Q W hW, real_inner_comm, ← hinner]

martingaleResidual.exact_header: def martingaleResidual (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q
martingaleResidual.exact_declaration:
def martingaleResidual (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  X t - X 0 - ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, drift r

martingaleResidual_continuous.exact_header:
theorem martingaleResidual_continuous (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hb : Continuous drift) :
    Continuous (martingaleResidual Q X drift)
martingaleResidual_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem martingaleResidual_continuous (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hb : Continuous drift) :
    Continuous (martingaleResidual Q X drift) :=
  (hX.sub continuous_const).sub
    (intervalIntegral.differentiable_integral_of_continuous hb).continuous

martingaleResidual_decomposition.exact_header:
theorem martingaleResidual_decomposition (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ℝ) :
    X t = X 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, drift r) + martingaleResidual Q X drift t
martingaleResidual_decomposition.exact_declaration:
theorem martingaleResidual_decomposition (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ℝ) :
    X t = X 0 + (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, drift r) + martingaleResidual Q X drift t := by
  dsimp [martingaleResidual]
  abel

def diffusionEnergy {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q) (t : ℝ) : ℝ

diffusionEnergy_continuous.exact_header:
theorem diffusionEnergy_continuous {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q) (hσ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => σ t i)) :
    Continuous (diffusionEnergy Q W σ)
diffusionEnergy_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem diffusionEnergy_continuous {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q) (hσ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => σ t i)) :
    Continuous (diffusionEnergy Q W σ) := by
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  exact (weightedPairing Q W).continuous₂.comp₂ (hσ i) (hσ i)

expected_energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_header:
theorem expected_energy_hasDerivWithinAt {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hb : Continuous drift)
    (hσ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => σ t i))
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X drift t)
    (hAdapt : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (X t) Q)
    (hIsometry : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X drift t - martingaleResidual Q X drift s)
        (martingaleResidual Q X drift t - martingaleResidual Q X drift s) =
          ∫ r in s..t, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪X r ω, W (X r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
      (2 * (∫ ω, ⟪X t ω, W (drift t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
        ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪σ t i ω, W (σ t i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) (Ici 0) t
expected_energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem expected_energy_hasDerivWithinAt {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (X drift : ℝ → Lp Z 2 Q) (σ : ℝ → I → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hX : Continuous X) (hb : Continuous drift)
    (hσ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => σ t i))
    (m : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hm : Martingale m ℱ Q)
    (hrep : ∀ t, m t =ᵐ[Q] martingaleResidual Q X drift t)
    (hAdapt : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[ℱ t] (X t) Q)
    (hIsometry : ∀ s t, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      weightedPairing Q W (martingaleResidual Q X drift t - martingaleResidual Q X drift s)
        (martingaleResidual Q X drift t - martingaleResidual Q X drift s) =
          ∫ r in s..t, diffusionEnergy Q W σ r)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪X r ω, W (X r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
      (2 * (∫ ω, ⟪X t ω, W (drift t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
        ∑ i, ∫ ω, ⟪σ t i ω, W (σ t i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) (Ici 0) t := by
  have h := quadratic_hasDerivWithinAt_of_integral
    (weightedPairing Q W) (weightedPairing_symmetric Q W hW)
    X drift (martingaleResidual Q X drift) (diffusionEnergy Q W σ)
    hX (martingaleResidual_continuous Q X drift hX hb) hb
    (diffusionEnergy_continuous Q W σ hσ)
    (fun r _ => martingaleResidual_decomposition Q X drift r)
    (fun s r _ hsr => martingale_weighted_increment_orthogonal Q ℱ W hW X
      (martingaleResidual Q X drift) m hm hrep hAdapt s r hsr)
    hIsometry t ht
  simpa only [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral, diffusionEnergy] using h

/-! # Expected energy from original raw finite-variation equations
The actual raw equation, an actual L² martingale and a pathwise variation cap
construct all auxiliary L² primitives and the square-integrable path radius.
No time-L¹(L²) drift or maximal-moment conclusion is a premise.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped Topology NNReal ENNReal RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.RandomVariationEnergy
open QuadraticMartingale RandomVariationRealization
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (F : Filtration ℝ mΩ)
  (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
include hW

energy. The finite path variation cap is the one provided by actual stopping;
the path radius and primitive L² variables are constructed within the proof. -/

quadratic_balance.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (x t) Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q)
    (hbx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      (∫ ω, ⟪m T ω, W (m T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
quadratic_balance.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (x t) Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q)
    (hbx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      (∫ ω, ⟪m T ω, W (m T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  let X (t : ℝ) := (h2x t).toLp (x t)
  let N (t : ℝ) := (h2m t).toLp (m t)
  have hVpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω := hpaths.mono (fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  let V := primitiveLp Q T b hbx B hB hVpaths
  have hX (t : ℝ) : x t =ᵐ[Q] X t := (h2x t).coeFn_toLp.symm
  have hN (t : ℝ) : m t =ᵐ[Q] N t := (h2m t).coeFn_toLp.symm
  have hV (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t :=
    (primitiveLp_ae Q T b hbx B hB hVpaths t ht).symm
  have hdecomp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : X t = X 0 + V t + N t := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hX t, hX 0, hV t ht, hN t, hpaths,
      Lp.coeFn_add (X 0) (V t), Lp.coeFn_add (X 0 + V t) (N t)]
      with ω hx hz hv hn hp ha hb
    rw [hb, Pi.add_apply, ha, Pi.add_apply, ← hx, ← hz, ← hv, ← hn]
    exact hp.2.2 t ht
  have hN0 : N 0 = 0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hN 0, hpaths, Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q] with ω hn hp hzero
    have hh := hp.2.2 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero] at hh
    have he : x 0 ω + 0 = x 0 ω + m 0 ω := by simpa only [add_zero] using hh
    have hmzero : m 0 ω = 0 := (add_left_cancel he).symm
    rw [← hn, hmzero, hzero]
    rfl
  have ha (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q :=
    (hadapt t ht).congr (hX t)
  obtain ⟨R, hRm, hR0, hR2, hRB, hRbound⟩ := DoobStrongL2.exists_continuous_radius Q F m
    hmart h2m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ⟨0, le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩ T (fun _ ht => ht.2) hmcont
  let C (ω : Ω) := ‖x 0 ω‖ + ‖B ω‖ + R ω
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := ((h2x 0).norm.add hB.norm).add hR2
  have hCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hC2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hC2
  have hpC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω ∧ ‖m t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω := by
    filter_upwards [hxcont, hmcont, hpaths, hRbound] with ω hx hm hp hr
    have hCnon : 0 ≤ C ω := by
      exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (hR0 ω)
    refine ⟨hx, hm, hp.1, hCnon, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have hv := (BoundedVariationRealization.primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2.1 |>.trans (le_abs_self _)
      constructor
      · rw [hp.2.2 t ht]
        apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
        dsimp [C]
        linarith [norm_add_le (x 0 ω) (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω), hr t ht]
      · exact (hr t ht).trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω, le_abs_self (B ω), abs_nonneg (B ω)])
    · exact hp.2.1.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω, le_abs_self (B ω), abs_nonneg (B ω)])
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := PathwiseMartingaleEnergy.quadratic_balance Q F W hW T X V N x b m C
    hmart hN hX hV hN0 hdecomp ha hCi hpC
  have hpairX (t : ℝ) : weightedPairing Q W (X t) (X t) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪x t ω, W (x t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hX t] with ω hω
    rw [← hω]
  have hpairN (t : ℝ) : weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪m t ω, W (m t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hN t] with ω hω
    rw [← hω]
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hpairX, hpairN] using he

primitive_memLp.exact_header:
theorem primitive_memLp (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) 2 Q
primitive_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem primitive_memLp (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) 2 Q := by

  filter_upwards [hpaths] with ω hp
  exact (BoundedVariationRealization.primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2

primitiveLp.exact_header:
def primitiveLp (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω) (t : ℝ) : Lp E 2 Q
primitiveLp.exact_declaration:
def primitiveLp (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω) (t : ℝ) : Lp E 2 Q :=
  if ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) then
    (primitive_memLp Q T b hb B hB hpaths t ht).toLp (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)

theorem primitiveLp_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    primitiveLp Q T b hb B hB hpaths t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)
primitiveLp_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem primitiveLp_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    primitiveLp Q T b hb B hB hpaths t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) := by
  simp only [primitiveLp, dite_eq_left ht]
  exact (primitive_memLp Q T b hb B hB hpaths t ht).coeFn_toLp

theorem state_memLp (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → E)
