exists_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_radius (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
        (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω
exists_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_radius (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
        (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω := by
  obtain ⟨R, _, hR0, hR2, _, hRbound⟩ := DoobStrongL2.exists_continuous_radius Q F m
    hmart h2m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ⟨0, le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩ T (fun _ ht => ht.2) hmcont
  let C (ω : Ω) := ‖x 0 ω‖ + ‖B ω‖ + R ω
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := (h2x₀.norm.add hB.norm).add hR2
  have hCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hC2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hC2
  refine ⟨C, hCi, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hxcont, hpaths, hRbound] with ω hx hp hr
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C ω := add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (hR0 ω)
  refine ⟨hx, hp.1, hC0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    have hv := (BoundedVariationRealization.primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2.1 |>.trans (le_abs_self _)
    rw [hp.2.2 t ht]
    apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
    dsimp [C]
    linarith [norm_add_le (x 0 ω) (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω), hr t ht]
  · exact hp.2.1.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω, le_abs_self (B ω), abs_nonneg (B ω)])

integrable_and_swap.exact_header:
theorem integrable_and_swap (T : ℝ≥0) (A : Z →L[ℝ] Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hxjoint : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hbjoint : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => A (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
      (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), A (x r ω) (b r ω)) ∂Q) =
        ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), (∫ ω, A (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q)
integrable_and_swap.exact_declaration:
theorem integrable_and_swap (T : ℝ≥0) (A : Z →L[ℝ] Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hxjoint : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hbjoint : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (B : Ω → ℝ) (hB : MemLp B 2 Q)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ B ω ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => A (x p.1 p.2) (b p.1 p.2))
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
      (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), A (x r ω) (b r ω)) ∂Q) =
        ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), (∫ ω, A (x r ω) (b r ω) ∂Q) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hCi, hCp⟩ := exists_radius Q F T x b m h2x₀ h2m hmart B hB hxcont hmcont hpaths
  exact ⟨PathwiseDriftFubini.work_integrable Q T A x b C
    hxjoint.aestronglyMeasurable hbjoint.aestronglyMeasurable hCi hCp,
    PathwiseDriftFubini.integral_swap Q T A x b C
      hxjoint.aestronglyMeasurable hbjoint.aestronglyMeasurable hCi hCp⟩

The drift may be superlinear. Neither a global drift moment nor an expected
energy identity is supplied: the genuine localizations derive both bounds. -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter

  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {D : Driver (I := I) Q} {T : ℝ≥0}
  {L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T}
  (U : RawDampedState.Data L)
  (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z,W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z,w⟫_ℝ)
  (m C S : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
  (hcoerc : ∀ z, m*‖z‖^2 ≤ ⟪z,W z⟫_ℝ)
  (hwork : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ⟪U.state r ω,W (U.drift r ω)⟫_ℝ ≤ C)

    (∑ i, ⟪L.sigma i r ω,W (L.sigma i r ω)⟫_ℝ) ≤ S)
include hW hm hC hS hcoerc hwork hnoise







end PBGSO.RawCoerciveMoment

budget.exact_declaration: def budget : ℝ := ((∫ ω, ⟪U.state 0 ω,W (U.state 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) + (2*C+S)*T)/m

budget_nonneg.exact_header: theorem budget_nonneg : 0 ≤ budget U W m C S
budget_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem budget_nonneg : 0 ≤ budget U W m C S := by
  apply div_nonneg _ hm.le
  exact add_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun ω => (mul_nonneg hm.le (sq_nonneg _)).trans (hcoerc _)))
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) T.coe_nonneg)

damped_generator_le.exact_header:
theorem damped_generator_le (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      2*⟪U.dampedState n 0 r ω,W (U.dampedDrift n 0 r ω)⟫_ℝ +
        ∑ i, ⟪L.stoppedSigma n i r ω,W (L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)⟫_ℝ ≤ 2*C+S
damped_generator_le.exact_declaration:
theorem damped_generator_le (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      2*⟪U.dampedState n 0 r ω,W (U.dampedDrift n 0 r ω)⟫_ℝ +
        ∑ i, ⟪L.stoppedSigma n i r ω,W (L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)⟫_ℝ ≤ 2*C+S := by
  filter_upwards [hwork r hr,hnoise r hr] with ω hw hn
  by_cases hs : r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ)
  · have hx : U.dampedState n 0 r ω = U.state r ω := by
      rw [RawDampedState.Data.dampedState,DampedContinuation.extension_before _ _ _ hs,
        RawDampedState.Data.clampedState,RawDampedState.timeClamp_eq T hr]
    simpa only [hx,RawDampedState.Data.dampedDrift,DampedContinuation.drift,hs,ite_true,
      RawLocalDiffusion.stoppedSigma,LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField] using add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by norm_num)) hn
  · simp only [RawDampedState.Data.dampedDrift,DampedContinuation.drift,hs,ite_false,
      neg_zero,zero_smul,map_zero,inner_zero_right,mul_zero,RawLocalDiffusion.stoppedSigma,
      LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField,Finset.sum_const_zero,zero_add]
    positivity

damped_moment_bound.exact_header:
theorem damped_moment_bound (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖(U.dampedState_square n (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0) t).toLp (U.dampedState n 0 t)‖^2 ≤
      budget U W m C S
damped_moment_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem damped_moment_bound (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    ‖(U.dampedState_square n (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0) t).toLp (U.dampedState n 0 t)‖^2 ≤
      budget U W m C S := by
  let x := U.dampedState n 0
  let b := U.dampedDrift n 0
  let e := fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪x r ω,W (x r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
  let w := fun r => 2*(∫ ω, ⟪x r ω,W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
    ∫ ω, ∑ i,⟪L.stoppedSigma n i r ω,W (L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
  have he := U.energy_integral n (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0) W hW
  have hiw := U.work_product_integrable n (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0) W
  have hid := rawDiffusion_weighted_integrable Q T (L.stoppedSigma n)
    (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) W
  have hwle : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), w r ≤ 2*C+S := by
    filter_upwards [hiw.prod_right_ae,hid.prod_right_ae,ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc]
      with r hw hd hr
    have hi := integral_mono_ae ((hw.const_mul 2).add hd) (integrable_const (2*C+S))
      (damped_generator_le U W hW m C S hm hC hS hcoerc hwork hnoise n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr))
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
    rw [integral_add (hw.const_mul 2) hd,integral_const_mul] at hi
    simpa [w] using hi
  have hwt : (∫ r in 0..(t : ℝ),w r) ≤ (2*C+S)*t := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le t.coe_nonneg]
    have hit : IntegrableOn w (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)) := he.1.def'.mono_set
      (by simpa only [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl (show (t : ℝ) ≤ T by exact_mod_cast ht))
    have hwl := ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset
      (Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl (show (t : ℝ) ≤ T by exact_mod_cast ht)) hwle
    have hh := integral_mono_ae hit (integrable_const (2*C+S)) hwl
    simpa [Real.volume_Ioc,t.coe_nonneg, mul_comm] using hh
  have heq : e t = (∫ ω,⟪U.state 0 ω,W (U.state 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) + ∫ r in 0..(t : ℝ),w r := by
    simpa only [e,w,x,b,RawDampedState.Data.dampedState_zero] using he.2 t ht
  have hx := U.dampedState_square n (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0) (t : ℝ)
  have hix : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪x t ω,W (x t ω)⟫_ℝ) Q := by
    apply ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hx.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hx |>.const_mul ‖W‖).mono'
      (hx.aestronglyMeasurable.inner (W.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hx.aestronglyMeasurable))
    filter_upwards with ω
    exact (norm_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (by nlinarith [W.le_opNorm (x t ω),norm_nonneg (x t ω)])
  have hlow : m*‖hx.toLp (x t)‖^2 ≤ e t := by
    rw [LinearGrowthMoment.toLp_norm_sq Q _ hx,← integral_const_mul]
    exact integral_mono (((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hx.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hx).const_mul m)
      hix (fun ω => hcoerc (x t ω))
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr
  have htime : (2*C+S)*(t : ℝ) ≤ (2*C+S)*T :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast ht) (by positivity)
  change _ ≤ _
  nlinarith

    ∃ hx : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q, ‖hx.toLp (U.state t)‖^2 ≤ budget U W m C S := by
  apply LinearGrowthMoment.localized_limit_memLp Q (fun n => U.dampedState n 0 t) (U.state t)

state_product_memLp.exact_declaration:

    MemLp (Function.uncurry U.state) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  let h (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=

/-- Frozen sampler dissipation isolates the actual parameter-cross work. -/

/-- The original raw common-Brownian model contracts under A3 and the
explicit parameter-cross-work condition. Frozen superlinear drift remains
allowed; the proof derives cancellation, Fubini, balance and Grönwall. -/


/-- A concrete additional sufficient condition: parameter-Lipschitz drift
with linear sampler growth, bounded projected-parameter gap, and actual
product-time state L². No growth bound on the frozen drift is imposed. -/


/-- The actual raw energy equals the weighted energy of its literal L²
sections. This identification does not require L²-valued sampler drift. -/

/-- The original joint optimizer/sampler RMS cost has exactly the source
condition-number prefactor under the explicit parameter-cross condition. -/


/-- The realized output joint law bounds the genuine sampler transport
infimum. This is a fixed common-source law bound, prior to the separate
arbitrary-initial-coupling construction. -/

rawMetricBilinear.exact_header:
def rawMetricBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    (S × Z) →L[ℝ] (S × Z) →L[ℝ] ℝ
rawMetricBilinear.exact_declaration:
def rawMetricBilinear (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) :
    (S × Z) →L[ℝ] (S × Z) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S Z)
    (D.optimizerWeight.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S Z)) +
  (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S Z)
    (D.samplerWeight.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S Z))

rawMetricBilinear_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem rawMetricBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : S × Z) :
    rawMetricBilinear D x y = ⟪x.1,D.optimizerWeight y.1⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪x.2,D.samplerWeight y.2⟫_ℝ
rawMetricBilinear_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem rawMetricBilinear_apply (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : S × Z) :
    rawMetricBilinear D x y = ⟪x.1,D.optimizerWeight y.1⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪x.2,D.samplerWeight y.2⟫_ℝ := rfl

rawMetricBilinear_symmetric.exact_header:
theorem rawMetricBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : S × Z) :
    rawMetricBilinear D x y = rawMetricBilinear D y x
rawMetricBilinear_symmetric.exact_declaration:
theorem rawMetricBilinear_symmetric (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x y : S × Z) :
    rawMetricBilinear D x y = rawMetricBilinear D y x := by
  simp only [rawMetricBilinear_apply]
  congr 1
  · exact (D.optimizer_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)
  · exact (D.sampler_symmetric _ _).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)

rawMetricBilinear_nonneg.exact_header:
theorem rawMetricBilinear_nonneg (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : S × Z) :
    0 ≤ rawMetricBilinear D x x
rawMetricBilinear_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem rawMetricBilinear_nonneg (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (x : S × Z) :
    0 ≤ rawMetricBilinear D x x :=
  add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg x.1) (D.samplerSq_nonneg x.2)

sampler_work_eq_drift.exact_header:
theorem sampler_work_eq_drift
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (s s' : S) (z w : Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) =
      ⟪z-w,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z-M.drift (M.parameter s') w)⟫_ℝ
sampler_work_eq_drift.exact_declaration:
theorem sampler_work_eq_drift
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (s s' : S) (z w : Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' (z,w) =
      ⟪z-w,D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z-M.drift (M.parameter s') w)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hz : ∑ i, D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i-
      M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [hσ s s' z w i,sub_self]
    simp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
  simp only [samplerCouplingWork,hz,mul_zero,add_zero]

original_work_le.exact_header:
theorem original_work_le (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (s s' : S) (x y : Ω → Z)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable x) (hy : StronglyMeasurable y)
    (hx2 : MemLp x 2 Q) (hy2 : MemLp y 2 Q)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) (Q.map x))
    (hobs' : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) (Q.map y))
    (hw : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪x ω-y ω,
      D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) (x ω)-M.drift (M.parameter s') (y ω))⟫_ℝ) Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s (Q.map x)-M.optimizerField t s' (Q.map y))⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪x ω-y ω,D.samplerWeight
        (M.drift (M.parameter s) (x ω)-M.drift (M.parameter s') (y ω))⟫_ℝ ∂Q) ≤
      -ρ * ∫ ω, D.optimizerSq (s-s') + D.samplerSq (x ω-y ω) ∂Q
original_work_le.exact_declaration:
theorem original_work_le (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (s s' : S) (x y : Ω → Z)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable x) (hy : StronglyMeasurable y)
    (hx2 : MemLp x 2 Q) (hy2 : MemLp y 2 Q)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) (Q.map x))
    (hobs' : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s') (M.position z)) (Q.map y))
    (hw : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪x ω-y ω,
      D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) (x ω)-M.drift (M.parameter s') (y ω))⟫_ℝ) Q) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪s-s',D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s (Q.map x)-M.optimizerField t s' (Q.map y))⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪x ω-y ω,D.samplerWeight
        (M.drift (M.parameter s) (x ω)-M.drift (M.parameter s') (y ω))⟫_ℝ ∂Q) ≤
      -ρ * ∫ ω, D.optimizerSq (s-s') + D.samplerSq (x ω-y ω) ∂Q := by
  let Λ := Q.map (fun ω => (x ω,y ω))
  have hxy : Measurable (fun ω => (x ω,y ω)) := hx.measurable.prodMk hy.measurable
  have hc : IsCoupling Λ (Q.map x) (Q.map y) := by
    constructor
    · rw [show Λ = Q.map (fun ω => (x ω,y ω)) from rfl,
        Measure.map_map measurable_fst hxy]
      rfl
    · rw [show Λ = Q.map (fun ω => (x ω,y ω)) from rfl,
        Measure.map_map measurable_snd hxy]
      rfl
  have hp : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map x) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hx.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hp' : IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map y) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hy.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hm : HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map x) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hx.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hx.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hx2
  have hm' : HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map y) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hy.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hy.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hy2
  have hcost : Integrable (fun ω => D.samplerSq (x ω-y ω)) Q := by
    have h := PBGSO.lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
      ((hx2.sub hy2).toLp (fun ω => x ω-y ω)) ((hx2.sub hy2).toLp (fun ω => x ω-y ω))
    exact h.congr (((hx2.sub hy2).coeFn_toLp.fun_comp
      (fun z => ⟪z,D.samplerWeight z⟫_ℝ)))
  have hcmeas : Continuous (fun zz : Z × Z => D.samplerSq (zz.1-zz.2)) := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    fun_prop
  have hworkmeas : Measurable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') := by
    have he : samplerCouplingWork M D s s' = fun zz =>
        ⟪zz.1-zz.2,D.samplerWeight
          (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1-M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ := by
      funext zz
      exact sampler_work_eq_drift M D hσ s s' zz.1 zz.2
    rw [he]
    exact (continuous_fst.inner continuous_snd).measurable.comp
      ((measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd).prodMk
      (D.samplerWeight.continuous.measurable.comp
        (((hb _).comp measurable_fst).sub ((hb _).comp measurable_snd))))
  have hwi : Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') Λ := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure hworkmeas.aestronglyMeasurable hxy.aemeasurable).mpr
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, sampler_work_eq_drift M D hσ] using hw
  have hci : Integrable (fun zz => D.samplerSq (zz.1-zz.2)) Λ :=
    (integrable_map_measure hcmeas.aestronglyMeasurable hxy.aemeasurable).mpr hcost
  have h := hmono t ht s s' (Q.map x) (Q.map y) Λ hc hp hp' hm hm' hobs hobs' hwi hci
  rw [show Λ = Q.map (fun ω => (x ω,y ω)) from rfl,
    integral_map hxy.aemeasurable hworkmeas.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_map hxy.aemeasurable hcmeas.aestronglyMeasurable] at h
  simp only [sampler_work_eq_drift M D hσ] at h
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hw, integral_add (integrable_const _) hcost]
  simpa only [integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ,
    ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] using h

Data.exact_header: structure Data (L : FilteredBrownian.RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q W T)
Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data (L : FilteredBrownian.RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q W T) where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift : ℝ → S
  sampler : ℝ → Ω → Z
  optimizer_strong : StronglyMeasurable optimizer
  optimizerDrift_strong : StronglyMeasurable optimizerDrift
  sampler_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry sampler)
  drift_strong : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
    M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer p.1)) (sampler p.1 p.2))
  optimizerDrift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable optimizerDrift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  optimizerDrift_realizes : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), optimizerDrift t =
    M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler t))
  optimizer_equation : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    optimizer t = optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, optimizerDrift r
  drift_integrable : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable
    (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer r)) (sampler r ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  sampler_equation : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    sampler t ω = sampler 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (optimizer r)) (sampler r ω)) +
        L.localNoise t.toNNReal ω
  diffusion_realizes : ∀ i r ω, L.sigma i r ω =
    M.diffusion (M.parameter (optimizer r)) (sampler r ω) i
  sampler_square : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (sampler t) 2 Q
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (sampler t))

pairState.exact_header: def pairState (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : S × Z
pairState.exact_declaration:
def pairState (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : S × Z :=
  (U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r,U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω)

pairDrift.exact_header: def pairDrift (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : S × Z
pairDrift.exact_declaration:
def pairDrift (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : S × Z :=
  (U.optimizerDrift r-V.optimizerDrift r,
    M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (U.sampler r ω)-
      M.drift (M.parameter (V.optimizer r)) (V.sampler r ω))

pairState_strong.exact_header:
theorem pairState_strong (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (pairState Q M U V))
pairState_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem pairState_strong (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (pairState Q M U V)) :=
  ((U.optimizer_strong.sub V.optimizer_strong).comp_measurable measurable_fst).prodMk
    (U.sampler_strong.sub V.sampler_strong)

pairDrift_strong.exact_header:
theorem pairDrift_strong (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (pairDrift Q M U V))
pairDrift_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem pairDrift_strong (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (pairDrift Q M U V)) :=
  ((U.optimizerDrift_strong.sub V.optimizerDrift_strong).comp_measurable measurable_fst).prodMk
    (U.drift_strong.sub V.drift_strong)

pair_path.exact_header:
theorem pair_path (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (hnoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => pairState Q M U V r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => pairDrift Q M U V r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), pairState Q M U V r ω =
        pairState Q M U V 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω
pair_path.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_path (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (hnoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => pairState Q M U V r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => pairDrift Q M U V r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), pairState Q M U V r ω =
        pairState Q M U V 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.drift_integrable,V.drift_integrable,U.sampler_equation,V.sampler_equation,
    hnoise] with ω hu hv heu hev hn
  have hg := U.optimizerDrift_integrable.sub V.optimizerDrift_integrable
  have hb := hu.sub hv
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => pairDrift Q M U V r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ⟨hg.1.prodMk hb.1,hg.2.prodMk hb.2⟩
  have he (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : pairState Q M U V r ω =
      pairState Q M U V 0 ω + ∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω := by
    have hsub : uIcc 0 r ⊆ uIcc 0 (T : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le hr.1,uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using
        (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hr.2 : Icc 0 r ⊆ Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
    have hit := hi.mono_set hsub
    apply Prod.ext
    · change U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r = U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0 +
        (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω).1
      have hf := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ S Z).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hit
      change (∫ s in 0..r, (pairDrift Q M U V s ω).1) =
        (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω).1 at hf
      rw [← hf]
      change U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r = U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0 +
        ∫ s in 0..r, U.optimizerDrift s-V.optimizerDrift s
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (U.optimizerDrift_integrable.mono_set hsub)
        (V.optimizerDrift_integrable.mono_set hsub),U.optimizer_equation r hr,V.optimizer_equation r hr]
      abel
    · change U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω = U.sampler 0 ω-V.sampler 0 ω +
        (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω).2
      have hf := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ S Z).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hit
      change (∫ s in 0..r, (pairDrift Q M U V s ω).2) =
        (∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω).2 at hf
      rw [← hf]
      change U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω = U.sampler 0 ω-V.sampler 0 ω +
        ∫ s in 0..r, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer s)) (U.sampler s ω)-
          M.drift (M.parameter (V.optimizer s)) (V.sampler s ω)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hu.mono_set hsub) (hv.mono_set hsub),heu r hr,hev r hr,
        hn r.toNNReal (by exact_mod_cast (Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr hr.2)]
      abel
  refine ⟨?_,hi,he⟩
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun r => pairState Q M U V 0 ω +
      ∫ s in 0..r, pairDrift Q M U V s ω) (uIcc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    continuousOn_const.add (intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive_interval' hi
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ uIcc 0 (T : ℝ) from left_mem_uIcc))
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hc
  exact hc.congr he

diffusion_square.exact_header:
theorem diffusion_square (U : Data Q M W T L)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
diffusion_square.exact_declaration:
theorem diffusion_square (U : Data Q M W T L)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have he : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) =
      fun _ => ‖M.diffusion (M.parameter (0 : S)) (0 : Z) i‖ ^ 2 := by
    funext p
    rw [U.diffusion_realizes]
    rw [hσ (U.optimizer p.1) 0 (U.sampler p.1 p.2) 0 i]
  rw [he]
  exact integrable_const _

noise_cancels.exact_header:
theorem noise_cancels (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω
noise_cancels.exact_declaration:
theorem noise_cancels (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω := by
  apply L.localNoise_congr_on_horizon K (diffusion_square Q M U hσ) (diffusion_square Q M V hσ)
  intro i
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun p => by
    change L.sigma i p.1 p.2 = K.sigma i p.1 p.2
    rw [U.diffusion_realizes,V.diffusion_realizes]
    exact hσ _ _ _ _ i)

pair_energy_integrable.exact_header:
theorem pair_energy_integrable (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V r ω)
      (pairState Q M U V r ω)) Q
pair_energy_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem pair_energy_integrable (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V r ω)
      (pairState Q M U V r ω)) Q := by
  have h2 := (U.sampler_square r hr).sub (V.sampler_square r hr)
  have hi := lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q D.samplerWeight
    (h2.toLp (fun ω => U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω))
    (h2.toLp (fun ω => U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω))
  have hs : Integrable (fun ω => D.samplerSq (U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω)) Q :=
    hi.congr (h2.coeFn_toLp.fun_comp (fun z => ⟪z,D.samplerWeight z⟫_ℝ))
  change Integrable (fun ω => D.optimizerSq (U.optimizer r-V.optimizer r) +
    D.samplerSq (U.sampler r ω-V.sampler r ω)) Q
  exact (integrable_const _).add hs

energy_decay.exact_header:
theorem energy_decay (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hp : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      max (rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V p.1 p.2)
        (pairDrift Q M U V p.1 p.2)) 0)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    (∫ ω, rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V T ω) (pairState Q M U V T ω) ∂Q) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        ∫ ω, rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V 0 ω) (pairState Q M U V 0 ω) ∂Q
energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_decay (U : Data Q M W T L) (V : Data Q M W T K)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)

    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (C P : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hparam : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ‖M.parameter (U.optimizer r)-M.parameter (V.optimizer r)‖ ≤ P)
    (hparamDrift : ∀ θ θ' z, ‖M.drift θ z-M.drift θ' z‖ ≤
      C * ‖θ-θ'‖ * (1+‖z‖))
    (hU2 : MemLp (Function.uncurry U.sampler) 2
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hV2 : MemLp (Function.uncurry V.sampler) 2
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    (∫ ω, rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V T ω) (pairState Q M U V T ω) ∂Q) ≤
      Real.exp (-2 * ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        ∫ ω, rawMetricBilinear D (pairState Q M U V 0 ω) (pairState Q M U V 0 ω) ∂Q := by
  apply energy_decay Q M D U V ρ hmono hσ hb
  apply positive_work_of_sampler Q M D U V
  let μ := (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q
  have hi : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.sampler p.1 p.2-V.sampler p.1 p.2‖ *
      (1+‖V.sampler p.1 p.2‖)) μ :=
    (hU2.sub hV2).norm.integrable_mul ((memLp_const (1 : ℝ)).add hV2.norm)
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      ⟪U.sampler p.1 p.2-V.sampler p.1 p.2,
        D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer p.1)) (U.sampler p.1 p.2)-
          M.drift (M.parameter (V.optimizer p.1)) (V.sampler p.1 p.2))⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    (U.sampler_strong.aestronglyMeasurable.sub V.sampler_strong.aestronglyMeasurable).inner

    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr

  filter_upwards [htime] with p hp
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_max_right _ _)]
  calc

      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler T))

  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ ν c

    ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler T)) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+

theorem rawSampler_pullback_law (U : Data R M D T L) (t : ℝ) :

rawSampler_pullback_law.exact_declaration:
theorem rawSampler_pullback_law (U : Data R M D T L) (t : ℝ) :
    Q.map (fun ω => U.sampler t (f ω)) = R.map (U.sampler t) := by
  change Q.map (U.sampler t ∘ f) = R.map (U.sampler t)

Data.pullback.exact_header: def Data.pullback (U : Data R M D T L) : Data Q M E T (L.pullback hf E he)
Data.pullback.exact_declaration:
def Data.pullback (U : Data R M D T L) : Data Q M E T (L.pullback hf E he) where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  optimizerDrift := U.optimizerDrift
  sampler r ω := U.sampler r (f ω)
  optimizer_strong := U.optimizer_strong
  optimizerDrift_strong := U.optimizerDrift_strong
  sampler_strong := U.sampler_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  drift_strong := U.drift_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizerDrift_integrable
  optimizerDrift_realizes r hr := by
    rw [rawSampler_pullback_law hf U r]
    exact U.optimizerDrift_realizes r hr
  optimizer_equation := U.optimizer_equation
  drift_integrable := hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.drift_integrable
  sampler_equation := by
    filter_upwards [hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.sampler_equation,
      L.pullback_noise_on_horizon hf E he hp (diffusion_square R M U hσ)] with ω hu hn
    intro r hr
    rw [hu r hr,hn r.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr hr.2)]
  diffusion_realizes i r ω := U.diffusion_realizes i r (f ω)
  sampler_square r hr := (U.sampler_square r hr).comp_measurePreserving hf
  observation_integrable r hr := by
    rw [rawSampler_pullback_law hf U r]
    exact U.observation_integrable r hr

Data.pullback_law.exact_declaration:

Data.pullback_section.exact_header:
theorem Data.pullback_section (U : Data R M D T L) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q (U.pullback hf E hp he hσ).sampler t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (ProductLpSections.sectionLp R U.sampler t)
Data.pullback_section.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.pullback_section (U : Data R M D T L) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q (U.pullback hf E hp he hσ).sampler t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (ProductLpSections.sectionLp R U.sampler t) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hleft := ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae Q (U.pullback hf E hp he hσ).sampler
    ((U.pullback hf E hp he hσ).sampler_square t ht)
  have hright := (lpPullback_coe hf (ProductLpSections.sectionLp R U.sampler t)).trans
    (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae R U.sampler (U.sampler_square t ht)))
  exact hleft.trans hright.symm

theorem parameter_bound
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)

    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Qp.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler r)))

    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp, (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 Qp ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Qp) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *

theorem parameter_bound
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (U.sampler r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Qp.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler r)))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp,
      (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.1 = U.optimizer r)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp, (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 Qp ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Qp) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler 0-ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler 0‖ ^ 2) +
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber * V0 / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1-Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ))) := by
  letI : ∀ r, IsProbabilityMeasure (Q.map (U.sampler r)) := fun r =>
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff U.sampler_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V0 :=
    (integral_nonneg (fun z => sq_nonneg
      ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer 0)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler 0)) (U.optimizer 0)‖)).trans
      (hVar 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)

  have hd := ConstantNoiseFluctuation.law_decay_of_reference_variance_stationary_target
    M D Q U hF V ρ hρ.le hmono hσ hb LΨ hΨ V0 hU2 hVar sStar νStar hopt hlaw hobs
  have ho := optimizer_norm_le_lawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar (Q.map (U.sampler T)) νStar
  exact ⟨hm,(hp.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (ho.trans hd))).trans_eq (add_comm _ _)⟩

          ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state t)) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      oneEquiv N (Y.state 0 ω) = (U.optimizer 0,RawIndependentCopies.cloud Q D N U 0 ω)) :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N (originalPair Q D M N U Y T ω)
      ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)*Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber*V/(N : ℝ))*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*T)) := by
  have hF' : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (M.position z)) 2
      (referenceLaw Q D M U t) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [referenceLaw_eq Q D M U t ht]
    exact hF t ht
  have hVar' : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (referenceLaw Q D M U t) (U.optimizer t)‖^2
          ∂referenceLaw Q D M U t) ≤ V := by
    intro t ht
    rw [referenceLaw_eq Q D M U t ht]
    exact hVar t ht
  have h := A.data.finite_particle_interaction_bound G ρ hρ hmono hN LΨ V hV U.optimizer
    hΨ hF' (reference_cloud_law Q D M N U Y A) (reference_optimizer Q D M N U Y A)
    hVar' (initial_coupling Q D M N U Y A hinit)
  have he : (fun ω => particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N (pairEquiv N (A.data.state T ω))) =ᵐ[
      IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q]
      (fun ω => particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N (originalPair Q D M N U Y T ω)) :=
    (pair_state Q D M N U Y A).mono (fun _ h => congrArg (particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N)
      (h T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩))
  rwa [integral_congr_ae he] at h

import PBGSO.RawReferenceCloudData
import PBGSO.RawEmpiricalDynamics
import PBGSO.RawOptimizerField

/-! # Actual original empirical solution paired with independent reference copies
The full independent Brownian driver and reference trajectories are built
from independent whole seeds. Literal original strong equations construct the
actual pair. Its physical coefficients and iid reference law are proved.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawConstructedParticleCopy
open FilteredBrownian ConstructedItoParticle RawDampedState
variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [MeasurableSpace Θ] [BorelSpace Θ] [SecondCountableTopology Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ≥0}
  (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)

/-- Only the observation window is relevant. This literal extension derives
probability normalization without measurability assumptions outside it. -/



/-- Every output compatibility is proved for the original native solution
and the explicitly independently seeded reference cloud. -/

structure Construction (Y : RawEmpiricalDynamics.Solution M N

Construction.exact_declaration:
structure Construction (Y : RawEmpiricalDynamics.Solution M N
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) T) where
  localDiffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := PairHilbert N S Z)
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
    (nullAugmentedDriver (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N)) T
  data : RawParticleInteraction.Data M (referenceLaw Q D M U) localDiffusion

    (pairEquiv N (data.state r ω)).1 = oneEquiv N (Y.state r ω)
  reference_state : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),

build.exact_header:
def build (Y : RawEmpiricalDynamics.Solution M N
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) T)
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hb : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hΨ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    Construction Q D M N U Y
build.exact_declaration:
def build (Y : RawEmpiricalDynamics.Solution M N
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) T)
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hb : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hΨ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    Construction Q D M N U Y := Classical.choice <| by
  let H := RawEmpiricalDynamics.build M N Y hF hb hΨ
  let C := RawReferenceCloudData.build Q D M N U hb
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hji,hjE⟩ := RawOptimizerField.exists_field U hF hΨ
  let a : ℝ → S := fun r => U.optimizer (timeClamp T r)
  have haC : Continuous a := (RawSamplerGrowth.optimizer_continuous U).comp_continuous
    (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  have haE (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : a r = U.optimizer r := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [timeClamp_eq T hr]
  have haODE : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), a r = a 0+∫ t in 0..r,j t := by
    intro r hr
    rw [haE r hr,haE 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,U.optimizer_equation r hr]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [uIcc_of_le hr.1] at ht
    exact (hjE t ⟨ht.1,ht.2.trans hr.2⟩).symm
  let KL := RawDeterministicODE.coefficient C.localDiffusion j hj hji
  let A := RawDeterministicODE.data C.localDiffusion a j haC hj hji haODE
  let RL := RawPairDynamics.coefficient KL C.localDiffusion
  let R := RawPairDynamics.pair KL C.localDiffusion A C.data
  let PL := RawPairDynamics.coefficient H.localDiffusion RL
  let P := RawPairDynamics.pair H.localDiffusion RL H.data R
  have hDrift : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      pairEquiv N (P.drift r ω) =
        particleCopyDrift M N (referenceLaw Q D M U r) r (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)) := by
    intro r hr
    filter_upwards [H.drift_realizes,C.drift_realizes] with ω hh hc
    apply Prod.ext
    · change oneEquiv N (H.data.drift r ω) = _
      rw [hh r hr]
      exact RawEmpiricalDynamics.drift_coordinates M N r (H.data.state r ω)
    · apply Prod.ext
      · change j r = M.optimizerField r (a r) (referenceLaw Q D M U r)
        rw [haE r hr,referenceLaw_eq Q D M U r hr]
        exact hjE r hr
      · change (fun i => C.data.drift r ω i) =
          (fun i => M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (C.data.state r ω i))
        rw [hc r hr,haE r hr]
        rfl
  have hSigma : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ ij : Fin N × I,
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      pairEquiv N (PL.sigma ij r ω) =
        particleCopyDiffusion M N (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)) ij := by
    intro r hr ij
    filter_upwards [H.sigma_realizes,C.sigma_realizes] with ω hh hc
    apply Prod.ext
    · change oneEquiv N (H.localDiffusion.sigma ij r ω) = _
      rw [hh r hr ij]
      exact RawEmpiricalDynamics.sigma_coordinates M N ij (H.data.state r ω)
    · apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · change (fun i => C.localDiffusion.sigma ij r ω i) =
          (fun k => if k = ij.1 then M.diffusion (M.parameter (a r)) (C.data.state r ω k) ij.2 else 0)
        rw [hc r hr ij,haE r hr]
        funext k
        by_cases h : k = ij.1
        · subst k
          simp [RawReferenceCloudData.cloudModel,RawReferenceCloud.single_apply]
        · simp [RawReferenceCloudData.cloudModel,RawReferenceCloud.single_apply,h,Ne.symm h]
  let V : RawParticleInteraction.Data M (referenceLaw Q D M U)
      PL := {
    toData := P
    drift_realizes := hDrift
    sigma_realizes := hSigma }
  have hNative : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (pairEquiv N (V.state r ω)).1 = oneEquiv N (Y.state r ω) := by
    filter_upwards [H.state_eq] with ω h r hr
    change oneEquiv N (H.data.state r ω) = _
    rw [h r hr]
  have hReference : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (pairEquiv N (V.state r ω)).2 = (U.optimizer r,RawIndependentCopies.cloud Q D N U r ω) := by
    filter_upwards [C.state_eq] with ω h r hr
    change (a r,fun i => C.data.state r ω i) = _
    rw [haE r hr,h r hr]
    rfl
  exact ⟨⟨_,V,hNative,hReference⟩⟩

is used to derive each sharp estimate before taking the joint limit.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology

A1 initial/path-source witnesses and the actual stationary target. No paired
particle/copy equation, iid output law, moment bound or final error estimate
is among these fields. -/

variable (F : Family Q W M μ νStar s0 sStar)

/-- The two primitive source A1 alternatives. The linear-growth option

theorem parameter_joint_limit
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 νStar)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (VF : ℝ)
    (hΨ : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (hU2 : ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter ((F.reference T).optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map ((F.reference T).sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter ((F.reference T).optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map ((F.reference T).sampler.state r)) ((F.reference T).optimizer r)‖^2
        ∂Q.map ((F.reference T).sampler.state r)) ≤ VF)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hbranch : Branch Q W M μ νStar s0 sStar F) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ => parameterError Q W M μ νStar s0 sStar F p.1 p.2)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
  have hVF : 0 ≤ VF := (integral_nonneg (fun z => sq_nonneg _)).trans
    (hVar 0 0 ⟨le_rfl,le_rfl⟩)
  let d0 := optimizerLawDistance s0 sStar μ νStar
  let floor := fun n : ℕ => ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)*Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber*VF/((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let decay := fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber*Real.exp (-ρ*t)*d0
  have hbound (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
      Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (oneEquiv (n+1) ((F.native n T).state T ω)).1-M.parameter sStar‖^2
        ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin (n+1)) Q) ≤ decay T+floor n*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*T)) := by
    cases hbranch with
    | constant hσ =>
      have h := (RawConstructedParticleParameter.original_parameter_bound_constant Q W
        (F.reference T) (F.native n T) μ νStar hμ hν (F.reference_initial_law T)
        (F.canonical T) (F.canonical_initial T) (F.canonical_initial_sampler T)
        (F.target T) (F.target_initial_sampler T) (F.unique_reference T) (F.unique_canonical T)
        (F.path_reference T) G ρ hρ hmono (Nat.succ_pos n) hProjection hσ hb hF hDrift hOptimizer
        LΨ VF (fun r hr => hΨ r hr.1) (hU2 T) (hVar T) sStar (F.target_optimizer T)
        (F.target_law T) hobs (F.synchronous_initial n T)).2
      simpa only [F.reference_initial T,decay,d0,floor] using h
    | linearGrowth hRA hRV hUnique hPath =>
      have h := (RawConstructedParticleParameter.original_parameter_bound_linearGrowth Q W
        (F.reference T) (F.native n T) μ νStar hμ hν (F.reference_initial_law T)
        (F.canonical T) (hRA T) (F.canonical_initial T) (F.canonical_initial_sampler T)
        (F.target T) (hRV T) (F.target_initial_sampler T) (F.unique_reference T) (F.unique_canonical T)
        (hUnique T) (F.path_reference T) (hPath T) G ρ hρ hmono (Nat.succ_pos n)
        hProjection hF hDrift hOptimizer LΨ VF (fun r hr => hΨ r hr.1) (hU2 T) (hVar T)
        sStar (F.target_optimizer T) (F.target_law T) (F.synchronous_initial n T)).2
      simpa only [F.reference_initial T,decay,d0,floor] using h
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G.conditionNumber*VF/((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (G.conditionNumber*VF)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_zero,mul_one_div] using h
  have hfloor : Tendsto floor atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdiv).const_mul ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)
    simpa only [floor,Real.sqrt_zero,mul_zero,Function.comp_def] using h
  have hdecay : Tendsto decay atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [decay,mul_zero,zero_mul] using
      ((relaxation_tendsto_zero hρ).const_mul (Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber)).mul_const d0
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ => decay p.2+floor p.1) (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero,Function.comp_def] using (hdecay.comp tendsto_snd).add (hfloor.comp tendsto_fst)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun p => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ?_ hsum
  filter_upwards [tendsto_snd.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ))] with p hp
  have h := hbound p.1 p.2.toNNReal
  have hfnonneg : 0 ≤ floor p.1 := by dsimp [floor]; positivity
  have hf : floor p.1*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*p.2)) ≤ floor p.1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-ρ*p.2)]
  have h' : parameterError Q W M μ νStar s0 sStar F p.1 p.2 ≤
      decay p.2+floor p.1*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*p.2)) := by
    simpa only [parameterError,Real.coe_toNNReal p.2 hp] using h
  exact h'.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hf)

/-! # Exact parameter bounds for the original constructed particle system
The original empirical strong solution is paired internally with independent
reference seeds. Physical coefficients, reference-cloud iid law, optimizer
matching, and local stochastic compatibility are proved by construction.
Source response/variance assumptions justify the constant-noise relaxation;
no paired-data record, final law bound or work hypothesis is an input.
-/

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawConstructedParticleParameter

  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (W : Driver (I := I) Q)
  {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0} {N : ℕ}

/-- Particle interaction controls the actual native parameter. The paired
strong equation, iid reference law and all matching identities are built
inside this proof from the original empirical solution and primitive Borel

Original mean-field and particle strong equations, their synchronous initial

is no paired equation, reference iid/matching premise, drift-growth or
positive-work assumption. The relaxation prefactor is the true initial law
distance. -/

/-- Exact source4 bound for the original empirical equation in the general

    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)

    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (VF : ℝ) (hVF : 0 ≤ VF) (sStar : S)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)) 2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖^2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ VF)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      oneEquiv N (Y.state 0 ω) = (U.optimizer 0,RawIndependentCopies.cloud Q W N U 0 ω)) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (oneEquiv N (Y.state T ω)).1-M.parameter sStar)
      2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (oneEquiv N (Y.state T ω)).1-M.parameter sStar‖^2
      ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)*Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber*VF/(N : ℝ))*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*T))+
        ‖U.optimizer T-sStar‖ := by
  let C := build Q W M N U Y hF hDrift hOptimizer
  have hF' : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)) 2 (referenceLaw Q W M U r) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [referenceLaw_eq Q W M U r hr]
    exact hU2 r hr
  have hVar' : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (referenceLaw Q W M U r) (U.optimizer r)‖^2 ∂referenceLaw Q W M U r) ≤ VF := by
    intro r hr
    rw [referenceLaw_eq Q W M U r hr]
    exact hVar r hr
  obtain ⟨hm,hb⟩ := RawParticleParameter.parameter_bias_bound C.data G ρ hρ hmono hN
    hProjection LΨ VF hVF U.optimizer sStar hΨ hF'
    (RawConstructedParticleBounds.reference_cloud_law Q W M N U Y C)
    (RawConstructedParticleBounds.reference_optimizer Q W M N U Y C) hVar'
    (RawConstructedParticleBounds.initial_coupling Q W M N U Y C hinit)
  have he : (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (C.data.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar) =ᵐ[
      IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q]
      (fun ω => M.parameter (oneEquiv N (Y.state T ω)).1-M.parameter sStar) := by
    filter_upwards [C.interacting_state] with ω h
    rw [h T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩]
  refine ⟨(memLp_congr_ae he).mp hm,?_⟩
  have hi : (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (C.data.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar‖^2
      ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) =
      ∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (oneEquiv N (Y.state T ω)).1-M.parameter sStar‖^2
        ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q :=
    integral_congr_ae (he.fun_comp (fun z => ‖z‖^2))
  rwa [hi] at hb

import PBGSO.RawDampedState
import PBGSO.RawLocalPullbackLocal

/-! # Original local raw equations under measure-preserving pullback
The actual local-integral identity is derived without a global expected
coefficient square. State, drift, variation control and original initial
moment are transported, preserving the literal original raw equation.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.RawDampedState
open FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω Ω' I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω']
  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {R : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure R]
  {f : Ω → Ω'} (hf : MeasurePreserving f Q R)
  {D : Driver (I := I) R} (E : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t)
  (hp : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hf D).process i t =ᵐ[Q] E.process i t)
  {T : ℝ≥0} {L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) R D T}

/-- The genuine original strong equation on a pulled, possibly enlarged
Brownian past. Noise and law compatibility are derived by construction. -/


end PBGSO.RawDampedState

Data.pullback.exact_header: def Data.pullback (U : Data L) : Data (L.pullback hf E he)
Data.pullback.exact_declaration:
def Data.pullback (U : Data L) : Data (L.pullback hf E he) where
  state r ω := U.state r (f ω)
  drift r ω := U.drift r (f ω)
  state_strong := U.state_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  drift_strong := U.drift_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  drift_control r ω := U.drift_control r (f ω)
  initial_square := U.initial_square.comp_measurePreserving hf
  state_adapted t := by
    refine ⟨(U.state_adapted t).mk (U.state t) ∘ f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (U.state_adapted t).stronglyMeasurable_mk.comp_measurable
        (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (he t))
    · exact hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.state_adapted t).ae_eq_mk
  state_continuous := hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.state_continuous
  equation := by
    filter_upwards [hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.equation,
      L.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon hf E he hp] with ω hu hn r hr
    rw [hn r.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr hr.2)]
    exact hu r hr

@[simp] theorem Data.pullback_state (U : Data L) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :

    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧

stoppedDrift_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedDrift_paths (n : ℕ) : ∀ ω,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedDrift n r ω‖) ≤ n := by
  intro ω
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun r => U.drift r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    (L.q_local ω).mono' U.drift_strong.of_uncurry_right.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun r => U.drift_control r ω))
  have hs : IntegrableOn (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    change Integrable ((Iic (L.stop n ω : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => U.drift r ω)) _
    exact hi.indicator measurableSet_Iic
  refine ⟨(intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mpr hs, ?_⟩
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
  have hm : ∀ r, ‖U.stoppedDrift n r ω‖ ≤
      LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω := by
    intro r
    change ‖if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then U.drift r ω else 0‖ ≤
      if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then L.q r ω else 0
    split_ifs
    · exact U.drift_control r ω
    · simp
  have hqi : IntegrableOn (fun r => LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω)
      (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := (L.q_local ω).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω :=
      integral_mono hs.norm hqi hm
    _ = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (L.stop n ω : ℝ), L.q r ω := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg,
        stoppedField_integral (L.stop n) L.q (T : ℝ) T.coe_nonneg ω,
        min_eq_right (show (L.stop n ω : ℝ) ≤ T by exact_mod_cast L.stop_bound n ω),
        intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg]
    _ ≤ n := L.stop_energy_bound n ω

    apply NNReal.coe_injective
    rw [NNReal.coe_min, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (le_min ht.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg),
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
  change U.state (min t (L.stop n ω : ℝ)) ω = _
  rw [heq _ ⟨le_min ht.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg,(min_le_left _ _).trans ht.2⟩,
    ← stoppedField_integral (L.stop n) U.drift t ht.1 ω,hmin,
    ← hn n t.toNNReal (by rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe,Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]; exact ht.2)]
  rfl

clampedState_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem clampedState_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry U.clampedState) :=
  U.state_strong.comp_measurable
    (((by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)).measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)

clampedState_continuous.exact_header: theorem clampedState_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.clampedState r ω)
clampedState_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem clampedState_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.clampedState r ω) := by
  filter_upwards [U.state_continuous] with ω hc
  exact hc.comp_continuous (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)

clampedState_adapted.exact_header:
theorem clampedState_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.clampedState t) Q
clampedState_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem clampedState_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.clampedState t) Q := by
  by_cases h : t ≤ T
  · have he : U.clampedState t = U.state t := by
      funext ω
      rw [clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ⟨t.coe_nonneg,by exact_mod_cast h⟩]
    rw [he]
    exact U.state_adapted t
  · have he : U.clampedState t = U.state T := by
      funext ω
      simp only [clampedState,timeClamp,min_eq_right (show (T : ℝ) ≤ t by exact_mod_cast le_of_not_ge h),
        max_eq_right T.coe_nonneg]
    rw [he]
    exact (U.state_adapted T).mono (D.filtration.mono (le_of_not_ge h))

exists_stopped_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_stopped_radius (n : ℕ) : ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧
    MemLp C 2 Q ∧ ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedState n t ω‖ ≤ C ω
exists_stopped_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_stopped_radius (n : ℕ) : ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧
    MemLp C 2 Q ∧ ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedState n t ω‖ ≤ C ω := by
  obtain ⟨R,hRm,hR0,hR2,hRB,hRbound⟩ := DoobStrongL2.exists_continuous_radius Q D.filtration
    (L.version n) (L.version_martingale n) (L.version_memLp n)
    (Icc 0 T) ⟨0,le_rfl,zero_le⟩ T (fun _ ht => ht.2)
    ((L.version_continuous n).mono (fun _ hc => hc.continuousOn))
  let C : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ‖U.state 0 ω‖ + n + R ω
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := (U.initial_square.norm.add (memLp_const (n : ℝ))).add hR2
  have hCm : Measurable C :=
    ((U.state_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable.norm).add measurable_const).add hRm
  refine ⟨C,hCm,fun ω => add_nonneg
    (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)) (hR0 ω),hC2,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [U.stopped_equation n,hRbound] with ω heq hR
  intro t ht
  rw [heq t ht]
  have hprim := (BoundedVariationRealization.primitive_norm_le T _ (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).1 t ht).trans
    (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).2
  have hMt : ‖L.version n t.toNNReal ω‖ ≤ R ω := hR _ ⟨bot_le,by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe,Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]; exact ht.2⟩
  dsimp only [C]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
    ((norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl hprim)) hMt)

radius.exact_declaration: def radius (n : ℕ) : Ω → ℝ := Classical.choose (U.exists_stopped_radius n)

radius_measurable.exact_declaration: theorem radius_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (U.radius n) := (Classical.choose_spec (U.exists_stopped_radius n)).1

radius_nonneg.exact_header: theorem radius_nonneg (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ U.radius n ω
radius_nonneg.exact_declaration: theorem radius_nonneg (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ U.radius n ω := (Classical.choose_spec (U.exists_stopped_radius n)).2.1 ω

radius_square.exact_header: theorem radius_square (n : ℕ) : MemLp (U.radius n) 2 Q
radius_square.exact_declaration: theorem radius_square (n : ℕ) : MemLp (U.radius n) 2 Q := (Classical.choose_spec (U.exists_stopped_radius n)).2.2.1

radius_bound.exact_header: theorem radius_bound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedState n t ω‖ ≤ U.radius n ω
radius_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem radius_bound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedState n t ω‖ ≤ U.radius n ω :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (U.exists_stopped_radius n)).2.2.2

dampedState.exact_header: def dampedState (n : ℕ) (ρ r : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
dampedState.exact_declaration:
def dampedState (n : ℕ) (ρ r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :=
  DampedContinuation.extension ρ (L.stop n ω) (fun r => U.clampedState r ω) r

dampedDrift.exact_header: def dampedDrift (n : ℕ) (ρ r : ℝ) (ω : Ω)
dampedDrift.exact_declaration:
def dampedDrift (n : ℕ) (ρ r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :=
  DampedContinuation.drift ρ (L.stop n ω) (fun r => U.clampedState r ω) (fun r => U.drift r ω) r

variationBudget.exact_header: def variationBudget (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ
variationBudget.exact_declaration: def variationBudget (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ := n + ρ * T * U.radius n ω

variationBudget_square.exact_header: theorem variationBudget_square (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : MemLp (U.variationBudget n ρ) 2 Q
variationBudget_square.exact_declaration:
theorem variationBudget_square (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : MemLp (U.variationBudget n ρ) 2 Q :=
  (memLp_const (n : ℝ)).add ((U.radius_square n).const_mul (ρ * T))

dampedState_strong.exact_header: theorem dampedState_strong (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.dampedState n ρ))
dampedState_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_strong (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.dampedState n ρ)) := by
  have hτ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (L.stop n p.2 : ℝ)) :=
    (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (L.stop_measurable n)).comp measurable_snd
  have hmin := measurable_fst.min hτ
  have hx := U.clampedState_strong.comp_measurable (hmin.prodMk measurable_snd)
  have he := ((measurable_fst.sub hmin).const_mul (-ρ)).exp
  exact he.stronglyMeasurable.smul hx

dampedDrift_strong.exact_header: theorem dampedDrift_strong (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.dampedDrift n ρ))
dampedDrift_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedDrift_strong (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.dampedDrift n ρ)) := by
  have hτ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (L.stop n p.2 : ℝ)) :=
    (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (L.stop_measurable n)).comp measurable_snd
  exact U.drift_strong.piecewise (measurableSet_le measurable_fst hτ)
    ((U.dampedState_strong n ρ).const_smul (-ρ))

dampedState_zero.exact_header: theorem dampedState_zero (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : U.dampedState n ρ 0 ω = U.state 0 ω
dampedState_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_zero (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : U.dampedState n ρ 0 ω = U.state 0 ω := by
  rw [dampedState,DampedContinuation.extension_before ρ _ _ (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg,
    clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩]

dampedState_continuous.exact_header:
theorem dampedState_continuous (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.dampedState n ρ r ω)
dampedState_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_continuous (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.dampedState n ρ r ω) := by
  filter_upwards [U.clampedState_continuous] with ω hc
  unfold dampedState DampedContinuation.extension DampedContinuation.damping
  exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul
    (continuous_id.sub (continuous_id.min continuous_const)))).smul
      (hc.comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const))

dampedState_norm_bound.exact_header:
theorem dampedState_norm_bound (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r : ℝ, ‖U.dampedState n ρ r ω‖ ≤ U.radius n ω
dampedState_norm_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_norm_bound (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r : ℝ, ‖U.dampedState n ρ r ω‖ ≤ U.radius n ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.radius_bound n] with ω hc
  intro r
  apply (DampedContinuation.extension_norm_le hρ (L.stop n ω) (fun s => U.clampedState s ω) r).trans
  have hτ : (L.stop n ω : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) :=
    ⟨(L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg, by exact_mod_cast L.stop_bound n ω⟩
  change ‖U.state (timeClamp T (min r (L.stop n ω : ℝ))) ω‖ ≤ _
  rw [timeClamp_min T _ r hτ]
  exact hc (timeClamp T r) (timeClamp_mem T r)

dampedState_square.exact_header:
theorem dampedState_square (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (r : ℝ) :
    MemLp (U.dampedState n ρ r) 2 Q
dampedState_square.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_square (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (r : ℝ) :
    MemLp (U.dampedState n ρ r) 2 Q :=
  (U.radius_square n).mono' (U.dampedState_strong n ρ).of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable
    ((U.dampedState_norm_bound n hρ).mono (fun ω hc => hc r))

damped_equation.exact_header:
theorem damped_equation (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    U.dampedState n ρ t ω = U.state 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω
damped_equation.exact_declaration:
theorem damped_equation (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    U.dampedState n ρ t ω = U.state 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.stopped_equation n] with ω he
  intro t ht
  have hib : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) volume 0 t :=
    (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).1.mono_set' (by
      rw [uIoc_of_le ht.1,uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
      exact Ioc_subset_Ioc_right ht.2)
  have he' : U.clampedState (min t (L.stop n ω : ℝ)) ω = U.clampedState 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, U.stoppedDrift n r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω := by
    rw [clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ⟨le_min ht.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg,(min_le_left _ _).trans ht.2⟩,
      clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩]
    exact he t ht
  have hd := DampedContinuation.extension_integral_equation ρ (L.stop n ω) t
    (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg ht.1 (fun r => U.clampedState r ω)
    (fun r => U.drift r ω) (fun r => L.version n r.toNNReal ω) hib he'
  have hz : U.clampedState 0 ω = U.state 0 ω := by
    rw [clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩]
  rw [hz] at hd
  exact hd

dampedDrift_paths.exact_header:
theorem dampedDrift_paths (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω‖) ≤ U.variationBudget n ρ ω
dampedDrift_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedDrift_paths (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω‖) ≤ U.variationBudget n ρ ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.radius_bound n] with ω hc
  refine ⟨DampedContinuation.drift_integrable ρ (L.stop n ω) _ _ 0 T
    (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).1, ?_⟩
  apply DampedContinuation.drift_variation_le hρ (L.stop n ω) T n (U.radius n ω) T.coe_nonneg
    (fun r => U.clampedState r ω) (fun r => U.drift r ω)
    (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).1 (U.stoppedDrift_paths n ω).2
  intro r hr
  rw [clampedState,timeClamp_eq T
    ⟨le_min hr.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg,(min_le_left _ _).trans hr.2⟩]
  exact hc r hr

minStop_measurable.exact_header:
theorem minStop_measurable (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Measurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => min t (L.stop n ω))
minStop_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem minStop_measurable (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Measurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => min t (L.stop n ω)) := by
  apply measurable_of_Iic
  intro r
  change MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | min t (L.stop n ω) ≤ r}
  by_cases hr : t ≤ r
  · have he : {ω | min t (L.stop n ω) ≤ r} = univ :=
      Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun ω => (min_le_left _ _).trans hr)
    rw [he]
    exact MeasurableSet.univ
  · have he : {ω | min t (L.stop n ω) ≤ r} = {ω | L.stop n ω ≤ r} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq,min_le_iff,hr,false_or]
    rw [he]
    exact D.filtration.mono (le_of_not_ge hr) _ (L.stop_stopping n r)

dampedState_adapted.exact_header:
theorem dampedState_adapted (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.dampedState n ρ t) Q
dampedState_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_adapted (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.dampedState n ρ t) Q := by
  have hx := stopped_raw_aestronglyAdapted Q D (L.stop n) (L.stop_stopping n)
    (fun t : ℝ≥0 => U.clampedState t) U.clampedState_adapted
    (U.clampedState_continuous.mono (fun _ hc => hc.comp continuous_subtype_val)) t
  have hc : Measurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => Real.exp (-ρ * ((t : ℝ) - (min t (L.stop n ω) : ℝ)))) :=
    (((measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (minStop_measurable (L := L) n t)).const_sub (t : ℝ)).const_mul (-ρ)).exp
  have he : U.dampedState n ρ t = fun ω =>
      Real.exp (-ρ * ((t : ℝ) - (min t (L.stop n ω) : ℝ))) • U.clampedState (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω := by
    funext ω
    simp only [dampedState,DampedContinuation.extension,DampedContinuation.damping,NNReal.coe_min]
  rw [he]
  exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.smul hx

energy_integral.exact_header:
theorem energy_integral (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z,W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z,w⟫_ℝ) :
    let e := fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪U.dampedState n ρ r ω,W (U.dampedState n ρ r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
    let w := fun r => 2 * (∫ ω, ⟪U.dampedState n ρ r ω,W (U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      ∫ ω, ∑ i, ⟪L.stoppedSigma n i r ω,W (L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
    IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ S : ℝ≥0, S ≤ T → e S = e 0 + ∫ r in 0..(S : ℝ), w r
energy_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_integral (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z,W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z,w⟫_ℝ) :
    let e := fun r => ∫ ω, ⟪U.dampedState n ρ r ω,W (U.dampedState n ρ r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
    let w := fun r => 2 * (∫ ω, ⟪U.dampedState n ρ r ω,W (U.dampedDrift n ρ r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      ∫ ω, ∑ i, ⟪L.stoppedSigma n i r ω,W (L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
    IntervalIntegrable w volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ S : ℝ≥0, S ≤ T → e S = e 0 + ∫ r in 0..(S : ℝ), w r := by
  refine ConstructedRandomVariationIntegral.energy_integral Q D W hW T
    (L.stoppedSigma n) (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    (U.dampedState n ρ) (U.dampedDrift n ρ) (fun r ω => L.version n r.toNNReal ω)
    (U.dampedState_square n hρ) (U.dampedState_strong n ρ) ?_ ?_ ?_
    (U.dampedDrift_strong n ρ) (U.variationBudget n ρ) (U.variationBudget_square n ρ)
    ((U.dampedState_continuous n ρ).mono (fun _ hc => hc.continuousOn)) ?_
  · intro t ht
    have hh := U.dampedState_adapted n ρ t.toNNReal
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1] using hh
  · intro t
    exact (L.version_martingale n).stronglyAdapted t.toNNReal
  · intro t
    exact L.version_ae n t.toNNReal
  · filter_upwards [U.dampedDrift_paths n hρ,U.damped_equation n ρ] with ω hp he
    refine ⟨hp.1,hp.2,?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [U.dampedState_zero n ρ ω]
    exact he t ht

dampedState_eventually_original.exact_header:
theorem dampedState_eventually_original (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) (ω : Ω) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, U.dampedState n ρ t ω = U.state t ω
dampedState_eventually_original.exact_declaration:
theorem dampedState_eventually_original (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) (ω : Ω) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, U.dampedState n ρ t ω = U.state t ω := by
  filter_upwards [L.stop_eventually_horizon ω] with n hn
  rw [dampedState,hn,DampedContinuation.extension_before ρ T _ ht.2,
    clampedState,timeClamp_eq T ht]

work_product_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_product_integrable (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ⟪U.dampedState n ρ p.1 p.2,W (U.dampedDrift n ρ p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
work_product_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_product_integrable (n : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ⟪U.dampedState n ρ p.1 p.2,W (U.dampedDrift n ρ p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  refine ConstructedRandomVariationWork.work_product_integrable Q D W T
    (L.stoppedSigma n) (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    (U.dampedState n ρ) (U.dampedDrift n ρ) (fun r ω => L.version n r.toNNReal ω)
    (U.dampedState_square n hρ) (U.dampedState_strong n ρ) ?_ ?_ ?_
    (U.dampedDrift_strong n ρ) (U.variationBudget n ρ) (U.variationBudget_square n ρ)
    ((U.dampedState_continuous n ρ).mono (fun _ hc => hc.continuousOn)) ?_
  · intro t ht
    have hh := U.dampedState_adapted n ρ t.toNNReal
    simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1] using hh
  · intro t
    exact (L.version_martingale n).stronglyAdapted t.toNNReal
  · intro t
    exact L.version_ae n t.toNNReal
  · filter_upwards [U.dampedDrift_paths n hρ,U.damped_equation n ρ] with ω hp he
    refine ⟨hp.1,hp.2,?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [U.dampedState_zero n ρ ω]
    exact he t ht

PBGSO/RawDeterministicODE.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawDampedState
import PBGSO.RawLocalLinearMap

/-! # Deterministic optimizer ODEs in actual local raw dynamics
The optimizer has literal zero physical Brownian columns. Zero stochastic
noise is proved by bounded-linear-map naturality of the actual local integral.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawDeterministicODE
