coefficient.exact_declaration:
def coefficient (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (j : ℝ → S)
    (hj : StronglyMeasurable j) (hi : IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := S) Q D T where
  sigma _ _ _ := 0
  sigma_strong _ := stronglyMeasurable_const
  sigma_adapted _ _ := stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable
  q r ω := L.q r ω+‖j r‖
  q_strong := L.q_strong.add (hj.norm.comp_measurable measurable_fst)
  q_nonneg r ω := add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (norm_nonneg _)
  q_local ω := (L.q_local ω).add
    (((intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp hi).norm)
  q_progressive t := by
    have hqj : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => ‖j r‖) p.1) :=
      (hj.norm.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).comp_measurable measurable_fst
    convert (L.q_progressive t).add hqj using 1
    funext p
    by_cases h : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [h]
  sigma_control r ω := by simp; exact add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (norm_nonneg _)

data.exact_header:
def data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (a j : ℝ → S)
    (ha : Continuous a) (hj : StronglyMeasurable j)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (he : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), a t = a 0+∫ r in 0..t,j r) :
    RawDampedState.Data (coefficient L j hj hi)
data.exact_declaration:
def data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (a j : ℝ → S)
    (ha : Continuous a) (hj : StronglyMeasurable j)
    (hi : IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (he : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), a t = a 0+∫ r in 0..t,j r) :
    RawDampedState.Data (coefficient L j hj hi) where
  state r _ := a r
  drift r _ := j r
  state_strong := ha.stronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable measurable_fst
  drift_strong := hj.comp_measurable measurable_fst
  drift_control r ω := le_add_of_nonneg_left (L.q_nonneg r ω)
  initial_square := memLp_const _
  state_adapted _ := stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable
  state_continuous := Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ha.continuousOn)
  equation := by
    have hn := L.localNoise_linearMap_congr (0 : Z →L[ℝ] S) (coefficient L j hj hi)
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl))
    filter_upwards [hn] with ω hn t ht
    rw [hn t.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr ht.2)]
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,add_zero] using he t ht

rawSubtract_square.exact_header:
theorem rawSubtract_square (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (i : I) :

rawSubtract_square.exact_declaration:
theorem rawSubtract_square (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2 - τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hs := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hσ i).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (hσ2 i)
  have ht := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hτ i).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (hτ2 i)
  exact (hs.sub ht).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)

rawDiffusionCurve_sub_ae.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_sub_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (fun i r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      rawDiffusionCurve Q σ - rawDiffusionCurve Q τ
rawDiffusionCurve_sub_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_sub_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (fun i r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      rawDiffusionCurve Q σ - rawDiffusionCurve Q τ := by
  have hs : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ∀ i, MemLp (σ i r) 2 Q :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_memLp (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q (σ i) (hσ i) (hσ2 i))
  have ht : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ∀ i, MemLp (τ i r) 2 Q :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_memLp (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q (τ i) (hτ i) (hτ2 i))
  filter_upwards [hs, ht] with r hs ht
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change sectionLp Q (fun r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω) r = sectionLp Q (σ i) r - sectionLp Q (τ i) r
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [sectionLp_ae Q (fun r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω) ((hs i).sub (ht i)),
    sectionLp_ae Q (σ i) (hs i), sectionLp_ae Q (τ i) (ht i),
    Lp.coeFn_sub (sectionLp Q (σ i) r) (sectionLp Q (τ i) r)] with ω hd hs ht hsub
  rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hd, hs, ht]

rawDiffusionIntegral_sub.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_sub (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (hB : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (τ i t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (fun i r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω)
      (rawSubtract_stronglyMeasurable σ τ hσ hτ) (rawSubtract_square Q T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2)
      (rawSubtract_adapted Q D σ τ hA hB) t =
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t
rawDiffusionIntegral_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_sub (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (hB : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (τ i t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (fun i r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω)
      (rawSubtract_stronglyMeasurable σ τ hσ hτ) (rawSubtract_square Q T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2)
      (rawSubtract_adapted Q D σ τ hA hB) t =
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t := by
  unfold rawDiffusionIntegral
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_eq_of_ae_coefficients Q D T _
    (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ - rawDiffusionCurve Q τ) _
    ((rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ hσ2).sub (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T τ hτ hτ2)) _
    (curveSubtract_adapted Q D (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ) (rawDiffusionCurve Q τ)
      (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D σ hA) (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D τ hB))
    (rawDiffusionCurve_sub_ae Q T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2) t]
  exact predictableCurveIntegral_sub Q D T _ _ _ _ _ _ t

rawDiffusionIntegral_difference_isometry.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_difference_isometry (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (hB : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (τ i t) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W
      ((rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t) -
        (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA s - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB s))
      ((rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t) -
        (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA s - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB s)) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∫ ω, ∑ i,
        ⟪σ i r ω - τ i r ω, W (σ i r ω - τ i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
rawDiffusionIntegral_difference_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_difference_isometry (T : ℝ≥0) (σ τ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hτ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (τ i)))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hτ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖τ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (hB : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (τ i t) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W
      ((rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t) -
        (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA s - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB s))
      ((rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB t) -
        (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ hσ2 hA s - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T τ hτ hτ2 hB s)) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∫ ω, ∑ i,
        ⟪σ i r ω - τ i r ω, W (σ i r ω - τ i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  have h := rawDiffusionIntegral_increment_isometry Q D T (fun i r ω => σ i r ω - τ i r ω)
    (rawSubtract_stronglyMeasurable σ τ hσ hτ) (rawSubtract_square Q T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2)
    (rawSubtract_adapted Q D σ τ hA hB) W hW s t hst ht
  rw [rawDiffusionIntegral_sub Q D T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2 hA hB t,
    rawDiffusionIntegral_sub Q D T σ τ hσ hτ hσ2 hτ2 hA hB s] at h
  exact h

      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ∑ i, ⟪σ i p.1 p.2, W (σ i p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ)

theorem rawDiffusion_weighted_integrable (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ∑ i, ⟪σ i p.1 p.2, W (σ i p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply ((h2 i).const_mul ‖W‖).mono'
    ((hσ i).inner (W.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hσ i))).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro p
  calc
    ‖⟪σ i p.1 p.2, W (σ i p.1 p.2)⟫_ℝ‖ ≤
        ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ * ‖W (σ i p.1 p.2)‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ * (‖W‖ * ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (W.le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖W‖ * ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2 := by ring

theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W
      (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA s)
      (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA s) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∫ ω, ∑ i, ⟪σ i r ω, W (σ i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
rawDiffusionIntegral_increment_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_increment_isometry (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z) (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    weightedPairing Q W
      (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA s)
      (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t - rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA s) =
      ∫ r in Ioc (s : ℝ) t, ∫ ω, ∑ i, ⟪σ i r ω, W (σ i r ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  simp only [rawDiffusionIntegral]
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_increment_isometry Q D T _ _ _ W hW s t hst ht]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  have hle : (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc (s : ℝ) (t : ℝ)) ≤
      volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono_set _ (fun r hr =>
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt s.coe_nonneg hr.1, hr.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast ht)⟩)
  have hsec := (columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q σ hσ h2).filter_mono
    (ae_mono hle)
  filter_upwards [hsec] with r hr
  have hint (i : I) : Integrable (fun ω => ⟪σ i r ω, W (σ i r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q := by
    apply (lp_weighted_pairing_integrable Q W
      ((rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r).ofLp i) ((rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r).ofLp i)).congr
    filter_upwards [hr i] with ω hω
    simp only [rawDiffusionCurve]
    rw [hω]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hint i)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hr i] with ω hω
  simp only [rawDiffusionCurve]
  rw [hω]

    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))

  have hR := columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) R σ hσ h2
  have hQ := columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q
    (fun i r ω => σ i r (f ω)) (rawPullback_stronglyMeasurable hf σ hσ)
    (rawPullback_square hf T σ h2)
  filter_upwards [hR, hQ] with r hr hq
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change sectionLp Q (fun r ω => σ i r (f ω)) r = lpPullbackCLM hf (sectionLp R (σ i) r)
  apply Lp.ext
  have hsec : sectionLp R (σ i) r =ᵐ[R] σ i r := hr i
  have hsecQ : sectionLp Q (fun r ω => σ i r (f ω)) r =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => σ i r (f ω)) := hq i
  filter_upwards [hsecQ, lpPullback_coe hf (sectionLp R (σ i) r),
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hsec] with ω hq hp hs
  change sectionLp R (σ i) r (f ω) = σ i r (f ω) at hs
  exact hq.trans (hp.trans hs).symm

PBGSO/RawDriftGauge.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawDampedState
import PBGSO.RawLocalSolutionTransport
import PBGSO.RawLocalGauge
import PBGSO.DriverNullAugmentation

/-! # Natural raw drift equations acquire a genuine localization gauge
An a.s. pathwise L¹ drift and progressive norm give an everywhere-defined
local energy after the proved initial-null augmentation. No expected drift
moment, quadratic-energy identity, or stochastic-output match is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawDriftGauge
open FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {D : Driver (I := I) Q} {T : ℝ≥0}

/-- A natural original raw equation produces the controlled localization
data. Only an a.s. ordinary drift integral is required, with no spatial L²
drift or expected variation assumption. The returned raw state is literal. -/

end PBGSO.RawDriftGauge

theorem exists_data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h0 : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (x t) Q)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hbi : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hbp : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
        ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => ‖b r p.2‖) p.1))
    (heq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      x t ω = x 0 ω+(∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)+L.localNoise t.toNNReal ω) :
    ∃ K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ U : RawDampedState.Data K,
        U.state = x ∧ (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, U.drift r ω = b r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, K.sigma i r ω = L.sigma i r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω)
exists_data.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T)
    (x b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry x))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h0 : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (x t) Q)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun r => x r ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hbi : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hbp : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
        ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => ‖b r p.2‖) p.1))
    (heq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      x t ω = x 0 ω+(∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)+L.localNoise t.toNNReal ω) :
    ∃ K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ U : RawDampedState.Data K,
        U.state = x ∧ (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, U.drift r ω = b r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, K.sigma i r ω = L.sigma i r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω) := by
  classical
  let E := nullAugmentedDriver Q D
  have hF (t : ℝ≥0) : (pullbackDriver (MeasurePreserving.id Q) D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t := by
    change (D.filtration t).comap id ≤ E.filtration t
    simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_id,E,nullAugmentedDriver] using filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t
  let P := L.pullback (MeasurePreserving.id Q) E hF
  have hn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → P.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω :=
    L.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon (MeasurePreserving.id Q) E hF (fun _ _ => ae_eq_refl _)
  let Good (ω : Ω) := IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  obtain ⟨B,hbad,hBm,hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null (ae_iff.mp hbi)
  let b' : ℝ → Ω → Z := fun r ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else b r ω
  have hb' : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b') :=
    stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise (hBm.preimage measurable_snd) hb
  have hbAE : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, b' r ω = b r ω := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hB0] with ω hω r
    exact ite_eq_right hω
  have hbi' (ω : Ω) : IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖b' r ω‖) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simp only [b',ite_eq_left hω,norm_zero]
      exact integrableOn_zero
    · have hg : Good ω := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hω (hbad hn)
      simpa only [b',ite_eq_right hω,IntegrableOn] using
        ((intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp hg).norm
  have hbp' (t : ℝ≥0) :
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (E.filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => ‖b' r p.2‖) p.1) := by
    have hm : MeasurableSet[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (E.filtration t)]
        {p : ℝ × Ω | p.2 ∈ B} :=
      (measurableSet_nullAugmentation Q (D.filtration t) B hBm hB0).preimage measurable_snd
    have hz : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (E.filtration t)]
        (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => (0 : ℝ)) := stronglyMeasurable_const
    convert hz.piecewise hm (hbp t) using 1
    funext p
    by_cases hω : p.2 ∈ B <;> by_cases hr : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;>
      simp [b',hω,hr]
    all_goals exact Classical.decPred _
  let K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q E T := {
    sigma := P.sigma
    sigma_strong := P.sigma_strong
    sigma_adapted := P.sigma_adapted
    q r ω := P.q r ω+‖b' r ω‖
    q_strong := P.q_strong.add hb'.norm
    q_nonneg r ω := add_nonneg (P.q_nonneg r ω) (norm_nonneg _)
    q_local ω := (P.q_local ω).add (hbi' ω)
    q_progressive t := by
      convert (P.q_progressive t).add (hbp' t) using 1
      funext p
      by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [hp]
    sigma_control r ω := (P.sigma_control r ω).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _)) }
  have hk : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω := by
    filter_upwards [K.localNoise_gauge_congr_of_eq P (fun _ _ _ => rfl),hn] with ω hk hn t ht
    exact (hk t ht).trans (hn t ht)
  let U : RawDampedState.Data K := {
    state := x
    drift := b'
    state_strong := hx
    drift_strong := hb'
    drift_control r ω := le_add_of_nonneg_left (P.q_nonneg r ω)
    initial_square := h0
    state_adapted t := (hA t).mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t)
    state_continuous := hC
    equation := by
      filter_upwards [heq,hbAE,hk] with ω he hb hk t ht
      rw [hk t.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr ht.2)]
      convert he t ht using 2
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r _
      exact hb r }
  exact ⟨K,U,rfl,hbAE,Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ _ => rfl),hk⟩

drift_measurable.exact_header:
theorem drift_measurable
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hb : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hΨ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z => drift M N p.1 p.2)
drift_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_measurable
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hb : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hΨ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z => drift M N p.1 p.2) := by
  have hs : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z => (oneEquiv N p.2).1) :=
    ((oneEquiv N).continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd).fst
  have hz (i : Fin N) : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z => (oneEquiv N p.2).2 i) :=
    (measurable_pi_apply i).comp (((oneEquiv N).continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd).snd)
  have hg : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z =>
      M.particleGradient N (oneEquiv N p.2).1 (oneEquiv N p.2).2) := by
    exact (Finset.measurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hF.comp (hs.prodMk (hz i)))).const_smul _
  have ho : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z =>
      M.particleField N p.1 (oneEquiv N p.2).1 (oneEquiv N p.2).2) :=
    hΨ.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk (hs.prodMk hg))
  have hc : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × OneHilbert N S Z =>
      fun i => M.drift (M.parameter (oneEquiv N p.2).1) ((oneEquiv N p.2).2 i)) := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact hb.comp (hs.prodMk (hz i))
  exact (oneEquiv N).symm.continuous.measurable.comp (ho.prodMk hc)

quadratic_balance.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (x t) Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q)
    (hbx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      (∫ ω, ⟪m T ω, W (m T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q)
quadratic_balance.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_balance (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x : ∀ t, MemLp (x t) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hadapt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (x t) Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q)
    (hbx : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) Q ∧
    (∫ ω, ⟪x T ω, W (x T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) = (∫ ω, ⟪x 0 ω, W (x 0 ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
      2 * (∫ ω, (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ⟪x r ω, W (b r ω)⟫_ℝ) ∂Q) +
      (∫ ω, ⟪m T ω, W (m T ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  let X (t : ℝ) := (h2x t).toLp (x t)
  let N (t : ℝ) := (h2m t).toLp (m t)
  have hVpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c := hpaths.mono (fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  let V := primitiveLp Q T b hbx c hVpaths
  have hX (t : ℝ) : x t =ᵐ[Q] X t := (h2x t).coeFn_toLp.symm
  have hN (t : ℝ) : m t =ᵐ[Q] N t := (h2m t).coeFn_toLp.symm
  have hV (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) =ᵐ[Q] V t :=
    (primitiveLp_ae Q T b hbx c hVpaths t ht).symm
  have hdecomp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : X t = X 0 + V t + N t := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hX t, hX 0, hV t ht, hN t, hpaths,
      Lp.coeFn_add (X 0) (V t), Lp.coeFn_add (X 0 + V t) (N t)]
      with ω hx hz hv hn hp ha hb
    rw [hb, Pi.add_apply, ha, Pi.add_apply, ← hx, ← hz, ← hv, ← hn]
    exact hp.2.2 t ht
  have hN0 : N 0 = 0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hN 0, hpaths, Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q] with ω hn hp hzero
    have hh := hp.2.2 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero] at hh
    have he : x 0 ω + 0 = x 0 ω + m 0 ω := by simpa only [add_zero] using hh
    have hmzero : m 0 ω = 0 := (add_left_cancel he).symm
    rw [← hn, hmzero, hzero]
    rfl
  have ha (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (X t) Q :=
    (hadapt t ht).congr (hX t)
  obtain ⟨R, hRm, hR0, hR2, hRB, hRbound⟩ := DoobStrongL2.exists_continuous_radius Q F m
    hmart h2m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ⟨0, le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩ T (fun _ ht => ht.2) hmcont
  let C (ω : Ω) := ‖x 0 ω‖ + c + R ω
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := ((h2x 0).norm.add (memLp_const c)).add hR2
  have hCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hC2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hC2
  have hpC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω ∧ ‖m t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω := by
    filter_upwards [hxcont, hmcont, hpaths, hRbound] with ω hx hm hp hr
    have hCnon : 0 ≤ C ω := by
      exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hc) (hR0 ω)
    refine ⟨hx, hm, hp.1, hCnon, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have hv := (primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2.1
      constructor
      · rw [hp.2.2 t ht]
        apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
        dsimp [C]
        linarith [norm_add_le (x 0 ω) (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω), hr t ht]
      · exact (hr t ht).trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω])
    · exact hp.2.1.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω])
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := PathwiseMartingaleEnergy.quadratic_balance Q F W hW T X V N x b m C
    hmart hN hX hV hN0 hdecomp ha hCi hpC
  have hpairX (t : ℝ) : weightedPairing Q W (X t) (X t) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪x t ω, W (x t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hX t] with ω hω
    rw [← hω]
  have hpairN (t : ℝ) : weightedPairing Q W (N t) (N t) =
      ∫ ω, ⟪m t ω, W (m t ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
    rw [weightedPairing_apply, lp_weighted_pairing_eq_integral]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hN t] with ω hω
    rw [← hω]
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hpairX, hpairN] using he

/-! # Invariant frozen transition kernels and actual stationary samplers

The kernel is computed by integrating a jointly measurable frozen strong
solver over its independent Brownian seed. Its action on an initial law is
proved to equal the original raw solver marginal, by product-measure Fubini.
Thus kernel invariance, rather than a supplied all-time marginal identity,
constructs the stationary local sampler used in the source theorem.

The existence of this frozen strong solver is explicit. This file does not
derive weak-to-strong existence or uniqueness in law from source A1.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.RawFrozenKernel

section Kernel
variable {Z Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (R : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure R]

/-- The actual frozen transition probability from an independent noise seed. -/



/-- The transition action is exactly the raw solver law on initial × noise.
No law-coherence hypothesis is used. -/

/-- Invariance for the computed transition kernel gives the original raw
marginal identity; the identity is derived rather than assumed. -/

end Kernel

section Frozen
open FilteredBrownian RawLocalStationarity ConstructedItoLaw
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (T : ℝ≥0)
  (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

/-- A genuine canonical frozen strong solver. It contains its original local
SDE, not a stationarity or law-evolution conclusion. Its noise is the actual
constructed Brownian local integral. -/

variable {M T ν}

/-- The actual frozen transition kernel generated by the supplied strong
solver and the original canonical independent Brownian seed. -/


/-- Source frozen invariance, interpreted for the actual strong transition
kernel, constructs the stationary raw sampler. Initial L² and every marginal
identity are derived from the initial law and kernel action. -/

/-- The source stationary complete-state product law, from invariance of

No all-time sampler marginal equality is a premise. -/

end Frozen

transition.exact_header: def transition (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) : Kernel Z Z
transition.exact_declaration:
def transition (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) : Kernel Z Z where
  toFun z := R.map (fun ω => f (z, ω))
  measurable' := by
    have h := (Measure.measurable_map f hf).comp
      (Measurable.map_prodMk_left (ν := R) (α := Z))
    convert h using 1
    funext z
    exact (Measure.map_map hf measurable_prodMk_left).symm

transition_apply.exact_header:
theorem transition_apply (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) (z : Z) :
    transition R f hf z = R.map (fun ω => f (z, ω))
transition_apply.exact_declaration:
theorem transition_apply (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) (z : Z) :
    transition R f hf z = R.map (fun ω => f (z, ω)) := rfl

transition_markov.exact_header:
instance transition_markov (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) :
    IsMarkovKernel (transition R f hf)
transition_markov.exact_declaration:
instance transition_markov (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) :
    IsMarkovKernel (transition R f hf) where
  isProbabilityMeasure z := (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
    (hf.comp measurable_prodMk_left).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance

transition_comp.exact_header:
theorem transition_comp (μ : Measure Z) [SFinite μ]
    (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (transition R f hf) ∘ₘ μ = (μ.prod R).map f
transition_comp.exact_declaration:
theorem transition_comp (μ : Measure Z) [SFinite μ]
    (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (transition R f hf) ∘ₘ μ = (μ.prod R).map f := by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.bind_apply hs (transition R f hf).aemeasurable,
    Measure.map_apply hf hs, Measure.prod_apply (hf hs)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro z
  exact Measure.map_apply (hf.comp measurable_prodMk_left) hs

marginal_of_invariant.exact_header:
theorem marginal_of_invariant (μ : Measure Z) [SFinite μ]
    (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hinvariant : transition R f hf ∘ₘ μ = μ) :
    (μ.prod R).map f = μ
marginal_of_invariant.exact_declaration:
theorem marginal_of_invariant (μ : Measure Z) [SFinite μ]
    (f : Z × Ω → Z) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hinvariant : transition R f hf ∘ₘ μ = μ) :
    (μ.prod R).map f = μ := (transition_comp R μ f hf).symm.trans hinvariant

Solver.exact_declaration:
structure Solver (sStar : S) where
  sampler : SamplerData (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
    (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T (fun _ => sStar)
  initial : sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] Prod.fst

Solver.kernel.exact_header:
def Solver.kernel {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Kernel Z Z
Solver.kernel.exact_declaration:
def Solver.kernel {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Kernel Z Z :=
  transition (brownianProbability (I := I)) (F.sampler.state t)
    (F.sampler.measurable t ht)

Solver.marginal.exact_header:
theorem Solver.marginal {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map
      (F.sampler.state t)
Solver.marginal.exact_declaration:
theorem Solver.marginal {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map
      (F.sampler.state t) :=
  transition_comp _ _ _ _

Solver.stationary.exact_header:
def Solver.stationary {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hinvariant : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)), F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = ν) :
    FrozenSamplerData (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T sStar ν
Solver.stationary.exact_declaration:
def Solver.stationary {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hinvariant : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)), F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = ν) :
    FrozenSamplerData (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T sStar ν where
  toSamplerData := F.sampler
  initial_square := by
    have hfst : MemLp (Prod.fst : Z × ULA.CanonicalBrownian.VectorSample I → Z) 2
        (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) :=
      hν.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_fst
        (μ := ν) (ν := brownianProbability (I := I)))
    exact (memLp_congr_ae F.initial).mpr hfst
  invariant_law t ht := (F.marginal t ht).symm.trans (hinvariant t ht)

stationary_product_law.exact_header:
theorem stationary_product_law {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    [MeasurableSpace S]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hinvariant : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)), F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = ν)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : M.meanGradient ν sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] Prod.fst)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map
      (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) =
        (Measure.dirac sStar).prod ν
stationary_product_law.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_product_law {sStar : S} (F : Solver M T ν sStar)
    [MeasurableSpace S]
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hinvariant : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)), F.kernel t ht ∘ₘ ν = ν)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) ν)
    (hg : M.meanGradient ν sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] Prod.fst)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map
      (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) =
        (Measure.dirac sStar).prod ν :=
  RawLocalStationarity.stationary_product_law hunique
    (F.stationary hν hinvariant) hint hg hfix U hs (hz.trans F.initial.symm) t ht

filtration.exact_header: def filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin N → Ω))
filtration.exact_declaration:
def filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin N → Ω)) where
  seq t := @MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin N) (fun _ => Ω) (fun _ => D.filtration t)
  mono' s t h := by
    change (⨆ i : Fin N, (D.filtration s).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i)) ≤
      ⨆ i : Fin N, (D.filtration t).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i)
    exact iSup_mono (fun _ => MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (D.filtration.mono h))
  le' t := by
    change (⨆ i : Fin N, (D.filtration t).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i)) ≤
      ⨆ i : Fin N, mΩ.comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i)
    exact iSup_mono (fun _ => MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (D.filtration.le t))

eval_filtration_le.exact_header:
theorem eval_filtration_le (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (D.filtration t).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i) ≤ filtration Q D N t
eval_filtration_le.exact_declaration:
theorem eval_filtration_le (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (D.filtration t).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i) ≤ filtration Q D N t := by
  exact le_iSup (fun j : Fin N => (D.filtration t).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω j)) i

process.exact_header: def process (ij : Fin N × I) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : ℝ
process.exact_declaration: def process (ij : Fin N × I) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : ℝ := D.process ij.2 t (ω ij.1)

adapted.exact_header: theorem adapted (ij : Fin N × I) : StronglyAdapted (filtration Q D N) (process Q D N ij)
adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem adapted (ij : Fin N × I) : StronglyAdapted (filtration Q D N) (process Q D N ij) := by
  intro t
  exact (D.adapted ij.2 t).comp_measurable (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (eval_filtration_le Q D N ij.1 t))

increment_independent.exact_header:
theorem increment_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    iIndepFun (fun ij (ω : Fin N → Ω) => process Q D N ij t ω-process Q D N ij s ω)
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
increment_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem increment_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    iIndepFun (fun ij (ω : Fin N → Ω) => process Q D N ij t ω-process Q D N ij s ω)
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
  change iIndepFun (fun (ij : Fin N × I) (ω : Fin N → Ω) => D.process ij.2 t (ω ij.1)-D.process ij.2 s (ω ij.1)) _
  apply iIndepFun_uncurry' (X := fun (i : Fin N) (j : I) (ω : Fin N → Ω) =>
    D.process j t (ω i)-D.process j s (ω i))
  · intro i j
    exact ((increment_measurable Q D s t j).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  · exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ : Fin N =>
      (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j => increment_measurable Q D s t j).aemeasurable)
  · intro i
    exact (pullbackDriver (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i) D).increment_coordinates s t hst

PastSpace.exact_header: def PastSpace (D : Driver (I := I) Q) (s : ℝ≥0)
PastSpace.exact_declaration: def PastSpace (D : Driver (I := I) Q) (s : ℝ≥0) := Ω

pastSpaceMeasurable.exact_header: instance pastSpaceMeasurable (s : ℝ≥0) : MeasurableSpace (PastSpace Q D s)
pastSpaceMeasurable.exact_declaration: instance pastSpaceMeasurable (s : ℝ≥0) : MeasurableSpace (PastSpace Q D s) := D.filtration s

future_independent.exact_header:
theorem future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun (ω : Fin N → Ω) ij => process Q D N ij t ω-process Q D N ij s ω) inferInstance)
      (filtration Q D N s) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
future_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem future_independent (s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun (ω : Fin N → Ω) ij => process Q D N ij t ω-process Q D N ij s ω) inferInstance)
      (filtration Q D N s) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
  let X : Fin N → (Fin N → Ω) → (I → ℝ) :=
    fun i ω j => D.process j t (ω i)-D.process j s (ω i)
  let Y : Fin N → (Fin N → Ω) → PastSpace Q D s := fun i ω => ω i
  have hX (i : Fin N) : Measurable (X i) := measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j =>
    (increment_measurable Q D s t j).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hY (i : Fin N) : Measurable (Y i) := by
    exact (measurable_pi_apply i).mono le_rfl (D.filtration.le s)
  have hpair : iIndepFun (fun i ω => (X i ω,Y i ω))
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
    exact iIndepFun_pi (X := fun (_ : Fin N) (ω : Ω) =>
      ((fun j : I => D.process j t ω-D.process j s ω),(show PastSpace Q D s from ω)))
      (fun _ => ((measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j => increment_measurable Q D s t j).prodMk
        (show @Measurable Ω (PastSpace Q D s) mΩ (D.filtration s) id from
          measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (by simpa using D.filtration.le s))).aemeasurable)
  have hxy (i : Fin N) : IndepFun (X i) (Y i) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
    have hi := (pullbackDriver (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i) D).future_independent s t hst
    change Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap
      (fun ω j => D.process j t (ω i)-D.process j s (ω i)) inferInstance)
      ((D.filtration s).comap (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ω i))
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
    exact hi
  have hv := independent_pair_vectors (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
    X Y (fun i => (hX i).aemeasurable) (fun i => (hY i).aemeasurable) hpair hxy
  have hv' : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω i => X i ω) inferInstance)
      (filtration Q D N s) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
    have hYid : (fun (ω : Fin N → Ω) i => Y i ω) = id := rfl
    rw [hYid] at hv
    simpa only [IndepFun,Kernel.IndepFun,Indep,MeasurableSpace.comap_id,
      filtration,pastSpaceMeasurable] using hv
  have hflat : Measurable (fun h : Fin N → I → ℝ => fun ij : Fin N × I => h ij.1 ij.2) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun ij => (measurable_pi_apply ij.2).comp (measurable_pi_apply ij.1)
  apply indep_of_indep_of_le_left hv'
  have hh := MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (g := fun ω i => X i ω) hflat.comap_le
  simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp,Function.comp_def,X,process] using hh

driver.exact_header: def driver : Driver (I := Fin N × I) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
driver.exact_declaration:
def driver : Driver (I := Fin N × I) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) where
  process := process Q D N
  brownian ij := ⟨fun J => (D.brownian ij.2).hasLaw J |>.comp
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) ij.1).hasLaw⟩
  filtration := filtration Q D N
  adapted := adapted Q D N
  increment_coordinates := increment_independent Q D N
  future_independent := future_independent Q D N

rowDriver.exact_header: def rowDriver (i : Fin N) : Driver (I := I) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
rowDriver.exact_declaration:
def rowDriver (i : Fin N) : Driver (I := I) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) where
  process j := (driver Q D N).process (i,j)
  brownian j := (driver Q D N).brownian (i,j)
  filtration := (driver Q D N).filtration
  adapted j := (driver Q D N).adapted (i,j)
  increment_coordinates s t hst := ((driver Q D N).increment_coordinates s t hst).precomp
    (g := fun j => (i,j)) (fun _ _ h => (Prod.mk.inj h).2)
  future_independent s t hst := by
    apply indep_of_indep_of_le_left ((driver Q D N).future_independent s t hst)
    have hm : Measurable (fun x : Fin N × I → ℝ => fun j => x (i,j)) :=
      measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun j => measurable_pi_apply (i,j)
    have hh := MeasurableSpace.comap_mono
      (g := fun ω ij => (driver Q D N).process ij t ω-(driver Q D N).process ij s ω) hm.comap_le
    simpa only [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp,Function.comp_def] using hh

fin_countablyGenerated.exact_header: theorem fin_countablyGenerated (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated (Fin n → Ω)
fin_countablyGenerated.exact_declaration:
theorem fin_countablyGenerated (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated (Fin n → Ω) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨⟨∅, Set.countable_empty, ?_⟩⟩
      simp [MeasurableSpace.pi]
  | succ n hn =>
      letI := hn
      let e := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => Ω) 0
      have h := MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated.comap (e : (Fin (n+1) → Ω) → _)
      rwa [e.measurableEmbedding.comap_eq] at h

pi_separable.exact_header: local instance pi_separable : IsSeparable (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q))
pi_separable.exact_declaration:
local instance pi_separable : IsSeparable (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q)) := by
  letI := fin_countablyGenerated (Ω := Ω) N
  infer_instance

seeds_separable.exact_header: local instance seeds_separable : IsSeparable (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
seeds_separable.exact_declaration: local instance seeds_separable : IsSeparable (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := pi_separable Q N

seeds_isSeparable.exact_header: theorem seeds_isSeparable : IsSeparable (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
seeds_isSeparable.exact_declaration:
theorem seeds_isSeparable : IsSeparable (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) :=
  seeds_separable Q N

copy.exact_header:
def copy (i : Fin N) : RawLocalStationarity.Data
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (rowDriver Q D N i) M T
copy.exact_declaration:
def copy (i : Fin N) : RawLocalStationarity.Data
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (rowDriver Q D N i) M T :=
  U.pullback (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i) (rowDriver Q D N i)
    (fun t => eval_filtration_le Q D N i t) (fun _ _ => Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))

copy_optimizer.exact_header: @[simp] theorem copy_optimizer (i : Fin N) : (copy Q D N U i).optimizer = U.optimizer
copy_optimizer.exact_declaration: @[simp] theorem copy_optimizer (i : Fin N) : (copy Q D N U i).optimizer = U.optimizer := rfl

copy_state.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem copy_state (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
    (copy Q D N U i).sampler.state t ω = U.sampler.state t (ω i)
copy_state.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem copy_state (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
    (copy Q D N U i).sampler.state t ω = U.sampler.state t (ω i) := rfl

cloud.exact_header: def cloud (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : Fin N → Z
cloud.exact_declaration: def cloud (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : Fin N → Z := fun i => U.sampler.state t (ω i)

cloud_measurable.exact_header: theorem cloud_measurable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Measurable (cloud Q D N U t)
cloud_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem cloud_measurable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Measurable (cloud Q D N U t) :=
  IndependentCopies.cloud_measurable _ (U.sampler.measurable t ht)

cloud_law.exact_header:
theorem cloud_law (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map (cloud Q D N U t) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler.state t))
cloud_law.exact_declaration:
theorem cloud_law (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map (cloud Q D N U t) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler.state t)) :=
  IndependentCopies.cloud_law Q _ (U.sampler.measurable t ht)

trajectories_independent.exact_header:
theorem trajectories_independent :
    iIndepFun (fun i (ω : Fin N → Ω) (t : Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) => U.sampler.state t (ω i))
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
trajectories_independent.exact_declaration:
theorem trajectories_independent :
    iIndepFun (fun i (ω : Fin N → Ω) (t : Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) => U.sampler.state t (ω i))
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
  exact iIndepFun_pi (fun _ : Fin N =>
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t : Icc 0 (T : ℝ) => U.sampler.measurable t t.property)).aemeasurable)

copy_law.exact_header:
theorem copy_law (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.state t) =
      Q.map (U.sampler.state t)
copy_law.exact_declaration:
theorem copy_law (i : Fin N) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.state t) =
      Q.map (U.sampler.state t) :=
  U.sampler.pullback_law (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i)
    (rowDriver Q D N i) (fun t => eval_filtration_le Q D N i t)
    (fun _ _ => Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)) t ht

physical_columns.exact_header:
theorem physical_columns :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ j : I,
      (copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.sigma j t ω =
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (cloud Q D N U t ω i) j
physical_columns.exact_declaration:
theorem physical_columns :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ j : I,
      (copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.sigma j t ω =
        M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (cloud Q D N U t ω i) j := by
  exact ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (copy Q D N U i).sampler.diffusion_realizes)

coordinate_equations.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_equations :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      cloud Q D N U t ω i = cloud Q D N U 0 ω i +
        (∫ r in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (cloud Q D N U r ω i)) +
          (copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t.toNNReal ω
coordinate_equations.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_equations :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      cloud Q D N U t ω i = cloud Q D N U 0 ω i +
        (∫ r in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (cloud Q D N U r ω i)) +
          (copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t.toNNReal ω := by
  exact ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (copy Q D N U i).sampler.equation)

cloud_adapted.exact_header:
theorem cloud_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(driver Q D N).filtration t] (cloud Q D N U t)
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
cloud_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem cloud_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[(driver Q D N).filtration t] (cloud Q D N U t)
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
  let f : (Fin N → Ω) → Fin N → Z := fun ω i =>
    ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.adapted t).mk ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.state t) ω
  have hh (i : Fin N) : StronglyMeasurable[(driver Q D N).filtration t] (fun ω => f ω i) :=
    ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.adapted t).stronglyMeasurable_mk
  have hf : StronglyMeasurable[(driver Q D N).filtration t] f := by
    letI : MeasurableSpace (Fin N → Ω) := (driver Q D N).filtration t
    exact (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => (hh i).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
  refine ⟨f,hf,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ((copy Q D N U i).sampler.adapted t).ae_eq_mk)] with ω hω
  exact funext hω

PBGSO/RawIntegralCLM.lean.scope_note: The original raw field is jointly strongly measurable, adapted and square integrable on the finite horizon. Transformed measurability, square integrability and adaptation are derived. No matching coefficient curve, stochastic output or integral identity is assumed.
PBGSO/RawIntegralCLM.lean.shared_context:

are all transported through the given continuous linear map. No stochastic

-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter

namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (L : Z →L[ℝ] Y)

/-- Apply the state map to each actual square-integrable noise column. -/



variable (D : Driver (I := I) Q)









/-- Literal closure membership is preserved by the state map. -/




/-- Actual past measurability is preserved by the state map. -/



section Raw
open PBGSO.ProductLpSections

/-- The transformed raw diffusion remains jointly strongly measurable. -/

/-- Its expected integrated square is derived from boundedness of the map. -/

/-- Raw adaptation is inherited directly from the original coefficient. -/

/-- Actual raw spatial sections commute with the state map outside one
horizon time-null set. Exceptional non-L² sections create no extra premise. -/

/-- The actual computed raw stochastic integral commutes with every bounded
linear state map. All finite-step, closure, section, and noise identities are
proved; no matching stochastic-output hypothesis is required. -/
end Raw
