columnMapCLM.exact_header:
def columnMapCLM : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]
    ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Y) Q
columnMapCLM.exact_declaration:
def columnMapCLM : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]
    ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Y) Q where
  toFun U := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => L.compLpL 2 Q (U i))
  map_add' U V := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    exact map_add (L.compLpL 2 Q) (U i) (V i)
  map_smul' c U := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    exact map_smul (L.compLpL 2 Q) c (U i)
  cont := (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : I => Lp Y 2 Q)).symm.continuous.comp
    (continuous_pi fun i => (L.compLpL 2 Q).continuous.comp
      (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : I => Lp Z 2 Q) i).continuous)

columnMapCLM_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem columnMapCLM_apply (U : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (i : I) :
    columnMapCLM Q L U i = L.compLpL 2 Q (U i)
columnMapCLM_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem columnMapCLM_apply (U : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (i : I) :
    columnMapCLM Q L U i = L.compLpL 2 Q (U i) := rfl

timeMapCLM.exact_declaration: def timeMapCLM := (columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

mapCoefficient.exact_header:
def mapCoefficient {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    Coefficient (Z := Y) Q D t
mapCoefficient.exact_declaration:
def mapCoefficient {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    Coefficient (Z := Y) Q D t where
  value i ω := L (A.value i ω)
  adapted i := L.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (A.adapted i)
  square i := L.comp_memLp' (A.square i)

mapCoefficient_toLp.exact_header:
theorem mapCoefficient_toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    (mapCoefficient Q L D A).toLp = columnMapCLM Q L A.toLp
mapCoefficient_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem mapCoefficient_toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    (mapCoefficient Q L D A).toLp = columnMapCLM Q L A.toLp := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [((mapCoefficient Q L D A).square i).coeFn_toLp,
    L.coeFn_compLpL ((A.square i).toLp (A.value i)),
    (A.square i).coeFn_toLp] with ω hnew hL hold
  change (((mapCoefficient Q L D A).square i).toLp _) ω = _ at hnew
  change (((mapCoefficient Q L D A).square i).toLp _) ω =
    (L.compLpL 2 Q ((A.square i).toLp (A.value i))) ω
  rw [hnew, hL, hold]
  rfl

mapCoefficients.exact_header:
def mapCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Y) Q D τ
mapCoefficients.exact_declaration:
def mapCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Y) Q D τ := fun k => mapCoefficient Q L D (A k)

coefficientStep_map.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_map (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D τ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n =
      timeMapCLM Q L (coefficientStep Q D τ A n)
coefficientStep_map.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_map (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q D τ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n =
      timeMapCLM Q L (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) := by
  simp only [coefficientStep, mapCoefficients, mapCoefficient_toLp, timeMapCLM, time_grid_map]

stochasticStep_map.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_map (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D τ hτ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n)
stochasticStep_map.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_map (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q D τ hτ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n).coeFn_toLp,
    L.coeFn_compLpL (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n),
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp] with ω hnew hL hold
  change (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ (mapCoefficients Q L D τ A) n) ω = _ at hnew
  change (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω at hold
  rw [hnew, hL, hold]
  simp only [gridSum, noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, map_sum, map_smul,
    mapCoefficients, mapCoefficient]

mapFiniteStep.exact_header:
def mapFiniteStep (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    FiniteStepData (Z := Y) Q D G

finiteStepInput_map.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem finiteStepInput_map (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepInput Q D G (mapFiniteStep Q L D G A) = timeMapCLM Q L (finiteStepInput Q D G A)
finiteStepInput_map.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem finiteStepInput_map (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepInput Q D G (mapFiniteStep Q L D G A) = timeMapCLM Q L (finiteStepInput Q D G A) :=
  coefficientStep_map Q L D (G.time A.1) A.2 (G.count A.1)

finiteStepOutput_map.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem finiteStepOutput_map (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepOutput Q D G (mapFiniteStep Q L D G A) = L.compLpL 2 Q (finiteStepOutput Q D G A)
finiteStepOutput_map.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem finiteStepOutput_map (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepOutput Q D G (mapFiniteStep Q L D G A) = L.compLpL 2 Q (finiteStepOutput Q D G A) :=
  stochasticStep_map Q L D (G.time A.1) (G.monotone A.1) A.2 (G.count A.1)

mapClosedDomain.exact_header:
def mapClosedDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Y) Q D G
mapClosedDomain.exact_declaration:
def mapClosedDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Y) Q D G := by
  refine ⟨timeMapCLM Q L u.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  have hlim := ((timeMapCLM (I := I) Q L).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto hlim
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro n
  change timeMapCLM Q L (finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) ∈ _
  rw [← finiteStepInput_map Q L D G (A n)]
  exact subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self _)

closedStepIntegral_map.exact_header:
theorem closedStepIntegral_map (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q D G (mapClosedDomain Q L D G u) =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (closedStepIntegral Q D G u)
closedStepIntegral_map.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_map (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q D G (mapClosedDomain Q L D G u) =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (closedStepIntegral Q D G u) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  have hB : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q D G (mapFiniteStep Q L D G (A n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (mapClosedDomain Q L D G u).val) := by
    simpa only [finiteStepInput_map, Function.comp_def, mapClosedDomain] using
      ((timeMapCLM (I := I) Q L).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA
  have h1 := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G (fun n => mapFiniteStep Q L D G (A n))
    (mapClosedDomain Q L D G u) hB
  have h2 := ((L.compLpL 2 Q).continuous.tendsto (closedStepIntegral Q D G u)).comp
    (closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G A u hA)
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique h1
  simpa only [finiteStepOutput_map, Function.comp_def] using h2

timeCut_map.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_map (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeMapCLM Q L U) s t = timeMapCLM Q L (timeCut Q U s t)
timeCut_map.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_map (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) :
    timeCut Q (timeMapCLM Q L U) s t = timeMapCLM Q L (timeCut Q U s t) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (timeMapCLM Q L U) s t,
    (columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).coeFn_compLpL U,
    (columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).coeFn_compLpL (timeCut Q U s t),
    timeCut_coe Q U s t] with r hcut hU hT hmask
  change (timeMapCLM Q L U) r = columnMapCLM Q L (U r) at hU
  change (timeMapCLM Q L (timeCut Q U s t)) r = _ at hT
  rw [hcut, hT, hmask]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hU]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero]

closedIntegral_map.exact_header:
theorem closedIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T (mapClosedDomain Q L D (dyadicGrids T) u) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (closedIntegral Q D T u t)
closedIntegral_map.exact_declaration:
theorem closedIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0)
    (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T (mapClosedDomain Q L D (dyadicGrids T) u) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (closedIntegral Q D T u t) := by
  have he : closedCutDomain Q D T (mapClosedDomain Q L D (dyadicGrids T) u) 0 t =
      mapClosedDomain Q L D (dyadicGrids T) (closedCutDomain Q D T u 0 t) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact timeCut_map Q L u.val 0 t
  rw [closedIntegral, he, closedStepIntegral_map]
  rfl

columnMap_adapted.exact_header:
theorem columnMap_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (U : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hU : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] U Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.compLpL 2 Q U) Q
columnMap_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem columnMap_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (U : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hU : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] U Q) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.compLpL 2 Q U) Q := by
  refine ⟨L ∘ hU.mk U, L.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable hU.stronglyMeasurable_mk, ?_⟩
  exact (L.coeFn_compLpL U).trans (hU.ae_eq_mk.fun_comp L)

curveHorizon_map.exact_header:
theorem curveHorizon_map (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))) :
    curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r)) ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu) =
      timeMapCLM Q L (curveHorizon Q T u hu)
curveHorizon_map.exact_declaration:
theorem curveHorizon_map (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))) :
    curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r)) ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu) =
      timeMapCLM Q L (curveHorizon Q T u hu) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [curveHorizon_coe Q T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r))
      ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu), curveHorizon_coe Q T u hu,
    (columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).coeFn_compLpL (curveHorizon Q T u hu)] with r hnew hold hL
  change (timeMapCLM Q L (curveHorizon Q T u hu)) r = _ at hL
  rw [hnew, hL, hold]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, map_zero]

predictableCurveIntegral_map.exact_header:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q D T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r))
      ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => columnMap_adapted Q L D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hU t)
predictableCurveIntegral_map.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q D T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r))
      ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r i => columnMap_adapted Q L D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hU t) := by
  let UZ := predictableDomain Q D T (curveHorizon Q T u hu) (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T u hu hU)
  let UY := predictableDomain Q D T
    (curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (u r)) ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' hu))
    (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T _ _ (fun r i => columnMap_adapted Q L D r ((u r).ofLp i) (hU r i)))
  have he : UY = mapClosedDomain Q L D (dyadicGrids T) UZ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change timeCut Q (curveHorizon Q T _ _) 0 T = timeMapCLM Q L (timeCut Q (curveHorizon Q T u hu) 0 T)
    rw [curveHorizon_map, timeCut_map]
  change closedIntegral Q D T UY t = L.compLpL 2 Q (closedIntegral Q D T UZ t)
  rw [he, closedIntegral_map]

rawMap_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem rawMap_stronglyMeasurable (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i))) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => L (σ i p.1 p.2))
rawMap_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem rawMap_stronglyMeasurable (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i))) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => L (σ i p.1 p.2)) :=
  L.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hσ i)

rawMap_square.exact_header:
theorem rawMap_square (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L (σ i p.1 p.2)‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
rawMap_square.exact_declaration:
theorem rawMap_square (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L (σ i p.1 p.2)‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hs := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hσ i).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (h2 i)
  exact (L.comp_memLp' hs).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)

rawMap_adapted.exact_header:
theorem rawMap_adapted (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => L (σ i t ω)) Q
rawMap_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem rawMap_adapted (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => L (σ i t ω)) Q := by
  refine ⟨L ∘ (hA t i).mk (σ i t),
    L.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (hA t i).stronglyMeasurable_mk, ?_⟩
  exact (hA t i).ae_eq_mk.fun_comp L

rawDiffusionCurve_map.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_map (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (fun i r ω => L (σ i r ω)) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r))
rawDiffusionCurve_map.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_map (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (fun i r ω => L (σ i r ω)) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r)) := by
  have hZ := columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q σ hσ h2
  have hY := columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q
    (fun i r ω => L (σ i r ω)) (rawMap_stronglyMeasurable L σ hσ)
    (rawMap_square Q L T σ hσ h2)
  filter_upwards [hZ, hY] with r hz hy
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change sectionLp Q (fun r ω => L (σ i r ω)) r = L.compLpL 2 Q (sectionLp Q (σ i) r)
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [hy i, L.coeFn_compLpL (sectionLp Q (σ i) r), hz i] with ω hnew hL hold
  exact hnew.trans (hL.trans (congrArg L hold)).symm

rawDiffusionIntegral_map.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (fun i r ω => L (σ i r ω))
      (rawMap_stronglyMeasurable L σ hσ) (rawMap_square Q L T σ hσ h2)
      (rawMap_adapted Q L D σ hA) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t)
rawDiffusionIntegral_map.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_map (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (fun i r ω => L (σ i r ω))
      (rawMap_stronglyMeasurable L σ hσ) (rawMap_square Q L T σ hσ h2)
      (rawMap_adapted Q L D σ hA) t =
      L.compLpL 2 Q (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t) := by
  unfold rawDiffusionIntegral
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_eq_of_ae_coefficients Q D T _
    (fun r => columnMapCLM Q L (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r)) _
    ((columnMapCLM (I := I) Q L).comp_memLp' (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2)) _
    (fun r i => columnMap_adapted Q L D r ((rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r).ofLp i)
      (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D σ hA r i)) (rawDiffusionCurve_map Q L T σ hσ h2) t]
  exact predictableCurveIntegral_map Q L D T (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ)
    (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2) (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D σ hA) t

PBGSO/RawIntegralNoiseEmbedding.lean.scope_note: The index injection and actual coordinate identities are explicit. Coefficient embeddings, zero-column sums, approximation and integral equality are derived; no stochastic-output equality is supplied.
PBGSO/RawIntegralNoiseEmbedding.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawDiffusionTransport

/-! # Literal inclusion of Brownian noise coordinates
Injecting a finite set of Brownian coordinates into a larger Driver and
padding its original diffusion columns by zero leaves the actual stochastic
integral unchanged. All coefficient/domain identities are derived from the
finite sums and their actual Hilbert completion.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I J Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]




variable (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (f : I ↪ J)





variable (D : Driver (I := I) Q) (E : Driver (I := J) Q)
  (hF : D.filtration = E.filtration)
  (hp : ∀ i t, D.process i t = E.process (f i) t)
include hF hp
















omit hF hp






omit hF
/-- The actual original Brownian integral is unchanged by a literal
injection of its noise indices into the full common Driver. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

embedFamily.exact_header: def embedFamily {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (j : J) : V
embedFamily.exact_declaration:
def embedFamily {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (j : J) : V :=
  ∑ i, if f i = j then u i else 0

embedFamily_image.exact_header:
theorem embedFamily_image {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (i : I) :
    embedFamily f u (f i) = u i
embedFamily_image.exact_declaration:
theorem embedFamily_image {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (i : I) :
    embedFamily f u (f i) = u i := by
  simp [embedFamily, f.injective.eq_iff]

embedFamily_outside.exact_header:
theorem embedFamily_outside {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (j : J)
    (hj : j ∉ range f) : embedFamily f u j = 0
embedFamily_outside.exact_declaration:
theorem embedFamily_outside {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] (f : I ↪ J) (u : I → V) (j : J)
    (hj : j ∉ range f) : embedFamily f u j = 0 := by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  exact ite_eq_right (fun h => hj ⟨i,h⟩)

columnEmbedCLM.exact_header:
def columnEmbedCLM : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]
    ColumnHilbert (I := J) (Z := Z) Q
columnEmbedCLM.exact_declaration:
def columnEmbedCLM : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]
    ColumnHilbert (I := J) (Z := Z) Q where
  toFun u := WithLp.toLp 2 (embedFamily f u.ofLp)
  map_add' u v := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    change (∑ i, if f i = j then u.ofLp i + v.ofLp i else 0) =
      (∑ i, if f i = j then u.ofLp i else 0) + ∑ i, if f i = j then v.ofLp i else 0
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    split_ifs <;> simp
  map_smul' c u := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    change (∑ i, if f i = j then c • u.ofLp i else 0) =
      c • ∑ i, if f i = j then u.ofLp i else 0
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    split_ifs <;> simp
  cont := (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : J => Lp Z 2 Q)).symm.continuous.comp
    (continuous_pi fun j => continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => by
      by_cases h : f i = j
      · simpa only [ite_eq_left h, Function.comp_def] using ((continuous_apply i).comp (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : I => Lp Z 2 Q)))
      · simpa only [ite_eq_right h] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ :
          ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q => (0 : Lp Z 2 Q)))))

columnEmbed_image.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem columnEmbed_image (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (i : I) :
    (columnEmbedCLM Q f u).ofLp (f i) = u.ofLp i
columnEmbed_image.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem columnEmbed_image (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (i : I) :
    (columnEmbedCLM Q f u).ofLp (f i) = u.ofLp i := embedFamily_image f u.ofLp i

columnEmbed_outside.exact_header:
theorem columnEmbed_outside (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (j : J) (hj : j ∉ range f) :
    (columnEmbedCLM Q f u).ofLp j = 0
columnEmbed_outside.exact_declaration:
theorem columnEmbed_outside (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) (j : J) (hj : j ∉ range f) :
    (columnEmbedCLM Q f u).ofLp j = 0 := embedFamily_outside f u.ofLp j hj

timeEmbedCLM.exact_declaration: def timeEmbedCLM := (columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).compLpL 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

injectCoefficient.exact_header: def injectCoefficient {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q E t
injectCoefficient.exact_declaration:
def injectCoefficient {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q E t where
  value j ω := embedFamily f (fun i => A.value i ω) j
  adapted j := by
    rw [← hF]
    by_cases hj : j ∈ range f
    · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hj
      simpa only [embedFamily_image] using A.adapted i
    · simpa only [embedFamily_outside f _ j hj] using
        (stronglyMeasurable_const : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun _ : Ω => (0 : Z)))
  square j := by
    by_cases hj : j ∈ range f
    · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hj
      simpa only [embedFamily_image] using A.square i
    · simpa only [embedFamily_outside f _ j hj] using (memLp_const (0 : Z) : MemLp (fun _ : Ω => (0 : Z)) 2 Q)

injectCoefficient_toLp.exact_header:
theorem injectCoefficient_toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    (injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).toLp = columnEmbedCLM Q f A.toLp
injectCoefficient_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem injectCoefficient_toLp {t : ℝ≥0} (A : Coefficient (Z := Z) Q D t) :
    (injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).toLp = columnEmbedCLM Q f A.toLp := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  apply Lp.ext
  by_cases hj : j ∈ range f
  · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hj
    rw [columnEmbed_image]
    filter_upwards [((injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).square (f i)).coeFn_toLp,
      (A.square i).coeFn_toLp] with ω hn ho
    change (((injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).square (f i)).toLp _) ω =
      ((A.square i).toLp _) ω
    rw [hn,ho]
    exact embedFamily_image f (fun i => A.value i ω) i
  · rw [columnEmbed_outside Q f A.toLp j hj]
    filter_upwards [((injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).square j).coeFn_toLp,
      Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (p := 2) (μ := Q)] with ω hn hz
    change (((injectCoefficient Q f D E hF A).square j).toLp _) ω = (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) ω
    rw [hn,hz]
    exact embedFamily_outside f (fun i => A.value i ω) j hj

injectCoefficients.exact_header:
def injectCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q E τ
injectCoefficients.exact_declaration:
def injectCoefficients (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q E τ := fun k => injectCoefficient Q f D E hF (A k)

coefficientStep_embed.exact_header:
theorem coefficientStep_embed (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q E τ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n =
      timeEmbedCLM Q f (coefficientStep Q D τ A n)
coefficientStep_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficientStep_embed (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientStep Q E τ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n =
      timeEmbedCLM Q f (coefficientStep Q D τ A n) := by
  simp only [coefficientStep, injectCoefficients, injectCoefficient_toLp Q f D E hF hp, timeEmbedCLM, time_grid_map]

stochasticStep_embed.exact_header:
theorem stochasticStep_embed (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n
stochasticStep_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem stochasticStep_embed (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (n : ℕ) :
    stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n =
      stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(gridSum_memLp Q E τ hτ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n).coeFn_toLp,
    (gridSum_memLp Q D τ hτ A n).coeFn_toLp] with ω hn ho
  change (stochasticStep Q E τ hτ (injectCoefficients Q f D E hF τ A) n) ω = _ at hn
  change (stochasticStep Q D τ hτ A n) ω = gridSum Q D τ A n ω at ho
  rw [hn,ho]
  unfold gridSum noiseStep PredictableIsometry.stepSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  change (∑ j, (E.process j (τ (k+1)) ω - E.process j (τ k) ω) •
    ∑ i, if f i = j then (A k).value i ω else 0) = _
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_ite, smul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  rw [← hp i (τ (k+1)), ← hp i (τ k)]
  rfl

injectFiniteStep.exact_header:
def injectFiniteStep (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q E G

finiteStepInput_embed.exact_header:
theorem finiteStepInput_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepInput Q E G (injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G A) =
      timeEmbedCLM Q f (finiteStepInput Q D G A)
finiteStepInput_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStepInput_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepInput Q E G (injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G A) =
      timeEmbedCLM Q f (finiteStepInput Q D G A) :=
  coefficientStep_embed Q f D E hF hp (G.time A.1) A.2 (G.count A.1)

finiteStepOutput_embed.exact_header:
theorem finiteStepOutput_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepOutput Q E G (injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G A) = finiteStepOutput Q D G A
finiteStepOutput_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem finiteStepOutput_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (A : FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    finiteStepOutput Q E G (injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G A) = finiteStepOutput Q D G A :=
  stochasticStep_embed Q f D E hF hp (G.time A.1) (G.monotone A.1) A.2 (G.count A.1)

injectClosedDomain.exact_header:
def injectClosedDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q E G
injectClosedDomain.exact_declaration:
def injectClosedDomain (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q E G := by
  refine ⟨timeEmbedCLM Q f u.val, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (((timeEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA)
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro n
  change timeEmbedCLM Q f (finiteStepInput Q D G (A n)) ∈ _
  rw [← finiteStepInput_embed Q f D E hF hp G (A n)]
  exact subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self _)

closedStepIntegral_embed.exact_header:
theorem closedStepIntegral_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q E G (injectClosedDomain Q f D E hF hp G u) = closedStepIntegral Q D G u
closedStepIntegral_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem closedStepIntegral_embed (G : RefiningGrids) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D G) :
    closedStepIntegral Q E G (injectClosedDomain Q f D E hF hp G u) = closedStepIntegral Q D G u := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G u
  have hB : Tendsto (fun n => finiteStepInput Q E G (injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G (A n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (injectClosedDomain Q f D E hF hp G u).val) := by
    simpa only [finiteStepInput_embed Q f D E hF hp, Function.comp_def, injectClosedDomain] using
      ((timeEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).continuous.tendsto u.val).comp hA
  have h1 := closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q E G (fun n => injectFiniteStep Q f D E hF G (A n))
    (injectClosedDomain Q f D E hF hp G u) hB
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique h1
  simpa only [finiteStepOutput_embed Q f D E hF hp] using closedStepIntegral_tendsto Q D G A u hA

timeCut_embed.exact_header:
theorem timeCut_embed (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : timeCut Q (timeEmbedCLM Q f u) s t = timeEmbedCLM Q f (timeCut Q u s t)
timeCut_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem timeCut_embed (u : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (s t : ℝ) : timeCut Q (timeEmbedCLM Q f u) s t = timeEmbedCLM Q f (timeCut Q u s t) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [timeCut_coe Q (timeEmbedCLM Q f u) s t,
    (columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).coeFn_compLpL u,
    (columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).coeFn_compLpL (timeCut Q u s t),
    timeCut_coe Q u s t] with r hc hu ht hm
  change (timeEmbedCLM Q f u) r = columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r) at hu
  change (timeEmbedCLM Q f (timeCut Q u s t)) r = _ at ht
  rw [hc,ht,hm]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr,hu]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr,map_zero]

theorem closedIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))

closedIntegral_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem closedIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))

columnEmbed_adapted.exact_header:
theorem columnEmbed_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u.ofLp i) Q) (j : J) :

columnEmbed_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem columnEmbed_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (u : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (u.ofLp i) Q) (j : J) :

  · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hj

theorem curveHorizon_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)

curveHorizon_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem curveHorizon_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))) :
    curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r)) ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' hu) =
      timeEmbedCLM Q f (curveHorizon Q T u hu) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [curveHorizon_coe Q T (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r))
      ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' hu), curveHorizon_coe Q T u hu,
    (columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).coeFn_compLpL (curveHorizon Q T u hu)] with r hn ho he
  change (timeEmbedCLM Q f (curveHorizon Q T u hu)) r = _ at he
  rw [hn,he,ho]

  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr,map_zero]

predictableCurveIntegral_embed.exact_header:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r))
      ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r j => columnEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF hp r (u r) (hU r) j) t =
      predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hU t
predictableCurveIntegral_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem predictableCurveIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))))
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((u t).ofLp i) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    predictableCurveIntegral Q E T (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r))
      ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' hu)
      (fun r j => columnEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF hp r (u r) (hU r) j) t =
      predictableCurveIntegral Q D T u hu hU t := by
  let U := predictableDomain Q D T (curveHorizon Q T u hu) (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q D T u hu hU)
  let V := predictableDomain Q E T
    (curveHorizon Q T (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (u r)) ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' hu))
    (curveHorizon_pastAdapted Q E T _ _ (fun r j => columnEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF hp r (u r) (hU r) j))
  have he : V = injectClosedDomain Q f D E hF hp (dyadicGrids T) U := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change timeCut Q (curveHorizon Q T _ _) 0 T = timeEmbedCLM Q f (timeCut Q (curveHorizon Q T u hu) 0 T)
    rw [curveHorizon_embed Q f D E hF hp, timeCut_embed Q f D E hF hp]
  change closedIntegral Q E T V t = closedIntegral Q D T U t
  rw [he,closedIntegral_embed]

theorem rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)

theorem rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)

rawDiffusionCurve_embed.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (rawEmbed f σ) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r))
rawDiffusionCurve_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionCurve_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    rawDiffusionCurve Q (rawEmbed f σ) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))]
      (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r)) := by
  unfold rawDiffusionCurve
  filter_upwards [ProductLpSections.columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q
    (rawEmbed f σ) (rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable f σ hσ) (rawEmbed_square Q f T σ h2),
    ProductLpSections.columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q σ hσ h2]
      with r hn ho
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j ∈ range f
  · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := hj
    rw [columnEmbed_image]
    apply Lp.ext
    have hn' := hn (f i)
    rw [rawEmbed_image] at hn'
    exact hn'.trans (ho i).symm
  · rw [columnEmbed_outside Q f (ProductLpSections.columnSections Q σ r) j hj]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hn j,Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (p := 2) (μ := Q)] with ω hω hz
    rw [hω,hz]
    exact embedFamily_outside f (fun i => σ i r ω) j hj

include hF hp

rawDiffusionIntegral_embed.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q E T (rawEmbed f σ) (rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable f σ hσ)
      (rawEmbed_square Q f T σ h2) (rawEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF σ hA) t =
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t
rawDiffusionIntegral_embed.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_embed (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    rawDiffusionIntegral Q E T (rawEmbed f σ) (rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable f σ hσ)
      (rawEmbed_square Q f T σ h2) (rawEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF σ hA) t =
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T σ hσ h2 hA t := by
  unfold rawDiffusionIntegral
  rw [predictableCurveIntegral_eq_of_ae_coefficients Q E T _
    (fun r => columnEmbedCLM Q f (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r)) _
    ((columnEmbedCLM (Z := Z) Q f).comp_memLp' (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2)) _
    (fun r j => columnEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF hp r (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r)
      (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D σ hA r) j)
    (rawDiffusionCurve_embed Q f T σ hσ h2) t]
  exact predictableCurveIntegral_embed Q f D E hF hp T _
    (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2) (rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D σ hA) t

def rawDiffusionDomain (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)

rawDiffusionDomain.exact_declaration:
def rawDiffusionDomain (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)

rawDiffusionDomain_coe.exact_header:
theorem rawDiffusionDomain_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂volume, ∀ i,
      ((rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA).val r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q]
        fun ω => (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => σ i r ω) r
rawDiffusionDomain_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDiffusionDomain_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂volume, ∀ i,
      ((rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA).val r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q]
        fun ω => (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => σ i r ω) r := by
  have hc := ProductLpSections.columnSections_ae (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q σ hσ h2
  have hc' : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) → ∀ i,
      (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] σ i r :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mp hc
  have hH := curveHorizon_coe Q T (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ) (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2)
  have hcut := timeCut_coe Q
    (curveHorizon Q T (rawDiffusionCurve Q σ) (rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T σ hσ h2)) 0 T
  filter_upwards [hc',hH,hcut] with r hr hh ht
  intro i
  change ((timeCut Q _ 0 T) r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] _
  rw [ht]
  by_cases hrt : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hrt, hh, Set.indicator_of_mem hrt]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hrt] using hr hrt i
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hrt]
    change (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) =ᵐ[Q] _
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (p := 2) (μ := Q)] with ω hz
    change (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) ω = (0 : Z) at hz
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hrt] using hz

    (h2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖σ i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (v : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hv : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (v i)))
    (hv2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖v i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hvA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (v i t) Q)
    (he : ∀ i r ω, v i r ω = LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField τ (σ i) r ω) :
    rawDiffusionDomain Q D T v hv hv2 hvA =
      boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hs (rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Lp.ext
  have hcσ := rawDiffusionDomain_coe Q D T σ hσ h2 hA
  have hcv := rawDiffusionDomain_coe Q D T v hv hv2 hvA
  have hcm := randomStoppedInput_coe Q D T τ hτ hs (rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA).val
  filter_upwards [hcσ,hcv,hcm] with r hσr hvr hmr
  change (rawDiffusionDomain Q D T v hv hv2 hvA).val r =
    randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hs (rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA).val r
  rw [hmr]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  apply Lp.ext
  by_cases hrt : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · have hmE : MeasurableSet {ω | r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)} := measurableSet_le measurable_const
      (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (stoppingTime_measurable Q D τ hs))
    have hmask := eventMask_coe Q {ω | r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ)} hmE
      (((rawDiffusionDomain Q D T σ hσ h2 hA).val r).ofLp i)
    filter_upwards [hσr i,hvr i,hmask] with ω hσω hvω hmω
    change (((rawDiffusionDomain Q D T v hv hv2 hvA).val r).ofLp i) ω = _
    simp only [randomStopCurve, ite_eq_left hrt, columnEventMask_apply]
    rw [hmω,hvω]
    by_cases hτω : r ≤ (τ ω : ℝ) <;>
      simp [Set.indicator, hrt, hτω, he, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField, hσω]
  · filter_upwards [hvr i, Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (p := 2) (μ := Q)] with ω hvω hz
    simp only [randomStopCurve, ite_eq_right hrt]
    change (((rawDiffusionDomain Q D T v hv hv2 hvA).val r).ofLp i) ω = (0 : Lp Z 2 Q) ω
    rw [hz]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hrt, Pi.zero_apply] using hvω

theorem rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)

theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    {Kμ Pμ Kν Pν : ℝ}
    (Lμ : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) T)
    (Lν : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) T)
    (U : RawLinearGrowthState.Data Lμ Kμ Pμ) (V : RawLinearGrowthState.Data Lν Kν Pν)
    (R : Realization M Lμ Kμ Pμ U) (R' : Realization M Lν Kν Pν V)
    (hU0 : U.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (hV0 : V.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer T) (R'.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.state T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer 0) (R'.optimizer 0) μ ν
law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    {Kμ Pμ Kν Pν : ℝ}
    (Lμ : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) T)
    (Lν : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) T)
    (U : RawLinearGrowthState.Data Lμ Kμ Pμ) (V : RawLinearGrowthState.Data Lν Kν Pν)
    (R : Realization M Lμ Kμ Pμ U) (R' : Realization M Lν Kν Pν V)
    (hU0 : U.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (hV0 : V.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer T) (R'.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.state T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer 0) (R'.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  have hRU0 : R.predictableData.sampler 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ U.state (U.state_memLp 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hU0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ).symm)
  have hRV0 : R'.predictableData.sampler 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ V.state (V.state_memLp 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hV0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν).symm)
  have he := ConstructedPredictableLaw.law_distance_decay μ ν hμ hν
    R.predictableData R'.predictableData hRU0 hRV0 G hb hσ ρ hmono
  change optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer T) (R'.optimizer T)
    ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (R.predictableData.sampler T))
    ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (R'.predictableData.sampler T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (R.optimizer 0) (R'.optimizer 0) μ ν at he
  rw [R.predictableData_law T ⟨T.coe_nonneg, le_rfl⟩,
    R'.predictableData_law T ⟨T.coe_nonneg, le_rfl⟩] at he
  exact he

theorem product_ae_of_sections (f g : ℝ → Ω → Z)

structure Realization (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (K P : ℝ)
    (U : RawLinearGrowthState.Data L K P) where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift : ℝ → S
  optimizerDrift_integrable : IntervalIntegrable optimizerDrift volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  state_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.state t) Q
  diffusion_borel : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)
  drift_strong : StronglyMeasurable
    (Function.uncurry (originalRawDrift M optimizer U.state))
  diffusion_strong : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable
    (Function.uncurry (originalRawDiffusion M optimizer U.state i))
  coefficients : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    U.drift r ω = originalRawDrift M optimizer U.state r ω ∧
      ∀ i, L.sigma i r ω = originalRawDiffusion M optimizer U.state i r ω
  optimizer_field : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), optimizerDrift t =
    M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (U.state t))
  optimizer_equation : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    optimizer t = optimizer 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, optimizerDrift r
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (U.state t))

theorem model_equation (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.state t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U.state 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, originalRawDrift M R.optimizer U.state r ω) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (originalRawDiffusion M R.optimizer U.state)
        R.diffusion_strong R.coefficients_square.2
        (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M R.optimizer U.state
          R.state_adapted R.diffusion_borel) t.toNNReal ω := by
  have hn := rawDiffusionIntegral_congr_ae_coefficients Q D T L.sigma
    (originalRawDiffusion M R.optimizer U.state) L.sigma_strong R.diffusion_strong
    U.coefficients_square.2 R.coefficients_square.2 L.sigma_adapted
    (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M R.optimizer U.state R.state_adapted R.diffusion_borel)
    R.diffusion_product_ae t.toNNReal
  filter_upwards [U.global_equation t ht, R.coefficients] with ω he hc
  rw [← hn]
  rw [he]
  congr 2
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro r hr
  rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hr
  exact (hc r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩).1

predictableData.exact_header: def predictableData : ConstructedPredictableModel.Data Q D M T
predictableData.exact_declaration:
def predictableData : ConstructedPredictableModel.Data Q D M T :=
  dataOfRaw Q D M T R.optimizer R.optimizerDrift U.state
    R.optimizerDrift_integrable U.state_memLp R.state_adapted R.diffusion_borel
    R.drift_strong R.diffusion_strong R.coefficients_square.1 R.coefficients_square.2
    R.drift_memLp R.diffusion_memLp R.optimizer_field R.optimizer_equation
    R.model_equation R.observation_integrable
