Data.exact_header: structure Data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (K P : ℝ)
Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (K P : ℝ) where
  state : ℝ → Ω → Z
  drift : ℝ → Ω → Z
  drift_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry drift)
  drift_control : ∀ r ω, ‖drift r ω‖ ≤ L.q r ω
  initial_square : MemLp (state 0) 2 Q
  K_nonneg : 0 ≤ K
  P_nonneg : 0 ≤ P
  growth : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
    ‖drift r ω‖ + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => L.sigma i r ω)‖ ≤
      K * (1 + P + ‖state r ω‖)
  equation : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), state t ω = state 0 ω +
    (∫ r in 0..t, drift r ω) + L.localNoise t.toNNReal ω

stoppedDrift.exact_declaration: def stoppedDrift (n : ℕ) := LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) U.drift

stoppedState.exact_declaration: def stoppedState (n : ℕ) := RawStoppingCoordinates.stoppedState (L.stop n) U.state

stoppedDrift_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedDrift_strong (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.stoppedDrift n)) :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable _ (L.stop_measurable n) U.drift U.drift_strong

stoppedDrift_paths.exact_header:
theorem stoppedDrift_paths (n : ℕ) : ∀ ω,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedDrift n r ω‖) ≤ n
stoppedDrift_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedDrift_paths (n : ℕ) : ∀ ω,
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖U.stoppedDrift n r ω‖) ≤ n := by
  intro ω
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun r => U.drift r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    (L.q_local ω).mono' U.drift_strong.of_uncurry_right.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun r => U.drift_control r ω))
  have hs : IntegrableOn (fun r => U.stoppedDrift n r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    change Integrable ((Iic (L.stop n ω : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => U.drift r ω)) _
    exact hi.indicator measurableSet_Iic
  refine ⟨(intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mpr hs, ?_⟩
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
  have hm : ∀ r, ‖U.stoppedDrift n r ω‖ ≤
      LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω := by
    intro r
    change ‖if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then U.drift r ω else 0‖ ≤
      if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then L.q r ω else 0
    split_ifs
    · exact U.drift_control r ω
    · simp
  have hqi : IntegrableOn (fun r => LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω)
      (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := (L.q_local ω).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ), LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) L.q r ω :=
      integral_mono hs.norm hqi hm
    _ = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (L.stop n ω : ℝ), L.q r ω := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le T.coe_nonneg,
        stoppedField_integral (L.stop n) L.q (T : ℝ) T.coe_nonneg ω,
        min_eq_right (show (L.stop n ω : ℝ) ≤ T by exact_mod_cast L.stop_bound n ω),
        intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg]
    _ ≤ n := L.stop_energy_bound n ω

stopped_equation.exact_header:
theorem stopped_equation (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.stoppedState n t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U.state 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, U.stoppedDrift n r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω
stopped_equation.exact_declaration:
theorem stopped_equation (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.stoppedState n t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U.state 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, U.stoppedDrift n r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.equation, L.localNoise_stopped] with ω heq hn
  have hmin : (min t (L.stop n ω : ℝ)).toNNReal = min t.toNNReal (L.stop n ω) := by
    apply NNReal.coe_injective
    rw [NNReal.coe_min, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (le_min ht.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg),
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]
  change U.state (min t (L.stop n ω : ℝ)) ω = _
  rw [heq _ ⟨le_min ht.1 (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg, (min_le_left _ _).trans ht.2⟩,
    ← stoppedField_integral (L.stop n) U.drift t ht.1 ω, hmin,
    ← hn n t.toNNReal (by rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]; exact ht.2)]
  rfl

stoppedState_memLp.exact_header:
theorem stoppedState_memLp (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (U.stoppedState n t) 2 Q
stoppedState_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedState_memLp (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (U.stoppedState n t) 2 Q :=
  BoundedVariationRealization.state_memLp Q T (U.stoppedDrift n) (U.stoppedDrift_strong n) n
    (Eventually.of_forall (U.stoppedDrift_paths n)) (U.state 0) (U.stoppedState n t)
    (L.version n t.toNNReal) U.initial_square (L.version_memLp n t.toNNReal) t ht
    (U.stopped_equation n t ht)

version_moment_le.exact_header:
theorem version_moment_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (∫ ω, ‖L.version n t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ n
version_moment_le.exact_declaration:
theorem version_moment_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (∫ ω, ‖L.version n t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ n := by
  have hm := MartingaleMaximalL2.norm_sq_submartingale Q D.filtration
    (L.version n) (L.version_martingale n) (L.version_memLp n)
  have hi := hm.setIntegral_le ht (s := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
  have hle : (∫ ω, ‖L.version n t ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ ∫ ω, ‖L.version n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
    simpa only [setIntegral_univ] using hi
  exact hle.trans (L.version_terminal_sq_le n)

stoppedState_moment_le.exact_header:
theorem stoppedState_moment_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖(U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht).toLp (U.stoppedState n t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * ‖U.initial_square.toLp (U.state 0)‖ ^ 2 + 3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 * n
stoppedState_moment_le.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedState_moment_le (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖(U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht).toLp (U.stoppedState n t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * ‖U.initial_square.toLp (U.state 0)‖ ^ 2 + 3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 * n := by
  rw [toLp_norm_sq Q _ _, toLp_norm_sq Q _ _]
  have hm := BoundedVariationRealization.state_moment_bound Q T
    (U.stoppedDrift n) (U.stoppedDrift_strong n) n (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    (Eventually.of_forall (U.stoppedDrift_paths n)) (U.state 0) (U.stoppedState n t)
    (L.version n t.toNNReal) U.initial_square (L.version_memLp n t.toNNReal) t ht
    (U.stopped_equation n t ht)
  have hn := version_moment_le (L := L) n t.toNNReal (by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]; exact ht.2)
  linarith

packedStoppedSigma.exact_header: def packedStoppedSigma (U : Data L K P) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z)
packedStoppedSigma.exact_declaration:
def packedStoppedSigma (U : Data L K P) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => L.stoppedSigma n i r ω)

packedStoppedSigma_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem packedStoppedSigma_strong (n : ℕ) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (U.packedStoppedSigma n)) := by
  apply (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z)).comp_stronglyMeasurable
  exact (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => (L.stoppedSigma_strong n i).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable

stopped_coefficients.exact_header:
theorem stopped_coefficients (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp (U.stoppedDrift n r) 2 Q,
    ∃ hσ2 : MemLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r) 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp (U.stoppedDrift n r)‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 +
          ‖(U.stoppedState_memLp n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)).toLp (U.stoppedState n r)‖ ^ 2)
stopped_coefficients.exact_declaration:
theorem stopped_coefficients (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hb2 : MemLp (U.stoppedDrift n r) 2 Q,
    ∃ hσ2 : MemLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r) 2 Q,
      ‖hb2.toLp (U.stoppedDrift n r)‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ2.toLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 +
          ‖(U.stoppedState_memLp n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)).toLp (U.stoppedState n r)‖ ^ 2) := by
  apply coefficients_of_linear_growth Q (U.stoppedState n r) (U.stoppedDrift n r)
    (U.packedStoppedSigma n r) (U.stoppedState_memLp n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr))
    (U.stoppedDrift_strong n).of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable
    (U.packedStoppedSigma_strong n).of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable U.K_nonneg U.P_nonneg
  filter_upwards [U.growth r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)] with ω hg
  by_cases hω : r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ)
  · have hb : U.stoppedDrift n r ω = U.drift r ω := by
      simp only [stoppedDrift, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField, ite_eq_left hω]
    have hσ : U.packedStoppedSigma n r ω = WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => L.sigma i r ω) := by
      unfold packedStoppedSigma
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp only [RawLocalDiffusion.stoppedSigma, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField, ite_eq_left hω]
    rw [hb, hσ]
    simpa only [stoppedState, RawStoppingCoordinates.stoppedState, min_eq_left hω] using hg
  · have hb : U.stoppedDrift n r ω = 0 := by
      simp only [stoppedDrift, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField, ite_eq_right hω]
    have hσ : U.packedStoppedSigma n r ω = 0 := by
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 (I → Z)).injective
      funext i
      change L.stoppedSigma n i r ω = 0
      simp only [RawLocalDiffusion.stoppedSigma, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField, ite_eq_right hω]
    simp only [hb, hσ, norm_zero, add_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg U.K_nonneg (by linarith [U.P_nonneg, norm_nonneg (U.stoppedState n r ω)])

stoppedDrift_product_square.exact_header:
theorem stoppedDrift_product_square (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.stoppedDrift n p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
stoppedDrift_product_square.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedDrift_product_square (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.stoppedDrift n p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hpoint (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := U.stopped_coefficients n r hr
  choose hb hσ hg using hpoint
  have hB : ∀ r (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ‖(hb r hr).toLp (U.stoppedDrift n r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + (3 * ‖U.initial_square.toLp (U.state 0)‖ ^ 2 +
        3 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 * n)) := by
    intro r hr
    have hc := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (U.stoppedState_moment_le n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr))
      (show 0 ≤ 3 * K ^ 2 by positivity)
    nlinarith [hg r hr, sq_nonneg ‖(hσ r hr).toLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r)‖]
  have hm := product_memLp_of_uniform_moment Q (U.stoppedDrift n) T
    (U.stoppedDrift_strong n) hb hB
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hm

stateLp.exact_header: def stateLp (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q
stateLp.exact_declaration: def stateLp (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q := sectionLp Q (U.stoppedState n) r

driftLp.exact_header: def driftLp (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q
driftLp.exact_declaration: def driftLp (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : Lp Z 2 Q := sectionLp Q (U.stoppedDrift n) r

sigmaCurve.exact_header: def sigmaCurve (U : Data L K P) (n : ℕ) : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q
sigmaCurve.exact_declaration:
def sigmaCurve (U : Data L K P) (n : ℕ) : ℝ → ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q :=
  rawDiffusionCurve Q (L.stoppedSigma n)

driftLp_square.exact_header: theorem driftLp_square (n : ℕ) : MemLp (U.driftLp n) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
driftLp_square.exact_declaration:
theorem driftLp_square (n : ℕ) : MemLp (U.driftLp n) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :=
  sectionLp_memLp _ Q _ (U.stoppedDrift_strong n) (U.stoppedDrift_product_square n)

sigmaCurve_square.exact_header:
theorem sigmaCurve_square (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (U.sigmaCurve n) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
sigmaCurve_square.exact_declaration:
theorem sigmaCurve_square (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (U.sigmaCurve n) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :=
  rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T _ (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n)

sigmaCurve_adapted.exact_header:
theorem sigmaCurve_adapted (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((U.sigmaCurve n t).ofLp i) Q
sigmaCurve_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem sigmaCurve_adapted (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] ((U.sigmaCurve n t).ofLp i) Q :=
  rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D _ (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n) t i

stateLp_integral.exact_header:
theorem stateLp_integral (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.stateLp n t = U.stateLp n 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, U.driftLp n r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T (U.sigmaCurve n)
        (U.sigmaCurve_square n) (U.sigmaCurve_adapted n) t
stateLp_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem stateLp_integral (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.stateLp n t = U.stateLp n 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, U.driftLp n r) +
      ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T (U.sigmaCurve n)
        (U.sigmaCurve_square n) (U.sigmaCurve_adapted n) t := by
  have hstate := sectionLp_ae Q (U.stoppedState n) (U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht)
  have hzero := sectionLp_ae Q (U.stoppedState n)
    (U.stoppedState_memLp n 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)
  have hz : U.stateLp n 0 =ᵐ[Q] U.state 0 := hzero.trans (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
    simp only [stoppedState, RawStoppingCoordinates.stoppedState, min_eq_left (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg]))
  have hi := ConstructedPredictableModel.rawDrift_sections_integral_ae Q T
    (U.stoppedDrift n) (U.stoppedDrift_strong n) (U.stoppedDrift_product_square n) t ht
  have he := U.stopped_equation n t ht
  have hn : ConstructedPredictableModel.integral Q D T (U.sigmaCurve n)
        (U.sigmaCurve_square n) (U.sigmaCurve_adapted n) t = L.noise n t.toNNReal := rfl
  rw [hn]
  apply Lp.ext
  have hadd : (U.stateLp n 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, U.driftLp n r) + L.noise n t.toNNReal) =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => U.state 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, U.stoppedDrift n r ω) + L.version n t.toNNReal ω :=
    (Lp.coeFn_add _ _).trans (((Lp.coeFn_add _ _).add EventuallyEq.rfl).trans
      ((hz.add hi).add (L.version_ae n t.toNNReal).symm))
  exact hstate.trans (he.trans hadd.symm)

stateLp_zero.exact_header: theorem stateLp_zero (n : ℕ) : U.stateLp n 0 = U.initial_square.toLp (U.state 0)
stateLp_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem stateLp_zero (n : ℕ) : U.stateLp n 0 = U.initial_square.toLp (U.state 0) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  have hz := sectionLp_ae Q (U.stoppedState n)
    (U.stoppedState_memLp n 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)
  exact (hz.trans (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
    simp only [stoppedState, RawStoppingCoordinates.stoppedState,
      min_eq_left (L.stop n ω).coe_nonneg]))).trans U.initial_square.coeFn_toLp.symm

sigmaCurve_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem sigmaCurve_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hσ : MemLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r) 2 Q) :
    ‖U.sigmaCurve n r‖ ^ 2 = ‖hσ.toLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r)‖ ^ 2
sigmaCurve_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem sigmaCurve_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hσ : MemLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r) 2 Q) :
    ‖U.sigmaCurve n r‖ ^ 2 = ‖hσ.toLp (U.packedStoppedSigma n r)‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hc (i : I) : MemLp (L.stoppedSigma n i r) 2 Q := by
    have hp := (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : I => Z) i).comp_memLp' hσ
    exact hp
  rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  change (∑ i, ‖sectionLp Q (L.stoppedSigma n i) r‖ ^ 2) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖L.stoppedSigma n i r ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => sectionLp_norm_sq Q _ (hc i))
    _ = ∫ ω, ∑ i, ‖L.stoppedSigma n i r ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q :=
      (integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hc i).aestronglyMeasurable).mp (hc i))).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [toLp_norm_sq Q _ hσ]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with ω
      simpa only [packedStoppedSigma, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using
        (PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : I => Z) (U.packedStoppedSigma n r ω)).symm

stoppedLp_growth.exact_header:
theorem stoppedLp_growth (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖U.driftLp n r‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sigmaCurve n r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (3 * K ^ 2) * ((1 + P ^ 2) + ‖U.stateLp n r‖ ^ 2)
stoppedLp_growth.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedLp_growth (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖U.driftLp n r‖ ^ 2 + ‖U.sigmaCurve n r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (3 * K ^ 2) * ((1 + P ^ 2) + ‖U.stateLp n r‖ ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨hb, hσ, hg⟩ := U.stopped_coefficients n r hr
  rw [U.sigmaCurve_norm_sq n r hσ]
  simpa only [driftLp, stateLp, sectionLp, dite_eq_left hb,
    dite_eq_left (U.stoppedState_memLp n r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)), add_assoc] using hg

stateLp_uniform_moment.exact_header:
theorem stateLp_uniform_moment (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖U.stateLp n t‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget
stateLp_uniform_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem stateLp_uniform_moment (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖U.stateLp n t‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget := by
  have hm := computed_uniform_moment_bound Q D (U.stateLp n) (U.driftLp n)
    (U.sigmaCurve n) T (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1+P^2 : ℝ)) (by positivity : 0 ≤ (3*K^2 : ℝ))
    (U.driftLp_square n) (U.sigmaCurve_square n) (U.sigmaCurve_adapted n)
    (U.stateLp_integral n) (U.stoppedLp_growth n) t ht
  rw [U.stateLp_zero n] at hm
  exact hm

globalState_moment.exact_header:
theorem globalState_moment (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hX : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q, ‖hX.toLp (U.state t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget
globalState_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem globalState_moment (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hX : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q, ‖hX.toLp (U.state t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget := by
  have hb (n : ℕ) : ‖(U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht).toLp (U.stoppedState n t)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      U.momentBudget := by
    have hs := U.stateLp_uniform_moment n t ht
    simpa only [stateLp, sectionLp, dite_eq_left (U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht)] using hs
  apply localized_limit_memLp Q (fun n => U.stoppedState n t) (U.state t)
    U.momentBudget_nonneg (fun n => U.stoppedState_memLp n t ht) hb
  exact RawStoppingCoordinates.stoppedState_tendsto Q L.stop T U.state
    (Eventually.of_forall L.stop_eventually_horizon) t ht

state_memLp.exact_header: theorem state_memLp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q
state_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem state_memLp (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q :=
  (U.globalState_moment t ht).choose

state_moment_le.exact_header:
theorem state_moment_le (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖(U.state_memLp t ht).toLp (U.state t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget
state_moment_le.exact_declaration:
theorem state_moment_le (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ‖(U.state_memLp t ht).toLp (U.state t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ U.momentBudget :=
  (U.globalState_moment t ht).choose_spec

packedSigma.exact_header: def packedSigma (U : Data L K P) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z)
packedSigma.exact_declaration:
def packedSigma (U : Data L K P) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : PiLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => L.sigma i r ω)

packedSigma_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem packedSigma_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry U.packedSigma) :=
  (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : I => Z)).comp_stronglyMeasurable
    (measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => (L.sigma_strong i).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable

global_coefficients.exact_header:
theorem global_coefficients (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hb : MemLp (U.drift r) 2 Q, ∃ hσ : MemLp (U.packedSigma r) 2 Q,
      ‖hb.toLp (U.drift r)‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ.toLp (U.packedSigma r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖(U.state_memLp r hr).toLp (U.state r)‖ ^ 2)
global_coefficients.exact_declaration:
theorem global_coefficients (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∃ hb : MemLp (U.drift r) 2 Q, ∃ hσ : MemLp (U.packedSigma r) 2 Q,
      ‖hb.toLp (U.drift r)‖ ^ 2 + ‖hσ.toLp (U.packedSigma r)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        3 * K ^ 2 * (1 + P ^ 2 + ‖(U.state_memLp r hr).toLp (U.state r)‖ ^ 2) :=
  coefficients_of_linear_growth Q (U.state r) (U.drift r) (U.packedSigma r)
    (U.state_memLp r hr) U.drift_strong.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable
    U.packedSigma_strong.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable U.K_nonneg U.P_nonneg (U.growth r hr)

coefficients_square.exact_header:
theorem coefficients_square :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.drift p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
coefficients_square.exact_declaration:
theorem coefficients_square :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖U.drift p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) ∧
    ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have hglobal := coefficient_product_memLp Q U.state U.drift U.packedSigma T
    U.K_nonneg U.P_nonneg U.drift_strong U.packedSigma_strong
    (fun t ht => U.state_memLp t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht))
    (fun t ht => U.state_moment_le t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht))
    (fun t ht => U.growth t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht))
  refine ⟨(memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hglobal.1.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hglobal.1, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hp := (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : I => Z) i).comp_memLp' hglobal.2
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hp.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hp

localNoise_eq_global.exact_header:
theorem localNoise_eq_global (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong
      U.coefficients_square.2 L.sigma_adapted t
localNoise_eq_global.exact_declaration:
theorem localNoise_eq_global (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong
      U.coefficients_square.2 L.sigma_adapted t := by
  obtain ⟨M, hMmart, hMcont, hM⟩ := rawDiffusionIntegral_exists_continuous_martingale Q D T
    L.sigma L.sigma_strong U.coefficients_square.2 L.sigma_adapted
  have hstop (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
      L.version n s ω = M (min s (L.stop n ω)) ω :=
    rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version Q D T (L.stop n) (L.stop_bound n) (L.stop_stopping n)
      L.sigma (L.stoppedSigma n) L.sigma_strong U.coefficients_square.2 L.sigma_adapted
      (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) M (L.version n) hM (L.version_ae n) hMcont (L.version_continuous n)
  have heq : L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] M t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hstop, L.version_eventually_localNoise] with ω hs hl
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hnl⟩ := ((L.stop_eventually_horizon ω).and (hl t ht)).exists
    exact hnl.symm.trans (by simpa only [hn, min_eq_left ht] using hs n t)
  exact heq.trans (hM t)

global_equation.exact_header:
theorem global_equation (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.state t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U.state 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, U.drift r ω) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong U.coefficients_square.2
        L.sigma_adapted t.toNNReal ω
global_equation.exact_declaration:
theorem global_equation (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.state t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U.state 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, U.drift r ω) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong U.coefficients_square.2
        L.sigma_adapted t.toNNReal ω := by
  filter_upwards [U.equation, U.localNoise_eq_global t.toNNReal (by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal _ ht.1]; exact ht.2)] with ω he hn
  rw [he t ht, hn]

PBGSO/RawLocalDriftEnergy.lean.scope_note: Original raw drift joint measurability, past progressivity and almost-sure pathwise L1 are explicit. Drift domination, the new gauge, coefficient identities and all-time local-noise equality are derived; no global drift moment is required.
PBGSO/RawLocalDriftEnergy.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawLocalGauge
import PBGSO.RawLocalRegularization
import PBGSO.RawLocalPullbackLocal

/-! # Adding raw drift variation to an actual local stochastic gauge
The local Brownian integral is unchanged when the gauge also controls raw
pathwise drift variation. The AE-path version derives a common null-set
normalization on the proved null-augmented Driver; it does not require a
pre-existing drift-control or noise-matching assumption.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {D : Driver (I := I) Q} {T : ℝ≥0}
  (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T)
  (b : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
  (hprog : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => b r p.2) p.1))

include hprog in

/-- The raw diffusion is unchanged; the actual energy is augmented by the
literal drift norm. Only primitive measurability/progressivity and path L¹
are required, and no global expected coefficient moments are imposed. -/

/-- Actual drift domination is a conclusion of the new gauge definition. -/

/-- The actual local Brownian integral is preserved simultaneously over the
horizon after adding drift variation to the stopping gauge. -/
/-- Almost-sure pathwise drift integrability is sufficient after the proved
initial null augmentation. The output drift-control and actual local-noise
matching are derived, not supplied as realization assumptions. -/

end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

augmented_progressive.exact_declaration:
private theorem augmented_progressive (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => L.q r p.2+‖b r p.2‖) p.1) := by
  have he : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => L.q r p.2+‖b r p.2‖) p.1) =
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => L.q r p.2) p.1)+
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖(Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => b r p.2) p.1‖) := by
    funext p
    by_cases h : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [h]
  rw [he]
  exact (L.q_progressive t).add (hprog t).norm

RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy.exact_header:
def RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T
RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy.exact_declaration:
def RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T where
  sigma := L.sigma
  sigma_strong := L.sigma_strong
  sigma_adapted := L.sigma_adapted
  q r ω := L.q r ω+‖b r ω‖
  q_strong := L.q_strong.add hb.norm
  q_nonneg r ω := add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (norm_nonneg _)
  q_local ω := (L.q_local ω).add (hloc ω).norm
  q_progressive := augmented_progressive L b hprog
  sigma_control r ω := (L.sigma_control r ω).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))

RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_contro.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_control
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖b r ω‖ ≤ (L.withDriftEnergy b hb hprog hloc).q r ω
RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_contro.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_control
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖b r ω‖ ≤ (L.withDriftEnergy b hb hprog hloc).q r ω :=
  le_add_of_nonneg_left (L.q_nonneg r ω)

RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_noise.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_noise
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      (L.withDriftEnergy b hb hprog hloc).localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω
RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.withDriftEnergy_noise
    (hloc : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      (L.withDriftEnergy b hb hprog hloc).localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω :=
  (L.withDriftEnergy b hb hprog hloc).localNoise_gauge_congr_of_eq L (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

include hb hprog in

RawLocalDiffusion.exists_withDriftEnergy.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.exists_withDriftEnergy_of_ae
    (hloc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∃ K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ b' : ℝ → Ω → Z,
        StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b') ∧
        (∀ r ω, ‖b' r ω‖ ≤ K.q r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, b' r ω = b r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, K.sigma i r ω = L.sigma i r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.exists_withDriftEnergy.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.exists_withDriftEnergy_of_ae
    (hloc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => b r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) :
    ∃ K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ b' : ℝ → Ω → Z,
        StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b') ∧
        (∀ r ω, ‖b' r ω‖ ≤ K.q r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, b' r ω = b r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, K.sigma i r ω = L.sigma i r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω) := by
  classical
  let q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun r ω => L.q r ω+‖b r ω‖
  have hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q) := L.q_strong.add hb.norm
  have hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω := fun r ω => add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hl : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    hloc.mono (fun ω h => (L.q_local ω).add h.norm)
  have hcontrol : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖L.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω :=
    fun r ω => (L.sigma_control r ω).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨K,B,hBm,hB0,hKσ,hKq,hreal⟩ := RawLocalDiffusion.exists_of_ae Q D T L.sigma
    L.sigma_strong L.sigma_adapted q hq hpos hl (augmented_progressive L b hprog) hcontrol
  let b' : ℝ → Ω → Z := fun r ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else b r ω
  have hb' : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b') :=
    stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise (hBm.preimage measurable_snd) hb
  have hdom : ∀ r ω, ‖b' r ω‖ ≤ K.q r ω := by
    intro r ω
    rw [hKq r ω]
    by_cases h : ω ∈ B
    · simp [b',h]
    · simpa only [b',ite_eq_right h,q] using (le_add_of_nonneg_left (L.q_nonneg r ω) : ‖b r ω‖ ≤ L.q r ω+‖b r ω‖)
  have hbAE : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r, b' r ω = b r ω := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hB0] with ω hω
    intro r
    exact ite_eq_right hω
  let hf := MeasurePreserving.id Q
  let E := nullAugmentedDriver Q D
  have he : ∀ t, (pullbackDriver hf D).filtration t ≤ E.filtration t := by
    intro t
    simpa only [pullbackDriver,pullbackFiltration,MeasurableSpace.comap_id,E,nullAugmentedDriver] using
      (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t)
  let L0 := L.pullback hf E he
  have hp : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hf D).process i t =ᵐ[Q] E.process i t :=
    fun _ _ => Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)
  have hnoise0 := L.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon hf E he hp
  have hσAE : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) → K.sigma i r ω = L0.sigma i r ω :=
    hreal.mono (fun ω h i r _ => h.1 i r)
  have hnoiseK := K.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon L0 hσAE
  refine ⟨K,b',hb',hdom,hbAE,hreal.mono (fun _ h => h.1),?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hnoiseK,hnoise0] with ω hk h0
  intro t ht
  exact (hk t ht).trans (h0 t ht)

PBGSO/RawLocalGauge.lean.scope_note: Only actual locally square-integrable raw columns with one-event horizon equality are used; gauges may differ. No global expected diffusion square, drift growth or gauge/noise identity is supplied.
PBGSO/RawLocalGauge.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawLocalIntegral

/-! # Actual local Itô noise is independent of the local-energy gauge
Two locally square-integrable raw diffusion fields equal on one event over
the entire horizon give identical actual glued noise. The proof compares
double-stopped computed integrals and exhausts both genuine stopping gauges.
No global expected diffusion-square moment or drift assumption is used.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]

doubleField.exact_header: private def doubleField (n m : ℕ) (i : I) : ℝ → Ω → Z
doubleField.exact_declaration:
private def doubleField (n m : ℕ) (i : I) : ℝ → Ω → Z :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (K.stop m) (L.stoppedSigma n i)

doubleField_strong.exact_header:
private theorem doubleField_strong (n m : ℕ) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (doubleField L K n m i))
doubleField_strong.exact_declaration:
private theorem doubleField_strong (n m : ℕ) (i : I) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (doubleField L K n m i)) :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable (K.stop m) (K.stop_measurable m)
    (L.stoppedSigma n i) (L.stoppedSigma_strong n i)

doubleField_adapted.exact_header:
private theorem doubleField_adapted (n m : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (doubleField L K n m i t) Q
doubleField_adapted.exact_declaration:
private theorem doubleField_adapted (n m : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (doubleField L K n m i t) Q :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField_adapted D.filtration (K.stop m) (K.stop_stopping m)
    (L.stoppedSigma n i) Q (fun t => L.stoppedSigma_adapted n t i) t

doubleField_square.exact_declaration:
private theorem doubleField_square (n m : ℕ) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖doubleField L K n m i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  apply (L.stoppedSigma_square n i).mono'
    (((doubleField_strong L K n m i).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun p => by
    change ‖‖doubleField L K n m i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    by_cases h : p.1 ≤ (K.stop m p.2 : ℝ)
    · simp [doubleField,LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField,h]
    · simp [doubleField,LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField,h,sq_nonneg])

doubleField_congr_ae.exact_declaration:
private theorem doubleField_congr_ae (n m : ℕ) (i : I) :
    Function.uncurry (doubleField L K n m i) =ᵐ[(volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q]
      Function.uncurry (doubleField K L m n i) := by
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae
    ((doubleField_strong L K n m i).measurableSet_eq_fun
      (doubleField_strong K L m n i))).mpr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
  filter_upwards [hσ] with ω hω
  by_cases hl : r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) <;> by_cases hk : r ≤ (K.stop m ω : ℝ) <;>
    simp [doubleField,RawLocalDiffusion.stoppedSigma,LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField,hl,hk,hω i r hr]

RawLocalDiffusion.version_double_stopped.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.version_double_stopped_congr (n m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      L.version n (min t (K.stop m ω)) ω = K.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω
RawLocalDiffusion.version_double_stopped.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.version_double_stopped_congr (n m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      L.version n (min t (K.stop m ω)) ω = K.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω := by
  obtain ⟨N,hNm,hNc,hN⟩ := rawDiffusionIntegral_exists_continuous_martingale Q D T
    (doubleField L K n m) (doubleField_strong L K n m) (doubleField_square L K n m)
    (doubleField_adapted L K n m)
  have heq (t : ℝ≥0) := rawDiffusionIntegral_congr_ae_coefficients Q D T
    (doubleField L K n m) (doubleField K L m n)
    (doubleField_strong L K n m) (doubleField_strong K L m n)
    (doubleField_square L K n m) (doubleField_square K L m n)
    (doubleField_adapted L K n m) (doubleField_adapted K L m n)
    (doubleField_congr_ae L K hσ n m) t
  have hN' (t : ℝ≥0) : N t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T
      (doubleField K L m n) (doubleField_strong K L m n) (doubleField_square K L m n)
      (doubleField_adapted K L m n) t :=
    (hN t).trans (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => congrArg (fun A : Lp Z 2 Q => A ω) (heq t)))
  have hL := rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version Q D T (K.stop m) (K.stop_bound m)
    (K.stop_stopping m) (L.stoppedSigma n) (doubleField L K n m)
    (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    (doubleField_strong L K n m) (doubleField_square L K n m) (doubleField_adapted L K n m)
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (L.version n) N (L.version_ae n) hN (L.version_continuous n) hNc
  have hK := rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version Q D T (L.stop n) (L.stop_bound n)
    (L.stop_stopping n) (K.stoppedSigma m) (doubleField K L m n)
    (K.stoppedSigma_strong m) (K.stoppedSigma_square m) (K.stoppedSigma_adapted m)
    (doubleField_strong K L m n) (doubleField_square K L m n) (doubleField_adapted K L m n)
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (K.version m) N (K.version_ae m) hN' (K.version_continuous m) hNc
  filter_upwards [hL,hK] with ω hl hk
  intro t
  exact (hl t).symm.trans (hk t)

RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω := by
  have hdouble : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      L.version n (min t (K.stop m ω)) ω = K.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => ae_all_iff.mpr (fun m => L.version_double_stopped_congr K hσ n m))
  filter_upwards [hdouble,L.localNoise_stopped,K.localNoise_stopped] with ω hω hl hk
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (L.stop_eventually_horizon ω).exists
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := (K.stop_eventually_horizon ω).exists
  intro t ht
  have hd := hω n m t
  have hln := hl n t ht
  have hkm := hk m t ht
  simp only [hn,hm,min_eq_left ht] at hd hln hkm
  exact hln.symm.trans (hd.trans hkm)

RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] K.localNoise t
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] K.localNoise t :=
  (L.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon K hσ).mono (fun _ h => h t ht)

RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_of_eq
    (he : ∀ i r ω, L.sigma i r ω = K.sigma i r ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_gauge_congr_of_eq
    (he : ∀ i r ω, L.sigma i r ω = K.sigma i r ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω :=
  L.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon K (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω i r _ => he i r ω))

PBGSO/RawLocalIntegral.lean.scope_note: Raw columns are jointly strongly measurable and AE adapted. A nonnegative progressive pathwise-L1 scalar controls their square sum; no global expected coefficient moment, local noise, stopped equation or energy conclusion is supplied.
PBGSO/RawLocalIntegral.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawIntegralStopping
import PBGSO.PathwiseLocalEnergy
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.FactorsThrough

/-! # Actual local stochastic integrals from pathwise local square coefficients
Every localized integral is a computed Brownian completion. Their consistency
is proved by actual coefficient stopping, then a single local noise process
is glued without a stopped-equation or output-equality premise.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I Z : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)

/-- Primitive raw locally square-integrable diffusion data. The scalar path
energy may also include raw drift variation. No global expected coefficient
energy, stopped integral, local-noise process, martingale, or isometry enters. -/

namespace RawLocalDiffusion
variable {Q D} {T : ℝ≥0} (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T)
















/-- The literal computed noise of the first-hit restricted raw diffusion. -/







/-- The terminal expected stochastic energy is bounded by the actual
first-hit threshold, derived from raw square coefficients and isometry. -/


/-- Nested coefficient masks give literal random-time consistency of the
computed martingale versions, simultaneously at every observation time. -/

/-- A finite path energy always reaches some localization threshold only
after the horizon, so some actual first-hit stop equals T on every sample. -/


/-- The actual local stochastic integral, glued from actual computed
localized martingales. No stopped-output law is used to define it. -/

/-- Single common event supporting the entire localized family. -/

/-- Genuine random-time stopped realization of the constructed local Ito
process. The stopped equation is a conclusion, not a realization premise. -/




/-- At every fixed time in the horizon, the actual finite-threshold
martingales eventually equal the constructed local noise on each good path. -/

/-- Genuine past AE-adaptation of the glued local process follows from its
actual adapted martingale approximants. No adaptation of the future-dependent
horizon selector is asserted. -/

end RawLocalDiffusion
end PBGSO.FilteredBrownian

RawLocalDiffusion.exact_declaration:
structure RawLocalDiffusion (T : ℝ≥0) where
  sigma : I → ℝ → Ω → Z
  sigma_strong : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (sigma i))
  sigma_adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (sigma i t) Q
  q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ
  q_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q)
  q_nonneg : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω
  q_local : ∀ ω, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))
  q_progressive : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1)
  sigma_control : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω

stop.exact_declaration: def stop (n : ℕ) : Ω → ℝ≥0 := PathEnergyStopping.firstHit T L.pathEnergy n

pathEnergy_continuous.exact_header: theorem pathEnergy_continuous (ω : Ω) : Continuous (fun t => L.pathEnergy t ω)
pathEnergy_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem pathEnergy_continuous (ω : Ω) : Continuous (fun t => L.pathEnergy t ω) :=
  PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_continuous T L.q L.q_local ω

pathEnergy_monotone.exact_header: theorem pathEnergy_monotone (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun t => L.pathEnergy t ω)
pathEnergy_monotone.exact_declaration:
theorem pathEnergy_monotone (ω : Ω) : Monotone (fun t => L.pathEnergy t ω) :=
  PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_monotone T L.q L.q_local L.q_nonneg ω

pathEnergy_measurable.exact_header: theorem pathEnergy_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable[D.filtration t] (L.pathEnergy t)
pathEnergy_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem pathEnergy_measurable (t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable[D.filtration t] (L.pathEnergy t) :=
  PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_measurable D.filtration T L.q L.q_progressive t

stop_stopping.exact_header: theorem stop_stopping (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | L.stop n ω ≤ t}
stop_stopping.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_stopping (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | L.stop n ω ≤ t} :=
  PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_stopping D.filtration T L.pathEnergy n
    L.pathEnergy_continuous L.pathEnergy_monotone L.pathEnergy_measurable t

stop_bound.exact_header: theorem stop_bound (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : L.stop n ω ≤ T
stop_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_bound (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : L.stop n ω ≤ T :=
  PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_le_horizon T L.pathEnergy n ω (L.pathEnergy_continuous ω)

stop_energy_bound.exact_header:
theorem stop_energy_bound (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∫ r in Ioc 0 (L.stop n ω : ℝ), L.q r ω) ≤ n
stop_energy_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_energy_bound (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (∫ r in Ioc 0 (L.stop n ω : ℝ), L.q r ω) ≤ n := by
  rw [← PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_eq_integral T L.q (L.stop n ω) (L.stop_bound n ω) ω]
  apply PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_energy_le T L.pathEnergy n ω (L.pathEnergy_continuous ω)
  simpa only [pathEnergy, PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy, NNReal.coe_zero,
    intervalIntegral.integral_same] using (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)

stop_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (L.stop n) :=
  stoppingTime_measurable Q D (L.stop n) (L.stop_stopping n)

stop_mono.exact_header: theorem stop_mono {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (ω : Ω) : L.stop n ω ≤ L.stop m ω
stop_mono.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_mono {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (ω : Ω) : L.stop n ω ≤ L.stop m ω :=
  PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_mono_threshold T L.pathEnergy n m (by exact_mod_cast h)
    ω (L.pathEnergy_continuous ω) (L.pathEnergy_monotone ω)

stop_eventually_horizon.exact_header: theorem stop_eventually_horizon (ω : Ω) : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L.stop n ω = T
stop_eventually_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem stop_eventually_horizon (ω : Ω) : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L.stop n ω = T :=
  PathEnergyStopping.firstHit_nat_eventually_horizon T L.pathEnergy ω (L.pathEnergy_monotone ω)

stoppedSigma.exact_header: def stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (i : I) : ℝ → Ω → Z
stoppedSigma.exact_declaration:
def stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (i : I) : ℝ → Ω → Z :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField (L.stop n) (L.sigma i)

stoppedSigma_strong.exact_header: theorem stoppedSigma_strong (n : ℕ) (i : I) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (L.stoppedSigma n i))
stoppedSigma_strong.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedSigma_strong (n : ℕ) (i : I) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (L.stoppedSigma n i)) :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField_stronglyMeasurable _ (L.stop_measurable n) _ (L.sigma_strong i)

stoppedSigma_adapted.exact_header:
theorem stoppedSigma_adapted (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.stoppedSigma n i t) Q
stoppedSigma_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedSigma_adapted (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.stoppedSigma n i t) Q :=
  LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField_adapted D.filtration (L.stop n) (L.stop_stopping n)
    (L.sigma i) Q (fun t => L.sigma_adapted t i) t

stoppedSigma_square.exact_header:
theorem stoppedSigma_square (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
stoppedSigma_square.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedSigma_square (n : ℕ) (i : I) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  apply LocalizedDiffusion.firstHit_column_square_integrable Q T L.q L.q_strong
    L.q_nonneg L.q_local L.pathEnergy L.pathEnergy_continuous
    (fun t ht ω => PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_eq_integral T L.q t ht ω)
    n (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (L.stop_measurable n) (L.sigma i) (L.sigma_strong i)
  intro r ω
  apply le_trans _ (L.sigma_control r ω)
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖L.sigma j r ω‖) (Finset.mem_univ i)

noise.exact_header: def noise (n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0 → Lp Z 2 Q

exists_version.exact_header:
theorem exists_version (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, Martingale M D.filtration Q ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) ∧ ∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] L.noise n t
exists_version.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_version (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, Martingale M D.filtration Q ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) ∧ ∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] L.noise n t :=
  rawDiffusionIntegral_exists_continuous_martingale Q D T (L.stoppedSigma n)

version.exact_declaration: def version (n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z := Classical.choose (L.exists_version n)

version_martingale.exact_declaration:

version_continuous.exact_header: theorem version_continuous (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => L.version n t ω)
version_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem version_continuous (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => L.version n t ω) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (L.exists_version n)).2.1

version_ae.exact_header: theorem version_ae (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : L.version n t =ᵐ[Q] L.noise n t
version_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem version_ae (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : L.version n t =ᵐ[Q] L.noise n t :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (L.exists_version n)).2.2 t

version_memLp.exact_header: theorem version_memLp (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : MemLp (L.version n t) 2 Q
version_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem version_memLp (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) : MemLp (L.version n t) 2 Q :=
  (memLp_congr_ae (L.version_ae n t)).mpr (Lp.memLp (L.noise n t))

noise_terminal_sq_le.exact_header: theorem noise_terminal_sq_le (n : ℕ) : ‖L.noise n T‖ ^ 2 ≤ n
noise_terminal_sq_le.exact_declaration:
theorem noise_terminal_sq_le (n : ℕ) : ‖L.noise n T‖ ^ 2 ≤ n := by
  have ht := LocalizedDiffusion.firstHit_physical_columns Q D.filtration T L.q L.q_strong
    L.q_nonneg L.q_local L.pathEnergy L.pathEnergy_continuous L.pathEnergy_monotone
    L.pathEnergy_measurable
    (fun t ht ω => PathwiseLocalEnergy.energy_eq_integral T L.q t ht ω)
    n (Nat.cast_nonneg n) L.sigma L.sigma_strong L.sigma_adapted L.sigma_control
  have htot := ht.2.2.2.2
  have hi : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ∑ i, ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => L.stoppedSigma_square n i)
  change ‖rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T _ _ _ _ T‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  rw [rawDiffusionIntegral_norm_sq Q D T _ _ _ _ T le_rfl]
  calc
    _ = ∫ p : ℝ × Ω, ∑ i, ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2
        ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := (integral_prod _ hi).symm
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ p : ℝ × Ω, ‖L.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2
        ∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) :=
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => L.stoppedSigma_square n i)
    _ = ∫ r in Ioc 0 (T : ℝ),
        ‖ProductLpSections.columnSections Q (L.stoppedSigma n) r‖ ^ 2 :=
      (ProductLpSections.integral_columnSections_norm_sq _ Q _
        (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n)).symm
    _ ≤ n := htot

version_terminal_sq_le.exact_header: theorem version_terminal_sq_le (n : ℕ) : (∫ ω, ‖L.version n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ n
version_terminal_sq_le.exact_declaration:
theorem version_terminal_sq_le (n : ℕ) : (∫ ω, ‖L.version n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ n := by
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, ‖L.noise n T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q :=
      integral_congr_ae ((L.version_ae n T).fun_comp (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ 2))
    _ = ‖L.noise n T‖ ^ 2 := (ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (L.noise n T)).symm
    _ ≤ n := L.noise_terminal_sq_le n

version_consistent.exact_header:
theorem version_consistent {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, L.version n t ω = L.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω
version_consistent.exact_declaration:
theorem version_consistent {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, L.version n t ω = L.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω := by
  apply rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version Q D T (L.stop n) (L.stop_bound n)
    (L.stop_stopping n) (L.stoppedSigma m) (L.stoppedSigma n)
    (L.stoppedSigma_strong m) (L.stoppedSigma_square m) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted m)
    (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    _ (L.version m) (L.version n) (L.version_ae m) (L.version_ae n)
    (L.version_continuous m) (L.version_continuous n)
  intro i r ω
  unfold stoppedSigma LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField
  by_cases hn : r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ)
  · have hm : r ≤ (L.stop m ω : ℝ) := hn.trans (by exact_mod_cast L.stop_mono h ω)
    simp [hn,hm]
  · simp [hn]

horizonIndex.exact_declaration: def horizonIndex (ω : Ω) : ℕ := Nat.find ((L.stop_eventually_horizon ω).exists)

horizonIndex_spec.exact_header: theorem horizonIndex_spec (ω : Ω) : L.stop (L.horizonIndex ω) ω = T
horizonIndex_spec.exact_declaration:
theorem horizonIndex_spec (ω : Ω) : L.stop (L.horizonIndex ω) ω = T :=
  Nat.find_spec ((L.stop_eventually_horizon ω).exists)

localNoise.exact_declaration: def localNoise (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) : Z := L.version (L.horizonIndex ω) t ω

all_consistency.exact_header:
theorem all_consistency :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∀ t,
      L.version n t ω = L.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω
all_consistency.exact_declaration:
theorem all_consistency :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∀ t,
      L.version n t ω = L.version m (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω := by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro n
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro m
  by_cases h : n ≤ m
  · exact (L.version_consistent h).mono (fun _ hc _ => hc)
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ hn => False.elim (h hn))

localNoise_stopped.exact_header:
theorem localNoise_stopped : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
    L.version n t ω = L.localNoise (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω
localNoise_stopped.exact_declaration:
theorem localNoise_stopped : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
    L.version n t ω = L.localNoise (min t (L.stop n ω)) ω := by
  filter_upwards [L.all_consistency] with ω hc
  intro n t ht
  let k := max n (L.horizonIndex ω)
  have hn := hc n k (le_max_left _ _) t
  have hN := hc (L.horizonIndex ω) k (le_max_right _ _) (min t (L.stop n ω))
  rw [L.horizonIndex_spec ω, min_eq_left ((min_le_left _ _).trans ht)] at hN
  exact hn.trans hN.symm

localNoise_continuous.exact_header: theorem localNoise_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => L.localNoise t ω)
localNoise_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem localNoise_continuous : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => L.localNoise t ω) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.version_continuous n)] with ω hc
  exact hc (L.horizonIndex ω)

version_zero.exact_header: theorem version_zero (n : ℕ) : L.version n 0 =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : Z))
version_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem version_zero (n : ℕ) : L.version n 0 =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : Z)) := by
  have hz : L.noise n 0 = 0 := rawDiffusionIntegral_zero Q D T _ _ _ _
  filter_upwards [L.version_ae n 0, Lp.coeFn_zero (E := Z) (p := 2) (μ := Q)] with ω hm h0
  rw [hz] at hm
  exact hm.trans h0

localNoise_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem localNoise_zero : L.localNoise 0 =ᵐ[Q] (fun _ => (0 : Z)) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.version_zero n)] with ω hω
  exact hω (L.horizonIndex ω)

version_eventually_localNoise.exact_header:
theorem version_eventually_localNoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L.version n t ω = L.localNoise t ω
version_eventually_localNoise.exact_declaration:
theorem version_eventually_localNoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L.version n t ω = L.localNoise t ω := by
  filter_upwards [L.localNoise_stopped] with ω hs
  intro t ht
  filter_upwards [L.stop_eventually_horizon ω] with n hn
  simpa only [hn,min_eq_left ht] using hs n t ht

localNoise_adapted.exact_header:
theorem localNoise_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.localNoise t) Q
localNoise_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem localNoise_adapted (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (L.localNoise t) Q := by
  have hsm : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t]
      (fun ω => limUnder atTop (fun n => L.version n t ω)) :=
    @StronglyMeasurable.limUnder ℕ Ω Z (D.filtration t) _ _ atTop _
      (fun n ω => L.version n t ω) _ _ (fun n => (L.version_martingale n).stronglyAdapted t)
  refine ⟨fun ω => limUnder atTop (fun n => L.version n t ω), hsm, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [L.version_eventually_localNoise] with ω hω
  have hc : Tendsto (fun n => L.version n t ω) atTop (𝓝 (L.localNoise t ω)) := by
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [hω t ht] with n hn
    exact hn.symm
  exact hc.limUnder_eq.symm

RawLocalDiffusion.scaleGauge.exact_header:
def RawLocalDiffusion.scaleGauge (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T
RawLocalDiffusion.scaleGauge.exact_declaration:
def RawLocalDiffusion.scaleGauge (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (c : ℝ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T where
  sigma := L.sigma
  sigma_strong := L.sigma_strong
  sigma_adapted := L.sigma_adapted
  q r ω := c * L.q r ω
  q_strong := stronglyMeasurable_const.mul L.q_strong
  q_nonneg r ω := mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hc) (L.q_nonneg r ω)
  q_local ω := (L.q_local ω).const_mul c
  q_progressive t := by
    have hm : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
        (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => c) := stronglyMeasurable_const
    convert hm.mul (L.q_progressive t) using 1
    funext p
    by_cases h : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [h]
  sigma_control r ω := (L.sigma_control r ω).trans (by
    nlinarith [L.q_nonneg r ω])

RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap.exact_header:
def RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (A : Z →L[ℝ] Y) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Y) Q D T
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap.exact_declaration:
def RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) (A : Z →L[ℝ] Y) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Y) Q D T where
  sigma i r ω := A (L.sigma i r ω)
  sigma_strong := rawMap_stronglyMeasurable A L.sigma L.sigma_strong
  sigma_adapted := rawMap_adapted Q A D L.sigma L.sigma_adapted
  q := (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).q
  q_strong := (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).q_strong
  q_nonneg := (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).q_nonneg
  q_local := (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).q_local
  q_progressive := (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).q_progressive
  sigma_control r ω := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (‖A‖ * ‖L.sigma i r ω‖) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (A.le_opNorm _) 2
      _ = ‖A‖ ^ 2 * ∑ i, ‖L.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp_rw [mul_pow]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2 * L.q r ω := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (L.sigma_control r ω) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2) * L.q r ω :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (L.q_nonneg r ω)

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stop (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.linearMap A).stop n ω = (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).stop n ω
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stop.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stop (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.linearMap A).stop n ω = (L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).stop n ω := rfl

RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stoppedSigma.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (i : I) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma n i r ω =
      A ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).stoppedSigma n i r ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stoppedSigma.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (i : I) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma n i r ω =
      A ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).stoppedSigma n i r ω) := by
  change (if r ≤ ((L.linearMap A).stop n ω : ℝ) then A (L.sigma i r ω) else 0) =
    A (if r ≤ ((L.linearMap A).stop n ω : ℝ) then L.sigma i r ω else 0)
  split_ifs <;> simp

RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_noise.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_noise (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.linearMap A).noise n t = A.compLpL 2 Q
      ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).noise n t)
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_noise (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.linearMap A).noise n t = A.compLpL 2 Q
      ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).noise n t) := by
  let K := L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)
  have he : ∀ i, Function.uncurry ((L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma n i) =ᵐ[
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => A (K.stoppedSigma n i p.1 p.2)) :=
    fun i => Eventually.of_forall (fun p => L.linearMap_stoppedSigma A n i p.1 p.2)
  have hi := rawDiffusionIntegral_congr_ae_coefficients Q D T
    ((L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma n) (fun i r ω => A (K.stoppedSigma n i r ω))
    ((L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma_strong n)
    (rawMap_stronglyMeasurable A (K.stoppedSigma n) (K.stoppedSigma_strong n))
    ((L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma_square n)
    (rawMap_square Q A T (K.stoppedSigma n) (K.stoppedSigma_strong n) (K.stoppedSigma_square n))
    ((L.linearMap A).stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    (rawMap_adapted Q A D (K.stoppedSigma n) (K.stoppedSigma_adapted n)) he t
  exact hi.trans (rawDiffusionIntegral_map Q A D T (K.stoppedSigma n) (K.stoppedSigma_strong n)
    (K.stoppedSigma_square n) (K.stoppedSigma_adapted n) t)

RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_version_ae.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_version_ae (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.linearMap A).version n t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>
      A ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).version n t ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_version_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_version_ae (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.linearMap A).version n t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>
      A ((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).version n t ω) := by
  have h := (L.linearMap A).version_ae n t
  rw [L.linearMap_noise A n t] at h
  exact h.trans ((A.coeFn_compLpL _).trans
    (((L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)).version_ae n t).symm.fun_comp A))

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (L.linearMap A).localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => A (L.localNoise t ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_a.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (L.linearMap A).localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => A (L.localNoise t ω) := by
  let K := L.scaleGauge (max 1 (‖A‖ ^ 2)) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω :=
    K.localNoise_gauge_congr_of_eq L (fun i r ω => rfl)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.linearMap_version_ae A n t),
    (L.linearMap A).version_eventually_localNoise, K.version_eventually_localNoise,hg]
      with ω hn hl hk hg
  obtain ⟨n,hnl,hnk⟩ := ((hl t ht).and (hk t ht)).exists
  exact hnl.symm.trans ((hn n).trans (congrArg A (hnk.trans (hg t ht))))

RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_o.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → (L.linearMap A).localNoise t ω = A (L.localNoise t ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_o.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.linearMap_localNoise_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → (L.linearMap A).localNoise t ω = A (L.localNoise t ω) := by
  let H := Iic T
  letI : Nonempty H := ⟨⟨0,by simp [H]⟩⟩
  let τ := TopologicalSpace.denseSeq H
  filter_upwards [(L.linearMap A).localNoise_continuous,L.localNoise_continuous,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.linearMap_localNoise_ae A (τ n).val (τ n).property)] with ω hl hk hn
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : H => (L.linearMap A).localNoise t.val ω) := hl.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hc' : Continuous (fun t : H => A (L.localNoise t.val ω)) :=
    A.continuous.comp (hk.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have he := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq H).equalizer hc hc' (funext hn)
  intro t ht
  exact congrFun he (⟨t,ht⟩ : H)

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_linearMap_congr
    (K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Y) Q D T)
    (hσ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) → K.sigma i r ω = A (L.sigma i r ω)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → K.localNoise t ω = A (L.localNoise t ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_linearMap_c.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_linearMap_congr
    (K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Y) Q D T)
    (hσ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) → K.sigma i r ω = A (L.sigma i r ω)) :

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] K.localNoise t
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] K.localNoise t := by
  have he := rawDiffusionIntegral_congr_ae_coefficients Q D T L.sigma K.sigma
    L.sigma_strong K.sigma_strong hL hK L.sigma_adapted K.sigma_adapted hσ t
  have hi : rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong hL L.sigma_adapted t =ᵐ[Q]
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T K.sigma K.sigma_strong hK K.sigma_adapted t :=
    Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => congrArg (fun A : Lp Z 2 Q => A ω) he)
  exact (L.localNoise_eq_global_of_square hL t ht).trans
    (hi.trans (K.localNoise_eq_global_of_square hK t ht).symm)

RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_on_ho.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_on_ho.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_congr_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → L.localNoise t ω = K.localNoise t ω := by
  let W := Iic T
  letI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨0, by simp [W]⟩⟩
  let τ := TopologicalSpace.denseSeq W
  have ht (n : ℕ) : (τ n).val ≤ T := (τ n).property
  filter_upwards [L.localNoise_continuous, K.localNoise_continuous,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.localNoise_congr_ae K hL hK hσ (τ n).val (ht n))]
    with ω hl hk he
  have hf : Continuous (fun t : W => L.localNoise t.val ω) := hl.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hg : Continuous (fun t : W => K.localNoise t.val ω) := hk.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have heq := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq W).equalizer hf hg (funext he)
  intro t htt
  exact congrFun heq (⟨t, htt⟩ : W)

/-! # Literal noise-index inclusions for actual local stochastic integrals
The original locally square diffusion is padded by zero in the larger noise
vector. Its local energy is unchanged, hence its true first-hit stops are
identical. Actual global stopped integral identities pass to the original
local process without an expected-square moment hypothesis.

embedFamily_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem embedFamily_norm_sq (v : I → Z) :
    ∑ j, ‖embedFamily f v j‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2
embedFamily_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem embedFamily_norm_sq (v : I → Z) :
    ∑ j, ‖embedFamily f v j‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let A := Finset.univ.image f
  have he : ∑ j ∈ A, ‖embedFamily f v j‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j, ‖embedFamily f v j‖ ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ A)
    intro j hj hja
    have hjr : j ∉ range f := by
      rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
      exact hja (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,rfl⟩)
    rw [embedFamily_outside f v j hjr]
    simp
  rw [← he]
  dsimp only [A]
  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i hi k hk h => f.injective h)]
  simp only [embedFamily_image]

RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise.exact_header:
def RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q E T
RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise.exact_declaration:
def RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q E T where
  sigma := rawEmbed f L.sigma
  sigma_strong := rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable f L.sigma L.sigma_strong
  sigma_adapted := rawEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF L.sigma L.sigma_adapted
  q := L.q
  q_strong := L.q_strong
  q_nonneg := L.q_nonneg
  q_local := L.q_local
  q_progressive t := by rw [← hF]; exact L.q_progressive t
  sigma_control r ω := by
    change (∑ j, ‖embedFamily f (fun i => L.sigma i r ω) j‖ ^ 2) ≤ L.q r ω
    rw [embedFamily_norm_sq f]
    exact L.sigma_control r ω

RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_stoppedSig.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (j : J) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).stoppedSigma n j r ω = rawEmbed f (L.stoppedSigma n) j r ω
RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_stoppedSig.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_stoppedSigma (n : ℕ) (j : J) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).stoppedSigma n j r ω = rawEmbed f (L.stoppedSigma n) j r ω := by
  change (if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then embedFamily f (fun i => L.sigma i r ω) j else 0) =
    embedFamily f (fun i => if r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) then L.sigma i r ω else 0) j
  by_cases hr : r ≤ (L.stop n ω : ℝ) <;> simp [hr,embedFamily]

RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_noise.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_noise (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).noise n t = L.noise n t
RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_noise (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).noise n t = L.noise n t := by
  let K := L.injectNoise f E hF
  have he : ∀ j, Function.uncurry (K.stoppedSigma n j) =ᵐ[
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q] Function.uncurry (rawEmbed f (L.stoppedSigma n) j) :=
    fun j => Eventually.of_forall (fun p => L.injectNoise_stoppedSigma f E hF hp n j p.1 p.2)
  have hi := rawDiffusionIntegral_congr_ae_coefficients Q E T (K.stoppedSigma n)
    (rawEmbed f (L.stoppedSigma n)) (K.stoppedSigma_strong n)
    (rawEmbed_stronglyMeasurable f (L.stoppedSigma n) (L.stoppedSigma_strong n))
    (K.stoppedSigma_square n) (rawEmbed_square Q f T (L.stoppedSigma n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n))
    (K.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
    (rawEmbed_adapted Q f D E hF (L.stoppedSigma n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)) he t
  exact hi.trans (rawDiffusionIntegral_embed Q f D E hF hp T (L.stoppedSigma n)
    (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n) t)

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :

RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] L.localNoise t := by
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.injectNoise_version_ae f E hF hp n t),
    (L.injectNoise f E hF).version_eventually_localNoise,L.version_eventually_localNoise]
      with ω hn hk hl
  obtain ⟨n,hnk,hnl⟩ := ((hk t ht).and (hl t ht)).exists
  exact hnk.symm.trans ((hn n).trans hnl)

RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → (L.injectNoise f E hF).localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω
RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.injectNoise_localNoise_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → (L.injectNoise f E hF).localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t ω := by
  let H := Iic T
  letI : Nonempty H := ⟨⟨0,by simp [H]⟩⟩
  let τ := TopologicalSpace.denseSeq H
  filter_upwards [(L.injectNoise f E hF).localNoise_continuous,L.localNoise_continuous,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.injectNoise_localNoise_ae f E hF hp (τ n).val (τ n).property)]
      with ω hk hl hn
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : H => (L.injectNoise f E hF).localNoise t.val ω) :=
    hk.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hc' : Continuous (fun t : H => L.localNoise t.val ω) := hl.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have he := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq H).equalizer hc hc' (funext hn)
  intro t ht
  exact congrFun he (⟨t,ht⟩ : H)

RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_eq_global_o.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_eq_global_of_square
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong
      hσ2 L.sigma_adapted t
RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_eq_global_o.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.localNoise_eq_global_of_square
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖L.sigma i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong
      hσ2 L.sigma_adapted t := by
  obtain ⟨M, hMmart, hMcont, hM⟩ := rawDiffusionIntegral_exists_continuous_martingale Q D T
    L.sigma L.sigma_strong hσ2 L.sigma_adapted
  have hstop (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
      L.version n s ω = M (min s (L.stop n ω)) ω :=
    rawDiffusionIntegral_stopped_version Q D T (L.stop n) (L.stop_bound n) (L.stop_stopping n)
      L.sigma (L.stoppedSigma n) L.sigma_strong hσ2 L.sigma_adapted
      (L.stoppedSigma_strong n) (L.stoppedSigma_square n) (L.stoppedSigma_adapted n)
      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) M (L.version n) hM (L.version_ae n) hMcont (L.version_continuous n)
  have heq : L.localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] M t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hstop, L.version_eventually_localNoise] with ω hs hl
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hnl⟩ := ((L.stop_eventually_horizon ω).and (hl t ht)).exists
    exact hnl.symm.trans (by simpa only [hn, min_eq_left ht] using hs n t)
  exact heq.trans (hM t)

RawLocalDiffusion.pullback.exact_header:
def RawLocalDiffusion.pullback (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) R D T) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q E T
RawLocalDiffusion.pullback.exact_declaration:
def RawLocalDiffusion.pullback (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) R D T) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q E T where
  sigma i r ω := L.sigma i r (f ω)
  sigma_strong := rawPullback_stronglyMeasurable hf L.sigma L.sigma_strong
  sigma_adapted t i := (rawPullback_adapted hf D L.sigma L.sigma_adapted t i).mono (he t)
  q r ω := L.q r (f ω)
  q_strong := L.q_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  q_nonneg r ω := L.q_nonneg r (f ω)
  q_local ω := L.q_local (f ω)
  q_progressive t := by
    have hm : @Measurable Ω Ω' (E.filtration t) (D.filtration t) f :=
      measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (he t)
    have hmap : @Measurable (ℝ × Ω) (ℝ × Ω')
        ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (E.filtration t))
        ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t))
        (fun p => (p.1,f p.2)) := measurable_fst.prodMk (hm.comp measurable_snd)
    exact (L.q_progressive t).comp_measurable hmap
  sigma_control r ω := L.sigma_control r (f ω)

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_noise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :

RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_noise_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_noise_ae (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    (L.pullback hf E he).localNoise t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => L.localNoise t (f ω) := by
  let K := L.pullback hf E he
  have hK2 := rawPullback_square hf T L.sigma h2
  have hi := rawDiffusionIntegral_pullback_enlarge hf D E hp he T L.sigma L.sigma_strong h2
    L.sigma_adapted t
  have heq : rawDiffusionIntegral Q E T K.sigma K.sigma_strong hK2 K.sigma_adapted t =
      lpPullbackCLM hf (rawDiffusionIntegral R D T L.sigma L.sigma_strong h2 L.sigma_adapted t) := by
    exact hi
  have hs := K.localNoise_eq_global_of_square hK2 t ht
  rw [heq] at hs
  exact hs.trans ((lpPullback_coe hf _).trans
    (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (L.localNoise_eq_global_of_square h2 t ht).symm))

    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (L.version_eventually_localNoise)] with ω hn hk hl
  obtain ⟨n, hnk, hnl⟩ := ((hk t ht).and (hl t ht)).exists
  exact hnk.symm.trans ((hn n).trans hnl)

theorem RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon :

RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_localNoise_on.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      (L.pullback hf E he).localNoise t ω = L.localNoise t (f ω) := by
  let A := Iic T
  letI : Nonempty A := ⟨⟨0,by simp [A]⟩⟩

  filter_upwards [(L.pullback hf E he).localNoise_continuous,
    hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (L.localNoise_continuous),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => L.pullback_localNoise_ae hf E he hp (τ n).val (τ n).property)]

  have hc : Continuous (fun t : A => (L.pullback hf E he).localNoise t.val ω) :=

  have hc' : Continuous (fun t : A => L.localNoise t.val (f ω)) :=
    hk.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have heq := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq A).equalizer hc hc' (funext hn)
