RawLocalDiffusion.exists_of_ae.exact_header:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.exists_of_ae (T : ℝ≥0)
    (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (hcontrol : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖σ i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    ∃ L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ B : Set Ω, MeasurableSet B ∧ Q B = 0 ∧
        (∀ i r ω, L.sigma i r ω = if ω ∈ B then 0 else σ i r ω) ∧
        (∀ r ω, L.q r ω = if ω ∈ B then 0 else q r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (∀ i r, L.sigma i r ω = σ i r ω) ∧ ∀ r, L.q r ω = q r ω)
RawLocalDiffusion.exists_of_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem RawLocalDiffusion.exists_of_ae (T : ℝ≥0)
    (σ : I → ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ i)))
    (hA : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (σ i t) Q)
    (q : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hq : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q))
    (hpos : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ q r ω)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpast : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1))
    (hcontrol : ∀ r ω, ∑ i, ‖σ i r ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ q r ω) :
    ∃ L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T,
      ∃ B : Set Ω, MeasurableSet B ∧ Q B = 0 ∧
        (∀ i r ω, L.sigma i r ω = if ω ∈ B then 0 else σ i r ω) ∧
        (∀ r ω, L.q r ω = if ω ∈ B then 0 else q r ω) ∧
        (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (∀ i r, L.sigma i r ω = σ i r ω) ∧ ∀ r, L.q r ω = q r ω) := by
  classical
  let P : Ω → Prop := fun ω => IntegrableOn (fun r => q r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))
  have hP : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, P ω := hlocal
  have hP0 : Q {ω | ¬ P ω} = 0 := ae_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨B,hbad,hBm,hB0⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null hP0
  let σ' : I → ℝ → Ω → Z := fun i r ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else σ i r ω
  let q' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun r ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else q r ω
  have hBprod : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × Ω | p.2 ∈ B} := hBm.preimage measurable_snd
  have hσs (i : I) : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (σ' i)) :=
    (stronglyMeasurable_const : StronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => (0 : Z))).piecewise hBprod (hσ i)
  have hσA (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable[(nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t] (σ' i t) Q := by
    have hAE := (hA t i).mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t)
    have hb := measurableSet_nullAugmentation Q (D.filtration t) B hBm hB0
    refine ⟨fun ω => if ω ∈ B then 0 else hAE.mk (σ i t) ω,
      stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise hb hAE.stronglyMeasurable_mk, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hAE.ae_eq_mk] with ω hω
    by_cases hB : ω ∈ B <;> simp [σ',hB,hω]
  have hqs : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry q') :=
    (stronglyMeasurable_const : StronglyMeasurable (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => (0 : ℝ))).piecewise hBprod hq
  have hqA (t : ℝ≥0) :
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q' r p.2) p.1) := by
    have hprod : (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t) ≤
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t) :=
      sup_le_sup le_rfl (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t))
    have hp := (hpast t).mono hprod
    have hb : MeasurableSet[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t)]
        {p : ℝ × Ω | p.2 ∈ B} :=
      (measurableSet_nullAugmentation Q (D.filtration t) B hBm hB0).preimage measurable_snd
    have he : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q' r p.2) p.1) =
        fun p : ℝ × Ω => if p.2 ∈ B then 0 else (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => q r p.2) p.1 := by
      funext p
      by_cases hB : p.2 ∈ B <;> by_cases ht : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [q',hB,ht]
    rw [he]
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const.piecewise hb hp
  have hqlocal (ω : Ω) : IntegrableOn (fun r => q' r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
    · simpa only [q',ite_eq_left hω] using (integrableOn_zero : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) _)
    · have hp : P ω := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hω (hbad hn)
      simpa only [q',ite_eq_right hω] using hp
  let L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T :=
    { sigma := σ'
      sigma_strong := hσs
      sigma_adapted := hσA
      q := q'
      q_strong := hqs
      q_nonneg := fun r ω => by by_cases hω : ω ∈ B <;> simp [q',hω,hpos]
      q_local := hqlocal
      q_progressive := hqA
      sigma_control := fun r ω => by
        by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
        · simp [σ',q',hω]
        · simpa only [σ',q',ite_eq_right hω] using hcontrol r ω }
  refine ⟨L,B,hBm,hB0,(fun _ _ _ => rfl),(fun _ _ => rfl),?_⟩
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hB0] with ω hω
  exact ⟨fun i r => ite_eq_right hω, fun r => ite_eq_right hω⟩

def SamplerData.pullback (U : SamplerData R D M T a) : SamplerData Q E M T a where
  localDiffusion := U.localDiffusion.pullback hf E he
  state t ω := U.state t (f ω)
  measurable t ht := (U.measurable t ht).comp hf.measurable
  adapted t := by
    refine ⟨(U.adapted t).mk (U.state t) ∘ f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (U.adapted t).stronglyMeasurable_mk.comp_measurable
        (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr (he t))
    · exact hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (U.adapted t).ae_eq_mk
  continuous_paths := hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.continuous_paths
  drift_integrable := hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.drift_integrable
  diffusion_realizes := hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.diffusion_realizes
  equation := by
    filter_upwards [hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae U.equation,
      U.localDiffusion.pullback_localNoise_on_horizon hf E he hp] with ω hu hn
    intro t ht
    have hnt : t.toNNReal ≤ T := by exact_mod_cast (Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr ht.2
    change U.state t (f ω) = U.state 0 (f ω) + _ + _
    rw [hn t.toNNReal hnt]
    exact hu t ht

def Data.pullback (U : Data R D M T) : Data Q E M T where
  optimizer := U.optimizer
  sampler := U.sampler.pullback hf E he hp
  second_moment t ht := by rw [U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp t ht]; exact U.second_moment t ht
  observation_integrable t ht := by
    rw [U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp t ht]
    exact U.observation_integrable t ht
  optimizer_field_integrable := by
    apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun t =>
      M.optimizerField t (U.optimizer t) (R.map (U.sampler.state t))) ?_).mpr
      U.optimizer_field_integrable
    intro t ht
    rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at ht
    dsimp only
    rw [U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp t (Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht)]
  optimizer_equation t ht := by
    rw [U.optimizer_equation t ht]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hr
    dsimp only
    rw [U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩]

structure SamplerData (a : ℝ → S) where
  localDiffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T
  state : ℝ → Ω → Z
  measurable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Measurable (state t)
  adapted : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (state t) Q
  continuous_paths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => state t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
  drift_integrable : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable
    (fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (state r ω)) volume 0 (T : ℝ)

    localDiffusion.sigma i t ω = M.diffusion (M.parameter (a t)) (state t ω) i
  equation : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), state t ω = state 0 ω +
    (∫ r in 0..t, M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (state r ω)) +
      localDiffusion.localNoise t.toNNReal ω

Data.exact_declaration:
structure Data where
  optimizer : ℝ → S
  sampler : SamplerData Q D M T optimizer
  second_moment : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), HasFiniteSecondMoment (Q.map (sampler.state t))
  observation_integrable : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
    (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (optimizer t)) (M.position z))
      (Q.map (sampler.state t))

    (fun t => M.optimizerField t (optimizer t) (Q.map (sampler.state t))) volume 0 (T : ℝ)
  optimizer_equation : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), optimizer t = optimizer 0 +
    ∫ r in 0..t, M.optimizerField r (optimizer r) (Q.map (sampler.state r))

def PathwiseUniqueness : Prop :=
  ∀ U V : Data Q D M T, U.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0 →
    U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q] V.sampler.state 0 → ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      U.optimizer t = V.optimizer t ∧ U.sampler.state t =ᵐ[Q] V.sampler.state t

FrozenSamplerData.constantData.exact_header:
def FrozenSamplerData.constantData {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) : Data Q D M T
FrozenSamplerData.constantData.exact_declaration:
def FrozenSamplerData.constantData {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0) : Data Q D M T where
  optimizer _ := sStar
  sampler := F.toSamplerData
  second_moment t ht := by rw [F.invariant_law t ht]; exact F.second_moment
  observation_integrable t ht := by rw [F.invariant_law t ht]; exact hint
  optimizer_field_integrable := by
    apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : S)) ?_).mpr intervalIntegrable_const
    intro r hr
    rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
    simp only [Model.optimizerField, F.invariant_law r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr), hg,
      hfix r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)]
  optimizer_equation t ht := by
    have hi : (∫ r in 0..t, M.optimizerField r sStar (Q.map (F.state r))) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ _r in 0..t, (0 : S) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro r hr
          rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hr
          have hrT : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
          simp only [Model.optimizerField, F.invariant_law r hrT, hg, hfix r hrT]
        _ = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_zero
    simpa only [hi, add_zero]

theorem stationary_of_frozen (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q] F.state 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) = νStar
stationary_of_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_of_frozen (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q] F.state 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) = νStar := by
  have hu := hunique U (F.constantData hint hg hfix) hs hz t ht
  exact ⟨hu.1, (Measure.map_congr hu.2).trans (F.invariant_law t ht)⟩

stationary_product_law.exact_header:
theorem stationary_product_law [MeasurableSpace S]
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q] F.state 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) =
      (Measure.dirac sStar).prod νStar
stationary_product_law.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_product_law [MeasurableSpace S]
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q D M T)
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} (F : FrozenSamplerData Q D M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (U : Data Q D M T) (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar)
    (hz : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q] F.state 0)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) =
      (Measure.dirac sStar).prod νStar := by
  obtain ⟨hopt, hsam⟩ := stationary_of_frozen hunique F hint hg hfix U hs hz t ht
  have hm := U.sampler.measurable t ht
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure νStar := F.probability
  rw [hopt, Measure.dirac_prod, ← hsam, Measure.map_map measurable_prodMk_left hm]
  rfl

      B.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)

    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))

    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',

    (huniqueU : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q W)) M T)

    (hpath : ∃ B : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ)

      B.optimizer 0 = U.optimizer 0 ∧
      B.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))

    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),

        2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))

        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)

    intro r hr
    rw [← (hUA r hr).1,← (hUA r hr).2]
    exact hU2 r hr

theorem law_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data (νStar.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) νStar) M T)
    (hU0 : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] Prod.fst)
    (hV0 : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[νStar.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] Prod.fst)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))

    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))

    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2
        ∂(μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S)
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (νStar.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) sStar μ νStar := by
  have hUI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) U.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ U.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ U 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hU0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ μ hμ).symm)
  have hVI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (νStar.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) V.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) νStar hν := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ V.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ V 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hV0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ νStar hν).symm)

    (fun c => Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+c ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)

  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  letI : IsSeparable Q := CanonicalSeparable.initial_vector_isSeparable (I := I) c.joint
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ νStar c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ νStar c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ νStar c
  have hp : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hf (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_process_eq μ νStar c) i) t)
  have hq : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hg (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) νStar)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_process_eq μ νStar c) i) t)
  let he := CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_filtration_le (I := I) μ νStar c
  let hk := CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_filtration_le (I := I) μ νStar c
  let Uc := U.pullback hf E he hp
  let Vc := V.pullback hg E hk hq
  have huLaw (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      Q.map (Uc.sampler.state r) = (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r) :=
    U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp r hr
  have hvLaw (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      Q.map (Vc.sampler.state r) = (νStar.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state r) :=
    V.sampler.pullback_law hg E hk hq r hr
  have h := RawNaturalConstantParameter.reference_law_decay Uc Vc D ρ hρ hmono hσ hb hF hDrift hOptimizer
    LΨ hΨ V0
    (fun r hr => by rw [huLaw r hr]; exact hU2 r hr)
    (fun r hr => by rw [huLaw r hr]; exact hVar r hr)
    sStar νStar hopt (fun r hr => (hvLaw r hr).trans (hlaw r hr)) hobs
  rw [huLaw T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩] at h
  change optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar
    ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar ≤
    Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
        ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Uc.sampler.state 0-
          ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Vc.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) at h
  rw [pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),
    pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),hUI,hVI,
    initial_difference_norm_sq μ νStar hμ hν c] at h

    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)

    {N : ℕ} {Wp : Driver (I := Fin N × I) Qp}

    (P : RawParticleInteraction.Data M
      (fun r => (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)) Lp)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),

        M.meanGradient ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2
        ∂(μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S)
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),

    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Qp.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp,
      (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.1 = U.optimizer r)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp, (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar) 2 Qp ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Qp) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *

  let ν : ℝ → Measure Z := fun r => Q.map (U.sampler.state (RawDampedState.timeClamp T r))
  have hνc (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ν r = Q.map (U.sampler.state r) := by
    dsimp only [ν]
    rw [RawDampedState.timeClamp_eq T hr]
  letI : ∀ r, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r) := fun r =>
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
      (U.sampler.measurable _ (RawDampedState.timeClamp_mem T r)).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  let Pc : RawParticleInteraction.Data M ν Lp := {
    toData := P.toData
    drift_realizes := by
      intro r hr
      rw [hνc r hr]
      exact P.drift_realizes r hr
    sigma_realizes := P.sigma_realizes }

    (hVar 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)

    hProjection LΨ V0 hVarNonneg U.optimizer sStar hΨ
    (fun r hr => by rw [hνc r hr]; exact hU2 r hr)
    (fun r hr => by simpa only [hνc r hr] using hCloud r hr)
    hbar (fun r hr => by rw [hνc r hr]; exact hVar r hr) hinit
  have hd := RawNaturalConstantLaw.law_decay μ νStar hμ hν U V hU0 hV0 D ρ hρ.le hmono
    hσ hb hF hDrift hOptimizer LΨ hΨ V0 hU2 hVar sStar hopt hlaw hobs
  have ho := optimizer_norm_le_lawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar

constantLocal.exact_header: def constantLocal (c : I → Z) : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T
constantLocal.exact_declaration:
def constantLocal (c : I → Z) : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T where
  sigma _ _ _ := c _
  sigma_strong _ := stronglyMeasurable_const
  sigma_adapted _ _ := stronglyMeasurable_const.aestronglyMeasurable
  q _ _ := ∑ i, ‖c i‖ ^ 2
  q_strong := stronglyMeasurable_const
  q_nonneg _ _ := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  q_local _ := integrable_const _
  q_progressive t := by
    exact (stronglyMeasurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).comp_measurable measurable_fst
  sigma_control _ _ := le_rfl

Realization.exact_header: structure Realization (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
Realization.exact_declaration:
structure Realization (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) where
  localDiffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T
  data : RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data Q M D T localDiffusion
  optimizer_eq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), data.optimizer t = U.optimizer t
  sampler_eq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), data.sampler t ω = U.sampler.state t ω

build.exact_declaration:
def build : Realization U := Classical.choice <| by
  classical
  let a : ℝ → S := fun r => U.optimizer (timeClamp T r)
  have haC : Continuous a := (RawSamplerGrowth.optimizer_continuous U).comp_continuous
    (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  have ha (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : a r = U.optimizer r := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [timeClamp_eq T hr]
  have hxMeas (r : ℝ) : Measurable (U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r)) :=
    U.sampler.measurable _ (timeClamp_mem T r)
  have hxCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r) ω) := by
    filter_upwards [U.sampler.continuous_paths] with ω h
    exact h.comp_continuous (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  obtain ⟨x,hxJoint,hxC,hxAE⟩ := ContinuousProcessRepresentative.exists_joint_of_measurable Q
    (fun r ω => U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r) ω) hxMeas hxCont
  have hx : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = U.sampler.state r ω := by
    filter_upwards [hxAE] with ω h r hr
    simpa only [timeClamp_eq T hr] using h r
  have hxLaw (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Q.map (x r) = Q.map (U.sampler.state r) :=
    Measure.map_congr (hx.mono (fun _ h => h r hr))
  let c : I → Z := M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer 0)) 0
  let L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q D T := constantLocal c
  have hnoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      L.localNoise t ω = U.sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω := by
    apply L.localNoise_gauge_congr_on_horizon U.sampler.localDiffusion
    filter_upwards [U.sampler.diffusion_realizes] with ω h i r hr
    exact (hσ (U.optimizer 0) (U.optimizer r) 0 (U.sampler.state r ω) i).trans
      (h r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr) i).symm
  let j : ℝ → S := fun r => M.optimizerField r (a r) (Q.map (x r))
  have hjEq (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      j r = M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) := by
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [ha r hr,hxLaw r hr]
  have hObsJoint : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      M.observation (M.parameter (a p.1)) (M.position (x p.1 p.2))) :=
    (hObs.comp ((haC.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk hxJoint.measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
  have hjStrong : StronglyMeasurable j := by
    have hm := hObsJoint.integral_prod_right' (ν := Q)
    have hψ : StronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.optimizer r (a r)
        (∫ ω, M.observation (M.parameter (a r)) (M.position (x r ω)) ∂Q)) :=
      (hOptimizer.comp (measurable_id.prodMk (haC.measurable.prodMk hm.measurable))).stronglyMeasurable
    convert hψ using 1
    funext r
    dsimp only [j,Model.optimizerField,Model.meanGradient]
    have hxr : Measurable (x r) := hxJoint.of_uncurry_left.measurable
    have hor : Measurable (fun z : Z => M.observation (M.parameter (a r)) (M.position z)) :=
      hObs.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    congr 1
    exact integral_map hxr.aemeasurable hor.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hjInt : IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun r =>
      M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r))) ?_).mpr U.optimizer_field_integrable
    intro r hr
    rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
    exact hjEq r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)
  let V : RawConstantNoiseContraction.Data Q M D T L := {
    optimizer := a
    optimizerDrift := j
    sampler := x
    optimizer_strong := haC.stronglyMeasurable
    optimizerDrift_strong := hjStrong
    sampler_strong := hxJoint
    drift_strong := (hDrift.comp ((haC.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk hxJoint.measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
    optimizerDrift_integrable := hjInt
    optimizerDrift_realizes := fun _ _ => rfl
    optimizer_equation := by
      intro r hr
      rw [ha r hr,ha 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,U.optimizer_equation r hr]
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hr.1] at hs
      exact (hjEq s ⟨hs.1,hs.2.trans hr.2⟩).symm
    drift_integrable := by
      filter_upwards [U.sampler.drift_integrable,hx] with ω hb hx
      apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun r =>
        M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (U.sampler.state r ω)) ?_).mpr hb
      intro r hr
      rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
      dsimp only
      rw [ha r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr),hx r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)]
    sampler_equation := by
      filter_upwards [U.sampler.equation,hx,hnoise] with ω he hx hn
      intro r hr
      rw [hx r hr,hx 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,hn r.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr hr.2),he r hr]
      congr 2
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hr.1] at hs
      dsimp only
      rw [ha s ⟨hs.1,hs.2.trans hr.2⟩,hx s ⟨hs.1,hs.2.trans hr.2⟩]
    diffusion_realizes := by
      intro i r ω
      exact hσ (U.optimizer 0) (a r) 0 (x r ω) i
    sampler_square := by
      intro r hr
      exact (memLp_congr_ae (hx.mono (fun _ h => h r hr))).mpr (RawSamplerGrowth.sampler_memLp D U r hr)
    observation_integrable := by
      intro r hr
      rw [ha r hr,hxLaw r hr]
      exact U.observation_integrable r hr }
  exact ⟨⟨L,V,ha,hx⟩⟩

theorem Realization.sampler_section (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :

theorem reference_law_decay
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler.state r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state 0-
            ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2)
reference_law_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem reference_law_decay
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler.state r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state 0-
            ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) := by
  let A := RawNaturalConstantNoise.build U hσ hF hDrift hOptimizer
  let B := RawNaturalConstantNoise.build V hσ hF hDrift hOptimizer
  have hA2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (A.data.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (A.data.sampler r)) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [A.optimizer_eq r hr,A.sampler_law r hr]
    exact hU2 r hr
  have hAV : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (A.data.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (A.data.sampler r)) (A.data.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2
          ∂Q.map (A.data.sampler r)) ≤ V0 := by
    intro r hr
    rw [A.optimizer_eq r hr,A.sampler_law r hr]
    exact hVar r hr
  have hd := ConstantNoiseFluctuation.law_decay_of_reference_variance_stationary_target
    M D Q A.data hF B.data ρ hρ hmono hσ hb LΨ hΨ V0 hA2 hAV sStar νStar
    (fun r hr => (B.optimizer_eq r hr).trans (hopt r hr))
    (fun r hr => (B.sampler_law r hr).trans (hlaw r hr)) hobs
  rw [A.optimizer_eq T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩,A.sampler_law T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩,
    A.optimizer_eq 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,
    A.sampler_section 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,
    B.sampler_section 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩] at hd
  exact hd

theorem parameter_bound
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler.state r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Qp.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.2) =

    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp,
      (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.1 = U.optimizer r)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp, (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar) 2 Qp ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Qp) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state 0-
            ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) +
      ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)*Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber*V0/(N : ℝ))*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*(T : ℝ)))
parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem parameter_bound
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hF : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer r s g-M.optimizer r s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ)*‖g-g'‖)
    (V0 : ℝ)
    (hU2 : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z))
        2 (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hVar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) (U.optimizer r)‖ ^ 2 ∂Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) ≤ V0)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (hopt : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), V.optimizer r = sStar)
    (hlaw : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (V.sampler.state r) = νStar)
    (hobs : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hCloud : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Qp.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler.state r)))
    (hbar : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp,
      (pairEquiv N (P.state r ω)).2.1 = U.optimizer r)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Qp, (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (P.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar) 2 Qp ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (P.state T ω)).1.1-M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Qp) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-sStar‖ ^ 2+
          ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state 0-
            ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q V.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) +
      ((LΨ : ℝ)/ρ)*Real.sqrt (D.conditionNumber*V0/(N : ℝ))*(1-Real.exp (-ρ*(T : ℝ))) := by
  let ν : ℝ → Measure Z := fun r => Q.map (U.sampler.state (RawDampedState.timeClamp T r))
  have hν (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : ν r = Q.map (U.sampler.state r) := by
    dsimp only [ν]
    rw [RawDampedState.timeClamp_eq T hr]
  letI : ∀ r, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν r) := fun r =>
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
      (U.sampler.measurable _ (RawDampedState.timeClamp_mem T r)).aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  let Pc : RawParticleInteraction.Data M ν Lp := {
    toData := P.toData
    drift_realizes := by
      intro r hr
      rw [hν r hr]
      exact P.drift_realizes r hr
    sigma_realizes := P.sigma_realizes }
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V0 :=
    (integral_nonneg (fun z => sq_nonneg
      ‖M.observation (M.parameter (U.optimizer 0)) (M.position z)-
        M.meanGradient (Q.map (U.sampler.state 0)) (U.optimizer 0)‖)).trans
      (hVar 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)
  obtain ⟨hm,hp⟩ := RawParticleParameter.parameter_bias_bound Pc D ρ hρ hmono hN
    hProjection LΨ V0 hV0 U.optimizer sStar hΨ
    (fun r hr => by rw [hν r hr]; exact hU2 r hr)
    (fun r hr => by simpa only [hν r hr] using hCloud r hr)
    hbar (fun r hr => by rw [hν r hr]; exact hVar r hr) hinit
  have hd := reference_law_decay U V D ρ hρ.le hmono hσ hb hF hDrift hOptimizer
    LΨ hΨ V0 hU2 hVar sStar νStar hopt hlaw hobs
  have ho := optimizer_norm_le_lawDistance (U.optimizer T) sStar (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) νStar
  exact ⟨hm,(hp.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (ho.trans hd))).trans_eq (add_comm _ _)⟩

Realization.exact_header: structure Realization (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a)
Realization.exact_declaration:
structure Realization (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a) where
  localDiffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T
  data : RawDampedState.Data localDiffusion
  continuous_all : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun r => data.state r ω)
  state_eq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), data.state r ω = U.state r ω
  drift_realizes : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
    data.drift r ω = M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (data.state r ω)
  sigma_realizes : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i,
    localDiffusion.sigma i r ω = M.diffusion (M.parameter (a r)) (data.state r ω) i
  noise_eq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
    localDiffusion.localNoise t ω = U.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω

build.exact_header:
def build (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (h0 : MemLp (U.state 0) 2 Q)
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2)) : Realization U
build.exact_declaration:
def build (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a)
    (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (h0 : MemLp (U.state 0) 2 Q)
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2)) : Realization U :=
  Classical.choice <| by
  let a' : ℝ → S := fun r => a (timeClamp T r)
  have haC : Continuous a' := ha.comp_continuous
    (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  have haE (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : a' r = a r := by
    dsimp only [a']
    rw [timeClamp_eq T hr]
  have hxMeas (r : ℝ) : Measurable (U.state (timeClamp T r)) := U.measurable _ (timeClamp_mem T r)
  have hxCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.state (timeClamp T r) ω) := by
    filter_upwards [U.continuous_paths] with ω h
    exact h.comp_continuous (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  obtain ⟨g,hgJoint,hgC,hgAE⟩ := ContinuousProcessRepresentative.exists_joint_of_measurable Q
    (fun r ω => U.state (timeClamp T r) ω) hxMeas hxCont
  have hgE : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), g r ω = U.state r ω := by
    filter_upwards [hgAE] with ω h r hr
    simpa only [timeClamp_eq T hr] using h r
  let b : ℝ → Ω → Z := fun r ω => M.drift (M.parameter (a' r)) (g r ω)
  have hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) :=
    (hDrift.comp ((haC.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk hgJoint.measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
  have hA (t : ℝ≥0) : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (g t) Q := by
    let c : ℝ≥0 := (timeClamp T t).toNNReal
    have hcR : (c : ℝ) = timeClamp T t := Real.coe_toNNReal _ (timeClamp_mem T t).1
    have hct : c ≤ t := by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe,hcR]
      exact max_le t.coe_nonneg (min_le_left _ _)
    have hX : AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (U.state (timeClamp T t)) Q := by
      simpa only [hcR] using (U.adapted c).mono (D.filtration.mono hct)
    exact hX.congr (hgAE.mono (fun _ h => (h t).symm))
  have hbi : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [U.drift_integrable,hgE] with ω hi hg
    apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun r => M.drift (M.parameter (a r)) (U.state r ω)) ?_).mpr hi
    intro r hr
    rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [haE r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr),hg r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)]
  have hbp : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
      StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
        ((nullAugmentedDriver Q D).filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => ‖b r p.2‖) p.1) := by
    let E := nullAugmentedDriver Q D
    let u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → S × Z := fun t ω => (a' t,g t ω)
    have hu : StronglyAdapted E.filtration u := by
      intro t
      have hg : StronglyMeasurable[E.filtration t] (g t) :=
        (measurable_nullAugmentation_of_aestrong Q (D.filtration t)
          hgJoint.of_uncurry_left.measurable (hA t)).stronglyMeasurable
      exact stronglyMeasurable_const.prodMk hg
    have hc : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t : ℝ≥0 => u t ω) := fun ω =>
      (haC.comp NNReal.continuous_coe).prodMk ((hgC ω).comp NNReal.continuous_coe)
    intro t
    have hw := RawProgressiveWindow.continuous_adapted_coefficient_window E.filtration u hu hc
      (fun p : S × Z => ‖M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2‖) hDrift.norm t
    convert hw using 1
    funext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hp,RawProgressiveWindow.realExtension,u,b,
        Real.coe_toNNReal _ hp.1.le]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp]
  have heq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      g t ω = g 0 ω+(∫ r in 0..t,b r ω)+U.localDiffusion.localNoise t.toNNReal ω := by
    filter_upwards [U.equation,hgE] with ω he hg t ht
    rw [hg t ht,hg 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩,he t ht]
    congr 2
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1] at hr
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [haE r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩,hg r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.trans ht.2⟩]
  have hG0 : MemLp (g 0) 2 Q :=
    (memLp_congr_ae (hgE.mono (fun _ h => h 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩))).mpr h0
  obtain ⟨K,R,hrState,hrDrift,hrSigma,hrNoise⟩ := RawDriftGauge.exists_data U.localDiffusion g b hgJoint hb
    hG0 hA (Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => (hgC ω).continuousOn)) hbi hbp heq
  have hstate : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), R.state r ω = U.state r ω := by
    simpa only [hrState] using hgE
  refine ⟨⟨K,R,?_,hstate,?_,?_,hrNoise⟩⟩
  · simpa only [hrState] using hgC
  · filter_upwards [hrDrift] with ω h r hr
    rw [h r,hrState]
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [haE r hr]
  · filter_upwards [hrSigma,U.diffusion_realizes,hstate] with ω hK hU hR r hr i
    rw [hK i r,hU r hr i,hR r hr]

build_model.exact_declaration:
def build_model (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2)) :
    Realization U.sampler :=
  build U.sampler (RawSamplerGrowth.optimizer_continuous U)
    (RawSamplerGrowth.sampler_memLp D U 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩) hDrift

PBGSO/RawOptimizerField.lean.scope_note: Original raw model data and primitive Borel observation/response composites are explicit. No coefficient growth, diffusion constancy, global drift moment or supplied population-field measurability is assumed.
PBGSO/RawOptimizerField.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawSamplerGrowth
import PBGSO.ContinuousProcessRepresentative
import PBGSO.RawDampedState

/-! # Measurable original optimizer fields from primitive Borel coefficients
A continuous joint representative of the original sampler proves actual
population observation measurability. No diffusion constancy, coefficient
growth, global sampler-drift moment, or supplied field measurability is used.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 900000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.RawOptimizerField
open FilteredBrownian RawDampedState
variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [MeasurableSpace Θ] [BorelSpace Θ] [SecondCountableTopology Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
  {D : Driver (I := I) Q} {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}

/-- The actual original optimizer field has a globally strongly measurable
extension retaining every horizon value and its original ordinary integral. -/

end PBGSO.RawOptimizerField

exists_field.exact_header:
theorem exists_field (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    ∃ j : ℝ → S, StronglyMeasurable j ∧ IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), j r = M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r))
exists_field.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_field (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    ∃ j : ℝ → S, StronglyMeasurable j ∧ IntervalIntegrable j volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), j r = M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) := by
  let a : ℝ → S := fun r => U.optimizer (timeClamp T r)
  have haC : Continuous a := (RawSamplerGrowth.optimizer_continuous U).comp_continuous
    (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  have ha (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : a r = U.optimizer r := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [timeClamp_eq T hr]
  have hxMeas (r : ℝ) : Measurable (U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r)) :=
    U.sampler.measurable _ (timeClamp_mem T r)
  have hxCont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r) ω) := by
    filter_upwards [U.sampler.continuous_paths] with ω h
    exact h.comp_continuous (by unfold timeClamp; fun_prop : Continuous (timeClamp T)) (timeClamp_mem T)
  obtain ⟨x,hxJoint,hxC,hxAE⟩ := ContinuousProcessRepresentative.exists_joint_of_measurable Q
    (fun r ω => U.sampler.state (timeClamp T r) ω) hxMeas hxCont
  have hx : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = U.sampler.state r ω := by
    filter_upwards [hxAE] with ω h r hr
    simpa only [timeClamp_eq T hr] using h r
  have hxLaw (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Q.map (x r) = Q.map (U.sampler.state r) :=
    Measure.map_congr (hx.mono (fun _ h => h r hr))
  let j : ℝ → S := fun r => M.optimizerField r (a r) (Q.map (x r))
  have hjEq (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
      j r = M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r)) := by
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [ha r hr,hxLaw r hr]
  have hObsJoint : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
      M.observation (M.parameter (a p.1)) (M.position (x p.1 p.2))) :=
    (hObs.comp ((haC.measurable.comp measurable_fst).prodMk hxJoint.measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
  have hjStrong : StronglyMeasurable j := by
    have hm := hObsJoint.integral_prod_right' (ν := Q)
    have hψ : StronglyMeasurable (fun r => M.optimizer r (a r)
        (∫ ω, M.observation (M.parameter (a r)) (M.position (x r ω)) ∂Q)) :=
      (hOptimizer.comp (measurable_id.prodMk (haC.measurable.prodMk hm.measurable))).stronglyMeasurable
    convert hψ using 1
    funext r
    dsimp only [j,Model.optimizerField,Model.meanGradient]
    have hxr : Measurable (x r) := hxJoint.of_uncurry_left.measurable
    have hor : Measurable (fun z : Z => M.observation (M.parameter (a r)) (M.position z)) :=
      hObs.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
    congr 1
    exact integral_map hxr.aemeasurable hor.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  refine ⟨j,hjStrong,?_,hjEq⟩
  apply (intervalIntegrable_congr (g := fun r =>
    M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r))) ?_).mpr U.optimizer_field_integrable
  intro r hr
  rw [uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hr
  exact hjEq r (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)

PBGSO/RawPairDynamics.lean.scope_note: Two actual original controlled local equations on the same finite Brownian Driver are inputs. No global coefficient moments, matching paired noise/output law or final energy is assumed.
PBGSO/RawPairDynamics.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.RawDampedState
import PBGSO.RawLocalLinearMap

/-! # Actual pairing of two original locally defined raw equations
Both equations use the same finite Brownian vector. The paired local
coefficient and its genuine gauge are constructed, and projection identities
are proved for the actual local integrals, with no global noise square moment.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawPairDynamics
open FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω I E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
  [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F]
  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {D : Driver (I := I) Q} {T : ℝ≥0}






variable (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := E) Q D T) (K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := F) Q D T)

/-- The actual full local stochastic integral projects to both original
noises on one common event throughout the horizon. -/

/-- The raw paired drift is controlled by the constructed localization gauge. -/

/-- Both original strong equations assemble into an actual paired raw
strong equation. Its stochastic integral is computed from the paired
physical columns; it is never an assumed matched-noise process. -/

end PBGSO.RawPairDynamics

Joint.exact_declaration: abbrev Joint (E F : Type*) := WithLp 2 (E × F)

pack.exact_header: def pack : (E × F) ≃L[ℝ] Joint E F
pack.exact_declaration: def pack : (E × F) ≃L[ℝ] Joint E F := (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ E F).symm

first.exact_header: def first : Joint E F →L[ℝ] E
first.exact_declaration:
def first : Joint E F →L[ℝ] E :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).comp (pack (E := E) (F := F)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap

second.exact_header: def second : Joint E F →L[ℝ] F
second.exact_declaration:
def second : Joint E F →L[ℝ] F :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).comp (pack (E := E) (F := F)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap

coefficient.exact_declaration:
def coefficient (L : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := E) Q D T)
    (K : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := F) Q D T) :
    RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Joint E F) Q D T := by
  let c : ℝ := max 1 ‖(pack (E := E) (F := F)).toContinuousLinearMap‖
  refine {
    sigma := fun i r ω => pack (L.sigma i r ω,K.sigma i r ω)
    sigma_strong := fun i => (pack (E := E) (F := F)).continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable
      ((L.sigma_strong i).prodMk (K.sigma_strong i))
    sigma_adapted := fun t i => (pack (E := E) (F := F)).continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      ((L.sigma_adapted t i).prodMk (K.sigma_adapted t i))
    q := fun r ω => c*(L.q r ω+K.q r ω)
    q_strong := stronglyMeasurable_const.mul (L.q_strong.add K.q_strong)
    q_nonneg := fun r ω => mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _))
      (add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (K.q_nonneg r ω))
    q_local := fun ω => ((L.q_local ω).add (K.q_local ω)).const_mul c
    q_progressive := ?_
    sigma_control := ?_ }
  · intro t
    have hc : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
        (fun _ : ℝ × Ω => c) := stronglyMeasurable_const
    convert hc.mul ((L.q_progressive t).add (K.q_progressive t)) using 1
    funext p
    by_cases h : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) <;> simp [h]
  · intro r ω
    have hn : 0 ≤ L.q r ω+K.q r ω := add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (K.q_nonneg r ω)
    calc
      _ = (∑ i, ‖L.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2)+(∑ i, ‖K.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2) := by
        simp_rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
        change (∑ i, (‖L.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2+‖K.sigma i r ω‖ ^ 2)) = _
        exact Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ ≤ L.q r ω+K.q r ω := add_le_add (L.sigma_control r ω) (K.sigma_control r ω)
      _ ≤ c*(L.q r ω+K.q r ω) := le_mul_of_one_le_left hn (le_max_left _ _)

noise_projections.exact_header:
theorem noise_projections :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      (first ((coefficient L K).localNoise t ω) = L.localNoise t ω) ∧
      (second ((coefficient L K).localNoise t ω) = K.localNoise t ω)
noise_projections.exact_declaration:
theorem noise_projections :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
      (first ((coefficient L K).localNoise t ω) = L.localNoise t ω) ∧
      (second ((coefficient L K).localNoise t ω) = K.localNoise t ω) := by
  have he : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) →
      L.sigma i r ω = first ((coefficient L K).sigma i r ω) :=
    Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)
  have hf : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) →
      K.sigma i r ω = second ((coefficient L K).sigma i r ω) :=
    Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)
  filter_upwards [(coefficient L K).localNoise_linearMap_congr first L he,
    (coefficient L K).localNoise_linearMap_congr second K hf] with ω he hf t ht
  exact ⟨(he t ht).symm,(hf t ht).symm⟩

drift_control.exact_header:
theorem drift_control (U : RawDampedState.Data L) (V : RawDampedState.Data K)
    (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖pack (U.drift r ω,V.drift r ω)‖ ≤ (coefficient L K).q r ω
drift_control.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_control (U : RawDampedState.Data L) (V : RawDampedState.Data K)
    (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    ‖pack (U.drift r ω,V.drift r ω)‖ ≤ (coefficient L K).q r ω := by
  let A := (pack (E := E) (F := F)).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hu := U.drift_control r ω
  have hv := V.drift_control r ω
  have hq : max ‖U.drift r ω‖ ‖V.drift r ω‖ ≤ L.q r ω+K.q r ω :=
    max_le (hu.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (K.q_nonneg r ω)))
      (hv.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (L.q_nonneg r ω)))
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖A‖*‖(U.drift r ω,V.drift r ω)‖ := A.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖A‖*(L.q r ω+K.q r ω) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg A)
    _ ≤ max 1 ‖A‖*(L.q r ω+K.q r ω) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
        (add_nonneg (L.q_nonneg r ω) (K.q_nonneg r ω))

pair.exact_header:
def pair (U : RawDampedState.Data L) (V : RawDampedState.Data K) :
    RawDampedState.Data (coefficient L K)
pair.exact_declaration:
def pair (U : RawDampedState.Data L) (V : RawDampedState.Data K) :
    RawDampedState.Data (coefficient L K) := by
  let A := pack (E := E) (F := F)
  let b : ℝ → Ω → Joint E F := fun r ω => A (U.drift r ω,V.drift r ω)
  have hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b) :=
    A.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (U.drift_strong.prodMk V.drift_strong)
  have hbi (ω : Ω) : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
    apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mpr
    exact ((coefficient L K).q_local ω).mono' hb.of_uncurry_right.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun r => drift_control L K U V r ω))
  refine {
    state := fun r ω => A (U.state r ω,V.state r ω)
    drift := b
    state_strong := A.continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable (U.state_strong.prodMk V.state_strong)
    drift_strong := hb
    drift_control := drift_control L K U V
    initial_square := ?_
    state_adapted := fun t => A.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      ((U.state_adapted t).prodMk (V.state_adapted t))
    state_continuous := ?_
    equation := ?_ }
  · let J := A.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E F)
    let H := A.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E F)
    convert (J.comp_memLp' U.initial_square).add (H.comp_memLp' V.initial_square) using 1
    funext ω
    change A (U.state 0 ω,V.state 0 ω) = A (U.state 0 ω,0)+A (0,V.state 0 ω)
    calc
      _ = A ((U.state 0 ω,0)+(0,V.state 0 ω)) := by congr 1 <;> simp
      _ = _ := map_add A _ _
  · filter_upwards [U.state_continuous,V.state_continuous] with ω hu hv
    exact A.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hu.prodMk hv)
  · filter_upwards [U.equation,V.equation,noise_projections L K] with ω hu hv hn t ht
    have hit : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 t := by
      apply (hbi ω).mono_set
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le ht.1,uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using
        (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2 : Icc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
    have he := (first (E := E) (F := F)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hit
    have hf := (second (E := E) (F := F)).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hit
    have htt : t.toNNReal ≤ T := (Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr ht.2
    apply A.symm.injective
    apply Prod.ext
    · change U.state t ω = U.state 0 ω+first (∫ r in 0..t,b r ω)+
        first ((coefficient L K).localNoise t.toNNReal ω)
      rw [(hn t.toNNReal htt).1,← he]
      exact hu t ht
    · change V.state t ω = V.state 0 ω+second (∫ r in 0..t,b r ω)+
        second ((coefficient L K).localNoise t.toNNReal ω)
      rw [(hn t.toNNReal htt).2,← hf]
      exact hv t ht

PBGSO/RawParticleDissipation.lean.scope_note: Positive particle count, source A3, the original coefficient identities, deterministic reference optimizer and response Lipschitz constant are explicit. No iid law for the artificial damped cloud or final dissipation conclusion is assumed.
PBGSO/RawParticleDissipation.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.ConstructedItoParticle
import PBGSO.DampedContinuation

/-! # Pointwise raw particle dissipation before and after damping
The original source joint monotonicity is applied to the actual empirical
coupling. The population residual is then bounded by the original optimiser
response and the literal iid-reference observation error.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Θ] [BorelSpace Θ] [SecondCountableTopology Θ]
  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

/-- Original particle/copy generator dissipation is derived pointwise from
the source law-coupling condition and the actual empirical coupling. -/

/-- Before the stop, the work is the original empirical particle work.
After the stop, the ordinary damped extension has exact rateρ dissipation.
The same original reference observation fluctuation therefore controls both
regions, without asserting an iid law for the artificially damped cloud. -/

end PBGSO

raw_particle_generator_forcing_le.exact_header:
theorem raw_particle_generator_forcing_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) (sbar : S) (p : ParticlePair N S Z)
    (hbar : p.2.1 = sbar) :
    particleCopyGenerator M N ν t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p ≤
      -2 * ρ * particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p +
        2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
          Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) *
          ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar p‖
raw_particle_generator_forcing_le.exact_declaration:
theorem raw_particle_generator_forcing_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ν : Measure Z) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0)
    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g - g'‖) (sbar : S) (p : ParticlePair N S Z)
    (hbar : p.2.1 = sbar) :
    particleCopyGenerator M N ν t (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) p ≤
      -2 * ρ * particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p +
        2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
          Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear D N p p) *
          ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar p‖ := by
  have hw := particleCouplingWork_le M D ρ hmono N hN t ht p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2 p.2.2
  have hr := particlePopulationResidual_abs_le M D N ν t LΨ hΨ sbar p hbar
  have hres := le_trans (le_abs_self (particlePopulationResidual M D N ν t p)) hr
  rw [particleCopyGenerator_quadratic]
  rw [← particleQuadraticBilinear_diag] at hw
  dsimp only [particlePopulationResidual] at hres
  nlinarith

damped_raw_particle_generator_forcing_le.exact_header:

    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (ν : Measure Z) (t τ : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)

    (hΨ : ∀ s g g', ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤

      ⟪if t ≤ τ then σ ij t else 0, W (if t ≤ τ then σ ij t else 0)⟫_ℝ ≤

    (hσ : ∀ ij, ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N (σ ij t) =

    (hbar : (ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N (x t)).2.1 = sbar) :

theorem raw_particle_expected_forcing_le (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (sbar : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (x y : Ω → ConstructedItoParticle.PairHilbert N S Z)
    (hx : AEStronglyMeasurable x Q) (hy : AEStronglyMeasurable y Q) (hy2 : MemLp y 2 Q)
    (hCloud : Q.map (fun ω => (ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N (x ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
    (ρ : ℝ) (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hVar : (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤ V)
    (work : Ω → ℝ) (hwork : Integrable work Q)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, work ω ≤
      -2 * ρ * ⟪y ω,ConstructedItoParticle.metricWeight N D (y ω)⟫_ℝ +
        2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper) *
          Real.sqrt ⟪y ω,ConstructedItoParticle.metricWeight N D (y ω)⟫_ℝ *
          ‖referenceObservationError M N ν sbar (ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N (x ω))‖) :
    (∫ ω, work ω ∂Q) ≤
      -2 * ρ * (∫ ω, ⟪y ω,ConstructedItoParticle.metricWeight N D (y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) +
        2 * ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) *
          Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ⟪y ω,ConstructedItoParticle.metricWeight N D (y ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) := by
  let energy : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ⟪y ω,ConstructedItoParticle.metricWeight N D (y ω)⟫_ℝ
  let cloud : Ω → Fin N → Z := fun ω => (ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N (x ω)).2.2
  let a : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Real.sqrt (energy ω)
  let b : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ‖M.particleGradient N sbar (cloud ω) - M.meanGradient ν sbar‖
  let C : ℝ := (LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt D.upper
  have hiE : Integrable energy Q := raw_particle_energy_integrable Q N D y hy hy2
  have ha : MemLp a 2 Q := sqrt_energy_memLp Q energy hiE.aestronglyMeasurable hiE
    (fun ω => raw_particle_energy_nonneg N D (y ω))
  have hmCloud : AEMeasurable cloud Q :=
    (measurable_snd.comp measurable_snd).comp_aemeasurable
      ((ConstructedItoParticle.pairEquiv N).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hx.aemeasurable)
  have hb0 : MemLp (fun w => M.particleGradient N sbar w - M.meanGradient ν sbar) 2
      (Q.map cloud) := by
    rw [hCloud]
    exact (particleGradient_memLp M ν sbar hF N).sub (memLp_const _)
  have hb : MemLp b 2 Q := (hb0.comp_of_map hmCloud).norm
  have hab : Integrable (fun ω => C * (a ω * b ω)) Q :=
    (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (ha.mul hb)).const_mul C
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun ω => -2 * ρ * energy ω + 2 * (C * (a ω * b ω))) Q :=
    (hiE.const_mul (-2 * ρ)).add (hab.const_mul 2)
  have hpoint' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, work ω ≤ -2 * ρ * energy ω + 2 * (C * (a ω * b ω)) :=
    hpoint.mono (fun ω hω => by simpa only [energy,a,b,C,cloud,referenceObservationError,mul_assoc] using hω)
  have hInt := integral_mono_ae hwork hmajor hpoint'
  rw [integral_add (hiE.const_mul (-2 * ρ)) (hab.const_mul 2),
    integral_const_mul,integral_const_mul,integral_const_mul] at hInt
  have hcs := integral_mul_le_sqrt_integrals Q a b ha hb
  have heA : (∫ ω, a ω ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ ω, energy ω ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => Real.sq_sqrt (raw_particle_energy_nonneg N D (y ω)))
  have heB : (∫ ω, b ω ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter sbar) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν sbar‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) / (N : ℝ) :=
    gradient_sampling_variance_of_cloud_law Q M ν sbar hF N hN cloud hmCloud hCloud
  rw [heA,heB] at hcs
  have hv := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hVar (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N))
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg LΨ.coe_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hcs' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hc0)
  have hvar' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hc0) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (∫ ω, energy ω ∂Q)))
  dsimp only [C] at *
  change _ ≤ -2 * ρ * (∫ ω, energy ω ∂Q) + _
  nlinarith

theorem forced_energy_bound [∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hΨ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.1 = sbar t)
    (hVar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient (ν t) (sbar t)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).2)
 :
    Integrable (fun ω => particleQuadraticBilinear G N (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω))) Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, particleQuadraticBilinear G N (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) ∂Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt G.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) := by
  let R := ((LΨ : ℝ) * Real.sqrt G.upper * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ))) / ρ * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T))
  have hExp : Real.exp (-ρ * T) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [T.coe_nonneg])
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) hρ.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hExp)
  let a (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) := Real.sqrt ⟪U.toData.dampedState n ρ T ω,
    metricWeight N G (U.toData.dampedState n ρ T ω)⟫_ℝ
  let aStar (ω : Ω) := Real.sqrt (particleQuadraticBilinear G N
    (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)))
  have ha (n : ℕ) : MemLp (a n) 2 Q := by
    have hi := raw_particle_energy_integrable Q N G (U.toData.dampedState n ρ T)
      (U.toData.dampedState_strong n ρ).of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable
      (U.toData.dampedState_square n hρ.le T)
    exact sqrt_energy_memLp Q _ hi.aestronglyMeasurable hi
      (fun ω => raw_particle_energy_nonneg N G _)
  have hnorm (n : ℕ) : ‖(ha n).toLp (a n)‖ ^ 2 = U.energy G n ρ T := by
    rw [LinearGrowthMoment.toLp_norm_sq Q _ (ha n)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      simp only [a,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs,Real.sq_sqrt (raw_particle_energy_nonneg N G _)])
  have hb (n : ℕ) : ‖(ha n).toLp (a n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    rw [hnorm n]
    have hh := U.damped_forced_energy_bound G ρ hρ hmono hN LΨ V hV sbar hΨ hF hCloud hbar hVar hinit n
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg (U.energy G n ρ T)) hh 2
    have hEn : 0 ≤ U.energy G n ρ T := integral_nonneg (fun ω => raw_particle_energy_nonneg N G _)
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hEn] at hsq
    exact hsq
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => a n ω) atTop (𝓝 (aStar ω)) := by
    apply Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [U.toData.dampedState_eventually_original ρ T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩ ω] with n hn
    simp only [a,aStar,hn,metricWeight_inner]
  obtain ⟨hA,hAB⟩ := LinearGrowthMoment.localized_limit_memLp Q a aStar (sq_nonneg R) ha hb hlim
  have hraw : Integrable (fun ω => particleQuadraticBilinear G N
      (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω))) Q := by
    have hi := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hA.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hA
    apply hi.congr
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      simp only [aStar,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs,Real.sq_sqrt (particleQuadratic_nonneg G N _)])
  have he : ‖hA.toLp aStar‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ω, particleQuadraticBilinear G N
      (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) ∂Q := by
    rw [LinearGrowthMoment.toLp_norm_sq Q aStar hA]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => by
      simp only [aStar,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs,Real.sq_sqrt (particleQuadratic_nonneg G N _)])
  refine ⟨hraw, ?_⟩
  rw [← he,Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR).mp hAB

    (hCloud : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.2) =

theorem finite_particle_interaction_bound [∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S)
    (hΨ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.1 = sbar t)
    (hVar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient (ν t) (sbar t)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).2)
 :
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, particleEmpiricalDistanceSq N (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)) ∂Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) := by
  obtain ⟨hraw,hE⟩ := U.forced_energy_bound G ρ hρ hmono hN LΨ V hV sbar hΨ hF hCloud hbar hVar hinit
  let p : Ω → ParticlePair N S Z := fun ω => pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)
  let Γ := Q.map p
  have hp : Measurable p := (pairEquiv N).continuous.measurable.comp U.state_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable
  have hq : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => particleQuadraticBilinear G N p p) :=
    (IntegralParticleBound.quadratic_continuous (particleQuadraticBilinear G N)).measurable
  have hqΓ : Integrable (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear G N p p) Γ :=
    (integrable_map_measure hq.aestronglyMeasurable hp.aemeasurable).mpr hraw
  have hm := particle_empirical_rms_le_energy G N hN Γ hqΓ
    (EmpiricalTransportMeasurable.particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_aestronglyMeasurable N hN Γ)
  rw [integral_map hp.aemeasurable
      (EmpiricalTransportMeasurable.particleEmpiricalDistanceSq_measurable N hN).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_map hp.aemeasurable hq.aestronglyMeasurable] at hm
  have he := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg G.lower)
  have hκ : 0 ≤ G.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) G.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt G.upper / Real.sqrt G.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = G.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ,G.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  apply hm.trans (he.trans_eq ?_)
  rw [hs]
  ring

    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤

theorem parameter_bias_bound [∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (sbar : ℝ → S) (sStar : S)
    (hΨ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.1 = sbar t)
    (hVar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient (ν t) (sbar t)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) + ‖sbar T - sStar‖ := by
  obtain ⟨hraw,hE⟩ := U.forced_energy_bound G ρ hρ hmono hN LΨ V hV sbar hΨ hF hCloud hbar hVar hinit
  let p : Ω → ParticlePair N S Z := fun ω => pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)
  let Γ := Q.map p
  have hp : Measurable p := (pairEquiv N).continuous.measurable.comp U.state_strong.of_uncurry_left.measurable
  have hq : Measurable (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => particleQuadraticBilinear G N p p) :=
    (IntegralParticleBound.quadratic_continuous (particleQuadraticBilinear G N)).measurable
  have hqΓ : Integrable (fun p => particleQuadraticBilinear G N p p) Γ :=
    (integrable_map_measure hq.aestronglyMeasurable hp.aemeasurable).mpr hraw
  have hbarΓ : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, p.2.1 = sbar T := by
    exact (ae_map_iff hp.aemeasurable (isClosed_eq continuous_snd.fst continuous_const).measurableSet).mpr (hbar T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨hm,ht⟩ := parameter_target_rms_bound M G hProjection N Γ (sbar T) sStar hbarΓ hqΓ
  have hmQ := hm.comp_of_map hp.aemeasurable
  have hmstrong : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : ParticlePair N S Z => ‖M.parameter p.1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2) Γ :=
    hm.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.pow 2
  rw [integral_map hp.aemeasurable hmstrong,integral_map hp.aemeasurable hq.aestronglyMeasurable] at ht
  refine ⟨hmQ,ht.trans (add_le_add ?_ le_rfl)⟩
  have he := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE (Real.sqrt_nonneg G.lower)
  apply he.trans_eq
  have hκ : 0 ≤ G.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) G.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hs : Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) =
      (Real.sqrt G.upper / Real.sqrt G.lower) * Real.sqrt (V / (N : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ) = G.conditionNumber * (V / (N : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul hκ,G.sqrt_conditionNumber]
  rw [hs]
  ring
