theorem finite_particle_parameter_bound [∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hgradientZero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hpairQuad : couplingQuadratic G ∈ pairTests)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ => sStar) ν (fun _ => νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hΨ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (hF : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Q.map (fun ω => (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.2) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state t ω)).2.1 = sbar t)
    (hVar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient (ν t) (sbar t)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).1 = (pairEquiv N (U.state 0 ω)).2) :
    MemLp (fun ω => M.parameter (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar) 2 Q ∧
    Real.sqrt (∫ ω, ‖M.parameter (pairEquiv N (U.state T ω)).1.1 - M.parameter sStar‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * T) *
        optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar +
      ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / (N : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ * T)) := by
  obtain ⟨hm,ht⟩ := parameter_bias_bound U G ρ hρ hmono hN hProjection LΨ V hV sbar sStar
    hΨ hF hCloud hbar hVar hinit
  have hrelax := (optimizer_norm_le_lawDistance (sbar T) sStar (ν T) νStar).trans

  refine ⟨hm,?_⟩

parameter_joint_limit.exact_declaration:
theorem parameter_joint_limit [∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν t)]
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hProjection : LipschitzWith 1 M.parameter)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (sbar : ℝ → S) (hmean : M.IsWeakSolution tests sbar ν)
    (sStar : S) (νStar : Measure Z)
    (hstationary : M.FrozenStationary tests (M.parameter sStar) νStar)
    (hgradient : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hgradientZero : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → M.optimizer r sStar 0 = 0)
    (hpairQuad : couplingQuadratic G ∈ pairTests)
    (realize : ∀ c : ULA.Coupling (ν 0) νStar,
      ∃ Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z),
        SynchronousCouplingData M pairTests sbar (fun _ => sStar) ν (fun _ => νStar) Λ ∧
          Λ 0 = c.joint)
    (LΨ : ℝ≥0) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hΨ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ s g g',
      ‖M.optimizer t s g - M.optimizer t s g'‖ ≤ (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖g-g'‖)
    (hF : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z)) 2 (ν t))
    (hCloud : ∀ n (T : ℝ≥0), ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      (QF n).map (fun ω => (pairEquiv (n+1) ((family n T).state t ω)).2.2) =
        Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => ν t))
    (hbar : ∀ n (T : ℝ≥0), ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂QF n, (pairEquiv (n+1) ((family n T).state t ω)).2.1 = sbar t)
    (hVar : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter (sbar t)) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient (ν t) (sbar t)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν t) ≤ V)
    (hinit : ∀ n (T : ℝ≥0), ∀ᵐ ω ∂QF n,
      (pairEquiv (n+1) ((family n T).state 0 ω)).1 =
        (pairEquiv (n+1) ((family n T).state 0 ω)).2) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ => parameterError QF drivers locals family sStar p.1 p.2)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
  let d0 := optimizerLawDistance (sbar 0) sStar (ν 0) νStar
  let floor := fun n : ℕ => ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) *
    Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  let decay := fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ*t) * d0
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G.conditionNumber * V / ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (G.conditionNumber * V)
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_zero,mul_one_div] using hh
  have hfloor : Tendsto floor atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hdiv).const_mul ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ)
    simpa only [floor,Real.sqrt_zero,mul_zero,Function.comp_def] using hh
  have hdecay : Tendsto decay atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [decay,mul_zero,zero_mul] using
      ((relaxation_tendsto_zero hρ).const_mul (Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber)).mul_const d0
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × ℝ => decay p.2 + floor p.1)
      (atTop ×ˢ atTop) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero,Function.comp_def] using
      (hdecay.comp tendsto_snd).add (hfloor.comp tendsto_fst)
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun p => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ?_ hsum
  filter_upwards [tendsto_snd.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ))] with p hp
  have hb := (RawParticleParameter.finite_particle_parameter_bound (family p.1 p.2.toNNReal)
    G ρ hρ hmono (Nat.succ_pos p.1) hProjection tests pairTests sbar hmean sStar νStar
    hstationary hgradient hgradientZero hfix hpairQuad realize LΨ V hV
    (fun t ht => hΨ t ht.1) (fun t ht => hF t ht.1) (hCloud p.1 p.2.toNNReal)
    (hbar p.1 p.2.toNNReal) (fun t ht => hVar t ht.1) (hinit p.1 p.2.toNNReal)).2
  have he : ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / ((p.1+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      (1 - Real.exp (-ρ*p.2)) ≤ floor p.1 := by
    have hn : 0 ≤ floor p.1 := by dsimp [floor]; positivity
    change floor p.1 * (1 - Real.exp (-ρ*p.2)) ≤ floor p.1
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-ρ*p.2)]
  have hb' : parameterError QF drivers locals family sStar p.1 p.2 ≤
      decay p.2 + ((LΨ : ℝ) / ρ) * Real.sqrt (G.conditionNumber * V / ((p.1+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-ρ*p.2)) := by
    simpa only [parameterError,Real.coe_toNNReal p.2 hp,decay,d0] using hb
  exact hb'.trans (add_le_add le_rfl he)

import PBGSO.BrownianPathDriver
import PBGSO.RawLocalSolutionTransport

/-! # Strong solution laws and frozen weak stationarity on actual path space

A genuine initial/Wiener-path map transports original raw local equations.
Pathwise uniqueness then identifies their original marginal laws. Applying
this twice transfers a stationary weak frozen sampler on any source to the
coupled strong solution on any other source. No common frozen strong solver,
law-matching interface, global moment bound or energy identity is assumed.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.RawLocalStationarity
open FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}

/-- The same original raw solution in a proved valid null-augmented past
and continuous Brownian modification. The raw state and optimizer are kept. -/

variable {Q D}

/-- The actual initial/path probability map for a natural raw solution.
Only its original initial law is specified; output laws are not premises. -/

/-- A1 same-driver uniqueness proves equality with the actual canonical
path-space strong solution. Brownian matching, the probability input map,
and original local-equation transport are all proved internally. -/

section WeakFrozen
variable {Ωw : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ωw]
  (Qw : Measure Ωw) [IsProbabilityMeasure Qw]
  (Dw : Driver (I := I) Qw)

/-- Source stationarity from an invariant frozen weak sampler on SOME
probability space, and A1 existence/uniqueness for the coupled strong system.

def Data.pathInputPreserving (U : Data Q D M T) (μ : Measure Z)

theorem Data.law_eq_pathspace_solution (U : Data Q D M T)
    (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = μ)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ) (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0)
    (hz : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = V.optimizer t ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) =
      (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ).map (V.sampler.state t)
Data.law_eq_pathspace_solution.exact_declaration:
theorem Data.law_eq_pathspace_solution (U : Data Q D M T)
    (μ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = μ)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ) (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0)
    (hz : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = V.optimizer t ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) =
      (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ).map (V.sampler.state t) := by
  let E := nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)
  let hf := U.pathInputPreserving μ hμ
  have hF : ∀ r, (pullbackDriver hf (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ)).filtration r ≤ E.filtration r := by
    intro r
    change MeasurableSpace.comap (BrownianPathDriver.inputMap Q D (U.sampler.state 0))
      (BrownianPathDriver.filtration r) ≤ E.filtration r
    exact BrownianPathDriver.inputMap_past Q D (U.sampler.state 0)
      (U.sampler.measurable 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩) (U.sampler.adapted 0) r
  have hp : ∀ i r, (pullbackDriver hf (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ)).process i r =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i r := by
    intro i r
    exact BrownianPathDriver.inputMap_coordinate_ae Q D (U.sampler.state 0)
      (U.sampler.measurable 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩) i r
  have hz' : (U.continuousAugmented Q D).sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => V.sampler.state 0 (BrownianPathDriver.inputMap Q D (U.sampler.state 0) ω) :=
    (hf.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp hz).symm
  exact law_unique_of_initial_noise_map hf E hF hp hunique V (U.continuousAugmented Q D)
    hs hz' t ht

stationary_of_weak_frozen.exact_header:
theorem stationary_of_weak_frozen {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Qw Dw M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (huniquew : PathwiseUniqueness Qw (nullAugmentedDriver Qw (continuousDriver Qw Dw)) M T)
    (hexists : ∃ V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver νStar) M T,
      V.optimizer 0 = sStar ∧ V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[
        BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar] Prod.fst)
    (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hν : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = νStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) = νStar
stationary_of_weak_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_of_weak_frozen {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Qw Dw M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (huniquew : PathwiseUniqueness Qw (nullAugmentedDriver Qw (continuousDriver Qw Dw)) M T)
    (hexists : ∃ V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver νStar) M T,
      V.optimizer 0 = sStar ∧ V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[
        BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar] Prod.fst)
    (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hν : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = νStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    U.optimizer t = sStar ∧ Q.map (U.sampler.state t) = νStar := by
  obtain ⟨V, hsV, hzV⟩ := hexists
  let W := F.constantData hint hg hfix
  have hw := W.law_eq_pathspace_solution νStar
    (F.invariant_law 0 ⟨le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩) huniquew V hsV.symm hzV t ht
  have hvopt : V.optimizer t = sStar := hw.1.symm
  have hvlaw : (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar).map (V.sampler.state t) = νStar :=
    hw.2.symm.trans (F.invariant_law t ht)
  have hu := U.law_eq_pathspace_solution νStar hν hunique V (hs.trans hsV.symm) hzV t ht
  exact ⟨hu.1.trans hvopt, hu.2.trans hvlaw⟩

stationary_product_law_of_weak_frozen.exact_header:
theorem stationary_product_law_of_weak_frozen [MeasurableSpace S]
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Qw Dw M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (huniquew : PathwiseUniqueness Qw (nullAugmentedDriver Qw (continuousDriver Qw Dw)) M T)
    (hexists : ∃ V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver νStar) M T,
      V.optimizer 0 = sStar ∧ V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[
        BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar] Prod.fst)
    (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hν : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = νStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) = (Measure.dirac sStar).prod νStar
stationary_product_law_of_weak_frozen.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_product_law_of_weak_frozen [MeasurableSpace S]
    {sStar : S} {νStar : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure νStar]
    (F : FrozenSamplerData Qw Dw M T sStar νStar)
    (hint : Integrable (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter sStar) (M.position z)) νStar)
    (hg : M.meanGradient νStar sStar = 0)
    (hfix : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), M.optimizer t sStar 0 = 0)
    (huniquew : PathwiseUniqueness Qw (nullAugmentedDriver Qw (continuousDriver Qw Dw)) M T)
    (hexists : ∃ V : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver νStar) M T,
      V.optimizer 0 = sStar ∧ V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[
        BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) νStar] Prod.fst)
    (U : Data Q D M T)
    (hunique : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (hs : U.optimizer 0 = sStar) (hν : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = νStar)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    Q.map (fun ω => (U.optimizer t, U.sampler.state t ω)) = (Measure.dirac sStar).prod νStar := by
  obtain ⟨ho, hl⟩ := stationary_of_weak_frozen Qw Dw F hint hg hfix huniquew hexists
    U hunique hs hν t ht
  rw [ho, Measure.dirac_prod, ← hl,
    Measure.map_map measurable_prodMk_left (U.sampler.measurable t ht)]
  rfl

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Set Filter

times are evaluated at zero and subsequently removed by the raw time mask. -/

realExtension.exact_header: def realExtension (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → R) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : R
realExtension.exact_declaration: def realExtension (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → R) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : R := u r.toNNReal ω

progressive_window.exact_header:
theorem progressive_window (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → R)
    (hu : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ u) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => realExtension u r p.2) p.1)
progressive_window.exact_declaration:
theorem progressive_window (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ) (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → R)
    (hu : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ u) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => realExtension u r p.2) p.1) := by
  let C : ℝ × Ω → (Iic t) × Ω := fun p => (⟨min p.1.toNNReal t, Set.mem_Iic.mpr (min_le_right _ _)⟩,p.2)
  have hC : @Measurable _ _ ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t))
      (Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ t)) C := by
    apply Measurable.prodMk
    · exact ((measurable_fst.real_toNNReal).min measurable_const).subtype_mk
    · exact measurable_snd
  have hU := (hu t).comp_measurable hC
  have hmask := hU.indicator ((measurableSet_Ioc : MeasurableSet (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ))).preimage measurable_fst)
  have he : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator
      (fun r => realExtension u r p.2) p.1) =
      {p : ℝ × Ω | p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)}.indicator
        (fun p : ℝ × Ω => u (C p).1 (C p).2) := by
    funext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)
    · have hm : p.1.toNNReal ≤ t := by
        simpa only [Real.toNNReal_coe] using Real.toNNReal_le_toNNReal hp.2
      simp only [Set.indicator,mem_setOf_eq,hp,ite_eq_left,realExtension,C,min_eq_left hm]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp,
        Set.indicator_of_notMem (show p ∉ {p : ℝ × Ω | p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)} from hp)]
  rw [he]
  exact hmask

progressive_measurable_coefficient.exact_header:
theorem progressive_measurable_coefficient (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hu : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ u)
    (g : Z → R) (hg : Measurable g) : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ (fun t ω => g (u t ω))
progressive_measurable_coefficient.exact_declaration:
theorem progressive_measurable_coefficient (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hu : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ u)
    (g : Z → R) (hg : Measurable g) : IsStronglyProgressive ℱ (fun t ω => g (u t ω)) := by
  intro t
  exact (hg.comp (hu t).measurable).stronglyMeasurable

theorem continuous_adapted_coefficient_window (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hu : StronglyAdapted ℱ u)
    (hcont : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => u t ω))
    (g : Z → R) (hg : Measurable g) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]

continuous_adapted_coefficient_window.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_adapted_coefficient_window (ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ)
    (u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hu : StronglyAdapted ℱ u)
    (hcont : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => u t ω))
    (g : Z → R) (hg : Measurable g) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (ℱ t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => g (u r.toNNReal p.2)) p.1) :=
  progressive_window ℱ _
    (progressive_measurable_coefficient ℱ u (hu.isStronglyProgressive_of_continuous hcont) g hg) t

diffusion.exact_header:
def diffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Cloud N Z) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
    (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) T
diffusion.exact_declaration:
def diffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Cloud N Z) (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
    (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) T where
  sigma := sigma Q D N L
  sigma_strong ij := (single (Z := Z) N ij.1).continuous.comp_stronglyMeasurable
    ((row Q D N L ij.1).sigma_strong ij.2)
  sigma_adapted t ij := (single (Z := Z) N ij.1).continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    ((row Q D N L ij.1).sigma_adapted t ij.2)
  q := q Q D N L
  q_strong := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × (Fin N → Ω) => ∑ i : Fin N, (row Q D N L i).q p.1 p.2)
    apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
    intro i _
    exact (row Q D N L i).q_strong
  q_nonneg r ω := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (row Q D N L i).q_nonneg r ω)
  q_local ω := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (row Q D N L i).q_local ω)
  q_progressive t := by
    have hs : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod
        ((RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N).filtration t)]
        (fun p : ℝ × (Fin N → Ω) => ∑ i : Fin N,
          (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => (row Q D N L i).q r p.2) p.1) := by
      apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_fun_sum
      intro i _
      exact (row Q D N L i).q_progressive t
    convert hs using 1
    funext p
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)
    · simp [q,hp]
    · simp [q,hp]
  sigma_control r ω := by
    simp only [sigma,single_norm,Fintype.sum_prod_type,q]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (row Q D N L i).sigma_control r ω)

@[simp] theorem diffusion_q (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :

projected_sigma.exact_header:
theorem projected_sigma (i : Fin N) (ij : Fin N × I) (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
    PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z) i ((diffusion Q D N L).sigma ij r ω) =
      if ij.1 = i then L.sigma ij.2 r (ω i) else 0
projected_sigma.exact_declaration:
theorem projected_sigma (i : Fin N) (ij : Fin N × I) (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
    PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z) i ((diffusion Q D N L).sigma ij r ω) =
      if ij.1 = i then L.sigma ij.2 r (ω i) else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : ij.1 = i
  · subst i
    simp [diffusion_sigma,single_apply]
  · simp [diffusion_sigma,single_apply,Pi.single_apply,h,Ne.symm h]

state.exact_header: def state (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : Cloud N Z

state_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem state_apply (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) (i : Fin N) :
    state Q D N U t ω i = U.sampler.state t (ω i)
state_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem state_apply (t : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) (i : Fin N) :
    state Q D N U t ω i = U.sampler.state t (ω i) := rfl

state_measurable.exact_header: theorem state_measurable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Measurable (state Q D N U t)
state_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem state_measurable (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) : Measurable (state Q D N U t) :=
  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin N => Z)).symm.continuous.measurable.comp
    (RawIndependentCopies.cloud_measurable Q D N U t ht)

physical_columns.exact_header:
theorem physical_columns :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ ij : Fin N × I,
      (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).sigma ij t ω =
        single (Z := Z) N ij.1
          (M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (state Q D N U t ω ij.1) ij.2)
physical_columns.exact_declaration:
theorem physical_columns :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ ij : Fin N × I,
      (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).sigma ij t ω =
        single (Z := Z) N ij.1
          (M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer t)) (state Q D N U t ω ij.1) ij.2) := by
  filter_upwards [RawIndependentCopies.physical_columns Q D N U] with ω hω t ht ij
  change single (Z := Z) N ij.1
      ((RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U ij.1).sampler.localDiffusion.sigma ij.2 t ω) = _
  rw [hω ij.1 t ht ij.2]
  rfl

state_square.exact_header:
theorem state_square (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (state Q D N U t) 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q)
state_square.exact_declaration:
theorem state_square (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    MemLp (state Q D N U t) 2 (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) := by
  have hU : MemLp (U.sampler.state t) 2 Q := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (U.sampler.measurable t ht).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    exact (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (U.sampler.measurable t ht).aemeasurable).mp
      (U.second_moment t ht)
  have hi (i : Fin N) : Integrable (fun ω : Fin N → Ω => ‖U.sampler.state t (ω i)‖ ^ 2)
      (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) :=
    ((hU.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => Q) i)).integrable_norm_pow
      (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0))
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (state_measurable Q D N U t ht).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  have hh := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)
  simpa only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2,state_apply] using hh

state_continuous_paths.exact_header:
theorem state_continuous_paths :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => state Q D N U t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
state_continuous_paths.exact_declaration:
theorem state_continuous_paths :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ContinuousOn (fun t => state Q D N U t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i : Fin N =>
    (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.continuous_paths)] with ω hω
  apply (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin N => Z)).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn
  exact continuousOn_pi.mpr hω

exists_regular_state.exact_header:
theorem exists_regular_state :
    ∃ g : Icc 0 (T : ℝ) → (Fin N → Ω) → Cloud N Z,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t,
        g t ω = state Q D N U t ω
exists_regular_state.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_regular_state :
    ∃ g : Icc 0 (T : ℝ) → (Fin N → Ω) → Cloud N Z,
      StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => g t ω)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t,
        g t ω = state Q D N U t ω := by
  apply ContinuousProcessRepresentative.exists_joint_of_measurable
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (fun (t : Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ω => state Q D N U t ω)
    (fun t => state_measurable Q D N U t t.property)
  exact (state_continuous_paths Q D N U).mono (fun _ hc => hc.restrict)

import PBGSO.RawReferenceCloudEquation

/-! # Natural independent-cloud equations produce actual controlled raw data
The reference cloud is constructed from independent whole seeds. Its literal
physical equation feeds the generic natural sampler realization; all drift,
diffusion, output-law and same-driver stochastic identities are conclusions.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawReferenceCloudData
open FilteredBrownian RawReferenceCloud
variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q)
  (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ≥0}

/-- The auxiliary physical sampler model. Its unused observation is zero;
only its literal independent coordinate drift/diffusion enters this file. -/

variable (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)

/-- The natural original full-cloud equation, with actual local noise and
physical coefficients, is derived from the one-copy equations. -/

/-- The actual full iid reference cloud acquires controlled raw dynamics
without any reference coefficient, joint law, noise output or moment premise.
Only the original one-copy solution and primitive projected-drift Borel
regularity enter. -/

end PBGSO.RawReferenceCloudData

cloudModel.exact_header: def cloudModel : Model S Θ (Cloud N Z) (Cloud N Z) (Fin N × I)
cloudModel.exact_declaration:
def cloudModel : Model S Θ (Cloud N Z) (Cloud N Z) (Fin N × I) where
  parameter := M.parameter
  position := id
  observation _ _ := 0
  optimizer := M.optimizer
  drift θ z := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => M.drift θ (z i))
  diffusion θ z ij := single (Z := Z) N ij.1 (M.diffusion θ (z ij.1) ij.2)

samplerData.exact_header:
def samplerData : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N)
    (cloudModel M N) T U.optimizer
samplerData.exact_declaration:
def samplerData : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N)
    (cloudModel M N) T U.optimizer where
  localDiffusion := diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion
  state := state Q D N U
  measurable := state_measurable Q D N U
  adapted t := (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin N => Z)).symm.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    (RawIndependentCopies.cloud_adapted Q D N U t)
  continuous_paths := state_continuous_paths Q D N U
  drift_integrable := by
    have he (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
        (cloudModel M N).drift ((cloudModel M N).parameter (U.optimizer r)) (state Q D N U r ω) =
          RawReferenceCloud.drift Q D N U r ω := by
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      exact (RawReferenceCloud.drift_apply Q D N U r ω i).symm
    simpa only [he] using RawReferenceCloud.drift_integrable Q D N U
  diffusion_realizes := physical_columns Q D N U
  equation := by
    have he (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) :
        (cloudModel M N).drift ((cloudModel M N).parameter (U.optimizer r)) (state Q D N U r ω) =
          RawReferenceCloud.drift Q D N U r ω := by
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      exact (RawReferenceCloud.drift_apply Q D N U r ω i).symm
    simpa only [he] using RawReferenceCloud.equation Q D N U

build.exact_header:
def build
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2)) :
    RawNaturalSampler.Realization (samplerData Q D M N U)
build.exact_declaration:
def build
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2)) :
    RawNaturalSampler.Realization (samplerData Q D M N U) := by
  have hb : Measurable (fun p : S × Cloud N Z =>
      (cloudModel M N).drift ((cloudModel M N).parameter p.1) p.2) := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun p : S × Cloud N Z => fun i =>
        M.drift (M.parameter p.1) (p.2 i)) := by
      apply measurable_pi_lambda
      intro i
      exact hDrift.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk
        ((PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z) i).continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
    exact (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin N => Z)).symm.continuous.measurable.comp hm
  exact RawNaturalSampler.build (samplerData Q D M N U)
    (RawSamplerGrowth.optimizer_continuous U)
    (state_square Q D N U 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩) hb

-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators
namespace PBGSO.RawReferenceCloud

variable {Ω I Z S Θ X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (D : Driver (I := I) Q) (N : ℕ)
  {T : ℝ≥0} {M : Model S Θ Z X I}
  (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)

/-- The original row's Brownian columns are its literal flattened indices. -/

/-- Projection of the actual full cloud stochastic integral is the actual
original row stochastic integral, on one event for every horizon time. -/

/-- The literal independent coordinate drifts in physical Hilbert coordinates. -/


/-- Finite cloud drift remains pathwise Bochner L¹ even if no expected
sampler-drift moment exists. -/

rowEmbedding.exact_header: def rowEmbedding (i : Fin N) : I ↪ Fin N × I
rowEmbedding.exact_declaration:
def rowEmbedding (i : Fin N) : I ↪ Fin N × I :=
  ⟨fun j => (i,j),fun _ _ h => (Prod.mk.inj h).2⟩

coordinate_noise.exact_header:
theorem coordinate_noise :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
        (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t ω i =
          (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω
coordinate_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem coordinate_noise :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
        (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t ω i =
          (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω := by
  classical
  let C := diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion
  have hi (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T → C.localNoise t ω i =
        (row Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion i).localNoise t ω := by
    let A := PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z) i
    let K := C.linearMap A
    have he : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
        ∀ ij r, r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) →
          K.sigma ij r ω = rawEmbed (rowEmbedding (I := I) N i)
            (row Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion i).sigma ij r ω := by
      apply Eventually.of_forall
      intro ω ij r hr
      change A (C.sigma ij r ω) = _
      rw [show A (C.sigma ij r ω) =
        if ij.1 = i then U.sampler.localDiffusion.sigma ij.2 r (ω i) else 0 from
          projected_sigma Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion i ij r ω]
      by_cases hij : ij.1 = i
      · subst i
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        exact (embedFamily_image (rowEmbedding (I := I) N ij.1)
          (fun j => (row Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion ij.1).sigma j r ω) ij.2).symm
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        symm
        apply embedFamily_outside
        rintro ⟨j,hj⟩
        exact hij (congrArg Prod.fst hj).symm
    have hk := (row Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion i).localNoise_noiseEmbedding_congr
      (rowEmbedding (I := I) N i) (RawIndependentCopies.driver Q D N) rfl (fun _ _ => rfl) K he
    filter_upwards [hk,C.linearMap_localNoise_on_horizon A] with ω hk hl t ht
    exact (hl t ht).symm.trans (hk t ht)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hi] with ω hi i t ht
  exact hi i t ht

drift.exact_header: def drift (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) : Cloud N Z

drift_apply.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem drift_apply (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) (i : Fin N) :
    drift Q D N U r ω i = M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (state Q D N U r ω i)
drift_apply.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem drift_apply (r : ℝ) (ω : Fin N → Ω) (i : Fin N) :
    drift Q D N U r ω i = M.drift (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (state Q D N U r ω i) := by
  classical
  simp [drift,single_apply,Pi.single_apply]

drift_integrable.exact_header:
theorem drift_integrable :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => drift Q D N U r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ)
drift_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_integrable :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun r => drift Q D N U r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i : Fin N =>
    (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.drift_integrable)] with ω hω
  unfold drift
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff]
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply (single (Z := Z) N i).integrable_comp
  simpa only [RawIndependentCopies.copy_optimizer, state_apply,
    RawIndependentCopies.copy_state, RawIndependentCopies.cloud, IntegrableOn] using
    (intervalIntegrable_iff.mp (hω i))

equation_of_coordinate_noise.exact_header:
theorem equation_of_coordinate_noise
    (hnoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
        (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t ω i =
          (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      state Q D N U t ω = state Q D N U 0 ω +
        (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) +
          (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t.toNNReal ω
equation_of_coordinate_noise.exact_declaration:
theorem equation_of_coordinate_noise
    (hnoise : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q,
      ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ t : ℝ≥0, t ≤ T →
        (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t ω i =
          (RawIndependentCopies.copy Q D N U i).sampler.localDiffusion.localNoise t ω) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      state Q D N U t ω = state Q D N U 0 ω +
        (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) +
          (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t.toNNReal ω := by
  filter_upwards [drift_integrable Q D N U,RawIndependentCopies.coordinate_equations Q D N U,
    hnoise] with ω hi he hn t ht
  have hit : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => drift Q D N U r ω) volume 0 t := by
    apply hi.mono_set
    simpa only [uIcc_of_le ht.1,uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] using
      (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2 : Icc 0 t ⊆ Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  have hproj := (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin N => Z) i).intervalIntegral_comp_comm hit
  have htt : t.toNNReal ≤ T := (Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr ht.2
  change state Q D N U t ω i = state Q D N U 0 ω i +
    (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) i +
      (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t.toNNReal ω i
  change (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω i) =
    (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) i at hproj
  rw [hn i t.toNNReal htt,← hproj]
  simpa only [state_apply,PiLp.proj_apply,drift_apply,RawIndependentCopies.cloud] using he i t ht

state_coordinate_law.exact_header:
theorem state_coordinate_law (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map (fun ω i => state Q D N U t ω i) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler.state t))
state_coordinate_law.exact_declaration:
theorem state_coordinate_law (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q).map (fun ω i => state Q D N U t ω i) =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => Q.map (U.sampler.state t)) :=
  RawIndependentCopies.cloud_law Q D N U t ht

equation.exact_header:
theorem equation :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      state Q D N U t ω = state Q D N U 0 ω +
        (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) +
          (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t.toNNReal ω
equation.exact_declaration:
theorem equation :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂IndependentCopies.seeds (J := Fin N) Q, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      state Q D N U t ω = state Q D N U 0 ω +
        (∫ r in 0..t, drift Q D N U r ω) +
          (diffusion Q D N U.sampler.localDiffusion).localNoise t.toNNReal ω :=
  equation_of_coordinate_noise Q D N U (coordinate_noise Q D N U)

import PBGSO.RawNaturalSampler

/-! Natural constant-diffusion equations have actual product-space second
moments under source joint monotonicity. The stochastic energy and moment
bounds are derived; no work-integrability convention is needed here. -/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology BigOperators RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.RawSamplerCoerciveMoment
open FilteredBrownian
variable {Ω S Θ Z X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S] [CompleteSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [SecondCountableTopology S] [FiniteDimensional ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z] [CompleteSpace Z]

  {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {D : Driver (I := I) Q}

realization_moments.exact_header:
theorem realization_moments (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a)
    (R : RawNaturalSampler.Realization U) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) :
    (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ∃ hx : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q, ‖hx.toLp (U.state t)‖^2 ≤ B) ∧
    MemLp (Function.uncurry U.state) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)
realization_moments.exact_declaration:
theorem realization_moments (U : RawLocalStationarity.SamplerData Q D M T a)
    (R : RawNaturalSampler.Realization U) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hσ : ∀ s s' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter s') w i) :
    (∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      ∃ hx : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q, ‖hx.toLp (U.state t)‖^2 ≤ B) ∧
    MemLp (Function.uncurry U.state) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  classical
  let K := a '' Icc 0 (T : ℝ)
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.image_of_continuousOn ha
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCr⟩ := DiracSamplerCoercivity.radial_coercivity_on_compact
    M G ρ hρ.le hmono hρ K hK
  let c : I → Z := M.diffusion (M.parameter (a 0)) 0
  let S : ℝ := ∑ i, G.samplerSq (c i)
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => G.samplerSq_nonneg _)
  have hwork : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      ⟪R.data.state r ω,G.samplerWeight (R.data.drift r ω)⟫_ℝ ≤ C := by
    intro r hr
    filter_upwards [R.drift_realizes] with ω hb
    rw [hb r hr]
    exact hCr (a r) ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩ _
  have hnoise : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q,
      (∑ i, ⟪R.localDiffusion.sigma i r ω,G.samplerWeight (R.localDiffusion.sigma i r ω)⟫_ℝ) ≤ S := by
    intro r hr
    filter_upwards [R.sigma_realizes] with ω hσr
    apply le_of_eq
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hσr r hr i,hσ (a r) (a 0) (R.data.state r ω) 0 i]
    rfl
  have hcoerc : ∀ z, G.lower*‖z‖^2 ≤ ⟪z,G.samplerWeight z⟫_ℝ := G.sampler_lower
  let B := RawCoerciveMoment.budget R.data G.samplerWeight G.lower C S
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := RawCoerciveMoment.budget_nonneg R.data G.samplerWeight
    G.sampler_symmetric G.lower C S G.lower_pos hC hS hcoerc hwork hnoise
  have hbound := RawCoerciveMoment.state_moment_bound R.data G.samplerWeight
    G.sampler_symmetric G.lower C S G.lower_pos hC hS hcoerc hwork hnoise
  have hp := RawCoerciveMoment.state_product_memLp R.data G.samplerWeight
    G.sampler_symmetric G.lower C S G.lower_pos hC hS hcoerc hwork hnoise
  have heq : Function.uncurry R.data.state =ᵐ[(volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q]
      Function.uncurry U.state := by
    have hx := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ν := Q)).ae R.state_eq
    have hr := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ν := Q)).ae (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc)
    filter_upwards [hx,hr] with p hx hr
    exact hx p.1 (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hr)
  refine ⟨⟨B,hB,?_⟩,(memLp_congr_ae heq).mp hp⟩
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨hx,hxb⟩ := hbound t ht
  have he : R.data.state t =ᵐ[Q] U.state t := R.state_eq.mono (fun _ h => h t ht)
  have hu : MemLp (U.state t) 2 Q := (memLp_congr_ae he).mp hx
  refine ⟨hu,?_⟩
  rwa [← hx.toLp_congr hu he]

theorem natural_moments (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)

theorem product_memLp_congr_on_horizon {x y : ℝ → Ω → Z}
    (hx : MemLp (Function.uncurry x) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (he : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = y r ω) :

product_memLp_congr_on_horizon.exact_declaration:
theorem product_memLp_congr_on_horizon {x y : ℝ → Ω → Z}
    (hx : MemLp (Function.uncurry x) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (he : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x r ω = y r ω) :
    MemLp (Function.uncurry y) 2 ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q) := by
  have heq : Function.uncurry x =ᵐ[(volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q]
      Function.uncurry y := by
    have hh := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
      (μ := volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) (ν := Q)).ae he
    have hr := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst

Construction.exact_header: structure Construction (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) (C P : ℝ)
Construction.exact_declaration:
structure Construction (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) (C P : ℝ) where
  localDiffusion : RawLocalDiffusion (Z := Z) Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q D) T
  stateData : RawLinearGrowthState.Data localDiffusion C P
  realization : RawLinearGrowthModel.Realization M localDiffusion C P stateData
  state_eq : stateData.state = U.sampler.state
  optimizer_eq : realization.optimizer = U.optimizer

build.exact_header: def build : Construction U C P
build.exact_declaration:
def build : Construction U C P := Classical.choice <| by
  classical
  have hloc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntegrableOn
      (fun r => originalRawDrift M U.optimizer U.sampler.state r ω) (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    U.sampler.drift_integrable.mono (fun ω h =>
      (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le T.coe_nonneg).mp h)
  obtain ⟨L,b',hb',hdom,hbAE,hσAE,hnAE⟩ := U.sampler.localDiffusion.exists_withDriftEnergy_of_ae
    (originalRawDrift M U.optimizer U.sampler.state) hb hprog hloc
  have hinit : MemLp (U.sampler.state 0) 2 Q := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
      (U.sampler.measurable 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
    exact (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop)
      (U.sampler.measurable 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩).aemeasurable).mp
        (U.second_moment 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)
  let V : RawLinearGrowthState.Data L C P := {
    state := U.sampler.state
    drift := b'
    drift_strong := hb'
    drift_control := hdom
    initial_square := hinit
    K_nonneg := hC
    P_nonneg := hP
    growth := by
      intro r hr
      filter_upwards [hbAE,hσAE,U.sampler.diffusion_realizes] with ω hbr hσr hmodel
      have he : (fun i => L.sigma i r ω) = M.diffusion (M.parameter (U.optimizer r)) (U.sampler.state r ω) := by
        funext i
        exact (hσr i r).trans (hmodel r hr i)
      rw [hbr r,he]
      exact (hgrowth (U.optimizer r) (U.sampler.state r ω)).trans (by gcongr; exact hparam r hr)
    equation := by
      filter_upwards [U.sampler.equation,hbAE,hnAE] with ω he hb hn
      intro r hr
      rw [he r hr,hn r.toNNReal ((Real.toNNReal_le_iff_le_coe).mpr hr.2)]
      congr 2
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => (hb s).symm) }
  let R : RawLinearGrowthModel.Realization M L C P V := {
    optimizer := U.optimizer
    optimizerDrift r := M.optimizerField r (U.optimizer r) (Q.map (U.sampler.state r))
    optimizerDrift_integrable := U.optimizer_field_integrable
    state_adapted t := (U.sampler.adapted t).mono (filtration_le_nullAugmented Q D.filtration t)
    diffusion_borel := hσB
    drift_strong := hb
    diffusion_strong := hσ
    coefficients := by
      filter_upwards [hbAE,hσAE,U.sampler.diffusion_realizes] with ω hb hσ hm
      intro r hr
      exact ⟨hb r,fun i => (hσ i r).trans (hm r hr i)⟩
    optimizer_field := fun _ _ => rfl
    optimizer_equation := U.optimizer_equation
    observation_integrable := U.observation_integrable }
  exact ⟨⟨L,V,R,rfl,rfl⟩⟩

theorem predictableData_optimizer :

predictableData_sampler.exact_header:
theorem predictableData_sampler (r : ℝ) :
    (predictableData U hb hprog hσ hσB C P hC hP hparam hgrowth).sampler r =
      ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state r

theorem predictableData_sampler (r : ℝ) :
    (predictableData U hb hprog hσ hσB C P hC hP hparam hgrowth).sampler r =
      ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q U.sampler.state r := by
  let A := build U hb hprog hσ hσB C P hC hP hparam hgrowth

theorem predictableData_law (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :

optimizer_continuous.exact_header:
theorem optimizer_continuous (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ))
optimizer_continuous.exact_declaration:
theorem optimizer_continuous (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) :
    ContinuousOn U.optimizer (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) := by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun r => U.optimizer 0+
      ∫ s in 0..r, M.optimizerField s (U.optimizer s) (Q.map (U.sampler.state s)))
      (uIcc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    continuousOn_const.add (intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive_interval'
      U.optimizer_field_integrable (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ uIcc 0 (T : ℝ) from left_mem_uIcc))
  rw [uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg] at hc
  exact hc.congr U.optimizer_equation

exists_parameter_bound.exact_header:
theorem exists_parameter_bound (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hProjection : Continuous M.parameter) :
    ∃ P, 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖M.parameter (U.optimizer r)‖ ≤ P
exists_parameter_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_parameter_bound (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T)
    (hProjection : Continuous M.parameter) :
    ∃ P, 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖M.parameter (U.optimizer r)‖ ≤ P := by
  obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hProjection.comp_continuousOn (optimizer_continuous U))
  exact ⟨max P 0,le_max_right _ _,fun r hr => (hP r hr).trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩

  drift_strong : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (originalRawDrift M U.optimizer U.sampler.state))
  drift_progressive : ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
    StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ).prod (D.filtration t)]
      (fun p : ℝ × Ω => (Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)).indicator
        (fun r => originalRawDrift M U.optimizer U.sampler.state r p.2) p.1)

    (Function.uncurry (originalRawDiffusion M U.optimizer U.sampler.state i))
  drift_borel : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ)
  diffusion_borel : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i)
  projection_continuous : Continuous M.parameter
  growthConstant : ℝ
  growth_nonneg : 0 ≤ growthConstant
  linear_growth : ∀ s z, ‖M.drift (M.parameter s) z‖+
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z)‖ ≤ growthConstant*(1+‖M.parameter s‖+‖z‖)

    (hU : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = μ) (hV : R.map (V.sampler.state 0) = ν)
    (A : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) μ (U.optimizer 0))
    (B : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) ν (V.optimizer 0))
    (huniqueU : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (huniqueV : PathwiseUniqueness R (nullAugmentedDriver R (continuousDriver R E)) M T)
    (huniqueA : PathwiseUniqueness (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ))) M T)
    (huniqueB : PathwiseUniqueness (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν))) M T)
    (hpathμ : ∃ W : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ) M T,

      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)

      W.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν] Prod.fst)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :

law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data Q D M T) (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data R E M T)
    (μ ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 μ) (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν)
    (hU : Q.map (U.sampler.state 0) = μ) (hV : R.map (V.sampler.state 0) = ν)
    (A : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) μ (U.optimizer 0))
    (B : CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) ν (V.optimizer 0))
    (huniqueU : PathwiseUniqueness Q (nullAugmentedDriver Q (continuousDriver Q D)) M T)
    (huniqueV : PathwiseUniqueness R (nullAugmentedDriver R (continuousDriver R E)) M T)
    (huniqueA : PathwiseUniqueness (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ))) M T)
    (huniqueB : PathwiseUniqueness (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (nullAugmentedDriver _ (continuousDriver _ (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν))) M T)
    (hpathμ : ∃ W : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver μ) M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = U.optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) μ] Prod.fst)
    (hpathν : ∃ W : RawLocalStationarity.Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν)
        (BrownianPathDriver.driver ν) M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = V.optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν] Prod.fst)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      (Q.map (U.sampler.state T)) (R.map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  have hA0 : (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (A.data.sampler.state 0) = μ := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr A.initial_sampler,Measure.map_fst_prod,measure_univ,one_smul]
  have hB0 : (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (B.data.sampler.state 0) = ν := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr B.initial_sampler,Measure.map_fst_prod,measure_univ,one_smul]
  have hUA := law_unique_two_sources U A.data μ hU hA0 A.initial_optimizer.symm
    huniqueU huniqueA hpathμ T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  have hVB := law_unique_two_sources V B.data ν hV hB0 B.initial_optimizer.symm
    huniqueV huniqueB hpathν T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  have h := RawSamplerGrowthLaw.law_distance_decay μ ν hμ hν A.data B.data
    A.regularity B.regularity A.initial_sampler B.initial_sampler G ρ hmono
  rw [A.initial_optimizer,B.initial_optimizer] at h
  rw [hUA.1,hVB.1,hUA.2,hVB.2]
  exact h

def Regularity.pullback {U : RawLocalStationarity.Data R D M T} (A : Regularity U) :

  drift_strong := A.drift_strong.comp_measurable
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))

    (measurable_fst.prodMk (hf.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
  drift_borel := A.drift_borel
  diffusion_borel := A.diffusion_borel

theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (A : Regularity U) (B : Regularity V)
    (hU0 : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (hV0 : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T))

law_distance_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem law_distance_decay {M : Model S Θ Z X I} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (U : RawLocalStationarity.Data (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ) M T)
    (V : RawLocalStationarity.Data (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I)))
      (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν) M T)
    (A : Regularity U) (B : Regularity V)
    (hU0 : U.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (hV0 : V.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))] fun ω => ω.1)
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ) :
    optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
      ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T))
      ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
      Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
        optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer 0) (V.optimizer 0) μ ν := by
  have hUI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) U.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ hμ := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ U.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ U 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hU0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ μ hμ).symm)
  have hVI : ProductLpSections.sectionLp (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))) V.sampler.state 0 =
      AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler (brownianProbability (I := I)) ν hν := by
    apply Lp.ext
    exact (ProductLpSections.sectionLp_ae _ V.sampler.state
      (sampler_memLp _ V 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩)).trans
      (hV0.trans (AdditiveCanonical.initialSampler_coe _ ν hν).symm)
  apply bound_of_all_finite_couplings μ ν (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp μ ν hμ hν)
    (fun c => Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+c ^ 2)) (by fun_prop)
  intro c hc
  let Q := ULA.initialExtension c (brownianProbability (I := I))
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure c.joint := c.isProbabilityMeasure
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := ULA.initialExtension_isProbabilityMeasure c _
  letI : IsSeparable Q := CanonicalSeparable.initial_vector_isSeparable (I := I) c.joint
  let hf := AdditiveCanonical.extension_left_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let hg := AdditiveCanonical.extension_right_preserving (brownianProbability (I := I)) μ ν c
  let E := CoupledBrownianFiltration.fullDriver (I := I) μ ν c
  have hp : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hf (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) μ)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_process_eq μ ν c) i) t)
  have hq : ∀ i t, (pullbackDriver hg (CanonicalBrownianDriver.driver (I := I) ν)).process i t =ᵐ[Q]
      E.process i t := fun i t => Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq
        (congrFun (congrFun (CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_process_eq μ ν c) i) t)
  let he := CoupledBrownianFiltration.left_filtration_le (I := I) μ ν c
  let hk := CoupledBrownianFiltration.right_filtration_le (I := I) μ ν c
  let Uc := U.pullback hf E he hp
  let Vc := V.pullback hg E hk hq
  have h := RawSamplerGrowth.law_distance_decay Uc Vc
    (A.pullback hf E he hp) (B.pullback hg E hk hq) G ρ hmono
  have huLaw : Q.map (Uc.sampler.state T) = (μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T) :=
    U.sampler.pullback_law hf E he hp T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  have hvLaw : Q.map (Vc.sampler.state T) = (ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T) :=
    V.sampler.pullback_law hg E hk hq T ⟨T.coe_nonneg,le_rfl⟩
  rw [huLaw,hvLaw] at h
  change optimizerLawDistance (U.optimizer T) (V.optimizer T)
    ((μ.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (U.sampler.state T))
    ((ν.prod (brownianProbability (I := I))).map (V.sampler.state T)) ≤
    Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * (T : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt (‖U.optimizer 0-V.optimizer 0‖ ^ 2+
        ‖ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Uc.sampler.state 0-
          ProductLpSections.sectionLp Q Vc.sampler.state 0‖ ^ 2) at h
  rw [pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),
    pullback_section (ht := ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),hUI,hVI,
    initial_difference_norm_sq μ ν hμ hν c] at h
  exact h

lawDistance_zero_separates.exact_header:
private theorem lawDistance_zero_separates (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (hd : optimizerLawDistance s s' ν ν' = 0) : s = s' ∧ ν = ν'
lawDistance_zero_separates.exact_declaration:
private theorem lawDistance_zero_separates (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (hd : optimizerLawDistance s s' ν ν' = 0) : s = s' ∧ ν = ν' := by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖s-s'‖)
    (sq_nonneg (ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν')))
  change optimizerLawDistance s s' ν ν' ^ 2 = _ at hs
  rw [hd, zero_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] at hs
  have hn : ‖s-s'‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν')]
  have hw : ULA.wasserstein2Real ν ν' = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖s-s'‖]
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn),
    measure_eq_of_finite_wasserstein2Real_zero ν ν'
      (ULA.wasserstein2_ne_top_of_memLp ν ν' hν hν') hw⟩

stationary_laws_unique_constant.exact_header:
theorem stationary_laws_unique_constant
    (F : Family Q D M s ν) (H : Family R E M s' ν')
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M G)
    (hσ : ∀ a a' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter a) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter a') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    s = s' ∧ ν = ν'
stationary_laws_unique_constant.exact_declaration:
theorem stationary_laws_unique_constant
    (F : Family Q D M s ν) (H : Family R E M s' ν')
    (hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν) (hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ν')
    (G : TwistedGeometry S Z) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M G ρ)
    (hfull : DiracOptimizerGrowth.FiniteCouplingWork M G)
    (hσ : ∀ a a' z w i, M.diffusion (M.parameter a) z i = M.diffusion (M.parameter a') w i)
    (hb : ∀ θ, Measurable (M.drift θ))
    (hObs : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.observation (M.parameter p.1) (M.position p.2)))
    (hDrift : Measurable (fun p : S × Z => M.drift (M.parameter p.1) p.2))
    (hOptimizer : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (S × Θ) => M.optimizer p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    s = s' ∧ ν = ν' := by
  apply lawDistance_zero_separates s s' ν ν' hν hν'
  apply stationary_distance_zero (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hρ
    (C := Real.sqrt G.conditionNumber)
  intro t ht
  let T : ℝ≥0 := ⟨t,ht⟩
  have htime : (T : ℝ) = t := rfl
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨le_rfl,ht⟩
  have hT : (T : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ) := ⟨ht,le_rfl⟩
  let A : NaturalFiniteWorkArbitraryLaw.CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) ν
      ((F.trajectory T).optimizer 0) := {
    data := (F.canonical T).data
    initial_optimizer := (F.canonical T).initial_optimizer.trans (F.optimizer_eq T 0 h0).symm
    initial_sampler := (F.canonical T).initial_sampler }
  let B : NaturalFiniteWorkArbitraryLaw.CanonicalSolution (M := M) (T := T) ν'
      ((H.trajectory T).optimizer 0) := {
    data := (H.canonical T).data
    initial_optimizer := (H.canonical T).initial_optimizer.trans (H.optimizer_eq T 0 h0).symm
    initial_sampler := (H.canonical T).initial_sampler }
  have hpF : ∃ W : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν)
      (BrownianPathDriver.driver ν) M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = (F.trajectory T).optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν] Prod.fst := by
    simpa only [F.optimizer_eq T 0 h0] using F.path T
  have hpH : ∃ W : Data (BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν')
      (BrownianPathDriver.driver ν') M T,
      W.optimizer 0 = (H.trajectory T).optimizer 0 ∧
      W.sampler.state 0 =ᵐ[BrownianPathDriver.probability (I := I) ν'] Prod.fst := by
    simpa only [H.optimizer_eq T 0 h0] using H.path T
  have hd := NaturalFiniteWorkArbitraryLaw.law_distance_decay (F.trajectory T) (H.trajectory T)
    ν ν' hν hν' (F.law_eq T 0 h0) (H.law_eq T 0 h0) A B
    (F.unique T) (H.unique T) (F.unique_canonical T) (H.unique_canonical T) hpF hpH
    G ρ hρ hmono hfull hσ hb hObs hDrift hOptimizer
  rw [F.optimizer_eq T T hT,H.optimizer_eq T T hT,F.law_eq T T hT,H.law_eq T T hT,
    F.optimizer_eq T 0 h0,H.optimizer_eq T 0 h0] at hd
  simpa only [htime, optimizerLawDistance] using hd

    initial_sampler := (H.canonical T).initial_sampler }

theorem stopped_raw_aestronglyAdapted (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hstop : ∀ r, MeasurableSet[D.filtration r] {ω | τ ω ≤ r})
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ r, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration r] (X r) Q)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => X r ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => X (min t (τ ω)) ω) Q
stopped_raw_aestronglyAdapted.exact_declaration:
theorem stopped_raw_aestronglyAdapted (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hstop : ∀ r, MeasurableSet[D.filtration r] {ω | τ ω ≤ r})
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hX : ∀ r, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration r] (X r) Q)
    (hC : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun r => X r ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => X (min t (τ ω)) ω) Q := by
  classical
  let ς : Ω → ℝ≥0 := fun ω => min t (τ ω)
  have hς : ∀ ω, ς ω ≤ t := fun ω => min_le_left _ _
  have hs : ∀ r, MeasurableSet[D.filtration r] {ω | ς ω ≤ r} := by
    intro r
    by_cases hr : t ≤ r
    · have he : {ω | ς ω ≤ r} = univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun ω => (hς ω).trans hr)
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.univ
    · have he : {ω | ς ω ≤ r} = {ω | τ ω ≤ r} := by
        ext ω
        simp only [ς,min_le_iff,hr,false_or,mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [he]
      exact hstop r
  let σ (m : ℕ) := dyadicStoppingIndex Q D t ς hς hs m
  have hj (m : ℕ) : Measurable[D.filtration t] (σ m).index := by
    apply measurable_of_Iic
    intro k
    change MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | (σ m).index ω ≤ k}
    by_cases hk : (dyadicGrids t).count m ≤ k
    · have he : {ω | (σ m).index ω ≤ k} = univ :=
        Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun ω => ((σ m).bound ω).trans hk)
      rw [he]
      exact MeasurableSet.univ
    · have hkt : (dyadicGrids t).time m k ≤ t := by
        exact ((dyadicGrids t).monotone m (le_of_not_ge hk)).trans_eq (dyadic_time_last t m)
      exact D.filtration.mono hkt _ ((σ m).stopping k)
  let F (m k : ℕ) : Ω → Z := if hk : k ≤ (dyadicGrids t).count m then
    (hX ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)).mk (X ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)) else 0
  have hF (m k : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (F m k) := by
    by_cases hk : k ≤ (dyadicGrids t).count m
    · have hkt : (dyadicGrids t).time m k ≤ t := by
        exact ((dyadicGrids t).monotone m hk).trans_eq (dyadic_time_last t m)
      simpa only [F,dite_eq_left hk] using
        (hX ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)).stronglyMeasurable_mk.mono (D.filtration.mono hkt)
    · simpa only [F,dite_eq_right hk] using (stronglyMeasurable_zero : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (0 : Ω → Z))
  let G (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : Z := F m ((σ m).index ω) ω
  have hG (m : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (G m) := by
    have hm : @Measurable _ _ ((inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℕ).prod (D.filtration t)) _
        (fun p : ℕ × Ω => F m p.1 p.2) :=
      measurable_from_prod_countable_right (fun k => (hF m k).measurable)
    exact (hm.comp ((hj m).prodMk measurable_id)).stronglyMeasurable
  have he (m : ℕ) : G m =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => X (dyadicStop t ς hς m ω) ω) := by
    have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ k : ℕ, X ((dyadicGrids t).time m k) ω =
        (hX ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)).mk (X ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)) ω :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun k => (hX ((dyadicGrids t).time m k)).ae_eq_mk)
    filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
    change F m ((σ m).index ω) ω = X ((dyadicGrids t).time m ((σ m).index ω)) ω
    simpa only [F,dite_eq_left ((σ m).bound ω)] using (hω ((σ m).index ω)).symm
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun m => G m ω) atTop (𝓝 (X (ς ω) ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hC,ae_all_iff.mpr he] with ω hc heω
    have ht := (hc.tendsto (ς ω)).comp (dyadicStop_tendsto t ς hς ω)
    exact ht.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun m => (heω m).symm))
  have hsm : StronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (fun ω => limUnder atTop (fun m => G m ω)) :=
    @StronglyMeasurable.limUnder ℕ Ω Z (D.filtration t) _ _ atTop _ G _ _ hG
  refine ⟨fun ω => limUnder atTop (fun m => G m ω), hsm, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlim] with ω hω
  exact hω.limUnder_eq.symm

stoppedState.exact_header: def stoppedState (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (X : ℝ → Ω → Z) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Z
stoppedState.exact_declaration:
def stoppedState (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (X : ℝ → Ω → Z) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : Z :=
  X (min t (τ ω : ℝ)) ω

stoppedState_stronglyMeasurable.exact_header:
theorem stoppedState_stronglyMeasurable (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Measurable τ)
    (X : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hX : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry X)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (stoppedState τ X))
stoppedState_stronglyMeasurable.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedState_stronglyMeasurable (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Measurable τ)
    (X : ℝ → Ω → Z) (hX : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry X)) :
    StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (stoppedState τ X)) := by
  exact hX.comp_measurable ((measurable_fst.min
    (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (hτ.comp measurable_snd))).prodMk measurable_snd)

stoppedField_integral.exact_header:
theorem stoppedField_integral (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ω : Ω) :
    (∫ r in 0..t, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField τ b r ω) =
      ∫ r in 0..min t (τ ω : ℝ), b r ω
stoppedField_integral.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedField_integral (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ω : Ω) :
    (∫ r in 0..t, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField τ b r ω) =
      ∫ r in 0..min t (τ ω : ℝ), b r ω := by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (le_min ht (τ ω).coe_nonneg)]
  change (∫ r in Ioc 0 t, (Iic (τ ω : ℝ)).indicator (fun r => b r ω) r) = _
  rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Iic]
  have hs : Iic (τ ω : ℝ) ∩ Ioc 0 t = Ioc 0 (min t (τ ω : ℝ)) := by
    ext r
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Iic, mem_Ioc, le_min_iff]
    tauto
  rw [Set.inter_comm, hs]

stoppedState_equation.exact_header:
theorem stoppedState_equation (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (X b M : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (heq : ∀ ω, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      X t ω = X 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + M t ω) :
    ∀ ω, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), stoppedState τ X t ω = X 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField τ b r ω) +
      M (min t (τ ω : ℝ)) ω
stoppedState_equation.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedState_equation (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (X b M : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (heq : ∀ ω, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ),
      X t ω = X 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + M t ω) :
    ∀ ω, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), stoppedState τ X t ω = X 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, LocalizedDiffusion.stoppedField τ b r ω) +
      M (min t (τ ω : ℝ)) ω := by
  intro ω t ht
  unfold stoppedState
  rw [stoppedField_integral τ b t ht.1 ω]
  exact heq ω _ ⟨le_min ht.1 (τ ω).coe_nonneg,
    (min_le_left _ _).trans ht.2⟩

stoppedState_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem stoppedState_tendsto (Q : Measure Ω) (τ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (X : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hτ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, τ n ω = T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => stoppedState (τ n) X t ω) atTop (𝓝 (X t ω))
stoppedState_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem stoppedState_tendsto (Q : Measure Ω) (τ : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (T : ℝ≥0) (X : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hτ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, τ n ω = T)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Tendsto (fun n => stoppedState (τ n) X t ω) atTop (𝓝 (X t ω)) := by
  filter_upwards [hτ] with ω hω
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [hω] with n hn
  simp only [stoppedState, hn, min_eq_left ht.2]
