rawSampler_section_law.exact_header:
theorem rawSampler_section_law (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) (t : ℝ) (ht : MemLp (Y t) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (sectionLp Q Y t) = Q.map (Y t)
rawSampler_section_law.exact_declaration:
theorem rawSampler_section_law (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) (t : ℝ) (ht : MemLp (Y t) 2 Q) :
    Q.map (sectionLp Q Y t) = Q.map (Y t) :=
  Measure.map_congr (sectionLp_ae Q Y ht)

originalRawDrift.exact_header: def originalRawDrift (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) : ℝ → Ω → Z
originalRawDrift.exact_declaration:
def originalRawDrift (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) : ℝ → Ω → Z :=
  fun t ω => M.drift (M.parameter (a t)) (Y t ω)

originalRawDiffusion.exact_header: def originalRawDiffusion (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) : I → ℝ → Ω → Z
originalRawDiffusion.exact_declaration:
def originalRawDiffusion (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z) : I → ℝ → Ω → Z :=
  fun i t ω => M.diffusion (M.parameter (a t)) (Y t ω) i

originalRawDiffusion_adapted.exact_header:
theorem originalRawDiffusion_adapted (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hY : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (Y t) Q)
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i t) Q
originalRawDiffusion_adapted.exact_declaration:
theorem originalRawDiffusion_adapted (a : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hY : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (Y t) Q)
    (hσ : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (i : I) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i t) Q := by
  let g : Z → Z := fun z => M.diffusion (M.parameter (a t)) z i
  refine ⟨g ∘ (hY t).mk (Y t), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ((hσ _ i).comp (hY t).stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable).stronglyMeasurable
  · exact (hY t).ae_eq_mk.fun_comp g

rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable.exact_header:
theorem rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖b p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (sectionLp Q b) volume 0 (T : ℝ)
rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖b p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (sectionLp Q b) volume 0 (T : ℝ) := by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, uIoc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
  exact (sectionLp_memLp (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q b hb h2).integrable (by norm_num)

rawDrift_sections_integral_ae.exact_header:
theorem rawDrift_sections_integral_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖b p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (∫ r in 0..t, sectionLp Q b r) =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω)
rawDrift_sections_integral_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem rawDrift_sections_integral_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry b))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖b p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q)) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) :
    (∫ r in 0..t, sectionLp Q b r) =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => ∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) := by
  have hi := (rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable Q T b hb h2).mono_set (by
    rw [uIcc_of_le ht.1, uIcc_of_le T.coe_nonneg]
    exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2)
  have hle : (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 t) ≤ volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono_set _ (Ioc_subset_Ioc le_rfl ht.2)
  have hsec : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t), b r =ᵐ[Q] sectionLp Q b r := by
    filter_upwards [(ae_memLp (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))) Q b hb h2).filter_mono
      (ae_mono hle)] with r hr
    exact (sectionLp_ae Q b hr).symm
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1]
  exact LpIntegralSections.integral_coe_ae Q (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 t))
    (sectionLp Q b) hi.1 b hb.aestronglyMeasurable hsec

dataOfRaw.exact_header:
def dataOfRaw (T : ℝ≥0) (a g : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hg : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hY2 : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (Y t) 2 Q)
    (hY : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (Y t) Q)
    (hσBorel : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (originalRawDrift M a Y)))
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i)))
    (hb2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖originalRawDrift M a Y p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖originalRawDiffusion M a Y i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hbt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (originalRawDrift M a Y t) 2 Q)
    (hσt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i, MemLp (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i t) 2 Q)
    (hgField : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), g t = M.optimizerField t (a t) (Q.map (Y t)))
    (haEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), a t = a 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, g r)
    (hYEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Y t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => Y 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, originalRawDrift M a Y r ω) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (originalRawDiffusion M a Y) hσ hσ2
        (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M a Y hY hσBorel) t.toNNReal ω))
    (hobs : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (a t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (Y t))) :
    Data Q D M T
dataOfRaw.exact_declaration:
def dataOfRaw (T : ℝ≥0) (a g : ℝ → S) (Y : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (hg : IntervalIntegrable g volume 0 (T : ℝ))
    (hY2 : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (Y t) 2 Q)
    (hY : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, AEStronglyMeasurable[D.filtration t] (Y t) Q)
    (hσBorel : ∀ θ i, Measurable (fun z => M.diffusion θ z i))
    (hb : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (originalRawDrift M a Y)))
    (hσ : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i)))
    (hb2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖originalRawDrift M a Y p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hσ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖originalRawDiffusion M a Y i p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
      ((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).prod Q))
    (hbt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), MemLp (originalRawDrift M a Y t) 2 Q)
    (hσt : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ∀ i, MemLp (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i t) 2 Q)
    (hgField : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), g t = M.optimizerField t (a t) (Q.map (Y t)))
    (haEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), a t = a 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, g r)
    (hYEq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Y t =ᵐ[Q] (fun ω => Y 0 ω +
      (∫ r in 0..t, originalRawDrift M a Y r ω) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (originalRawDiffusion M a Y) hσ hσ2
        (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M a Y hY hσBorel) t.toNNReal ω))
    (hobs : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), Integrable
      (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter (a t)) (M.position z)) (Q.map (Y t))) :
    Data Q D M T where
  optimizer := a
  optimizerDrift := g
  sampler := sectionLp Q Y
  drift := sectionLp Q (originalRawDrift M a Y)
  diffusion := rawDiffusionCurve Q (originalRawDiffusion M a Y)
  optimizerDrift_integrable := hg
  drift_integrable := rawDrift_sections_intervalIntegrable Q T _ hb hb2
  diffusion_square := rawDiffusionCurve_square Q T _ hσ hσ2
  sampler_adapted t := sectionLp_adapted Q (D.filtration t) Y t (hY t)
  diffusion_adapted := rawDiffusionCurve_adapted Q D _
    (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M a Y hY hσBorel)
  optimizerDrift_realizes t ht := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr (sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 t ht))]
    exact hgField t ht
  optimizer_integral := haEq
  sampler_integral t ht := by
    change sectionLp Q Y t = sectionLp Q Y 0 + (∫ r in 0..t, sectionLp Q (originalRawDrift M a Y) r) +
      rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (originalRawDiffusion M a Y) hσ hσ2
        (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M a Y hY hσBorel) t.toNNReal
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 t ht), sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 0 ⟨le_rfl,T.coe_nonneg⟩),
      rawDrift_sections_integral_ae Q T _ hb hb2 t ht, hYEq t ht,
      Lp.coeFn_add (sectionLp Q Y 0 + ∫ r in 0..t, sectionLp Q (originalRawDrift M a Y) r)
        (rawDiffusionIntegral Q D T (originalRawDiffusion M a Y) hσ hσ2
          (originalRawDiffusion_adapted Q D M a Y hY hσBorel) t.toNNReal),
      Lp.coeFn_add (sectionLp Q Y 0) (∫ r in 0..t, sectionLp Q (originalRawDrift M a Y) r)]
      with ω hyt hy0 hi he ha hb
    rw [ha, Pi.add_apply, hb, Pi.add_apply, hyt, hy0, hi]
    exact he
  drift_realizes t ht := by
    filter_upwards [sectionLp_ae Q (originalRawDrift M a Y) (hbt t ht),
      sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 t ht)] with ω hb hy
    rw [hb, hy]
    rfl
  diffusion_realizes t ht i := by
    filter_upwards [sectionLp_ae Q (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i) (hσt t ht i),
      sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 t ht)] with ω hb hy
    change sectionLp Q (originalRawDiffusion M a Y i) t ω = _
    rw [hb, hy]
    rfl
  observation_integrable t ht := by
    rw [Measure.map_congr (sectionLp_ae Q Y (hY2 t ht))]
    exact hobs t ht

exists_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_radius (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
        (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω
exists_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_radius (T : ℝ≥0) (x b m : ℝ → Ω → Z)
    (h2x₀ : MemLp (x 0) 2 Q) (h2m : ∀ t, MemLp (m t) 2 Q)
    (hmart : Martingale m F Q) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hxcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hmcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => m t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)))
    (hpaths : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧
      (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ c ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), x t ω = x 0 ω + (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω) + m t ω) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => x t ω) (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable (fun r => b r ω) volume 0 (T : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ C ω ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖x t ω‖ ≤ C ω) ∧
        (∫ r in 0..(T : ℝ), ‖b r ω‖) ≤ C ω := by
  obtain ⟨R, _, hR0, hR2, _, hRbound⟩ := DoobStrongL2.exists_continuous_radius Q F m
    hmart h2m (Icc 0 (T : ℝ)) ⟨0, le_rfl, T.coe_nonneg⟩ T (fun _ ht => ht.2) hmcont
  let C (ω : Ω) := ‖x 0 ω‖ + c + R ω
  have hC2 : MemLp C 2 Q := (h2x₀.norm.add (memLp_const c)).add hR2
  have hCi : Integrable (fun ω => C ω ^ 2) Q := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hC2.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hC2
  refine ⟨C, hCi, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hxcont, hpaths, hRbound] with ω hx hp hr
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C ω := add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hc) (hR0 ω)
  refine ⟨hx, hp.1, hC0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    have hv := (BoundedVariationRealization.primitive_norm_le T (fun r => b r ω) hp.1 t ht).trans hp.2.1
    rw [hp.2.2 t ht]
    apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
    dsimp [C]
    linarith [norm_add_le (x 0 ω) (∫ r in 0..t, b r ω), hr t ht]
  · exact hp.2.1.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [norm_nonneg (x 0 ω), hR0 ω])

import PBGSO.Framework
import ProximalLangevin.MeanFieldVariance

/-! # Actual independent-copy Monte Carlo error

The particle interaction theorem needs independent mean-field copies.
Exchangeability of interacting particles is insufficient for this identity.
Every expectation below is integration on the actual finite product law.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
namespace PBGSO

variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [MeasurableSpace Θ] [BorelSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z] [MeasurableSpace Z]
  [Fintype I]

/-- Exact variance of the model's empirical gradient for independent sampler
states. No relation between the observation and sampler drift is required. -/

/-- The corresponding root mean square identity has exactly 1/sqrt(N). -/

/-- A uniform one-copy variance bound implies the stated sampling rate. -/

/-- The actual finite empirical gradient is square integrable on the iid
product law whenever the one-copy observation is square integrable. -/

/-- The same variance identity on any actual probability space carrying a
reference cloud with the iid product marginal. This transfers the sampling
bound to an interacting/reference joint law without asserting independence
of that cloud from the interacting optimiser or particles. -/

    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∫ z : Fin N → Z, ‖M.particleGradient N s z - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) =
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) /
        (N : ℝ)

      ‖M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤ V) :

theorem gradient_sampling_rms_le (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)

      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) ≤ Real.sqrt V / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by

particleGradient_memLp.exact_header:
theorem particleGradient_memLp (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (N : ℕ) :
    MemLp (M.particleGradient N s) 2 (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν))
particleGradient_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem particleGradient_memLp (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (N : ℕ) :
    MemLp (M.particleGradient N s) 2 (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) := by
  classical
  have hi (i : Fin N) : MemLp
      (fun z : Fin N → Z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position (z i))) 2
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) :=
    hF.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin N => ν) i)
  exact (memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)).const_smul (N : ℝ)⁻¹

theorem gradient_sampling_variance_of_cloud_law {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (Y : Ω → Fin N → Z)
    (hY : AEMeasurable Y Q)
    (hLaw : Q.map Y = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) :
    (∫ ω, ‖M.particleGradient N s (Y ω) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) /
        (N : ℝ)
gradient_sampling_variance_of_cloud_law.exact_declaration:
theorem gradient_sampling_variance_of_cloud_law {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (s : S)
    (hF : MemLp (fun z => M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)) 2 ν)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (Y : Ω → Fin N → Z)
    (hY : AEMeasurable Y Q)
    (hLaw : Q.map Y = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => ν)) :
    (∫ ω, ‖M.particleGradient N s (Y ω) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) =
      (∫ z, ‖M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z) - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2 ∂ν) /
        (N : ℝ) := by
  have hm := (particleGradient_memLp M ν s hF N).sub
    (memLp_const (M.meanGradient ν s))
  have hs : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun z : Fin N → Z => ‖M.particleGradient N s z - M.meanGradient ν s‖ ^ 2)
      (Q.map Y) := by
    rw [hLaw]
    exact hm.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.pow 2
  have he := integral_map hY hs
  rw [hLaw] at he
  exact he.symm.trans (gradient_sampling_variance M ν s hF N hN)

import PBGSO.SeparatedGeometry

/-!
# Separate primitive optimiser/sampler assumptions imply joint monotonicity

The metric estimates below follow from the actual symmetric positive quadratic
weights. The law comparisons use genuine coupling marginals and Bochner
expectations; no optimiser/sampler work inequality is assumed as a substitute
for the primitive separated hypotheses.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace BigOperators
namespace PBGSO




section LawCriteria
variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Fintype I]

/-- A globally Lipschitz observation is Bochner integrable under every P₂
law. The constant offset is retained. -/

/-- A true coupling of probability marginals is itself a probability law. -/

/-- The observation expectation discrepancy is derived from the actual
coupling identity, sampler Lipschitz observation, and weighted quadratic cost. -/

/-- The exact primitive separated conditions from the appendix, stated on
actual optimiser fields, observation maps, frozen sampler drifts and diffusion
columns. No combined work estimate or final monotonicity inequality is a field. -/

/-- The optimiser part of the actual law-coupling work is controlled by the
primitive frozen-law contraction and observation response. -/

/-- Frozen sampler dissipativity, parameter Lipschitzness, and the actual
finite sum of diffusion columns imply the pointwise sampler work estimate. -/

/-- Integrating the sampler estimate uses Cauchy--Schwarz under the actual
coupling probability measure, not an assumed Wasserstein comparison. -/

/-- A conservative explicit small-gain criterion at the full law level.
All coupling work bounds are derived from the primitive separated conditions.
The two displayed diagonal inequalities give the contraction rate directly. -/

/-- The minimum of the explicit diagonal margins is always an available
joint rate. Positivity of this displayed number is precisely the additional
strict small-gain condition needed to call it a contraction rate. -/


end LawCriteria

observation_integrable_of_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem observation_integrable_of_lipschitz (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (f : Z → Θ) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) :
    Integrable f ν
observation_integrable_of_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem observation_integrable_of_lipschitz (ν : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (f : Z → Θ) {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) :
    Integrable f ν := by
  have hid : MemLp (fun z : Z ↦ z) 2 ν :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm continuous_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hν
  have hn := (hid.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)).norm
  apply ((integrable_const ‖f 0‖).add (hn.const_mul (L : ℝ))).mono'
    hf.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
  apply ae_of_all
  intro z
  have hl := hf.norm_sub_le z 0
  simp only [sub_zero] at hl
  have hnorm : ‖f z‖ ≤ ‖f z - f 0‖ + ‖f 0‖ := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (f z - f 0) (f 0)
  change ‖f z‖ ≤ ‖f 0‖ + (L : ℝ) * ‖z‖
  linarith

meanGradient_coupling_bound.exact_header:
theorem meanGradient_coupling_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (LF : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ∀ s, LipschitzWith LF (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)))
    (s : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) (hν' : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν')
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) (hc : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hcost : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    ‖M.meanGradient ν s - M.meanGradient ν' s‖ ≤
      (LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower *
        Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ)
meanGradient_coupling_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem meanGradient_coupling_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (LF : ℝ≥0)
    (hF : ∀ s, LipschitzWith LF (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)))
    (s : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) (hν' : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν')
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) (hc : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hcost : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    ‖M.meanGradient ν s - M.meanGradient ν' s‖ ≤
      (LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower *
        Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) := by
  letI := coupling_isProbability Λ ν ν' hc
  let f := fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z)
  have hi := observation_integrable_of_lipschitz ν f (hF s) hν
  have hi' := observation_integrable_of_lipschitz ν' f (hF s) hν'
  have hfst : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ f zz.1) Λ := by
    rw [← hc.1] at hi
    exact hi.comp_measurable measurable_fst
  have hsnd : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ f zz.2) Λ := by
    rw [← hc.2] at hi'
    exact hi'.comp_measurable measurable_snd
  have hm1 : M.meanGradient ν s = ∫ zz : Z × Z, f zz.1 ∂Λ := by
    rw [Model.meanGradient, ← hc.1]
    exact integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable (hF s).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hm2 : M.meanGradient ν' s = ∫ zz : Z × Z, f zz.2 ∂Λ := by
    rw [Model.meanGradient, ← hc.2]
    exact integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable (hF s).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
  let q := fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)
  have hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Λ := by
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    dsimp [q, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    fun_prop
  have hqpos : ∀ zz, 0 ≤ q zz := fun zz ↦ D.samplerSq_nonneg _
  have hsq := sqrt_energy_memLp Λ q hq hcost hqpos
  have hsqrtInt := hsq.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hbound (zz : Z × Z) : ‖f zz.1 - f zz.2‖ ≤
      ((LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (q zz) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (LF : ℝ) * ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ := (hF s).norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (LF : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (q zz) / Real.sqrt D.lower) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.sampler_norm_le _) LF.coe_nonneg
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [hm1, hm2, ← integral_sub hfst hsnd]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ zz, ‖f zz.1 - f zz.2‖ ∂Λ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ zz, ((LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower) * Real.sqrt (q zz) ∂Λ :=
      integral_mono (hfst.sub hsnd).norm (hsqrtInt.const_mul _) hbound
    _ = ((LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower) * (∫ zz, Real.sqrt (q zz) ∂Λ) := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_sqrt_energy_le Λ q hq hcost hqpos) (by positivity)

SeparatedAssumptions.exact_header:
structure SeparatedAssumptions (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (rOptimizer rSampler : ℝ) (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0) : Prop
SeparatedAssumptions.exact_declaration:
structure SeparatedAssumptions (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (rOptimizer rSampler : ℝ) (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0) : Prop where
  optimizer_contract : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ s s' ν, IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
    HasFiniteSecondMoment ν →
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν)⟫_ℝ ≤
      -rOptimizer * D.optimizerSq (s - s')
  optimizer_response : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ s ν ν', IsProbabilityMeasure ν → IsProbabilityMeasure ν' →
    HasFiniteSecondMoment ν → HasFiniteSecondMoment ν' →
    ‖M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s ν'‖ ≤
      (LΨ : ℝ) * ‖M.meanGradient ν s - M.meanGradient ν' s‖
  observation_lipschitz : ∀ s,
    LipschitzWith LF (fun z ↦ M.observation (M.parameter s) (M.position z))
  sampler_frozen : ∀ s z z',
    ⟪z - z', D.samplerWeight (M.drift (M.parameter s) z - M.drift (M.parameter s) z')⟫_ℝ ≤
      -rSampler * D.samplerSq (z - z')
  sampler_parameter : ∀ s s' z,
    ‖M.drift (M.parameter s) z - M.drift (M.parameter s') z‖ ≤ (Lb : ℝ) * ‖s - s'‖
  diffusion_lipschitz : ∀ s s' z z',
    (∑ i, ‖M.diffusion (M.parameter s) z i - M.diffusion (M.parameter s') z' i‖ ^ 2) ≤

    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) (hν' : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν')

    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')⟫_ℝ ≤
      -rO * D.optimizerSq (s - s') +
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) *

theorem separated_optimizer_work_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν']
    (hν : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν) (hν' : HasFiniteSecondMoment ν')
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) (hc : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hcost : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')⟫_ℝ ≤
      -rO * D.optimizerSq (s - s') +
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) *
        Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) := by
  have hg := meanGradient_coupling_bound M D LF H.observation_lipschitz
    s' ν ν' hν hν' Λ hc hcost
  have hr := H.optimizer_response t ht s' ν ν' inferInstance inferInstance hν hν'
  have he := hr.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg LΨ.coe_nonneg)
  have hp := D.optimizer_pairing_bound (s - s')
    (M.optimizerField t s' ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')
  have hp' := hp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (by positivity))
  have hs := H.optimizer_contract t ht s s' ν inferInstance hν
  have hid : M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν' =
      (M.optimizerField t s ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν) +
      (M.optimizerField t s' ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν') := by module
  rw [hid, map_add, inner_add_right]
  calc
    _ ≤ -rO * D.optimizerSq (s - s') +
      (Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) * Real.sqrt D.upper *
       ((LΨ : ℝ) * ((LF : ℝ) / Real.sqrt D.lower *
         Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ)))) := by
      linarith [le_abs_self ⟪s - s', D.optimizerWeight
        (M.optimizerField t s' ν - M.optimizerField t s' ν')⟫_ℝ]

    {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz ≤
      -rS * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) +
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (Lb : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) *
        Real.sqrt (D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) +
      (D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2) *
        (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2))
separated_sampler_work_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem separated_sampler_work_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) :
    samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz ≤
      -rS * D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) +
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (Lb : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) *
        Real.sqrt (D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) +
      (D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2) *
        (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
  have hu : 0 ≤ D.upper := D.lower_pos.le.trans D.lower_le_upper
  have hp := D.sampler_pairing_bound (zz.1 - zz.2)
    (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.2 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)
  have hb := H.sampler_parameter s s' zz.2
  have hb' := hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.optimizer_norm_le _) Lb.coe_nonneg)
  have hcross := hp.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb' (by positivity))
  have hcross' : ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.2 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (Lb : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) *
        Real.sqrt (D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
        (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.2 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫_ℝ| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ _ := hcross
      _ = _ := by rw [← D.sqrt_conditionNumber]; ring
  have hnorm : ‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) / D.lower := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ D.lower_pos).mpr
    have hs := D.optimizer_lower (s - s')
    have hz := D.sampler_lower (zz.1 - zz.2)
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.optimizerSq, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    linarith
  have hdiff : (∑ i, D.samplerSq
      (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i - M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)) ≤
      D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, D.upper * ‖M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i‖ ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          exact D.sampler_upper _
      _ = D.upper * ∑ i, ‖M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i‖ ^ 2 := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm
      _ ≤ D.upper * ((Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 * (‖s - s'‖ ^ 2 + ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (H.diffusion_lipschitz s s' zz.1 zz.2) hu
      _ ≤ D.upper * ((Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ((D.optimizerSq (s - s') + D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) / D.lower)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (sq_nonneg _)) hu
      _ = _ := by dsimp [TwistedGeometry.conditionNumber]; ring
  have hf := H.sampler_frozen s zz.1 zz.2
  have hid : M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2 =
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.2) +
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.2 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2) := by module
  unfold samplerCouplingWork
  rw [hid, map_add, inner_add_right]
  linarith

    {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)

theorem separated_sampler_integral_bound (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (s s' : S) (ν ν' : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (Λ : Measure (Z × Z)) (hc : IsCoupling Λ ν ν')
    (hwork : Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D s s') Λ)
    (hcost : Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)) Λ) :
    (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz ∂Λ) ≤
      -rS * (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) +
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (Lb : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) +
      (D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2) *
        (D.optimizerSq (s - s') + ∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ) := by
  letI := coupling_isProbability Λ ν ν' hc
  let q := fun zz : Z × Z ↦ D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)
  let A := D.optimizerSq (s - s')
  let C := Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * (Lb : ℝ) * Real.sqrt A
  let V := D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2
  have hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Λ := by
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    dsimp [q, TwistedGeometry.samplerSq]
    fun_prop
  have hpos : ∀ zz, 0 ≤ q zz := fun zz ↦ D.samplerSq_nonneg _
  have hsqrtInt := (sqrt_energy_memLp Λ q hq hcost hpos).integrable
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hg1 := hcost.const_mul (-rS)
  have hg2 := hsqrtInt.const_mul C
  have hg3 := ((integrable_const A).add hcost).const_mul V
  have hw : (∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz ∂Λ) ≤
      ∫ zz, -rS * q zz + C * Real.sqrt (q zz) + V * (A + q zz) ∂Λ :=
    integral_mono hwork ((hg1.add hg2).add hg3)
      (separated_sampler_work_bound M D H s s')
  have heq : (∫ zz, A + q zz ∂Λ) = A + ∫ zz, q zz ∂Λ := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ _ : Z × Z, A ∂Λ) + ∫ zz, q zz ∂Λ :=
        integral_add (integrable_const A) hcost
      _ = _ := by simp
  have he : (∫ zz, -rS * q zz + C * Real.sqrt (q zz) + V * (A + q zz) ∂Λ) =
      -rS * (∫ zz, q zz ∂Λ) + C * (∫ zz, Real.sqrt (q zz) ∂Λ) +
        V * (A + ∫ zz, q zz ∂Λ) := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ zz, -rS * q zz + C * Real.sqrt (q zz) ∂Λ) +
          ∫ zz, V * (A + q zz) ∂Λ := integral_add (hg1.add hg2) hg3
      _ = (∫ zz, -rS * q zz ∂Λ) + (∫ zz, C * Real.sqrt (q zz) ∂Λ) +
          ∫ zz, V * (A + q zz) ∂Λ := by
            congr 1
            exact integral_add hg1 hg2
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, heq]
  rw [he] at hw
  have hcs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_sqrt_energy_le Λ q hq hcost hpos)
    (show 0 ≤ C by dsimp [C]; positivity)
  dsimp [C, V, A, q] at hw hcs
  linarith

theorem separated_joint_monotonicity (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    {rO rS ρ : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
    (hO : ρ ≤ rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 -
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) + (Lb : ℝ)) / 2)

  letI := hp'

theorem weighted_cauchy_schwarz (W : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ) (x y : E) :
    |⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ| ≤ Real.sqrt ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ * Real.sqrt ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ
weighted_cauchy_schwarz.exact_declaration:
theorem weighted_cauchy_schwarz (W : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ) (x y : E) :
    |⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ| ≤ Real.sqrt ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ * Real.sqrt ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ := by
  let A := ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ
  let B := ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ
  let C := ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := hpos x
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := hpos y
  have hsym' : ⟪y, W x⟫_ℝ = B := by
    calc
      ⟪y, W x⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ := real_inner_comm _ _
      _ = B := (hsym x y).symm
  have hsq : B ^ 2 ≤ A * C := by
    by_cases hc : C = 0
    · have hquad (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ A + 2 * t * B := by
        have hp := hpos (x + t • y)
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
          real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hsym'] at hp
        dsimp [A, B, C] at *
        rw [hc] at hp
        nlinarith
      have hb : B = 0 := by
        by_contra hb
        have hp := hquad (-(A + 1) / (2 * B))
        have he : A + 2 * (-(A + 1) / (2 * B)) * B = -1 := by field_simp; ring
        rw [he] at hp
        linarith
      rw [hb, hc]
      simp
    · have hcpos : 0 < C := lt_of_le_of_ne hC (Ne.symm hc)
      have hp := hpos (C • x - B • y)
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right,
        real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hsym'] at hp
      have he : 0 ≤ C * (A * C - B ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [A, B, C] at *
        nlinarith only [hp]
      have hh := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right he hcpos
      linarith
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hA, Real.sq_sqrt hC]
  exact hsq

    (hupper : ∀ y, ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ ≤ upper * ‖y‖ ^ 2) (x y : E) :

theorem weighted_pairing_bound (W : E →L[ℝ] E) (upper : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ upper)
    (hsym : ∀ x y, ⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ = ⟪W x, y⟫_ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ)
    (hupper : ∀ y, ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ ≤ upper * ‖y‖ ^ 2) (x y : E) :
    |⟪x, W y⟫_ℝ| ≤ Real.sqrt ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ * Real.sqrt upper * ‖y‖ := by
  have hy : Real.sqrt ⟪y, W y⟫_ℝ ≤ Real.sqrt upper * ‖y‖ := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hpos y), mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hu]
    exact hupper y
  exact (weighted_cauchy_schwarz W hsym hpos x y).trans
    (by have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy (Real.sqrt_nonneg ⟪x, W x⟫_ℝ); nlinarith)

theorem sqrt_energy_memLp (q : Ω → ℝ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Q)
    (hint : Integrable q Q) (hpos : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt (q ω)) 2 Q
sqrt_energy_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem sqrt_energy_memLp (q : Ω → ℝ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Q)
    (hint : Integrable q Q) (hpos : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt (q ω)) 2 Q := by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hq)).mpr
  simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (hpos _)] using hint

integral_sqrt_energy_le.exact_header:
theorem integral_sqrt_energy_le (q : Ω → ℝ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Q)
    (hint : Integrable q Q) (hpos : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) :
    (∫ ω, Real.sqrt (q ω) ∂Q) ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, q ω ∂Q)
integral_sqrt_energy_le.exact_declaration:
theorem integral_sqrt_energy_le (q : Ω → ℝ) (hq : AEStronglyMeasurable q Q)
    (hint : Integrable q Q) (hpos : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ q ω) :
    (∫ ω, Real.sqrt (q ω) ∂Q) ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, q ω ∂Q) := by
  let f := fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt (q ω)
  have hm : MemLp f 2 Q := sqrt_energy_memLp Q q hq hint hpos
  have hi := hm.integrable (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hOne : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖f ω‖ ∂Q) = eLpNorm f 1 Q := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hi, eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm hm.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hle : eLpNorm f 1 Q ≤ eLpNorm f 2 Q :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono hm.eLpNorm_ne_top hle
  rw [← hOne, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)] at hr
  have hn := ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral Q (hm.toLp f)
  rw [Lp.norm_toLp] at hn
  have he : (∫ ω, ‖hm.toLp f ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q) = ∫ ω, q ω ∂Q := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hm.coeFn_toLp] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
    simp only [f, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt (hpos ω)]
  rw [he] at hn
  have hfpos : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, f ω ∂Q := integral_nonneg (fun ω ↦ Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hr' : (∫ ω, f ω ∂Q) ≤ (eLpNorm f 2 Q).toReal := by
    simpa only [f, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] using hr
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  nlinarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := eLpNorm f 2 Q)]

import PBGSO.SeparatedCriteria

/-! # The full two-by-two small-gain condition

The smaller eigenvalue is written by its explicit quadratic formula. The
quadratic lower bound and positivity under the paper's determinant condition
are proved algebraically, then applied to the already derived actual coupling
work bounds. This also covers small-gain matrices that fail diagonal dominance.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal RealInnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO

/-- Explicit smaller eigenvalue of [[a,-c/2],[-c/2,b]]. -/


/-- The exact quadratic-form lower bound for the explicit spectral rate,
including degenerate eigenvalues and vanishing off-diagonal entries. -/

/-- The paper's positive-diagonal and determinant conditions give a
strictly positive rate, rather than merely positivity of a quadratic form. -/

variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z] [Fintype I]

/-- The full explicit spectral rate of the source small-gain matrix. -/

/-- Full actual-law small-gain criterion at the explicit spectral rate.
Every optimiser and sampler work estimate comes from the primitive separated
assumptions. The final joint inequality is a conclusion. -/

/-- Precisely the source's three strict scalar conditions ensure that the
certified full law-level rate is positive. -/

end PBGSO

smallGainSpectralRate.exact_header: def smallGainSpectralRate (a b c : ℝ) : ℝ
smallGainSpectralRate.exact_declaration:
def smallGainSpectralRate (a b c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (a + b - Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2)) / 2

smallGainSpectralRate_margins.exact_header:
theorem smallGainSpectralRate_margins (a b c : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c ∧
    0 ≤ b - smallGainSpectralRate a b c ∧
    c ^ 2 = 4 * (a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c) *
      (b - smallGainSpectralRate a b c)
smallGainSpectralRate_margins.exact_declaration:
theorem smallGainSpectralRate_margins (a b c : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c ∧
    0 ≤ b - smallGainSpectralRate a b c ∧
    c ^ 2 = 4 * (a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c) *
      (b - smallGainSpectralRate a b c) := by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hp := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
  have ha : a - b ≤ Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg c]
  have hb : b - a ≤ Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg c]
  dsimp [smallGainSpectralRate]
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor
  · linarith
  · nlinarith

small_gain_spectral_form.exact_header:
theorem small_gain_spectral_form (a b c u v : ℝ) :
    -a * u ^ 2 - b * v ^ 2 + c * u * v ≤
      -smallGainSpectralRate a b c * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)
small_gain_spectral_form.exact_declaration:
theorem small_gain_spectral_form (a b c u v : ℝ) :
    -a * u ^ 2 - b * v ^ 2 + c * u * v ≤
      -smallGainSpectralRate a b c * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, he⟩ := smallGainSpectralRate_margins a b c
  by_cases hp : 0 < a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c
  · exact small_gain_schur hp he.le
  · have hz : a - smallGainSpectralRate a b c = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hp) ha
    have hc : c = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero, zero_mul] at he; nlinarith [sq_nonneg c]
    have hn := mul_nonneg hb (sq_nonneg v)
    subst c
    nlinarith

smallGainSpectralRate_pos.exact_header:
theorem smallGainSpectralRate_pos {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdet : c ^ 2 < 4 * a * b) : 0 < smallGainSpectralRate a b c
smallGainSpectralRate_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem smallGainSpectralRate_pos {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdet : c ^ 2 < 4 * a * b) : 0 < smallGainSpectralRate a b c := by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hp := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
  have hlt : Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2) < a + b := by nlinarith
  dsimp [smallGainSpectralRate]
  linarith

separatedSpectralRate.exact_header:
def separatedSpectralRate (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (rO rS : ℝ)
    (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ
separatedSpectralRate.exact_declaration:
def separatedSpectralRate (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (rO rS : ℝ)
    (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ :=
  smallGainSpectralRate
    (rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)
    (rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)
    (Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) + (Lb : ℝ)))

separated_joint_monotonicity_spectral.exact_header:
theorem separated_joint_monotonicity_spectral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ) :
    TwistedJointMonotonicity M D (separatedSpectralRate D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ)
separated_joint_monotonicity_spectral.exact_declaration:
theorem separated_joint_monotonicity_spectral (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) {rO rS : ℝ} {LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0}
    (H : SeparatedAssumptions M D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ) :
    TwistedJointMonotonicity M D (separatedSpectralRate D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ) := by
  intro t ht s s' ν ν' Λ hc hp hp' hν hν' _ _ hwork hcost
  letI := hp
  letI := hp'
  have ho := separated_optimizer_work_bound M D H t ht s s' ν ν' hν hν' Λ hc hcost
  have hs := separated_sampler_integral_bound M D H s s' ν ν' Λ hc hwork hcost
  have hqO := D.optimizerSq_nonneg (s - s')
  have hqS : 0 ≤ ∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun zz => D.samplerSq_nonneg _)
  have hg := small_gain_spectral_form
    (rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)
    (rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)
    (Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) + (Lb : ℝ)))
    (Real.sqrt (D.optimizerSq (s - s')))
    (Real.sqrt (∫ zz, D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2) ∂Λ))
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hqO, Real.sq_sqrt hqS] at hg
  dsimp only [separatedSpectralRate]
  nlinarith

separatedSpectralRate_pos.exact_header:
theorem separatedSpectralRate_pos (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (rO rS : ℝ)
    (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0)
    (hO : 0 < 2 * rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hS : 0 < 2 * rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hdet : D.conditionNumber * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) + (Lb : ℝ)) ^ 2 <
      (2 * rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        (2 * rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    0 < separatedSpectralRate D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ
separatedSpectralRate_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem separatedSpectralRate_pos (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (rO rS : ℝ)
    (LΨ LF Lb Lσ : ℝ≥0)
    (hO : 0 < 2 * rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hS : 0 < 2 * rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hdet : D.conditionNumber * ((LΨ : ℝ) * (LF : ℝ) + (Lb : ℝ)) ^ 2 <
      (2 * rO - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        (2 * rS - D.conditionNumber * (Lσ : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    0 < separatedSpectralRate D rO rS LΨ LF Lb Lσ := by
  have hκ : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  apply smallGainSpectralRate_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hκ]
  nlinarith

The explicit scalar rate is identified with the minimum of the actual two
matrix eigenvalues in Mathlib's spectral theorem. Thus the determinant
criterion produces the manuscript's spectral rate, not just a lower bound.

open MeasureTheory
open scoped Matrix NNReal
namespace PBGSO

/-- The actual symmetric two-by-two small-gain matrix. -/


/-- The explicit smaller-root formula is the actual minimum eigenvalue,

/-- The three strict small-gain conditions imply actual matrix positive
definiteness, as well as a positive scalar lower-bound certificate. -/

variable {S Θ Z X I : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup S] [InnerProductSpace ℝ S]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Θ] [NormedSpace ℝ Θ] [CompleteSpace Θ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Z]

/-- The source's matrix H, with its actual metric condition number. -/

smallGainMatrix.exact_header: def smallGainMatrix (a b c : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ
smallGainMatrix.exact_declaration:
def smallGainMatrix (a b c : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  !![a, -c / 2; -c / 2, b]

smallGainMatrix_isHermitian.exact_header: theorem smallGainMatrix_isHermitian (a b c : ℝ) : (smallGainMatrix a b c).IsHermitian
smallGainMatrix_isHermitian.exact_declaration:
theorem smallGainMatrix_isHermitian (a b c : ℝ) : (smallGainMatrix a b c).IsHermitian := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [smallGainMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

smallGainMatrix_min_eigenvalue.exact_header:
theorem smallGainMatrix_min_eigenvalue (a b c : ℝ) :
    min ((smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c).eigenvalues 0)
      ((smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c).eigenvalues 1) = smallGainSpectralRate a b c
smallGainMatrix_min_eigenvalue.exact_declaration:
theorem smallGainMatrix_min_eigenvalue (a b c : ℝ) :
    min ((smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c).eigenvalues 0)
      ((smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c).eigenvalues 1) = smallGainSpectralRate a b c := by
  let H := smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c
  let eigs := H.eigenvalues
  have ht : a + b = eigs 0 + eigs 1 := by
    have h := H.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
    simpa [smallGainMatrix, Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_two, eigs, H] using h
  have hd : a * b - c ^ 2 / 4 = eigs 0 * eigs 1 := by
    have h := H.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues
    simp [smallGainMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_two, Fin.prod_univ_two] at h
    change a * b - -c / 2 * (-c / 2) = eigs 0 * eigs 1 at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have htsq : (a + b) ^ 2 = (eigs 0 + eigs 1) ^ 2 := congrArg (fun x => x ^ 2) ht
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hp := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
  change min (eigs 0) (eigs 1) = _
  by_cases ho : eigs 0 ≤ eigs 1
  · have he : Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2) = eigs 1 - eigs 0 := by
      apply (sq_eq_sq₀ hp (sub_nonneg.mpr ho)).mp
      nlinarith [htsq]
    rw [min_eq_left ho]
    dsimp only [smallGainSpectralRate]
    rw [he]
    linarith
  · have ho' : eigs 1 ≤ eigs 0 := (le_of_not_ge ho)
    have he : Real.sqrt ((a - b) ^ 2 + c ^ 2) = eigs 0 - eigs 1 := by
      apply (sq_eq_sq₀ hp (sub_nonneg.mpr ho')).mp
      nlinarith [htsq]
    rw [min_eq_right ho']
    dsimp only [smallGainSpectralRate]
    rw [he]
    linarith

theorem smallGainMatrix_posDef {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)

theorem smallGainMatrix_posDef {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdet : c ^ 2 < 4 * a * b) : (smallGainMatrix a b c).PosDef := by
  apply (smallGainMatrix_isHermitian a b c).posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos.mpr
  have hp := smallGainSpectralRate_pos ha hb hdet
  rw [← smallGainMatrix_min_eigenvalue] at hp
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hp.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  · exact hp.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)

def columnEventMask (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) :

def eventTimePiece (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (s t : ℝ)

    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    eventTimePiece Q E hE s t U =ᵐ[volume] fun r =>

eventTimePiece_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem eventTimePiece_coe (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (s t : ℝ)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    eventTimePiece Q E hE s t U =ᵐ[volume] fun r =>
      if r ∈ Ioc s t then columnEventMask Q E hE (U r) else 0 := by
  filter_upwards [(columnEventMask (I := I) (Z := Z) Q E hE).coeFn_compLpL (timeCut Q U s t),
    timeCut_coe Q U s t] with r hmap hcut
  rw [show eventTimePiece Q E hE s t U r = _ from hmap, hcut]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t <;> simp [Set.indicator, hr]

GridStoppingIndex.maskInput.exact_declaration:
def GridStoppingIndex.maskInput {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :

theorem GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_coe {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_coe {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    σ.maskInput U =ᵐ[volume] fun r => ∑ j : Fin n,
      if r ∈ Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1)) then
        columnEventMask Q (σ.active j) (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable j)) (U r) else 0 := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n =>

        (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) U),

      (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable j)) (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) U)]
    with r hsum hpiece
  rw [GridStoppingIndex.maskInput, hsum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hpiece j)

GridStoppingIndex.masked_toLp.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.masked_toLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (σ.coefficients A k).toLp =
      columnEventMask Q (σ.active k) (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k)) (A k).toLp
GridStoppingIndex.masked_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.masked_toLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) :
    (σ.coefficients A k).toLp =
      columnEventMask Q (σ.active k) (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k)) (A k).toLp := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [columnEventMask_apply]
  change ((σ.coefficients A k).square i).toLp _ = eventMask Q (σ.active k)
    (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k)) (((A k).square i).toLp _)
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [((σ.coefficients A k).square i).coeFn_toLp,
    ((A k).square i).coeFn_toLp,
    eventMask_coe Q (σ.active k) (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k))
      (((A k).square i).toLp _)] with ω hmask hA hE
  rw [hmask, hE]
  by_cases h : ω ∈ σ.active k <;> simp [GridStoppingIndex.coefficients, Set.indicator, h, hA]

compatible_cell.exact_header:
theorem compatible_cell {τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} (hυ : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc (υ k : ℝ) (υ (k + 1))) :
    r ∈ Ioc (τ (k / d) : ℝ) (τ (k / d + 1))
compatible_cell.exact_declaration:
theorem compatible_cell {τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} (hυ : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioc (υ k : ℝ) (υ (k + 1))) :
    r ∈ Ioc (τ (k / d) : ℝ) (τ (k / d + 1)) := by
  constructor
  · rw [← hgrid]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hυ (Nat.mul_div_le k d)) hr.1
  · rw [← hgrid]
    have hb : k < (k / d + 1) * d :=
      (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hd).mp (Nat.lt_succ_self (k / d))
    have hb' : k + 1 ≤ d * (k / d + 1) := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.succ_le_of_lt hb
    exact hr.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast hυ hb')

GridStoppingIndex.coefficientStep_mask.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.coefficientStep_mask {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (m : ℕ) (hm : m = d * n)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D υ) :
    coefficientStep Q D υ ((σ.refine υ hυ d hd hgrid m hm).coefficients A) m =
      σ.maskInput (coefficientStep Q D υ A m)
GridStoppingIndex.coefficientStep_mask.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.coefficientStep_mask {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (m : ℕ) (hm : m = d * n)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D υ) :
    coefficientStep Q D υ ((σ.refine υ hυ d hd hgrid m hm).coefficients A) m =
      σ.maskInput (coefficientStep Q D υ A m) := by
  let σ' := σ.refine υ hυ d hd hgrid m hm
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [TimeGridContinuity.grid_coe υ (fun k => (σ'.coefficients A k).toLp) m,
    TimeGridContinuity.grid_coe υ (fun k => (A k).toLp) m,
    σ.maskInput_coe (coefficientStep Q D υ A m)] with r hstop hA hmask
  change (coefficientStep Q D υ (σ'.coefficients A) m) r = _
  change (coefficientStep Q D υ (σ'.coefficients A) m) r = _ at hstop
  change (coefficientStep Q D υ A m) r = _ at hA
  rw [hstop, hmask]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc (υ 0 : ℝ) (υ m)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_interval υ hυ m r hr
    rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_eq υ hυ _ m k r hk]
    rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_eq υ hυ _ m k r hk] at hA
    have hj : k.val / d < n := by
      apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hd).mpr
      have hkbound : k.val < d * n := by rw [← hm]; exact k.isLt
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hkbound
    let j : Fin n := ⟨k / d, hj⟩
    have hcell : r ∈ Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1)) := compatible_cell hυ d hd hgrid k r hk
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · rw [ite_eq_left hcell, hA]
      rw [σ'.masked_toLp A k]
      have he : σ'.active k = σ.active j := by
        ext ω
        change k.val < d * σ.index ω ↔ k.val / d < σ.index ω
        simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hd).symm
      exact congrArg (fun C : ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q →L[ℝ]
        ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q => C (A k).toLp)
        (columnEventMask_congr Q _ _ _ _ he)

    · intro l _ hlj
      apply ite_eq_right
      intro hl
      exact hlj (Fin.ext (TimeGridContinuity.interval_unique τ hτ l j r hl hcell))
    · simp
  · rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_zero_outside υ hυ _ m r hr]
    rw [TimeGridContinuity.rawGrid_zero_outside υ hυ _ m r hr] at hA
    simp [hA]

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedMask_approximat.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedMask_approximations (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T),
      Tendsto (fun k => finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) (A k)) atTop
        (𝓝 (σ.maskInput U.val)) ∧
      ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => stoppedIntegralLp Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time (A k).1)
        ((dyadicGrids T).monotone (A k).1) (A k).2 ((dyadicGrids T).count (A k).1) t)
        atTop (𝓝 (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t))
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedMask_approximat.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedMask_approximations (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T),
      Tendsto (fun k => finiteStepInput Q D (dyadicGrids T) (A k)) atTop
        (𝓝 (σ.maskInput U.val)) ∧
      ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => stoppedIntegralLp Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time (A k).1)
        ((dyadicGrids T).monotone (A k).1) (A k).2 ((dyadicGrids T).count (A k).1) t)
        atTop (𝓝 (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t)) := by
  let G := dyadicGrids T
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G U
  choose B hB hBout using fun k =>
    finiteStep_refine_exists Q D G (A k) (max m (A k).1) (le_max_right _ _)
  let C : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G := fun k => ⟨max m (A k).1, B k⟩
  have hC : Tendsto (fun k => finiteStepInput Q D G (C k)) atTop (𝓝 U.val) := by
    convert hA using 1
    funext k
    exact hB k
  choose d hd hcount hgrid using fun k => G.compatible m (C k).1 (le_max_left _ _)
  let σ' k : GridStoppingIndex Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.count (C k).1) :=
    σ.refine (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1) (d k) (hd k) (hgrid k)
      (G.count (C k).1) (hcount k)
  let V : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G :=
    fun k => ⟨(C k).1, (σ' k).coefficients (C k).2⟩
  have hinput (k : ℕ) : finiteStepInput Q D G (V k) =
      σ.maskInput (finiteStepInput Q D G (C k)) :=
    σ.coefficientStep_mask (G.monotone m) (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1)
      (d k) (hd k) (hgrid k) (G.count (C k).1) (hcount k) (C k).2
  refine ⟨V, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hl := (σ.maskInput_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto).comp hC
    exact hl.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun k => (hinput k).symm))
  · intro t
    have hl := σ.select_tendsto
      (fun k j => stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1)
        (C k).2 (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j)))
      (fun j => closedIntegral Q D T U (min t (G.time m j)))
      (fun j => closedIntegral_stopped_tendsto Q D T U C hC (min t (G.time m j)))
    convert hl using 1
    · funext k
      apply Lp.ext
      filter_upwards [(stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D (G.time (V k).1) (G.monotone (V k).1)
          (V k).2 (G.count (V k).1) t).coeFn_toLp,
        σ.select_coe (fun j => stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1)
          (C k).2 (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j))),
        ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j : Fin (G.count m + 1) =>
          (stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1)
            (C k).2 (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j))).coeFn_toLp)]
        with ω hV hselect hj
      change (stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time (V k).1) (G.monotone (V k).1)
        (V k).2 (G.count (V k).1) t) ω = _
      simp only [stoppedIntegralLp] at hselect ⊢
      rw [hV, hselect, hj (σ.finIndex ω)]
      change FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time (C k).1)
        ((σ' k).coefficients (C k).2) (G.count (C k).1) t ω = _
      rw [(σ' k).stoppedGridSum (G.monotone (C k).1)]
      dsimp only [σ', GridStoppingIndex.refine]
      rw [hgrid k]
      rfl
    · rfl

theorem GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_raw {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ i,
      (σ.maskInput U r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>

GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_raw.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.maskInput_raw {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ i,
      (σ.maskInput U r).ofLp i =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>
        if r ∈ Ioc (τ 0 : ℝ) (τ n) ∧ r ≤ (τ (σ.index ω) : ℝ)
          then (U r).ofLp i ω else 0 := by
  filter_upwards [σ.maskInput_coe U] with r hmask
  intro i
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc (τ 0 : ℝ) (τ n)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := TimeGridContinuity.exists_interval τ hτ n r hr
    have heq : σ.maskInput U r = columnEventMask Q (σ.active j)
        (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable j)) (U r) := by
      rw [hmask, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · exact ite_eq_left hj
      · intro k _ hkj
        apply ite_eq_right
        intro hk
        exact hkj (Fin.ext (TimeGridContinuity.interval_unique τ hτ k j r hk hj))
      · simp
    rw [heq, columnEventMask_apply]
    filter_upwards [eventMask_coe Q (σ.active j)
      (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable j)) ((U r).ofLp i)] with ω hω
    rw [hω]
    by_cases hstop : (j : ℕ) < σ.index ω
    · have hle : r ≤ (τ (σ.index ω) : ℝ) :=
        hj.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hstop))
      simp [Set.indicator, GridStoppingIndex.active, hstop, hr, hle]
    · have hlt : (τ (σ.index ω) : ℝ) < r :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hτ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hstop)) hj.1
      simp [Set.indicator, GridStoppingIndex.active, hstop, hr, not_le_of_gt hlt]
  · have heq : σ.maskInput U r = 0 := by
      rw [hmask]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j _
      apply ite_eq_right
      intro hj
      apply hr
      exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hτ (Nat.zero_le j)) hj.1,
        hj.2.trans (by exact_mod_cast hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.isLt))⟩
    rw [heq]
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero Z 2 Q] with ω hω
    simpa only [hr, false_and, ite_false, PiLp.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hω

theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe_version (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hM : ∀ s, M s =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U s) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => M
      (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe_ve.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe_version (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hM : ∀ s, M s =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U s) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => M
      (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω := by
  filter_upwards [σ.select_coe (fun j => closedIntegral Q D T U
      (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m j))),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j : Fin ((dyadicGrids T).count m + 1) =>
      hM (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m j)))] with ω hselect hj
  exact hselect.trans (hj (σ.finIndex ω)).symm

theorem boundedStoppedIntegral_realizes_of_continuous (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hM : ∀ s, M s =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U s)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => M (min t (τ ω)) ω
boundedStoppedIntegral_realizes_of_conti.exact_declaration:
theorem boundedStoppedIntegral_realizes_of_continuous (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z) (hM : ∀ s, M s =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U s)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => M (min t (τ ω)) ω := by
  let σ m := dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m
  have hl := dyadicStoppedIntegral_tendsto Q D T τ hτ hstop U t
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hAE⟩ := (tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_Lp hl).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  have hfinite (m : ℕ) : (σ m).stoppedIntegral T m U t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => M (min t (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω)) ω :=
    (σ m).stoppedIntegral_coe_version T m U M hM t
  filter_upwards [hAE, hcont, ae_all_iff.mpr hfinite] with ω hω hc hf
  have ht : Tendsto (fun m => min t (dyadicStop T τ hτ m ω)) atTop (𝓝 (min t (τ ω))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.min (dyadicStop_tendsto T τ hτ ω)
  have hm := (hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hm' : Tendsto (fun n => (σ (φ n)).stoppedIntegral T (φ n) U t ω)
      atTop (𝓝 (M (min t (τ ω)) ω)) :=
    hm.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hf (φ n)).symm))
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hω hm'

theorem continuous_versions_indistinguishable (M N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hM : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω))
    (hN : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => N t ω))
    (hMN : ∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] N t) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, M t ω = N t ω
continuous_versions_indistinguishable.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_versions_indistinguishable (M N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z)
    (hM : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω))
    (hN : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => N t ω))
    (hMN : ∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] N t) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, M t ω = N t ω := by
  filter_upwards [hM, hN, ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => hMN (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq ℝ≥0 n))] with ω hm hn he
  have hEq := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq ℝ≥0).equalizer hm hn (funext he)

theorem exists_bounded_stopped_martingale (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∃ M N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, Martingale M D.filtration Q ∧ Martingale N D.filtration Q ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => N t ω)) ∧
      (∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U t) ∧
      (∀ t, N t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, N t ω = M (min t (τ ω)) ω)
exists_bounded_stopped_martingale.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_bounded_stopped_martingale (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))
    (hB : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ i, Continuous (fun t => D.process i t ω)) :
    ∃ M N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, Martingale M D.filtration Q ∧ Martingale N D.filtration Q ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => M t ω)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, Continuous (fun t => N t ω)) ∧
      (∀ t, M t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T U t) ∧
      (∀ t, N t =ᵐ[Q] closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t) ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t, N t ω = M (min t (τ ω)) ω) := by
  obtain ⟨M, hMM, hMC, hM⟩ := exists_continuous_martingale_version Q D T U hB
  obtain ⟨N, hNM, hNC, hN⟩ := exists_continuous_martingale_version Q D T
    (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) hB
  refine ⟨M, N, hMM, hNM, hMC, hNC, hM, hN, ?_⟩
  apply continuous_versions_indistinguishable Q N (fun t ω => M (min t (τ ω)) ω) hNC
  · exact hMC.mono (fun ω hc => hc.comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const))
  · intro t
    exact (hN t).trans (boundedStoppedIntegral_realizes_of_continuous Q D T τ hτ hstop U M hM hMC t)

lp_tendsto_dominated_square.exact_header:
theorem lp_tendsto_dominated_square {A H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (μ : Measure A) (U : ℕ → Lp H 2 μ) (V : Lp H 2 μ) (B : A → ℝ)
    (hB : Integrable B μ) (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ‖U n a - V a‖ ^ 2 ≤ B a)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => U n a) atTop (𝓝 (V a))) :
    Tendsto U atTop (𝓝 V)
lp_tendsto_dominated_square.exact_declaration:
theorem lp_tendsto_dominated_square {A H : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (μ : Measure A) (U : ℕ → Lp H 2 μ) (V : Lp H 2 μ) (B : A → ℝ)
    (hB : Integrable B μ) (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ‖U n a - V a‖ ^ 2 ≤ B a)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => U n a) atTop (𝓝 (V a))) :
    Tendsto U atTop (𝓝 V) := by
  have hb (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ‖‖(U n - V) a‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ B a := by
    filter_upwards [hbound n, Lp.coeFn_sub (U n) V] with a hba hsub
    rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact hba
  have hl : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => ‖(U n - V) a‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hlim, ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => Lp.coeFn_sub (U n) V)] with a hla hsub
    have he := (hla.sub_const (V a)).norm.pow 2
    have he' : Tendsto (fun n => ‖U n a - V a‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] using he
    exact he'.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by
      change ‖U n a - V a‖ ^ 2 = ‖(U n - V) a‖ ^ 2
      rw [hsub n]
      rfl))
  have hDCT := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence B
    (fun n => (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (U n - V)).norm.pow 2) hB hb hl
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun n => ‖U n - V‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral, Pi.pow_apply, integral_zero] using hDCT
  have hn := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hsq
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero] using hn

theorem eventMask_tendsto (E : ℕ → Set Ω) (hE : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (E n))
    (F : Set Ω) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (U : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hEF : ∀ ω, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (ω ∈ E n ↔ ω ∈ F)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => eventMask Q (E n) (hE n) U) atTop (𝓝 (eventMask Q F hF U))
eventMask_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem eventMask_tendsto (E : ℕ → Set Ω) (hE : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (E n))
    (F : Set Ω) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (U : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hEF : ∀ ω, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (ω ∈ E n ↔ ω ∈ F)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => eventMask Q (E n) (hE n) U) atTop (𝓝 (eventMask Q F hF U)) := by
  apply lp_tendsto_dominated_square Q _ _ (fun ω => 4 * ‖U ω‖ ^ 2)
  · exact ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U)).mp (Lp.memLp U)).const_mul 4
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [eventMask_coe Q (E n) (hE n) U, eventMask_coe Q F hF U] with ω hn hf
    rw [hn, hf]
    by_cases he : ω ∈ E n <;> by_cases hf' : ω ∈ F <;>
      simp [Set.indicator, he, hf', norm_neg, sq_nonneg] <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖U ω‖]
  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => eventMask_coe Q (E n) (hE n) U),
      eventMask_coe Q F hF U] with ω hn hf
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [hEF ω] with n he
    rw [hn n, hf]
    by_cases h : ω ∈ F <;> simp [Set.indicator, h, he]

    Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).maskInput U) atTop
      (𝓝 (randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U))
dyadicStoppedInput_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStoppedInput_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : Lp (ColumnHilbert (I := I) (Z := Z) Q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).maskInput U) atTop
      (𝓝 (randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U)) := by
  let σ m := dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m
  have heq (m : ℕ) : (σ m).maskInput U =ᵐ[volume]
      randomStopCurve Q T (dyadicStop T τ hτ m) (dyadicStop_measurable Q D T τ hτ hstop m) U :=
    (σ m).maskInput_eq_randomCurve ((dyadicGrids T).monotone m) T
      (by simp [GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids]) (dyadic_time_last T m) U
  apply lp_tendsto_dominated_square volume _ _ (fun r => 4 * ‖U r‖ ^ 2)
  · exact ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable U)).mp (Lp.memLp U)).const_mul 4
  · intro m
    filter_upwards [heq m, randomStoppedInput_coe Q D T τ hτ hstop U] with r hm hv
    rw [hm, hv]
    have hb := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
      (randomStopCurve_norm Q T (dyadicStop T τ hτ m) (dyadicStop_measurable Q D T τ hτ hstop m) U r)
      (randomStopCurve_norm Q T τ (stoppingTime_measurable Q D τ hstop) U r))
    have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hb 2
    nlinarith
  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr heq, randomStoppedInput_coe Q D T τ hτ hstop U]
      with r hm hv
    rw [hv]
    exact (randomStopCurve_dyadic_tendsto Q D T τ hτ hstop U r).congr'
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun m => (hm m).symm))

randomStoppedInput_mem_closed.exact_header:
theorem randomStoppedInput_mem_closed (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val ∈
      closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)))
randomStoppedInput_mem_closed.exact_declaration:
theorem randomStoppedInput_mem_closed (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val ∈
      closure (Set.range (finiteStepInput (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T))) := by
  apply isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (dyadicStoppedInput_tendsto Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val)
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun m =>
    (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).maskInput_mem_closed T m U)

boundedStoppedDomain.exact_header:
def boundedStoppedDomain (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)
boundedStoppedDomain.exact_declaration:
def boundedStoppedDomain (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T) :=
  ⟨randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val, randomStoppedInput_mem_closed Q D T τ hτ hstop U⟩

closedIntegral_lipschitz.exact_header:
theorem closedIntegral_lipschitz (T t : ℝ≥0) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T) => closedIntegral Q D T U t)
closedIntegral_lipschitz.exact_declaration:
theorem closedIntegral_lipschitz (T t : ℝ≥0) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (fun U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T) => closedIntegral Q D T U t) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro U V
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
  rw [closedIntegral, closedIntegral, (closedStepIntegral_isometry Q D (dyadicGrids T)).dist_eq]
  change dist (timeCut Q U.val 0 t) (timeCut Q V.val 0 t) ≤ dist U.val V.val
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using
    (timeCut_lipschitz (I := I) (Z := Z) Q 0 t).dist_le_mul U.val V.val

dyadicStoppedIntegral_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem dyadicStoppedIntegral_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).stoppedIntegral T m U t)
      atTop (𝓝 (closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t))
dyadicStoppedIntegral_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadicStoppedIntegral_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (τ : Ω → ℝ≥0)
    (hτ : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) (hstop : ∀ t, MeasurableSet[D.filtration t] {ω | τ ω ≤ t})
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).stoppedIntegral T m U t)
      atTop (𝓝 (closedIntegral Q D T (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U) t)) := by
  have hl := dyadicStoppedInput_tendsto Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val
  have hd : Tendsto (fun m => (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).stoppedDomain T m U)
      atTop (𝓝 (boundedStoppedDomain Q D T τ hτ hstop U)) := by
    apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hl ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    change dist ((dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).maskInput U.val)
      (randomStoppedInput Q D T τ hτ hstop U.val) < ε
    exact hN m hm
  have he := ((closedIntegral_lipschitz Q D T t).continuous.tendsto _).comp hd
  exact he.congr' (Eventually.of_forall (fun m =>
    (dyadicStoppingIndex Q D T τ hτ hstop m).closedIntegral_stoppedDomain T m U t))
