eventMaskValue.exact_header: def eventMaskValue (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) : Lp Z 2 Q
eventMaskValue.exact_declaration:
def eventMaskValue (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  ((Lp.memLp U).indicator hE).toLp (E.indicator U)

eventMaskValue_coe.exact_header:
theorem eventMaskValue_coe (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    eventMaskValue Q E hE U =ᵐ[Q] E.indicator U
eventMaskValue_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem eventMaskValue_coe (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    eventMaskValue Q E hE U =ᵐ[Q] E.indicator U :=
  ((Lp.memLp U).indicator hE).coeFn_toLp

eventMaskValue_norm.exact_header:
theorem eventMaskValue_norm (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ‖eventMaskValue Q E hE U‖ ≤ ‖U‖
eventMaskValue_norm.exact_declaration:
theorem eventMaskValue_norm (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ‖eventMaskValue Q E hE U‖ ≤ ‖U‖ := by
  apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
  filter_upwards [eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE U] with ω hω
  rw [hω]
  by_cases h : ω ∈ E
  · simp [Set.indicator, h]
  · simp [Set.indicator, h]

eventMask.exact_header: def eventMask (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) : Lp Z 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp Z 2 Q
eventMask.exact_declaration:
def eventMask (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) : Lp Z 2 Q →L[ℝ] Lp Z 2 Q :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := eventMaskValue Q E hE
      map_add' := by
        intro U V
        apply Lp.ext
        filter_upwards [eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE (U + V),
          eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE U, eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE V,
          Lp.coeFn_add U V,
          Lp.coeFn_add (eventMaskValue Q E hE U) (eventMaskValue Q E hE V)]
          with ω huv hu hv hsum hsum'
        simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hsum hsum'
        rw [hsum', huv, hu, hv]
        by_cases h : ω ∈ E
        · simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem h] using hsum
        · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem h, add_zero]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c U
        apply Lp.ext
        filter_upwards [eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE (c • U),
          eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE U, Lp.coeFn_smul c U,
          Lp.coeFn_smul c (eventMaskValue Q E hE U)] with ω hc hu hsm hsm'
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
        simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at hsm hsm'
        rw [hsm', hc, hu]
        by_cases h : ω ∈ E <;> simp [Set.indicator, h, hsm] }
    1 (fun U => by simpa using eventMaskValue_norm Q E hE U)

eventMask_coe.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem eventMask_coe (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    eventMask Q E hE U =ᵐ[Q] E.indicator U
eventMask_coe.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem eventMask_coe (E : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (U : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    eventMask Q E hE U =ᵐ[Q] E.indicator U := eventMaskValue_coe Q E hE U

GridStoppingIndex.exact_declaration:
structure GridStoppingIndex (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) where
  index : Ω → ℕ
  bound : ∀ ω, index ω ≤ n
  stopping : ∀ k, MeasurableSet[D.filtration (τ k)] {ω | index ω ≤ k}

GridStoppingIndex.active.exact_header:
def GridStoppingIndex.active {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (k : ℕ) : Set Ω
GridStoppingIndex.active.exact_declaration:
def GridStoppingIndex.active {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (k : ℕ) : Set Ω := {ω | k < σ.index ω}

GridStoppingIndex.active_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.active_measurable {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (k : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet[D.filtration (τ k)] (σ.active k) := by
  convert (σ.stopping k).compl using 1
  ext ω
  simp [GridStoppingIndex.active]

GridStoppingIndex.coefficients.exact_declaration:
def GridStoppingIndex.coefficients {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ := fun k =>
  { value := fun i => (σ.active k).indicator ((A k).value i)
    adapted := fun i => ((A k).adapted i).indicator (σ.active_measurable k)
    square := fun i => ((A k).square i).indicator
      (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k)) }

sum_prefix.exact_header:
theorem sum_prefix {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (f : ℕ → E) (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    (∑ k : Fin n, if (k : ℕ) < m then f k else 0) = ∑ k : Fin m, f k
sum_prefix.exact_declaration:
theorem sum_prefix {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (f : ℕ → E) (n m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    (∑ k : Fin n, if (k : ℕ) < m then f k else 0) = ∑ k : Fin m, f k := by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => have : m = 0 := by omega
            subst m
            simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hmn : m ≤ n
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬ n < m), add_zero]
      exact ih m hmn
    · have hme : m = n + 1 := by omega
      subst m
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ite_eq_left k.isLt

GridStoppingIndex.noiseStep_stopped.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.noiseStep_stopped {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

    noiseStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (σ.coefficients A k) ω =

GridStoppingIndex.noiseStep_stopped.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.noiseStep_stopped {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    noiseStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (σ.coefficients A k) ω =
      if k < σ.index ω then noiseStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k) ω else 0 := by
  by_cases h : k < σ.index ω
  · simp [FilteredBrownian.noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, GridStoppingIndex.coefficients,
      GridStoppingIndex.active, Set.indicator, h]
  · simp [FilteredBrownian.noiseStep, PredictableIsometry.stepSum, GridStoppingIndex.coefficients,
      GridStoppingIndex.active, Set.indicator, h]

GridStoppingIndex.gridSum_stopped.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.gridSum_stopped {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (ω : Ω) :
    gridSum Q D τ (σ.coefficients A) n ω = gridSum Q D τ A (σ.index ω) ω := by
  simp only [FilteredBrownian.gridSum, σ.noiseStep_stopped A]
  exact sum_prefix (fun k : ℕ => FilteredBrownian.noiseStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k) ω)
    n (σ.index ω) (σ.bound ω)

GridStoppingIndex.stopped_isometry.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stopped_isometry {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum Q D τ A (σ.index ω) ω,
      W (gridSum Q D τ A (σ.index ω) ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * ∑ i,
        ∫ ω in σ.active k, ⟪(A k).value i ω, W ((A k).value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q
GridStoppingIndex.stopped_isometry.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stopped_isometry {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (W : Z →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hW : ∀ z w, ⟪z, W w⟫_ℝ = ⟪W z, w⟫_ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, ⟪gridSum Q D τ A (σ.index ω) ω,
      W (gridSum Q D τ A (σ.index ω) ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q) =
      ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * ∑ i,
        ∫ ω in σ.active k, ⟪(A k).value i ω, W ((A k).value i ω)⟫_ℝ ∂Q := by
  have he := gridSum_isometry Q D W hW τ hτ (σ.coefficients A) n
  simp_rw [σ.gridSum_stopped A] at he
  rw [he]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← integral_indicator (D.filtration.le _ _ (σ.active_measurable k))]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  apply ae_of_all
  intro ω
  by_cases h : ω ∈ σ.active k <;>
    simp [GridStoppingIndex.coefficients, Set.indicator, h]

theorem GridStoppingIndex.index_measurable {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

GridStoppingIndex.index_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.index_measurable {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedStep.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedStep {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    FilteredBrownian.stoppedStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (σ.coefficients A k) t ω =
      FilteredBrownian.stoppedStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k)
        (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedStep.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedStep {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    FilteredBrownian.stoppedStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (σ.coefficients A k) t ω =
      FilteredBrownian.stoppedStep Q D (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k)
        (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω := by
  rw [stoppedStep_clamp Q D _ _ t (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)),
    stoppedStep_clamp Q D _ _ (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) (hτ (Nat.le_succ k))]
  by_cases hk : k < σ.index ω
  · have ha := hτ (Nat.le_of_lt hk)
    have hb := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)
    simp [GridStoppingIndex.coefficients, GridStoppingIndex.active, Set.indicator, hk,
      min_assoc, min_eq_right ha, min_eq_right hb]
  · have ha := hτ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk)
    have hb := ha.trans (hτ (Nat.le_succ k))
    simp [GridStoppingIndex.coefficients, GridStoppingIndex.active, Set.indicator, hk,
      min_assoc, min_eq_left ha, min_eq_left hb]

theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ (σ.coefficients A) n t ω =
      FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω) :
    FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ (σ.coefficients A) n t ω =
      FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω := by
  simp only [FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum, σ.stoppedStep hτ A]

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum_marting.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum_martingale {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Martingale (fun t ω => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n
      (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω) D.filtration Q
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum_marting.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedGridSum_martingale {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (hτ : Monotone τ)
    (A : Coefficients (Z := Z) Q D τ) :
    Martingale (fun t ω => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n
      (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω) D.filtration Q := by
  have he : (fun t ω => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ A n
      (min t (τ (σ.index ω))) ω) =
      FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D τ (σ.coefficients A) n := by
    funext t ω
    exact (σ.stoppedGridSum hτ A t ω).symm
  rw [he]
  exact FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum_martingale Q D τ hτ (σ.coefficients A) n

GridStoppingIndex.finIndex.exact_header:
def GridStoppingIndex.finIndex {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (ω : Ω) : Fin (n + 1)

GridStoppingIndex.fiber_measurable.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.fiber_measurable {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}

GridStoppingIndex.select.exact_header:
def GridStoppingIndex.select {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (U : Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q) : Lp Z 2 Q

GridStoppingIndex.select_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_coe {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (U : Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q) :
    σ.select U =ᵐ[Q] fun ω => U (σ.finIndex ω) ω := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => eventMask Q {ω | σ.index ω = (j : ℕ)} (σ.fiber_measurable j) (U j)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => eventMask_coe Q {ω | σ.index ω = (j : ℕ)} (σ.fiber_measurable j) (U j))]
    with ω hsum hmask
  change (σ.select U) ω = _
  rw [GridStoppingIndex.select, hsum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [hmask]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (σ.finIndex ω)]
  · simp [Set.indicator, GridStoppingIndex.finIndex]
  · intro j _ hj
    apply Set.indicator_of_notMem
    intro he
    exact hj (Fin.ext he.symm)
  · simp

GridStoppingIndex.select_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_tendsto {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (U : ℕ → Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (V : Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hU : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun k => U k j) atTop (𝓝 (V j))) :
    Tendsto (fun k => σ.select (U k)) atTop (𝓝 (σ.select V))
GridStoppingIndex.select_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_tendsto {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (U : ℕ → Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (V : Fin (n + 1) → Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hU : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun k => U k j) atTop (𝓝 (V j))) :
    Tendsto (fun k => σ.select (U k)) atTop (𝓝 (σ.select V)) := by
  unfold GridStoppingIndex.select
  apply tendsto_finsetSum
  intro j _
  exact ((eventMask Q {ω | σ.index ω = j} (σ.fiber_measurable j)).continuous.tendsto _).comp (hU j)

GridStoppingIndex.select_memLp.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_memLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (f : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → Z)
    (hf : ∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 Q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => f (σ.finIndex ω) ω) 2 Q
GridStoppingIndex.select_memLp.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_memLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (f : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → Z)
    (hf : ∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 Q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => f (σ.finIndex ω) ω) 2 Q := by
  apply (Lp.memLp (σ.select (fun j => (hf j).toLp (f j)))).ae_eq
  filter_upwards [σ.select_coe (fun j => (hf j).toLp (f j)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j => (hf j).coeFn_toLp)] with ω hselect hj
  exact hselect.trans (hj (σ.finIndex ω))

GridStoppingIndex.select_toLp.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_toLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (f : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → Z)
    (hf : ∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 Q) :
    (σ.select_memLp f hf).toLp (fun ω => f (σ.finIndex ω) ω) =
      σ.select (fun j => (hf j).toLp (f j))
GridStoppingIndex.select_toLp.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.select_toLp {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (f : Fin (n + 1) → Ω → Z)
    (hf : ∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 Q) :
    (σ.select_memLp f hf).toLp (fun ω => f (σ.finIndex ω) ω) =
      σ.select (fun j => (hf j).toLp (f j)) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(σ.select_memLp f hf).coeFn_toLp,
    σ.select_coe (fun j => (hf j).toLp (f j)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j => (hf j).coeFn_toLp)] with ω hfun hselect hj
  rw [hfun, hselect, hj (σ.finIndex ω)]

GridStoppingIndex.refine.exact_header:
def GridStoppingIndex.refine {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m = d * n) : GridStoppingIndex Q D υ m
GridStoppingIndex.refine.exact_declaration:
def GridStoppingIndex.refine {τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {n : ℕ}
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D τ n) (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hgrid : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m = d * n) : GridStoppingIndex Q D υ m where
  index ω := d * σ.index ω
  bound ω := by rw [hm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (σ.bound ω)
  stopping k := by
    have htime : τ (k / d) ≤ υ k := by
      rw [← hgrid]
      exact hυ (Nat.mul_div_le k d)
    have he : {ω | d * σ.index ω ≤ k} = {ω | σ.index ω ≤ k / d} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd, Nat.mul_comm]
    rw [he]
    exact D.filtration.mono htime _ (σ.stopping (k / d))

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral.exact_declaration:
def GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) : Lp Z 2 Q :=
  σ.select (fun j => closedIntegral Q D T U (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m j)))

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_approx.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_approximations (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, (∀ k, Martingale (F k) D.filtration Q) ∧
      ∃ hF : ∀ k t, MemLp (F k t) 2 Q,
        ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => (hF k t).toLp (F k t)) atTop
          (𝓝 (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t))
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_approx.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_approximations (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    ∃ F : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z, (∀ k, Martingale (F k) D.filtration Q) ∧
      ∃ hF : ∀ k t, MemLp (F k t) 2 Q,
        ∀ t, Tendsto (fun k => (hF k t).toLp (F k t)) atTop
          (𝓝 (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t)) := by
  let G := dyadicGrids T
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_finiteStep_approximation Q D G U
  choose B hB hBout using fun k =>
    finiteStep_refine_exists Q D G (A k) (max m (A k).1) (le_max_right _ _)
  let C : ℕ → FiniteStepData (Z := Z) Q D G :=
    fun k => ⟨max m (A k).1, B k⟩
  have hC : Tendsto (fun k => finiteStepInput Q D G (C k)) atTop (𝓝 U.val) := by
    convert hA using 1
    funext k
    exact hB k
  choose d hd hcount hgrid using fun k => G.compatible m (C k).1 (le_max_left _ _)
  let σ' k : GridStoppingIndex Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.count (C k).1) :=
    σ.refine (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1) (d k) (hd k) (hgrid k)
      (G.count (C k).1) (hcount k)
  let F : ℕ → ℝ≥0 → Ω → Z := fun k t ω =>
    FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time (C k).1) (C k).2 (G.count (C k).1)
      (min t (G.time m (σ.index ω))) ω
  have hFM : ∀ k, Martingale (F k) D.filtration Q := by
    intro k
    have he : F k = (fun t ω => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time (C k).1) (C k).2
        (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time (C k).1 ((σ' k).index ω))) ω) := by
      funext t ω
      dsimp only [F, σ', GridStoppingIndex.refine]
      rw [hgrid k]
    rw [he]
    exact (σ' k).stoppedGridSum_martingale (G.monotone (C k).1) (C k).2
  have hFM2 : ∀ k t, MemLp (F k t) 2 Q := by
    intro k t
    exact σ.select_memLp (fun j => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time (C k).1) (C k).2
      (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j)))
      (fun j => stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D _ (G.monotone (C k).1) _ _ _)
  refine ⟨F, hFM, hFM2, ?_⟩
  intro t
  have hl := σ.select_tendsto
    (fun k j => stoppedIntegralLp Q D (G.time (C k).1) (G.monotone (C k).1)
      (C k).2 (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j)))
    (fun j => closedIntegral Q D T U (min t (G.time m j)))
    (fun j => closedIntegral_stopped_tendsto Q D T U C hC (min t (G.time m j)))
  convert hl using 1
  funext k
  exact σ.select_toLp
    (fun j => FilteredBrownian.stoppedGridSum Q D (G.time (C k).1) (C k).2
      (G.count (C k).1) (min t (G.time m j)))
    (fun j => stoppedGridSum_memLp Q D _ (G.monotone (C k).1) _ _ _)
  rfl

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_martin.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_martingale (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    Martingale (MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U))
      D.filtration Q
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_martin.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_martingale (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) :
    Martingale (MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U))
      D.filtration Q := by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, h2, hlim⟩ := σ.stoppedIntegral_approximations T m U
  exact MartingaleL2Limit.martingale_representative Q D.filtration F hF h2 _ hlim

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_repres.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_representative_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_repres.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_representative_ae (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U) t =ᵐ[Q]
      σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t := by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, h2, hlim⟩ := σ.stoppedIntegral_approximations T m U
  exact MartingaleL2Limit.representative_ae Q D.filtration F hF h2 _ hlim t

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>
      MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (closedIntegral Q D T U)
        (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    σ.stoppedIntegral T m U t =ᵐ[Q] fun ω =>
      MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (closedIntegral Q D T U)
        (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω := by
  filter_upwards [σ.select_coe (fun j => closedIntegral Q D T U
      (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m j))),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j : Fin ((dyadicGrids T).count m + 1) =>
      closedIntegral_representative_ae Q D T U (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m j)))]
    with ω hselect hj
  exact hselect.trans (hj (σ.finIndex ω)).symm

GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_realiz.exact_header:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_realizes (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U) t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (closedIntegral Q D T U)
        (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω
GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_realiz.exact_declaration:
theorem GridStoppingIndex.stoppedIntegral_realizes (T : ℝ≥0) (m : ℕ)
    (σ : GridStoppingIndex Q D ((dyadicGrids T).time m) ((dyadicGrids T).count m))
    (U : ClosedStepDomain (Z := Z) Q D (dyadicGrids T)) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (σ.stoppedIntegral T m U) t =ᵐ[Q]
      fun ω => MartingaleL2Limit.representative Q D.filtration (closedIntegral Q D T U)
        (min t ((dyadicGrids T).time m (σ.index ω))) ω :=
  (σ.stoppedIntegral_representative_ae T m U t).trans (σ.stoppedIntegral_coe T m U t)

/-- Arbitrary finite observations are sorted internally, giving the same

le_running.exact_header:
theorem le_running (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) (ω : Ω) :
    f k ω ≤ running f n ω
le_running.exact_declaration:
theorem le_running (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) (ω : Ω) :
    f k ω ≤ running f n ω := by
  exact (le_max_right (running f k ω) (f k ω)).trans
    (running_mono f ω (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk))

running_le.exact_header:
theorem running_le (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ω : Ω) (h : ∀ k < n, f k ω ≤ C) : running f n ω ≤ C
running_le.exact_declaration:
theorem running_le (f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ω : Ω) (h : ∀ k < n, f k ω ≤ C) : running f n ω ≤ C := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hC
  | succ n ih => exact max_le (ih (fun k hk => h k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))) (h n (Nat.lt_succ_self _))

finite_family_square.exact_header:
theorem finite_family_square (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ k, τ k ≤ T) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, running (fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖) n ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q
finite_family_square.exact_declaration:
theorem finite_family_square (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ k, τ k ≤ T) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, running (fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖) n ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤
      4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q := by
  classical
  let s := (Finset.range n).image τ
  let σ : ℕ → ι := fun k => if hk : k < s.card then s.orderEmbOfFin rfl ⟨k, hk⟩ else T
  have hσ : Monotone σ := by
    intro i j hij
    dsimp [σ]
    split_ifs with hi hj
    · exact (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).monotone hij
    · obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (s.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl ⟨i, hi⟩)
      rw [← hk]
      exact hτ k
    · omega
    · rfl
  have hend : σ s.card = T := by simp [σ]
  have hb := finite_grid Q F X hX h2 σ hσ s.card
  rw [hend] at hb
  apply le_trans _ hb
  have hsq (a : ℕ → ι) (k : ℕ) :
      Integrable (fun ω => running (fun j ω => ‖X (a j) ω‖) k ω ^ 2) Q := by
    have hi := running_memLp Q (fun j ω => ‖X (a j) ω‖) (fun j => (h2 (a j)).norm) k
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hi.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hi
  apply integral_mono (hsq τ n) (hsq σ s.card)
  intro ω
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (running_nonneg _ _ _) _ 2
  apply running_le _ n _ (running_nonneg _ _ _) ω
  intro k hk
  have hmem : τ k ∈ s := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hk, rfl⟩
  have hrange : τ k ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact hmem
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hrange
  have he : σ j.val = τ k := by simp only [σ, dif_pos j.isLt, hj]
  simpa only [he] using le_running (fun k ω => ‖X (σ k) ω‖) s.card j.val j.isLt ω

exists_countable_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_countable_radius (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ k, τ k ≤ T) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ k, ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ≤ C ω
exists_countable_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_countable_radius (τ : ℕ → ι) (T : ι) (hτ : ∀ k, τ k ≤ T) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ k, ‖X (τ k) ω‖ ≤ C ω := by
  let f := fun k ω => ‖X (τ k) ω‖
  have hf (k : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable (f k) :=
    ((hX.stronglyAdapted (τ k)).mono (F.le _)).norm
  have hu (n : ℕ) : Measurable (running f n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact measurable_const
    | succ n ih => exact ih.max (hf n).measurable
  have hR : 0 ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hC2, hCB, hCu⟩ := MonotoneSquareRadius.exists_radius Q (running f)
    hu (running_memLp Q f (fun k => (h2 (τ k)).norm)) (running_nonneg f)
    (running_mono f) _ hR (finite_family_square Q F X hX h2 τ T hτ)
  refine ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hC2, hCB, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hCu] with ω hω k
  exact (le_running f (k + 1) k (Nat.lt_succ_self _) ω).trans (hω (k + 1))

exists_continuous_radius.exact_header:
theorem exists_continuous_radius [TopologicalSpace ι] [SecondCountableTopology ι]
    (s : Set ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (T : ι) (hsT : ∀ t ∈ s, t ≤ T)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => X t ω) s) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ s, ‖X t ω‖ ≤ C ω
exists_continuous_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_continuous_radius [TopologicalSpace ι] [SecondCountableTopology ι]
    (s : Set ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (T : ι) (hsT : ∀ t ∈ s, t ≤ T)
    (hc : ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ContinuousOn (fun t => X t ω) s) :
    ∃ C : Ω → ℝ, Measurable C ∧ (∀ ω, 0 ≤ C ω) ∧ MemLp C 2 Q ∧
      (∫ ω, C ω ^ 2 ∂Q) ≤ 4 * ∫ ω, ‖X T ω‖ ^ 2 ∂Q ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂Q, ∀ t ∈ s, ‖X t ω‖ ≤ C ω := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty s := hs.to_subtype
  let τ := TopologicalSpace.denseSeq s
  obtain ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hC2, hCB, hCτ⟩ := exists_countable_radius Q F X hX h2
    (fun k => (τ k).val) T (fun k => hsT _ (τ k).property)
  refine ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hC2, hCB, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hc, hCτ] with ω hω hτ t ht
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : s => ‖X t.val ω‖) :=
    (continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hω).norm
  have hclosed : IsClosed {t : s | ‖X t.val ω‖ ≤ C ω} := isClosed_le hcont continuous_const
  have hr : Set.range τ ⊆ {t : s | ‖X t.val ω‖ ≤ C ω} := by
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact hτ k
  have hd : closure (Set.range τ) = Set.univ := (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq s).closure_range
  exact hclosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr hr (by rw [hd]; exact Set.mem_univ (⟨t, ht⟩ : s))

PBGSO/TargetBias.lean.scope_note: Assume positive gradient monotonicity m, a stationary original gradient at star, a spatially Lipschitz observation, the original gradient expectation identity, zero surrogate mean observation and an actual coupling radius epsilon. The code does not derive epsilon for the Moreau model or repair the improper TV prior.
PBGSO/TargetBias.lean.shared_context:
import PBGSO.GeneralProcess

/-! # Bias caused by changing the sampler target

The hybrid HOL method observes the original force while sampling a smoothed
law. It need not have the original objective's critical point. Strong
monotonicity of the original gradient and an actual coupling of the original
and surrogate sampler laws give the explicit bias bound below. No smoothing
coupling bound or validity of the manuscript's TV prior is silently assumed.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace NNReal
namespace PBGSO

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

/-- A residual gradient bounds distance to a strongly monotone critical point. -/

section CoupledTargets
variable {Ω Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
  [CompleteSpace H]
  (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]

/-- Actual coupled sampler variables control the difference between their
Bochner force expectations. Independence is neither needed nor assumed. -/

/-- Explicit hybrid-target bias. `X` represents the original target at `a`,
`Y` its surrogate. The original gradient identity and surrogate stationarity
are explicit, and the true objective's gradient must be strongly monotone.
Any separately proved coupling radius epsilon gives bias at most L epsilon/m. -/

end CoupledTargets
end PBGSO

critical_point_residual_bound.exact_header:
theorem critical_point_residual_bound (g : H → H) (m δ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a star : H) (hstar : g star = 0)
    (hmono : m * ‖a - star‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪a - star, g a - g star⟫)
    (hresidual : ‖g a‖ ≤ δ) : ‖a - star‖ ≤ δ / m
critical_point_residual_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem critical_point_residual_bound (g : H → H) (m δ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a star : H) (hstar : g star = 0)
    (hmono : m * ‖a - star‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪a - star, g a - g star⟫)
    (hresidual : ‖g a‖ ≤ δ) : ‖a - star‖ ≤ δ / m := by
  have hinner := real_inner_le_norm (a - star) (g a)
  rw [hstar, sub_zero] at hmono
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hresidual (norm_nonneg (a - star))
  by_cases ha : ‖a - star‖ = 0
  · rw [ha]
    have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := (norm_nonneg (g a)).trans hresidual
    exact div_nonneg hδ hm.le
  · have hp : 0 < ‖a - star‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm ha)
    have hprod : m * ‖a - star‖ ≤ δ := by nlinarith
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr (by nlinarith)

coupled_observation_expectation_bound.exact_header:
theorem coupled_observation_expectation_bound (f : Z → H) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ‖(∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂Q) - (∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂Q)‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖X - Y‖
coupled_observation_expectation_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem coupled_observation_expectation_bound (f : Z → H) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q) :
    ‖(∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂Q) - (∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂Q)‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ‖X - Y‖ := by
  have hX : (∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂Q) =
      ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM Q (liftMap Q f hf X) :=
    (integral_congr_ae (liftMap_coe Q f hf X)).symm
  have hY : (∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂Q) =
      ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM Q (liftMap Q f hf Y) :=
    (integral_congr_ae (liftMap_coe Q f hf Y)).symm
  rw [hX, hY, ← map_sub]
  exact (ProximalLangevin.lpExpectationCLM_norm_le Q _).trans
    ((liftMap_lipschitz Q f hf).norm_sub_le X Y)

hybrid_target_bias.exact_header:
theorem hybrid_target_bias (g : H → H) (f : Z → H) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (m ε : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a star : H) (hstar : g star = 0)
    (hmono : m * ‖a - star‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪a - star, g a - g star⟫)
    (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hgradient : g a = ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂Q)
    (hsurrogate : (∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂Q) = 0)
    (hcoupling : ‖X - Y‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖a - star‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ε / m
hybrid_target_bias.exact_declaration:
theorem hybrid_target_bias (g : H → H) (f : Z → H) (L : ℝ≥0)
    (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (m ε : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a star : H) (hstar : g star = 0)
    (hmono : m * ‖a - star‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪a - star, g a - g star⟫)
    (X Y : Lp Z 2 Q)
    (hgradient : g a = ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂Q)
    (hsurrogate : (∫ ω, f (Y ω) ∂Q) = 0)
    (hcoupling : ‖X - Y‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖a - star‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * ε / m := by
  apply critical_point_residual_bound g m ((L : ℝ) * ε) hm a star hstar hmono
  have he := coupled_observation_expectation_bound Q f L hf X Y
  rw [hsurrogate, sub_zero, ← hgradient] at he
  exact he.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoupling L.coe_nonneg)

open MeasureTheory Set Filter

namespace PBGSO.TimeGridContinuity
variable {R : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup R] [InnerProductSpace ℝ R] [CompleteSpace R]


/-- The actual time-L² grid is represented by the literal finite interval sum. -/

/-- A finite monotone grid covers its full interval, including repeated knots. -/

/-- The interval cells of a monotone grid are pairwise disjoint. -/

/-- At a grid-cell point the raw sum has exactly its left-endpoint value. -/

/-- Outside the full interval every actual grid cell contributes zero. -/

/-- Dyadic mesh widths tend to zero on every fixed finite horizon. -/

/-- Literal dyadic finite sums converge at every continuity point in the horizon. -/



/-- A bounded measurable time integrand on a finite horizon is genuinely in time-L². -/

/-- The actual finite-horizon time-L² integrand. -/

/-- Actual dyadic sums remain bounded by the original integrand bound. -/

/-- Literal dyadic time-step functions converge in genuine time-L² to every
bounded measurable integrand continuous almost everywhere on the horizon.
Deterministic interval masks are permitted because their endpoints are null. -/



/-- A deterministic interval mask of a continuous integrand is continuous
almost everywhere; neither boundary value changes its actual time-L² class. -/

/-- Continuous integrands and all their deterministic interval cuts have
literal dyadic approximations in actual time-L². -/

rawGrid.exact_header: def rawGrid (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : R
rawGrid.exact_declaration:
def rawGrid (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : R :=
  ∑ k : Fin n, (Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1))).indicator (fun _ => A k) r

grid_coe.exact_header:
theorem grid_coe (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    TimeGridEnergy.grid τ A n =ᵐ[volume] rawGrid τ A n
grid_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_coe (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    TimeGridEnergy.grid τ A n =ᵐ[volume] rawGrid τ A n := by
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun k : Fin n => TimeGridEnergy.column (τ k) (τ (k + 1)) (A k)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun k : Fin n =>
      indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp)
        (c := A k) (s := Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1))))] with r hsum hc
  change (TimeGridEnergy.grid τ A n) r = rawGrid τ A n r
  rw [TimeGridEnergy.grid, hsum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, rawGrid]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hc k

exists_interval.exact_header:
theorem exists_interval (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Ioc (τ 0 : ℝ) (τ n)) :
    ∃ k : Fin n, r ∈ Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1))
exists_interval.exact_declaration:
theorem exists_interval (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Ioc (τ 0 : ℝ) (τ n)) :
    ∃ k : Fin n, r ∈ Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hr.2) hr.1)
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hn : r ≤ τ n
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih ⟨hr.1, hn⟩
      exact ⟨k.castSucc, hk⟩
    · exact ⟨Fin.last n, lt_of_not_ge hn, hr.2⟩

interval_unique.exact_header:
theorem interval_unique (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (i j : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hi : r ∈ Ioc (τ i : ℝ) (τ (i + 1)))
    (hj : r ∈ Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1))) : i = j
interval_unique.exact_declaration:
theorem interval_unique (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (i j : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hi : r ∈ Ioc (τ i : ℝ) (τ (i + 1)))
    (hj : r ∈ Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1))) : i = j := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain h | h := lt_or_gt_of_ne hne
  · have hh : (τ (i + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ j := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hi.2.trans hh)) hj.1
  · have hh : (τ (j + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ i := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hj.2.trans hh)) hi.1

rawGrid_eq.exact_header:
theorem rawGrid_eq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ)
    (k : Fin n) (r : ℝ) (hk : r ∈ Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1))) :

rawGrid_eq.exact_declaration:
theorem rawGrid_eq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ)
    (k : Fin n) (r : ℝ) (hk : r ∈ Ioc (τ k : ℝ) (τ (k + 1))) :
    rawGrid τ A n r = A k := by
  classical
  unfold rawGrid
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hk _
  · intro j _ hj
    apply Set.indicator_of_notMem
    intro hm
    exact hj (Fin.ext (interval_unique τ hτ j k r hm hk))
  · simp

theorem rawGrid_zero_outside (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ)

theorem rawGrid_zero_outside (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ)

theorem dyadic_mesh_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
dyadic_mesh_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_mesh_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (T : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (T : ℝ)

theorem rawGrid_dyadic_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) (hu : ContinuousAt u r) :
    Tendsto (fun n => rawGrid ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n)
      (fun k => u ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n k))
      ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).count n) r) atTop (𝓝 (u r))
rawGrid_dyadic_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem rawGrid_dyadic_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)) (hu : ContinuousAt u r) :
    Tendsto (fun n => rawGrid ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n)
      (fun k => u ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n k))
      ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).count n) r) atTop (𝓝 (u r)) := by
  let G := GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T
  have hzero (n : ℕ) : G.time n 0 = 0 := by simp [G, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids]
  have hend (n : ℕ) : G.time n (G.count n) = T := by
    simp only [G, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hp : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have hcell (n : ℕ) := exists_interval (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (G.count n) r
    (by simpa only [hzero, hend, NNReal.coe_zero] using hr)
  choose k hk using hcell
  have hdist (n : ℕ) : dist (G.time n (k n) : ℝ) r ≤ (T : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hk n).1.le)]
    have he : (G.time n ((k n : ℕ) + 1) : ℝ) =
        (G.time n (k n) : ℝ) + (T : ℝ) / 2 ^ n := by
      simp only [G, GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_div,
        NNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_natCast]
      push_cast
      ring
    linarith [(hk n).2]
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun n => (G.time n (k n) : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 r) :=
    Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr fun ε hε => by
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (dyadic_mesh_tendsto T) ε hε
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn => (hdist n).trans_lt ?_⟩
      have hh := hN n hn
      simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity :
        (0 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)] using hh
  have hout := hu.tendsto.comp hleft
  convert hout using 1
  funext n
  exact rawGrid_eq (G.time n) (G.monotone n) _ (G.count n) (k n) r (hk n)

theorem rawGrid_dyadic_bound (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :

    have hp : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ n ≠ 0 := by positivity

  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_interval (G.time n) (G.monotone n) (G.count n) r

dyadic_grid_tendsto.exact_header:
theorem dyadic_grid_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R)
    (hu : AEStronglyMeasurable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ContinuousAt u r) :
    Tendsto (fun n => TimeGridEnergy.grid ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n)
      (fun k => u ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n k))
      ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).count n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (horizonLp T u hu P hP))
dyadic_grid_tendsto.exact_declaration:
theorem dyadic_grid_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R)
    (hu : AEStronglyMeasurable u (volume : Measure ℝ)) (P : ℝ) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hP : ∀ r ∈ Icc 0 (T : ℝ), ‖u r‖ ≤ P)
    (hcont : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)), ContinuousAt u r) :
    Tendsto (fun n => TimeGridEnergy.grid ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n)
      (fun k => u ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).time n k))
      ((GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T).count n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (horizonLp T u hu P hP)) := by
  let G := GridIntegralCompletion.dyadicGrids T
  let U := horizonLp T u hu P hP
  let S (n : ℕ) := TimeGridEnergy.grid (G.time n) (fun k => u (G.time n k)) (G.count n)
  have hU : U =ᵐ[volume] (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator u := (horizon_memLp T u hu P hP).coeFn_toLp
  have hS (n : ℕ) := grid_coe (G.time n) (fun k => u (G.time n k)) (G.count n)
  have hcont' : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ) → ContinuousAt u r :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mp hcont
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖(S n - U) r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ => (2 * P) ^ 2) r := by
    filter_upwards [hS n, hU, Lp.coeFn_sub (S n) U] with r hs hu hsub
    rw [hsub, Pi.sub_apply, hs, hu]
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
      have hb := rawGrid_dyadic_bound T u P hP0 hP n r
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr] at hb
      have he : ‖rawGrid (G.time n) (fun k => u (G.time n k)) (G.count n) r - u r‖ ≤ 2 * P :=
        (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hP r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩])
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) he 2
    · have hb := rawGrid_dyadic_bound T u P hP0 hP n r
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr] at hb
      have hz : rawGrid (G.time n) (fun k => u (G.time n k)) (G.count n) r = 0 :=
        norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hb (norm_nonneg _))
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, hz, sub_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide)]
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ),
      Tendsto (fun n => ‖(S n - U) r‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hS, hU, hcont',
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun n => Lp.coeFn_sub (S n) U)] with r hs hu hc hsub
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n => S n r) atTop (𝓝 (U r)) := by
      by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)
      · rw [hu, Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
        exact (rawGrid_dyadic_tendsto T u r hr (hc hr)).congr (fun n => (hs n).symm)
      · have hz (n : ℕ) : S n r = 0 := by
          have hb := rawGrid_dyadic_bound T u P hP0 hP n r
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, ← hs n] at hb
          exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hb (norm_nonneg _))
        simp only [hu, Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, hz]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have he := (ht.sub_const (U r)).norm.pow 2
    have he' : Tendsto (fun n => ‖S n r - U r‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] using he
    convert he' using 1
    funext n
    rw [hsub n]
    rfl
  have hDCT := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    ((Ioc 0 (T : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ => (2 * P) ^ 2))
    (fun n => (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (S n - U)).norm.pow 2)
    ((integrableOn_const (C := (2 * P) ^ 2) (s := Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))
      (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (by simp)).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ioc)
    (fun n => (hbound n).mono fun r hr => by rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]) hlim
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun n => ‖S n - U‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [ProximalLangevin.lp_norm_sq_eq_integral, Pi.pow_apply, integral_zero] using hDCT
  have hn := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hsq
  have hn' : Tendsto (fun n => ‖S n - U‖) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero] using hn
  exact tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr hn'

theorem continuous_mask_ae (u : ℝ → R) (hu : Continuous u) (s t : ℝ) :

continuous_mask_ae.exact_declaration:
theorem continuous_mask_ae (u : ℝ → R) (hu : Continuous u) (s t : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ContinuousAt ((Ioc s t).indicator u) r := by
  by_cases hst : s < t
  · have hfront : (volume : Measure ℝ) (frontier (Ioc s t)) = 0 := by

    filter_upwards [compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr hfront] with r hr

  · have he : Ioc s t = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty hst

    exact ae_of_all _ fun _ => continuousAt_const

theorem dyadic_masked_grid_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R) (hu : Continuous u)

theorem dyadic_masked_grid_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (u : ℝ → R) (hu : Continuous u)

splitTime.exact_header: def splitTime (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (j : ℕ) : ℝ≥0
splitTime.exact_declaration:
def splitTime (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (j : ℕ) : ℝ≥0 :=
  if j % 2 = 0 then τ (j / 2) else max (τ (j / 2)) (min t (τ (j / 2 + 1)))

splitTime_even.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem splitTime_even (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    splitTime τ t (2 * k) = τ k
splitTime_even.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem splitTime_even (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    splitTime τ t (2 * k) = τ k := by simp [splitTime]

splitTime_odd.exact_header:
@[simp] theorem splitTime_odd (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    splitTime τ t (2 * k + 1) = max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1)))
splitTime_odd.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem splitTime_odd (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    splitTime τ t (2 * k + 1) = max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1))) := by
  simp [splitTime, Nat.add_div]

midpoint_bounds.exact_header:
theorem midpoint_bounds (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    τ k ≤ max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1))) ∧
      max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1))) ≤ τ (k + 1)
midpoint_bounds.exact_declaration:
theorem midpoint_bounds (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ℕ) :
    τ k ≤ max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1))) ∧
      max (τ k) (min t (τ (k + 1))) ≤ τ (k + 1) :=
  ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (hτ (Nat.le_succ k)) (min_le_right _ _)⟩

splitTime_monotone.exact_header:
theorem splitTime_monotone (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Monotone (splitTime τ t)
splitTime_monotone.exact_declaration:
theorem splitTime_monotone (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    Monotone (splitTime τ t) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j % 2 = 0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, j = 2 * k := ⟨j / 2, by omega⟩
    subst j
    simpa only [splitTime_even, splitTime_odd] using (midpoint_bounds τ hτ t k).1
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, j = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨j / 2, by omega⟩
    subst j
    rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by omega, splitTime_odd, splitTime_even]
    exact (midpoint_bounds τ hτ t k).2

splitValues.exact_header: def splitValues (A : ℕ → R) (j : ℕ) : R
splitValues.exact_declaration: def splitValues (A : ℕ → R) (j : ℕ) : R := if j % 2 = 0 then A (j / 2) else 0

splitValues_even.exact_header: @[simp] theorem splitValues_even (A : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) : splitValues A (2 * k) = A k
splitValues_even.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem splitValues_even (A : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) : splitValues A (2 * k) = A k := by

splitValues_odd.exact_header: @[simp] theorem splitValues_odd (A : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) : splitValues A (2 * k + 1) = 0
splitValues_odd.exact_declaration:
@[simp] theorem splitValues_odd (A : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) : splitValues A (2 * k + 1) = 0 := by

cut.exact_header: def cut (U : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)
cut.exact_declaration:
def cut (U : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=

cut_coe.exact_header:
theorem cut_coe (U : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    cut U s t =ᵐ[volume] (Ioc s t).indicator U
cut_coe.exact_declaration:
theorem cut_coe (U : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    cut U s t =ᵐ[volume] (Ioc s t).indicator U :=

cut_zero.exact_header: theorem cut_zero (s t : ℝ) : cut (0 : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) s t = 0
cut_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem cut_zero (s t : ℝ) : cut (0 : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) s t = 0 := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe (0 : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) s t,
    Lp.coeFn_zero R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)] with r hc hz
  rw [hc]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hz]
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, hz]
    rfl

cut_add.exact_header:
theorem cut_add (U V : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    cut (U + V) s t = cut U s t + cut V s t
cut_add.exact_declaration:
theorem cut_add (U V : Lp R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (s t : ℝ) :
    cut (U + V) s t = cut U s t + cut V s t := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe (U + V) s t, cut_coe U s t, cut_coe V s t,
    Lp.coeFn_add (cut U s t) (cut V s t), Lp.coeFn_add U V] with r hsum hU hV ha hUV
  rw [ha, hsum]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [hU, hV]
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc s t
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, Set.indicator_of_mem hr, Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hUV]
    rfl
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, zero_add]

column_zero.exact_header: theorem column_zero (a b : ℝ) : TimeGridEnergy.column a b (0 : R) = 0
column_zero.exact_declaration:
theorem column_zero (a b : ℝ) : TimeGridEnergy.column a b (0 : R) = 0 := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [indicatorConstLp_coeFn (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (p := 2)
    (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp) (c := (0 : R)) (s := Ioc a b),
    Lp.coeFn_zero R 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)] with r hc hz
  change (TimeGridEnergy.column a b (0 : R)) r = _ at hc
  rw [hc, hz]
  simp

cell_intersection.exact_header:
theorem cell_intersection (a b t : ℝ≥0) :
    Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) ∩ Ioc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) = Ioc (a : ℝ) (max a (min t b) : ℝ≥0)
cell_intersection.exact_declaration:
theorem cell_intersection (a b t : ℝ≥0) :
    Ioc 0 (t : ℝ) ∩ Ioc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) = Ioc (a : ℝ) (max a (min t b) : ℝ≥0) := by
  ext r
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Ioc, NNReal.coe_max, NNReal.coe_min]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, hrt⟩, hra, hrb⟩
    exact ⟨hra, (le_min hrt hrb).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hra, hrm⟩
    have hm : r ≤ min (t : ℝ) b := (le_max_iff.mp hrm).resolve_left (not_le.mpr hra)
    exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt a.coe_nonneg hra, hm.trans (min_le_left _ _)⟩,
      hra, hm.trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩

cut_column.exact_header:
theorem cut_column (a b t : ℝ≥0) (z : R) :
    cut (TimeGridEnergy.column a b z) 0 t = TimeGridEnergy.column a (max a (min t b)) z
cut_column.exact_declaration:
theorem cut_column (a b t : ℝ≥0) (z : R) :
    cut (TimeGridEnergy.column a b z) 0 t = TimeGridEnergy.column a (max a (min t b)) z := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [cut_coe (TimeGridEnergy.column a b z) 0 t,
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp)
      (c := z) (s := Ioc (a : ℝ) b),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp)
      (c := z) (s := Ioc (a : ℝ) (max a (min t b) : ℝ≥0))] with r hc hcol hmid
  change (TimeGridEnergy.column (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) z) r = _ at hcol
  change (TimeGridEnergy.column (a : ℝ) (max a (min t b) : ℝ≥0) z) r = _ at hmid
  simp only [NNReal.coe_max, NNReal.coe_min] at hmid
  rw [hc, hmid]
  have he := congrArg (fun s : Set ℝ => s.indicator (fun _ => z) r) (cell_intersection a b t)
  rw [← Set.indicator_indicator] at he
  simp only [NNReal.coe_max, NNReal.coe_min] at he
  by_cases hr : r ∈ Ioc 0 (t : ℝ)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hcol]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem hr] using he
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr] using he

split_grid_eq_cut.exact_header:
theorem split_grid_eq_cut (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    TimeGridEnergy.grid (splitTime τ t) (splitValues A) (2 * n) =

split_grid_eq_cut.exact_declaration:
theorem split_grid_eq_cut (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (t : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    TimeGridEnergy.grid (splitTime τ t) (splitValues A) (2 * n) =
      cut (TimeGridEnergy.grid τ A n) 0 t := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [TimeGridEnergy.grid_zero, cut_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, show 2 * n + 2 = (2 * n + 1) + 1 by omega,
      TimeGridEnergy.grid_succ, TimeGridEnergy.grid_succ,
      splitValues_odd, splitValues_even, splitTime_odd, splitTime_even,
      show 2 * n + 1 + 1 = 2 * (n + 1) by omega, splitTime_even]
    rw [column_zero, add_zero, ih, TimeGridEnergy.grid_succ, cut_add, cut_column]
    simp only [NNReal.coe_max, NNReal.coe_min]

grid_column_inner.exact_header:
theorem grid_column_inner (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    ⟪column (τ i) (τ (i + 1)) (A i), column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) (A j)⟫_ℝ =
      if i = j then ((τ (i + 1) : ℝ) - τ i) * ‖A i‖ ^ 2 else 0
grid_column_inner.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_column_inner (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    ⟪column (τ i) (τ (i + 1)) (A i), column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) (A j)⟫_ℝ =
      if i = j then ((τ (i + 1) : ℝ) - τ i) * ‖A i‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
  rw [column_inner]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, Set.inter_self, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (show (τ i : ℝ) ≤ τ (i + 1) from hτ (Nat.le_succ i)))]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
    have hd : Disjoint (Ioc (τ i : ℝ) (τ (i + 1))) (Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1))) := by
      apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      obtain h | h := lt_or_gt_of_ne hij
      · have hh : (τ (i + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ j := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (hx.2.trans hh)) hy.1
      · have hh : (τ (j + 1) : ℝ) ≤ τ i := hτ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (hy.2.trans hh)) hx.1
    have he : Ioc (τ i : ℝ) (τ (i + 1)) ∩ Ioc (τ j : ℝ) (τ (j + 1)) = ∅ :=
      Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hd
    rw [he]
    simp

grid_norm_sq.exact_header:
theorem grid_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖grid τ A n‖ ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * ‖A k‖ ^ 2
grid_norm_sq.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_norm_sq (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Monotone τ) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖grid τ A n‖ ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin n, ((τ (k + 1) : ℝ) - τ k) * ‖A k‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [grid, sum_inner, inner_sum]
  simp_rw [grid_column_inner τ hτ A]
  simp only [Fin.val_inj]
  simp

column_sub.exact_header:
theorem column_sub (s t : ℝ) (a b : R) :
    column s t (a - b) = column s t a - column s t b
column_sub.exact_declaration:

grid_sub.exact_header:
theorem grid_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    grid τ (A - C) n = grid τ A n - grid τ C n
grid_sub.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_sub (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A C : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :

column_split.exact_header:
theorem column_split (s u t : ℝ) (hsu : s ≤ u) (hut : u ≤ t) (a : R) :
    column s u a + column u t a = column s t a
column_split.exact_declaration:
theorem column_split (s u t : ℝ) (hsu : s ≤ u) (hut : u ≤ t) (a : R) :
    column s u a + column u t a = column s t a := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add (column s u a) (column u t a),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp) (c := a)
      (s := Ioc s u),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp) (c := a)
      (s := Ioc u t),
    indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc) (hμs := by simp) (c := a)
      (s := Ioc s t)] with r hadd h1 h2 h3
  rw [hadd]
  change column s u a r + column u t a r = column s t a r
  change column s u a r = _ at h1
  change column u t a r = _ at h2
  change column s t a r = _ at h3
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  by_cases hrs : r ≤ s
  · have hru : r ≤ u := hrs.trans hsu
    simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, not_lt.mpr hrs, not_lt.mpr hru]
  · have hsr : s < r := lt_of_not_ge hrs
    by_cases hru : r ≤ u
    · have hrt : r ≤ t := hru.trans hut
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, hsr, hru, hrt, not_lt.mpr hru]
    · have hur : u < r := lt_of_not_ge hru
      simp [Set.indicator, Set.mem_Ioc, hsr, hur, hru]

grid_succ.exact_header:
theorem grid_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :

grid_succ.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_succ (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :

  simp only [grid, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]

grid_zero.exact_header: theorem grid_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) : grid τ A 0 = 0
grid_zero.exact_declaration: theorem grid_zero (τ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (A : ℕ → R) : grid τ A 0 = 0 := by simp [grid]

constant_block_sum.exact_header:
theorem constant_block_sum (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ) (a d : ℕ) (z : R) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, column (υ (a + j)) (υ (a + j + 1)) z) =
      column (υ a) (υ (a + d)) z
constant_block_sum.exact_declaration:
theorem constant_block_sum (υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυ : Monotone υ) (a d : ℕ) (z : R) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d, column (υ (a + j)) (υ (a + j + 1)) z) =
      column (υ a) (υ (a + d)) z := by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero (E := R) (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (p := 2),
      indicatorConstLp_coeFn (p := 2) (hs := measurableSet_Ioc)
      (hμs := by simp) (c := z) (s := Ioc (υ a : ℝ) (υ a))] with r hz hr
    rw [hz]
    simpa only [Set.Ioc_self, Set.indicator_empty, Pi.zero_apply, column] using hr.symm
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    exact column_split _ _ _ (hυ (Nat.le_add_right a d)) (hυ (Nat.le_succ _)) z

grid_refine_mul.exact_header:
theorem grid_refine_mul (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    grid υ (fun k => A (k / d)) (d * n) = grid τ A n
grid_refine_mul.exact_declaration:
theorem grid_refine_mul (τ υ : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hυmono : Monotone υ)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hυ : ∀ k, υ (d * k) = τ k) (A : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    grid υ (fun k => A (k / d)) (d * n) = grid τ A n := by
  have h1 (m : ℕ) : grid υ (fun k => A (k / d)) m =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, column (υ j) (υ (j + 1)) (A (j / d)) :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => column (υ j) (υ (j + 1)) (A (j / d))) m
  have h2 (m : ℕ) : grid τ A m =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) (A j) :=
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => column (τ j) (τ (j + 1)) (A j)) m
  rw [h1, h2]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Finset.sum_range_add, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    congr 1
    have he : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
        column (υ (d * n + j)) (υ (d * n + j + 1)) (A ((d * n + j) / d))) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
          column (υ (d * n + j)) (υ (d * n + j + 1)) (A n) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [Nat.mul_add_div hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hj), add_zero]
    rw [he, constant_block_sum υ hυmono]
    rw [show d * n + d = d * (n + 1) by ring, hυ n, hυ (n + 1)]

momentumExpandedConstant0.exact_header: def momentumExpandedConstant0 (L γ fzero Ξ β : ℝ) : ℝ

/-! # Time-uniform comparison without numerical contractivity
The chains below satisfy their actual numerical and reference update equations.
Only the exact update is contractive. The numerical defect may grow linearly
with its input radius; that radius is bounded by the derived comparison error
plus the exact reference radius and is absorbed for a sufficiently small step.
-/
noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
open scoped NNReal
namespace PBGSO.UniformDiscrete


section Chains
variable {H K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]

/-- The actual two updates imply the affine error recursion. No numerical
Lipschitz or numerical contraction condition is required. -/

/-- Closed-form time-uniform comparison for actual chains. The defect's
linear dependence on the numerical radius is absorbed into r=q+εb<1. -/

/-- The same construction yields a uniform bound on numerical moments;
stability is a conclusion of the actual comparison argument. -/
end Chains

/-- An elementary exponential estimate used for one-step absorption. -/

/-- The numerical defect is absorbed by exact one-step contraction for
an explicit positive step range; numerical contractivity is not assumed. -/

section OneStep
variable {H K : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℝ K]

/-- One-step local defects of size h√h yield a time-uniform √h bound
for the actual numerical chain, even though it is not assumed contractive. -/
/-- In synchronous initialization, the original numerical/reference error
is bounded uniformly over every iteration by an explicit constant times √h. -/

/-- A coercivity bound on the actual metric transform converts the proved

affine_recurrence_bound.exact_declaration:
private theorem affine_recurrence_bound (u : ℕ → ℝ) (r β : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hr1 : r < 1) (hstep : ∀ n, u (n+1) ≤ r*u n+β) (n : ℕ) :
    u n ≤ r^n*u 0+β/(1-r)*(1-r^n) := by
  have hden : 1-r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hr1)
  have hB : r*(β/(1-r))+β=β/(1-r) := by field_simp; ring
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      u (n+1) ≤ r*u n+β := hstep n
      _ ≤ r*(r^n*u 0+β/(1-r)*(1-r^n))+β := by gcongr
      _ = r^(n+1)*u 0+β/(1-r)*(1-r^(n+1)) := by rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [hB]

chain_error_step.exact_header:
theorem chain_error_step (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (q ε a b R : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hX : ∀ n, X (n+1)=A n (X n)) (hY : ∀ n, Y (n+1)=Φ n (Y n))
    (hcontract : ∀ n x y, ‖C (Φ n x-Φ n y)‖ ≤ q*‖C (x-y)‖)
    (hdefect : ∀ n x, ‖C (A n x-Φ n x)‖ ≤ ε*(a+b*‖C x‖))
    (hreference : ∀ n, ‖C (Y n)‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖C (X (n+1)-Y (n+1))‖ ≤
      (q+ε*b)*‖C (X n-Y n)‖+ε*(a+b*R)
chain_error_step.exact_declaration:
theorem chain_error_step (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (q ε a b R : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hX : ∀ n, X (n+1)=A n (X n)) (hY : ∀ n, Y (n+1)=Φ n (Y n))
    (hcontract : ∀ n x y, ‖C (Φ n x-Φ n y)‖ ≤ q*‖C (x-y)‖)
    (hdefect : ∀ n x, ‖C (A n x-Φ n x)‖ ≤ ε*(a+b*‖C x‖))
    (hreference : ∀ n, ‖C (Y n)‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖C (X (n+1)-Y (n+1))‖ ≤
      (q+ε*b)*‖C (X n-Y n)‖+ε*(a+b*R) := by
  have hradius : ‖C (X n)‖ ≤ ‖C (X n-Y n)‖+R := by
    have he : C (X n)=C (X n-Y n)+C (Y n) := by simp
    rw [he]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) (hreference n))
  have he : C (X (n+1)-Y (n+1))=
      C (A n (X n)-Φ n (X n))+C (Φ n (X n)-Φ n (Y n)) := by
    rw [hX,hY]
    simp
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖C (A n (X n)-Φ n (X n))‖+‖C (Φ n (X n)-Φ n (Y n))‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ε*(a+b*‖C (X n)‖)+q*‖C (X n-Y n)‖ :=
      add_le_add (hdefect n (X n)) (hcontract n (X n) (Y n))
    _ ≤ ε*(a+b*(‖C (X n-Y n)‖+R))+q*‖C (X n-Y n)‖ := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem chain_error_bound (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)

theorem chain_radius_bound (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)

chain_radius_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem chain_radius_bound (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (q ε a b R : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hsmall : q+ε*b<1)
    (hX : ∀ n, X (n+1)=A n (X n)) (hY : ∀ n, Y (n+1)=Φ n (Y n))
    (hcontract : ∀ n x y, ‖C (Φ n x-Φ n y)‖ ≤ q*‖C (x-y)‖)
    (hdefect : ∀ n x, ‖C (A n x-Φ n x)‖ ≤ ε*(a+b*‖C x‖))
    (hreference : ∀ n, ‖C (Y n)‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖C (X n)‖ ≤ R+‖C (X 0-Y 0)‖+(ε*(a+b*R))/(1-(q+ε*b)) := by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ (q+ε*b)^n := pow_nonneg (by positivity) _
  have hp1 : (q+ε*b)^n ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by positivity) hsmall.le
  have hβ : 0 ≤ (ε*(a+b*R))/(1-(q+ε*b)) := by positivity
  have he := chain_error_bound C A Φ X Y q ε a b R hq hε hb hsmall hX hY hcontract hdefect hreference n
  have htri : ‖C (X n)‖ ≤ ‖C (X n-Y n)‖+R := by
    have heq : C (X n)=C (X n-Y n)+C (Y n) := by simp
    rw [heq]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) (hreference n))
  have hfirst : (q+ε*b)^n*‖C (X 0-Y 0)‖ ≤ ‖C (X 0-Y 0)‖ :=
    mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hp1
  have hsecond : ((ε*(a+b*R))/(1-(q+ε*b)))*(1-(q+ε*b)^n) ≤
      (ε*(a+b*R))/(1-(q+ε*b)) := mul_le_of_le_one_right hβ (by linarith)
  linarith

theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_half (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :

exp_neg_le_one_sub_half.exact_declaration:
theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_half (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1-x/2 := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1+x := by linarith
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp x) (Real.exp_pos (-x)).le
  have heq : Real.exp x*Real.exp (-x)=1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  rw [heq] at he
  have hi : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1/(1+x) := (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr (by nlinarith [he])
  apply hi.trans
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hpos).mpr
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)]

theorem one_step_absorption (ρ h b : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)

theorem one_step_uniform_error (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (ρ h a b R : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hρh : ρ*h≤1) (hsmall : b*Real.sqrt h≤ρ/4)
    (hX : ∀ n, X (n+1)=A n (X n)) (hY : ∀ n, Y (n+1)=Φ n (Y n))
    (hcontract : ∀ n x y, ‖C (Φ n x-Φ n y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*h)*‖C (x-y)‖)
    (hdefect : ∀ n x, ‖C (A n x-Φ n x)‖ ≤ (h*Real.sqrt h)*(a+b*‖C x‖))
    (hreference : ∀ n, ‖C (Y n)‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖C (X n-Y n)‖ ≤ (1-ρ*h/4)^n*‖C (X 0-Y 0)‖+
      (4*(a+b*R)/ρ)*Real.sqrt h*(1-(1-ρ*h/4)^n)
one_step_uniform_error.exact_declaration:
theorem one_step_uniform_error (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (ρ h a b R : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hρh : ρ*h≤1) (hsmall : b*Real.sqrt h≤ρ/4)
    (hX : ∀ n, X (n+1)=A n (X n)) (hY : ∀ n, Y (n+1)=Φ n (Y n))
    (hcontract : ∀ n x y, ‖C (Φ n x-Φ n y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*h)*‖C (x-y)‖)
    (hdefect : ∀ n x, ‖C (A n x-Φ n x)‖ ≤ (h*Real.sqrt h)*(a+b*‖C x‖))
    (hreference : ∀ n, ‖C (Y n)‖ ≤ R) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖C (X n-Y n)‖ ≤ (1-ρ*h/4)^n*‖C (X 0-Y 0)‖+
      (4*(a+b*R)/ρ)*Real.sqrt h*(1-(1-ρ*h/4)^n) := by
  let p := 1-ρ*h/4
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
  have hp1 : p<1 := by dsimp [p]; nlinarith
  have hrec (k : ℕ) : ‖C (X (k+1)-Y (k+1))‖ ≤
      p*‖C (X k-Y k)‖+(h*Real.sqrt h)*(a+b*R) := by
    have he := chain_error_step C A Φ X Y (Real.exp (-ρ*h)) (h*Real.sqrt h) a b R
      (by positivity) hb hX hY hcontract hdefect hreference k
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (one_step_absorption ρ h b hρ hh hρh hsmall)
      (norm_nonneg (C (X k-Y k)))
    exact he.trans (by dsimp [p]; nlinarith [hm])
  have he := affine_recurrence_bound (fun k => ‖C (X k-Y k)‖) p
    ((h*Real.sqrt h)*(a+b*R)) hp hp1 hrec n
  have hc : ((h*Real.sqrt h)*(a+b*R))/(1-p)=(4*(a+b*R)/ρ)*Real.sqrt h := by
    dsimp [p]
    field_simp
    ring
  simpa only [hc] using he

theorem one_step_same_initial_uniform (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)
    (ρ h a b R : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)

theorem one_step_same_initial_uniform_norm (C : H →L[ℝ] K) (A Φ : ℕ → H → H) (X Y : ℕ → H)

/-! # Explicit local and uniform moments for additive integral trajectories

Local radii are derived from the actual integral equation and a bound on the
input. They depend affinely on the initial norm, with no compactness-chosen or
horizon-dependent constant. Uniform radii will use exact-flow contraction.
-/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology RealInnerProductSpace InnerProductSpace
namespace PBGSO.UniformIntegral

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- An explicit radius on every time interval of length at most one. -/


/-- The primitive Lipschitz integral equation gives an explicit radius.
The input need not be differentiable, adapted or independent of the initial
state. Brownian increments supply its bound in the applications. -/

omit [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] in
/-- Drift growth follows from the derived radius and primitive Lipschitzness. -/

/-- Explicit one-step state, drift and square-root increment bounds.
Every constant is affine in the initial norm and independent of start time. -/

section Contractive
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

/-- The actual integral equations, rather than a numerical stability premise,
give contraction in a quadratic metric. -/

/-- Uniform bound for any exact continuous trajectory. Zero-start Picard

radius.exact_header: def radius (L : ℝ≥0) (fzero noise initial : ℝ) : ℝ
radius.exact_declaration:
def radius (L : ℝ≥0) (fzero noise initial : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (initial + fzero + noise)

local_radius.exact_header:
theorem local_radius (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (T Ξ : ℝ) (hT : T ≤ 1) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t)
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖Y t‖ ≤ radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖
local_radius.exact_declaration:
theorem local_radius (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (T Ξ : ℝ) (hT : T ≤ 1) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t)
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖Y t‖ ≤ radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖ := by
  let K : ℝ := (L : ℝ) + 1
  let c : ℝ := ‖f 0‖ + Ξ
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hforce : Continuous (fun r => f (Y r)) := hf.continuous.comp hY
  have hidentity (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 T) :
      Y r - B r = Y 0 + ∫ s in 0..r, f (Y s) := by
    have he := heq r hr
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at he
    rw [he]
    abel
  have hder : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => Y s-B s) (f (Y r)) (Ici r) r := by
    intro r hr
    have hd := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (a := 0) (b := r)
      (hforce.intervalIntegrable 0 r) (hforce.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (𝓝 r))
      hforce.continuousAt
    have hmem : Icc 0 T ∈ 𝓝[Ici r] r := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
        mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iic_mem_nhds hr.2)] with s hs hsT
      exact ⟨hr.1.trans hs, hsT⟩
    have he : (fun s => Y s-B s) =ᶠ[𝓝[Ici r] r]
        (fun s => Y 0 + ∫ u in 0..s, f (Y u)) := by
      filter_upwards [hmem] with s hs
      exact hidentity s hs
    exact (hd.const_add (Y 0)).hasDerivWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq he
      (hidentity r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.le⟩)
  have hbzero : B 0 = 0 := by
    have he := heq 0 ⟨le_rfl,ht.1.trans ht.2⟩
    simpa using he.symm
  have hbound : ∀ r ∈ Ico 0 T,
      ‖f (Y r)‖ ≤ K * ‖Y r-B r‖ + K*c := by
    intro r hr
    have hi := hinput r ⟨hr.1,hr.2.le⟩
    have hfn : ‖f (Y r)‖ ≤ (L : ℝ)*‖Y r‖ + ‖f 0‖ := by
      have hl := hf.norm_sub_le (Y r) 0
      simp only [sub_zero] at hl
      exact (norm_le_norm_sub_add (f (Y r)) (f 0)).trans (add_le_add hl le_rfl)
    have hyn : ‖Y r‖ ≤ ‖Y r-B r‖ + Ξ :=
      (norm_le_norm_sub_add (Y r) (B r)).trans (add_le_add le_rfl hi)
    have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyn L.coe_nonneg
    dsimp [K,c]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Y r-B r), norm_nonneg (f 0)]
  have hv := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le
    (hY.sub hB).continuousOn hder
    (show ‖Y 0-B 0‖ ≤ ‖Y 0‖ by simp [hbzero]) hbound t ht
  rw [sub_zero, gronwallBound, ite_eq_right (ne_of_gt hK)] at hv
  have hcdiv : K*c/K = c := by field_simp
  rw [hcdiv] at hv
  have he : Real.exp (K*t) ≤ Real.exp K :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [ht.2.trans hT])
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he
    (show 0 ≤ ‖Y 0‖+c by dsimp [c]; positivity)
  have hyt : ‖Y t‖ ≤ ‖Y t-B t‖ + Ξ :=
    (norm_le_norm_sub_add (Y t) (B t)).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (hinput t ht))
  change ‖Y t‖ ≤ Real.exp K * (‖Y 0‖+‖f 0‖+Ξ)
  dsimp [c] at hv hprod
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f 0)]

drift_bound.exact_header:
theorem drift_bound (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (x : E) (P : ℝ) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ P) :
    ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f 0‖ + (L : ℝ)*P
drift_bound.exact_declaration:
theorem drift_bound (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (x : E) (P : ℝ) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ P) :
    ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f 0‖ + (L : ℝ)*P := by
  have hb := (norm_le_norm_sub_add (f x) (f 0)).trans
    (add_le_add (hf.norm_sub_le x 0) le_rfl)
