  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx L.coe_nonneg]

local_regularity.exact_header:
theorem local_regularity (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (T Ξ : ℝ) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ 1) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t)
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ * Real.sqrt t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      ‖Y t‖ ≤ radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖ ∧
      ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ ‖f 0‖+(L : ℝ)*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖ ∧
      ‖Y t-Y 0‖ ≤ (‖f 0‖+(L : ℝ)*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖+Ξ)*Real.sqrt t
local_regularity.exact_declaration:
theorem local_regularity (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (T Ξ : ℝ) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hT : T ≤ 1) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t - Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r)) + B t)
    (hinput : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ * Real.sqrt t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      ‖Y t‖ ≤ radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖ ∧
      ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ ‖f 0‖+(L : ℝ)*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖ ∧
      ‖Y t-Y 0‖ ≤ (‖f 0‖+(L : ℝ)*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖+Ξ)*Real.sqrt t := by
  let P := radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ ‖Y 0‖
  let D := ‖f 0‖+(L : ℝ)*P
  have hP : 0 ≤ P := radius_nonneg L (norm_nonneg _) hΞ (norm_nonneg _)
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hunit : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖B t‖ ≤ Ξ := by
    intro t ht
    exact (hinput t ht).trans (by
      have hs : Real.sqrt t ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr (ht.2.trans hT)
      nlinarith)
  have hstate (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : ‖Y t‖ ≤ P :=
    local_radius f L hf Y B hY hB T Ξ hT hΞ heq hunit t ht
  have hdrift (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : ‖f (Y t)‖ ≤ D :=
    drift_bound f L hf (Y t) P (hstate t ht)
  have hbzero : B 0 = 0 := by
    simpa using (heq 0 ⟨le_rfl,hT0⟩).symm
  intro t ht
  refine ⟨hstate t ht,hdrift t ht,?_⟩
  have hm := integral_segment_sqrt_modulus f Y B T 0 t D Ξ
    (hf.continuous.comp hY) (le_refl 0) ht.1 (ht.2.trans hT)
    (by simpa using ht.2) hD heq hdrift
    (by simpa only [zero_add,hbzero,sub_zero] using hinput t ht)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hm

contraction.exact_header:
theorem contraction (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t-Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))+B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Z t-Z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Z r))+B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t-Z t)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*t)*‖C (Y 0-Z 0)‖
contraction.exact_declaration:
theorem contraction (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y Z B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hZ : Continuous Z) (T : ℝ)
    (heY : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Y t-Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))+B t)
    (heZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, Z t-Z 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Z r))+B t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖C (Y t-Z t)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*t)*‖C (Y 0-Z 0)‖ := by
  apply transformed_additive_integral_contraction (fun x => -f x) L hf.neg C ρ ?_
    Y Z B hY hZ T ?_ ?_ t ht
  · intro x y
    have hm := hmono x y
    have he : -f x- -f y = -(f x-f y) := by abel
    rw [he,map_neg,inner_neg_right]
    linarith
  · intro s hs
    simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg,neg_neg] using heY s hs
  · intro s hs
    simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg,neg_neg] using heZ s hs

uniform_moment.exact_header:
theorem uniform_moment (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))+B t)
    (Ξ : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (hincrement : ∀ a s, 0 ≤ a → s ∈ Icc 0 1 →
      ‖B (a+s)-B a‖ ≤ Ξ*Real.sqrt s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖C (Y t)‖ ≤ ‖C (Y 0)‖ +
      (‖C‖*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0)/(1-Real.exp (-ρ)) +
      ‖C‖*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0
uniform_moment.exact_declaration:
theorem uniform_moment (f : E → E) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] H) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hmono : ∀ x y, ⟪C (x-y),C (f x-f y)⟫_ℝ ≤ -ρ*‖C (x-y)‖^2)
    (Y B : ℝ → E) (hY : Continuous Y) (hB : Continuous B)
    (heq : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Y t-Y 0 = (∫ r in 0..t, f (Y r))+B t)
    (Ξ : ℝ) (hΞ : 0 ≤ Ξ)
    (hincrement : ∀ a s, 0 ≤ a → s ∈ Icc 0 1 →
      ‖B (a+s)-B a‖ ≤ Ξ*Real.sqrt s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ‖C (Y t)‖ ≤ ‖C (Y 0)‖ +
      (‖C‖*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0)/(1-Real.exp (-ρ)) +
      ‖C‖*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0 := by
  let S : ℝ := ‖C‖*radius L ‖f 0‖ Ξ 0
  let q : ℝ := Real.exp (-ρ)
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)
    (radius_nonneg L (norm_nonneg _) hΞ (le_refl 0))
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hq1 : q < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  have hgap : 0 < 1-q := by linarith
  have hsegment (a s : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 1) :
      ‖C (Y (a+s))‖ ≤ Real.exp (-ρ*s)*‖C (Y a)‖+S := by
    let Bshift := fun r => B (a+r)-B a
    have hBc : Continuous Bshift :=
      (hB.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const
    have hB0 : Bshift 0 = 0 := by simp [Bshift]
    obtain ⟨Z,hZ,hZ0,hZe⟩ := ULA.exists_langevin_integral
      (fun x => -f x) L hf.neg (0 : E) Bshift hBc hB0 1 (by norm_num)
    have heZ (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 1) :
        Z r-Z 0 = (∫ u in 0..r, f (Z u))+Bshift r := by
      simpa only [hZ0,intervalIntegral.integral_neg,neg_neg] using hZe r hr
    have heY (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc 0 1) :
        Y (a+r)-Y (a+0) = (∫ u in 0..r, f (Y (a+u)))+Bshift r := by
      simpa only [add_zero,Bshift] using
        MethodSegments.integral_shift Y (fun r => f (Y r)) B
          (hf.continuous.comp hY) heq a r ha hr.1
    have hloc := (local_regularity f L hf Z Bshift hZ hBc 1 Ξ
      (by norm_num) (le_refl 1) hΞ heZ
      (fun r hr => hincrement a r ha hr) s hs).1
    rw [hZ0,norm_zero] at hloc
    have hc := contraction f L hf C ρ hmono (fun r => Y (a+r)) Z Bshift
      (hY.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)) hZ 1 heY heZ s hs
    simp only [add_zero,hZ0,sub_zero] at hc
    have hh := (norm_le_norm_sub_add (C (Y (a+s))) (C (Z s)))
    rw [← map_sub] at hh
    have hcz := (C.le_opNorm (Z s)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloc (norm_nonneg C))
    exact hh.trans (add_le_add hc hcz)
  have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖C (Y (n : ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖C (Y 0)‖+S/(1-q) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simpa using (le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hS hgap.le) :
        ‖C (Y 0)‖ ≤ ‖C (Y 0)‖+S/(1-q))
    | succ n ih =>
      have hs := hsegment (n : ℝ) 1 (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (by constructor <;> norm_num)
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_one] at hs ⊢
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hq0
      have he : (1-q)*(S/(1-q))=S := by field_simp
      have hqnorm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq1.le (norm_nonneg (C (Y 0)))
      change ‖C (Y ((n : ℝ)+1))‖ ≤ q*‖C (Y (n : ℝ))‖+S at hs
      nlinarith
  let n : ℕ := ⌊t⌋₊
  let s : ℝ := t-(n : ℝ)
  have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.floor_le ht
  have hlt : t < (n : ℝ)+1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one t
  have hs : s ∈ Icc 0 1 := ⟨by dsimp [s]; linarith,by dsimp [s]; linarith⟩
  have hseg := hsegment (n : ℝ) s (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hs
  have he : (n : ℝ)+s=t := by dsimp [s]; ring
  rw [he] at hseg
  have hexp : Real.exp (-ρ*s) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp (norm_nonneg (C (Y (n : ℝ))))
  change ‖C (Y t)‖ ≤ ‖C (Y 0)‖+S/(1-q)+S
  linarith [hn n]

    Lp.coeFn_const 2 Q (D.F 0 0)] with ω hf ha hx hc

theorem constant_cloud_norm (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :

constant_cloud_norm.exact_declaration:
theorem constant_cloud_norm (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :
    ‖(euclideanParticleEncoding N J).symm (fun _ ↦ v)‖ =

  have hs := MethodMetricComparisons.cloud_norm_sq

/-! # An explicit positive step range for time-uniform error absorption

The `b+1` denominator keeps the bound strictly positive when the computed
local-growth coefficient is zero. All quantities depend only on primitive
model constants, the dissipativity rate and the quadratic metric.
-/
noncomputable section
namespace PBGSO.UniformStep

/-- A conservative, strictly positive computable upper step size. -/


/-- The positive maximum step discharges every scalar small-step condition
in the time-uniform comparison theorem. No final error budget is assumed. -/

end PBGSO.UniformStep

maximumStep.exact_declaration:
def maximumStep (ρ b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min 1 (min (1 / ρ) ((ρ / (4 * (b + 1))) ^ 2))

maximumStep_pos.exact_header:
theorem maximumStep_pos (ρ b : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 < maximumStep ρ b
maximumStep_pos.exact_declaration:
theorem maximumStep_pos (ρ b : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 < maximumStep ρ b := by
  unfold maximumStep
  apply lt_min (by norm_num)
  exact lt_min (by positivity) (sq_pos_of_pos (by positivity))

admissible.exact_header:
theorem admissible (ρ b h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (_hh : 0 < h) (hhmax : h ≤ maximumStep ρ b) :
    h ≤ 1 ∧ ρ * h ≤ 1 ∧ b * Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ / 4
admissible.exact_declaration:
theorem admissible (ρ b h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (_hh : 0 < h) (hhmax : h ≤ maximumStep ρ b) :
    h ≤ 1 ∧ ρ * h ≤ 1 ∧ b * Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ / 4 := by
  have hunit : h ≤ 1 := hhmax.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hrest : h ≤ min (1 / ρ) ((ρ / (4 * (b + 1))) ^ 2) :=
    hhmax.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hρstep : ρ * h ≤ 1 := by
    have hr := (le_div_iff₀ hρ).mp (hrest.trans (min_le_left _ _))
    simpa [mul_comm] using hr
  have hden : 0 < 4 * (b + 1) := by positivity
  have hquot : 0 ≤ ρ / (4 * (b + 1)) := div_nonneg hρ.le hden.le
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt h ≤ ρ / (4 * (b + 1)) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨hquot, hrest.trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  refine ⟨hunit, hρstep, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ b * (ρ / (4 * (b + 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt hb
    _ ≤ (b + 1) * (ρ / (4 * (b + 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hquot
    _ = ρ / 4 := by field_simp

/-! Universal integrability against finite-moment laws forces a genuine
pointwise growth bound. This separates a finite signed-work interpretation
of an assumption from a conditional Bochner-integral inequality. -/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology
namespace PBGSO.UniversalMomentGrowth
variable {E F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F]

growth_of_finite_measure_integrability.exact_header:
theorem growth_of_finite_measure_integrability (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 1 ≤ w x)
    (f : E → F)
    (h : ∀ μ : Measure E, IsFiniteMeasure μ → Integrable w μ → Integrable f μ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * w x
growth_of_finite_measure_integrability.exact_declaration:
theorem growth_of_finite_measure_integrability (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 1 ≤ w x)
    (f : E → F)
    (h : ∀ μ : Measure E, IsFiniteMeasure μ → Integrable w μ → Integrable f μ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * w x := by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hx : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x : E, (2 : ℝ)^n * w x < ‖f x‖ := by
    intro n
    exact hn (2^n) (by positivity)
  choose x hx using hx
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n / w (x n)
  have hwpos (n : ℕ) : 0 < w (x n) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hw _)
  have hc (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ c n := div_nonneg (by positivity) (hwpos n).le
  have hc_le (n : ℕ) : c n ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n := by
    exact div_le_self (by positivity) (hw _)
  have hcs : Summable c := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hc hc_le
    (by simpa only [one_div] using summable_geometric_two)
  let μ : Measure E := Measure.sum (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (c n) • Measure.dirac (x n))
  have hconst : Integrable (fun _ : E => (1 : ℝ)) μ := by
    apply integrable_sum_dirac (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hc _), norm_one, mul_one] using hcs
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := (integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure one_ne_zero).mp hconst
  have hwm : Integrable w μ := by
    apply integrable_sum_dirac (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
    convert (show Summable (fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) by
      simpa only [one_div] using summable_geometric_two) using 1
    ext n
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hc _), Real.norm_of_nonneg (hwpos n).le]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hwpos n).ne'
  have hf := (h μ inferInstance hwm).summable_of_dirac
  have hlarge (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (c n)).toReal * ‖f (x n)‖ := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hc _)]
    have hp : 0 < (2 : ℝ)^n := by positivity
    have he : c n * ((2 : ℝ)^n * w (x n)) = 1 := by
      dsimp [c]
      rw [inv_pow]
      field_simp [hp.ne', (hwpos n).ne']
    calc
      1 = c n * ((2 : ℝ)^n * w (x n)) := he.symm
      _ ≤ c n * ‖f (x n)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx n).le (hc n)
  have hs : Summable (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => zero_le_one) hlarge hf
  exact one_ne_zero (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hs.tendsto_atTop_zero)

growth_of_probability_integrability.exact_header:
theorem growth_of_probability_integrability (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 1 ≤ w x)
    (f : E → F)
    (h : ∀ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ → Integrable w μ → Integrable f μ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * w x
growth_of_probability_integrability.exact_declaration:
theorem growth_of_probability_integrability (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 1 ≤ w x)
    (f : E → F)
    (h : ∀ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ → Integrable w μ → Integrable f μ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C * w x := by
  apply growth_of_finite_measure_integrability w hw f
  intro μ hμ hwm
  letI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ
  by_cases hzero : μ = 0
  · simp [hzero]
  have hm0 : μ univ ≠ 0 := fun hz => hzero (Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp hz)
  have hmfin : μ univ ≠ ∞ := measure_ne_top _ _
  let ν := (μ univ)⁻¹ • μ
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := ⟨by
    dsimp [ν]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hm0 hmfin⟩
  have hwν : Integrable w ν := hwm.smul_measure (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hm0)
  have hfν := h ν inferInstance hwν
  exact (integrable_inv_smul_measure hm0 hmfin).mp hfν

quadratic_hasFDerivAt.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_hasFDerivAt (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => B y y) (B x + B.flip x) x
quadratic_hasFDerivAt.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_hasFDerivAt (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => B y y) (B x + B.flip x) x := by
  simpa using B.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_id x)

quadratic_second_fderiv.exact_header:
theorem quadratic_second_fderiv (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x u v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => B y y)) x u v = B u v + B v u
quadratic_second_fderiv.exact_declaration:
theorem quadratic_second_fderiv (B : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x u v : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => B y y)) x u v = B u v + B v u := by
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun y => B y y) = fun y => (B + B.flip) y := by
    funext y
    exact (quadratic_hasFDerivAt B y).fderiv
  rw [heq, (B + B.flip).hasFDerivAt.fderiv]
  rfl

couplingQuadratic.exact_header: def couplingQuadratic (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ
couplingQuadratic.exact_declaration:
def couplingQuadratic (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ :=
  D.samplerSq (zz.1 - zz.2)

synchronousGenerator.exact_header:
def synchronousGenerator (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (s s' : S)
    (φ : Z × Z → ℝ) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ
synchronousGenerator.exact_declaration:
def synchronousGenerator (M : Model S Θ Z X I) (s s' : S)
    (φ : Z × Z → ℝ) (zz : Z × Z) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ φ zz (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1, M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) zz
        (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)
        (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i, M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)

synchronousGenerator_quadratic.exact_header:
theorem synchronousGenerator_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) :
    synchronousGenerator M s s' (couplingQuadratic D) zz =
      2 * samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz
synchronousGenerator_quadratic.exact_declaration:
theorem synchronousGenerator_quadratic (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (D : TwistedGeometry S Z) (s s' : S) (zz : Z × Z) :
    synchronousGenerator M s s' (couplingQuadratic D) zz =
      2 * samplerCouplingWork M D s s' zz := by
  let R : (Z × Z) →L[ℝ] Z :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ Z Z - ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ Z Z
  let B : (Z × Z) →L[ℝ] (Z × Z) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (innerSL ℝ).bilinearComp R (D.samplerWeight.comp R)
  have hq : couplingQuadratic D = fun y => B y y := rfl
  rw [synchronousGenerator, hq, (quadratic_hasFDerivAt B zz).fderiv]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  simp_rw [quadratic_second_fderiv]
  change (⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
      (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫ +
      ⟪M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2,
        D.samplerWeight (zz.1 - zz.2)⟫) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i,
      (D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i) +
       D.samplerSq (M.diffusion (M.parameter s) zz.1 i -
        M.diffusion (M.parameter s') zz.2 i)) = _
  have hsym : ⟪M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2,
      D.samplerWeight (zz.1 - zz.2)⟫ =
      ⟪zz.1 - zz.2, D.samplerWeight
        (M.drift (M.parameter s) zz.1 - M.drift (M.parameter s') zz.2)⟫ :=
    (real_inner_comm _ _).trans (D.sampler_symmetric _ _).symm
  rw [hsym]
  simp only [← two_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, samplerCouplingWork]
  ring

IsCoupledWeakSolution.exact_header:
structure IsCoupledWeakSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z) (Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z)) : Prop
IsCoupledWeakSolution.exact_declaration:
structure IsCoupledWeakSolution (M : Model S Θ Z X I)
    (tests : Set (Z → ℝ)) (pairTests : Set (Z × Z → ℝ))
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (ν ν' : ℝ → Measure Z) (Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z)) : Prop where
  left : M.IsWeakSolution tests s ν
  right : M.IsWeakSolution tests s' ν'
  coupling : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → IsCoupling (Λ t) (ν t) (ν' t)
  test_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ pairTests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → Integrable φ (Λ t)
  generator_integrable : ∀ φ ∈ pairTests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    Integrable (synchronousGenerator M (s t) (s' t) φ) (Λ t)
  forward_equation : ∀ φ ∈ pairTests, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => ∫ zz, φ zz ∂Λ r)
      (∫ zz, synchronousGenerator M (s t) (s' t) φ zz ∂Λ t) (Ici 0) t

def weakCouplingEnergy (D : TwistedGeometry S Z)
    (s s' : ℝ → S) (Λ : ℝ → Measure (Z × Z)) (t : ℝ) : ℝ

def euclideanCouplingEnergy (s s' : ℝ → S)

work_integrable.exact_header:
theorem work_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (s t) (s' t)) (Λ t)
work_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem work_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (samplerCouplingWork M D (s t) (s' t)) (Λ t) := by
  have hi := (hsol.generator_integrable _ hquad t ht).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  convert hi using 1
  ext zz
  rw [synchronousGenerator_quadratic]
  ring

energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_header:
theorem energy_hasDerivWithinAt (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ)
      (2 * (⟪s t - s' t, D.optimizerWeight
        (M.optimizerField t (s t) (ν t) - M.optimizerField t (s' t) (ν' t))⟫ +
        ∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (s t) (s' t) zz ∂Λ t)) (Ici 0) t
energy_hasDerivWithinAt.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_hasDerivWithinAt (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ)
      (2 * (⟪s t - s' t, D.optimizerWeight
        (M.optimizerField t (s t) (ν t) - M.optimizerField t (s' t) (ν' t))⟫ +
        ∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (s t) (s' t) zz ∂Λ t)) (Ici 0) t := by
  have hs := (hsol.left.optimizer_ode t ht).sub (hsol.right.optimizer_ode t ht)
  have hw := D.optimizerWeight.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt t hs
  have ho := hs.inner ℝ hw
  have hg := hsol.forward_equation _ hquad t ht
  simp_rw [synchronousGenerator_quadratic] at hg
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hg
  have hsym : ⟪M.optimizerField t (s t) (ν t) - M.optimizerField t (s' t) (ν' t),
      D.optimizerWeight (s t - s' t)⟫ =
      ⟪s t - s' t, D.optimizerWeight
        (M.optimizerField t (s t) (ν t) - M.optimizerField t (s' t) (ν' t))⟫ :=
    (real_inner_comm _ _).trans (D.optimizer_symmetric _ _).symm
  convert ho.add hg using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hsym]
    ring

energy_decay.exact_header:
theorem energy_decay (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t ≤
      weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ 0 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t)
energy_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_decay (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t ≤
      weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ 0 * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
  let E' : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 *
    (⟪s r - s' r, D.optimizerWeight
      (M.optimizerField r (s r) (ν r) - M.optimizerField r (s' r) (ν' r))⟫ +
      ∫ zz, samplerCouplingWork M D (s r) (s' r) zz ∂Λ r)
  have hd (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ) (E' r) (Ici 0) r :=
    hsol.energy_hasDerivWithinAt D hquad r hr
  apply PBGSO.energy_decay (E' := E') (T := T)
  · intro r hr
    exact ((hd r hr.1).continuousWithinAt).mono Icc_subset_Ici_self
  · intro r hr
    exact (hd r hr.1).mono (Ici_subset_Ici.mpr hr.1)
  · intro r hr
    have h := hmono r hr.1 (s r) (s' r) (ν r) (ν' r) (Λ r)
      (hsol.coupling r hr.1) (hsol.left.probability r hr.1)
      (hsol.right.probability r hr.1) (hsol.left.second_moment r hr.1)
      (hsol.right.second_moment r hr.1)
      (hsol.left.gradient_integrable r hr.1) (hsol.right.gradient_integrable r hr.1)
      (hsol.work_integrable D hquad r hr.1) (hsol.test_integrable _ hquad r hr.1)
    dsimp [E', weakCouplingEnergy, couplingQuadratic]
    linarith
  · exact ht

energy_nonneg.exact_header: theorem energy_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t
energy_nonneg.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t := by
  exact add_nonneg (D.optimizerSq_nonneg _)
    (integral_nonneg fun _ => D.samplerSq_nonneg _)

cost_integrable.exact_header:
theorem cost_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z => ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2) (Λ t)
cost_integrable.exact_declaration:
theorem cost_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Integrable (fun zz : Z × Z => ‖zz.1 - zz.2‖ ^ 2) (Λ t) := by
  have hν : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.left.second_moment t ht)
  have hν' : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 (ν' t) :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).2
      (hsol.right.second_moment t ht)
  have hf : MemLp (fun zz : Z × Z => zz.1) 2 (Λ t) := by
    have he : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ((Λ t).map Prod.fst) := by
      rw [(hsol.coupling t ht).1]
      exact hν
    exact he.comp_of_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable
  have hg : MemLp (fun zz : Z × Z => zz.2) 2 (Λ t) := by
    have he : MemLp (fun z : Z => z) 2 ((Λ t).map Prod.snd) := by
      rw [(hsol.coupling t ht).2]
      exact hν'
    exact he.comp_of_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (hf.sub hg).aestronglyMeasurable).1
    (hf.sub hg)

energy_lower.exact_header:
theorem energy_lower (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    D.lower * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t ≤ weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t
energy_lower.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_lower (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    D.lower * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t ≤ weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t := by
  have hc := hsol.cost_integrable D hquad t ht
  have hq := hsol.test_integrable _ hquad t ht
  have hi := integral_mono (hc.const_mul D.lower) hq
    (fun zz : Z × Z => D.sampler_lower (zz.1 - zz.2))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hi
  simpa [weakCouplingEnergy, euclideanCouplingEnergy, TwistedGeometry.optimizerSq,
    mul_add] using add_le_add (D.optimizer_lower (s t - s' t)) hi

energy_upper.exact_header:
theorem energy_upper (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t ≤ D.upper * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t
energy_upper.exact_declaration:
theorem energy_upper (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    weakCouplingEnergy D s s' Λ t ≤ D.upper * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t := by
  have hc := hsol.cost_integrable D hquad t ht
  have hq := hsol.test_integrable _ hquad t ht
  have hi := integral_mono hq (hc.const_mul D.upper)
    (fun zz : Z × Z => D.sampler_upper (zz.1 - zz.2))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hi
  simpa [weakCouplingEnergy, euclideanCouplingEnergy, TwistedGeometry.optimizerSq,
    mul_add] using add_le_add (D.optimizer_upper (s t - s' t)) hi

rms_decay.exact_header:
theorem rms_decay (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        Real.sqrt (euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ 0)
rms_decay.exact_declaration:
theorem rms_decay (ρ T : ℝ) (hmono : TwistedJointMonotonicity M D ρ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    Real.sqrt (euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t) ≤
      Real.sqrt D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-ρ * t) *
        Real.sqrt (euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ 0) := by
  have hT := ht.1.trans ht.2
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 T := ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hd := hsol.energy_decay D hquad ρ T hmono t ht
  have hlo := hsol.energy_lower D hquad t ht.1
  have hup := hsol.energy_upper D hquad 0 le_rfl
  have hcn : 0 ≤ D.conditionNumber :=
    le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) D.conditionNumber_ge_one
  have hn (r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ r :=
    add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hn t), mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hcn,
    Real.sq_sqrt (hn 0)]
  have he : Real.exp (-ρ * t) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hup (Real.exp_pos (-2 * ρ * t)).le
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left D.lower_pos).mp
  have hκ : D.lower * D.conditionNumber = D.upper := by
    dsimp [TwistedGeometry.conditionNumber]
    field_simp [D.lower_pos.ne']
  calc
    D.lower * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ t ≤
        (D.upper * euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ 0) *
          Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) := hlo.trans (hd.trans hi)
    _ = D.lower * (D.conditionNumber * Real.exp (-2 * ρ * t) *
        euclideanCouplingEnergy s s' Λ 0) := by rw [← hκ]; ring
